    20: static void send_to_clan(int clan_id, const char *msg, struct char_data *from)
    21: {
    22:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    23: 
    24:   if (clan_id <= 0 || !msg || !*msg)
    25:     return;
    26: 
    27:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
    28:     if (!d->character)
    29:       continue;
    30:     if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING)
    31:       continue;
    32:     if (GET_CLAN_ID(d->character) != clan_id)
    33:       continue;
    34: 
    35:     {
    36:       const char *G = CBGRN(d->character, C_NRM);
    37:       const char *R = CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM);
    38: 
    39:       if (from)
    40:         send_to_char(d->character, "\r\n%s[Clan]%s %s%s%s: %s%s%s\r\n", G, R, G, GET_NAME(from), R, G, msg, R);
    41:       else
    42:         send_to_char(d->character, "\r\n%s[Clan]%s %s%s%s\r\n", G, R, G, msg, R);
    43:     }
    44:   }

    47: static int is_valid_plain_clan_name(const char *s)
    48: {
    49:   /* For matching/commands: only letters and numbers, no color codes or spaces. */
    50:   if (!s || !*s)
    51:     return 0;
    52: 
    53:   for (size_t i = 0; s[i]; i++) {
    54:     if (s[i] == '\\')
    55:       return 0;
    56:     if (isspace((unsigned char)s[i]))
    57:       return 0;
    58:     if (!isalnum((unsigned char)s[i]))
    59:       return 0;
    60:   }
    61:   return 1;
    62: }
    63: 
    64: static int is_valid_display_clan_name(const char *s)
    65: {
    66:   /* Allow: letters/numbers, and tbaMUD color codes like @R @n (stored as a tab
    67:    * followed by a color code), no spaces. */
    68:   if (!s || !*s)
    69:     return 0;
    70: 
    71:   for (size_t i = 0; s[i]; i++) {
    72:     if (s[i] == '\t') {
    73:       if (!s[i + 1])
    74:         return 0; /* A lone tab can't start a color code. */
    75:       i++; /* Skip the color code character. */
    76:       continue;
    77:     }
    78: 
    79:     if (s[i] == '@')
    80:       continue; /* Escaped @@ that survived parsing. */
    81: 
    82:     if (isspace((unsigned char)s[i]))
    83:       return 0;
    84:     if (!isalnum((unsigned char)s[i]))
    85:       return 0;
    86:   }
    87:   return 1;
    88: }
    89: 
    90: static void normalize_display_name(char *dest, size_t destlen, const char *src)
    91: {
    92:   /* Translate both legacy \tX sequences and builder-friendly @X into the
    93:    * protocol tab codes used by the output layer. */
    94:   size_t di = 0;
    95: 
    96:   for (size_t si = 0; src[si] && di + 1 < destlen; si++) {
    97:     if (src[si] == '\\' && src[si + 1] == 't') {
    98:       dest[di++] = '@';
    99:       si++; /* Skip the 't'. */
   100:     } else {
   101:       dest[di++] = src[si];
   102:     }
   103:   }
   104: 
   105:   dest[di] = '\0';
   106:   parse_at(dest);
   107: }

   127: static int roster_cmp(const void *a, const void *b)
   128: {
   129:   const struct char_data *ca = *(const struct char_data * const *)a;
   130:   const struct char_data *cb = *(const struct char_data * const *)b;
   131: 
   132:   int la = GET_LEVEL(ca);
   133:   int lb = GET_LEVEL(cb);
   134: 
   135:   if (la != lb)
   136:     return (lb - la);
   137: 
   138:   return strcasecmp(GET_NAME(ca), GET_NAME(cb));
   139: }

   169: static void roster_format_color_field(char *out, size_t outsz, const char *src, size_t width)
   170: {
   171:   size_t pos = 0, vis = 0;
   172:   const char *p;
   173: 
   174:   if (!out || outsz == 0)
   175:     return;
   176: 
   177:   out[0] = '\0';
   178: 
   179:   if (!src)
   180:     src = "Unknown";
   181: 
   182:   for (p = src; *p && pos + 1 < outsz; ) {
   183:     if (*p == '\t' && *(p + 1)) {
   184:       if (pos + 2 >= outsz)
   185:         break;
   186:       out[pos++] = *p++;
   187:       out[pos++] = *p++;
   188:       continue;
   189:     }
   190: 
   191:     if (vis >= width)
   192:       break;
   193: 
   194:     out[pos++] = *p++;
   195:     vis++;
   196:   }
   197: 
   198:   while (vis < width && pos + 1 < outsz) {
   199:     out[pos++] = ' ';
   200:     vis++;
   201:   }
   202: 
   203:   out[pos] = '\0';
   204: }

   207: static void clan_show_roster(struct char_data *ch)
   208: {
   209:   struct descriptor_data *d;
   210:   struct char_data *tch;
   211:   int clan_id, count = 0;
   212:   const char *B = CCBLU(ch, C_NRM);
   213:   const char *R = CCNRM(ch, C_NRM);
   214:   const char *Y = CCYEL(ch, C_NRM);
   215:   const char *C = CCCYN(ch, C_NRM);
   216:   const char *clan_name = clan_display_name_by_id(GET_CLAN_ID(ch));
   217:   char clan_name_buf[128];
   218: 
   219:   if (!clan_name)
   220:     clan_name = "(unknown clan)";
   221: 
   222:   /* Leave one space of padding on either side of the clan name to fit the 70-char interior. */
   223:   roster_format_color_field(clan_name_buf, sizeof(clan_name_buf), clan_name, 68);
   224: 
   225:   clan_id = GET_CLAN_ID(ch);
   226:   if (clan_id <= 0) {
   227:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not in a clan.\r\n");
   228:     return;
   229:   }
   230: 
   231:   /* Count online clan members */
   232:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   233:     if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING)
   234:       continue;
   235:     if (!(tch = d->character))
   236:       continue;
   237:     if (IS_NPC(tch))
   238:       continue;
   239:     if (GET_CLAN_ID(tch) != clan_id)
   240:       continue;
   241:     count++;
   242:   }
   243: 
   244:   /* Build list */
   245:   struct char_data **list = NULL;
   246:   if (count > 0) {
   247:     list = (struct char_data **)calloc((size_t)count, sizeof(*list));
   248:     if (!list) {
   249:       send_to_char(ch, "Roster: out of memory.\r\n");
   250:       return;
   251:     }
   252:   }
   253: 
   254:   int i = 0;
   255:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   256:     if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING)
   257:       continue;
   258:     if (!(tch = d->character))
   259:       continue;
   260:     if (IS_NPC(tch))
   261:       continue;
   262:     if (GET_CLAN_ID(tch) != clan_id)
   263:       continue;
   264:     if (i < count)
   265:       list[i++] = tch;
   266:   }
   267: 
   268:   if (count > 1)
   269:     qsort(list, (size_t)count, sizeof(*list), roster_cmp);
   270: 
   271:   send_to_char(ch,
   272:     "\r\n"
   273:     "%s╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗%s\r\n"
   274:     "%s║%s %s %s║%s\r\n"
   275:     "%s║%s                              %sClan Roster%s                             %s║%s\r\n"
   276:     "%s╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣%s\r\n"
   277:     "%s║%s %sName                     Race            Class            Level      %s%s║%s\r\n"
   278:     "%s╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣%s\r\n"
   279:     , B, R,
   280:       B, R, clan_name_buf, B, R, B,
   281:       R, Y, R, B, R,
   282:       B, R,
   283:       B, R, C, R, B, R,
   284:       B, R
   285:   );
   286: 
   287:   if (count == 0) {
   288:     send_to_char(ch,
   289:       "%s║%s No clan members are currently online.                                %s║%s\r\n"
   290:       , B, R, B, R
   291:     );
   292:   } else {
   293:     for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   294:       const char *rname = roster_race_name(GET_RACE(list[i]));
   295:       const char *cname = roster_class_name(GET_CLASS(list[i]));
   296:       char name_buf[64], race_buf[32], class_buf[32];
   297: 
   298:       roster_format_color_field(name_buf, sizeof(name_buf), GET_NAME(list[i]), 24);
   299:       roster_format_color_field(race_buf, sizeof(race_buf), (rname ? rname : "Unknown"), 15);
   300:       roster_format_color_field(class_buf, sizeof(class_buf), (cname ? cname : "Unknown"), 15);
   301: 
   302:       send_to_char(ch, "%s║%s %s %s %s %5d       %s║%s\r\n",
   303:         B, R,
   304:         name_buf,
   305:         race_buf,
   306:         class_buf,
   307:         GET_LEVEL(list[i]),
   308:         B, R
   309:       );
   310:     }
   311:   }
   312: 
   313:   send_to_char(ch,
   314:     "%s╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝%s\r\n"
   315:     "\r\n"
   316:     , B, R
   317:   );
   318: 
   319:   if (list)
   320:     free(list);
   321: }

   334: static int clanlist_cmp(const void *a, const void *b)
   335: {
   336:   const struct clanlist_row *ra = (const struct clanlist_row *)a;
   337:   const struct clanlist_row *rb = (const struct clanlist_row *)b;
   338: 
   339:   if (!ra->name && !rb->name) return 0;
   340:   if (!ra->name) return 1;
   341:   if (!rb->name) return -1;
   342: 
   343:   return strcasecmp(ra->name, rb->name);
   344: }

   389:     id, disp, plain,

   396: void clanedit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   397: {
   398:   if (!d || !d->character) return;
   399: 
   400:   skip_spaces(&arg);
   401:   if (!arg) arg = "";
   402: 
   403:   switch (d->clanedit_mode) {
   404:     case CLANEDIT_SET_NAME:
   405:       if (!*arg) {
   406:         write_to_output(d, "Clan name cannot be empty. Enter new clan name: ");
   407:         return;
   408:       }
   409: 
   410:       if (!is_valid_plain_clan_name(arg)) {
   411:         write_to_output(d, "Clan names may only use letters or numbers (no color codes). Try again: ");
   412:         return;
   413:       }
   414: 
   415:       if (strlen(arg) >= CLAN_NAME_LEN) {
   416:         write_to_output(d, "Clan names must be under %d characters. Try again: ", CLAN_NAME_LEN);
   417:         return;
   418:       }
   419: 
   420:       if (!clan_set_name_and_save(d->clanedit_id, arg)) {
   421:         write_to_output(d, "Unable to save the new clan name.\r\n");
   422:         d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_MAIN;
   423:         clanedit_menu(d);
   424:         return;
   425:       }
   426: 
   427:       write_to_output(d, "Clan name updated to %s.\r\n", clan_name_by_id(d->clanedit_id));
   428:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_MAIN;
   429:       clanedit_menu(d);
   430:       return;
   431: 
   432:     case CLANEDIT_SET_DISPLAY_NAME:
   433:       if (!*arg) {
   434:         write_to_output(d, "Display name cannot be empty. Enter new display name: ");
   435:         return;
   436:       }
   437: 
   438:       char parsed_name[CLAN_DISPLAY_LEN];
   439: 
   440:       normalize_display_name(parsed_name, sizeof(parsed_name), arg);
   441: 
   442:       if (!is_valid_display_clan_name(parsed_name)) {
   443:         write_to_output(d, "Display names may only use letters, numbers, and color codes. Try again: ");
   444:         return;
   445:       }
   446: 
   447:       if (strlen(parsed_name) >= CLAN_DISPLAY_LEN) {
   448:         write_to_output(d, "Display names must be under %d characters. Try again: ", CLAN_DISPLAY_LEN);
   449:         return;
   450:       }
   451: 
   452:       if (!clan_set_display_name_and_save(d->clanedit_id, parsed_name)) {
   453:         write_to_output(d, "Unable to save the new display name.\r\n");
   454:         d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_MAIN;
   455:         clanedit_menu(d);
   456:         return;
   457:       }
   458: 
   459:       write_to_output(d, "Clan display name updated to %s.\r\n", clan_display_name_by_id(d->clanedit_id));
   460:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_MAIN;
   461:       clanedit_menu(d);
   462:       return;
   463: 
   464:     case CLANEDIT_SET_TAG:
   465:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nTag edit is not persisted yet. Use file edits for now.\r\n");
   466:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_MAIN;
   467:       clanedit_menu(d);
   468:       return;
   469: 
   470:     
   471: 
   472:     case CLANEDIT_SET_PVP_TYPE:
   473:       if (!*arg) {
   474:         clanedit_pvp_menu(d);
   475:         return;
   476:       }
   477:       if (*arg < '0' || *arg > '2') {
   478:         write_to_output(d, "Please enter 0, 1, or 2: ");
   479:         return;
   480:       }
   481:       if (!clan_set_pvp_type_and_save(d->clanedit_id, (*arg - '0'))) {
   482:         write_to_output(d, "Unable to save the new PvP/PK type.\r\n");
   483:         d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_MAIN;
   484:         clanedit_menu(d);
   485:         return;
   486:       }
   487:       write_to_output(d, "Clan PvP/PK type updated to %s.\r\n",
   488:         clan_pvp_type_name(clan_pvp_type_by_id(d->clanedit_id)));
   489:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_MAIN;
   490:       clanedit_menu(d);
   491:       return;
   492: case CLANEDIT_CONFIRM_QUIT:
   493:       if (!*arg) {
   494:         write_to_output(d, "Save changes before exiting? (Y/N): ");
   495:         return;
   496:       }
   497: 
   498:       switch (LOWER(*arg)) {
   499:         case 'y':
   500:           if (clan_save_all())
   501:             write_to_output(d, "Clans saved. Exiting clan editor.\r\n");
   502:           else
   503:             write_to_output(d, "Could not save clans, exiting anyway.\r\n");
   504:           break;
   505: 
   506:         case 'n':
   507:           write_to_output(d, "Exiting clan editor without saving.\r\n");
   508:           break;
   509: 
   510:         default:
   511:           write_to_output(d, "Please enter Y or N: ");
   512:           return;
   513:       }
   514: 
   515:       d->clanedit_id = 0;
   516:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_MAIN;
   517:       STATE(d) = CON_PLAYING;
   518:       return;
   519: 
   520:     default:
   521:       break;
   522:   }
   523: 
   524:   if (!*arg) {
   525:     clanedit_menu(d);
   526:     return;
   527:   }
   528: 
   529:   switch (LOWER(*arg)) {
   530:     case '1':
   531:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_SET_NAME;
   532:       write_to_output(d, "Enter new clan name: ");
   533:       return;
   534:     case '2':
   535:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_SET_DISPLAY_NAME;
   536:       write_to_output(d, "Enter new clan display name (colors allowed): ");
   537:       return;
   538:     case '3':
   539:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_SET_TAG;
   540:       write_to_output(d, "Enter new clan tag (shown in who): ");
   541:       return;
   542:     case '4':
   543:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_SET_PVP_TYPE;
   544:       clanedit_pvp_menu(d);
   545:       return;
   546: case 'q':
   547:       d->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_CONFIRM_QUIT;
   548:       write_to_output(d, "Save changes before exiting? (Y/N): ");
   549:       return;
   550:     default:
   551:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice.\r\n");
   552:       clanedit_menu(d);
   553:       return;
   554:   }
   555: }

   557: ACMD(do_clist)
   558: {
   559:   struct clanlist_row rows[256];
   560:   int n = 0, i;
   561: 
   562:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   563:     return;
   564: 
   565:   /* Build list from clan ids. */
   566: #ifdef MAX_CLANS
   567:   int max_id = MAX_CLANS;
   568: #else
   569:   /* Fallback if MAX_CLANS is not visible for some reason. */
   570:   int max_id = clan_next_id();
   571: #endif
   572: 
   573:   if (max_id > (int)(sizeof(rows) / sizeof(rows[0])))
   574:     max_id = (int)(sizeof(rows) / sizeof(rows[0]));
   575: 
   576:   for (i = 1; i < max_id; i++) {
   577:     const char *nm = NULL;
   578:     if (!clan_exists(i))
   579:       continue;
   580: 
   581:     nm = clan_name_by_id(i);
   582:     if (!nm || !*nm)
   583:       continue;
   584: 
   585:     rows[n].id = i;
   586:     rows[n].name = nm;
   587:     rows[n].display_name = clan_display_name_by_id(i);
   588:     rows[n].online = 0;
   589:     n++;
   590:   }
   591: 
   592:   if (n <= 0) {
   593:     send_to_char(ch, "No clans found.\r\n");
   594:     return;
   595:   }
   596: 
   597:   /* Count online members for each clan. */
   598:   for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   599:     struct descriptor_data *d;
   600:     for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   601:       struct char_data *tch;
   602:       if (!d->character)
   603:         continue;
   604:       tch = d->character;
   605:       if (!IS_PLAYING(d))
   606:         continue;
   607:       if (IS_NPC(tch))
   608:         continue;
   609:       if (GET_CLAN_ID(tch) == rows[i].id)
   610:         rows[i].online++;
   611:     }
   612:   }
   613: 
   614:   qsort(rows, n, sizeof(rows[0]), clanlist_cmp);
   615: 
   616:   send_to_char(ch, "Clans\r\n");
   617:   send_to_char(ch, "-----\r\n");
   618:   for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   619:     /* Keep it compact, like who/finger style. */
   620:     send_to_char(ch, "%-20s Online: %d\r\n", rows[i].display_name ? rows[i].display_name : rows[i].name, rows[i].online);
   621:   }
   622:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\n%d clan%s listed.\r\n", n, (n == 1 ? "" : "s"));
   623: }
   624: 
   625: 
   626: 
   627: /* Clan editor entry point. Full editor will be implemented after state plumbing is stable. */
   628: ACMD(do_clanedit)
   629: {
   630:   int id = 0;
   631: 
   632:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   633:     return;
   634: 
   635:   if (!ch->desc) {
   636:     send_to_char(ch, "Clanedit requires a live descriptor.\r\n");
   637:     return;
   638:   }
   639: 
   640:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   641: 
   642:   if (!*argument) {
   643:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: clanedit <clan name>\r\n");
   644:     return;
   645:   }
   646: 
   647:   if (is_number(argument)) {
   648:     id = atoi(argument);
   649:   } else {
   650:     id = clan_id_by_name(argument);
   651:   }
   652: 
   653:   if (id <= 0 || !clan_name_by_id(id)) {
   654:     send_to_char(ch, "Clan not found.\r\n");
   655:     return;
   656:   }
   657: 
   658:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMPL && GET_CLAN_ID(ch) != id) {
   659:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have permission to edit that clan.\r\n");
   660:     return;
   661:   }
   662: 
   663:   ch->desc->clanedit_id = id;
   664:   ch->desc->clanedit_mode = CLANEDIT_MAIN;
   665:   STATE(ch->desc) = CON_CLANEDIT;
   666: 
   667:   clanedit_menu(ch->desc);
   668: }
   669: 
   670: 
   671: 
   672: ACMD(do_roster)
   673: {
   674:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   675:     return;
   676: 
   677:   if (GET_CLAN_ID(ch) <= 0) {
   678:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not in a clan.\r\n");
   679:     return;
   680:   }
   681: 
   682:   clan_show_roster(ch);
   683: }

   685: ACMD(do_clan)
   686: {
   687:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   688:   char arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   689:   int clan_id = 0;
   690:   struct char_data *vict = NULL;
   691:   int actor_rank;
   692:   const int clan_rank_max = 10;
   693: 
   694:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   695:     return;
   696: 
   697:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   698:   if (!*argument) {
   699:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage:\r\n  clan <message>\r\n  cjoin <clan name or id>\r\n  cquit\r\n");
   700:     return;
   701:   }
   702: 
   703:   /* Parse first word. We allow both: "clan join X" and wrapper calls like cjoin -> "join X". */
   704:   argument = any_one_arg(argument, arg1);
   705: 
   706:   /* Helper: resolve clan id by numeric id or exact name match using clan_name_by_id(). */
   707:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "join")) {
   708:     if (GET_CLAN_ID(ch) > 0) {
   709:       send_to_char(ch, "You are already in a clan.\r\n");
   710:       return;
   711:     }
   712: 
   713:     skip_spaces(&argument);
   714:     if (!*argument) {
   715:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: cjoin <clan name or id>\r\n");
   716:       return;
   717:     }
   718: 
   719:     argument = any_one_arg(argument, arg2);
   720: 
   721:     clan_id = is_number(arg2) ? atoi(arg2) : clan_id_by_name(arg2);
   722: 
   723:     if (clan_id <= 0 || !clan_name_by_id(clan_id)) {
   724:       send_to_char(ch, "No such clan.\r\n");
   725:       return;
   726:     }
   727: 
   728:     SET_CLAN_ID(ch, clan_id);
   729:     SET_CLAN_RANK(ch, CLAN_RANK_MEMBER);
   730: 
   731:     send_to_char(ch, "You have joined %s.\r\n", clan_display_name_by_id(clan_id));
   732: 
   733:     /* Save if available in your codebase; harmless if you remove it later. */
   734:     save_char(ch);
   735:     return;
   736:   }
   737: 
   738:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "quit")) {
   739:     if (GET_CLAN_ID(ch) <= 0) {
   740:       send_to_char(ch, "You are not in a clan.\r\n");
   741:       return;
   742:     }
   743:     send_to_char(ch, "You have left %s.\r\n", clan_display_name_by_id(GET_CLAN_ID(ch)));
   744:     SET_CLAN_ID(ch, 0);
   745:     SET_CLAN_RANK(ch, 0);
   746:     save_char(ch);
   747:     return;
   748:   }
   749: 
   750:   actor_rank = GET_CLAN_RANK(ch);
   751:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "invite")) {
   752:     if (GET_CLAN_ID(ch) <= 0) {
   753:       send_to_char(ch, "You are not in a clan.\r\n");
   754:       return;
   755:     }
   756: 
   757:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMPL && actor_rank < CLAN_RANK_LEADER) {
   758:       send_to_char(ch, "Only clan leaders may invite members.\r\n");
   759:       return;
   760:     }
   761: 
   762:     skip_spaces(&argument);
   763:     if (!*argument) {
   764:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: cinvite <player>\r\n");
   765:       return;
   766:     }
   767: 
   768:     argument = any_one_arg(argument, arg2);
   769:     if (!(vict = get_player_vis(ch, arg2, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD))) {
   770:       send_to_char(ch, "No such player is online.\r\n");
   771:       return;
   772:     }
   773: 
   774:     if (IS_NPC(vict)) {
   775:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only invite players.\r\n");
   776:       return;
   777:     }
   778: 
   779:     if (vict == ch) {
   780:       send_to_char(ch, "You are already in your own clan.\r\n");
   781:       return;
   782:     }
   783: 
   784:     if (GET_CLAN_ID(vict) > 0) {
   785:       send_to_char(ch, "%s is already in %s.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict), clan_display_name_by_id(GET_CLAN_ID(vict)));
   786:       return;
   787:     }
   788: 
   789:     SET_CLAN_ID(vict, GET_CLAN_ID(ch));
   790:     SET_CLAN_RANK(vict, CLAN_RANK_MEMBER);
   791:     save_char(vict);
   792: 
   793:     send_to_char(ch, "You invite %s into %s.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict), clan_display_name_by_id(GET_CLAN_ID(ch)));
   794:     send_to_char(vict, "%s invites you into %s.\r\n", GET_NAME(ch), clan_display_name_by_id(GET_CLAN_ID(ch)));
   795:     send_to_clan(GET_CLAN_ID(ch), "A new member has joined the clan.", NULL);
   796:     return;
   797:   }
   798: 
   799:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "promote") || !str_cmp(arg1, "demote")) {
   800:     int delta = !str_cmp(arg1, "promote") ? 1 : -1;
   801:     int new_rank;
   802: 
   803:     if (GET_CLAN_ID(ch) <= 0) {
   804:       send_to_char(ch, "You are not in a clan.\r\n");
   805:       return;
   806:     }
   807: 
   808:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMPL && actor_rank < CLAN_RANK_LEADER) {
   809:       send_to_char(ch, "Only clan leaders may change ranks.\r\n");
   810:       return;
   811:     }
   812: 
   813:     skip_spaces(&argument);
   814:     if (!*argument) {
   815:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: c%s <player>\r\n", (delta > 0) ? "promote" : "demote");
   816:       return;
   817:     }
   818: 
   819:     argument = any_one_arg(argument, arg2);
   820:     if (!(vict = get_player_vis(ch, arg2, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD))) {
   821:       send_to_char(ch, "No such player is online.\r\n");
   822:       return;
   823:     }
   824: 
   825:     if (IS_NPC(vict)) {
   826:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only change player ranks.\r\n");
   827:       return;
   828:     }
   829: 
   830:     if (vict == ch) {
   831:       send_to_char(ch, "You cannot change your own rank.\r\n");
   832:       return;
   833:     }
   834: 
   835:     if (GET_CLAN_ID(vict) != GET_CLAN_ID(ch)) {
   836:       send_to_char(ch, "%s is not in your clan.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict));
   837:       return;
   838:     }
   839: 
   840:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMPL && GET_CLAN_RANK(vict) >= actor_rank) {
   841:       send_to_char(ch, "You cannot change the rank of an equal or higher-ranked member.\r\n");
   842:       return;
   843:     }
   844: 
   845:     new_rank = GET_CLAN_RANK(vict) + delta;
   846:     if (new_rank < CLAN_RANK_MEMBER) {
   847:       send_to_char(ch, "%s is already at the lowest rank.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict));
   848:       return;
   849:     }
   850: 
   851:     if (new_rank > clan_rank_max) {
   852:       send_to_char(ch, "%s is already at the highest rank.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict));
   853:       return;
   854:     }
   855: 
   856:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMPL && new_rank >= actor_rank) {
   857:       send_to_char(ch, "You may not raise someone to your own rank or higher.\r\n");
   858:       return;
   859:     }
   860: 
   861:     SET_CLAN_RANK(vict, new_rank);
   862:     save_char(vict);
   863: 
   864:     send_to_char(ch, "You %s %s to clan rank %d.\r\n",
   865:       (delta > 0) ? "promote" : "demote", GET_NAME(vict), new_rank);
   866:     send_to_char(vict, "%s %ss you to clan rank %d.\r\n",
   867:       GET_NAME(ch), (delta > 0) ? "promote" : "demote", new_rank);
   868:     return;
   869:   }
   870:   /* Otherwise treat as clan chat. The wrapper also lands here for "join" only if something went wrong. */
   871:   if (GET_CLAN_ID(ch) <= 0) {
   872:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not in a clan.\r\n");
   873:     return;
   874:   }
   875: 
   876:   /* Rebuild the message with arg1 included. */
   877:   {
   878:     char msg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH * 2];
   879:     if (*argument)
   880:       snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%s %s", arg1, argument);
   881:     else
   882:       snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%s", arg1);
   883:     send_to_clan(GET_CLAN_ID(ch), msg, ch);
   884:   }
   885: }
   886: 
   887: 
   888: 
   889: /* Shortcut wrappers */
   890: static void clan_wrap(struct char_data *ch, const char *prefix, const char *argument, int cmd, int subcmd)
   891: {
   892:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   893:   if (argument && *argument)
   894:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s %s", prefix, argument);
   895:   else
   896:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s", prefix);
   897:   do_clan(ch, buf, cmd, subcmd);
   898: }
   899: 
   900: ACMD(do_ccreate)
   901: {
   902:   char name[128];
   903: 
   904:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   905:     return;
   906: 
   907:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < 104) {
   908:     send_to_char(ch, "Only immortals (level 104+) may create clans right now.\r\n");
   909:     return;
   910:   }
   911: 
   912:   if (GET_CLAN_ID(ch) > 0) {
   913:     send_to_char(ch, "You are already in a clan.\r\n");
   914:     return;
   915:   }
   916: 
   917:   one_argument(argument, name);
   918: 
   919:   if (!*name) {
   920:     clan_help(ch);
   921:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: ccreate <clanname>\r\n");
   922:     send_to_char(ch, "Tip: keep the base name plain; set colors later in clanedit.\r\n");
   923:     return;
   924:   }
   925: 
   926:   if (!is_valid_plain_clan_name(name)) {
   927:     send_to_char(ch, "Invalid clan name. Use letters and numbers only (no color codes).\r\n");
   928:     send_to_char(ch, "Tip: set the colored display with 'clanedit' after creation.\r\n");
   929:     return;
   930:   }
   931: 
   932:   {
   933:     int new_id = clan_next_id();
   934:     if (new_id <= 0) {
   935:       send_to_char(ch, "Clan system error: could not allocate a new clan id.\r\n");
   936:       return;
   937:     }
   938: 
   939:     if (!clan_create_and_save(new_id, GET_IDNUM(ch), name)) {
   940:       send_to_char(ch, "Clan system error: could not create clan.\r\n");
   941:       return;
   942:     }
   943: 
   944:     SET_CLAN_ID(ch, new_id);
   945:     SET_CLAN_RANK(ch, 10); /* leader rank for now */
   946:     save_char(ch);
   947: 
   948:     send_to_char(ch, "Clan created.\r\n");
   949:   }
   950: }
   951: 
   952: ACMD(do_cinvite)  { clan_wrap(ch, "invite",  argument, cmd, subcmd); }
   953: ACMD(do_cjoin)    { clan_wrap(ch, "join",    argument, cmd, subcmd); }
   954: ACMD(do_cquit)    { clan_wrap(ch, "quit",    argument, cmd, subcmd); }
   955: ACMD(do_cpromote) { clan_wrap(ch, "promote", argument, cmd, subcmd); }
   956: ACMD(do_cdemote)  { clan_wrap(ch, "demote",  argument, cmd, subcmd); }

    25: static bool legal_communication(char * arg);
    26: 
    27: static bool legal_communication(char * arg) 
    28: {
    29:   while (*arg) {
    30:     if (*arg == '@') {
    31:       arg++;
    32:       if (*arg == '(' || *arg == ')' || *arg == '<' || *arg == '>')
    33:         return FALSE; 
    34:     }
    35:     arg++;
    36:   }
    37:   return TRUE;
    38: }

    40: ACMD(do_say)
    41: {
    42:   skip_spaces(&argument);
    43: 
    44:   if (!*argument)
    45:     send_to_char(ch, "Yes, but WHAT do you want to say?\r\n");
    46:   else {
    47:     char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 14], *msg;
    48:     struct char_data *vict;
    49:  
    50:     if (CONFIG_SPECIAL_IN_COMM && legal_communication(argument))
    51:       parse_at(argument);
    52: 
    53:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n\tn says, '%s'", argument);
    54:     msg = act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM | DG_NO_TRIG);
    55: 
    56:     for (vict = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; vict; vict = vict->next_in_room)
    57:       if (vict != ch && GET_POS(vict) > POS_SLEEPING)
    58:         add_history(vict, msg, HIST_SAY);
    59: 
    60:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOREPEAT))
    61:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
    62:     else {
    63:       sprintf(buf, "You say, '%s'", argument);
    64:       msg = act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_CHAR | DG_NO_TRIG);
    65:       add_history(ch, msg, HIST_SAY);
    66:     }
    67:   }
    68: 
    69:   /* Trigger check. */
    70: 
    71:   speech_mtrigger(ch, argument);
    72:   speech_wtrigger(ch, argument);
    73: }

    91:

    99: static void perform_tell(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict, char *arg)
   100: {
   101:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], *msg;
   102: 
   103:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s$n tells you, '%s'%s", CCRED(vict, C_NRM), arg, CCNRM(vict, C_NRM));
   104:   msg = act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
   105:   add_history(vict, msg, HIST_TELL);
   106: 
   107:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOREPEAT))
   108:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
   109:   else {
   110:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%sYou tell $N, '%s'%s", CCRED(ch, C_NRM), arg, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   111:     msg = act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR | TO_SLEEP);     
   112:     add_history(ch, msg, HIST_TELL);
   113:   }
   114: 
   115:   if (!IS_NPC(vict) && !IS_NPC(ch))
   116:     GET_LAST_TELL(vict) = GET_IDNUM(ch);
   117: }
   118: 
   119: static int is_tell_ok(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict)
   120: {
   121:   if (!ch)
   122:     log("SYSERR: is_tell_ok called with no characters");
   123:   else if (!vict)
   124:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
   125:   else if (ch == vict)
   126:     send_to_char(ch, "You try to tell yourself something.\r\n");
   127:   else if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOTELL))
   128:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't tell other people while you have notell on.\r\n");
   129:   else if (ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(ch), ROOM_SOUNDPROOF) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD))
   130:     send_to_char(ch, "The walls seem to absorb your words.\r\n");
   131:   else if (!IS_NPC(vict) && !vict->desc)        /* linkless */
   132:     act("$E's linkless at the moment.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR | TO_SLEEP);
   133:   else if (PLR_FLAGGED(vict, PLR_WRITING))
   134:     act("$E's writing a message right now; try again later.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR | TO_SLEEP);
   135:   else if ((!IS_NPC(vict) && PRF_FLAGGED(vict, PRF_NOTELL)) || (ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(vict), ROOM_SOUNDPROOF) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD)))
   136:     act("$E can't hear you.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR | TO_SLEEP);
   137:   else
   138:     return (TRUE);
   139: 
   140:   return (FALSE);
   141: }
   142: 
   143: /* Yes, do_tell probably could be combined with whisper and ask, but it is
   144:  * called frequently, and should IMHO be kept as tight as possible. */
   145: ACMD(do_tell)
   146: {
   147:   struct char_data *vict = NULL;
   148:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 25], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];  // +25 to make room for constants
   149: 
   150:   half_chop(argument, buf, buf2);
   151: 
   152:   if (!*buf || !*buf2)
   153:     send_to_char(ch, "Who do you wish to tell what??\r\n");
   154:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT && !(vict = get_player_vis(ch, buf, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)))
   155:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
   156:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT && !(vict = get_char_vis(ch, buf, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)))
   157:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
   158:   else if (is_tell_ok(ch, vict)) {
   159:     if (CONFIG_SPECIAL_IN_COMM && legal_communication(argument))
   160:       parse_at(buf2);
   161:     perform_tell(ch, vict, buf2);
   162: 	}
   163: }
   164: 
   165: ACMD(do_reply)
   166: {
   167:   struct char_data *tch = character_list;
   168: 
   169:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   170:     return;
   171: 
   172:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   173: 
   174:   if (GET_LAST_TELL(ch) == NOBODY)
   175:     send_to_char(ch, "You have nobody to reply to!\r\n");
   176:   else if (!*argument)
   177:     send_to_char(ch, "What is your reply?\r\n");
   178:   else {
   179:     /* Make sure the person you're replying to is still playing by searching
   180:      * for them.  Note, now last tell is stored as player IDnum instead of
   181:      * a pointer, which is much better because it's safer, plus will still
   182:      * work if someone logs out and back in again. A descriptor list based 
   183:      * search would be faster although we could not find link dead people.  
   184:      * Not that they can hear tells anyway. :) -gg 2/24/98 */
   185:     while (tch && (IS_NPC(tch) || GET_IDNUM(tch) != GET_LAST_TELL(ch)))
   186:       tch = tch->next;
   187: 
   188:     if (!tch)
   189:       send_to_char(ch, "That player is no longer here.\r\n");
   190:     else if (is_tell_ok(ch, tch)) {
   191:       if (CONFIG_SPECIAL_IN_COMM && legal_communication(argument))
   192:         parse_at(argument);
   193:       perform_tell(ch, tch, argument);
   194: 		}
   195:   }
   196: }
   197: 
   198: ACMD(do_spec_comm)
   199: {
   200:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   201:   struct char_data *vict;
   202:   const char *action_sing, *action_plur, *action_others;
   203: 
   204:   switch (subcmd) {
   205:   case SCMD_WHISPER:
   206:     action_sing = "whisper to";
   207:     action_plur = "whispers to";
   208:     action_others = "$n whispers something to $N.";
   209:     break;
   210: 
   211:   case SCMD_ASK:
   212:     action_sing = "ask";
   213:     action_plur = "asks";
   214:     action_others = "$n asks $N a question.";
   215:     break;
   216: 
   217:   default:
   218:     action_sing = "oops";
   219:     action_plur = "oopses";
   220:     action_others = "$n is tongue-tied trying to speak with $N.";
   221:     break;
   222:   }
   223: 
   224:   half_chop(argument, buf, buf2);
   225: 
   226:   if (!*buf || !*buf2)
   227:     send_to_char(ch, "Whom do you want to %s.. and what??\r\n", action_sing);
   228:   else if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, buf, NULL, FIND_CHAR_ROOM)))
   229:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
   230:   else if (vict == ch)
   231:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't get your mouth close enough to your ear...\r\n");
   232:   else {
   233:     char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   234: 
   235:     if (CONFIG_SPECIAL_IN_COMM && legal_communication(argument))
   236:       parse_at(buf2);
   237: 
   238:     snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "$n %s you, '%s'", action_plur, buf2);
   239:     act(buf1, FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_VICT);
   240: 
   241:     if ((!IS_NPC(ch)) && (PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOREPEAT))) 
   242:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
   243:     else
   244:       send_to_char(ch, "You %s %s, '%s'\r\n", action_sing, GET_NAME(vict), buf2);
   245:     act(action_others, FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
   246:   }
   247: }
   248: 
   249: ACMD(do_write)
   250: {
   251:   struct obj_data *paper, *pen = NULL;
   252:   char *papername, *penname;
   253:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   254: 
   255:   papername = buf1;
   256:   penname = buf2;
   257: 
   258:   two_arguments(argument, papername, penname);
   259: 
   260:   if (!ch->desc)
   261:     return;
   262: 
   263:   if (!*papername) {
   264:     /* Nothing was delivered. */
   265:     send_to_char(ch, "Write?  With what?  ON what?  What are you trying to do?!?\r\n");
   266:     return;
   267:   }
   268:   if (*penname) {
   269:     /* Nothing was delivered. */
   270:     if (!(paper = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, papername, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
   271:       send_to_char(ch, "You have no %s.\r\n", papername);
   272:       return;
   273:     }
   274:     if (!(pen = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, penname, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
   275:       send_to_char(ch, "You have no %s.\r\n", penname);
   276:       return;
   277:     }
   278:   } else { /* There was one arg.. let's see what we can find. */
   279:     if (!(paper = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, papername, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
   280:       send_to_char(ch, "There is no %s in your inventory.\r\n", papername);
   281:       return;
   282:     }
   283:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(paper) == ITEM_PEN) { /* Oops, a pen. */
   284:       pen = paper;
   285:       paper = NULL;
   286:     } else if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(paper) != ITEM_NOTE) {
   287:       send_to_char(ch, "That thing has nothing to do with writing.\r\n");
   288:       return;
   289:     }
   290: 
   291:     /* One object was found.. now for the other one. */
   292:     if (!GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD)) {
   293:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't write with %s %s alone.\r\n", AN(papername), papername);
   294:       return;
   295:     }
   296:     if (!CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD))) {
   297:       send_to_char(ch, "The stuff in your hand is invisible!  Yeech!!\r\n");
   298:       return;
   299:     }
   300:     if (pen)
   301:       paper = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD);
   302:     else
   303:       pen = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD);
   304:   }
   305: 
   306:   /* Now let's see what kind of stuff we've found. */
   307:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(pen) != ITEM_PEN)
   308:     act("$p is no good for writing with.", FALSE, ch, pen, 0, TO_CHAR);
   309:   else if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(paper) != ITEM_NOTE)
   310:     act("You can't write on $p.", FALSE, ch, paper, 0, TO_CHAR);
   311:   else {
   312:     char *backstr = NULL;
   313: 
   314:     /* Something on it, display it as that's in input buffer. */
   315:     if (paper->action_description) {
   316:       backstr = strdup(paper->action_description);
   317:       send_to_char(ch, "There's something written on it already:\r\n");
   318:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", paper->action_description);
   319:     }
   320: 
   321:     /* We can write. */
   322:     act("$n begins to jot down a note.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   323:     send_editor_help(ch->desc);
   324:     string_write(ch->desc, &paper->action_description, MAX_NOTE_LENGTH, 0, backstr);
   325:   }
   326: }
   327: 
   328: ACMD(do_page)
   329: {
   330:   struct descriptor_data *d;
   331:   struct char_data *vict;
   332:   char buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   333: 
   334:   half_chop(argument, arg, buf2);
   335: 
   336:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   337:     send_to_char(ch, "Monsters can't page.. go away.\r\n");
   338:   else if (!*arg)
   339:     send_to_char(ch, "Whom do you wish to page?\r\n");
   340:   else {
   341:     char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   342: 
   343:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "\007\007*$n* %s", buf2);
   344:     if (!str_cmp(arg, "all")) {
   345:       if (GET_LEVEL(ch) > LVL_GOD) {
   346: 	for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next)
   347: 	  if (STATE(d) == CON_PLAYING && d->character)
   348: 	    act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, d->character, TO_VICT);
   349:       } else
   350: 	send_to_char(ch, "You will never be godly enough to do that!\r\n");
   351:       return;
   352:     }
   353:     if ((vict = get_char_vis(ch, arg, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD))) {
   354:       act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_VICT);
   355:       if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOREPEAT))
   356: 	send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
   357:       else
   358: 	act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
   359:     } else
   360:       send_to_char(ch, "There is no such person in the game!\r\n");
   361:   }
   362: }
   363: 
   364: /* Generalized communication function by Fred C. Merkel (Torg). */
   365: ACMD(do_gen_comm)
   366: {
   367:   struct descriptor_data *i;
   368:   char color_on[24];
   369:   char buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 50], *msg;   // + 50 to make room for color codes
   370:   bool emoting = FALSE;
   371: 
   372:   /* Array of flags which must _not_ be set in order for comm to be heard. */
   373:   int channels[] = {
   374:     0,
   375:     PRF_NOSHOUT,
   376:     PRF_NOGOSS,
   377:     PRF_NOAUCT,
   378:     PRF_NOGRATZ,
   379:     PRF_NOGOSS,
   380:     0
   381:   };
   382: 
   383:   int hist_type[] = {
   384:     HIST_HOLLER,
   385:     HIST_SHOUT,
   386:     HIST_GOSSIP,
   387:     HIST_AUCTION,
   388:     HIST_GRATS,
   389:   };
   390: 
   391:   /* com_msgs: [0] Message if you can't perform the action because of noshout
   392:    *           [1] name of the action
   393:    *           [2] message if you're not on the channel
   394:    *           [3] a color string. */
   395:   const char *com_msgs[][4] = {
   396:     {"You cannot holler!!\r\n",
   397:       "holler",
   398:       "",
   399:       KYEL},
   400: 
   401:     {"You cannot shout!!\r\n",
   402:       "shout",
   403:       "Turn off your noshout flag first!\r\n",
   404:       KYEL},
   405: 
   406:     {"You cannot gossip!!\r\n",
   407:       "gossip",
   408:       "You aren't even on the channel!\r\n",
   409:       KYEL},
   410: 
   411:     {"You cannot auction!!\r\n",
   412:       "auction",
   413:       "You aren't even on the channel!\r\n",
   414:       KMAG},
   415: 
   416:     {"You cannot congratulate!\r\n",
   417:       "congrat",
   418:       "You aren't even on the channel!\r\n",
   419:       KGRN},
   420: 
   421:     {"You cannot gossip your emotions!\r\n",
   422:       "gossip",
   423:       "You aren't even on the channel!\r\n",
   424:       KYEL}
   425:   };
   426: 
   427:   if (PLR_FLAGGED(ch, PLR_NOSHOUT)) {
   428:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", com_msgs[subcmd][0]);
   429:     return;
   430:   }
   431:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(ch), ROOM_SOUNDPROOF) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD)) {
   432:     send_to_char(ch, "The walls seem to absorb your words.\r\n");
   433:     return;
   434:   }
   435: 
   436: 
   437:   if (subcmd == SCMD_GEMOTE) {
   438:     if (!*argument)
   439:       send_to_char(ch, "Gemote? Yes? Gemote what?\r\n");
   440:     else
   441:       do_gmote(ch, argument, 0, 1);
   442:     return;
   443:   }
   444: 
   445:   /* Level_can_shout defined in config.c. */
   446:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < CONFIG_LEVEL_CAN_SHOUT) {
   447:     send_to_char(ch, "You must be at least level %d before you can %s.\r\n", CONFIG_LEVEL_CAN_SHOUT, com_msgs[subcmd][1]);
   448:     return;
   449:   }
   450:   /* Make sure the char is on the channel. */
   451:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, channels[subcmd])) {
   452:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", com_msgs[subcmd][2]);
   453:     return;
   454:   }
   455: 
   456:   /* skip leading spaces */
   457:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   458: 
   459:   /* Make sure that there is something there to say! */
   460:   if (!*argument) {
   461:     send_to_char(ch, "Yes, %s, fine, %s we must, but WHAT???\r\n", com_msgs[subcmd][1], com_msgs[subcmd][1]);
   462:     return;
   463:   }
   464:   if (subcmd == SCMD_HOLLER) {
   465:     if (GET_MOVE(ch) < CONFIG_HOLLER_MOVE_COST) {
   466:       send_to_char(ch, "You're too exhausted to holler.\r\n");
   467:       return;
   468:     } else
   469:       GET_MOVE(ch) -= CONFIG_HOLLER_MOVE_COST;
   470:   }
   471:   /* Set up the color on code. */
   472:   strlcpy(color_on, com_msgs[subcmd][3], sizeof(color_on));
   473: 
   474:   /* First, set up strings to be given to the communicator. */
   475:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOREPEAT))
   476:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
   477:   else {
   478: 		if (CONFIG_SPECIAL_IN_COMM && legal_communication(argument))
   479:       parse_at(argument);
   480:       
   481:     snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "%sYou %s, '%s%s'%s", COLOR_LEV(ch) >= C_CMP ? color_on : "",
   482:         com_msgs[subcmd][1], argument, COLOR_LEV(ch) >= C_CMP ? color_on : "", CCNRM(ch, C_CMP));
   483:     
   484:     msg = act(buf1, FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_CHAR | TO_SLEEP);
   485:     add_history(ch, msg, hist_type[subcmd]);
   486:   }
   487:   if (!emoting)
   488:     snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "$n %ss, '%s'", com_msgs[subcmd][1], argument);
   489: 
   490:   /* Now send all the strings out. */
   491:   for (i = descriptor_list; i; i = i->next) {
   492:     if (STATE(i) != CON_PLAYING || i == ch->desc || !i->character )
   493:       continue;
   494:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && (PRF_FLAGGED(i->character, channels[subcmd]) || PLR_FLAGGED(i->character, PLR_WRITING)))
   495:       continue;
   496: 
   497:     if (ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(i->character), ROOM_SOUNDPROOF) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD))
   498:       continue;
   499: 
   500:     if (subcmd == SCMD_SHOUT && ((world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone != world[IN_ROOM(i->character)].zone) ||
   501:          !AWAKE(i->character)))
   502:       continue;
   503: 
   504:     snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "%s%s%s", (COLOR_LEV(i->character) >= C_NRM) ? color_on : "", buf1, KNRM); 
   505:     msg = act(buf2, FALSE, ch, 0, i->character, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
   506:     add_history(i->character, msg, hist_type[subcmd]);
   507:   }
   508: }
   509: 
   510: ACMD(do_qcomm)
   511: {
   512:   if (!PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_QUEST)) {
   513:     send_to_char(ch, "You aren't even part of the quest!\r\n");
   514:     return;
   515:   }
   516:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   517: 
   518:   if (!*argument)
   519:     send_to_char(ch, "%c%s?  Yes, fine, %s we must, but WHAT??\r\n", UPPER(*CMD_NAME), CMD_NAME + 1, CMD_NAME);
   520:   else {
   521:     char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   522:     struct descriptor_data *i;
   523:     
   524:     if (CONFIG_SPECIAL_IN_COMM && legal_communication(argument))
   525:       parse_at(argument);
   526: 
   527:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOREPEAT))
   528:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
   529:     else if (subcmd == SCMD_QSAY) {
   530:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "You quest-say, '%s'", argument);
   531:       act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, argument, TO_CHAR);
   532:     } else
   533:       act(argument, FALSE, ch, 0, argument, TO_CHAR);
   534: 
   535:     if (subcmd == SCMD_QSAY)
   536:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n quest-says, '%s'", argument);
   537:     else {
   538:       strlcpy(buf, argument, sizeof(buf));
   539:       mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s qechoed: %s", GET_NAME(ch), argument);
   540:     }
   541:     for (i = descriptor_list; i; i = i->next)
   542:       if (STATE(i) == CON_PLAYING && i != ch->desc && PRF_FLAGGED(i->character, PRF_QUEST))
   543:         act(buf, 0, ch, 0, i->character, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
   544:   }
   545: }

    18: 
    19: static void format_color_field(char *out, size_t outsz, const char *src, size_t width)
    20: {
    21:   size_t pos = 0, vis = 0;
    22:   const char *p;
    23: 
    24:   if (!out || outsz == 0)
    25:     return;
    26: 
    27:   out[0] = '\0';
    28: 
    29:   if (!src)
    30:     src = "None";
    31: 
    32:   for (p = src; *p && pos + 1 < outsz; ) {
    33:     if (*p == '\t' && *(p + 1)) {
    34:       if (pos + 2 >= outsz)
    35:         break;
    36:       out[pos++] = *p++;
    37:       out[pos++] = *p++;
    38:       continue;
    39:     }
    40: 
    41:     if (vis >= width)
    42:       break;
    43: 
    44:     out[pos++] = *p++;
    45:     vis++;
    46:   }
    47: 
    48:   while (vis < width && pos + 1 < outsz) {
    49:     out[pos++] = ' ';
    50:     vis++;
    51:   }
    52: 
    53:   out[pos] = '\0';
    54: }

   119: /* Encumbrance label for score display */
   120: /* Ensure exactly one blank line after room descriptions before exits/contents. */
   121: static void ensure_one_blank_line_after_desc(struct char_data *ch, const char *desc)
   122: {
   123:   size_t n;
   124:   int trailing_nl = 0;
   125: 
   126:   if (!ch)
   127:     return;
   128: 
   129:   if (!desc || !*desc) {
   130:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   131:     return;
   132:   }
   133: 
   134:   n = strlen(desc);
   135: 
   136:   /* Count trailing '\n' ignoring '\r'. */
   137:   while (n > 0) {
   138:     char c = desc[n - 1];
   139:     if (c == '\r') { n--; continue; }
   140:     if (c == '\n') { trailing_nl++; n--; continue; }
   141:     break;
   142:   }
   143: 
   144:   /* If desc doesn't end in newline, add one. */
   145:   if (trailing_nl == 0)
   146:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   147: 
   148:   /* If desc ends with 1 newline, add one more to make a blank line. */
   149:   if (trailing_nl == 1)
   150:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   151: 
   152:   /* If desc already has 2+ newlines, do nothing (prevents double blank gaps). */
   153: }
   154: 
   155: static const char *encumbrance_text(struct char_data *ch)
   156: {
   157:   int cap = CAN_CARRY_W(ch);
   158:   int cur = IS_CARRYING_W(ch);
   159: 
   160:   if (cap <= 0)
   161:     return "None";
   162: 
   163:   /* Percent carried (integer math) */
   164:   int pct = (cur * 100) / cap;
   165: 
   166:   if (pct < 25) return "Light";
   167:   if (pct < 50) return "Moderate";
   168:   if (pct < 75) return "Heavy";
   169:   return "Overloaded";
   170: }

   201: /* Subcommands */
   202: /* For show_obj_to_char 'mode'.    /-- arbitrary */
   203: #define SHOW_OBJ_LONG     0
   204: #define SHOW_OBJ_SHORT    1
   205: #define SHOW_OBJ_ACTION   2
   206: 
   207: static void show_obj_to_char(struct obj_data *obj, struct char_data *ch, int mode)
   208: {
   209:   int found = 0;
   210:   struct char_data *temp;
   211:   char obj_tags[256];
   212: 
   213:   if (!obj || !ch) {
   214:     log("SYSERR: NULL pointer in show_obj_to_char(): obj=%p ch=%p", (void *)obj, (void *)ch);
   215:     /*  SYSERR_DESC: Somehow a NULL pointer was sent to show_obj_to_char() in
   216:      *  either the 'obj' or the 'ch' variable.  The error will indicate which
   217:      *  was NULL by listing both of the pointers passed to it.  This is often a
   218:      *  difficult one to trace, and may require stepping through a debugger. */
   219:     return;
   220:   }
   221: 
   222:   if ((mode == 0) && obj->description) {
   223:     if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1) != 0 || OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(obj)) {
   224:       for (temp = OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(obj); temp; temp = NEXT_SITTING(temp)) {
   225:         if (temp == ch)
   226:           found++;
   227:       }
   228:       if (found) {
   229:         send_to_char(ch, "You are %s upon %s.", GET_POS(ch) == POS_SITTING ? "sitting" :
   230:         "resting", obj->short_description);
   231:         goto end;
   232:       }
   233:     }
   234:   }
   235: 
   236:   switch (mode) {
   237:   case SHOW_OBJ_LONG:
   238:     /* Hide objects starting with . from non-holylighted people. - Elaseth */
   239:     if (*obj->description == '.' && (IS_NPC(ch) || !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_HOLYLIGHT)))
   240:       return;
   241: 
   242:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_SHOWVNUMS)) {
   243:       send_to_char(ch, "%s[%d] ", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj));
   244:       if (SCRIPT(obj)) {
   245:         if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj))->next)
   246:           send_to_char(ch, "[T%d] ", GET_TRIG_VNUM(TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj))));
   247:         else
   248:           send_to_char(ch, "[TRIGS] ");
   249:       }
   250:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   251:     }
   252:     build_obj_aura_tags(obj, ch, obj_tags, sizeof(obj_tags), TRUE);
   253:     send_to_char(ch, "%s%s", obj_tags, obj->description);
   254:     
   255:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));break;
   256: 
   257:   case SHOW_OBJ_SHORT:
   258:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_SHOWVNUMS)) {
   259:       send_to_char(ch, "%s[%d] ", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj));
   260:       if (SCRIPT(obj)) {
   261:         if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj))->next)
   262:           send_to_char(ch, "[T%d] ", GET_TRIG_VNUM(TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj))));
   263:         else
   264:           send_to_char(ch, "[TRIGS] ");
   265:       }
   266:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   267:     }
   268:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && (obj->carried_by == ch || obj->worn_by == ch))
   269:       build_player_kept_marker(obj, ch, obj_tags, sizeof(obj_tags));
   270:     else
   271:       build_obj_aura_tags(obj, ch, obj_tags, sizeof(obj_tags), TRUE);
   272:     send_to_char(ch, "%s%s", obj_tags, obj->short_description);
   273:     break;
   274: 
   275:   case SHOW_OBJ_ACTION:
   276:     switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj)) {
   277:     case ITEM_NOTE:
   278:       if (obj->action_description) {
   279:         char notebuf[MAX_NOTE_LENGTH + 64];
   280: 
   281:         snprintf(notebuf, sizeof(notebuf), "There is something written on it:\r\n\r\n%s", obj->action_description);
   282:         page_string(ch->desc, notebuf, TRUE);
   283:       } else
   284:     send_to_char(ch, "It's blank.\r\n");
   285:       return;
   286: 
   287:     case ITEM_DRINKCON:
   288:       send_to_char(ch, "It looks like a drink container.");
   289:       break;
   290: 
   291:     default:
   292:       send_to_char(ch, "You see nothing special..");
   293:       break;
   294:     }
   295:     break;
   296: 
   297:   default:
   298:     log("SYSERR: Bad display mode (%d) in show_obj_to_char().", mode);
   299:     /*  SYSERR_DESC:  show_obj_to_char() has some predefined 'mode's (argument
   300:      *  #3) to tell it what to display to the character when it is called.  If
   301:      *  the mode is not one of these, it will output this error, and indicate
   302:      *  what mode was passed to it.  To correct it, you will need to find the
   303:      *  call with the incorrect mode and change it to an acceptable mode. */
   304:     return;
   305:   }
   306:   end:
   307: 
   308:   if (mode == SHOW_OBJ_ACTION)
   309:     show_obj_modifiers(obj, ch);
   310:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   311: }
   312: 
   313: static void show_obj_modifiers(struct obj_data *obj, struct char_data *ch)
   314: {
   315:   char obj_tags[256];
   316: 
   317:   build_obj_aura_tags(obj, ch, obj_tags, sizeof(obj_tags), TRUE);
   318:   send_to_char(ch, " %s", obj_tags);
   319: }

   321: static void build_player_kept_marker(struct obj_data *obj, struct char_data *ch, char *out, size_t outsz)
   322: {
   323:   if (!out || outsz == 0)
   324:     return;
   325: 
   326:   out[0] = '\0';
   327:   if (obj && OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_KEPT))
   328:     out_append(out, outsz, "\tr[Kept]\tn ");
   329: }
   330: 
   331: static void list_obj_to_char(struct obj_data *list, struct char_data *ch, int mode, int show)
   332: {
   333:   struct obj_data *i, *j, *display;
   334:   bool found;
   335:   int num;
   336: 
   337:   found = FALSE;
   338: 
   339:   /* Loop through the list of objects */
   340:   for (i = list; i; i = i->next_content) {
   341:     num = 0;
   342: 
   343:     /* Check the list to see if we've already counted this object */
   344:     for (j = list; j != i; j = j->next_content)
   345:       if ((j->short_description == i->short_description && j->name == i->name) ||
   346:           (!strcmp(j->short_description, i->short_description) && !strcmp(j->name, i->name)))
   347:         break; /* found a matching object */
   348:     if (j != i)
   349:       continue; /* we counted object i earlier in the list */
   350: 
   351:     /* Count matching objects, including this one */
   352:     for (display = j = i; j; j = j->next_content)
   353:       /* This if-clause should be exactly the same as the one in the loop above */
   354:       if ((j->short_description == i->short_description && j->name == i->name) ||
   355:           (!strcmp(j->short_description, i->short_description) && !strcmp(j->name, i->name)))
   356:         if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, j)) {
   357:           ++num;
   358:           /* If the original item can't be seen, switch it for this one */
   359:           if (display == i && !CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, display))
   360:             display = j;
   361:         }
   362: 
   363:     /* When looking in room, hide objects starting with '.', except for holylight */
   364:     if (num > 0 && (mode != SHOW_OBJ_LONG || *display->description != '.' ||
   365:         (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_HOLYLIGHT)))) {
   366:       if (num != 1) {
   367:         if (mode == SHOW_OBJ_LONG)
   368:           send_to_char(ch, "(%2i) ", num);
   369:         else if (mode == SHOW_OBJ_SHORT)
   370:           send_to_char(ch, "%dx ", num);
   371:       }
   372:       show_obj_to_char(display, ch, mode);
   373:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   374:       found = TRUE;
   375:     }
   376:   }
   377:   if (!found && show)
   378:     send_to_char(ch, "  Nothing.\r\n");
   379: }
   380: 
   381: static void diag_char_to_char(struct char_data *i, struct char_data *ch)
   382: {
   383:   struct {
   384:     byte percent;
   385:     const char *text;
   386:   } diagnosis[] = {
   387:     { 100, "is in excellent condition."            },
   388:     {  90, "has a few scratches."            },
   389:     {  75, "has some small wounds and bruises."        },
   390:     {  50, "has quite a few wounds."            },
   391:     {  30, "has some big nasty wounds and scratches."    },
   392:     {  15, "looks pretty hurt."                },
   393:     {   0, "is in awful condition."            },
   394:     {  -1, "is bleeding awfully from big wounds."    },
   395:   };
   396:   int percent, ar_index;
   397:   const char *pers = PERS(i, ch);
   398: 
   399:   if (GET_MAX_HIT(i) > 0)
   400:     percent = (100 * GET_HIT(i)) / GET_MAX_HIT(i);
   401:   else
   402:     percent = -1;        /* How could MAX_HIT be < 1?? */
   403: 
   404:   for (ar_index = 0; diagnosis[ar_index].percent >= 0; ar_index++)
   405:     if (percent >= diagnosis[ar_index].percent)
   406:       break;
   407: 
   408:   send_to_char(ch, "%c%s %s\r\n", UPPER(*pers), pers + 1, diagnosis[ar_index].text);
   409: }
   410: 
   411: static void look_at_char(struct char_data *i, struct char_data *ch)
   412: {
   413:   if (!ch->desc)
   414:     return;
   415: 
   416:    if (i->player.description)
   417:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", i->player.description);
   418:   else
   419:     act("You see nothing special about $m.", FALSE, i, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   420: 
   421:   diag_char_to_char(i, ch);
   422:   if (IS_NPC(i)) {
   423:     show_mob_equipment_to_char(ch, i);
   424: 
   425:     if (ch != i && can_view_mob_inventory(ch, i)) {
   426:       act("\r\nYou size up what $n is carrying:", FALSE, i, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   427:       if (i->carrying)
   428:         list_obj_to_char(i->carrying, ch, SHOW_OBJ_SHORT, TRUE);
   429:       else
   430:         send_to_char(ch, " Nothing.\r\n");
   431:     }
   432:   }
   433: }
   434: 
   435: static int can_view_mob_inventory(struct char_data *viewer, struct char_data *target)
   436: {
   437:   if (!viewer || !target || !IS_NPC(target))
   438:     return FALSE;
   439: 
   440:   if (GET_LEVEL(viewer) >= LVL_IMMORT)
   441:     return TRUE;
   442: 
   443:   if (IS_THIEF(viewer))
   444:     return TRUE;
   445: 
   446:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(viewer, AFF_TRUESIGHT))
   447:     return TRUE;
   448: 
   449:   return FALSE;
   450: }
   451: 
   452: static void show_mob_equipment_to_char(struct char_data *viewer, struct char_data *target)
   453: {
   454:   int j, found = FALSE;
   455: 
   456:   if (!viewer || !target)
   457:     return;
   458: 
   459:   for (j = 0; !found && j < NUM_WEARS; j++)
   460:     if (GET_EQ(target, j) && CAN_SEE_OBJ(viewer, GET_EQ(target, j)))
   461:       found = TRUE;
   462: 
   463:   if (!found)
   464:     return;
   465: 
   466:   send_to_char(viewer, "\r\n");
   467:   act("$n is using:", FALSE, target, 0, viewer, TO_VICT);
   468:   for (j = 0; j < NUM_WEARS; j++) {
   469:     struct obj_data *obj = GET_EQ(target, j);
   470:     if (!obj || !CAN_SEE_OBJ(viewer, obj))
   471:       continue;
   472: 
   473:     send_to_char(viewer, "%s", wear_where[j]);
   474:     if (GET_LEVEL(viewer) >= LVL_IMMORT)
   475:       send_to_char(viewer, "[%d] %s\r\n", GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description);
   476:     else
   477:       send_to_char(viewer, "%s\r\n", obj->short_description);
   478:   }
   479: }

   481: static void list_one_char(struct char_data *i, struct char_data *ch)
   482: {
   483:   struct obj_data *furniture;
   484:   char tags[256];
   485:   const char *positions[] = {
   486:     " is lying here, dead.",
   487:     " is lying here, mortally wounded.",
   488:     " is lying here, incapacitated.",
   489:     " is lying here, stunned.",
   490:     " is sleeping here.",
   491:     " is resting here.",
   492:     " is sitting here.",
   493:     "!FIGHTING!",
   494:     " is standing here."
   495:   };
   496: 
   497:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_SHOWVNUMS)) {
   498:     if (IS_NPC(i) || (SCRIPT(i) && TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(i))))
   499:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM));
   500:     if (IS_NPC(i))
   501:       send_to_char(ch, "[%d] ", GET_MOB_VNUM(i));
   502:     if (SCRIPT(i) && TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(i))) {
   503:       if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(i))->next)
   504:         send_to_char(ch, "[T%d] ", GET_TRIG_VNUM(TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(i))));
   505:       else
   506:         send_to_char(ch, "[TRIGS] ");
   507:     }
   508:     if (IS_NPC(i) || (SCRIPT(i) && TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(i))))
   509:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   510:   }
   511: 
   512:   if (GROUP(i)) {
   513:     if (GROUP(i) == GROUP(ch))
   514:       send_to_char(ch, "(%s%s%s) ", CBGRN(ch, C_NRM),
   515:               GROUP_LEADER(GROUP(i)) == i ? "leader" : "group",
   516:               CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   517:     else
   518:       send_to_char(ch, "(%s%s%s) ", CBRED(ch, C_NRM),
   519:               GROUP_LEADER(GROUP(i)) == i ? "leader" : "group",
   520:               CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   521:   }
   522: 
   523:   if (IS_NPC(i) && i->player.long_descr && GET_POS(i) == GET_DEFAULT_POS(i)) {
   524:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_INVISIBLE))
   525:       send_to_char(ch, "*");
   526:     build_visible_target_tags(ch, i, tags, sizeof(tags), FALSE);
   527:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", tags);
   528:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", i->player.long_descr);
   529: 
   530:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_SANCTUARY))
   531:       act("...$e glows with a bright light!", FALSE, i, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   532:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_BLIND) && GET_LEVEL(i) < LVL_IMMORT)
   533:       act("...$e is groping around blindly!", FALSE, i, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   534: 
   535:     return;
   536:   }
   537: 
   538:   build_visible_target_tags(ch, i, tags, sizeof(tags), FALSE);
   539:   if (*tags)
   540:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", tags);
   541: 
   542:   if (IS_NPC(i))
   543:     send_to_char(ch, "%c%s", UPPER(*i->player.short_descr), i->player.short_descr + 1);
   544:   else
   545:     send_to_char(ch, "%s%s%s", i->player.name, *GET_TITLE(i) ? " " : "", GET_TITLE(i));
   546: 
   547:   if (!IS_NPC(i) && !i->desc)
   548:     send_to_char(ch, " (linkless)");
   549:   if (!IS_NPC(i) && PLR_FLAGGED(i, PLR_WRITING))
   550:     send_to_char(ch, " (writing)");
   551:   if (!IS_NPC(i) && PRF_FLAGGED(i, PRF_BUILDWALK))
   552:     send_to_char(ch, " (buildwalk)");
   553:   if (!IS_NPC(i) && PRF_FLAGGED(i, PRF_AFK))
   554:     send_to_char(ch, " (AFK)");
   555: 
   556:   if (GET_POS(i) != POS_FIGHTING) {
   557:     if (!SITTING(i))
   558:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", positions[(int) GET_POS(i)]);
   559:     else {
   560:       furniture = SITTING(i);
   561:       send_to_char(ch, " is %s upon %s.", (GET_POS(i) == POS_SLEEPING ?
   562:         "sleeping" : (GET_POS(i) == POS_RESTING ? "resting" : "sitting")),
   563:         OBJS(furniture, ch));
   564:     }
   565:   } else {
   566:     if (FIGHTING(i)) {
   567:       send_to_char(ch, " is here, fighting ");
   568:       if (FIGHTING(i) == ch)
   569:         send_to_char(ch, "YOU!");
   570:       else {
   571:         if (IN_ROOM(i) == IN_ROOM(FIGHTING(i)))
   572:           send_to_char(ch, "%s!", PERS(FIGHTING(i), ch));
   573:         else
   574:           send_to_char(ch,  "someone who has already left!");
   575:       }
   576:     } else            /* NIL fighting pointer */
   577:       send_to_char(ch, " is here struggling with thin air.");
   578:   }
   579: 
   580:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   581: 
   582:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_SANCTUARY))
   583:     act("...$e glows with a bright light!", FALSE, i, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   584: }

   586: static void list_char_to_char(struct char_data *list, struct char_data *ch)
   587: {
   588:   struct char_data *i;
   589: 
   590:   for (i = list; i; i = i->next_in_room)
   591:     if (ch != i) {
   592:       /* hide npcs whose description starts with a '.' from non-holylighted people - Idea from Elaseth of TBA */
   593:       if (!IS_NPC(ch) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_HOLYLIGHT) &&
   594:              IS_NPC(i) && i->player.long_descr && *i->player.long_descr == '.')
   595:         continue;
   596:       if (CAN_SEE(ch, i))
   597:         list_one_char(i, ch);
   598:       else if (IS_DARK(IN_ROOM(ch)) && !CAN_SEE_IN_DARK(ch) &&
   599:            AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_INFRAVISION))
   600:         send_to_char(ch, "You see a pair of glowing red eyes looking your way.\r\n");
   601:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   602:     }
   603: }

   605: static void do_auto_exits(struct char_data *ch)
   606: {
   607:   int door, slen = 0;
   608:   static const int exit_order[] = { 0, 3, 2, 1, 4, 5 }; /* N W S E U D */
   609:   int ord;
   610: 
   611:   send_to_char(ch, "%s[ Exits: ", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM));
   612: 
   613:   for (ord = 0; ord < (int)(sizeof(exit_order) / sizeof(exit_order[0])) && ord < DIR_COUNT; ord++) {
   614:     door = exit_order[ord];
   615:     if (!EXIT(ch, door) || EXIT(ch, door)->to_room == NOWHERE)
   616:       continue;
   617:     if (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_CLOSED) && !CONFIG_DISP_CLOSED_DOORS)
   618:       continue;
   619:     if (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_HIDDEN) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_HOLYLIGHT))
   620:       continue;
   621:     if (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_CLOSED))
   622:       send_to_char(ch, "%s(%s)%s ", EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_HIDDEN) ? CCWHT(ch, C_NRM) : CCRED(ch, C_NRM), autoexits[door], CCCYN(ch, C_NRM));
   623:     else if (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_HIDDEN))
   624:       send_to_char(ch, "%s%s%s ", CCWHT(ch, C_NRM), autoexits[door], CCCYN(ch, C_NRM));
   625:     else
   626:       send_to_char(ch, "\t(%s\t) ", autoexits[door]);
   627:     slen++;
   628:   }
   629: 
   630:   send_to_char(ch, "%s]%s\r\n", slen ? "" : "None!", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   631: }
   632: 
   633: ACMD(do_exits)
   634: {
   635:   int door, len = 0;
   636:   static const int exit_order[] = { 0, 3, 2, 1, 4, 5 }; /* N W S E U D */
   637:   int ord;
   638: 
   639:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_BLIND) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)
   640:   {
   641:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't see a damned thing, you're blind!\r\n");
   642:     return;
   643:   }
   644: 
   645:   send_to_char(ch, "Obvious exits:\r\n");
   646: 
   647:   for (ord = 0; ord < (int)(sizeof(exit_order) / sizeof(exit_order[0])) && ord < DIR_COUNT; ord++) {
   648:     door = exit_order[ord];
   649:     if (!EXIT(ch, door) || EXIT(ch, door)->to_room == NOWHERE)
   650:       continue;
   651:     if (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_CLOSED) && !CONFIG_DISP_CLOSED_DOORS)
   652:       continue;
   653:     if (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_HIDDEN) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_HOLYLIGHT))
   654:       continue;
   655: 
   656:     len++;
   657: 
   658:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_SHOWVNUMS) && !EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_CLOSED))
   659:     {
   660:       send_to_char(ch, "%-5s -[%5d]%s %s\r\n", dirs[door], GET_ROOM_VNUM(EXIT(ch, door)->to_room),
   661:         EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_HIDDEN) ? "[HIDDEN]" : "", world[EXIT(ch, door)->to_room].name);
   662:     }
   663:     else if (CONFIG_DISP_CLOSED_DOORS && EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_CLOSED))
   664:     {
   665:       /*But we tell them the door is closed */
   666:       send_to_char(ch, "%-5s - The %s is closed%s\r\n", dirs[door],
   667:         (EXIT(ch, door)->keyword) ? fname(EXIT(ch, door)->keyword) : "opening",
   668:         EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_HIDDEN) ? " and hidden." : ".");
   669:     }
   670:     else
   671:     {
   672:       send_to_char(ch, "%-5s - %s\r\n", dirs[door], IS_DARK(EXIT(ch, door)->to_room) &&
   673:         !CAN_SEE_IN_DARK(ch) ? "Too dark to tell." : world[EXIT(ch, door)->to_room].name);
   674:     }
   675:   }
   676:   if (!len)
   677:     send_to_char(ch, " None.\r\n");
   678: }
   679: 
   680: static bool compass_exit_visible(struct char_data *ch, int dir)
   681: {
   682:   struct room_direction_data *ex = EXIT(ch, dir);
   683: 
   684:   if (!ex || ex->to_room == NOWHERE)
   685:     return FALSE;
   686: 
   687:   /* Mirror exit display rules. */
   688:   if (EXIT_FLAGGED(ex, EX_CLOSED) && !CONFIG_DISP_CLOSED_DOORS)
   689:     return FALSE;
   690: 
   691:   if (EXIT_FLAGGED(ex, EX_HIDDEN) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_HOLYLIGHT))
   692:     return FALSE;
   693: 
   694:   return TRUE;
   695: }

   697: /* Map centering preference uses an unused PRF flag slot. */
   698: #define PRF_MAPCENTER PRF_UNUSED4
   699: 
   700: static size_t visible_strlen_ansi(const char *s)
   701: {
   702:   size_t len = 0;
   703: 
   704:   if (!s)
   705:     return 0;
   706: 
   707:   while (*s) {
   708:     if (*s == '\r' || *s == '\n') {
   709:       s++;
   710:       continue;
   711:     }
   712: 
   713:     if (*s == '\t' && *(s + 1)) {
   714:       s += 2;
   715:       continue;
   716:     }
   717: 
   718:     if (*s == '@' && *(s + 1)) {
   719:       s += 2;
   720:       continue;
   721:     }
   722: 
   723:     if (*s == '\033') {
   724:       s++;
   725:       if (*s == '[') {
   726:         s++;
   727:         while (*s && *s != 'm')
   728:           s++;
   729:         if (*s == 'm')
   730:           s++;
   731:       } else if (*s) {
   732:         s++;
   733:       }
   734:       continue;
   735:     }
   736: 
   737:     len++;
   738:     s++;
   739:   }
   740: 
   741:   return len;
   742: }
   743: 
   744: static size_t map_screen_width(const struct char_data *ch)
   745: {
   746:   if (ch && ch->desc && ch->desc->pProtocol && ch->desc->pProtocol->bMSDP &&
   747:       ch->desc->pProtocol->ScreenWidth > 0)
   748:     return (size_t)ch->desc->pProtocol->ScreenWidth;
   749: 
   750:   if (ch && !IS_NPC(ch) && GET_SCREEN_WIDTH(ch) > 0)
   751:     return (size_t)GET_SCREEN_WIDTH(ch);
   752: 
   753:   return 80;
   754: }
