   756: static bool room_has_shopkeeper(room_rnum rnum)
   757: {
   758:   struct char_data *mob;
   759: 
   760:   if (!VALID_ROOM_RNUM(rnum))
   761:     return FALSE;
   762: 
   763:   for (mob = world[rnum].people; mob; mob = mob->next_in_room) {
   764:     if (!IS_MOB(mob))
   765:       continue;
   766: 
   767:     if (GET_MOB_SPEC(mob) == shop_keeper)
   768:       return TRUE;
   769: 
   770:     if (shop_index) {
   771:       int shop;
   772: 
   773:       for (shop = 0; shop <= top_shop; shop++) {
   774:         if (SHOP_KEEPER(shop) == GET_MOB_RNUM(mob))
   775:           return TRUE;
   776:       }
   777:     }
   778:   }
   779: 
   780:   return FALSE;
   781: }
   782: 
   783: static bool room_has_guildmaster(room_rnum rnum)
   784: {
   785:   struct char_data *mob;
   786: 
   787:   if (!VALID_ROOM_RNUM(rnum))
   788:     return FALSE;
   789: 
   790:   for (mob = world[rnum].people; mob; mob = mob->next_in_room) {
   791:     if (!IS_MOB(mob))
   792:       continue;
   793: 
   794:     if (GET_MOB_SPEC(mob) == guild || MOB_FLAGGED(mob, MOB_GUILD_MASTER))
   795:       return TRUE;
   796:   }
   797: 
   798:   return FALSE;
   799: }
   800: 
   801: static bool room_has_board(room_rnum rnum)
   802: {
   803:   struct obj_data *obj;
   804: 
   805:   if (!VALID_ROOM_RNUM(rnum))
   806:     return FALSE;
   807: 
   808:   for (obj = world[rnum].contents; obj; obj = obj->next_content) {
   809:     if (GET_OBJ_SPEC(obj) == gen_board)
   810:       return TRUE;
   811: 
   812:     if (obj->item_number != NOTHING) {
   813:       int board;
   814: 
   815:       for (board = 0; board < NUM_OF_BOARDS; board++) {
   816:         if (BOARD_RNUM(board) == obj->item_number)
   817:           return TRUE;
   818:       }
   819:     }
   820:   }
   821: 
   822:   return FALSE;
   823: }
   824: 
   825: static bool room_has_quest_or_spec(room_rnum rnum)
   826: {
   827:   struct char_data *mob;
   828: 
   829:   if (!VALID_ROOM_RNUM(rnum))
   830:     return FALSE;
   831: 
   832:   if (GET_ROOM_SPEC(rnum) != NULL)
   833:     return TRUE;
   834: 
   835:   for (mob = world[rnum].people; mob; mob = mob->next_in_room) {
   836:     if (!IS_MOB(mob))
   837:       continue;
   838: 
   839:     if (GET_MOB_SPEC(mob) == questmaster)
   840:       return TRUE;
   841:   }
   842: 
   843:   return FALSE;
   844: }
   845: 
   846: static char room_poi_marker(room_rnum rnum)
   847: {
   848:   if (!VALID_ROOM_RNUM(rnum))
   849:     return ' ';
   850: 
   851:   if (room_has_shopkeeper(rnum))
   852:     return '$';
   853: 
   854:   if (room_has_guildmaster(rnum))
   855:     return 'G';
   856: 
   857:   if (room_has_board(rnum))
   858:     return 'B';
   859: 
   860:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(rnum, ROOM_DEATH))
   861:     return '!';
   862: 
   863:   if (room_has_quest_or_spec(rnum))
   864:     return '?';
   865: 
   866:   return ' ';
   867: }
   868: 
   869: static void append_map_line(char *out, size_t outsz, const char *line, size_t indent)
   870: {
   871:   size_t len;
   872:   int nlen;
   873: 
   874:   if (!out || outsz == 0 || !line)
   875:     return;
   876: 
   877:   len = strlen(out);
   878:   if (len >= outsz)
   879:     return;
   880: 
   881:   nlen = snprintf(out + len, outsz - len, "%*s%s\r\n", (int)indent, "", line);
   882:   if (nlen < 0)
   883:     out[outsz - 1] = '\0';
   884: }
   885: 
   886: 
   887: /* Safe append that does not rely on strlcat(). */
   888: static void out_append(char *dst, size_t dstsz, const char *src)
   889: {
   890:   size_t len;
   891: 
   892:   if (!dst || dstsz == 0)
   893:     return;
   894: 
   895:   if (!src)
   896:     src = "";
   897: 
   898:   len = strlen(dst);
   899:   if (len >= dstsz)
   900:     return;
   901: 
   902:   snprintf(dst + len, dstsz - len, "%s", src);
   903: }
   904: 
   905: const char *get_aura_color(int aura_flag)
   906: {
   907:   switch (aura_flag) {
   908:     case AURA_ANIMATED:   return BMAG;
   909:     case AURA_ANGRY:      return BRED;
   910:     case AURA_CHARMED:    return BCYN;
   911:     case AURA_DISEASED:   return KBLU;
   912:     case AURA_FLYING:     return BCYN;
   913:     case AURA_GOLDEN:     return BYEL;
   914:     case AURA_HIDDEN:     return KWHT;
   915:     case AURA_INVIS:      return KWHT;
   916:     case AURA_MARKED:     return KWHT;
   917:     case AURA_OPK:        return BMAG;
   918:     case AURA_PLAYER:     return BWHT;
   919:     case AURA_RED:        return BRED;
   920:     case AURA_STEALTH:    return BCYN;
   921:     case AURA_TRANSLUCENT:return KWHT;
   922:     case AURA_UNDEAD:     return BRED;
   923:     case AURA_WHITE:      return BWHT;
   924:     case AURA_WOUNDED:    return BRED;
   925:     case AURA_BLUE_OBJ:   return BBLU;
   926:     case AURA_GLOW_OBJ:   return BYEL;
   927:     case AURA_HUM_OBJ:    return BCYN;
   928:     case AURA_KEEP_OBJ:   return BRED;
   929:     case AURA_MAGIC_OBJ:  return BBLU;
   930:     case AURA_CURSED_OBJ: return KWHT;
   931:     case AURA_TEMPERED_OBJ:return BRED;
   932:     case AURA_ENVENOMED_OBJ:return BGRN;
   933:     case AURA_ITEM:       return BWHT;
   934:     default:              return KNRM;
   935:   }
   936: }
   937: 
   938: static void append_colored_aura_tag(struct char_data *viewer, char *out, size_t outsz,
   939:                                     int aura_flag, const char *label)
   940: {
   941:   char tagbuf[96];
   942:   const char *clr = "";
   943:   const char *reset = "";
   944: 
   945:   if (!out || !label)
   946:     return;
   947: 
   948:   if (viewer && clr(viewer, C_NRM)) {
   949:     clr = get_aura_color(aura_flag);
   950:     reset = KNRM;
   951:   }
   952: 
   953:   snprintf(tagbuf, sizeof(tagbuf), "%s%s%s ", clr, label, reset);
   954:   out_append(out, outsz, tagbuf);
   955: }
   956: 
   957: static void append_char_aura_tag(struct char_data *viewer, char *out, size_t outsz,
   958:                                  int aura_flag, const char *long_tag, const char *short_tag,
   959:                                  int shortflags)
   960: {
   961:   const char *label = (shortflags && short_tag) ? short_tag : long_tag;
   962: 
   963:   if (!label)
   964:     return;
   965: 
   966:   if (aura_flag == AURA_MARKED && shortflags && short_tag)
   967:     append_colored_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_RED, label);
   968:   else
   969:     append_colored_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, aura_flag, label);
   970: }
   971: 
   972: static bool obj_has_envenomed_state(const struct obj_data *obj)
   973: {
   974:   if (!obj)
   975:     return FALSE;
   976: 
   977:   if ((GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_DRINKCON || GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_FOUNTAIN || GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_FOOD) &&
   978:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3) > 0)
   979:     return TRUE;
   980: 
   981:   return FALSE;
   982: }
   983: 
   984: static bool obj_has_tempered_state(const struct obj_data *obj)
   985: {
   986:   if (!obj)
   987:     return FALSE;
   988: 
   989:   return (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON && OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_ANTI_EVIL));
   990: }
   991: 
   992: static void build_obj_aura_tags(struct obj_data *obj, struct char_data *ch, char *out, size_t outsz, int include_item_tag)
   993: {
   994:   int shortflags = (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_SHORTFLAGS));
   995: 
   996:   if (!out || outsz == 0)
   997:     return;
   998: 
   999:   out[0] = '\0';
  1000:   if (include_item_tag)
  1001:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, AURA_ITEM, "(Item)");
  1002: 
  1003:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_MAGIC) && AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_DETECT_MAGIC))
  1004:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, AURA_MAGIC_OBJ, shortflags ? "(M)" : "(Magic)");
  1005: 
  1006:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_BLESS) && AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_DETECT_ALIGN))
  1007:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, AURA_BLUE_OBJ, shortflags ? "(B)" : "(Blue Aura)");
  1008: 
  1009:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_GLOW))
  1010:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, AURA_GLOW_OBJ, shortflags ? "(G)" : "(Glow)");
  1011: 
  1012:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_HUM))
  1013:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, AURA_HUM_OBJ, shortflags ? "(H)" : "(Hum)");
  1014: 
  1015:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_INVISIBLE))
  1016:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, AURA_INVIS, shortflags ? "(I)" : "(Invis)");
  1017: 
  1018:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_NODROP))
  1019:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, shortflags ? AURA_KEEP_OBJ : AURA_CURSED_OBJ,
  1020:                             shortflags ? "(K)" : "(Cursed)");
  1021: 
  1022:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_ANTI_GOOD))
  1023:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, AURA_RED, shortflags ? "(R)" : "(Red Aura)");
  1024: 
  1025:   if (obj_has_tempered_state(obj))
  1026:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, AURA_TEMPERED_OBJ, shortflags ? "(T)" : "(Tempered)");
  1027: 
  1028:   if (obj_has_envenomed_state(obj))
  1029:     append_colored_aura_tag(ch, out, outsz, AURA_ENVENOMED_OBJ, shortflags ? "(E)" : "(Envenomed)");
  1030: }
  1031: 
  1032: static void build_room_compass_map(struct char_data *ch, struct room_data *room,
  1033:                                    char *out, size_t outsz)
  1034: {
  1035:   bool has_n = FALSE;
  1036:   bool has_e = FALSE;
  1037:   bool has_s = FALSE;
  1038:   bool has_w = FALSE;
  1039:   room_rnum to_n = NOWHERE;
  1040:   room_rnum to_e = NOWHERE;
  1041:   room_rnum to_s = NOWHERE;
  1042:   room_rnum to_w = NOWHERE;
  1043:   const char *box = CCFWHT(ch, C_NRM);
  1044:   const char *x_color = CCFYEL(ch, C_NRM);
  1045:   const char *reset = CCNRM(ch, C_NRM);
  1046:   const char *blank = "     ";
  1047:   const char *gap = " ";
  1048:   bool center_map = FALSE;
  1049:   size_t map_width = 0;
  1050:   size_t indent = 0;
  1051:   int line = 0;
  1052:   char north_marker = ' ';
  1053:   char east_marker = ' ';
  1054:   char south_marker = ' ';
  1055:   char west_marker = ' ';
  1056:   char north_top[32];
  1057:   char north_mid[64];
  1058:   char north_bot[32];
  1059:   char south_top[32];
  1060:   char south_mid[64];
  1061:   char south_bot[32];
  1062:   char west_top[32];
  1063:   char west_mid[64];
  1064:   char west_bot[32];
  1065:   char east_top[32];
  1066:   char east_mid[64];
  1067:   char east_bot[32];
  1068:   char center_top[32];
  1069:   char center_mid[64];
  1070:   char center_bot[32];
  1071:   char connector_n[32];
  1072:   char connector_s[32];
  1073:   char connector_w[16];
  1074:   char connector_e[16];
  1075:   char lines[11][512];
  1076: 
  1077:   (void)room;
  1078: 
  1079:   if (!out || outsz == 0)
  1080:     return;
  1081: 
  1082:   has_n = compass_exit_visible(ch, NORTH);
  1083:   has_e = compass_exit_visible(ch, EAST);
  1084:   has_s = compass_exit_visible(ch, SOUTH);
  1085:   has_w = compass_exit_visible(ch, WEST);
  1086: 
  1087:   to_n = (has_n && EXIT(ch, NORTH)) ? EXIT(ch, NORTH)->to_room : NOWHERE;
  1088:   to_e = (has_e && EXIT(ch, EAST)) ? EXIT(ch, EAST)->to_room : NOWHERE;
  1089:   to_s = (has_s && EXIT(ch, SOUTH)) ? EXIT(ch, SOUTH)->to_room : NOWHERE;
  1090:   to_w = (has_w && EXIT(ch, WEST)) ? EXIT(ch, WEST)->to_room : NOWHERE;
  1091: 
  1092:   if (has_n && to_n != NOWHERE)
  1093:     north_marker = room_poi_marker(to_n);
  1094:   if (has_e && to_e != NOWHERE)
  1095:     east_marker = room_poi_marker(to_e);
  1096:   if (has_s && to_s != NOWHERE)
  1097:     south_marker = room_poi_marker(to_s);
  1098:   if (has_w && to_w != NOWHERE)
  1099:     west_marker = room_poi_marker(to_w);
  1100: 
  1101:   if (has_n) {
  1102:     snprintf(north_top, sizeof(north_top), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1103:     snprintf(north_mid, sizeof(north_mid), "%s|%s %c %s|%s", box, reset, north_marker, box, reset);
  1104:     snprintf(north_bot, sizeof(north_bot), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1105:   } else {
  1106:     snprintf(north_top, sizeof(north_top), "%s", blank);
  1107:     snprintf(north_mid, sizeof(north_mid), "%s", blank);
  1108:     snprintf(north_bot, sizeof(north_bot), "%s", blank);
  1109:   }
  1110: 
  1111:   if (has_s) {
  1112:     snprintf(south_top, sizeof(south_top), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1113:     snprintf(south_mid, sizeof(south_mid), "%s|%s %c %s|%s", box, reset, south_marker, box, reset);
  1114:     snprintf(south_bot, sizeof(south_bot), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1115:   } else {
  1116:     snprintf(south_top, sizeof(south_top), "%s", blank);
  1117:     snprintf(south_mid, sizeof(south_mid), "%s", blank);
  1118:     snprintf(south_bot, sizeof(south_bot), "%s", blank);
  1119:   }
  1120: 
  1121:   if (has_w) {
  1122:     snprintf(west_top, sizeof(west_top), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1123:     snprintf(west_mid, sizeof(west_mid), "%s|%s %c %s|%s", box, reset, west_marker, box, reset);
  1124:     snprintf(west_bot, sizeof(west_bot), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1125:   } else {
  1126:     snprintf(west_top, sizeof(west_top), "%s", blank);
  1127:     snprintf(west_mid, sizeof(west_mid), "%s", blank);
  1128:     snprintf(west_bot, sizeof(west_bot), "%s", blank);
  1129:   }
  1130: 
  1131:   if (has_e) {
  1132:     snprintf(east_top, sizeof(east_top), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1133:     snprintf(east_mid, sizeof(east_mid), "%s|%s %c %s|%s", box, reset, east_marker, box, reset);
  1134:     snprintf(east_bot, sizeof(east_bot), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1135:   } else {
  1136:     snprintf(east_top, sizeof(east_top), "%s", blank);
  1137:     snprintf(east_mid, sizeof(east_mid), "%s", blank);
  1138:     snprintf(east_bot, sizeof(east_bot), "%s", blank);
  1139:   }
  1140: 
  1141:   snprintf(center_top, sizeof(center_top), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1142:   snprintf(center_mid, sizeof(center_mid), "%s|%s %sX%s %s|%s", box, reset, x_color, reset, box, reset);
  1143:   snprintf(center_bot, sizeof(center_bot), "%s+---+%s", box, reset);
  1144: 
  1145:   if (has_n)
  1146:     snprintf(connector_n, sizeof(connector_n), "%s  |  %s", box, reset);
  1147:   else
  1148:     snprintf(connector_n, sizeof(connector_n), "%s", blank);
  1149: 
  1150:   if (has_s)
  1151:     snprintf(connector_s, sizeof(connector_s), "%s  |  %s", box, reset);
  1152:   else
  1153:     snprintf(connector_s, sizeof(connector_s), "%s", blank);
  1154: 
  1155:   if (has_w)
  1156:     snprintf(connector_w, sizeof(connector_w), "%s-%s", box, reset);
  1157:   else
  1158:     snprintf(connector_w, sizeof(connector_w), " ");
  1159: 
  1160:   if (has_e)
  1161:     snprintf(connector_e, sizeof(connector_e), "%s-%s", box, reset);
  1162:   else
  1163:     snprintf(connector_e, sizeof(connector_e), " ");
  1164: 
  1165:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s %s %s", blank, north_top, blank);
  1166:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s %s %s", blank, north_mid, blank);
  1167:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s %s %s", blank, north_bot, blank);
  1168:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s %s %s", blank, connector_n, blank);
  1169:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s%s%s%s%s", west_top, gap, center_top, gap, east_top);
  1170:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s%s%s%s%s", west_mid, connector_w, center_mid, connector_e, east_mid);
  1171:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s%s%s%s%s", west_bot, gap, center_bot, gap, east_bot);
  1172:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s %s %s", blank, connector_s, blank);
  1173:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s %s %s", blank, south_top, blank);
  1174:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s %s %s", blank, south_mid, blank);
  1175:   snprintf(lines[line++], sizeof(lines[0]), "%s %s %s", blank, south_bot, blank);
  1176: 
  1177:   for (line = 0; line < 11; line++) {
  1178:     size_t line_width = visible_strlen_ansi(lines[line]);
  1179: 
  1180:     if (line_width > map_width)
  1181:       map_width = line_width;
  1182:   }
  1183: 
  1184:   center_map = TRUE;
  1185: 
  1186:   if (center_map) {
  1187:     size_t screen_width = map_screen_width(ch);
  1188: 
  1189:     if (screen_width > map_width)
  1190:       indent = (screen_width - map_width) / 2;
  1191:   }
  1192: 
  1193:   out[0] = '\0';
  1194:   for (line = 0; line < 11; line++)
  1195:     append_map_line(out, outsz, lines[line], indent);
  1196: 
  1197:   out_append(out, outsz, "\r\n");
  1198: }
  1199: 
  1200: 
  1201: 
  1202: void look_at_room(struct char_data *ch, int ignore_brief)
  1203: {
  1204:   trig_data * t;
  1205:   struct room_data *rm = &world[IN_ROOM(ch)];
  1206:   room_vnum target_room;
  1207: 
  1208:   target_room = IN_ROOM(ch);
  1209: 
  1210:   if (!ch->desc)
  1211:     return;
  1212: 
  1213:   if (IS_DARK(IN_ROOM(ch)) && !CAN_SEE_IN_DARK(ch)){
  1214:     send_to_char(ch, "It is pitch black...\r\n");
  1215:     return;
  1216:   }
  1217:   else if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_BLIND) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) {
  1218:     send_to_char(ch, "You see nothing but infinite darkness...\r\n");
  1219:     return;
  1220:   }
  1221: 
  1222:   {
  1223:     char mapbuf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1224: 
  1225:     build_room_compass_map(ch, rm, mapbuf, sizeof(mapbuf));
  1226:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", mapbuf);
  1227:   }
  1228: 
  1229:   send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM));
  1230:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_SHOWVNUMS)) {
  1231:     char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1232: 
  1233:     sprintbitarray(ROOM_FLAGS(IN_ROOM(ch)), room_bits, RF_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
  1234:     send_to_char(ch, "[%5d] ", GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch)));
  1235:     send_to_char(ch, "%s[ %s][ %s ]", world[IN_ROOM(ch)].name, buf, sector_types[world[IN_ROOM(ch)].sector_type]);
  1236: 
  1237:     if (SCRIPT(rm)) {
  1238:       send_to_char(ch, "[T");
  1239:       for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(rm)); t; t = t->next)
  1240:         send_to_char(ch, " %d", GET_TRIG_VNUM(t));
  1241:       send_to_char(ch, "]");
  1242:     }
  1243:   }
  1244:   else
  1245:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", world[IN_ROOM(ch)].name);
  1246: 
  1247:   send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1248: 
  1249:   if ((!IS_NPC(ch) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_BRIEF)) || ignore_brief ||
  1250:     ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(ch), ROOM_DEATH)) {
  1251:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_AUTOMAP) && can_see_map(ch))
  1252:       str_and_map(world[target_room].description, ch, target_room);
  1253:     else
  1254:        send_to_char(ch, "%s", world[IN_ROOM(ch)].description);
  1255: 
  1256:   ensure_one_blank_line_after_desc(ch, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].description);
  1257:   }
  1258: 
  1259: 
  1260:   /*autoexits */
  1261:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_AUTOEXIT))
  1262:     do_auto_exits(ch);
  1263: 
  1264:   /*now list characters &objects */
  1265:   list_obj_to_char(world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents, ch, SHOW_OBJ_LONG, FALSE);
  1266:   list_char_to_char(world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people, ch);
  1267:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
  1268: }

  1270: static void look_in_direction(struct char_data *ch, int dir)
  1271: {
  1272:   if (EXIT(ch, dir)) {
  1273:     if (EXIT(ch, dir)->general_description)
  1274:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", EXIT(ch, dir)->general_description);
  1275:     else
  1276:       send_to_char(ch, "You see nothing special.\r\n");
  1277: 
  1278:     if (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, dir), EX_CLOSED) && EXIT(ch, dir)->keyword)
  1279:       send_to_char(ch, "The %s is closed.\r\n", fname(EXIT(ch, dir)->keyword));
  1280:     else if (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, dir), EX_ISDOOR) && EXIT(ch, dir)->keyword)
  1281:       send_to_char(ch, "The %s is open.\r\n", fname(EXIT(ch, dir)->keyword));
  1282:   } else
  1283:     send_to_char(ch, "Nothing special there...\r\n");
  1284: }

  1286: static void look_in_obj(struct char_data *ch, char *arg)
  1287: {
  1288:   struct obj_data *obj = NULL;
  1289:   struct char_data *dummy = NULL;
  1290:   int amt, bits;
  1291: 
  1292:   if (!*arg)
  1293:     send_to_char(ch, "Look in what?\r\n");
  1294:   else if (!(bits = generic_find(arg, FIND_OBJ_INV | FIND_OBJ_ROOM |
  1295:                  FIND_OBJ_EQUIP, ch, &dummy, &obj))) {
  1296:     send_to_char(ch, "There doesn't seem to be %s %s here.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
  1297:   } else if ((GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_DRINKCON) &&
  1298:          (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_FOUNTAIN) &&
  1299:          (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_CONTAINER))
  1300:     send_to_char(ch, "There's nothing inside that!\r\n");
  1301:   else {
  1302:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_CONTAINER) {
  1303:       if (OBJVAL_FLAGGED(obj, CONT_CLOSED) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT || !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE)))
  1304:         send_to_char(ch, "It is closed.\r\n");
  1305:       else {
  1306:         send_to_char(ch, "%s", fname(obj->name));
  1307:         switch (bits) {
  1308:         case FIND_OBJ_INV:
  1309:           send_to_char(ch, " (carried): \r\n");
  1310:           break;
  1311:         case FIND_OBJ_ROOM:
  1312:           send_to_char(ch, " (here): \r\n");
  1313:           break;
  1314:         case FIND_OBJ_EQUIP:
  1315:           send_to_char(ch, " (used): \r\n");
  1316:           break;
  1317:         }
  1318: 
  1319:         list_obj_to_char(obj->contains, ch, SHOW_OBJ_SHORT, TRUE);
  1320:       }
  1321:     } else {        /* item must be a fountain or drink container */
  1322:       if ((GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1) == 0) && (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0) != -1))
  1323:         send_to_char(ch, "It is empty.\r\n");
  1324:       else {
  1325:         if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0) < 0)
  1326:         {
  1327:           char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1328:           sprinttype(GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2), color_liquid, buf2, sizeof(buf2));
  1329:           send_to_char(ch, "It's full of a %s liquid.\r\n", buf2);
  1330:         }
  1331:         else if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj,1)>GET_OBJ_VAL(obj,0))
  1332:           send_to_char(ch, "Its contents seem somewhat murky.\r\n"); /* BUG */
  1333:         else
  1334:         {
  1335:           char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1336:           amt = (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1) * 3) / GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0);
  1337:           sprinttype(GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2), color_liquid, buf2, sizeof(buf2));
  1338:           send_to_char(ch, "It's %sfull of a %s liquid.\r\n", fullness[amt], buf2);
  1339:         }
  1340:       }
  1341:     }
  1342:   }
  1343: }

  1345: char *find_exdesc(char *word, struct extra_descr_data *list)
  1346: {
  1347:   struct extra_descr_data *i;
  1348: 
  1349:   for (i = list; i; i = i->next)
  1350:     if (*i->keyword == '.' ? isname(word, i->keyword + 1) : isname(word, i->keyword))
  1351:       return (i->description);
  1352: 
  1353:   return (NULL);
  1354: }

  1356: /* Given the argument "look at <target>", figure out what object or char
  1357:  * matches the target.  First, see if there is another char in the room with
  1358:  * the name.  Then check local objs for exdescs. Thanks to Angus Mezick for
  1359:  * the suggested fix to this problem. */
  1360: static void look_at_target(struct char_data *ch, char *arg)
  1361: {
  1362:   int bits, found = FALSE, j, fnum, i = 0;
  1363:   struct char_data *found_char = NULL;
  1364:   struct obj_data *obj, *found_obj = NULL;
  1365:   char *desc;
  1366: 
  1367:   if (!ch->desc)
  1368:     return;
  1369: 
  1370:   if (!*arg) {
  1371:     send_to_char(ch, "Look at what?\r\n");
  1372:     return;
  1373:   }
  1374: 
  1375:   bits = generic_find(arg, FIND_OBJ_INV | FIND_OBJ_ROOM | FIND_OBJ_EQUIP |
  1376:               FIND_CHAR_ROOM, ch, &found_char, &found_obj);
  1377: 
  1378:   /* Is the target a character? */
  1379:   if (found_char != NULL) {
  1380:     look_at_char(found_char, ch);
  1381:     if (ch != found_char) {
  1382:       if (CAN_SEE(found_char, ch))
  1383:     act("$n looks at you.", TRUE, ch, 0, found_char, TO_VICT);
  1384:       act("$n looks at $N.", TRUE, ch, 0, found_char, TO_NOTVICT);
  1385:     }
  1386:     return;
  1387:   }
  1388: 
  1389:   /* Strip off "number." from 2.foo and friends. */
  1390:   if (!(fnum = get_number(&arg))) {
  1391:     send_to_char(ch, "Look at what?\r\n");
  1392:     return;
  1393:   }
  1394: 
  1395:   /* Does the argument match an extra desc in the room? */
  1396:   if ((desc = find_exdesc(arg, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].ex_description)) != NULL && ++i == fnum) {
  1397:     page_string(ch->desc, desc, FALSE);
  1398:     return;
  1399:   }
  1400: 
  1401:   /* Does the argument match an extra desc in the char's equipment? */
  1402:   for (j = 0; j < NUM_WEARS && !found; j++)
  1403:     if (GET_EQ(ch, j) && CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, GET_EQ(ch, j)))
  1404:       if ((desc = find_exdesc(arg, GET_EQ(ch, j)->ex_description)) != NULL && ++i == fnum) {
  1405:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", desc);
  1406:     found = TRUE;
  1407:       }
  1408: 
  1409:   /* Does the argument match an extra desc in the char's inventory? */
  1410:   for (obj = ch->carrying; obj && !found; obj = obj->next_content) {
  1411:     if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj))
  1412:       if ((desc = find_exdesc(arg, obj->ex_description)) != NULL && ++i == fnum) {
  1413:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", desc);
  1414:     found = TRUE;
  1415:       }
  1416:   }
  1417: 
  1418:   /* Does the argument match an extra desc of an object in the room? */
  1419:   for (obj = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents; obj && !found; obj = obj->next_content)
  1420:     if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj))
  1421:       if ((desc = find_exdesc(arg, obj->ex_description)) != NULL && ++i == fnum) {
  1422:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", desc);
  1423:     found = TRUE;
  1424:       }
  1425: 
  1426:   /* If an object was found back in generic_find */
  1427:   if (bits) {
  1428:     if (!found)
  1429:       show_obj_to_char(found_obj, ch, SHOW_OBJ_ACTION);
  1430:     else {
  1431:       show_obj_modifiers(found_obj, ch);
  1432:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
  1433:     }
  1434:   } else if (!found)
  1435:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not see that here.\r\n");
  1436: }
  1437: 
  1438: ACMD(do_look)
  1439: {
  1440:   int look_type;
  1441:   int found = 0;
  1442:   char tempsave[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1443: 
  1444:   if (!ch->desc)
  1445:     return;
  1446: 
  1447:   if (GET_POS(ch) < POS_SLEEPING)
  1448:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't see anything but stars!\r\n");
  1449:   else if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_BLIND) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)
  1450:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't see a damned thing, you're blind!\r\n");
  1451:   else if (IS_DARK(IN_ROOM(ch)) && !CAN_SEE_IN_DARK(ch)) {
  1452:     send_to_char(ch, "It is pitch black...\r\n");
  1453:     list_char_to_char(world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people, ch);    /* glowing red eyes */
  1454:   } else {
  1455:     char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1456: 
  1457:     half_chop(argument, arg, arg2);
  1458: 
  1459:     if (subcmd == SCMD_READ) {
  1460:       if (!*arg)
  1461:     send_to_char(ch, "Read what?\r\n");
  1462:       else
  1463:     look_at_target(ch, strcpy(tempsave, arg));
  1464:       return;
  1465:     }
  1466:     if (!*arg)            /* "look" alone, without an argument at all */
  1467:       look_at_room(ch, 1);
  1468:     else if (is_abbrev(arg, "in"))
  1469:       look_in_obj(ch, arg2);
  1470:     /* did the char type 'look <direction>?' */
  1471:     else if ((look_type = search_block(arg, dirs, FALSE)) >= 0)
  1472:       look_in_direction(ch, look_type);
  1473:     else if (is_abbrev(arg, "at"))
  1474:       look_at_target(ch, strcpy(tempsave, arg2));
  1475:     else if (is_abbrev(arg, "around")) {
  1476:       struct extra_descr_data *i;
  1477: 
  1478:       for (i = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].ex_description; i; i = i->next) {
  1479:         if (*i->keyword != '.') {
  1480:           send_to_char(ch, "%s%s:\r\n%s",
  1481:           (found ? "\r\n" : ""), i->keyword, i->description);
  1482:           found = 1;
  1483:         }
  1484:       }
  1485:       if (!found)
  1486:          send_to_char(ch, "You couldn't find anything noticeable.\r\n");
  1487:     } else
  1488:       look_at_target(ch, strcpy(tempsave, arg));
  1489:   }
  1490: }

  1492: ACMD(do_examine)
  1493: {
  1494:   struct char_data *tmp_char;
  1495:   struct obj_data *tmp_object;

  1509:               FIND_OBJ_EQUIP, ch, &tmp_char, &tmp_object);
  1510: 
  1511:   if (tmp_object) {
  1512:     if ((GET_OBJ_TYPE(tmp_object) == ITEM_DRINKCON) ||
  1513:     (GET_OBJ_TYPE(tmp_object) == ITEM_FOUNTAIN) ||
  1514:     (GET_OBJ_TYPE(tmp_object) == ITEM_CONTAINER)) {
  1515:       send_to_char(ch, "When you look inside, you see:\r\n");
  1516:       look_in_obj(ch, arg);
  1517:     }
  1518:   }
  1519: }

  1533: __attribute__((unused)) static size_t visible_strlen_mud(const char *s)
  1534: {
  1535:   size_t vis = 0;
  1536: 
  1537:   while (s && *s) {
  1538:     /* \tX color code */
  1539:     if (*s == '\t' && s[1]) {
  1540:       s += 2;
  1541:       continue;
  1542:     }
  1543: 
  1544:     /* ANSI ESC[...m */
  1545:     if ((unsigned char)*s == 27 && s[1] == '[') {
  1546:       s += 2;
  1547:       while (*s && *s != 'm') s++;
  1548:       if (*s == 'm') s++;
  1549:       continue;
  1550:     }
  1551: 
  1552:     vis++;
  1553:     s++;
  1554:   }
  1555: 
  1556:   return vis;
  1557: }
  1558: 
  1559: static size_t copy_trunc_visible(char *dst, size_t dstsz, const char *src, size_t max_vis)
  1560: {
  1561:   size_t out = 0;
  1562:   size_t vis = 0;
  1563: 
  1564:   if (dstsz == 0) return 0;
  1565:   if (!src) { dst[0] = '\0'; return 0; }
  1566: 
  1567:   while (*src && out + 1 < dstsz) {
  1568:     /* \tX */
  1569:     if (*src == '\t' && src[1]) {
  1570:       if (out + 2 >= dstsz) break;
  1571:       dst[out++] = *src++;
  1572:       dst[out++] = *src++;
  1573:       continue;
  1574:     }
  1575: 
  1576:     /* ANSI ESC[...m */
  1577:     if ((unsigned char)*src == 27 && src[1] == '[') {
  1578:       if (out + 2 >= dstsz) break;
  1579:       dst[out++] = *src++;
  1580:       dst[out++] = *src++;
  1581:       while (*src && *src != 'm' && out + 1 < dstsz) dst[out++] = *src++;
  1582:       if (*src == 'm' && out + 1 < dstsz) dst[out++] = *src++;
  1583:       continue;
  1584:     }
  1585: 
  1586:     if (vis >= max_vis) break;
  1587:     dst[out++] = *src++;
  1588:     vis++;
  1589:   }
  1590: 
  1591:   dst[out] = '\0';
  1592:   return vis;
  1593: }

  1595: static bool load_player_target(struct char_data *ch, const char *name, struct char_data **out, bool *from_file)
  1596: {
  1597:   char namebuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1598:   struct char_data *vict;
  1599: 
  1600:   strlcpy(namebuf, name, sizeof(namebuf));
  1601:   vict = get_player_vis(ch, namebuf, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD);
  1602: 
  1603:   if (vict) {
  1604:     if (from_file)
  1605:       *from_file = FALSE;
  1606:     *out = vict;
  1607:     return TRUE;
  1608:   }
  1609: 
  1610:   CREATE(vict, struct char_data, 1);
  1611:   clear_char(vict);
  1612:   new_mobile_data(vict);
  1613:   CREATE(vict->player_specials, struct player_special_data, 1);
  1614: 
  1615:   const int pfilepos = load_char(name, vict);
  1616: 
  1617:   if (pfilepos > -1) {
  1618:     GET_PFILEPOS(vict) = pfilepos;
  1619:     if (from_file)
  1620:       *from_file = TRUE;
  1621:     *out = vict;
  1622:     return TRUE;
  1623:   }
  1624: 
  1625:   free_char(vict);
  1626:   return FALSE;
  1627: }
  1628: 
  1629: static bool parse_bounty_amount(const char *arg, long long *amount_out)
  1630: {
  1631:   char token[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1632:   const char *p = arg;
  1633:   long long total = 0;
  1634:   bool saw_token = FALSE;
  1635: 
  1636:   while (isspace((unsigned char)*p))
  1637:     p++;
  1638: 
  1639:   while (*p) {
  1640:     size_t tlen = 0;
  1641:     while (*p && !isspace((unsigned char)*p) && tlen + 1 < sizeof(token))
  1642:       token[tlen++] = *(p++);
  1643:     token[tlen] = '\0';
  1644: 
  1645:     while (isspace((unsigned char)*p))
  1646:       p++;
  1647: 
  1648:     if (tlen == 0)
  1649:       continue;
  1650: 
  1651:     saw_token = TRUE;
  1652: 
  1653:     char suffix = token[tlen - 1];
  1654:     long long multiplier = 1;
  1655:     if (isalpha((unsigned char)suffix)) {
  1656:       token[tlen - 1] = '\0';
  1657:       switch (tolower((unsigned char)suffix)) {
  1658:         case 'g': multiplier = 1; break;
  1659:         default: return FALSE; /* Unknown suffix */
  1660:       }
  1661:     }
  1662: 
  1663:     if (token[0] == '\0')
  1664:       return FALSE;
  1665: 
  1666:     char *end = NULL;
  1667:     long long value = strtoll(token, &end, 10);
  1668:     if (end == NULL || *end != '\0' || value <= 0)
  1669:       return FALSE;
  1670: 
  1671:     if (multiplier != 0 && value > LLONG_MAX / multiplier)
  1672:       return FALSE;
  1673: 
  1674:     long long add = value * multiplier;
  1675:     if (add > LLONG_MAX - total)
  1676:       return FALSE;
  1677: 
  1678:     total += add;
  1679:   }
  1680: 
  1681:   if (!saw_token || total <= 0)
  1682:     return FALSE;
  1683: 
  1684:   *amount_out = total;
  1685:   return TRUE;
  1686: }
  1687: 
  1688: static int append_box_line(char *buf, int len, size_t bufsz,
  1689:                            const char *border_color, const char *reset_color,
  1690:                            const char *content, size_t inner_width)
  1691: {
  1692:   char trimmed[2048];
  1693:   size_t vis;
  1694:   size_t pad;
  1695: 
  1696:   vis = copy_trunc_visible(trimmed, sizeof(trimmed), content, inner_width);
  1697:   pad = (vis < inner_width) ? (inner_width - vis) : 0;
  1698: 
  1699:   if ((size_t)len < bufsz) {
  1700:     len += snprintf(buf + len, bufsz - (size_t)len,
  1701:       "%s║%s %s%*s %s║%s\r\n",
  1702:       border_color, reset_color,
  1703:       trimmed, (int)pad, "",
  1704:       border_color, reset_color);
  1705:   }
  1706: 
  1707:   return len;
  1708: }
  1709: 
  1710: static int append_wrapped_box_text(char *buf, int len, size_t bufsz,
  1711:                                    const char *border_color, const char *reset_color,
  1712:                                    const char *text, size_t inner_width)
  1713: {
  1714:   const char *p = text ? text : "";
  1715:   char linebuf[2048];
  1716: 
  1717:   if (!*p)
  1718:     return append_box_line(buf, len, bufsz, border_color, reset_color, "", inner_width);
  1719: 
  1720:   while (*p) {
  1721:     size_t vis = 0, idx = 0, last_space_idx = 0;
  1722:     bool saw_space = FALSE;
  1723: 
  1724:     /* Skip leading newlines */
  1725:     if (*p == '\n' || *p == '\r') {
  1726:       len = append_box_line(buf, len, bufsz, border_color, reset_color, "", inner_width);
  1727:       while (*p == '\n' || *p == '\r')
  1728:         p++;
  1729:       continue;
  1730:     }
  1731: 
  1732:     while (p[idx] && p[idx] != '\n') {
  1733:       if (p[idx] == '\t' && p[idx + 1]) {
  1734:         idx += 2;
  1735:         continue;
  1736:       }
  1737: 
  1738:       if ((unsigned char)p[idx] == 27 && p[idx + 1] == '[') {
  1739:         idx += 2;
  1740:         while (p[idx] && p[idx] != 'm')
  1741:           idx++;
  1742:         if (p[idx] == 'm')
  1743:           idx++;
  1744:         continue;
  1745:       }
  1746: 
  1747:       if (isspace((unsigned char)p[idx])) {
  1748:         saw_space = TRUE;
  1749:         last_space_idx = idx + 1;
  1750:       }
  1751: 
  1752:       vis++;
  1753:       idx++;
  1754: 
  1755:       if (vis >= inner_width)
  1756:         break;
  1757:     }
  1758: 
  1759:     size_t break_idx = idx;
  1760:     if (p[idx] == '\n')
  1761:       break_idx = idx;
  1762:     else if (vis >= inner_width && saw_space && last_space_idx > 0)
  1763:       break_idx = last_space_idx;
  1764: 
  1765:     while (break_idx > 0 && isspace((unsigned char)p[break_idx - 1]) && p[break_idx - 1] != '\t')
  1766:       break_idx--;
  1767: 
  1768:     snprintf(linebuf, sizeof(linebuf), "%.*s", (int)break_idx, p);
  1769:     len = append_box_line(buf, len, bufsz, border_color, reset_color, linebuf, inner_width);
  1770: 
  1771:     p += break_idx;
  1772:     while (*p == ' ')
  1773:       p++;
  1774:     if (*p == '\n')
  1775:       p++;
  1776:   }
  1777: 
  1778:   return len;
  1779: }
  1780: 
  1781: /* ========================================================================= 
  1782:  * MAIN SCORE FUNCTION - Replace your entire ACMD(do_score) with this
  1783:  * ========================================================================= */
  1784: 
  1785: static const char *score_class_name(struct char_data *ch)
  1786: {
  1787:   return classtrack_display_class_name(ch);
  1788: }
  1789: 
  1790: 
  1791: ACMD(do_score)
  1792: {
  1793:   struct time_info_data playing_time;
  1794:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1795:   char line[2048];
  1796:   int len = 0;
  1797:   const size_t W = 77;  /* Inner width of the box */

  1800:   const char *R = CCNRM(ch, C_NRM);   /* Reset/normal */
  1801:   const char *Y = CCYEL(ch, C_NRM);   /* Yellow/gold */
  1802:   const char *C = CCCYN(ch, C_NRM);   /* Cyan */
  1803:   const char *M = CCMAG(ch, C_NRM);   /* Magenta */
  1804:   const char *W_CLR = CCWHT(ch, C_NRM);   /* White */
  1805:   const char *RED = CCRED(ch, C_NRM); /* Red */
  1806: 
  1807:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  1808:     return;
  1809: 
  1810:   /* Top border */
  1811:   len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  1812:     "\r\n%s╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗%s\r\n", B, R);
  1813: 
  1814:   /* Title */
  1815:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%sCHARACTER STATUS%s", Y, R);
  1816:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  1817: 
  1818:   /* Separator */
  1819:   len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  1820:     "%s╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣%s\r\n", B, R);
  1821: 
  1822:   /* Name and Title */
  1823:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
  1824:     "%sName:%s %-22s  %sTitle:%s %s",
  1825:     C, R, GET_NAME(ch),
  1826:     C, R, GET_TITLE(ch));
  1827:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  1828: 
  1829:   /* Race and Class */
  1830:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
  1831:     "%sRace:%s %-22s  %sClass:%s %s",
  1832:     C, R, pc_race_types[GET_RACE(ch)],
  1833:     C, R, score_class_name(ch));
  1834:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  1835: 
  1836:   /* Level and Age */
  1837:   {
  1838:     char age_text[32];
  1839: 
  1840:     snprintf(age_text, sizeof(age_text), "%d year%s old", GET_AGE(ch), (GET_AGE(ch) == 1 ? "" : "s"));
  1841:     snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
  1842:       "%sLevel:%s %-21d  %sAge:%s %s",
  1843:       C, R, GET_LEVEL(ch),
  1844:       C, R, age_text);
  1845:   }
  1846:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  1847: 
  1848:   /* Birthday message */
  1849:   if (age(ch)->month == 0 && age(ch)->day == 0) {
  1850:     snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%s*** It's your birthday today! ***%s", Y, R);
  1851:     len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  1852:   }
  1853: 
  1854:   /* Separator */
  1855:   len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  1856:     "%s╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣%s\r\n", B, R);
  1857: 
  1858:   /* HP, Mana, Move, Alignment */
  1859:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
  1860:     "%sHP:%s %d/%d  %sMana:%s %d/%d  %sMove:%s %d/%d  %sAlignment:%s %d",
  1861:     C, R, GET_HIT(ch), GET_MAX_HIT(ch),
  1862:     C, R, GET_MANA(ch), effective_max_mana(ch),
  1863:     C, R, GET_MOVE(ch), effective_max_move(ch),
  1864:     C, R, GET_ALIGNMENT(ch));
  1865:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  1866: 
  1867:   /* Blank spacer line */
  1868:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, "", W);
  1869: 
  1870:   /* Experience and TNL */
  1871:   {
  1872:     int next_need = 0;
  1873:     int alignment_col = 0;
  1874:     char exp_part[128];
  1875:     char tnl_part[80];

  1883:

  1892:     snprintf(tnl_part, sizeof(tnl_part), "%sTNL:%s %d", C, R, next_need);

  1895:       spacer = 2;

  1897:   }
  1898:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);

  2020:     "%s╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣%s\r\n", B, R);

  2173:     if (POOFOUT(ch))
  2174:       snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%sPOOFOUT:%s %s %s",
  2175:         Y, R, GET_NAME(ch), POOFOUT(ch));
  2176:     else
  2177:       snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%sPOOFOUT:%s %s disappears in a puff of smoke.",
  2178:         Y, R, GET_NAME(ch));
  2179:     len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  2180: 
  2181:     snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%sYour current zone:%s %d",
  2182:       C, R, GET_OLC_ZONE(ch));
  2183:     len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  2184:   }
  2185: 
  2186:   /* Bottom border */
  2187:   len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  2188:     "%s╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝%s\r\n", B, R);
  2189: 
  2190:   /* Ensure null termination */
  2191:   buf[sizeof(buf) - 1] = '\0';
  2192:   
  2193:   /* Send to character */
  2194:   send_to_char(ch, "%s", buf);
  2195: }

  2197: ACMD(do_finger)
  2198: {
  2199:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2200:   struct char_data *vict = NULL;
  2201:   bool from_file = FALSE;
  2202:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2203:   char line[2048];
  2204:   int len = 0;
  2205:   const size_t W = 77;
  2206:   const char *B = CCBLU(ch, C_NRM);
  2207:   const char *R = CCNRM(ch, C_NRM);
  2208:   const char *Y = CCYEL(ch, C_NRM);
  2209:   const char *C = CCCYN(ch, C_NRM);
  2210:   const char *BY = CBYEL(ch, C_NRM);
  2211: 
  2212:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  2213:     return;
  2214: 
  2215:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  2216: 
  2217:   if (!*arg)
  2218:     vict = ch;
  2219:   else if (!load_player_target(ch, arg, &vict, &from_file)) {
  2220:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no such player.\r\n");
  2221:     return;
  2222:   }
  2223: 
  2224:   if (IS_NPC(vict)) {
  2225:     send_to_char(ch, "You can only finger player characters.\r\n");
  2226:     if (from_file)
  2227:       free_char(vict);
  2228:     return;
  2229:   }
  2230: 
  2231:   const char *race = (GET_RACE(vict) >= 0 && GET_RACE(vict) < NUM_RACES) ? pc_race_types[GET_RACE(vict)] : "Unknown";
  2232:   const char *clan = clan_display_name_by_id(GET_CLAN_ID(vict));
  2233:   long long bounty = GET_BOUNTY(vict);
  2234:   const char *bounty_color = bounty > 0 ? BY : R;
  2235:   char bounty_buf[64];
  2236:   char clan_buf[128];
  2237: 
  2238:   format_gold_as_currency(bounty_buf, sizeof(bounty_buf), bounty);
  2239:   format_color_field(clan_buf, sizeof(clan_buf), clan, 20);
  2240: 
  2241:   /* Top border */
  2242:   len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  2243:     "\r\n%s╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗%s\r\n", B, R);
  2244: 
  2245:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%sCHARACTER FINGER%s", Y, R);
  2246:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  2247: 
  2248:   len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  2249:     "%s╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣%s\r\n", B, R);
  2250: 
  2251:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%sName:%s %-20s  %sRace:%s %-20s", C, R, GET_NAME(vict), C, R, race);
  2252:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  2253: 
  2254:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%sClass:%s %-19s  %sLevel:%s %-5d", C, R,
  2255:            classtrack_display_class_name(vict), C, R, GET_LEVEL(vict));
  2256:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  2257: 
  2258:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%sClan:%s %s  %sBounty:%s %s%s%s", C, R, clan_buf, C, R, bounty_color, bounty_buf, R);
  2259:   len = append_box_line(buf, len, sizeof(buf), B, R, line, W);
  2260: 
  2261:   len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  2262:     "%s╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣%s\r\n", B, R);
  2263:

  2283: ACMD(do_bounty)
  2284: {
  2285:   char target[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2286:   char amount_buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2287:   char bounty_buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2288:   long long amount = 0;
  2289:   struct char_data *vict = NULL;
  2290:   bool from_file = FALSE;
  2291: 
  2292:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  2293:     return;
  2294: 
  2295:   argument = one_argument(argument, target);
  2296:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  2297: 
  2298:   if (!*target || !*argument) {
  2299:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: bounty <player> <amount>\r\n");
  2300:     return;
  2301:   }
  2302: 
  2303:   strlcpy(amount_buf, argument, sizeof(amount_buf));
  2304: 
  2305:   if (!parse_bounty_amount(amount_buf, &amount) || amount <= 0) {
  2306:     send_to_char(ch, "Invalid bounty amount. Use numbers or amounts like 10g.\r\n");
  2307:     return;
  2308:   }
  2309: 
  2310:   if (!load_player_target(ch, target, &vict, &from_file)) {
  2311:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no such player.\r\n");
  2312:     return;
  2313:   }
  2314: 
  2315:   if (IS_NPC(vict)) {
  2316:     send_to_char(ch, "You can only place bounties on players.\r\n");
  2317:     if (from_file)
  2318:       free_char(vict);
  2319:     return;
  2320:   }
  2321: 
  2322:   if (GET_LEVEL(vict) >= LVL_IMMORT) {
  2323:     send_to_char(ch, "You cannot place a bounty on an immortal.\r\n");
  2324:     if (from_file)
  2325:       free_char(vict);
  2326:     return;
  2327:   }
  2328: 
  2329:   if (GET_MONEY(ch) < amount) {
  2330:     send_to_char(ch, "You cannot afford that bounty.\r\n");
  2331:     if (from_file)
  2332:       free_char(vict);
  2333:     return;
  2334:   }
  2335: 
  2336:   if (amount > LLONG_MAX - GET_BOUNTY(vict)) {
  2337:     send_to_char(ch, "That bounty would overflow the coffers.\r\n");
  2338:     if (from_file)
  2339:       free_char(vict);
  2340:     return;
  2341:   }
  2342: 
  2343:   increase_money_gold(ch, -amount);
  2344:   SET_BOUNTY(vict, GET_BOUNTY(vict) + amount);
  2345: 
  2346:   save_char(ch);
  2347:   save_char(vict);
  2348: 
  2349:   format_gold_as_currency(bounty_buf, sizeof(bounty_buf), amount);
  2350: 
  2351:   send_to_char(ch, "You place a bounty of %s on %s.\r\n", bounty_buf, GET_NAME(vict));
  2352:   if (!from_file && vict->desc)
  2353:     send_to_char(vict, "%s has placed a bounty of %s on you!\r\n", GET_NAME(ch), bounty_buf);
  2354: 
  2355:   if (from_file)
  2356:     free_char(vict);
  2357: }

  2391: static const char *aff_apply_name(int loc)
  2392: {
  2393:   /* tbaMUD has apply_types[] in spell_parser.c (or similar) */
  2394:   extern const char *apply_types[];
  2395: 
  2396:   if (loc <= APPLY_NONE)
  2397:     return "none";
  2398:   if (loc < 0 || loc >= NUM_APPLIES)
  2399:     return "unknown";
  2400:   if (!apply_types[loc])
  2401:     return "unknown";
  2402: 
  2403:   return apply_types[loc];
  2404: }
  2405: 
  2406: static int is_aff_debuff(const struct affected_type *af)
  2407: {
  2408:   if (!af) return 0;
  2409: 
  2410:   /* Common debuff flags */
  2411: #ifdef AFF_POISON
  2412:   if (IS_SET_AR(af->bitvector, AFF_POISON)) return 1;
  2413: #endif
  2414: #ifdef AFF_BLIND
  2415:   if (IS_SET_AR(af->bitvector, AFF_BLIND)) return 1;
  2416: #endif
  2417: #ifdef AFF_CURSE
  2418:   if (IS_SET_AR(af->bitvector, AFF_CURSE)) return 1;
  2419: #endif
  2420: #ifdef AFF_CHARM
  2421:   if (IS_SET_AR(af->bitvector, AFF_CHARM)) return 1;
  2422: #endif
  2423: #ifdef AFF_ARCANE_LEAK
  2424:   if (IS_SET_AR(af->bitvector, AFF_ARCANE_LEAK)) return 1;
  2425: #endif
  2426: 
  2427: #ifdef SPELL_CORRUPTION
  2428:   if (af->spell == SPELL_CORRUPTION) return 1;
  2429: #endif
  2430: 
  2431:   if (is_spirit_spell(af->spell))
  2432:     return 0;
  2433: 
  2434:   if (af->location == APPLY_NONE)
  2435:     return 0;
  2436: 
  2437:   switch (af->location) {
  2438:     case APPLY_AC:
  2439:     case APPLY_EVASION:
  2440:       return (af->modifier < 0);
  2441:     case APPLY_SAVING_BREATH:
  2442:     case APPLY_SAVING_SPELL:
  2443:     case APPLY_SAVING_PARA:
  2444:     case APPLY_SAVING_ROD:
  2445:     case APPLY_SAVING_PETRI:
  2446:       return (af->modifier > 0);
  2447:   }
  2448: 
  2449:   if (af->modifier < 0)
  2450:     return 1;
  2451: 
  2452:   return 0;
  2453: }
  2454: 
  2455: static void format_affect_duration(int duration, char *out, size_t outsz)
  2456: {
  2457:   long total_secs;
  2458:   long hours;
  2459:   long mins;
  2460: 
  2461:   if (!out || outsz == 0)
  2462:     return;
  2463: 
  2464:   if (duration < 0) {
  2465:     snprintf(out, outsz, "permanent");
  2466:     return;
  2467:   }
  2468: 
  2469:   total_secs = (long)duration * SECS_PER_MUD_HOUR;
  2470:   hours = total_secs / 3600;
  2471:   mins = (total_secs % 3600) / 60;
  2472: 
  2473:   if (hours > 0)
  2474:     snprintf(out, outsz, "%ldh %ldm", hours, mins);
  2475:   else
  2476:     snprintf(out, outsz, "%ldm", mins);
  2477: }
  2478: 
  2479: static int aff_flags_has_meaningful_bits(const char *flags)
  2480: {
  2481:   char cleaned[256];
  2482:   size_t i = 0;
  2483: 
  2484:   if (!flags || !*flags)
  2485:     return 0;
  2486: 
  2487:   while (*flags == ' ')
  2488:     flags++;
  2489:   if (!*flags)
  2490:     return 0;
  2491: 
  2492:   while (*flags && i + 1 < sizeof(cleaned)) {
  2493:     if (*flags != ' ' && *flags != '.')
  2494:       cleaned[i++] = UPPER(*flags);
  2495:     flags++;
  2496:   }
  2497:   cleaned[i] = '\0';
  2498: 
  2499:   if (!*cleaned)
  2500:     return 0;
  2501:   if (!strcmp(cleaned, "NOBITS"))
  2502:     return 0;
  2503: 
  2504:   return 1;
  2505: }
  2506: 
  2507: static const char *aff_apply_verb(int location, int modifier)
  2508: {
  2509:   switch (location) {
  2510:     case APPLY_SAVING_BREATH:
  2511:     case APPLY_SAVING_SPELL:
  2512:     case APPLY_SAVING_PARA:
  2513:     case APPLY_SAVING_ROD:
  2514:     case APPLY_SAVING_PETRI:
  2515:       return (modifier < 0) ? "improves" : "worsens";
  2516:   }
  2517: 
  2518:   if (location == APPLY_AC || location == APPLY_EVASION)
  2519:     return (modifier >= 0) ? "improves" : "reduces";
  2520:   return (modifier >= 0) ? "increases" : "reduces";
  2521: }
  2522:

  2528:     case APPLY_SAVING_PARA:
  2529:     case APPLY_SAVING_ROD:
  2530:     case APPLY_SAVING_PETRI:
  2531:       return 1;
  2532:   }
  2533: 
  2534:   return 0;
  2535: }

  2555: static int aff_seen_contains(const struct affected_type * const *seen, int seen_count,
  2556:                              const struct affected_type *af)
  2557: {
  2558:   int i;
  2559: 
  2560:   for (i = 0; i < seen_count; i++)
  2561:     if (seen[i] == af)
  2562:       return 1;
  2563: 
  2564:   return 0;
  2565: }
  2566: 
  2567: static void aff_seen_add(const struct affected_type **seen, int *seen_count,
  2568:                          int seen_cap, const struct affected_type *af)
  2569: {
  2570:   if (!seen || !seen_count || !af)
  2571:     return;
  2572:   if (*seen_count >= seen_cap)
  2573:     return;
  2574:   seen[*seen_count] = af;
  2575:   (*seen_count)++;
  2576: }
  2577: 
  2578: static const char *resolve_affect_display_name(int spell, const char *flags, char *fallback, size_t fallbacksz)
  2579: {
  2580:   const char *name = NULL;
  2581:   size_t i = 0;
  2582: 
  2583:   if (spell > 0 && spell <= TOP_SPELL_DEFINE && spell_info[spell].name)
  2584:     name = spell_info[spell].name;
  2585:   else if (spell > TOP_SPELL_DEFINE && spell <= MAX_SKILLS)
  2586:     name = skill_name(spell);
  2587: 
  2588:   if ((!name || !*name || !str_cmp(name, "Unknown")) && aff_flags_has_meaningful_bits(flags)) {
  2589:     while (flags[i] && flags[i] != ' ' && i + 1 < fallbacksz) {
  2590:       fallback[i] = flags[i];
  2591:       i++;
  2592:     }
  2593:     fallback[i] = '\0';
  2594:     if (*fallback)
  2595:       name = fallback;
  2596:   }
  2597: 
  2598:   if (!name || !*name || !str_cmp(name, "Unknown"))
  2599:     name = "System effect";
  2600: 
  2601:   return name;
  2602: }
  2603: 
  2604: static const char *aff_name_from_spell_and_flags(int spell, const char *flags, char *fallback, size_t fallbacksz)
  2605: {
  2606:   return resolve_affect_display_name(spell, flags, fallback, fallbacksz);
  2607: }

  2609: struct aff_display_entry {
  2610:   char name[128];

  2618: static void drain_desc_for_affect(int spell, const int bits[AF_ARRAY_MAX],
  2619:                                   char *out, size_t outsz)
  2620: {
  2621:   int hp = 0, mana = 0, move = 0;
  2622: 
  2623:   if (!out || outsz == 0)
  2624:     return;
  2625:   out[0] = '\0';
  2626: 
  2627: #ifdef AFF_ARCANE_LEAK
  2628:   if (IS_SET_AR(bits, AFF_ARCANE_LEAK))
  2629:     mana = 1;
  2630: #endif
  2631: #ifdef AFF_BLOODLUST
  2632:   if (IS_SET_AR(bits, AFF_BLOODLUST))
  2633:     hp = 1;
  2634: #endif
  2635: #ifdef SPELL_CORRUPTION
  2636:   if (spell == SPELL_CORRUPTION)
  2637:     hp = 1;
  2638: #endif
  2639: 
  2640:   if (hp && mana && move)
  2641:     snprintf(out, outsz, "drains HP, Mana, and Move over time");
  2642:   else if (hp && mana)
  2643:     snprintf(out, outsz, "drains HP and Mana over time");
  2644:   else if (hp && move)
  2645:     snprintf(out, outsz, "drains HP and Move over time");
  2646:   else if (mana && move)
  2647:     snprintf(out, outsz, "drains Mana and Move over time");
  2648:   else if (hp)
  2649:     snprintf(out, outsz, "drains HP over time");
  2650:   else if (mana)
  2651:     snprintf(out, outsz, "drains Mana over time");
  2652:   else if (move)
  2653:     snprintf(out, outsz, "drains Move over time");
  2654: }
  2655: 
  2656: static void build_grouped_aff_entry(const struct affected_type *list,
  2657:                                     const struct affected_type *seed,
  2658:                                     int only_debuff,
  2659:                                     const struct affected_type **seen,
  2660:                                     int *seen_count,
  2661:                                     int seen_cap,
  2662:                                     struct aff_display_entry *entry)
  2663: {
  2664:   const struct affected_type *af;
  2665:   const struct affected_type **sig_nodes = NULL;
  2666:   int *sig_freq = NULL;
  2667:   int mod_totals[NUM_APPLIES];
  2668:   int mod_used[NUM_APPLIES];
  2669:   int bits[AF_ARRAY_MAX];
  2670:   char name_fallback[64];
  2671:   const char *name;
  2672:   int max_duration = seed->duration;
  2673:   int count = 0, sig_count = 0;
  2674:   int i;
  2675: 
  2676:   if (!entry || !seed || !list || !seen || !seen_count)
  2677:     return;
  2678:   entry->name[0] = '\0';
  2679:   entry->mods[0] = '\0';
  2680:   entry->flags[0] = '\0';
  2681:   entry->drain[0] = '\0';
  2682:   entry->max_duration = seed->duration;
  2683:   entry->count = 1;
  2684: 
  2685:   name_fallback[0] = '\0';
  2686:   for (i = 0; i < AF_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
  2687:     bits[i] = 0;
  2688:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_APPLIES; i++) {
  2689:     mod_totals[i] = 0;
  2690:     mod_used[i] = 0;
  2691:   }
  2692:   if (seen_cap <= 0)
  2693:     seen_cap = MAX_AFFECT;
  2694: 
  2695:   CREATE(sig_nodes, const struct affected_type *, seen_cap);
  2696:   CREATE(sig_freq, int, seen_cap);
  2697:   for (i = 0; i < seen_cap; i++) {
  2698:     sig_nodes[i] = NULL;
  2699:     sig_freq[i] = 0;
  2700:   }
  2701: 
  2702:   for (af = list; af; af = af->next) {
  2703:     if (aff_seen_contains(seen, *seen_count, af))
  2704:       continue;
  2705:     if (af->spell != seed->spell)
  2706:       continue;
  2707:     if (!!is_aff_debuff(af) != !!only_debuff)
  2708:       continue;
  2709: 
  2710:     aff_seen_add(seen, seen_count, seen_cap, af);
  2711:     count++;
  2712:     {
  2713:       int found_sig = 0;
  2714:       for (i = 0; i < sig_count; i++) {
  2715:         if (sig_nodes[i]->location == af->location &&
  2716:             sig_nodes[i]->modifier == af->modifier &&
  2717:             sig_nodes[i]->bitvector[0] == af->bitvector[0] &&
  2718:             sig_nodes[i]->bitvector[1] == af->bitvector[1] &&
  2719:             sig_nodes[i]->bitvector[2] == af->bitvector[2] &&
  2720:             sig_nodes[i]->bitvector[3] == af->bitvector[3]) {
  2721:           sig_freq[i]++;
  2722:           found_sig = 1;
  2723:           break;
  2724:         }
  2725:       }
  2726:       if (!found_sig && sig_count < seen_cap) {
  2727:         sig_nodes[sig_count] = af;
  2728:         sig_freq[sig_count] = 1;
  2729:         sig_count++;
  2730:       }
  2731:     }
  2732:     max_duration = MAX(max_duration, af->duration);
  2733:     if (af->location > APPLY_NONE && af->location < NUM_APPLIES && af->modifier != 0) {
  2734:       mod_totals[af->location] += af->modifier;
  2735:       mod_used[af->location] = 1;
  2736:     }
  2737:     for (i = 0; i < AF_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
  2738:       bits[i] |= af->bitvector[i];
  2739:   }
  2740: 
  2741:   for (i = APPLY_NONE + 1; i < NUM_APPLIES; i++) {
  2742:     char piece[128];
  2743: 
  2744:     if (!mod_used[i] || mod_totals[i] == 0)
  2745:       continue;
  2746: 
  2747:     if (is_saving_apply(i))
  2748:       snprintf(piece, sizeof(piece), "%s %s by %d",
  2749:         aff_apply_verb(i, mod_totals[i]),
  2750:         saving_apply_player_name(i),
  2751:         abs(mod_totals[i]));
  2752:     else if (i == APPLY_AC)
  2753:       snprintf(piece, sizeof(piece), "%s Armor by %d", aff_apply_verb(i, mod_totals[i]), abs(mod_totals[i]));
  2754:     else if (i == APPLY_EVASION)
  2755:       snprintf(piece, sizeof(piece), "%s Evasion by %d", aff_apply_verb(i, mod_totals[i]), abs(mod_totals[i]));
  2756:     else
  2757:       snprintf(piece, sizeof(piece), "%s %s by %d",
  2758:         aff_apply_verb(i, mod_totals[i]),
  2759:         aff_apply_name(i),
  2760:         abs(mod_totals[i]));
  2761: 
  2762:     if (*entry->mods)
  2763:       out_append(entry->mods, sizeof(entry->mods), ", ");
  2764:     out_append(entry->mods, sizeof(entry->mods), piece);
  2765:   }
  2766: 
  2767:   sprintbitarray(bits, affected_bits, AF_ARRAY_MAX, entry->flags);
  2768:   if (!aff_flags_has_meaningful_bits(entry->flags))
  2769:     entry->flags[0] = '\0';
  2770:   name = aff_name_from_spell_and_flags(seed->spell, entry->flags, name_fallback, sizeof(name_fallback));
  2771:   snprintf(entry->name, sizeof(entry->name), "%s", name);
  2772:   entry->max_duration = max_duration;
  2773:   /* Display stack count as full repeated "sets" of this spell's affect
  2774:    * signature. Using the minimum signature frequency avoids overstating
  2775:    * stacks for multi-component spells (e.g. one cast that applies multiple
  2776:    * different modifiers). */
  2777:   if (count > 0 && sig_count > 0) {
  2778:     int min_sig_freq = sig_freq[0];
  2779:     for (i = 1; i < sig_count; i++)
  2780:       min_sig_freq = MIN(min_sig_freq, sig_freq[i]);
  2781:     entry->count = MAX(1, min_sig_freq);
  2782:   } else {
  2783:     entry->count = 1;
  2784:   }
  2785:   drain_desc_for_affect(seed->spell, bits, entry->drain, sizeof(entry->drain));
  2786: 
  2787:   free(sig_nodes);
  2788:   free(sig_freq);
  2789: }
  2790: 
  2791: static int aff_entry_same_visible(const struct aff_display_entry *a, const struct aff_display_entry *b)
  2792: {
  2793:   if (!a || !b)
  2794:     return 0;
  2795:   return !strcmp(a->name, b->name)
  2796:       && !strcmp(a->mods, b->mods)
  2797:       && !strcmp(a->flags, b->flags)
  2798:       && !strcmp(a->drain, b->drain);
  2799: }
  2800: 
  2801: static int hunger_is_actively_draining(const struct char_data *ch)
  2802: {
  2803:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch))
  2804:     return 0;
  2805:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT)
  2806:     return 0;
  2807:   if (GET_POS(ch) < POS_STUNNED)
  2808:     return 0;
  2809: 
  2810:   return (GET_COND(ch, HUNGER) <= 0);
  2811: }
  2812: 
  2813: static int thirst_is_actively_draining(const struct char_data *ch)
  2814: {
  2815:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch))
  2816:     return 0;
  2817:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT)
  2818:     return 0;
  2819:   if (GET_POS(ch) < POS_STUNNED)
  2820:     return 0;
  2821: 
  2822:   return (GET_COND(ch, THIRST) <= 0);
  2823: }
  2824: 
  2825: static void format_aff_display_entry_line(const struct aff_display_entry *entry,
  2826:                                           char *out, size_t outsz)
  2827: {
  2828:   char dur[32];
  2829:   char dur_with_count[64];
  2830:   int need_sep = 0;
  2831: 
  2832:   if (!entry || !out || outsz == 0)
  2833:     return;
  2834: 
  2835:   out[0] = '\0';
  2836:   format_affect_duration(entry->max_duration, dur, sizeof(dur));
  2837:   if (entry->count > 1)
  2838:     snprintf(dur_with_count, sizeof(dur_with_count), "%s x%d", dur, entry->count);
  2839:   else
  2840:     snprintf(dur_with_count, sizeof(dur_with_count), "%s", dur);
  2841: 
  2842:   snprintf(out, outsz, "%s (%s)", entry->name, dur_with_count);
  2843:   if (!*entry->mods && !*entry->flags && !*entry->drain) {
  2844:     out_append(out, outsz, ".");
  2845:     return;
  2846:   }
  2847: 
  2848:   out_append(out, outsz, ": ");
  2849:   if (*entry->mods) {
  2850:     out_append(out, outsz, entry->mods);
  2851:     need_sep = 1;
  2852:   }
  2853:   if (*entry->flags) {
  2854:     if (need_sep)
  2855:       out_append(out, outsz, ", ");
  2856:     out_append(out, outsz, entry->flags);
  2857:     need_sep = 1;
  2858:   }
  2859:   if (*entry->drain) {
  2860:     if (need_sep)
  2861:       out_append(out, outsz, ", ");
  2862:     out_append(out, outsz, entry->drain);
  2863:   }
  2864:   out_append(out, outsz, ".");
  2865: }
  2866: 
  2867: ACMD(do_affects)
  2868: {
  2869:   const struct affected_type *af;
  2870:   const struct affected_type **seen = NULL;
  2871:   struct aff_display_entry *buff_entries = NULL;
  2872:   struct aff_display_entry *debuff_entries = NULL;
  2873:   int buff_count = 0, debuff_count = 0;
  2874:   int seen_count = 0;
  2875:   int any = 0, any_buff = 0, any_debuff = 0;
  2876:   int i, j;
  2877:   int added_hidden_drain = 0;
  2878:   int affect_count = 0;
  2879: 
  2880:   enum { AFF_PROLONGED_TICK_THRESHOLD = 6 };
  2881: 
  2882:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch)) {
  2883:     send_to_char(ch, "Not for mobiles.\r\n");
  2884:     return;
  2885:   }
  2886: 
  2887:   if (!ch->affected) {
  2888:     send_to_char(ch, "You have no active effects.\r\n");
  2889:     return;
  2890:   }
  2891: 
  2892:   for (af = ch->affected; af; af = af->next) {
  2893:     affect_count++;
  2894:     any = 1;
  2895:     if (is_aff_debuff(af)) any_debuff = 1;
  2896:     else any_buff = 1;
  2897:   }
  2898: 
  2899:   if (!any) {
  2900:     send_to_char(ch, "You have no active effects.\r\n");
  2901:     return;
  2902:   }
  2903: 
  2904:   CREATE(seen, const struct affected_type *, affect_count);
  2905:   CREATE(buff_entries, struct aff_display_entry, affect_count);
  2906:   CREATE(debuff_entries, struct aff_display_entry, (affect_count * 2) + 4);
  2907: 
  2908:   for (af = ch->affected; af; af = af->next) {
  2909:     struct aff_display_entry entry;
  2910:     struct aff_display_entry *target = NULL;
  2911:     if (aff_seen_contains(seen, seen_count, af))
  2912:       continue;
  2913: 
  2914:     build_grouped_aff_entry(ch->affected, af, is_aff_debuff(af), seen, &seen_count, affect_count, &entry);
  2915: 
  2916:     target = is_aff_debuff(af) ? debuff_entries : buff_entries;
  2917:     if (is_aff_debuff(af)) {
  2918:       for (i = 0; i < debuff_count; i++) {
  2919:         if (aff_entry_same_visible(&debuff_entries[i], &entry)) {
  2920:           debuff_entries[i].count += entry.count;
  2921:           debuff_entries[i].max_duration = MAX(debuff_entries[i].max_duration, entry.max_duration);
  2922:           target = NULL;
  2923:           break;
  2924:         }
  2925:       }
  2926:       if (target && debuff_count < (affect_count * 2 + 4))
  2927:         debuff_entries[debuff_count++] = entry;
  2928:     } else {
  2929:       for (i = 0; i < buff_count; i++) {
  2930:         if (aff_entry_same_visible(&buff_entries[i], &entry)) {
  2931:           buff_entries[i].count += entry.count;
  2932:           buff_entries[i].max_duration = MAX(buff_entries[i].max_duration, entry.max_duration);
  2933:           target = NULL;
  2934:           break;
  2935:         }
  2936:       }
  2937:       if (target && buff_count < affect_count)
  2938:         buff_entries[buff_count++] = entry;
  2939:     }
  2940:   }
  2941: 
  2942:   for (i = 0; i < buff_count; i++) {
  2943:     if (!*buff_entries[i].drain)
  2944:       continue;
  2945:     if (debuff_count >= (affect_count * 2 + 4))
  2946:       break;
  2947:     debuff_entries[debuff_count] = buff_entries[i];
  2948:     debuff_entries[debuff_count].mods[0] = '\0';
  2949:     debuff_entries[debuff_count].flags[0] = '\0';
  2950:     debuff_entries[debuff_count].name[0] = '\0';
  2951:     out_append(debuff_entries[debuff_count].name, sizeof(debuff_entries[debuff_count].name), buff_entries[i].name);
  2952:     out_append(debuff_entries[debuff_count].name, sizeof(debuff_entries[debuff_count].name), " strain");
  2953:     debuff_count++;
  2954:   }
  2955: 
  2956:   if (hunger_is_actively_draining(ch)) {
  2957:     struct aff_display_entry e;
  2958:     memset(&e, 0, sizeof(e));
  2959:     snprintf(e.name, sizeof(e.name), "hunger strain");
  2960:     snprintf(e.drain, sizeof(e.drain),
  2961:              (ch->char_specials.starving_ticks >= AFF_PROLONGED_TICK_THRESHOLD)
  2962:                ? "drains HP, Mana, and Move over time"
  2963:                : "drains Move over time");
  2964:     e.max_duration = -1;
  2965:     e.count = 1;
  2966:     if (debuff_count < (affect_count * 2 + 4))
  2967:       debuff_entries[debuff_count++] = e;
  2968:     added_hidden_drain = 1;
  2969:   }
  2970: 
  2971:   if (thirst_is_actively_draining(ch)) {
  2972:     struct aff_display_entry e;
  2973:     memset(&e, 0, sizeof(e));
  2974:     snprintf(e.name, sizeof(e.name), "thirst strain");
  2975:     snprintf(e.drain, sizeof(e.drain),
  2976:              (ch->char_specials.dehydrated_ticks >= AFF_PROLONGED_TICK_THRESHOLD)
  2977:                ? "drains HP, Mana, and Move over time"
  2978:                : "drains Move over time");
  2979:     e.max_duration = -1;
  2980:     e.count = 1;
  2981:     if (debuff_count < (affect_count * 2 + 4))
  2982:       debuff_entries[debuff_count++] = e;
  2983:     added_hidden_drain = 1;
  2984:   }
  2985: 
  2986:   for (i = 0; i < debuff_count; i++) {
  2987:     for (j = i + 1; j < debuff_count; ) {
  2988:       if (aff_entry_same_visible(&debuff_entries[i], &debuff_entries[j])) {
  2989:         debuff_entries[i].count += debuff_entries[j].count;
  2990:         debuff_entries[i].max_duration = MAX(debuff_entries[i].max_duration, debuff_entries[j].max_duration);
  2991:         for (; j + 1 < debuff_count; j++)
  2992:           debuff_entries[j] = debuff_entries[j + 1];
  2993:         debuff_count--;
  2994:       } else
  2995:         j++;
  2996:     }
  2997:   }
  2998: 
  2999:   any_buff = (buff_count > 0);
  3000:   any_debuff = (debuff_count > 0) || added_hidden_drain;
  3001: 
  3002:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\n%sActive Effects%s\r\n", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  3003: 
  3004:   /* Buffs */
  3005:   if (any_buff) {
  3006:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n%sBuffs%s\r\n", CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  3007:     for (i = 0; i < buff_count; i++) {
  3008:       char line[512];
  3009:       format_aff_display_entry_line(&buff_entries[i], line, sizeof(line));
  3010:       send_to_char(ch, "  %s\r\n", line);
  3011:     }
  3012:   } else {
  3013:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n%sBuffs%s\r\n  None.\r\n", CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  3014:   }
  3015: 
  3016:   /* Debuffs */
  3017:   if (any_debuff) {
  3018:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n%sDebuffs%s\r\n", CCRED(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  3019:     for (i = 0; i < debuff_count; i++) {
  3020:       char line[512];
  3021:       format_aff_display_entry_line(&debuff_entries[i], line, sizeof(line));
  3022:       send_to_char(ch, "  %s\r\n", line);
  3023:     }
  3024:   } else {
  3025:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n%sDebuffs%s\r\n  None.\r\n", CCRED(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  3026:   }
  3027: 
  3028:   free(seen);
  3029:   free(buff_entries);
  3030:   free(debuff_entries);
  3031: }
  3032: 
  3033: ACMD(do_inventory)
  3034: {
  3035:   send_to_char(ch, "You are carrying:\r\n");
  3036:   list_obj_to_char(ch->carrying, ch, SHOW_OBJ_SHORT, TRUE);
  3037: }
  3038: 
  3039: ACMD(do_compare)
  3040: {
  3041:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3042:   struct obj_data *candidate, *equipped = NULL;
  3043:   int slot, i;
  3044: 
  3045:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  3046:   if (!*arg) {
  3047:     send_to_char(ch, "Compare which carried item?\r\n");
  3048:     return;
  3049:   }
  3050:   if (!(candidate = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
  3051:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have that item.\r\n");
  3052:     return;
  3053:   }
  3054: 
  3055:   slot = find_eq_pos(ch, candidate, NULL);
  3056:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(candidate) == ITEM_WEAPON && OBJ_FLAGGED(candidate, ITEM_OFFHAND) &&
  3057:       GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD))
  3058:     slot = WEAR_HOLD;
  3059:   else if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(candidate) == ITEM_WEAPON || GET_OBJ_TYPE(candidate) == ITEM_WAND)
  3060:     slot = WEAR_WIELD;
  3061:   if (slot < 0 || slot >= NUM_WEARS) {
  3062:     send_to_char(ch, "%s has no logical equipment slot to compare.\r\n",
  3063:                  CAP(GET_OBJ_SHORT(candidate)));
  3064:     return;
  3065:   }
  3066:   equipped = GET_EQ(ch, slot);
  3067:   send_to_char(ch, "Comparing %s against %s in %s:\r\n",
  3068:                GET_OBJ_SHORT(candidate),
  3069:                equipped ? GET_OBJ_SHORT(equipped) : "nothing",
  3070:                equipment_types[slot]);
  3071:   send_to_char(ch, "  Level: %d%s\r\n", GET_OBJ_LEVEL(candidate),
  3072:                GET_LEVEL(ch) < GET_OBJ_LEVEL(candidate) ? " (too high)" : "");
  3073:   send_to_char(ch, "  Weight: %d%s\r\n", GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(candidate),
  3074:                equipped ? "" : " (no equipped comparison)");
  3075: 
  3076:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(candidate) == ITEM_WEAPON) {
  3077:     int old_num = equipped && GET_OBJ_TYPE(equipped) == ITEM_WEAPON ? GET_OBJ_VAL(equipped, 1) : 0;
  3078:     int old_size = equipped && GET_OBJ_TYPE(equipped) == ITEM_WEAPON ? GET_OBJ_VAL(equipped, 2) : 0;
  3079:     send_to_char(ch, "  Damage: %dd%d (equipped: %dd%d)\r\n",
  3080:                  GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 1), GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 2), old_num, old_size);
  3081:     if (OBJ_FLAGGED(candidate, ITEM_TWO_HANDER))
  3082:       send_to_char(ch, "  Conflict: two-handed; primary=%s, offhand/hold=%s.\r\n",
  3083:                    GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD) ? GET_OBJ_SHORT(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD)) : "empty",
  3084:                    GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD) ? GET_OBJ_SHORT(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD)) : "empty");
  3085:     else if (OBJ_FLAGGED(candidate, ITEM_OFFHAND))
  3086:       send_to_char(ch, "  Hand use: offhand-capable; comparison shown against primary by default.\r\n");
  3087:   } else if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(candidate) == ITEM_WAND) {
  3088:     send_to_char(ch, "  Wand: %s, spell level %d, charges %d/%d.\r\n",
  3089:                  (GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 3) > 0 && GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 3) <= TOP_SPELL_DEFINE) ?
  3090:                    skill_name(GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 3)) : "<invalid spell>",
  3091:                  GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 0), GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 2), GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 1));
  3092:   } else if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(candidate) == ITEM_ARMOR) {
  3093:     int old_ac = equipped && GET_OBJ_TYPE(equipped) == ITEM_ARMOR ? GET_OBJ_VAL(equipped, 0) : 0;
  3094:     send_to_char(ch, "  Armor contribution: %d (equipped: %d, difference: %+d)\r\n",
  3095:                  GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 0), old_ac, GET_OBJ_VAL(candidate, 0) - old_ac);
  3096:   }
  3097:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; i++) {
  3098:     int oldmod = 0, j;
  3099:     if (!candidate->affected[i].location || !candidate->affected[i].modifier)
  3100:       continue;
  3101:     if (equipped)
  3102:       for (j = 0; j < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; j++)
  3103:         if (equipped->affected[j].location == candidate->affected[i].location)
  3104:           oldmod += equipped->affected[j].modifier;
  3105:     send_to_char(ch, "  %s: %+d (equipped: %+d, difference: %+d)\r\n",
  3106:                  apply_types[candidate->affected[i].location],
  3107:                  candidate->affected[i].modifier, oldmod,
  3108:                  candidate->affected[i].modifier - oldmod);
  3109:   }
  3110:   if (equipped) {
  3111:     for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; i++) {
  3112:       int j;
  3113:       bool retained = FALSE;
  3114:       if (!equipped->affected[i].location || !equipped->affected[i].modifier)
  3115:         continue;
  3116:       for (j = 0; j < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; j++)
  3117:         if (candidate->affected[j].location == equipped->affected[i].location)
  3118:           retained = TRUE;
  3119:       if (!retained)
  3120:         send_to_char(ch, "  Lost %s: %+d\r\n",
  3121:                      apply_types[equipped->affected[i].location],
  3122:                      equipped->affected[i].modifier);
  3123:     }
  3124:   }
  3125:   {
  3126:     char candidate_flags[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], equipped_flags[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  3127:     sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_AFFECT(candidate), affected_bits, AF_ARRAY_MAX, candidate_flags);
  3128:     if (equipped)
  3129:       sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_AFFECT(equipped), affected_bits, AF_ARRAY_MAX, equipped_flags);
  3130:     else
  3131:       strlcpy(equipped_flags, "NOBITS", sizeof(equipped_flags));
  3132:     send_to_char(ch, "  Affect flags: %s (equipped: %s)\r\n",
  3133:                  candidate_flags, equipped_flags);
  3134:   }
  3135:   send_to_char(ch, "This is a factual comparison, not an overall item score.\r\n");
  3136: }
  3137: 
  3138: ACMD(do_equipment)
  3139: {
  3140:   /* Custom EQ display: always show all slots in a fixed order. */
  3141:   static const int eq_order[] = {
  3142:     WEAR_HEAD,
  3143:     WEAR_NECK_1,
  3144:     WEAR_NECK_2,
  3145:     WEAR_ABOUT,     /* Back */
  3146:     WEAR_BODY,
  3147:     WEAR_ARMS,
  3148:     WEAR_WRIST_R,
  3149:     WEAR_WRIST_L,
  3150:     WEAR_HANDS,

  3230: ACMD(do_time)
  3231: {
  3232:   const char *suf;
  3233:   int weekday, day;
  3234: 
  3235:   /* day in [1..35] */
  3236:   day = time_info.day + 1;
  3237: 
  3238:   /* 35 days in a month, 7 days a week */
  3239:   weekday = ((35 * time_info.month) + day) % 7;
  3240: 
  3241:   send_to_char(ch, "It is %d o'clock %s, on %s.\r\n",
  3242:       (time_info.hours % 12 == 0) ? 12 : (time_info.hours % 12),
  3243:       time_info.hours >= 12 ? "pm" : "am", weekdays[weekday]);
  3244: 
  3245:   /* Peter Ajamian supplied the following as a fix for a bug introduced in the
  3246:    * ordinal display that caused 11, 12, and 13 to be incorrectly displayed as
  3247:    * 11st, 12nd, and 13rd.  Nate Winters had already submitted a fix, but it
  3248:    * hard-coded a limit on ordinal display which I want to avoid. -dak */
  3249:   suf = "th";
  3250: 
  3251:   if (((day % 100) / 10) != 1) {
  3252:     switch (day % 10) {
  3253:     case 1:
  3254:       suf = "st";
  3255:       break;
  3256:     case 2:
  3257:       suf = "nd";
  3258:       break;
  3259:     case 3:
  3260:       suf = "rd";
  3261:       break;
  3262:     }
  3263:   }
  3264:   send_to_char(ch, "The %d%s Day of the %s, Year %d.\r\n",
  3265:       day, suf, month_name[time_info.month], time_info.year);
  3266: }
