  3293: /* puts -'s instead of spaces */
  3294: void space_to_minus(char *str)
  3295: {
  3296:   while ((str = strchr(str, ' ')) != NULL)
  3297:     *str = '-';
  3298: }
  3299: 
  3300: static void normalize_help_keyword(const char *src, char *dst, size_t dstsz)
  3301: {
  3302:   size_t out = 0;
  3303:   int last_was_sep = 1;
  3304: 
  3305:   if (!dst || dstsz == 0)
  3306:     return;
  3307: 
  3308:   dst[0] = '\0';
  3309:   if (!src)
  3310:     return;
  3311: 
  3312:   while (*src && out + 1 < dstsz) {
  3313:     unsigned char c = (unsigned char)*src++;
  3314: 
  3315:     if (isalnum(c)) {
  3316:       dst[out++] = LOWER(c);
  3317:       last_was_sep = 0;
  3318:       continue;
  3319:     }
  3320: 
  3321:     if (!last_was_sep) {
  3322:       dst[out++] = '-';
  3323:       last_was_sep = 1;
  3324:     }
  3325:   }
  3326: 
  3327:   while (out > 0 && dst[out - 1] == '-')
  3328:     out--;
  3329: 
  3330:   dst[out] = '\0';
  3331: }
  3332: 
  3333: static void normalize_help_keyword_compact(const char *src, char *dst, size_t dstsz)
  3334: {
  3335:   size_t out = 0;
  3336: 
  3337:   if (!dst || dstsz == 0)
  3338:     return;
  3339: 
  3340:   dst[0] = '\0';
  3341:   if (!src)
  3342:     return;
  3343: 
  3344:   while (*src && out + 1 < dstsz) {
  3345:     unsigned char c = (unsigned char)*src++;
  3346: 
  3347:     if (isalnum(c))
  3348:       dst[out++] = LOWER(c);
  3349:   }
  3350: 
  3351:   dst[out] = '\0';
  3352: }
  3353: 
  3354: static int help_keyword_matches_query(const char *keywords, const char *argument)
  3355: {
  3356:   char normalized_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3357:   char compact_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3358:   char keyword_copy[MAX_HELP_KEYWORDS + 1];
  3359:   char *tokens[64];
  3360:   int token_count = 0;
  3361:   int i, j;
  3362: 
  3363:   if (!keywords || !*keywords || !argument || !*argument)
  3364:     return FALSE;
  3365: 
  3366:   normalize_help_keyword(argument, normalized_arg, sizeof(normalized_arg));
  3367:   normalize_help_keyword_compact(argument, compact_arg, sizeof(compact_arg));
  3368:   if (!*normalized_arg || !*compact_arg)
  3369:     return FALSE;
  3370: 
  3371:   strlcpy(keyword_copy, keywords, sizeof(keyword_copy));
  3372: 
  3373:   {
  3374:     char *saveptr = NULL;
  3375:     char *tok = strtok_r(keyword_copy, " \t\r\n", &saveptr);
  3376: 
  3377:     while (tok && token_count < (int)(sizeof(tokens) / sizeof(tokens[0]))) {
  3378:       tokens[token_count++] = tok;
  3379:       tok = strtok_r(NULL, " \t\r\n", &saveptr);
  3380:     }
  3381:   }
  3382: 
  3383:   for (i = 0; i < token_count; i++) {
  3384:     char normalized_token[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3385:     char compact_token[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3386:     size_t compact_len;
  3387: 
  3388:     normalize_help_keyword(tokens[i], normalized_token, sizeof(normalized_token));
  3389:     normalize_help_keyword_compact(tokens[i], compact_token, sizeof(compact_token));
  3390:     compact_len = strlen(compact_arg);
  3391: 
  3392:     if ((*normalized_token && !str_cmp(normalized_arg, normalized_token)) ||
  3393:         (*compact_token && !str_cmp(compact_arg, compact_token)))
  3394:       return TRUE;
  3395: 
  3396:     if (compact_len > 0 && *compact_token &&
  3397:         !strncmp(compact_token, compact_arg, compact_len))
  3398:       return TRUE;
  3399:   }
  3400: 
  3401:   for (i = 0; i < token_count; i++) {
  3402:     char combined[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3403:     size_t len = 0;
  3404: 
  3405:     combined[0] = '\0';
  3406:     for (j = i; j < token_count; j++) {
  3407:       char compact_token[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3408:       size_t tok_len;
  3409:       size_t compact_len = strlen(compact_arg);
  3410: 
  3411:       normalize_help_keyword_compact(tokens[j], compact_token, sizeof(compact_token));
  3412:       if (!*compact_token)
  3413:         continue;
  3414: 
  3415:       tok_len = strlen(compact_token);
  3416:       if (len + tok_len + 1 >= sizeof(combined))
  3417:         break;
  3418: 
  3419:       memcpy(combined + len, compact_token, tok_len);
  3420:       len += tok_len;
  3421:       combined[len] = '\0';
  3422: 
  3423:       if (!str_cmp(compact_arg, combined))
  3424:         return TRUE;
  3425:       if (compact_len > 0 && len >= compact_len &&
  3426:           !strncmp(combined, compact_arg, compact_len))
  3427:         return TRUE;
  3428:     }
  3429:   }
  3430: 
  3431:   return FALSE;
  3432: }
  3433: 
  3434: static int search_help_flexible(const char *argument, int level)
  3435: {
  3436:   int i, exact;
  3437:   char normalized_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3438: 
  3439:   if (!argument || !*argument)
  3440:     return NOWHERE;
  3441: 
  3442:   exact = search_help(argument, level);
  3443:   if (exact != NOWHERE)
  3444:     return exact;
  3445: 
  3446:   normalize_help_keyword(argument, normalized_arg, sizeof(normalized_arg));
  3447:   if (!*normalized_arg)
  3448:     return NOWHERE;
  3449: 
  3450:   exact = search_help(normalized_arg, level);
  3451:   if (exact != NOWHERE)
  3452:     return exact;
  3453: 
  3454:   for (i = 0; i < top_of_helpt; i++) {
  3455:     if (!help_table[i].keywords || help_table[i].min_level > level)
  3456:       continue;
  3457:     if (help_keyword_matches_query(help_table[i].keywords, normalized_arg))
  3458:       return i;
  3459:   }
  3460: 
  3461:   return NOWHERE;
  3462: }
  3463: 
  3464: static int append_help_line(char *buf, size_t bufsz, size_t *len, const char *line)
  3465: {
  3466:   int wrote;
  3467: 
  3468:   if (!buf || !len || !line || *len >= bufsz)
  3469:     return FALSE;
  3470: 
  3471:   wrote = snprintf(buf + *len, bufsz - *len, "%s", line);
  3472:   if (wrote < 0 || (size_t)wrote >= bufsz - *len) {
  3473:     *len = bufsz - 1;
  3474:     buf[*len] = '\0';
  3475:     return FALSE;
  3476:   }
  3477: 
  3478:   *len += (size_t)wrote;
  3479:   return TRUE;
  3480: }

  3482: static int find_live_ability_by_name(const char *argument, int *ability_out)
  3483: {
  3484:   int i;
  3485:   char normalized_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3486:   char normalized_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3487: 
  3488:   if (!argument || !*argument || !ability_out)
  3489:     return FALSE;
  3490: 
  3491:   normalize_help_keyword(argument, normalized_arg, sizeof(normalized_arg));
  3492:   if (!*normalized_arg)
  3493:     return FALSE;
  3494: 
  3495:   for (i = 1; i <= TOP_SPELL_DEFINE; i++) {
  3496:     if (!spell_info[i].name || !str_cmp(spell_info[i].name, unused_spellname))
  3497:       continue;
  3498: 
  3499:     normalize_help_keyword(skill_name(i), normalized_name, sizeof(normalized_name));
  3500:     if (!*normalized_name)
  3501:       continue;
  3502: 
  3503:     if (!str_cmp(normalized_arg, normalized_name)) {
  3504:       *ability_out = i;
  3505:       return TRUE;
  3506:     }
  3507:   }
  3508: 
  3509:   return FALSE;
  3510: }

  3512: static void show_live_ability_help(struct char_data *ch, int show_skills)
  3513: {
  3514:   int i, count = 0;
  3515:   int start = show_skills ? MAX_SPELLS + 1 : 1;
  3516:   int end = show_skills ? TOP_SPELL_DEFINE : MAX_SPELLS;
  3517:   char outbuf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  3518:   size_t len = 0;
  3519:   const char *title = show_skills ? "SKILLS" : "SPELLS";
  3520: 
  3521:   if (!ch || !ch->desc)
  3522:     return;
  3523: 
  3524:   outbuf[0] = '\0';
  3525:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, title);
  3526:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, "\r\n\r\n");
  3527: 
  3528:   for (i = start; i <= end; i++) {
  3529:     if (!spell_info[i].name || !str_cmp(spell_info[i].name, unused_spellname))
  3530:       continue;
  3531:     count++;
  3532:     if (!append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len,
  3533:         show_skills ? "  " : "  "))
  3534:       break;
  3535:     if (!append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, skill_name(i)))
  3536:       break;
  3537:     if (!append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, "\r\n"))
  3538:       break;
  3539:   }
  3540: 
  3541:   if (!count)
  3542:     append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, "No abilities are currently available.\r\n");
  3543: 
  3544:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, "\r\nType HELP <name> for details.\r\n");
  3545:   page_string(ch->desc, outbuf, 1);
  3546: }

  3548: static void show_live_ability_topic_help(struct char_data *ch, int ability)
  3549: {
  3550:   char outbuf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  3551:   size_t len = 0;
  3552:   const char *name;
  3553:   const char *type;
  3554: 
  3555:   if (!ch || !ch->desc)
  3556:     return;
  3557:   if (ability < 1 || ability > TOP_SPELL_DEFINE)
  3558:     return;
  3559: 
  3560:   name = skill_name(ability);
  3561:   if (!name || !*name || !str_cmp(name, unused_spellname))
  3562:     return;
  3563: 
  3564:   type = (ability <= MAX_SPELLS) ? "Spell" : "Skill";
  3565: 
  3566:   outbuf[0] = '\0';
  3567:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, name);
  3568:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, "\r\n\r\n");
  3569:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, "Type: ");
  3570:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, type);
  3571:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, "\r\n");
  3572:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, "Source: Live ability table\r\n\r\n");
  3573:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len,
  3574:     "This help topic is resolved directly from the current in-game ability name.\r\n");
  3575:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len,
  3576:     "If this ability has a detailed static help page, use HSET/XHELP tools to add or update it.\r\n\r\n");
  3577:   append_help_line(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &len, "See also: SPELLS SKILLS\r\n");
  3578: 
  3579:   page_string(ch->desc, outbuf, 1);
  3580: }
  3581: 
  3582: int search_help(const char *argument, int level)
  3583: {
  3584:   int chk, bot, top, mid, minlen;
  3585: 
  3586:   if (!help_table || top_of_helpt <= 0 || !argument || !*argument)
  3587:     return NOWHERE;
  3588: 
  3589:   bot = 0;
  3590:   top = top_of_helpt - 1;
  3591:   minlen = strlen(argument);
  3592: 
  3593:   while (bot <= top) {
  3594:     mid = (bot + top) / 2;
  3595: 
  3596:     if (!help_table[mid].keywords) {
  3597:       int scan;
  3598:       for (scan = bot; scan <= top; scan++) {
  3599:         if (!help_table[scan].keywords)
  3600:           continue;
  3601:         chk = strn_cmp(argument, help_table[scan].keywords, minlen);
  3602:         if (!chk) {
  3603:           mid = scan;
  3604:           break;
  3605:         }
  3606:       }
  3607:       if (scan > top)
  3608:         return NOWHERE;
  3609:     }
  3610: 
  3611:     if (!(chk = strn_cmp(argument, help_table[mid].keywords, minlen))) {
  3612:       while ((mid > 0) && help_table[mid - 1].keywords &&
  3613:              !strn_cmp(argument, help_table[mid - 1].keywords, minlen))
  3614:         mid--;
  3615: 
  3616:       while (mid < top_of_helpt && level < help_table[mid].min_level)
  3617:         mid++;
  3618: 
  3619:       if (mid >= top_of_helpt || !help_table[mid].keywords ||
  3620:           strn_cmp(argument, help_table[mid].keywords, minlen) ||
  3621:           level < help_table[mid].min_level)
  3622:         break;
  3623: 
  3624:       return (mid);
  3625:     } else if (chk > 0)
  3626:       bot = mid + 1;
  3627:     else
  3628:       top = mid - 1;
  3629:   }
  3630: 
  3631:   return NOWHERE;
  3632: }
  3633: 
  3634: ACMD(do_help)
  3635: {
  3636:   int mid = 0;
  3637:   int i, found = 0;
  3638:   int live_ability = 0;
  3639:   char help_query[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3640:   char normalized_query[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3641: 
  3642:   if (!ch->desc)
  3643:     return;
  3644: 
  3645:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  3646: 
  3647:   if (!help_table) {
  3648:     send_to_char(ch, "No help available.\r\n");
  3649:     return;
  3650:   }
  3651: 
  3652:   if (!*argument) {
  3653:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)
  3654:       page_string(ch->desc, help, 0);
  3655:     else
  3656:       page_string(ch->desc, ihelp, 0);
  3657:     return;
  3658:   }
  3659: 
  3660:   strlcpy(help_query, argument, sizeof(help_query));
  3661:   normalize_help_keyword(help_query, normalized_query, sizeof(normalized_query));
  3662: 
  3663:   if (!str_cmp(normalized_query, "spells")) {
  3664:     show_live_ability_help(ch, FALSE);
  3665:     return;
  3666:   }
  3667:   if (!str_cmp(normalized_query, "skills")) {
  3668:     show_live_ability_help(ch, TRUE);
  3669:     return;
  3670:   }
  3671: 
  3672:   if ((mid = search_help_flexible(help_query, GET_LEVEL(ch))) == NOWHERE) {
  3673:     if (find_live_ability_by_name(help_query, &live_ability)) {
  3674:       show_live_ability_topic_help(ch, live_ability);
  3675:       return;
  3676:     }
  3677: 
  3678:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no help on that word.\r\n");
  3679:     mudlog(NRM, MIN(LVL_IMPL, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  3680:       "%s tried to get help on %s", GET_NAME(ch), help_query);
  3681:     for (i = 0; i < top_of_helpt; i++)  {
  3682:       char normalized_keyword[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3683: 
  3684:       if (!help_table[i].keywords)
  3685:         continue;
  3686:       if (help_table[i].min_level > GET_LEVEL(ch))
  3687:         continue;
  3688: 
  3689:       normalize_help_keyword(help_table[i].keywords, normalized_keyword, sizeof(normalized_keyword));
  3690:       if (!*normalized_keyword)
  3691:         continue;
  3692: 
  3693:       /* To help narrow down results, if they don't start with the same letters, move on. */
  3694:       if (*normalized_query != *normalized_keyword)
  3695:         continue;
  3696: 
  3697:       if (levenshtein_distance(normalized_query, normalized_keyword) <= 2) {
  3698:         if (!found) {
  3699:           send_to_char(ch, "\r\nDid you mean:\r\n");
  3700:           found = 1;
  3701:         }
  3702:         send_to_char(ch, "  \t<send link=\"Help %s\">%s\t</send>\r\n", help_table[i].keywords, help_table[i].keywords);
  3703:       }
  3704:     }
  3705:     return;
  3706:   }
  3707:   page_string(ch->desc, help_table[mid].entry, 0);
  3708: }

  3710: #define WHO_FORMAT \
  3711: "Usage: who [minlev[-maxlev]] [-n name] [-c classlist] [-k] [-l] [-n] [-q] [-r] [-s] [-z]\r\n"
  3712: 
  3713: /* Written by Rhade */
  3714: ACMD(do_who)
  3715: {
  3716:   struct descriptor_data *d;
  3717:   struct char_data *tch;
  3718:   int i, num_can_see = 0;
  3719:   char name_search[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3720:   char mode;
  3721:   int low = 0, high = LVL_IMPL, localwho = 0, questwho = 0;
  3722:   int showclass = 0, short_list = 0, outlaws = 0;
  3723:   int who_room = 0, showgroup = 0, showleader = 0;
  3724: 
  3725:   struct {
  3726:     char *disp;
  3727:     int min_level;
  3728:     int max_level;
  3729:     int count; /* must always start as 0 */
  3730:   } rank[] = {
  3731:     { "Immortals\r\n---------\r\n", LVL_IMMORT, LVL_IMPL, 0},
  3732:     { "Mortals\r\n-------\r\n", 1, LVL_IMMORT - 1, 0 },
  3733:     { "\n", 0, 0, 0 }
  3734:   };
  3735: 
  3736:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  3737:   strcpy(buf, argument);   /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: argument == buf) */
  3738:   name_search[0] = '\0';
  3739: 
  3740:   while (*buf) {
  3741:     char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3742: 
  3743:     half_chop(buf, arg, buf1);
  3744:     if (isdigit(*arg)) {
  3745:       sscanf(arg, "%d-%d", &low, &high);
  3746:       strcpy(buf, buf1);   /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  3747:     } else if (*arg == '-') {
  3748:       mode = *(arg + 1);       /* just in case; we destroy arg in the switch */
  3749:       switch (mode) {
  3750:       case 'k':
  3751:         outlaws = 1;
  3752:         strcpy(buf, buf1);   /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  3753:         break;
  3754:       case 'z':
  3755:         localwho = 1;
  3756:         strcpy(buf, buf1);   /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  3757:         break;
  3758:       case 's':
  3759:         short_list = 1;
  3760:         strcpy(buf, buf1);   /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  3761:         break;
  3762:       case 'q':
  3763:         questwho = 1;
  3764:         strcpy(buf, buf1);   /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  3765:         break;
  3766:       case 'n':
  3767:         half_chop(buf1, name_search, buf);
  3768:         break;
  3769:       case 'r':
  3770:         who_room = 1;
  3771:         strcpy(buf, buf1);   /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  3772:         break;
  3773:       case 'c':
  3774:         half_chop(buf1, arg, buf);
  3775:         showclass = find_class_bitvector(arg);
  3776:         break;
  3777:       case 'l':
  3778:         showleader = 1;
  3779:         strcpy(buf, buf1);   /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  3780:         break;
  3781:       case 'g':
  3782:         showgroup = 1;
  3783:         strcpy(buf, buf1);   /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  3784:         break;
  3785:       default:
  3786:         send_to_char(ch, "%s", WHO_FORMAT);
  3787:         return;
  3788:       }
  3789:     } else {
  3790:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", WHO_FORMAT);
  3791:       return;
  3792:     }
  3793:   }
  3794: 
  3795:   for (d = descriptor_list; d && !short_list; d = d->next) {
  3796:     if (d->original)
  3797:       tch = d->original;
  3798:     else if (!(tch = d->character))
  3799:       continue;
  3800: 
  3801:     if (CAN_SEE(ch, tch) && IS_PLAYING(d)) {
  3802:       if (*name_search && str_cmp(GET_NAME(tch), name_search) &&
  3803:           !strstr(GET_TITLE(tch), name_search))
  3804:         continue;
  3805:       if (!CAN_SEE(ch, tch) || GET_LEVEL(tch) < low || GET_LEVEL(tch) > high)
  3806:         continue;
  3807:       if (outlaws && !PLR_FLAGGED(tch, PLR_KILLER) && !PLR_FLAGGED(tch, PLR_THIEF))
  3808:         continue;
  3809:       if (questwho && !PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_QUEST))
  3810:         continue;
  3811:       if (localwho && world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone != world[IN_ROOM(tch)].zone)
  3812:         continue;
  3813:       if (who_room && (IN_ROOM(tch) != IN_ROOM(ch)))
  3814:         continue;
  3815:       if (showclass && !(showclass & (1 << GET_CLASS(tch))))
  3816:         continue;
  3817:       if (showgroup && !GROUP(tch))
  3818:         continue;
  3819:       if (showleader && (!GROUP(tch) || GROUP_LEADER(GROUP(tch)) != tch))
  3820:         continue;
  3821:       for (i = 0; *rank[i].disp != '\n'; i++)
  3822:         if (GET_LEVEL(tch) >= rank[i].min_level && GET_LEVEL(tch) <= rank[i].max_level)
  3823:           rank[i].count++;
  3824:     }
  3825:   }
  3826: 
  3827:   for (i = 0; *rank[i].disp != '\n'; i++) {
  3828:     if (!rank[i].count && !short_list)
  3829:       continue;
  3830: 
  3831:     if (short_list)
  3832:       send_to_char(ch, "Players\r\n-------\r\n");
  3833:     else
  3834:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", rank[i].disp);
  3835: 
  3836:     for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
  3837:       if (d->original)
  3838:         tch = d->original;
  3839:       else if (!(tch = d->character))
  3840:         continue;
  3841: 
  3842:       if ((GET_LEVEL(tch) < rank[i].min_level || GET_LEVEL(tch) > rank[i].max_level) && !short_list)
  3843:         continue;
  3844:       if (!IS_PLAYING(d))
  3845:         continue;
  3846:       if (*name_search && str_cmp(GET_NAME(tch), name_search) &&
  3847:           !strstr(GET_TITLE(tch), name_search))
  3848:         continue;
  3849:       if (!CAN_SEE(ch, tch) || GET_LEVEL(tch) < low || GET_LEVEL(tch) > high)
  3850:         continue;
  3851:       if (outlaws && !PLR_FLAGGED(tch, PLR_KILLER) && !PLR_FLAGGED(tch, PLR_THIEF))
  3852:         continue;
  3853:       if (questwho && !PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_QUEST))
  3854:         continue;
  3855:       if (localwho && world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone != world[IN_ROOM(tch)].zone)
  3856:         continue;
  3857:       if (who_room && (IN_ROOM(tch) != IN_ROOM(ch)))
  3858:         continue;
  3859:       if (showclass && !(showclass & (1 << GET_CLASS(tch))))
  3860:         continue;
  3861:       if (showgroup && !GROUP(tch))

  3863:       if (showleader && (!GROUP(tch) || GROUP_LEADER(GROUP(tch)) != tch))
  3864:         continue;
  3865: 
  3866:       if (short_list) {
  3867:         send_to_char(ch, "%s[%2d %3s] %-12.12s%s%s",
  3868:           (GET_LEVEL(tch) >= LVL_IMMORT ? CCYEL(ch, C_SPR) : ""),
  3869:           GET_LEVEL(tch), classtrack_display_class_abbrev(tch), GET_NAME(tch),
  3870:           CCNRM(ch, C_SPR), ((!(++num_can_see % 4)) ? "\r\n" : ""));
  3871:       } else {
  3872:         num_can_see++;
  3873:         {
  3874:           char clancol[256];
  3875:           clancol[0] = '\0';
  3876: 
  3877:           if (GET_CLAN_ID(tch) > 0) {
  3878:             const char *clan_name = clan_display_name_by_id(GET_CLAN_ID(tch));
  3879:             char clan_name_buf[256];
  3880:             size_t name_len = strlen(clan_name);
  3881:             size_t max_clan_len = sizeof(clancol) - 7; /* '\t','n','[', name, '\t','n',']','\0' */
  3882: 
  3883:             if (max_clan_len >= sizeof(clan_name_buf))
  3884:               max_clan_len = sizeof(clan_name_buf) - 1;
  3885: 
  3886:             if (name_len >= 2 && clan_name[name_len - 2] == '\t' && clan_name[name_len - 1] == 'n')
  3887:               name_len -= 2;
  3888:             if (name_len > max_clan_len)
  3889:               name_len = max_clan_len;
  3890: 
  3891:             memcpy(clan_name_buf, clan_name, name_len);
  3892:             clan_name_buf[name_len] = '\0';
  3893: 
  3894:             {
  3895:               const char *cn = clan_name_buf;
  3896:               size_t cn_len = strcspn(cn, "\r\n");
  3897: 
  3898:               /* If the clan name already ends with a reset, move it outside the bracket. */
  3899:               if (cn_len >= 2 && cn[cn_len - 2] == '	' && cn[cn_len - 1] == 'n')
  3900:                 cn_len -= 2;
  3901: 
  3902:               /* Leave room for: '	','n','[', name, '	','n',']','\0' */
  3903:               size_t max_inside = sizeof(clancol) - 7;
  3904:               if (cn_len > max_inside)
  3905:                 cn_len = max_inside;
  3906:

  3908:             }

  3915:

  3923:                   (GET_LEVEL(tch) >= LVL_IMMORT ? CCYEL(ch, C_SPR) : ""),
  3924:                   GET_LEVEL(tch), classtrack_display_class_abbrev(tch),
  3925:                   (*clan_chunk ? clan_chunk : " "),

  3936:           send_to_char(ch, " (invis)");
  3937: 
  3938:         if (PLR_FLAGGED(tch, PLR_MAILING))
  3939:           send_to_char(ch, " (mailing)");
  3940:         else if (d->olc)
  3941:           send_to_char(ch, " (OLC)");

  3943:           send_to_char(ch, " (writing)");
  3944:

  3946:           send_to_char(ch, " (out of body)");
  3947: 
  3948:         if (d->connected == CON_OEDIT)
  3949:           send_to_char(ch, " (Object Edit)");
  3950:         if (d->connected == CON_MEDIT)
  3951:           send_to_char(ch, " (Mobile Edit)");
  3952:         if (d->connected == CON_ZEDIT)
  3953:           send_to_char(ch, " (Zone Edit)");
  3954:         if (d->connected == CON_SEDIT)
  3955:           send_to_char(ch, " (Shop Edit)");
  3956:         if (d->connected == CON_REDIT)
  3957:           send_to_char(ch, " (Room Edit)");
  3958:         if (d->connected == CON_TEDIT)
  3959:           send_to_char(ch, " (Text Edit)");
  3960:         if (d->connected == CON_TRIGEDIT)
  3961:           send_to_char(ch, " (Trigger Edit)");
  3962:         if (d->connected == CON_AEDIT)
  3963:           send_to_char(ch, " (Social Edit)");
  3964:         if (d->connected == CON_CEDIT)
  3965:           send_to_char(ch, " (Configuration Edit)");
  3966:         if (d->connected == CON_HEDIT)
  3967:           send_to_char(ch, " (Help edit)");
  3968:         if (d->connected == CON_QEDIT)
  3969:           send_to_char(ch, " (Quest Edit)");
  3970:         if (PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_BUILDWALK))
  3971:           send_to_char(ch, " (Buildwalking)");
  3972:         if (PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_AFK))
  3973:           send_to_char(ch, " (AFK)");
  3974:         if (PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_NOGOSS))
  3975:           send_to_char(ch, " (nogos)");
  3976:         if (PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_NOWIZ))
  3977:           send_to_char(ch, " (nowiz)");
  3978:         if (PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_NOSHOUT))
  3979:           send_to_char(ch, " (noshout)");
  3980:         if (PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_NOTELL))
  3981:           send_to_char(ch, " (notell)");
  3982:         if (PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_QUEST))

  3995:   if (short_list && num_can_see % 4)
  3996:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
  3997:   if (!num_can_see)

  3999:   else if (num_can_see == 1)
  4000:     send_to_char(ch, "One lonely character displayed.\r\n");
  4001:   else
  4002:     send_to_char(ch, "%d characters displayed.\r\n", num_can_see);

  4009: #define USERS_FORMAT \
  4010: "format: users [-l minlevel[-maxlevel]] [-n name] [-h host] [-c classlist] [-o] [-p]\r\n"
  4011: 
  4012: ACMD(do_users)
  4013: {
  4014:   char line[200], line2[220], idletime[10], classname[20];
  4015:   char state[30], timestr[9], mode;
  4016:   char name_search[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], host_search[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  4017:   struct char_data *tch;
  4018:   struct descriptor_data *d;
  4019:   int low = 0, high = LVL_IMPL, num_can_see = 0;
  4020:   int showclass = 0, outlaws = 0, playing = 0, deadweight = 0;
  4021:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  4022: 
  4023:   host_search[0] = name_search[0] = '\0';
  4024: 
  4025:   strcpy(buf, argument);    /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: argument == buf) */
  4026:   while (*buf) {
  4027:     char buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  4028: 
  4029:     half_chop(buf, arg, buf1);
  4030:     if (*arg == '-') {
  4031:       mode = *(arg + 1);  /* just in case; we destroy arg in the switch */
  4032:       switch (mode) {
  4033:       case 'o':
  4034:       case 'k':
  4035:     outlaws = 1;
  4036:     playing = 1;
  4037:     strcpy(buf, buf1);    /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  4038:     break;
  4039:       case 'p':
  4040:     playing = 1;
  4041:     strcpy(buf, buf1);    /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  4042:     break;
  4043:       case 'd':
  4044:     deadweight = 1;
  4045:     strcpy(buf, buf1);    /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  4046:     break;
  4047:       case 'l':
  4048:     playing = 1;
  4049:     half_chop(buf1, arg, buf);
  4050:     sscanf(arg, "%d-%d", &low, &high);
  4051:     break;
  4052:       case 'n':
  4053:     playing = 1;
  4054:     half_chop(buf1, name_search, buf);
  4055:     break;
  4056:       case 'h':
  4057:     playing = 1;
  4058:     half_chop(buf1, host_search, buf);
  4059:     break;
  4060:       case 'c':
  4061:     playing = 1;
  4062:     half_chop(buf1, arg, buf);
  4063:     showclass = find_class_bitvector(arg);
  4064:     break;
  4065:       default:
  4066:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", USERS_FORMAT);
  4067:     return;
  4068:       }                /* end of switch */
  4069: 
  4070:     } else {            /* endif */
  4071:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", USERS_FORMAT);
  4072:       return;
  4073:     }
  4074:   }                /* end while (parser) */
  4075:   send_to_char(ch,
  4076:      "Num Class   Name         State          Idl   Login\t*   Site\r\n"
  4077:      "--- ------- ------------ -------------- ----- -------- ------------------------\r\n");
  4078: 
  4079:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  4080: 
  4081:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
  4082:     if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING && playing)
  4083:       continue;
  4084:     if (STATE(d) == CON_PLAYING && deadweight)
  4085:       continue;
  4086:     if (IS_PLAYING(d)) {
  4087:       if (d->original)
  4088:         tch = d->original;
  4089:       else if (!(tch = d->character))
  4090:         continue;
  4091: 
  4092:       if (*host_search && !strstr(d->host, host_search))
  4093:         continue;
  4094:       if (*name_search && str_cmp(GET_NAME(tch), name_search))
  4095:         continue;
  4096:       if (!CAN_SEE(ch, tch) || GET_LEVEL(tch) < low || GET_LEVEL(tch) > high)
  4097:         continue;
  4098:       if (outlaws && !PLR_FLAGGED(tch, PLR_KILLER) &&
  4099:       !PLR_FLAGGED(tch, PLR_THIEF))
  4100:         continue;
  4101:       if (showclass && !(showclass & (1 << GET_CLASS(tch))))
  4102:         continue;
  4103:       if (GET_INVIS_LEV(tch) > GET_LEVEL(ch))
  4104:         continue;
  4105: 
  4106:       if (d->original)
  4107:     sprintf(classname, "[%2d %3s]", GET_LEVEL(d->original),
  4108:         classtrack_display_class_abbrev(d->original));
  4109:       else
  4110:     sprintf(classname, "[%2d %3s]", GET_LEVEL(d->character),
  4111:         classtrack_display_class_abbrev(d->character));
  4112:     } else
  4113:       strcpy(classname, "   -   ");
  4114: 
  4115:     strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%H:%M:%S", localtime(&(d->login_time)));
  4116: 
  4117:     if (STATE(d) == CON_PLAYING && d->original)
  4118:       strcpy(state, "Switched");
  4119:     else
  4120:       strcpy(state, connected_types[STATE(d)]);
  4121: 
  4122:     if (d->character && STATE(d) == CON_PLAYING)
  4123:       sprintf(idletime, "%5d", d->character->char_specials.timer *
  4124:           SECS_PER_MUD_HOUR / SECS_PER_REAL_MIN);
  4125:     else
  4126:       strcpy(idletime, "     ");
  4127: 
  4128:     sprintf(line, "%3d %-7s %-12s %-14s %-3s %-8s ", d->desc_num, classname,
  4129:     d->original && d->original->player.name ? d->original->player.name :
  4130:     d->character && d->character->player.name ? d->character->player.name :
  4131:     "UNDEFINED",
  4132:     state, idletime, timestr);
  4133: 
  4134:     if (*d->host)
  4135:       sprintf(line + strlen(line), "[%s]\r\n", d->host);
  4136:     else
  4137:       strcat(line, "[Hostname unknown]\r\n");
  4138: 
  4139:     if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING) {
  4140:       sprintf(line2, "%s%s%s", CCGRN(ch, C_SPR), line, CCNRM(ch, C_SPR));
  4141:       strcpy(line, line2);
  4142:     }
  4143:     if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING || (STATE(d) == CON_PLAYING && CAN_SEE(ch, d->character))) {
  4144:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", line);
  4145:       num_can_see++;
  4146:     }
  4147:   }
  4148: 
  4149:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\n%d visible sockets connected.\r\n", num_can_see);
  4150: }

  4152: /* Generic page_string function for displaying text */
  4153: ACMD(do_gen_ps)
  4154: {
  4155:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) {
  4156:     send_to_char(ch, "Not for mobiles!\r\n");
  4157:     return;
  4158:   }
  4159: 
  4160:   switch (subcmd) {
  4161:   case SCMD_CREDITS:
  4162:     page_string(ch->desc, credits, 0);
  4163:     break;
  4164:   case SCMD_NEWS:
  4165:     GET_LAST_NEWS(ch) = time(0);
  4166:     page_string(ch->desc, news, 0);
  4167:     break;
  4168:   case SCMD_INFO:
  4169:     page_string(ch->desc, info, 0);
  4170:     break;
  4171:   case SCMD_WIZLIST:
  4172:     page_string(ch->desc, wizlist, 0);
  4173:     break;
  4174:   case SCMD_IMMLIST:
  4175:     page_string(ch->desc, immlist, 0);
  4176:     break;
  4177:   case SCMD_HANDBOOK:
  4178:     page_string(ch->desc, handbook, 0);
  4179:     break;
  4180:   case SCMD_POLICIES:
  4181:     page_string(ch->desc, policies, 0);
  4182:     break;
  4183:   case SCMD_MOTD:
  4184:     GET_LAST_MOTD(ch) = time(0);
  4185:     page_string(ch->desc, motd, 0);
  4186:     break;
  4187:   case SCMD_IMOTD:
  4188:     page_string(ch->desc, imotd, 0);
  4189:     break;
  4190:   case SCMD_CLEAR:
  4191:     send_to_char(ch, "\033[H\033[J");
  4192:     break;
  4193:   case SCMD_VERSION:
  4194:     send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", tbamud_version);
  4195:     break;
  4196:   case SCMD_WHOAMI:
  4197:     send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", GET_NAME(ch));
  4198:     break;
  4199:   default:
  4200:     log("SYSERR: Unhandled case in do_gen_ps. (%d)", subcmd);
  4201:     /* SYSERR_DESC: General page string function for such things as 'credits',
  4202:      * 'news', 'wizlist', 'clear', 'version'.  This occurs when a call is made
  4203:      * to this routine that is not one of the predefined calls.  To correct it,
  4204:      * either a case needs to be added into the function to account for the
  4205:      * subcmd that is being passed to it, or the call to the function needs to
  4206:      * have the correct subcmd put into place. */
  4207:     return;
  4208:   }
  4209: }

  4211: static void perform_mortal_where(struct char_data *ch, char *arg)
  4212: {
  4213:   struct char_data *i;
  4214:   struct descriptor_data *d;
  4215:   int j;
  4216: 
  4217:   if (!*arg) {
  4218:     j = world[(IN_ROOM(ch))].zone;
  4219:     send_to_char(ch, "Players in %s\tn.\r\n--------------------\r\n", zone_table[j].name);
  4220:     for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
  4221:       if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING || d->character == ch)
  4222:     continue;
  4223:       if ((i = (d->original ? d->original : d->character)) == NULL)
  4224:     continue;
  4225:       if (IN_ROOM(i) == NOWHERE || !CAN_SEE(ch, i))
  4226:     continue;
  4227:       if (world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone != world[IN_ROOM(i)].zone)
  4228:     continue;
  4229:       send_to_char(ch, "%-20s%s - %s%s\r\n", GET_NAME(i), QNRM, world[IN_ROOM(i)].name, QNRM);
  4230:     }
  4231:   } else {            /* print only FIRST char, not all. */
  4232:     for (i = character_list; i; i = i->next) {
  4233:       if (IN_ROOM(i) == NOWHERE || i == ch)
  4234:     continue;
  4235:       if (!CAN_SEE(ch, i) || world[IN_ROOM(i)].zone != world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone)
  4236:     continue;
  4237:       if (!isname(arg, i->player.name))
  4238:     continue;
  4239:       send_to_char(ch, "%-25s%s - %s%s\r\n", GET_NAME(i), QNRM, world[IN_ROOM(i)].name, QNRM);
  4240:       return;
  4241:     }
  4242:     send_to_char(ch, "Nobody around by that name.\r\n");
  4243:   }
  4244: }

  4246: static size_t print_object_location(const int num, const obj_data *obj, const char_data *ch, // NOLINT(*-no-recursion)
  4247:                    char *buf, size_t len, const size_t buf_size, const int recur)
  4248: {
  4249:   size_t nlen = 0;
  4250: 
  4251:   if (num > 0)
  4252:     nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "O%4d. %-25s%s - ", num, obj->short_description, QNRM);
  4253:   else
  4254:     nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "%37s", " - ");
  4255: 
  4256:   len += nlen;
  4257:   nlen = 0;
  4258:   if (len > buf_size)
  4259:     return len; // let the caller know we overflowed
  4260: 
  4261:   if (SCRIPT(obj)) {
  4262:     if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj))->next)
  4263:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "[T%d] ", GET_TRIG_VNUM(TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj))));
  4264:     else
  4265:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "[TRIGS] ");
  4266:   }
  4267: 
  4268:   len += nlen;
  4269:   if (len > buf_size)
  4270:     return len; // let the caller know we overflowed
  4271: 
  4272:   if (IN_ROOM(obj) != NOWHERE)
  4273:     nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "[%5d] %s%s\r\n", GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(obj)), world[IN_ROOM(obj)].name, QNRM);
  4274:   else if (obj->carried_by) {
  4275:     if (PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_SHOWVNUMS))
  4276:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "carried by [%5d] %s%s\r\n", GET_MOB_VNUM(obj->carried_by), PERS(obj->carried_by, ch), QNRM);
  4277:     else
  4278:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "carried by %s%s\r\n", PERS(obj->carried_by, ch), QNRM);
  4279:     if (PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_VERBOSE) && IN_ROOM(obj->carried_by) != NOWHERE && len + nlen < buf_size)
  4280:       nlen += snprintf(buf + len + nlen, buf_size - len - nlen, "%37sin [%5d] %s%s\r\n", " - ", GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(obj->carried_by)), world[IN_ROOM(obj->carried_by)].name, QNRM);
  4281:   } else if (obj->worn_by) {
  4282:     if (PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_SHOWVNUMS))
  4283:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "worn by [%5d] %s%s\r\n", GET_MOB_VNUM(obj->worn_by), PERS(obj->worn_by, ch), QNRM);
  4284:     else
  4285:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "worn by %s%s\r\n", PERS(obj->worn_by, ch), QNRM);
  4286:     if (PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_VERBOSE) && IN_ROOM(obj->worn_by) != NOWHERE && len + nlen < buf_size)
  4287:       nlen += snprintf(buf + len + nlen, buf_size - len - nlen, "%37sin [%5d] %s%s\r\n", " - ", GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(obj->worn_by)), world[IN_ROOM(obj->worn_by)].name, QNRM);
  4288:   } else if (obj->in_obj) {
  4289:     nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "inside %s%s%s\r\n", obj->in_obj->short_description, QNRM, (recur ? ", which is" : " "));
  4290:     if (recur && nlen + len < buf_size) {
  4291:       len += nlen;
  4292:       nlen = 0;
  4293:       len = print_object_location(0, obj->in_obj, ch, buf, len, buf_size, recur);
  4294:     }
  4295:   } else
  4296:     nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "in an unknown location\r\n");
  4297:   len += nlen;
  4298:   return len;
  4299: }

  4301: static void perform_immort_where(char_data *ch, const char *arg)
  4302: {
  4303:   char_data *i;
  4304:   obj_data *k;
  4305:   struct descriptor_data *d;
  4306:   int num = 0, found = FALSE; // "num" here needs to match the lookup in do_stat, so "stat 4.sword" finds the right one
  4307:   const char *error_message = "\r\n***OVERFLOW***\r\n";
  4308:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  4309:   size_t len = 0, nlen = 0;
  4310:   const size_t buf_size = sizeof(buf) - strlen(error_message) - 1;
  4311: 
  4312:   if (!*arg) {
  4313:     send_to_char(ch, "Players  Room    Location                       Zone\r\n");
  4314:     send_to_char(ch, "-------- ------- ------------------------------ -------------------\r\n");
  4315:     for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next)
  4316:       if (IS_PLAYING(d)) {
  4317:         i = (d->original ? d->original : d->character);
  4318:         if (i && CAN_SEE(ch, i) && (IN_ROOM(i) != NOWHERE)) {
  4319:           if (d->original)
  4320:             send_to_char(ch, "%-8s%s - [%5d] %s%s (in %s%s)\r\n",
  4321:               GET_NAME(i), QNRM, GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(d->character)),
  4322:               world[IN_ROOM(d->character)].name, QNRM, GET_NAME(d->character), QNRM);
  4323:           else
  4324:             send_to_char(ch, "%-8s%s %s[%s%5d%s]%s %-*s%s %s%s\r\n", GET_NAME(i), QNRM,
  4325:               QCYN, QYEL, GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(i)), QCYN, QNRM,
  4326:               30+count_color_chars(world[IN_ROOM(i)].name), world[IN_ROOM(i)].name, QNRM,
  4327:               zone_table[(world[IN_ROOM(i)].zone)].name, QNRM);
  4328:         }
  4329:       }
  4330:   } else {
  4331:     if (PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_VERBOSE))
  4332:       len = snprintf(buf, buf_size, "   ### Mob name                   - Room #  Room name\r\n");
  4333: 
  4334:     for (i = character_list; i; i = i->next)
  4335:       if (CAN_SEE(ch, i) && IN_ROOM(i) != NOWHERE && isname(arg, i->player.name)) {
  4336:         found = 1;
  4337:         nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "M%4d. %-25s%s - [%5d] %-25s%s", ++num, GET_NAME(i), QNRM,
  4338:                GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(i)), world[IN_ROOM(i)].name, QNRM);
  4339:         if (len + nlen >= buf_size) {
  4340:           len += snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "%s", error_message);
  4341:           break;
  4342:         }
  4343:         len += nlen;
  4344:         if (SCRIPT(i) && TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(i))) {
  4345:           if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(i))->next)
  4346:             nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "[T%d]", GET_TRIG_VNUM(TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(i))));
  4347:           else
  4348:             nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "[TRIGS]");
  4349: 
  4350:           if (len + nlen >= buf_size) {
  4351:             snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "%s", error_message);
  4352:             break;
  4353:           }
  4354:           len += nlen;
  4355:         }
  4356:         nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "%s\r\n", QNRM);
  4357:         if (len + nlen >= buf_size) {
  4358:           snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "%s", error_message);
  4359:           break;
  4360:         }
  4361:         len += nlen;
  4362:       }
  4363: 
  4364:     if (PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_VERBOSE) && len < buf_size) {
  4365:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "  ###  Object name                 Location\r\n");
  4366:       if (len + nlen >= buf_size) {
  4367:         snprintf(buf + len, buf_size - len, "%s", error_message);
  4368:       }
  4369:       len += nlen;
  4370:     }
  4371: 
  4372:     if (len < buf_size) {
  4373:       for (k = object_list; k; k = k->next) {
  4374:         if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, k) && isname(arg, k->name)) {
  4375:           found = 1;
  4376:           len = print_object_location(++num, k, ch, buf, len, buf_size, TRUE);
  4377:           if (len >= buf_size) {
  4378:             snprintf(buf + buf_size, sizeof(buf) - buf_size, "%s", error_message);
  4379:             break;
  4380:           }
  4381:         }
  4382:       }
  4383:     }
  4384: 
  4385:     if (!found)
  4386:       send_to_char(ch, "Couldn't find any such thing.\r\n");
  4387:     else
  4388:       page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
  4389:   }
  4390: }

  4404: ACMD(do_levels)
  4405: {
  4406:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], arg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  4407:   size_t len = 0, nlen;
  4408:   int i, ret, min_lev=1, max_lev=LVL_IMMORT, val;
  4409: 
  4410:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) {
  4411:     send_to_char(ch, "You ain't nothin' but a hound-dog.\r\n");
  4412:     return;
  4413:   }
  4414:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  4415: 
  4416:   if (*arg) {
  4417:     if (isdigit(*arg)) {
  4418:       ret = sscanf(arg, "%d-%d", &min_lev, &max_lev);
  4419:       if (ret == 0) {
  4420:         /* No valid args found */
  4421:         min_lev = 1;
  4422:         max_lev = LVL_IMMORT;
  4423:       }
  4424:       else if (ret == 1) {
  4425:         /* One arg = range is (num) either side of current level */
  4426:         val = min_lev;
  4427:         max_lev = MIN(GET_LEVEL(ch) + val, LVL_IMMORT);
  4428:         min_lev = MAX(GET_LEVEL(ch) - val, 1);
  4429:       }
  4430:       else if (ret == 2) {
  4431:         /* Two args = min-max range limit - just do sanity checks */
  4432:         min_lev = MAX(min_lev, 1);
  4433:         max_lev = MIN(max_lev + 1, LVL_IMMORT);
  4434:       }
  4435:     }
  4436:     else
  4437:     {
  4438:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %slevels [<min>-<max> | <range>]%s\r\n\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
  4439:       send_to_char(ch, "Displays exp required for levels.\r\n");
  4440:       send_to_char(ch, "%slevels       %s- shows all levels (1-%d)\r\n", QCYN, QNRM, (LVL_IMMORT-1));
  4441:       send_to_char(ch, "%slevels 5     %s- shows 5 levels either side of your current level\r\n", QCYN, QNRM);
  4442:       send_to_char(ch, "%slevels 10-20 %s- shows level 10 to level 20\r\n",QCYN, QNRM);
  4443:       return;
  4444:     }
  4445:   }
  4446: 
  4447:   for (i = min_lev; i < max_lev; i++) {
  4448:     nlen = snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "[%2d] %8d-%-8d : ", (int)i,
  4449:     level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), i), level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), i + 1) - 1);
  4450:     if (len + nlen >= sizeof(buf))
  4451:       break;
  4452:     len += nlen;
  4453: 
  4454:     switch (GET_SEX(ch)) {
  4455:     case SEX_MALE:
  4456:     case SEX_NEUTRAL:
  4457:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s\r\n", title_male(GET_CLASS(ch), i));
  4458:       break;
  4459:     case SEX_FEMALE:
  4460:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s\r\n", title_female(GET_CLASS(ch), i));
  4461:       break;
  4462:     default:
  4463:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "Oh dear.  You seem to be sexless.\r\n");
  4464:       break;
  4465:     }
  4466:     if (len + nlen >= sizeof(buf))
  4467:       break;
  4468:     len += nlen;
  4469:   }
  4470: 
  4471:   if (len < sizeof(buf) && max_lev == LVL_IMMORT)
  4472:     snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "[%2d] %8d          : Immortality\r\n",
  4473:         LVL_IMMORT, level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), LVL_IMMORT));
  4474:   page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
  4475: }

  4477: ACMD(do_consider)
  4478: {
  4479:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  4480:   const char *vict_name;
  4481:   struct char_data *victim;
  4482:   int diff;
  4483: 
  4484:   one_argument(argument, buf);
  4485: 
  4486:   if (!(victim = get_char_vis(ch, buf, NULL, FIND_CHAR_ROOM))) {
  4487:     send_to_char(ch, "Consider killing who?\r\n");
  4488:     return;
  4489:   }
  4490:   if (victim == ch) {
  4491:     send_to_char(ch, "Easy!  Very easy indeed!\r\n");
  4492:     return;
  4493:   }
  4494:   if (!IS_NPC(victim)) {
  4495:     send_to_char(ch, "Would you like to borrow a cross and a shovel?\r\n");
  4496:     return;
  4497:   }
  4498:   vict_name = PERS(victim, ch);
  4499:   diff = (GET_LEVEL(victim) - GET_LEVEL(ch));
  4500: 
  4501:   if (diff <= -10)
  4502:     send_to_char(ch, "You would absolutely destroy %s.\r\n", vict_name);
  4503:   else if (diff <= -6)
  4504:     send_to_char(ch, "%s would be no match for you.\r\n", vict_name);
  4505:   else if (diff <= -3)
  4506:     send_to_char(ch, "You should handle %s with little trouble.\r\n", vict_name);
  4507:   else if (diff <= 2)
  4508:     send_to_char(ch, "%s might put up a decent fight.\r\n", vict_name);
  4509:   else if (diff <= 5)
  4510:     send_to_char(ch, "%s would put up a good fight.\r\n", vict_name);
  4511:   else if (diff <= 8)
  4512:     send_to_char(ch, "%s looks dangerous.\r\n", vict_name);
  4513:   else if (diff <= 11)
  4514:     send_to_char(ch, "%s would be a serious threat.\r\n", vict_name);
  4515:   else if (diff <= 15)
  4516:     send_to_char(ch, "%s might overwhelm you.\r\n", vict_name);
  4517:   else
  4518:     send_to_char(ch, "%s would likely destroy you.\r\n", vict_name);
  4519: 
  4520:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_DETECT_ALIGN)) {
  4521:     if (GET_ALIGNMENT(victim) >= 800)
  4522:       send_to_char(ch, "You sense a deeply benevolent presence.\r\n");
  4523:     else if (GET_ALIGNMENT(victim) >= 300)
  4524:       send_to_char(ch, "There is a faint sense of virtue about them.\r\n");
  4525:     else if (GET_ALIGNMENT(victim) <= -800)
  4526:       send_to_char(ch, "They radiate a deeply malevolent aura.\r\n");
  4527:     else if (GET_ALIGNMENT(victim) <= -300)
  4528:       send_to_char(ch, "Something about them feels off.\r\n");
  4529:     else
  4530:       send_to_char(ch, "You sense little moral weight from them.\r\n");
  4531:   }
  4532: }

  4954: ACMD(do_commands)
  4955: {
  4956:   int no, i, cmd_num;
  4957:   int socials = 0;
  4958:   const char *commands[1000];
  4959:   int overflow = sizeof(commands) / sizeof(commands[0]);
  4960: 
  4961:   if (!ch->desc)
  4962:     return;
  4963: 
  4964:   if (subcmd == SCMD_SOCIALS)
  4965:     socials = 1;
  4966: 
  4967:   send_to_char(ch, "The following %s are available to you:\r\n", socials ? "socials" : "commands");
  4968: 
  4969:   /* cmd_num starts at 1, not 0, to remove 'RESERVED' */
  4970:   for (no = 0, cmd_num = 1;
  4971:        complete_cmd_info[cmd_sort_info[cmd_num]].command[0] != '\n';
  4972:        ++cmd_num) {
  4973: 
  4974:     i = cmd_sort_info[cmd_num];
  4975: 
  4976:     if (complete_cmd_info[i].minimum_level < 0 || GET_LEVEL(ch) < complete_cmd_info[i].minimum_level)
  4977: 
  4978:       continue;
  4979: 
  4980:     if (complete_cmd_info[i].minimum_level >= LVL_IMMORT)
  4981:       continue;
  4982: 
  4983:     if (socials != (complete_cmd_info[i].command_pointer == do_action))
  4984:       continue;
  4985: 
  4986:     if (--overflow < 0)
  4987:       continue;
  4988: 
  4989:     /* matching command: copy to commands list */
  4990:     commands[no++] = complete_cmd_info[i].command;
  4991:   }
  4992: 
  4993:   /* display commands list in a nice columnized format */
  4994:   column_list(ch, 0, commands, no, FALSE);
  4995: }

  4997: void free_history(struct char_data *ch, int type)
  4998: {
  4999:   struct txt_block *tmp = GET_HISTORY(ch, type), *ftmp;
  5000: 
  5001:   while ((ftmp = tmp)) {
  5002:     tmp = tmp->next;
  5003:     if (ftmp->text)
  5004:       free(ftmp->text);
  5005:     free(ftmp);
  5006:   }
  5007:   GET_HISTORY(ch, type) = NULL;
  5008: }
  5009: 
  5010: ACMD(do_history)
  5011: {
  5012:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  5013:   int type;
  5014: 
  5015:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  5016: 
  5017:   type = search_block(arg, history_types, FALSE);
  5018:   if (!*arg || type < 0) {
  5019:     int i;
  5020: 
  5021:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: history <");
  5022:     for (i = 0; *history_types[i] != '\n'; i++) {
  5023:       send_to_char(ch, " %s ", history_types[i]);
  5024:       if (*history_types[i + 1] == '\n')
  5025:         send_to_char(ch, ">\r\n");
  5026:       else
  5027:         send_to_char(ch, "|");
  5028:     }
  5029:     return;
  5030:   }
  5031: 
  5032:   if (GET_HISTORY(ch, type) && GET_HISTORY(ch, type)->text && *GET_HISTORY(ch, type)->text) {
  5033:     struct txt_block *tmp;
  5034:     for (tmp = GET_HISTORY(ch, type); tmp; tmp = tmp->next)
  5035:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", tmp->text);
  5036: /* Make this a 1 if you want history to clear after viewing */
  5037: #if 0
  5038:       free_history(ch, type);
  5039: #endif
  5040:   } else
  5041:     send_to_char(ch, "You have no history in that channel.\r\n");
  5042: }
  5043: 
  5044: #define HIST_LENGTH 100
  5045: void add_history(struct char_data *ch, char *str, int type)
  5046: {
  5047:   int i = 0;
  5048:   char time_str[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  5049:   struct txt_block *tmp;
  5050:   time_t ct;
  5051: 
  5052:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  5053:     return;
  5054: 
  5055:   tmp = GET_HISTORY(ch, type);
  5056:   ct = time(0);
  5057:   strftime(time_str, sizeof(time_str), "%H:%M ", localtime(&ct));
  5058: 
  5059:   sprintf(buf, "%s%s", time_str, str);
  5060: 
  5061:   if (!tmp) {
  5062:     CREATE(GET_HISTORY(ch, type), struct txt_block, 1);
  5063:     GET_HISTORY(ch, type)->text = strdup(buf);
  5064:   }
  5065:   else {
  5066:     while (tmp->next)
  5067:       tmp = tmp->next;
  5068:     CREATE(tmp->next, struct txt_block, 1);
  5069:     tmp->next->text = strdup(buf);
  5070: 
  5071:     for (tmp = GET_HISTORY(ch, type); tmp; tmp = tmp->next, i++);
  5072: 
  5073:     for (; i > HIST_LENGTH && GET_HISTORY(ch, type); i--) {
  5074:       tmp = GET_HISTORY(ch, type);
  5075:       GET_HISTORY(ch, type) = tmp->next;
  5076:       if (tmp->text)
  5077:         free(tmp->text);
  5078:       free(tmp);
  5079:     }
  5080:   }
  5081:   /* add this history message to ALL */
  5082:   if (type != HIST_ALL)
  5083:     add_history(ch, str, HIST_ALL);
  5084: }

  5086: ACMD(do_whois)
  5087: {
  5088:   struct char_data *victim = 0;
  5089:   int hours;
  5090:   int got_from_file = 0;
  5091:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  5092: 
  5093:   one_argument(argument, buf);
  5094: 
  5095:   if (!*buf) {
  5096:     send_to_char(ch, "Whois who?\r\n");
  5097:     return;
  5098:   }
  5099: 
  5100:   if (!(victim=get_player_vis(ch, buf, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)))
  5101:   {
  5102:      CREATE(victim, struct char_data, 1);
  5103:      clear_char(victim);
  5104: 
  5105:      new_mobile_data(victim);
  5106: 
  5107:      CREATE(victim->player_specials, struct player_special_data, 1);
  5108: 
  5109:      if (load_char(buf, victim) > -1)
  5110:        got_from_file = 1;
  5111:      else {
  5112:         send_to_char (ch, "There is no such player.\r\n");
  5113:         free_char (victim);
  5114:         return;
  5115:      }
  5116:   }
  5117: 
  5118:   /* We either have our victim from file or he's playing or function has returned. */
  5119:   sprinttype(GET_SEX(victim), genders, buf, sizeof(buf));
  5120:   send_to_char(ch, "Name: %s %s\r\nSex: %s\r\n", GET_NAME(victim),
  5121:                    (victim->player.title ? victim->player.title : ""), buf);
  5122: 
  5123:   strlcpy(buf, classtrack_display_class_name(victim), sizeof(buf));
  5124:   send_to_char(ch, "Class: %s\r\n", buf);
  5125: 
  5126: 
  5127:   send_to_char(ch, "Level: %d\r\n", GET_LEVEL(victim));
  5128: 
  5129:   if (!(GET_LEVEL(victim) < LVL_IMMORT) || (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= GET_LEVEL(victim))) {
  5130:     strftime(buf, sizeof(buf), "%a %b %d %Y", localtime(&(victim->player.time.logon)));
  5131: 
  5132:     hours = (time(0) - victim->player.time.logon) / 3600;
  5133: 
  5134:     if (!got_from_file) {
  5135:       send_to_char(ch, "Last Logon: Playing now!  (Idle %d Minutes)",
  5136:            victim->char_specials.timer * SECS_PER_MUD_HOUR / SECS_PER_REAL_MIN);
  5137: 
  5138:       if (!victim->desc)
  5139:         send_to_char(ch, "  (Linkless)\r\n");
  5140:       else
  5141:         send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
  5142: 
  5143:       if (PRF_FLAGGED(victim, PRF_AFK))
  5144:         send_to_char(ch, "%s%s is afk right now, so %s may not respond to communication.%s\r\n", CBGRN(ch, C_NRM), GET_NAME(victim), HSSH(victim), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  5145:     }
  5146:     else if (hours > 0)
  5147:       send_to_char(ch, "Last Logon: %s (%d days & %d hours ago.)\r\n", buf, hours/24, hours%24);
  5148:     else
  5149:       send_to_char(ch, "Last Logon: %s (0 hours & %d minutes ago.)\r\n",
  5150:                    buf, (int)(time(0) - victim->player.time.logon)/60);
  5151:   }
  5152: 
  5153:   if (has_mail(GET_IDNUM(victim)))
  5154:      act("$E$u has mail waiting.", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_CHAR);
  5155:   else
  5156:      act("$E$u has no mail waiting.", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_CHAR);
  5157: 
  5158:   if (PLR_FLAGGED(victim, PLR_DELETED))
  5159:     send_to_char (ch, "***DELETED***\r\n");
  5160: 
  5161:   if (!got_from_file && victim->desc != NULL && GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GOD) {
  5162:     protocol_t * prot = victim->desc->pProtocol;
  5163:     send_to_char(ch, "Client:  %s [%s]\r\n", prot->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString, prot->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->pValueString ? prot->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->pValueString : "Unknown");
  5164:     send_to_char(ch, "Color:   %s\r\n", prot->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt ? "Xterm" : (prot->pVariables[eMSDP_ANSI_COLORS]->ValueInt ? "Ansi" : "None"));
  5165:     send_to_char(ch, "MXP:     %s\r\n", prot->bMXP ? "Yes" : "No");
  5166:     send_to_char(ch, "Charset: %s\r\n", prot->bCHARSET ? "Yes" : "No");
  5167:     send_to_char(ch, "MSP:     %s\r\n", prot->bMSP ? "Yes" : "No");
  5168:     send_to_char(ch, "ATCP:    %s\r\n", prot->bATCP ? "Yes" : "No");
  5169:     send_to_char(ch, "MSDP:    %s\r\n", prot->bMSDP ? "Yes" : "No");
  5170:   }
  5171: 
  5172:   if (got_from_file)
  5173:     free_char (victim);
  5174: }

  5176: static bool get_zone_levels(zone_rnum znum, char *buf)
  5177: {
  5178:   /* Create a string for the level restrictions for this zone. */
  5179:   if ((zone_table[znum].min_level == -1) && (zone_table[znum].max_level == -1)) {
  5180:     sprintf(buf, "<Not Set!>");
  5181:     return FALSE;
  5182:   }
  5183: 
  5184:   if (zone_table[znum].min_level == -1) {
  5185:     sprintf(buf, "Up to level %d", zone_table[znum].max_level);
  5186:     return TRUE;
  5187:   }
  5188: 
  5189:   if (zone_table[znum].max_level == -1) {
  5190:     sprintf(buf, "Above level %d", zone_table[znum].min_level);
  5191:     return TRUE;
  5192:   }
  5193: 
  5194:   sprintf(buf, "Levels %d to %d", zone_table[znum].min_level, zone_table[znum].max_level);
  5195:   return TRUE;
  5196: }

  5198: ACMD(do_areas)
  5199: {
  5200:   int i, hilev=-1, lolev=-1, zcount=0, lev_set, len=0, tmp_len=0;
  5201:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *second, lev_str[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  5202:   bool show_zone = FALSE, overlap = FALSE, overlap_shown = FALSE;
  5203: 
  5204:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  5205: 
  5206:   if (*arg) {
  5207:     /* There was an arg typed - check for level range */
  5208:     second = strchr(arg, '-');
  5209:     if (second) {
  5210:       /* Check for 1st value */
  5211:       if (second == arg)
  5212:         lolev = 0;
  5213:       else
  5214:         lolev = atoi(arg);
  5215: 
  5216:       /* Check for 2nd value */
  5217:       if (*(second+1) == '\0' || !isdigit(*(second+1)) )
  5218:         hilev = 100;
  5219:       else
  5220:         hilev = atoi(second+1);
  5221: 
  5222:     } else {
  5223:       /* No range - single number */
  5224:       lolev = atoi(arg);
  5225:       hilev = -1;  /* No high level - indicates single level */
  5226:     }
  5227:   }
  5228:   if (hilev != -1 && lolev > hilev) {
  5229:     /* Swap hi and lo lev if needed */
  5230:     i     = lolev;
  5231:     lolev = hilev;
  5232:     hilev = i;
  5233:   }
  5234:   if (hilev != -1)
  5235:     len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Checking range: %s%d to %d%s\r\n", QYEL, lolev, hilev, QNRM);
  5236:   else if (lolev != -1)
  5237:     len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Checking level: %s%d%s\r\n", QYEL, lolev, QNRM);
  5238:   else
  5239:     len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Checking all areas.\r\n");
  5240: 
  5241:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_zone_table; i++) {    /* Go through the whole zone table */
  5242:     show_zone = FALSE;
  5243:     overlap = FALSE;
  5244: 
  5245:     if (ZONE_FLAGGED(i, ZONE_GRID)) {           /* Is this zone 'on the grid' ?    */
  5246:       if (lolev == -1) {
  5247:         /* No range supplied, show all zones */
  5248:         show_zone = TRUE;
  5249:       } else if ((hilev == -1) && (lolev >= ZONE_MINLVL(i)) && (lolev <= ZONE_MAXLVL(i))) {
  5250:         /* Single number supplied, it's in this zone's range */
  5251:         show_zone = TRUE;
  5252:       } else if ((hilev != -1) && (lolev >= ZONE_MINLVL(i)) && (hilev <= ZONE_MAXLVL(i))) {
  5253:         /* Range supplied, it's completely within this zone's range (no overlap) */
  5254:         show_zone = TRUE;
  5255:       } else if ((hilev != -1) && ((lolev >= ZONE_MINLVL(i) && lolev <= ZONE_MAXLVL(i)) || (hilev <= ZONE_MAXLVL(i) && hilev >= ZONE_MINLVL(i)))) {
  5256:         /* Range supplied, it overlaps this zone's range */
  5257:         show_zone = TRUE;
  5258:         overlap = TRUE;
  5259:       } else if (ZONE_MAXLVL(i) < 0 && (lolev >= ZONE_MINLVL(i))) {
  5260:         /* Max level not set for this zone, but specified min in range */
  5261:         show_zone = TRUE;
  5262:       } else if (ZONE_MAXLVL(i) < 0 && (hilev >= ZONE_MINLVL(i))) {
  5263:         /* Max level not set for this zone, so just display it as red */
  5264:         show_zone = TRUE;
  5265:         overlap = TRUE;
  5266:       }
  5267:     }
  5268: 
  5269:     if (show_zone) {
  5270:       if (overlap) overlap_shown = TRUE;
  5271:       lev_set = get_zone_levels(i, lev_str);
  5272:       tmp_len = snprintf(buf+len, sizeof(buf)-len, "\tn(%3d) %s%-*s\tn %s%s\tn\r\n", ++zcount, overlap ? QRED : QCYN,
  5273:                  count_color_chars(zone_table[i].name)+30, zone_table[i].name,
  5274:                  lev_set ? "\tc" : "\tn", lev_set ? lev_str : "All Levels");
  5275:       len += tmp_len;
  5276:     }
  5277:   }
  5278:   tmp_len = snprintf(buf+len, sizeof(buf)-len, "%s%d%s area%s found.\r\n", QYEL, zcount, QNRM, zcount == 1 ? "" : "s");
  5279:   len += tmp_len;
  5280: 
  5281:   if (overlap_shown) {
  5282:     snprintf(buf+len, sizeof(buf)-len, "Areas shown in \trred\tn may have some creatures outside the specified range.\r\n");
  5283:   }
  5284: 
  5285:   if (zcount == 0)
  5286:     send_to_char(ch, "No areas found.\r\n");
  5287:   else
  5288:     page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
  5289: }

  5291: static void build_visible_target_tags(struct char_data *viewer, struct char_data *target,
  5292:                                    char *out, size_t outsz, int include_afk)
  5293: {
  5294:   int shortflags = (!IS_NPC(viewer) && PRF_FLAGGED(viewer, PRF_SHORTFLAGS));
  5295:   bool is_charmed_pet = (IS_NPC(target) && AFF_FLAGGED(target, AFF_CHARM));
  5296: 
  5297:   if (!out || outsz == 0)
  5298:     return;
  5299: 
  5300:   out[0] = '\0';
  5301: 
  5302:   if (include_afk && !IS_NPC(target) && PRF_FLAGGED(target, PRF_AFK))
  5303:     out_append(out, outsz, "[AFK] ");
  5304: 
  5305:   /* Type tags always first. */
  5306:   if (!IS_NPC(target))
  5307:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_PLAYER, "(Player)", "(P)", shortflags);
  5308:   else if (is_charmed_pet)
  5309:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_CHARMED, "(Charmed)", "(C)", shortflags);
  5310: 
  5311:   /* Special status first. */
  5312:   if (!IS_NPC(target) && PLR_FLAGGED(target, PLR_KILLER))
  5313:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_OPK, "(OPK)", NULL, shortflags);
  5314: 
  5315:   /* Visibility/stealth state ordering. */
  5316:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(target, AFF_INVISIBLE))
  5317:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_INVIS, "(Invis)", "(I)", shortflags);
  5318:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(target, AFF_HIDE))
  5319:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_HIDDEN, "(Hidden)", "(H)", shortflags);
  5320:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(target, AFF_SNEAK) && AFF_FLAGGED(viewer, AFF_SENSE_LIFE))
  5321:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_STEALTH, "(Stealth)", "(S)", shortflags);
  5322:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(target, AFF_FLYING))
  5323:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_FLYING, "(Flying)", "(F)", shortflags);
  5324:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(target, AFF_NOTRACK))
  5325:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_TRANSLUCENT, "(Translucent)", "(T)", shortflags);
  5326: 
  5327:   /* Alignment/protection/major aura ordering. */
  5328:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(target, AFF_SANCTUARY))
  5329:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_WHITE, "(White Aura)", "(W)", shortflags);
  5330:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(viewer, AFF_DETECT_ALIGN)) {
  5331:     if (IS_GOOD(target))
  5332:       append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_GOLDEN, "(Golden Aura)", "(G)", shortflags);
  5333:     else if (IS_EVIL(target))
  5334:       append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_RED, "(Red Aura)", "(R)", shortflags);
  5335:   }
  5336:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(target, AFF_CURSE))
  5337:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_MARKED, "(Marked)", "(X)", shortflags);
  5338:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(target, AFF_POISON))
  5339:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_DISEASED, "(Diseased)", "(D)", shortflags);
  5340:   if (IS_NPC(target) && GET_CLASS(target) == CLASS_UNDEAD && AFF_FLAGGED(viewer, AFF_SENSE_LIFE))
  5341:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_UNDEAD, "(Undead)", "(U)", shortflags);
  5342: 
  5343:   /* Secondary state ordering. */
  5344:   if (is_charmed_pet)
  5345:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_ANIMATED, "(Animated)", "(A)", shortflags);
  5346:   if (IS_NPC(target) && MOB_FLAGGED(target, MOB_AGGRESSIVE) && AFF_FLAGGED(viewer, AFF_SENSE_LIFE))
  5347:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_ANGRY, "(Angry)", NULL, shortflags);
  5348:   if (GET_MAX_HIT(target) > 0 && (100 * GET_HIT(target) / GET_MAX_HIT(target)) < 60)
  5349:     append_char_aura_tag(viewer, out, outsz, AURA_WOUNDED, "(Wounded)", NULL, shortflags);
  5350: 
  5351:   if (is_player_quest_target(viewer, target))
  5352:     out_append(out, outsz, "[QUEST] ");
  5353: }

  5355: static void build_scan_target_tags(struct char_data *viewer, struct char_data *target,
  5356:                                    char *out, size_t outsz)
  5357: {
  5358:   build_visible_target_tags(viewer, target, out, outsz, TRUE);

  5361: static void send_scan_section_header(struct char_data *ch, int door, int range)
  5362: {
  5363:   if (range == 0)
  5364:     send_to_char(ch, "Right here you see:\r\n");
  5365:   else if (range == 1)
  5366:     send_to_char(ch, "%s from here you see:\r\n", dirs[door]);
  5367:   else
  5368:     send_to_char(ch, "%d %s from here you see:\r\n", range, dirs[door]);
  5369: }
  5370: 
  5371: static int count_scanned_group_visible(struct char_data *list, struct char_data *ch)
  5372: {
  5373:   struct char_data *i;
  5374:   int shown = 0;
  5375: 
  5376:   for (i = list; i; i = i->next_in_room)
  5377:     if (CAN_SEE(ch, i))
  5378:       shown++;
  5379: 
  5380:   return shown;
  5381: }
  5382: 
  5383: static int list_scanned_group(struct char_data *list, struct char_data *ch)
  5384: {
  5385:   struct char_data *i;
  5386:   int shown = 0;
  5387: 
  5388:   for (i = list; i; i = i->next_in_room) {
  5389:     char tags[256];
  5390: 
  5391:     if (!CAN_SEE(ch, i))
  5392:       continue;
  5393: 
  5394:     build_scan_target_tags(ch, i, tags, sizeof(tags));
  5395:     send_to_char(ch, "     - %s%s\r\n", tags, PERS(i, ch));
  5396:     shown++;
  5397:   }
  5398: 
  5399:   return shown;
  5400: }

  5402: ACMD(do_scan)
  5403: {
  5404:   int door;
  5405:   bool found = FALSE;
  5406:   int range;
  5407:   int maxrange = 3;
  5408:   room_rnum scanned_room;
  5409: 
  5410:   if (IS_AFFECTED(ch, AFF_BLIND)) {
  5411:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't see a damned thing, you're blind!\r\n");
  5412:     return;
  5413:   }
  5414: 
  5415:   if (world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people) {
  5416:     int visible_here = count_scanned_group_visible(world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people, ch);
  5417:     if (visible_here > 0) {
  5418:       struct char_data *i;
  5419:       send_scan_section_header(ch, NORTH, 0);
  5420:       for (i = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; i; i = i->next_in_room) {
  5421:         char tags[256];
  5422:         if (!CAN_SEE(ch, i))
  5423:           continue;
  5424:         build_scan_target_tags(ch, i, tags, sizeof(tags));
  5425:         send_to_char(ch, "     - %s%s\r\n", tags, PERS(i, ch));
  5426:       }
  5427:       found = TRUE;
  5428:     }
  5429:   }
  5430: 
  5431:   for (door = 0; door < DIR_COUNT; door++) {
  5432:     scanned_room = IN_ROOM(ch);
  5433:     for (range = 1; range<= maxrange; range++) {
  5434:       if (world[scanned_room].dir_option[door] && world[scanned_room].dir_option[door]->to_room != NOWHERE &&
  5435:        !IS_SET(world[scanned_room].dir_option[door]->exit_info, EX_CLOSED) &&
  5436:        !IS_SET(world[scanned_room].dir_option[door]->exit_info, EX_HIDDEN)) {
  5437:         int printed_header = FALSE;
  5438: 
  5439:         scanned_room = world[scanned_room].dir_option[door]->to_room;
  5440:         if (IS_DARK(scanned_room) && !CAN_SEE_IN_DARK(ch)) {
  5441:           if (!printed_header) {
  5442:             send_scan_section_header(ch, door, range);
  5443:             printed_header = TRUE;
  5444:           }
  5445:           if (world[scanned_room].people)
  5446:             send_to_char(ch, "     - It's too dark to see, but you can hear shuffling.\r\n");
  5447:           else
  5448:             send_to_char(ch, "     - It is too dark to see anything.\r\n");
  5449:           found = TRUE;
  5450:           break;
  5451:         } else {
  5452:           int shown = 0;
  5453: 
  5454:           if (world[scanned_room].people)
  5455:             shown = count_scanned_group_visible(world[scanned_room].people, ch);
  5456: 
  5457:           if (shown > 0) {
  5458:             if (!printed_header) {
  5459:               send_scan_section_header(ch, door, range);
  5460:               printed_header = TRUE;
  5461:             }
  5462:             list_scanned_group(world[scanned_room].people, ch);
  5463:             found = TRUE;
  5464:           }
  5465:         }
  5466:       }                  // end of if
  5467:       else
  5468:         break;
  5469:     }                    // end of range
  5470:   }                      // end of directions
  5471:   if (!found) {
  5472:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't see anything nearby!\r\n");
  5473:   }
  5474: } // end of do_scan

  5476: ACMD(do_saffects)
  5477: {
  5478:   const struct affected_type *af;
  5479:   int seen_spells[MAX_AFFECT];
  5480:   int seen_count = 0;
  5481:   int skills = 0, spells = 0, any = 0;
  5482: 
  5483:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch)) {
  5484:     send_to_char(ch, "Not for mobiles.\r\n");
  5485:     return;
  5486:   }
  5487: 
  5488:   if (!ch->affected) {
  5489:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not affected by anything.\r\n");
  5490:     return;
  5491:   }
  5492: 
  5493:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\nYou are affected by the following:\r\n");
  5494:   for (af = ch->affected; af; af = af->next) {
  5495:     const struct affected_type *scan;
  5496:     int max_duration = af->duration;
  5497:     const char *name = "System effect";
  5498:     const char *kind = "Spell";
  5499:     char dur[32];
  5500:     char name_fallback[64];
  5501:     char flags[256];
  5502:     int bits[AF_ARRAY_MAX];
  5503:     int is_skill = 0;
  5504:     int already_seen = FALSE;
  5505:     int i;
  5506: 
  5507:     dur[0] = '\0';
  5508:     for (i = 0; i < seen_count; i++) {
  5509:       if (seen_spells[i] == af->spell) {
  5510:         already_seen = TRUE;
  5511:         break;
  5512:       }
  5513:     }
  5514:     if (already_seen)
  5515:       continue;
  5516: 
  5517:     for (scan = ch->affected; scan; scan = scan->next) {
  5518:       if (scan->spell == af->spell)
  5519:         max_duration = MAX(max_duration, scan->duration);
  5520:     }
  5521:     if (seen_count < MAX_AFFECT)
  5522:       seen_spells[seen_count++] = af->spell;
  5523:     any = 1;
  5524: 
  5525:     name_fallback[0] = '\0';
  5526:     for (i = 0; i < AF_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
  5527:       bits[i] = 0;
  5528:     for (scan = ch->affected; scan; scan = scan->next) {
  5529:       if (scan->spell == af->spell)
  5530:         for (i = 0; i < AF_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
  5531:           bits[i] |= scan->bitvector[i];
  5532:     }
  5533:     sprintbitarray(bits, affected_bits, AF_ARRAY_MAX, flags);
  5534:     if (!aff_flags_has_meaningful_bits(flags))
  5535:       flags[0] = '\0';
  5536:     name = resolve_affect_display_name(af->spell, flags, name_fallback, sizeof(name_fallback));
  5537: 
  5538:     if (af->spell > 0 && IS_SKILL(af->spell)) {
  5539:       kind = "Skill";
  5540:       is_skill = 1;
  5541:     } else {
  5542:       kind = "Spell";
  5543:     }
  5544:     if (is_skill) skills++;
  5545:     else spells++;
  5546: 
  5547:     format_affect_duration(max_duration, dur, sizeof(dur));
  5548:     send_to_char(ch, "%-7s : %s (%s)\r\n", kind, name, dur);
  5549:   }
  5550: 
  5551:   if (!any) {
  5552:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not affected by anything.\r\n");
  5553:     return;
  5554:   }
  5555: 
  5556:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\nYou are affected by %d skills and %d spells.\r\n", skills, spells);
  5557: }

  5644: static int ci_contains(const char *haystack, const char *needle)
  5645: {
  5646:   size_t nlen;
  5647: 
  5648:   if (!needle || !*needle)
  5649:     return TRUE;
  5650:   if (!haystack)
  5651:     return FALSE;
  5652: 
  5653:   nlen = strlen(needle);
  5654:   for (; *haystack; haystack++)
  5655:     if (!strncasecmp(haystack, needle, nlen))
  5656:       return TRUE;
  5657: 
  5658:   return FALSE;
  5659: }

  5661: static const char *score_cond_label(int cond)
  5662: {
  5663:   if (cond <= 0)
  5664:     return "Starving";
  5665:   if (cond <= 4)
  5666:     return "Hungry";
  5667:   if (cond <= 9)
  5668:     return "Peckish";
  5669:   if (cond <= 14)
  5670:     return "Average";
  5671:   if (cond <= 19)
  5672:     return "Satisfied";
  5673:   return "Full";
  5674: }

  5676: static int speedwalk_reverse_token_to_dir(const char *token, int len)
  5677: {
  5678:   char dirbuf[8];
  5679: 
  5680:   if (len <= 0 || len >= (int)sizeof(dirbuf))
  5681:     return -1;
  5682: 
  5683:   snprintf(dirbuf, sizeof(dirbuf), "%.*s", len, token);
  5684:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "n"))
  5685:     return NORTH;
  5686:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "e"))
  5687:     return EAST;
  5688:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "s"))
  5689:     return SOUTH;
  5690:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "w"))
  5691:     return WEST;
  5692:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "u"))
  5693:     return UP;
  5694:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "d"))
  5695:     return DOWN;
  5696:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "nw"))
  5697:     return NORTHWEST;
  5698:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "ne"))
  5699:     return NORTHEAST;
  5700:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "se"))
  5701:     return SOUTHEAST;
  5702:   if (!str_cmp(dirbuf, "sw"))
  5703:     return SOUTHWEST;
  5704: 
  5705:   return -1;
  5706: }
  5707: 
  5708: static int speedwalk_append_dir_token(char *out, size_t outsz, int dir, int count)
  5709: {
  5710:   char token[16];
  5711:   size_t len;
  5712: 
  5713:   if (dir < 0 || dir >= NUM_OF_DIRS || count <= 0)
  5714:     return FALSE;
  5715: 
  5716:   if (count > 1)
  5717:     snprintf(token, sizeof(token), "%d%s", count, autoexits[dir]);
  5718:   else
  5719:     snprintf(token, sizeof(token), "%s", autoexits[dir]);
  5720: 
  5721:   len = strlen(out);
  5722:   if (len + strlen(token) + 1 >= outsz)
  5723:     return FALSE;
  5724: 
  5725:   if (len < outsz - 1)
  5726:     snprintf(out + len, outsz - len, "%s", token);
  5727: 
  5728:   return TRUE;
  5729: }
  5730: 
  5731: static int speedwalk_reverse_route(const char *route, char *out, size_t outsz)
  5732: {
  5733:   int dirs_seen[256];
  5734:   int dir_count = 0;
  5735:   int i = 0;
  5736:   int count = 0;
  5737: 
  5738:   if (!route || !out || outsz == 0)
  5739:     return FALSE;
  5740: 
  5741:   out[0] = '\0';
  5742: 
  5743:   while (route[i] != '\0') {
  5744:     int start;
  5745:     int dir;
  5746:     int k;
  5747: 
  5748:     if (isspace((unsigned char)route[i])) {
  5749:       i++;
  5750:       continue;
  5751:     }
  5752: 
  5753:     count = 0;
  5754:     while (isdigit((unsigned char)route[i])) {
  5755:       count = (count * 10) + (route[i] - '0');
  5756:       i++;
  5757:     }
  5758:     if (count <= 0)
  5759:       count = 1;
  5760: 
  5761:     start = i;
  5762:     while (isalpha((unsigned char)route[i]))
  5763:       i++;
  5764: 
  5765:     dir = speedwalk_reverse_token_to_dir(route + start, i - start);
  5766:     if (dir < 0)
  5767:       return FALSE;
  5768: 
  5769:     for (k = 0; k < count; k++) {
  5770:       if (dir_count >= (int)(sizeof(dirs_seen) / sizeof(dirs_seen[0])))
  5771:         return FALSE;
  5772:       dirs_seen[dir_count++] = dir;
  5773:     }
  5774:   }
  5775: 
  5776:   if (dir_count == 0)
  5777:     return FALSE;
  5778: 
  5779:   i = dir_count - 1;
  5780:   while (i >= 0) {
  5781:     int rev = rev_dir[dirs_seen[i]];
  5782:     int step;
  5783:     count = 1;
  5784:     i--;
  5785:     while (i >= 0 && rev_dir[dirs_seen[i]] == rev) {
  5786:       count++;
  5787:       i--;
  5788:     }
  5789:     step = speedwalk_append_dir_token(out, outsz, rev, count);
  5790:     if (!step)
  5791:       return FALSE;
  5792:   }
  5793: 
  5794:   return TRUE;
  5795: }

  5826: ACMD(do_speedwalk)
  5827: {
  5828:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  5829:   FILE *fl;
  5830:   char line[256];
  5831:   char current_route[200];
  5832:   const char *recall_name = "mortal recall";
  5833:   int shown = 0;
  5834:   zone_rnum current_zone = NOWHERE;
  5835: 
  5836:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  5837:   strlcpy(arg, argument, sizeof(arg));
  5838:   current_route[0] = '\0';
  5839: 
  5840:   if (IN_ROOM(ch) != NOWHERE)
  5841:     current_zone = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone;
  5842: 
  5843:   fl = fopen("misc/speedwalk.lst", "r");
  5844:   if (!fl) {
  5845:     send_to_char(ch, "No speedwalk routes are available.\r\n");
  5846:     return;
  5847:   }
  5848: 
  5849:   if (r_mortal_start_room != NOWHERE && world[r_mortal_start_room].name)
  5850:     recall_name = world[r_mortal_start_room].name;
  5851: 
  5852:   send_to_char(ch, "                  Directions from %s\r\n\r\n", recall_name);
  5853:   send_to_char(ch, "Area Name                       Speedwalk\r\n");
  5854:   send_to_char(ch, "------------------------------  ----------------------------------------------\r\n");
  5855: 
  5856:   while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fl)) {
  5857:     int zvnum;
  5858:     char route[200];
  5859:     zone_rnum z;
  5860: 
  5861:     if (line[0] == '\0' || line[0] == '\n' || line[0] == '#')
  5862:       continue;
  5863: 
  5864:     route[0] = '\0';
  5865:     if (sscanf(line, "%d %199[^\r\n]", &zvnum, route) != 2)
  5866:       continue;
  5867: 
  5868:     z = real_zone(zvnum);
  5869:     if (z == NOWHERE)
  5870:       continue;
  5871: 
  5872:     if (*arg && !ci_contains(zone_table[z].name, arg))
  5873:       continue;
  5874: 
  5875:     if (current_zone != NOWHERE && z == current_zone)
  5876:       strlcpy(current_route, route, sizeof(current_route));
  5877:   }
  5878: 
  5879:   rewind(fl);
  5880: 
  5881:   while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fl)) {
  5882:     int zvnum;
  5883:     char route[200];
  5884:     char display_route[400];
  5885:     zone_rnum z;
  5886: 
  5887:     if (line[0] == '\0' || line[0] == '\n' || line[0] == '#')
  5888:       continue;
  5889: 
  5890:     route[0] = '\0';
  5891:     if (sscanf(line, "%d %199[^\r\n]", &zvnum, route) != 2)
  5892:       continue;
  5893: 
  5894:     z = real_zone(zvnum);
  5895:     if (z == NOWHERE)
  5896:       continue;
  5897: 
  5898:     if (*arg && !ci_contains(zone_table[z].name, arg))
  5899:       continue;
  5900: 
  5901:     strlcpy(display_route, route, sizeof(display_route));
  5902:     if (*current_route) {
  5903:       char rev[400];
  5904: 
  5905:       if (z == current_zone) {
  5906:         strlcpy(display_route, "you are here", sizeof(display_route));
  5907:       } else if (speedwalk_reverse_route(current_route, rev, sizeof(rev))) {
  5908:         size_t len;
  5909: 
  5910:         strlcpy(display_route, rev, sizeof(display_route));
  5911:         len = strlen(display_route);
  5912:         if (len < sizeof(display_route) - 1)
  5913:           snprintf(display_route + len, sizeof(display_route) - len, "%s", route);
  5914:       }
  5915:     }
  5916: 
  5917:     send_to_char(ch, "%-30.30s  %s\r\n", zone_table[z].name, display_route);
  5918:     shown++;
  5919:   }
  5920: 
  5921:   fclose(fl);
  5922: 
  5923:   if (!shown) {
  5924:     if (*arg)
  5925:       send_to_char(ch, "No areas matched that filter.\r\n");
  5926:     else
  5927:       send_to_char(ch, "No speedwalk routes are available.\r\n");
  5928:   }
  5929: }

  5931: ACMD(do_saudit)

  5978:   total_h = crit_total_heal(vict);
