  5981:   mbonus_s = GET_SPELL_CRIT_MULT(vict);
  5982:   mbonus_h = GET_HEAL_CRIT_MULT(vict);
  5983: 
  5984:   mult_m = crit_mult_melee(vict);
  5985:   mult_s = crit_mult_spell(vict);
  5986:   mult_h = crit_mult_heal(vict);
  5987: 
  5988:   send_to_char(ch, "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\r\n");
  5989:   send_to_char(ch, "║ Stat Audit                                                                    ║\r\n");
  5990:   send_to_char(ch, "╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\r\n");
  5991: 
  5992:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
  5993:            "║ Melee Crit: base %2d + bonus %2d = total %3d   mult base 200 + bonus %3d = %3d ║\r\n",
  5994:            base_m, bonus_m, total_m, mbonus_m, mult_m);
  5995:   send_to_char(ch, "%s", line);
  5996: 
  5997:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
  5998:            "║ Spell Crit: base %2d + bonus %2d = total %3d   mult base 200 + bonus %3d = %3d ║\r\n",
  5999:            base_s, bonus_s, total_s, mbonus_s, mult_s);
  6000:   send_to_char(ch, "%s", line);
  6001: 
  6002:   snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
  6003:            "║ Heal  Crit: base %2d + bonus %2d = total %3d   mult base 200 + bonus %3d = %3d ║\r\n",
  6004:            base_h, bonus_h, total_h, mbonus_h, mult_h);
  6005:   send_to_char(ch, "%s", line);
  6006: 
  6007:   send_to_char(ch, "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\r\n");
  6008: }

    80: static int is_kept_item_for(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj)
    81: {
    82:   if (!ch || !obj)
    83:     return FALSE;
    84: 
    85:   if (!OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_KEPT))
    86:     return FALSE;
    87: 
    88:   if (obj->carried_by == ch || obj->worn_by == ch)
    89:     return TRUE;
    90: 
    91:   return FALSE;
    92: }
    93: 
    94: static int reject_kept_item_action(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj)
    95: {
    96:   if (!is_kept_item_for(ch, obj))
    97:     return FALSE;
    98: 
    99:   act("You are keeping $p safe. Unlock it first.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   100:   return TRUE;
   101: }

   103: static void perform_put(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj, struct obj_data *cont)
   104: {
   105:   long object_id = obj_script_id(obj);
   106: 
   107:   if (reject_kept_item_action(ch, obj))
   108:     return;
   109: 
   110:   if (!drop_otrigger(obj, ch))
   111:     return;
   112: 
   113:   if (!has_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table(object_id)) /* object might be extracted by drop_otrigger */
   114:     return;
   115: 
   116:   if ((GET_OBJ_VAL(cont, 0) > 0) &&
   117:       (GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(cont) + GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) > GET_OBJ_VAL(cont, 0)))
   118:     act("$p won't fit in $P.", FALSE, ch, obj, cont, TO_CHAR);
   119:   else if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_NODROP) && IN_ROOM(cont) != NOWHERE)
   120:     act("You can't get $p out of your hand.", FALSE, ch, obj, NULL, TO_CHAR);
   121:   else {
   122:     obj_from_char(obj);
   123:     obj_to_obj(obj, cont);
   124: 
   125:     act("$n puts $p in $P.", TRUE, ch, obj, cont, TO_ROOM);
   126: 
   127:     /* Yes, I realize this is strange until we have auto-equip on rent. -gg */
   128:     if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_NODROP) && !OBJ_FLAGGED(cont, ITEM_NODROP)) {
   129:       SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(cont), ITEM_NODROP);
   130:       act("You get a strange feeling as you put $p in $P.", FALSE,
   131:                 ch, obj, cont, TO_CHAR);
   132:     } else
   133:       act("You put $p in $P.", FALSE, ch, obj, cont, TO_CHAR);
   134:   }
   135: }
   136: 
   137: /* The following put modes are supported:
   138:      1) put <object> <container>
   139:      2) put all.<object> <container>
   140:      3) put all <container>
   141:    The <container> must be in inventory or on ground. All objects to be put
   142:    into container must be in inventory. */
   143: ACMD(do_put)
   144: {
   145:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   146:   char arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   147:   char arg3[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   148:   struct obj_data *obj, *next_obj, *cont;
   149:   struct char_data *tmp_char;
   150:   int obj_dotmode, cont_dotmode, found = 0, howmany = 1;
   151:   char *theobj, *thecont;
   152: 
   153:   one_argument(two_arguments(argument, arg1, arg2), arg3);	/* three_arguments */
   154: 
   155:   if (*arg3 && is_number(arg1)) {
   156:     howmany = atoi(arg1);
   157:     theobj = arg2;
   158:     thecont = arg3;
   159:   } else {
   160:     theobj = arg1;
   161:     thecont = arg2;
   162:   }
   163:   obj_dotmode = find_all_dots(theobj);
   164:   cont_dotmode = find_all_dots(thecont);
   165: 
   166:   if (!*theobj)
   167:     send_to_char(ch, "Put what in what?\r\n");
   168:   else if (cont_dotmode != FIND_INDIV)
   169:     send_to_char(ch, "You can only put things into one container at a time.\r\n");
   170:   else if (!*thecont) {
   171:     send_to_char(ch, "What do you want to put %s in?\r\n", obj_dotmode == FIND_INDIV ? "it" : "them");
   172:   } else {
   173:     generic_find(thecont, FIND_OBJ_INV | FIND_OBJ_EQUIP | FIND_OBJ_ROOM, ch, &tmp_char, &cont);
   174:     if (!cont)
   175:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't see %s %s here.\r\n", AN(thecont), thecont);
   176:     else if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(cont) != ITEM_CONTAINER)
   177:       act("$p is not a container.", FALSE, ch, cont, 0, TO_CHAR);
   178:     else if (OBJVAL_FLAGGED(cont, CONT_CLOSED) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT || !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE)))
   179:       send_to_char(ch, "You'd better open it first!\r\n");
   180:     else {
   181:       if (obj_dotmode == FIND_INDIV) {	/* put <obj> <container> */
   182: 	if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, theobj, NULL, ch->carrying)))
   183: 	  send_to_char(ch, "You aren't carrying %s %s.\r\n", AN(theobj), theobj);
   184: 	else if (obj == cont && howmany == 1)
   185: 	  send_to_char(ch, "You attempt to fold it into itself, but fail.\r\n");
   186: 	else {
   187: 	  while (obj && howmany) {
   188: 	    next_obj = obj->next_content;
   189:             if (obj != cont) {
   190:               howmany--;
   191: 	      perform_put(ch, obj, cont);
   192:             }
   193: 	    obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, theobj, NULL, next_obj);
   194: 	  }
   195: 	}
   196:       } else {
   197: 	for (obj = ch->carrying; obj; obj = next_obj) {
   198: 	  next_obj = obj->next_content;
   199: 	  if (obj != cont && CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj) &&
   200: 	      (obj_dotmode == FIND_ALL || isname(theobj, obj->name))) {
   201: 	    found = 1;
   202: 	    perform_put(ch, obj, cont);
   203: 	  }
   204: 	}
   205: 	if (!found) {
   206: 	  if (obj_dotmode == FIND_ALL)
   207: 	    send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have anything to put in it.\r\n");
   208: 	  else
   209: 	    send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have any %ss.\r\n", theobj);
   210: 	}
   211:       }
   212:     }
   213:   }
   214: }

   216: static int can_take_obj(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj)
   217: {
   218: if (!(CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_TAKE))) {
   219:   act("$p: you can't take that!", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   220:   return (0);
   221:   }
   222: 
   223: if (!IS_NPC(ch) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE)) {
   224:   if (IS_CARRYING_N(ch) >= CAN_CARRY_N(ch)) {
   225:     act("$p: you can't carry that many items.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   226:     return (0);
   227:   } else if ((IS_CARRYING_W(ch) + GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj)) > CAN_CARRY_W(ch)) {
   228:     act("$p: you can't carry that much weight.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   229:     return (0);
   230:   }
   231: }
   232:   
   233:   if (OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(obj)){
   234:     act("It appears someone is sitting on $p..", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   235:     return (0);
   236:   }
   237:   
   238:   return (1);
   239: }

   241: static void get_check_money(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj)
   242: {
   243:   int value = GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0);
   244: 
   245:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_MONEY || value <= 0)
   246:     return;
   247: 
   248:   extract_obj(obj);
   249:   increase_money_gold(ch, (long long)value);
   250:   if (value == 1)
   251:     send_to_char(ch, "The pile of coins was worth %d gold coin.\r\n", value);
   252:   else
   253:     send_to_char(ch, "The pile of coins was worth %d gold coins.\r\n", value);
   254: }

   256: static void perform_get_from_container(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj,
   257: 				     struct obj_data *cont, int mode)
   258: {
   259:   if (mode == FIND_OBJ_INV || can_take_obj(ch, obj)) {
   260:     if (IS_CARRYING_N(ch) >= CAN_CARRY_N(ch))
   261:       act("$p: you can't hold any more items.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   262:     else if (get_otrigger(obj, ch)) {
   263:       obj_from_obj(obj);
   264:       obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   265:       act("You get $p from $P.", FALSE, ch, obj, cont, TO_CHAR);
   266:       act("$n gets $p from $P.", TRUE, ch, obj, cont, TO_ROOM);
   267:       get_check_money(ch, obj);
   268:     }
   269:   }
   270: }
   271: 
   272: void get_from_container(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *cont,
   273: 			     char *arg, int mode, int howmany)
   274: {
   275:   struct obj_data *obj, *next_obj;
   276:   int obj_dotmode, found = 0;
   277: 
   278:   obj_dotmode = find_all_dots(arg);
   279: 
   280:   if (OBJVAL_FLAGGED(cont, CONT_CLOSED) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT || !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE)))
   281:     act("$p is closed.", FALSE, ch, cont, 0, TO_CHAR);
   282:   else if (obj_dotmode == FIND_INDIV) {
   283:     if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, cont->contains))) {
   284:       char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   285: 
   286:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "There doesn't seem to be %s %s in $p.", AN(arg), arg);
   287:       act(buf, FALSE, ch, cont, 0, TO_CHAR);
   288:     } else {
   289:       struct obj_data *obj_next;
   290:       while (obj && howmany--) {
   291:         obj_next = obj->next_content;
   292:         perform_get_from_container(ch, obj, cont, mode);
   293:         obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, obj_next);
   294:       }
   295:     }
   296:   } else {
   297:     if (obj_dotmode == FIND_ALLDOT && !*arg) {
   298:       send_to_char(ch, "Get all of what?\r\n");
   299:       return;
   300:     }
   301:     for (obj = cont->contains; obj; obj = next_obj) {
   302:       next_obj = obj->next_content;
   303:       if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj) &&
   304: 	  (obj_dotmode == FIND_ALL || isname(arg, obj->name))) {
   305: 	found = 1;
   306: 	perform_get_from_container(ch, obj, cont, mode);
   307:       }
   308:     }
   309:     if (!found) {
   310:       if (obj_dotmode == FIND_ALL)
   311: 	act("$p seems to be empty.", FALSE, ch, cont, 0, TO_CHAR);
   312:       else {
   313:         char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   314: 
   315: 	snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "You can't seem to find any %ss in $p.", arg);
   316: 	act(buf, FALSE, ch, cont, 0, TO_CHAR);
   317:       }
   318:     }
   319:   }
   320: }
   321: 
   322: static int perform_get_from_room(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj)
   323: {
   324:   if (can_take_obj(ch, obj) && get_otrigger(obj, ch)) {
   325:     obj_from_room(obj);
   326:     obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   327:     act("You get $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   328:     act("$n gets $p.", TRUE, ch, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
   329:     get_check_money(ch, obj);
   330:     return (1);
   331:   }
   332:   return (0);
   333: }
   334: 
   335: static void get_from_room(struct char_data *ch, char *arg, int howmany)
   336: {
   337:   struct obj_data *obj, *next_obj;
   338:   int dotmode, found = 0;
   339: 
   340:   dotmode = find_all_dots(arg);
   341: 
   342:   if (dotmode == FIND_INDIV) {
   343:     if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents))) {
   344:         /* Are they trying to take something in a room extra description? */
   345:         if (find_exdesc(arg, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].ex_description) != NULL) {
   346:             send_to_char(ch, "You can't take %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
   347:             return;
   348:         }
   349:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't see %s %s here.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
   350:     } else {
   351:       struct obj_data *obj_next;
   352:       while(obj && howmany--) {
   353: 	obj_next = obj->next_content;
   354:         perform_get_from_room(ch, obj);
   355:         obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, obj_next);
   356:       }
   357:     }
   358:   } else {
   359:     if (dotmode == FIND_ALLDOT && !*arg) {
   360:       send_to_char(ch, "Get all of what?\r\n");
   361:       return;
   362:     }
   363:     for (obj = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents; obj; obj = next_obj) {
   364:       next_obj = obj->next_content;
   365:       if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj) &&
   366: 	  (dotmode == FIND_ALL || isname(arg, obj->name))) {
   367: 	found = 1;
   368: 	perform_get_from_room(ch, obj);
   369:       }
   370:     }
   371:     if (!found) {
   372:       if (dotmode == FIND_ALL)
   373: 	send_to_char(ch, "There doesn't seem to be anything here.\r\n");
   374:       else
   375: 	send_to_char(ch, "You don't see any %ss here.\r\n", arg);
   376:     }
   377:   }
   378: }

   380: ACMD(do_get)
   381: {
   382:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   383:   char arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   384:   char arg3[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   385: 
   386:   int cont_dotmode, found = 0, mode;
   387:   struct obj_data *cont;
   388:   struct char_data *tmp_char;
   389: 
   390:   one_argument(two_arguments(argument, arg1, arg2), arg3);	/* three_arguments */
   391: 
   392:   if (!*arg1)
   393:     send_to_char(ch, "Get what?\r\n");
   394:   else if (!*arg2)
   395:     get_from_room(ch, arg1, 1);
   396:   else if (is_number(arg1) && !*arg3)
   397:     get_from_room(ch, arg2, atoi(arg1));
   398:   else {
   399:     int amount = 1;
   400:     if (is_number(arg1)) {
   401:       amount = atoi(arg1);
   402:       strcpy(arg1, arg2); /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: arg1 == arg2) */
   403:       strcpy(arg2, arg3); /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: arg2 == arg3) */
   404:     }
   405:     cont_dotmode = find_all_dots(arg2);
   406:     if (cont_dotmode == FIND_INDIV) {
   407:       mode = generic_find(arg2, FIND_OBJ_INV | FIND_OBJ_EQUIP | FIND_OBJ_ROOM, ch, &tmp_char, &cont);
   408:       if (!cont)
   409: 	send_to_char(ch, "You don't have %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg2), arg2);
   410:       else if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(cont) != ITEM_CONTAINER)
   411: 	act("$p is not a container.", FALSE, ch, cont, 0, TO_CHAR);
   412:       else
   413: 	get_from_container(ch, cont, arg1, mode, amount);
   414:     } else {
   415:       if (cont_dotmode == FIND_ALLDOT && !*arg2) {
   416: 	send_to_char(ch, "Get from all of what?\r\n");
   417: 	return;
   418:       }
   419:       for (cont = ch->carrying; cont; cont = cont->next_content)
   420: 	if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, cont) &&
   421: 	    (cont_dotmode == FIND_ALL || isname(arg2, cont->name))) {
   422: 	  if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(cont) == ITEM_CONTAINER) {
   423: 	    found = 1;
   424: 	    get_from_container(ch, cont, arg1, FIND_OBJ_INV, amount);
   425: 	  } else if (cont_dotmode == FIND_ALLDOT) {
   426: 	    found = 1;
   427: 	    act("$p is not a container.", FALSE, ch, cont, 0, TO_CHAR);
   428: 	  }
   429: 	}
   430:       for (cont = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents; cont; cont = cont->next_content)
   431: 	if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, cont) &&
   432: 	    (cont_dotmode == FIND_ALL || isname(arg2, cont->name))) {
   433: 	  if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(cont) == ITEM_CONTAINER) {
   434: 	    get_from_container(ch, cont, arg1, FIND_OBJ_ROOM, amount);
   435: 	    found = 1;
   436: 	  } else if (cont_dotmode == FIND_ALLDOT) {
   437: 	    act("$p is not a container.", FALSE, ch, cont, 0, TO_CHAR);
   438: 	    found = 1;
   439: 	  }
   440: 	}
   441:       if (!found) {
   442: 	if (cont_dotmode == FIND_ALL)
   443: 	  send_to_char(ch, "You can't seem to find any containers.\r\n");
   444: 	else
   445: 	  send_to_char(ch, "You can't seem to find any %ss here.\r\n", arg2);
   446:       }
   447:     }
   448:   }
   449: }
   450: 
   451: static void perform_drop_gold(struct char_data *ch, int amount, byte mode, room_rnum RDR)
   452: {
   453:   struct obj_data *obj;
   454: 
   455:   if (amount <= 0)
   456:     send_to_char(ch, "Heh heh heh.. we are jolly funny today, eh?\r\n");
   457:   else if (GET_GOLD(ch) < amount)
   458:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't have that many coins!\r\n");
   459:   else {
   460:     if (mode != SCMD_JUNK) {
   461:       WAIT_STATE(ch, PULSE_VIOLENCE); /* to prevent coin-bombing */
   462:       obj = create_money(amount, 3);
   463:       if (mode == SCMD_DONATE) {
   464: 	      send_to_char(ch, "You throw some gold into the air where it disappears in a puff of smoke!\r\n");
   465: 	      act("$n throws some gold into the air where it disappears in a puff of smoke!",
   466: 	          FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   467: 	      obj_to_room(obj, RDR);
   468: 	      act("$p suddenly appears in a puff of orange smoke!", 0, 0, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
   469:       } else {
   470:         char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   471:         long object_id = obj_script_id(obj);
   472: 
   473:         if (!drop_wtrigger(obj, ch)) {
   474:           if (has_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table(object_id))
   475:             extract_obj(obj);
   476: 
   477:           return;
   478:         }
   479: 
   480: 	      snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n drops %s.", money_desc(amount));
   481: 	      act(buf, TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   482: 
   483: 	      send_to_char(ch, "You drop some gold.\r\n");
   484: 	      obj_to_room(obj, IN_ROOM(ch));
   485:       }
   486:     } else {
   487:       char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   488: 
   489:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n drops %s which disappears in a puff of smoke!", money_desc(amount));
   490:       act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   491: 
   492:       send_to_char(ch, "You drop some gold which disappears in a puff of smoke!\r\n");
   493:     }
   494:     decrease_gold(ch, amount);
   495:   }
   496: }
   497: 
   498: #define VANISH(mode) ((mode == SCMD_DONATE || mode == SCMD_JUNK) ? \
   499: 		      "  It vanishes in a puff of smoke!" : "")
   500: static int perform_drop(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj,
   501: 		     byte mode, const char *sname, room_rnum RDR)
   502: {
   503:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   504:   int value;
   505:   long object_id = obj_script_id(obj);
   506: 
   507:   if (!drop_otrigger(obj, ch))
   508:     return 0;
   509: 
   510:   if (!has_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table(object_id))
   511:     return 0; // item was extracted by script
   512: 
   513:   if ((mode == SCMD_DROP) && !drop_wtrigger(obj, ch))
   514:     return 0;
   515: 
   516:   if (!has_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table(object_id))
   517:     return 0; // item was extracted by script
   518: 
   519:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_NODROP) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE)) {
   520:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "You can't %s $p, it must be CURSED!", sname);
   521:     act(buf, FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   522:     return (0);
   523:   }
   524:   if (reject_kept_item_action(ch, obj))
   525:     return (0);
   526: 
   527:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "You %s $p.%s", sname, VANISH(mode));
   528:   act(buf, FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   529: 
   530:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n %ss $p.%s", sname, VANISH(mode));
   531:   act(buf, TRUE, ch, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
   532: 
   533:   obj_from_char(obj);
   534: 
   535:   if ((mode == SCMD_DONATE) && OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_NODONATE))
   536:     mode = SCMD_JUNK;
   537: 
   538:   switch (mode) {
   539:   case SCMD_DROP:
   540:     obj_to_room(obj, IN_ROOM(ch));
   541:     return (0);
   542:   case SCMD_DONATE:
   543:     obj_to_room(obj, RDR);
   544:     act("$p suddenly appears in a puff a smoke!", FALSE, 0, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
   545:     return (0);
   546:   case SCMD_JUNK:
   547:     value = MAX(1, MIN(200, GET_OBJ_COST(obj) / 16));
   548:     extract_obj(obj);
   549:     return (value);
   550:   default:
   551:     log("SYSERR: Incorrect argument %d passed to perform_drop.", mode);
   552:     /* SYSERR_DESC: This error comes from perform_drop() and is output when
   553:      * perform_drop() is called with an illegal 'mode' argument. */
   554:     break;
   555:   }
   556: 
   557:   return (0);
   558: }
   559: 
   560: static void perform_drop_currency(struct char_data *ch, int amount, int denom, int subcmd)
   561: {
   562:   long long amount_gold = 0;
   563:   const char *metal = "gold";
   564: 
   565:   (void)denom;
   566: 
   567:   if (amount <= 0) {
   568:     send_to_char(ch, "Drop how much?\r\n");
   569:     return;
   570:   }
   571: 
   572:   amount_gold = (long long)amount;
   573: 
   574:   if (amount_gold <= 0) {
   575:     send_to_char(ch, "Drop how much?\r\n");
   576:     return;
   577:   }
   578: 
   579:   if (GET_MONEY(ch) < amount_gold) {
   580:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't have that much currency.\r\n");
   581:     return;
   582:   }
   583: 
   584:   /* JUNK: delete money instead of creating a pile */
   585:   if (subcmd == SCMD_JUNK) {
   586:     GET_MONEY(ch) -= amount_gold;
   587:     send_to_char(ch, "You junk %d %s coin%s.\r\n", amount, metal, (amount == 1 ? "" : "s"));
   588:     act("$n junks some coins.", FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   589:     return;
   590:   }
   591: 
   592:   /* DONATE: behave like normal drop into room (your donate rooms logic is separate) */
   593:   {
   594:     struct obj_data *obj = create_money((int)amount_gold, denom);
   595:     if (!obj) {
   596:       send_to_char(ch, "Something went wrong.\r\n");
   597:       return;
   598:     }
   599:     GET_MONEY(ch) -= amount_gold;
   600: 
   601:     send_to_char(ch, "You drop %d %s coin%s.\r\n", amount, metal, (amount == 1 ? "" : "s"));
   602:     act("$n drops some coins.", FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   603: 
   604:     obj_to_room(obj, IN_ROOM(ch));
   605:   }
   606: }

   610: /* Forward declarations for currency drop helpers */
   611: static int parse_money_denom(const char *w);
   612: static int parse_compact_money_token(const char *tok, int *out_amount, int *out_denom);

   614: ACMD(do_drop)
   615: {
   616:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   617:   struct obj_data *obj, *next_obj;
   618:   room_rnum RDR = 0;
   619:   byte mode = SCMD_DROP;
   620:   int dotmode, amount = 0, multi, num_don_rooms;
   621:   const char *sname;
   622: 
   623:   switch (subcmd) {
   624:   case SCMD_JUNK:
   625:     sname = "junk";
   626:     mode = SCMD_JUNK;
   627:     break;
   628:   case SCMD_DONATE:
   629:     sname = "donate";
   630:     mode = SCMD_DONATE;
   631:     /* fail + double chance for room 1   */
   632:     num_don_rooms = (CONFIG_DON_ROOM_1 != NOWHERE) * 2 +
   633:                     (CONFIG_DON_ROOM_2 != NOWHERE)     +
   634:                     (CONFIG_DON_ROOM_3 != NOWHERE)     + 1 ;
   635:     switch (rand_number(0, num_don_rooms)) {
   636:     case 0:
   637:       mode = SCMD_JUNK;
   638:       break;
   639:     case 1:
   640:     case 2:
   641:       RDR = real_room(CONFIG_DON_ROOM_1);
   642:       break;
   643:     case 3: RDR = real_room(CONFIG_DON_ROOM_2); break;
   644:     case 4: RDR = real_room(CONFIG_DON_ROOM_3); break;
   645: 
   646:     }
   647:     if (RDR == NOWHERE) {
   648:       send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, you can't donate anything right now.\r\n");
   649:       return;
   650:     }
   651:     break;
   652:   default:
   653:     sname = "drop";
   654:     break;
   655:   }
   656: 
   657:   argument = one_argument(argument, arg);
   658: 
   659: 
   660:   /* Currency drop support: 10g, 5s, 2c */
   661:   {
   662:     int c_amt = 0, c_denom = 0;
   663:     if (parse_compact_money_token(arg, &c_amt, &c_denom)) {
   664:       perform_drop_currency(ch, c_amt, c_denom, subcmd);
   665:       return;
   666:     }
   667:   }
   668:   if (!*arg) {
   669:     send_to_char(ch, "What do you want to %s?\r\n", sname);
   670:     return;
   671:   } else if (is_number(arg)) {
   672:     int denom = 0;
   673:     multi = atoi(arg);
   674:     one_argument(argument, arg);
   675: 
   676:     if (!str_cmp("coins", arg) || !str_cmp("coin", arg)) {
   677:       perform_drop_gold(ch, multi, mode, RDR);
   678:       return;
   679:     }
   680: 
   681:     denom = parse_money_denom(arg);
   682:     if (denom == 1 || denom == 2 || denom == 3) {
   683:       perform_drop_currency(ch, multi, denom, subcmd);
   684:       return;
   685:     }
   686: else if (multi <= 0)
   687:       send_to_char(ch, "Yeah, that makes sense.\r\n");
   688:     else if (!*arg)
   689:       send_to_char(ch, "What do you want to %s %d of?\r\n", sname, multi);
   690:     else if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying)))
   691:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have any %ss.\r\n", arg);
   692:     else {
   693:       do {
   694:         next_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, obj->next_content);
   695:         amount += perform_drop(ch, obj, mode, sname, RDR);
   696:         obj = next_obj;
   697:       } while (obj && --multi);
   698:     }
   699:   } else {
   700:     dotmode = find_all_dots(arg);
   701: 
   702:     /* Can't junk or donate all */
   703:     if ((dotmode == FIND_ALL) && (subcmd == SCMD_JUNK || subcmd == SCMD_DONATE)) {
   704:       if (subcmd == SCMD_JUNK)
   705: 	send_to_char(ch, "Go to the dump if you want to junk EVERYTHING!\r\n");
   706:       else
   707: 	send_to_char(ch, "Go do the donation room if you want to donate EVERYTHING!\r\n");
   708:       return;
   709:     }
   710:     if (dotmode == FIND_ALL) {
   711:       if (!ch->carrying)
   712: 	send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to be carrying anything.\r\n");
   713:       else
   714: 	for (obj = ch->carrying; obj; obj = next_obj) {
   715: 	  next_obj = obj->next_content;
   716: 	  amount += perform_drop(ch, obj, mode, sname, RDR);
   717: 	}
   718:     } else if (dotmode == FIND_ALLDOT) {
   719:       if (!*arg) {
   720: 	send_to_char(ch, "What do you want to %s all of?\r\n", sname);
   721: 	return;
   722:       }
   723:       if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying)))
   724: 	send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have any %ss.\r\n", arg);
   725: 
   726:       while (obj) {
   727: 	next_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, obj->next_content);
   728: 	amount += perform_drop(ch, obj, mode, sname, RDR);
   729: 	obj = next_obj;
   730:       }
   731:     } else {
   732:       if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying)))
   733: 	send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
   734:       else
   735: 	amount += perform_drop(ch, obj, mode, sname, RDR);
   736:     }
   737:   }
   738: 
   739:   if (amount && (subcmd == SCMD_JUNK)) {
   740:     send_to_char(ch, "You have been rewarded by the gods!\r\n");
   741:     act("$n has been rewarded by the gods!", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   742:     increase_money_gold(ch, (long long)amount);
   743:   }
   744: }
   745: 
   746: static void perform_give(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict,
   747: 		       struct obj_data *obj)
   748: {
   749:   if (!give_otrigger(obj, ch, vict))
   750:     return;
   751:   if (!receive_mtrigger(vict, ch, obj))
   752:     return;
   753: 
   754:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_NODROP) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE)) {
   755:     act("You can't let go of $p!!  Yeech!", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   756:     return;
   757:   }
   758:   if (reject_kept_item_action(ch, obj))
   759:     return;
   760:   if (IS_CARRYING_N(vict) >= CAN_CARRY_N(vict) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT && GET_LEVEL(vict) < LVL_IMMORT) {
   761:     act("$N seems to have $S hands full.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
   762:     return;
   763:   }
   764:   if (GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) + IS_CARRYING_W(vict) > CAN_CARRY_W(vict) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT && GET_LEVEL(vict) < LVL_IMMORT) {
   765:     act("$E can't carry that much weight.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
   766:     return;
   767:   }
   768:   obj_from_char(obj);
   769:   obj_to_char(obj, vict);
   770:   act("You give $p to $N.", FALSE, ch, obj, vict, TO_CHAR);
   771:   act("$n gives you $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, vict, TO_VICT);
   772:   act("$n gives $p to $N.", TRUE, ch, obj, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
   773: 
   774:   autoquest_trigger_check( ch, vict, obj, AQ_OBJ_RETURN);
   775: }

   777: 
   778: /* Currency helpers for give: gold primary with diamonds as premium currency */
   779: static int parse_money_denom(const char *w)
   780: {
   781:   if (!w || !*w) return 0;
   782:   if (!str_cmp(w, "gold") || !str_cmp(w, "g")) return 3;
   783:   if (!str_cmp(w, "diamond") || !str_cmp(w, "d")) return 4;
   784:   if (!str_cmp(w, "coin") || !str_cmp(w, "coins")) return 3;
   785:   return 0;
   786: }
   787: 
   788: 
   789: 
   790: /* Parse tokens like 10g, 5s, 2c */
   791: static int parse_compact_money_token(const char *tok, int *out_amount, int *out_denom)
   792: {
   793:   int len;
   794:   char last;
   795: 
   796:   if (!tok || !*tok || !out_amount || !out_denom)
   797:     return 0;
   798: 
   799:   len = (int)strlen(tok);
   800:   if (len < 2)
   801:     return 0;
   802: 
   803:   last = tok[len - 1];
   804:   if (last != 'g' && last != 'G' &&
   805:       last != 'd' && last != 'D')
   806:     return 0;
   807: 
   808:   for (int i = 0; i < len - 1; i++)
   809:     if (!isdigit((unsigned char)tok[i]))
   810:       return 0;
   811: 
   812:   *out_amount = atoi(tok);
   813:   if (last == 'd' || last == 'D') *out_denom = 4;
   814:   else *out_denom = 3;
   815: 
   816:   return 1;
   817: }
   818: static const char *denom_name(int denom, int amount)
   819: {
   820:   if (denom == 4) return amount == 1 ? "diamond" : "diamonds";
   821:   return amount == 1 ? "gold coin" : "gold coins";
   822: }
   823: 
   824: static void perform_give_currency(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict, int amount, int denom)
   825: {
   826:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   827: 
   828:   if (amount <= 0) {
   829:     send_to_char(ch, "Heh heh heh ... we are jolly funny today, eh?\r\n");
   830:     return;
   831:   }
   832: 
   833:   if (denom == 4) {
   834:     if ((GET_DIAMONDS(ch) < amount) && (IS_NPC(ch) || (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD))) {
   835:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't have that many diamonds!\r\n");
   836:       return;
   837:     }
   838: 
   839:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n gives you %d %s.", amount, denom_name(denom, amount));
   840:     act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_VICT);
   841: 
   842:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n gives %d %s to $N.", amount, denom_name(denom, amount));
   843:     act(buf, TRUE, ch, 0, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
   844: 
   845:     if (IS_NPC(ch) || (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD))
   846:       decrease_diamonds(ch, amount);
   847: 
   848:     increase_diamonds(vict, amount);
   849:     return;
   850:   }
   851: 
   852:   long long gold = amount;
   853:   if (gold <= 0) {
   854:     send_to_char(ch, "Give how much of what?\r\n");
   855:     return;
   856:   }
   857: 
   858:   if ((GET_MONEY(ch) < gold) && (IS_NPC(ch) || (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD))) {
   859:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't have that much currency!\r\n");
   860:     return;
   861:   }
   862: 
   863:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n gives you %d %s.", amount, denom_name(denom, amount));
   864:   act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_VICT);
   865: 
   866:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n gives %d %s to $N.", amount, denom_name(denom, amount));
   867:   act(buf, TRUE, ch, 0, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
   868: 
   869:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD))
   870:     increase_money_gold(ch, -gold);
   871: 
   872:   increase_money_gold(vict, gold);
   873: 
   874:   /* DG bribe triggers are defined in coins, so premium-currency gifts do not
   875:    * dispatch them.  Run after the successful transfer so scripts observe the
   876:    * same balances as the players do. */
   877:   if (IS_NPC(vict))
   878:     bribe_mtrigger(vict, ch, amount);
   879: }

   881: /* utility function for give */
   882: static struct char_data *give_find_vict(struct char_data *ch, char *arg)
   883: {
   884:   struct char_data *vict;
   885: 
   886:   skip_spaces(&arg);
   887:   if (!*arg)
   888:     send_to_char(ch, "To who?\r\n");
   889:   else if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, arg, NULL, FIND_CHAR_ROOM)))
   890:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
   891:   else if (vict == ch)
   892:     send_to_char(ch, "What's the point of that?\r\n");
   893:   else
   894:     return (vict);
   895: 
   896:   return (NULL);
   897: }

   899: 
   900: ACMD(do_give)
   901: {
   902:   char arg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   903:   int amount, dotmode;
   904:   struct char_data *vict;
   905:   struct obj_data *obj, *next_obj;
   906: 
   907:   argument = one_argument(argument, arg);
   908: 
   909:   if (!*arg)
   910:     send_to_char(ch, "Give what to who?\r\n");
   911:   else if (is_number(arg)) {
   912:     int denom;
   913:     amount = atoi(arg);
   914:     argument = one_argument(argument, arg);
   915:     denom = parse_money_denom(arg);
   916:     if (denom) {
   917:       one_argument(argument, arg);
   918:       if ((vict = give_find_vict(ch, arg)) != NULL)
   919:         perform_give_currency(ch, vict, amount, denom);
   920:       return;
   921:     } else if (!*arg) /* Give multiple code. */
   922:       send_to_char(ch, "What do you want to give %d of?\r\n", amount);
   923:     else if (!(vict = give_find_vict(ch, argument)))
   924:       return;
   925:     else if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying)))
   926:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have any %ss.\r\n", arg);
   927:     else {
   928:       while (obj && amount--) {
   929: 	next_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, obj->next_content);
   930: 	perform_give(ch, vict, obj);
   931: 	obj = next_obj;
   932:       }
   933:     }
   934:   } else {
   935:     char buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   936: 
   937:     one_argument(argument, buf1);
   938:     if (!(vict = give_find_vict(ch, buf1)))
   939:       return;
   940:     dotmode = find_all_dots(arg);
   941:     if (dotmode == FIND_INDIV) {
   942:       if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying)))
   943: 	send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
   944:       else
   945: 	perform_give(ch, vict, obj);
   946:     } else {
   947:       if (dotmode == FIND_ALLDOT && !*arg) {
   948: 	send_to_char(ch, "All of what?\r\n");
   949: 	return;
   950:       }
   951:       if (!ch->carrying)
   952: 	send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to be holding anything.\r\n");
   953:       else
   954: 	for (obj = ch->carrying; obj; obj = next_obj) {
   955: 	  next_obj = obj->next_content;
   956: 	  if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj) &&
   957: 	      ((dotmode == FIND_ALL || isname(arg, obj->name))))
   958: 	    perform_give(ch, vict, obj);
   959: 	}
   960:     }
   961:   }
   962: }
   963: 
   964: void weight_change_object(struct obj_data *obj, int weight)
   965: {
   966:   struct obj_data *tmp_obj;
   967:   struct char_data *tmp_ch;
   968: 
   969:   if (IN_ROOM(obj) != NOWHERE) {
   970:     GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) += weight;
   971:   } else if ((tmp_ch = obj->carried_by)) {
   972:     obj_from_char(obj);
   973:     GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) += weight;
   974:     obj_to_char(obj, tmp_ch);
   975:   } else if ((tmp_obj = obj->in_obj)) {
   976:     obj_from_obj(obj);
   977:     GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) += weight;
   978:     obj_to_obj(obj, tmp_obj);
   979:   } else {
   980:     log("SYSERR: Unknown attempt to subtract weight from an object.");
   981:     /* SYSERR_DESC: weight_change_object() outputs this error when weight is
   982:      * attempted to be removed from an object that is not carried or in
   983:      * another object. */
   984:   }
   985: }
   986: 
   987: void name_from_drinkcon(struct obj_data *obj)
   988: {
   989:   /*
   990:    * Adventurer's Lair:
   991:    * Liquid type lives in GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2). Emptying a container must not
   992:    * rewrite builder-authored object aliases.
   993:    */
   994:   (void)obj;
   995: }
   996: void name_to_drinkcon(struct obj_data *obj, int type)
   997: {
   998:   /*
   999:    * Adventurer's Lair:
  1000:    * Filling a container must not append the liquid name to its keyword list.
  1001:    * Drink/fill/pour behavior uses the object's numeric liquid type instead.
  1002:    */
  1003:   (void)obj;
  1004:   (void)type;
  1005: }
  1006: ACMD(do_drink)
  1007: {
  1008:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1009:   struct obj_data *temp;
  1010:   struct affected_type af;
  1011:   int amount, weight;
  1012:   int on_ground = 0;
  1013: 
  1014:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1015: 
  1016:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) /* Cannot use GET_COND() on mobs. */
  1017:     return;
  1018: 
  1019:   if (!*arg) {
  1020:     char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1021:     switch (SECT(IN_ROOM(ch))) {
  1022:       case SECT_WATER_SWIM:
  1023:       case SECT_WATER_NOSWIM:
  1024:       case SECT_UNDERWATER:
  1025:         if (GET_COND(ch, THIRST) > 20) {
  1026:           send_to_char(ch, "You don't feel thirsty any more.\r\n");
  1027:           return;
  1028:         }
  1029:         snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n takes a refreshing drink.");
  1030:         act(buf, TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1031:         send_to_char(ch, "You take a refreshing drink.\r\n");
  1032:         gain_condition(ch, THIRST, 1);
  1033:         if (GET_COND(ch, THIRST) > 20)
  1034:           send_to_char(ch, "You don't feel thirsty any more.\r\n");
  1035:         return;
  1036:       default:
  1037:     send_to_char(ch, "Drink from what?\r\n");
  1038:     return;
  1039:     }
  1040:   }
  1041:   if (!(temp = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
  1042:     if (!(temp = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents))) {
  1043:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't find it!\r\n");
  1044:       return;
  1045:     } else
  1046:       on_ground = 1;
  1047:   }
  1048:   if ((GET_OBJ_TYPE(temp) != ITEM_DRINKCON) &&
  1049:       (GET_OBJ_TYPE(temp) != ITEM_FOUNTAIN)) {
  1050:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't drink from that!\r\n");
  1051:     return;
  1052:   }
  1053:   if (on_ground && (GET_OBJ_TYPE(temp) == ITEM_DRINKCON)) {
  1054:     send_to_char(ch, "You have to be holding that to drink from it.\r\n");
  1055:     return;
  1056:   }
  1057:   if ((GET_COND(ch, DRUNK) > 10) && (GET_COND(ch, THIRST) > 0)) {
  1058:     /* The pig is drunk */
  1059:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't seem to get close enough to your mouth.\r\n");
  1060:     act("$n tries to drink but misses $s mouth!", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1061:     return;
  1062:   }
  1063:   if (GET_COND(ch, THIRST) > 20) {
  1064:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't feel thirsty any more.\r\n");
  1065:     return;
  1066:   }
  1067:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 1) < 1) {
  1068:     send_to_char(ch, "It is empty.\r\n");
  1069:     return;
  1070:   }
  1071: 
  1072:   if (!consume_otrigger(temp, ch, OCMD_DRINK))  /* check trigger */
  1073:     return;
  1074: 
  1075:   if (subcmd == SCMD_DRINK) {
  1076:     char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1077: 
  1078:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n drinks %s from $p.", drinks[GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 2)]);
  1079:     act(buf, TRUE, ch, temp, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1080: 
  1081:     send_to_char(ch, "You drink the %s.\r\n", drinks[GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 2)]);
  1082: 
  1083:     if (drink_aff[GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 2)][DRUNK] > 0)
  1084:       amount = (25 - GET_COND(ch, THIRST)) / drink_aff[GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 2)][DRUNK];
  1085:     else
  1086:       amount = rand_number(3, 10);
  1087: 
  1088:   } else {
  1089:     act("$n sips from $p.", TRUE, ch, temp, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1090:     send_to_char(ch, "It tastes like %s.\r\n", drinks[GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 2)]);
  1091:     amount = 1;
  1092:   }
  1093: 
  1094:   amount = MIN(amount, GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 1));
  1095: 
  1096:   /* You can't subtract more than the object weighs, unless its unlimited. */
  1097:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 0) > 0) {
  1098:     weight = MIN(amount, GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(temp));
  1099:     weight_change_object(temp, -weight); /* Subtract amount */
  1100:   }
  1101: 
  1102:   gain_condition(ch, DRUNK,  drink_aff[GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 2)][DRUNK]  * amount / 4);
  1103:   gain_condition(ch, THIRST, drink_aff[GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 2)][THIRST] * amount / 4);
  1104: 
  1105:   if (GET_COND(ch, DRUNK) > 10)
  1106:     send_to_char(ch, "You feel drunk.\r\n");
  1107: 
  1108:   if (GET_COND(ch, THIRST) > 20)
  1109:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't feel thirsty any more.\r\n");
  1110: 
  1111:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 3) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) { /* The crap was poisoned ! */
  1112:     send_to_char(ch, "Oops, it tasted rather strange!\r\n");
  1113:     act("$n chokes and utters some strange sounds.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1114: 
  1115:     new_affect(&af);
  1116:     af.spell = SPELL_POISON;
  1117:     af.duration = amount * 3;
  1118:     SET_BIT_AR(af.bitvector, AFF_POISON);
  1119:     affect_join(ch, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  1120:   }
  1121:   /* Empty the container (unless unlimited), and no longer poison. */
  1122:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 0) > 0) {
  1123:     GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 1) -= amount;
  1124:     if (!GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 1)) { /* The last bit */
  1125:       name_from_drinkcon(temp);
  1126:       GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 2) = 0;
  1127:       GET_OBJ_VAL(temp, 3) = 0;
  1128:     }
  1129:   }
  1130:   return;
  1131: }
  1132: 
  1133: ACMD(do_eat)
  1134: {
  1135:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1136:   struct obj_data *food;
  1137:   struct affected_type af;
  1138:   int hunger_amount;
  1139:   int sated_duration;
  1140: 
  1141:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1142: 
  1143:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) /* Cannot use GET_COND() on mobs. */
  1144:     return;
  1145: 
  1146:   if (!*arg) {
  1147:     send_to_char(ch, "Eat what?\r\n");
  1148:     return;
  1149:   }
  1150:   if (!(food = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
  1151:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
  1152:     return;
  1153:   }
  1154:   if (subcmd == SCMD_TASTE && ((GET_OBJ_TYPE(food) == ITEM_DRINKCON) ||
  1155: 			       (GET_OBJ_TYPE(food) == ITEM_FOUNTAIN))) {
  1156:     do_drink(ch, argument, 0, SCMD_SIP);
  1157:     return;
  1158:   }
  1159:   if ((GET_OBJ_TYPE(food) != ITEM_FOOD) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)) {
  1160:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't eat THAT!\r\n");
  1161:     return;
  1162:   }
  1163:   if (GET_COND(ch, HUNGER) > 20) { /* Stomach full */
  1164:     send_to_char(ch, "You are too full to eat more!\r\n");
  1165:     return;
  1166:   }
  1167: 
  1168:   if (!consume_otrigger(food, ch, OCMD_EAT)) /* check trigger */
  1169:     return;
  1170: 
  1171:   if (subcmd == SCMD_EAT) {
  1172:     act("You eat $p.", FALSE, ch, food, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1173:     act("$n eats $p.", TRUE, ch, food, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1174:   } else {
  1175:     act("You nibble a little bit of $p.", FALSE, ch, food, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1176:     act("$n tastes a little bit of $p.", TRUE, ch, food, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1177:   }
  1178: 
  1179:   if (subcmd == SCMD_EAT) {
  1180:     hunger_amount = GET_OBJ_VAL(food, 0);
  1181:     sated_duration = GET_OBJ_VAL(food, 2);
  1182:   } else {
  1183:     hunger_amount = (GET_OBJ_VAL(food, 0) > 0) ? 1 : 0;
  1184:     sated_duration = (GET_OBJ_VAL(food, 2) > 0) ? 1 : 0;
  1185:   }
  1186: 
  1187:   gain_condition(ch, HUNGER, hunger_amount);
  1188:   ch->char_specials.food_sated_ticks = MAX(ch->char_specials.food_sated_ticks, 0) + MAX(sated_duration, 0);
  1189: 
  1190:   if (GET_COND(ch, HUNGER) > 20)
  1191:     send_to_char(ch, "You are full.\r\n");
  1192:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(food, 3) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)) {
  1193:     /* The crap was poisoned ! */
  1194:     send_to_char(ch, "Oops, that tasted rather strange!\r\n");
  1195:     act("$n coughs and utters some strange sounds.", FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1196: 
  1197:     new_affect(&af);
  1198:     af.spell = SPELL_POISON;
  1199:     af.duration = MAX(1, hunger_amount) * 2;
  1200:     SET_BIT_AR(af.bitvector, AFF_POISON);
  1201:     affect_join(ch, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  1202:   }
  1203:   if (subcmd == SCMD_EAT)
  1204:     extract_obj(food);
  1205: }
  1206: 
  1207: ACMD(do_pour)
  1208: {
  1209:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1210:   struct obj_data *from_obj = NULL, *to_obj = NULL;
  1211:   int amount = 0;
  1212: 
  1213:   two_arguments(argument, arg1, arg2);
  1214: 
  1215:   /* Currency drop: drop <amount> <gold> */
  1216:   if (*arg1 && is_number(arg1) && *arg2) {
  1217:     int denom = parse_money_denom(arg2);
  1218:     if (denom) {
  1219:       perform_drop_currency(ch, atoi(arg1), denom, subcmd);
  1220:       return;
  1221:     }
  1222:   }
  1223: 
  1224:   if (subcmd == SCMD_POUR) {
  1225:     if (!*arg1) { /* No arguments */
  1226:       send_to_char(ch, "From what do you want to pour?\r\n");
  1227:       return;
  1228:     }
  1229:     if (!(from_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
  1230:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't find it!\r\n");
  1231:       return;
  1232:     }
  1233:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(from_obj) != ITEM_DRINKCON) {
  1234:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't pour from that!\r\n");
  1235:       return;
  1236:     }
  1237:   }
  1238:   if (subcmd == SCMD_FILL) {
  1239:     if (!*arg1) { /* no arguments */
  1240:       send_to_char(ch, "What do you want to fill?  And what are you filling it from?\r\n");
  1241:       return;
  1242:     }
  1243:     if (!(to_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
  1244:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't find it!\r\n");
  1245:       return;
  1246:     }
  1247:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(to_obj) != ITEM_DRINKCON) {
  1248:       act("You can't fill $p!", FALSE, ch, to_obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1249:       return;
  1250:     }
  1251:     if (!*arg2) { /* no 2nd argument */
  1252:       act("What do you want to fill $p from?", FALSE, ch, to_obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1253:       return;
  1254:     }
  1255:     if (!(from_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg2, NULL, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents))) {
  1256:       send_to_char(ch, "There doesn't seem to be %s %s here.\r\n", AN(arg2), arg2);
  1257:       return;
  1258:     }
  1259:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(from_obj) != ITEM_FOUNTAIN) {
  1260:       act("You can't fill something from $p.", FALSE, ch, from_obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1261:       return;
  1262:     }
  1263:   }
  1264:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 1) == 0) {
  1265:     act("The $p is empty.", FALSE, ch, from_obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1266:     return;
  1267:   }
  1268:   if (subcmd == SCMD_POUR) { /* pour */
  1269:     if (!*arg2) {
  1270:       send_to_char(ch, "Where do you want it?  Out or in what?\r\n");
  1271:       return;
  1272:     }
  1273:     if (!str_cmp(arg2, "out")) {
  1274:       if (GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 0) > 0) {
  1275:         act("$n empties $p.", TRUE, ch, from_obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1276:         act("You empty $p.", FALSE, ch, from_obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1277: 
  1278:         weight_change_object(from_obj, -GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 1)); /* Empty */
  1279: 
  1280:         name_from_drinkcon(from_obj);
  1281:         GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 1) = 0;
  1282:         GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 2) = 0;
  1283:         GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 3) = 0;
  1284:       }
  1285:       else
  1286:         send_to_char(ch, "You can't possibly pour that container out!\r\n");
  1287: 
  1288:       return;
  1289:     }
  1290:     if (!(to_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg2, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
  1291:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't find it!\r\n");
  1292:       return;
  1293:     }
  1294:     if ((GET_OBJ_TYPE(to_obj) != ITEM_DRINKCON) &&
  1295: 	(GET_OBJ_TYPE(to_obj) != ITEM_FOUNTAIN)) {
  1296:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't pour anything into that.\r\n");
  1297:       return;
  1298:     }
  1299:   }
  1300:   if (to_obj == from_obj) {
  1301:     send_to_char(ch, "A most unproductive effort.\r\n");
  1302:     return;
  1303:   }
  1304:   if ((GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 0) < 0) ||
  1305:       (!(GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 1) < GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 0)))) {
  1306:     send_to_char(ch, "There is already another liquid in it!\r\n");
  1307:     return;
  1308:   }
  1309:   if (!(GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 1) < GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 0))) {
  1310:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no room for more.\r\n");
  1311:     return;
  1312:   }
  1313:   if (subcmd == SCMD_POUR)
  1314:     send_to_char(ch, "You pour the %s into the %s.", drinks[GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 2)], arg2);
  1315: 
  1316:   if (subcmd == SCMD_FILL) {
  1317:     act("You gently fill $p from $P.", FALSE, ch, to_obj, from_obj, TO_CHAR);
  1318:     act("$n gently fills $p from $P.", TRUE, ch, to_obj, from_obj, TO_ROOM);
  1319:   }
  1320:   /* New alias */
  1321:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 1) == 0)
  1322:     name_to_drinkcon(to_obj, GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 2));
  1323: 
  1324:   /* First same type liq. */
  1325:   GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 2) = GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 2);
  1326: 
  1327:   /* Then how much to pour */
  1328:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 0) > 0) {
  1329:     GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 1) -= (amount =
  1330:         (GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 0) - GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 1)));
  1331: 
  1332:     GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 1) = GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 0);
  1333: 
  1334:     if (GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 1) < 0) {	/* There was too little */
  1335:       GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 1) += GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 1);
  1336:       amount += GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 1);
  1337:       name_from_drinkcon(from_obj);
  1338:       GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 1) = 0;
  1339:       GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 2) = 0;
  1340:       GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 3) = 0;
  1341:     }
  1342:   }
  1343:   else {
  1344:     GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 1) = GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 0);
  1345:     amount = GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 0);
  1346:   }
  1347:   /* Poisoned? */
  1348:   GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 3) = (GET_OBJ_VAL(to_obj, 3) || GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 3))
  1349: ;
  1350:   /* Weight change, except for unlimited. */
  1351:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(from_obj, 0) > 0) {
  1352:     weight_change_object(from_obj, -amount);
  1353:   }
  1354:   weight_change_object(to_obj, amount); /* Add weight */
  1355: }

  1426: static int can_equip_weapon(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj, int where, int show_message, int allow_replace)
  1427: {
  1428:   struct obj_data *prim = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD);
  1429:   int dual_level;
  1430: 
  1431: #define WEAPON_REJECT(message) do { if (show_message) send_to_char(ch, message); return FALSE; } while (0)
  1432: 
  1433:   if (!obj || GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_WEAPON)
  1434:     WEAPON_REJECT("You can only wield weapons.\r\n");
  1435:   if (!CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_WIELD))
  1436:     WEAPON_REJECT("You can't wield that.\r\n");
  1437:   if (is_two_hander(obj) && is_offhand_weapon(obj))
  1438:     WEAPON_REJECT("That weapon has incompatible two-handed and offhand properties.\r\n");
  1439:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj))
  1440:     WEAPON_REJECT("You are not experienced enough to use that.\r\n");
  1441:   if (invalid_align(ch, obj) || invalid_class(ch, obj)) {
  1442:     if (show_message)
  1443:       act("You are not permitted to use $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1444:     return FALSE;
  1445:   }
  1446:   if (!can_wield_by_weight(ch, obj, show_message))
  1447:     return FALSE;
  1448: 
  1449:   if (where == WEAR_WIELD) {
  1450:     if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD) && !allow_replace)
  1451:       WEAPON_REJECT("You're already wielding a weapon.\r\n");
  1452:     if (is_two_hander(obj) && (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_SHIELD) || GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD)))
  1453:       WEAPON_REJECT("That weapon requires two hands. Remove your shield and held item first.\r\n");
  1454:     if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_SHIELD) && GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD))
  1455:       WEAPON_REJECT("You cannot wield a weapon while using both a shield and a held item.\r\n");
  1456:     if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD) && GET_OBJ_TYPE(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD)) == ITEM_WEAPON &&
  1457:         GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD)) > GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj))
  1458:       WEAPON_REJECT("Your offhand weapon must be the same weight or lighter than your primary weapon.\r\n");
  1459:   } else if (where == WEAR_HOLD) {
  1460:     if (!is_offhand_weapon(obj))
  1461:       WEAPON_REJECT("That weapon is not balanced for offhand use.\r\n");
  1462:     if (is_two_hander(obj))
  1463:       WEAPON_REJECT("A two-handed weapon cannot be used in your offhand.\r\n");
  1464:     if (!IS_NPC(ch)) {
  1465:       dual_level = spell_info[SKILL_DUAL_WIELD].min_level[(int)GET_CLASS(ch)];
  1466:       if (dual_level >= LVL_IMMORT && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)
  1467:         WEAPON_REJECT("Your class cannot learn Dual Wield.\r\n");
  1468:       if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < dual_level)
  1469:         WEAPON_REJECT("You have not reached the level required to learn Dual Wield.\r\n");
  1470:       if (GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_DUAL_WIELD) <= 0)
  1471:         WEAPON_REJECT("Dual Wield is available to you, but you have not learned it; your current skill is insufficient.\r\n");
  1472:     }
  1473:     if (!prim || GET_OBJ_TYPE(prim) != ITEM_WEAPON)
  1474:       WEAPON_REJECT("You need a primary weapon wielded first.\r\n");
  1475:     if (character_is_using_two_hander(ch))
  1476:       WEAPON_REJECT("Your weapon requires both hands.\r\n");
  1477:     if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_SHIELD))
  1478:       WEAPON_REJECT("You cannot dual wield while using a shield.\r\n");
  1479:     if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD) && !allow_replace)
  1480:       WEAPON_REJECT("You're already holding something.\r\n");
  1481:     if (GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) > GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(prim))
  1482:       WEAPON_REJECT("Your offhand weapon must be the same weight or lighter than your primary weapon.\r\n");
  1483:   } else
  1484:     WEAPON_REJECT("You can't wear that weapon there.\r\n");
  1485: 
  1486: #undef WEAPON_REJECT
  1487:   return TRUE;
  1488: }
  1489: 
  1490: static int perform_wear(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj, int where)
  1491: {
  1492:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON && (where == WEAR_WIELD || where == WEAR_HOLD) &&
  1493:       !can_equip_weapon(ch, obj, where, TRUE, FALSE))
  1494:     return FALSE;
  1495: 
  1496:   /* dual wield + two hander rules begin */
  1497:   {
  1498:     struct obj_data *prim = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD);
  1499:     struct obj_data *sh = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_SHIELD);
  1500:     struct obj_data *held = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD);
  1501: 
  1502:     /* With a primary weapon equipped: shield XOR hold (not both). */
  1503:     if (prim && GET_OBJ_TYPE(prim) == ITEM_WEAPON) {
  1504:       if (sh && held) {
  1505:         send_to_char(ch, "You cannot use both a shield and a held item while wielding a weapon.\r\n");
  1506:         return FALSE;
  1507:       }
  1508:       if (character_is_using_two_hander(ch) && (sh || held)) {
  1509:         send_to_char(ch, "Your weapon requires two hands. Remove your shield and held item first.\r\n");
  1510:         return FALSE;
  1511:       }
  1512:     }
  1513: 
  1514:     if (where == WEAR_WIELD) {
  1515:       if (is_two_hander(obj) && (sh || held)) {
  1516:         send_to_char(ch, "That weapon requires two hands. Remove your shield and held item first.\r\n");
  1517:         return FALSE;
  1518:       }
  1519:       if (sh && held) {
  1520:         send_to_char(ch, "You cannot wield a weapon while using both a shield and a held item.\r\n");
  1521:         return FALSE;
  1522:       }
  1523:     }
  1524: 
  1525:     if (where == WEAR_SHIELD) {
  1526:       if (held) {
  1527:         send_to_char(ch, "You cannot use a shield while holding an item.\r\n");
  1528:         return FALSE;
  1529:       }
  1530:       if (character_is_using_two_hander(ch)) {
  1531:         send_to_char(ch, "Your weapon requires both hands.\r\n");
  1532:         return FALSE;
  1533:       }
  1534:     }
  1535: 
  1536:     if (where == WEAR_HOLD) {
  1537:       /* Weapon validation is centralized above. */
  1538:       if (!obj || GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_WEAPON) {
  1539:         /* Non-weapon hold item: cannot be used with a shield. Also blocked by two handers. */
  1540:         if (sh) {
  1541:           send_to_char(ch, "You cannot hold an item while using a shield.\r\n");
  1542:           return FALSE;
  1543:         }
  1544:         if (character_is_using_two_hander(ch)) {
  1545:           send_to_char(ch, "Your weapon requires both hands.\r\n");
  1546:           return FALSE;
  1547:         }
  1548:       }
  1549:     }
  1550:   }
  1551:   /* dual wield + two hander rules end */
  1552: 
  1553:   /*
  1554:    * ITEM_WEAR_TAKE is used for objects that do not require special bits
  1555:    * to be put into that position (e.g. you can hold any object, not just
  1556:    * an object with a HOLD bit.)
  1557:    */
  1558: 
  1559:   int wear_bitvectors[] = {
  1560:     ITEM_WEAR_TAKE, ITEM_WEAR_FINGER, ITEM_WEAR_FINGER, ITEM_WEAR_NECK,
  1561:     ITEM_WEAR_NECK, ITEM_WEAR_BODY, ITEM_WEAR_HEAD, ITEM_WEAR_LEGS,
  1562:     ITEM_WEAR_FEET, ITEM_WEAR_HANDS, ITEM_WEAR_ARMS, ITEM_WEAR_SHIELD,
  1563:     ITEM_WEAR_ABOUT, ITEM_WEAR_WAIST, ITEM_WEAR_WRIST, ITEM_WEAR_WRIST,
  1564:     ITEM_WEAR_WIELD, ITEM_WEAR_TAKE
  1565:   };
  1566: 
  1567:   const char *already_wearing[] = {
  1568:     "You're already using a light.\r\n",
  1569:     "YOU SHOULD NEVER SEE THIS MESSAGE.  PLEASE REPORT.\r\n",
  1570:     "You're already wearing something on both of your ring fingers.\r\n",
  1571:     "YOU SHOULD NEVER SEE THIS MESSAGE.  PLEASE REPORT.\r\n",
  1572:     "You can't wear anything else around your neck.\r\n",
  1573:     "You're already wearing something on your body.\r\n",
  1574:     "You're already wearing something on your head.\r\n",
  1575:     "You're already wearing something on your legs.\r\n",
  1576:     "You're already wearing something on your feet.\r\n",
  1577:     "You're already wearing something on your hands.\r\n",
  1578:     "You're already wearing something on your arms.\r\n",
  1579:     "You're already using a shield.\r\n",
  1580:     "You're already wearing something about your body.\r\n",
  1581:     "You already have something around your waist.\r\n",
  1582:     "YOU SHOULD NEVER SEE THIS MESSAGE.  PLEASE REPORT.\r\n",
  1583:     "You're already wearing something around both of your wrists.\r\n",
  1584:     "You're already wielding a weapon.\r\n",
  1585:     "You're already holding something.\r\n"
  1586:   };
  1587: 
  1588:   /* first, make sure that the wear position is valid. */
  1589:   if (!CAN_WEAR(obj, wear_bitvectors[where]) &&
  1590:       !(where == WEAR_HOLD && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON && OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_OFFHAND)) &&
  1591:       !(where == WEAR_WIELD && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WAND)) {
  1592:     act("You can't wear $p there.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1593:     return FALSE;
  1594:   }
  1595:   /* for neck, finger, and wrist, try pos 2 if pos 1 is already full */
  1596:   if ((where == WEAR_FINGER_R) || (where == WEAR_NECK_1) || (where == WEAR_WRIST_R))
  1597:     if (GET_EQ(ch, where))
  1598:       where++;
  1599: 
  1600:   if (GET_EQ(ch, where)) {
  1601:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", already_wearing[where]);
  1602:     return FALSE;
  1603:   }
  1604: 
  1605:   /* See if a trigger disallows it */
  1606:   if (!wear_otrigger(obj, ch, where) || (obj->carried_by != ch))
  1607:     return FALSE;
  1608: 
  1609:   wear_message(ch, obj, where);
  1610:   obj_from_char(obj);
  1611:   equip_char(ch, obj, where);
  1612:   return (obj->worn_by == ch);
  1613: }
  1614: 
  1615: /* Explicit weapon commands may replace one occupied hand slot.  Validate and
  1616:  * run both triggers before moving either object so every ordinary rejection is
  1617:  * atomic.  Numbered lookup has already selected obj from carried inventory. */
  1618: static int perform_weapon_swap(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj, int where)
  1619: {
  1620:   struct obj_data *old = GET_EQ(ch, where);
  1621: 
  1622:   if (!old)
  1623:     return perform_wear(ch, obj, where);
  1624: 
  1625:   if (!can_equip_weapon(ch, obj, where, TRUE, TRUE))
  1626:     return FALSE;
  1627: 
  1628:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(old, ITEM_NODROP) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE)) {
  1629:     act("You can't remove $p, it must be CURSED!", FALSE, ch, old, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1630:     return FALSE;
  1631:   }
  1632: 
  1633:   if (!wear_otrigger(obj, ch, where) || obj->carried_by != ch || GET_EQ(ch, where) != old)
  1634:     return FALSE;
  1635:   if (!remove_otrigger(old, ch) || GET_EQ(ch, where) != old || obj->carried_by != ch)
  1636:     return FALSE;
  1637: 
  1638:   old = unequip_char(ch, where);
  1639:   obj_from_char(obj);
  1640:   obj_to_char(old, ch);
  1641:   equip_char(ch, obj, where);
  1642: 
  1643:   if (obj->worn_by != ch) {
  1644:     if (obj->carried_by != ch)
  1645:       obj_to_char(obj, ch);
  1646:     if (old->carried_by == ch) {
  1647:       obj_from_char(old);
  1648:       equip_char(ch, old, where);
  1649:     }
  1650:     return FALSE;
  1651:   }
  1652: 
  1653:   act("You stop using $p.", FALSE, ch, old, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1654:   act("$n stops using $p.", TRUE, ch, old, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1655:   wear_message(ch, obj, where);
  1656:   return TRUE;
  1657: }
  1658: 
  1659: int find_eq_pos(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj, char *arg)
  1660: {
  1661:   int where = -1;
  1662: 
  1663:   const char *keywords[] = {
  1664:     "!RESERVED!",
  1665:     "finger",
  1666:     "!RESERVED!",
  1667:     "neck",
  1668:     "!RESERVED!",
  1669:     "body",
  1670:     "head",
  1671:     "legs",
  1672:     "feet",
  1673:     "hands",
  1674:     "arms",
  1675:     "shield",
  1676:     "about",
  1677:     "waist",
  1678:     "wrist",
  1679:     "!RESERVED!",
  1680:     "!RESERVED!",
  1681:     "!RESERVED!",
  1682:     "\n"
  1683:   };
  1684: 
  1685:   if (!arg || !*arg) {
  1686:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_FINGER))      where = WEAR_FINGER_R;
  1687:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_NECK))        where = WEAR_NECK_1;
  1688:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_BODY))        where = WEAR_BODY;
  1689:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_HEAD))        where = WEAR_HEAD;
  1690:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_LEGS))        where = WEAR_LEGS;
  1691:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_FEET))        where = WEAR_FEET;
  1692:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_HANDS))       where = WEAR_HANDS;
  1693:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_ARMS))        where = WEAR_ARMS;
  1694:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_SHIELD))      where = WEAR_SHIELD;
  1695:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_ABOUT))       where = WEAR_ABOUT;
  1696:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_WAIST))       where = WEAR_WAIST;
  1697:     if (CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_WRIST))       where = WEAR_WRIST_R;
  1698:   } else if ((where = search_block(arg, keywords, FALSE)) < 0)
  1699:     send_to_char(ch, "'%s'?  What part of your body is THAT?\r\n", arg);
  1700: 
  1701:   return (where);
  1702: }
  1703: 
  1704: ACMD(do_wear)
  1705: {
  1706:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1707:   char arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1708:   struct obj_data *obj, *next_obj, *first_offhand;
  1709:   int where, dotmode, items_worn = 0, wear_attempted = 0;
  1710: 
  1711:   two_arguments(argument, arg1, arg2);
  1712: 
  1713:   if (!*arg1) {
  1714:     send_to_char(ch, "Wear what?\r\n");
  1715:     return;
  1716:   }
  1717:   dotmode = find_all_dots(arg1);
  1718: 
  1719:   if (*arg2 && (dotmode != FIND_INDIV)) {
  1720:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't specify the same body location for more than one item!\r\n");
  1721:     return;
  1722:   }
  1723: 
  1724:   if (dotmode == FIND_ALL) {
  1725:     /* Equip ordinary wearables and prefer a normal or two-handed primary.
  1726:      * Offhand-capable weapons are deferred so a normal primary wins regardless
  1727:      * of inventory order. */
  1728:     for (obj = ch->carrying; obj; obj = next_obj) {
  1729:       next_obj = obj->next_content;
  1730:       if (!CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj))
  1731:         continue;
  1732:       if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj)) {
  1733:         send_to_char(ch, "You are not experienced enough to use that.\r\n");
  1734:         continue;
  1735:       }
  1736: 
  1737:       if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON && CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_WIELD) &&
  1738:           !is_offhand_weapon(obj)) {
  1739:         wear_attempted = 1;
  1740:         if (!GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD) && perform_wear(ch, obj, WEAR_WIELD))
  1741:           items_worn++;
  1742:         continue;
  1743:       }
  1744: 
  1745:       where = find_eq_pos(ch, obj, 0);
  1746:       if (where >= 0) {
  1747:         wear_attempted = 1;
  1748:         if (perform_wear(ch, obj, where))
  1749:           items_worn++;
  1750:       }
  1751:     }
  1752: 
  1753:     if (!character_is_using_two_hander(ch)) {
  1754:       first_offhand = NULL;
  1755:       for (obj = ch->carrying; obj; obj = next_obj) {
  1756:         next_obj = obj->next_content;
  1757:         if (!CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj) || !is_offhand_weapon(obj))
  1758:           continue;
  1759:         wear_attempted = 1;
  1760:         if (!GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD)) {
  1761:           if (perform_wear(ch, obj, WEAR_WIELD))
  1762:             items_worn++;
  1763:           continue;
  1764:         }
  1765:         if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD))
  1766:           break;
  1767:         if (!first_offhand)
  1768:           first_offhand = obj;
  1769:         if (can_equip_weapon(ch, obj, WEAR_HOLD, FALSE, FALSE)) {
  1770:           first_offhand = NULL;
  1771:           if (perform_wear(ch, obj, WEAR_HOLD))
  1772:             items_worn++;
  1773:           break;
  1774:         }
  1775:       }
  1776:       if (!GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD) && first_offhand)
  1777:         perform_wear(ch, first_offhand, WEAR_HOLD); /* Report one relevant failure. */
  1778:     }
  1779: 
  1780:     if (!items_worn && !wear_attempted)
  1781:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have anything wearable.\r\n");
  1782:   } else if (dotmode == FIND_ALLDOT) {
  1783:     if (!*arg1) {
  1784:       send_to_char(ch, "Wear all of what?\r\n");
  1785:       return;
  1786:     }
  1787:     if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, ch->carrying)))
  1788:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have any %ss.\r\n", arg1);
  1789:     else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj))
  1790:       send_to_char(ch, "You are not experienced enough to use that.\r\n");
  1791:     else
  1792:       while (obj) {
  1793: 	next_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, obj->next_content);
  1794: 	if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON)
  1795: 	  perform_wear(ch, obj, weapon_wear_position(ch, obj));
  1796: 	else if ((where = find_eq_pos(ch, obj, 0)) >= 0)
  1797: 	  perform_wear(ch, obj, where);
  1798: 	else
  1799: 	  act("You can't wear $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1800: 	obj = next_obj;
  1801:       }
  1802:   } else {
  1803:     if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, ch->carrying)))
  1804:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg1), arg1);
  1805:     else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj))
  1806:       send_to_char(ch, "You are not experienced enough to use that.\r\n");
  1807:     else {
  1808: 
  1809:       if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON)
  1810: 	perform_weapon_swap(ch, obj, weapon_wear_position(ch, obj));
  1811:       else if ((where = find_eq_pos(ch, obj, arg2)) >= 0)
  1812: 	perform_wear(ch, obj, where);
  1813:       else if (!*arg2)
  1814: 	act("You can't wear $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1815:     }
  1816:   }
  1817: }
  1818: 
  1819: ACMD(do_wield)
  1820: {
  1821:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1822:   struct obj_data *obj;
  1823: 
  1824:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1825: 
  1826:   if (!*arg)
  1827:     send_to_char(ch, "Wield what?\r\n");
  1828:   else if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying)))
  1829:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
  1830:   else {
  1831:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WAND)
  1832:       perform_wear(ch, obj, WEAR_WIELD);
  1833:     else if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_WEAPON)
  1834:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only wield weapons or wands.\r\n");
  1835:     else
  1836:       perform_weapon_swap(ch, obj, WEAR_WIELD);
  1837:   }
  1838: }
  1839: 
  1840: ACMD(do_offhand)
  1841: {
  1842:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1843:   struct obj_data *obj;
  1844: 
  1845:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  1846:   if (!strn_cmp(argument, "wield", 5) && (!argument[5] || isspace((unsigned char)argument[5]))) {
  1847:     argument += 5;
  1848:     skip_spaces(&argument);
  1849:   }
  1850:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1851: 
  1852:   if (!*arg) {
  1853:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: offhand <weapon>\r\n");
  1854:     return;
  1855:   }
  1856: 
  1857:   obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying);
  1858:   if (!obj) {
  1859:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have %s.\r\n", arg);
  1860:     return;
  1861:   }
  1862: 
  1863:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_WEAPON) {
  1864:     send_to_char(ch, "You can only offhand weapons.\r\n");
  1865:     return;
  1866:   }
  1867: 
  1868:   perform_weapon_swap(ch, obj, WEAR_HOLD);
  1869: }
  1870: 
  1871: 
  1872: ACMD(do_grab)
  1873: {
  1874:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1875:   struct obj_data *obj;
  1876: 
  1877:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1878: 
  1879:   if (!*arg)
  1880:     send_to_char(ch, "Hold what?\r\n");
  1881:   else if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying)))
  1882:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
  1883:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj))
  1884:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not experienced enough to use that.\r\n");
  1885:   else {
  1886:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_LIGHT)
  1887:       perform_wear(ch, obj, WEAR_LIGHT);
  1888:     else if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON)
  1889:       perform_weapon_swap(ch, obj, weapon_wear_position(ch, obj));
  1890:     else {
  1891:       if (!CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_HOLD) && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_WAND &&
  1892:       GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_STAFF && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_SCROLL &&
  1893: 	  GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_POTION)
  1894: 	send_to_char(ch, "You can't hold that.\r\n");
  1895:       else
  1896: 	perform_wear(ch, obj, WEAR_HOLD);
  1897:     }
  1898:   }
  1899: }

  1901: static void perform_remove(struct char_data *ch, int pos)
  1902: {
  1903:   struct obj_data *obj;
  1904: 
  1905:   if (!(obj = GET_EQ(ch, pos)))
  1906:     log("SYSERR: perform_remove: bad pos %d passed.", pos);
  1907:     /*  This error occurs when perform_remove() is passed a bad 'pos'
  1908:      *  (location) to remove an object from. */
  1909:   else if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_NODROP) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE))
  1910:     act("You can't remove $p, it must be CURSED!", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1911:   else if (IS_CARRYING_N(ch) >= CAN_CARRY_N(ch)&& !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE))
  1912:     act("$p: you can't carry that many items!", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1913:   else {
  1914:     if (!remove_otrigger(obj, ch))
  1915:       return;
  1916: 
  1917:     obj_to_char(unequip_char(ch, pos), ch);
  1918:     act("You stop using $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1919:     act("$n stops using $p.", TRUE, ch, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1920:   }
  1921: }

  1923: ACMD(do_remove)
  1924: {
  1925:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1926:   int i, dotmode, found;
  1927: 
  1928:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1929: 
  1930:   if (!*arg) {
  1931:     send_to_char(ch, "Remove what?\r\n");
  1932:     return;
  1933:   }
  1934:   dotmode = find_all_dots(arg);
  1935: 
  1936:   if (dotmode == FIND_ALL) {
  1937:     found = 0;
  1938:     for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
  1939:       if (GET_EQ(ch, i)) {
  1940: 	perform_remove(ch, i);
  1941: 	found = 1;
  1942:       }
  1943:     if (!found)
  1944:       send_to_char(ch, "You're not using anything.\r\n");
  1945:   } else if (dotmode == FIND_ALLDOT) {
  1946:     if (!*arg)
  1947:       send_to_char(ch, "Remove all of what?\r\n");
  1948:     else {
  1949:       found = 0;
  1950:       for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
  1951: 	if (GET_EQ(ch, i) && CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, GET_EQ(ch, i)) &&
  1952: 	    isname(arg, GET_EQ(ch, i)->name)) {
  1953: 	  perform_remove(ch, i);
  1954: 	  found = 1;
  1955: 	}
  1956:       if (!found)
  1957: 	send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to be using any %ss.\r\n", arg);
  1958:     }
  1959:   } else {
  1960:     if ((i = get_obj_pos_in_equip_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->equipment)) < 0)
  1961:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to be using %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
  1962:     else
  1963:       perform_remove(ch, i);
  1964:   }
  1965: }

  1967: ACMD(do_ilock)
  1968: {
  1969:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];

  1976:     send_to_char(ch, "Lock which item?\r\n");
  1977:     return;

  2016:     return;

  2018:

  2020:   act("You remove the keep protection from $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  2021: }

  2023: ACMD(do_sac)
  2024: {
  2025:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2026:   struct obj_data *j, *jj, *next_thing2;
  2027: 
  2028:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  2029: 
  2030:   if (!*arg) {
  2031:     send_to_char(ch, "Sacrifice what?\n\r");
  2032:     return;
  2033:   }
  2034:     
  2035:   if (!(j = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents)) && (!(j = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying)))) {
  2036:     send_to_char(ch, "It doesn't seem to be here.\n\r");
  2037:     return;
  2038:   }
  2039: 
  2040:   if (reject_kept_item_action(ch, j))
  2041:     return;
  2042: 
  2043:   if (!CAN_WEAR(j, ITEM_WEAR_TAKE)) {
  2044:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't sacrifice that!\n\r");
  2045:     return;
  2046:   }
  2047: 
  2048:    act("$n sacrifices $p.", FALSE, ch, j, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2049: 
  2050:   switch (rand_number(0, 5)) {
  2051:     case 0:
  2052:       send_to_char(ch, "You sacrifice %s to the Gods.\r\nYou receive one gold coin for your humility.\r\n", GET_OBJ_SHORT(j));
  2053:       increase_gold(ch, 1);
  2054:     break;
  2055:     case 1:
  2056:       send_to_char(ch, "You sacrifice %s to the Gods.\r\nThe Gods ignore your sacrifice.\r\n", GET_OBJ_SHORT(j));
  2057:     break;
  2058:     case 2:
  2059:       send_to_char(ch, "You sacrifice %s to the Gods.\r\nThe gods give you %d experience points.\r\n", GET_OBJ_SHORT(j), 1+2*GET_OBJ_LEVEL(j));
  2060:       gain_exp(ch, (1 + 2 * GET_OBJ_LEVEL(j))); break;
  2061:     case 3:
  2062:       send_to_char(ch, "You sacrifice %s to the Gods.\r\nYou receive %s%d%s experience points.\r\n", GET_OBJ_SHORT(j),
  2063:                    CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), 1 + GET_OBJ_LEVEL(j), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  2064:       gain_exp(ch, (1 + GET_OBJ_LEVEL(j))); break;
  2065:     case 4:
  2066:       send_to_char(ch, "Your sacrifice to the Gods is rewarded with %d gold coins.\r\n", 1+GET_OBJ_LEVEL(j));
  2067:       increase_gold(ch, (1+GET_OBJ_LEVEL(j)));
  2068:     break;
  2069:     case 5:
  2070:       send_to_char(ch, "Your sacrifice to the Gods is rewarded with %d gold coins\r\n", (1+2*GET_OBJ_LEVEL(j)));
  2071:       increase_gold(ch, (1+2*GET_OBJ_LEVEL(j)));
  2072:     break;
  2073:     default:
  2074:       send_to_char(ch, "You sacrifice %s to the Gods.\r\nYou receive one gold coin for your humility.\r\n",GET_OBJ_SHORT(j));
  2075:       increase_gold(ch, 1);
  2076:     break;
  2077:   }
  2078:   for (jj = j->contains; jj; jj = next_thing2) {
  2079:     next_thing2 = jj->next_content;       /* Next in inventory */
  2080:     obj_from_obj(jj);
  2081: 
  2082:     if (j->carried_by)
  2083:       obj_to_room(jj, IN_ROOM(j));
  2084:     else if (IN_ROOM(j) != NOWHERE)
  2085:       obj_to_room(jj, IN_ROOM(j));
  2086:     else
  2087:       assert(FALSE);
  2088:   }
  2089:   extract_obj(j);
  2090: }

  2103: static void auction_namebuf_append(char *dst, size_t dstsz, const char *src)
  2104: {
  2105:   size_t len;
  2106: 
  2107:   if (!dst || dstsz == 0)
  2108:     return;
  2109:   if (!src)
  2110:     src = "";
  2111: 
  2112:   len = strlen(dst);
  2113:   if (len >= dstsz)
  2114:     return;
  2115: 
  2116:   snprintf(dst + len, dstsz - len, "%s", src);
  2117: }

  2119: static const char *auction_item_display_name(struct obj_data *obj)
  2120: {
  2121:   static char namebuf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2122: 
  2123:   if (!obj || !GET_OBJ_SHORT(obj))
  2124:     return "something";
  2125: 
  2126:   namebuf[0] = '\0';
  2127:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_BLESS))
  2128:     auction_namebuf_append(namebuf, sizeof(namebuf), "(Blue Aura) ");
  2129:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_GLOW))
  2130:     auction_namebuf_append(namebuf, sizeof(namebuf), "(Glow) ");
  2131:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_HUM))
  2132:     auction_namebuf_append(namebuf, sizeof(namebuf), "(Hum) ");
  2133:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_INVISIBLE))
  2134:     auction_namebuf_append(namebuf, sizeof(namebuf), "(Invis) ");
  2135:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_NODROP))
  2136:     auction_namebuf_append(namebuf, sizeof(namebuf), "(K) ");
  2137:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_MAGIC))
  2138:     auction_namebuf_append(namebuf, sizeof(namebuf), "(Magic) ");
  2139:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_ANTI_GOOD))
  2140:     auction_namebuf_append(namebuf, sizeof(namebuf), "(Red Aura) ");
  2141:   auction_namebuf_append(namebuf, sizeof(namebuf), GET_OBJ_SHORT(obj));
  2142:   return namebuf;
  2143: }
