  2202: static void send_auction_message(const char *msg, int item_level)
  2203: {
  2204:   struct descriptor_data *d;
  2205: 
  2206:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
  2207:     if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING || !d->character)
  2208:       continue;
  2209:     if (PRF_FLAGGED(d->character, PRF_NOAUCT))
  2210:       continue;
  2211:     if (item_level > 1 &&
  2212:         (GET_LEVEL(d->character) < GET_AUCTION_LOW(d->character) ||
  2213:          GET_LEVEL(d->character) > GET_AUCTION_HIGH(d->character)))
  2214:       continue;
  2215:     send_to_char(d->character, "%s\r\n", msg);
  2216:     add_history(d->character, (char *)msg, HIST_AUCTION);
  2217:   }
  2218: }
  2219: 
  2220: static int seller_tax_percent(struct char_data *seller, int seller_won)
  2221: {
  2222:   int tier_discount = 0;
  2223:   int tax = 10;
  2224: 
  2225:   if (!seller)
  2226:     return 10;
  2227: 
  2228:   if (GET_CLAN_RANK(seller) > 0)
  2229:     tier_discount = MIN(5, GET_CLAN_RANK(seller));
  2230:   tax -= tier_discount;
  2231:   if (seller_won)
  2232:     tax += 10;
  2233:   return MAX(0, tax);
  2234: }
  2235: 
  2236: void auction_update(void)
  2237: {
  2238:   char msg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2239:   long long tax_amt, seller_take;
  2240:   int tax_pct;
  2241: 
  2242:   if (!live_auction.obj)
  2243:     return;
  2244: 
  2245:   live_auction.going++;
  2246:   if (live_auction.going == 1) {
  2247:     format_auction_listing_message(msg, sizeof(msg), live_auction.seller, live_auction.obj, live_auction.current_bid);
  2248:     send_auction_message(msg, auction_item_level(live_auction.obj));
  2249:     return;
  2250:   }
  2251:   if (live_auction.going == 2) {
  2252:     snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%sAuction:%s %s going once for %s%lld%s %s.",
  2253:              KMAG, KNRM, auction_item_display_name(live_auction.obj),
  2254:              KYEL, live_auction.current_bid, KNRM,
  2255:              auction_currency_name());
  2256:     send_auction_message(msg, auction_item_level(live_auction.obj));
  2257:     return;
  2258:   }
  2259:   if (live_auction.going == 3) {
  2260:     snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%sAuction:%s %s going twice for %s%lld%s %s.",
  2261:              KMAG, KNRM, auction_item_display_name(live_auction.obj),
  2262:              KYEL, live_auction.current_bid, KNRM,
  2263:              auction_currency_name());
  2264:     send_auction_message(msg, auction_item_level(live_auction.obj));
  2265:     return;
  2266:   }
  2267: 
  2268:   if (!live_auction.buyer) {
  2269:     snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%sAuction:%s No bids for %s. Item returned to seller.",
  2270:              KMAG, KNRM, auction_item_display_name(live_auction.obj));
  2271:     send_auction_message(msg, auction_item_level(live_auction.obj));
  2272:     if (live_auction.seller)
  2273:       obj_to_char(live_auction.obj, live_auction.seller);
  2274:   } else {
  2275:     tax_pct = seller_tax_percent(live_auction.seller, live_auction.buyer == live_auction.seller);
  2276:     tax_amt = (live_auction.current_bid * tax_pct) / 100;
  2277:     seller_take = live_auction.current_bid - tax_amt;
  2278:     increase_gold(live_auction.seller, seller_take);
  2279:     obj_to_char(live_auction.obj, live_auction.buyer);
  2280: 
  2281:     format_auction_sale_message(msg, sizeof(msg), live_auction.buyer, live_auction.seller,
  2282:                                 live_auction.obj, live_auction.current_bid);
  2283:     send_auction_message(msg, auction_item_level(live_auction.obj));
  2284:     snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%sAuction:%s Seller tax is %s%d%%%s (%s%lld%s %s).",
  2285:              KMAG, KNRM, KYEL, tax_pct, KNRM, KYEL, tax_amt, KNRM, auction_currency_name());
  2286:     send_auction_message(msg, auction_item_level(live_auction.obj));
  2287:   }
  2288: 
  2289:   live_auction.obj = NULL;
  2290:   live_auction.seller = NULL;
  2291:   live_auction.buyer = NULL;
  2292:   live_auction.current_bid = 0;
  2293:   live_auction.min_bid = 0;
  2294:   live_auction.going = 0;
  2295: }
  2296: 
  2297: ACMD(do_bid)
  2298: {
  2299:   long long amount;
  2300:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2301:   char msg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2302: 
  2303:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  2304: 
  2305:   if (!live_auction.obj) {
  2306:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no active auction right now.\r\n");
  2307:     return;
  2308:   }
  2309: 
  2310:   if (!*arg) {
  2311:     format_auction_listing_message(msg, sizeof(msg), live_auction.seller, live_auction.obj, live_auction.current_bid);
  2312:     send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", msg);
  2313:     return;
  2314:   }
  2315:   if (!is_number(arg)) {
  2316:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: bid <amount>\r\n");
  2317:     return;
  2318:   }
  2319: 
  2320:   amount = atoll(arg);
  2321:   if (amount <= live_auction.current_bid) {
  2322:     send_to_char(ch, "Your bid must be higher than the current bid.\r\n");
  2323:     return;
  2324:   }
  2325:   if ((long long)GET_GOLD(ch) < amount) {
  2326:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have that much gold on hand.\r\n");
  2327:     return;
  2328:   }
  2329: 
  2330:   live_auction.current_bid = amount;
  2331:   live_auction.buyer = ch;
  2332:   live_auction.going = 0;
  2333:   format_auction_listing_message(msg, sizeof(msg), live_auction.seller, live_auction.obj, live_auction.current_bid);
  2334:   send_auction_message(msg, auction_item_level(live_auction.obj));
  2335: }
  2336: 
  2337: ACMD(do_auction)
  2338: {
  2339:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], msg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2340:   struct obj_data *obj;
  2341:   long long min_bid = 100;
  2342: 
  2343:   two_arguments(argument, arg1, arg2);
  2344: 
  2345:   if (!*arg1) {
  2346:     TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(ch), PRF_NOAUCT);
  2347:     send_to_char(ch, "Auction channel is now %s.\r\n", PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOAUCT) ? "OFF" : "ON");
  2348:     return;
  2349:   }
  2350: 
  2351:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "-h")) {
  2352:     char history_arg[] = "auction";
  2353:     do_history(ch, history_arg, 0, 0);
  2354:     return;
  2355:   }
  2356:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "set")) {
  2357:     if (!*arg2 || !is_number(arg2)) {
  2358:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: auction set <level>\r\n");
  2359:       return;
  2360:     }
  2361:     GET_AUCTION_LOW(ch) = MAX(0, atoi(arg2));
  2362:     if (GET_AUCTION_HIGH(ch) < GET_AUCTION_LOW(ch))
  2363:       GET_AUCTION_HIGH(ch) = GET_AUCTION_LOW(ch);
  2364:     send_to_char(ch, "Auction low-level filter set to %d.\r\n", GET_AUCTION_LOW(ch));
  2365:     return;
  2366:   }
  2367:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "sethigh")) {
  2368:     if (!*arg2 || !is_number(arg2)) {
  2369:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: auction sethigh <level>\r\n");
  2370:       return;
  2371:     }
  2372:     GET_AUCTION_HIGH(ch) = MAX(0, atoi(arg2));
  2373:     if (GET_AUCTION_HIGH(ch) < GET_AUCTION_LOW(ch))
  2374:       GET_AUCTION_LOW(ch) = GET_AUCTION_HIGH(ch);
  2375:     send_to_char(ch, "Auction high-level filter set to %d.\r\n", GET_AUCTION_HIGH(ch));
  2376:     return;
  2377:   }
  2378: 
  2379:   obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, ch->carrying);
  2380:   if (!obj) {
  2381:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have that item.\r\n");
  2382:     return;
  2383:   }
  2384:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_NODROP)) {
  2385:     send_to_char(ch, "You cannot auction that item.\r\n");
  2386:     return;
  2387:   }
  2388:   if (reject_kept_item_action(ch, obj))
  2389:     return;
  2390:   if (live_auction.obj) {
  2391:     send_to_char(ch, "There is already an auction in progress.\r\n");
  2392:     return;
  2393:   }
  2394:   if (*arg2) {
  2395:     if (!is_number(arg2)) {
  2396:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: auction <item> [minbid]\r\n");
  2397:       return;
  2398:     }
  2399:     min_bid = MAX(100, atoll(arg2));
  2400:   }
  2401: 
  2402:   obj_from_char(obj);
  2403:   live_auction.obj = obj;
  2404:   live_auction.seller = ch;
  2405:   live_auction.buyer = NULL;
  2406:   live_auction.current_bid = min_bid;
  2407:   live_auction.min_bid = min_bid;
  2408:   live_auction.going = 0;
  2409: 
  2410:   format_market_listing_message(msg, sizeof(msg), ch, obj);
  2411:   send_auction_message(msg, auction_item_level(obj));
  2412:   format_auction_listing_message(msg, sizeof(msg), ch, obj, min_bid);
  2413:   send_auction_message(msg, auction_item_level(obj));
  2414: }

    45: static int has_boat(struct char_data *ch)
    46: {
    47:   struct obj_data *obj;
    48:   int i;
    49: 
    50:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) > LVL_IMMORT)
    51:     return (1);
    52: 
    53:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_WATERWALK) || AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_FLYING))
    54:     return (1);
    55: 
    56:   /* non-wearable boats in inventory will do it */
    57:   for (obj = ch->carrying; obj; obj = obj->next_content)

    59:       return (1);
    60:

    62:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
    63:     if (GET_EQ(ch, i) && GET_OBJ_TYPE(GET_EQ(ch, i)) == ITEM_BOAT)
    64:       return (1);
    65: 
    66:   return (0);
    67: }

    69: static int furniture_occupants(struct obj_data *obj)
    70: {
    71:   struct char_data *tempch;
    72:   int count = 0;
    73: 
    74:   if (!obj)
    75:     return 0;
    76: 
    77:   for (tempch = OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(obj); tempch; tempch = NEXT_SITTING(tempch))
    78:     count++;
    79: 
    80:   return count;
    81: }
    82: 
    83: static int furniture_is_available(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj)
    84: {
    85:   int capacity, occupants;
    86: 
    87:   if (!obj || GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_FURNITURE || !CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj))
    88:     return FALSE;
    89: 
    90:   capacity = GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1);
    91:   occupants = furniture_occupants(obj);
    92: 
    93:   if (SITTING(ch) == obj)
    94:     occupants--;
    95: 
    96:   if (capacity > 0 && occupants >= capacity)
    97:     return FALSE;
    98: 
    99:   return TRUE;
   100: }

   102: static struct obj_data *find_furniture(struct char_data *ch, char *arg, const char *verb, int *state)
   103: {
   104:   struct obj_data *obj, *furniture = NULL;
   105:   int count = 0;
   106: 
   107:   *state = 0;
   108: 
   109:   if (arg && *arg) {
   110:     obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, world[ch->in_room].contents);
   111: 
   112:     if (!obj) {
   113:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't see that here.\r\n");
   114:       *state = -2;
   115:       return NULL;
   116:     }
   117: 
   118:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_FURNITURE) {
   119:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't %s that.\r\n", verb);
   120:       *state = -2;
   121:       return NULL;
   122:     }
   123: 
   124:     if (!furniture_is_available(ch, obj)) {
   125:       act("There is nowhere left to use $p right now.", TRUE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   126:       *state = -2;
   127:       return NULL;
   128:     }
   129: 
   130:     *state = 1;
   131:     return obj;
   132:   }
   133: 
   134:   if (SITTING(ch) && GET_OBJ_TYPE(SITTING(ch)) == ITEM_FURNITURE &&
   135:       CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, SITTING(ch)) && furniture_is_available(ch, SITTING(ch))) {
   136:     *state = 1;
   137:     return SITTING(ch);
   138:   }
   139: 
   140:   for (obj = world[ch->in_room].contents; obj; obj = obj->next_content) {
   141:     if (!furniture_is_available(ch, obj))
   142:       continue;
   143: 
   144:     furniture = obj;
   145:     count++;
   146: 
   147:     if (count > 1)
   148:       break;
   149:   }
   150: 
   151:   if (count == 1) {
   152:     *state = 1;
   153:     return furniture;
   154:   }
   155: 
   156:   if (count > 1) {
   157:     send_to_char(ch, "You'll need to specify which piece of furniture you want to %s.\r\n", verb);
   158:     *state = -1;
   159:   }
   160: 
   161:   return NULL;
   162: }

   164: static void place_char_on_furniture(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *furniture)
   165: {
   166:   struct char_data *tempch;
   167: 
   168:   if (!furniture || GET_OBJ_TYPE(furniture) != ITEM_FURNITURE)

   190: static int run_dir_from_token(const char *token, int *consumed)
   191: {
   192:   if (!token || !*token) return -1;
   193: 
   194:   if (!strncasecmp(token, "north", 5)) { *consumed = 5; return NORTH; }
   195:   if (!strncasecmp(token, "east", 4))  { *consumed = 4; return EAST; }
   196:   if (!strncasecmp(token, "south", 5)) { *consumed = 5; return SOUTH; }
   197:   if (!strncasecmp(token, "west", 4))  { *consumed = 4; return WEST; }
   198:   if (!strncasecmp(token, "up", 2))    { *consumed = 2; return UP; }
   199:   if (!strncasecmp(token, "down", 4))  { *consumed = 4; return DOWN; }
   200: 
   201:   if (tolower((unsigned char)token[0]) == 'n') { *consumed = 1; return NORTH; }
   202:   if (tolower((unsigned char)token[0]) == 'e') { *consumed = 1; return EAST; }
   203:   if (tolower((unsigned char)token[0]) == 's') { *consumed = 1; return SOUTH; }
   204:   if (tolower((unsigned char)token[0]) == 'w') { *consumed = 1; return WEST; }
   205:   if (tolower((unsigned char)token[0]) == 'u') { *consumed = 1; return UP; }
   206:   if (tolower((unsigned char)token[0]) == 'd') { *consumed = 1; return DOWN; }
   207: 
   208:   return -1;
   209: }

   211: static int room_is_runto_safe(room_rnum room)
   212: {
   213:   if (!VALID_ROOM_RNUM(room))
   214:     return FALSE;
   215: 
   216:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(room, ROOM_DEATH) || ROOM_FLAGGED(room, ROOM_GODROOM))

   222: static int runto_path_distance(room_rnum src, room_rnum target)
   223: {
   224:   int steps = 0;
   225:   room_rnum current = src;
   226: 
   227:   if (!VALID_ROOM_RNUM(src) || !VALID_ROOM_RNUM(target))
   228:     return BFS_ERROR;
   229:   if (src == target)
   230:     return 0;
   231: 
   232:   while (steps <= top_of_world + 1) {
   233:     int dir = graph_find_first_step(current, target);
   234:     room_rnum next_room;
   235: 
   236:     if (dir == BFS_ALREADY_THERE)
   237:       return steps;
   238:     if (dir < 0)
   239:       return dir;
   240:     if (!world[current].dir_option[dir])
   241:       return BFS_NO_PATH;
   242: 
   243:     next_room = world[current].dir_option[dir]->to_room;
   244:     if (!room_is_runto_safe(next_room))
   245:       return BFS_NO_PATH;
   246: 
   247:     current = next_room;
   248:     steps++;
   249:     if (current == target)
   250:       return steps;
   251:   }
   252: 
   253:   return BFS_NO_PATH;
   254: }

   256: static struct char_data *find_closest_mob_in_area_by_name(struct char_data *ch, const char *name)
   257: {
   258:   struct char_data *mob, *best = NULL;
   259:   int best_distance = INT_MAX;
   260:   zone_rnum zone;
   261: 
   262:   if (!ch || !name || !*name || IN_ROOM(ch) == NOWHERE)
   263:     return NULL;
   264: 
   265:   zone = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone;
   266:   for (mob = character_list; mob; mob = mob->next) {
   267:     int distance;
   268: 
   269:     if (!IS_NPC(mob) || IN_ROOM(mob) == NOWHERE)
   270:       continue;
   271:     if (world[IN_ROOM(mob)].zone != zone)
   272:       continue;
   273:     if (!CAN_SEE(ch, mob))
   274:       continue;
   275:     if (!isname(name, mob->player.name))
   276:       continue;
   277: 
   278:     distance = runto_path_distance(IN_ROOM(ch), IN_ROOM(mob));
   279:     if (distance < 0)
   280:       continue;
   281:     if (distance < best_distance) {
   282:       best = mob;
   283:       best_distance = distance;
   284:     }
   285:   }
   286: 
   287:   return best;
   288: }

   290: static int execute_runto_path(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *target)
   291: {
   292:   long target_id;
   293:   room_rnum target_room;
   294: 
   295:   if (!ch || !target || IN_ROOM(ch) == NOWHERE || IN_ROOM(target) == NOWHERE)
   296:     return FALSE;
   297: 
   298:   target_id = char_script_id(target);
   299:   target_room = IN_ROOM(target);
   300: 
   301:   while (IN_ROOM(ch) != target_room) {
   302:     int dir;
   303:     room_rnum next_room;
   304:     struct char_data *current_target;
   305: 
   306:     if (FIGHTING(ch))
   307:       return FALSE;
   308: 
   309:     current_target = find_char(target_id);
   310:     if (!current_target || IN_ROOM(current_target) == NOWHERE)
   311:       return FALSE;
   312: 
   313:     target_room = IN_ROOM(current_target);
   314:     dir = graph_find_first_step(IN_ROOM(ch), target_room);
   315:     if (dir < 0 || !EXIT(ch, dir))
   316:       return FALSE;
   317: 
   318:     next_room = EXIT(ch, dir)->to_room;
   319:     if (!room_is_runto_safe(next_room))
   320:       return FALSE;
   321: 
   322:     if (!perform_move(ch, dir, 0))
   323:       return FALSE;
   324:   }
   325: 
   326:   return TRUE;
   327: }

   329: ACMD(do_run)
   330: {
   331:   const char *p = argument;
   332:   int steps = 0;
   333: 
   334:   if (!*p) {
   335:     send_to_char(ch, "Run where?\r\n");
   336:     return;
   337:   }
   338: 
   339:   while (*p) {
   340:     long reps = 0;
   341:     int dir = -1;
   342:     int consumed = 0;
   343: 
   344:     while (*p && isspace((unsigned char)*p))
   345:       p++;
   346:     if (!*p)
   347:       break;
   348: 
   349:     if (isdigit((unsigned char)*p)) {
   350:       char *endp = NULL;
   351:       reps = strtol(p, &endp, 10);
   352:       if (endp == p || reps <= 0 || reps > 1000) {
   353:         send_to_char(ch, "Invalid run repeat count near '%s'.\r\n", p);
   354:         return;
   355:       }
   356:       p = endp;
   357:     } else {
   358:       reps = 1;
   359:     }
   360: 
   361:     dir = run_dir_from_token(p, &consumed);
   362:     if (dir < 0) {
   363:       send_to_char(ch, "Invalid run direction near '%s'.\r\n", p);
   364:       return;
   365:     }
   366:     p += consumed;
   367: 
   368:     while (reps-- > 0) {
   369:       if (!perform_move(ch, dir, 0)) {
   370:         send_to_char(ch, "Run stopped after %d step%s.\r\n", steps, steps == 1 ? "" : "s");
   371:         return;
   372:       }
   373:       steps++;
   374:     }
   375:   }
   376: 
   377:   if (steps <= 0)
   378:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't go anywhere.\r\n");
   379: }

   381: ACMD(do_runto)
   382: {
   383:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   384:   struct char_data *target = NULL;
   385:   int distance;
   386: 
   387:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   388:   one_argument(argument, arg);
   389:   if (!*arg) {
   390:     send_to_char(ch, "Run to whom or what?\r\n");
   391:     return;
   392:   }
   393: 
   394:   if (!str_cmp(argument, "quest") && GET_KQUEST_ACTIVE(ch) && GET_KQUEST_COMPLETE(ch)) {
   395:     struct char_data *mob;
   396:     zone_rnum zone = (IN_ROOM(ch) != NOWHERE) ? world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone : NOWHERE;
   397: 
   398:     for (mob = character_list; mob; mob = mob->next) {
   399:       if (!IS_NPC(mob) || IN_ROOM(mob) == NOWHERE)
   400:         continue;
   401:       if (world[IN_ROOM(mob)].zone != zone)
   402:         continue;
   403:       if (!CAN_SEE(ch, mob))
   404:         continue;
   405:       if (GET_MOB_SPEC(mob) != questmaster)
   406:         continue;
   407:       if (GET_KQUEST_GIVER(ch) != NOBODY && GET_MOB_VNUM(mob) != GET_KQUEST_GIVER(ch))
   408:         continue;
   409:       target = mob;
   410:       break;
   411:     }
   412:   }
   413: 
   414:   if (!target)
   415:     target = find_closest_mob_in_area_by_name(ch, argument);
   416: 
   417:   if (!target) {
   418:     send_to_char(ch, "No such target found in this area.\r\n");
   419:     return;
   420:   }
   421: 
   422:   distance = runto_path_distance(IN_ROOM(ch), IN_ROOM(target));
   423:   if (distance < 0) {
   424:     send_to_char(ch, "You cannot find a path to that target.\r\n");
   425:     return;
   426:   }
   427: 
   428:   send_to_char(ch, "You begin running toward %s...\r\n", GET_NAME(target));
   429:   if (!execute_runto_path(ch, target)) {
   430:     send_to_char(ch, "Your path is interrupted.\r\n");
   431:     return;
   432:   }
   433: 
   434:   if (IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(target)) {
   435:     send_to_char(ch, "You cannot find a path to that target.\r\n");
   436:     return;
   437:   }
   438: 
   439:   send_to_char(ch, "You arrive near %s.\r\n", GET_NAME(target));
   440: }

   491: 
   492: /** Move a PC/NPC character from their current location to a new location. This
   493:  * is the standard movement locomotion function that all normal walking
   494:  * movement by characters should be sent through. This function also defines
   495:  * the move cost of normal locomotion as:
   496:  * ( (move cost for source room) + (move cost for destination) ) / 2
   497:  *
   498:  * @pre Function assumes that ch has no master controlling character, that
   499:  * ch has no followers (in other words followers won't be moved by this
   500:  * function) and that the direction traveled in is one of the valid, enumerated
   501:  * direction.
   502:  * @param ch The character structure to attempt to move.
   503:  * @param dir The defined direction (NORTH, SOUTH, etc...) to attempt to
   504:  * move into.
   505:  * @param need_specials_check If TRUE will cause 
   506:  * @retval int 1 for a successful move (ch is now in a new location)		
   507:  * or 0 for a failed move (ch is still in the original location). */
   508: int do_simple_move(struct char_data *ch, int dir, int need_specials_check)
   509: {
   510:   /* Begin Local variable definitions */
   511:   /*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   512:   /* Used in our special proc check. By default, we pass a NULL argument
   513:    * when checking for specials */
   514:   char spec_proc_args[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH] = "";
   515:   /* The room the character is currently in and will move from... */
   516:   room_rnum was_in = IN_ROOM(ch);
   517:   /* ... and the room the character will move into. */
   518:   room_rnum going_to = EXIT(ch, dir)->to_room;
   519:   /* How many movement points are required to travel from was_in to going_to.
   520:    * We redefine this later when we need it. */
   521:   int need_movement = 0;
   522:   /* Contains the "leave" message to display to the was_in room. */
   523:   char leave_message[SMALL_BUFSIZE];
   524:   /* Pet mount carrying the character, if any. */
   525:   struct char_data *mount = GET_MOUNT(ch);
   526:   /*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   527:   /* End Local variable definitions */
   528: 
   529: 
   530:   /* Begin checks that can prevent a character from leaving the was_in room. */
   531:   /* Future checks should be implemented within this section and return 0.   */
   532:   /*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   533:   /* Check for special routines that might activate because of the move and
   534:    * also might prevent the movement. Special requires commands, so we pass
   535:    * in the "command" equivalent of the direction (ie. North is '1' in the
   536:    * command list, but NORTH is defined as '0').
   537:    * Note -- only check if following; this avoids 'double spec-proc' bug */
   538:   if (need_specials_check && special(ch, dir + 1, spec_proc_args))
   539:     return 0;
   540: 
   541:   /* Leave Trigger Checks: Does a leave trigger block exit from the room? */
   542:   if (!leave_mtrigger(ch, dir) || IN_ROOM(ch) != was_in) /* prevent teleport crashes */
   543:     return 0;
   544:   if (!leave_wtrigger(&world[IN_ROOM(ch)], ch, dir) || IN_ROOM(ch) != was_in) /* prevent teleport crashes */
   545:     return 0;
   546:   if (!leave_otrigger(&world[IN_ROOM(ch)], ch, dir) || IN_ROOM(ch) != was_in) /* prevent teleport crashes */
   547:     return 0;
   548: 
   549:   /* Charm effect: Does it override the movement? */
   550:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM) && ch->master && was_in == IN_ROOM(ch->master))
   551:   {
   552:     send_to_char(ch, "The thought of leaving your master makes you weep.\r\n");
   553:     act("$n bursts into tears.", FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   554:     return (0);
   555:   }
   556: 
   557:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_ROOTED)) {
   558:     send_to_char(ch, "Your feet are rooted in place!\r\n");
   559:     return (0);
   560:   }
   561:   if (room_has_effect(&world[was_in], ROOM_EFFECT_GRAVITY_WELL)) {
   562:     send_to_char(ch, "Crushing gravity pins you in place!\r\n");
   563:     return (0);
   564:   }
   565: 
   566:   if (mount && (IN_ROOM(mount) != was_in || mount->master != ch)) {
   567:     dismount_char(ch);
   568:     mount = NULL;
   569:   }
   570: 
   571:   /* Water, No Swimming Rooms: Does the deep water prevent movement? */
   572:   if ((SECT(was_in) == SECT_WATER_NOSWIM) ||
   573:       (SECT(going_to) == SECT_WATER_NOSWIM))
   574:   {
   575:     if (!has_boat(ch))
   576:     {
   577:       send_to_char(ch, "You need a boat to go there.\r\n");
   578:       return (0);
   579:     }
   580:   }
   581: 
   582:   /* Flying Required: Does lack of flying prevent movement? */
   583:   if ((SECT(was_in) == SECT_FLYING) || (SECT(going_to) == SECT_FLYING))
   584:   {
   585:     if (!has_flight(ch))
   586:     {
   587:       send_to_char(ch, "You need to be flying to go there!\r\n");
   588:       return (0);
   589:     }
   590:   }
   591: 
   592:   /* Underwater Room: Does lack of underwater breathing prevent movement? */
   593:   if ((SECT(was_in) == SECT_UNDERWATER) || (SECT(going_to) == SECT_UNDERWATER))
   594:   {
   595:     if (!has_scuba(ch) && !IS_NPC(ch) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE)) {
   596:       send_to_char(ch, "You need to be able to breathe water to go there!\r\n");
   597:       return (0);
   598:     }
   599:   }
   600: 
   601:   /* Houses: Can the player walk into the house? */
   602:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(was_in, ROOM_ATRIUM))
   603:   {
   604:     if (!House_can_enter(ch, GET_ROOM_VNUM(going_to)))
   605:     {
   606:       send_to_char(ch, "That's private property -- no trespassing!\r\n");
   607:       return (0);
   608:     }
   609:   }
   610: 
   611:   /* Check zone level recommendations */
   612:   if ((ZONE_MINLVL(GET_ROOM_ZONE(going_to)) != -1) && ZONE_MINLVL(GET_ROOM_ZONE(going_to)) > GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
   613:     send_to_char(ch, "This zone is above your recommended level.\r\n");
   614:   }
   615: 
   616:   /* Check zone flag restrictions */
   617:   if (ZONE_FLAGGED(GET_ROOM_ZONE(going_to), ZONE_CLOSED)) {
   618:     send_to_char(ch, "A mysterious barrier forces you back! That area is off-limits.\r\n");
   619:     return (0);
   620:   }
   621:   if (ZONE_FLAGGED(GET_ROOM_ZONE(going_to), ZONE_NOIMMORT) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD)) {
   622:     send_to_char(ch, "A mysterious barrier forces you back! That area is off-limits.\r\n");
   623:     return (0);
   624:   }
   625: 
   626:   /* Room Size Capacity: Is the room full of people already? */
   627:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(going_to, ROOM_TUNNEL) &&
   628:       num_pc_in_room(&(world[going_to])) >= CONFIG_TUNNEL_SIZE)
   629:   {
   630:     if (CONFIG_TUNNEL_SIZE > 1)
   631:       send_to_char(ch, "There isn't enough room for you to go there!\r\n");
   632:     else
   633:       send_to_char(ch, "There isn't enough room there for more than one person!\r\n");
   634:     return (0);
   635:   }
   636: 
   637:   /* Room Level Requirements: Is ch privileged enough to enter the room? */
   638:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(going_to, ROOM_GODROOM) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD)
   639:   {
   640:     send_to_char(ch, "You aren't godly enough to use that room!\r\n");
   641:     return (0);
   642:   }
   643: 
   644:   /* All checks passed, nothing will prevent movement now other than lack of
   645:    * move points. */
   646:   /* move points needed is avg. move loss for src and destination sect type */
   647:   need_movement = (movement_loss[SECT(was_in)] +
   648: 		   movement_loss[SECT(going_to)]) / 2;
   649: 
   650:   /* Move Point Requirement Check */
   651:   if (mount) {
   652:     if (GET_MOVE(mount) < need_movement) {
   653:       send_to_char(ch, "%s is too exhausted to move.\r\n", GET_NAME(mount));
   654:       return (0);
   655:     }
   656:   } else if (GET_MOVE(ch) < need_movement && !IS_NPC(ch))
   657:   {
   658:     if (need_specials_check && ch->master)
   659:       send_to_char(ch, "You are too exhausted to follow.\r\n");
   660:     else
   661:       send_to_char(ch, "You are too exhausted.\r\n");
   662: 
   663:     return (0);
   664:   }
   665: 
   666:   /*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   667:   /* End checks that can prevent a character from leaving the was_in room. */
   668: 
   669: 
   670:   /* Begin: the leave operation. */
   671:   /*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   672:   /* If applicable, subtract movement cost. */
   673:   if (mount)
   674:     GET_MOVE(mount) -= need_movement;
   675:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT && !IS_NPC(ch))
   676:     GET_MOVE(ch) -= need_movement;
   677: 
   678:   /* Generate the leave message and display to others in the was_in room. */
   679:   if (!AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_SNEAK))
   680:   {
   681:     snprintf(leave_message, sizeof(leave_message), "$n leaves %s.", dirs[dir]);
   682:     act(leave_message, TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   683:   }
   684: 
   685:   char_from_room(ch);
   686:   char_to_room(ch, going_to);
   687:   /*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   688:   /* End: the leave operation. The character is now in the new room. */
   689: 
   690: 
   691:   /* Begin: Post-move operations. */
   692:   /*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   693:   /* Post Move Trigger Checks: Check the new room for triggers.
   694:    * Assumptions: The character has already truly left the was_in room. If
   695:    * the entry trigger "prevents" movement into the room, it is the triggers
   696:    * job to provide a message to the original was_in room. */
   697:   if (!entry_mtrigger(ch) || !enter_wtrigger(&world[going_to], ch, dir)) {
   698:     char_from_room(ch);
   699:     char_to_room(ch, was_in);
   700:     return 0;
   701:   }
   702: 
   703:   /* Display arrival information to anyone in the destination room... */
   704:   if (!AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_SNEAK))
   705:     act("$n has arrived.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   706: 
   707:   /* ... and the room description to the character. */
   708:   if (ch->desc != NULL)
   709:     look_at_room(ch, 0);
   710: 
   711:   /* ... and Kill the player if the room is a death trap. */
   712:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(going_to, ROOM_DEATH) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)
   713:   {
   714:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "%s hit death trap #%d (%s)", GET_NAME(ch), GET_ROOM_VNUM(going_to), world[going_to].name);
   715:     death_cry(ch);
   716:     extract_char(ch);
   717:     return (0);
   718:   }
   719: 
   720:   /* At this point, the character is safe and in the room. */
   721:   /* Fire memory and greet triggers, check and see if the greet trigger
   722:    * prevents movement, and if so, move the player back to the previous room. */
   723:   entry_memory_mtrigger(ch);
   724:   if (!greet_mtrigger(ch, dir))
   725:   {
   726:     char_from_room(ch);
   727:     char_to_room(ch, was_in);
   728:     look_at_room(ch, 0);
   729:     /* Failed move, return a failure */
   730:     return (0);
   731:   }
   732:   else
   733:     greet_memory_mtrigger(ch);
   734:   /*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   735:   /* End: Post-move operations. */
   736: 
   737:   /* Only here is the move successful *and* complete. Return success for
   738:    * calling functions to handle post move operations. */
   739:   return (1);
   740: }
   741: 
   742: int perform_move(struct char_data *ch, int dir, int need_specials_check)
   743: {
   744:   room_rnum was_in;
   745:   struct follow_type *k, *next;
   746: 
   747:   if (ch == NULL || dir < 0 || dir >= NUM_OF_DIRS || FIGHTING(ch))
   748:     return (0);
   749:   else if (!CONFIG_DIAGONAL_DIRS && IS_DIAGONAL(dir))
   750:     send_to_char(ch, "Alas, you cannot go that way...\r\n");
   751:   else if ((!EXIT(ch, dir) && !buildwalk(ch, dir)) || EXIT(ch, dir)->to_room == NOWHERE)
   752:     send_to_char(ch, "Alas, you cannot go that way...\r\n");
   753:   else if (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, dir), EX_CLOSED) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT || (!IS_NPC(ch) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE)))) {
   754:     if (EXIT(ch, dir)->keyword)
   755:       send_to_char(ch, "The %s seems to be closed.\r\n", fname(EXIT(ch, dir)->keyword));
   756:     else
   757:       send_to_char(ch, "It seems to be closed.\r\n");
   758:   } else {
   759:     if (!ch->followers)
   760:       return (do_simple_move(ch, dir, need_specials_check));
   761: 
   762:     was_in = IN_ROOM(ch);
   763:     if (!do_simple_move(ch, dir, need_specials_check))
   764:       return (0);
   765: 
   766:     for (k = ch->followers; k; k = next) {
   767:       next = k->next;
   768:       if ((IN_ROOM(k->follower) == was_in) &&
   769: 	  (GET_POS(k->follower) >= POS_STANDING)) {
   770: 	act("You follow $N.\r\n", FALSE, k->follower, 0, ch, TO_CHAR);
   771: 	perform_move(k->follower, dir, 1);
   772:       }
   773:     }
   774:     return (1);
   775:   }
   776:   return (0);
   777: }
   778: 
   779: ACMD(do_move)
   780: {
   781:   /* These subcmd defines are mapped precisely to the direction defines. */
   782:   perform_move(ch, subcmd, 0);
   783: }
   784: 
   785: ACMD(do_mount)
   786: {
   787:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   788:   struct char_data *mount;
   789: 
   790:   one_argument(argument, arg);
   791: 
   792:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) {
   793:     send_to_char(ch, "Only players can mount pets.\r\n");
   794:     return;
   795:   }
   796: 
   797:   if (!*arg) {
   798:     send_to_char(ch, "Mount whom?\r\n");
   799:     return;
   800:   }
   801: 
   802:   if (GET_MOUNT(ch)) {
   803:     send_to_char(ch, "You are already mounted on %s.\r\n", GET_NAME(GET_MOUNT(ch)));
   804:     return;
   805:   }
   806: 
   807:   if (!(mount = get_char_room_vis(ch, arg, NULL))) {
   808:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't see that pet here.\r\n");
   809:     return;
   810:   }
   811: 
   812:   if (mount == ch) {
   813:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't mount yourself.\r\n");
   814:     return;
   815:   }
   816: 
   817:   if (!IS_NPC(mount) || mount->master != ch) {
   818:     send_to_char(ch, "You can only mount a pet that follows you.\r\n");
   819:     return;
   820:   }
   821: 
   822:   if (GET_RIDER(mount)) {
   823:     send_to_char(ch, "%s is already being ridden.\r\n", GET_NAME(mount));
   824:     return;
   825:   }
   826: 
   827:   if (GET_POS(mount) < POS_STANDING) {
   828:     send_to_char(ch, "%s needs to be standing first.\r\n", GET_NAME(mount));
   829:     return;
   830:   }
   831: 
   832:   GET_MOUNT(ch) = mount;
   833:   GET_RIDER(mount) = ch;
   834: 
   835:   act("You climb onto $N.", FALSE, ch, 0, mount, TO_CHAR);
   836:   act("$n climbs onto $N.", FALSE, ch, 0, mount, TO_ROOM);
   837: }
   838: 
   839: ACMD(do_dismount)
   840: {
   841:   struct char_data *mount = GET_MOUNT(ch);
   842: 
   843:   if (!mount) {
   844:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not mounted.\r\n");
   845:     return;
   846:   }
   847: 
   848:   act("You dismount from $N.", FALSE, ch, 0, mount, TO_CHAR);
   849:   act("$n dismounts from $N.", FALSE, ch, 0, mount, TO_ROOM);
   850: 
   851:   dismount_char(ch);
   852: }

   854: static int find_door(struct char_data *ch, const char *type, char *dir, const char *cmdname)
   855: {
   856:   int door;
   857: 
   858:   if (*dir) {			/* a direction was specified */
   859:     if ((door = search_block(dir, dirs, FALSE)) == -1) { /* Partial Match */
   860:       if ((door = search_block(dir, autoexits, FALSE)) == -1) { /* Check 'short' dirs too */
   861:         send_to_char(ch, "That's not a direction.\r\n");
   862:         return (-1);
   863:       }
   864:     }
   865:     if (EXIT(ch, door)) {	/* Braces added according to indent. -gg */
   866:       if (EXIT(ch, door)->keyword && *type) {
   867:         if (is_name(type, EXIT(ch, door)->keyword))
   868:           return (door);
   869:         else {
   870:           send_to_char(ch, "I see no %s there.\r\n", type);
   871:           return (-1);
   872:         }
   873:       } else
   874:         return (door);
   875:     } else {
   876:       send_to_char(ch, "I really don't see how you can %s anything there.\r\n", cmdname);
   877:       return (-1);
   878:     }
   879:   } else {			/* try to locate the keyword */
   880:     if (!*type) {
   881:       send_to_char(ch, "What is it you want to %s?\r\n", cmdname);
   882:       return (-1);
   883:     }
   884:     for (door = 0; door < DIR_COUNT; door++)
   885:     {
   886:       if (EXIT(ch, door))
   887:       {
   888:         if (EXIT(ch, door)->keyword)
   889:         {
   890:           if (isname(type, EXIT(ch, door)->keyword))
   891:           {
   892:             if ((!IS_NPC(ch)) && (!PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_AUTODOOR)))
   893:               return door;
   894:             else if (is_abbrev(cmdname, "open"))
   895:             {
   896:               if (IS_SET(EXIT(ch, door)->exit_info, EX_CLOSED))
   897:                 return door;
   898:               else if (IS_SET(EXIT(ch, door)->exit_info, EX_LOCKED))
   899:                 return door;
   900:             }
   901:             else if ((is_abbrev(cmdname, "close")) && (!(IS_SET(EXIT(ch, door)->exit_info, EX_CLOSED))) )
   902:               return door;
   903:             else if ((is_abbrev(cmdname, "lock")) && (!(IS_SET(EXIT(ch, door)->exit_info, EX_LOCKED))) )
   904:               return door;
   905:             else if ((is_abbrev(cmdname, "unlock")) && (IS_SET(EXIT(ch, door)->exit_info, EX_LOCKED)) )
   906:               return door;
   907:             else if ((is_abbrev(cmdname, "pick")) && (IS_SET(EXIT(ch, door)->exit_info, EX_LOCKED)) )
   908:               return door;
   909:           }
   910:         }
   911:       }
   912:     }
   913: 
   914:     if ((!IS_NPC(ch)) && (!PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_AUTODOOR)))
   915:       send_to_char(ch, "There doesn't seem to be %s %s here.\r\n", AN(type), type);
   916:     else if (is_abbrev(cmdname, "open"))
   917:       send_to_char(ch, "There doesn't seem to be %s %s that can be opened.\r\n", AN(type), type);
   918:     else if (is_abbrev(cmdname, "close"))
   919:       send_to_char(ch, "There doesn't seem to be %s %s that can be closed.\r\n", AN(type), type);
   920:     else if (is_abbrev(cmdname, "lock"))
   921:       send_to_char(ch, "There doesn't seem to be %s %s that can be locked.\r\n", AN(type), type);
   922:     else if (is_abbrev(cmdname, "unlock"))
   923:       send_to_char(ch, "There doesn't seem to be %s %s that can be unlocked.\r\n", AN(type), type);
   924:     else
   925:       send_to_char(ch, "There doesn't seem to be %s %s that can be picked.\r\n", AN(type), type);
   926: 
   927:     return (-1);
   928:   }
   929: }
   930: 
   931: int has_key(struct char_data *ch, obj_vnum key)
   932: {
   933:   struct obj_data *o;
   934: 
   935:   if (key == NOTHING)
   936:     return (0);
   937: 
   938:   for (o = ch->carrying; o; o = o->next_content)
   939:     if (GET_OBJ_VNUM(o) == key)
   940:       return (1);
   941: 
   942:   if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD))
   943:     if (GET_OBJ_VNUM(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD)) == key)
   944:       return (1);
   945: 
   946:   return (0);
   947: }
   948: 
   949: #define NEED_OPEN	(1 << 0)
   950: #define NEED_CLOSED	(1 << 1)
   951: #define NEED_UNLOCKED	(1 << 2)
   952: #define NEED_LOCKED	(1 << 3)
   953: 
   954: /* cmd_door is required external from act.movement.c */
   955: const char *cmd_door[] =
   956: {
   957:   "open",
   958:   "close",
   959:   "unlock",
   960:   "lock",
   961:   "pick"
   962: };

   964: static const int flags_door[] =
   965: {
   966:   NEED_CLOSED | NEED_UNLOCKED,
   967:   NEED_OPEN,
   968:   NEED_CLOSED | NEED_LOCKED,
   969:   NEED_CLOSED | NEED_UNLOCKED,
   970:   NEED_CLOSED | NEED_LOCKED
   971: };

   973: #define EXITN(room, door)		(world[room].dir_option[door])
   974: #define OPEN_DOOR(room, obj, door)	((obj) ?\
   975: 		(REMOVE_BIT(GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1), CONT_CLOSED)) :\
   976: 		(REMOVE_BIT(EXITN(room, door)->exit_info, EX_CLOSED)))
   977: #define CLOSE_DOOR(room, obj, door)	((obj) ?\
   978: 		(SET_BIT(GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1), CONT_CLOSED)) :\
   979: 		(SET_BIT(EXITN(room, door)->exit_info, EX_CLOSED)))
   980: #define LOCK_DOOR(room, obj, door)	((obj) ?\
   981: 		(SET_BIT(GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1), CONT_LOCKED)) :\
   982: 		(SET_BIT(EXITN(room, door)->exit_info, EX_LOCKED)))
   983: #define UNLOCK_DOOR(room, obj, door)	((obj) ?\
   984: 		(REMOVE_BIT(GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1), CONT_LOCKED)) :\
   985: 		(REMOVE_BIT(EXITN(room, door)->exit_info, EX_LOCKED)))
   986: #define TOGGLE_LOCK(room, obj, door)	((obj) ?\
   987: 		(TOGGLE_BIT(GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1), CONT_LOCKED)) :\
   988: 		(TOGGLE_BIT(EXITN(room, door)->exit_info, EX_LOCKED)))
   989: 
   990: static void do_doorcmd(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj, int door, int scmd)
   991: {
   992:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   993:   size_t len;
   994:   room_rnum other_room = NOWHERE;
   995:   struct room_direction_data *back = NULL;
   996: 
   997:   if (!door_mtrigger(ch, scmd, door))
   998:     return;
   999: 
  1000:   if (!door_wtrigger(ch, scmd, door))
  1001:     return;
  1002: 
  1003:   len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n %ss ", cmd_door[scmd]);
  1004:   if (!obj && ((other_room = EXIT(ch, door)->to_room) != NOWHERE))
  1005:     if ((back = world[other_room].dir_option[rev_dir[door]]) != NULL)
  1006:       if (back->to_room != IN_ROOM(ch))
  1007:         back = NULL;
  1008: 
  1009:   switch (scmd) {
  1010:   case SCMD_OPEN:
  1011:     OPEN_DOOR(IN_ROOM(ch), obj, door);
  1012:     if (back)
  1013:       OPEN_DOOR(other_room, obj, rev_dir[door]);
  1014:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
  1015:     break;
  1016: 
  1017:   case SCMD_CLOSE:
  1018:     CLOSE_DOOR(IN_ROOM(ch), obj, door);
  1019:     if (back)
  1020:       CLOSE_DOOR(other_room, obj, rev_dir[door]);
  1021:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
  1022:     break;
  1023: 
  1024:   case SCMD_LOCK:
  1025:     LOCK_DOOR(IN_ROOM(ch), obj, door);
  1026:     if (back)
  1027:       LOCK_DOOR(other_room, obj, rev_dir[door]);
  1028:     send_to_char(ch, "*Click*\r\n");
  1029:     break;
  1030: 
  1031:   case SCMD_UNLOCK:
  1032:     UNLOCK_DOOR(IN_ROOM(ch), obj, door);
  1033:     if (back)
  1034:       UNLOCK_DOOR(other_room, obj, rev_dir[door]);
  1035:     send_to_char(ch, "*Click*\r\n");
  1036:     break;
  1037: 
  1038:   case SCMD_PICK:
  1039:     TOGGLE_LOCK(IN_ROOM(ch), obj, door);
  1040:     if (back)
  1041:       TOGGLE_LOCK(other_room, obj, rev_dir[door]);
  1042:     send_to_char(ch, "The lock quickly yields to your skills.\r\n");
  1043:     len = strlcpy(buf, "$n skillfully picks the lock on ", sizeof(buf));
  1044:     break;
  1045:   }
  1046: 
  1047:   /* Notify the room. */
  1048:   if (len < sizeof(buf))
  1049:     snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s%s.",
  1050:       obj ? "" : "the ", obj ? "$p" : EXIT(ch, door)->keyword ? "$F" : "door");
  1051:   if (!obj || IN_ROOM(obj) != NOWHERE)
  1052:     act(buf, FALSE, ch, obj, obj ? 0 : EXIT(ch, door)->keyword, TO_ROOM);
  1053: 
  1054:   /* Notify the other room */
  1055:   if (back && (scmd == SCMD_OPEN || scmd == SCMD_CLOSE))
  1056:       send_to_room(EXIT(ch, door)->to_room, "The %s is %s%s from the other side.\r\n",
  1057:         back->keyword ? fname(back->keyword) : "door", cmd_door[scmd],
  1058:         scmd == SCMD_CLOSE ? "d" : "ed");
  1059: }
  1060: 
  1061: static int ok_pick(struct char_data *ch, obj_vnum keynum, int pickproof, int scmd)
  1062: {
  1063:   int percent, skill_lvl;
  1064: 
  1065:   if (scmd != SCMD_PICK)
  1066:     return (1);
  1067: 
  1068:   percent = rand_number(1, 101);
  1069:   skill_lvl = GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_PICK_LOCK) + dex_app_skill[GET_DEX(ch)].p_locks;
  1070: 
  1071:   if (keynum == NOTHING)
  1072:     send_to_char(ch, "Odd - you can't seem to find a keyhole.\r\n");
  1073:   else if (pickproof)
  1074:     send_to_char(ch, "It resists your attempts to pick it.\r\n");
  1075:   else if (percent > skill_lvl)
  1076:     send_to_char(ch, "You failed to pick the lock.\r\n");
  1077:   else
  1078:     return (1);
  1079: 
  1080:   return (0);
  1081: }
  1082: 
  1083: #define DOOR_IS_OPENABLE(ch, obj, door)	((obj) ? ((GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == \
  1084:     ITEM_CONTAINER) && OBJVAL_FLAGGED(obj, CONT_CLOSEABLE)) :\
  1085:     (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_ISDOOR)))
  1086: #define DOOR_IS_OPEN(ch, obj, door) ((obj) ? (!OBJVAL_FLAGGED(obj, \
  1087:     CONT_CLOSED)) : (!EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_CLOSED)))
  1088: #define DOOR_IS_UNLOCKED(ch, obj, door)	((obj) ? (!OBJVAL_FLAGGED(obj, \
  1089:     CONT_LOCKED)) : (!EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_LOCKED)))
  1090: #define DOOR_IS_PICKPROOF(ch, obj, door) ((obj) ? (OBJVAL_FLAGGED(obj, \
  1091:     CONT_PICKPROOF)) : (EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_PICKPROOF)))
  1092: #define DOOR_IS_CLOSED(ch, obj, door) (!(DOOR_IS_OPEN(ch, obj, door)))
  1093: #define DOOR_IS_LOCKED(ch, obj, door) (!(DOOR_IS_UNLOCKED(ch, obj, door)))
  1094: #define DOOR_KEY(ch, obj, door)	((obj) ? (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2)) : \
  1095:     (EXIT(ch, door)->key))
  1096: 
  1097: ACMD(do_gen_door)
  1098: {
  1099:   int door = -1;
  1100:   obj_vnum keynum;
  1101:   char type[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], dir[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1102:   struct obj_data *obj = NULL;
  1103:   struct char_data *victim = NULL;
  1104: 
  1105:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  1106:   if (!*argument) {
  1107:     send_to_char(ch, "%c%s what?\r\n", UPPER(*cmd_door[subcmd]), cmd_door[subcmd] + 1);
  1108:     return;
  1109:   }
  1110:   two_arguments(argument, type, dir);
  1111:   if (!*dir) {
  1112:     int door_dir = search_block(type, dirs, FALSE);
  1113:     if (door_dir == -1)
  1114:       door_dir = search_block(type, autoexits, FALSE);
  1115:     if (door_dir != -1) {
  1116:       strlcpy(dir, type, sizeof(dir));
  1117:       type[0] = '\0';
  1118:     }
  1119:   }
  1120:   if (!generic_find(type, FIND_OBJ_INV | FIND_OBJ_ROOM, ch, &victim, &obj))
  1121:     door = find_door(ch, type, dir, cmd_door[subcmd]);
  1122: 
  1123:   if ((obj) && (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_CONTAINER)) {
  1124:     obj = NULL;
  1125:     door = find_door(ch, type, dir, cmd_door[subcmd]);
  1126:   }
  1127: 
  1128:   if ((obj) || (door >= 0)) {
  1129:     keynum = DOOR_KEY(ch, obj, door);
  1130:     if (!(DOOR_IS_OPENABLE(ch, obj, door)))
  1131:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't %s that!\r\n", cmd_door[subcmd]);
  1132:     else if (!DOOR_IS_OPEN(ch, obj, door) && IS_SET(flags_door[subcmd], NEED_OPEN))
  1133:       send_to_char(ch, "But it's already closed!\r\n");
  1134:     else if (!DOOR_IS_CLOSED(ch, obj, door) && IS_SET(flags_door[subcmd], NEED_CLOSED))
  1135:       send_to_char(ch, "But it's currently open!\r\n");
  1136:     else if (!(DOOR_IS_LOCKED(ch, obj, door)) && IS_SET(flags_door[subcmd], NEED_LOCKED))
  1137:       send_to_char(ch, "Oh.. it wasn't locked, after all..\r\n");
  1138:     else if (!(DOOR_IS_UNLOCKED(ch, obj, door)) && IS_SET(flags_door[subcmd], NEED_UNLOCKED) && ((!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_AUTOKEY))) && (has_key(ch, keynum)) )
  1139:     {
  1140:       send_to_char(ch, "It is locked, but you have the key.\r\n");
  1141:       do_doorcmd(ch, obj, door, SCMD_UNLOCK);
  1142:       do_doorcmd(ch, obj, door, subcmd);
  1143:     }
  1144:     else if (!(DOOR_IS_UNLOCKED(ch, obj, door)) && IS_SET(flags_door[subcmd], NEED_UNLOCKED) && ((!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_AUTOKEY))) && (!has_key(ch, keynum)) )
  1145:     {
  1146:       send_to_char(ch, "It is locked, and you do not have the key!\r\n");
  1147:     }
  1148:     else if (!(DOOR_IS_UNLOCKED(ch, obj, door)) && IS_SET(flags_door[subcmd], NEED_UNLOCKED) &&
  1149:              (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT || (!IS_NPC(ch) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE))))
  1150:       send_to_char(ch, "It seems to be locked.\r\n");
  1151:     else if (!has_key(ch, keynum) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD) && ((subcmd == SCMD_LOCK) || (subcmd == SCMD_UNLOCK)))
  1152:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have the proper key.\r\n");
  1153:     else if (ok_pick(ch, keynum, DOOR_IS_PICKPROOF(ch, obj, door), subcmd))
  1154:       do_doorcmd(ch, obj, door, subcmd);
  1155:   }
  1156:   return;
  1157: }
  1158: 
  1159: ACMD(do_enter)
  1160: {
  1161:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1162:   int door;
  1163:   struct obj_data *portal;
  1164: 
  1165:   one_argument(argument, buf);
  1166: 
  1167:   if (*buf && !str_cmp(buf, "portal")) {
  1168:     for (portal = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents; portal; portal = portal->next_content) {
  1169:       room_rnum to_room;
  1170:       if (GET_OBJ_VNUM(portal) != OBJVNUM_SPELL_PORTAL)
  1171:         continue;
  1172:       to_room = real_room(GET_OBJ_VAL(portal, 0));
  1173:       if (to_room == NOWHERE)
  1174:         continue;
  1175:       act("$n steps into $p and vanishes.", TRUE, ch, portal, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1176:       char_from_room(ch);
  1177:       char_to_room(ch, to_room);
  1178:       act("$n steps out of a shimmering portal.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1179:       look_at_room(ch, 0);
  1180:       return;
  1181:     }
  1182:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no portal here.\r\n");
  1183:     return;
  1184:   }
  1185: 
  1186:   if (*buf) {			/* an argument was supplied, search for door
  1187: 				 * keyword */
  1188:     for (door = 0; door < DIR_COUNT; door++)
  1189:       if (EXIT(ch, door))
  1190:         if (EXIT(ch, door)->keyword)
  1191:           if (!str_cmp(EXIT(ch, door)->keyword, buf)) {
  1192:             perform_move(ch, door, 1);
  1193:             return;
  1194:           }
  1195:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no %s here.\r\n", buf);
  1196:   } else if (ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(ch), ROOM_INDOORS))
  1197:     send_to_char(ch, "You are already indoors.\r\n");
  1198:   else {
  1199:     /* try to locate an entrance */
  1200:     for (door = 0; door < DIR_COUNT; door++)
  1201:       if (EXIT(ch, door))
  1202: 	if (EXIT(ch, door)->to_room != NOWHERE)
  1203: 	  if (!EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_CLOSED) &&
  1204: 	      ROOM_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door)->to_room, ROOM_INDOORS)) {
  1205: 	    perform_move(ch, door, 1);
  1206: 	    return;
  1207: 	  }
  1208:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't seem to find anything to enter.\r\n");
  1209:   }
  1210: }
  1211: 
  1212: ACMD(do_leave)
  1213: {
  1214:   int door;
  1215: 
  1216:   if (OUTSIDE(ch))
  1217:     send_to_char(ch, "You are outside.. where do you want to go?\r\n");
  1218:   else {
  1219:     for (door = 0; door < DIR_COUNT; door++)
  1220:       if (EXIT(ch, door))
  1221: 	if (EXIT(ch, door)->to_room != NOWHERE)
  1222: 	  if (!EXIT_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door), EX_CLOSED) &&
  1223: 	    !ROOM_FLAGGED(EXIT(ch, door)->to_room, ROOM_INDOORS)) {
  1224: 	    perform_move(ch, door, 1);
  1225: 	    return;
  1226: 	  }
  1227:     send_to_char(ch, "I see no obvious exits to the outside.\r\n");
  1228:   }
  1229: }

  1231: ACMD(do_stand)
  1232: {
  1233:   switch (GET_POS(ch)) {
  1234:   case POS_STANDING:
  1235:     send_to_char(ch, "You are already standing.\r\n");
  1236:     break;
  1237: 
  1238:   case POS_SITTING:
  1239:     send_to_char(ch, "You stand up.\r\n");
  1240:     act("$n clambers to $s feet.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1241:     /* Were they sitting in something? */
  1242:     char_from_furniture(ch);
  1243:     /* Will be sitting after a successful bash and may still be fighting. */
  1244:     GET_POS(ch) = FIGHTING(ch) ? POS_FIGHTING : POS_STANDING;
  1245:     /* Recompute after furniture state change so derived effects drop immediately. */
  1246:     affect_total(ch);
  1247:     break;
  1248: 
  1249:   case POS_RESTING:
  1250:     send_to_char(ch, "You stop resting, and stand up.\r\n");
  1251:     act("$n stops resting, and clambers on $s feet.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1252:     /* Were they resting on furniture? */
  1253:     char_from_furniture(ch);
  1254:     GET_POS(ch) = POS_STANDING;
  1255:     /* Recompute after furniture state change so derived effects drop immediately. */
  1256:     affect_total(ch);
  1257:     break;
  1258: 
  1259:   case POS_SLEEPING:
  1260:     send_to_char(ch, "You have to wake up first!\r\n");
  1261:     break;
  1262: 
  1263:   case POS_FIGHTING:
  1264:     send_to_char(ch, "Do you not consider fighting as standing?\r\n");
  1265:     break;
  1266: 
  1267:   default:
  1268:     send_to_char(ch, "You stop floating around, and put your feet on the ground.\r\n");
  1269:     act("$n stops floating around, and puts $s feet on the ground.",
  1270:         TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1271:     GET_POS(ch) = POS_STANDING;
  1272:     break;
  1273:   }
  1274: }
  1275: ACMD(do_sit)
  1276: {
  1277:   char arg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1278:   struct obj_data *furniture;
  1279:   int state;
  1280: 
  1281:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1282: 
  1283:   furniture = find_furniture(ch, arg, "sit on", &state);
  1284: 
  1285:   if (state < 0)
  1286:     return;
  1287: 
  1288:   switch (GET_POS(ch)) {
  1289:   case POS_STANDING:
  1290:     if (state == 1 && furniture) {
  1291:       place_char_on_furniture(ch, furniture);
  1292:       act("You sit down upon $p.", TRUE, ch, furniture, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1293:       act("$n sits down upon $p.", TRUE, ch, furniture, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1294:       GET_POS(ch) = POS_SITTING;
  1295:     } else {
  1296:       send_to_char(ch, "You sit down.\r\n");
  1297:       act("$n sits down.", FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1298:       GET_POS(ch) = POS_SITTING;
  1299:     }
  1300:     break;
  1301:   case POS_SITTING:
  1302:     if (state == 1 && furniture && SITTING(ch) != furniture) {
  1303:       place_char_on_furniture(ch, furniture);
  1304:       act("You move over and sit upon $p.", TRUE, ch, furniture, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1305:       act("$n moves over and sits upon $p.", TRUE, ch, furniture, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1306:     } else
  1307:       send_to_char(ch, "You're sitting already.\r\n");
  1308:     break;
  1309:   case POS_RESTING:
  1310:     if (state == 1 && furniture && SITTING(ch) != furniture)
  1311:       place_char_on_furniture(ch, furniture);
  1312: 
  1313:     send_to_char(ch, "You stop resting, and sit up.\r\n");
  1314:     act("$n stops resting.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1315:     GET_POS(ch) = POS_SITTING;
  1316:     break;
  1317:   case POS_SLEEPING:
  1318:     send_to_char(ch, "You have to wake up first.\r\n");
  1319:     break;
  1320:   case POS_FIGHTING:
  1321:     send_to_char(ch, "Sit down while fighting? Are you MAD?\r\n");
  1322:     break;
  1323:   default:
  1324:     send_to_char(ch, "You stop floating around, and sit down.\r\n");
  1325:     act("$n stops floating around, and sits down.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1326:     GET_POS(ch) = POS_SITTING;
  1327:     break;
  1328:   }
  1329: }

  1379:     break;

  1383:     GET_POS(ch) = POS_RESTING;
  1384:     break;
  1385:   }
  1386: }

  1429: ACMD(do_wake)
  1430: {
  1431:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1432:   struct char_data *vict;
  1433:   int self = 0;
  1434: 
  1435:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1436:   if (!*arg && (GET_POS(ch) == POS_RESTING || GET_POS(ch) == POS_SITTING)) {
  1437:     do_stand(ch, "", 0, 0);
  1438:     return;
  1439:   }
  1440:   if (*arg) {
  1441:     if (GET_POS(ch) == POS_SLEEPING)
  1442:       send_to_char(ch, "Maybe you should wake yourself up first.\r\n");
  1443:     else if ((vict = get_char_vis(ch, arg, NULL, FIND_CHAR_ROOM)) == NULL)
  1444:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
  1445:     else if (vict == ch)
  1446:       self = 1;
  1447:     else if (AWAKE(vict))
  1448:       act("$E is already awake.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1449:     else if (AFF_FLAGGED(vict, AFF_SLEEP))
  1450:       act("You can't wake $M up!", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1451:     else if (GET_POS(vict) < POS_SLEEPING)
  1452:       act("$E's in pretty bad shape!", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1453:     else {
  1454:       act("You wake $M up.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1455:       act("You are awakened by $n.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
  1456:       GET_POS(vict) = POS_STANDING;
  1457:       char_from_furniture(vict);
  1458:       affect_total(vict);
  1459:     }
  1460:     if (!self)
  1461:       return;
  1462:   }
  1463:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_SLEEP))
  1464:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't wake up!\r\n");
  1465:   else if (GET_POS(ch) > POS_SLEEPING)
  1466:     send_to_char(ch, "You are already awake...\r\n");
  1467:   else {
  1468:     send_to_char(ch, "You wake and stand up.\r\n");
  1469:     act("$n awakens.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1470:     GET_POS(ch) = POS_STANDING;
  1471:     char_from_furniture(ch);
  1472:   }
  1473:   /* RECOMPUTE_AFFECTS_AFTER_DO_WAKE */
  1474:   affect_total(ch);
  1475: 
  1476: }
  1477: 
  1478: 
  1479: ACMD(do_follow)
  1480: {
  1481:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1482:   struct char_data *leader;
  1483: 
  1484:   one_argument(argument, buf);
  1485: 
  1486:   if (*buf) {
  1487:     if (!(leader = get_char_vis(ch, buf, NULL, FIND_CHAR_ROOM))) {
  1488:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
  1489:       return;
  1490:     }
  1491:   } else {
  1492:     if (ch->master != (char_data*)  NULL) {
  1493:       send_to_char(ch, "You are following %s.\r\n", 
  1494:          GET_NAME(ch->master));
  1495:     } else {
  1496:       send_to_char(ch, "Whom do you wish to follow?\r\n");
  1497:     }
  1498:     return;
  1499:   }
  1500: 
  1501:   if (ch->master == leader) {
  1502:     act("You are already following $M.", FALSE, ch, 0, leader, TO_CHAR);
  1503:     return;
  1504:   }
  1505:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM) && (ch->master)) {
  1506:     act("But you only feel like following $N!", FALSE, ch, 0, ch->master, TO_CHAR);
  1507:   } else {			/* Not Charmed follow person */
  1508:     if (leader == ch) {
  1509:       if (!ch->master) {
  1510:         send_to_char(ch, "You are already following yourself.\r\n");
  1511:         return;
  1512:       }
  1513:       stop_follower(ch);
  1514:     } else {
  1515:       if (circle_follow(ch, leader)) {
  1516:         send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, but following in loops is not allowed.\r\n");
  1517:         return;
  1518:       }
  1519:       if (ch->master)
  1520:         stop_follower(ch);
  1521: 
  1522:       add_follower(ch, leader);
  1523:     }
  1524:   }
  1525: }
  1526: 
  1527: ACMD(do_unfollow)
  1528: {
  1529:   if (ch->master) {
  1530:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM)) { 
  1531:        send_to_char(ch, "You feel compelled to follow %s.\r\n",
  1532:          GET_NAME(ch->master));
  1533:     } else {
  1534:       stop_follower(ch);
  1535:     }
  1536:   } else {
  1537:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not following anyone.\r\n");
  1538:   }
  1539:   return;
  1540: }

    56:   if (a->lvl != b->lvl)

    92: static int is_active_on_char(struct char_data *ch, int spellnum)

   102: static int contains_ci(const char *haystack, const char *needle)
   103: {
   104:   size_t nlen;
   105: 
   106:   if (!needle || !*needle)
   107:     return TRUE;
   108:   if (!haystack)
   109:     return FALSE;
   110: 
   111:   nlen = strlen(needle);
   112:   for (; *haystack; haystack++)
   113:     if (!strncasecmp(haystack, needle, nlen))
   114:       return TRUE;
   115: 
   116:   return FALSE;
   117: }

   119: static int ability_matches_damage_filter(const char *filter, const char *nm)
   120: {
   121:   static const char *damage_words[] = {
   122:     "fire", "cold", "acid", "electric", "lightning", "poison", "disease",
   123:     "shadow", "holy", "mental", "energy", "water", "air", "earth",
   124:     "negative", "light", "magic", "sonic", NULL
   125:   };
   126:   int i;
   127: 
   128:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "damage"))
   129:     filter = "";
   130: 
   131:   for (i = 0; damage_words[i]; i++) {
   132:     if (*filter && str_cmp(filter, damage_words[i]))
   133:       continue;
   134:     if (contains_ci(nm, damage_words[i]))
   135:       return TRUE;
   136:   }
   137: 
   138:   return FALSE;
   139: }

   141: static int shadow_capacity(struct char_data *ch)
   142: {
   143:   int cap;
   144:   if (!ch)
   145:     return 0;
   146:   cap = 2 + (GET_INT(ch) / 8) + (GET_WIS(ch) / 8);
   147:   return MIN(MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER, MAX(2, cap));
   148: }

   150: static int sanitize_shadow_name_input(const char *input, char *out, size_t out_sz)
   151: {
   152:   const char *src;
   153:   char *dst;
   154:   size_t remaining;
   155: 
   156:   if (!input || !out || out_sz == 0)
   157:     return FALSE;
   158: 
   159:   while (*input && isspace((unsigned char)*input))
   160:     input++;
   161:   if (!*input)
   162:     return FALSE;
   163: 
   164:   src = input;
   165:   dst = out;
   166:   remaining = out_sz - 1;
   167:   while (*src && remaining > 0) {
   168:     unsigned char c = (unsigned char)*src;
   169: 
   170:     if (iscntrl(c))
   171:       return FALSE;
   172:     if (c == '%' || c == '&' || c == '{' || c == '}' || c == '`')
   173:       return FALSE;
   174: 
   175:     *dst++ = *src++;
   176:     remaining--;
   177:   }
   178:   *dst = '\0';
   179: 
   180:   while (dst > out && isspace((unsigned char)dst[-1])) {
   181:     dst--;
   182:     *dst = '\0';
   183:   }
   184: 
   185:   return shadow_name_looks_valid(out);
   186: }

   188: static int shadow_find_slot(struct char_data *ch, const char *selector)
   189: {
   190:   int slot, i;
   191:   if (!ch || !selector || !*selector)
   192:     return -1;
   193:   if (isdigit((unsigned char)*selector)) {
   194:     slot = atoi(selector) - 1;
   195:     if (slot >= 0 && slot < MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER)
   196:       return slot;
   197:   }
   198:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER; i++) {
   199:     if (SHADOW_SLOT_OCCUPIED(ch, i) && isname(selector, SHADOW_SLOT_NAME(ch, i)))
   200:       return i;
   201:   }
   202:   return -1;
   203: }

   205: static struct char_data *shadow_active_mob(struct char_data *ch, int slot)
   206: {
   207:   struct follow_type *f;
   208:   struct affected_type *af;
   209:   if (!ch || slot < 0)
   210:     return NULL;
   211:   for (f = ch->followers; f; f = f->next) {
   212:     struct char_data *mob = f->follower;
   213:     if (!mob || mob->master != ch)
   214:       continue;
   215:     for (af = mob->affected; af; af = af->next) {
   216:       if (af->spell == SPELL_SHADOW_EXTRACTION && af->location == APPLY_NONE && af->modifier == slot + 2)
   217:         return mob;
   218:     }
   219:   }
   220:   return NULL;
   221: }

   223: static void remove_follower_link_silently(struct char_data *master, struct char_data *follower)
   224: {
   225:   struct follow_type *node, *prev = NULL;
   226: 
   227:   if (!master || !follower)
   228:     return;
   229: 
   230:   for (node = master->followers; node; prev = node, node = node->next) {
   231:     if (node->follower != follower)
   232:       continue;
   233:     if (prev)
   234:       prev->next = node->next;
   235:     else
   236:       master->followers = node->next;
   237:     free(node);
   238:     break;
   239:   }
   240: }

   242: static void shadow_prepare_for_removal(struct char_data *mob)
   243: {
   244:   struct char_data *fighter, *next_fighter;
   245: 
   246:   if (!mob)
   247:     return;
   248: 
   249:   GET_SUMMON_TIMER(mob) = 0;
   250:   HUNTING(mob) = NULL;
   251: 
   252:   if (FIGHTING(mob))
   253:     stop_fighting(mob);
   254: 
   255:   for (fighter = combat_list; fighter; fighter = next_fighter) {
   256:     next_fighter = fighter->next_fighting;
   257:     if (FIGHTING(fighter) == mob)
   258:       stop_fighting(fighter);
   259:   }
   260: 
   261:   while (mob->followers) {
   262:     struct follow_type *next = mob->followers->next;
   263:     if (mob->followers->follower)
   264:       mob->followers->follower->master = NULL;
   265:     free(mob->followers);
   266:     mob->followers = next;
   267:   }
   268: 
   269:   if (mob->master) {
   270:     remove_follower_link_silently(mob->master, mob);
   271:     mob->master = NULL;
   272:   }
   273:   REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(mob), AFF_CHARM);
   274: }

   276: static void shadow_sync_active_flags(struct char_data *ch)
   277: {
   278:   int i;
   279:   if (!ch)
   280:     return;
   281:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER; i++) {
   282:     if (!SHADOW_SLOT_OCCUPIED(ch, i)) {
   283:       SHADOW_SLOT_ACTIVE(ch, i) = 0;
   284:       continue;
   285:     }

   287:       SHADOW_SLOT_ACTIVE(ch, i) = 0;
   288:   }
   289: }

   291: static int ability_matches_filter(struct char_data *ch, int ability, const char *filter, int show_spells)
   292: {
   293:   const struct spell_info_type *si = &spell_info[ability];
   294:   const char *nm = si->name ? si->name : "";
   295: 
   296:   if (!filter || !*filter)
   297:     return 1;
   298: 
   299:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "affected"))
   300:     return show_spells && is_active_on_char(ch, ability);
   301:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "unaffected"))
   302:     return show_spells && !is_active_on_char(ch, ability);
   303:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "combat"))
   304:     return si->violent || IS_SET(si->routines, MAG_DAMAGE);
   305:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "healing") || !str_cmp(filter, "curative"))
   306:     return IS_SET(si->routines, MAG_POINTS) || contains_ci(nm, "cure") || contains_ci(nm, "heal");
   307:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "movement"))
   308:     return contains_ci(nm, "fly") || contains_ci(nm, "recall") || contains_ci(nm, "portal") || contains_ci(nm, "haste");
   309:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "area"))
   310:     return IS_SET(si->routines, MAG_AREAS | MAG_MASSES);
   311:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "spellup"))
   312:     return !si->violent && IS_SET(si->routines, MAG_AFFECTS) && IS_SET(si->targets, TAR_SELF_ONLY);
   313:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "resist"))
   314:     return contains_ci(nm, "resist") || contains_ci(nm, "protection");
   315:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "stats"))
   316:     return contains_ci(nm, "strength") || contains_ci(nm, "dex") || contains_ci(nm, "con")
   317:         || contains_ci(nm, "int") || contains_ci(nm, "wis") || contains_ci(nm, "charisma")
   318:         || contains_ci(nm, "armor") || contains_ci(nm, "bless");
   319:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "weapon"))
   320:     return contains_ci(nm, "weapon") || contains_ci(nm, "shield") || contains_ci(nm, "enchant");
   321:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "learned"))
   322:     return GET_SKILL(ch, ability) > 0;
   323:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "object"))
   324:     return IS_SET(si->targets, TAR_OBJ_ROOM | TAR_OBJ_INV | TAR_OBJ_WORLD | TAR_OBJ_EQUIP) || IS_SET(si->routines, MAG_ALTER_OBJS);
   325:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "attack") || !str_cmp(filter, "bad"))
   326:     return si->violent;
   327:   if (!str_cmp(filter, "damage") || !str_cmp(filter, "fire") || !str_cmp(filter, "cold") ||
   328:       !str_cmp(filter, "acid") || !str_cmp(filter, "electric") || !str_cmp(filter, "poison") ||
   329:       !str_cmp(filter, "disease") || !str_cmp(filter, "holy") || !str_cmp(filter, "shadow") ||
   330:       !str_cmp(filter, "mental") || !str_cmp(filter, "energy") || !str_cmp(filter, "water") ||
   331:       !str_cmp(filter, "air") || !str_cmp(filter, "earth") || !str_cmp(filter, "negative") ||
   332:       !str_cmp(filter, "light") || !str_cmp(filter, "magic") || !str_cmp(filter, "sonic"))
   333:     return ability_matches_damage_filter(filter, nm);
   334: 
   335:   return contains_ci(nm, filter);
   336: }
   337: 
   338: void show_ability_table_aligned(struct char_data *ch, int show_spells, int show_all, const char *filter)
   339: {
   340:   int i;
   341:   int cls = GET_CLASS(ch);
   342:   struct abil_row rows[TOP_SPELL_DEFINE + 1];
   343:   int n = 0;
   344: 
   345:   send_to_char(ch, "%s:\r\n", show_spells ? "SPELLS" : "SKILLS");
   346: 
   347:   /* Collect rows */
   348:   for (i = 1; i <= TOP_SPELL_DEFINE; i++) {
   349:     int lvl;
   350:     int pct;
   351:     const char *nm;
   352: 
   353:     if (show_spells) {
   354:       if (!is_spell_id(i)) continue;
   355:     } else {
   356:       if (!is_skill_id(i)) continue;
   357:     }
   358: 
   359:     lvl = spell_info[i].min_level[cls];
   360:     if (i == SKILL_STUDY && (lvl <= 0 || lvl >= LVL_IMMORT))
   361:       lvl = 1;
   362:     lvl = classtrack_get_study_display_level(ch, i, lvl);
   363:     if (lvl <= 0) continue;
   364: 
   365:     if (show_all && lvl >= LVL_IMMORT) continue;
   366:     pct = GET_SKILL(ch, i);
   367:     if (!show_all && pct <= 0) continue;
   368:     if (pct <= 0) pct = -1;
   369:     nm = spell_info[i].name;
   370:     if (!nm || !*nm) continue;
   371:     if (!ability_matches_filter(ch, i, filter, show_spells)) continue;
   372: 
   373:     /* filter placeholders */
   374:     if (!strcmp(nm, "!UNUSED!")) continue;
   375: 
   376:     if (pct >= 0 && pct > 100) pct = 100;
   377:     rows[n].id = i;
   378:     rows[n].lvl = lvl;
   379:     rows[n].name = nm;
   380:     rows[n].pct = pct;
   381:     n++;
   382:   }
   383: 
   384:   if (n == 0) {
   385:     send_to_char(ch, "None.\r\n");
   386:     return;
   387:   }
   388: 
   389:   qsort(rows, (size_t)n, sizeof(rows[0]), abil_row_cmp);
   390: 
   391:   /* Both sections use the same renderer.  A pair only shares a row when its
   392:    * complete names and percentage cells fit the normal terminal width. */
   393:   {
   394:     int idx = 0;
   395:     int global_left_name_len = 0;
   396:     int global_right_name_len = 0;
   397:     int fixed_left_cell_width;
   398:     int fixed_right_cell_width;
   399: 
   400:     for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   401:       int level = rows[i].lvl;
   402:       int level_idx = 0;
   403: 
   404:       while (i + level_idx < n && rows[i + level_idx].lvl == level) {
   405:         int name_len = (int)strlen(rows[i + level_idx].name);
   406: 
   407:         if ((level_idx % 2) == 0) {
   408:           if (name_len > global_left_name_len)
   409:             global_left_name_len = name_len;
   410:         } else {
   411:           if (name_len > global_right_name_len)
   412:             global_right_name_len = name_len;
   413:         }
   414:         level_idx++;
   415:       }
   416:       i += (level_idx - 1);
   417:     }
   418:     fixed_left_cell_width = global_left_name_len + 7;   /* " [100%]" or " [ -- ]" */
   419:     fixed_right_cell_width = global_right_name_len + 7; /* " [100%]" or " [ -- ]" */
   420: 
   421:     while (idx < n) {
   422:       int level = rows[idx].lvl;
   423:       int level_start = idx;
   424:       int level_count = 0;
   425:       int first_row_for_level = 1;
   426: 
   427:       while ((level_start + level_count) < n && rows[level_start + level_count].lvl == level) {
   428:         level_count++;
   429:       }
   430: 
   431:       i = level_start;
   432:       while (i < level_start + level_count) {
   433:         char left_cell[256];
   434:         char right_cell[256];
   435:         int has_right = (i + 1 < level_start + level_count);
   436:         int left_name_len = (int)strlen(rows[i].name);
   437:         int right_name_len = 0;
   438:         int left_pad = MAX(0, global_left_name_len - left_name_len);
   439:         int right_pad = 0;
   440:         int pair_fits = FALSE;
   441:         int avail_after_indent = SPELL_TERM_WIDTH - LEVEL_LABEL_PADDING;
   442: 
   443:         if (has_right) {
   444:           right_name_len = (int)strlen(rows[i + 1].name);
   445:           right_pad = MAX(0, global_right_name_len - right_name_len);
   446:           if (fixed_left_cell_width + SPELL_ROW_GAP + fixed_right_cell_width <= avail_after_indent)
   447:             pair_fits = TRUE;
   448:         }
   449: 
   450:         if (rows[i].pct < 0)
   451:           snprintf(left_cell, sizeof(left_cell), "%s%*s [ -- ]", rows[i].name, left_pad, "");
   452:         else
   453:           snprintf(left_cell, sizeof(left_cell), "%s%*s [%3d%%]", rows[i].name, left_pad, "", rows[i].pct);
   454: 
   455:         if (has_right) {
   456:           if (rows[i + 1].pct < 0)
   457:             snprintf(right_cell, sizeof(right_cell), "%s%*s [ -- ]", rows[i + 1].name, right_pad, "");
   458:           else
   459:             snprintf(right_cell, sizeof(right_cell), "%s%*s [%3d%%]", rows[i + 1].name, right_pad, "", rows[i + 1].pct);
   460:         }
   461: 
   462:         if (first_row_for_level) {
   463:           send_to_char(ch, "%sLevel %-2d%s:%s ",
   464:                        CCCYN(ch, C_NRM),
   465:                        level,
   466:                        CCWHT(ch, C_NRM),
   467:                        CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   468:           first_row_for_level = 0;
   469:         } else {
   470:           send_to_char(ch, "\r\n%*s", LEVEL_LABEL_PADDING, "");
   471:         }
   472: 
   473:         if (pair_fits) {
   474:           send_to_char(ch, "%-*s%*s%s",
   475:                        fixed_left_cell_width + count_color_chars(left_cell), left_cell,
   476:                        SPELL_ROW_GAP, "", right_cell);
   477:           i += 2;
   478:         } else {
   479:           send_to_char(ch, "%s", left_cell);
   480:           i++;
   481:         }
   482:       }
   483: 
   484:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   485:       idx = level_start + level_count;
   486:     }
   487:     return;
   488:   }
   489: 
   490: }

   518: ACMD(do_quit)
   519: {
   520:   struct descriptor_data *desc;
   521: 
   522:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc)
   523:     return;
   524: 
   525:   if (subcmd != SCMD_QUIT && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)
   526:     send_to_char(ch, "You have to type quit--no less, to quit!\r\n");
   527:   else if (GET_POS(ch) == POS_FIGHTING)
   528:     send_to_char(ch, "No way!  You're fighting for your life!\r\n");
   529:   else if (GET_POS(ch) < POS_STUNNED) {
   530:     send_to_char(ch, "You die before your time...\r\n");
   531:     die(ch, NULL);
   532:   } else {
   533:     desc = ch->desc;
   534:     act("$n has left the game.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   535:     mudlog(NRM, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "%s has quit the game.", GET_NAME(ch));
   536: 
   537:     if (GET_QUEST_TIME(ch) != -1)
   538:       quest_timeout(ch);
   539: 
   540:     send_to_char(ch, "Goodbye, friend.. Come back soon!\r\n");
   541: 
   542:     /* We used to check here for duping attempts, but we may as well do it right
   543:      * in extract_char(), since there is no check if a player rents out and it
   544:      * can leave them in an equally screwy situation. */
   545: 
   546:     if (CONFIG_FREE_RENT)
   547:       Crash_rentsave(ch, 0);
   548: 
   549:     /* LoadRoom is an administrator override.  Record session location
   550:      * separately, before extraction makes IN_ROOM invalid. */
   551:     GET_LAST_ROOM(ch) = GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch));
   552: 
   553:     /* Stop snooping so you can't see passwords during deletion or change. */
   554:     if (ch->desc->snoop_by) {
   555:       write_to_output(ch->desc->snoop_by, "Your victim is no longer among us.\r\n");
   556:       ch->desc->snoop_by->snooping = NULL;
   557:       ch->desc->snoop_by = NULL;
   558:     }
   559: 
   560:     extract_char(ch);		/* Char is saved before extracting. */
   561:     /* Close the socket without freeing the character before deferred extraction
   562:      * finishes.  CON_DISCONNECT is the descriptor-safe extraction state. */
   563:     STATE(desc) = CON_DISCONNECT;
   564:   }
   565: }

   579: ACMD(do_recall)
   580: {
   581:   int recall_move_cost;
   582:   int move_before_recall;
   583: 
   584:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_RECALL)) {
   585:     send_to_char(ch, "You have no idea how.\r\n");
   586:     return;
   587:   }
   588: 
   589:   if (GET_POS(ch) <= POS_STUNNED || GET_POS(ch) == POS_SLEEPING) {
   590:     send_to_char(ch, "You are in no condition to recall.\r\n");
   591:     return;
   592:   }
   593: 
   594:   if (ZONE_FLAGGED(GET_ROOM_ZONE(IN_ROOM(ch)), ZONE_NOASTRAL)) {
   595:     send_to_char(ch, "A bright flash prevents your recall from working!");
   596:     return;
   597:   }
   598: 
   599:   send_to_char(ch, "You focus and force yourself back to safety, collapsing from exhaustion.\r\n");
   600:   act("$n vanishes in a blur of motion.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   601: 
   602:   move_before_recall = GET_MOVE(ch);
   603:   recall_move_cost = MAX(1, move_before_recall / 2);
   604:   GET_MOVE(ch) = MAX(0, move_before_recall - recall_move_cost);
   605:   WAIT_STATE(ch, PULSE_VIOLENCE * 2);
   606: 
   607:   char_from_room(ch);
   608:   char_to_room(ch, r_mortal_start_room);
   609:   act("$n appears in the middle of the room.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   610:   look_at_room(ch, 0);
   611:   entry_memory_mtrigger(ch);
   612:   greet_mtrigger(ch, -1);
   613:   greet_memory_mtrigger(ch);
   614:   handle_followers_after_owner_teleport_or_recall(ch);
   615:   improve_ability_from_use(ch, SKILL_RECALL, TRUE);
   616: }

   641:     return;
