   672: ACMD(do_steal)
   673: {
   674:   struct char_data *vict;
   675:   struct obj_data *obj;
   676:   char vict_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], obj_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   677:   int percent, gold, eq_pos, pcsteal = 0, ohoh = 0;
   678: 
   679:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_STEAL)) {
   680:     send_to_char(ch, "You have no idea how to do that.\r\n");
   681:     return;
   682:   }
   683:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(ch), ROOM_PEACEFUL)) {
   684:     send_to_char(ch, "This room just has such a peaceful, easy feeling...\r\n");
   685:     return;
   686:   }
   687: 
   688:   two_arguments(argument, obj_name, vict_name);
   689: 
   690:   if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, vict_name, NULL, FIND_CHAR_ROOM))) {
   691:     send_to_char(ch, "Steal what from who?\r\n");
   692:     return;
   693:   } else if (vict == ch) {
   694:     send_to_char(ch, "Come on now, that's rather stupid!\r\n");
   695:     return;
   696:   }
   697: 
   698:   /* 101% is a complete failure */
   699:   percent = rand_number(1, 101) - dex_app_skill[GET_DEX(ch)].p_pocket;
   700: 
   701:   if (GET_POS(vict) < POS_SLEEPING)
   702:     percent = -1;		/* ALWAYS SUCCESS, unless heavy object. */
   703: 
   704:   if (!CONFIG_PT_ALLOWED && !IS_NPC(vict))
   705:     pcsteal = 1;
   706: 
   707:   if (!AWAKE(vict))	/* Easier to steal from sleeping people. */
   708:     percent -= 50;
   709: 
   710:   /* No stealing if not allowed. If it is no stealing from Imm's or Shopkeepers. */
   711:   if (GET_LEVEL(vict) >= LVL_IMMORT || pcsteal || GET_MOB_SPEC(vict) == shop_keeper)
   712:     percent = 101;		/* Failure */
   713: 
   714:   if (str_cmp(obj_name, "coins") && str_cmp(obj_name, "gold")) {
   715: 
   716:     if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, obj_name, NULL, vict->carrying))) {
   717: 
   718:       for (eq_pos = 0; eq_pos < NUM_WEARS; eq_pos++)
   719: 	if (GET_EQ(vict, eq_pos) &&
   720: 	    (isname(obj_name, GET_EQ(vict, eq_pos)->name)) &&
   721: 	    CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, GET_EQ(vict, eq_pos))) {
   722: 	  obj = GET_EQ(vict, eq_pos);
   723: 	  break;
   724: 	}
   725:       if (!obj) {
   726: 	act("$E hasn't got that item.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
   727: 	return;
   728:       } else {			/* It is equipment */
   729: 	if ((GET_POS(vict) > POS_STUNNED)) {
   730: 	  send_to_char(ch, "Steal the equipment now?  Impossible!\r\n");
   731: 	  return;
   732: 	} else {
   733:           if (!give_otrigger(obj, vict, ch) ||
   734:               !receive_mtrigger(ch, vict, obj) ) {
   735:             send_to_char(ch, "Impossible!\r\n");
   736:             return;
   737:           }
   738: 	  act("You unequip $p and steal it.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   739: 	  act("$n steals $p from $N.", FALSE, ch, obj, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
   740: 	  obj_to_char(unequip_char(vict, eq_pos), ch);
   741: 	}
   742:       }
   743:     } else {			/* obj found in inventory */
   744: 
   745:       percent += GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj);	/* Make heavy harder */
   746: 
   747:       if (percent > GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_STEAL)) {
   748: 	ohoh = TRUE;
   749: 	send_to_char(ch, "Oops..\r\n");
   750: 	act("$n tried to steal something from you!", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_VICT);
   751: 	act("$n tries to steal something from $N.", TRUE, ch, 0, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
   752:       } else {			/* Steal the item */
   753: 	if (IS_CARRYING_N(ch) + 1 < CAN_CARRY_N(ch)) {
   754:           if (!give_otrigger(obj, vict, ch) ||
   755:               !receive_mtrigger(ch, vict, obj) ) {
   756:             send_to_char(ch, "Impossible!\r\n");
   757:             return;
   758:           }
   759: 	  if (IS_CARRYING_W(ch) + GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) < CAN_CARRY_W(ch)) {
   760: 	    obj_from_char(obj);
   761: 	    obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   762: 	    send_to_char(ch, "Got it!\r\n");
   763: 	  }
   764: 	} else
   765: 	  send_to_char(ch, "You cannot carry that much.\r\n");
   766:       }
   767:     }
   768:   } else {			/* Steal some coins */
   769:     if (AWAKE(vict) && (percent > GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_STEAL))) {
   770:       ohoh = TRUE;
   771:       send_to_char(ch, "Oops..\r\n");
   772:       act("You discover that $n has $s hands in your wallet.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_VICT);
   773:       act("$n tries to steal gold from $N.", TRUE, ch, 0, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
   774:     } else {
   775:       /* Steal some gold coins */
   776:       gold = (GET_GOLD(vict) * rand_number(1, 10)) / 100;
   777:       gold = MIN(1782, gold);
   778:       if (gold > 0) {
   779: 		increase_gold(ch, gold);
   780: 		decrease_gold(vict, gold);
   781:         if (gold > 1)
   782: 	  send_to_char(ch, "Bingo!  You got %d gold coins.\r\n", gold);
   783: 	else
   784: 	  send_to_char(ch, "You manage to swipe a solitary gold coin.\r\n");
   785:       } else {
   786: 	send_to_char(ch, "You couldn't get any gold...\r\n");
   787:       }
   788:     }
   789:   }
   790: 
   791:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && vict && vict != ch)
   792: 
   793:   if (ohoh && IS_NPC(vict) && AWAKE(vict))
   794:     hit(vict, ch, TYPE_UNDEFINED);
   795: }

   833: static int can_use_practice_trainer(struct char_data *ch)
   834: {
   835:   struct obj_data *obj;
   836:   struct char_data *mob;
   837:   int i;
   838: 
   839:   if (GET_ROOM_SPEC(IN_ROOM(ch)) == guild)
   840:     return TRUE;
   841: 
   842:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
   843:     if (GET_EQ(ch, i) && GET_OBJ_SPEC(GET_EQ(ch, i)) == guild)
   844:       return TRUE;
   845: 
   846:   for (obj = ch->carrying; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
   847:     if (GET_OBJ_SPEC(obj) == guild)
   848:       return TRUE;
   849: 
   850:   for (mob = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; mob; mob = mob->next_in_room)
   851:     if (!MOB_FLAGGED(mob, MOB_NOTDEADYET) && GET_MOB_SPEC(mob) == guild)
   852:       return TRUE;
   853: 
   854:   for (obj = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
   855:     if (GET_OBJ_SPEC(obj) == guild)
   856:       return TRUE;
   857: 
   858:   return FALSE;
   859: }

   861: static int study_is_valid_ability_id(int id)
   862: {
   863:   return (id > 0 &&
   864:           id <= TOP_SPELL_DEFINE &&
   865:           id <= MAX_SKILLS &&
   866:           spell_info[id].name &&
   867:           *spell_info[id].name &&
   868:           str_cmp(spell_info[id].name, "!UNUSED!"));
   869: }

   889: static int study_item_level_allows(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *study_obj)
   890: {
   891:   if (!ch || !study_obj)
   892:     return FALSE;
   893: 
   894:   return (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= GET_OBJ_LEVEL(study_obj));
   895: }

   897: static void study_debug_imm(struct char_data *ch, const char *fmt, ...)
   898: {
   899:   va_list args;
   900:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   901: 
   902:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch) || GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)
   903:     return;
   904: 
   905:   va_start(args, fmt);
   906:   vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, args);
   907:   va_end(args);
   908: 
   909:   send_to_char(ch, "[study debug] %s\r\n", buf);
   910: }
   911: 
   912: static const char *study_item_result_name(enum study_item_result result)
   913: {
   914:   switch (result) {
   915:     case STUDY_ITEM_SUCCESS: return "success";
   916:     case STUDY_ITEM_NOT_FOUND: return "not-found";
   917:     case STUDY_ITEM_INVALID_SOURCE: return "invalid-source";
   918:     case STUDY_ITEM_NO_VALID_SLOTS: return "no-valid-slots";
   919:     case STUDY_ITEM_NO_STUDYABLE_SPELLS: return "no-studyable-spells";
   920:     case STUDY_ITEM_ALL_KNOWN: return "all-known";
   921:     case STUDY_ITEM_ALL_TOO_ADVANCED: return "item-level-blocked";
   922:     case STUDY_ITEM_ALL_BLOCKED_PATH: return "path-blocked";
   923:     case STUDY_ITEM_TARGET_NOT_PRESENT: return "target-not-present";
   924:     default: return "unknown";
   925:   }
   926: }

   928: static int study_can_learn_ability(struct char_data *student, int id, char *why, size_t whylen)
   929: {
   930:   int required_level;
   931:   int ability_archetype;
   932: 
   933:   if (!study_is_valid_ability_id(id)) {
   934:     if (why && whylen)
   935:       snprintf(why, whylen, "You do not recognize that technique.");
   936:     return FALSE;
   937:   }
   938: 
   939:   if (GET_SKILL(student, id) > 0) {
   940:     if (why && whylen)
   941:       snprintf(why, whylen, "You already know that.");
   942:     return FALSE;
   943:   }
   944: 
   945:   required_level = classtrack_get_study_min_level(id);
   946:   if (required_level > 0 && GET_LEVEL(student) < required_level) {
   947:     if (why && whylen)
   948:       snprintf(why, whylen, "You are not experienced enough to study that yet.");
   949:     return FALSE;
   950:   }
   951: 
   952:   ability_archetype = classtrack_get_ability_archetype(id);
   953:   if (ability_archetype >= 0 && ability_archetype < NUM_ARCHETYPES) {
   954:     if (why && whylen)
   955:       why[0] = '\0';
   956:     if (!classtrack_can_study_archetype(student, ability_archetype, why, whylen)) {
   957:       if (why && whylen && !*why)
   958:         snprintf(why, whylen,
   959:                  "You have gone too far down your current path to learn that kind of power.");
   960:       return FALSE;
   961:     }
   962:   }
   963: 
   964:   return TRUE;
   965: }
   966: 
   967: static int study_extract_item_spells(struct obj_data *obj, int *out, int out_cap)
   968: {
   969:   int spell_slots[3];
   970:   int slot_count = 0;
   971:   int c, i, j;
   972: 
   973:   if (!obj || !out || out_cap <= 0)
   974:     return 0;
   975: 
   976:   switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj)) {
   977:     case ITEM_WAND:
   978:     case ITEM_STAFF:
   979:       spell_slots[slot_count++] = GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3);
   980:       break;
   981:     case ITEM_SCROLL:
   982:     case ITEM_POTION:
   983:       spell_slots[slot_count++] = GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1);
   984:       spell_slots[slot_count++] = GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2);
   985:       spell_slots[slot_count++] = GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3);
   986:       break;
   987:     default:
   988:       return 0;
   989:   }
   990: 
   991:   c = 0;
   992:   for (i = 0; i < slot_count && c < out_cap; i++) {
   993:     int sid = spell_slots[i];
   994:     int duplicate = FALSE;
   995: 
   996:     if (sid <= 0 || sid > TOP_SPELL_DEFINE || sid > MAX_SPELLS)
   997:       continue;
   998:     if (!study_is_valid_ability_id(sid))
   999:       continue;
  1000: 
  1001:     for (j = 0; j < c; j++) {
  1002:       if (out[j] == sid) {
  1003:         duplicate = TRUE;
  1004:         break;
  1005:       }
  1006:     }
  1007:     if (!duplicate)
  1008:       out[c++] = sid;
  1009:   }
  1010: 
  1011:   return c;
  1012: }
  1013: 
  1014: static int study_item_contains_spell(const int *spell_ids, int spell_count, int target_id)
  1015: {
  1016:   int i;
  1017: 
  1018:   if (!spell_ids || spell_count <= 0 || target_id <= 0)
  1019:     return FALSE;
  1020: 
  1021:   for (i = 0; i < spell_count; i++)
  1022:     if (spell_ids[i] == target_id)
  1023:       return TRUE;
  1024: 
  1025:   return FALSE;
  1026: }
  1027: 
  1028: static int study_is_numbered_item_token(const char *token)
  1029: {
  1030:   const char *dot;
  1031:   const char *p;
  1032: 
  1033:   if (!token || !*token)
  1034:     return FALSE;
  1035: 
  1036:   dot = strchr(token, '.');
  1037:   if (!dot || dot == token || *(dot + 1) == '\0')
  1038:     return FALSE;
  1039: 
  1040:   for (p = token; p < dot; p++)
  1041:     if (!isdigit(*p))
  1042:       return FALSE;
  1043: 
  1044:   return TRUE;
  1045: }
  1046: 
  1047: static struct obj_data *study_resolve_inventory_item_source(struct char_data *ch,
  1048:                                                             const char *item_text)
  1049: {
  1050:   char lookup[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1051: 
  1052:   if (!ch || !item_text || !*item_text)
  1053:     return NULL;
  1054: 
  1055:   strlcpy(lookup, item_text, sizeof(lookup));
  1056:   return get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, lookup, NULL, ch->carrying);
  1057: }
  1058: 
  1059: static int study_find_item_and_target(struct char_data *ch, char *argument,
  1060:                                       struct obj_data **study_obj_out,
  1061:                                       int *target_id_out,
  1062:                                       int *has_target_out,
  1063:                                       int *used_numbered_item_token_out)
  1064: {
  1065:   char work[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1066:   char item_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH] = "";
  1067:   char target_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH] = "";
  1068:   char *tokens[64];
  1069:   int token_count = 0;
  1070:   char *tok;
  1071:   int i, j;
  1072:   struct obj_data *obj = NULL;
  1073:   int first_token_numbered = FALSE;
  1074: 
  1075:   if (!ch || !study_obj_out || !target_id_out || !has_target_out ||
  1076:       !used_numbered_item_token_out || !argument || !*argument)
  1077:     return FALSE;
  1078: 
  1079:   *study_obj_out = NULL;
  1080:   *target_id_out = -1;
  1081:   *has_target_out = FALSE;
  1082:   *used_numbered_item_token_out = FALSE;
  1083: 
  1084:   strlcpy(work, argument, sizeof(work));
  1085:   tok = strtok(work, " ");
  1086:   while (tok && token_count < 64) {
  1087:     tokens[token_count++] = tok;
  1088:     tok = strtok(NULL, " ");
  1089:   }
  1090: 
  1091:   if (token_count <= 0)
  1092:     return FALSE;
  1093: 
  1094:   first_token_numbered = study_is_numbered_item_token(tokens[0]);
  1095:   *used_numbered_item_token_out = first_token_numbered;
  1096: 
  1097:   for (i = token_count; i >= 1; i--) {
  1098:     size_t item_len = 0;
  1099:     item_name[0] = '\0';
  1100:     for (j = 0; j < i; j++) {
  1101:       int wrote = snprintf(item_name + item_len, sizeof(item_name) - item_len,
  1102:                            "%s%s", item_len ? " " : "", tokens[j]);
  1103:       if (wrote < 0)
  1104:         break;
  1105:       if ((size_t)wrote >= sizeof(item_name) - item_len) {
  1106:         item_len = sizeof(item_name) - 1;
  1107:         item_name[item_len] = '\0';
  1108:         break;
  1109:       }
  1110:       item_len += (size_t)wrote;
  1111:     }
  1112: 
  1113:     obj = study_resolve_inventory_item_source(ch, item_name);
  1114:     if (!obj)
  1115:       continue;
  1116: 
  1117:     *study_obj_out = obj;
  1118:     if (i < token_count) {
  1119:       size_t target_len = 0;
  1120:       target_name[0] = '\0';
  1121:       for (j = i; j < token_count; j++) {
  1122:         int wrote = snprintf(target_name + target_len, sizeof(target_name) - target_len,
  1123:                              "%s%s", target_len ? " " : "", tokens[j]);
  1124:         if (wrote < 0)
  1125:           break;
  1126:         if ((size_t)wrote >= sizeof(target_name) - target_len) {
  1127:           target_len = sizeof(target_name) - 1;
  1128:           target_name[target_len] = '\0';
  1129:           break;
  1130:         }
  1131:         target_len += (size_t)wrote;
  1132:       }
  1133:       *target_id_out = find_skill_num(target_name);
  1134:       *has_target_out = TRUE;
  1135:     }
  1136:     return TRUE;
  1137:   }
  1138: 
  1139:   return FALSE;
  1140: }
  1141: 
  1142: static enum study_item_result study_try_from_item(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *study_obj,
  1143:                                                    int requested_ability_id,
  1144:                                                    int has_requested_ability,
  1145:                                                    int *ability_id_out)
  1146: {
  1147:   int i;
  1148:   int raw_spell_ids[3];
  1149:   int raw_spell_count = 0;
  1150:   int eligible_spell_ids[3];
  1151:   int eligible_count = 0;
  1152:   struct study_item_debug_info debug_info = {0, 0, 0};
  1153:   int item_level_gate_passed = FALSE;
  1154:   char raw_names[MAX_STRING_LENGTH] = "";
  1155:   char eligible_names[MAX_STRING_LENGTH] = "";
  1156: 
  1157:   if (!study_obj)
  1158:     return STUDY_ITEM_NOT_FOUND;
  1159: 
  1160:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj) != ITEM_WAND &&
  1161:       GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj) != ITEM_STAFF &&
  1162:       GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj) != ITEM_SCROLL &&
  1163:       GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj) != ITEM_POTION) {
  1164:     study_debug_imm(ch, "item '%s' type %d is not a study source",
  1165:                     study_obj->short_description, GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj));
  1166:     return STUDY_ITEM_INVALID_SOURCE;
  1167:   }
  1168: 
  1169:   raw_spell_count = study_extract_item_spells(study_obj, raw_spell_ids, 3);
  1170:   if (raw_spell_count <= 0) {
  1171:     study_debug_imm(ch, "item '%s' has no valid spell slots", study_obj->short_description);
  1172:     return STUDY_ITEM_NO_VALID_SLOTS;
  1173:   }
  1174: 
  1175:   if (has_requested_ability) {
  1176:     if (!study_is_valid_ability_id(requested_ability_id) ||
  1177:         !study_item_contains_spell(raw_spell_ids, raw_spell_count, requested_ability_id)) {
  1178:       study_debug_imm(ch, "item '%s' does not contain requested ability id=%d",
  1179:                       study_obj->short_description, requested_ability_id);
  1180:       return STUDY_ITEM_TARGET_NOT_PRESENT;
  1181:     }
  1182:   }
  1183: 
  1184:   item_level_gate_passed = study_item_level_allows(ch, study_obj);
  1185: 
  1186:   for (i = 0; i < raw_spell_count; i++) {
  1187:     int sid = raw_spell_ids[i];
  1188:     int ability_archetype = classtrack_get_ability_archetype(sid);
  1189:     size_t raw_len = strlen(raw_names);
  1190: 
  1191:     if (has_requested_ability && sid != requested_ability_id)
  1192:       continue;
  1193: 
  1194:     {
  1195:       int wrote = snprintf(raw_names + raw_len, sizeof(raw_names) - raw_len, "%s%s",
  1196:                            raw_len ? ", " : "", spell_info[sid].name);
  1197:       if (wrote >= (int)(sizeof(raw_names) - raw_len))
  1198:         raw_names[sizeof(raw_names) - 1] = '\0';
  1199:     }
  1200: 
  1201:     if (GET_SKILL(ch, sid) > 0) {
  1202:       debug_info.known_count++;
  1203:       study_debug_imm(ch, "item-study spell=%s item_level=%d player_level=%d item_gate=pass path_gate=skip result=known",
  1204:                       spell_info[sid].name, GET_OBJ_LEVEL(study_obj), GET_LEVEL(ch));
  1205:       continue;
  1206:     }
  1207: 
  1208:     if (!item_level_gate_passed) {
  1209:       debug_info.item_level_blocked_count++;
  1210:       study_debug_imm(ch, "item-study spell=%s item_level=%d player_level=%d item_gate=fail path_gate=skip result=item-level-blocked",
  1211:                       spell_info[sid].name, GET_OBJ_LEVEL(study_obj), GET_LEVEL(ch));
  1212:       continue;
  1213:     }
  1214: 
  1215:     if (ability_archetype >= 0 && ability_archetype < NUM_ARCHETYPES &&
  1216:         !classtrack_can_study_archetype(ch, ability_archetype, NULL, 0)) {
  1217:       debug_info.path_blocked_count++;
  1218:       study_debug_imm(ch, "item-study spell=%s item_level=%d player_level=%d item_gate=pass path_gate=fail result=path-blocked",
  1219:                       spell_info[sid].name, GET_OBJ_LEVEL(study_obj), GET_LEVEL(ch));
  1220:       continue;
  1221:     }
  1222: 
  1223:     eligible_spell_ids[eligible_count++] = sid;
  1224:     study_debug_imm(ch, "item-study spell=%s item_level=%d player_level=%d item_gate=pass path_gate=pass result=eligible",
  1225:                     spell_info[sid].name, GET_OBJ_LEVEL(study_obj), GET_LEVEL(ch));
  1226:     {
  1227:       size_t eligible_len = strlen(eligible_names);
  1228:       int wrote = snprintf(eligible_names + eligible_len,
  1229:                            sizeof(eligible_names) - eligible_len, "%s%s",
  1230:                            eligible_len ? ", " : "", spell_info[sid].name);
  1231:       if (wrote >= (int)(sizeof(eligible_names) - eligible_len))
  1232:         eligible_names[sizeof(eligible_names) - 1] = '\0';
  1233:     }
  1234:   }
  1235: 
  1236:   study_debug_imm(ch, "item '%s' vnum=%d type %d target=%s candidates=[%s] eligible=[%s]",
  1237:                   study_obj->short_description, GET_OBJ_VNUM(study_obj),
  1238:                   GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj),
  1239:                   (has_requested_ability && study_is_valid_ability_id(requested_ability_id)) ?
  1240:                     spell_info[requested_ability_id].name : "auto",
  1241:                   *raw_names ? raw_names : "none",
  1242:                   *eligible_names ? eligible_names : "none");
  1243: 
  1244:   if (eligible_count > 0) {
  1245:     int chosen = (eligible_count == 1) ? 0 : rand_number(0, eligible_count - 1);
  1246:     *ability_id_out = eligible_spell_ids[chosen];
  1247:     return STUDY_ITEM_SUCCESS;
  1248:   }
  1249: 
  1250:   if (debug_info.known_count > 0 &&
  1251:       debug_info.item_level_blocked_count == 0 &&
  1252:       debug_info.path_blocked_count == 0)
  1253:     return STUDY_ITEM_ALL_KNOWN;
  1254: 
  1255:   if (debug_info.item_level_blocked_count > 0 &&
  1256:       debug_info.known_count == 0 &&
  1257:       debug_info.path_blocked_count == 0)
  1258:     return STUDY_ITEM_ALL_TOO_ADVANCED;
  1259: 
  1260:   if (debug_info.path_blocked_count > 0 &&
  1261:       debug_info.known_count == 0 &&
  1262:       debug_info.item_level_blocked_count == 0)
  1263:     return STUDY_ITEM_ALL_BLOCKED_PATH;
  1264: 
  1265:   if (debug_info.known_count == raw_spell_count)
  1266:     return STUDY_ITEM_ALL_KNOWN;
  1267: 
  1268:   if (debug_info.item_level_blocked_count == raw_spell_count)
  1269:     return STUDY_ITEM_ALL_TOO_ADVANCED;
  1270: 
  1271:   if (debug_info.path_blocked_count == raw_spell_count)
  1272:     return STUDY_ITEM_ALL_BLOCKED_PATH;
  1273: 
  1274:   return STUDY_ITEM_NO_STUDYABLE_SPELLS;
  1275: }
  1276: 
  1277: static int study_is_on_cooldown(struct char_data *ch, time_t now)
  1278: {
  1279:   time_t cooldown_until = GET_STUDY_COOLDOWN_UNTIL(ch);
  1280: 
  1281:   return (cooldown_until > now);
  1282: }
  1283: 
  1284: static int study_success_chance(struct char_data *ch, int source_level, int source_complexity)
  1285: {
  1286:   int study_pct;
  1287:   int level_delta;
  1288:   int chance;
  1289: 
  1290:   if (!ch)
  1291:     return 0;
  1292: 
  1293:   study_pct = GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_STUDY);
  1294:   if (study_pct < 0)
  1295:     study_pct = 0;
  1296:   if (study_pct > 100)
  1297:     study_pct = 100;
  1298: 
  1299:   if (source_level < 1)
  1300:     source_level = 1;
  1301:   if (source_complexity < 1)
  1302:     source_complexity = 1;
  1303: 
  1304:   level_delta = GET_LEVEL(ch) - source_level;
  1305: 
  1306:   /* Keep low Study mastery difficult while still allowing easy sources. */
  1307:   chance = 5 + (study_pct * 3) / 4;
  1308:   chance += URANGE(-20, level_delta * 4, 20);
  1309:   if (source_level <= 5)
  1310:     chance += 10;
  1311:   else if (source_level <= 10)
  1312:     chance += 5;
  1313: 
  1314:   /* Simpler sources (single-technique study) are slightly easier. */
  1315:   chance += (source_complexity == 1) ? 5 : 0;
  1316: 
  1317:   return URANGE(3, chance, 95);
  1318: }
  1319: 
  1320: static int study_attempt_succeeds(struct char_data *ch, int source_level, int source_complexity)
  1321: {
  1322:   int chance = study_success_chance(ch, source_level, source_complexity);
  1323:   return (rand_number(1, 100) <= chance);
  1324: }
  1325: 
  1326: static void study_apply_cooldown(struct char_data *ch, time_t now, int cooldown_secs)
  1327: {
  1328:   GET_STUDY_COOLDOWN_UNTIL(ch) = now + cooldown_secs;
  1329: }
  1330: 
  1331: ACMD(do_study)
  1332: {
  1333:   struct obj_data *study_obj = NULL;
  1334:   char reason[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1335:   char argument_copy[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1336:   int ability_id;
  1337:   int requested_ability_id = -1;
  1338:   int has_requested_ability = FALSE;
  1339:   int used_numbered_item_token = FALSE;
  1340:   int parsed_item = FALSE;
  1341:   enum study_item_result item_result;
  1342:   const int study_cooldown_secs = 2;
  1343:   time_t now = time(NULL);
  1344:   int source_level = 1;
  1345:   int source_complexity = 1;
  1346: 
  1347:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  1348: 
  1349:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  1350:     return;
  1351: 
  1352:   if (!*argument) {
  1353:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: study <spell, skill, or magical item>\r\n");
  1354:     return;
  1355:   }
  1356: 
  1357:   if (study_is_on_cooldown(ch, now)) {
  1358:     send_to_char(ch, "You need a moment to gather your thoughts before studying again.\r\n");
  1359:     return;
  1360:   }
  1361: 
  1362:   if (GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_STUDY) <= 0) {
  1363:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not yet understand how to study new techniques.\r\n");
  1364:     return;
  1365:   }
  1366: 
  1367:   ability_id = find_skill_num(argument);
  1368:   if (study_is_valid_ability_id(ability_id)) {
  1369:     if (!study_can_learn_ability(ch, ability_id, reason, sizeof(reason))) {
  1370:       send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", *reason ? reason : "You cannot study that right now.");
  1371:       study_apply_cooldown(ch, now, study_cooldown_secs);
  1372:       return;
  1373:     }
  1374:     source_level = classtrack_get_study_min_level(ability_id);
  1375:     if (source_level < 1)
  1376:       source_level = 1;
  1377:     if (!study_attempt_succeeds(ch, source_level, 1)) {
  1378:       send_to_char(ch, "You misread the pattern and learn nothing.\r\n");
  1379:       study_apply_cooldown(ch, now, study_cooldown_secs);
  1380:       return;
  1381:     }
  1382: 
  1383:     SET_SKILL(ch, ability_id, 1);
  1384:     classtrack_record_study_learn_level(ch, ability_id, GET_LEVEL(ch));
  1385:     send_to_char(ch, "You study the knowledge of %s and begin to understand it.\r\n",
  1386:                  spell_info[ability_id].name);
  1387:     study_apply_cooldown(ch, now, study_cooldown_secs);
  1388:     return;
  1389:   }
  1390: 
  1391:   strlcpy(argument_copy, argument, sizeof(argument_copy));
  1392:   parsed_item = study_find_item_and_target(ch, argument_copy, &study_obj,
  1393:                                            &requested_ability_id, &has_requested_ability,
  1394:                                            &used_numbered_item_token);
  1395:   if (!parsed_item || !study_obj) {
  1396:     if (used_numbered_item_token)
  1397:       send_to_char(ch, "You do not have that item to study.\r\n");
  1398:     else
  1399:       send_to_char(ch, "You do not recognize that technique.\r\n");
  1400:     return;
  1401:   }
  1402: 
  1403:   item_result = study_try_from_item(ch, study_obj, requested_ability_id,
  1404:                                     has_requested_ability, &ability_id);
  1405:   if (item_result != STUDY_ITEM_SUCCESS) {
  1406:     switch (item_result) {
  1407:       case STUDY_ITEM_INVALID_SOURCE:
  1408:       case STUDY_ITEM_NO_VALID_SLOTS:
  1409:         send_to_char(ch, "You study %s, but there is no technique within it for you to study.\r\n",
  1410:                      study_obj->short_description);
  1411:         break;
  1412:       case STUDY_ITEM_TARGET_NOT_PRESENT:
  1413:         send_to_char(ch, "You study %s, but that item does not contain that technique.\r\n",
  1414:                      study_obj->short_description);
  1415:         break;
  1416:       case STUDY_ITEM_ALL_KNOWN:
  1417:         send_to_char(ch, "You study %s, but you already know all of the knowledge bound within it.\r\n",
  1418:                      study_obj->short_description);
  1419:         break;
  1420:       case STUDY_ITEM_ALL_TOO_ADVANCED:
  1421:         send_to_char(ch, "You study %s, but it is beyond your current ability to study.\r\n",
  1422:                      study_obj->short_description);
  1423:         break;
  1424:       case STUDY_ITEM_ALL_BLOCKED_PATH:
  1425:         send_to_char(ch, "You study %s, but your current path rejects the knowledge bound within it.\r\n",
  1426:                      study_obj->short_description);
  1427:         break;
  1428:       case STUDY_ITEM_NO_STUDYABLE_SPELLS:
  1429:       default:
  1430:         send_to_char(ch, "You study %s, but cannot yet make use of the knowledge bound within it.\r\n",
  1431:                      study_obj->short_description);
  1432:         break;
  1433:     }
  1434:     study_debug_imm(ch,
  1435:                     "item-study final=%s item='%s' vnum=%d item_level=%d player_level=%d target=%s learned=none",
  1436:                     study_item_result_name(item_result),
  1437:                     study_obj->short_description,
  1438:                     GET_OBJ_VNUM(study_obj),
  1439:                     GET_OBJ_LEVEL(study_obj),
  1440:                     GET_LEVEL(ch),
  1441:                     (has_requested_ability && study_is_valid_ability_id(requested_ability_id)) ?
  1442:                       spell_info[requested_ability_id].name : "auto");
  1443:     if (item_result != STUDY_ITEM_INVALID_SOURCE &&
  1444:         item_result != STUDY_ITEM_NO_VALID_SLOTS &&
  1445:         item_result != STUDY_ITEM_TARGET_NOT_PRESENT)
  1446:       study_apply_cooldown(ch, now, study_cooldown_secs);
  1447:     return;
  1448:   }
  1449: 
  1450:   source_level = GET_OBJ_LEVEL(study_obj);
  1451:   source_complexity = 0;
  1452:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj) == ITEM_SCROLL ||
  1453:       GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj) == ITEM_WAND ||
  1454:       GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj) == ITEM_STAFF ||
  1455:       GET_OBJ_TYPE(study_obj) == ITEM_POTION) {
  1456:     int i;
  1457:     for (i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
  1458:       int sid = GET_OBJ_VAL(study_obj, i);
  1459:       if (study_is_valid_ability_id(sid))
  1460:         source_complexity++;
  1461:     }
  1462:   }
  1463:   if (!study_attempt_succeeds(ch, source_level, source_complexity)) {
  1464:     send_to_char(ch, "You fail to properly grasp the knowledge within it.\r\n");
  1465:     study_debug_imm(ch,
  1466:                     "item-study final=attempt-failed item='%s' vnum=%d item_level=%d player_level=%d stored_spell=%s learned=none",
  1467:                     study_obj->short_description,
  1468:                     GET_OBJ_VNUM(study_obj),
  1469:                     GET_OBJ_LEVEL(study_obj),
  1470:                     GET_LEVEL(ch),
  1471:                     spell_info[ability_id].name);
  1472:     study_apply_cooldown(ch, now, study_cooldown_secs);
  1473:     return;
  1474:   }
  1475: 
  1476:   SET_SKILL(ch, ability_id, 1);
  1477:   classtrack_record_study_learn_level(ch, ability_id, GET_LEVEL(ch));
  1478:   player_record_identified_item(ch, study_obj);
  1479:   if (has_requested_ability)
  1480:     send_to_char(ch, "You focus on %s within %s and begin to understand it.\r\n",
  1481:                  spell_info[ability_id].name, study_obj->short_description);
  1482:   else
  1483:     send_to_char(ch, "You study %s and begin to understand %s.\r\n",
  1484:                  study_obj->short_description, spell_info[ability_id].name);
  1485:   study_debug_imm(ch,
  1486:                   "item-study final=%s item='%s' vnum=%d item_level=%d player_level=%d stored_spell=%s learned=%s",
  1487:                   study_item_result_name(STUDY_ITEM_SUCCESS),
  1488:                   study_obj->short_description,
  1489:                   GET_OBJ_VNUM(study_obj),
  1490:                   GET_OBJ_LEVEL(study_obj),
  1491:                   GET_LEVEL(ch),
  1492:                   spell_info[ability_id].name,
  1493:                   spell_info[ability_id].name);
  1494:   study_apply_cooldown(ch, now, study_cooldown_secs);
  1495: }

  1645:     stat_label = "Strength";
  1646:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "dex")) {

  1660:     stat_name = "wis";
  1661:     stat_label = "Wisdom";
  1662:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "cha")) {

  1699:     new_evasion = compute_evasion(ch);
  1700:     new_melee_crit = crit_total_melee(ch);

  1730:   send_to_char(ch, "Train str dex con int wis cha (cost 1, cap %d) or hit mana move (cost 10).\r\n",
  1731:                stat_cap);
  1732: }

  1782:   else if (strlen(argument) > MAX_TITLE_LENGTH)
  1783:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, titles can't be longer than %d characters.\r\n", MAX_TITLE_LENGTH);
  1784:   else {
  1785:     set_title(ch, argument);
  1786:     send_to_char(ch, "Okay, you're now %s%s%s.\r\n", GET_NAME(ch), *GET_TITLE(ch) ? " " : "", GET_TITLE(ch));
  1787:     save_char(ch);
  1788:   }
  1789: }

  1791: static void print_group(struct char_data *ch)
  1792: {
  1793:   struct char_data * k;
  1794: 
  1795:   send_to_char(ch, "Your group consists of:\r\n");
  1796: 
  1797:   while ((k = (struct char_data *) simple_list(ch->group->members)) != NULL)
  1798:     send_to_char(ch, "%-*s: %s[%4d/%-4d]H [%4d/%-4d]M [%4d/%-4d]V%s\r\n",
  1799: 	    count_color_chars(GET_NAME(k))+22, GET_NAME(k), 
  1800:             GROUP_LEADER(GROUP(ch)) == k ? CBGRN(ch, C_NRM) : CCGRN(ch, C_NRM),
  1801:             GET_HIT(k), GET_MAX_HIT(k),
  1802:             GET_MANA(k), effective_max_mana(k),
  1803:             GET_MOVE(k), GET_MAX_MOVE(k),
  1804:             CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1805: }
  1806: 
  1807: static void display_group_list(struct char_data * ch)
  1808: {
  1809:   struct group_data * group;
  1810:   int count = 0;
  1811: 	
  1812:   if (group_list->iSize) {
  1813:     send_to_char(ch, "#   Group Leader     # of Members    In Zone\r\n"
  1814:                      "---------------------------------------------------\r\n");
  1815: 		
  1816:     while ((group = (struct group_data *) simple_list(group_list)) != NULL) {
  1817: 			if (IS_SET(GROUP_FLAGS(group), GROUP_NPC))
  1818: 			  continue;
  1819:       if (GROUP_LEADER(group) && !IS_SET(GROUP_FLAGS(group), GROUP_ANON))
  1820:         send_to_char(ch, "%-2d) %s%-12s     %-2d              %s%s\r\n", 
  1821:           ++count,
  1822:           IS_SET(GROUP_FLAGS(group), GROUP_OPEN) ? CCGRN(ch, C_NRM) : CCRED(ch, C_NRM), 
  1823:           GET_NAME(GROUP_LEADER(group)), group->members->iSize, zone_table[world[IN_ROOM(GROUP_LEADER(group))].zone].name,
  1824:           CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1825:       else
  1826:         send_to_char(ch, "%-2d) Hidden\r\n", ++count);
  1827: 				
  1828: 		}
  1829:   }
  1830:   if (count)
  1831:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n"
  1832:                      "%sSeeking Members%s\r\n"
  1833:                      "%sClosed%s\r\n", 
  1834:                      CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1835:                      CCRED(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1836:   else
  1837:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n"
  1838:                      "Currently no groups formed.\r\n");
  1839: }
  1840: 
  1841: /* Vatiken's Group System: Version 1.1 */
  1842: ACMD(do_group)
  1843: {
  1844:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1845:   struct char_data *vict;
  1846: 
  1847:   argument = one_argument(argument, buf);
  1848: 
  1849:   if (!*buf) {
  1850:     if (GROUP(ch))
  1851:       print_group(ch);
  1852:     else
  1853:       send_to_char(ch, "You must specify a group option, or type HELP GROUP for more info.\r\n");
  1854:     return;
  1855:   }
  1856:   
  1857:   if (is_abbrev(buf, "new")) {
  1858:     if (GROUP(ch))
  1859:       send_to_char(ch, "You are already in a group.\r\n");
  1860:     else
  1861:       create_group(ch);
  1862:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf, "list"))
  1863:     display_group_list(ch);
  1864:   else if (is_abbrev(buf, "join")) {
  1865:     skip_spaces(&argument);
  1866:     if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, argument, NULL, FIND_CHAR_ROOM))) {
  1867:       send_to_char(ch, "Join who?\r\n");
  1868:       return;
  1869:     } else if (vict == ch) {
  1870:       send_to_char(ch, "That would be one lonely grouping.\r\n");
  1871:       return;
  1872:     } else if (GROUP(ch)) {
  1873:       send_to_char(ch, "But you are already part of a group.\r\n");
  1874:       return;
  1875:     } else if (!GROUP(vict)) {
  1876:       act("$E$u is not part of a group!", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1877:       return;
  1878:     } else if (!IS_SET(GROUP_FLAGS(GROUP(vict)), GROUP_OPEN)) {
  1879:       send_to_char(ch, "That group isn't accepting members.\r\n");
  1880:       return;
  1881:     }   
  1882:     join_group(ch, GROUP(vict)); 
  1883:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf, "kick")) {
  1884:     skip_spaces(&argument);
  1885:     if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, argument, NULL, FIND_CHAR_ROOM))) {
  1886:       send_to_char(ch, "Kick out who?\r\n");
  1887:       return;
  1888:     } else if (vict == ch) {
  1889:       send_to_char(ch, "There are easier ways to leave the group.\r\n");
  1890:       return;
  1891:     } else if (!GROUP(ch) ) {
  1892:       send_to_char(ch, "But you are not part of a group.\r\n");
  1893:       return;
  1894:     } else if (GROUP_LEADER(GROUP(ch)) != ch ) {
  1895:       send_to_char(ch, "Only the group's leader can kick members out.\r\n");
  1896:       return;
  1897:     } else if (GROUP(vict) != GROUP(ch)) {
  1898:       act("$E$u is not a member of your group!", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1899:       return;
  1900:     } 
  1901:     send_to_char(ch, "You have kicked %s out of the group.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict));
  1902:     send_to_char(vict, "You have been kicked out of the group.\r\n"); 
  1903:     leave_group(vict);
  1904:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf, "regroup")) {
  1905:     if (!GROUP(ch)) {
  1906:       send_to_char(ch, "But you aren't part of a group!\r\n");
  1907:       return;
  1908:     }
  1909:     vict = GROUP_LEADER(GROUP(ch));
  1910:     if (ch == vict) {
  1911:       send_to_char(ch, "You are the group leader and cannot re-group.\r\n");
  1912:     } else {
  1913:       leave_group(ch);
  1914:       join_group(ch, GROUP(vict));
  1915:     }
  1916:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf, "leave")) {
  1917:     
  1918:     if (!GROUP(ch)) {
  1919:       send_to_char(ch, "But you aren't part of a group!\r\n");
  1920:       return;
  1921:     }
  1922: 		
  1923:     leave_group(ch);
  1924:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf, "option")) {
  1925:     skip_spaces(&argument);
  1926:     if (!GROUP(ch)) {
  1927:       send_to_char(ch, "But you aren't part of a group!\r\n");
  1928:       return;
  1929:     } else if (GROUP_LEADER(GROUP(ch)) != ch) {
  1930:       send_to_char(ch, "Only the group leader can adjust the group flags.\r\n");
  1931:       return;
  1932:     }
  1933:     if (is_abbrev(argument, "open")) {
  1934:       TOGGLE_BIT(GROUP_FLAGS(GROUP(ch)), GROUP_OPEN);
  1935:       send_to_char(ch, "The group is now %s to new members.\r\n", IS_SET(GROUP_FLAGS(GROUP(ch)), GROUP_OPEN) ? "open" : "closed");
  1936:     } else if (is_abbrev(argument, "anonymous")) {
  1937:       TOGGLE_BIT(GROUP_FLAGS(GROUP(ch)), GROUP_ANON);
  1938:       send_to_char(ch, "The group location is now %s to other players.\r\n", IS_SET(GROUP_FLAGS(GROUP(ch)), GROUP_ANON) ? "invisible" : "visible");
  1939:     } else 
  1940:       send_to_char(ch, "The flag options are: Open, Anonymous\r\n");
  1941:   } else {
  1942:     send_to_char(ch, "You must specify a group option, or type HELP GROUP for more info.\r\n");		
  1943:   }
  1944: 
  1945: }

  1947: static struct char_data *find_charmed_follower(struct char_data *ch, const char *name)
  1948: {
  1949:   struct follow_type *follower;
  1950:   struct char_data *first_charmed = NULL, *named_match = NULL, *pet_named = NULL;
  1951: 
  1952:   for (follower = ch->followers; follower; follower = follower->next) {
  1953:     struct char_data *current = follower->follower;
  1954: 
  1955:     if (!current || current->master != ch)
  1956:       continue;
  1957:     if (!AFF_FLAGGED(current, AFF_CHARM))
  1958:       continue;
  1959: 
  1960:     if (!first_charmed)
  1961:       first_charmed = current;
  1962: 
  1963:     if (!pet_named && isname("pet", current->player.name))
  1964:       pet_named = current;
  1965: 
  1966:     if (name && *name && isname(name, current->player.name)) {
  1967:       named_match = current;
  1968:       break;
  1969:     }
  1970:   }
  1971: 
  1972:   if (named_match)
  1973:     return named_match;
  1974:   if (name && *name)
  1975:     return NULL;
  1976:   if (pet_named)
  1977:     return pet_named;
  1978: 
  1979:   return first_charmed;
  1980: }
  1981: 
  1982: static void detach_charmed_follower(struct char_data *pet)
  1983: {
  1984:   struct follow_type *f, *prev = NULL;
  1985: 
  1986:   if (!pet || !pet->master)
  1987:     return;
  1988: 
  1989:   for (f = pet->master->followers; f; prev = f, f = f->next) {
  1990:     if (f->follower != pet)
  1991:       continue;
  1992: 
  1993:     if (prev)
  1994:       prev->next = f->next;
  1995:     else
  1996:       pet->master->followers = f->next;
  1997: 
  1998:     free(f);
  1999:     break;
  2000:   }
  2001: 
  2002:   pet->master = NULL;
  2003: }

  2005: ACMD(do_pet_release)
  2006: {
  2007:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2008:   struct char_data *pet;
  2009: 
  2010:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  2011: 
  2012:   if (!*arg) {
  2013:     send_to_char(ch, "Dismiss whom?\r\n");
  2014:     return;
  2015:   }
  2016: 
  2017:   if (!(pet = get_char_room_vis(ch, arg, NULL))) {
  2018:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
  2019:     return;
  2020:   }
  2021: 
  2022:   if (pet->master != ch) {
  2023:     send_to_char(ch, "That pet is not following you.\r\n");
  2024:     return;
  2025:   }
  2026: 
  2027:   if (!IS_NPC(pet)) {
  2028:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(pet, AFF_CHARM))
  2029:       break_charm_follower(ch, pet);
  2030:     else
  2031:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only dismiss a charmed follower.\r\n");
  2032:     return;
  2033:   }
  2034: 
  2035:   if (!is_purchased_pet(ch, pet)) {
  2036:     send_to_char(ch, "You can only dismiss a purchased pet.\r\n");
  2037:     return;
  2038:   }
  2039: 
  2040:   act("$N stops following you.", FALSE, ch, 0, pet, TO_CHAR);
  2041:   act("$N stops following $n.", FALSE, ch, 0, pet, TO_ROOM);
  2042: 
  2043:   if (pet->master) {
  2044:     struct follow_type *f, *prev = NULL;
  2045: 
  2046:     for (f = ch->followers; f; prev = f, f = f->next) {
  2047:       if (f->follower != pet)
  2048:         continue;
  2049: 
  2050:       if (prev)
  2051:         prev->next = f->next;
  2052:       else
  2053:         ch->followers = f->next;
  2054: 
  2055:       free(f);
  2056:       break;
  2057:     }
  2058: 
  2059:     pet->master = NULL;
  2060:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(pet), AFF_CHARM);
  2061:   }
  2062: 
  2063:   extract_char(pet);
  2064: }

  2066: ACMD(do_heel)

  2309: ACMD(do_opet)
  2310: {
  2311:   char first_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], command_part[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2312:   char cmd_sub[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], target[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2313:   char order_argument[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH * 2];
  2314:   struct char_data *follower;
  2315:   const char *usage =
  2316:     "Usage: opet [follower] stay | opet [follower] follow | opet [follower] attack <target> | opet [follower] assist <target>\r\n";
  2317: 
  2318:   half_chop(argument, first_arg, command_part);
  2319: 
  2320:   follower = find_charmed_follower(ch, first_arg);
  2321: 
  2322:   if (!follower) {
  2323:     follower = find_charmed_follower(ch, NULL);
  2324:     if (*first_arg)
  2325:       strlcpy(command_part, argument, sizeof(command_part));
  2326:   }
  2327: 
  2328:   if (!follower || follower->master != ch) {
  2329:     send_to_char(ch, "You have no charmed follower to command.\r\n");
  2330:     return;
  2331:   }
  2332: 
  2333:   if (!*command_part) {
  2334:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", usage);
  2335:     return;
  2336:   }
  2337: 
  2338:   half_chop(command_part, cmd_sub, target);
  2339: 
  2340:   if (is_abbrev(cmd_sub, "stay")) {
  2341:     if (follower->master == ch) {
  2342:       act("You order $N to stay here.", FALSE, ch, 0, follower, TO_CHAR);
  2343:       act("$n orders $N to stay here.", FALSE, ch, 0, follower, TO_ROOM);
  2344:       if (GET_POS(follower) > POS_SITTING) {
  2345:         act("$n sits down obediently.", TRUE, follower, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2346:         act("$n sits down obediently.", TRUE, follower, 0, 0, TO_CHAR);
  2347:       }
  2348:       GET_POS(follower) = POS_SITTING;
  2349:     } else {
  2350:       send_to_char(ch, "%s isn't following you.\r\n", GET_NAME(follower));
  2351:     }
  2352:     return;
  2353:   } else if (is_abbrev(cmd_sub, "follow")) {
  2354:     if (follower->master && follower->master != ch)
  2355:       detach_charmed_follower(follower);
  2356: 
  2357:     if (follower->master == ch) {
  2358:       if (GET_POS(follower) < POS_STANDING) {
  2359:         act("You motion for $N to stand up and follow you.", FALSE, ch, 0, follower, TO_CHAR);
  2360:         act("$n motions for $N to stand up and follow $m.", FALSE, ch, 0, follower, TO_ROOM);
  2361:         GET_POS(follower) = POS_STANDING;
  2362:       } else
  2363:         send_to_char(ch, "%s is already following you.\r\n", GET_NAME(follower));
  2364:       return;
  2365:     }
  2366: 
  2367:     add_follower(follower, ch);
  2368:     SET_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(follower), AFF_CHARM);
  2369:     return;
  2370:   } else if (is_abbrev(cmd_sub, "attack")) {
  2371:     if (!*target) {
  2372:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: opet [follower] attack <target>\r\n");
  2373:       return;
  2374:     }
  2375: 
  2376:     snprintf(order_argument, sizeof(order_argument), "hit %s", target);
  2377:   } else if (is_abbrev(cmd_sub, "assist")) {
  2378:     if (!*target) {
  2379:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: opet [follower] assist <target>\r\n");
  2380:       return;
  2381:     }
  2382: 
  2383:     snprintf(order_argument, sizeof(order_argument), "assist %s", target);
  2384:   } else {
  2385:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", usage);
  2386:     return;
  2387:   }
  2388: 
  2389:   do_order(ch, order_argument, 0, 0);
  2390: }

  2415: ACMD(do_split)
  2416: {
  2417:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2418:   int amount, num = 0, share, rest;
  2419:   size_t len;
  2420:   struct char_data *k;
  2421:   
  2422:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  2423:     return;
  2424: 
  2425:   one_argument(argument, buf);
  2426: 
  2427:   if (is_number(buf)) {
  2428:     amount = atoi(buf);
  2429:     if (amount <= 0) {
  2430:       send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, you can't do that.\r\n");
  2431:       return;
  2432:     }
  2433:     if (amount > GET_GOLD(ch)) {
  2434:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have that much gold to split.\r\n");
  2435:       return;
  2436:     }
  2437:     
  2438:     if (GROUP(ch))
  2439:       while ((k = (struct char_data *) simple_list(GROUP(ch)->members)) != NULL)
  2440:         if (IN_ROOM(ch) == IN_ROOM(k) && !IS_NPC(k))
  2441:           num++;
  2442: 
  2443:     if (num && GROUP(ch)) {
  2444:       share = amount / num;
  2445:       rest = amount % num;
  2446:     } else {
  2447:       send_to_char(ch, "With whom do you wish to share your gold?\r\n");
  2448:       return;
  2449:     }
  2450: 
  2451:     decrease_gold(ch, share * (num - 1));
  2452: 
  2453:     /* Abusing signed/unsigned to make sizeof work. */
  2454:     len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s splits %d coins; you receive %d.\r\n",
  2455: 		GET_NAME(ch), amount, share);
  2456:     if (rest && len < sizeof(buf)) {
  2457:       snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  2458: 		"%d coin%s %s not splitable, so %s keeps the money.\r\n", rest,
  2459: 		(rest == 1) ? "" : "s", (rest == 1) ? "was" : "were", GET_NAME(ch));
  2460:     }
  2461: 
  2462:     while ((k = (struct char_data *) simple_list(GROUP(ch)->members)) != NULL)
  2463:       if (k != ch && IN_ROOM(ch) == IN_ROOM(k) && !IS_NPC(k)) {
  2464: 	      increase_gold(k, share);
  2465: 	      send_to_char(k, "%s", buf);
  2466: 			}
  2467: 
  2468:     send_to_char(ch, "You split %d coins among %d members -- %d coins each.\r\n",
  2469: 	    amount, num, share);
  2470: 
  2471:     if (rest) {
  2472:       send_to_char(ch, "%d coin%s %s not splitable, so you keep the money.\r\n",
  2473: 		rest, (rest == 1) ? "" : "s", (rest == 1) ? "was" : "were");
  2474:     }
  2475:   } else {
  2476:     send_to_char(ch, "How many coins do you wish to split with your group?\r\n");
  2477:     return;
  2478:   }
  2479: }

  2481: ACMD(do_use)
  2482: {
  2483:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2484:   struct obj_data *mag_item;
  2485: 
  2486:   half_chop(argument, arg, buf);
  2487:   if (!*arg) {
  2488:     send_to_char(ch, "What do you want to %s?\r\n", CMD_NAME);
  2489:     return;
  2490:   }
  2491:   mag_item = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD);
  2492: 
  2493:   if (!mag_item || !isname(arg, mag_item->name)) {
  2494:     switch (subcmd) {
  2495:     case SCMD_RECITE:
  2496:     case SCMD_QUAFF:
  2497:       if (!(mag_item = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
  2498: 	send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to have %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
  2499: 	return;
  2500:       }
  2501:       break;
  2502:     case SCMD_USE:
  2503:       send_to_char(ch, "You don't seem to be holding %s %s.\r\n", AN(arg), arg);
  2504:       return;
  2505:     default:
  2506:       log("SYSERR: Unknown subcmd %d passed to do_use.", subcmd);
  2507:       /* SYSERR_DESC: This is the same as the unhandled case in do_gen_ps(),
  2508:        * but in the function which handles 'quaff', 'recite', and 'use'. */
  2509:       return;
  2510:     }
  2511:   }
  2512:   switch (subcmd) {
  2513:   case SCMD_QUAFF:
  2514:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(mag_item) != ITEM_POTION) {
  2515:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only quaff potions.\r\n");
  2516:       return;
  2517:     }
  2518:     break;
  2519:   case SCMD_RECITE:
  2520:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(mag_item) != ITEM_SCROLL) {
  2521:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only recite scrolls.\r\n");
  2522:       return;
  2523:     }
  2524:     break;
  2525:   case SCMD_USE:
  2526:     if ((GET_OBJ_TYPE(mag_item) != ITEM_WAND) &&
  2527: 	(GET_OBJ_TYPE(mag_item) != ITEM_STAFF)) {
  2528:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't seem to figure out how to use it.\r\n");
  2529:       return;
  2530:     }
  2531:     break;
  2532:   }
  2533: 
  2534:   mag_objectmagic(ch, mag_item, buf);
  2535: }

  2537: ACMD(do_zap)

  2544:     send_to_char(ch, "You must hold or wield a wand to zap it.\r\n");
  2545:     return;

  2548:       !spell_info[GET_OBJ_VAL(wand, 3)].name) {
  2549:     send_to_char(ch, "That wand is malformed and cannot be activated.\r\n");
  2550:     return;
  2551:   }
  2552:   mag_objectmagic(ch, wand, argument);
  2553: }

  2752: /* Toggle auto zone reset notifications with optional on/off arguments. */
  2753: ACMD(do_azr)
  2754: {
  2755:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2756: 
  2757:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  2758:     return;
  2759: 
  2760:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  2761: 
  2762:   if (!*arg) {
  2763:     int enabled = PRF_TOG_CHK(ch, PRF_ZONERESETS);
  2764:     send_to_char(ch, "Auto zone reset notifications %s.\r\n",
  2765:                  enabled ? "enabled" : "disabled");
  2766:     return;
  2767:   }
  2768: 
  2769:   if (is_abbrev(arg, "on")) {
  2770:     SET_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(ch), PRF_ZONERESETS);
  2771:     send_to_char(ch, "Auto zone reset notifications enabled.\r\n");
  2772:   } else if (is_abbrev(arg, "off")) {
  2773:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(ch), PRF_ZONERESETS);
  2774:     send_to_char(ch, "Auto zone reset notifications disabled.\r\n");
  2775:   } else {
  2776:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: azr [on|off]\r\n");
  2777:   }
  2778: }

  2780: static void show_happyhour(struct char_data *ch)
  2781: {
  2782:   char happyexp[80], happygold[80], happyqp[80];
  2783:   int secs_left;
  2784: 
  2785:   if ((IS_HAPPYHOUR) || (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GRGOD))
  2786:   {
  2787:       if (HAPPY_TIME)
  2788:         secs_left = ((HAPPY_TIME - 1) * SECS_PER_MUD_HOUR) + next_tick;
  2789:       else
  2790:         secs_left = 0;
  2791: 
  2792:       sprintf(happyqp,   "%s+%d%%%s to Questpoints per quest\r\n", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), HAPPY_QP,   CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  2793:       sprintf(happygold, "%s+%d%%%s to Gold gained per kill\r\n",  CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), HAPPY_GOLD, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  2794:       sprintf(happyexp,  "%s+%d%%%s to Experience per kill\r\n",   CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), HAPPY_EXP,  CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  2795: 
  2796:       send_to_char(ch, "tbaMUD Happy Hour!\r\n"
  2797:                        "------------------\r\n"
  2798:                        "%s%s%sTime Remaining: %s%d%s hours %s%d%s mins %s%d%s secs\r\n",
  2799:                        (IS_HAPPYEXP || (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GOD)) ? happyexp : "",
  2800:                        (IS_HAPPYGOLD || (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GOD)) ? happygold : "",
  2801:                        (IS_HAPPYQP || (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GOD)) ? happyqp : "",
  2802:                        CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), (secs_left / 3600), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  2803:                        CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), (secs_left % 3600) / 60, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  2804:                        CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), (secs_left % 60), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM) );
  2805:   }
  2806:   else
  2807:   {
  2808:       send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, there is currently no happy hour!\r\n");
  2809:   }
  2810: }
  2811: 
  2812: ACMD(do_happyhour)
  2813: {
  2814:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], val[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2815:   int num;
  2816: 
  2817:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD)
  2818:   {
  2819:     show_happyhour(ch);
  2820:     return;
  2821:   }
  2822: 
  2823:   /* Only Imms get here, so check args */
  2824:   two_arguments(argument, arg, val);
  2825: 
  2826:   if (is_abbrev(arg, "experience"))
  2827:   {
  2828:     num = MIN(MAX((atoi(val)), 0), 1000);
  2829:     HAPPY_EXP = num;
  2830:     send_to_char(ch, "Happy Hour Exp rate set to +%d%%\r\n", HAPPY_EXP);
  2831:   }
  2832:   else if ((is_abbrev(arg, "gold")) || (is_abbrev(arg, "coins")))
  2833:   {
  2834:     num = MIN(MAX((atoi(val)), 0), 1000);
  2835:     HAPPY_GOLD = num;
  2836:     send_to_char(ch, "Happy Hour Gold rate set to +%d%%\r\n", HAPPY_GOLD);
  2837:   }
  2838:   else if ((is_abbrev(arg, "time")) || (is_abbrev(arg, "ticks")))
  2839:   {

  2916:     return;
  2917:   }
  2918:   if (show_all || subcmd == 1)
  2919:     send_to_char(ch, "Showing all spells your class can learn at any level.\r\n");
  2920:   show_ability_table_aligned(ch, 1, show_all, filter);

   145: static void zonemap_append(char *buf, size_t bufsz, size_t *len, const char *fmt, ...)
   146: {
   147:   va_list args;
   148:   int wrote;
   149: 
   150:   if (*len >= bufsz)
   151:     return;
   152: 
   153:   va_start(args, fmt);
   154:   wrote = vsnprintf(buf + *len, bufsz - *len, fmt, args);
   155:   va_end(args);
   156: 
   157:   if (wrote < 0)
   158:     return;
   159: 
   160:   if ((size_t)wrote >= bufsz - *len)
   161:     *len = bufsz - 1;
   162:   else
   163:     *len += (size_t)wrote;
   164: }

   166: static bool zonemap_has_exit_to(room_rnum from, int dir, room_rnum to)
   167: {
   168:   struct room_direction_data *exit;
   169: 
   170:   if (from == NOWHERE || to == NOWHERE || dir < NORTH || dir > WEST)
   171:     return FALSE;
   172: 
   173:   exit = W_EXIT(from, dir);
   174:   if (exit == NULL || exit->to_room == NOWHERE)
   175:     return FALSE;
   176: 
   177:   return exit->to_room == to;
   178: }

   180: static void zonemap_cell_text(room_vnum vnum, room_rnum rrnum, room_vnum player_room_vnum,
   181:                               char out[3])
   182: {
   183:   if (rrnum == NOWHERE) {
   184:     strlcpy(out, "..", 3);
   185:     return;
   186:   }
   187: 
   188:   if (player_room_vnum != NOWHERE && vnum == player_room_vnum) {
   189:     snprintf(out, 3, "@%1d", (int)(vnum % 10));
   190:     return;
   191:   }
   192: 
   193:   snprintf(out, 3, "%02d", (int)(vnum % 100));
   194: }

   196: static int purge_room(room_rnum room)
   197: {
   198:   int j;
   199:   struct char_data *vict;
   200: 
   201:   if (room == NOWHERE || room > top_of_world) return 0;
   202: 
   203:   for (vict = world[room].people; vict; vict = vict->next_in_room) {
   204:     if (!IS_NPC(vict))
   205:       continue;
   206: 
   207:     /* Dump inventory. */
   208:     while (vict->carrying)
   209:       extract_obj(vict->carrying);
   210: 
   211:     /* Dump equipment. */
   212:     for (j = 0; j < NUM_WEARS; j++)
   213:       if (GET_EQ(vict, j))
   214:         extract_obj(GET_EQ(vict, j));
   215: 
   216:     /* Dump character. */
   217:     extract_char(vict);
   218:   }
   219: 
   220:   /* Clear the ground. */
   221:   while (world[room].contents)
   222:     extract_obj(world[room].contents);
   223: 
   224:   return 1;
   225: }

   227: ACMD(do_wizhelp) 
   228: { 
   229:   extern int *cmd_sort_info; 
   230:   int no = 1, i, cmd_num; 
   231:   int level;
   232: 
   233:   if (!ch->desc)
   234:     return;
   235: 
   236:   send_to_char(ch, "The following privileged commands are available:\r\n"); 
   237:   
   238:   for (level = LVL_IMPL; level >= LVL_IMMORT; level--) { 
   239:     send_to_char(ch, "%sLevel %d%s:\r\n", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), level, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM)); 
   240:     for (no = 1, cmd_num = 1; complete_cmd_info[cmd_sort_info[cmd_num]].command[0] != '\n'; cmd_num++) { 
   241:       i = cmd_sort_info[cmd_num]; 
   242:   
   243:       if (complete_cmd_info[i].minimum_level != level) 
   244:         continue;            
   245:   
   246:       send_to_char(ch, "%-14s%s", complete_cmd_info[i].command, no++ % 7 == 0 ? "\r\n" : ""); 
   247:     } 
   248:     if (no % 7 != 1) 
   249:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n"); 
   250:     if (level != LVL_IMMORT) 
   251:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n"); 
   252:   } 
   253: }

   255: ACMD(do_echo)
   256: {
   257:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   258: 
   259:   if (!*argument)
   260:     send_to_char(ch, "Yes.. but what?\r\n");
   261:   else {
   262:     char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 4];
   263: 
   264:     if (subcmd == SCMD_EMOTE)
   265:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n %s", argument);
   266:     else {
   267:       strlcpy(buf, argument, sizeof(buf));
   268:       mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s echoed: %s", GET_NAME(ch), buf);
   269:       }
   270:     act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   271:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOREPEAT))
   272:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
   273:     else
   274:       act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_CHAR);
   275:   }
   276: }

   278: ACMD(do_send)
   279: {
   280:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   281:   struct char_data *vict;
   282: 
   283:   half_chop(argument, arg, buf);
   284: 
   285:   if (!*arg) {
   286:     send_to_char(ch, "Send what to who?\r\n");
   287:     return;

   289:   if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, arg, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD))) {
   290:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
   291:     return;
   292:   }
   293:   send_to_char(vict, "%s\r\n", buf);
   294:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s sent %s: %s", GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(vict), buf);
   295: 
   296:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOREPEAT))
   297:     send_to_char(ch, "Sent.\r\n");
   298:   else
   299:     send_to_char(ch, "You send '%s' to %s.\r\n", buf, GET_NAME(vict));

   302: /* take a string, and return an rnum.. used for goto, at, etc.  -je 4/6/93 */
   303: room_rnum find_target_room(struct char_data *ch, char *rawroomstr)
   304: {
   305:   room_rnum location = NOWHERE;
   306:   char roomstr[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   307: 
   308:   one_argument(rawroomstr, roomstr);
   309: 
   310:   if (!*roomstr) {
   311:     send_to_char(ch, "You must supply a room number or name.\r\n");
   312:     return (NOWHERE);
   313:   }
   314: 
   315:   if (isdigit(*roomstr) && !strchr(roomstr, '.')) {
   316:     if ((location = real_room((room_vnum)atoi(roomstr))) == NOWHERE) {
   317:       send_to_char(ch, "No room exists with that number.\r\n");
   318:       return (NOWHERE);
   319:     }
   320:   } else {
   321:     struct char_data *target_mob;
   322:     struct obj_data *target_obj;
   323:     char *mobobjstr = roomstr;
   324:     int num;
   325: 
   326:     num = get_number(&mobobjstr);
   327:     if ((target_mob = get_char_vis(ch, mobobjstr, &num, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)) != NULL) {
   328:       if ((location = IN_ROOM(target_mob)) == NOWHERE) {
   329:         send_to_char(ch, "That character is currently lost.\r\n");
   330:         return (NOWHERE);
   331:       }
   332:     } else if ((target_obj = get_obj_vis(ch, mobobjstr, &num)) != NULL) {
   333:       if (IN_ROOM(target_obj) != NOWHERE)
   334:         location = IN_ROOM(target_obj);
   335:       else if (target_obj->carried_by && IN_ROOM(target_obj->carried_by) != NOWHERE)
   336:         location = IN_ROOM(target_obj->carried_by);
   337:       else if (target_obj->worn_by && IN_ROOM(target_obj->worn_by) != NOWHERE)
   338:         location = IN_ROOM(target_obj->worn_by);
   339: 
   340:       if (location == NOWHERE) {
   341:         send_to_char(ch, "That object is currently not in a room.\r\n");
   342:         return (NOWHERE);
   343:       }
   344:     }
   345: 
   346:     if (location == NOWHERE) {
   347:       send_to_char(ch, "Nothing exists by that name.\r\n");
   348:       return (NOWHERE);
   349:     }
   350:   }
   351: 
   352:   /* A location has been found -- if you're >= GRGOD, no restrictions. */
   353:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GRGOD)
   354:     return (location);
   355: 
   356:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(location, ROOM_GODROOM))
   357:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not godly enough to use that room!\r\n");
   358:   else if (ROOM_FLAGGED(location, ROOM_PRIVATE) && world[location].people && world[location].people->next_in_room)
   359:     send_to_char(ch, "There's a private conversation going on in that room.\r\n");
   360:   else if (ROOM_FLAGGED(location, ROOM_HOUSE) && !House_can_enter(ch, GET_ROOM_VNUM(location)))
   361:     send_to_char(ch, "That's private property -- no trespassing!\r\n");
   362:   else
   363:     return (location);
   364: 
   365:   return (NOWHERE);
   366: }
   367: 
   368: ACMD(do_at)
   369: {
   370:   char command[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   371:   room_rnum location, original_loc;
   372: 
   373:   half_chop(argument, buf, command);
   374:   if (!*buf) {
   375:     send_to_char(ch, "You must supply a room number or a name.\r\n");
   376:     return;
   377:   }
   378: 
   379:   if (!*command) {
   380:     send_to_char(ch, "What do you want to do there?\r\n");
   381:     return;
   382:   }
   383: 
   384:   if ((location = find_target_room(ch, buf)) == NOWHERE)
   385:     return;
   386: 
   387:   /* a location has been found. */
   388:   original_loc = IN_ROOM(ch);
   389:   char_from_room(ch);
   390:   char_to_room(ch, location);
   391:   command_interpreter(ch, command);
   392: 
   393:   /* check if the char is still there */
   394:   if (IN_ROOM(ch) == location) {
   395:     char_from_room(ch);
   396:     char_to_room(ch, original_loc);
   397:   }
   398: }
   399: 
   400: ACMD(do_goto)
   401: {
   402:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   403:   room_rnum location;
   404: 
   405:   if ((location = find_target_room(ch, argument)) == NOWHERE)
   406:     return;
   407: 
   408:   if (ZONE_FLAGGED(GET_ROOM_ZONE(location), ZONE_NOIMMORT) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD)) {
   409:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, that zone is off-limits for immortals!");
   410:     return;
   411:   }
   412: 
   413:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n %s", POOFOUT(ch) ? POOFOUT(ch) : "disappears in a puff of smoke.");
   414:   act(buf, TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   415: 
   416:   char_from_room(ch);
   417:   char_to_room(ch, location);
   418: 
   419:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n %s", POOFIN(ch) ? POOFIN(ch) : "appears with an ear-splitting bang.");
   420:   act(buf, TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   421: 
   422:   look_at_room(ch, 0);
   423:   enter_wtrigger(&world[IN_ROOM(ch)], ch, -1);
   424: }
   425: 
   426: ACMD(do_trans)
   427: {
   428:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   429:   struct descriptor_data *i;
   430:   struct char_data *victim;
   431: 
   432:   one_argument(argument, buf);
   433:   if (!*buf)
   434:     send_to_char(ch, "Whom do you wish to transfer?\r\n");
   435:   else if (str_cmp("all", buf)) {
   436:     if (!(victim = get_char_vis(ch, buf, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)))
   437:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
   438:     else if (victim == ch)
   439:       send_to_char(ch, "That doesn't make much sense, does it?\r\n");
   440:     else {
   441:       if ((GET_LEVEL(ch) < GET_LEVEL(victim)) && !IS_NPC(victim)) {
   442: 	send_to_char(ch, "Go transfer someone your own size.\r\n");
   443: 	return;
   444:       }
   445:       act("$n disappears in a mushroom cloud.", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   446:       shadow_return_active_to_storage(victim, FALSE);
   447:       char_from_room(victim);
   448:       char_to_room(victim, IN_ROOM(ch));
   449:       act("$n arrives from a puff of smoke.", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   450:       act("$n has transferred you!", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_VICT);
   451:       look_at_room(victim, 0);
   452: 
   453:       enter_wtrigger(&world[IN_ROOM(victim)], victim, -1);
   454:     }
   455:   } else {			/* Trans All */
   456:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD) {
   457:       send_to_char(ch, "I think not.\r\n");
   458:       return;
   459:     }
   460: 
   461:     for (i = descriptor_list; i; i = i->next)
   462:       if (STATE(i) == CON_PLAYING && i->character && i->character != ch) {
   463: 	victim = i->character;
   464: 	if (GET_LEVEL(victim) >= GET_LEVEL(ch))
   465: 	  continue;
   466: 	act("$n disappears in a mushroom cloud.", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   467: 	shadow_return_active_to_storage(victim, FALSE);
   468: 	char_from_room(victim);
   469: 	char_to_room(victim, IN_ROOM(ch));
   470: 	act("$n arrives from a puff of smoke.", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   471: 	act("$n has transferred you!", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_VICT);
   472: 	look_at_room(victim, 0);
   473:         enter_wtrigger(&world[IN_ROOM(victim)], victim, -1);
   474:       }
   475:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
   476:   }
   477: }
   478: 
   479: ACMD(do_teleport)
   480: {
   481:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   482:   struct char_data *victim;
   483:   room_rnum target;
   484: 
   485:   two_arguments(argument, buf, buf2);
   486: 
   487:   if (!*buf)
   488:     send_to_char(ch, "Whom do you wish to teleport?\r\n");
   489:   else if (!(victim = get_char_vis(ch, buf, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)))
   490:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_NOPERSON);
   491:   else if (victim == ch)
   492:     send_to_char(ch, "Use 'goto' to teleport yourself.\r\n");
   493:   else if (GET_LEVEL(victim) >= GET_LEVEL(ch))
   494:     send_to_char(ch, "Maybe you shouldn't do that.\r\n");
   495:   else if (!*buf2)
   496:     send_to_char(ch, "Where do you wish to send this person?\r\n");
   497:   else if ((target = find_target_room(ch, buf2)) != NOWHERE) {
   498:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
   499:     act("$n disappears in a puff of smoke.", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   500:     shadow_return_active_to_storage(victim, FALSE);
   501:     char_from_room(victim);
   502:     char_to_room(victim, target);
   503:     act("$n arrives from a puff of smoke.", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   504:     act("$n has teleported you!", FALSE, ch, 0, (char *) victim, TO_VICT);
   505:     look_at_room(victim, 0);
   506:     enter_wtrigger(&world[IN_ROOM(victim)], victim, -1);
   507:   }
   508: }

   510: ACMD(do_vnum)
   511: {
   512:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   513:   int good_arg = 0;
   514: 
   515:   half_chop(argument, buf, buf2);
   516: 
   517:   if (!*buf || !*buf2) {
   518:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: vnum { obj | mob | room | trig } <name>\r\n");
   519:     return;
   520:   }
   521:   if (is_abbrev(buf, "mob") && (good_arg = 1))
   522:     if (!vnum_mobile(buf2, ch))
   523:       send_to_char(ch, "No mobiles by that name.\r\n");
   524: 
   525:   if (is_abbrev(buf, "obj") && (good_arg =1 ))
   526:     if (!vnum_object(buf2, ch))
   527:       send_to_char(ch, "No objects by that name.\r\n");
   528: 
   529:   if (is_abbrev(buf, "room") && (good_arg = 1))
   530:     if (!vnum_room(buf2, ch))
   531:       send_to_char(ch, "No rooms by that name.\r\n");
   532: 
   533:   if (is_abbrev(buf, "trig") && (good_arg = 1))
   534:     if (!vnum_trig(buf2, ch))
   535:       send_to_char(ch, "No triggers by that name.\r\n");
   536: 
   537:   if (!good_arg)
   538:      send_to_char(ch, "Usage: vnum { obj | mob | room | trig } <name>\r\n");
   539:  }

   541: #define ZOCMD zone_table[zrnum].cmd[subcmd]

   543: static void list_zone_commands_room(struct char_data *ch, room_vnum rvnum)
   544: {
   545:   zone_rnum zrnum = real_zone_by_thing(rvnum);
   546:   room_rnum rrnum = real_room(rvnum), cmd_room = NOWHERE;
   547:   int subcmd = 0, count = 0;
   548: 
   549:   if (zrnum == NOWHERE || rrnum == NOWHERE) {
   550:     send_to_char(ch, "No zone information available.\r\n");
   551:     return;
   552:   }
   553: 
   554:   get_char_colors(ch);
   555: 
   556:   send_to_char(ch, "Zone commands in this room:%s\r\n", yel);
   557:   while (ZOCMD.command != 'S') {
   558:     switch (ZOCMD.command) {
   559:       case 'M':
   560:       case 'O':
   561:       case 'T':
   562:       case 'V':
   563:         cmd_room = ZOCMD.arg3;
   564:         break;
   565:       case 'D':
   566:       case 'R':
   567:         cmd_room = ZOCMD.arg1;
   568:         break;
   569:       default:
   570:         break;
   571:     }
   572:     if (cmd_room == rrnum) {
   573:       count++;
   574:       /* start listing */
   575:       switch (ZOCMD.command) {
   576:         case 'M':
   577:           send_to_char(ch, "%sLoad %s [%s%d%s], Max : %d\r\n",
   578:                   ZOCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   579:                   mob_proto[ZOCMD.arg1].player.short_descr, cyn,
   580:                   mob_index[ZOCMD.arg1].vnum, yel, ZOCMD.arg2
   581:                   );
   582:           break;
   583:         case 'G':
   584:           send_to_char(ch, "%sGive it %s [%s%d%s], Max : %d\r\n",
   585:     	      ZOCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   586:     	      obj_proto[ZOCMD.arg1].short_description,
   587:     	      cyn, obj_index[ZOCMD.arg1].vnum, yel,
   588:     	      ZOCMD.arg2
   589:     	      );
   590:           break;
   591:         case 'O':
   592:           send_to_char(ch, "%sLoad %s [%s%d%s], Max : %d\r\n",
   593:     	      ZOCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   594:     	      obj_proto[ZOCMD.arg1].short_description,
   595:     	      cyn, obj_index[ZOCMD.arg1].vnum, yel,
   596:     	      ZOCMD.arg2
   597:     	      );
   598:           break;
   599:         case 'E':
   600:           send_to_char(ch, "%sEquip with %s [%s%d%s], %s, Max : %d\r\n",
   601:     	      ZOCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   602:     	      obj_proto[ZOCMD.arg1].short_description,
   603:     	      cyn, obj_index[ZOCMD.arg1].vnum, yel,
   604:     	      equipment_types[ZOCMD.arg3],
   605:     	      ZOCMD.arg2
   606:     	      );
   607:           break;
   608:         case 'P':
   609:           send_to_char(ch, "%sPut %s [%s%d%s] in %s [%s%d%s], Max : %d\r\n",
   610:     	      ZOCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   611:     	      obj_proto[ZOCMD.arg1].short_description,
   612:     	      cyn, obj_index[ZOCMD.arg1].vnum, yel,
   613:     	      obj_proto[ZOCMD.arg3].short_description,
   614:     	      cyn, obj_index[ZOCMD.arg3].vnum, yel,
   615:     	      ZOCMD.arg2
   616:     	      );
   617:           break;
   618:         case 'R':
   619:           send_to_char(ch, "%sRemove %s [%s%d%s] from room.\r\n",
   620:     	      ZOCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   621:     	      obj_proto[ZOCMD.arg2].short_description,
   622:     	      cyn, obj_index[ZOCMD.arg2].vnum, yel
   623:     	      );
   624:           break;
   625:         case 'D':
   626:           send_to_char(ch, "%sSet door %s as %s.\r\n",
   627:     	      ZOCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   628:     	      dirs[ZOCMD.arg2],
   629:     	      ZOCMD.arg3 ? ((ZOCMD.arg3 == 1) ? "closed" : "locked") : "open"
   630:     	      );
   631:           break;
   632:         case 'T':
   633:           send_to_char(ch, "%sAttach trigger %s%s%s [%s%d%s] to %s\r\n",
   634:             ZOCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   635:             cyn, trig_index[ZOCMD.arg2]->proto->name, yel,
   636:             cyn, trig_index[ZOCMD.arg2]->vnum, yel,
   637:             ((ZOCMD.arg1 == MOB_TRIGGER) ? "mobile" :
   638:               ((ZOCMD.arg1 == OBJ_TRIGGER) ? "object" :
   639:                 ((ZOCMD.arg1 == WLD_TRIGGER)? "room" : "????"))));
   640:           break;
   641:         case 'V':
   642:           send_to_char(ch, "%sAssign global %s:%d to %s = %s\r\n",
   643:             ZOCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   644:             ZOCMD.sarg1, ZOCMD.arg2,
   645:             ((ZOCMD.arg1 == MOB_TRIGGER) ? "mobile" :
   646:               ((ZOCMD.arg1 == OBJ_TRIGGER) ? "object" :
   647:                 ((ZOCMD.arg1 == WLD_TRIGGER)? "room" : "????"))),
   648:             ZOCMD.sarg2);
   649:           break;
   650:         default:
   651:           send_to_char(ch, "<Unknown Command>\r\n");
   652:           break;
   653:       }
   654:     }
   655:     subcmd++;
   656:   }
   657:   send_to_char(ch, "%s", nrm);
   658:   if (!count)
   659:     send_to_char(ch, "None!\r\n");
   660: }
   661: #undef ZOCMD
