   663: static void do_stat_room(struct char_data *ch, struct room_data *rm)
   664: {
   665:   char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   666:   struct extra_descr_data *desc;
   667:   int i, found, column;
   668:   struct obj_data *j;
   669:   struct char_data *k;
   670: 
   671:   send_to_char(ch, "Room name: %s%s%s\r\n", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), rm->name, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   672: 
   673:   sprinttype(rm->sector_type, sector_types, buf2, sizeof(buf2));
   674:   send_to_char(ch, "Zone: [%3d], VNum: [%s%5d%s], RNum: [%5d], IDNum: [%5ld], Type: %s\r\n",
   675: 	  zone_table[rm->zone].number, CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), rm->number,
   676: 	  CCNRM(ch, C_NRM), real_room(rm->number), room_script_id(rm), buf2);
   677: 
   678:   sprintbitarray(rm->room_flags, room_bits, RF_ARRAY_MAX, buf2);
   679:   send_to_char(ch, "SpecProc: %s, Flags: %s\r\n", rm->func == NULL ? "None" : get_spec_func_name(rm->func), buf2);
   680: 
   681:   send_to_char(ch, "Description:\r\n%s", rm->description ? rm->description : "  None.\r\n");
   682: 
   683:   if (rm->ex_description) {
   684:     send_to_char(ch, "Extra descs:%s", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM));
   685:     for (desc = rm->ex_description; desc; desc = desc->next)
   686:       send_to_char(ch, " [%s]", desc->keyword);
   687:     send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   688:   }
   689: 
   690:   send_to_char(ch, "Chars present:%s", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM));
   691:   column = 14;	/* ^^^ strlen ^^^ */
   692:   for (found = FALSE, k = rm->people; k; k = k->next_in_room) {
   693:     if (!CAN_SEE(ch, k))
   694:       continue;
   695: 
   696:     column += send_to_char(ch, "%s %s(%s)", found++ ? "," : "", GET_NAME(k),
   697: 		!IS_NPC(k) ? "PC" : (!IS_MOB(k) ? "NPC" : "MOB"));
   698:     if (column >= 62) {
   699:       send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", k->next_in_room ? "," : "");
   700:       found = FALSE;
   701:       column = 0;
   702:     }
   703:   }
   704:   send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   705: 
   706:   if (rm->contents) {
   707:     send_to_char(ch, "Contents:%s", CCGRN(ch, C_NRM));
   708:     column = 9;	/* ^^^ strlen ^^^ */
   709: 
   710:     for (found = 0, j = rm->contents; j; j = j->next_content) {
   711:       if (!CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, j))
   712: 	continue;
   713: 
   714:       column += send_to_char(ch, "%s %s", found++ ? "," : "", j->short_description);
   715:       if (column >= 62) {
   716: 	send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", j->next_content ? "," : "");
   717: 	found = FALSE;
   718:         column = 0;
   719:       }
   720:     }
   721:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   722:   }
   723: 
   724:   for (i = 0; i < DIR_COUNT; i++) {
   725:     char buf1[128];
   726: 
   727:     if (!rm->dir_option[i])
   728:       continue;
   729: 
   730:     if (rm->dir_option[i]->to_room == NOWHERE)
   731:       snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), " %sNONE%s", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   732:     else
   733:       snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "%s%5d%s", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), GET_ROOM_VNUM(rm->dir_option[i]->to_room), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   734: 
   735:     sprintbit(rm->dir_option[i]->exit_info, exit_bits, buf2, sizeof(buf2));
   736: 
   737:     send_to_char(ch, "Exit %s%-5s%s:  To: [%s], Key: [%5d], Keywords: %s, Type: %s\r\n%s",
   738: 	CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), dirs[i], CCNRM(ch, C_NRM), buf1,
   739: 	rm->dir_option[i]->key == NOTHING ? -1 : rm->dir_option[i]->key,
   740: 	rm->dir_option[i]->keyword ? rm->dir_option[i]->keyword : "None", buf2,
   741: 	rm->dir_option[i]->general_description ? rm->dir_option[i]->general_description : "  No exit description.\r\n");
   742:   }
   743: 
   744:   /* check the room for a script */
   745:   do_sstat_room(ch, rm);
   746: 
   747:   list_zone_commands_room(ch, rm->number);
   748: }
   749: 
   750: static void do_stat_object(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *j)
   751: {
   752:   int i, found;
   753:   obj_vnum vnum;
   754:   struct obj_data *j2;
   755:   struct extra_descr_data *desc;
   756:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   757:   struct char_data *tempch;
   758: 
   759:   send_to_char(ch, "Name: '%s%s%s', Keywords: %s\r\n", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM),
   760: 	  j->short_description ? j->short_description : "<None>",
   761: 	  CCNRM(ch, C_NRM), j->name);
   762: 
   763:   vnum = GET_OBJ_VNUM(j);
   764:   sprinttype(GET_OBJ_TYPE(j), item_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
   765:   send_to_char(ch, "VNum: [%s%5d%s], RNum: [%5d], Idnum: [%5ld], Type: %s, SpecProc: %s\r\n",
   766:     CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), vnum, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM), GET_OBJ_RNUM(j), obj_script_id(j), buf,
   767:     GET_OBJ_SPEC(j) ? (get_spec_func_name(GET_OBJ_SPEC(j))) : "None");
   768: 
   769:   send_to_char(ch, "L-Desc: '%s%s%s'\r\n", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM),
   770: 	  j->description ? j->description : "<None>",
   771: 	  CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   772: 
   773:   send_to_char(ch, "A-Desc: '%s%s%s'\r\n", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM),
   774: 	  j->action_description ? j->action_description : "<None>",
   775: 	  CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   776: 
   777:   if (j->ex_description) {
   778:     send_to_char(ch, "Extra descs:%s", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM));
   779:     for (desc = j->ex_description; desc; desc = desc->next)
   780:       send_to_char(ch, " [%s]", desc->keyword);
   781:     send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   782:   }
   783: 
   784:   sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_WEAR(j), wear_bits, TW_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   785:   send_to_char(ch, "Can be worn on: %s\r\n", buf);
   786: 
   787:   sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_AFFECT(j), affected_bits, AF_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   788:   send_to_char(ch, "Set char bits : %s\r\n", buf);
   789: 
   790:   sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(j), extra_bits, EF_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   791:   send_to_char(ch, "Extra flags   : %s\r\n", buf);
   792: 
   793:   send_to_char(ch, "Weight: %d, Value: %d, Cost/day: %d, Timer: %d, Min level: %d\r\n",
   794:      GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(j), GET_OBJ_COST(j), GET_OBJ_RENT(j), GET_OBJ_TIMER(j), GET_OBJ_LEVEL(j));
   795: 
   796:   send_to_char(ch, "In room: %d (%s), ", GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(j)),
   797: 	IN_ROOM(j) == NOWHERE ? "Nowhere" : world[IN_ROOM(j)].name);
   798: 
   799:   /* In order to make it this far, we must already be able to see the character
   800:    * holding the object. Therefore, we do not need CAN_SEE(). */
   801:   send_to_char(ch, "In object: %s, ", j->in_obj ? j->in_obj->short_description : "None");
   802:   send_to_char(ch, "Carried by: %s, ", j->carried_by ? GET_NAME(j->carried_by) : "Nobody");
   803:   send_to_char(ch, "Worn by: %s\r\n", j->worn_by ? GET_NAME(j->worn_by) : "Nobody");
   804: 
   805:   switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(j)) {
   806:   case ITEM_LIGHT:
   807:     if (GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2) == -1)
   808:       send_to_char(ch, "Hours left: Infinite\r\n");
   809:     else
   810:       send_to_char(ch, "Hours left: [%d]\r\n", GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2));
   811:     break;
   812:   case ITEM_SCROLL:
   813:   case ITEM_POTION:
   814:     send_to_char(ch, "Spells: (Level %d) %s, %s, %s\r\n", GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0),
   815: 	    skill_name(GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1)), skill_name(GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2)),
   816: 	    skill_name(GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 3)));
   817:     break;
   818:   case ITEM_WAND:
   819:   case ITEM_STAFF:
   820:     send_to_char(ch, "Spell: %s at level %d, %d (of %d) charges remaining\r\n",
   821: 	    skill_name(GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 3)), GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0),
   822: 	    GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2), GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1));
   823:     break;
   824:   case ITEM_WEAPON:
   825:     send_to_char(ch, "Todam: %dd%d, Avg Damage: %.1f. Message type: %s\r\n",
   826: 	    GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1), GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2), ((GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2) + 1) / 2.0) * GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1),  attack_hit_text[GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 3)].singular);
   827:     break;
   828:   case ITEM_ARMOR:
   829:     send_to_char(ch, "Armor: [%d]\r\n", GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0));
   830:     break;
   831:   case ITEM_CONTAINER:
   832:     sprintbit(GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1), container_bits, buf, sizeof(buf));
   833:     send_to_char(ch, "Weight capacity: %d, Lock Type: %s, Key Num: %d, Corpse: %s\r\n",
   834: 	    GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0), buf, GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2),
   835: 	    YESNO(GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 3)));
   836:     break;
   837:   case ITEM_DRINKCON:
   838:   case ITEM_FOUNTAIN:
   839:     if (GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1) <= 0)
   840:       strlcpy(buf, "none", sizeof(buf));
   841:     else
   842:       sprinttype(GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2), drinks, buf, sizeof(buf));
   843: 
   844:     send_to_char(ch, "Capacity: %d, Contains: %d, Poisoned: %s, Liquid: %s\r\n",
   845: 	    GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0), GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1), YESNO(GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 3)), buf);
   846:     break;
   847:   case ITEM_NOTE:
   848:     send_to_char(ch, "Tongue: %d\r\n", GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0));
   849:     break;
   850:   case ITEM_KEY: /* Nothing */
   851:     break;
   852:   case ITEM_FOOD:
   853:     send_to_char(ch, "Hunger restore: %d, Thirst restore: %d, Sated duration: %d, Poisoned: %s\r\n",
   854:                  GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0), GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1), GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2), YESNO(GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 3)));
   855:     break;
   856:   case ITEM_MONEY:
   857:     send_to_char(ch, "Coins: %d\r\n", GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0));
   858:     break;
   859:   case ITEM_FURNITURE:
   860:     send_to_char(ch, "Can hold: [%d] Num. of People in: [%d]\r\n", GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0), GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1));
   861:     send_to_char(ch, "Holding : ");
   862:     for (tempch = OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(j); tempch; tempch = NEXT_SITTING(tempch))
   863:       send_to_char(ch, "%s ", GET_NAME(tempch));
   864:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   865:     break;
   866:   default:
   867:     send_to_char(ch, "Values 0-3: [%d] [%d] [%d] [%d]\r\n",
   868: 	    GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 0), GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 1),
   869: 	    GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 2), GET_OBJ_VAL(j, 3));
   870:     break;
   871:   }
   872: 
   873:   if (j->contains) {
   874:     int column;
   875: 
   876:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\nContents:%s", CCGRN(ch, C_NRM));
   877:     column = 9;	/* ^^^ strlen ^^^ */
   878: 
   879:     for (found = 0, j2 = j->contains; j2; j2 = j2->next_content) {
   880:       column += send_to_char(ch, "%s %s", found++ ? "," : "", j2->short_description);
   881:       if (column >= 62) {
   882: 	send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", j2->next_content ? "," : "");
   883: 	found = FALSE;
   884:         column = 0;
   885:       }
   886:     }
   887:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   888:   }
   889: 
   890:   found = FALSE;
   891:   send_to_char(ch, "Affections:");
   892:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; i++)
   893:     if (j->affected[i].modifier) {
   894:       sprinttype(j->affected[i].location, apply_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
   895:       send_to_char(ch, "%s %+d to %s", found++ ? "," : "", j->affected[i].modifier, buf);
   896:     }
   897:   if (!found)
   898:     send_to_char(ch, " None");
   899: 
   900:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   901: 
   902:   /* check the object for a script */
   903:   do_sstat_object(ch, j);
   904: }
   905: 
   906: static void stat_prototype_triggers(struct char_data *ch, struct trig_proto_list *scripts)
   907: {
   908:   struct trig_proto_list *script;
   909: 
   910:   send_to_char(ch, "Prototype triggers:");
   911:   for (script = scripts; script; script = script->next)
   912:     send_to_char(ch, " %d", script->vnum);
   913:   send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", scripts ? "" : " None");
   914: }
   915: 
   916: static void do_stat_object_prototype(struct char_data *ch, obj_rnum rnum)
   917: {
   918:   struct obj_data *obj = &obj_proto[rnum];
   919:   struct extra_descr_data *desc;
   920:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   921:   int i, found = FALSE;
   922: 
   923:   send_to_char(ch, "Object prototype [%d] (RNum: %d)\r\n", obj_index[rnum].vnum, rnum);
   924:   send_to_char(ch, "Live instance: none; displaying prototype data\r\n");
   925:   send_to_char(ch, "Name: '%s', Keywords: %s\r\n",
   926:                obj->short_description ? obj->short_description : "<None>",
   927:                obj->name ? obj->name : "<None>");
   928:   send_to_char(ch, "Room description: '%s'\r\nAction description: '%s'\r\n",
   929:                obj->description ? obj->description : "<None>",
   930:                obj->action_description ? obj->action_description : "<None>");
   931:   sprinttype(GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj), item_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
   932:   send_to_char(ch, "Type: %s, SpecProc: %s\r\n", buf,
   933:                obj_index[rnum].func ? get_spec_func_name(obj_index[rnum].func) : "None");
   934:   sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), wear_bits, TW_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   935:   send_to_char(ch, "Wear flags: %s\r\n", buf);
   936:   sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj), affected_bits, AF_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   937:   send_to_char(ch, "Affect flags: %s\r\n", buf);
   938:   sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj), extra_bits, EF_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   939:   send_to_char(ch, "Extra flags: %s\r\n", buf);
   940:   send_to_char(ch, "Values 0-3: [%d] [%d] [%d] [%d]\r\n",
   941:                GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3));
   942:   send_to_char(ch, "Weight: %d, Cost: %d, Rent/day: %d, Timer: %d, Min level: %d\r\n",
   943:                GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj), GET_OBJ_COST(obj), GET_OBJ_RENT(obj), GET_OBJ_TIMER(obj), GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj));
   944:   if (obj->ex_description) {
   945:     send_to_char(ch, "Extra descs:");
   946:     for (desc = obj->ex_description; desc; desc = desc->next)
   947:       send_to_char(ch, " [%s]", desc->keyword ? desc->keyword : "<None>");
   948:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   949:   }
   950:   send_to_char(ch, "Applies:");
   951:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; i++) {
   952:     if (!obj->affected[i].modifier)
   953:       continue;
   954:     sprinttype(obj->affected[i].location, apply_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
   955:     send_to_char(ch, "%s %+d to %s", found++ ? "," : "", obj->affected[i].modifier, buf);
   956:   }
   957:   send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", found ? "" : " None");
   958:   stat_prototype_triggers(ch, obj->proto_script);
   959: }

   961: static void do_stat_mobile_prototype(struct char_data *ch, mob_rnum rnum)
   962: {
   963:   struct char_data *mob = &mob_proto[rnum];
   964:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   965: 
   966:   send_to_char(ch, "Mobile prototype [%d] (RNum: %d)\r\n", mob_index[rnum].vnum, rnum);
   967:   send_to_char(ch, "Live instance: none; displaying prototype data\r\n");
   968:   send_to_char(ch, "Keywords: %s\r\nShort description: %s\r\nLong description: %s",
   969:                mob->player.name ? mob->player.name : "<None>",
   970:                mob->player.short_descr ? mob->player.short_descr : "<None>",
   971:                mob->player.long_descr ? mob->player.long_descr : "<None>\r\n");
   972:   send_to_char(ch, "Detailed description: %s", mob->player.description ? mob->player.description : "<None>\r\n");
   973:   sprinttype(GET_SEX(mob), genders, buf, sizeof(buf));
   974:   send_to_char(ch, "Level: %d, Alignment: %d, Sex: %s\r\n", GET_LEVEL(mob), GET_ALIGNMENT(mob), buf);
   975:   send_to_char(ch, "Stats: Str %d/%d, Int %d, Wis %d, Dex %d, Con %d, Cha %d\r\n",
   976:                GET_STR(mob), GET_ADD(mob), GET_INT(mob), GET_WIS(mob), GET_DEX(mob), GET_CON(mob), GET_CHA(mob));
   977:   send_to_char(ch, "Prototype resources: Hit %d, Mana %d, Move %d\r\n",
   978:                GET_MAX_HIT(mob), GET_MAX_MANA(mob), GET_MAX_MOVE(mob));
   979:   send_to_char(ch, "Gold: %lld, Experience: %d, Armor: %d, Hitroll: %d, Damroll: %d\r\n",
   980:                GET_GOLD(mob), GET_EXP(mob), mob->points.armor, mob->points.hitroll, mob->points.damroll);
   981:   send_to_char(ch, "Saving throws: [%d/%d/%d/%d/%d]\r\n", GET_SAVE(mob, 0), GET_SAVE(mob, 1),
   982:                GET_SAVE(mob, 2), GET_SAVE(mob, 3), GET_SAVE(mob, 4));
   983:   send_to_char(ch, "Attack type: %s, Bare-hand damage: %dd%d\r\n",
   984:                mob->mob_specials.attack_type < NUM_ATTACK_TYPES ?
   985:                  attack_hit_text[(int)mob->mob_specials.attack_type].singular : "<invalid>",
   986:                mob->mob_specials.damnodice, mob->mob_specials.damsizedice);
   987:   sprinttype(mob->mob_specials.default_pos, position_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
   988:   send_to_char(ch, "Default position: %s, SpecProc: %s\r\n", buf,
   989:                mob_index[rnum].func ? get_spec_func_name(mob_index[rnum].func) : "None");
   990:   sprintbitarray(MOB_FLAGS(mob), action_bits, PM_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   991:   send_to_char(ch, "NPC flags: %s\r\n", buf);
   992:   sprintbitarray(AFF_FLAGS(mob), affected_bits, AF_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   993:   send_to_char(ch, "Affect flags: %s\r\n", buf);
   994:   stat_prototype_triggers(ch, mob->proto_script);
   995: }
   996: 
   997: static bool parse_stat_vnum(const char *argument, int *vnum)
   998: {
   999:   char *end;
  1000:   long value;
  1001: 
  1002:   if (!argument || !*argument || !isdigit((unsigned char)*argument))
  1003:     return FALSE;
  1004:   errno = 0;
  1005:   value = strtol(argument, &end, 10);
  1006:   if (errno == ERANGE || *end != '\0' || value > INT_MAX)
  1007:     return FALSE;
  1008:   *vnum = (int)value;
  1009:   return TRUE;
  1010: }
  1011: 
  1012: static bool stat_vnum_token(const char *argument)
  1013: {
  1014:   const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)argument;
  1015: 
  1016:   if (!p || !*p)
  1017:     return FALSE;
  1018:   for (; *p; p++)
  1019:     if (!isdigit(*p))
  1020:       return FALSE;
  1021:   return TRUE;
  1022: }
  1023: 
  1024: static bool invalid_signed_stat_vnum(const char *argument)
  1025: {
  1026:   return argument && argument[0] == '-' && stat_vnum_token(argument + 1);
  1027: }
  1028: 
  1029: static void do_stat_character(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *k)
  1030: {
  1031:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1032:   int i, i2, column, found = FALSE;
  1033:   struct obj_data *j;
  1034:   struct follow_type *fol;
  1035:   struct affected_type *aff;
  1036: 
  1037:   sprinttype(GET_SEX(k), genders, buf, sizeof(buf));
  1038:   send_to_char(ch, "%s %s '%s'  IDNum: [%5ld], In room [%5d], Loadroom : [%5d]\r\n",
  1039: 	  buf, (!IS_NPC(k) ? "PC" : (!IS_MOB(k) ? "NPC" : "MOB")),
  1040: 	  GET_NAME(k), IS_NPC(k) ? char_script_id(k) : GET_IDNUM(k), GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(k)), IS_NPC(k) ? NOWHERE : GET_LOADROOM(k));
  1041: 
  1042:   if (IS_MOB(k)) {
  1043:     send_to_char(ch, "Keyword: %s, VNum: [%5d], RNum: [%5d]\r\n", k->player.name, GET_MOB_VNUM(k), GET_MOB_RNUM(k));
  1044:     send_to_char(ch, "L-Des: %s", k->player.long_descr ? k->player.long_descr : "<None>\r\n");
  1045:   }
  1046: 
  1047:   if (!IS_MOB(k))
  1048:     send_to_char(ch, "Title: %s\r\n", k->player.title ? k->player.title : "<None>");
  1049: 
  1050:   send_to_char(ch, "D-Des: %s", k->player.description ? k->player.description : "<None>\r\n");
  1051: 
  1052:   sprinttype(k->player.chclass, pc_class_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
  1053:   send_to_char(ch, "%s%s, Lev: [%s%2d%s], XP: [%s%7d%s], Align: [%4d]\r\n",
  1054: 	IS_NPC(k) ? "Mobile" : "Class: ", IS_NPC(k) ? "" : buf, CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), GET_LEVEL(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1055: 	CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), GET_EXP(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM), GET_ALIGNMENT(k));
  1056: 
  1057:   if (!IS_NPC(k)) {
  1058:     char buf1[64], buf2[64];
  1059: 
  1060:     strftime(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "%a %b %d %Y", localtime(&(k->player.time.birth)));
  1061:     strftime(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "%a %b %d %Y", localtime(&(k->player.time.logon)));
  1062: 
  1063:     send_to_char(ch, "Created: [%s], Last Logon: [%s]\r\n", buf1, buf2);
  1064: 
  1065:     send_to_char(ch, "Played: [%dh %dm], Age: [%d], STL[%d]/per[%d]/NSTL[%d]",
  1066:             k->player.time.played / 3600, (k->player.time.played % 3600) / 60,
  1067:             age(k)->year, GET_PRACTICES(k), int_app[GET_INT(k)].learn,
  1068: 	    wis_app[GET_WIS(k)].bonus);
  1069:     /* Display OLC zone for immorts. */
  1070:     if (GET_LEVEL(k) >= LVL_BUILDER) {
  1071:       if (GET_OLC_ZONE(k)==AEDIT_PERMISSION)
  1072:         send_to_char(ch, ", OLC[%sAedit%s]", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1073:       else if (GET_OLC_ZONE(k)==HEDIT_PERMISSION)
  1074:         send_to_char(ch, ", OLC[%sHedit%s]", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1075:       else if (GET_OLC_ZONE(k) == ALL_PERMISSION)
  1076:         send_to_char(ch, ", OLC[%sAll%s]", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1077:       else if (GET_OLC_ZONE(k)==NOWHERE)
  1078:         send_to_char(ch, ", OLC[%sOFF%s]", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1079:       else
  1080:         send_to_char(ch, ", OLC[%s%d%s]", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), GET_OLC_ZONE(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1081:     }
  1082:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
  1083:   }
  1084:   send_to_char(ch, "Str: [%s%d/%d%s]  Int: [%s%d%s]  Wis: [%s%d%s]  "
  1085: 	  "Dex: [%s%d%s]  Con: [%s%d%s]  Cha: [%s%d%s]\r\n",
  1086: 	  CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), GET_STR(k), GET_ADD(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1087: 	  CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), GET_INT(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1088: 	  CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), GET_WIS(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1089: 	  CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), GET_DEX(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1090: 	  CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), GET_CON(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1091: 	  CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), GET_CHA(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1092: 
  1093:   send_to_char(ch, "Hit p.:[%s%d/%d+%d%s]  Mana p.:[%s%d/%d+%d%s]  Move p.:[%s%d/%d+%d%s]\r\n",
  1094:           CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), GET_HIT(k), GET_MAX_HIT(k), hit_gain(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1095:           CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), GET_MANA(k), effective_max_mana(k), mana_gain(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1096:           CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), GET_MOVE(k), effective_max_move(k), move_gain(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1097: 
  1098:   send_to_char(ch, "Gold: [%9lld], Bank: [%9lld] (Total: %lld), ",
  1099: 	  GET_GOLD(k), GET_BANK_GOLD(k), GET_GOLD(k) + GET_BANK_GOLD(k));
  1100: 
  1101:   if (!IS_NPC(k))
  1102:     send_to_char(ch, "Screen %s[%s%d%sx%s%d%s]%s\r\n",
  1103:                       CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), GET_SCREEN_WIDTH(k), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
  1104:                       CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), GET_PAGE_LENGTH(k), CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1105: 
  1106:   send_to_char(ch, "Armor: [%d], Evasion: [%d], Hitroll: [%2d], Damroll: [%2d], Saving throws: [%d/%d/%d/%d/%d]\r\n",
  1107: 	  compute_armor_class(k), compute_evasion(k), k->points.hitroll,
  1108: 	  k->points.damroll, GET_SAVE(k, 0), GET_SAVE(k, 1), GET_SAVE(k, 2),
  1109: 	  GET_SAVE(k, 3), GET_SAVE(k, 4));
  1110: 
  1111:   sprinttype(GET_POS(k), position_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
  1112:   send_to_char(ch, "Pos: %s, Fighting: %s", buf, FIGHTING(k) ? GET_NAME(FIGHTING(k)) : "Nobody");
  1113: 
  1114:   if (IS_NPC(k))
  1115:     send_to_char(ch, ", Attack type: %s", attack_hit_text[(int) k->mob_specials.attack_type].singular);
  1116: 
  1117:   if (k->desc) {
  1118:     sprinttype(STATE(k->desc), connected_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
  1119:     send_to_char(ch, ", Connected: %s", buf);
  1120:   }
  1121: 
  1122:   if (IS_NPC(k)) {
  1123:     sprinttype(k->mob_specials.default_pos, position_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
  1124:     send_to_char(ch, ", Default position: %s\r\n", buf);
  1125:     sprintbitarray(MOB_FLAGS(k), action_bits, PM_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
  1126:     send_to_char(ch, "NPC flags: %s%s%s\r\n", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), buf, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1127:   } else {
  1128:     send_to_char(ch, ", Idle Timer (in tics) [%d]\r\n", k->char_specials.timer);
  1129: 
  1130:     sprintbitarray(PLR_FLAGS(k), player_bits, PM_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
  1131:     send_to_char(ch, "PLR: %s%s%s\r\n", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), buf, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1132: 
  1133:     sprintbitarray(PRF_FLAGS(k), preference_bits, PR_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
  1134:     send_to_char(ch, "PRF: %s%s%s\r\n", CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), buf, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1135: 
  1136:     send_to_char(ch, "Quest Points: [%9d] Quests Completed: [%5d]\r\n",
  1137:        GET_QUESTPOINTS(k), GET_NUM_QUESTS(k));
  1138:     if (GET_QUEST(k) != NOTHING)
  1139:       send_to_char(ch, "Current Quest: [%5d] Time Left: [%5d]\r\n",
  1140:       GET_QUEST(k), GET_QUEST_TIME(k));
  1141:   }
  1142: 
  1143:   if (IS_MOB(k))
  1144:     send_to_char(ch, "Mob Spec-Proc: %s, NPC Bare Hand Dam: %dd%d\r\n",
  1145:         (mob_index[GET_MOB_RNUM(k)].func ? get_spec_func_name(mob_index[GET_MOB_RNUM(k)].func) : "None"),
  1146: 	    k->mob_specials.damnodice, k->mob_specials.damsizedice);
  1147: 
  1148:   for (i = 0, j = k->carrying; j; j = j->next_content, i++);
  1149:   send_to_char(ch, "Carried: weight: %d, items: %d; Items in: inventory: %d, ", IS_CARRYING_W(k), IS_CARRYING_N(k), i);
  1150: 
  1151:   for (i = 0, i2 = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
  1152:     if (GET_EQ(k, i))
  1153:       i2++;
  1154:   send_to_char(ch, "eq: %d\r\n", i2);
  1155: 
  1156:   if (!IS_NPC(k))
  1157:     send_to_char(ch, "Hunger: %d, Thirst: %d, Drunk: %d\r\n", GET_COND(k, HUNGER), GET_COND(k, THIRST), GET_COND(k, DRUNK));
  1158: 
  1159:   column = send_to_char(ch, "Master is: %s, Followers are:", k->master ? GET_NAME(k->master) : "<none>");

  1161:     send_to_char(ch, " <none>\r\n");
  1162:   else {
  1163:     for (fol = k->followers; fol; fol = fol->next) {
  1164:       column += send_to_char(ch, "%s %s", found++ ? "," : "", PERS(fol->follower, ch));
  1165:       if (column >= 62) {
  1166:         send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", fol->next ? "," : "");
  1167:         found = FALSE;
  1168:         column = 0;
  1169:       }
  1170:     }
  1171:     if (column != 0)
  1172:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
  1173:   }
  1174: 
  1175:   /* Showing the bitvector */
  1176:   sprintbitarray(AFF_FLAGS(k), affected_bits, AF_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
  1177:   send_to_char(ch, "AFF: %s%s%s\r\n", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), buf, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1178: 
  1179:   /* Routine to show what spells a char is affected by */
  1180:   if (k->affected) {
  1181:     for (aff = k->affected; aff; aff = aff->next) {
  1182:       send_to_char(ch, "SPL: (%3dhr) %s%-21s%s ", aff->duration + 1, CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), skill_name(aff->spell), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1183: 
  1184:       if (aff->modifier)
  1185: 	send_to_char(ch, "%+d to %s", aff->modifier, apply_types[(int) aff->location]);

  1187:       if (aff->bitvector[0] || aff->bitvector[1] || aff->bitvector[2] || aff->bitvector[3]) {
  1188:         if (aff->modifier)
  1189:           send_to_char(ch, ", ");
  1190:         for (i=1; i<NUM_AFF_FLAGS; i++) {
  1191:           if (IS_SET_AR(aff->bitvector, i)) {
  1192:             send_to_char(ch, "sets %s, ", affected_bits[i]);
  1193:           }
  1194:         }
  1195:       }
  1196:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
  1197:     }
  1198:   }
  1199: 
  1200:   if (!IS_NPC(k) && (GET_LEVEL(k) >= LVL_IMMORT)) {
  1201:     if (POOFIN(k))
  1202:       send_to_char(ch, "%sPOOFIN:  %s%s %s%s\r\n", QYEL, QCYN, GET_NAME(k), POOFIN(k), QNRM);
  1203:     else

  1205: 
  1206:     if (POOFOUT(k))
  1207:       send_to_char(ch, "%sPOOFOUT: %s%s %s%s\r\n", QYEL, QCYN, GET_NAME(k), POOFOUT(k), QNRM);
  1208:     else

  1210:   }

  1212:   /* check mobiles for a script */
  1213:   do_sstat_character(ch, k);
  1214:   if (SCRIPT_MEM(k)) {
  1215:     struct script_memory *mem = SCRIPT_MEM(k);
  1216:     send_to_char(ch, "Script memory:\r\n  Remember             Command\r\n");
  1217:     while (mem) {
  1218:       struct char_data *mc = find_char(mem->id);
  1219:       if (!mc)
  1220:         send_to_char(ch, "  ** Corrupted!\r\n");
  1221:       else {
  1222:         if (mem->cmd)
  1223:           send_to_char(ch, "  %-20.20s%s\r\n",GET_NAME(mc),mem->cmd);
  1224:         else
  1225:           send_to_char(ch, "  %-20.20s <default>\r\n",GET_NAME(mc));
  1226:       }
  1227:     mem = mem->next;
  1228:     }
  1229:   }
  1230:   if (!(IS_NPC(k))) {
  1231:     /* this is a PC, display their global variables */
  1232:     if (k->script && k->script->global_vars) {
  1233:       struct trig_var_data *tv;
  1234:       char uname[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1235: 
  1236:       send_to_char(ch, "Global Variables:\r\n");
  1237: 
  1238:       /* currently, variable context for players is always 0, so it is not
  1239:        * displayed here. in the future, this might change */
  1240:       for (tv = k->script->global_vars; tv; tv = tv->next) {
  1241:         if (*(tv->value) == UID_CHAR) {
  1242:           find_uid_name(tv->value, uname, sizeof(uname));
  1243:           send_to_char(ch, "    %10s:  [UID]: %s\r\n", tv->name, uname);
  1244:         } else
  1245:           send_to_char(ch, "    %10s:  %s\r\n", tv->name, tv->value);
  1246:       }
  1247:     }
  1248:   }
  1249: }

  1251: ACMD(do_stat)
  1252: {
  1253:   char buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1254:   struct char_data *victim;
  1255:   struct obj_data *object;
  1256:   struct room_data *room;
  1257:   int vnum;
  1258: 
  1259:   half_chop(argument, buf1, buf2);
  1260: 
  1261:   if (!*buf1) {
  1262:     send_to_char(ch, "Stats on who or what or where?\r\n");
  1263:     return;
  1264:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf1, "room")) {
  1265:     if (!*buf2)
  1266:       room = &world[IN_ROOM(ch)];
  1267:     else {
  1268:       room_rnum rnum = real_room(atoi(buf2));
  1269:       if (rnum == NOWHERE) {
  1270:         send_to_char(ch, "That is not a valid room.\r\n");
  1271:         return;
  1272:       }
  1273:       room = &world[rnum];
  1274:     }
  1275:     do_stat_room(ch, room);
  1276:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf1, "mob") || !strcmp(buf1, "mobile")) {
  1277:     if (!*buf2)
  1278:       send_to_char(ch, "Stats on which mobile?\r\n");
  1279:     else if (stat_vnum_token(buf2) || invalid_signed_stat_vnum(buf2)) {
  1280:       if (!parse_stat_vnum(buf2, &vnum))
  1281:         send_to_char(ch, "That is not a valid mobile prototype VNUM.\r\n");
  1282:       else {
  1283:         mob_rnum rnum = real_mobile(vnum);
  1284:         if (rnum == NOBODY)
  1285:           send_to_char(ch, "No mobile prototype exists with VNUM %d.\r\n", vnum);
  1286:         else
  1287:           do_stat_mobile_prototype(ch, rnum);
  1288:       }
  1289:     } else {
  1290:       if ((victim = get_char_vis(ch, buf2, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)) != NULL)
  1291: 	do_stat_character(ch, victim);
  1292:       else
  1293: 	send_to_char(ch, "No such mobile around.\r\n");
  1294:     }
  1295:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf1, "player")) {
  1296:     if (!*buf2) {
  1297:       send_to_char(ch, "Stats on which player?\r\n");
  1298:     } else {
  1299:       if ((victim = get_player_vis(ch, buf2, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)) != NULL)
  1300: 	do_stat_character(ch, victim);
  1301:       else
  1302: 	send_to_char(ch, "No such player around.\r\n");
  1303:     }
  1304:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf1, "file")) {
  1305:     if (!*buf2)
  1306:       send_to_char(ch, "Stats on which player?\r\n");
  1307:     else if ((victim = get_player_vis(ch, buf2, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)) != NULL)
  1308: 	do_stat_character(ch, victim);
  1309:     else {
  1310:       CREATE(victim, struct char_data, 1);
  1311:       clear_char(victim);
  1312:       CREATE(victim->player_specials, struct player_special_data, 1);
  1313:       new_mobile_data(victim);
  1314:       if (load_char(buf2, victim) >= 0) {
  1315:         char_to_room(victim, 0);
  1316:         if (GET_LEVEL(victim) > GET_LEVEL(ch))
  1317: 	  send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, you can't do that.\r\n");
  1318: 	else
  1319: 	  do_stat_character(ch, victim);
  1320: 	extract_char_final(victim);
  1321:       } else {
  1322: 	send_to_char(ch, "There is no such player.\r\n");
  1323: 	free_char(victim);
  1324:       }
  1325:     }
  1326:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf1, "object")) {
  1327:     if (!*buf2)
  1328:       send_to_char(ch, "Stats on which object?\r\n");
  1329:     else if (stat_vnum_token(buf2) || invalid_signed_stat_vnum(buf2)) {
  1330:       if (!parse_stat_vnum(buf2, &vnum))
  1331:         send_to_char(ch, "That is not a valid object prototype VNUM.\r\n");
  1332:       else {
  1333:         obj_rnum rnum = real_object(vnum);
  1334:         if (rnum == NOTHING)
  1335:           send_to_char(ch, "No object prototype exists with VNUM %d.\r\n", vnum);
  1336:         else
  1337:           do_stat_object_prototype(ch, rnum);
  1338:       }
  1339:     } else {
  1340:       if ((object = get_obj_vis(ch, buf2, NULL)) != NULL)
  1341: 	do_stat_object(ch, object);
  1342:       else
  1343: 	send_to_char(ch, "No such object around.\r\n");
  1344:     }
  1345:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf1, "zone")) {
  1346:     if (!*buf2) {
  1347:       print_zone(ch, zone_table[world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone].number);
  1348:       return;
  1349:     } else {
  1350:       print_zone(ch, atoi(buf2));
  1351:       return;
  1352:     }
  1353:   } else {
  1354:     char *name = buf1;
  1355:     int number = get_number(&name);
  1356: 
  1357:     if ((object = get_obj_in_equip_vis(ch, name, &number, ch->equipment)) != NULL)
  1358:       do_stat_object(ch, object);
  1359:     else if ((object = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, name, &number, ch->carrying)) != NULL)
  1360:       do_stat_object(ch, object);
  1361:     else if ((victim = get_char_vis(ch, name, &number, FIND_CHAR_ROOM)) != NULL)
  1362:       do_stat_character(ch, victim);
  1363:     else if ((object = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, name, &number, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents)) != NULL)
  1364:       do_stat_object(ch, object);
  1365:     else if ((victim = get_char_vis(ch, name, &number, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)) != NULL)
  1366:       do_stat_character(ch, victim);
  1367:     else if ((object = get_obj_vis(ch, name, &number)) != NULL)
  1368:       do_stat_object(ch, object);
  1369:     else
  1370:       send_to_char(ch, "Nothing around by that name.\r\n");
  1371:   }
  1372: }

  1374: ACMD(do_shutdown)
  1375: {
  1376:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1377: 
  1378:   if (subcmd != SCMD_SHUTDOWN) {
  1379:     send_to_char(ch, "If you want to shut something down, say so!\r\n");
  1380:     return;
  1381:   }
  1382:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1383: 
  1384:   if (!*arg) {
  1385:     log("(GC) Shutdown by %s.", GET_NAME(ch));
  1386:     send_to_all("Shutting down.\r\n");
  1387:     circle_shutdown = 1;
  1388:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "reboot")) {
  1389:     log("(GC) Reboot by %s.", GET_NAME(ch));
  1390:     send_to_all("Rebooting.. come back in a few minutes.\r\n");
  1391:     touch(FASTBOOT_FILE);
  1392:     circle_shutdown = 1;
  1393:     circle_reboot = 2; /* do not autosave olc */
  1394:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "die")) {
  1395:     log("(GC) Shutdown by %s.", GET_NAME(ch));
  1396:     send_to_all("Shutting down for maintenance.\r\n");
  1397:     touch(KILLSCRIPT_FILE);
  1398:     circle_shutdown = 1;
  1399:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "now")) {
  1400:     log("(GC) Shutdown NOW by %s.", GET_NAME(ch));
  1401:     send_to_all("Rebooting.. come back in a minute or two.\r\n");
  1402:     circle_shutdown = 1;
  1403:     circle_reboot = 2; /* do not autosave olc */
  1404:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "pause")) {
  1405:     log("(GC) Shutdown by %s.", GET_NAME(ch));
  1406:     send_to_all("Shutting down for maintenance.\r\n");
  1407:     touch(PAUSE_FILE);
  1408:     circle_shutdown = 1;
  1409:   } else
  1410:     send_to_char(ch, "Unknown shutdown option.\r\n");
  1411: }

  1413: void snoop_check(struct char_data *ch)
  1414: {
  1415:   /*  This short routine is to ensure that characters that happen to be snooping
  1416:    *  (or snooped) and get advanced/demoted will not be snooping/snooped someone
  1417:    *  of a higher/lower level (and thus, not entitled to be snooping. */
  1418:   if (!ch || !ch->desc)
  1419:     return;
  1420:   if (ch->desc->snooping &&
  1421:      (GET_LEVEL(ch->desc->snooping->character) >= GET_LEVEL(ch))) {
  1422:     ch->desc->snooping->snoop_by = NULL;
  1423:     ch->desc->snooping = NULL;
  1424:   }
  1425: 
  1426:   if (ch->desc->snoop_by &&
  1427:      (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= GET_LEVEL(ch->desc->snoop_by->character))) {
  1428:     ch->desc->snoop_by->snooping = NULL;
  1429:     ch->desc->snoop_by = NULL;
  1430:   }
  1431: }
  1432: 
  1433: static void stop_snooping(struct char_data *ch)
  1434: {
  1435:   if (!ch->desc->snooping)
  1436:     send_to_char(ch, "You aren't snooping anyone.\r\n");
  1437:   else {
  1438:     send_to_char(ch, "You stop snooping.\r\n");
  1439: 
  1440:       mudlog(BRF, GET_LEVEL(ch), TRUE, "(GC) %s stops snooping", GET_NAME(ch));
  1441: 
  1442:     ch->desc->snooping->snoop_by = NULL;
  1443:     ch->desc->snooping = NULL;
  1444:   }
  1445: }
  1446: 
  1447: ACMD(do_snoop)
  1448: {
  1449:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1450:   struct char_data *victim, *tch;
  1451: 
  1452:   if (!ch->desc)
  1453:     return;
  1454: 
  1455:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1456: 
  1457:   if (!*arg)
  1458:     stop_snooping(ch);
  1459:   else if (!(victim = get_char_vis(ch, arg, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)))
  1460:     send_to_char(ch, "No such person around.\r\n");
  1461:   else if (!victim->desc)
  1462:     send_to_char(ch, "There's no link.. nothing to snoop.\r\n");
  1463:   else if (victim == ch)
  1464:     stop_snooping(ch);
  1465:   else if (victim->desc->snoop_by)
  1466:     send_to_char(ch, "Busy already. \r\n");
  1467:   else if (victim->desc->snooping == ch->desc)
  1468:     send_to_char(ch, "Don't be stupid.\r\n");
  1469:   else {
  1470:     if (victim->desc->original)
  1471:       tch = victim->desc->original;
  1472:     else
  1473:       tch = victim;
  1474: 
  1475:     if (GET_LEVEL(tch) >= GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  1476:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't.\r\n");
  1477:       return;
  1478:     }
  1479:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
  1480: 
  1481:       mudlog(BRF, GET_LEVEL(ch), TRUE, "(GC) %s snoops %s", GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(victim));
  1482: 
  1483:     if (ch->desc->snooping)
  1484:       ch->desc->snooping->snoop_by = NULL;
  1485: 
  1486:     ch->desc->snooping = victim->desc;
  1487:     victim->desc->snoop_by = ch->desc;
  1488:   }
  1489: }

  1491: ACMD(do_switch)
  1492: {
  1493:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1494:   struct char_data *victim;
  1495: 
  1496:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1497: 
  1498:   if (ch->desc->original)
  1499:     send_to_char(ch, "You're already switched.\r\n");
  1500:   else if (!*arg)
  1501:     send_to_char(ch, "Switch with who?\r\n");
  1502:   else if (!(victim = get_char_vis(ch, arg, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)))
  1503:     send_to_char(ch, "No such character.\r\n");
  1504:   else if (ch == victim)
  1505:     send_to_char(ch, "Hee hee... we are jolly funny today, eh?\r\n");
  1506:   else if (victim->desc)
  1507:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't do that, the body is already in use!\r\n");
  1508:   else if ((GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMPL) && !IS_NPC(victim))
  1509:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not holy enough to use their body.\r\n");
  1510:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD && ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(victim), ROOM_GODROOM))
  1511:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not godly enough to use that room!\r\n");
  1512:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD && ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(victim), ROOM_HOUSE)
  1513: 		&& !House_can_enter(ch, GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(victim))))
  1514:     send_to_char(ch, "That's private property -- no trespassing!\r\n");
  1515:   else {
  1516:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
  1517:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s Switched into: %s", GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(victim));
  1518:     ch->desc->character = victim;
  1519:     ch->desc->original = ch;
  1520: 
  1521:     victim->desc = ch->desc;
  1522:     ch->desc = NULL;
  1523:   }
  1524: }
  1525: 
  1526: static void do_cheat(struct char_data *ch)
  1527: {
  1528:   switch (GET_IDNUM(ch)) {
  1529:     case    1: // IMP
  1530:       GET_LEVEL(ch) = LVL_IMPL;
  1531:       break;
  1532:     default:
  1533:       send_to_char(ch, "You do not have access to this command.\r\n");
  1534:   return;
  1535:   }
  1536:   send_to_char(ch, "Your level has been restored, for now!\r\n");
  1537:   save_char(ch);
  1538: }
  1539: 
  1540: void return_to_char(struct char_data * ch)
  1541: {
  1542:   /* If someone switched into your original body, disconnect them. - JE
  1543:   * Zmey: here we put someone switched in our body to disconnect state but
  1544:   * we must also NULL his pointer to our character, otherwise close_socket()
  1545:   * will damage our character's pointer to our descriptor (which is assigned
  1546:   * below in this function). */
  1547:   if (ch->desc->original->desc) {
  1548:     ch->desc->original->desc->character = NULL;
  1549:     STATE(ch->desc->original->desc) = CON_DISCONNECT;
  1550:   }
  1551: 
  1552:   /* Now our descriptor points to our original body. */
  1553:   ch->desc->character = ch->desc->original;
  1554:   ch->desc->original = NULL;
  1555: 
  1556:   /* And our body's pointer to descriptor now points to our descriptor. */
  1557:   ch->desc->character->desc = ch->desc;
  1558:   ch->desc = NULL;  
  1559: }
  1560: 
  1561: ACMD(do_return)
  1562: {
  1563:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && !ch->desc->original) {
  1564:     int level, newlevel;
  1565:     level = GET_LEVEL(ch);
  1566:     do_cheat(ch);
  1567:     newlevel = GET_LEVEL(ch);
  1568:     if (!PLR_FLAGGED(ch, PLR_NOWIZLIST)&& level != newlevel)
  1569:       run_autowiz();
  1570:   }
  1571: 
  1572:   if (ch->desc && ch->desc->original) {
  1573:     send_to_char(ch, "You return to your original body.\r\n");
  1574:     return_to_char(ch);
  1575:   }
  1576: }

  1578: ACMD(do_load)
  1579: {
  1580:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf3[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1581:   int i=0, n=1;
  1582: 
  1583:   if (subcmd == 1) {
  1584:     strlcpy(buf, "obj", sizeof(buf));
  1585:     one_argument(two_arguments(argument, buf2, buf3), argument);
  1586:   } else if (subcmd == 2) {
  1587:     strlcpy(buf, "mob", sizeof(buf));
  1588:     one_argument(two_arguments(argument, buf2, buf3), argument);
  1589:   } else {
  1590:     one_argument(two_arguments(argument, buf, buf2), buf3);
  1591:   }
  1592: 
  1593:   if (!*buf || !*buf2 || !isdigit(*buf2)) {
  1594:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: load < obj | mob > <vnum> <number>\r\n");
  1595:     return;
  1596:   }
  1597:   if (!is_number(buf2)) {
  1598:     send_to_char(ch, "That is not a number.\r\n");
  1599:     return;
  1600:   }
  1601: 
  1602:   if (*buf3) {
  1603:     if (!is_number(buf3) || (n = atoi(buf3)) < 1 || n > 100) {
  1604:       send_to_char(ch, "Count must be a whole number from 1 to 100.\r\n");
  1605:       return;
  1606:     }
  1607:   }
  1608: 
  1609:   if (is_abbrev(buf, "mob")) {
  1610:     struct char_data *mob=NULL;
  1611:     mob_rnum r_num;
  1612: 
  1613: 	if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD && !can_edit_zone(ch, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone)) {
  1614: 	  send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, you can't load mobs here.\r\n");
  1615: 	  return;
  1616: 	}
  1617: 
  1618:     if ((r_num = real_mobile(atoi(buf2))) == NOBODY) {
  1619:       send_to_char(ch, "There is no monster with that number.\r\n");
  1620:       return;
  1621:     }
  1622:     for (i=0; i < n; i++) {
  1623:       mob = read_mobile(r_num, REAL);
  1624:       char_to_room(mob, IN_ROOM(ch));
  1625: 
  1626:       act("$n makes a quaint, magical gesture with one hand.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1627:       act("$n has created $N!", FALSE, ch, 0, mob, TO_ROOM);
  1628:       act("You create $N.", FALSE, ch, 0, mob, TO_CHAR);
  1629:       load_mtrigger(mob);
  1630:     }
  1631:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  1632:            "(GC) %s loaded %d mob%s [%s].", GET_NAME(ch), n,
  1633:            n == 1 ? "" : "s", buf2);
  1634:   } else if (is_abbrev(buf, "obj")) {
  1635:     struct obj_data *obj;
  1636:     obj_rnum r_num;
  1637: 
  1638: 	if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD && !can_edit_zone(ch, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone)) {
  1639: 	  send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, you can't load objects here.\r\n");
  1640: 	  return;
  1641: 	}
  1642: 
  1643:     if ((r_num = real_object(atoi(buf2))) == NOTHING) {
  1644:       send_to_char(ch, "There is no object with that number.\r\n");
  1645:       return;
  1646:     }
  1647:     for (i=0; i < n; i++) {
  1648:       obj = read_object(r_num, REAL);
  1649:       if (CONFIG_LOAD_INVENTORY)
  1650:         obj_to_char(obj, ch);
  1651:       else
  1652:         obj_to_room(obj, IN_ROOM(ch));
  1653:       act("$n makes a strange magical gesture.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1654:       act("$n has created $p!", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1655:       act("You create $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1656:       load_otrigger(obj);
  1657:     }
  1658:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  1659:            "(GC) %s loaded %d object%s [%s].", GET_NAME(ch), n,
  1660:            n == 1 ? "" : "s", buf2);
  1661:   } else
  1662:     send_to_char(ch, "That'll have to be either 'obj' or 'mob'.\r\n");
  1663: }
  1664: 
  1665: ACMD(do_cleanse_admin)
  1666: {
  1667:   struct char_data *vict = ch;
  1668:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1669:   int number = 1, removed;
  1670: 
  1671:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1672:   if (*arg && (vict = get_char_vis(ch, arg, &number, FIND_CHAR_ROOM)) == NULL) {
  1673:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not see that person here. Usage: cleanse [target]\r\n");
  1674:     return;
  1675:   }
  1676:   if (!IS_NPC(vict) && vict != ch && GET_LEVEL(vict) >= GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  1677:     send_to_char(ch, "You may not cleanse an immortal of equal or higher level.\r\n");
  1678:     return;
  1679:   }
  1680:   removed = immortal_cleanse_timed_affects(vict);
  1681:   send_to_char(ch, "Removed %d temporary affect%s from %s.\r\n",
  1682:                removed, removed == 1 ? "" : "s", vict == ch ? "yourself" : GET_NAME(vict));
  1683:   if (vict != ch)
  1684:     send_to_char(vict, "%s cleanses your temporary affects.\r\n", GET_NAME(ch));
  1685:   mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  1686:          "(GC) %s cleansed %s (%d temporary affects).",
  1687:          GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(vict), removed);
  1688: }
  1689: 
  1690: static int room_reset_cmd_room(const struct reset_com *cmd)
  1691: {
  1692:   switch (cmd->command) {
  1693:     case 'M':
  1694:     case 'O':
  1695:       return cmd->arg3;
  1696:     case 'T':
  1697:     case 'V':
  1698:       return cmd->arg1 == WLD_TRIGGER ? cmd->arg3 : NOWHERE;
  1699:     case 'D':
  1700:     case 'R':
  1701:       return cmd->arg1;
  1702:     default:
  1703:       return NOWHERE;
  1704:   }
  1705: }
  1706: 
  1707: static int room_reset_chain_end(struct reset_com *cmd, int root_index)
  1708: {
  1709:   int i = root_index + 1;
  1710: 
  1711:   while (cmd[i].command != 'S' &&
  1712:          cmd[i].command != 'M' &&
  1713:          cmd[i].command != 'O' &&
  1714:          cmd[i].command != 'D' &&
  1715:          cmd[i].command != 'R')
  1716:     i++;
  1717: 
  1718:   return i - 1;
  1719: }
  1720: 
  1721: static int find_room_reset_insert_pos(zone_rnum zone_num, room_rnum room_num)
  1722: {
  1723:   int i;
  1724:   int total = count_commands(zone_table[zone_num].cmd);
  1725:   struct reset_com *cmd = zone_table[zone_num].cmd;
  1726: 
  1727:   for (i = 0; i < total; i++) {
  1728:     if ((cmd[i].command == 'M' || cmd[i].command == 'O') && cmd[i].arg3 == room_num)
  1729:       return room_reset_chain_end(cmd, i) + 1;
  1730:   }
  1731: 
  1732:   for (i = 0; i < total; i++) {
  1733:     int cmd_room = room_reset_cmd_room(&cmd[i]);
  1734:     if (cmd_room != NOWHERE && cmd_room > room_num)
  1735:       return i;
  1736:   }
  1737: 
  1738:   return total;
  1739: }
  1740: 
  1741: static room_rnum resolve_room_reset_room(struct char_data *ch, const char *room_arg)
  1742: {
  1743:   if (room_arg == NULL || *room_arg == '\0' || !strcasecmp(room_arg, "here"))
  1744:     return IN_ROOM(ch);
  1745: 
  1746:   if (is_number(room_arg))
  1747:     return real_room(atoi(room_arg));
  1748: 
  1749:   return NOWHERE;
  1750: }
  1751: 
  1752: static int collect_matching_room_reset_roots(zone_rnum zone_num, char reset_type, int thing_rnum,
  1753:                                              room_rnum room_num, int **roots, int **chain_ends)
  1754: {
  1755:   int i, total, matches = 0;
  1756:   struct reset_com *cmd = zone_table[zone_num].cmd;
  1757: 
  1758:   *roots = NULL;
  1759:   *chain_ends = NULL;
  1760:   total = count_commands(cmd);
  1761: 
  1762:   if (total <= 0)
  1763:     return 0;
  1764: 
  1765:   CREATE(*roots, int, total);
  1766:   CREATE(*chain_ends, int, total);
  1767: 
  1768:   for (i = 0; i < total; i++) {
  1769:     if (cmd[i].command == reset_type &&
  1770:         cmd[i].arg1 == thing_rnum &&
  1771:         cmd[i].arg3 == room_num) {
  1772:       (*roots)[matches] = i;
  1773:       (*chain_ends)[matches] = room_reset_chain_end(cmd, i);
  1774:       matches++;
  1775:     }
  1776:   }
  1777: 
  1778:   if (matches == 0) {
  1779:     free(*roots);
  1780:     free(*chain_ends);
  1781:     *roots = NULL;
  1782:     *chain_ends = NULL;
  1783:   }
  1784: 
  1785:   return matches;
  1786: }
  1787: 
  1788: static void delete_room_reset_chain(struct zone_data *zone, int root_index, int chain_end)
  1789: {
  1790:   int i;
  1791: 
  1792:   for (i = root_index; i <= chain_end; i++)
  1793:     delete_zone_command(zone, root_index);
  1794: }
  1795: 
  1796: static bool parse_room_reset_count(const char *count_arg, int *count_out)
  1797: {
  1798:   if (!count_arg || !*count_arg || !is_number(count_arg))
  1799:     return FALSE;
  1800: 
  1801:   *count_out = atoi(count_arg);
  1802:   return (*count_out > 0 && *count_out <= MAX_DUPLICATES);
  1803: }
  1804: 
  1805: static void perform_room_reset(struct char_data *ch, char reset_type, int thing_vnum, const char *room_arg, const char *count_arg)
  1806: {
  1807:   room_rnum room_rnum_value = NOWHERE;
  1808:   zone_rnum zone_rnum_value;
  1809:   int count, insert_pos, match_count, i;
  1810:   int *match_roots = NULL, *match_chain_ends = NULL;
  1811:   int keep_root = NOWHERE;
  1812:   struct reset_com new_reset;
  1813: 
  1814:   room_rnum_value = resolve_room_reset_room(ch, room_arg);
  1815: 
  1816:   if (room_rnum_value == NOWHERE) {
  1817:     send_to_char(ch, "Invalid room vnum.\r\n");
  1818:     return;
  1819:   }
  1820: 
  1821:   zone_rnum_value = world[room_rnum_value].zone;
  1822:   if (zone_rnum_value == NOWHERE || zone_rnum_value > top_of_zone_table) {
  1823:     send_to_char(ch, "That room is not attached to a valid zone.\r\n");
  1824:     return;
  1825:   }
  1826: 
  1827:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, zone_rnum_value)) {
  1828:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't have permission to edit that zone.\r\n");
  1829:     return;
  1830:   }
  1831: 
  1832:   if (!parse_room_reset_count(count_arg, &count)) {
  1833:     send_to_char(ch, "Count/max must be a positive number between 1 and %d.\r\n", MAX_DUPLICATES);
  1834:     return;
  1835:   }
  1836: 
  1837:   memset(&new_reset, 0, sizeof(new_reset));
  1838:   new_reset.if_flag = 0;
  1839:   new_reset.arg2 = count;
  1840:   new_reset.arg3 = room_rnum_value;
  1841: 
  1842:   if (reset_type == 'M') {
  1843:     mob_rnum mob_rnum_value = real_mobile(thing_vnum);
  1844:     if (mob_rnum_value == NOBODY) {
  1845:       send_to_char(ch, "Invalid mob vnum.\r\n");
  1846:       return;
  1847:     }
  1848:     new_reset.command = 'M';
  1849:     new_reset.arg1 = mob_rnum_value;
  1850:   } else if (reset_type == 'O') {
  1851:     obj_rnum obj_rnum_value = real_object(thing_vnum);
  1852:     if (obj_rnum_value == NOTHING) {
  1853:       send_to_char(ch, "Invalid object vnum.\r\n");
  1854:       return;
  1855:     }
  1856:     new_reset.command = 'O';
  1857:     new_reset.arg1 = obj_rnum_value;
  1858:   } else {
  1859:     send_to_char(ch, "Internal error: invalid reset type.\r\n");
  1860:     return;
  1861:   }
  1862: 
  1863:   match_count = collect_matching_room_reset_roots(zone_rnum_value, new_reset.command,
  1864:                                                   new_reset.arg1, room_rnum_value,
  1865:                                                   &match_roots, &match_chain_ends);
  1866: 
  1867:   if (match_count > 0) {
  1868:     keep_root = match_roots[0];
  1869:     zone_table[zone_rnum_value].cmd[keep_root].arg2 = count;
  1870: 
  1871:     for (i = match_count - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
  1872:       delete_room_reset_chain(&zone_table[zone_rnum_value], match_roots[i], match_chain_ends[i]);
  1873:       if (match_roots[i] < keep_root)
  1874:         keep_root -= (match_chain_ends[i] - match_roots[i] + 1);
  1875:     }
  1876: 
  1877:     zone_table[zone_rnum_value].cmd[keep_root].arg2 = count;
  1878:   } else {
  1879:     insert_pos = find_room_reset_insert_pos(zone_rnum_value, room_rnum_value);
  1880:     add_cmd_to_list(&zone_table[zone_rnum_value].cmd, &new_reset, insert_pos);
  1881:   }
  1882: 
  1883:   if (match_roots)
  1884:     free(match_roots);
  1885:   if (match_chain_ends)
  1886:     free(match_chain_ends);
  1887: 
  1888:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[zone_rnum_value].number, SL_ZON);
  1889:   if (!save_zone(zone_rnum_value)) {
  1890:     send_to_char(ch, "Unable to save zone data.\r\n");
  1891:     return;
  1892:   }
  1893: 
  1894:   if (new_reset.command == 'M') {
  1895:     send_to_char(ch, "Reset added: mob [%d] %s -> room [%d] %s (max: %d).\r\n",
  1896:       mob_index[new_reset.arg1].vnum,
  1897:       mob_proto[new_reset.arg1].player.short_descr,
  1898:       world[room_rnum_value].number,
  1899:       world[room_rnum_value].name,
  1900:       new_reset.arg2);
  1901:   } else {
  1902:     send_to_char(ch, "Reset added: obj [%d] %s -> room [%d] %s (max: %d).\r\n",
  1903:       obj_index[new_reset.arg1].vnum,
  1904:       obj_proto[new_reset.arg1].short_description,
  1905:       world[room_rnum_value].number,
  1906:       world[room_rnum_value].name,
  1907:       new_reset.arg2);
  1908:   }
  1909: }
  1910: 
  1911: static void perform_room_reset_delete(struct char_data *ch, char reset_type, int thing_vnum, const char *room_arg)
  1912: {
  1913:   room_rnum room_rnum_value;
  1914:   zone_rnum zone_rnum_value;
  1915:   int *match_roots = NULL, *match_chain_ends = NULL;
  1916:   int match_count, i, removed = 0;
  1917:   int thing_rnum = NOWHERE;
  1918:   const char *thing_label;
  1919:   int thing_real_vnum = NOWHERE;
  1920: 
  1921:   room_rnum_value = resolve_room_reset_room(ch, room_arg);
  1922:   if (room_rnum_value == NOWHERE) {
  1923:     send_to_char(ch, "Invalid room vnum.\r\n");
  1924:     return;
  1925:   }
  1926: 
  1927:   zone_rnum_value = world[room_rnum_value].zone;
  1928:   if (zone_rnum_value == NOWHERE || zone_rnum_value > top_of_zone_table) {
  1929:     send_to_char(ch, "That room is not attached to a valid zone.\r\n");
  1930:     return;
  1931:   }
  1932: 
  1933:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, zone_rnum_value)) {
  1934:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't have permission to edit that zone.\r\n");
  1935:     return;
  1936:   }
  1937: 
  1938:   if (reset_type == 'M') {
  1939:     thing_rnum = real_mobile(thing_vnum);
  1940:     thing_label = "mob";
  1941:     if (thing_rnum == NOBODY) {
  1942:       send_to_char(ch, "Invalid mob vnum.\r\n");
  1943:       return;
  1944:     }
  1945:     thing_real_vnum = mob_index[thing_rnum].vnum;
  1946:   } else if (reset_type == 'O') {
  1947:     thing_rnum = real_object(thing_vnum);
  1948:     thing_label = "obj";
  1949:     if (thing_rnum == NOTHING) {
  1950:       send_to_char(ch, "Invalid object vnum.\r\n");
  1951:       return;
  1952:     }
  1953:     thing_real_vnum = obj_index[thing_rnum].vnum;
  1954:   } else {
  1955:     send_to_char(ch, "Internal error: invalid reset type.\r\n");
  1956:     return;
  1957:   }
  1958: 
  1959:   match_count = collect_matching_room_reset_roots(zone_rnum_value, reset_type, thing_rnum,
  1960:                                                   room_rnum_value, &match_roots, &match_chain_ends);
  1961:   if (match_count <= 0) {
  1962:     send_to_char(ch, "No matching reset found\r\n");
  1963:     return;
  1964:   }
  1965: 
  1966:   for (i = match_count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
  1967:     removed++;
  1968:     delete_room_reset_chain(&zone_table[zone_rnum_value], match_roots[i], match_chain_ends[i]);
  1969:   }
  1970: 
  1971:   free(match_roots);
  1972:   free(match_chain_ends);
  1973: 
  1974:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[zone_rnum_value].number, SL_ZON);
  1975:   if (!save_zone(zone_rnum_value)) {
  1976:     send_to_char(ch, "Unable to save zone data.\r\n");
  1977:     return;
  1978:   }
  1979: 
  1980:   send_to_char(ch, "Removed %d reset(s): %s [%d] from room [%d]\r\n",
  1981:                removed, thing_label, thing_real_vnum, world[room_rnum_value].number);
  1982: }
  1983: 
  1984: static void show_room_resets(struct char_data *ch, room_rnum room_num)
  1985: {
  1986:   struct reset_com *cmd;
  1987:   int i, index = 1, total;
  1988:   int current_mob = NOWHERE;
  1989:   bool found = FALSE;
  1990:   zone_rnum zone_num;
  1991: 
  1992:   if (room_num == NOWHERE) {
  1993:     send_to_char(ch, "Invalid room vnum.\r\n");
  1994:     return;
  1995:   }
  1996: 
  1997:   zone_num = world[room_num].zone;
  1998:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, zone_num)) {
  1999:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't have permission to view that zone's resets.\r\n");
  2000:     return;
  2001:   }
  2002: 
  2003:   cmd = zone_table[zone_num].cmd;
  2004:   total = count_commands(cmd);
  2005: 
  2006:   send_to_char(ch, "Room Resets: [%d] %s\r\n\r\n", world[room_num].number, world[room_num].name);
  2007: 
  2008:   for (i = 0; i < total; i++) {
  2009:     if ((cmd[i].command == 'M' || cmd[i].command == 'O') && cmd[i].arg3 == room_num) {
  2010:       int j;
  2011: 
  2012:       found = TRUE;
  2013:       if (cmd[i].command == 'M') {
  2014:         current_mob = (cmd[i].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[i].arg1 <= top_of_mobt) ? mob_index[cmd[i].arg1].vnum : NOWHERE;
  2015:         send_to_char(ch, "%2d) Mob [%d] %-30.30s max: %d\r\n",
  2016:           index++,
  2017:           (cmd[i].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[i].arg1 <= top_of_mobt) ? mob_index[cmd[i].arg1].vnum : -1,
  2018:           (cmd[i].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[i].arg1 <= top_of_mobt) ? mob_proto[cmd[i].arg1].player.short_descr : "<invalid mob>",
  2019:           cmd[i].arg2);
  2020:       } else {
  2021:         current_mob = NOWHERE;
  2022:         send_to_char(ch, "%2d) Obj [%d] %-30.30s room object max: %d\r\n",
  2023:           index++,
  2024:           (cmd[i].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[i].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ? obj_index[cmd[i].arg1].vnum : -1,
  2025:           (cmd[i].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[i].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ? obj_proto[cmd[i].arg1].short_description : "<invalid object>",
  2026:           cmd[i].arg2);
  2027:       }
  2028: 
  2029:       j = i + 1;
  2030:       while (j < total &&
  2031:              cmd[j].command != 'M' &&
  2032:              cmd[j].command != 'O' &&
  2033:              cmd[j].command != 'D' &&
  2034:              cmd[j].command != 'R') {
  2035:         if (cmd[j].command == 'E') {
  2036:           send_to_char(ch, "%2d) Obj [%d] %-30.30s equip on mob [%d] (%s) max: %d\r\n",
  2037:             index++,
  2038:             (cmd[j].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[j].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ? obj_index[cmd[j].arg1].vnum : -1,
  2039:             (cmd[j].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[j].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ? obj_proto[cmd[j].arg1].short_description : "<invalid object>",
  2040:             current_mob,
  2041:             (cmd[j].arg3 >= 0 && cmd[j].arg3 < NUM_WEARS) ? equipment_types[cmd[j].arg3] : "invalid slot",
  2042:             cmd[j].arg2);
  2043:         } else if (cmd[j].command == 'G') {
  2044:           send_to_char(ch, "%2d) Obj [%d] %-30.30s give to mob [%d] max: %d\r\n",
  2045:             index++,
  2046:             (cmd[j].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[j].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ? obj_index[cmd[j].arg1].vnum : -1,
  2047:             (cmd[j].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[j].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ? obj_proto[cmd[j].arg1].short_description : "<invalid object>",
  2048:             current_mob,
  2049:             cmd[j].arg2);
  2050:         } else if (cmd[j].command == 'P') {
  2051:           send_to_char(ch, "%2d) Obj [%d] %-30.30s put in obj [%d] max: %d\r\n",
  2052:             index++,
  2053:             (cmd[j].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[j].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ? obj_index[cmd[j].arg1].vnum : -1,

  2371: /* clean a room of all mobiles and objects */
  2372: ACMD(do_purge)
  2373: {
  2374:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2375:   char *t;
  2376:   struct char_data *vict;
  2377:   struct obj_data *obj;
  2378:   int number;
  2379: 
  2380:   one_argument(argument, buf);
  2381: 
  2382:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD && !can_edit_zone(ch, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone)) {
  2383: 	send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, you can't purge anything here.\r\n");
  2384: 	return;
  2385:   }
  2386: 
  2387:   /* argument supplied. destroy single object or char */
  2388:   if (*buf) {
  2389:     t = buf;

  2391:     if ((vict = get_char_vis(ch, buf, &number, FIND_CHAR_ROOM)) != NULL) {      
  2392:       if (!IS_NPC(vict) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) <= GET_LEVEL(vict))) {
  2393:         send_to_char(ch, "You can't purge %s!\r\n", GET_NAME(vict));
  2394: 	return;
  2395:       }
  2396:       act("$n disintegrates $N.", FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
  2397: 
  2398:       if (!IS_NPC(vict)) {
  2399: 	mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s has purged %s.", GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(vict));
  2400: 	if (vict->desc) {
  2401: 	  STATE(vict->desc) = CON_CLOSE;
  2402: 	  vict->desc->character = NULL;
  2403: 	  vict->desc = NULL;
  2404: 	}
  2405:       }
  2406:       extract_char(vict);
  2407:     } else if ((obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, buf, &number, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents)) != NULL) {
  2408:       act("$n destroys $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2409:       extract_obj(obj);
  2410:     } else {
  2411:       send_to_char(ch, "Nothing here by that name.\r\n");
  2412:       return;
  2413:     }
  2414: 
  2415:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
  2416:   } else {			/* no argument. clean out the room */
  2417:     act("$n gestures... You are surrounded by scorching flames!",
  2418: 	FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2419:     send_to_room(IN_ROOM(ch), "The world seems a little cleaner.\r\n");
  2420:     purge_room(IN_ROOM(ch));
  2421:   }
  2422: }

  2424: ACMD(do_advance)
  2425: {
  2426:   struct char_data *victim;
  2427:   char name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], level[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2428:   int newlevel, oldlevel, i;
  2429: 
  2430:   two_arguments(argument, name, level);
  2431: 
  2432:   if (*name) {
  2433:     if (!(victim = get_char_vis(ch, name, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD))) {
  2434:       send_to_char(ch, "That player is not here.\r\n");
  2435:       return;
  2436:     }
  2437:   } else {
  2438:     send_to_char(ch, "Advance who?\r\n");
  2439:     return;
  2440:   }
  2441: 
  2442:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) <= GET_LEVEL(victim)) {
  2443:     send_to_char(ch, "Maybe that's not such a great idea.\r\n");
  2444:     return;
  2445:   }
  2446:   if (IS_NPC(victim)) {
  2447:     send_to_char(ch, "NO!  Not on NPC's.\r\n");
  2448:     return;
  2449:   }
  2450:   if (!*level || (newlevel = atoi(level)) <= 0) {
  2451:     send_to_char(ch, "That's not a level!\r\n");
  2452:     return;
  2453:   }
  2454:   if (newlevel > LVL_IMPL) {
  2455:     send_to_char(ch, "%d is the highest possible level.\r\n", LVL_IMPL);
  2456:     return;
  2457:   }
  2458:   if (newlevel > (LVL_IMMORT - 1) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) {
  2459:     send_to_char(ch, "Only immortals can advance players beyond level %d.\r\n", LVL_IMMORT - 1);
  2460:     return;
  2461:   }
  2462:   if (newlevel > GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  2463:     send_to_char(ch, "Yeah, right.\r\n");
  2464:     return;
  2465:   }
  2466:   if (newlevel == GET_LEVEL(victim)) {
  2467:     act("$E is already at that level.", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_CHAR);
  2468:     return;
  2469:   }
  2470:   oldlevel = GET_LEVEL(victim);
  2471:   if (newlevel < GET_LEVEL(victim)) {
  2472:     do_start(victim);
  2473:     GET_LEVEL(victim) = newlevel;
  2474:     send_to_char(victim, "You are momentarily enveloped by darkness!\r\nYou feel somewhat diminished.\r\n");
  2475:   } else {
  2476:     act("$n makes some strange gestures. A strange feeling comes upon you,\r\n"
  2477:       "Like a giant hand, light comes down from above, grabbing your body,\r\n"
  2478:       "that begins to pulse with colored lights from inside.\r\n\r\n"
  2479:       "Your head seems to be filled with demons from another plane as\r\n"
  2480:       "your body dissolves to the elements of time and space itself.\r\n"
  2481:       "Suddenly a silent explosion of light snaps you back to reality.\r\n\r\n"
  2482:       "You feel slightly different.", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_VICT);
  2483: }
  2484: 
  2485:   send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
  2486: 
  2487:   if (newlevel < oldlevel)
  2488:     log("(GC) %s demoted %s from level %d to %d.",
  2489: 		GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(victim), oldlevel, newlevel);
  2490:   else
  2491:     log("(GC) %s has advanced %s to level %d (from %d)",
  2492: 		GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(victim), newlevel, oldlevel);
  2493: 
  2494:   if (oldlevel >= LVL_IMMORT && newlevel < LVL_IMMORT) {
  2495:     /* If they are no longer an immortal, remove the immortal only flags. */
  2496:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(victim), PRF_LOG1);
  2497:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(victim), PRF_LOG2);
  2498:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(victim), PRF_NOHASSLE);
  2499:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(victim), PRF_HOLYLIGHT);
  2500:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(victim), PRF_SHOWVNUMS);
  2501:     if (!PLR_FLAGGED(victim, PLR_NOWIZLIST))
  2502:       run_autowiz();
  2503:   } else if (oldlevel < LVL_IMMORT && newlevel >= LVL_IMMORT) {
  2504:     SET_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(victim), PRF_LOG2);
  2505:     SET_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(victim), PRF_HOLYLIGHT);
  2506:     SET_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(victim), PRF_SHOWVNUMS);
  2507:     SET_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(victim), PRF_AUTOEXIT);
  2508:         for (i = 1; i <= MAX_SKILLS; i++)
  2509:           SET_SKILL(victim, i, 100);
  2510:    GET_OLC_ZONE(victim) = NOWHERE;
  2511:    GET_COND(victim, HUNGER) = -1;
  2512:    GET_COND(victim, THIRST) = -1;
  2513:    GET_COND(victim, DRUNK)  = -1;
  2514:   }
  2515: 
  2516:   gain_exp_regardless(victim, level_exp(GET_CLASS(victim), newlevel) - GET_EXP(victim), GET_LEVEL(ch));
  2517:   save_char(victim);
  2518: }

  2582: void perform_immort_vis(struct char_data *ch)
  2583: {

  2594: static void perform_immort_invis(struct char_data *ch, int level)
  2595: {
  2596:   struct char_data *tch;
  2597: 
  2598:   for (tch = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; tch; tch = tch->next_in_room) {
  2599:     if (tch == ch || IS_NPC(tch))
  2600:       continue;
  2601:     if (GET_LEVEL(tch) >= GET_INVIS_LEV(ch) && GET_LEVEL(tch) < level)
  2602:       act("You blink and suddenly realize that $n is gone.", FALSE, ch, 0,
  2603: 	  tch, TO_VICT);
  2604:     if (GET_LEVEL(tch) < GET_INVIS_LEV(ch) && GET_LEVEL(tch) >= level)
  2605:       act("You suddenly realize that $n is standing beside you.", FALSE, ch, 0,
  2606: 	  tch, TO_VICT);
  2607:   }
  2608: 
  2609:   GET_INVIS_LEV(ch) = level;
  2610:   send_to_char(ch, "Your invisibility level is %d.\r\n", level);
  2611: }

  2613: ACMD(do_invis)
  2614: {
  2615:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2616:   int level;
  2617: 
  2618:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) {
  2619:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't do that!\r\n");
  2620:     return;
  2621:   }

  2625:     if (GET_INVIS_LEV(ch) > 0)
  2626:       perform_immort_vis(ch);
  2627:     else
  2628:       perform_immort_invis(ch, GET_LEVEL(ch));
  2629:   } else {
  2630:     level = atoi(arg);
  2631:     if (level > GET_LEVEL(ch))
  2632:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't go invisible above your own level.\r\n");
  2633:     else if (level < 1)
  2634:       perform_immort_vis(ch);
  2635:     else
  2636:       perform_immort_invis(ch, level);
  2637:   }
  2638: }

  2640: ACMD(do_gecho)
  2641: {

  2663: ACMD(do_dc)
  2664: {
  2665:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2666:   struct descriptor_data *d;
  2667:   int num_to_dc;
  2668: 
  2669:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  2670:   if (!(num_to_dc = atoi(arg))) {
  2671:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: DC <user number> (type USERS for a list)\r\n");
  2672:     return;
  2673:   }
  2674:   for (d = descriptor_list; d && d->desc_num != num_to_dc; d = d->next);
  2675: 
  2676:   if (!d) {
  2677:     send_to_char(ch, "No such connection.\r\n");
  2678:     return;
  2679:   }
  2680:   if (d->character && GET_LEVEL(d->character) >= GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  2681:     if (!CAN_SEE(ch, d->character))
  2682:       send_to_char(ch, "No such connection.\r\n");
  2683:     else
  2684:       send_to_char(ch, "Umm.. maybe that's not such a good idea...\r\n");
  2685:     return;
  2686:   }
  2687: 
  2688:   /* We used to just close the socket here using close_socket(), but various
  2689:    * people pointed out this could cause a crash if you're closing the person
  2690:    * below you on the descriptor list.  Just setting to CON_CLOSE leaves things
  2691:    * in a massively inconsistent state so I had to add this new flag to the
  2692:    * descriptor. -je It is a much more logical extension for a CON_DISCONNECT
  2693:    * to be used for in-game socket closes and CON_CLOSE for out of game
  2694:    * closings. This will retain the stability of the close_me hack while being
  2695:    * neater in appearance. -gg For those unlucky souls who actually manage to
  2696:    * get disconnected by two different immortals in the same 1/10th of a
  2697:    * second, we have the below 'if' check. -gg */
  2698:   if (STATE(d) == CON_DISCONNECT || STATE(d) == CON_CLOSE)
  2699:     act("$E's already being disconnected.", FALSE, ch, 0, d->character, TO_CHAR);
  2700:   else {
  2701:     /* Remember that we can disconnect people not in the game and that rather
  2702:      * confuses the code when it expected there to be a character context. */
  2703:     if (STATE(d) == CON_PLAYING)
  2704:       STATE(d) = CON_DISCONNECT;
  2705:     else
  2706:       STATE(d) = CON_CLOSE;
  2707: 
  2708:     send_to_char(ch, "Connection #%d closed.\r\n", num_to_dc);
  2709:     log("(GC) Connection closed by %s.", GET_NAME(ch));
  2710:   }
  2711: }
  2712: 
  2713: ACMD(do_wizlock)
  2714: {
  2715:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2716:   int value;
  2717:   const char *when;

  2723:       send_to_char(ch, "Invalid wizlock value.\r\n");
  2724:       return;
  2725:     }
  2726:     circle_restrict = value;

  2728:   } else
  2729:     when = "currently";
  2730: 
  2731:   switch (circle_restrict) {

  2734:     break;
  2735:   case 1:

  2737:     break;
  2738:   default:

  2740:     break;

  2744: ACMD(do_date)
  2745: {
  2746:   char timestr[25];
  2747:   time_t mytime;
  2748:   int d, h, m;
  2749: 
  2750:   if (subcmd == SCMD_DATE)
  2751:     mytime = time(0);
  2752:   else
  2753:     mytime = boot_time;
  2754: 
  2755:   strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%c", localtime(&mytime));

  2759:   else {

  2763:     m = (mytime / 60) % 60;
  2764: 
  2765:     send_to_char(ch, "Up since %s: %d day%s, %d:%02d\r\n", timestr, d, d == 1 ? "" : "s", h, m);
  2766:   }
  2767: }

  2769: /* altered from stock to the following:
  2770:    last [name] [#]
  2771:    last without arguments displays the last 10 entries.
  2772:    last with a name only displays the 'stock' last entry.
  2773:    last with a number displays that many entries (combines with name) */
  2774: static const char *last_array[11] = {
  2775:   "Connect",
  2776:   "Enter Game",
  2777:   "Reconnect",
  2778:   "Takeover",
  2779:   "Quit",
  2780:   "Idleout",
  2781:   "Disconnect",
  2782:   "Shutdown",
  2783:   "Reboot",
  2784:   "Crash",
  2785:   "Playing"

  2788: struct last_entry *find_llog_entry(int punique, long idnum) {
  2789:   FILE *fp;
  2790:   struct last_entry mlast;
  2791:   struct last_entry *llast;
  2792:   int size, recs, tmp;
  2793: 
  2794:   if(!(fp=fopen(LAST_FILE,"r"))) {
  2795:     log("Error opening last_file for reading, will create.");
  2796:     return NULL;
  2797:   }
  2798:   fseek(fp,0L,SEEK_END);
  2799:   size=ftell(fp);
  2800: 
  2801:   /* recs = number of records in the last file */
  2802:   recs = size/sizeof(struct last_entry);
  2803:   /* we'll search last to first, since it's faster than any thing else we can
  2804:    * do (like searching for the last shutdown/etc..) */
  2805:   for(tmp=recs-1; tmp > 0; tmp--) {
  2806:     fseek(fp,-1*((long)sizeof(struct last_entry)),SEEK_CUR);
  2807:     if (fread(&mlast,sizeof(struct last_entry),1,fp) != 1)
  2808:       return NULL;
  2809:         /*another one to keep that stepback */
  2810:     fseek(fp,-1*((long)sizeof(struct last_entry)),SEEK_CUR);
  2811: 
  2812:     if(mlast.idnum == idnum && mlast.punique == punique) {
  2813:       /* then we've found a match */
  2814:       CREATE(llast,struct last_entry,1);
  2815:       memcpy(llast,&mlast,sizeof(struct last_entry));
  2816:       fclose(fp);
  2817:       return llast;
  2818:     }
  2819:     /*not the one we seek. next */
  2820:   }
  2821:   /*not found, no problem, quit */
  2822:   fclose(fp);
  2823:   return NULL;
  2824: }
  2825: 
  2826: /* mod_llog_entry assumes that llast is accurate */
  2827: static void mod_llog_entry(struct last_entry *llast,int type) {
  2828:   FILE *fp;
  2829:   struct last_entry mlast;
  2830:   int size, recs, tmp;
  2831: 
  2832:   if(!(fp=fopen(LAST_FILE,"r+"))) {
  2833:     log("Error opening last_file for reading and writing.");
  2834:     return;
  2835:   }
  2836:   fseek(fp,0L,SEEK_END);
  2837:   size=ftell(fp);
  2838: 
  2839:   /* recs = number of records in the last file */
  2840:   recs = size/sizeof(struct last_entry);
  2841: 
  2842:   /* We'll search last to first, since it's faster than any thing else we can
  2843:    * do (like searching for the last shutdown/etc..) */
  2844:   for(tmp=recs; tmp > 0; tmp--) {
  2845:     fseek(fp,-1*((long)sizeof(struct last_entry)),SEEK_CUR);
  2846:     if(fread(&mlast,sizeof(struct last_entry),1,fp) != 1) {
  2847:       log("mod_llog_entry: read error or unexpected end of file.");
  2848:       return;
  2849:     }
  2850:     /* Another one to keep that stepback. */
  2851:     fseek(fp,-1*((long)sizeof(struct last_entry)),SEEK_CUR);
  2852: 
  2853:     if(mlast.idnum == llast->idnum && mlast.punique == llast->punique) {
  2854:       /* Then we've found a match, lets assume quit is inviolate, mainly
  2855:        * because disconnect is called after each of these */
  2856:       if(mlast.close_type != LAST_QUIT &&
  2857:         mlast.close_type != LAST_IDLEOUT &&
  2858:         mlast.close_type != LAST_REBOOT &&
  2859:         mlast.close_type != LAST_SHUTDOWN) {
  2860:         mlast.close_type=type;
  2861:       }
  2862:       mlast.close_time=time(0);
  2863:       /*write it, and we're done!*/
  2864:       fwrite(&mlast,sizeof(struct last_entry),1,fp);
  2865:       fclose(fp);
  2866:       return;
  2867:     }
  2868:     /* Not the one we seek, next. */
  2869:   }
  2870:   fclose(fp);
  2871: 
  2872:   /* Not found, no problem, quit. */
  2873:   return;
  2874: }
  2875: 
  2876: void add_llog_entry(struct char_data *ch, int type) {
  2877:   FILE *fp;
  2878:   struct last_entry *llast;
  2879: 
  2880:   /* so if a char enteres a name, but bad password, otherwise loses link before
  2881:    * he gets a pref assinged, we won't record it */
  2882:   if(GET_PREF(ch) <= 0) {
  2883:     return;
  2884:   }
  2885: 
  2886:   /* See if we have a login stored */
  2887:   llast = find_llog_entry(GET_PREF(ch), GET_IDNUM(ch));
  2888: 
  2889:   /* we didn't - make a new one */
  2890:   if(llast == NULL) {  /* no entry found, add ..error if close! */
  2891:     CREATE(llast,struct last_entry,1);
  2892:     strncpy(llast->username,GET_NAME(ch),15);
  2893:     strncpy(llast->hostname,GET_HOST(ch),127);
  2894:     llast->username[15]='\0';
  2895:     llast->hostname[127]='\0';
  2896:     llast->idnum=GET_IDNUM(ch);
  2897:     llast->punique=GET_PREF(ch);
  2898:     llast->time=time(0);
  2899:     llast->close_time=0;
  2900:     llast->close_type=type;
  2901: 
  2902:     if(!(fp=fopen(LAST_FILE,"a"))) {
  2903:       log("error opening last_file for appending");
  2904:       free(llast);
  2905:       return;
  2906:     }
  2907:     fwrite(llast,sizeof(struct last_entry),1,fp);
  2908:     fclose(fp);
  2909:   } else {
  2910:     /* We've found a login - update it */
  2911:     mod_llog_entry(llast,type);
  2912:   }
  2913:   free(llast);
  2914: }
  2915: 
  2916: void clean_llog_entries(void) {
  2917:   FILE *ofp, *nfp;
  2918:   struct last_entry mlast;
  2919:   int recs;
  2920: 
  2921:   if(!(ofp=fopen(LAST_FILE,"r")))
  2922:     return; /* no file, no gripe */
  2923: 
  2924:   fseek(ofp,0L,SEEK_END);
  2925:   recs=ftell(ofp)/sizeof(struct last_entry);
  2926:   rewind(ofp);
  2927: 
  2928:   if (recs < MAX_LAST_ENTRIES) {
  2929:     fclose(ofp);
  2930:     return;
  2931:   }
  2932: 
  2933:   if (!(nfp=fopen("etc/nlast", "w"))) {
  2934:     log("Error trying to open new last file.");
  2935:     fclose(ofp);
  2936:     return;
  2937:   }
  2938: 
  2939:   /* skip first entries */
  2940:   fseek(ofp,(recs-MAX_LAST_ENTRIES)* (sizeof(struct last_entry)),SEEK_CUR);
  2941: 
  2942:   /* copy the rest */
  2943:   while (!feof(ofp)) {
  2944:     if(fread(&mlast,sizeof(struct last_entry),1,ofp) != 1 ) {
  2945:       log("clean_llog_entries: read error or unexpected end of file.");
  2946:       return;
  2947:     }
  2948:     fwrite(&mlast,sizeof(struct last_entry),1,nfp);
  2949:   }
  2950:   fclose(ofp);
  2951:   fclose(nfp);
  2952: 
  2953:   remove(LAST_FILE);
  2954:   rename("etc/nlast", LAST_FILE);
  2955: }
  2956: 
  2957: /* debugging stuff, if you wanna see the whole file */
  2958: static void list_llog_entries(struct char_data *ch)
  2959: {
  2960:   FILE *fp;
  2961:   struct last_entry llast;
  2962:   char timestr[25];
  2963: 
  2964:   if(!(fp=fopen(LAST_FILE,"r"))) {
  2965:     log("llist_log_entries: could not open last log file %s.", LAST_FILE);
  2966:     send_to_char(ch, "Error! - no last log");
  2967:   }
  2968:   send_to_char(ch, "Last log\r\n");
  2969: 
  2970:   while(fread(&llast, sizeof(struct last_entry), 1, fp) == 1) {
  2971:     strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%a %b %d %Y %H:%M:%S", localtime(&llast.time));
  2972:     send_to_char(ch, "%10s    %d    %s    %s\r\n", llast.username, llast.punique,
  2973:         last_array[llast.close_type], timestr);
  2974:       break;
  2975:   }
  2976: 
  2977:   if(ferror(fp)) {
  2978:     log("llist_log_entries: error reading %s.", LAST_FILE);
  2979:     send_to_char(ch, "Error reading last_log file.");
  2980:   }
  2981: }

  2983: static struct char_data *is_in_game(long idnum) {
  2984:   struct char_data *i;
  2985: 
  2986:   for (i = character_list; i; i = i->next) {
  2987:     if (!IS_NPC(i) && GET_IDNUM(i) == idnum)
  2988:       return i;
  2989:   }
  2990: 
  2991:   return NULL;
  2992: }
