  2994: ACMD(do_last)
  2995: {
  2996:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], timestr[25], to[6];
  2997:   char deltastr[6];
  2998:   time_t delta;
  2999:   struct char_data *vict = NULL;
  3000:   struct char_data *temp;
  3001:   int recs, num = 0;
  3002:   FILE *fp;
  3003:   struct last_entry mlast;
  3004: 
  3005:   *name = '\0';
  3006: 
  3007:   if (*argument) { /* parse it */
  3008:     half_chop(argument, arg, argument);
  3009:     while (*arg) {
  3010:       if ((*arg == '*' || !strcmp(arg, "all")) && (GET_LEVEL(ch) == LVL_IMPL)) {
  3011:         list_llog_entries(ch);
  3012:         return;
  3013:       }
  3014:       if (isdigit(*arg)) {
  3015:         num = atoi(arg);
  3016:         if (num < 0)
  3017:           num = 0;
  3018:       } else {
  3019:         strncpy(name, arg, sizeof(name)-1);
  3020:         name[sizeof(name) - 1] = '\0';
  3021:       }
  3022:       
  3023:       half_chop(argument, arg, argument);
  3024:     }
  3025:   }
  3026: 
  3027:   if (*name && !num) {
  3028:     CREATE(vict, struct char_data, 1);
  3029:     clear_char(vict);
  3030:     CREATE(vict->player_specials, struct player_special_data, 1);
  3031:     new_mobile_data(vict);
  3032:     if (load_char(name, vict) <  0) {
  3033:       send_to_char(ch, "There is no such player.\r\n");
  3034:       free_char(vict);
  3035:       return;
  3036:     }
  3037: 
  3038:     strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y", localtime(&(vict->player.time.logon)));
  3039: 
  3040:     send_to_char(ch, "[%5ld] [%2d %s] %-12s : %-18s : %-24s\r\n",
  3041:     GET_IDNUM(vict), (int) GET_LEVEL(vict),
  3042:     class_abbrevs[(int) GET_CLASS(vict)], GET_NAME(vict),
  3043:     GET_HOST(vict) && *GET_HOST(vict) ? GET_HOST(vict) : "(NOHOST)", timestr);
  3044:     free_char(vict);
  3045:     return;
  3046:     }
  3047: 
  3048:   if(num <= 0 || num >= 100) {
  3049:     num=10;
  3050:   }
  3051: 
  3052:   if(!(fp=fopen(LAST_FILE,"r"))) {
  3053:     send_to_char(ch, "No entries found.\r\n");
  3054:     return;
  3055:   }
  3056:   fseek(fp,0L,SEEK_END);
  3057:   recs=ftell(fp)/sizeof(struct last_entry);
  3058: 
  3059:   send_to_char(ch, "Last log\r\n");
  3060:   while(num > 0 && recs > 0) {
  3061:     fseek(fp,-1* ((long)sizeof(struct last_entry)),SEEK_CUR);
  3062:     if(fread(&mlast,sizeof(struct last_entry),1,fp) != 1) {
  3063:       send_to_char(ch, "Error reading log file.");
  3064:       return;
  3065:     }
  3066:     fseek(fp,-1*((long)sizeof(struct last_entry)),SEEK_CUR);
  3067:     if(!*name ||(*name && !str_cmp(name, mlast.username))) {
  3068:       strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%a %b %d %Y %H:%M", localtime(&mlast.time));
  3069:       send_to_char(ch, "%10.10s %20.20s %20.21s - ",
  3070:         mlast.username, mlast.hostname, timestr);
  3071:       if((temp=is_in_game(mlast.idnum)) && mlast.punique == GET_PREF(temp)) {
  3072:         send_to_char(ch, "Still Playing  ");
  3073:       } else {
  3074:         delta = mlast.close_time - mlast.time;
  3075: 	strftime(to, sizeof(to), "%H:%M", localtime(&mlast.close_time));
  3076: 	strftime(deltastr, sizeof(deltastr), "%H:%M", gmtime(&delta));
  3077: 
  3078:         send_to_char(ch, "%5.5s (%5.5s) %s", to, deltastr,
  3079:           last_array[mlast.close_type]);
  3080:       }
  3081: 
  3082:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
  3083:       num--;
  3084:     }
  3085:     recs--;
  3086:   }
  3087:   fclose(fp);
  3088: }

  3142: ACMD(do_wiznet)
  3143: {
  3144:   char buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + MAX_NAME_LENGTH + 32],
  3145:        buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + MAX_NAME_LENGTH + 32];
  3146:   struct descriptor_data *d;
  3147:   char emote = FALSE;

  3149: 
  3150:   skip_spaces(&argument);

  3152:   if (!*argument) {
  3153:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: wiznet [ #<level> ] [<text> | *<emotetext> | @ ]\r\n");
  3154:     return;
  3155:   }
  3156:   switch (*argument) {
  3157:   case '*':
  3158:     emote = TRUE;
  3159:   case '#':
  3160:     one_argument(argument + 1, buf1);
  3161:     if (is_number(buf1)) {
  3162:       half_chop(argument+1, buf1, argument);
  3163:       level = MAX(atoi(buf1), LVL_IMMORT);
  3164:       if (level > GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  3165: 	send_to_char(ch, "You can't wizline above your own level.\r\n");
  3166: 	return;
  3167:       }
  3168:     } else if (emote)
  3169:       argument++;
  3170:     break;
  3171: 
  3172:   case '@':
  3173:     send_to_char(ch, "God channel status:\r\n");
  3174:     for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
  3175:       if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING || GET_LEVEL(d->character) < LVL_IMMORT)
  3176:         continue;
  3177:       if (!CAN_SEE(ch, d->character))
  3178:         continue;
  3179: 
  3180:       send_to_char(ch, "  %-*s%s%s%s\r\n", MAX_NAME_LENGTH, GET_NAME(d->character),
  3181: 		PLR_FLAGGED(d->character, PLR_WRITING) ? " (Writing)" : "",
  3182: 		PLR_FLAGGED(d->character, PLR_MAILING) ? " (Writing mail)" : "",
  3183: 		PRF_FLAGGED(d->character, PRF_NOWIZ) ? " (Offline)" : "");
  3184:     }
  3185:     return;
  3186: 
  3187:   case '\\':
  3188:     ++argument;
  3189:     break;
  3190:   default:
  3191:     break;
  3192:   }
  3193:   if (PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOWIZ)) {
  3194:     send_to_char(ch, "You are offline!\r\n");
  3195:     return;
  3196:   }
  3197:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  3198: 
  3199:   if (!*argument) {
  3200:     send_to_char(ch, "Don't bother the gods like that!\r\n");
  3201:     return;
  3202:   }
  3203:   if (level > LVL_IMMORT) {
  3204:     snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "\tc%s: <%d> %s%s\tn\r\n", GET_NAME(ch), level, emote ? "<--- " : "", argument);
  3205:     snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf1), "\tcSomeone: <%d> %s%s\tn\r\n", level, emote ? "<--- " : "", argument);
  3206: } else {
  3207:     snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "\tc%s: %s%s\tn\r\n", GET_NAME(ch), emote ? "<--- " : "", argument);
  3208:     snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf1), "\tcSomeone: %s%s\tn\r\n", emote ? "<--- " : "", argument);
  3209:   }
  3210: 
  3211:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
  3212:     if (IS_PLAYING(d) && (GET_LEVEL(d->character) >= level) &&
  3213: 	(!PRF_FLAGGED(d->character, PRF_NOWIZ))
  3214: 	&& (d != ch->desc || !(PRF_FLAGGED(d->character, PRF_NOREPEAT)))) {
  3215:       if (CAN_SEE(d->character, ch)) {
  3216:         parse_at(buf1);
  3217:         send_to_char(d->character, "%s%s%s", CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), buf1, CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
  3218:         add_history(d->character, buf1, HIST_WIZNET);
  3219:       } else {
  3220:         parse_at(buf2);
  3221:         send_to_char(d->character, "%s%s%s", CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), buf2, CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
  3222:         add_history(d->character, buf2, HIST_WIZNET);
  3223:       }
  3224:     }
  3225:   }
  3226: 
  3227:   if (PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOREPEAT))
  3228:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);

  3266: ACMD(do_wizutil)
  3267: {
  3268:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3269:   struct char_data *vict;
  3270:   int taeller;
  3271:   long result;
  3272: 
  3273:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  3274: 
  3275:   if (!*arg)
  3276:     send_to_char(ch, "Yes, but for whom?!?\r\n");
  3277:   else if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, arg, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)))
  3278:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no such player.\r\n");
  3279:   else if (IS_NPC(vict))
  3280:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't do that to a mob!\r\n");
  3281:   else if (GET_LEVEL(vict) >= GET_LEVEL(ch) && vict != ch)
  3282:     send_to_char(ch, "Hmmm...you'd better not.\r\n");
  3283:   else {
  3284:     switch (subcmd) {
  3285:     case SCMD_REROLL:
  3286:       send_to_char(ch, "Rerolled...\r\n");
  3287:       roll_real_abils(vict);
  3288:       log("(GC) %s has rerolled %s.", GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(vict));
  3289:       send_to_char(ch, "New stats: Str %d/%d, Int %d, Wis %d, Dex %d, Con %d, Cha %d\r\n",
  3290: 	      GET_STR(vict), GET_ADD(vict), GET_INT(vict), GET_WIS(vict),
  3291: 	      GET_DEX(vict), GET_CON(vict), GET_CHA(vict));
  3292:       break;
  3293:     case SCMD_PARDON:
  3294:       if (!PLR_FLAGGED(vict, PLR_THIEF) && !PLR_FLAGGED(vict, PLR_KILLER)) {
  3295: 	send_to_char(ch, "Your victim is not flagged.\r\n");
  3296: 	return;
  3297:       }
  3298:       REMOVE_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(vict), PLR_THIEF);
  3299:       REMOVE_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(vict), PLR_KILLER);
  3300:       send_to_char(ch, "Pardoned.\r\n");
  3301:       send_to_char(vict, "You have been pardoned by the Gods!\r\n");
  3302:       mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s pardoned by %s", GET_NAME(vict), GET_NAME(ch));
  3303:       break;
  3304:     case SCMD_NOTITLE:
  3305:       result = PLR_TOG_CHK(vict, PLR_NOTITLE);
  3306:       mudlog(NRM, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) Notitle %s for %s by %s.",
  3307: 		ONOFF(result), GET_NAME(vict), GET_NAME(ch));
  3308:       send_to_char(ch, "(GC) Notitle %s for %s by %s.\r\n", ONOFF(result), GET_NAME(vict), GET_NAME(ch));
  3309:       break;
  3310:     case SCMD_MUTE:
  3311:       result = PLR_TOG_CHK(vict, PLR_NOSHOUT);
  3312:       mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) Mute %s for %s by %s.",
  3313: 		ONOFF(result), GET_NAME(vict), GET_NAME(ch));
  3314:       send_to_char(ch, "(GC) Mute %s for %s by %s.\r\n", ONOFF(result), GET_NAME(vict), GET_NAME(ch));
  3315:       break;
  3316:     case SCMD_FREEZE:
  3317:       if (ch == vict) {
  3318: 	send_to_char(ch, "Oh, yeah, THAT'S real smart...\r\n");
  3319: 	return;
  3320:       }
  3321:       if (PLR_FLAGGED(vict, PLR_FROZEN)) {
  3322: 	send_to_char(ch, "Your victim is already pretty cold.\r\n");
  3323: 	return;
  3324:       }
  3325:       SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(vict), PLR_FROZEN);
  3326:       GET_FREEZE_LEV(vict) = GET_LEVEL(ch);
  3327:       send_to_char(vict, "A bitter wind suddenly rises and drains every erg of heat from your body!\r\nYou feel frozen!\r\n");
  3328:       send_to_char(ch, "Frozen.\r\n");
  3329:       act("A sudden cold wind conjured from nowhere freezes $n!", FALSE, vict, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  3330:       mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s frozen by %s.", GET_NAME(vict), GET_NAME(ch));
  3331:       break;
  3332:     case SCMD_THAW:
  3333:       if (!PLR_FLAGGED(vict, PLR_FROZEN)) {
  3334: 	send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, your victim is not morbidly encased in ice at the moment.\r\n");
  3335: 	return;
  3336:       }
  3337:       if (GET_FREEZE_LEV(vict) > GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  3338: 	send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, a level %d God froze %s... you can't unfreeze %s.\r\n",
  3339: 		GET_FREEZE_LEV(vict), GET_NAME(vict), HMHR(vict));
  3340: 	return;
  3341:       }
  3342:       mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s un-frozen by %s.", GET_NAME(vict), GET_NAME(ch));
  3343:       REMOVE_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(vict), PLR_FROZEN);
  3344:       send_to_char(vict, "A fireball suddenly explodes in front of you, melting the ice!\r\nYou feel thawed.\r\n");
  3345:       send_to_char(ch, "Thawed.\r\n");
  3346:       act("A sudden fireball conjured from nowhere thaws $n!", FALSE, vict, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  3347:       break;
  3348:     case SCMD_UNAFFECT:
  3349:       if (vict->affected || has_any_affect_flags(vict)) {
  3350: 	while (vict->affected)
  3351: 	  affect_remove(vict, vict->affected);
  3352:     for(taeller=0; taeller < AF_ARRAY_MAX; taeller++)
  3353:       AFF_FLAGS(vict)[taeller] = 0;
  3354:     send_to_char(vict, "There is a brief flash of light!\r\nYou feel slightly different.\r\n");
  3355: 	send_to_char(ch, "All spells removed.\r\n");
  3356:       } else {
  3357: 	send_to_char(ch, "Your victim does not have any affections!\r\n");
  3358: 	return;
  3359:       }
  3360:       break;
  3361:     default:
  3362:       log("SYSERR: Unknown subcmd %d passed to do_wizutil (%s)", subcmd, __FILE__);
  3363:       /*  SYSERR_DESC: This is the same as the unhandled case in do_gen_ps(),
  3364:        *  but this function handles 'reroll', 'pardon', 'freeze', etc. */
  3365:       break;
  3366:     }
  3367:     save_char(vict);
  3368:   }
  3369: }

  3371: /* single zone printing fn used by "show zone" so it's not repeated in the
  3372:    code 3 times ... -je, 4/6/93 FIXME: overflow possible */
  3373: static size_t print_zone_to_buf(char *bufptr, size_t left, zone_rnum zone, int listall)
  3374: {
  3375:   size_t tmp;
  3376: 
  3377:   if (listall) {
  3378:     int i, j, k, l, m, n, o;
  3379:     char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  3380: 
  3381:     sprintbitarray(zone_table[zone].zone_flags, zone_bits, ZN_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
  3382: 
  3383:     tmp = snprintf(bufptr, left,
  3384: 	"%3d %-30.30s%s By: %-10.10s%s Age: %3d; Reset: %3d (%s); Range: %5d-%5d\r\n",
  3385: 	zone_table[zone].number, zone_table[zone].name, KNRM, zone_table[zone].builders, KNRM,
  3386: 	zone_table[zone].age, zone_table[zone].lifespan,
  3387:         zone_table[zone].reset_mode ? ((zone_table[zone].reset_mode == 1) ? "Reset when no players are in zone" : "Normal reset") : "Never reset",
  3388: 	zone_table[zone].bot, zone_table[zone].top);
  3389:         j = k = l = m = n = o = 0;
  3390: 
  3391:         for (i = 0; i < top_of_world; i++)
  3392:           if (world[i].number >= zone_table[zone].bot && world[i].number <= zone_table[zone].top)
  3393:             j++;
  3394: 
  3395:         for (i = 0; i < top_of_objt; i++)
  3396:           if (obj_index[i].vnum >= zone_table[zone].bot && obj_index[i].vnum <= zone_table[zone].top)
  3397:             k++;
  3398: 
  3399:         for (i = 0; i < top_of_mobt; i++)
  3400:           if (mob_index[i].vnum >= zone_table[zone].bot && mob_index[i].vnum <= zone_table[zone].top)
  3401:             l++;
  3402: 
  3403:         for (i = 0; i<= top_shop; i++)
  3404:           if (SHOP_NUM(i) >= zone_table[zone].bot && SHOP_NUM(i) <= zone_table[zone].top)
  3405:             m++;
  3406: 
  3407:         for (i = 0; i < top_of_trigt; i++)
  3408:           if (trig_index[i]->vnum >= zone_table[zone].bot && trig_index[i]->vnum <= zone_table[zone].top)
  3409:             n++;
  3410: 
  3411:         o = count_quests(zone_table[zone].bot, zone_table[zone].top);
  3412: 
  3413: 	tmp += snprintf(bufptr + tmp, left - tmp,
  3414:                         "       Zone stats:\r\n"
  3415:                         "       ---------------\r\n"
  3416:                         "         Flags:    %s\r\n"
  3417:                         "         Min Lev:  %2d\r\n"
  3418:                         "         Max Lev:  %2d\r\n"
  3419:                         "         Rooms:    %2d\r\n"
  3420:                         "         Objects:  %2d\r\n"
  3421:                         "         Mobiles:  %2d\r\n"
  3422:                         "         Shops:    %2d\r\n"
  3423:                         "         Triggers: %2d\r\n"
  3424:                         "         Quests:   %2d\r\n",
  3425: 			buf, zone_table[zone].min_level, zone_table[zone].max_level,

  3428:     return tmp;
  3429:   }
  3430: 
  3431:     return snprintf(bufptr, left,
  3432:         "%3d %-*s%s By: %-10.10s%s Range: %5d-%5d\r\n", zone_table[zone].number,
  3433: 	count_color_chars(zone_table[zone].name)+30, zone_table[zone].name, KNRM,
  3434: 	zone_table[zone].builders, KNRM, zone_table[zone].bot, zone_table[zone].top);

  3773:         if (on) SET_BIT_AR(flagset, flags); \
  3774:         else if (off) REMOVE_BIT_AR(flagset, flags); }

  3776: #define RANGE(low, high) (value = MAX((low), MIN((high), (value))))

  3848: static int perform_set(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict, int mode, char *val_arg)
  3849: {
  3850:   int i, on = 0, off = 0, value = 0, qvnum;

  3854:   /* Check to make sure all the levels are correct */

  4272: 
  4273: static void show_set_help(struct char_data *ch)
  4274: {
  4275:   const char *set_levels[] = {"Imm", "God", "GrGod", "IMP"};
  4276:   const char *set_targets[] = {"PC", "NPC", "BOTH"};
  4277:   const char *set_types[] = {"MISC", "BINARY", "NUMBER"};
  4278:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  4279:   int i, len=0, add_len=0;
  4280: 
  4281:   len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  4282:       "Syntax: set <target> <field> <value>  OR  set <field> <target> <value>\r\n"
  4283:       "Aliases: health/hp (current + max), maxhealth/maxhp, mp/maxmp, "
  4284:       "mv/moves/maxmv, xp/experience, armor, full stat names, qp, money.\r\n"
  4285:       "Exact field names in the first position select field-first syntax.\r\n\r\n"
  4286:       "%sCommand             Lvl    Who?  Type%s\r\n",
  4287:       CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  4288:   for (i = 0; *(set_fields[i].cmd) != '\n'; i++) {
  4289: 	if (set_fields[i].level <= GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  4290:       add_len = snprintf(buf+len, sizeof(buf)-len, "%-20s%-5s  %-4s  %-6s\r\n", set_fields[i].cmd,
  4291:                                         set_levels[((int)(set_fields[i].level) - LVL_IMMORT)],
  4292:                                         set_targets[(int)(set_fields[i].pcnpc)-1],
  4293:                                         set_types[(int)(set_fields[i].type)]);
  4294:       len += add_len;
  4295:     }
  4296:   }
  4297:   page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
  4298: }
  4299: 
  4300: static const char *canonical_set_field(const char *field)
  4301: {
  4302:   static const struct { const char *alias, *field; } aliases[] = {
  4303:     { "armor", "ac" }, { "strength", "str" }, { "dexterity", "dex" },
  4304:     { "constitution", "con" }, { "intelligence", "int" },
  4305:     { "wisdom", "wis" }, { "charisma", "cha" },
  4306:     { "xp", "exp" }, { "experience", "exp" },
  4307:     { "mp", "mana" }, { "maxmp", "maxmana" },
  4308:     { "mv", "move" }, { "moves", "move" }, { "maxmv", "maxmove" },
  4309:     { "maxhealth", "maxhit" }, { "maxhp", "maxhit" },
  4310:     { "qp", "questpoints" }, { "money", "gold" },
  4311:     { NULL, NULL }
  4312:   };
  4313:   int i;
  4314: 
  4315:   for (i = 0; aliases[i].alias; i++)
  4316:     if (!str_cmp(field, aliases[i].alias))
  4317:       return aliases[i].field;
  4318:   return field;
  4319: }
  4320: 
  4321: static bool is_set_field_name(const char *field)
  4322: {
  4323:   const char *canonical = canonical_set_field(field);
  4324:   int i;
  4325: 
  4326:   if (!str_cmp(field, "health") || !str_cmp(field, "hp"))
  4327:     return TRUE;
  4328:   for (i = 0; *(set_fields[i].cmd) != '\n'; i++)
  4329:     if (!str_cmp(canonical, set_fields[i].cmd))
  4330:       return TRUE;
  4331:   return FALSE;
  4332: }
  4333: 
  4334: static bool set_field_rejects_negative(const char *field)
  4335: {
  4336:   return !str_cmp(field, "bank") || !str_cmp(field, "exp") ||
  4337:          !str_cmp(field, "gold") || !str_cmp(field, "mana") ||
  4338:          !str_cmp(field, "maxhit") || !str_cmp(field, "maxmana") ||
  4339:          !str_cmp(field, "maxmove") || !str_cmp(field, "move") ||
  4340:          !str_cmp(field, "practices") || !str_cmp(field, "questpoints") ||
  4341:          !str_cmp(field, "diamond") || !str_cmp(field, "diamonds");
  4342: }

  4344: ACMD(do_set)
  4345: {
  4346:   struct char_data *vict = NULL, *cbuf = NULL;
  4347:   char field[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  4348:   int mode, len, player_i = 0, retval = 0;
  4349:   char is_file = 0, is_player = 0, field_first = 0;
  4350: 
  4351:   half_chop(argument, name, buf);
  4352: 
  4353:   /* Exact field names take precedence in field-first form. This avoids
  4354:    * ambiguous abbreviation/name collisions while preserving target-first. */
  4355:   if (is_set_field_name(name)) {
  4356:     strlcpy(field, name, sizeof(field));
  4357:     half_chop(buf, name, buf);
  4358:     field_first = 1;
  4359:   }
  4360: 
  4361:   if (!field_first && !strcmp(name, "file")) {
  4362:     is_file = 1;
  4363:     half_chop(buf, name, buf);
  4364:   } else if (!str_cmp(name, "help")) {
  4365:     show_set_help(ch);
  4366:     return;
  4367:   } else if (!str_cmp(name, "player")) {
  4368:     is_player = 1;
  4369:     half_chop(buf, name, buf);
  4370:   } else if (!str_cmp(name, "mob"))
  4371:     half_chop(buf, name, buf);
  4372: 
  4373:   if (!field_first)
  4374:     half_chop(buf, field, buf);
  4375: 
  4376:   if (!*name || !*field || !*buf) {
  4377:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: set <victim> <field> <value>\r\n");
  4378:     send_to_char(ch, "       set <field> <victim> <value>\r\n");
  4379:     send_to_char(ch, "       %sset help%s will display valid fields\r\n", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  4380:     return;
  4381:   }
  4382: 
  4383:   strlcpy(field, canonical_set_field(field), sizeof(field));
  4384: 
  4385:   /* find the target */
  4386:   if (!is_file) {
  4387:     if (is_player) {
  4388:       if (!(vict = get_player_vis(ch, name, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD))) {
  4389:         send_to_char(ch, "There is no such player.\r\n");
  4390:         return;
  4391:       }
  4392:     } else { /* is_mob */
  4393:       if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, name, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD))) {
  4394:         send_to_char(ch, "There is no such creature.\r\n");
  4395:         return;
  4396:       }
  4397:     }
  4398:   } else if (is_file) {
  4399:     /* try to load the player off disk */
  4400:     CREATE(cbuf, struct char_data, 1);
  4401:     clear_char(cbuf);
  4402:     CREATE(cbuf->player_specials, struct player_special_data, 1);
  4403:     new_mobile_data(cbuf);
  4404:     if ((player_i = load_char(name, cbuf)) > -1) {
  4405:       if (GET_LEVEL(cbuf) > GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  4406:         free_char(cbuf);
  4407:         send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, you can't do that.\r\n");
  4408:         return;
  4409:       }
  4410:       vict = cbuf;
  4411:     } else {
  4412:       free_char(cbuf);
  4413:       send_to_char(ch, "There is no such player.\r\n");
  4414:       return;
  4415:     }
  4416:   }
  4417: 
  4418:   if (!str_cmp(field, "health") || !str_cmp(field, "hp") ||
  4419:       !str_cmp(field, "mana") || !str_cmp(field, "move")) {
  4420:     char *end = NULL;
  4421:     long value_long;
  4422:     const char *resource;
  4423:     errno = 0;
  4424:     value_long = strtol(buf, &end, 10);
  4425:     while (end && *end && isspace((unsigned char)*end))
  4426:       end++;
  4427:     if (errno == ERANGE || end == buf || (end && *end) ||
  4428:         value_long < 1 || value_long > 999999) {
  4429:       send_to_char(ch, "Resource maximum must be a whole number from 1 to 999999.\r\n");
  4430:       goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4431:     }
  4432:     if (!str_cmp(field, "mana")) {
  4433:       GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(vict) = (int)value_long;
  4434:       affect_total(vict);
  4435:       GET_MANA(vict) = effective_max_mana(vict);
  4436:       resource = "mana";
  4437:       send_to_char(ch, "%s's %s set to %d/%d.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict), resource,
  4438:                    GET_MANA(vict), effective_max_mana(vict));
  4439:     } else if (!str_cmp(field, "move")) {
  4440:       GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(vict) = (int)value_long;
  4441:       affect_total(vict);
  4442:       GET_MOVE(vict) = effective_max_move(vict);
  4443:       resource = "move";
  4444:       send_to_char(ch, "%s's %s set to %d/%d.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict), resource,
  4445:                    GET_MOVE(vict), effective_max_move(vict));
  4446:     } else {
  4447:       GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(vict) = (int)value_long;
  4448:       affect_total(vict);
  4449:       GET_HIT(vict) = GET_MAX_HIT(vict);
  4450:       send_to_char(ch, "%s's health set to %d/%d.\r\n",
  4451:                    GET_NAME(vict), GET_HIT(vict), GET_MAX_HIT(vict));
  4452:     }
  4453:     retval = 1;
  4454:     goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4455:   }
  4456: 
  4457:     if (!strcmp(field, "diamond") || !strcmp(field, "diamonds")) {
  4458:     char *endp = NULL;
  4459:     long long req;
  4460: 
  4461:     errno = 0;
  4462:     req = strtoll(buf, &endp, 10);
  4463:     while (endp && *endp && isspace((unsigned char)*endp))
  4464:       endp++;
  4465:     if (errno == ERANGE || endp == buf || (endp && *endp) || req < 0) {
  4466:       send_to_char(ch, "Value must be a non-negative whole number.\r\n");
  4467:       retval = 0;
  4468:       goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4469:     }
  4470: 
  4471:     if (req > 2147483647LL) req = 2147483647LL;
  4472: 
  4473:     GET_DIAMONDS(vict) = (int)req;
  4474: 
  4475:     send_to_char(ch, "%s set %s's diamonds to %lld.\r\n",
  4476:       GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(vict), req);
  4477: 
  4478:     retval = 1;
  4479:     goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4480:   }
  4481: 
  4482:   /* Direct currency set: canonical total is gold units. */
  4483:   if (!strcmp(field, "gold") || !strcmp(field, "money")) {
  4484:       long long amount = 0;
  4485:       char *endp = NULL;
  4486:       char *valp = buf;
  4487: 
  4488:       skip_spaces(&valp);
  4489:       if (!*valp) {
  4490:         send_to_char(ch, "Usage: set <victim> <gold|money> <number>\r\n");
  4491:         retval = 0;
  4492:         goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4493:       }
  4494: 
  4495:       errno = 0;
  4496:       amount = strtoll(valp, &endp, 10);
  4497:       while (endp && *endp && isspace((unsigned char)*endp))
  4498:         endp++;
  4499:       if (errno == ERANGE || endp == valp || (endp && *endp) || amount < 0) {
  4500:         send_to_char(ch, "Value must be a non-negative whole number.\r\n");
  4501:         retval = 0;
  4502:         goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4503:       }
  4504: 
  4505:       if (amount > MAX_MONEY) amount = MAX_MONEY;
  4506: 
  4507:       GET_MONEY(vict) = amount;
  4508: 
  4509:       send_to_char(ch, "%s set %s's gold to %lld.\r\n",
  4510:         GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(vict), amount);
  4511: 
  4512:       retval = 1;
  4513:       goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4514:     }
  4515: 
  4516:   if (!strcmp(field, "glory")) {
  4517:     char *endp = NULL;
  4518:     long long req;
  4519: 
  4520:     errno = 0;
  4521:     req = strtoll(buf, &endp, 10);
  4522:     while (endp && *endp && isspace((unsigned char)*endp))
  4523:       endp++;
  4524:     if (errno == ERANGE || endp == buf || (endp && *endp) || req < 0) {
  4525:       send_to_char(ch, "Value must be a non-negative whole number.\r\n");
  4526:       retval = 0;
  4527:       goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4528:     }
  4529: 
  4530:     if (req > 2147483647LL) req = 2147483647LL;
  4531: 
  4532:     GET_GLORY(vict) = (int)req;
  4533: 
  4534:     send_to_char(ch, "%s set %s's glory to %lld.\r\n",
  4535:       GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(vict), req);
  4536: 
  4537:     retval = 1;
  4538:     goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4539:   }
  4540: 
  4541:   /* find the command in the list */
  4542:   len = strlen(field);
  4543:   for (mode = 0; *(set_fields[mode].cmd) != '\n'; mode++)
  4544:     if (!strncmp(field, set_fields[mode].cmd, len))
  4545:       break;
  4546: 
  4547:   if (*(set_fields[mode].cmd) == '\n') {
  4548:     retval = 0; /* skips saving below */
  4549:     send_to_char(ch, "Can't set that!\r\n");
  4550:   } else {
  4551:     if (set_fields[mode].type == NUMBER) {
  4552:       char *end = NULL;
  4553:       long parsed;
  4554:       errno = 0;
  4555:       parsed = strtol(buf, &end, 10);
  4556:       while (end && *end && isspace((unsigned char)*end))
  4557:         end++;
  4558:       if (errno == ERANGE || parsed < INT_MIN || parsed > INT_MAX ||
  4559:           end == buf || (end && *end)) {
  4560:         send_to_char(ch, "Value must be a valid whole number.\r\n");
  4561:         goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4562:       }
  4563:       if (parsed < 0 && set_field_rejects_negative(field)) {
  4564:         send_to_char(ch, "That field does not accept negative values.\r\n");
  4565:         goto do_set_save_and_cleanup;
  4566:       }
  4567:     }
  4568:     /* perform the set */
  4569:     retval = perform_set(ch, vict, mode, buf);
  4570:   }
  4571: 
  4572: do_set_save_and_cleanup:
  4573:   /* save the character if a change was made */
  4574:   if (retval) {
  4575:     if (!is_file && !IS_NPC(vict))
  4576:       save_char(vict);
  4577:     if (is_file) {
  4578:       GET_PFILEPOS(cbuf) = player_i;
  4579:       save_char(cbuf);
  4580:       send_to_char(ch, "Saved in file.\r\n");
  4581:     }
  4582:   }
  4583: 
  4584:   /* free the memory if we allocated it earlier */
  4585:   if (is_file)
  4586:     free_char(cbuf);
  4587: }

  4731: ACMD (do_zcheck)

  4767:

  4769:           len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  4770:                           "- Short description hasn't been set.\r\n");
  4771: 
  4772:         if (!strncmp(mob->player.long_descr, "An unfinished mob stands here.", 30) && (found=1))
  4773:           len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  4774:                           "- Long description hasn't been set.\r\n");
  4775: 
  4776:         if (mob->player.description && *mob->player.description) {
  4777:           if (!strncmp(mob->player.description, "It looks unfinished.", 20) && (found=1))
  4778:             len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  4779:                             "- Description hasn't been set.\r\n");

  4781:             len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  4782:                             "- Description hasn't been formatted. (/fi)\r\n");
  4783:         }
  4784: 
  4785:         if (GET_LEVEL(mob)>MAX_LEVEL_ALLOWED && (found=1))
  4786:           len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  4787:                           "- Is level %d (limit: 1-%d)\r\n",
  4788:                           GET_LEVEL(mob), MAX_LEVEL_ALLOWED);
  4789: 
  4790:         if (GET_DAMROLL(mob)>MAX_DAMROLL_ALLOWED && (found=1))

  4793:                           GET_DAMROLL(mob), MAX_DAMROLL_ALLOWED);
  4794:

  4796:           len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,

  4798:                           GET_HITROLL(mob), MAX_HITROLL_ALLOWED);
  4799: 
  4800:         /* avg. dam including damroll per round of combat */
  4801:         avg_dam = (((mob->mob_specials.damsizedice / 2.0) * mob->mob_specials.damnodice)+GET_DAMROLL(mob));

  4810:             (found=1))

  4815: 	 len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,

  4858: 
  4859:  /* Check objects */
  4860:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\nChecking Objects for limits...\r\n");

  4890:           break;
  4891:

  4893: 
  4894:       if (!CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_TAKE)) {
  4895:         if ((GET_OBJ_COST(obj) || (GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_FOUNTAIN) ||

  4902:           len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,

  4904:

  4912:                           GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj), MAX_OBJ_WEIGHT);
  4913: 
  4914:

  4920:

  4924:                           GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj), LVL_IMMORT-1);
  4925: 
  4926:       if (obj->action_description && *obj->action_description &&
  4927:           GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_STAFF &&
  4928:           GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_WAND &&
  4929:           GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_SCROLL &&
  4930:           GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_NOTE && (found=1))
  4931:         len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  4932:                           "- has action_description set, but is inappropriate type.\r\n");
  4933:

  4935:       for (affs=0, j = 0; j < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; j++)

  4946:             (obj->affected[j].modifier > zaffs[(int)obj->affected[j].location].max_aff ||
  4947:              obj->affected[j].modifier < zaffs[(int)obj->affected[j].location].min_aff ||
  4948:              zaffs[(int)obj->affected[j].location].min_aff == zaffs[(int)obj->affected[j].location].max_aff) && (found=1))
  4949:           len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,

  4951:                                zaffs[(int)obj->affected[j].location].message,
  4952:                                obj->affected[j].modifier,
  4953:                                zaffs[(int)obj->affected[j].location].min_aff,
  4954:                                zaffs[(int)obj->affected[j].location].max_aff);
  4955: 
  4956:      /* special handling of +hit and +dam because of +hit_n_dam */
  4957:      for (todam=0, tohit=0, j=0;j<MAX_OBJ_AFFECT;j++) {

  4970:                        tohit, MAX_APPLY_HITROLL_TOTAL);

  4979:                        "- has unformatted extra description\r\n");
  4980:      /* Additional object checks. */
  4981:      if (found) {
  4982:         send_to_char(ch, "[%5d] %-30s: \r\n", GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description);
  4983:         send_to_char(ch, "%s", buf);

  4985:       strcpy(buf, "");

  4987:       found = 0;
  4988:     }   /*object is in zone*/
  4989:   } /*check objects*/
  4990: 
  4991:   /* Check rooms */
  4992:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\nChecking Rooms for limits...\r\n");
  4993:   for (i=0; i<top_of_world;i++) {
  4994:     if (world[i].zone==zrnum) {
  4995:       for (j = 0; j < DIR_COUNT; j++) {
  4996:         /*check for exit, but ignore off limits if you're in an offlimit zone*/
  4997:         if (!world[i].dir_option[j])
  4998:           continue;
  4999:         exroom=world[i].dir_option[j]->to_room;
  5000:         if (exroom==NOWHERE)
  5001:           continue;
  5002:         if (world[exroom].zone == zrnum)
  5003:           continue;
  5004:         if (world[exroom].zone == world[i].zone)
  5005:           continue;

  5008:           if (world[exroom].zone == real_zone(offlimit_zones[k]) && (found = 1))

  5016:          len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,

  5020:                             ROOM_FLAGGED(i, ROOM_HOUSE_CRASH) ? "HCRSH" : "",

  5022:                             ROOM_FLAGGED(i, ROOM_BFS_MARK) ? "*" : "");

  5028:

  5057:

  5071: 
  5072: }

  5074: static void mob_checkload(struct char_data *ch, mob_vnum mvnum)
  5075: {
  5076:   int cmd_no;
  5077:   zone_rnum zone;
  5078:   mob_rnum mrnum = real_mobile(mvnum);
  5079: 
  5080:   if (mrnum == NOBODY) {
  5081:       send_to_char(ch, "That mob does not exist.\r\n");
  5082:       return;
  5083:   }
  5084: 
  5085:   send_to_char(ch, "Checking load info for the mob %s...\r\n",
  5086:                     mob_proto[mrnum].player.short_descr);
  5087: 
  5088:   for (zone=0; zone <= top_of_zone_table; zone++) {
  5089:     for (cmd_no = 0; ZCMD2.command != 'S'; cmd_no++) {
  5090:       if (ZCMD2.command != 'M')
  5091:         continue;
  5092: 
  5093:       /* read a mobile */
  5094:       if (ZCMD2.arg1 == mrnum) {
  5095:         send_to_char(ch, "  [%5d] %s (%d MAX)\r\n",
  5096:                          world[ZCMD2.arg3].number,
  5097:                          world[ZCMD2.arg3].name,
  5098:                          ZCMD2.arg2);
  5099:       }
  5100:     }
  5101:   }
  5102: }
  5103: 
  5104: static void obj_checkload(struct char_data *ch, obj_vnum ovnum)
  5105: {
  5106:   int cmd_no;
  5107:   zone_rnum zone;
  5108:   obj_rnum ornum = real_object(ovnum);
  5109:   room_vnum lastroom_v = 0;
  5110:   room_rnum lastroom_r = 0;
  5111:   mob_rnum lastmob_r = 0;
  5112: 
  5113:   if (ornum ==NOTHING) {
  5114:     send_to_char(ch, "That object does not exist.\r\n");
  5115:     return;
  5116:   }
  5117: 
  5118:   send_to_char(ch, "Checking load info for the obj %s...\r\n",
  5119:                    obj_proto[ornum].short_description);
  5120: 
  5121:   for (zone=0; zone <= top_of_zone_table; zone++) {
  5122:     for (cmd_no = 0; ZCMD2.command != 'S'; cmd_no++) {
  5123:       switch (ZCMD2.command) {
  5124:         case 'M':
  5125:           lastroom_v = world[ZCMD2.arg3].number;
  5126:           lastroom_r = ZCMD2.arg3;
  5127:           lastmob_r = ZCMD2.arg1;
  5128:           break;
  5129:         case 'O':                   /* read an object */
  5130:           lastroom_v = world[ZCMD2.arg3].number;
  5131:           lastroom_r = ZCMD2.arg3;
  5132:           if (ZCMD2.arg1 == ornum)
  5133:             send_to_char(ch, "  [%5d] %s (%d Max)\r\n",
  5134:                              lastroom_v,
  5135:                              world[lastroom_r].name,
  5136:                              ZCMD2.arg2);
  5137:           break;
  5138:         case 'P':                   /* object to object */
  5139:           if (ZCMD2.arg1 == ornum)
  5140:             send_to_char(ch, "  [%5d] %s (Put in another object [%d Max])\r\n",
  5141:                              lastroom_v,
  5142:                              world[lastroom_r].name,
  5143:                              ZCMD2.arg2);
  5144:           break;
  5145:         case 'G':                   /* obj_to_char */
  5146:           if (ZCMD2.arg1 == ornum)
  5147:             send_to_char(ch, "  [%5d] %s (Given to %s [%d][%d Max])\r\n",
  5148:                              lastroom_v,
  5149:                              world[lastroom_r].name,
  5150:                              mob_proto[lastmob_r].player.short_descr,
  5151:                              mob_index[lastmob_r].vnum,
  5152:                              ZCMD2.arg2);
  5153:           break;
  5154:         case 'E':                   /* object to equipment list */
  5155:           if (ZCMD2.arg1 == ornum)
  5156:             send_to_char(ch, "  [%5d] %s (Equipped to %s [%d][%d Max])\r\n",
  5157:                              lastroom_v,
  5158:                              world[lastroom_r].name,
  5159:                              mob_proto[lastmob_r].player.short_descr,
  5160:                              mob_index[lastmob_r].vnum,
  5161:                              ZCMD2.arg2);
  5162:           break;
  5163:         case 'R': /* rem obj from room */
  5164:           lastroom_v = world[ZCMD2.arg1].number;
  5165:           lastroom_r = ZCMD2.arg1;
  5166:           if (ZCMD2.arg2 == ornum)
  5167:             send_to_char(ch, "  [%5d] %s (Removed from room)\r\n",
  5168:                              lastroom_v,
  5169:                              world[lastroom_r].name);
  5170:           break;
  5171:       }/* switch */
  5172:     } /*for cmd_no......*/
  5173:   }  /*for zone...*/
  5174: }
  5175: 
  5176: static void trg_checkload(struct char_data *ch, trig_vnum tvnum)
  5177: {
  5178:   int cmd_no, found = 0;
  5179:   zone_rnum zone;
  5180:   trig_rnum trnum = real_trigger(tvnum);
  5181:   room_vnum lastroom_v = 0;
  5182:   room_rnum lastroom_r = 0, k;
  5183:   mob_rnum lastmob_r = 0, i;
  5184:   obj_rnum lastobj_r = 0, j;
  5185:   struct trig_proto_list *tpl;
  5186: 
  5187:   if (trnum == NOTHING) {
  5188:     send_to_char(ch, "That trigger does not exist.\r\n");
  5189:     return;
  5190:   }
  5191: 
  5192:   send_to_char(ch, "Checking load info for the %s trigger '%s':\r\n",
  5193:                     trig_index[trnum]->proto->attach_type == MOB_TRIGGER ? "mobile" :
  5194:                     (trig_index[trnum]->proto->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? "object" : "room"),
  5195:                     trig_index[trnum]->proto->name);
  5196: 
  5197:   for (zone=0; zone <= top_of_zone_table; zone++) {
  5198:     for (cmd_no = 0; ZCMD2.command != 'S'; cmd_no++) {
  5199:       switch (ZCMD2.command) {
  5200:         case 'M':
  5201:           lastroom_v = world[ZCMD2.arg3].number;
  5202:           lastroom_r = ZCMD2.arg3;
  5203:           lastmob_r = ZCMD2.arg1;
  5204:           break;
  5205:         case 'O':                   /* read an object */
  5206:           lastroom_v = world[ZCMD2.arg3].number;
  5207:           lastroom_r = ZCMD2.arg3;
  5208:           lastobj_r = ZCMD2.arg1;
  5209:           break;
  5210:         case 'P':                   /* object to object */
  5211:           lastobj_r = ZCMD2.arg1;
  5212:           break;
  5213:         case 'G':                   /* obj_to_char */
  5214:           lastobj_r = ZCMD2.arg1;
  5215:           break;
  5216:         case 'E':                   /* object to equipment list */
  5217:           lastobj_r = ZCMD2.arg1;
  5218:           break;
  5219:         case 'R':                   /* rem obj from room */
  5220:           lastroom_v = 0;
  5221:           lastroom_r = 0;
  5222:           lastobj_r = 0;
  5223:           lastmob_r = 0;
  5224:         case 'T':                   /* trigger to something */
  5225:           if (ZCMD2.arg2 != trnum)
  5226:             break;
  5227:           if (ZCMD2.arg1 == MOB_TRIGGER) {
  5228:             send_to_char(ch, "mob [%5d] %-60s (zedit room %5d)\r\n",
  5229:                                mob_index[lastmob_r].vnum,
  5230:                                mob_proto[lastmob_r].player.short_descr,
  5231:                                lastroom_v);
  5232:             found = 1;
  5233:           } else if (ZCMD2.arg1 == OBJ_TRIGGER) {
  5234:             send_to_char(ch, "obj [%5d] %-60s  (zedit room %d)\r\n",
  5235:                                obj_index[lastobj_r].vnum,
  5236:                                obj_proto[lastobj_r].short_description,
  5237:                                lastroom_v);
  5238:             found = 1;
  5239:           } else if (ZCMD2.arg1==WLD_TRIGGER) {
  5240:             send_to_char(ch, "room [%5d] %-60s (zedit)\r\n",
  5241:                                lastroom_v,
  5242:                                world[lastroom_r].name);
  5243:             found = 1;
  5244:           }
  5245:         break;
  5246:       } /* switch */
  5247:     } /*for cmd_no......*/
  5248:   }  /*for zone...*/
  5249: 
  5250:   /* top_of_* is the highest valid rnum for world/mobile/object tables (unlike
  5251:    * top_of_trigt, which is a count).  Include the final prototype so builder
  5252:    * inspection remains truthful when an attachment lives on the last entry. */
  5253:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_mobt; i++) {
  5254:     if (!mob_proto[i].proto_script)
  5255:       continue;
  5256: 
  5257:     for (tpl = mob_proto[i].proto_script;tpl;tpl = tpl->next)
  5258:       if (tpl->vnum == tvnum) {
  5259:         send_to_char(ch, "mob [%5d] %s\r\n",
  5260:                          mob_index[i].vnum,
  5261:                          mob_proto[i].player.short_descr);
  5262:         found = 1;
  5263:       }
  5264:   }
  5265: 
  5266:   for (j = 0; j <= top_of_objt; j++) {
  5267:     if (!obj_proto[j].proto_script)
  5268:       continue;
  5269: 
  5270:     for (tpl = obj_proto[j].proto_script;tpl;tpl = tpl->next)
  5271:       if (tpl->vnum == tvnum) {
  5272:         send_to_char(ch, "obj [%5d] %s\r\n",
  5273:                          obj_index[j].vnum,
  5274:                          obj_proto[j].short_description);
  5275:         found = 1;
  5276:       }
  5277:   }
  5278: 
  5279:   for (k = 0; k <= top_of_world; k++) {
  5280:     if (!world[k].proto_script)
  5281:       continue;
  5282: 
  5283:     for (tpl = world[k].proto_script;tpl;tpl = tpl->next)
  5284:       if (tpl->vnum == tvnum) {
  5285:         send_to_char(ch, "room[%5d] %s\r\n",
  5286:                          world[k].number,
  5287:                          world[k].name);
  5288:         found = 1;
  5289:       }
  5290:   }
  5291: 
  5292:   if (!found)
  5293:     send_to_char(ch, "This trigger is not attached to anything.\r\n");
  5294: }

  5296: ACMD(do_checkloadstatus)
  5297: {
  5298:   char buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  5299: 
  5300:   two_arguments(argument, buf1, buf2);
  5301: 
  5302:   if ((!*buf1) || (!*buf2) || (!isdigit(*buf2))) {
  5303:     send_to_char(ch, "Checkload <M | O | T> <vnum>\r\n");

  5305:   }
  5306: 
  5307:   if (LOWER(*buf1) == 'm') {

  5312:   if (LOWER(*buf1) == 'o') {
  5313:     obj_checkload(ch, atoi(buf2));
  5314:     return;
  5315:   }
  5316: 
  5317:   if (LOWER(*buf1) == 't') {
  5318:     trg_checkload(ch, atoi(buf2));
  5319:     return;
  5320:   }
  5321: }

  5325: ACMD(do_copyover)
  5326: {
  5327:   FILE *fp;
  5328:   struct descriptor_data *d, *d_next;
  5329:   char buf [100], buf2[100];
  5330: 
  5331:   fp = fopen (COPYOVER_FILE, "w");
  5332:     if (!fp) {
  5333:       send_to_char (ch, "Copyover file not writeable, aborted.\n\r");
  5334:       return;
  5335:     }
  5336: 
  5337:    sprintf (buf, "\n\r *** COPYOVER by %s - please remain seated!\n\r", GET_NAME(ch));
  5338: 
  5339:    /* write boot_time as first line in file */
  5340:    fprintf(fp, "%ld\n", (long)boot_time);
  5341: 
  5342:    /* For each playing descriptor, save its state */
  5343:    for (d = descriptor_list; d ; d = d_next) {
  5344:      struct char_data * och = d->character;
  5345:    
  5346:    /* If d is currently in someone else's body, return them. */  
  5347:    if (och && d->original)
  5348:      return_to_char(och);
  5349:         
  5350:    /* We delete from the list , so need to save this */
  5351:      d_next = d->next;
  5352: 
  5353:   /* drop those logging on */
  5354:    if (!d->character || d->connected > CON_PLAYING) {
  5355:      write_to_descriptor (d->descriptor, "\n\rSorry, we are rebooting. Come back in a few minutes.\n\r");
  5356:      close_socket (d); /* throw'em out */
  5357:    } else {
  5358:       fprintf (fp, "%d %ld %s %s %s\n", d->descriptor, GET_PREF(och), GET_NAME(och), d->host, CopyoverGet(d));
  5359:       /* save och */
  5360:       GET_LOADROOM(och) = GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(och));
  5361:       Crash_rentsave(och,0);
  5362:       save_char(och);
  5363:       write_to_descriptor (d->descriptor, buf);
  5364:     }
  5365:   }
  5366: 
  5367:   fprintf (fp, "-1\n");
  5368:   fclose (fp);
  5369: 
  5370:   /* exec - descriptors are inherited */
  5371:   sprintf (buf, "%d", port);
  5372:   sprintf (buf2, "-C%d", mother_desc);
  5373: 
  5374:   /* Ugh, seems it is expected we are 1 step above lib - this may be dangerous! */
  5375:   if(chdir ("..") != 0) {
  5376:     log("Error changing working directory: %s", strerror(errno));
  5377:     send_to_char(ch, "Error changing working directory: %s.", strerror(errno));
  5378:     exit(1);
  5379:   }
  5380: 
  5381:   /* Close reserve and other always-open files and release other resources */
  5382:   execl (EXE_FILE, "circle", buf2, buf, (char *) NULL);
  5383: 
  5384:   /* Failed - successful exec will not return */
  5385:   perror ("do_copyover: execl");
  5386:   send_to_char (ch, "Copyover FAILED!\n\r");
  5387: 
  5388:   exit (1); /* too much trouble to try to recover! */
  5389: }

  5407: ACMD(do_zpurge)
  5408: {
  5409:   int vroom, room, zone = 0;
  5410:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  5411:   int purge_all = FALSE;
  5412:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  5413:   if (*arg == '.' || !*arg) {
  5414:     zone = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone;
  5415:   }
  5416:   else if (is_number(arg)) {
  5417:     zone = real_zone(atoi(arg));
  5418:     if (zone == NOWHERE || zone > top_of_zone_table) {
  5419:       send_to_char(ch, "That zone doesn't exist!\r\n");
  5420:       return;
  5421:     }
  5422:   }
  5423:   else if (*arg == '*') {
  5424:     purge_all = TRUE;
  5425:   }
  5426:   else {
  5427:     send_to_char(ch, "That isn't a valid zone number!\r\n");
  5428:     return;
  5429:   }
  5430:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GOD && !can_edit_zone(ch, zone)) {
  5431:     send_to_char(ch, "You can only purge your own zone!\r\n");
  5432:     return;
  5433:   }
  5434:   if (!purge_all) {
  5435:     for (vroom = zone_table[zone].bot; vroom <= zone_table[zone].top; vroom++) {
  5436:       purge_room(real_room(vroom));
  5437:     }
  5438:     send_to_char(ch, "Purged zone #%d: %s.\r\n", zone_table[zone].number, zone_table[zone].name);
  5439:     mudlog(NRM, MAX(LVL_GRGOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s purged zone %d (%s)", GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[zone].number, zone_table[zone].name);
  5440:   }
  5441:   else {
  5442:     for (room = 0; room <= top_of_world; room++) {
  5443:       purge_room(room);
  5444:     }
  5445:     send_to_char(ch, "Purged world.\r\n");
  5446:     mudlog(NRM, MAX(LVL_GRGOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s purged entire world.", GET_NAME(ch));
  5447:   }
  5448: }

  5450: /** Used to read and gather a bit of information about external log files while
  5451:  * in game.
  5452:  * Makes use of the '\t' color codes in the file status information.
  5453:  * Some of the methods used are a bit wasteful (reading through the file
  5454:  * multiple times to gather diagnostic information), but it is
  5455:  * assumed that the files read with this function will never be very large.
  5456:  * Files to be read are assumed to exist and be readable and if they aren't,
  5457:  * log the name of the missing file.
  5458:  */
  5459: ACMD(do_file)
  5460: {
  5461:   /* Local variables */
  5462:   int def_lines_to_read = 15;  /* Set the default num lines to be read. */
  5463:   int max_lines_to_read = 300; /* Maximum number of lines to read. */
  5464:   FILE *req_file;              /* Pointer to file to be read. */
  5465:   size_t req_file_size = 0;    /* Size of file to be read. */
  5466:   int req_file_lines = 0;      /* Number of total lines in file to be read. */
  5467:   int lines_read = 0;     /* Counts total number of lines read from the file. */
  5468:   int req_lines = 0;      /* Number of lines requested to be displayed. */
  5469:   int i;                  /* Generic loop counter. */
  5470:   int l;                  /* Marks choice of file in fields array. */
  5471:   char field[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];  /* Holds users choice of file to be read. */
  5472:   char value[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];  /* Holds # lines to be read, if requested. */
  5473:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];   /* Display buffer for req_file. */
  5474: 
  5475:   /* Defines which files are available to read. */
  5476:   struct file_struct {
  5477:     char *cmd;          /* The 'name' of the file to view */
  5478:     char level;         /* Minimum level needed to view. */
  5479:     char *file;         /* The file location, relative to the working dir. */
  5480:     int read_backwards; /* Should the file be read backwards by default? */
  5481:   } fields[] = {
  5482:     { "xnames",         LVL_GOD,    XNAME_FILE,          TRUE},
  5483:     { "levels",         LVL_GOD,    LEVELS_LOGFILE,      TRUE},
  5484:     { "rip",            LVL_GOD,    RIP_LOGFILE,         TRUE},
  5485:     { "players",        LVL_GOD,    NEWPLAYERS_LOGFILE,  TRUE},
  5486:     { "rentgone",       LVL_GOD,    RENTGONE_LOGFILE,    TRUE},
  5487:     { "errors",         LVL_GOD,    ERRORS_LOGFILE,      TRUE},
  5488:     { "godcmds",        LVL_GOD,    GODCMDS_LOGFILE,     TRUE},
  5489:     { "syslog",         LVL_GOD,    SYSLOG_LOGFILE,      TRUE},
  5490:     { "crash",          LVL_GOD,    CRASH_LOGFILE,       TRUE},
  5491:     { "help",           LVL_GOD,    HELP_LOGFILE,        TRUE},
  5492:     { "changelog",      LVL_GOD,    CHANGE_LOG_FILE,     FALSE},
  5493:     { "deletes",        LVL_GOD,    DELETES_LOGFILE,     TRUE},
  5494:     { "restarts",       LVL_GOD,    RESTARTS_LOGFILE,    TRUE},
  5495:     { "usage",          LVL_GOD,    USAGE_LOGFILE,       TRUE},
  5496:     { "badpws",         LVL_GOD,    BADPWS_LOGFILE,      TRUE},
  5497:     { "olc",            LVL_GOD,    OLC_LOGFILE,         TRUE},
  5498:     { "trigger",        LVL_GOD,    TRIGGER_LOGFILE,     TRUE},
  5499:     { "\n", 0, "\n", FALSE } /* This must be the last entry */
  5500:   };
  5501: 
  5502:    /* Initialize buffer */
  5503:    buf[0] = '\0';
  5504: 
  5505:    /**/
  5506:    /* End function variable set-up and initialization. */
  5507: 
  5508:    skip_spaces(&argument);
  5509: 
  5510:    /* Display usage if no argument. */
  5511:    if (!*argument) {
  5512:      send_to_char(ch, "USAGE: file <filename> <num lines>\r\n\r\nFile options:\r\n");
  5513:      for (i = 0; fields[i].level; i++)
  5514:        if (fields[i].level <= GET_LEVEL(ch))
  5515:          send_to_char(ch, "%-15s%s\r\n", fields[i].cmd, fields[i].file);
  5516:      return;
  5517:    }
  5518: 
  5519:    /* Begin validity checks. Is the file choice valid and accessible? */
  5520:    /**/
  5521:    /* There are some arguments, deal with them. */
  5522:    two_arguments(argument, field, value);
  5523: 
  5524:    for (l = 0; *(fields[l].cmd) != '\n'; l++)
  5525:    {
  5526:      if (!strncmp(field, fields[l].cmd, strlen(field)))
  5527:        break;
  5528:    }
  5529: 
  5530:    if(*(fields[l].cmd) == '\n') {
  5531:      send_to_char(ch, "'%s' is not a valid file.\r\n", field);
  5532:      return;
  5533:    }
  5534: 
  5535:    if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < fields[l].level) {
  5536:      send_to_char(ch, "You have not achieved a high enough level to view '%s'.\r\n",
  5537:          fields[l].cmd);
  5538:      return;
  5539:    }
  5540: 
  5541:    /* Number of lines to view. Default is 15. */
  5542:    if(!*value)
  5543:      req_lines = def_lines_to_read;
  5544:    else if (!isdigit(*value))
  5545:    {
  5546:      /* This check forces the requisite positive digit and prevents negative
  5547:       * numbers of lines from being read. */
  5548:      send_to_char(ch, "'%s' is not a valid number of lines to view.\r\n", value);
  5549:      return;
  5550:    }
  5551:    else
  5552:    {
  5553:      req_lines = atoi(value);
  5554:      /* Limit the maximum number of lines */
  5555:      req_lines = MIN( req_lines, max_lines_to_read );
  5556:    }
  5557: 
  5558:    /* Must be able to access the file on disk. */
  5559:    if (!(req_file=fopen(fields[l].file,"r"))) {
  5560:      send_to_char(ch, "The file %s can not be opened.\r\n", fields[l].file);
  5561:      mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: Error opening file %s using 'file' command.", fields[l].file);
  5562:      return;
  5563:    }
  5564:    /**/
  5565:    /* End validity checks. From here on, the file should be viewable. */
  5566: 
  5567:    /* Diagnostic information about the file */
  5568:    req_file_size = file_sizeof(req_file);
  5569:    req_file_lines = file_numlines(req_file);
  5570: 
  5571:    snprintf( buf, sizeof(buf),
  5572:        "\tgFile:\tn %s\tg; Min. Level to read:\tn %d\tg; File Location:\tn %s\tg\r\n"
  5573:        "File size (bytes):\tn %ld\tg; Total num lines:\tn %d\r\n",
  5574:        fields[l].cmd, fields[l].level, fields[l].file, (long) req_file_size,
  5575:        req_file_lines);
  5576: 
  5577:    /* Should the file be 'headed' or 'tailed'? */
  5578:    if ( (fields[l].read_backwards == TRUE) && (req_lines < req_file_lines) )
  5579:    {
  5580:      snprintf( buf + strlen(buf), sizeof(buf) - strlen(buf),
  5581:                "\tgReading from the tail of the file.\tn\r\n\r\n" );
  5582:      lines_read = file_tail( req_file, buf, sizeof(buf), req_lines );
  5583:    }
  5584:    else
  5585:    {
  5586:      snprintf( buf + strlen(buf), sizeof(buf) - strlen(buf),
  5587:               "\tgReading from the head of the file.\tn\r\n\r\n" );
  5588:      lines_read = file_head( req_file, buf, sizeof(buf), req_lines );
  5589:    }
  5590: 
  5591:    /* Since file_head and file_tail will add the overflow message, we
  5592:     * don't check for status here. */
  5593:    if ( lines_read == req_file_lines )
  5594:    {
  5595:      /* We're reading the entire file */
  5596:      snprintf( buf + strlen(buf), sizeof(buf) - strlen(buf),
  5597:          "\r\n\tgEntire file returned (\tn%d \tglines).\tn\r\n",
  5598:          lines_read );
  5599:    }
  5600:    else if ( lines_read == max_lines_to_read )
  5601:    {
  5602:      snprintf( buf + strlen(buf), sizeof(buf) - strlen(buf),
  5603:          "\r\n\tgMaximum number of \tn%d \tglines returned.\tn\r\n",
  5604:          lines_read );
  5605:    }
  5606:    else
  5607:    {
  5608:      snprintf( buf + strlen(buf), sizeof(buf) - strlen(buf),
  5609:          "\r\n%d \tglines returned.\tn\r\n",
  5610:          lines_read );
  5611:    }
  5612: 
  5613:    /* Clean up before return */
  5614:    fclose(req_file);
  5615: 
  5616:    page_string(ch->desc, buf, 1);
  5617: }

  5619: ACMD(do_changelog)
  5620: {
  5621:   time_t rawtime;
  5622:   char timestr[12], line[READ_SIZE], last_buf[READ_SIZE],
  5623:       buf[READ_SIZE];
  5624:   FILE *fl, *new;
  5625: 
  5626:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  5627: 
  5628:   if (!*argument) {
  5629:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: changelog <change>\r\n");
  5630:     return;
  5631:   }
  5632: 
  5633:   sprintf(buf, "%s.bak", CHANGE_LOG_FILE);
  5634:   if (rename(CHANGE_LOG_FILE, buf)) {
  5635:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE,
  5636:            "SYSERR: Error making backup changelog file (%s)", buf);
  5637:     return;
  5638:   }
  5639: 
  5640:   if (!(fl = fopen(buf, "r"))) {
  5641:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE,
  5642:            "SYSERR: Error opening backup changelog file (%s)", buf);
  5643:     return;
  5644:   }
  5645: 
  5646:   if (!(new = fopen(CHANGE_LOG_FILE, "w"))) {
  5647:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE,
  5648:            "SYSERR: Error opening new changelog file (%s)", CHANGE_LOG_FILE);
  5649:     return;
  5650:   }
  5651: 
  5652:   while (get_line(fl, line)) {
  5653:     if (*line != '[')
  5654:       fprintf(new, "%s\n", line);
  5655:     else {
  5656:       strcpy(last_buf, line);
  5657:       break;
  5658:     }
  5659:   }
  5660: 
  5661:   rawtime = time(0);
  5662:   strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%b %d %Y", localtime(&rawtime));
  5663: 
  5664:   sprintf(buf, "[%s] - %s", timestr, GET_NAME(ch));
  5665: 
  5666:   fprintf(new, "%s\n", buf);
  5667:   fprintf(new, "  %s\n", argument);
  5668: 
  5669:   if (strcmp(buf, last_buf))
  5670:     fprintf(new, "%s\n", line);
  5671: 
  5672:   while (get_line(fl, line))
  5673:     fprintf(new, "%s\n", line);
  5674: 
  5675:   fclose(fl);
  5676:   fclose(new);
  5677:   send_to_char(ch, "Change added.\r\n");
  5678: }
  5679: 
  5680: #define PLIST_FORMAT \
  5681:   "Usage: plist [minlev[-maxlev]] [-n name] [-d days] [-h hours] [-i] [-m]"
  5682: 
  5683: ACMD(do_plist)
  5684: {
  5685:   int i, len = 0, count = 0;
  5686:   char mode, buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH * 20], name_search[MAX_NAME_LENGTH], timestr[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  5687:   struct time_info_data time_away;
  5688:   int low = 0, high = LVL_IMPL, low_day = 0, high_day = 10000, low_hr = 0, high_hr = 24;
  5689: 
  5690:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  5691:   strcpy(buf, argument);        /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: argument == buf) */
  5692:   name_search[0] = '\0';
  5693: 
  5694:   while (*buf) {
  5695:     char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  5696: 
  5697:     half_chop(buf, arg, buf1);
  5698:     if (isdigit(*arg)) {
  5699:       if (sscanf(arg, "%d-%d", &low, &high) == 1)
  5700:         high = low;
  5701:       strcpy(buf, buf1);        /* strcpy: OK (sizeof: buf1 == buf) */
  5702:     } else if (*arg == '-') {
  5703:       mode = *(arg + 1);        /* just in case; we destroy arg in the switch */
  5704:       switch (mode) {
  5705:       case 'l':
  5706:         half_chop(buf1, arg, buf);
  5707:         sscanf(arg, "%d-%d", &low, &high);
  5708:         break;
  5709:       case 'n':
  5710:         half_chop(buf1, name_search, buf);
  5711:         break;
  5712:       case 'i':
  5713:         strcpy(buf, buf1);
  5714:         low = LVL_IMMORT;
  5715:         break;
  5716:       case 'm':
  5717:         strcpy(buf, buf1);
  5718:         high = LVL_IMMORT - 1;
  5719:         break;
  5720:       case 'd':
  5721:         half_chop(buf1, arg, buf);
  5722:         if (sscanf(arg, "%d-%d", &low_day, &high_day) == 1)
  5723:           high_day = low_day;
  5724:         break;
  5725:       case 'h':
  5726:         half_chop(buf1, arg, buf);
  5727:         if (sscanf(arg, "%d-%d", &low_hr, &high_hr) == 1)
  5728:           high_hr = low_hr;
  5729:         break;
  5730:       default:
  5731:         send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", PLIST_FORMAT);
  5732:         return;
  5733:       }
  5734:     } else {
  5735:       send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", PLIST_FORMAT);
  5736:       return;
  5737:     }
  5738:   }
  5739: 
  5740:   len = 0;
  5741:   len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "\tW[ Id] (Lv) Name         Last\tn\r\n"
  5742:                   "%s-------------------------------------%s\r\n", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM),
  5743:                   CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  5744: 
  5745:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_p_table; i++) {
  5746:     if (player_table[i].level < low || player_table[i].level > high)
  5747:       continue;
  5748: 
  5749:     time_away = *real_time_passed(time(0), player_table[i].last);
  5750: 
  5751:     if (*name_search && str_cmp(name_search, player_table[i].name))
  5752:       continue;
  5753: 
  5754:     if (time_away.day > high_day || time_away.day < low_day)
  5755:       continue;
  5756:     if (time_away.hours > high_hr || time_away.hours < low_hr)
  5757:       continue;
  5758: 
  5759:     strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%c", localtime(&player_table[i].last));
  5760: 
  5761:     len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "[%3ld] (%2d) %c%-15s %s\r\n",
  5762:                     player_table[i].id, player_table[i].level,
  5763:                     UPPER(*player_table[i].name), player_table[i].name + 1, timestr);
  5764:     count++;
  5765:   }
  5766:   snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s-------------------------------------%s\r\n"
  5767:            "%d players listed.\r\n", CCCYN(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM), count);
  5768:   page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
  5769: }

  5961: /* NOTE: This is called from perform_set */
  5962: bool change_player_name(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict, char *new_name)
  5963: {
  5964:   struct char_data *temp_ch=NULL;
  5965:   int plr_i = 0, i, k;
  5966:   char old_name[MAX_NAME_LENGTH], old_pfile[50], new_pfile[50], buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  5967: 
  5968:   if (!ch)
  5969:   {
  5970:     log("SYSERR: No char passed to change_player_name.");
  5971:     return FALSE;
  5972:   }
  5973: 
  5974:   if (!vict)
  5975:   {
  5976:     log("SYSERR: No victim passed to change_player_name.");
  5977:     send_to_char(ch, "Invalid victim.\r\n");
  5978:     return FALSE;
  5979:   }
  5980: 
  5981:   if (!new_name || !(*new_name) || strlen(new_name) < 2 ||
  5982:       strlen(new_name) > MAX_NAME_LENGTH || !valid_name(new_name) ||
  5983:       fill_word(new_name) || reserved_word(new_name) ) {
  5984:     send_to_char(ch, "Invalid new name.\r\n");
  5985:     return FALSE;
  5986:   }
  5987: 
  5988:   /* Check that someone with new_name isn't already logged in */
  5989:   if ((temp_ch = get_player_vis(ch, new_name, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)) != NULL) {
  5990:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, the new name already exists.\r\n");
  5991:     return FALSE;
  5992:   } else  {
  5993:     /* try to load the player off disk */
  5994:     CREATE(temp_ch, struct char_data, 1);
  5995:     clear_char(temp_ch);
  5996:     CREATE(temp_ch->player_specials, struct player_special_data, 1);
  5997:     new_mobile_data(temp_ch);
  5998:     if ((plr_i = load_char(new_name, temp_ch)) > -1) {
  5999:       free_char(temp_ch);
  6000:       send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, the new name already exists.\r\n");
  6001:       return FALSE;
  6002:     }
  6003:   }
  6004: 
  6005:   /* New playername is OK - find the entry in the index */
  6006:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_p_table; i++)
  6007:     if (player_table[i].id == GET_IDNUM(vict))
  6008:       break;
  6009: 
  6010:   if (player_table[i].id != GET_IDNUM(vict))
  6011:   {
  6012:     send_to_char(ch, "Your target was not found in the player index.\r\n");
  6013:     log("SYSERR: Player %s, with ID %ld, could not be found in the player index.", GET_NAME(vict), GET_IDNUM(vict));
  6014:     return FALSE;
  6015:   }
  6016: 
  6017:   /* Set up a few variables that will be needed */
  6018:   sprintf(old_name, "%s", GET_NAME(vict));
  6019:   if (!get_filename(old_pfile, sizeof(old_pfile), PLR_FILE, old_name))
  6020:   {
  6021:     send_to_char(ch, "Unable to ascertain player's old pfile name.\r\n");
  6022:     return FALSE;
  6023:   }
  6024:   if (!get_filename(new_pfile, sizeof(new_pfile), PLR_FILE, new_name))
  6025:   {
  6026:     send_to_char(ch, "Unable to ascertain player's new pfile name.\r\n");
  6027:     return FALSE;
  6028:   }
  6029: 
  6030:   /* Now start changing the name over - all checks and setup have passed */
  6031:   free(player_table[i].name);              // Free the old name in the index
  6032:   player_table[i].name = strdup(new_name); // Insert the new name into the index
  6033:   for (k=0; (*(player_table[i].name+k) = LOWER(*(player_table[i].name+k))); k++);
  6034: 
  6035:   free(GET_PC_NAME(vict));
  6036:   GET_PC_NAME(vict) = strdup(CAP(new_name));    // Change the name in the victims char struct
  6037: 
  6038:   /* Rename the player's pfile */
  6039:   sprintf(buf, "mv %s %s", old_pfile, new_pfile);
  6040: 
  6041:   /* Save the changed player index - the pfile is saved by perform_set */
  6042:   save_player_index();
  6043: 
  6044:   mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "(GC) %s changed the name of %s to %s", GET_NAME(ch), old_name, new_name);
  6045: 
  6046:   if (vict->desc)  /* Descriptor is set if the victim is logged in */
  6047:     send_to_char(vict, "Your login name has changed from %s%s%s to %s%s%s.\r\n", CCYEL(vict, C_NRM), old_name, CCNRM(vict, C_NRM),
  6048:                                                                                  CCYEL(vict, C_NRM), new_name, CCNRM(vict, C_NRM));
  6049: 
  6050:   return TRUE;
  6051: }

  6053: ACMD(do_zlock)
  6054: {
  6055:   zone_vnum znvnum;
  6056:   zone_rnum zn;
  6057:   char      arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  6058:   int       counter = 0;
  6059:   bool      fail = FALSE;
  6060: 
  6061:   two_arguments(argument, arg, arg2);
  6062: 
  6063:   if (!*arg) {
  6064:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %szlock <zone number>%s\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
  6065:     send_to_char(ch, "%s       zlock list%s\r\n\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
  6066:     send_to_char(ch, "Locks a zone so that building or editing is not possible.\r\n");
  6067:     send_to_char(ch, "The 'list' shows all currently locked zones.\r\n");
  6068:     send_to_char(ch, "'zlock all' will lock every zone with the GRID flag set.\r\n");
  6069:     send_to_char(ch, "'zlock all all' will lock every zone in the MUD.\r\n");
  6070:     return;
  6071:   }
  6072:   if (is_abbrev(arg, "all")) {
  6073:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD) {
  6074:       send_to_char(ch, "You do not have sufficient access to lock all zones.\r\n");
  6075:       return;
  6076:     }
  6077:     if (!*arg2) {
  6078:       for (zn = 0; zn <= top_of_zone_table; zn++) {
  6079:         if (!ZONE_FLAGGED(zn, ZONE_NOBUILD) && ZONE_FLAGGED(zn, ZONE_GRID)) {
  6080:           counter++;
  6081:           SET_BIT_AR(ZONE_FLAGS(zn), ZONE_NOBUILD);
  6082:           if (save_zone(zn)) {
  6083:             log("(GC) %s has locked zone %d", GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[zn].number);
  6084:           } else {
  6085:             fail = TRUE;
  6086:           }
  6087:         }
  6088:       }
  6089:     } else if (is_abbrev(arg2, "all")) {
  6090:       for (zn = 0; zn <= top_of_zone_table; zn++) {
  6091:         if (!ZONE_FLAGGED(zn, ZONE_NOBUILD)) {
  6092:           counter++;
  6093:           SET_BIT_AR(ZONE_FLAGS(zn), ZONE_NOBUILD);
  6094:           if (save_zone(zn)) {
  6095:             log("(GC) %s has locked zone %d", GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[zn].number);
  6096:           } else {
  6097:             fail = TRUE;
  6098:           }
  6099:         }
  6100:       }
  6101:     }
  6102:     if (counter == 0) {
  6103:       send_to_char(ch, "There are no unlocked zones to lock!\r\n");
  6104:       return;
  6105:     }
  6106:     if (fail) {
  6107:       send_to_char(ch, "Unable to save zone changes.  Check syslog!\r\n");
  6108:       return;
  6109:     }
  6110:     send_to_char(ch, "%d zones have now been locked.\r\n", counter);
  6111:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s has locked ALL zones!", GET_NAME(ch));
  6112:     return;
  6113:   }
  6114:   if (is_abbrev(arg, "list")) {
  6115:     /* Show all locked zones */
  6116:     for (zn = 0; zn <= top_of_zone_table; zn++) {
  6117:       if (ZONE_FLAGGED(zn, ZONE_NOBUILD)) {
  6118:         if (!counter) send_to_char(ch, "Locked Zones\r\n");
  6119: 
  6120:         send_to_char(ch, "[%s%3d%s] %s%-*s %s%-1s%s\r\n",
  6121:           QGRN, zone_table[zn].number, QNRM, QCYN, count_color_chars(zone_table[zn].name)+30, zone_table[zn].name,
  6122:           QYEL, zone_table[zn].builders ? zone_table[zn].builders : "None.", QNRM);
  6123:         counter++;
  6124:       }
  6125:     }
  6126:     if (counter == 0) {
  6127:       send_to_char(ch, "There are currently no locked zones!\r\n");
  6128:     }
  6129:     return;
  6130:   }
  6131:   else if ((znvnum = atoi(arg)) == 0) {
  6132:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %szlock <zone number>%s\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
  6133:     return;
  6134:   }
  6135: 
  6136:   if ((zn = real_zone(znvnum)) == NOWHERE) {
  6137:     send_to_char(ch, "That zone does not exist!\r\n");
  6138:     return;
  6139:   }
  6140: 
  6141:   /* Check the builder list */
  6142:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD && !is_name(GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[zn].builders) && GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) != znvnum) {
  6143:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have sufficient access to lock that zone!\r\n");
  6144:     return;
  6145:   }
  6146: 
  6147:   /* If we get here, player has typed 'zlock <num>' */
  6148:   if (ZONE_FLAGGED(zn, ZONE_NOBUILD)) {
  6149:     send_to_char(ch, "Zone %d is already locked!\r\n", znvnum);
  6150:     return;
  6151:   }
  6152:   SET_BIT_AR(ZONE_FLAGS(zn), ZONE_NOBUILD);
  6153:   if (save_zone(zn)) {
  6154:     mudlog(NRM, MAX(LVL_GRGOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s has locked zone %d", GET_NAME(ch), znvnum);
  6155:   }
  6156:   else
  6157:   {
  6158:     send_to_char(ch, "Unable to save zone changes.  Check syslog!\r\n");
  6159:   }
  6160: }
  6161: 
  6162: static int compute_areatemplate_width(int room_count)
  6163: {
  6164:   int width = 1;
  6165: 
  6166:   while ((width * width) < room_count)
  6167:     width++;
  6168: 
  6169:   return width;
  6170: }
  6171: 
  6172: static int compute_areatemplate_height(int room_count, int width)
  6173: {
  6174:   return (room_count + width - 1) / width;
  6175: }
  6176: 
  6177: static void compute_template_dimensions(int room_count, int *width_out, int *height_out)
  6178: {
  6179:   /* Width is chosen first (smallest square-ish fit), then height rounds up. */
  6180:   int width = compute_areatemplate_width(room_count);
  6181:   int height = compute_areatemplate_height(room_count, width);
  6182: 
  6183:   if (width_out)
  6184:     *width_out = width;
  6185:   if (height_out)
  6186:     *height_out = height;
  6187: }
  6188: 
  6189: static int template_compute_level(int min_level, int max_level, int count, int index)
  6190: {
  6191:   if (count <= 1)
  6192:     return min_level;
  6193: 
  6194:   return min_level + ((index * (max_level - min_level)) / (count - 1));
  6195: }
  6196: 
  6197: static char *template_alloc_printf(const char *fmt, ...)
  6198: {
  6199:   va_list args;
  6200:   va_list args_copy;
  6201:   int needed;
  6202:   char *out;
  6203: 
  6204:   va_start(args, fmt);
  6205:   va_copy(args_copy, args);
  6206:   needed = vsnprintf(NULL, 0, fmt, args_copy);
  6207:   va_end(args_copy);
  6208:   if (needed < 0) {
  6209:     va_end(args);
  6210:     return NULL;
  6211:   }
  6212: 
  6213:   CREATE(out, char, (size_t)needed + 1);
  6214:   vsnprintf(out, (size_t)needed + 1, fmt, args);
  6215:   va_end(args);
  6216:   return out;
  6217: }

  6219: static bool room_range_is_clear(room_vnum start, int room_count, char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  6220: {
  6221:   int i;
  6222: 
  6223:   for (i = 0; i < room_count; i++) {
  6224:     room_vnum vnum = start + i;
  6225: 
  6226:     if (real_room(vnum) != NOWHERE) {
  6227:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Room vnum %d already exists.\r\n", vnum);
  6228:       return FALSE;
  6229:     }
  6230: 
  6231:     if (real_zone_by_thing(vnum) != NOWHERE) {
  6232:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Room vnum %d falls inside an existing zone range.\r\n", vnum);
  6233:       return FALSE;
  6234:     }
  6235:   }
  6236: 
  6237:   return TRUE;
  6238: }

  6240: static bool roomtemplate_range_is_valid(room_vnum start, int room_count, zone_rnum *zone_out,
  6241:                                         char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  6242: {
  6243:   int i;
  6244:   zone_rnum owning_zone = NOWHERE;
  6245: 
  6246:   for (i = 0; i < room_count; i++) {
  6247:     room_vnum vnum = start + i;
  6248:     zone_rnum rznum = real_zone_by_thing(vnum);
  6249: 
  6250:     if (rznum == NOWHERE) {
  6251:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Room vnum %d is not inside an existing zone range.\r\n", vnum);
  6252:       return FALSE;
  6253:     }
  6254: 
  6255:     if (owning_zone == NOWHERE)
  6256:       owning_zone = rznum;
  6257:     else if (rznum != owning_zone) {
  6258:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Roomtemplate cannot span multiple zones.\r\n");
  6259:       return FALSE;
  6260:     }
  6261: 
  6262:     if (real_room(vnum) != NOWHERE) {
  6263:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Room vnum %d already exists.\r\n", vnum);
  6264:       return FALSE;
  6265:     }
  6266:   }
  6267: 
  6268:   *zone_out = owning_zone;
  6269:   return TRUE;
  6270: }

  6272: static bool roomtemplate_builder_can_edit(struct char_data *ch, zone_rnum rznum,

  6277:     return FALSE;
  6278:   }
  6279:   return TRUE;
  6280: }

  6310: static bool parse_areatemplate_args(char *argument, zone_vnum *zone_vnum_out,
  6311:                                     room_vnum *start_room_out, int *room_count_out,
  6312:                                     char *zone_name_out, size_t zone_name_sz)
  6313: {
  6314:   char zone_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  6315:   char start_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  6316:   char count_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  6317:   char *p, *q;
  6318:   size_t len;
  6319: 
  6320:   argument = one_argument(argument, zone_arg);
  6321:   argument = one_argument(argument, start_arg);
  6322:   argument = one_argument(argument, count_arg);
  6323:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  6324: 
  6325:   if (!*zone_arg || !*start_arg || !*count_arg || !*argument)
  6326:     return FALSE;
  6327:   if (!is_number(zone_arg) || !is_number(start_arg) || !is_number(count_arg))
  6328:     return FALSE;
  6329: 
  6330:   *zone_vnum_out = atoi(zone_arg);
  6331:   *start_room_out = atoi(start_arg);
  6332:   *room_count_out = atoi(count_arg);
  6333: 
  6334:   p = argument;
  6335:   if (*p != '\"')
  6336:     return FALSE;
  6337:   p++;
  6338:   q = strrchr(p, '\"');
  6339:   if (q == NULL)
  6340:     return FALSE;
  6341:   {
  6342:     char *trail = q + 1;
  6343:     while (*trail && isspace(*trail))
  6344:       trail++;
  6345:     if (*trail)
  6346:       return FALSE;
  6347:   }
  6348:   *q = '\0';
  6349: 
  6350:   while (*p && isspace(*p))
  6351:     p++;
  6352:   len = strlen(p);
  6353:   while (len > 0 && isspace(p[len - 1])) {
  6354:     p[len - 1] = '\0';
  6355:     len--;
  6356:   }
  6357: 
  6358:   if (!*p)
  6359:     return FALSE;
  6360: 
  6361:   strlcpy(zone_name_out, p, zone_name_sz);
  6362:   return TRUE;
  6363: }

  6365: static bool parse_roomtemplate_args(char *argument, room_vnum *start_room_out, int *room_count_out)
  6366: {
  6367:   char start_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  6368:   char count_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  6369: 
  6370:   argument = one_argument(argument, start_arg);
  6371:   argument = one_argument(argument, count_arg);
  6372:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  6373: 
  6374:   if (!*start_arg || !*count_arg || *argument)
  6375:     return FALSE;
  6376:   if (!is_number(start_arg) || !is_number(count_arg))
  6377:     return FALSE;
  6378: 
  6379:   *start_room_out = atoi(start_arg);
  6380:   *room_count_out = atoi(count_arg);
  6381:   return TRUE;
  6382: }
