  6389: static bool areatemplate_set_exit(room_rnum from_rnum, int dir, room_rnum to_rnum)
  6390: {
  6391:   struct room_direction_data *exit_data;
  6392: 
  6393:   if (from_rnum == NOWHERE || to_rnum == NOWHERE || dir < 0 || dir >= DIR_COUNT)
  6394:     return FALSE;
  6395: 
  6396:   if (W_EXIT(from_rnum, dir) == NULL) {
  6397:     CREATE(W_EXIT(from_rnum, dir), struct room_direction_data, 1);
  6398:     if (W_EXIT(from_rnum, dir) == NULL)
  6399:       return FALSE;
  6400:     W_EXIT(from_rnum, dir)->general_description = NULL;
  6401:     W_EXIT(from_rnum, dir)->keyword = NULL;
  6402:   }
  6403: 
  6404:   exit_data = W_EXIT(from_rnum, dir);
  6405:   if (exit_data->general_description) {
  6406:     free(exit_data->general_description);
  6407:     exit_data->general_description = NULL;
  6408:   }
  6409:   if (exit_data->keyword) {
  6410:     free(exit_data->keyword);
  6411:     exit_data->keyword = NULL;
  6412:   }
  6413:   exit_data->exit_info = 0;
  6414:   exit_data->key = NOTHING;
  6415:   exit_data->to_room = to_rnum;
  6416:   return TRUE;
  6417: }
  6418: 
  6419: static bool template_link_pair(room_rnum from_rnum, int dir_from, room_rnum to_rnum, int dir_to)
  6420: {
  6421:   if (!areatemplate_set_exit(from_rnum, dir_from, to_rnum))
  6422:     return FALSE;
  6423:   if (!areatemplate_set_exit(to_rnum, dir_to, from_rnum))
  6424:     return FALSE;
  6425:   return TRUE;
  6426: }
  6427: 
  6428: static void link_areatemplate_rooms(room_vnum start, int room_count, int width,
  6429:                                     int *ew_links, int *ns_links, int *skipped_neighbors)
  6430: {
  6431:   int i;
  6432:   int height = compute_areatemplate_height(room_count, width);
  6433:   int ew = 0, ns = 0, skipped = 0;
  6434: 
  6435:   for (i = 0; i < room_count; i++) {
  6436:     int row = i / width;
  6437:     int col = i % width;
  6438:     room_vnum from_vnum = template_room_vnum_from_index(start, i);
  6439:     room_rnum from_rnum = real_room(from_vnum);
  6440: 
  6441:     if (from_rnum == NOWHERE)
  6442:       continue;
  6443: 
  6444:     /*
  6445:      * Build the grid with explicit row/column math.
  6446:      * East links are only valid when we are not on the last column and the
  6447:      * target index exists in room_count, which prevents row wraparound.
  6448:      */
  6449:     if ((col + 1) < width) {
  6450:       int east_index = i + 1;
  6451: 
  6452:       if (east_index < room_count) {
  6453:         room_rnum east_rnum = real_room(template_room_vnum_from_index(start, east_index));
  6454:         if (east_rnum != NOWHERE && template_link_pair(from_rnum, EAST, east_rnum, WEST))
  6455:           ew++;
  6456:       } else {
  6457:         skipped++;
  6458:       }
  6459:     } else {
  6460:       skipped++;
  6461:     }
  6462: 
  6463:     /*
  6464:      * South links are only valid when i + width is still inside room_count.
  6465:      * This blocks links into non-existent cells in a partial final row.
  6466:      */
  6467:     if ((row + 1) < height) {
  6468:       int south_index = ((row + 1) * width) + col;
  6469: 
  6470:       if (south_index >= room_count) {
  6471:         skipped++;
  6472:         continue;
  6473:       }
  6474: 
  6475:       room_rnum south_rnum = real_room(template_room_vnum_from_index(start, south_index));
  6476:       if (south_rnum != NOWHERE && template_link_pair(from_rnum, SOUTH, south_rnum, NORTH))
  6477:         ns++;
  6478:     } else {
  6479:       skipped++;
  6480:     }
  6481:   }
  6482: 
  6483:   if (ew_links)
  6484:     *ew_links = ew;
  6485:   if (ns_links)
  6486:     *ns_links = ns;
  6487:   if (skipped_neighbors)
  6488:     *skipped_neighbors = skipped;
  6489: }

  6520: static bool parse_mobtemplate_args(char *argument, mob_vnum *start_vnum_out, int *min_level_out,
  6521:                                    int *max_level_out, int *mob_count_out,
  6522:                                    char *base_name_out, size_t base_name_sz)
  6523: {

  6525:   char min_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];

  6532:   argument = one_argument(argument, min_arg);
  6533:   argument = one_argument(argument, max_arg);

  6617: static bool mobtemplate_build_strings(const char *base_name, int number,
  6618:                                       char **keywords, char **shortd,
  6619:                                       char **longd, char **desc,
  6620:                                       char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  6621: {
  6622:   *keywords = template_alloc_printf("template %s mob %d", base_name, number);
  6623:   *shortd = template_alloc_printf("a template %s %d", base_name, number);
  6624:   *longd = template_alloc_printf(
  6625:     "A template %s %d stands here awaiting builder customization.\r\n", base_name, number);
  6626:   *desc = template_alloc_printf(
  6627:     "This mob was generated by the mobtemplate command.\r\n"
  6628:     "Builders should customize its keywords, descriptions, stats, flags, and behavior.\r\n");
  6629: 
  6630:   if (!*keywords || !*shortd || !*longd || !*desc) {
  6631:     free(*keywords);
  6632:     free(*shortd);
  6633:     free(*longd);
  6634:     free(*desc);
  6635:     *keywords = *shortd = *longd = *desc = NULL;
  6636:     snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Failed to allocate mob strings.\r\n");
  6637:     return FALSE;
  6638:   }
  6639: 
  6640:   return TRUE;
  6641: }

  6643: static bool mobtemplate_create_one(mob_vnum vnum, const char *base_name, int number, int level,
  6644:                                    char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  6645: {
  6646:   struct char_data mob;
  6647:   char *keywords = NULL, *shortd = NULL, *longd = NULL, *desc = NULL;
  6648:   int new_rnum;
  6649: 
  6650:   memset(&mob, 0, sizeof(mob));
  6651:   clear_char(&mob);
  6652:   mob.player_specials = &dummy_mob;
  6653: 
  6654:   GET_HIT(&mob) = 1;
  6655:   GET_MANA(&mob) = 1;
  6656:   GET_MAX_MANA(&mob) = 100;
  6657:   GET_MAX_MOVE(&mob) = 100;
  6658:   GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(&mob) = GET_MAX_HIT(&mob);
  6659:   GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(&mob) = GET_MAX_MANA(&mob);
  6660:   GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(&mob) = GET_MAX_MOVE(&mob);
  6661:   GET_NDD(&mob) = 1;
  6662:   GET_SDD(&mob) = 1;
  6663:   GET_WEIGHT(&mob) = 200;
  6664:   GET_HEIGHT(&mob) = 198;
  6665:   GET_PET_PRICE(&mob) = 0;
  6666:   mob.real_abils.str = mob.real_abils.intel = mob.real_abils.wis = 11;
  6667:   mob.real_abils.dex = mob.real_abils.con = mob.real_abils.cha = 11;
  6668:   mob.aff_abils = mob.real_abils;
  6669:   GET_SAVE(&mob, SAVING_PARA) = 0;
  6670:   GET_SAVE(&mob, SAVING_ROD) = 0;
  6671:   GET_SAVE(&mob, SAVING_PETRI) = 0;
  6672:   GET_SAVE(&mob, SAVING_BREATH) = 0;
  6673:   GET_SAVE(&mob, SAVING_SPELL) = 0;
  6674:   SET_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(&mob), MOB_ISNPC);
  6675: 
  6676:   if (!mobtemplate_build_strings(base_name, number, &keywords, &shortd, &longd, &desc,
  6677:                                  errmsg, errmsg_sz))
  6678:     return FALSE;
  6679: 
  6680:   GET_ALIAS(&mob) = keywords;
  6681:   GET_SDESC(&mob) = shortd;
  6682:   GET_LDESC(&mob) = longd;
  6683:   GET_DDESC(&mob) = desc;
  6684:   if (!GET_ALIAS(&mob) || !GET_SDESC(&mob) || !GET_LDESC(&mob) || !GET_DDESC(&mob)) {
  6685:     free_mobile_strings(&mob);
  6686:     snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Failed to allocate mob strings for vnum %d.\r\n", vnum);
  6687:     return FALSE;
  6688:   }
  6689: 
  6690:   GET_LEVEL(&mob) = level;
  6691:   GET_SEX(&mob) = SEX_NEUTRAL;
  6692:   GET_CLASS(&mob) = CLASS_OTHER;
  6693:   GET_RACE(&mob) = RACE_UNDEFINED;
  6694:   GET_POS(&mob) = POS_STANDING;
  6695:   GET_DEFAULT_POS(&mob) = POS_STANDING;
  6696:   GET_ATTACK(&mob) = TYPE_HIT - TYPE_HIT;
  6697:   GET_ALIGNMENT(&mob) = 0;
  6698:   GET_GOLD(&mob) = 0;
  6699:   mob.mob_specials.gold_min = 0;
  6700:   mob.mob_specials.gold_max = 0;
  6701:   GET_EXP(&mob) = 0;
  6702:   GET_HITROLL(&mob) = MAX(1, level / 2);
  6703:   GET_AC(&mob) = 100 - MIN(level * 4, 80);
  6704:   GET_HIT(&mob) = MAX(1, level);
  6705:   GET_MANA(&mob) = 8;
  6706:   GET_MOVE(&mob) = level * 2;
  6707:   GET_NDD(&mob) = MAX(1, (level / 10) + 1);
  6708:   GET_SDD(&mob) = 4;
  6709:   GET_DAMROLL(&mob) = MAX(0, level / 3);
  6710: 
  6711:   new_rnum = add_mobile(&mob, vnum);
  6712:   free_mobile_strings(&mob);
  6713: 
  6714:   if (new_rnum == NOBODY || real_mobile(vnum) == NOBODY) {
  6715:     snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Failed to create mob vnum %d.\r\n", vnum);
  6716:     return FALSE;
  6717:   }
  6718: 
  6719:   return TRUE;
  6720: }
  6721: 
  6722: static bool mobtemplate_save_affected_zones(struct char_data *ch, mob_vnum start, int mob_count,
  6723:                                             char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  6724: {
  6725:   bool *saved;
  6726:   int i;
  6727: 
  6728:   CREATE(saved, bool, top_of_zone_table + 1);
  6729:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_zone_table; i++)
  6730:     saved[i] = FALSE;
  6731: 
  6732:   for (i = 0; i < mob_count; i++) {
  6733:     mob_vnum vnum = start + i;
  6734:     zone_rnum rznum = real_zone_by_thing(vnum);
  6735: 
  6736:     if (rznum == NOWHERE) {
  6737:       free(saved);
  6738:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Cannot save mobs: vnum %d has no valid zone.\r\n", vnum);
  6739:       return FALSE;
  6740:     }
  6741: 
  6742:     if (saved[rznum])
  6743:       continue;
  6744: 
  6745:     if (!save_mobiles(rznum)) {
  6746:       free(saved);
  6747:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Failed saving mobile data for zone %d.\r\n",
  6748:                zone_table[rznum].number);
  6749:       return FALSE;
  6750:     }
  6751:     saved[rznum] = TRUE;
  6752:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  6753:            "OLC: %s saved mobile templates in zone %d.",
  6754:            GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[rznum].number);
  6755:   }
  6756: 
  6757:   free(saved);
  6758:   return TRUE;
  6759: }

  6761: ACMD(do_mobtemplate)
  6762: {
  6763:   char usage[] = "Usage: mobtemplate <start_mob_vnum> <min_level> <max_level> <mob_count> \"<base name>\"\r\n";
  6764:   char base_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  6765:   char errmsg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  6766:   mob_vnum start_vnum, top_vnum;
  6767:   int min_level, max_level, mob_count;
  6768:   int i, created = 0;
  6769: 
  6770:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
  6771:     return;
  6772: 
  6773:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_BUILDER) {
  6774:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have builder permissions for this command.\r\n");
  6775:     return;
  6776:   }
  6777: 
  6778:   if (!parse_mobtemplate_args(argument, &start_vnum, &min_level, &max_level, &mob_count,
  6779:                               base_name, sizeof(base_name))) {
  6780:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", usage);
  6781:     return;
  6782:   }
  6783: 
  6784:   if (start_vnum <= 0) {
  6785:     send_to_char(ch, "Start mob vnum must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  6786:     return;
  6787:   }
  6788: 
  6789:   if (min_level <= 0) {
  6790:     send_to_char(ch, "Minimum level must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  6791:     return;
  6792:   }
  6793: 
  6794:   if (max_level <= 0) {
  6795:     send_to_char(ch, "Maximum level must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  6796:     return;
  6797:   }
  6798: 
  6799:   if (mob_count <= 0) {
  6800:     send_to_char(ch, "Mob count must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  6801:     return;
  6802:   }
  6803: 
  6804:   if (!*base_name) {
  6805:     send_to_char(ch, "Base name must be present and non-empty.\r\n");
  6806:     return;
  6807:   }
  6808:   if (strlen(base_name) > MAX_TEMPLATE_BASENAME_LEN) {
  6809:     send_to_char(ch, "Base name is too long. Maximum length is %d characters.\r\n",
  6810:                  MAX_TEMPLATE_BASENAME_LEN);
  6811:     return;
  6812:   }
  6813: 
  6814:   if (min_level > max_level) {
  6815:     send_to_char(ch, "Minimum level must be less than or equal to maximum level.\r\n");
  6816:     return;
  6817:   }
  6818: 
  6819:   if (((long long)start_vnum + (long long)mob_count - 1) > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
  6820:     send_to_char(ch, "Computed top mob vnum exceeds valid vnum range.\r\n");
  6821:     return;
  6822:   }
  6823:   top_vnum = start_vnum + mob_count - 1;
  6824: 
  6825:   if (!mobtemplate_range_is_clear(start_vnum, mob_count, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  6826:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  6827:     return;
  6828:   }
  6829: 
  6830:   if (!mobtemplate_builder_can_edit_range(ch, start_vnum, mob_count, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  6831:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  6832:     return;
  6833:   }
  6834: 
  6835:   for (i = 0; i < mob_count; i++) {
  6836:     mob_vnum vnum = start_vnum + i;
  6837:     int level = mobtemplate_compute_level(min_level, max_level, mob_count, i);
  6838: 
  6839:     if (!mobtemplate_create_one(vnum, base_name, i + 1, level, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  6840:       int rollback;
  6841: 
  6842:       for (rollback = 0; rollback < created; rollback++) {
  6843:         mob_vnum created_vnum = start_vnum + rollback;
  6844:         mob_rnum rmob = real_mobile(created_vnum);
  6845:         if (rmob != NOBODY)
  6846:           delete_mobile(rmob);
  6847:       }
  6848:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  6849:       return;
  6850:     }
  6851:     created++;
  6852:   }
  6853: 
  6854:   if (!mobtemplate_save_affected_zones(ch, start_vnum, mob_count, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  6855:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  6856:     return;
  6857:   }
  6858: 
  6859:   send_to_char(ch,
  6860:     "Mob template created successfully.\r\n"
  6861:     "Mob range: %d-%d\r\n"
  6862:     "Mobs created: %d\r\n"
  6863:     "Level range: %d-%d\r\n"
  6864:     "Base name: %s\r\n",
  6865:     start_vnum, top_vnum, mob_count, min_level, max_level, base_name);
  6866: 
  6867:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  6868:          "OLC: %s used mobtemplate for mobs %d-%d (%d mobs, level %d-%d, base '%s').",
  6869:          GET_NAME(ch), start_vnum, top_vnum, mob_count, min_level, max_level, base_name);
  6870: }
  6871: 
  6872: ACMD(do_zonemap)
  6873: {
  6874:   const int map_width = 10;
  6875:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  6876:   room_vnum bottom, top, vnum, player_room_vnum = NOWHERE;
  6877:   zone_vnum zone_vnum_input;
  6878:   zone_rnum zone;
  6879:   int player_row = -1, player_col = -1;
  6880:   int slots_scanned, rows, row, col;
  6881:   int existing_rooms = 0, missing_rooms = 0, isolated_rooms = 0, one_way_links = 0;
  6882:   size_t estimated_line_len, estimated_bufsz, outlen = 0;
  6883:   room_rnum *room_cache;
  6884:   char *outbuf;
  6885: 
  6886:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  6887:   if (!*arg) {
  6888:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: zonemap <zone_vnum>\r\n");
  6889:     return;
  6890:   }
  6891: 
  6892:   if (!str_cmp(arg, "here")) {
  6893:     if (IN_ROOM(ch) == NOWHERE) {
  6894:       send_to_char(ch, "You are not currently in a room.\r\n");
  6895:       return;
  6896:     }
  6897:     zone = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone;
  6898:     zone_vnum_input = zone_table[zone].number;
  6899:   } else if (!is_number(arg)) {
  6900:     send_to_char(ch, "Zone not found.\r\n");
  6901:     return;
  6902:   } else {
  6903:     zone_vnum_input = atoi(arg);
  6904:     zone = real_zone(zone_vnum_input);
  6905:     if (zone == NOWHERE) {
  6906:       send_to_char(ch, "Zone not found.\r\n");
  6907:       return;
  6908:     }
  6909:   }
  6910: 
  6911:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD && !can_edit_zone(ch, zone)) {
  6912:     send_cannot_edit(ch, zone_table[zone].number);
  6913:     return;
  6914:   }
  6915: 
  6916:   bottom = zone_table[zone].bot;
  6917:   top = zone_table[zone].top;
  6918:   slots_scanned = top - bottom + 1;
  6919:   if (slots_scanned <= 0) {
  6920:     send_to_char(ch, "Zone range is invalid.\r\n");
  6921:     return;
  6922:   }
  6923: 
  6924:   CREATE(room_cache, room_rnum, slots_scanned);
  6925:   for (vnum = bottom; vnum <= top; vnum++) {
  6926:     room_rnum rrnum = real_room(vnum);
  6927:     int idx = vnum - bottom;
  6928: 
  6929:     room_cache[idx] = rrnum;
  6930:     if (rrnum == NOWHERE)
  6931:       missing_rooms++;
  6932:     else
  6933:       existing_rooms++;
  6934:   }
  6935: 
  6936:   if (IN_ROOM(ch) != NOWHERE &&
  6937:       world[IN_ROOM(ch)].number >= bottom &&
  6938:       world[IN_ROOM(ch)].number <= top)
  6939:     player_room_vnum = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].number;
  6940: 
  6941:   if (player_room_vnum != NOWHERE) {
  6942:     int player_index = player_room_vnum - bottom;
  6943:     player_row = player_index / map_width;
  6944:     player_col = player_index % map_width;
  6945:   }
  6946: 
  6947:   for (vnum = bottom; vnum <= top; vnum++) {
  6948:     room_rnum rrnum = room_cache[vnum - bottom];
  6949: 
  6950:     if (rrnum == NOWHERE)
  6951:       continue;
  6952: 
  6953:     if (W_EXIT(rrnum, NORTH) == NULL && W_EXIT(rrnum, EAST) == NULL &&
  6954:         W_EXIT(rrnum, SOUTH) == NULL && W_EXIT(rrnum, WEST) == NULL)
  6955:       isolated_rooms++;
  6956:   }
  6957: 
  6958:   rows = (slots_scanned + map_width - 1) / map_width;
  6959:   estimated_line_len = (size_t)(map_width * 2) + (size_t)((map_width - 1) * 2) + 24;
  6960:   estimated_bufsz = 4096 + (size_t)rows * (estimated_line_len * 2 + 8);
  6961:   CREATE(outbuf, char, estimated_bufsz);
  6962:   outbuf[0] = '\0';
  6963: 
  6964:   zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen,
  6965:                  "Zone %d: %s\r\nRange: %d-%d\r\n",
  6966:                  zone_table[zone].number,
  6967:                  zone_table[zone].name ? zone_table[zone].name : "<unnamed>",
  6968:                  bottom, top);
  6969:   if (player_room_vnum != NOWHERE)
  6970:     zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen,
  6971:                    "You are in: %d (row %d, col %d)\r\n",
  6972:                    player_room_vnum, player_row, player_col);
  6973:   else
  6974:     zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "You are in: (outside this zone)\r\n");
  6975: 
  6976:   zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen,
  6977:                  "\r\nLegend:\r\n"
  6978:                  "  00 = room exists\r\n"
  6979:                  "  .. = missing room\r\n"
  6980:                  "  -- and | = two-way exits\r\n"
  6981:                  "  -> <- ^ v = one-way exits\r\n"
  6982:                  "  @ = your current room\r\n\r\n");
  6983: 
  6984:   zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "    ");
  6985:   for (col = 0; col < map_width; col++) {
  6986:     zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "%02d", col);
  6987:     if (col < map_width - 1)
  6988:       zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "  ");
  6989:   }
  6990:   zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "\r\n");
  6991: 
  6992:   for (row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
  6993:     zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "%02d  ", row);
  6994: 
  6995:     for (col = 0; col < map_width; col++) {
  6996:       int idx = (row * map_width) + col;
  6997:       char cell[3];
  6998: 
  6999:       if (idx >= slots_scanned) {
  7000:         zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "  ");
  7001:       } else {
  7002:         room_vnum cell_vnum = bottom + idx;
  7003:         room_rnum cell_room = room_cache[idx];
  7004: 
  7005:         zonemap_cell_text(cell_vnum, cell_room, player_room_vnum, cell);
  7006:         zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "%s", cell);
  7007:       }
  7008: 
  7009:       if (col < map_width - 1) {
  7010:         int right_idx = idx + 1;
  7011: 
  7012:         if (idx < slots_scanned && right_idx < slots_scanned) {
  7013:           room_rnum left_room = room_cache[idx];
  7014:           room_rnum right_room = room_cache[right_idx];
  7015:           bool east_link = zonemap_has_exit_to(left_room, EAST, right_room);
  7016:           bool west_link = zonemap_has_exit_to(right_room, WEST, left_room);
  7017: 
  7018:           if (east_link && west_link)
  7019:             zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "--");
  7020:           else if (east_link)
  7021:             zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "->");
  7022:           else if (west_link)
  7023:             zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "<-");
  7024:           else
  7025:             zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "  ");
  7026: 
  7027:           if (east_link != west_link)
  7028:             one_way_links++;
  7029:         } else {
  7030:           zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "  ");
  7031:         }
  7032:       }
  7033:     }
  7034:     zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "\r\n");
  7035: 
  7036:     if (row < rows - 1) {
  7037:       zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "    ");
  7038:       for (col = 0; col < map_width; col++) {
  7039:         int idx = (row * map_width) + col;
  7040:         int down_idx = idx + map_width;
  7041:         char vconn = ' ';
  7042: 
  7043:         if (idx < slots_scanned && down_idx < slots_scanned) {
  7044:           room_rnum top_room = room_cache[idx];
  7045:           room_rnum bottom_room = room_cache[down_idx];
  7046:           bool south_link = zonemap_has_exit_to(top_room, SOUTH, bottom_room);
  7047:           bool north_link = zonemap_has_exit_to(bottom_room, NORTH, top_room);
  7048: 
  7049:           if (south_link && north_link)
  7050:             vconn = '|';
  7051:           else if (south_link)
  7052:             vconn = 'v';
  7053:           else if (north_link)
  7054:             vconn = '^';
  7055: 
  7056:           if (south_link != north_link)
  7057:             one_way_links++;
  7058:         }
  7059: 
  7060:         zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "%c", vconn);
  7061:         if (col < map_width - 1)
  7062:           zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "   ");
  7063:       }
  7064:       zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen, "\r\n");
  7065:     }
  7066:   }
  7067: 
  7068:   zonemap_append(outbuf, estimated_bufsz, &outlen,
  7069:                  "\r\nSummary:\r\n"
  7070:                  "- Existing rooms: %d / %d slots scanned\r\n"
  7071:                  "- Missing rooms: %d\r\n"
  7072:                  "- One-way links: %d\r\n"
  7073:                  "- Isolated rooms: %d\r\n",
  7074:                  existing_rooms, slots_scanned, missing_rooms, one_way_links, isolated_rooms);
  7075: 
  7076:   page_string(ch->desc, outbuf, TRUE);
  7077:   free(outbuf);
  7078:   free(room_cache);
  7079: }

  7081: ACMD(do_areatemplate)
  7082: {
  7083:   char usage[] = "Usage: areatemplate <zone_vnum> <start_room_vnum> <room_count> \"<zone name>\"\r\n";
  7084:   char zone_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7085:   char errmsg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  7086:   const char *create_err = NULL;

  7089:   room_vnum top_room_vnum;

  7094:   bool can_edit_new_zone = FALSE;

  7101:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", usage);
  7102:     return;
  7103:   }
  7104:

  7106:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have builder permissions for this command.\r\n");
  7107:     return;

  7109: 
  7110:   if (zone_vnum_input < 0 || zone_vnum_input > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
  7111:     send_to_char(ch, "Zone vnum must be numeric and valid.\r\n");

  7119: 
  7120:   if (room_count <= 0) {
  7121:     send_to_char(ch, "Room count must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");

  7124:

  7130:   if (((long long) start_room_vnum + (long long) room_count - 1) > IDXTYPE_MAX) {

  7138:     return;
  7139:   }
  7140: 
  7141:   if (!room_range_is_clear(start_room_vnum, room_count, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  7142:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  7143:     return;
  7144:   }

  7146:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GRGOD || GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) == ALL_PERMISSION)
  7147:     can_edit_new_zone = TRUE;
  7148:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_BUILDER && GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) != NOWHERE &&
  7149:            GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) == zone_vnum_input)
  7150:     can_edit_new_zone = TRUE;
  7151: 
  7152:   if (!can_edit_new_zone) {
  7153:     send_cannot_edit(ch, zone_vnum_input);
  7154:     return;
  7155:   }
  7156: 
  7157:   new_zone_rnum = create_new_zone(zone_vnum_input, start_room_vnum, top_room_vnum, &create_err);
  7158:   if (new_zone_rnum == NOWHERE) {
  7159:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", create_err ? create_err : "Unable to create zone.\r\n");
  7160:     return;
  7161:   }
  7162: 
  7163:   if (!areatemplate_set_zone_name(new_zone_rnum, zone_name)) {
  7164:     send_to_char(ch, "Unable to set zone name.\r\n");
  7165:     return;
  7166:   }
  7167: 
  7168:   compute_template_dimensions(room_count, &width, &height);
  7169: 
  7170:   for (i = 0; i < room_count; i++) {
  7171:     struct room_data new_room;
  7172: 
  7173:     init_areatemplate_room(&new_room, start_room_vnum + i, new_zone_rnum);
  7174:     if (add_room(&new_room) == NOWHERE) {
  7175:       free_areatemplate_room_strings(&new_room);
  7176:       send_to_char(ch, "Room creation failed at vnum %d.\r\n", start_room_vnum + i);
  7177:       return;
  7178:     }
  7179:     free_areatemplate_room_strings(&new_room);
  7180:   }
  7181: 
  7182:   link_areatemplate_rooms(start_room_vnum, room_count, width,
  7183:                           &ew_links, &ns_links, &skipped_neighbors);
  7184:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[new_zone_rnum].number, SL_WLD);
  7185:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[new_zone_rnum].number, SL_ZON);
  7186: 
  7187:   if (!save_rooms(new_zone_rnum)) {
  7188:     send_to_char(ch, "Room data could not be saved to disk.\r\n");
  7189:     return;
  7190:   }
  7191:   if (!save_zone(new_zone_rnum)) {
  7192:     send_to_char(ch, "Zone data could not be saved to disk.\r\n");
  7193:     return;
  7194:   }
  7195: 
  7196:   send_to_char(ch,
  7197:     "Area template created successfully.\r\n"
  7198:     "Zone: %d\r\n"
  7199:     "Name: %s\r\n"
  7200:     "Room range: %d-%d\r\n"
  7201:     "Rooms created: %d\r\n"
  7202:     "Layout: %d x %d\r\n"
  7203:     "East/West links created: %d\r\n"
  7204:     "North/South links created: %d\r\n"
  7205:     "Skipped edge/nonexistent neighbors: %d\r\n",
  7206:     zone_table[new_zone_rnum].number,
  7207:     zone_table[new_zone_rnum].name ? zone_table[new_zone_rnum].name : "New Zone",
  7208:     start_room_vnum, top_room_vnum,
  7209:     room_count, width, height,
  7210:     ew_links, ns_links, skipped_neighbors);
  7211: 
  7212:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  7213:          "OLC: %s used areatemplate for zone %d (%d-%d, %d rooms, %dx%d).",
  7214:          GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[new_zone_rnum].number, start_room_vnum, top_room_vnum,
  7215:          room_count, width, height);
  7216: }

  7218: ACMD(do_roomtemplate)
  7219: {
  7220:   char usage[] = "Usage: roomtemplate <start_room_vnum> <room_count>\r\n";
  7221:   char errmsg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  7222:   room_vnum start_room_vnum, top_room_vnum;
  7223:   zone_rnum owning_zone;
  7224:   int room_count, width, height;
  7225:   int ew_links = 0, ns_links = 0, skipped_neighbors = 0;
  7226:   int i;
  7227: 
  7228:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
  7229:     return;
  7230: 
  7231:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_BUILDER) {
  7232:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have builder permissions for this command.\r\n");
  7233:     return;
  7234:   }
  7235: 
  7236:   if (!parse_roomtemplate_args(argument, &start_room_vnum, &room_count)) {
  7237:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", usage);
  7238:     return;
  7239:   }
  7240: 
  7241:   if (start_room_vnum <= 0) {
  7242:     send_to_char(ch, "Start room vnum must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  7243:     return;
  7244:   }
  7245:   if (room_count <= 0) {
  7246:     send_to_char(ch, "Room count must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  7247:     return;
  7248:   }
  7249:   if (((long long)start_room_vnum + (long long)room_count - 1) > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
  7250:     send_to_char(ch, "Computed top room exceeds valid vnum range.\r\n");
  7251:     return;
  7252:   }
  7253:   top_room_vnum = start_room_vnum + room_count - 1;
  7254: 
  7255:   if (!roomtemplate_range_is_valid(start_room_vnum, room_count, &owning_zone, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  7256:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  7257:     return;
  7258:   }
  7259:   if (!roomtemplate_builder_can_edit(ch, owning_zone, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  7260:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  7261:     return;
  7262:   }
  7263: 
  7264:   compute_template_dimensions(room_count, &width, &height);
  7265: 
  7266:   for (i = 0; i < room_count; i++) {
  7267:     struct room_data new_room;
  7268: 
  7269:     init_areatemplate_room(&new_room, start_room_vnum + i, owning_zone);
  7270:     if (add_room(&new_room) == NOWHERE) {
  7271:       free_areatemplate_room_strings(&new_room);
  7272:       send_to_char(ch, "Room creation failed at vnum %d.\r\n", start_room_vnum + i);
  7273:       return;
  7274:     }
  7275:     free_areatemplate_room_strings(&new_room);
  7276:   }
  7277: 
  7278:   link_areatemplate_rooms(start_room_vnum, room_count, width,
  7279:                           &ew_links, &ns_links, &skipped_neighbors);
  7280:   if (!save_roomtemplate_zone(ch, owning_zone, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  7281:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  7282:     return;
  7283:   }
  7284: 
  7285:   send_to_char(ch,
  7286:     "Room template created successfully.\r\n"
  7287:     "Zone: %d\r\n"
  7288:     "Room range: %d-%d\r\n"
  7289:     "Rooms created: %d\r\n"
  7290:     "Layout: %d x %d\r\n"
  7291:     "East/West links created: %d\r\n"
  7292:     "North/South links created: %d\r\n"
  7293:     "Skipped edge/nonexistent neighbors: %d\r\n",
  7294:     zone_table[owning_zone].number, start_room_vnum, top_room_vnum, room_count, width, height,
  7295:     ew_links, ns_links, skipped_neighbors);
  7296: 
  7297:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  7298:          "OLC: %s used roomtemplate in zone %d (%d-%d, %d rooms, %dx%d).",
  7299:          GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[owning_zone].number,
  7300:          start_room_vnum, top_room_vnum, room_count, width, height);
  7301: }
  7302: 
  7303: static bool parse_objtemplate_args(char *argument, obj_vnum *start_vnum_out, int *min_level_out,
  7304:                                    int *max_level_out, int *obj_count_out,
  7305:                                    char *base_name_out, size_t base_name_sz,
  7306:                                    char *type_out, size_t type_sz)
  7307: {
  7308:   char start_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7309:   char min_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7310:   char max_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7311:   char count_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7312:   char *p, *q;
  7313:   size_t len;
  7314: 
  7315:   argument = one_argument(argument, start_arg);
  7316:   argument = one_argument(argument, min_arg);
  7317:   argument = one_argument(argument, max_arg);
  7318:   argument = one_argument(argument, count_arg);
  7319:   skip_spaces(&argument);
  7320: 
  7321:   if (!*start_arg || !*min_arg || !*max_arg || !*count_arg || !*argument)
  7322:     return FALSE;
  7323:   if (!is_number(start_arg) || !is_number(min_arg) || !is_number(max_arg) || !is_number(count_arg))
  7324:     return FALSE;
  7325: 
  7326:   *start_vnum_out = atoi(start_arg);
  7327:   *min_level_out = atoi(min_arg);
  7328:   *max_level_out = atoi(max_arg);
  7329:   *obj_count_out = atoi(count_arg);
  7330: 
  7331:   p = argument;
  7332:   if (*p != '\"')
  7333:     return FALSE;
  7334:   p++;
  7335:   q = strrchr(p, '\"');
  7336:   if (!q)
  7337:     return FALSE;
  7338:   *q = '\0';
  7339: 
  7340:   while (*p && isspace(*p))
  7341:     p++;
  7342:   len = strlen(p);
  7343:   while (len > 0 && isspace(p[len - 1])) {
  7344:     p[len - 1] = '\0';
  7345:     len--;
  7346:   }
  7347:   if (!*p)
  7348:     return FALSE;
  7349:   strlcpy(base_name_out, p, base_name_sz);
  7350: 
  7351:   q++;
  7352:   while (*q && isspace(*q))
  7353:     q++;
  7354:   if (!*q)
  7355:     return FALSE;
  7356:   {
  7357:     char *end = q + strlen(q) - 1;
  7358:     while (end > q && isspace(*end))
  7359:       *end-- = '\0';
  7360:   }
  7361:   if (!*q || strchr(q, ' '))
  7362:     return FALSE;
  7363:   strlcpy(type_out, q, type_sz);
  7364:   return TRUE;
  7365: }
  7366: 
  7367: static bool objtemplate_range_is_clear(obj_vnum start, int obj_count, char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  7368: {
  7369:   int i;
  7370:   for (i = 0; i < obj_count; i++) {
  7371:     obj_vnum vnum = start + i;
  7372:     if (real_object(vnum) != NOTHING) {
  7373:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Object vnum %d already exists.\r\n", vnum);
  7374:       return FALSE;
  7375:     }
  7376:   }
  7377:   return TRUE;
  7378: }
  7379: 
  7380: static bool objtemplate_builder_can_edit_range(struct char_data *ch, obj_vnum start, int obj_count,
  7381:                                                char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  7382: {
  7383:   int i;
  7384:   for (i = 0; i < obj_count; i++) {
  7385:     zone_rnum rznum = real_zone_by_thing(start + i);
  7386:     if (rznum == NOWHERE || !can_edit_zone(ch, rznum)) {
  7387:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "You are not allowed to create objects in that vnum range.\r\n");
  7388:       return FALSE;
  7389:     }
  7390:   }
  7391:   return TRUE;
  7392: }
  7393: 
  7394: static bool objtemplate_build_strings(const char *base_name, int number,
  7395:                                       char **keywords, char **shortd,
  7396:                                       char **longd, char **action_desc,
  7397:                                       char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  7398: {
  7399:   *keywords = template_alloc_printf("template %s object %d", base_name, number);
  7400:   *shortd = template_alloc_printf("a template %s %d", base_name, number);
  7401:   *longd = template_alloc_printf(
  7402:     "A template %s %d is here awaiting builder customization.\r\n", base_name, number);
  7403:   *action_desc = strdup("");
  7404: 
  7405:   if (!*keywords || !*shortd || !*longd || !*action_desc) {
  7406:     free(*keywords);
  7407:     free(*shortd);
  7408:     free(*longd);
  7409:     free(*action_desc);
  7410:     *keywords = *shortd = *longd = *action_desc = NULL;
  7411:     snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Failed to allocate object strings.\r\n");
  7412:     return FALSE;
  7413:   }
  7414:   return TRUE;
  7415: }
  7416: 
  7417: static int objtemplate_type_from_name(const char *type_name)
  7418: {
  7419:   if (!strcmp(type_name, "trash"))
  7420:     return ITEM_TRASH;
  7421:   if (!strcmp(type_name, "treasure"))
  7422:     return ITEM_TREASURE;
  7423:   if (!strcmp(type_name, "weapon"))
  7424:     return ITEM_WEAPON;
  7425:   if (!strcmp(type_name, "armor"))
  7426:     return ITEM_ARMOR;
  7427:   if (!strcmp(type_name, "container"))
  7428:     return ITEM_CONTAINER;
  7429:   return -1;
  7430: }
  7431: 
  7432: static bool objtemplate_apply_defaults(struct obj_data *obj, int type, int level)
  7433: {
  7434:   int i;
  7435: 
  7436:   GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) = type;
  7437:   GET_OBJ_COST(obj) = 0;
  7438:   GET_OBJ_RENT(obj) = 0;
  7439:   GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj) = level;
  7440:   GET_OBJ_TIMER(obj) = 0;
  7441:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_OBJ_VAL_POSITIONS; i++)
  7442:     GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, i) = 0;
  7443: 
  7444:   switch (type) {
  7445:     case ITEM_TRASH:
  7446:     case ITEM_TREASURE:
  7447:       SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), ITEM_WEAR_TAKE);
  7448:       GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) = MAX(1, (level / 5) + 1);
  7449:       break;
  7450:     case ITEM_WEAPON:
  7451:       SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), ITEM_WEAR_TAKE);
  7452:       SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), ITEM_WEAR_WIELD);
  7453:       GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) = MAX(1, (level / 4) + 2);
  7454:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0) = 0;
  7455:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1) = MAX(1, (level / 10) + 1);
  7456:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2) = 4;
  7457:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3) = TYPE_HIT - TYPE_HIT;
  7458:       break;
  7459:     case ITEM_ARMOR:
  7460:       SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), ITEM_WEAR_TAKE);
  7461:       SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), ITEM_WEAR_BODY);
  7462:       GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) = MAX(1, (level / 4) + 2);
  7463:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0) = MAX(1, level / 3);
  7464:       break;
  7465:     case ITEM_CONTAINER:
  7466:       SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), ITEM_WEAR_TAKE);
  7467:       GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) = MAX(1, (level / 4) + 2);
  7468:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0) = MAX(10, level * 2);
  7469:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1) = 0;
  7470:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2) = NOTHING;
  7471:       GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3) = 0;
  7472:       break;
  7473:     default:
  7474:       return FALSE;
  7475:   }
  7476: 
  7477:   return TRUE;
  7478: }
  7479: 
  7480: static bool objtemplate_create_one(obj_vnum vnum, const char *base_name, int number, int level,
  7481:                                    const char *type_name, char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  7482: {
  7483:   struct obj_data obj;
  7484:   char *keywords = NULL, *shortd = NULL, *longd = NULL, *action_desc = NULL;
  7485:   int type = objtemplate_type_from_name(type_name);
  7486:   obj_rnum new_rnum;
  7487: 
  7488:   if (type < 0) {
  7489:     snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz,
  7490:              "Unknown object template type. Valid types are: trash treasure weapon armor container.\r\n");
  7491:     return FALSE;
  7492:   }
  7493: 
  7494:   memset(&obj, 0, sizeof(obj));
  7495:   clear_object(&obj);
  7496:   if (!objtemplate_build_strings(base_name, number, &keywords, &shortd, &longd, &action_desc,
  7497:                                  errmsg, errmsg_sz))
  7498:     return FALSE;
  7499: 
  7500:   obj.name = keywords;
  7501:   obj.short_description = shortd;
  7502:   obj.description = longd;
  7503:   obj.action_description = action_desc;
  7504: 
  7505:   if (!objtemplate_apply_defaults(&obj, type, level)) {
  7506:     free_object_strings(&obj);
  7507:     snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Failed to apply object defaults for vnum %d.\r\n", vnum);
  7508:     return FALSE;
  7509:   }
  7510: 
  7511:   new_rnum = add_object(&obj, vnum);
  7512:   free_object_strings(&obj);
  7513: 
  7514:   if (new_rnum == NOTHING || real_object(vnum) == NOTHING) {
  7515:     snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Failed to create object vnum %d.\r\n", vnum);
  7516:     return FALSE;
  7517:   }
  7518: 
  7519:   return TRUE;
  7520: }
  7521: 
  7522: static bool objtemplate_save_affected_zones(struct char_data *ch, obj_vnum start, int obj_count,
  7523:                                             char *errmsg, size_t errmsg_sz)
  7524: {
  7525:   bool *saved;
  7526:   int i;
  7527: 
  7528:   CREATE(saved, bool, top_of_zone_table + 1);
  7529:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_zone_table; i++)
  7530:     saved[i] = FALSE;
  7531: 
  7532:   for (i = 0; i < obj_count; i++) {
  7533:     zone_rnum rznum = real_zone_by_thing(start + i);
  7534:     if (rznum == NOWHERE) {
  7535:       free(saved);
  7536:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Cannot save objects: vnum %d has no valid zone.\r\n", start + i);
  7537:       return FALSE;
  7538:     }
  7539: 
  7540:     if (saved[rznum])
  7541:       continue;
  7542:     if (!save_objects(rznum)) {
  7543:       free(saved);
  7544:       snprintf(errmsg, errmsg_sz, "Failed saving object data for zone %d.\r\n", zone_table[rznum].number);
  7545:       return FALSE;
  7546:     }
  7547:     saved[rznum] = TRUE;
  7548:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  7549:            "OLC: %s saved object templates in zone %d.",
  7550:            GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[rznum].number);
  7551:   }
  7552: 
  7553:   free(saved);
  7554:   return TRUE;
  7555: }

  7557: ACMD(do_objtemplate)
  7558: {
  7559:   char usage[] = "Usage: objtemplate <start_obj_vnum> <min_level> <max_level> <obj_count> \"<base name>\" <type>\r\n";
  7560:   char errmsg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  7561:   char base_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7562:   char type_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7563:   obj_vnum start_vnum, top_vnum;
  7564:   int min_level, max_level, obj_count;
  7565:   int i, created = 0;
  7566: 
  7567:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
  7568:     return;
  7569: 
  7570:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_BUILDER) {
  7571:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have builder permissions for this command.\r\n");
  7572:     return;
  7573:   }
  7574: 
  7575:   if (!parse_objtemplate_args(argument, &start_vnum, &min_level, &max_level, &obj_count,
  7576:                               base_name, sizeof(base_name), type_name, sizeof(type_name))) {
  7577:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", usage);
  7578:     return;
  7579:   }
  7580: 
  7581:   if (start_vnum <= 0) {
  7582:     send_to_char(ch, "Start object vnum must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  7583:     return;
  7584:   }
  7585:   if (min_level <= 0) {
  7586:     send_to_char(ch, "Minimum level must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  7587:     return;
  7588:   }
  7589:   if (max_level <= 0) {
  7590:     send_to_char(ch, "Maximum level must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  7591:     return;
  7592:   }
  7593:   if (obj_count <= 0) {
  7594:     send_to_char(ch, "Object count must be numeric and greater than 0.\r\n");
  7595:     return;
  7596:   }
  7597:   if (!*base_name) {
  7598:     send_to_char(ch, "Base name must be present and non-empty.\r\n");
  7599:     return;
  7600:   }
  7601:   if (strlen(base_name) > MAX_TEMPLATE_BASENAME_LEN) {
  7602:     send_to_char(ch, "Base name is too long. Maximum length is %d characters.\r\n",
  7603:                  MAX_TEMPLATE_BASENAME_LEN);
  7604:     return;
  7605:   }
  7606:   if (objtemplate_type_from_name(type_name) < 0) {
  7607:     send_to_char(ch, "Unknown object template type. Valid types are: trash treasure weapon armor container.\r\n");
  7608:     return;
  7609:   }
  7610:   if (min_level > max_level) {
  7611:     send_to_char(ch, "Minimum level must be less than or equal to maximum level.\r\n");
  7612:     return;
  7613:   }
  7614:   if (((long long)start_vnum + (long long)obj_count - 1) > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
  7615:     send_to_char(ch, "Computed top object vnum exceeds valid vnum range.\r\n");
  7616:     return;
  7617:   }
  7618:   top_vnum = start_vnum + obj_count - 1;
  7619: 
  7620:   if (!objtemplate_range_is_clear(start_vnum, obj_count, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  7621:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  7622:     return;
  7623:   }
  7624:   if (!objtemplate_builder_can_edit_range(ch, start_vnum, obj_count, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  7625:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  7626:     return;
  7627:   }
  7628: 
  7629:   for (i = 0; i < obj_count; i++) {
  7630:     obj_vnum vnum = start_vnum + i;
  7631:     int level = template_compute_level(min_level, max_level, obj_count, i);
  7632: 
  7633:     if (!objtemplate_create_one(vnum, base_name, i + 1, level, type_name, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  7634:       int rollback;
  7635:       for (rollback = 0; rollback < created; rollback++) {
  7636:         obj_rnum robj = real_object(start_vnum + rollback);
  7637:         if (robj != NOTHING)
  7638:           delete_object(robj);
  7639:       }
  7640:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  7641:       return;
  7642:     }
  7643:     created++;
  7644:   }
  7645: 
  7646:   if (!objtemplate_save_affected_zones(ch, start_vnum, obj_count, errmsg, sizeof(errmsg))) {
  7647:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", errmsg);
  7648:     return;
  7649:   }
  7650: 
  7651:   send_to_char(ch,
  7652:     "Object template created successfully.\r\n"
  7653:     "Object range: %d-%d\r\n"
  7654:     "Objects created: %d\r\n"
  7655:     "Level range: %d-%d\r\n"
  7656:     "Base name: %s\r\n"
  7657:     "Type: %s\r\n",
  7658:     start_vnum, top_vnum, obj_count, min_level, max_level, base_name, type_name);
  7659: 
  7660:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
  7661:          "OLC: %s used objtemplate for objects %d-%d (%d objects, level %d-%d, base '%s', type '%s').",
  7662:          GET_NAME(ch), start_vnum, top_vnum, obj_count, min_level, max_level, base_name, type_name);
  7663: }

  7665: ACMD(do_zunlock)
  7666: {
  7667:   zone_vnum znvnum;
  7668:   zone_rnum zn;
  7669:   char      arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7670:   int       counter = 0;
  7671:   bool      fail = FALSE;
  7672: 
  7673:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  7674: 
  7675:   if (!*arg) {
  7676:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %szunlock <zone number>%s\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
  7677:     send_to_char(ch, "%s       zunlock list%s\r\n\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
  7678:     send_to_char(ch, "Unlocks a 'locked' zone to allow building or editing.\r\n");
  7679:     send_to_char(ch, "The 'list' shows all currently unlocked zones.\r\n");
  7680:     send_to_char(ch, "'zunlock all' will unlock every zone in the MUD.\r\n");
  7681:     return;
  7682:   }
  7683:   if (is_abbrev(arg, "all")) {
  7684:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD) {
  7685:       send_to_char(ch, "You do not have sufficient access to lock zones.\r\n");
  7686:       return;
  7687:     }
  7688:     for (zn = 0; zn <= top_of_zone_table; zn++) {
  7689:       if (ZONE_FLAGGED(zn, ZONE_NOBUILD)) {
  7690:         counter++;
  7691:         REMOVE_BIT_AR(ZONE_FLAGS(zn), ZONE_NOBUILD);
  7692:         if (save_zone(zn)) {
  7693:           log("(GC) %s has unlocked zone %d", GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[zn].number);
  7694:         } else {
  7695:           fail = TRUE;
  7696:         }
  7697:       }
  7698:     }
  7699:     if (counter == 0) {
  7700:       send_to_char(ch, "There are no locked zones to unlock!\r\n");
  7701:       return;
  7702:     }
  7703:     if (fail) {
  7704:       send_to_char(ch, "Unable to save zone changes.  Check syslog!\r\n");
  7705:       return;
  7706:     }
  7707:     send_to_char(ch, "%d zones have now been unlocked.\r\n", counter);
  7708:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s has unlocked ALL zones!", GET_NAME(ch));
  7709:     return;
  7710:   }
  7711:   if (is_abbrev(arg, "list")) {
  7712:     /* Show all unlocked zones */
  7713:     for (zn = 0; zn <= top_of_zone_table; zn++) {
  7714:       if (!ZONE_FLAGGED(zn, ZONE_NOBUILD)) {
  7715:         if (!counter) send_to_char(ch, "Unlocked Zones\r\n");
  7716: 
  7717:         send_to_char(ch, "[%s%3d%s] %s%-*s %s%-1s%s\r\n",
  7718:           QGRN, zone_table[zn].number, QNRM, QCYN, count_color_chars(zone_table[zn].name)+30, zone_table[zn].name,
  7719:           QYEL, zone_table[zn].builders ? zone_table[zn].builders : "None.", QNRM);
  7720:         counter++;
  7721:       }
  7722:     }
  7723:     if (counter == 0) {
  7724:       send_to_char(ch, "There are currently no unlocked zones!\r\n");
  7725:     }
  7726:     return;
  7727:   }
  7728:   else if ((znvnum = atoi(arg)) == 0) {
  7729:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %szunlock <zone number>%s\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
  7730:     return;
  7731:   }
  7732: 
  7733:   if ((zn = real_zone(znvnum)) == NOWHERE) {
  7734:     send_to_char(ch, "That zone does not exist!\r\n");
  7735:     return;
  7736:   }
  7737: 
  7738:   /* Check the builder list */
  7739:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD && !is_name(GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[zn].builders) && GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) != znvnum) {
  7740:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have sufficient access to unlock that zone!\r\n");
  7741:     return;
  7742:   }
  7743: 
  7744:   /* If we get here, player has typed 'zunlock <num>' */
  7745:   if (!ZONE_FLAGGED(zn, ZONE_NOBUILD)) {
  7746:     send_to_char(ch, "Zone %d is already unlocked!\r\n", znvnum);
  7747:     return;
  7748:   }
  7749:   REMOVE_BIT_AR(ZONE_FLAGS(zn), ZONE_NOBUILD);
  7750:   if (save_zone(zn)) {
  7751:     mudlog(NRM, MAX(LVL_GRGOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "(GC) %s has unlocked zone %d", GET_NAME(ch), znvnum);
  7752:   }
  7753:   else
  7754:   {
  7755:     send_to_char(ch, "Unable to save zone changes.  Check syslog!\r\n");
  7756:   }
  7757: }

  7759: /* get highest vnum in recent player list  */
  7760: static int get_max_recent(void)
  7761: {
  7762:   struct recent_player *this;
  7763:   int iRet=0;
  7764: 
  7765:   this = recent_list;
  7766: 
  7767:   while (this)
  7768:   {
  7769:    if (this->vnum > iRet) iRet = this->vnum;
  7770:    this = this->next;
  7771:   }
  7772: 
  7773:   return iRet;
  7774: }
  7775: 
  7776: /* clear an item in recent player list */
  7777: static void clear_recent(struct recent_player *this)
  7778: {
  7779:   this->vnum = 0;
  7780:   this->time = 0;
  7781:   strcpy(this->name, "");
  7782:   strcpy(this->host, "");
  7783:   this->next = NULL;
  7784: }
  7785: 
  7786: /* create new blank player in recent players list */
  7787: static struct recent_player *create_recent(void)
  7788: {
  7789:   struct recent_player *newrecent;
  7790: 
  7791:   CREATE(newrecent, struct recent_player, 1);
  7792:   clear_recent(newrecent);
  7793:   newrecent->next = recent_list;
  7794:   recent_list = newrecent;
  7795: 
  7796:   newrecent->vnum = get_max_recent();
  7797:   newrecent->vnum++;
  7798:   return newrecent;
  7799: }
  7800: 
  7801: /* Add player to recent player list */
  7802: bool AddRecentPlayer(char *chname, char *chhost, bool newplr, bool cpyplr)
  7803: {
  7804:   struct recent_player *this;
  7805:   time_t ct;
  7806:   int max_vnum;
  7807: 
  7808:   if (!chname || !*chname) // dropped connection with no name given
  7809:        return FALSE;
  7810: 
  7811:   ct = time(0);  /* Grab the current time */
  7812: 
  7813:   this = create_recent();
  7814: 
  7815:   if (!this) return FALSE;
  7816: 
  7817:   this->time = ct;
  7818:   this->new_player = newplr;
  7819:   this->copyover_player = cpyplr;
  7820:   strcpy(this->host, chhost);
  7821:   strcpy(this->name, chname);
  7822:   max_vnum = get_max_recent();
  7823:   this->vnum = max_vnum;   /* Possibly should be +1 ? */
  7824: 
  7825:   return TRUE;
  7826: }

  7834:

  7836:   {
  7837: 	this = this->next;
  7838: 	free(temp);

  7842: ACMD(do_recent)
  7843: {
  7844:   time_t ct;
  7845:   char timestr[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7846:   int hits = 0, limit = 0, count = 0;
  7847:   struct recent_player *this;
  7848:   bool loc;
  7849: 
  7850:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  7851:   if (!*arg) {
  7852:     limit = 0;
  7853:   } else {
  7854:     limit = atoi(arg);
  7855:   }
  7856: 
  7857:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GRGOD) {  /* If High-Level Imm, then show Host IP */
  7858:     send_to_char(ch, " ID | DATE/TIME                | HOST IP                          | Player Name\r\n");
  7859:   } else {
  7860:     send_to_char(ch, " ID | DATE/TIME                | Player Name\r\n");
  7861:   }
  7862: 
  7863:   this = recent_list;
  7864:   while(this)
  7865:   {
  7866:     loc = FALSE;
  7867:     hits++;
  7868:     ct = this->time;
  7869:     strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y", localtime(&ct));
  7870: 
  7871:     if (*(this->host)) {
  7872:       if (!strcmp(this->host, "localhost")) loc = TRUE;
  7873:     }
  7874: 
  7875:     if ((limit == 0) || (count < limit))
  7876:     {
  7877:       if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GRGOD)   /* If High-Level Imm, then show Host IP */
  7878:       {
  7879:         if (this->new_player == TRUE) {
  7880:           send_to_char(ch, "%3d | %-24.24s | %s%-32s%s | %s %s(New Player)%s\r\n", this->vnum, timestr, loc ? QRED : "", this->host, QNRM, this->name, QYEL, QNRM);
  7881:         } else if (this->copyover_player == TRUE) {
  7882:           send_to_char(ch, "%3d | %-24.24s | %s%-32s%s | %s %s(Copyover)%s\r\n", this->vnum, timestr, loc ? QRED : "", this->host, QNRM, this->name, QCYN, QNRM);
  7883:         } else {
  7884:           send_to_char(ch, "%3d | %-24.24s | %s%-32s%s | %s\r\n", this->vnum, timestr, loc ? QRED : "", this->host, QNRM, this->name);
  7885:         }
  7886:       }
  7887:       else
  7888:       {
  7889:         if (this->new_player == TRUE) {
  7890:           send_to_char(ch, "%3d | %-24.24s | %s %s(New Player)%s\r\n", this->vnum, timestr, this->name, QYEL, QNRM);
  7891:         } else if (this->copyover_player == TRUE) {
  7892:           send_to_char(ch, "%3d | %-24.24s | %s %s(Copyover)%s\r\n", this->vnum, timestr, this->name, QCYN, QNRM);
  7893:         } else {
  7894:           send_to_char(ch, "%3d | %-24.24s | %s\r\n", this->vnum, timestr, this->name);
  7895:         }
  7896:       }
  7897:       count++;
  7898: 
  7899:       this = this->next;
  7900:     }
  7901:     else
  7902:     {
  7903:       this = NULL;
  7904:     }
  7905:   }
  7906: 
  7907:   ct = time(0);  /* Grab the current time */
  7908:   strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%c", localtime(&ct));
  7909:   send_to_char(ch, "Current Server Time: %s\r\nShowing %d players since last copyover/reboot\r\n", timestr, hits);
  7910: }

  7960: ACMD(do_pull)
  7961: {
  7962:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  7963:   struct char_data *vict = NULL, *iter;
  7964:   int load_result;
  7965: 
  7966:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  7967: 
  7968:   if (!*arg) {
  7969:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: pull <playername>\r\n");
  7970:     return;
  7971:   }
  7972: 
  7973:   for (iter = character_list; iter; iter = iter->next)
  7974:     if (!IS_NPC(iter) && GET_NAME(iter) && !str_cmp(GET_NAME(iter), arg)) {
  7975:       send_to_char(ch, "That player is already in the game.\r\n");
  7976:       return;
  7977:     }
  7978: 
  7979:   CREATE(vict, struct char_data, 1);
  7980:   clear_char(vict);
  7981:   CREATE(vict->player_specials, struct player_special_data, 1);
  7982:   new_mobile_data(vict);
  7983: 
  7984:   vict->desc = NULL;
  7985: 
  7986:   if ((load_result = load_char(arg, vict)) < 0 || PLR_FLAGGED(vict, PLR_DELETED)) {
  7987:     send_to_char(ch, "Failed to load that player file.\r\n");
  7988:     free_char(vict);
  7989:     return;
  7990:   }
  7991: 
  7992:   GET_PFILEPOS(vict) = load_result;
  7993: 
  7994:   if (GET_LEVEL(vict) >= GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  7995:     send_to_char(ch, "You cannot pull an immortal of equal or higher level.\r\n");
  7996:     free_char(vict);
  7997:     return;
  7998:   }
  7999: 
  8000:   reset_char(vict);
  8001:   vict->script_id = GET_IDNUM(vict);
  8002:   add_to_lookup_table(vict->script_id, (void *)vict);
  8003: 
  8004:   if (!SCRIPT(vict))
  8005:     read_saved_vars(vict);
  8006: 
  8007:   vict->next = character_list;
  8008:   character_list = vict;
  8009: 
  8010:   char_to_room(vict, IN_ROOM(ch));
  8011:   GET_POS(vict) = POS_STANDING;
  8012:   Crash_load(vict);
  8013: 
  8014:   act("$n appears in a swirl of magic.", FALSE, vict, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  8015:   send_to_char(ch, "You pull %s into the world.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict));
  8016:   mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_LEVEL(ch)), TRUE, "%s pulled %s into room %d", GET_NAME(ch),
  8017:          GET_NAME(vict), GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch)));
  8018: }
  8019: 
  8020: static void perform_push(struct char_data *ch, char *argument, const char *command)
  8021: {
  8022:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  8023:   struct char_data *iter, *vict = NULL;
  8024:   int matches = 0;
  8025: 
  8026:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  8027: 
  8028:   if (!*arg) {
  8029:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %s <playername>\r\n", command);
  8030:     return;
  8031:   }
  8032: 
  8033:   /* Prefer an exact player name, but reject ambiguous abbreviations instead of
  8034:    * allowing a destructive command to select whichever match happens to be
  8035:    * first in character_list. */
  8036:   for (iter = character_list; iter; iter = iter->next) {
  8037:     if (IS_NPC(iter) || !CAN_SEE(ch, iter) || !is_abbrev(arg, GET_NAME(iter)))
  8038:       continue;
  8039:     if (!str_cmp(arg, GET_NAME(iter))) {
  8040:       vict = iter;
  8041:       matches = 1;
  8042:       break;
  8043:     }
  8044:     vict = iter;
  8045:     matches++;
  8046:   }
  8047: 
  8048:   if (matches > 1) {
  8049:     send_to_char(ch, "That player name is ambiguous.\r\n");
  8050:     return;
  8051:   }
  8052: 
  8053:   if (!vict) {
  8054:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not see that player here.\r\n");
  8055:     return;
  8056:   }
  8057: 
  8058:   if (vict == ch) {
  8059:     send_to_char(ch, "You cannot push yourself out of the world.\r\n");
  8060:     return;
  8061:   }
  8062: 
  8063:   if (vict->desc) {
  8064:     send_to_char(ch, "That player is currently connected and cannot be pushed.\r\n");
  8065:     return;
  8066:   }
  8067: 
  8068:   GET_LOADROOM(vict) = GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(vict));
  8069:   if (!save_char(vict)) {
  8070:     send_to_char(ch, "Unable to save that player; push aborted.\r\n");
  8071:     return;
  8072:   }
  8073:   Crash_rentsave(vict, 0); /* Persist and detach equipment/inventory before extraction. */
  8074: 
  8075:   mudlog(NRM, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_LEVEL(ch)), TRUE, "%s pushed %s from room %d", GET_NAME(ch),
  8076:          GET_NAME(vict), GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(vict)));
  8077: 
  8078:   act("$n disappears in a swirl of magic.", FALSE, vict, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  8079:   send_to_char(ch, "You push %s out of the world.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict));
  8080:   extract_char(vict);
  8081: }
  8082: 
  8083: ACMD(do_push)
  8084: {
  8085:   perform_push(ch, argument, "push");
  8086: }
  8087: 
  8088: /* Retain the existing administrative spelling as a compatibility alias. */
  8089: ACMD(do_unpull)
  8090: {
  8091:   perform_push(ch, argument, "unpull");
  8092: }

  8094: /* AFFREMOVE COMMAND BEGIN */
  8095: ACMD(do_affremove)
  8096: {
  8097:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  8098:   struct char_data *vict = NULL;
  8099:   struct affected_type *af, *next_af;
  8100:   int affnum = -1, removed = 0;
  8101: 
  8102:   one_argument(argument, arg1);
  8103:   argument = one_argument(argument, arg1);
  8104:   argument = one_argument(argument, arg2);
  8105: 
  8106:   if (!*arg1) {
  8107:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage:\r\n"
  8108:                      "  affremove all\r\n"
  8109:                      "  affremove all <target>\r\n"
  8110:                      "  affremove <affect> <target>\r\n");
  8111:     return;
  8112:   }
  8113: 
  8114:   /* helper: remove all affects and all AFF flags from one character */
  8115:   #define CLEAR_ALL_AFFECTS(v) do {                                     \
  8116:     struct affected_type *a_, *n_;                                      \
  8117:     for (a_ = (v)->affected; a_; a_ = n_) {                             \
  8118:       n_ = a_->next;                                                    \
  8119:       affect_remove((v), a_);                                           \
  8120:     }                                                                   \
  8121:     AFF_FLAGS((v))[0] = 0;                                              \
  8122:     AFF_FLAGS((v))[1] = 0;                                              \
  8123:     AFF_FLAGS((v))[2] = 0;                                              \
  8124:     AFF_FLAGS((v))[3] = 0;                                              \
  8125:     affect_total((v));                                                  \
  8126:   } while (0)
  8127: 
  8128:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "all")) {
  8129: 
  8130:     /* affremove all <target> */
  8131:     if (*arg2) {
  8132:       if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, arg2, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD))) {
  8133:         send_to_char(ch, "That player is not here.\r\n");
  8134:         return;
  8135:       }
  8136:       if (GET_LEVEL(vict) >= GET_LEVEL(ch) && vict != ch) {
  8137:         send_to_char(ch, "You cannot affect someone of equal or higher level.\r\n");
  8138:         return;
  8139:       }
  8140: 
  8141:       CLEAR_ALL_AFFECTS(vict);
  8142: 
  8143:       send_to_char(ch, "All affects removed from %s.\r\n", GET_NAME(vict));
  8144:       send_to_char(vict, "An immortal strips all magical effects from you.\r\n");
  8145:       act("$n gestures, cleansing $N of all lingering magic.",
  8146:           FALSE, ch, NULL, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
  8147:       return;
  8148:     }
  8149: 
  8150:     /* affremove all   (global, all connected PCs) */
  8151:     {
  8152:       struct descriptor_data *d;
  8153:       int count = 0;
  8154: 
  8155:       for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
  8156:         if (!d->character)
  8157:           continue;
  8158:         if (STATE(d) != CON_PLAYING)
  8159:           continue;
  8160:         if (IS_NPC(d->character))
  8161:           continue;
  8162: 
  8163:         /* do not allow lower imm to strip higher imm */
  8164:         if (GET_LEVEL(d->character) >= GET_LEVEL(ch) && d->character != ch)
  8165:           continue;
  8166: 
  8167:         CLEAR_ALL_AFFECTS(d->character);
  8168:         count++;
  8169:       }
  8170: 
  8171:       send_to_char(ch, "All affects removed from %d connected player(s).\r\n", count);
  8172:       return;
  8173:     }
  8174:   }
  8175: 
  8176:   /* affremove <affect> <target> */
  8177:   if (!*arg2) {
  8178:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: affremove <affect> <target>\r\n");
  8179:     return;
  8180:   }
  8181: 
  8182:   if (!(vict = get_char_vis(ch, arg2, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD))) {
  8183:     send_to_char(ch, "That player is not here.\r\n");
  8184:     return;
  8185:   }
  8186: 
  8187:   if (GET_LEVEL(vict) >= GET_LEVEL(ch) && vict != ch) {
  8188:     send_to_char(ch, "You cannot affect someone of equal or higher level.\r\n");
  8189:     return;
  8190:   }
  8191: 
  8192:     /* Resolve affect by number or name.
  8193:    * This codebase does not provide find_spell_num(), so we use find_skill_num()
  8194:    * which covers skills and (in most tba forks) spells by name too.
  8195:    */
  8196:   if (is_number(arg1)) {
  8197:     affnum = atoi(arg1);
  8198:   } else {
  8199:     affnum = find_skill_num(arg1);
  8200:   }
  8201: 
  8202:   /* Remove all affect nodes matching this type */
  8203:   if (affnum >= 0) {
  8204:     for (af = vict->affected; af; af = next_af) {
  8205:       next_af = af->next;
  8206:       if (af->spell == affnum) {
  8207:         affect_remove(vict, af);
  8208:         removed++;
  8209:       }
  8210:     }
  8211:   }
  8212: 
  8213:   /* Special-case: stuck sanctuary bit can exist with no affect node */
  8214:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "sanctuary")) {
  8215:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(vict), AFF_SANCTUARY);
  8216:     affect_total(vict);
  8217:   }
  8218: 
  8219: #ifdef SPELL_SANCTUARY
  8220:   if (affnum == SPELL_SANCTUARY) {
  8221:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(vict), AFF_SANCTUARY);
  8222:     affect_total(vict);
  8223:   }
  8224: #endif
  8225: 
  8226:   if (affnum < 0 && str_cmp(arg1, "sanctuary")) {
  8227:     send_to_char(ch, "Unknown affect: %s\r\n", arg1);
  8228:     return;
  8229:   }
  8230: 
  8231:   /* Always recompute after selective removal */
  8232:   affect_total(vict);
  8233: 
  8234:   send_to_char(ch, "Removed %d instance(s) of '%s' from %s.\r\n",
  8235:                removed, arg1, GET_NAME(vict));
  8236:   send_to_char(vict, "An immortal strips '%s' from you.\r\n", arg1);
  8237: 
  8238:   #undef CLEAR_ALL_AFFECTS
  8239: }
  8240: /* AFFREMOVE COMMAND END */

    35: ACMD(do_oasis_aedit)
    36: {
    37:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
    38:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    39:   int i;
    40: 
    41:   /* No building as a mob or while being forced. */
    42:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
    43:     return;
    44:     
    45:   if (CONFIG_NEW_SOCIALS == 0) {
    46:     send_to_char(ch, "Socials cannot be edited at the moment.\r\n");
    47:     return;
    48:   }
    49: 
    50:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, AEDIT_PERMISSION)) {
    51:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't have access to editing socials.\r\n");
    52:     return;
    53:   }
    54: 
    55:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next)
    56:     if (STATE(d) == CON_AEDIT) {
    57:       send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, only one can edit socials at a time.\r\n");
    58:       return;
    59:     }
    60: 
    61:   one_argument(argument, arg);
    62: 
    63:   if (!*arg) {
    64:     send_to_char(ch, "Please specify a social to edit.\r\n");
    65:     return;
    66:   }
    67: 
    68:   d = ch->desc;
    69: 
    70:   if (!str_cmp("save", arg)) {
    71:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "OLC: %s saves socials.", GET_NAME(ch));
    72:     send_to_char(ch, "Writing social file.\r\n");
    73:     aedit_save_to_disk(d);
    74:     send_to_char(ch, "Done.\r\n");
    75:     return;
    76:   }
    77: 
    78:   /* Give descriptor an OLC structure. */
    79:   if (d->olc) {
    80:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: do_oasis: Player already had olc structure.");
    81:     free(d->olc);
    82:   }
    83:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
    84: 
    85:   OLC_NUM(d) = 0;
    86:   OLC_STORAGE(d) = strdup(arg);
    87: 
    88:   for (OLC_ZNUM(d) = 0; (OLC_ZNUM(d) <= top_of_socialt); OLC_ZNUM(d)++)
    89:     if (is_abbrev(OLC_STORAGE(d), soc_mess_list[OLC_ZNUM(d)].command))
    90:       break;
    91: 
    92:   if (OLC_ZNUM(d) > top_of_socialt)  {
    93:     if ((i = aedit_find_command(OLC_STORAGE(d))) != -1)  {
    94:       send_to_char(ch, "The '%s' command already exists (%s).\r\n", OLC_STORAGE(d), complete_cmd_info[i].command);
    95:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
    96:       return;
    97:     }
    98:     send_to_char(ch, "Do you wish to add the '%s' action? ", OLC_STORAGE(d));
    99:     OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_CONFIRM_ADD;
   100:   } else {
   101:     send_to_char(ch, "Do you wish to edit the '%s' action? ", soc_mess_list[OLC_ZNUM(d)].command);
   102:     OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_CONFIRM_EDIT;
   103:   }
   104:   STATE(d) = CON_AEDIT;
   105:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   106:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   107:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "OLC: %s starts editing actions.", GET_NAME(ch));
   108: }

   173: static void aedit_save_internally(struct descriptor_data *d) {
   174:    struct social_messg *new_soc_mess_list = NULL;
   175:    int i;
   176: 
   177:    /* add a new social into the list */
   178:    if (OLC_ZNUM(d) > top_of_socialt)  {
   179:       CREATE(new_soc_mess_list, struct social_messg, top_of_socialt + 2);
   180:       for (i = 0; i <= top_of_socialt; i++)
   181:               new_soc_mess_list[i] = soc_mess_list[i];
   182:       new_soc_mess_list[++top_of_socialt] = *OLC_ACTION(d);
   183:       free(soc_mess_list);
   184:       soc_mess_list = new_soc_mess_list;
   185:    }
   186:    /* pass the editted action back to the list - no need to add */
   187:    else {
   188:       aedit_find_command(OLC_ACTION(d)->command);
   189:       OLC_ACTION(d)->act_nr = soc_mess_list[OLC_ZNUM(d)].act_nr;
   190:       /* why did i do this..? hrm */
   191:       free_action(soc_mess_list + OLC_ZNUM(d));
   192:       soc_mess_list[OLC_ZNUM(d)] = *OLC_ACTION(d);
   193:    }
   194: 
   195:    create_command_list();
   196:    /* aedit patch -- M. Scott */
   197:    sort_commands();
   198: 
   199:    add_to_save_list(AEDIT_PERMISSION, SL_ACT);
   200:    aedit_save_to_disk(d); /* autosave by Rumble */
   201: }

   203: static void aedit_save_to_disk(struct descriptor_data *d) {
   204:    FILE *fp;
   205:    int i;
   206:    char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   207:    if (!(fp = fopen(SOCMESS_FILE_NEW, "w+")))  {
   208:      char error[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   209:      snprintf(error, sizeof(error), "Can't open socials file '%s'", SOCMESS_FILE);
   210:      perror(error);
   211:      exit(1);
   212:    }
   213: 
   214:    for (i = 0; i <= top_of_socialt; i++)  {
   215:       fprintf(fp, "~%s %s %d %d %d %d\n",
   216:               soc_mess_list[i].command,
   217:               soc_mess_list[i].sort_as,
   218:               soc_mess_list[i].hide,
   219:               soc_mess_list[i].min_char_position,
   220:               soc_mess_list[i].min_victim_position,
   221:               soc_mess_list[i].min_level_char);
   222:               
   223:       sprintf(buf, "%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n",
   224:               ((soc_mess_list[i].char_no_arg)?soc_mess_list[i].char_no_arg:"#"),
   225:               ((soc_mess_list[i].others_no_arg)?soc_mess_list[i].others_no_arg:"#"),
   226:               ((soc_mess_list[i].char_found)?soc_mess_list[i].char_found:"#"),
   227:               ((soc_mess_list[i].others_found)?soc_mess_list[i].others_found:"#"));
   228:       fprintf(fp, "%s", convert_from_tabs(buf));
   229:       
   230:       sprintf(buf, "%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n",
   231:               ((soc_mess_list[i].vict_found)?soc_mess_list[i].vict_found:"#"),
   232:               ((soc_mess_list[i].not_found)?soc_mess_list[i].not_found:"#"),
   233:               ((soc_mess_list[i].char_auto)?soc_mess_list[i].char_auto:"#"),
   234:               ((soc_mess_list[i].others_auto)?soc_mess_list[i].others_auto:"#"));
   235:       fprintf(fp, "%s", convert_from_tabs(buf));
   236:       
   237:       sprintf(buf, "%s\n%s\n%s\n",
   238:               ((soc_mess_list[i].char_body_found)?soc_mess_list[i].char_body_found:"#"),
   239:               ((soc_mess_list[i].others_body_found)?soc_mess_list[i].others_body_found:"#"),
   240:               ((soc_mess_list[i].vict_body_found)?soc_mess_list[i].vict_body_found:"#"));
   241:       fprintf(fp, "%s", convert_from_tabs(buf));
   242:       
   243:       sprintf(buf, "%s\n%s\n\n",
   244:               ((soc_mess_list[i].char_obj_found)?soc_mess_list[i].char_obj_found:"#"),
   245:               ((soc_mess_list[i].others_obj_found)?soc_mess_list[i].others_obj_found:"#"));
   246:       fprintf(fp, "%s", convert_from_tabs(buf));
   247:    }
   248: 
   249:    fprintf(fp, "$\n");
   250:    fclose(fp);
   251:    remove_from_save_list(AEDIT_PERMISSION, SL_ACT);
   252: }
