   324: /* The main loop. */
   325: void aedit_parse(struct descriptor_data * d, char *arg) {
   326:    int i;
   327: 
   328:    switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   329:     case AEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   330:       switch (*arg) {
   331:        case 'y': case 'Y':
   332:          aedit_save_internally(d);
   333:          mudlog (CMP, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE, "OLC: %s edits action %s",
   334:                  GET_NAME(d->character), OLC_ACTION(d)->command);
   335: 
   336:          /* do not free the strings.. just the structure */
   337:          cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_STRUCTS);
   338:          write_to_output(d, "Action saved to disk.\r\n");
   339:          break;
   340:        case 'n': case 'N':
   341:          /* free everything up, including strings etc */
   342:          cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   343:          break;
   344:        default:
   345:          write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n"
   346:                             "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   347:          break;
   348:       }
   349:       return; /* end of AEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING */
   350: 
   351:     case AEDIT_CONFIRM_EDIT:
   352:       switch (*arg)  {
   353:        case 'y': case 'Y':
   354:          aedit_setup_existing(d, OLC_ZNUM(d));
   355:          break;
   356:        case 'q': case 'Q':
   357:          cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   358:          break;
   359:        case 'n': case 'N':
   360:          OLC_ZNUM(d)++;
   361:          for (;(OLC_ZNUM(d) <= top_of_socialt); OLC_ZNUM(d)++)
   362:            if (is_abbrev(OLC_STORAGE(d), soc_mess_list[OLC_ZNUM(d)].command))
   363:              break;
   364: 
   365:          if (OLC_ZNUM(d) > top_of_socialt) {
   366:             if (aedit_find_command(OLC_STORAGE(d)) != -1)  {
   367:                cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   368:                break;
   369:             }
   370:             write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to add the '%s' action? ",
   371:                                OLC_STORAGE(d));
   372:             OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_CONFIRM_ADD;
   373:          } else  {
   374:             write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to edit the '%s' action? ",
   375:                             soc_mess_list[OLC_ZNUM(d)].command);
   376:             OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_CONFIRM_EDIT;
   377:          }
   378:          break;
   379:        default:
   380:          write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n"
   381:                             "Do you wish to edit the '%s' action? ",
   382:                             soc_mess_list[OLC_ZNUM(d)].command);
   383:          break;
   384:       }
   385:       return;
   386: 
   387:     case AEDIT_CONFIRM_ADD:
   388:       switch (*arg)  {
   389:        case 'y': case 'Y':
   390:          aedit_setup_new(d);
   391:          break;
   392:        case 'n': case 'N': case 'q': case 'Q':
   393:          cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   394:          break;
   395:        default:
   396:          write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n"
   397:                             "Do you wish to add the '%s' action? ",
   398:                             OLC_STORAGE(d));
   399:          break;
   400:       }
   401:       return;
   402: 
   403:     case AEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   404:       switch (*arg) {
   405:        case 'q': case 'Q':
   406:          if (OLC_VAL(d))  { /* Something was modified */
   407:             write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   408:             OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   409:          }
   410:          else cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   411:          break;
   412:        case 'n':
   413:          write_to_output(d, "Enter action name: ");
   414:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_ACTION_NAME;
   415:          return;
   416:        case '1':
   417:          write_to_output(d, "Enter sort info for this action (for the command listing): ");
   418:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_SORT_AS;
   419:          return;
   420:        case '2':
   421:          write_to_output(d, "Enter the minimum position the Character has to be in to activate social:\r\n");
   422:          for (i=POS_DEAD;i<=POS_STANDING;i++)
   423:            write_to_output(d, "   %d) %s\r\n", i, position_types[i]);
   424: 
   425:          write_to_output(d, "Enter choice: ");
   426:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_MIN_CHAR_POS;
   427:          return;
   428:        case '3':
   429:          write_to_output(d, "Enter the minimum position the Victim has to be in to activate social:\r\n");
   430:          for (i=POS_DEAD;i<=POS_STANDING;i++)
   431:            write_to_output(d, "   %d) %s\r\n", i, position_types[i]);
   432: 
   433:          write_to_output(d, "Enter choice: ");
   434:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_MIN_VICT_POS;
   435:          return;
   436:        case '4':
   437:          write_to_output(d, "Enter new minimum level for social: ");
   438:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_MIN_CHAR_LEVEL;
   439:          return;
   440:        case '5':
   441:          OLC_ACTION(d)->hide = !OLC_ACTION(d)->hide;
   442:          aedit_disp_menu(d);
   443:          OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   444:          break;
   445:        case 'a': case 'A':
   446:          write_to_output(d, "Enter social shown to the Character when there is no argument supplied.\r\n"
   447:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   448:                             "[NEW]: ",
   449:                  ((OLC_ACTION(d)->char_no_arg)?OLC_ACTION(d)->char_no_arg:"NULL"));
   450:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_NOVICT_CHAR;
   451:          return;
   452:        case 'b': case 'B':
   453:          write_to_output(d, "Enter social shown to Others when there is no argument supplied.\r\n"
   454:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   455:                             "[NEW]: ",
   456:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->others_no_arg)?OLC_ACTION(d)->others_no_arg:"NULL"));
   457:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_NOVICT_OTHERS;
   458:          return;
   459:        case 'c': case 'C':
   460:          write_to_output(d, "Enter text shown to the Character when his victim isnt found.\r\n"
   461:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   462:                             "[NEW]: ",
   463:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->not_found)?OLC_ACTION(d)->not_found:"NULL"));
   464: 
   465:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_VICT_NOT_FOUND;
   466:          return;
   467:        case 'd': case 'D':
   468:          write_to_output(d, "Enter social shown to the Character when it is its own victim.\r\n"
   469:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   470:                             "[NEW]: ",
   471:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->char_auto)?OLC_ACTION(d)->char_auto:"NULL"));
   472: 
   473:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_SELF_CHAR;
   474:          return;
   475:        case 'e': case 'E':
   476:          write_to_output(d, "Enter social shown to Others when the Char is its own victim.\r\n"
   477:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   478:                             "[NEW]: ",
   479:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->others_auto)?OLC_ACTION(d)->others_auto:"NULL"));
   480: 
   481:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_SELF_OTHERS;
   482:          return;
   483:        case 'f': case 'F':
   484:          write_to_output(d, "Enter normal social shown to the Character when the victim is found.\r\n"
   485:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   486:                             "[NEW]: ",
   487:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->char_found)?OLC_ACTION(d)->char_found:"NULL"));
   488: 
   489:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_VICT_CHAR_FOUND;
   490:          return;
   491:        case 'g': case 'G':
   492:          write_to_output(d, "Enter normal social shown to Others when the victim is found.\r\n"
   493:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   494:                             "[NEW]: ",
   495:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->others_found)?OLC_ACTION(d)->others_found:"NULL"));
   496: 
   497:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_VICT_OTHERS_FOUND;
   498:          return;
   499:        case 'h': case 'H':
   500:          write_to_output(d, "Enter normal social shown to the Victim when the victim is found.\r\n"
   501:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   502:                             "[NEW]: ",
   503:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_found)?OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_found:"NULL"));
   504: 
   505:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_VICT_VICT_FOUND;
   506:          return;
   507:        case 'i': case 'I':
   508:          write_to_output(d, "Enter 'body part' social shown to the Character when the victim is found.\r\n"
   509:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   510:                             "[NEW]: ",
   511:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->char_body_found)?OLC_ACTION(d)->char_body_found:"NULL"));
   512: 
   513:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_VICT_CHAR_BODY_FOUND;
   514:          return;
   515:        case 'j': case 'J':
   516:          write_to_output(d, "Enter 'body part' social shown to Others when the victim is found.\r\n"
   517:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   518:                             "[NEW]: ",
   519:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->others_body_found)?OLC_ACTION(d)->others_body_found:"NULL"));
   520: 
   521:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_VICT_OTHERS_BODY_FOUND;
   522:          return;
   523:        case 'k': case 'K':
   524:          write_to_output(d, "Enter 'body part' social shown to the Victim when the victim is found.\r\n"
   525:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   526:                             "[NEW]: ",
   527:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_body_found)?OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_body_found:"NULL"));
   528: 
   529:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_VICT_VICT_BODY_FOUND;
   530:          return;
   531:        case 'l': case 'L':
   532:          write_to_output(d, "Enter 'object' social shown to the Character when the object is found.\r\n"
   533:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"

   536: 
   537:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_OBJ_CHAR_FOUND;
   538:          return;
   539:        case 'm': case 'M':
   540:          write_to_output(d, "Enter 'object' social shown to the Room when the object is found.\r\n"
   541:                             "[OLD]: %s\r\n"
   542:                             "[NEW]: ",
   543:                             ((OLC_ACTION(d)->others_obj_found)?OLC_ACTION(d)->others_obj_found:"NULL"));
   544: 
   545:          OLC_MODE(d) = AEDIT_OBJ_OTHERS_FOUND;
   546:          return;
   547:        default:
   548:          aedit_disp_menu(d);
   549:          break;
   550:       }
   551:       return;
   552: 
   553:     case AEDIT_ACTION_NAME:
   554:       if (!*arg || strchr(arg,' ')) {
   555:         aedit_disp_menu(d);
   556:         return;
   557:       }
   558:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->command)
   559:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->command);
   560:       OLC_ACTION(d)->command = strdup(arg);
   561: 
   562:       break;
   563: 
   564:     case AEDIT_SORT_AS:
   565:       if (!*arg || strchr(arg,' ')) {
   566:         aedit_disp_menu(d);
   567:         return;
   568:       }
   569:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->sort_as) 
   570:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->sort_as);
   571:       OLC_ACTION(d)->sort_as = strdup(arg);
   572:       
   573:       break;
   574: 
   575:     case AEDIT_MIN_CHAR_POS:
   576:     case AEDIT_MIN_VICT_POS:
   577:       if (!*arg) {
   578:         aedit_disp_menu(d);
   579:         return;
   580:       }
   581:       i = atoi(arg);
   582:       if ((i < POS_DEAD) && (i > POS_STANDING))  {
   583:         aedit_disp_menu(d);
   584:         return;
   585:       }
   586:       if (OLC_MODE(d) == AEDIT_MIN_CHAR_POS)
   587:         OLC_ACTION(d)->min_char_position = i;
   588:       else
   589:         OLC_ACTION(d)->min_victim_position = i;
   590:       break;
   591: 
   592:     case AEDIT_MIN_CHAR_LEVEL:
   593:       if (!*arg) {
   594:         aedit_disp_menu(d);
   595:         return;
   596:       }
   597:       i = atoi(arg);
   598:       if ((i < 0) && (i > LVL_IMPL))  {
   599:         aedit_disp_menu(d);
   600:         return;
   601:       }
   602:       OLC_ACTION(d)->min_level_char = i;
   603:       break;
   604: 
   605:     case AEDIT_NOVICT_CHAR:
   606:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->char_no_arg)
   607:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->char_no_arg);
   608:       if (*arg) {
   609:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   610:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_no_arg = strdup(arg);
   611:       } else
   612:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_no_arg = NULL;
   613:       break;
   614: 
   615:     case AEDIT_NOVICT_OTHERS:
   616:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->others_no_arg)
   617:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->others_no_arg);
   618:       if (*arg) {
   619:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   620:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_no_arg = strdup(arg);
   621:       } else
   622:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_no_arg = NULL;
   623:       break;
   624: 
   625:     case AEDIT_VICT_CHAR_FOUND:
   626:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->char_found)
   627:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->char_found);
   628:       if (*arg) {
   629:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   630:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_found = strdup(arg);
   631:       } else
   632:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_found = NULL;
   633:       break;
   634: 
   635:     case AEDIT_VICT_OTHERS_FOUND:
   636:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->others_found)
   637:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->others_found);
   638:       if (*arg) {
   639:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   640:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_found = strdup(arg);
   641:       } else
   642:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_found = NULL;
   643:       break;
   644: 
   645:     case AEDIT_VICT_VICT_FOUND:
   646:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_found)
   647:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_found);
   648:       if (*arg) {
   649:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   650:         OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_found = strdup(arg);
   651:       } else
   652:         OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_found = NULL;
   653:       break;
   654: 
   655:     case AEDIT_VICT_NOT_FOUND:
   656:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->not_found)
   657:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->not_found);
   658:       if (*arg) {
   659:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   660:         OLC_ACTION(d)->not_found = strdup(arg);
   661:       } else
   662:         OLC_ACTION(d)->not_found = NULL;
   663:       break;
   664: 
   665:     case AEDIT_SELF_CHAR:
   666:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->char_auto)
   667:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->char_auto);
   668:       if (*arg) {
   669:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   670:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_auto = strdup(arg);
   671:       } else
   672:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_auto = NULL;
   673:       break;
   674: 
   675:     case AEDIT_SELF_OTHERS:
   676:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->others_auto)
   677:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->others_auto);
   678:       if (*arg) {
   679:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   680:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_auto = strdup(arg);
   681:       } else
   682:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_auto = NULL;
   683:       break;
   684: 
   685:     case AEDIT_VICT_CHAR_BODY_FOUND:
   686:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->char_body_found)
   687:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->char_body_found);
   688:       if (*arg) {
   689:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   690:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_body_found = strdup(arg);
   691:       } else
   692:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_body_found = NULL;
   693:       break;
   694: 
   695:     case AEDIT_VICT_OTHERS_BODY_FOUND:
   696:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->others_body_found)
   697:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->others_body_found);
   698:       if (*arg) {
   699:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   700:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_body_found = strdup(arg);
   701:       } else
   702:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_body_found = NULL;
   703:       break;
   704: 
   705:     case AEDIT_VICT_VICT_BODY_FOUND:
   706:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_body_found)
   707:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_body_found);
   708:       if (*arg) {
   709:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   710:         OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_body_found = strdup(arg);
   711:       } else
   712:         OLC_ACTION(d)->vict_body_found = NULL;
   713:       break;
   714: 
   715:     case AEDIT_OBJ_CHAR_FOUND:
   716:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->char_obj_found)
   717:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->char_obj_found);
   718:       if (*arg) {
   719:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   720:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_obj_found = strdup(arg);
   721:       } else
   722:         OLC_ACTION(d)->char_obj_found = NULL;
   723:       break;
   724: 
   725:     case AEDIT_OBJ_OTHERS_FOUND:
   726:       if (OLC_ACTION(d)->others_obj_found)
   727:         free(OLC_ACTION(d)->others_obj_found);
   728:       if (*arg) {
   729:         delete_doubledollar(arg);
   730:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_obj_found = strdup(arg);
   731:       } else
   732:         OLC_ACTION(d)->others_obj_found = NULL;
   733:       break;
   734: 
   735:     default:
   736:       /* we should never get here */
   737:       break;
   738:    }
   739:    OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   740:    aedit_disp_menu(d);
   741: }
   742: 
   743: ACMD(do_astat)
   744: {
   745:   int i, real = FALSE;
   746:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   747: 
   748:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   749:     return;
   750: 
   751:   one_argument(argument, arg);
   752: 
   753:   if(!*arg) {
   754:     send_to_char(ch, "Astat which social?\r\n");
   755:     return;
   756:   }
   757: 
   758:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_socialt; i++) {
   759:     if (is_abbrev(arg, soc_mess_list[i].command)) {
   760:       real = TRUE;
   761:       break;
   762:     }
   763:   }
   764: 
   765:   if (!real) {
   766:     send_to_char(ch, "No such social.\r\n");
   767:     return;
   768:   }
   769: 
   770:    get_char_colors(ch);
   771:    send_to_char(ch,
   772:     "n) Command         : %s%-15.15s%s 1) Sort as Command : %s%-15.15s%s\r\n"
   773:     "2) Min Position[CH]: %s%-8.8s%s        3) Min Position[VT]: %s%-8.8s%s\r\n"
   774:     "4) Min Level   [CH]: %s%-3d%s             5) Show if Invis   : %s%s%s\r\n"
   775:     "a) Char    [NO ARG]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   776:     "b) Others  [NO ARG]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   777:     "c) Char [NOT FOUND]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   778:     "d) Char  [ARG SELF]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   779:     "e) Others[ARG SELF]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   780:     "f) Char      [VICT]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   781:     "g) Others    [VICT]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   782:     "h) Victim    [VICT]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   783:     "i) Char  [BODY PRT]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   784:     "j) Others[BODY PRT]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   785:     "k) Victim[BODY PRT]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   786:     "l) Char       [OBJ]: %s%s%s\r\n"
   787:     "m) Others     [OBJ]: %s%s%s\r\n",
   788: 
   789:     yel, soc_mess_list[i].command, nrm,
   790:     yel, soc_mess_list[i].sort_as, nrm,
   791:     cyn, position_types[soc_mess_list[i].min_char_position], nrm,
   792:     cyn, position_types[soc_mess_list[i].min_victim_position], nrm,
   793:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].min_level_char, nrm,
   794:     cyn, (soc_mess_list[i].hide ? "HIDDEN" : "NOT HIDDEN"), nrm,
   795:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].char_no_arg ? soc_mess_list[i].char_no_arg : "", nrm,
   796:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].others_no_arg ? soc_mess_list[i].others_no_arg : "", nrm,
   797:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].not_found ? soc_mess_list[i].not_found : "", nrm,
   798:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].char_auto ? soc_mess_list[i].char_auto : "", nrm,
   799:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].others_auto ? soc_mess_list[i].others_auto : "", nrm,
   800:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].char_found ? soc_mess_list[i].char_found : "", nrm,
   801:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].others_found ? soc_mess_list[i].others_found : "", nrm,
   802:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].vict_found ? soc_mess_list[i].vict_found : "", nrm,
   803:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].char_body_found ? soc_mess_list[i].char_body_found : "", nrm,
   804:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].others_body_found ? soc_mess_list[i].others_body_found : "", nrm,
   805:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].vict_body_found ? soc_mess_list[i].vict_body_found : "", nrm,
   806:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].char_obj_found ? soc_mess_list[i].char_obj_found : "", nrm,
   807:     cyn, soc_mess_list[i].others_obj_found ? soc_mess_list[i].others_obj_found : "", nrm);
   808: 
   809: }
   810: 
   811: static int aedit_find_command(const char *txt)
   812: {
   813:   int cmd;
   814: 
   815:   for (cmd = 1; *complete_cmd_info[cmd].command != '\n'; cmd++)
   816:     if (!strncmp(complete_cmd_info[cmd].sort_as, txt, strlen(txt)) ||
   817:         !strcmp(complete_cmd_info[cmd].command, txt))
   818:       return (cmd);
   819:   return (-1);
   820: }

    11: /* FEATURES & INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS
    12:  * - Arbitrary number of boards handled by one set of generalized routines.
    13:  *   Adding a new board is as easy as adding another entry to an array.
    14:  * - Safe removal of messages while other messages are being written.
    15:  *
    16:  * TO ADD A NEW BOARD, simply follow our easy 4-step program:
    17:  * 1 - Create a new board object in the object files.
    18:  * 2 - Increase the NUM_OF_BOARDS constant in boards.h.
    19:  * 3 - Add a new line to the board_info array below.  The fields are:
    20:  * 	Board's virtual number.
    21:  * 	Min level one must be to look at this board or read messages on it.
    22:  * 	Min level one must be to post a message to the board.
    23:  * 	Min level one must be to remove other people's messages from this
    24:  * 	  board (but you can always remove your own message).
    25:  * 	Filename of this board, in quotes.
    26:  * 	Last field must always be 0.
    27:  * 4 - In spec_assign.c, find the section which assigns the special procedure
    28:  *     gen_board to the other bulletin boards, and add your new one in a
    29:  *     similar fashion. */
    30:

    43: /* Board appearance order. */
    44: #define	NEWEST_AT_TOP	FALSE
    45: 
    46: /* Format: vnum, read lvl, write lvl, remove lvl, filename, 0 at end. Be sure 
    47:  * to also change NUM_OF_BOARDS in board.h*/
    48: struct board_info_type board_info[NUM_OF_BOARDS] = {
    49:   {3096, 0, 0, LVL_IMMORT, LIB_ETC "board.social", 0},
    50:   {1226, 0, 0, LVL_IMPL, LIB_ETC "board.builder", 0},
    51:   {1227, 0, 0, LVL_IMPL, LIB_ETC "board.staff", 0},
    52:   {1228, 0, 0, LVL_IMPL, LIB_ETC "board.advertising", 0},
    53: };

    55: /* local (file scope) global variables */
    56: static char *msg_storage[INDEX_SIZE];
    57: static int msg_storage_taken[INDEX_SIZE];
    58: static int num_of_msgs[NUM_OF_BOARDS];
    59: static struct board_msginfo msg_index[NUM_OF_BOARDS][MAX_BOARD_MESSAGES];

    68: static int find_slot(void)
    69: {
    70:   int i;
    71: 
    72:   for (i = 0; i < INDEX_SIZE; i++)
    73:     if (!msg_storage_taken[i]) {
    74:       msg_storage_taken[i] = 1;
    75:       return (i);
    76:     }
    77:   return (-1);
    78: }
    79: 
    80: /* search the room ch is standing in to find which board he's looking at */
    81: static int find_board(struct char_data *ch)
    82: {
    83:   struct obj_data *obj;
    84:   int i;
    85: 
    86:   for (obj = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
    87:     for (i = 0; i < NUM_OF_BOARDS; i++)
    88:       if (BOARD_RNUM(i) == GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj))
    89: 	return (i);
    90: 
    91:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT)
    92:     for (obj = ch->carrying; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
    93:       for (i = 0; i < NUM_OF_BOARDS; i++)
    94:         if (BOARD_RNUM(i) == GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj))
    95:           return (i);
    96: 
    97:   return (-1);
    98: }
    99: 
   100: static void init_boards(void)
   101: {
   102:   int i, j, fatal_error = 0;
   103: 
   104:   for (i = 0; i < INDEX_SIZE; i++) {
   105:     msg_storage[i] = 0;
   106:     msg_storage_taken[i] = 0;
   107:   }
   108: 
   109:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_OF_BOARDS; i++) {
   110:     if ((BOARD_RNUM(i) = real_object(BOARD_VNUM(i))) == NOTHING) {
   111:       log("SYSERR: Fatal board error: board vnum %d does not exist!",
   112: 	      BOARD_VNUM(i));
   113:       fatal_error = 1;
   114:     }
   115:     num_of_msgs[i] = 0;
   116:     for (j = 0; j < MAX_BOARD_MESSAGES; j++) {
   117:       memset((char *) &(msg_index[i][j]), 0, sizeof(struct board_msginfo));
   118:       msg_index[i][j].slot_num = -1;
   119:     }
   120:     board_load_board(i);
   121:   }
   122: 
   123:   if (fatal_error)
   124:     exit(1);
   125: }
   126: 
   127: SPECIAL(gen_board)
   128: {
   129:   int board_type;
   130:   static int loaded = 0;
   131:   struct obj_data *board = (struct obj_data *)me;
   132: 
   133:   /* These were originally globals for some unknown reason. */
   134:   int ACMD_READ, ACMD_LOOK, ACMD_EXAMINE, ACMD_WRITE, ACMD_REMOVE;
   135:   
   136:   if (!loaded) {
   137:     init_boards();
   138:     loaded = 1;
   139:   }
   140:   if (!ch->desc)
   141:     return (0);
   142: 
   143:   ACMD_READ = find_command("read");
   144:   ACMD_WRITE = find_command("write");
   145:   ACMD_REMOVE = find_command("remove");
   146:   ACMD_LOOK = find_command("look");
   147:   ACMD_EXAMINE = find_command("examine");
   148: 
   149:   if (cmd != ACMD_WRITE && cmd != ACMD_LOOK && cmd != ACMD_EXAMINE &&
   150:       cmd != ACMD_READ && cmd != ACMD_REMOVE)
   151:     return (0);
   152: 
   153:   if ((board_type = find_board(ch)) == -1) {
   154:     log("SYSERR:  degenerate board!  (what the hell...)");
   155:     return (0);
   156:   }
   157:   if (cmd == ACMD_WRITE)
   158:     return (board_write_message(board_type, ch, argument, board));
   159:   else if (cmd == ACMD_LOOK || cmd == ACMD_EXAMINE)
   160:     return (board_show_board(board_type, ch, argument, board));
   161:   else if (cmd == ACMD_READ)
   162:     return (board_display_msg(board_type, ch, argument, board));
   163:   else if (cmd == ACMD_REMOVE)
   164:     return (board_remove_msg(board_type, ch, argument, board));
   165:   else
   166:     return (0);
   167: }
   168: 
   169: int board_write_message(int board_type, struct char_data *ch, char *arg, struct obj_data *board)
   170: {
   171:   time_t ct;
   172:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_NAME_LENGTH + 3], tmstr[100];
   173: 
   174:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < WRITE_LVL(board_type)) {
   175:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not holy enough to write on this board.\r\n");
   176:     return (1);
   177:   }
   178:   if (num_of_msgs[board_type] >= MAX_BOARD_MESSAGES) {
   179:     send_to_char(ch, "The board is full.\r\n");
   180:     return (1);
   181:   }
   182:   if ((NEW_MSG_INDEX(board_type).slot_num = find_slot()) == -1) {
   183:     send_to_char(ch, "The board is malfunctioning - sorry.\r\n");
   184:     log("SYSERR: Board: failed to find empty slot on write.");
   185:     return (1);
   186:   }
   187:   /* skip blanks */
   188:   skip_spaces(&arg);
   189:   delete_doubledollar(arg);
   190: 
   191:   /* JE Truncate headline at 80 chars if it's longer than that. */
   192:   arg[80] = '\0';
   193: 
   194:   if (!*arg) {
   195:     send_to_char(ch, "We must have a headline!\r\n");
   196:     return (1);
   197:   }
   198:   ct = time(0);
   199:   strftime(tmstr, sizeof(tmstr), "%a %b %d %Y", localtime(&ct));
   200: 
   201:   snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "(%s)", GET_NAME(ch));
   202:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s %-12s :: %s", tmstr, buf2, arg);
   203:   NEW_MSG_INDEX(board_type).heading = strdup(buf);
   204:   NEW_MSG_INDEX(board_type).level = GET_LEVEL(ch);
   205: 
   206:   send_to_char(ch, "Write your message.\r\n");
   207:   send_editor_help(ch->desc);
   208:   act("$n starts to write a message.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   209: 
   210:   string_write(ch->desc, &(msg_storage[NEW_MSG_INDEX(board_type).slot_num]),
   211: 		MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH, board_type + BOARD_MAGIC, NULL);
   212: 
   213:   num_of_msgs[board_type]++;
   214:   return (1);
   215: }
   216: 
   217: int board_show_board(int board_type, struct char_data *ch, char *arg, struct obj_data *board)
   218: {
   219:   int i;
   220:   char tmp[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   221: 
   222:   if (!ch->desc)
   223:     return (0);
   224: 
   225:   one_argument(arg, tmp);
   226: 
   227:   if (!*tmp || !isname(tmp, board->name))
   228:     return (0);
   229: 
   230:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < READ_LVL(board_type)) {
   231:     send_to_char(ch, "You try but fail to understand the holy words.\r\n");
   232:     return (1);
   233:   }
   234:   act("$n studies the board.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   235: 
   236:   if (!num_of_msgs[board_type])
   237:     send_to_char(ch, "This is a bulletin board.  Usage: READ/REMOVE <messg #>, WRITE <header>.\r\nThe board is empty.\r\n");
   238:   else {
   239:     size_t len = 0;
   240:     int nlen;
   241: 
   242:     len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
   243: 		"This is a bulletin board.  Usage: READ/REMOVE <messg #>, WRITE <header>.\r\n"
   244: 		"You will need to look at the board to save your message.\r\n"
   245: 		"There are %d messages on the board.\r\n",
   246: 		num_of_msgs[board_type]);
   247: #if NEWEST_AT_TOP
   248:     for (i = num_of_msgs[board_type] - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   249:       if (!MSG_HEADING(board_type, i))
   250:         goto fubar;
   251: 
   252:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%-2d : %s\r\n", num_of_msgs[board_type] - i, MSG_HEADING(board_type, i));
   253:       if (len + nlen >= sizeof(buf) || nlen < 0)
   254:         break;
   255:       len += nlen;
   256:     }
   257: #else
   258:     for (i = 0; i < num_of_msgs[board_type]; i++) {
   259:       if (!MSG_HEADING(board_type, i))
   260:         goto fubar;
   261: 
   262:       nlen = snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%-2d : %s\r\n", i + 1, MSG_HEADING(board_type, i));
   263:       if (len + nlen >= sizeof(buf) || nlen < 0)
   264:         break;
   265:       len += nlen;
   266:     }
   267: #endif
   268:     page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   269:   }
   270:   return (1);
   271: 
   272: fubar:
   273:   log("SYSERR: Board %d is fubar'd.", board_type);
   274:   send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, the board isn't working.\r\n");
   275:   return (1);
   276: }
   277: 
   278: int board_display_msg(int board_type, struct char_data *ch, char *arg, struct obj_data *board)
   279: {
   280:   char number[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buffer[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   281:   int msg, ind;
   282: 
   283:   one_argument(arg, number);
   284:   if (!*number)
   285:     return (0);
   286:   if (isname(number, board->name))	/* so "read board" works */
   287:     return (board_show_board(board_type, ch, arg, board));
   288:   if (!is_number(number))	/* read 2.mail, look 2.sword */
   289:     return (0);
   290:   if (!(msg = atoi(number)))
   291:     return (0);
   292: 
   293:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < READ_LVL(board_type)) {
   294:     send_to_char(ch, "You try but fail to understand the holy words.\r\n");
   295:     return (1);
   296:   }
   297:   if (!num_of_msgs[board_type]) {
   298:     send_to_char(ch, "The board is empty!\r\n");
   299:     return (1);
   300:   }
   301:   if (msg < 1 || msg > num_of_msgs[board_type]) {
   302:     send_to_char(ch, "That message exists only in your imagination.\r\n");
   303:     return (1);
   304:   }
   305: #if NEWEST_AT_TOP
   306:   ind = num_of_msgs[board_type] - msg;
   307: #else
   308:   ind = msg - 1;
   309: #endif
   310:   if (MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, ind) < 0 ||
   311:       MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, ind) >= INDEX_SIZE) {
   312:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, the board is not working.\r\n");
   313:     log("SYSERR: Board is screwed up. (Room #%d)", GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch)));
   314:     return (1);
   315:   }
   316:   if (!(MSG_HEADING(board_type, ind))) {
   317:     send_to_char(ch, "That message appears to be screwed up.\r\n");
   318:     return (1);
   319:   }
   320:   if (!(msg_storage[MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, ind)])) {
   321:     send_to_char(ch, "That message seems to be empty.\r\n");
   322:     return (1);
   323:   }
   324:   snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "Message %d : %s\r\n\r\n%s\r\n", msg,
   325: 	  MSG_HEADING(board_type, ind),
   326: 	  msg_storage[MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, ind)]);
   327: 
   328:   page_string(ch->desc, buffer, TRUE);
   329: 
   330:   return (1);
   331: }
   332: 
   333: int board_remove_msg(int board_type, struct char_data *ch, char *arg, struct obj_data *board)
   334: {
   335:   int ind, msg, slot_num;
   336:   char number[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   337:   struct descriptor_data *d;
   338: 
   339:   one_argument(arg, number);
   340: 
   341:   if (!*number || !is_number(number))
   342:     return (0);
   343:   if (!(msg = atoi(number)))
   344:     return (0);
   345: 
   346:   if (!num_of_msgs[board_type]) {
   347:     send_to_char(ch, "The board is empty!\r\n");
   348:     return (1);
   349:   }
   350:   if (msg < 1 || msg > num_of_msgs[board_type]) {
   351:     send_to_char(ch, "That message exists only in your imagination.\r\n");
   352:     return (1);
   353:   }
   354: #if NEWEST_AT_TOP
   355:   ind = num_of_msgs[board_type] - msg;
   356: #else
   357:   ind = msg - 1;
   358: #endif
   359:   if (!MSG_HEADING(board_type, ind)) {
   360:     send_to_char(ch, "That message appears to be screwed up.\r\n");
   361:     return (1);
   362:   }
   363:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "(%s)", GET_NAME(ch));
   364:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < REMOVE_LVL(board_type) &&
   365:       !(strstr(MSG_HEADING(board_type, ind), buf))) {
   366:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not holy enough to remove other people's messages.\r\n");
   367:     return (1);
   368:   }
   369:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < MSG_LEVEL(board_type, ind)) {
   370:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't remove a message holier than yourself.\r\n");
   371:     return (1);
   372:   }
   373:   slot_num = MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, ind);
   374:   if (slot_num < 0 || slot_num >= INDEX_SIZE) {
   375:     send_to_char(ch, "That message is majorly screwed up.\r\n");
   376:     log("SYSERR: The board is seriously screwed up. (Room #%d)", GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch)));
   377:     return (1);
   378:   }
   379:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next)
   380:     if (STATE(d) == CON_PLAYING && d->str == &(msg_storage[slot_num])) {
   381:       send_to_char(ch, "At least wait until the author is finished before removing it!\r\n");
   382:       return (1);
   383:     }
   384:   if (msg_storage[slot_num])
   385:     free(msg_storage[slot_num]);
   386:   msg_storage[slot_num] = 0;
   387:   msg_storage_taken[slot_num] = 0;
   388:   if (MSG_HEADING(board_type, ind))
   389:     free(MSG_HEADING(board_type, ind));
   390: 
   391:   for (; ind < num_of_msgs[board_type] - 1; ind++) {
   392:     MSG_HEADING(board_type, ind) = MSG_HEADING(board_type, ind + 1);
   393:     MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, ind) = MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, ind + 1);
   394:     MSG_LEVEL(board_type, ind) = MSG_LEVEL(board_type, ind + 1);
   395:   }
   396:   num_of_msgs[board_type]--;
   397: 
   398:   send_to_char(ch, "Message removed.\r\n");
   399:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n just removed message %d.", msg);
   400:   act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   401:   board_save_board(board_type);
   402: 
   403:   return (1);
   404: }
   405: 
   406: void board_save_board(int board_type)
   407: {
   408:   FILE *fl;
   409:   int i;
   410:   char *tmp1, *tmp2 = NULL;
   411: 
   412:   if (!num_of_msgs[board_type]) {
   413:     remove(FILENAME(board_type));
   414:     return;
   415:   }
   416:   if (!(fl = fopen(FILENAME(board_type), "wb"))) {
   417:     perror("SYSERR: Error writing board");
   418:     return;
   419:   }
   420:   fwrite(&(num_of_msgs[board_type]), sizeof(int), 1, fl);
   421: 
   422:   for (i = 0; i < num_of_msgs[board_type]; i++) {
   423:     if ((tmp1 = MSG_HEADING(board_type, i)) != NULL)
   424:       msg_index[board_type][i].heading_len = strlen(tmp1) + 1;
   425:     else
   426:       msg_index[board_type][i].heading_len = 0;
   427: 
   428:     if (MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i) < 0 ||
   429: 	MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i) >= INDEX_SIZE ||
   430: 	(!(tmp2 = msg_storage[MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i)])))
   431:       msg_index[board_type][i].message_len = 0;
   432:     else
   433:       msg_index[board_type][i].message_len = strlen(tmp2) + 1;
   434: 
   435:     fwrite(&(msg_index[board_type][i]), sizeof(struct board_msginfo), 1, fl);
   436:     if (tmp1)
   437:       fwrite(tmp1, sizeof(char), msg_index[board_type][i].heading_len, fl);
   438:     if (tmp2)
   439:       fwrite(tmp2, sizeof(char), msg_index[board_type][i].message_len, fl);
   440:   }
   441: 
   442:   fclose(fl);
   443: }
   444: 
   445: void board_load_board(int board_type)
   446: {
   447:   FILE *fl;
   448:   int i, len1, len2;
   449:   char *tmp1, *tmp2;
   450: 
   451:   if (!(fl = fopen(FILENAME(board_type), "rb"))) {
   452:     if (errno != ENOENT)
   453:       perror("SYSERR: Error reading board");
   454:     return;
   455:   }
   456:   if (fread(&(num_of_msgs[board_type]), sizeof(int), 1, fl) != 1)
   457:     return;
   458:   if (num_of_msgs[board_type] < 1 || num_of_msgs[board_type] > MAX_BOARD_MESSAGES) {
   459:     log("SYSERR: Board file %d corrupt.  Resetting.", board_type);
   460:     board_reset_board(board_type);
   461:     return;
   462:   }
   463:   for (i = 0; i < num_of_msgs[board_type]; i++) {
   464:     if (fread(&(msg_index[board_type][i]), sizeof(struct board_msginfo), 1, fl) != 1) {
   465:       if (feof(fl))
   466:         log("SYSERR: Unexpected EOF encountered in board file %d! Resetting.", board_type);
   467:       else if (ferror(fl))
   468:         log("SYSERR: Error reading board file %d: %s. Resetting.", board_type, strerror(errno));
   469:       else
   470:         log("SYSERR: Error reading board file %d. Resetting.", board_type);
   471:       board_reset_board(board_type);
   472:     }
   473:     if ((len1 = msg_index[board_type][i].heading_len) <= 0) {
   474:       log("SYSERR: Board file %d corrupt!  Resetting.", board_type);
   475:       board_reset_board(board_type);
   476:       return;
   477:     }
   478: 
   479:     CREATE(tmp1, char, len1);
   480: 
   481:     if (fread(tmp1, sizeof(char), len1, fl) != len1) {
   482:       if (feof(fl))
   483:         log("SYSERR: Unexpected EOF encountered in board file %d! Resetting.", board_type);
   484:       else if (ferror(fl))
   485:         log("SYSERR: Error reading board file %d: %s. Resetting.", board_type, strerror(errno));
   486:       else
   487:         log("SYSERR: Error reading board file %d. Resetting.", board_type);
   488:       board_reset_board(board_type);
   489:     }
   490: 
   491:     MSG_HEADING(board_type, i) = tmp1;
   492: 
   493:     if ((MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i) = find_slot()) == -1) {
   494:       log("SYSERR: Out of slots booting board %d!  Resetting...", board_type);
   495:       board_reset_board(board_type);
   496:       return;
   497:     }
   498:     if ((len2 = msg_index[board_type][i].message_len) > 0) {
   499:       CREATE(tmp2, char, len2);
   500:       if (fread(tmp2, sizeof(char), len2, fl) != sizeof(char) * len2) {
   501:         if (feof(fl))
   502:           log("SYSERR: Unexpected EOF encountered in board file %d! Resetting.", board_type);
   503:         else if (ferror(fl))
   504:           log("SYSERR: Error reading board file %d: %s. Resetting.", board_type, strerror(errno));
   505:         else
   506:           log("SYSERR: Error reading board file %d. Resetting.", board_type);
   507:         board_reset_board(board_type);
   508:       }
   509: 
   510:       msg_storage[MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i)] = tmp2;
   511:     } else
   512:       msg_storage[MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i)] = NULL;
   513:   }
   514: 
   515:   fclose(fl);
   516: }
   517: 
   518: /* When shutting down, clear all boards. */
   519: void board_clear_all(void)
   520: {
   521:   int i;
   522: 
   523:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_OF_BOARDS; i++)
   524:     board_clear_board(i);
   525: }
   526: 
   527: /* Clear the in-memory structures. */
   528: void board_clear_board(int board_type)
   529: {
   530:   int i;
   531: 
   532:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_BOARD_MESSAGES; i++) {
   533:     if (MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i) == -1)
   534:       continue; /* don't try to free non-existant slots */
   535:     if (MSG_HEADING(board_type, i))
   536:       free(MSG_HEADING(board_type, i));
   537:     if (msg_storage[MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i)])
   538:       free(msg_storage[MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i)]);
   539:     msg_storage_taken[MSG_SLOTNUM(board_type, i)] = 0;
   540:     memset((char *)&(msg_index[board_type][i]),0,sizeof(struct board_msginfo));
   541:     msg_index[board_type][i].slot_num = -1;
   542:   }
   543:   num_of_msgs[board_type] = 0;
   544: }
   545: 
   546: /* Destroy the on-disk and in-memory board. */
   547: static void board_reset_board(int board_type)
   548: {
   549:   board_clear_board(board_type);
   550:   remove(FILENAME(board_type));
   551: }

    33: ACMD(do_oasis_cedit)
    34: {
    35:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    36:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    37: 
    38:   /* No building as a mob or while being forced. */
    39:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
    40:     return;
    41: 
    42:   /* Parse any arguments. */
    43:   one_argument(argument, buf1);
    44: 
    45:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMPL) {
    46:     send_to_char(ch, "You can't modify the game configuration.\r\n");
    47:     return;
    48:   }
    49: 
    50:   d = ch->desc;
    51: 
    52:   if (!*buf1) {
    53:     CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
    54:     OLC_ZONE(d) = 0;
    55:     cedit_setup(d);
    56:     STATE(d) = CON_CEDIT;
    57:     act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
    58:     SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
    59: 
    60:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
    61:       "OLC: %s starts editing the game configuration.", GET_NAME(ch));
    62:     return;
    63:   } else if (str_cmp("save", buf1) != 0) {
    64:     send_to_char(ch, "Yikes!  Stop that, someone will get hurt!\r\n");
    65:     return;
    66:   }
    67: 
    68:   send_to_char(ch, "Saving the game configuration.\r\n");
    69:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
    70:     "OLC: %s saves the game configuration.", GET_NAME(ch));
    71: 
    72:   cedit_save_to_disk();
    73: }

   311: void cedit_save_to_disk( void )
   312: {

   317: int save_config( IDXTYPE nowhere )
   318: {
   319:   FILE *fl;
   320:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   321: 
   322:   if (!(fl = fopen(CONFIG_CONFFILE, "w"))) {
   323:     perror("SYSERR: save_config");
   324:     return (FALSE);
   325:   }
   326: 
   327:   fprintf(fl,
   328:     "* This file is autogenerated by OasisOLC (CEdit).\n"
   329:     "* Please note the following information about this file's format.\n"
   330:     "*\n"
   331:     "* - If variable is a yes/no or true/false based variable, use 1's and 0's\n"
   332:     "*   where YES or TRUE = 1 and NO or FALSE = 0.\n"
   333:     "* - Variable names in this file are case-insensitive.  Variable values\n"
   334:     "*   are not case-insensitive.\n"
   335:     "* -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n"
   336:     "* Lines starting with * are comments, and are not parsed.\n"
   337:     "* -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n"
   338:     "* [ Game Play Options ]\n"
   339:   );
   340: 
   341:   fprintf(fl, "* Is player killing allowed on the mud?\n"
   342:               "pk_allowed = %d\n\n", CONFIG_PK_ALLOWED);
   343:   fprintf(fl, "* Is player thieving allowed on the mud?\n"
   344:   	      "pt_allowed = %d\n\n", CONFIG_PT_ALLOWED);
   345:   fprintf(fl, "* What is the minimum level a player can shout/gossip/etc?\n"
   346:               "level_can_shout = %d\n\n", CONFIG_LEVEL_CAN_SHOUT);
   347:   fprintf(fl, "* How many movement points does shouting cost the player?\n"
   348:   	      "holler_move_cost = %d\n\n", CONFIG_HOLLER_MOVE_COST);
   349:   fprintf(fl, "* How many players can fit in a tunnel?\n"
   350:               "tunnel_size = %d\n\n", CONFIG_TUNNEL_SIZE);
   351:   fprintf(fl, "* Maximum experience gainable per kill?\n"

   400:   strip_cr(buf);
   401: 
   402:   fprintf(fl, "* Text sent to players when noone is available.\n"
   403:               "noperson = %s\n\n", buf);
   404: 
   405:   strcpy(buf, CONFIG_NOEFFECT);
   406:   strip_cr(buf);
   407: 
   408:   fprintf(fl, "* Text sent to players when an effect fails.\n"
   409:               "noeffect = %s\n", buf);
   410: 
   411:    /* RENT / CRASHSAVE OPTIONS */
   412:   fprintf(fl, "\n\n\n* [ Rent/Crashsave Options ]\n");
   413: 
   414:   fprintf(fl, "* Should the MUD allow you to 'rent' for free?  (i.e. if you just quit,\n"
   415:               "* your objects are saved at no cost, as in Merc-type MUDs.)\n"
   416:               "free_rent = %d\n\n", CONFIG_FREE_RENT);
   417: 
   418:   fprintf(fl, "* Maximum number of items players are allowed to rent.\n"
   419:    	      "max_obj_save = %d\n\n", CONFIG_MAX_OBJ_SAVE);
   420:

   422:               "auto_save = %d\n\n", CONFIG_AUTO_SAVE);
   423:

   426:

   428:               "crash_file_timeout = %d\n\n", CONFIG_CRASH_TIMEOUT);
   429: 
   430:   fprintf(fl, "* Lifetime of normal rent files in days.\n"
   431:               "rent_file_timeout = %d\n\n", CONFIG_RENT_TIMEOUT);
   432:

   438:

   443: 	      "frozen_start_room = %d\n\n", CONFIG_FROZEN_START);
   444: 
   445:   fprintf(fl, "* The virtual numbers of the donation rooms.  Note: Add donation rooms\n"
   446:               "* sequentially (1 & 2 before 3). If you don't, you might not be able to\n"
   447:               "* donate. Use -1 for 'no such room'.\n"
   448:               "donation_room_1 = %d\n"
   449:               "donation_room_2 = %d\n"
   450:               "donation_room_3 = %d\n\n",
   451:               CONFIG_DON_ROOM_1 != NOWHERE ? CONFIG_DON_ROOM_1 : -1,
   452:               CONFIG_DON_ROOM_2 != NOWHERE ? CONFIG_DON_ROOM_2 : -1,
   453:               CONFIG_DON_ROOM_3 != NOWHERE ? CONFIG_DON_ROOM_3 : -1);
   454: 
   455: 
   456:   fprintf(fl, "\n\n\n* [ Game Operation Options ]\n");
   457: 
   458:   fprintf(fl, "* This is the default port on which the game should run if no port is\n"
   459:               "* given on the command-line.  NOTE WELL: If you're using the\n"
   460:               "* 'autorun' script, the port number there will override this setting.\n"
   461:               "* Change the PORT= line in autorun instead of (or in addition to)\n"
   462:               "* changing this.\n"
   463:               "DFLT_PORT = %d\n\n",
   464:               CONFIG_DFLT_PORT);
   465: 
   466:   if (CONFIG_DFLT_IP) {
   467:     strcpy(buf, CONFIG_DFLT_IP);
   468:     strip_cr(buf);
   469: 
   470:     fprintf(fl, "* IP address to which the MUD should bind.\nDFLT_IP = %s\n\n", buf);
   471:   }
   472: 
   473:   if (CONFIG_DFLT_DIR) {
   474:     strcpy(buf, CONFIG_DFLT_DIR);
   475:     strip_cr(buf);
   476: 
   477:     fprintf(fl, "* default directory to use as data directory.\n"
   478:                 "DFLT_DIR = %s\n\n", buf);
   479:   }
   480: 
   481:   if (CONFIG_LOGNAME) {
   482:     strcpy(buf, CONFIG_LOGNAME);
   483:     strip_cr(buf);
   484: 
   485:     fprintf(fl, "* What file to log messages to (ex: 'log/syslog').\n"
   486:                 "LOGNAME = %s\n\n", buf);
   487:   }
   488: 
   489:   fprintf(fl, "* Maximum number of players allowed before game starts to turn people away.\n"
   490:               "max_playing = %d\n\n",
   491:               CONFIG_MAX_PLAYING);
   492: 
   493:   fprintf(fl, "* Maximum size of bug, typo, and idea files in bytes (to prevent bombing).\n"
   494:               "max_filesize = %d\n\n",
   495:               CONFIG_MAX_FILESIZE);
   496: 
   497:   fprintf(fl, "* Maximum number of password attempts before disconnection.\n"
   498:               "max_bad_pws = %d\n\n",
   499:               CONFIG_MAX_BAD_PWS);
   500: 
   501:   fprintf(fl, "* Is the site ok for everyone except those that are banned?\n"
   502:               "siteok_everyone = %d\n\n",
   503:               CONFIG_SITEOK_ALL);
   504: 
   505:   fprintf(fl, "* If you want to use the original social file format\n"
   506:               "* and disable Aedit, set to 0, otherwise, 1.\n"
   507:               "use_new_socials = %d\n\n",
   508:               CONFIG_NEW_SOCIALS);
   509: 
   510:   fprintf(fl, "* If the nameserver is fast, set to 0, otherwise, 1.\n"
   511:               "nameserver_is_slow = %d\n\n",
   512:               CONFIG_NS_IS_SLOW);
   513: 
   514:   fprintf(fl, "* Should OLC autosave to disk (1) or save internally (0).\n"
   515:               "auto_save_olc = %d\n\n",
   516:               CONFIG_OLC_SAVE);
   517: 
   518:   if (CONFIG_MENU) {
   519:     strcpy(buf, CONFIG_MENU);
   520:     strip_cr(buf);
   521: 
   522:     fprintf(fl, "* The entrance/exit menu.\n"
   523:                 "MENU = \n%s~\n\n", convert_from_tabs(buf));
   524:   }
   525: 
   526:   if (CONFIG_WELC_MESSG) {
   527:     strcpy(buf, CONFIG_WELC_MESSG);
   528:     strip_cr(buf);
   529: 
   530:     fprintf(fl, "* The welcome message.\nWELC_MESSG = \n%s~\n\n", convert_from_tabs(buf));
   531:   }
   532: 
   533:   if (CONFIG_START_MESSG) {
   534:     strcpy(buf, CONFIG_START_MESSG);
   535:     strip_cr(buf);
   536: 
   537:     fprintf(fl, "* NEWBIE start message.\n"
   538:                 "START_MESSG = \n%s~\n\n", convert_from_tabs(buf));
   539:   }
   540: 
   541:   fprintf(fl, "* Should the medit OLC show the advanced stats menu (1) or not (0).\n"
   542:               "medit_advanced_stats = %d\n\n",
   543:               CONFIG_MEDIT_ADVANCED);
   544: 
   545:   fprintf(fl, "* Should the idea, bug and typo commands autosave (1) or not (0).\n"
   546: 		      "ibt_autosave = %d\n\n",
   547: 			  CONFIG_IBT_AUTOSAVE);
   548: 
   549:   fprintf(fl, "\n\n\n* [ Autowiz Options ]\n");
   550: 
   551:   fprintf(fl, "* Should the game automatically create a new wizlist/immlist every time\n"
   552:               "* someone immorts, or is promoted to a higher (or lower) god level?\n"
   553:               "use_autowiz = %d\n\n",
   554:               CONFIG_USE_AUTOWIZ);
   555: 
   556:   fprintf(fl, "* If yes, what is the lowest level which should be on the wizlist?\n"
   557:               "min_wizlist_lev = %d\n\n",
   558:               CONFIG_MIN_WIZLIST_LEV);
   559: 
   560:   fprintf(fl, "* If yes, enable the protocol negotiation system.\n"
   561:               "protocol_negotiation = %d\n\n",
   562:               CONFIG_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION);
   563: 
   564:   fprintf(fl, "* If yes, enable the special character in comm channels.\n"
   565:               "special_in_comm = %d\n\n",
   566:               CONFIG_SPECIAL_IN_COMM);
   567:               
   568:   fprintf(fl, "* If 0 then off, otherwise 1: Brief, 2: Normal, 3: Complete.\n"
   569:               "debug_mode = %d\n\n",
   570:               CONFIG_DEBUG_MODE);
   571: 
   572: 
   573:   fclose(fl);
   574: 
   575:   if (in_save_list(NOWHERE, SL_CFG))
   576:     remove_from_save_list(NOWHERE, SL_CFG);
   577: 
   578:   return (TRUE);
   579: }

   758:   	"%sP%s) Autosave bugs when resolved from commandline : %s%s\r\n"
   759:   	"%sR%s) Enable Protocol Negotiation : %s%s\r\n"
   760:   	"%sS%s) Enable Special Char in Comm : %s%s\r\n"
   761:   	"%sT%s) Current Debug Mode : %s%s\r\n"
   762:     "%sQ%s) Exit To The Main Menu\r\n"
   763:     "Enter your choice : ",
   764:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.DFLT_PORT,
   765:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.DFLT_IP ? OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.DFLT_IP : "<None>",
   766:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.DFLT_DIR ? OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.DFLT_DIR : "<None>",
   767:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.LOGNAME ? OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.LOGNAME : "<None>",
   768:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.max_playing,
   769:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.max_filesize,
   770:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.max_bad_pws,
   771:     grn, nrm, cyn, YESNO(OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.siteok_everyone),
   772:     grn, nrm, cyn, YESNO(OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.nameserver_is_slow),
   773:     grn, nrm, cyn, YESNO(OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.use_new_socials),
   774:     grn, nrm, cyn, YESNO(OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.auto_save_olc),
   775:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.MENU ? OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.MENU : "<None>",
   776:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.WELC_MESSG ? OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.WELC_MESSG : "<None>",
   777:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.START_MESSG ? OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.START_MESSG : "<None>",
   778:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.medit_advanced ? "Advanced" : "Standard",
   779:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.ibt_autosave ? "Yes" : "No",
   780:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.protocol_negotiation ? "Yes" : "No",
   781:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.special_in_comm ? "Yes" : "No",
   782:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.debug_mode == 0 ? "OFF" : (OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.debug_mode == 1 ? "BRIEF" : (OLC_CONFIG(d)->operation.debug_mode == 2 ? "NORMAL" : "COMPLETE")),
   783:     grn, nrm
   784:     );
   785: 
   786:   OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_OPERATION_OPTIONS_MENU;
   787: }
   788: 
   789: static void cedit_disp_autowiz_options(struct descriptor_data *d)
   790: {
   791:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   792:   clear_screen(d);
   793: 
   794:   write_to_output(d, "\r\n\r\n"
   795:     "%sA%s) Use the autowiz        : %s%s\r\n"
   796:     "%sB%s) Minimum wizlist level  : %s%d\r\n"
   797:     "%sQ%s) Exit To The Main Menu\r\n"
   798:     "Enter your choice : ",
   799:     grn, nrm, cyn, CHECK_VAR(OLC_CONFIG(d)->autowiz.use_autowiz),
   800:     grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_CONFIG(d)->autowiz.min_wizlist_lev,
   801:     grn, nrm
   802:     );
   803: 
   804:   OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_AUTOWIZ_OPTIONS_MENU;
   805: }
   806: 
   807: /* The event handler. */
   808: void cedit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   809: {
   810:   char *oldtext = NULL;
   811: 
   812:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   813:     case CEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   814:       switch (*arg) {
   815:         case 'y':
   816:         case 'Y':
   817:           cedit_save_internally(d);
   818:           mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE,
   819:                  "OLC: %s modifies the game configuration.", GET_NAME(d->character));
   820:           cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_CONFIG);
   821: 	  if (CONFIG_AUTO_SAVE) {
   822: 	    cedit_save_to_disk();
   823: 	    write_to_output(d, "Game configuration saved to disk.\r\n");
   824: 	  } else
   825:             write_to_output(d, "Game configuration saved to memory.\r\n");
   826:           return;
   827:         case 'n':
   828:         case 'N':
   829:           write_to_output(d, "Game configuration not saved to memory.\r\n");
   830:           cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_CONFIG);
   831:           return;
   832:         default :
   833:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nThat is an invalid choice!\r\n");
   834:           write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   835:           return;
   836:       }
   837: 
   838:     case CEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   839:       switch (*arg) {
   840:         case 'g':
   841:         case 'G':
   842:           cedit_disp_game_play_options(d);
   843:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_GAME_OPTIONS_MENU;
   844:           break;
   845: 
   846:         case 'c':
   847:         case 'C':
   848:           cedit_disp_crash_save_options(d);
   849:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_CRASHSAVE_OPTIONS_MENU;
   850:           break;
   851: 
   852:         case 'r':
   853:         case 'R':
   854:           cedit_disp_room_numbers(d);
   855:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_ROOM_NUMBERS_MENU;
   856:           break;
   857: 
   858:         case 'o':
   859:         case 'O':
   860:           cedit_disp_operation_options(d);
   861:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_OPERATION_OPTIONS_MENU;
   862:           break;
   863: 
   864:         case 'a':
   865:         case 'A':
   866:           cedit_disp_autowiz_options(d);
   867:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_AUTOWIZ_OPTIONS_MENU;
   868:           break;
   869: 
   870:         case 'q':
   871:         case 'Q':
   872:           write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   873:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   874:           break;
   875: 
   876:         default:
   877:           write_to_output(d, "That is an invalid choice!\r\n");
   878:           cedit_disp_menu(d);
   879:           break;
   880:       }
   881:       break;
   882: 
   883:     case CEDIT_GAME_OPTIONS_MENU:
   884:       switch (*arg) {
   885:         case 'a':
   886:         case 'A':
   887:           TOGGLE_VAR(OLC_CONFIG(d)->play.pk_allowed);
   888:           break;
   889: 
   890:         case 'b':
   891:         case 'B':
   892:           TOGGLE_VAR(OLC_CONFIG(d)->play.pt_allowed);
   893:           break;
   894: 
   895:         case 'c':
   896:         case 'C':
   897:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the minimum level a player must be to shout, gossip, etc : ");
   898:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_LEVEL_CAN_SHOUT;
   899:           return;
   900: 
   901:         case 'd':
   902:         case 'D':
   903:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the amount it costs (in move points) to holler : ");
   904:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_HOLLER_MOVE_COST;
   905:           return;
   906: 
   907:         case 'e':
   908:         case 'E':
   909:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the maximum number of people allowed in a tunnel : ");
   910:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_TUNNEL_SIZE;
   911:           return;
   912: 
   913:         case 'f':
   914:         case 'F':
   915:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the maximum gain of experience per kill for players : ");
   916:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_MAX_EXP_GAIN;
   917:           return;
   918: 
   919:         case 'g':
   920:         case 'G':
   921:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the maximum loss of experience per death for players : ");
   922:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_MAX_EXP_LOSS;
   923:           return;
   924: 
   925:         case 'h':
   926:         case 'H':
   927:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the number of tics before NPC corpses decompose : ");
   928:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_MAX_NPC_CORPSE_TIME;
   929:           return;
   930: 
   931:         case 'i':

   933:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the number of tics before PC corpses decompose : ");
   934:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_MAX_PC_CORPSE_TIME;
   935:           return;
   936: 
   937:         case 'j':

   939:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the number of tics before PC's are sent to the void (idle) : ");
   940:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_IDLE_VOID;
   941:           return;

   977: 		  TOGGLE_VAR(OLC_CONFIG(d)->play.diagonal_dirs);
   978: 		  break;
   979:  
   980: 		case 's':

   988:           return;

   992:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_HUH;
   993:           return;

   997:           OLC_MODE(d) = CEDIT_NOPERSON;
   998:           return;
   999: 
  1000:         case '4':

  1727:     world[i].func = NULL;
  1728: 
  1729:   /* reassign spec_procs */
  1730:   assign_rooms();
  1731: }

  1741:   }

   178: #if defined(CIRCLE_WINDOWS) || defined(CIRCLE_MACINTOSH)
   179: /* Windows and Mac do not have gettimeofday, so we'll simulate it. Borland C++
   180:  * warns: "Undefined structure 'timezone'" */
   181: void gettimeofday(struct timeval *t, struct timezone *dummy)
   182: {
   183: #if defined(CIRCLE_WINDOWS)
   184:   DWORD millisec = GetTickCount();
   185: #elif defined(CIRCLE_MACINTOSH)
   186:   unsigned long int millisec;
   187:   millisec = (int)((float)TickCount() * 1000.0 / 60.0);
   188: #endif
   189: 
   190:   t->tv_sec = (int) (millisec / 1000);
   191:   t->tv_usec = (millisec % 1000) * 1000;
   192: }
