  2371: static const char *ACTNULL = "<NULL>";
  2372: #define CHECK_NULL(pointer, expression) \
  2373:   if ((pointer) == NULL) i = ACTNULL; else i = (expression);
  2374: /* higher-level communication: the act() function */
  2375: void perform_act(const char *orig, struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj,
  2376:     void *vict_obj, struct char_data *to)
  2377: {
  2378:   const char *i = NULL;
  2379:   char lbuf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], *buf, *j;
  2380:   bool uppercasenext = FALSE;
  2381:   struct char_data *dg_victim = (to == vict_obj) ? vict_obj : NULL;
  2382:   struct obj_data *dg_target = NULL;
  2383:   char *dg_arg = NULL;
  2384: 
  2385:   buf = lbuf;
  2386: 
  2387:   for (;;) {
  2388:     if (*orig == '$') {
  2389:       switch (*(++orig)) {
  2390:       case 'n':
  2391: 	i = PERS(ch, to);
  2392: 	break;
  2393:       case 'N':
  2394: 	CHECK_NULL(vict_obj, PERS((const struct char_data *) vict_obj, to));
  2395: 	dg_victim = (struct char_data *) vict_obj;
  2396: 	break;
  2397:       case 'm':
  2398: 	i = HMHR(ch);
  2399: 	break;
  2400:       case 'M':
  2401: 	CHECK_NULL(vict_obj, HMHR((const struct char_data *) vict_obj));
  2402: 	dg_victim = (struct char_data *) vict_obj;
  2403: 	break;
  2404:       case 's':
  2405: 	i = HSHR(ch);
  2406: 	break;
  2407:       case 'S':
  2408: 	CHECK_NULL(vict_obj, HSHR((const struct char_data *) vict_obj));
  2409: 	dg_victim = (struct char_data *) vict_obj;
  2410: 	break;
  2411:       case 'e':
  2412: 	i = HSSH(ch);
  2413: 	break;
  2414:       case 'E':
  2415: 	CHECK_NULL(vict_obj, HSSH((const struct char_data *) vict_obj));
  2416: 	dg_victim = (struct char_data *) vict_obj;
  2417: 	break;
  2418:       case 'o':
  2419: 	CHECK_NULL(obj, OBJN(obj, to));
  2420: 	break;
  2421:       case 'O':
  2422: 	CHECK_NULL(vict_obj, OBJN((const struct obj_data *) vict_obj, to));
  2423: 	dg_target = (struct obj_data *) vict_obj;
  2424: 	break;
  2425:       case 'p':
  2426: 	CHECK_NULL(obj, OBJS(obj, to));
  2427: 	break;
  2428:       case 'P':
  2429: 	CHECK_NULL(vict_obj, OBJS((const struct obj_data *) vict_obj, to));
  2430: 	dg_target = (struct obj_data *) vict_obj;
  2431: 	break;
  2432:       case 'a':
  2433: 	CHECK_NULL(obj, SANA(obj));
  2434: 	break;
  2435:       case 'A':
  2436: 	CHECK_NULL(vict_obj, SANA((const struct obj_data *) vict_obj));
  2437: 	dg_target = (struct obj_data *) vict_obj;
  2438: 	break;
  2439:        case 'T':
  2440:  	CHECK_NULL(vict_obj, (const char *) vict_obj);
  2441:  	dg_arg = (char *) vict_obj;
  2442: 	break;
  2443:       case 't':
  2444:  	CHECK_NULL(obj, (char *) obj);
  2445: 	break;
  2446:       case 'F':
  2447: 	CHECK_NULL(vict_obj, fname((const char *) vict_obj));
  2448: 	break;
  2449:       /* uppercase previous word */
  2450:       case 'u':
  2451:         for (j=buf; j > lbuf && !isspace((int) *(j-1)); j--);
  2452:         if (j != buf)
  2453:           *j = UPPER(*j);
  2454:         i = "";
  2455:         break;
  2456:       /* uppercase next word */
  2457:       case 'U':
  2458:         uppercasenext = TRUE;
  2459:         i = "";
  2460:         break;
  2461:       case '$':
  2462: 	i = "$";
  2463: 	break;
  2464:       default:
  2465: 	log("SYSERR: Illegal $-code to act(): %c", *orig);
  2466: 	log("SYSERR: %s", orig);
  2467: 	i = "";
  2468: 	break;
  2469:       }
  2470:       while ((*buf = *(i++)))
  2471:         {
  2472:         if (uppercasenext && !isspace((int) *buf))
  2473:           {
  2474:           *buf = UPPER(*buf);
  2475:           uppercasenext = FALSE;
  2476:           }
  2477: 	buf++;
  2478:         }
  2479:       orig++;
  2480:     } else if (!(*(buf++) = *(orig++))) {
  2481:       break;
  2482:     } else if (uppercasenext && !isspace((int) *(buf-1))) {
  2483:       *(buf-1) = UPPER(*(buf-1));
  2484:       uppercasenext = FALSE;
  2485:     }
  2486:   }
  2487: 
  2488:   *(--buf) = '\r';
  2489:   *(++buf) = '\n';
  2490:   *(++buf) = '\0';
  2491: 
  2492:   if (to->desc)
  2493:     write_to_output(to->desc, "%s", CAP(lbuf));
  2494: 
  2495:   if ((IS_NPC(to) && dg_act_check) && (to != ch))
  2496:     act_mtrigger(to, lbuf, ch, dg_victim, obj, dg_target, dg_arg);
  2497: 
  2498:   if (last_act_message)
  2499:     free(last_act_message);
  2500:   last_act_message = strdup(lbuf);
  2501: }
  2502: 
  2503: char *act(const char *str, int hide_invisible, struct char_data *ch,
  2504: 	 struct obj_data *obj, void *vict_obj, int type)
  2505: {
  2506:   struct char_data *to;
  2507:   int to_sleeping;
  2508: 
  2509:   if (!str || !*str)
  2510:     return NULL;
  2511: 
  2512:   /* Warning: the following TO_SLEEP code is a hack. I wanted to be able to tell
  2513:    * act to deliver a message regardless of sleep without adding an additional
  2514:    * argument.  TO_SLEEP is 128 (a single bit high up).  It's ONLY legal to
  2515:    * combine TO_SLEEP with one other TO_x command.  It's not legal to combine
  2516:    * TO_x's with each other otherwise. TO_SLEEP only works because its value
  2517:    * "happens to be" a single bit; do not change it to something else.  In
  2518:    * short, it is a hack. */
  2519: 
  2520:   /* check if TO_SLEEP is there, and remove it if it is. */
  2521:   if ((to_sleeping = (type & TO_SLEEP)))
  2522:     type &= ~TO_SLEEP;
  2523: 
  2524:   /* this is a hack as well - DG_NO_TRIG is 256 -- Welcor */
  2525:   /* If the bit is set, unset dg_act_check, thus the ! below */
  2526:   if (!(dg_act_check = !IS_SET(type, DG_NO_TRIG)))
  2527:     REMOVE_BIT(type, DG_NO_TRIG);
  2528: 
  2529:   if (type == TO_CHAR) {
  2530:     if (ch && SENDOK(ch)) {
  2531:       perform_act(str, ch, obj, vict_obj, ch);
  2532:       return last_act_message;
  2533:     }
  2534:     return NULL;
  2535:   }
  2536: 
  2537:   if (type == TO_VICT) {
  2538:     if ((to = vict_obj) != NULL && SENDOK(to)) {
  2539:       perform_act(str, ch, obj, vict_obj, to);
  2540:       return last_act_message;
  2541:     }
  2542:     return NULL;
  2543:   }
  2544: 
  2545:   if (type == TO_GMOTE && !IS_NPC(ch)) {
  2546:     struct descriptor_data *i;
  2547:     char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2548: 
  2549:     for (i = descriptor_list; i; i = i->next) {
  2550:       if (!i->connected && i->character &&
  2551:           !PRF_FLAGGED(i->character, PRF_NOGOSS) &&
  2552:           !PLR_FLAGGED(i->character, PLR_WRITING) &&
  2553:           !ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(i->character), ROOM_SOUNDPROOF)) {
  2554: 
  2555:         sprintf(buf, "%s%s%s", CCYEL(i->character, C_NRM), str, CCNRM(i->character, C_NRM));
  2556:         perform_act(buf, ch, obj, vict_obj, i->character);
  2557:       }
  2558:     }
  2559:     return last_act_message;
  2560:   }
  2561:   /* ASSUMPTION: at this point we know type must be TO_NOTVICT or TO_ROOM */
  2562: 
  2563:   if (ch && IN_ROOM(ch) != NOWHERE)
  2564:     to = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people;
  2565:   else if (obj && IN_ROOM(obj) != NOWHERE)
  2566:     to = world[IN_ROOM(obj)].people;
  2567:   else {
  2568:     log("SYSERR: no valid target to act()!");
  2569:     return NULL;
  2570:   }
  2571: 
  2572:   for (; to; to = to->next_in_room) {
  2573:     if (!SENDOK(to) || (to == ch))
  2574:       continue;
  2575:     if (hide_invisible && ch && !CAN_SEE(to, ch))
  2576:       continue;
  2577:     if (type != TO_ROOM && to == vict_obj)
  2578:       continue;
  2579:     perform_act(str, ch, obj, vict_obj, to);
  2580:   }
  2581:   return last_act_message;
  2582: }
  2583: 
  2584: /* Prefer the file over the descriptor. */
  2585: static void setup_log(const char *filename, int fd)
  2586: {
  2587:   FILE *s_fp;
  2588: 
  2589: #if defined(__MWERKS__) || defined(__GNUC__)
  2590:   s_fp = stderr;
  2591: #else
  2592:   if ((s_fp = fdopen(STDERR_FILENO, "w")) == NULL) {
  2593:     puts("SYSERR: Error opening stderr, trying stdout.");
  2594: 
  2595:     if ((s_fp = fdopen(STDOUT_FILENO, "w")) == NULL) {
  2596:       puts("SYSERR: Error opening stdout, trying a file.");
  2597: 
  2598:       /* If we don't have a file, try a default. */
  2599:       if (filename == NULL || *filename == '\0')
  2600:         filename = "log/syslog";
  2601:     }
  2602:   }
  2603: #endif
  2604: 
  2605:   if (filename == NULL || *filename == '\0') {
  2606:     /* No filename, set us up with the descriptor we just opened. */
  2607:     logfile = s_fp;
  2608:     puts("Using file descriptor for logging.");
  2609:     return;
  2610:   }
  2611: 
  2612:   /* We honor the default filename first. */
  2613:   if (open_logfile(filename, s_fp))
  2614:     return;
  2615: 
  2616:   /* Well, that failed but we want it logged to a file so try a default. */
  2617:   if (open_logfile("log/syslog", s_fp))
  2618:     return;
  2619: 
  2620:   /* Ok, one last shot at a file. */
  2621:   if (open_logfile("syslog", s_fp))
  2622:     return;
  2623: 
  2624:   /* Erp, that didn't work either, just die. */
  2625:   puts("SYSERR: Couldn't open anything to log to, giving up.");
  2626:   exit(1);
  2627: }
  2628: 
  2629: static int open_logfile(const char *filename, FILE *stderr_fp)
  2630: {
  2631:   if (stderr_fp)	/* freopen() the descriptor. */
  2632:     logfile = freopen(filename, "w", stderr_fp);
  2633:   else
  2634:     logfile = fopen(filename, "w");
  2635: 
  2636:   if (logfile) {
  2637:     printf("Using log file '%s'%s.\n",
  2638: 		filename, stderr_fp ? " with redirection" : "");
  2639:     return (TRUE);
  2640:   }
  2641: 
  2642:   printf("SYSERR: Error opening file '%s': %s\n", filename, strerror(errno));
  2643:   return (FALSE);
  2644: }
  2645: 
  2646: /* This may not be pretty but it keeps game_loop() neater than if it was inline. */
  2647: #if defined(CIRCLE_WINDOWS)
  2648: void circle_sleep(struct timeval *timeout)
  2649: {
  2650:   Sleep(timeout->tv_sec * 1000 + timeout->tv_usec / 1000);
  2651: }
  2652: 
  2653: #else
  2654: static void circle_sleep(struct timeval *timeout)
  2655: {
  2656:   if (select(0, (fd_set *) 0, (fd_set *) 0, (fd_set *) 0, timeout) < 0) {
  2657:     if (errno != EINTR) {
  2658:       perror("SYSERR: Select sleep");
  2659:       exit(1);
  2660:     }
  2661:   }
  2662: }
  2663: 
  2664: #endif /* CIRCLE_WINDOWS */

  2666: /* KaVir's plugin*/
  2667: static void msdp_update( void )
  2668: {
  2669:   struct descriptor_data *d;
  2670:   int PlayerCount = 0;
  2671:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2672:   extern const char *pc_class_types[];
  2673: 
  2674:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next)
  2675:   {
  2676:     struct char_data *ch = d->character;
  2677:     if ( ch && !IS_NPC(ch) && d->connected == CON_PLAYING )
  2678:     {
  2679:       struct char_data *pOpponent = FIGHTING(ch);
  2680:       ++PlayerCount;
  2681: 
  2682:       MSDPSetString( d, eMSDP_CHARACTER_NAME, GET_NAME(ch) );
  2683:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_ALIGNMENT, GET_ALIGNMENT(ch) );
  2684:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_EXPERIENCE, GET_EXP(ch) );
  2685: 
  2686:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_HEALTH, GET_HIT(ch) );
  2687:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_HEALTH_MAX, GET_MAX_HIT(ch) );
  2688:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_LEVEL, GET_LEVEL(ch) );
  2689: 
  2690:       sprinttype( ch->player.chclass, pc_class_types, buf, sizeof(buf) );
  2691:       MSDPSetString( d, eMSDP_CLASS, buf );
  2692: 
  2693:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_MANA, GET_MANA(ch) );
  2694:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_MANA_MAX, effective_max_mana(ch) );
  2695:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_WIMPY, GET_WIMP_LEV(ch) );
  2696:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_MONEY, GET_GOLD(ch) );
  2697:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_MOVEMENT, GET_MOVE(ch) );
  2698:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_MOVEMENT_MAX, effective_max_move(ch) );
  2699:       MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_AC, compute_armor_class(ch) );
  2700: 
  2701:       /* This would be better moved elsewhere */
  2702:       if ( pOpponent != NULL )
  2703:       {
  2704:           int hit_points = (GET_HIT(pOpponent) * 100) / GET_MAX_HIT(pOpponent);
  2705:           MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_OPPONENT_HEALTH, hit_points );
  2706:           MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_OPPONENT_HEALTH_MAX, 100 );
  2707:           MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_OPPONENT_LEVEL, GET_LEVEL(pOpponent) );
  2708:           MSDPSetString( d, eMSDP_OPPONENT_NAME, PERS(pOpponent, ch) );
  2709:       }
  2710:       else /* Clear the values */
  2711:       {
  2712:           MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_OPPONENT_HEALTH, 0 );
  2713:           MSDPSetNumber( d, eMSDP_OPPONENT_LEVEL, 0 ); 
  2714:           MSDPSetString( d, eMSDP_OPPONENT_NAME, "" ); 
  2715:       }
  2716: 
  2717:       MSDPUpdate( d );
  2718:     }
  2719: 
  2720:     /* Ideally this should be called once at startup, and again whenever
  2721:      * someone leaves or joins the mud.  But this works, and it keeps the
  2722:      * snippet simple.  Optimise as you see fit.
  2723:      */
  2724:     MSSPSetPlayers( PlayerCount );
  2725:   }
  2726: }

    28:  * this file and relink; you don't have to wait for the whole thing to recompile
    29:  * as you do if you change a header file. I realize that it would be slightly
    30:  * more efficient to have lots of #defines strewn about, so that, for example,
    31:  * the autowiz code isn't compiled at all if you don't want to use autowiz.
    32:  * However, the actual code for the various options is quite small, as is the

   140: /* Autowipe deletion criteria. This struct holds information used to determine
   141:  * which players to wipe when the mud boots.  The levels must be in ascending
   142:  * order, with a descending level marking the end of the array.  A level -1
   143:  * entry in the beginning is the case for players with the PLR_DELETED flag.
   144:  * The values below match the stock purgeplay.c criteria.
   145: 
   146:    Detailed explanation by array element:
   147:    * Element 0, level -1, days 0: Players with PLR_DELETED flag are always wiped
   148:    * Element 1, level 0, days 0: Players at level 0 have created a character,
   149:      but have never actually entered the game, so always wipe them.
   150:    * Element 2, level 1, days 4: Players at level 1 are wiped if they haven't
   151:      logged on in the past 4 days.
   152:    * Element 3, level 4, days 7: Players level 2 through 4 are wiped if they
   153:      haven't logged on in the past 7 days.
   154:    * Element 4, level 10, days 30: Players level 5-10 get 30 days.
   155:    * Element 5, level LVL_IMMORT - 1, days 60: All other mortals get 60 days.
   156:    * Element 6, level LVL_IMPL, days 90: Immortals get 90 days.
   157:    * Element 7: Because -2 is less than LVL_IMPL, this is assumed to be the end
   158:      of the criteria.  The days entry is not used in this case. */
   159: struct pclean_criteria_data pclean_criteria[] = {
   160: /*	LEVEL		DAYS	*/
   161:   {	0		,0	}, /* level 0 */
   162:   {	1		,4	},
   163:   {	4		,7	},
   164:   {	10		,30	},
   165:   {	LVL_IMMORT - 1	,60	}, /* highest mortal */
   166:   {	LVL_IMPL	,90	}, /* all immortals */

   159: /* Help table must be sorted for binary search in do_help(). */
   160: static int help_table_qsort_cmp(const void *a, const void *b)
   161: {
   162:   const struct help_index_element *ha = (const struct help_index_element *)a;
   163:   const struct help_index_element *hb = (const struct help_index_element *)b;
   164: 
   165:   if (!ha || !ha->keywords) return -1;
   166:   if (!hb || !hb->keywords) return 1;
   167: 
   168:   return str_cmp(ha->keywords, hb->keywords);
   169: }
   170: 
   171: /* routines for booting the system */
   172: char *fread_action(FILE *fl, int nr)
   173: {
   174:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   175:   int i;
   176: 
   177:   if(fgets(buf, MAX_STRING_LENGTH, fl) == NULL) {
   178:     if(feof(fl)) {
   179:       log("SYSERR: fread_action: unexpected EOF near action #%d", nr);
   180:       /* SYSERR_DESC: fread_action() will fail if it discovers an end of file
   181:       * marker before it is able to read in the expected string.  This can be
   182:       * caused by a truncated socials file. */
   183:     } else {
   184:       log("SYSERR: fread_action: read error near action #%d: %s", nr, strerror(errno));
   185:     }
   186:     exit(1);
   187:   }
   188: 
   189:   if (*buf == '#')
   190:     return (NULL);
   191: 
   192:   parse_at(buf);
   193: 
   194:   /* Some clients interpret '\r' the same as { '\r' '\n' }, so the original way
   195:    * of just replacing '\n' with '\0' would appear as 2 new lines following the
   196:    * action */
   197:   for (i = 0; buf[i] != '\0'; i++)
   198:     if (buf[i] == '\r' || buf[i] == '\n') {
   199:       buf[i] = '\0';
   200:       break;
   201:     }
   202:   
   203:   return (strdup(buf));
   204: }
   205: 
   206: static void boot_social_messages(void)
   207: {
   208:   FILE *fl;
   209:   int line_number, nr = 0, hide, min_char_pos, min_pos, min_lvl, curr_soc = -1;
   210:   char next_soc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], sorted[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   211: 
   212:   if (CONFIG_NEW_SOCIALS == TRUE) {
   213:     /* open social file */
   214:     if (!(fl = fopen(SOCMESS_FILE_NEW, "r"))) {
   215:       log("SYSERR: can't open socials file '%s': %s", SOCMESS_FILE_NEW, strerror(errno));
   216:       /* SYSERR_DESC: This error, from boot_social_messages(), occurs when the
   217:        * server fails to open the file containing the social messages.  The
   218:        * error at the end will indicate the reason why. */
   219:       exit(1);
   220:     }
   221:     /* count socials */
   222:     *next_soc = '\0';
   223:     while (fgets(next_soc, MAX_STRING_LENGTH, fl))
   224:       if (*next_soc == '~') top_of_socialt++;
   225: 
   226:     if(ferror(fl)) {
   227:       log("SYSERR: error encountered reading socials file %s: %s", SOCMESS_FILE_NEW, strerror(errno));
   228:       exit(1);
   229:     }
   230:   } else { /* old style */
   231: 
   232:     /* open social file */
   233:     if (!(fl = fopen(SOCMESS_FILE, "r"))) {
   234:       log("SYSERR: can't open socials file '%s': %s", SOCMESS_FILE, strerror(errno));
   235:       /* SYSERR_DESC: This error, from boot_social_messages(), occurs when the
   236:        * server fails to open the file containing the social messages.  The
   237:        * error at the end will indicate the reason why. */
   238:       exit(1);
   239:     }
   240:     /* count socials */
   241:     while (fgets(next_soc, MAX_STRING_LENGTH, fl))
   242:       if (*next_soc == '\n' || *next_soc == '\r') top_of_socialt++; /* all socials are followed by a blank line */
   243: 
   244:     if(ferror(fl)) {
   245:       log("SYSERR: error encountered reading socials file %s: %s", SOCMESS_FILE_NEW, strerror(errno));
   246:       exit(1);
   247:     }
   248:   }
   249: 
   250:   log("Social table contains %d socials.", top_of_socialt);
   251:   rewind(fl);
   252: 
   253:   CREATE(soc_mess_list, struct social_messg, top_of_socialt + 1);
   254: 
   255:   /* now read 'em */
   256:   for (line_number = 0;; ++line_number) {
   257:     if (fscanf(fl, " %s ", next_soc) != 1) {
   258:       if(feof(fl))
   259:         log("SYSERR: unexpected end of file encountered in socials file %s", SOCMESS_FILE_NEW);
   260:       else if(ferror(fl))
   261:         log("SYSERR: error reading socials file %s: %s", SOCMESS_FILE_NEW, strerror(errno));
   262:       else
   263:         log("SYSERR: format error in social file near line %d", line_number);
   264:       exit(1);
   265:     }
   266:     if (*next_soc == '$') break;
   267:     if (CONFIG_NEW_SOCIALS == TRUE) {
   268:       if (fscanf(fl, " %s %d %d %d %d \n",
   269:   		sorted, &hide, &min_char_pos, &min_pos, &min_lvl) != 5) {
   270:       log("SYSERR: format error in social file near social '%s'", next_soc);
   271:       /* SYSERR_DESC: From boot_social_messages(), this error is output when
   272:        * the server is expecting to find the remainder of the first line of the
   273:        * social ('hide' and 'minimum position').  These must follow the name of
   274:        * the social with a single space such as: 'accuse 0 5\n'. This error
   275:        * often occurs when one of the numbers is missing or the social name has
   276:        * a space in it (i.e., 'bend over'). */
   277:       exit(1);
   278:     }
   279:       curr_soc++;
   280:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].command = strdup(next_soc+1);
   281:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].sort_as = strdup(sorted);
   282:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].hide = hide;
   283:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].min_char_position = min_char_pos;
   284:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].min_victim_position = min_pos;
   285:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].min_level_char = min_lvl;
   286:     } else {  /* old style */
   287:       if (fscanf(fl, " %d %d \n", &hide, &min_pos) != 2) {
   288:         log("SYSERR: format error in social file near social '%s'", next_soc);
   289:       /* SYSERR_DESC: From boot_social_messages(), this error is output when the
   290:        * server is expecting to find the remainder of the first line of the
   291:        * social ('hide' and 'minimum position').  These must follow the name of
   292:        * the social with a single space such as: 'accuse 0 5\n'. This error
   293:        * often occurs when one of the numbers is missing or the social name has
   294:        * a space in it (i.e., 'bend over'). */
   295:       exit(1);
   296:       }
   297:       curr_soc++;
   298:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].command = strdup(next_soc);
   299:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].sort_as = strdup(next_soc);
   300:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].hide = hide;
   301:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].min_char_position = POS_RESTING;
   302:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].min_victim_position = min_pos;
   303:       soc_mess_list[curr_soc].min_level_char = 0;
   304:     }
   305: 
   306: #ifdef CIRCLE_ACORN
   307:     if (fgetc(fl) != '\n')
   308:       log("SYSERR: Acorn bug workaround failed.");
   309:       /* SYSERR_DESC: The only time that this error should ever arise is if you
   310:        * are running your MUD on the Acorn platform.  The error arises when the
   311:        * server cannot properly read a '\n' out of the file at the end of the
   312:        * first line of the social (that with 'hide' and 'min position').  This
   313:        * is in boot_social_messages(). */
   314: #endif
   315: 
   316:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].char_no_arg = fread_action(fl, nr);
   317:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].others_no_arg = fread_action(fl, nr);
   318:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].char_found = fread_action(fl, nr);
   319: 
   320:     /* if no char_found, the rest is to be ignored */
   321:     if (CONFIG_NEW_SOCIALS == FALSE && !soc_mess_list[curr_soc].char_found)
   322:       continue;
   323: 
   324:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].others_found = fread_action(fl, nr);
   325:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].vict_found = fread_action(fl, nr);
   326:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].not_found = fread_action(fl, nr);
   327:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].char_auto = fread_action(fl, nr);
   328:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].others_auto = fread_action(fl, nr);
   329: 
   330:     if (CONFIG_NEW_SOCIALS == FALSE)
   331:       continue;
   332: 
   333:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].char_body_found = fread_action(fl, nr);
   334:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].others_body_found = fread_action(fl, nr);
   335:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].vict_body_found = fread_action(fl, nr);
   336:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].char_obj_found = fread_action(fl, nr);
   337:     soc_mess_list[curr_soc].others_obj_found = fread_action(fl, nr);
   338:   }
   339: 
   340:   /* close file & set top */
   341:   fclose(fl);
   342:   assert(curr_soc <= top_of_socialt);
   343:   top_of_socialt = curr_soc;
   344: }

   353: /* Wipe out all the loaded text files, for shutting down. */
   354: void free_text_files(void)
   355: {
   356:   char **textfiles[] = {
   357: 	&wizlist, &immlist, &news, &credits, &motd, &imotd, &help, &ihelp, &info,
   358: 	&policies, &handbook, &background, &GREETINGS, &bugs, &typos, &ideas, NULL
   359:   };
   360:   int rf;
   361: 
   362:   for (rf = 0; textfiles[rf]; rf++)
   363:     if (*textfiles[rf]) {
   364:       free(*textfiles[rf]);
   365:       *textfiles[rf] = NULL;
   366:     }
   367: }
   368: 
   369: /* Too bad it doesn't check the return values to let the user know about -1
   370:  * values.  This will result in an 'Okay.' to a 'reload' command even when the
   371:  * string was not replaced. To fix later. */
   372: ACMD(do_reboot)
   373: {
   374:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   375: 
   376:   one_argument(argument, arg);
   377: 
   378:   if (!str_cmp(arg, "all") || *arg == '*') {
   379:     if (file_to_string_alloc(GREETINGS_FILE, &GREETINGS) == 0)
   380:       prune_crlf(GREETINGS);
   381:     if (file_to_string_alloc(WIZLIST_FILE, &wizlist) < 0)
   382:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read wizlist\r\n");
   383:     if (file_to_string_alloc(IMMLIST_FILE, &immlist) < 0)
   384:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read immlist\r\n");
   385:     if (file_to_string_alloc(NEWS_FILE, &news) < 0)
   386:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read news\r\n");
   387:     if (file_to_string_alloc(CREDITS_FILE, &credits) < 0)
   388:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read credits\r\n");
   389:     if (file_to_string_alloc(MOTD_FILE, &motd) < 0)
   390:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read motd\r\n");
   391:     if (file_to_string_alloc(IMOTD_FILE, &imotd) < 0)
   392:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read imotd\r\n");
   393:     if (file_to_string_alloc(HELP_PAGE_FILE, &help) < 0)
   394:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read help front page\r\n");
   395:     if (file_to_string_alloc(IHELP_PAGE_FILE, &ihelp) < 0)
   396:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read help front page\r\n");
   397:     if (file_to_string_alloc(INFO_FILE, &info) < 0)
   398:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read info file\r\n");
   399:     if (file_to_string_alloc(POLICIES_FILE, &policies) < 0)
   400:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read policies\r\n");
   401:     if (file_to_string_alloc(HANDBOOK_FILE, &handbook) < 0)
   402:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read handbook\r\n");
   403:     if (file_to_string_alloc(BACKGROUND_FILE, &background) < 0)
   404:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read background\r\n");
   405:     if (help_table) {
   406:       free_help_table();
   407:     index_boot(DB_BOOT_HLP);
   408:     }
   409:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "wizlist")) {
   410:     if (file_to_string_alloc(WIZLIST_FILE, &wizlist) < 0)
   411:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read wizlist\r\n");
   412:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "immlist")) {
   413:     if (file_to_string_alloc(IMMLIST_FILE, &immlist) < 0)
   414:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read immlist\r\n");
   415:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "news")) {
   416:     if (file_to_string_alloc(NEWS_FILE, &news) < 0)
   417:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read news\r\n");
   418:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "credits")) {
   419:     if (file_to_string_alloc(CREDITS_FILE, &credits) < 0)
   420:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read credits\r\n");
   421:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "motd")) {
   422:     if (file_to_string_alloc(MOTD_FILE, &motd) < 0)
   423:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read motd\r\n");
   424:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "imotd")) {
   425:     if (file_to_string_alloc(IMOTD_FILE, &imotd) < 0)
   426:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read imotd\r\n");
   427:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "help")) {
   428:     if (file_to_string_alloc(HELP_PAGE_FILE, &help) < 0)
   429:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read help front page\r\n");
   430:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "ihelp")) {
   431:     if (file_to_string_alloc(IHELP_PAGE_FILE, &ihelp) < 0)
   432:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read help front page\r\n");
   433:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "info")) {
   434:     if (file_to_string_alloc(INFO_FILE, &info) < 0)
   435:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read info\r\n");
   436:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "policy")) {
   437:     if (file_to_string_alloc(POLICIES_FILE, &policies) < 0)
   438:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read policy\r\n");
   439:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "handbook")) {
   440:     if (file_to_string_alloc(HANDBOOK_FILE, &handbook) < 0)
   441:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read handbook\r\n");
   442:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "background")) {
   443:     if (file_to_string_alloc(BACKGROUND_FILE, &background) < 0)
   444:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read background\r\n");
   445:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "greetings")) {
   446:     if (file_to_string_alloc(GREETINGS_FILE, &GREETINGS) == 0)
   447:       prune_crlf(GREETINGS);
   448:     else
   449:       send_to_char(ch, "Cannot read greetings.\r\n");
   450:   } else if (!str_cmp(arg, "xhelp")) {
   451:     if (help_table) {
   452:       free_help_table();
   453:     index_boot(DB_BOOT_HLP);
   454:     }
   455:   } else {
   456:     send_to_char(ch, "Unknown reload option.\r\n");
   457:     return;
   458:   }
   459: 
   460:   send_to_char(ch, "%s", CONFIG_OK);
   461: }

   463: void boot_world(void)
   464: {
   465:   log("Loading zone table.");
   466:   index_boot(DB_BOOT_ZON);
   467: 
   468:   log("Loading triggers and generating index.");
   469:   index_boot(DB_BOOT_TRG);
   470: 
   471:   log("Loading rooms.");
   472:   index_boot(DB_BOOT_WLD);
   473: 
   474:   log("Renumbering rooms.");
   475:   renum_world();
   476: 
   477:   log("Checking start rooms.");
   478:   check_start_rooms();
   479: 
   480:   log("Loading mobs and generating index.");
   481:   index_boot(DB_BOOT_MOB);
   482: 
   483:   log("Loading objs and generating index.");
   484:   index_boot(DB_BOOT_OBJ);
   485: 
   486:   log("Renumbering zone table.");
   487:   renum_zone_table();
   488: 
   489:   if(converting) {
   490:     log("Saving 128bit world files to disk.");
   491:     save_all();
   492:   }
   493: 
   494:   if (!no_specials) {
   495:     log("Loading shops.");
   496:     index_boot(DB_BOOT_SHP);
   497:   }
   498: 
   499:   log("Loading quests.");
   500:   index_boot(DB_BOOT_QST);
   501: 
   502: }

   504: static void free_extra_descriptions(struct extra_descr_data *edesc)
   505: {
   506:   struct extra_descr_data *enext;
   507: 
   508:   for (; edesc; edesc = enext) {
   509:     enext = edesc->next;
   510: 
   511:     free(edesc->keyword);
   512:     free(edesc->description);
   513:     free(edesc);
   514:   }
   515: }
   516: 
   517: /* Free the world, in a memory allocation sense. */
   518: void destroy_db(void)
   519: {
   520:   ssize_t cnt, itr;
   521:   struct char_data *chtmp, *i = character_list;
   522:   struct obj_data *objtmp;
   523: 
   524:   /* Active Mobiles & Players */
   525:   while (i) {
   526:     chtmp = i;
   527:     i = i->next;
   528: 
   529:     if (chtmp->master)
   530:       stop_follower(chtmp);
   531:   }
   532: 
   533:   while (character_list) {
   534:     chtmp = character_list;
   535:     character_list = character_list->next;
   536: 
   537:     free_char(chtmp);
   538:   }
   539: 
   540:   /* Active Objects */
   541:   while (object_list) {
   542:     objtmp = object_list;
   543:     object_list = object_list->next;
   544:     free_obj(objtmp);
   545:   }
   546: 
   547:   /* Rooms */
   548:   for (cnt = 0; cnt <= top_of_world; cnt++) {
   549:     if (world[cnt].name)
   550:       free(world[cnt].name);
   551:     if (world[cnt].description)
   552:       free(world[cnt].description);
   553:     free_extra_descriptions(world[cnt].ex_description);
   554: 
   555:   if (world[cnt].events != NULL) {
   556: 	  if (world[cnt].events->iSize > 0) {
   557: 		struct event * pEvent;
   558: 
   559: 		while ((pEvent = simple_list(world[cnt].events)) != NULL)
   560: 		  event_cancel(pEvent);
   561: 	  }
   562: 	  free_list(world[cnt].events);
   563:     world[cnt].events = NULL;
   564:   }
   565: 
   566:     /* free any assigned scripts */
   567:     if (SCRIPT(&world[cnt]))
   568:       extract_script(&world[cnt], WLD_TRIGGER);
   569:     /* free script proto list */
   570:     free_proto_script(&world[cnt], WLD_TRIGGER);
   571: 
   572:     for (itr = 0; itr < NUM_OF_DIRS; itr++) { /* NUM_OF_DIRS here, not DIR_COUNT */
   573:       if (!world[cnt].dir_option[itr])
   574:         continue;
   575: 
   576:       if (world[cnt].dir_option[itr]->general_description)
   577:         free(world[cnt].dir_option[itr]->general_description);
   578:       if (world[cnt].dir_option[itr]->keyword)
   579:         free(world[cnt].dir_option[itr]->keyword);
   580:       free(world[cnt].dir_option[itr]);
   581:     }
   582:   }
   583:   free(world);
   584:   top_of_world = 0;
   585: 
   586:   /* Objects */
   587:   for (cnt = 0; cnt <= top_of_objt; cnt++) {
   588:     if (obj_proto[cnt].name)
   589:       free(obj_proto[cnt].name);
   590:     if (obj_proto[cnt].description)
   591:       free(obj_proto[cnt].description);
   592:     if (obj_proto[cnt].short_description)
   593:       free(obj_proto[cnt].short_description);
   594:     if (obj_proto[cnt].action_description)
   595:       free(obj_proto[cnt].action_description);
   596:     free_extra_descriptions(obj_proto[cnt].ex_description);
   597: 
   598:     /* free script proto list */
   599:     free_proto_script(&obj_proto[cnt], OBJ_TRIGGER);
   600:   }
   601:   free(obj_proto);
   602:   free(obj_index);
   603: 
   604:   /* Mobiles */
   605:   for (cnt = 0; cnt <= top_of_mobt; cnt++) {
   606:     if (mob_proto[cnt].player.name)
   607:       free(mob_proto[cnt].player.name);
   608:     if (mob_proto[cnt].player.title)
   609:       free(mob_proto[cnt].player.title);
   610:     if (mob_proto[cnt].player.short_descr)
   611:       free(mob_proto[cnt].player.short_descr);
   612:     if (mob_proto[cnt].player.long_descr)
   613:       free(mob_proto[cnt].player.long_descr);
   614:     if (mob_proto[cnt].player.description)
   615:       free(mob_proto[cnt].player.description);
   616: 
   617:     /* free script proto list */
   618:     free_proto_script(&mob_proto[cnt], MOB_TRIGGER);
   619: 
   620:     while (mob_proto[cnt].affected)
   621:       affect_remove(&mob_proto[cnt], mob_proto[cnt].affected);
   622:   }
   623:   free(mob_proto);
   624:   free(mob_index);
   625: 
   626:   /* Shops */
   627:   destroy_shops();
   628: 
   629:   /* Quests */
   630:   destroy_quests();
   631: 
   632:   /* Zones */
   633: #define THIS_CMD zone_table[cnt].cmd[itr]
   634: 
   635:   for (cnt = 0; cnt <= top_of_zone_table; cnt++) {
   636:     if (zone_table[cnt].name)
   637:       free(zone_table[cnt].name);
   638:     if (zone_table[cnt].builders)
   639:       free(zone_table[cnt].builders);
   640:     if (zone_table[cnt].cmd) {
   641:       /* first see if any vars were defined in this zone */
   642:       for (itr = 0;THIS_CMD.command != 'S';itr++)
   643:         if (THIS_CMD.command == 'V') {
   644:           if (THIS_CMD.sarg1)
   645:             free(THIS_CMD.sarg1);
   646:           if (THIS_CMD.sarg2)
   647:             free(THIS_CMD.sarg2);
   648:         }
   649:       /* then free the command list */
   650:       free(zone_table[cnt].cmd);
   651:     }
   652:   }
   653:   free(zone_table);
   654: 
   655: #undef THIS_CMD
   656: 
   657:   /* zone table reset queue */
   658:   if (reset_q.head) {
   659:     struct reset_q_element *ftemp=reset_q.head, *temp;
   660:     while (ftemp) {
   661:       temp = ftemp->next;
   662:       free(ftemp);
   663:       ftemp = temp;
   664:     }
   665:   }
   666: 
   667:   /* Triggers */
   668:   for (cnt=0; cnt < top_of_trigt; cnt++) {
   669:     if (trig_index[cnt]->proto) {
   670:       /* make sure to nuke the command list (memory leak) */
   671:       /* free_trigger() doesn't free the command list */
   672:       if (trig_index[cnt]->proto->cmdlist) {
   673:         struct cmdlist_element *i, *j;
   674:         i = trig_index[cnt]->proto->cmdlist;
   675:         while (i) {
   676:           j = i->next;
   677:           if (i->cmd)
   678:             free(i->cmd);
   679:           free(i);
   680:           i = j;
   681:         }
   682:       }
   683:       free_trigger(trig_index[cnt]->proto);
   684:     }
   685:     free(trig_index[cnt]);
   686:   }
   687:   free(trig_index);
   688: 
   689:   /* Events */
   690:   event_free_all();
   691: 
   692: }
   693: 
   694: /* body of the booting system */
   695: void boot_db(void)
   696: {
   697:   zone_rnum i;
   698: 
   699:   log("Boot db -- BEGIN.");
   700: 
   701:   log("Resetting the game time:");
   702:   reset_time();
   703:   
   704:   log("Initialize Global Lists");
   705:   global_lists = create_list();
   706:   group_list   = create_list();
   707: 
   708:   log("Initializing Events");
   709:   init_events();
   710: 
   711:   log("Reading news, credits, help, ihelp, bground, info & motds.");
   712:   file_to_string_alloc(NEWS_FILE, &news);
   713:   file_to_string_alloc(CREDITS_FILE, &credits);
   714:   file_to_string_alloc(MOTD_FILE, &motd);
   715:   file_to_string_alloc(IMOTD_FILE, &imotd);
   716:   file_to_string_alloc(HELP_PAGE_FILE, &help);
   717:   file_to_string_alloc(IHELP_PAGE_FILE, &ihelp);
   718:   file_to_string_alloc(INFO_FILE, &info);
   719:   file_to_string_alloc(WIZLIST_FILE, &wizlist);
   720:   file_to_string_alloc(IMMLIST_FILE, &immlist);
   721:   file_to_string_alloc(POLICIES_FILE, &policies);
   722:   file_to_string_alloc(HANDBOOK_FILE, &handbook);
   723:   file_to_string_alloc(BACKGROUND_FILE, &background);
   724:   if (file_to_string_alloc(GREETINGS_FILE, &GREETINGS) == 0)
   725:     prune_crlf(GREETINGS);
   726: 
   727:   log("Loading spell definitions.");
   728:   mag_assign_spells();
   729: 
   730:   boot_world();
   731:   clan_boot();
   732: 
   733:   log("Loading help entries.");
   734:   index_boot(DB_BOOT_HLP);
   735: 
   736:   log("Generating player index.");
   737:   build_player_index();
   738: 
   739:   if (auto_pwipe) {
   740:     log("Cleaning out inactive pfiles.");
   741:     clean_pfiles();
   742:   }
   743: 
   744:   log("Loading fight messages.");
   745:   load_messages();
   746: 
   747:   log("Loading social messages.");
   748:   boot_social_messages();
   749: 
   750:   log("Building command list.");
   751:   create_command_list(); /* aedit patch -- M. Scott */
   752: 
   753:   log("Assigning function pointers:");
   754: 
   755:   if (!no_specials) {
   756:     log("   Mobiles.");
   757:     assign_mobiles();
   758:     log("   Shopkeepers.");
   759:     assign_the_shopkeepers();
   760:     log("   Objects.");
   761:     assign_objects();
   762:     log("   Rooms.");
   763:     assign_rooms();
   764:     log("   Questmasters.");
   765:     assign_the_quests();
   766: 
   767:     /*
   768:      * Adventurer's Lair:
   769:      * Old world files can retain MOB_SPEC after a legacy hardcoded special
   770:      * procedure has been retired.  Once all legitimate special assignments
   771:      * are complete, clear MOB_SPEC only on prototypes that have no callable
   772:      * function.  This prevents every reset/load from creating mobs that try
   773:      * to invoke a non-existent special while preserving real specials.
   774:      */
   775:     {
   776:       mob_rnum i;
   777:       int cleared_stale_specs = 0;
   778: 
   779:       for (i = 0; i <= top_of_mobt; i++) {
   780:         if (MOB_FLAGGED(&mob_proto[i], MOB_SPEC) && mob_index[i].func == NULL) {
   781:           REMOVE_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(&mob_proto[i]), MOB_SPEC);
   782:           cleared_stale_specs++;
   783:         }
   784:       }
   785: 
   786:       if (cleared_stale_specs > 0)
   787:         log("   Cleared stale MOB_SPEC flag from %d mob prototype%s.",
   788:             cleared_stale_specs, cleared_stale_specs == 1 ? "" : "s");
   789:     }
   790:   }
   791: 
   792:   log("Assigning spell and skill levels.");
   793:   init_spell_levels();
   794: 
   795:   log("Sorting command list and spells.");
   796:   sort_commands();
   797:   sort_spells();
   798: 
   799:   log("Booting mail system.");
   800:   if (!scan_file()) {
   801:     log("    Mail boot failed -- Mail system disabled");
   802:     no_mail = 1;
   803:   }
   804:   log("Reading banned site and invalid-name list.");
   805:   load_banned();
   806:   read_invalid_list();
   807: 
   808:   log("Loading Ideas.");
   809:   load_ibt_file(SCMD_IDEA);
   810: 
   811:   log("Loading Bugs.");
   812:   load_ibt_file(SCMD_BUG);
   813: 
   814:   log("Loading Typos.");
   815:   load_ibt_file(SCMD_TYPO);
   816: 
   817:   if (!no_rent_check) {
   818:     log("Deleting timed-out crash and rent files:");
   819:     update_obj_file();
   820:     log("   Done.");
   821:   }
   822: 
   823:   /* Moved here so the object limit code works. -gg 6/24/98 */
   824:   if (!mini_mud)  {
   825:     log("Booting houses.");
   826:     House_boot();
   827:   }
   828: 
   829:   log("Cleaning up last log.");
   830:   clean_llog_entries();
   831: 
   832: #if 1
   833: {
   834:   int j;
   835: 
   836:   for (j = 0 ; j < top_of_objt; j++) {
   837:     if (obj_proto[j].script == (struct script_data *)&shop_keeper) {
   838:       log("Item %d (%s) had shopkeeper trouble.", obj_index[j].vnum, obj_proto[j].short_description);
   839:       obj_proto[j].script = NULL;
   840:     }
   841:   }
   842: }
   843: #endif
   844: 
   845:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_zone_table; i++) {
   846:     log("Resetting #%d: %s (rooms %d-%d).", zone_table[i].number,
   847: 	zone_table[i].name, zone_table[i].bot, zone_table[i].top);
   848:     reset_zone(i);
   849:   }
   850: 
   851:   reset_q.head = reset_q.tail = NULL;
   852: 
   853:   if (!boot_time)
   854:     boot_time = time(0);
   855: 
   856:   log("Boot db -- DONE.");
   857: }

   859: /* reset the time in the game from file */
   860: static void reset_time(void)
   861: {
   862:   time_t beginning_of_time = 0;
   863:   FILE *bgtime;
   864: 
   865:   if ((bgtime = fopen(TIME_FILE, "r")) == NULL)
   866:     log("No time file '%s' starting from the beginning.", TIME_FILE);
   867:   else {
   868:     if(fscanf(bgtime, "%ld\n", (long *)&beginning_of_time) == EOF) {
   869:       if(feof(bgtime)) {
   870:         log("SYSERR: reset_time: unexpected end of file encountered reading %s.", TIME_FILE);
   871:       } else if(ferror(bgtime)) {
   872:         log("SYSERR: reset_time: unexpected end of file encountered reading %s: %s.", TIME_FILE, strerror(errno));
   873:       }
   874:     }
   875:     fclose(bgtime);
   876:   }
   877: 
   878:   if (beginning_of_time == 0)
   879:     beginning_of_time = 650336715;
   880: 
   881: time_info = *mud_time_passed(time(0), beginning_of_time);
   882: 
   883:   if (time_info.hours <= 4)
   884:     weather_info.sunlight = SUN_DARK;
   885:   else if (time_info.hours == 5)
   886:     weather_info.sunlight = SUN_RISE;
   887:   else if (time_info.hours <= 20)
   888:     weather_info.sunlight = SUN_LIGHT;
   889:   else if (time_info.hours == 21)
   890:     weather_info.sunlight = SUN_SET;
   891:   else
   892:     weather_info.sunlight = SUN_DARK;
   893: 
   894:   log("   Current Gametime: %dH %dD %dM %dY.", time_info.hours,
   895: 	  time_info.day, time_info.month, time_info.year);
   896: 
   897:   weather_info.pressure = 960;
   898:   if ((time_info.month >= 7) && (time_info.month <= 12))
   899:     weather_info.pressure += dice(1, 50);
   900:   else
   901:     weather_info.pressure += dice(1, 80);
   902: 
   903:   weather_info.change = 0;
   904: 
   905:   if (weather_info.pressure <= 980)
   906:     weather_info.sky = SKY_LIGHTNING;
   907:   else if (weather_info.pressure <= 1000)
   908:     weather_info.sky = SKY_RAINING;
   909:   else if (weather_info.pressure <= 1020)
   910:     weather_info.sky = SKY_CLOUDY;
   911:   else
   912:     weather_info.sky = SKY_CLOUDLESS;
   913: }

   915: /* Write the time in 'when' to the MUD-time file. */
   916: void save_mud_time(struct time_info_data *when)
   917: {
   918:   FILE *bgtime;
   919: 
   920:   if ((bgtime = fopen(TIME_FILE, "w")) == NULL)
   921:     log("SYSERR: Can't write to '%s' time file.", TIME_FILE);
   922:   else {
   923:     fprintf(bgtime, "%ld\n", (long)mud_time_to_secs(when));
   924:     fclose(bgtime);
   925:   }
   926: }
   927: 
   928: /* Thanks to Andrey (andrey@alex-ua.com) for this bit of code, although I did
   929:  * add the 'goto' and changed some "while()" into "do { } while()". -gg */
   930: static int count_alias_records(FILE *fl)
   931: {
   932:   char key[READ_SIZE], next_key[READ_SIZE];
   933:   char line[READ_SIZE], *scan;
   934:   int total_keywords = 0;
   935: 
   936:   /* get the first keyword line */
   937:   get_one_line(fl, key);
   938: 
   939:   while (*key != '$') {
   940:     char *keyp = key;
   941: 
   942:     while (*keyp && isspace((unsigned char)*keyp))
   943:       keyp++;
   944: 
   945:     if (!*keyp || *keyp == '!') {
   946:       get_one_line(fl, key);
   947:       if (feof(fl))
   948:         goto ackeof;
   949:       continue;
   950:     }
   951: 
   952:     /* skip the text */
   953:     do {
   954:       get_one_line(fl, line);
   955:       if (feof(fl))
   956: 	goto ackeof;
   957:     } while (*line != '#');
   958: 
   959:     /* now count keywords */
   960:     scan = keyp;
   961:     do {
   962:       scan = one_word(scan, next_key);
   963:       if (*next_key)
   964:         ++total_keywords;
   965:     } while (*next_key);
   966: 
   967:     /* get next keyword line (or $) */
   968:     get_one_line(fl, key);
   969: 
   970:     if (feof(fl))
   971:       goto ackeof;
   972:   }
   973: 
   974:   return (total_keywords);
   975: 
   976:   /* No, they are not evil. -gg 6/24/98 */
   977: ackeof:
   978:   log("SYSERR: Unexpected end of help file.");
   979:   exit(1);	/* Some day we hope to handle these things better... */
   980: }
   981: 
   982: /* function to count how many hash-mark delimited records exist in a file */
   983: int count_hash_records(FILE *fl)
   984: {
   985:   char buf[128];
   986:   int count = 0;
   987: 
   988:   while (fgets(buf, 128, fl))
   989:     if (*buf == '#')
   990:       count++;
   991: 
   992:   return (count);
   993: }

   995: void index_boot(int mode)
   996: {
   997:   const char *index_filename, *prefix = NULL;	/* NULL or egcs 1.1 complains */
   998:   FILE *db_index, *db_file;
   999:   int line_number, rec_count = 0, size[2];
  1000:   char buf2[PATH_MAX], buf1[PATH_MAX - 100];   // - 100 to make room for prefix
  1001: 
  1002:   switch (mode) {
  1003:   case DB_BOOT_WLD:
  1004:     prefix = WLD_PREFIX;
  1005:     break;
  1006:   case DB_BOOT_MOB:
  1007:     prefix = MOB_PREFIX;
  1008:     break;
  1009:   case DB_BOOT_OBJ:
  1010:     prefix = OBJ_PREFIX;
  1011:     break;
  1012:   case DB_BOOT_ZON:
  1013:     prefix = ZON_PREFIX;
  1014:     break;
  1015:   case DB_BOOT_SHP:
  1016:     prefix = SHP_PREFIX;
  1017:     break;
  1018:   case DB_BOOT_HLP:
  1019:     prefix = HLP_PREFIX;
  1020: 
  1021:     /* Ensure help_table is sorted for binary search in do_help(). */
  1022:     if (help_table && top_of_helpt > 1)
  1023:       qsort(help_table, top_of_helpt, sizeof(struct help_index_element), help_table_qsort_cmp);
  1024: 
  1025:     break;
  1026:   case DB_BOOT_TRG:
  1027:     prefix = TRG_PREFIX;
  1028:     break;
  1029:   case DB_BOOT_QST:
  1030:     prefix = QST_PREFIX;
  1031:     break;
  1032:   default:
  1033:     log("SYSERR: Unknown subcommand %d to index_boot!", mode);
  1034:     exit(1);
  1035:   }
  1036: 
  1037:   if (mini_mud)
  1038:     index_filename = MINDEX_FILE;
  1039:   else
  1040:     index_filename = INDEX_FILE;
  1041: 
  1042:   snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "%s%s", prefix, index_filename);
  1043:   if (!(db_index = fopen(buf2, "r"))) {
  1044:     log("SYSERR: opening index file '%s': %s", buf2, strerror(errno));
  1045:     exit(1);
  1046:   }
  1047: 
  1048:   for (line_number = 0;; ++line_number) {
  1049:     /* first, count the number of records in the file so we can malloc */
  1050:     if (fscanf(db_index, "%s\n", buf1) != 1) {
  1051:       if (feof(db_index))
  1052:         log("SYSERR: boot error -- unexpected end of file encountered in index file ./%s%s. "
  1053:             "Ensure that the last line of the file starts with the character '$'.",
  1054:             prefix, index_filename);
  1055:       else if (ferror(db_index))
  1056:         log("SYSERR: boot error -- unexpected end of file encountered in index file ./%s%s: %s",
  1057:             prefix, index_filename, strerror(errno));
  1058:       else
  1059:         log("SYSERR: boot error -- error parsing index file %s%s on line %d",
  1060:             prefix, index_filename, line_number);
  1061:       exit(1);
  1062:     }
  1063: 
  1064:     if (*buf1 == '$')
  1065:       break;
  1066: 
  1067:     snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "%s%s", prefix, buf1);
  1068:     if (!(db_file = fopen(buf2, "r"))) {
  1069:       log("SYSERR: File '%s' listed in '%s/%s': %s", buf2, prefix,
  1070:           index_filename, strerror(errno));
  1071:     } else {
  1072:       if (mode == DB_BOOT_ZON)
  1073:         rec_count++;
  1074:       else if (mode == DB_BOOT_HLP)
  1075:         rec_count += count_alias_records(db_file);
  1076:       else
  1077:         rec_count += count_hash_records(db_file);
  1078:       fclose(db_file);
  1079:     }
  1080:   }
  1081: 
  1082:   /* Exit if 0 records, unless this is shops */
  1083:   if (!rec_count) {
  1084:     if (mode == DB_BOOT_SHP || mode == DB_BOOT_QST)
  1085:       return;
  1086:     log("SYSERR: boot error - 0 records counted in %s/%s.", prefix,
  1087: 	index_filename);
  1088:     exit(1);
  1089:   }
  1090: 
  1091:   /* "bytes" does _not_ include strings or other later malloc'd things. */
  1092:   switch (mode) {
  1093:   case DB_BOOT_TRG:
  1094:     CREATE(trig_index, struct index_data *, rec_count);
  1095:     break;
  1096:   case DB_BOOT_WLD:
  1097:     CREATE(world, struct room_data, rec_count);
  1098:     size[0] = sizeof(struct room_data) * rec_count;
  1099:     log("   %d rooms, %d bytes.", rec_count, size[0]);
  1100:     break;
  1101:   case DB_BOOT_MOB:
  1102:     CREATE(mob_proto, struct char_data, rec_count);
  1103:     CREATE(mob_index, struct index_data, rec_count);
  1104:     size[0] = sizeof(struct index_data) * rec_count;
  1105:     size[1] = sizeof(struct char_data) * rec_count;
  1106:     log("   %d mobs, %d bytes in index, %d bytes in prototypes.", rec_count, size[0], size[1]);
  1107:     break;
  1108:   case DB_BOOT_OBJ:
  1109:     CREATE(obj_proto, struct obj_data, rec_count);
  1110:     CREATE(obj_index, struct index_data, rec_count);
  1111:     size[0] = sizeof(struct index_data) * rec_count;
  1112:     size[1] = sizeof(struct obj_data) * rec_count;
  1113:     log("   %d objs, %d bytes in index, %d bytes in prototypes.", rec_count, size[0], size[1]);
  1114:     break;
  1115:   case DB_BOOT_ZON:
  1116:     CREATE(zone_table, struct zone_data, rec_count);
  1117:     size[0] = sizeof(struct zone_data) * rec_count;
  1118:     log("   %d zones, %d bytes.", rec_count, size[0]);
  1119:     break;
  1120:   case DB_BOOT_HLP:
  1121:     CREATE(help_table, struct help_index_element, rec_count);
  1122:     help_table_allocated = rec_count;
  1123:     size[0] = sizeof(struct help_index_element) * rec_count;
  1124:     log("   %d entries, %d bytes.", rec_count, size[0]);
  1125:     break;
  1126:   case DB_BOOT_QST:
  1127:     CREATE(aquest_table, struct aq_data, rec_count);
  1128:     size[0] = sizeof(struct aq_data) * rec_count;
  1129:     log("   %d entries, %d bytes.", rec_count, size[0]);
  1130:     break;
  1131:   }
  1132: 
  1133:   rewind(db_index);
  1134: 
  1135:   for (line_number = 1;; ++line_number) {
  1136:     if (fscanf(db_index, "%s\n", buf1) != 1) {
  1137:       if (feof(db_index))
  1138:         log("SYSERR: boot error -- unexpected end of file encountered in index file ./%s%s",
  1139:             prefix, index_filename);
  1140:       else if (ferror(db_index))
  1141:         log("SYSERR: boot error -- unexpected end of file encountered in index file ./%s%s: %s",
  1142:             prefix, index_filename, strerror(errno));
  1143:       else
  1144:         log("SYSERR: boot error -- error parsing index file ./%s%s on line %d",
  1145:             prefix, index_filename, line_number);
  1146:       exit(1);
  1147:     }
  1148: 
  1149:     if (*buf1 == '$')
  1150:       break;
  1151: 
  1152:     snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "%s%s", prefix, buf1);
  1153:     if (!(db_file = fopen(buf2, "r"))) {
  1154:       log("SYSERR: %s: %s", buf2, strerror(errno));
  1155:       exit(1);
  1156:     }
  1157:     switch (mode) {
  1158:     case DB_BOOT_WLD:
  1159:     case DB_BOOT_OBJ:
  1160:     case DB_BOOT_MOB:
  1161:     case DB_BOOT_TRG:
  1162:     case DB_BOOT_QST:
  1163:       discrete_load(db_file, mode, buf2);
  1164:       break;
  1165:     case DB_BOOT_ZON:
  1166:       load_zones(db_file, buf2);
  1167:       break;
  1168:     case DB_BOOT_HLP:
  1169:       load_help(db_file, buf2);
  1170:       break;
  1171:     case DB_BOOT_SHP:
  1172:       boot_the_shops(db_file, buf2, rec_count);
  1173:       break;
  1174:     }
  1175: 
  1176:     fclose(db_file);
  1177:   }
  1178:   fclose(db_index);
  1179: 
  1180:   /* Sort the help index. */
  1181:   if (mode == DB_BOOT_HLP) {
  1182:     qsort(help_table, top_of_helpt, sizeof(struct help_index_element), hsort);
  1183:   }
  1184: }
  1185: 
  1186: void discrete_load(FILE *fl, int mode, char *filename)
  1187: {
  1188:   int nr = -1, last;
  1189:   char line[READ_SIZE];
  1190: 
  1191:   const char *modes[] = {"world", "mob", "obj", "ZON", "SHP", "HLP", "trg", "qst"};
  1192:   /* modes positions correspond to DB_BOOT_xxx in db.h */
  1193: 
  1194:   for (;;) {
  1195:     /* We have to do special processing with the obj files because they have no
  1196:      * end-of-record marker. */
  1197:     if (mode != DB_BOOT_OBJ || nr < 0)
  1198:       if (!get_line(fl, line)) {
  1199: 	if (nr == -1) {
  1200: 	  log("SYSERR: %s file %s is empty!", modes[mode], filename);
  1201: 	} else {
  1202: 	  log("SYSERR: Format error in %s after %s #%d\n"
  1203: 	      "...expecting a new %s, but file ended!\n"
  1204: 	      "(maybe the file is not terminated with '$'?)", filename,
  1205: 	      modes[mode], nr, modes[mode]);
  1206: 	}
  1207: 	exit(1);
  1208:       }
  1209:     if (*line == '$')
  1210:       return;
  1211: 
  1212:     if (*line == '#') {
  1213:       last = nr;
  1214:       if (sscanf(line, "#%d", &nr) != 1) {
  1215: 	log("SYSERR: Format error after %s #%d", modes[mode], last);
  1216: 	exit(1);
  1217:       }
  1218:       if (nr >= 99999)
  1219: 	return;
  1220:       else
  1221: 	switch (mode) {
  1222: 	case DB_BOOT_WLD:
  1223: 	  parse_room(fl, nr);
  1224: 	  break;
  1225: 	case DB_BOOT_MOB:
  1226: 	  parse_mobile(fl, nr);
  1227: 	  break;
  1228:         case DB_BOOT_TRG:
  1229:           parse_trigger(fl, nr);
  1230:           break;
  1231: 	case DB_BOOT_OBJ:
  1232: 	  strlcpy(line, parse_object(fl, nr), sizeof(line));
  1233: 	  break;
  1234:   case DB_BOOT_QST:
  1235:     parse_quest(fl, nr);
  1236:     break;
  1237: 	}
  1238:     } else {
  1239:       log("SYSERR: Format error in %s file %s near %s #%d", modes[mode],
  1240: 	  filename, modes[mode], nr);
  1241:       log("SYSERR: ... offending line: '%s'", line);
  1242:       exit(1);
  1243:     }
  1244:   }
  1245: }

  1247: static char fread_letter(FILE *fp)
  1248: {
  1249:   char c;
  1250:   do {
  1251:     c = getc(fp);
  1252:   } while (isspace(c));
  1253:   return c;
  1254: }

  1256: bitvector_t asciiflag_conv(char *flag)
  1257: {
  1258:   bitvector_t flags = 0;
  1259:   int is_num = TRUE;
  1260:   char *p;
  1261: 
  1262:   for (p = flag; *p; p++) {
  1263:     if (islower(*p))
  1264:       flags |= 1 << (*p - 'a');
  1265:     else if (isupper(*p))
  1266:       flags |= 1 << (26 + (*p - 'A'));
  1267: 
  1268:     /* Allow the first character to be a minus sign */
  1269:     if (!isdigit(*p) && (*p != '-' || p != flag))
  1270:       is_num = FALSE;
  1271:   }
  1272: 
  1273:   if (is_num)
  1274:     flags = atol(flag);
  1275: 
  1276:   return (flags);
  1277: }
  1278: 
  1279: static bitvector_t asciiflag_conv_aff(char *flag)
  1280: {
  1281:   bitvector_t flags = 0;
  1282:   int is_num = TRUE;
  1283:   char *p;
  1284: 
  1285:   for (p = flag; *p; p++) {
  1286:     if (islower(*p))
  1287:       flags |= 1 << (*p - 'a' + 1);
  1288:     else if (isupper(*p))
  1289:       flags |= 1 << (26 + (*p - 'A' + 1));
  1290: 
  1291:     /* Allow the first character to be a minus sign */
  1292:     if (!isdigit(*p) && (*p != '-' || p != flag))
  1293:       is_num = FALSE;
  1294:   }
  1295: 
  1296:   if (is_num)
  1297:     flags = atol(flag);
  1298: 
  1299:   return (flags);
  1300: }
