  1302: /* Fix for crashes in the editor when formatting. E-descs are assumed to
  1303:   * end with a \r\n. -Welcor */
  1304: void ensure_newline_terminated(struct extra_descr_data* new_descr) {
  1305:   char *with_term, *end;
  1306: 
  1307:   if (new_descr->description == NULL) {
  1308:     return;
  1309:   }
  1310: 
  1311:   end = strchr(new_descr->description, '\0');
  1312:   if (end > new_descr->description && *(end - 1) != '\n') {
  1313:     CREATE(with_term, char, strlen(new_descr->description) + 3);
  1314:     sprintf(with_term, "%s\r\n", new_descr->description); /* snprintf ok : size checked above*/
  1315:     free(new_descr->description);
  1316:     new_descr->description = with_term;
  1317:   }
  1318: }
  1319: 
  1320: /* load the rooms */
  1321: void parse_room(FILE *fl, int virtual_nr)
  1322: {
  1323:   static int room_nr = 0, zone = 0;
  1324:   int t[10], i, retval;
  1325:   char line[READ_SIZE], flags[128], flags2[128], flags3[128];
  1326:   char flags4[128], buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf[128];
  1327:   struct extra_descr_data *new_descr;
  1328:   char letter;
  1329: 
  1330:   /* This really had better fit or there are other problems. */
  1331:   snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "room #%d", virtual_nr);
  1332: 
  1333:   if (virtual_nr < zone_table[zone].bot) {
  1334:     log("SYSERR: Room #%d is below zone %d (bot=%d, top=%d).", virtual_nr, zone_table[zone].number, zone_table[zone].bot, zone_table[zone].top);
  1335:     exit(1);
  1336:   }
  1337:   while (virtual_nr > zone_table[zone].top)
  1338:     if (++zone > top_of_zone_table) {
  1339:       log("SYSERR: Room %d is outside of any zone.", virtual_nr);
  1340:       exit(1);
  1341:     }
  1342:   world[room_nr].zone = zone;
  1343:   world[room_nr].number = virtual_nr;
  1344:   world[room_nr].name = fread_string(fl, buf2);
  1345:   world[room_nr].description = fread_string(fl, buf2);
  1346: 
  1347:   if (!get_line(fl, line)) {
  1348:     log("SYSERR: Expecting roomflags/sector type of room #%d but file ended!",
  1349: 	virtual_nr);
  1350:     exit(1);
  1351:   }
  1352: 
  1353:   if (((retval = sscanf(line, " %d %s %s %s %s %d ", t, flags, flags2, flags3, flags4, t + 2)) == 3) && (bitwarning == TRUE)) {
  1354:     log("WARNING: Conventional world files detected. See config.c.");
  1355:     exit(1);
  1356:   } else if ((retval == 3) && (bitwarning == FALSE)) {
  1357:     /* Looks like the implementor is ready, so let's load the world files. We
  1358:      * load the extra three flags as 0, since they won't be anything anyway. We
  1359:      * will save the entire world later on, when every room, mobile, and object
  1360:      * is converted. */
  1361:     log("Converting room #%d to 128bits..", virtual_nr);
  1362:     world[room_nr].room_flags[0] = asciiflag_conv(flags);
  1363:     world[room_nr].room_flags[1] = 0;
  1364:     world[room_nr].room_flags[2] = 0;
  1365:     world[room_nr].room_flags[3] = 0;
  1366: 
  1367:     /* In the old-style files, the 3rd item was the sector-type */
  1368:     world[room_nr].sector_type = atoi(flags2);
  1369: 
  1370:    sprintf(flags, "room #%d", virtual_nr);	/* sprintf: OK (until 399-bit integers) */
  1371: 
  1372:     /* No need to scan the other three sections; they're 0 anyway. */
  1373:     check_bitvector_names(world[room_nr].room_flags[0], room_bits_count, flags, "room");
  1374: 
  1375:     if(bitsavetodisk) { /* Maybe the implementor just wants to look at the 128bit files */
  1376:       add_to_save_list(zone_table[real_zone_by_thing(virtual_nr)].number, 3);
  1377:       converting = TRUE;
  1378:     }
  1379: 
  1380:   log("   done.");
  1381:   } else if (retval == 6) {
  1382:     int taeller;
  1383: 
  1384:     world[room_nr].room_flags[0] = asciiflag_conv(flags);
  1385:     world[room_nr].room_flags[1] = asciiflag_conv(flags2);
  1386:     world[room_nr].room_flags[2] = asciiflag_conv(flags3);
  1387:     world[room_nr].room_flags[3] = asciiflag_conv(flags4);
  1388: 
  1389:     sprintf(flags, "room #%d", virtual_nr);	/* sprintf: OK (until 399-bit integers) */
  1390:     for(taeller=0; taeller < AF_ARRAY_MAX; taeller++)
  1391:       check_bitvector_names(world[room_nr].room_flags[taeller], room_bits_count, flags, "room");
  1392: 
  1393:     /* Added Sanity check */
  1394:     if (t[2] > NUM_ROOM_SECTORS) t[2] = SECT_INSIDE;
  1395: 
  1396:     world[room_nr].sector_type = t[2];
  1397:     } else {
  1398:       log("SYSERR: Format error in roomflags/sector type of room #%d", virtual_nr);
  1399:     exit(1);
  1400:   }
  1401: 
  1402:   world[room_nr].func = NULL;
  1403:   world[room_nr].contents = NULL;
  1404:   world[room_nr].people = NULL;
  1405:   world[room_nr].light = 0;	/* Zero light sources */
  1406: 
  1407:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_OF_DIRS; i++) /* NUM_OF_DIRS here, not DIR_COUNT */
  1408:     world[room_nr].dir_option[i] = NULL;
  1409: 
  1410:   world[room_nr].ex_description = NULL;
  1411: 
  1412:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "SYSERR: Format error in room #%d (expecting D/E/S)", virtual_nr);
  1413: 
  1414:   for (;;) {
  1415:     if (!get_line(fl, line)) {
  1416:       log("%s", buf);
  1417:       exit(1);
  1418:     }
  1419:     switch (*line) {
  1420:     case 'D':
  1421:       setup_dir(fl, room_nr, atoi(line + 1));
  1422:       break;
  1423:     case 'E':
  1424:       CREATE(new_descr, struct extra_descr_data, 1);
  1425:       new_descr->keyword = fread_string(fl, buf2);
  1426:       new_descr->description = fread_string(fl, buf2);
  1427:       ensure_newline_terminated(new_descr);
  1428: 
  1429:       new_descr->next = world[room_nr].ex_description;
  1430:       world[room_nr].ex_description = new_descr;
  1431:       break;
  1432:     case 'S':			/* end of room */
  1433:       /* DG triggers -- script is defined after the end of the room */
  1434:       letter = fread_letter(fl);
  1435:       ungetc(letter, fl);
  1436:       while (letter=='T') {
  1437:         dg_read_trigger(fl, &world[room_nr], WLD_TRIGGER);
  1438:         letter = fread_letter(fl);
  1439:         ungetc(letter, fl);
  1440:       }
  1441:       top_of_world = room_nr++;
  1442:       return;
  1443:     default:
  1444:       log("%s", buf);
  1445:       exit(1);
  1446:     }
  1447:   }
  1448: }
  1449: 
  1450: /* read direction data */
  1451: void setup_dir(FILE *fl, int room, int dir)
  1452: {
  1453:   int t[5];
  1454:   char line[READ_SIZE], buf2[128];
  1455: 
  1456:   snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "room #%d, direction D%d", GET_ROOM_VNUM(room)+1, dir);
  1457: 
  1458:   if (!CONFIG_DIAGONAL_DIRS && IS_DIAGONAL(dir)) {
  1459:     log("Warning: Diagonal direction disabled: %s", buf2);
  1460:     return;
  1461:   }
  1462: 
  1463:   CREATE(world[room].dir_option[dir], struct room_direction_data, 1);
  1464:   world[room].dir_option[dir]->general_description = fread_string(fl, buf2);
  1465:   world[room].dir_option[dir]->keyword = fread_string(fl, buf2);
  1466: 
  1467:   if (!get_line(fl, line)) {
  1468:     log("SYSERR: Format error, %s", buf2);
  1469:     exit(1);
  1470:   }
  1471:   if (sscanf(line, " %d %d %d ", t, t + 1, t + 2) != 3) {
  1472:     log("SYSERR: Format error, %s", buf2);
  1473:     exit(1);
  1474:   }
  1475:   if (t[0] == 1)
  1476:     world[room].dir_option[dir]->exit_info = EX_ISDOOR;
  1477:   else if (t[0] == 2)
  1478:     world[room].dir_option[dir]->exit_info = EX_ISDOOR | EX_PICKPROOF;
  1479:   else if (t[0] == 3)
  1480:     world[room].dir_option[dir]->exit_info = EX_ISDOOR | EX_HIDDEN;
  1481:   else if (t[0] == 4)
  1482:     world[room].dir_option[dir]->exit_info = EX_ISDOOR | EX_PICKPROOF | EX_HIDDEN;
  1483:   else
  1484:     world[room].dir_option[dir]->exit_info = 0;
  1485: 
  1486:   world[room].dir_option[dir]->key = ((t[1] == -1 || t[1] == 65535) ? NOTHING : t[1]);
  1487:   world[room].dir_option[dir]->to_room = ((t[2] == -1  || t[2] == 0) ? NOWHERE : t[2]);
  1488: }
  1489: 
  1490: /* make sure the start rooms exist & resolve their vnums to rnums */
  1491: static void check_start_rooms(void)
  1492: {
  1493:   if ((r_mortal_start_room = real_room(CONFIG_MORTAL_START)) == NOWHERE) {
  1494:     log("SYSERR:  Mortal start room does not exist.  Change in config.c.");
  1495:     exit(1);
  1496:   }
  1497:   if ((r_immort_start_room = real_room(CONFIG_IMMORTAL_START)) == NOWHERE) {
  1498:     if (!mini_mud)
  1499:       log("SYSERR:  Warning: Immort start room does not exist.  Change in config.c.");
  1500:     r_immort_start_room = r_mortal_start_room;
  1501:   }
  1502:   if ((r_frozen_start_room = real_room(CONFIG_FROZEN_START)) == NOWHERE) {
  1503:     if (!mini_mud)
  1504:       log("SYSERR:  Warning: Frozen start room does not exist.  Change in config.c.");
  1505:     r_frozen_start_room = r_mortal_start_room;
  1506:   }
  1507: }
  1508: 
  1509: /* resolve all vnums into rnums in the world */
  1510: void renum_world(void)
  1511: {
  1512:   int room, door;
  1513: 
  1514:   for (room = 0; room <= top_of_world; room++)
  1515:     for (door = 0; door < NUM_OF_DIRS; door++)
  1516:       if (world[room].dir_option[door])
  1517: 	if (world[room].dir_option[door]->to_room != NOWHERE)
  1518: 	  world[room].dir_option[door]->to_room =
  1519: 	    real_room(world[room].dir_option[door]->to_room);
  1520: }
  1521: 
  1522: /** This is not the same ZCMD as used elsewhere. GRUMBLE... namespace conflict
  1523:  * @todo refactor this particular ZCMD and remove this redefine. */
  1524: #ifdef ZCMD
  1525: #undef ZCMD
  1526: #endif
  1527: #define ZCMD zone_table[zone].cmd[cmd_no]
  1528: 
  1529: /* Resolve vnums into rnums in the zone reset tables. In English: Once all of
  1530:  * the zone reset tables have been loaded, we resolve the virtual numbers into
  1531:  * real numbers all at once so we don't have to do it repeatedly while the game
  1532:  * is running.  This does make adding any room, mobile, or object a little more
  1533:  * difficult while the game is running. Assumes NOWHERE == NOBODY == NOTHING.
  1534:  * Assumes sizeof(room_rnum) >= (sizeof(mob_rnum) and sizeof(obj_rnum)) */
  1535: static void renum_zone_table(void)
  1536: {
  1537:   int cmd_no;
  1538:   room_rnum a, b, c, olda, oldb, oldc;
  1539:   zone_rnum zone;
  1540:   char buf[128];
  1541: 
  1542:   for (zone = 0; zone <= top_of_zone_table; zone++)
  1543:     for (cmd_no = 0; ZCMD.command != 'S'; cmd_no++) {
  1544:       a = b = c = 0;
  1545:       olda = ZCMD.arg1;
  1546:       oldb = ZCMD.arg2;
  1547:       oldc = ZCMD.arg3;
  1548:       switch (ZCMD.command) {
  1549:       case 'M':
  1550: 	a = ZCMD.arg1 = real_mobile(ZCMD.arg1);
  1551: 	c = ZCMD.arg3 = real_room(ZCMD.arg3);
  1552: 	break;
  1553:       case 'O':
  1554: 	a = ZCMD.arg1 = real_object(ZCMD.arg1);
  1555: 	if (ZCMD.arg3 != NOWHERE)
  1556: 	  c = ZCMD.arg3 = real_room(ZCMD.arg3);
  1557: 	break;
  1558:       case 'G':
  1559: 	a = ZCMD.arg1 = real_object(ZCMD.arg1);
  1560: 	break;
  1561:       case 'E':
  1562: 	a = ZCMD.arg1 = real_object(ZCMD.arg1);
  1563: 	break;
  1564:       case 'P':
  1565: 	a = ZCMD.arg1 = real_object(ZCMD.arg1);
  1566: 	c = ZCMD.arg3 = real_object(ZCMD.arg3);
  1567: 	break;
  1568:       case 'D':
  1569: 	a = ZCMD.arg1 = real_room(ZCMD.arg1);
  1570: 	break;
  1571:       case 'R': /* rem obj from room */
  1572:         a = ZCMD.arg1 = real_room(ZCMD.arg1);
  1573: 	b = ZCMD.arg2 = real_object(ZCMD.arg2);
  1574:         break;
  1575:       case 'T': /* a trigger */
  1576:         b = ZCMD.arg2 = real_trigger(ZCMD.arg2);
  1577:         c = ZCMD.arg3 = real_room(ZCMD.arg3);
  1578:         break;
  1579:       case 'V': /* trigger variable assignment */
  1580:         b = ZCMD.arg3 = real_room(ZCMD.arg3);
  1581:         break;
  1582:       }
  1583:       if (a == NOWHERE || b == NOWHERE || c == NOWHERE) {
  1584: 	if (!mini_mud) {
  1585: 	  snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Invalid vnum %d, cmd disabled",
  1586: 			 a == NOWHERE ? olda : b == NOWHERE ? oldb : oldc);
  1587: 	  log_zone_error(zone, cmd_no, buf);
  1588: 	}
  1589: 	ZCMD.command = '*';
  1590:       }
  1591:     }
  1592: }
  1593: 
  1594: static void parse_simple_mob(FILE *mob_f, int i, int nr)
  1595: {
  1596:   int j, t[10];
  1597:   char line[READ_SIZE];
  1598: 
  1599:   mob_proto[i].real_abils.str = 11;
  1600:   mob_proto[i].real_abils.intel = 11;
  1601:   mob_proto[i].real_abils.wis = 11;
  1602:   mob_proto[i].real_abils.dex = 11;
  1603:   mob_proto[i].real_abils.con = 11;
  1604:   mob_proto[i].real_abils.cha = 11;
  1605: 
  1606:   if (!get_line(mob_f, line)) {
  1607:     log("SYSERR: Format error in mob #%d, file ended after S flag!", nr);
  1608:     exit(1);
  1609:   }
  1610: 
  1611:   if (sscanf(line, " %d %d %d %dd%d+%d %dd%d+%d ",
  1612: 	  t, t + 1, t + 2, t + 3, t + 4, t + 5, t + 6, t + 7, t + 8) != 9) {
  1613:     log("SYSERR: Format error in mob #%d, first line after S flag\n"
  1614: 	"...expecting line of form '# # # #d#+# #d#+#'", nr);
  1615:     exit(1);
  1616:   }
  1617: 
  1618:   GET_LEVEL(mob_proto + i) = t[0];
  1619:   GET_HITROLL(mob_proto + i) = 20 - t[1];
  1620:   {
  1621:     int legacy_ac = 10 * t[2];
  1622:     GET_AC(mob_proto + i) = legacy_ac_to_armor(legacy_ac);
  1623:     GET_EVASION(mob_proto + i) = 0;
  1624:   }
  1625: 
  1626:   /* max hit = 0 is a flag that H, M, V is xdy+z */
  1627:   GET_MAX_HIT(mob_proto + i) = 0;
  1628:   GET_HIT(mob_proto + i) = t[3];
  1629:   GET_MANA(mob_proto + i) = t[4];
  1630:   GET_MOVE(mob_proto + i) = t[5];
  1631: 
  1632:   GET_MAX_MANA(mob_proto + i) = 10;
  1633:   GET_MAX_MOVE(mob_proto + i) = 50;
  1634: 
  1635:   mob_proto[i].mob_specials.damnodice = t[6];
  1636:   mob_proto[i].mob_specials.damsizedice = t[7];
  1637:   GET_DAMROLL(mob_proto + i) = t[8];
  1638: 
  1639:   if (!get_line(mob_f, line)) {
  1640:       log("SYSERR: Format error in mob #%d, second line after S flag\n"
  1641: 	  "...expecting line of form '# #', but file ended!", nr);
  1642:       exit(1);
  1643:     }
  1644: 
  1645:   if (sscanf(line, " %d %d ", t, t + 1) != 2) {
  1646:     log("SYSERR: Format error in mob #%d, second line after S flag\n"
  1647: 	"...expecting line of form '# #'", nr);
  1648:     exit(1);
  1649:   }
  1650: 
  1651:   SET_GOLD(mob_proto + i, t[0]);
  1652:   /* Default gold_min/gold_max to the base gold if not specified via E-spec. */
  1653:   if ((long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min == 0 && (long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_max == 0) {
  1654:     long long g = (long long)GET_GOLD(mob_proto + i);
  1655:     if (g < 0) g = 0;
  1656:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min = g;
  1657:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_max = g;
  1658:   }
  1659: 
  1660:   /* Clamp bad values */
  1661:   if ((long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min < 0)
  1662:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min = 0;
  1663:   if ((long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_max < (long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min)
  1664:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_max = mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min;
  1665: 
  1666:   GET_EXP(mob_proto + i) = t[1];
  1667: 
  1668:   if (!get_line(mob_f, line)) {
  1669:     log("SYSERR: Format error in last line of mob #%d\n"
  1670: 	"...expecting line of form '# # #', but file ended!", nr);
  1671:     exit(1);
  1672:   }
  1673: 
  1674:   if (sscanf(line, " %d %d %d ", t, t + 1, t + 2) != 3) {
  1675:     log("SYSERR: Format error in last line of mob #%d\n"
  1676: 	"...expecting line of form '# # #'", nr);
  1677:     exit(1);
  1678:   }
  1679: 
  1680:   GET_POS(mob_proto + i) = t[0];
  1681:   GET_DEFAULT_POS(mob_proto + i) = t[1];
  1682:   GET_SEX(mob_proto + i) = LIMIT(t[2], SEX_NEUTRAL, NUM_GENDERS - 1);
  1683: 
  1684:   GET_CLASS(mob_proto + i) = 0;
  1685:   GET_WEIGHT(mob_proto + i) = 200;
  1686:   GET_HEIGHT(mob_proto + i) = 198;
  1687: 
  1688:   /* These are now save applies; base save numbers for MOBs are now from the
  1689:    * warrior save table. */
  1690:   for (j = 0; j < NUM_OF_SAVING_THROWS; j++)
  1691:     GET_SAVE(mob_proto + i, j) = 0;
  1692: }
  1693: 
  1694: /* interpret_espec is the function that takes espec keywords and values and
  1695:  * assigns the correct value to the mob as appropriate.  Adding new e-specs is
  1696:  * absurdly easy -- just add a new CASE statement to this function! No other
  1697:  * changes need to be made anywhere in the code.
  1698:  * CASE		: Requires a parameter through 'value'. */
  1699: #define CASE(test)	\
  1700: 	if (value && !matched && !str_cmp(keyword, test) && (matched = TRUE))
  1701: #define RANGE(low, high)	\
  1702: 	(num_arg = MAX((low), MIN((high), (num_arg))))
  1703: 
  1704: static void interpret_espec(const char *keyword, const char *value, int i, int nr)
  1705: {
  1706:   int num_arg = 0, matched = FALSE;
  1707: 
  1708:   /* If there isn't a colon, there is no value.  While Boolean options are
  1709:    * possible, we don't actually have any.  Feel free to make some. */
  1710:   if (value)
  1711:     num_arg = atoi(value);
  1712: 
  1713:   CASE("BareHandAttack") {
  1714:     RANGE(0, NUM_ATTACK_TYPES - 1);
  1715:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.attack_type = num_arg;
  1716:   }
  1717: 
  1718:   CASE("Str") {
  1719:     RANGE(3, 25);
  1720:     mob_proto[i].real_abils.str = num_arg;
  1721:   }
  1722: 
  1723:   CASE("StrAdd") {
  1724:     RANGE(0, 100);
  1725:     mob_proto[i].real_abils.str_add = num_arg;
  1726:   }
  1727: 
  1728:   CASE("Int") {
  1729:     RANGE(3, 25);
  1730:     mob_proto[i].real_abils.intel = num_arg;
  1731:   }
  1732: 
  1733:   CASE("Wis") {
  1734:     RANGE(3, 25);
  1735:     mob_proto[i].real_abils.wis = num_arg;
  1736:   }
  1737: 
  1738:   CASE("Dex") {
  1739:     RANGE(3, 25);
  1740:     mob_proto[i].real_abils.dex = num_arg;
  1741:   }
  1742: 
  1743:   CASE("Con") {
  1744:     RANGE(3, 25);
  1745:     mob_proto[i].real_abils.con = num_arg;
  1746:   }
  1747: 
  1748:   CASE("Cha") {
  1749:     RANGE(3, 25);
  1750:     mob_proto[i].real_abils.cha = num_arg;
  1751:   }
  1752: 
  1753:   CASE("PetPrice") {
  1754:     RANGE(0, INT_MAX);
  1755:     GET_PET_PRICE(&mob_proto[i]) = num_arg;
  1756:   }
  1757: 
  1758: 
  1759:   CASE("GoldMin") {
  1760:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min = atoll(value);
  1761:   }
  1762: 
  1763:   CASE("GoldMax") {
  1764:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_max = atoll(value);
  1765:   }
  1766: 
  1767:   if (value && !matched && !str_cmp(keyword, "EquipItem")) {
  1768:     int vnum, wear_pos;
  1769:     matched = TRUE;
  1770:     if (sscanf(value, "%d %d", &vnum, &wear_pos) == 2) {
  1771:       if (mob_proto[i].mob_specials.equip_loadout_count < MAX_MOB_LOADOUT_ITEMS) {
  1772:         int idx = mob_proto[i].mob_specials.equip_loadout_count++;
  1773:         mob_proto[i].mob_specials.equip_loadout[idx].vnum = vnum;
  1774:         mob_proto[i].mob_specials.equip_loadout[idx].wear_pos = LIMIT(wear_pos, 0, NUM_WEARS - 1);
  1775:       } else {
  1776:         log("SYSERR: Mob #%d exceeds MAX_MOB_LOADOUT_ITEMS for EquipItem.", nr);
  1777:       }
  1778:     } else {
  1779:       log("SYSERR: Bad EquipItem format in mob #%d", nr);
  1780:     }
  1781:   }
  1782: 
  1783:   if (value && !matched && !str_cmp(keyword, "InvItem")) {
  1784:     int vnum, count;
  1785:     matched = TRUE;
  1786:     if (sscanf(value, "%d %d", &vnum, &count) == 2) {
  1787:       if (mob_proto[i].mob_specials.inventory_loadout_count < MAX_MOB_LOADOUT_ITEMS) {
  1788:         int idx = mob_proto[i].mob_specials.inventory_loadout_count++;
  1789:         mob_proto[i].mob_specials.inventory_loadout[idx].vnum = vnum;
  1790:         mob_proto[i].mob_specials.inventory_loadout[idx].count = MAX(1, count);
  1791:       } else {
  1792:         log("SYSERR: Mob #%d exceeds MAX_MOB_LOADOUT_ITEMS for InvItem.", nr);
  1793:       }
  1794:     } else {
  1795:       log("SYSERR: Bad InvItem format in mob #%d", nr);
  1796:     }
  1797:   }
  1798: 
  1799:   if (value && !matched && !str_cmp(keyword, "LootItem")) {
  1800:     int vnum, chance;
  1801:     matched = TRUE;
  1802:     if (sscanf(value, "%d %d", &vnum, &chance) == 2) {
  1803:       if (mob_proto[i].mob_specials.loot_table_count < MAX_MOB_LOOT_ITEMS) {
  1804:         int idx = mob_proto[i].mob_specials.loot_table_count++;
  1805:         mob_proto[i].mob_specials.loot_table[idx].vnum = vnum;
  1806:         mob_proto[i].mob_specials.loot_table[idx].chance = LIMIT(chance, 0, 100);
  1807:       } else {
  1808:         log("SYSERR: Mob #%d exceeds MAX_MOB_LOOT_ITEMS for LootItem.", nr);
  1809:       }
  1810:     } else {
  1811:       log("SYSERR: Bad LootItem format in mob #%d", nr);
  1812:     }
  1813:   }
  1814:   CASE("Wimpy") {
  1815:     RANGE(0, 30000);
  1816:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.wimpy_threshold = num_arg;
  1817:   }
  1818:   CASE("Evasion") {
  1819:     RANGE(0, 200);
  1820:     GET_EVASION(&mob_proto[i]) = num_arg;
  1821:   }
  1822:   CASE("SavingPara") {
  1823:     RANGE(0, 100);
  1824:     mob_proto[i].char_specials.saved.apply_saving_throw[SAVING_PARA] = num_arg;
  1825:   }
  1826: 
  1827:   CASE("SavingRod") {
  1828:     RANGE(0, 100);
  1829:     mob_proto[i].char_specials.saved.apply_saving_throw[SAVING_ROD] = num_arg;
  1830:   }
  1831: 
  1832:   CASE("SavingPetri") {
  1833:     RANGE(0, 100);
  1834:     mob_proto[i].char_specials.saved.apply_saving_throw[SAVING_PETRI] = num_arg;
  1835:   }
  1836: 
  1837:   CASE("SavingBreath") {
  1838:     RANGE(0, 100);
  1839:     mob_proto[i].char_specials.saved.apply_saving_throw[SAVING_BREATH] = num_arg;
  1840:   }
  1841: 
  1842:   CASE("SavingSpell") {
  1843:     RANGE(0, 100);
  1844:     mob_proto[i].char_specials.saved.apply_saving_throw[SAVING_SPELL] = num_arg;
  1845:   }
  1846: 
  1847:   if (!matched) {
  1848:     log("SYSERR: Warning: unrecognized espec keyword %s in mob #%d",
  1849: 	    keyword, nr);
  1850:   }
  1851: }
  1852: 
  1853: #undef CASE
  1854: #undef BOOL_CASE
  1855: #undef RANGE
  1856: 
  1857: static void parse_espec(char *buf, int i, int nr)
  1858: {
  1859:   char *ptr;
  1860: 
  1861:   if ((ptr = strchr(buf, ':')) != NULL) {
  1862:     *(ptr++) = '\0';
  1863:     while (isspace(*ptr))
  1864:       ptr++;
  1865:   }
  1866:   interpret_espec(buf, ptr, i, nr);
  1867: }
  1868: 
  1869: static void parse_enhanced_mob(FILE *mob_f, int i, int nr)
  1870: {
  1871:   char line[READ_SIZE];
  1872: 
  1873:   parse_simple_mob(mob_f, i, nr);
  1874: 
  1875:   while (get_line(mob_f, line)) {
  1876:     if (!strcmp(line, "E"))	/* end of the enhanced section */
  1877:       return;
  1878:     else if (*line == '#') {	/* we've hit the next mob, maybe? */
  1879:       log("SYSERR: Unterminated E section in mob #%d", nr);
  1880:       exit(1);
  1881:     } else
  1882:       parse_espec(line, i, nr);
  1883: 
  1884:   /*
  1885:    * GoldMin/GoldMax legacy fix:
  1886:    * If mob files contain GoldMin: 0 and GoldMax: 0, they override base gold to 0 drops.
  1887:    * If base gold is non-zero, treat 0/0 as "unspecified" and default min/max to base gold.
  1888:    * Builders can still force no-gold by setting base gold to 0.
  1889:    */
  1890:   if ((long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min == 0 &&
  1891:       (long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_max == 0) {
  1892:     long long g = (long long)GET_GOLD(mob_proto + i);
  1893:     if (g > 0) {
  1894:       mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min = g;
  1895:       mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_max = g;
  1896:     }
  1897:   }
  1898: 
  1899:   /* Clamp bad values */
  1900:   if ((long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min < 0)
  1901:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min = 0;
  1902:   if ((long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_max < (long long)mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min)
  1903:     mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_max = mob_proto[i].mob_specials.gold_min;
  1904: 
  1905:   }
  1906: 
  1907:   log("SYSERR: Unexpected end of file reached after mob #%d", nr);
  1908:   exit(1);
  1909: }
  1910: 
  1911: void parse_mobile(FILE *mob_f, int nr)
  1912: {
  1913:   static int i = 0;
  1914:   int j, t[10], retval;
  1915:   char line[READ_SIZE], *tmpptr, letter;
  1916:   char f1[128], f2[128], f3[128], f4[128], f5[128], f6[128], f7[128], f8[128], buf2[128];
  1917: 
  1918:   mob_index[i].vnum = nr;
  1919:   mob_index[i].number = 0;
  1920:   mob_index[i].func = NULL;
  1921: 
  1922:   clear_char(mob_proto + i);
  1923: 
  1924:   /* Mobiles should NEVER use anything in the 'player_specials' structure.
  1925:    * The only reason we have every mob in the game share this copy of the
  1926:    * structure is to save newbie coders from themselves. -gg */
  1927:   mob_proto[i].player_specials = &dummy_mob;
  1928:   sprintf(buf2, "mob vnum %d", nr);	/* sprintf: OK (for 'buf2 >= 19') */
  1929: 
  1930:   /* String data */
  1931:   mob_proto[i].player.name = fread_string(mob_f, buf2);
  1932:   tmpptr = mob_proto[i].player.short_descr = fread_string(mob_f, buf2);
  1933:   if (tmpptr && *tmpptr)
  1934:     if (!str_cmp(fname(tmpptr), "a") || !str_cmp(fname(tmpptr), "an") ||
  1935: 	!str_cmp(fname(tmpptr), "the"))
  1936:       *tmpptr = LOWER(*tmpptr);
  1937:   mob_proto[i].player.long_descr = fread_string(mob_f, buf2);
  1938:   mob_proto[i].player.description = fread_string(mob_f, buf2);
  1939:   GET_TITLE(mob_proto + i) = NULL;
  1940: 
  1941:   /* Numeric data */
  1942:   if (!get_line(mob_f, line)) {
  1943:     log("SYSERR: Format error after string section of mob #%d\n"
  1944: 	"...expecting line of form '# # # {S | E}', but file ended!", nr);
  1945:     exit(1);
  1946:   }
  1947: 
  1948:   if (((retval = sscanf(line, "%s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %d %c", f1, f2, f3, f4, f5, f6, f7, f8, t + 2, &letter)) != 10) && (bitwarning == TRUE)) {
  1949:     /* Let's make the implementor read some, before converting his world files. */
  1950:     log("WARNING: Conventional mobile files detected. See config.c.");
  1951:     exit(1);
  1952:   } else if ((retval == 4) && (bitwarning == FALSE)) {
  1953:     log("Converting mobile #%d to 128bits..", nr);
  1954:     MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f1);
  1955:     MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[1] = 0;
  1956:     MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[2] = 0;
  1957:     MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[3] = 0;
  1958:     check_bitvector_names(MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[0], action_bits_count, buf2, "mobile");
  1959: 
  1960:     AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv_aff(f2);
  1961:     AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[1] = 0;
  1962:     AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[2] = 0;
  1963:     AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[3] = 0;
  1964: 
  1965:     GET_ALIGNMENT(mob_proto + i) = atoi(f3);
  1966: 
  1967:     /* Make some basic checks. */
  1968:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i), AFF_CHARM);
  1969:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i), AFF_POISON);
  1970:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i), AFF_SLEEP);
  1971:     if (MOB_FLAGGED(mob_proto + i, MOB_AGGRESSIVE) && MOB_FLAGGED(mob_proto + i, MOB_AGGR_GOOD))
  1972:       REMOVE_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i), MOB_AGGR_GOOD);
  1973:     if (MOB_FLAGGED(mob_proto + i, MOB_AGGRESSIVE) && MOB_FLAGGED(mob_proto + i, MOB_AGGR_NEUTRAL))
  1974:       REMOVE_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i), MOB_AGGR_NEUTRAL);
  1975:     if (MOB_FLAGGED(mob_proto + i, MOB_AGGRESSIVE) && MOB_FLAGGED(mob_proto + i, MOB_AGGR_EVIL))
  1976:       REMOVE_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i), MOB_AGGR_EVIL);
  1977: 
  1978:     check_bitvector_names(AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[0], affected_bits_count, buf2, "mobile affect");
  1979: 
  1980:     /* This is necessary, since if we have conventional world files, &letter is
  1981:      * loaded into f4 instead of the letter characters. So what we do, is copy
  1982:      * f4 into letter. Disadvantage is that &letter cannot be longer then 128
  1983:      * characters, but this shouldn't occur anyway. */
  1984:     letter = *f4;
  1985: 
  1986:     if(bitsavetodisk) {
  1987:       add_to_save_list(zone_table[real_zone_by_thing(nr)].number, 0);
  1988:       converting =TRUE;
  1989:     }
  1990: 
  1991:   log("   done.");
  1992:   } else if (retval == 10) {
  1993:     int taeller;
  1994: 
  1995:     MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f1);
  1996:     MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[1] = asciiflag_conv(f2);
  1997:     MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[2] = asciiflag_conv(f3);
  1998:     MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[3] = asciiflag_conv(f4);
  1999:     for(taeller=0; taeller < AF_ARRAY_MAX; taeller++)
  2000:       check_bitvector_names(MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[taeller], action_bits_count, buf2, "mobile");
  2001: 
  2002:     AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f5);
  2003:     AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[1] = asciiflag_conv(f6);
  2004:     AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[2] = asciiflag_conv(f7);
  2005:     AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[3] = asciiflag_conv(f8);
  2006: 
  2007:     GET_ALIGNMENT(mob_proto + i) = t[2];
  2008: 
  2009:     for(taeller=0; taeller < AF_ARRAY_MAX; taeller++)
  2010:       check_bitvector_names(AFF_FLAGS(mob_proto + i)[taeller], affected_bits_count, buf2, "mobile affect");
  2011:   } else {
  2012:     log("SYSERR: Format error after string section of mob #%d\n ...expecting line of form '# # # {S | E}'", nr);
  2013:     exit(1);
  2014:   }
  2015: 
  2016:   SET_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i), MOB_ISNPC);
  2017:   if (MOB_FLAGGED(mob_proto + i, MOB_NOTDEADYET)) {
  2018:     /* Rather bad to load mobiles with this bit already set. */
  2019:     log("SYSERR: Mob #%d has reserved bit MOB_NOTDEADYET set.", nr);
  2020:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(mob_proto + i), MOB_NOTDEADYET);
  2021:   }
  2022: 
  2023:   switch (UPPER(letter)) {
  2024:   case 'S':	/* Simple monsters */
  2025:     parse_simple_mob(mob_f, i, nr);
  2026:     break;
  2027:   case 'E':	/* Circle3 Enhanced monsters */
  2028:     parse_enhanced_mob(mob_f, i, nr);
  2029:     break;
  2030:   /* add new mob types here.. */
  2031:   default:
  2032:     log("SYSERR: Unsupported mob type '%c' in mob #%d", letter, nr);
  2033:     exit(1);
  2034:   }
  2035: 
  2036:   /* DG triggers -- script info follows mob S/E section */
  2037:   letter = fread_letter(mob_f);
  2038:   ungetc(letter, mob_f);
  2039:   while (letter=='T') {
  2040:     dg_read_trigger(mob_f, &mob_proto[i], MOB_TRIGGER);
  2041:     letter = fread_letter(mob_f);
  2042:     ungetc(letter, mob_f);
  2043:   }
  2044: 
  2045:   mob_proto[i].aff_abils = mob_proto[i].real_abils;
  2046: 
  2047:   for (j = 0; j < NUM_WEARS; j++)
  2048:     mob_proto[i].equipment[j] = NULL;
  2049: 
  2050:   mob_proto[i].nr = i;
  2051:   mob_proto[i].desc = NULL;
  2052: 
  2053:   top_of_mobt = i++;
  2054: }
  2055: 
  2056: /* read all objects from obj file; generate index and prototypes */
  2057: char *parse_object(FILE *obj_f, int nr)
  2058: {
  2059:   static int i = 0;
  2060:   static char line[READ_SIZE];
  2061:   int t[10], j, retval;
  2062:   char *tmpptr, buf2[128], f1[READ_SIZE], f2[READ_SIZE], f3[READ_SIZE], f4[READ_SIZE];
  2063:   char f5[READ_SIZE], f6[READ_SIZE], f7[READ_SIZE], f8[READ_SIZE];
  2064:   char f9[READ_SIZE], f10[READ_SIZE], f11[READ_SIZE], f12[READ_SIZE];
  2065:   struct extra_descr_data *new_descr;
  2066: 
  2067:   obj_index[i].vnum = nr;
  2068:   obj_index[i].number = 0;
  2069:   obj_index[i].func = NULL;
  2070: 
  2071:   clear_object(obj_proto + i);
  2072:   obj_proto[i].item_number = i;
  2073: 
  2074:   sprintf(buf2, "object #%d", nr);	/* sprintf: OK (for 'buf2 >= 19') */
  2075: 
  2076:   /* string data */
  2077:   if ((obj_proto[i].name = fread_string(obj_f, buf2)) == NULL) {
  2078:     log("SYSERR: Null obj name or format error at or near %s", buf2);
  2079:     exit(1);
  2080:   }
  2081:   tmpptr = obj_proto[i].short_description = fread_string(obj_f, buf2);
  2082:   if (tmpptr && *tmpptr)
  2083:     if (!str_cmp(fname(tmpptr), "a") || !str_cmp(fname(tmpptr), "an") ||
  2084: 	!str_cmp(fname(tmpptr), "the"))
  2085:       *tmpptr = LOWER(*tmpptr);
  2086: 
  2087:   tmpptr = obj_proto[i].description = fread_string(obj_f, buf2);
  2088:   if (tmpptr && *tmpptr)
  2089:     CAP(tmpptr);
  2090:   obj_proto[i].action_description = fread_string(obj_f, buf2);
  2091: 
  2092:   /* numeric data */
  2093:   if (!get_line(obj_f, line)) {
  2094:     log("SYSERR: Expecting first numeric line of %s, but file ended!", buf2);
  2095:     exit(1);
  2096:   }
  2097: 
  2098:   if (((retval = sscanf(line, " %d %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s", t, f1, f2, f3,
  2099:       f4, f5, f6, f7, f8, f9, f10, f11, f12)) == 4) && (bitwarning == TRUE)) {
  2100:     /* Let's make the implementor read some, before converting his world files. */
  2101:     log("WARNING: Conventional object files detected. Please see config.c.");
  2102:     exit(1);
  2103:   } else if (((retval == 4) || (retval == 3)) && (bitwarning == FALSE)) {
  2104: 
  2105:     if (retval == 3)
  2106:       t[3] = 0;
  2107:     else if (retval == 4)
  2108:       t[3] = asciiflag_conv_aff(f3);
  2109: 
  2110:     log("Converting object #%d to 128bits..", nr);
  2111:     GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f1);
  2112:     GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj_proto + i)[1] = 0;
  2113:     GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj_proto + i)[2] = 0;
  2114:     GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj_proto + i)[3] = 0;
  2115:     GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f2);
  2116:     GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj_proto + i)[1] = 0;
  2117:     GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj_proto + i)[2] = 0;
  2118:     GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj_proto + i)[3] = 0;
  2119:     GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv_aff(f3);
  2120:     GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj_proto + i)[1] = 0;
  2121:     GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj_proto + i)[2] = 0;
  2122:     GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj_proto + i)[3] = 0;
  2123: 
  2124:     if(bitsavetodisk) {
  2125:       add_to_save_list(zone_table[real_zone_by_thing(nr)].number, 1);
  2126:       converting = TRUE;
  2127:     }
  2128: 
  2129:     log("   done.");
  2130:   } else if (retval == 13) {
  2131: 
  2132:     GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f1);
  2133:     GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj_proto + i)[1] = asciiflag_conv(f2);
  2134:     GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj_proto + i)[2] = asciiflag_conv(f3);
  2135:     GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj_proto + i)[3] = asciiflag_conv(f4);
  2136:     GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f5);
  2137:     GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj_proto + i)[1] = asciiflag_conv(f6);
  2138:     GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj_proto + i)[2] = asciiflag_conv(f7);
  2139:     GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj_proto + i)[3] = asciiflag_conv(f8);
  2140:     GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj_proto + i)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f9);
  2141:     GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj_proto + i)[1] = asciiflag_conv(f10);
  2142:     GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj_proto + i)[2] = asciiflag_conv(f11);
  2143:     GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj_proto + i)[3] = asciiflag_conv(f12);
  2144: 
  2145:   } else {
  2146:     log("SYSERR: Format error in first numeric line (expecting 13 args, got %d), %s", retval, buf2);
  2147:     exit(1);
  2148:   }
  2149: 
  2150:   /* Object flags checked in check_object(). */
  2151:   GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj_proto + i) = t[0];
  2152: 
  2153:   if (!get_line(obj_f, line)) {
  2154:     log("SYSERR: Expecting second numeric line of %s, but file ended!", buf2);
  2155:     exit(1);
  2156:   }
  2157:   if ((retval = sscanf(line, "%d %d %d %d", t, t + 1, t + 2, t + 3)) != 4) {
  2158:     log("SYSERR: Format error in second numeric line (expecting 4 args, got %d), %s", retval, buf2);
  2159:     exit(1);
  2160:   }
  2161:   GET_OBJ_VAL(obj_proto + i, 0) = t[0];
  2162:   GET_OBJ_VAL(obj_proto + i, 1) = t[1];
  2163:   GET_OBJ_VAL(obj_proto + i, 2) = t[2];
  2164:   GET_OBJ_VAL(obj_proto + i, 3) = t[3];
  2165: 
  2166:   if (!get_line(obj_f, line)) {
  2167:     log("SYSERR: Expecting third numeric line of %s, but file ended!", buf2);
  2168:     exit(1);
  2169:   }
  2170:   if ((retval = sscanf(line, "%d %d %d %d %d", t, t + 1, t + 2, t + 3, t + 4)) != 5) {
  2171:     if (retval == 3) {
  2172:       t[3] = 0;
  2173:       t[4] = 0;
  2174:     } else if (retval == 4)
  2175:       t[4] = 0;
  2176:     else {
  2177:       log("SYSERR: Format error in third numeric line (expecting 5 args, got %d), %s", retval, buf2);
  2178:       exit(1);
  2179:     }
  2180:   }
  2181: 
  2182:   GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj_proto + i) = t[0];
  2183:   GET_OBJ_COST(obj_proto + i) = t[1];
  2184:   GET_OBJ_RENT(obj_proto + i) = t[2];
  2185:   GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj_proto + i) = t[3];
  2186:   GET_OBJ_TIMER(obj_proto + i) = t[4];
  2187: 
  2188:   obj_proto[i].sitting_here = NULL;
  2189: 
  2190:   /* check to make sure that weight of containers exceeds curr. quantity */
  2191:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj_proto + i) == ITEM_DRINKCON ||
  2192:       GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj_proto + i) == ITEM_FOUNTAIN) {
  2193:     if (GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj_proto + i) < GET_OBJ_VAL(obj_proto + i, 1) && CAN_WEAR(obj_proto + i, ITEM_WEAR_TAKE))
  2194:       GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj_proto + i) = GET_OBJ_VAL(obj_proto + i, 1) + 5;
  2195:   }
  2196: 
  2197:   /* extra descriptions and affect fields */
  2198:   for (j = 0; j < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; j++) {
  2199:     obj_proto[i].affected[j].location = APPLY_NONE;
  2200:     obj_proto[i].affected[j].modifier = 0;
  2201:   }
  2202: 
  2203:   strcat(buf2, ", after numeric constants\n" /* strcat: OK (for 'buf2 >= 87') */
  2204: 	 "...expecting 'E', 'A', '$', or next object number");
  2205:   j = 0;
  2206: 
  2207:   for (;;) {
  2208:     if (!get_line(obj_f, line)) {
  2209:       log("SYSERR: Format error in %s", buf2);
  2210:       exit(1);
  2211:     }
  2212:     switch (*line) {
  2213:     case 'E':
  2214:       CREATE(new_descr, struct extra_descr_data, 1);
  2215:       new_descr->keyword = fread_string(obj_f, buf2);
  2216:       new_descr->description = fread_string(obj_f, buf2);
  2217:       new_descr->next = obj_proto[i].ex_description;
  2218:       obj_proto[i].ex_description = new_descr;
  2219:       break;
  2220:     case 'A':
  2221:       if (j >= MAX_OBJ_AFFECT) {
  2222: 	log("SYSERR: Too many A fields (%d max), %s", MAX_OBJ_AFFECT, buf2);
  2223: 	exit(1);
  2224:       }
  2225:       if (!get_line(obj_f, line)) {
  2226: 	log("SYSERR: Format error in 'A' field, %s\n"
  2227: 	    "...expecting 2 numeric constants but file ended!", buf2);
  2228: 	exit(1);
  2229:       }
  2230: 
  2231:       if ((retval = sscanf(line, " %d %d ", t, t + 1)) != 2) {
  2232: 	log("SYSERR: Format error in 'A' field, %s\n"
  2233: 	    "...expecting 2 numeric arguments, got %d\n"
  2234: 	    "...offending line: '%s'", buf2, retval, line);
  2235: 	exit(1);
  2236:       }
  2237:       obj_proto[i].affected[j].location = t[0];
  2238:       obj_proto[i].affected[j].modifier = t[1];
  2239:       j++;
  2240:       break;
  2241:     case 'T':  /* DG triggers */
  2242:       dg_obj_trigger(line, &obj_proto[i]);
  2243:       break;
  2244:     case '$':
  2245:     case '#':
  2246:       top_of_objt = i;
  2247:       check_object(obj_proto + i);
  2248:       i++;
  2249:       return (line);
  2250:     default:
  2251:       log("SYSERR: Format error in (%c): %s", *line, buf2);
  2252:       exit(1);
  2253:     }
  2254:   }
  2255: }

  2257: #define Z	zone_table[zone]
  2258: /* load the zone table and command tables */
  2259: static void load_zones(FILE *fl, char *zonename)
  2260: {
  2261:   static zone_rnum zone = 0;
  2262:   int i, cmd_no, num_of_cmds = 0, line_num = 0, tmp, error;
  2263:   char *ptr, buf[READ_SIZE], zname[READ_SIZE], buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2264:   int zone_fix = FALSE;
  2265:   char t1[80], t2[80];
  2266:   char zbuf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], zbuf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2267:   char zbuf3[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], zbuf4[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2268: 
  2269:   strlcpy(zname, zonename, sizeof(zname));
  2270: 
  2271:   /* Skip first 3 lines lest we mistake the zone name for a command. */
  2272:   for (tmp = 0; tmp < 3; tmp++)
  2273:     get_line(fl, buf);
  2274: 
  2275:   /* More accurate count. Previous was always 4 or 5 too high. -gg Note that if
  2276:    * a new zone command is added to reset_zone(), this string will need to be
  2277:    * updated to suit. - ae. */
  2278:   while (get_line(fl, buf))
  2279:     if ((strchr("MOPGERDTV", buf[0]) && buf[1] == ' ') || (buf[0] == 'S' && buf[1] == '\0'))
  2280:       num_of_cmds++;
  2281: 
  2282:   rewind(fl);
  2283: 
  2284:   if (num_of_cmds == 0) {
  2285:     log("SYSERR: %s is empty!", zname);
  2286:     exit(1);
  2287:   } else
  2288:     CREATE(Z.cmd, struct reset_com, num_of_cmds);
  2289: 
  2290:   line_num += get_line(fl, buf);
  2291: 
  2292:   if (sscanf(buf, "#%hd", &Z.number) != 1) {
  2293:     log("SYSERR: Format error in %s, line %d", zname, line_num);
  2294:     exit(1);
  2295:   }
  2296:   snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "beginning of zone #%d", Z.number);
  2297: 
  2298:   line_num += get_line(fl, buf);
  2299:   if ((ptr = strchr(buf, '~')) != NULL) /* take off the '~' if it's there */
  2300:     *ptr = '\0';
  2301:   Z.builders = strdup(buf);
  2302: 
  2303:   line_num += get_line(fl, buf);
  2304:   if ((ptr = strchr(buf, '~')) != NULL)	/* take off the '~' if it's there */
  2305:     *ptr = '\0';
  2306:   Z.name = strdup(buf);
  2307:   parse_at(Z.name);
  2308: 
  2309:   /* Clear all the zone flags */
  2310:   for (i=0; i<ZN_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
  2311:     Z.zone_flags[i] = 0;
  2312: 
  2313:   line_num += get_line(fl, buf);
  2314:   /* Look for 10 items first (new tbaMUD), if not found, try 4 (old tbaMUD) */
  2315:   if  (sscanf(buf, " %hd %hd %d %d %s %s %s %s %d %d", &Z.bot, &Z.top, &Z.lifespan,
  2316:       &Z.reset_mode, zbuf1, zbuf2, zbuf3, zbuf4, &Z.min_level, &Z.max_level) != 10)
  2317:   {
  2318:     if (sscanf(buf, " %hd %hd %d %d ", &Z.bot, &Z.top, &Z.lifespan, &Z.reset_mode) != 4) {
  2319:       /* This may be due to the fact that the zone has no builder.  So, we just
  2320:        * attempt to fix this by copying the previous 2 last reads into this
  2321:        * variable and the last one. */
  2322:       log("SYSERR: Format error in numeric constant line of %s, attempting to fix.", zname);
  2323:       if (sscanf(Z.name, " %hd %hd %d %d ", &Z.bot, &Z.top, &Z.lifespan, &Z.reset_mode) != 4) {
  2324:         log("SYSERR: Could not fix previous error, aborting game.");
  2325:         exit(1);
  2326:       } else {
  2327:         free(Z.name);
  2328:         Z.name = strdup(Z.builders);
  2329:         free(Z.builders);
  2330:         Z.builders = strdup("None.");
  2331:         zone_fix = TRUE;
  2332:       }
  2333:     }
  2334:     /* We only found 4 values, so set 'defaults' for the ones not found */
  2335:     Z.min_level = -1;
  2336:     Z.max_level = -1;
  2337:   }
  2338:   else
  2339:   {
  2340:     /* We found 10 values, so deal with the strings */
  2341:     Z.zone_flags[0] = asciiflag_conv(zbuf1);
  2342:     Z.zone_flags[1] = asciiflag_conv(zbuf2);
  2343:     Z.zone_flags[2] = asciiflag_conv(zbuf3);
  2344:     Z.zone_flags[3] = asciiflag_conv(zbuf4);
  2345:   }
  2346:   if (Z.bot > Z.top) {
  2347:     log("SYSERR: Zone %d bottom (%d) > top (%d).", Z.number, Z.bot, Z.top);
  2348:     exit(1);
  2349:   }
  2350: 
  2351:   cmd_no = 0;
  2352: 
  2353:   for (;;) {
  2354:     /* skip reading one line if we fixed above (line is correct already) */
  2355:     if (zone_fix != TRUE) {
  2356:       if ((tmp = get_line(fl, buf)) == 0) {
  2357:         log("SYSERR: Format error in %s - premature end of file", zname);
  2358:         exit(1);
  2359:       }
  2360:     } else
  2361:       zone_fix = FALSE;
  2362: 
  2363:     line_num += tmp;
  2364:     ptr = buf;
  2365:     skip_spaces(&ptr);
  2366: 
  2367:     if ((ZCMD.command = *ptr) == '*')
  2368:       continue;
  2369: 
  2370:     ptr++;
  2371: 
  2372:     if (ZCMD.command == 'S' || ZCMD.command == '$') {
  2373:       ZCMD.command = 'S';
  2374:       break;
  2375:     }
  2376:     error = 0;
  2377:     if (strchr("MOGEPDTV", ZCMD.command) == NULL) {	/* a 3-arg command */
  2378:       if (sscanf(ptr, " %d %d %d ", &tmp, &ZCMD.arg1, &ZCMD.arg2) != 3)
  2379: 	error = 1;
  2380:     } else if (ZCMD.command=='V') { /* a string-arg command */
  2381:       if (sscanf(ptr, " %d %d %d %d %79s %79[^\f\n\r\t\v]", &tmp, &ZCMD.arg1, &ZCMD.arg2,
  2382: 		 &ZCMD.arg3, t1, t2) != 6)
  2383: 	error = 1;
  2384:       else {
  2385:         ZCMD.sarg1 = strdup(t1);
  2386:         ZCMD.sarg2 = strdup(t2);
  2387:       }
  2388:     } else {
  2389:       if (sscanf(ptr, " %d %d %d %d ", &tmp, &ZCMD.arg1, &ZCMD.arg2,
  2390: 		 &ZCMD.arg3) != 4)
  2391: 	error = 1;
  2392:     }
  2393: 
  2394:     ZCMD.if_flag = tmp;
  2395: 
  2396:     if (error) {
  2397:       log("SYSERR: Format error in %s, line %d: '%s'", zname, line_num, buf);
  2398:       exit(1);
  2399:     }
  2400:     ZCMD.line = line_num;
  2401:     cmd_no++;
  2402:   }
  2403: 
  2404:   if (num_of_cmds != cmd_no + 1) {
  2405:     log("SYSERR: Zone command count mismatch for %s. Estimated: %d, Actual: %d", zname, num_of_cmds, cmd_no + 1);
  2406:     exit(1);
  2407:   }
  2408: 
  2409:   top_of_zone_table = zone++;
  2410: }
  2411: #undef Z

  2413: static void get_one_line(FILE *fl, char *buf)
  2414: {
  2415:   if (fgets(buf, READ_SIZE, fl) == NULL) {
  2416:     log("SYSERR: error reading help file: not terminated with $?");
  2417:     exit(1);
  2418:   }
  2419: 
  2420:   buf[strlen(buf) - 1] = '\0'; /* take off the trailing \n */
  2421: }
  2422: 
  2423: void free_help(struct help_index_element *hentry)
  2424: {
  2425:   if (hentry->keywords)
  2426:     free(hentry->keywords);
  2427:   if (hentry->entry && !hentry->duplicate)
  2428:     free(hentry->entry);
  2429: 
  2430:   free(hentry);
  2431: }
  2432: 
  2433: void free_help_table(void)
  2434: {
  2435:   if (help_table) {
  2436:     int hp;
  2437:     for (hp = 0; hp < top_of_helpt; hp++) {
  2438:       if (help_table[hp].keywords)
  2439:         free(help_table[hp].keywords);
  2440:       if (help_table[hp].entry && !help_table[hp].duplicate)
  2441:         free(help_table[hp].entry);
  2442:     }
  2443:     free(help_table);
  2444:     help_table = NULL;
  2445:   }
  2446:   help_table_allocated = 0;
  2447:   top_of_helpt = 0;
  2448: }
  2449: 
  2450: void load_help(FILE * fl, char *name)
  2451: {
  2452:   char key[READ_SIZE + 1], next_key[READ_SIZE + 1], entry[32384];
  2453:   size_t entrylen;
  2454:   char line[READ_SIZE + 1], hname[READ_SIZE + 1], *scan;
  2455:   struct help_index_element el;
  2456: 
  2457:   strlcpy(hname, name, sizeof(hname));
  2458: 
  2459:   get_one_line(fl, key);
  2460:   while (*key != '$') {
  2461:     char *keyp = key;
  2462: 
  2463:     while (*keyp && isspace((unsigned char)*keyp))
  2464:       keyp++;
  2465: 
  2466:     if (!*keyp || *keyp == '!') {
  2467:       get_one_line(fl, key);
  2468:       continue;
  2469:     }
  2470: 
  2471:     strcat(keyp, "\r\n"); /* strcat: OK (READ_SIZE - "\n"  "\r\n" == READ_SIZE  1) */
  2472:     entrylen = strlcpy(entry, keyp, sizeof(entry));
  2473: 
  2474:     /* Read in the corresponding help entry. */
  2475:     get_one_line(fl, line);
  2476:     while (*line != '#' && entrylen < sizeof(entry) - 1) {
  2477:       entrylen += strlcpy(entry + entrylen, line, sizeof(entry) - entrylen);
  2478: 
  2479:       if (entrylen + 2 < sizeof(entry) - 1) {
  2480:         strcpy(entry + entrylen, "\r\n"); /* strcpy: OK (size checked above) */
  2481:         entrylen += 2;
  2482:       }
  2483:       get_one_line(fl, line);
  2484:     }
  2485: 
  2486:     if (entrylen >= sizeof(entry) - 1) {
  2487:       int keysize;
  2488:       const char *truncmsg = "\r\n*TRUNCATED*\r\n";
  2489: 
  2490:       strcpy(entry + sizeof(entry) - strlen(truncmsg) - 1, truncmsg); /* strcpy: OK (assuming sane 'entry' size) */
  2491: 
  2492:       keysize = strlen(key) - 2;
  2493:       log("SYSERR: Help entry exceeded buffer space: %.*s", keysize, key);
  2494: 
  2495:       /* If we ran out of buffer space, eat the rest of the entry. */
  2496:       while (*line != '#')
  2497:       get_one_line(fl, line);
  2498:     }
  2499: 
  2500:     if (*line == '#') {
  2501:       if (sscanf(line, "#%d", &el.min_level) != 1) {
  2502:         log("SYSERR: Help entry does not have a min level. %s", key);
  2503:         el.min_level = 0;
  2504:       }
  2505:     }
  2506: 
  2507:     el.duplicate = 0;
  2508:     el.entry = strdup(entry);
  2509:     parse_at(el.entry);
  2510:     scan = one_word(keyp, next_key);
  2511: 
  2512:     while (*next_key) {
  2513:       if (top_of_helpt >= help_table_allocated) {
  2514:         log("SYSERR: Help table overflow while loading %s (allocated=%d, next=%d, key='%s').",
  2515:             hname, help_table_allocated, top_of_helpt + 1, next_key);
  2516:         exit(1);
  2517:       }
  2518:       el.keywords = strdup(next_key);
  2519:       help_table[top_of_helpt++] = el;
  2520:       el.duplicate++;
  2521:       scan = one_word(scan, next_key);
  2522:     }
  2523:   get_one_line(fl, key);
  2524:   }
  2525: }
  2526: 
  2527: static int hsort(const void *a, const void *b)
  2528: {
  2529:   const struct help_index_element *a1, *b1;
  2530: 
  2531:   a1 = (const struct help_index_element *) a;
  2532:   b1 = (const struct help_index_element *) b;
  2533: 
  2534:   if (!a1 || !a1->keywords) return -1;
  2535:   if (!b1 || !b1->keywords) return 1;
  2536: 
  2537:   return (str_cmp(a1->keywords, b1->keywords));
  2538: }

  2612: static int mob_slot_required_wear_flag(int wear_pos)
  2613: {
  2614:   switch (wear_pos) {
  2615:     case WEAR_LIGHT:    return ITEM_WEAR_TAKE;
  2616:     case WEAR_FINGER_R:
  2617:     case WEAR_FINGER_L: return ITEM_WEAR_FINGER;
  2618:     case WEAR_NECK_1:   return ITEM_WEAR_NECK;
  2619:     case WEAR_BODY:     return ITEM_WEAR_BODY;
  2620:     case WEAR_HEAD:     return ITEM_WEAR_HEAD;
  2621:     case WEAR_LEGS:     return ITEM_WEAR_LEGS;
  2622:     case WEAR_FEET:     return ITEM_WEAR_FEET;
  2623:     case WEAR_HANDS:    return ITEM_WEAR_HANDS;
  2624:     case WEAR_ARMS:     return ITEM_WEAR_ARMS;
  2625:     case WEAR_SHIELD:   return ITEM_WEAR_SHIELD;
  2626:     case WEAR_ABOUT:    return ITEM_WEAR_ABOUT;
  2627:     case WEAR_WAIST:    return ITEM_WEAR_WAIST;
  2628:     case WEAR_WRIST_R:
  2629:     case WEAR_WRIST_L:  return ITEM_WEAR_WRIST;
  2630:     case WEAR_WIELD:    return ITEM_WEAR_WIELD;
  2631:     case WEAR_HOLD:     return ITEM_WEAR_TAKE;
  2632:     default:            return ITEM_WEAR_TAKE;
  2633:   }
  2634: }
  2635: 
  2636: static int mob_object_can_equip_slot(struct obj_data *obj, int wear_pos)
  2637: {
  2638:   if (!obj || wear_pos < 0 || wear_pos >= NUM_WEARS)
  2639:     return FALSE;
  2640: 
  2641:   if (wear_pos == WEAR_HOLD && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON && OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_OFFHAND) &&
  2642:       !OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_TWO_HANDER))
  2643:     return TRUE;
  2644: 
  2645:   return CAN_WEAR(obj, mob_slot_required_wear_flag(wear_pos));
  2646: }
  2647: 
  2648: static void apply_mob_loadout(struct char_data *mob)
  2649: {
  2650:   int i, j;
  2651: 
  2652:   if (!mob || !IS_NPC(mob))
  2653:     return;
  2654: 
  2655:   for (i = 0; i < mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout_count; i++) {
  2656:     int wear_pos = mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout[i].wear_pos;
  2657:     obj_rnum ornum = real_object(mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout[i].vnum);
  2658:     struct obj_data *obj;
  2659: 
  2660:     if (ornum == NOTHING || wear_pos < 0 || wear_pos >= NUM_WEARS || GET_EQ(mob, wear_pos))
  2661:       continue;
  2662: 
  2663:     obj = read_object(ornum, REAL);
  2664:     if (!obj)
  2665:       continue;
  2666: 
  2667:     /* Mirror zone reset equip behavior: fire load/wear triggers and only ever
  2668:      * keep the item on the mob (equipped or inventory), never the room. */
  2669:     if (!mob_object_can_equip_slot(obj, wear_pos)) {
  2670:       obj_to_char(obj, mob);
  2671:       continue;
  2672:     }
  2673: 
  2674:     IN_ROOM(obj) = IN_ROOM(mob);
  2675:     load_otrigger(obj);
  2676:     if (wear_otrigger(obj, mob, wear_pos) && !GET_EQ(mob, wear_pos)) {
  2677:       IN_ROOM(obj) = NOWHERE;
  2678:       equip_char(mob, obj, wear_pos);
  2679:     } else {
  2680:       IN_ROOM(obj) = NOWHERE;
  2681:       obj_to_char(obj, mob);
  2682:     }
  2683:   }
  2684: 
  2685:   for (i = 0; i < mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout_count; i++) {
  2686:     obj_rnum ornum = real_object(mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout[i].vnum);
  2687:     int count = MAX(1, mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout[i].count);
  2688:     if (ornum == NOTHING)
  2689:       continue;
  2690: 
  2691:     for (j = 0; j < count; j++) {
  2692:       struct obj_data *obj = read_object(ornum, REAL);
  2693:       if (!obj)
  2694:         break;
  2695:       IN_ROOM(obj) = IN_ROOM(mob);
  2696:       load_otrigger(obj);
  2697:       IN_ROOM(obj) = NOWHERE;
  2698:       obj_to_char(obj, mob);
  2699:     }
  2700:   }
  2701: }
  2702: 
  2703: /* Apply prototype-defined MEDIT equipment/inventory only after the live mob
  2704:  * has a real room.  The counts are cleared on the live copy afterward so
  2705:  * later movement through char_to_room() cannot duplicate the loadout. */
  2706: void apply_mob_loadout_after_placement(struct char_data *mob)
  2707: {
  2708:   if (!mob || !IS_NPC(mob) || IN_ROOM(mob) == NOWHERE)
  2709:     return;
  2710: 
  2711:   if (mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout_count <= 0 &&
  2712:       mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout_count <= 0)
  2713:     return;
  2714: 
  2715:   apply_mob_loadout(mob);
  2716:   mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout_count = 0;
  2717:   mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout_count = 0;
  2718: }
  2719: 
  2720: 
  2721: /* create a new mobile from a prototype */
  2722: struct char_data *read_mobile(mob_vnum nr, int type) /* and mob_rnum */
  2723: {
  2724:   mob_rnum i;
  2725:   struct char_data *mob;
  2726: 
  2727:   if (type == VIRTUAL) {
  2728:     if ((i = real_mobile(nr)) == NOBODY) {
  2729:       log("WARNING: Mobile vnum %d does not exist in database.", nr);
  2730:       return (NULL);
  2731:     }
  2732:   } else
  2733:     i = nr;
  2734: 
  2735:   CREATE(mob, struct char_data, 1);
  2736:   clear_char(mob);
  2737:  
  2738:   *mob = mob_proto[i];
  2739:   /* The prototype owns its persisted AI configuration.  A live mobile must
  2740:    * have its own copy because extraction releases the live configuration. */
  2741:   if (GET_SEX(mob) == SEX_RANDOM)
  2742:     GET_SEX(mob) = rand_number(SEX_MALE, SEX_FEMALE);
  2743:   mob->next = character_list;
  2744:   character_list = mob;
  2745:   
  2746:   new_mobile_data(mob);  
  2747:   
  2748:   if (!mob->points.max_hit) {
  2749:     mob->points.max_hit = dice(mob->points.hit, mob->points.mana) +
  2750:       mob->points.move;
  2751:   } else
  2752:     mob->points.max_hit = rand_number(mob->points.hit, mob->points.mana);
  2753: 
  2754:   mob->points.hit = mob->points.max_hit;
  2755:   mob->points.mana = mob->points.max_mana;
  2756:   mob->points.move = mob->points.max_move;
  2757:   GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(mob) = GET_MAX_HIT(mob);
  2758:   GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(mob) = GET_MAX_MANA(mob);
  2759:   GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(mob) = GET_MAX_MOVE(mob);
  2760: 
  2761:   mob->player.time.birth = time(0);
  2762:   mob->player.time.played = 0;
  2763:   mob->player.time.logon = time(0);
  2764: 
  2765:   mob_index[i].number++;
  2766: 
  2767:   mob->script_id = 0;	// this is set later by char_script_id
  2768: 
  2769:   copy_proto_script(&mob_proto[i], mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
  2770:   assign_triggers(mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
  2771: 
  2772:   return (mob);
  2773: }
  2774: 
  2775: /* create an object, and add it to the object list */
  2776: struct obj_data *create_obj(void)
  2777: {
  2778:   struct obj_data *obj;
  2779: 
  2780:   CREATE(obj, struct obj_data, 1);
  2781:   clear_object(obj);
  2782:   obj->next = object_list;
  2783:   object_list = obj;
  2784:   
  2785:   obj->events = NULL;
  2786: 
  2787:   obj->script_id = 0;	// this is set later by obj_script_id
  2788: 
  2789:   return (obj);
  2790: }
  2791: 
  2792: /* create a new object from a prototype */
  2793: struct obj_data *read_object(obj_vnum nr, int type) /* and obj_rnum */
  2794: {
  2795:   struct obj_data *obj;
  2796:   obj_rnum i = type == VIRTUAL ? real_object(nr) : nr;
  2797: 
  2798:   if (i == NOTHING || i > top_of_objt) {
  2799:     log("Object (%c) %d does not exist in database.", type == VIRTUAL ? 'V' : 'R', nr);
  2800:     return (NULL);
  2801:   }
  2802: 
  2803:   CREATE(obj, struct obj_data, 1);
  2804:   clear_object(obj);
  2805:   *obj = obj_proto[i];
  2806:   obj->next = object_list;
  2807:   object_list = obj;
  2808:   
  2809:   obj->events = NULL;
  2810: 
  2811:   obj_index[i].number++;
  2812: 
  2813:   obj->script_id = 0;	// this is set later by obj_script_id
  2814: 
  2815:   copy_proto_script(&obj_proto[i], obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
  2816:   assign_triggers(obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
  2817: 
  2818:   return (obj);
  2819: }
  2820: 
  2821: #define ZO_DEAD  999
  2822: /* update zone ages, queue for reset if necessary, and dequeue when possible */
  2823: void zone_update(void)
  2824: {
  2825:   int i;
  2826:   struct reset_q_element *update_u, *temp;
  2827:   static int timer = 0;
  2828: 
  2829:   /* jelson 10/22/92 */
  2830:   if (((++timer * PULSE_ZONE) / PASSES_PER_SEC) >= 60) {
  2831:     /* one minute has passed NOT accurate unless PULSE_ZONE is a multiple of
  2832:      * PASSES_PER_SEC or a factor of 60 */
  2833: 
  2834:     timer = 0;
  2835: 
  2836:     /* since one minute has passed, increment zone ages */
  2837:     for (i = 0; i <= top_of_zone_table; i++) {
  2838:       if (zone_table[i].age < zone_table[i].lifespan &&
  2839: 	  zone_table[i].reset_mode)
  2840: 	(zone_table[i].age)++;
  2841: 
  2842:       if (zone_table[i].age >= zone_table[i].lifespan &&
  2843: 	  zone_table[i].age < ZO_DEAD && zone_table[i].reset_mode) {
  2844: 	/* enqueue zone */
  2845: 
  2846: 	CREATE(update_u, struct reset_q_element, 1);
  2847: 
  2848: 	update_u->zone_to_reset = i;
  2849: 	update_u->next = 0;
  2850: 
  2851: 	if (!reset_q.head)
  2852: 	  reset_q.head = reset_q.tail = update_u;
  2853: 	else {
  2854: 	  reset_q.tail->next = update_u;
  2855: 	  reset_q.tail = update_u;
  2856: 	}
  2857: 
  2858: 	zone_table[i].age = ZO_DEAD;
  2859:       }
  2860:     }
  2861:   }	/* end - one minute has passed */
  2862: 
  2863:   /* Dequeue zones (if possible) and reset. This code is executed every 10
  2864:    * seconds (i.e. PULSE_ZONE). */
  2865:   for (update_u = reset_q.head; update_u; update_u = update_u->next)
  2866:     if (zone_table[update_u->zone_to_reset].reset_mode == 2 ||
  2867: 	is_empty(update_u->zone_to_reset)) {
  2868:       reset_zone(update_u->zone_to_reset);
  2869:       mudlog(CMP, LVL_IMPL+1, FALSE, "Auto zone reset: %s (Zone %d)",
  2870:           zone_table[update_u->zone_to_reset].name, zone_table[update_u->zone_to_reset].number);
  2871:       struct descriptor_data *pt;
  2872:       for (pt = descriptor_list; pt; pt = pt->next)
  2873:         if (IS_PLAYING(pt) && pt->character && PRF_FLAGGED(pt->character, PRF_ZONERESETS))
  2874:           send_to_char(pt->character, "%s[Auto zone reset: %s (Zone %d)]%s", 
  2875:             CCGRN(pt->character, C_NRM), zone_table[update_u->zone_to_reset].name, 
  2876:             zone_table[update_u->zone_to_reset].number, CCNRM(pt->character, C_NRM));
  2877:       /* dequeue */
  2878:       if (update_u == reset_q.head)
  2879: 	reset_q.head = reset_q.head->next;
  2880:       else {
  2881: 	for (temp = reset_q.head; temp->next != update_u;
  2882: 	     temp = temp->next);
  2883: 
  2884: 	if (!update_u->next)
  2885: 	  reset_q.tail = temp;
  2886: 
  2887: 	temp->next = update_u->next;
  2888:       }
  2889: 
  2890:       free(update_u);
  2891:       break;
  2892:     }
  2893: }
  2894: 
  2895: static void log_zone_error(zone_rnum zone, int cmd_no, const char *message)
  2896: {
  2897:   mudlog(NRM, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: zone file: %s", message);
  2898:   mudlog(NRM, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: ...offending cmd: '%c' cmd in zone #%d, line %d",
  2899: 	ZCMD.command, zone_table[zone].number, ZCMD.line);
  2900: }
  2901: 
  2902: #define ZONE_ERROR(message) \
  2903: 	{ log_zone_error(zone, cmd_no, message); last_cmd = 0; }
  2904: 
  2905: /* execute the reset command table of a given zone */
  2906: void reset_zone(zone_rnum zone)
  2907: {
  2908:   int cmd_no, last_cmd = 0;
  2909:   struct char_data *mob = NULL;
  2910:   struct obj_data *obj, *obj_to;
  2911:   room_vnum rvnum;
  2912:   room_rnum rrnum;
  2913:   struct char_data *tmob=NULL; /* for trigger assignment */
  2914:   struct obj_data *tobj=NULL;  /* for trigger assignment */
  2915: 
  2916:   for (cmd_no = 0; ZCMD.command != 'S'; cmd_no++) {
  2917: 
  2918:     if (ZCMD.if_flag && !last_cmd)
  2919:       continue;
  2920: 
  2921:     /* This is the list of actual zone commands. If any new zone commands are
  2922:      * added to the game, be certain to update the list of commands in load_zone
  2923:      * () so that the counting will still be correct. - ae. */
  2924:     switch (ZCMD.command) {
  2925:     case '*':			/* ignore command */
  2926:       last_cmd = 0;
  2927:       break;
  2928: 
  2929:     case 'M':			/* read a mobile */
  2930:       if (mob_index[ZCMD.arg1].number < ZCMD.arg2) {
  2931: 	mob = read_mobile(ZCMD.arg1, REAL);
  2932: 	char_to_room(mob, ZCMD.arg3);
  2933:         load_mtrigger(mob);
  2934:         tmob = mob;
  2935: 	last_cmd = 1;
  2936:       } else
  2937: 	last_cmd = 0;
  2938:       tobj = NULL;
  2939:       break;
  2940: 
  2941:     case 'O':			/* read an object */
  2942:       if (obj_index[ZCMD.arg1].number < ZCMD.arg2) {
  2943: 	if (ZCMD.arg3 != NOWHERE) {
  2944: 	  obj = read_object(ZCMD.arg1, REAL);
  2945: 	  obj_to_room(obj, ZCMD.arg3);
  2946: 	  last_cmd = 1;
  2947:           load_otrigger(obj);
  2948:           tobj = obj;
  2949: 	} else {
  2950: 	  obj = read_object(ZCMD.arg1, REAL);
  2951: 	  IN_ROOM(obj) = NOWHERE;
  2952: 	  last_cmd = 1;
  2953:           tobj = obj;
  2954: 	}
  2955:       } else
  2956: 	last_cmd = 0;
  2957:       tmob = NULL;
  2958:       break;
  2959: 
  2960:     case 'P':			/* object to object */
  2961:       if (obj_index[ZCMD.arg1].number < ZCMD.arg2) {
  2962: 	obj = read_object(ZCMD.arg1, REAL);
  2963: 	if (!(obj_to = get_obj_num(ZCMD.arg3))) {
  2964: 	  ZONE_ERROR("target obj not found, command disabled");
  2965: 	  ZCMD.command = '*';
  2966: 	  break;
  2967: 	}
  2968: 	obj_to_obj(obj, obj_to);
  2969: 	last_cmd = 1;
  2970:         load_otrigger(obj);
  2971:         tobj = obj;
  2972:       } else
  2973: 	last_cmd = 0;
  2974:       tmob = NULL;
  2975:       break;
  2976: 
  2977:     case 'G':			/* obj_to_char */
  2978:       if (!mob) {
  2979: 	char error[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2980: 	snprintf(error, sizeof(error), "attempt to give obj #%d to non-existant mob, command disabled", obj_index[ZCMD.arg1].vnum);
  2981: 	ZONE_ERROR(error);
  2982: 	ZCMD.command = '*';
  2983: 	break;
  2984:       }
  2985:       if (obj_index[ZCMD.arg1].number < ZCMD.arg2) {
  2986: 	obj = read_object(ZCMD.arg1, REAL);
  2987: 	obj_to_char(obj, mob);
  2988: 	last_cmd = 1;
  2989:         load_otrigger(obj);
  2990:         tobj = obj;
  2991:       } else
  2992: 	last_cmd = 0;
  2993:       tmob = NULL;
  2994:       break;
  2995: 
  2996:     case 'E':			/* object to equipment list */
  2997:       if (!mob) {
  2998: 	char error[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2999: 	snprintf(error, sizeof(error), "trying to equip non-existant mob with obj #%d, command disabled", obj_index[ZCMD.arg1].vnum);
  3000: 	ZONE_ERROR(error);
  3001: 	ZCMD.command = '*';
  3002: 	break;
  3003:       }
  3004:       if (obj_index[ZCMD.arg1].number < ZCMD.arg2) {
  3005: 	if (ZCMD.arg3 < 0 || ZCMD.arg3 >= NUM_WEARS) {
  3006:           char error[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3007: 	  snprintf(error, sizeof(error), "invalid equipment pos number (mob %s, obj %d, pos %d)", GET_NAME(mob), obj_index[ZCMD.arg2].vnum, ZCMD.arg3);
  3008: 	  ZONE_ERROR(error);
  3009: 	} else {
  3010: 	  obj = read_object(ZCMD.arg1, REAL);
  3011:           IN_ROOM(obj) = IN_ROOM(mob);
  3012:           load_otrigger(obj);
  3013:           if (wear_otrigger(obj, mob, ZCMD.arg3)) {
  3014:             IN_ROOM(obj) = NOWHERE;
  3015:             equip_char(mob, obj, ZCMD.arg3);
  3016:           } else
  3017:             obj_to_char(obj, mob);
  3018:           tobj = obj;
  3019: 	  last_cmd = 1;
  3020: 	}
  3021:       } else
  3022: 	last_cmd = 0;
  3023:       tmob = NULL;
  3024:       break;
  3025: 
  3026:     case 'R': /* rem obj from room */
  3027:       if ((obj = get_obj_in_list_num(ZCMD.arg2, world[ZCMD.arg1].contents)) != NULL)
  3028:         extract_obj(obj);
  3029:       last_cmd = 1;
  3030:       tmob = NULL;
  3031:       tobj = NULL;
  3032:       break;
  3033: 
  3034: 
  3035:     case 'D':			/* set state of door */
  3036:       if (ZCMD.arg2 < 0 || ZCMD.arg2 >= DIR_COUNT ||
  3037: 	  (world[ZCMD.arg1].dir_option[ZCMD.arg2] == NULL)) {
  3038:         char error[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3039:         snprintf(error, sizeof(error), "door does not exist in room %d - dir %d, command disabled",  world[ZCMD.arg1].number, ZCMD.arg2);
  3040: 	ZONE_ERROR(error);
  3041: 	ZCMD.command = '*';
  3042:       } else
  3043: 	switch (ZCMD.arg3) {
  3044: 	case 0:
  3045: 	  REMOVE_BIT(world[ZCMD.arg1].dir_option[ZCMD.arg2]->exit_info,
  3046: 		     EX_LOCKED);
  3047: 	  REMOVE_BIT(world[ZCMD.arg1].dir_option[ZCMD.arg2]->exit_info,
  3048: 		     EX_CLOSED);
  3049: 	  break;
  3050: 	case 1:
  3051: 	  SET_BIT(world[ZCMD.arg1].dir_option[ZCMD.arg2]->exit_info,
  3052: 		  EX_CLOSED);
  3053: 	  REMOVE_BIT(world[ZCMD.arg1].dir_option[ZCMD.arg2]->exit_info,
  3054: 		     EX_LOCKED);
  3055: 	  break;
  3056: 	case 2:
  3057: 	  SET_BIT(world[ZCMD.arg1].dir_option[ZCMD.arg2]->exit_info,
  3058: 		  EX_LOCKED);
  3059: 	  SET_BIT(world[ZCMD.arg1].dir_option[ZCMD.arg2]->exit_info,
  3060: 		  EX_CLOSED);
  3061: 	  break;
  3062: 	}
  3063:       last_cmd = 1;
  3064:       tmob = NULL;
  3065:       tobj = NULL;
  3066:       break;
  3067: 
  3068:     case 'T': /* trigger command */
  3069:       if (ZCMD.arg1==MOB_TRIGGER && tmob) {
  3070:         if (!SCRIPT(tmob))
  3071:           CREATE(SCRIPT(tmob), struct script_data, 1);
  3072:         add_trigger(SCRIPT(tmob), read_trigger(ZCMD.arg2), -1);
  3073:         last_cmd = 1;
  3074:       } else if (ZCMD.arg1==OBJ_TRIGGER && tobj) {
  3075:         if (!SCRIPT(tobj))
  3076:           CREATE(SCRIPT(tobj), struct script_data, 1);
  3077:         add_trigger(SCRIPT(tobj), read_trigger(ZCMD.arg2), -1);
  3078:         last_cmd = 1;
  3079:       } else if (ZCMD.arg1==WLD_TRIGGER) {
  3080:         if (ZCMD.arg3 == NOWHERE || ZCMD.arg3>top_of_world) {
  3081:           ZONE_ERROR("Invalid room number in trigger assignment");
  3082:         }
  3083:         if (!world[ZCMD.arg3].script)
  3084:           CREATE(world[ZCMD.arg3].script, struct script_data, 1);
  3085:         add_trigger(world[ZCMD.arg3].script, read_trigger(ZCMD.arg2), -1);
  3086:         last_cmd = 1;
  3087:       }
  3088: 
  3089:       break;
  3090: 
  3091:     case 'V':
  3092:       if (ZCMD.arg1==MOB_TRIGGER && tmob) {
  3093:         if (!SCRIPT(tmob)) {
  3094:           ZONE_ERROR("Attempt to give variable to scriptless mobile");
  3095:         } else
  3096:           add_var(&(SCRIPT(tmob)->global_vars), ZCMD.sarg1, ZCMD.sarg2,
  3097:                   ZCMD.arg3);
  3098:         last_cmd = 1;
  3099:       } else if (ZCMD.arg1==OBJ_TRIGGER && tobj) {
  3100:         if (!SCRIPT(tobj)) {
  3101:           ZONE_ERROR("Attempt to give variable to scriptless object");
  3102:         } else
  3103:           add_var(&(SCRIPT(tobj)->global_vars), ZCMD.sarg1, ZCMD.sarg2,
  3104:                   ZCMD.arg3);
  3105:         last_cmd = 1;
  3106:       } else if (ZCMD.arg1==WLD_TRIGGER) {
  3107:         if (ZCMD.arg3 == NOWHERE || ZCMD.arg3>top_of_world) {
  3108:           ZONE_ERROR("Invalid room number in variable assignment");
  3109:         } else {
  3110:           if (!(world[ZCMD.arg3].script)) {
  3111:             ZONE_ERROR("Attempt to give variable to scriptless object");
  3112:           } else
  3113:             add_var(&(world[ZCMD.arg3].script->global_vars),
  3114:                     ZCMD.sarg1, ZCMD.sarg2, ZCMD.arg2);
  3115:           last_cmd = 1;
  3116:         }
  3117:       }
  3118:       break;
  3119: 
  3120:     default:
  3121:       ZONE_ERROR("unknown cmd in reset table; cmd disabled");
  3122:       ZCMD.command = '*';
  3123:       break;
  3124:     }
  3125:   }
  3126: 
  3127:   zone_table[zone].age = 0;
  3128: 
  3129:   /* handle reset_wtrigger's */
  3130:   rvnum = zone_table[zone].bot;
  3131:   while (rvnum <= zone_table[zone].top) {
  3132:     rrnum = real_room(rvnum);
  3133:     if (rrnum != NOWHERE) reset_wtrigger(&world[rrnum]);
  3134:     rvnum++;
  3135:   }
  3136: }
  3137: 
  3138: /* for use in reset_zone; return TRUE if zone 'nr' is free of PC's  */
  3139: int is_empty(zone_rnum zone_nr)
  3140: {
  3141:   struct descriptor_data *i;
  3142: 
  3143:   for (i = descriptor_list; i; i = i->next) {
  3144:     if (STATE(i) != CON_PLAYING)
  3145:       continue;
  3146:     if (IN_ROOM(i->character) == NOWHERE)
  3147:       continue;
  3148:     if (world[IN_ROOM(i->character)].zone != zone_nr)
  3149:       continue;
  3150:     /* If an immortal has nohassle off, he counts as present. Added for testing
  3151:      * zone reset triggers -Welcor */
  3152:     if ((!IS_NPC(i->character)) && (GET_LEVEL(i->character) >= LVL_IMMORT) && (PRF_FLAGGED(i->character, PRF_NOHASSLE)))
  3153:       continue;
  3154: 
  3155:     return (0);
  3156:   }
  3157: 
  3158:   return (1);
  3159: }
  3160: 
  3161: /* Functions of a general utility nature. */
  3162: /* read and allocate space for a '~'-terminated string from a given file */
  3163: char *fread_string(FILE *fl, const char *error)
  3164: {
  3165:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], tmp[513];
  3166:   char *point;
  3167:   int done = 0, length = 0, templength;
  3168: 
  3169:   *buf = '\0';
  3170: 
  3171:   do {
  3172:     if (!fgets(tmp, 512, fl)) {
  3173:       log("SYSERR: fread_string: format error at or near %s", error);
  3174:       exit(1);
  3175:     }
  3176:     /* If there is a '~', end the string; else put an "\r\n" over the '\n'. */
  3177:     /* now only removes trailing ~'s -- Welcor */
  3178:     point = strchr(tmp, '\0');
  3179:     for (point-- ; (*point=='\r' || *point=='\n') && point > tmp; point--);
  3180:     if (*point=='~') {
  3181:       *point='\0';
  3182:       done = 1;
  3183:     } else {
  3184:       if (*point == '\n' || *point == '\r')
  3185:         *point = '\r';
  3186:       else
  3187:         *(++point) = '\r';
  3188: 
  3189:       *(++point) = '\n';
  3190:       *(++point) = '\0';
  3191:     }
  3192: 
  3193:     templength = point - tmp;
  3194: 
  3195:     if (length + templength >= MAX_STRING_LENGTH) {
  3196:       log("SYSERR: fread_string: string too large (db.c)");
  3197:       log("%s", error);
  3198:       exit(1);
  3199:     } else {
  3200:       strcat(buf + length, tmp);	/* strcat: OK (size checked above) */
  3201:       length += templength;
  3202:     }
  3203:   } while (!done);
  3204:   
  3205:   parse_at(buf);
  3206:   /* allocate space for the new string and copy it */
  3207:   return (strlen(buf) ? strdup(buf) : NULL);
  3208: }
  3209: 
  3210: /* fread_clean_string is the same as fread_string, but skips preceding spaces */
  3211: char *fread_clean_string(FILE *fl, const char *error)
  3212: {
  3213:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], tmp[513];
  3214:   char *point, c;
  3215:   int done = 0, length = 0, templength;
  3216: 
  3217:   *buf = '\0';
  3218: 
  3219:   do
  3220:   {
  3221:     if( feof( fl ) )
  3222:     {
  3223:       log( "%s", "fread_clean_string: EOF encountered on read." );
  3224:       return 0;
  3225:     }
  3226:     c = getc( fl );
  3227:   }
  3228:   while( isspace( c ) );
  3229:   ungetc( c, fl );
  3230: 
  3231:   do {
  3232:     if (!fgets(tmp, 512, fl)) {
  3233:       log("SYSERR: fread_clean_string: format error at or near %s", error);
  3234:       exit(1);
  3235:     }
  3236:     /* If there is a '~', end the string; else put an "\r\n" over the '\n'. */
  3237:     /* now only removes trailing ~'s -- Welcor */
  3238:     point = strchr(tmp, '\0');
  3239:     for (point-- ; (*point=='\r' || *point=='\n'); point--);
  3240:     if (*point=='~') {
  3241:       *point='\0';
  3242:       done = 1;
  3243:     } else {
  3244:       *(++point) = '\r';
  3245:       *(++point) = '\n';
  3246:       *(++point) = '\0';
  3247:     }
  3248: 
  3249:     templength = point - tmp;
  3250: 
  3251:     if (length + templength >= MAX_STRING_LENGTH) {
  3252:       log("SYSERR: fread_clean_string: string too large (db.c)");
  3253:       log("%s", error);
  3254:       exit(1);
  3255:     } else {
  3256:       strcat(buf + length, tmp);	/* strcat: OK (size checked above) */
  3257:       length += templength;
  3258:     }
  3259:   } while (!done);
  3260:   
  3261:   parse_at(buf);
  3262:   /* allocate space for the new string and copy it */
  3263:   return (strlen(buf) ? strdup(buf) : NULL);
  3264: }
  3265: 
  3266: /* Read a numerical value from a given file */
  3267: int fread_number(FILE *fp)
  3268: {
  3269:   int number;
  3270:   bool sign;
  3271:   char c;
  3272: 
  3273:   do
  3274:   {
  3275:     if( feof( fp ) )
  3276:     {
  3277:       log( "%s", "fread_number: EOF encountered on read." );
  3278:       return 0;
  3279:     }
  3280:     c = getc( fp );
  3281:   }
  3282:   while( isspace( c ) );
  3283: 
  3284:   number = 0;
  3285: 
  3286:   sign = FALSE;
  3287:   if( c == '+' )
  3288:     c = getc( fp );
  3289:   else if( c == '-' ) {
  3290:     sign = TRUE;
  3291:     c = getc( fp );
  3292:   }
  3293: 
  3294:   if(!isdigit(c)) {
  3295:     log( "fread_number: bad format. (%c)", c );
  3296:     return 0;
  3297:   }
  3298: 
  3299:   while(isdigit(c)) {
  3300:     if(feof(fp)) {
  3301:       log( "%s", "fread_number: EOF encountered on read." );
  3302:       return number;
  3303:     }
  3304:     number = number * 10 + c - '0';
  3305:     c = getc( fp );
  3306:   }
  3307: 
  3308:   if( sign )
  3309:     number = 0 - number;
  3310: 
  3311:   if( c == '|' )
  3312:     number += fread_number( fp );
  3313:   else if( c != ' ' )
  3314:     ungetc( c, fp );
  3315: 
  3316:   return number;
  3317: }
  3318: 
  3319: /* Read to end of line from a given file into a static buffer */
  3320: char *fread_line(FILE *fp)
  3321: {
  3322:   static char line[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  3323:   char *pline;
  3324:   char c;
  3325:   int ln;
  3326: 
  3327:   pline = line;
  3328:   line[0] = '\0';
  3329:   ln = 0;
  3330: 
  3331:   /* Skip blanks.     */
  3332:   /* Read first char. */
  3333:   do {
  3334:     if(feof(fp)) {
  3335:       log("fread_line: EOF encountered on read.");
  3336:       *pline = '\0';
  3337:       return (line);
  3338:     }
  3339:     c = getc( fp );
  3340:   }
  3341:   while(isspace(c));
  3342: 
  3343:   /* Un-Read first char */
  3344:   ungetc( c, fp );
  3345: 
  3346:   do {
  3347:     if(feof(fp)) {
  3348:       log("fread_line: EOF encountered on read.");
  3349:       *pline = '\0';
  3350:       return ( line );
  3351:     }
  3352:     c = getc( fp );
  3353:     *pline++ = c;
  3354:     ln++;
  3355:     if( ln >= ( MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1 ) ) {
  3356:       log("fread_line: line too long");
  3357:       break;
  3358:     }
  3359:   }
  3360:   while( (c != '\n') && (c != '\r') );
  3361: 
  3362:   do
  3363:   {
  3364:     c = getc(fp);
  3365:   }
  3366:   while( c == '\n' || c == '\r' );
  3367: 
  3368:   ungetc( c, fp );
  3369:   pline--;
  3370:   *pline = '\0';
  3371: 
  3372:   /* Since tildes generally aren't found at the end of lines, this seems workable. Will enable reading old configs. */
  3373:   if( line[strlen(line) - 1] == '~' )
  3374:     line[strlen(line) - 1] = '\0';
  3375: 
  3376:   return (line);
  3377: }

  3379: /* Read to end of line from a given file and convert to flag values, then return number of ints */
  3380: int fread_flags(FILE *fp, int *fg, int fg_size)
  3381: {
  3382:   char line[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  3383:   char *pline, *tmp_txt, val_txt[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  3384:   char c;
  3385:   int ln,i;
  3386: 
  3387:   pline = line;
  3388:   line[0] = '\0';
  3389:   ln = 0;
  3390: 
  3391:   /* Skip blanks.     */
  3392:   /* Read first char. */
  3393:   do {
  3394:     if(feof(fp)) {
  3395:       log("fread_flags: EOF encountered on read.");
  3396:       *pline = '\0';
  3397:       return (0);
  3398:     }
  3399:     c = getc( fp );
  3400:   }
  3401:   while(isspace(c));
  3402: 
  3403:   /* Un-Read first char */
  3404:   ungetc( c, fp );
  3405: 
  3406:   do {
  3407:     if(feof(fp)) {
  3408:       log("fread_flags: EOF encountered on read.");
  3409:       *pline = '\0';
  3410:       return (0);
  3411:     }
  3412:     c = getc( fp );
  3413:     *pline++ = c;
  3414:     ln++;
  3415:     if( ln >= ( MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1 ) ) {
  3416:       log("fread_flags: line too long");
  3417:       break;
  3418:     }
  3419:   }
  3420:   while( (c != '\n') && (c != '\r') );
  3421: 
  3422:   do
  3423:   {
  3424:     c = getc(fp);
  3425:   }
  3426:   while( c == '\n' || c == '\r' );
  3427: 
  3428:   ungetc( c, fp );
  3429:   pline--;
  3430:   *pline = '\0';
  3431: 
  3432:   /* Since tildes generally aren't found at the end of lines, this seems workable. Will enable reading old configs. */
  3433:   if( line[strlen(line) - 1] == '~' )
  3434:     line[strlen(line) - 1] = '\0';
  3435: 
  3436:   /* We now have a line of text with all the flags on it - let's convert it */
  3437:   for (i=0,tmp_txt=line;tmp_txt && *tmp_txt && i<fg_size;i++) {
  3438:     tmp_txt = one_argument(tmp_txt,val_txt);  /* Grab a number  */
  3439:     fg[i]   = atoi(val_txt);                  /* Convert to int */
  3440:   }
  3441: 
  3442:   return (i);
  3443: }
