  3445: /* Read one word from a given file (into static buffer). */
  3446: char *fread_word(FILE *fp)
  3447: {
  3448:    static char word[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  3449:    char *pword;
  3450:    char cEnd;
  3451: 
  3452:    do
  3453:    {
  3454:       if( feof( fp ) )
  3455:       {
  3456:          log( "fread_word: EOF encountered on read.");
  3457:          word[0] = '\0';
  3458:          return word;
  3459:       }
  3460:       cEnd = getc( fp );
  3461:    }
  3462:    while( isspace( cEnd ) );
  3463: 
  3464:    if( cEnd == '\'' || cEnd == '"' )
  3465:    {
  3466:       pword = word;
  3467:    }
  3468:    else
  3469:    {
  3470:       word[0] = cEnd;
  3471:       pword = word + 1;
  3472:       cEnd = ' ';
  3473:    }
  3474: 
  3475:    for( ; pword < word + MAX_STRING_LENGTH; pword++ )
  3476:    {
  3477:       if( feof( fp ) )
  3478:       {
  3479:          log( "fread_word: EOF encountered on read.");
  3480:          *pword = '\0';
  3481:          return word;
  3482:       }
  3483:       *pword = getc( fp );
  3484:       if( cEnd == ' ' ? isspace( *pword ) : *pword == cEnd )
  3485:       {
  3486:          if( cEnd == ' ' )
  3487:             ungetc( *pword, fp );
  3488:          *pword = '\0';
  3489:          return word;
  3490:       }
  3491:    }
  3492:    log( "fread_word: word too long");
  3493:    return NULL;
  3494: }

  3496: /* Read to end of line in a given file (for comments) */

  3531: /* release memory allocated for a char struct */
  3532: void free_char(struct char_data *ch)
  3533: {
  3534:   int i;
  3535:   struct alias_data *a;
  3536: 
  3537:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  3538:     dg_cooldowns_free(ch);
  3539: 
  3540:   if (ch->player_specials != NULL && ch->player_specials != &dummy_mob) {
  3541:     while ((a = GET_ALIASES(ch)) != NULL) {
  3542:       GET_ALIASES(ch) = (GET_ALIASES(ch))->next;
  3543:       free_alias(a);
  3544:     }
  3545:     if (ch->player_specials->poofin)
  3546:       free(ch->player_specials->poofin);
  3547:     if (ch->player_specials->poofout)
  3548:       free(ch->player_specials->poofout);
  3549:     if (ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests)
  3550:       free(ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests);
  3551:     if (GET_HOST(ch))
  3552:       free(GET_HOST(ch));
  3553:     if (IS_NPC(ch))
  3554:       log("SYSERR: Mob %s (#%d) had player_specials allocated!", GET_NAME(ch), GET_MOB_VNUM(ch));
  3555:   }
  3556:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) || (IS_NPC(ch) && GET_MOB_RNUM(ch) == NOBODY)) {
  3557:     /* if this is a player, or a non-prototyped non-player, free all */
  3558:     if (GET_NAME(ch))
  3559:       free(GET_NAME(ch));
  3560:     if (ch->player.title)
  3561:       free(ch->player.title);
  3562:     if (ch->player.short_descr)
  3563:       free(ch->player.short_descr);
  3564:     if (ch->player.long_descr)
  3565:       free(ch->player.long_descr);
  3566:     if (ch->player.description)
  3567:       free(ch->player.description);
  3568:     for (i = 0; i < NUM_HIST; i++)
  3569:       if (GET_HISTORY(ch, i))
  3570:         free_history(ch, i);
  3571: 
  3572:     if (ch->player_specials)
  3573:       free(ch->player_specials);
  3574: 
  3575:     /* free script proto list */
  3576:     free_proto_script(ch, MOB_TRIGGER);
  3577: 
  3578:   } else if ((i = GET_MOB_RNUM(ch)) != NOBODY) {
  3579:     /* otherwise, free strings only if the string is not pointing at proto */
  3580:     if (ch->player.name && ch->player.name != mob_proto[i].player.name)
  3581:       free(ch->player.name);
  3582:     if (ch->player.title && ch->player.title != mob_proto[i].player.title)
  3583:       free(ch->player.title);
  3584:     if (ch->player.short_descr && ch->player.short_descr != mob_proto[i].player.short_descr)
  3585:       free(ch->player.short_descr);
  3586:     if (ch->player.long_descr && ch->player.long_descr != mob_proto[i].player.long_descr)
  3587:       free(ch->player.long_descr);
  3588:     if (ch->player.description && ch->player.description != mob_proto[i].player.description)
  3589:       free(ch->player.description);
  3590:     /* free script proto list if it's not the prototype */
  3591:     if (ch->proto_script && ch->proto_script != mob_proto[i].proto_script)
  3592:       free_proto_script(ch, MOB_TRIGGER);
  3593:   }
  3594: 
  3595:   while (ch->affected)
  3596:     affect_remove(ch, ch->affected);
  3597: 
  3598:   /* free any assigned scripts */
  3599:   if (SCRIPT(ch))
  3600:     extract_script(ch, MOB_TRIGGER);
  3601: 
  3602:     /* Mud Events */
  3603:   if (ch->events != NULL) {
  3604: 	  if (ch->events->iSize > 0) {
  3605: 		struct event * pEvent;
  3606: 
  3607: 		while ((pEvent = simple_list(ch->events)) != NULL)
  3608: 		  event_cancel(pEvent);
  3609: 	  }
  3610: 	  free_list(ch->events);
  3611:     ch->events = NULL;
  3612:   }
  3613: 
  3614:   /* new version of free_followers take the followers pointer as arg */
  3615:   free_followers(ch->followers);
  3616: 
  3617:   if (ch->desc)
  3618:     ch->desc->character = NULL;
  3619: 
  3620:   /* find_char helper, when free_char is called with a blank character struct,
  3621:    * ID is set to 0, and has not yet been added to the lookup table. */
  3622:   if (ch->script_id != 0) {
  3623:     remove_from_lookup_table(ch->script_id);
  3624:   }
  3625: 
  3626:   free(ch);
  3627: }

  3629: /* release memory allocated for an obj struct */

  3648:     remove_from_lookup_table(obj->script_id);
  3649:   }
  3650:

  3654: /* Steps: 1: Read contents of a text file. 2: Make sure no one is using the
  3655:  * pointer in paging. 3: Allocate space. 4: Point 'buf' to it.
  3656:  * We don't want to free() the string that someone may be viewing in the pager.
  3657:  * page_string() keeps the internal strdup()'d copy on ->showstr_head and it
  3658:  * won't care if we delete the original.  Otherwise, strings are kept on
  3659:  * ->showstr_vector but we'll only match if the pointer is to the string we're
  3660:  * interested in and not a copy. If someone is reading a global copy we're
  3661:  * trying to replace, give everybody using it a different copy so as to avoid
  3662:  * special cases. */
  3663: static int file_to_string_alloc(const char *name, char **buf)
  3664: {
  3665:   int temppage;
  3666:   char temp[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  3667:   struct descriptor_data *in_use;
  3668: 
  3669:   for (in_use = descriptor_list; in_use; in_use = in_use->next)
  3670:     if (in_use->showstr_vector && *in_use->showstr_vector == *buf)
  3671:       return (-1);
  3672: 
  3673:   /* Lets not free() what used to be there unless we succeeded. */
  3674:   if (file_to_string(name, temp) < 0)
  3675:     return (-1);
  3676: 
  3677:   for (in_use = descriptor_list; in_use; in_use = in_use->next) {
  3678:     if (!in_use->showstr_count || *in_use->showstr_vector != *buf)
  3679:       continue;
  3680: 
  3681:     /* Let's be nice and leave them at the page they were on. */
  3682:     temppage = in_use->showstr_page;
  3683:     paginate_string((in_use->showstr_head = strdup(*in_use->showstr_vector)), in_use);
  3684:     in_use->showstr_page = temppage;
  3685:   }
  3686: 
  3687:   if (*buf)
  3688:     free(*buf);
  3689:   
  3690:   parse_at(temp);   
  3691:     
  3692:   *buf = strdup(temp);
  3693:   return (0);
  3694: }
  3695: 
  3696: /* read contents of a text file, and place in buf */
  3697: static int file_to_string(const char *name, char *buf)
  3698: {
  3699:   FILE *fl;
  3700:   char tmp[READ_SIZE + 3];
  3701:   int len;
  3702:   struct stat statbuf;
  3703: 
  3704:   *buf = '\0';
  3705: 
  3706:   if (!(fl = fopen(name, "r"))) {
  3707:     log("SYSERR: reading %s: %s", name, strerror(errno));
  3708:     return (-1);
  3709:   }
  3710: 
  3711:    /* Grab the date/time the file was last edited */
  3712:    if (!strcmp(name, NEWS_FILE))
  3713:    {
  3714:      fstat(fileno(fl), &statbuf);
  3715:      newsmod = statbuf.st_mtime;
  3716:    }
  3717:    if (!strcmp(name, MOTD_FILE))
  3718:    {
  3719:      fstat(fileno(fl), &statbuf);
  3720:      motdmod = statbuf.st_mtime;
  3721:    }
  3722: 
  3723:   for (;;) {
  3724:     if (!fgets(tmp, READ_SIZE, fl))	/* EOF check */
  3725:       break;
  3726:     if ((len = strlen(tmp)) > 0)
  3727:       tmp[len - 1] = '\0'; /* take off the trailing \n */
  3728:     strcat(tmp, "\r\n");	/* strcat: OK (tmp:READ_SIZE+3) */
  3729: 
  3730:     if (strlen(buf) + strlen(tmp) + 1 > MAX_STRING_LENGTH) {
  3731:       log("SYSERR: %s: string too big (%d max)", name, MAX_STRING_LENGTH);
  3732:       *buf = '\0';
  3733:       fclose(fl);
  3734:       return (-1);
  3735:     }
  3736:     strcat(buf, tmp);	/* strcat: OK (size checked above) */
  3737:   }
  3738: 
  3739:   fclose(fl);
  3740: 
  3741:   return (0);
  3742: }

  3744: /* clear some of the the working variables of a char */

  3746: {

  3759:   FIGHTING(ch) = NULL;

  3814: /* Called during character creation after picking character class (and then
  3815:  * never again for that character). */
  3816: void init_char(struct char_data *ch)
  3817: {
  3818:   int i;
  3819: 
  3820:   /* create a player_special structure */
  3821:   if (ch->player_specials == NULL)
  3822:     CREATE(ch->player_specials, struct player_special_data, 1);
  3823: 
  3824:   /* top_of_p_table is the last occupied zero-based slot: -1 is empty, while
  3825:    * 0 already means one record.  create_entry() has just inserted the first
  3826:    * character at slot zero, so only that slot is eligible for implementor. */
  3827:   if (first_player_record_is_new(GET_PFILEPOS(ch))) {
  3828:     GET_LEVEL(ch) = LVL_IMPL;
  3829:     GET_EXP(ch) = 7000000;
  3830: 
  3831:     /* The implementor never goes through do_start(). */
  3832:     GET_MAX_HIT(ch) = 500;
  3833:     GET_MAX_MANA(ch) = 100;
  3834:     GET_MAX_MOVE(ch) = 82;
  3835:     GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(ch) = GET_MAX_HIT(ch);
  3836:     GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(ch) = GET_MAX_MANA(ch);
  3837:     GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(ch) = GET_MAX_MOVE(ch);
  3838:     GET_HIT(ch) = GET_MAX_HIT(ch);
  3839:     GET_MANA(ch) = effective_max_mana(ch);
  3840:     GET_MOVE(ch) = GET_MAX_MOVE(ch);
  3841:   }

  3843:   set_title(ch, NULL);
  3844:   ch->player.short_descr = NULL;
  3845:   ch->player.long_descr = NULL;
  3846:   ch->player.description = NULL;
  3847: 
  3848:   GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch) = 0;
  3849:   ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests = NULL;
  3850:   ch->player_specials->saved.identified_item_count = 0;

  3862:   GET_EVASION(ch) = 0;
  3863: 
  3864:   /* Bias the height and weight of the character depending on what gender
  3865:    * they have chosen. While it is possible to have a tall, heavy female it's
  3866:    * not as likely as a male. Height is in centimeters. Weight is in pounds.
  3867:    * The only place they're ever printed (in stock code) is SPELL_IDENTIFY. */
  3868:   if (GET_SEX(ch) == SEX_MALE) {
  3869:     GET_WEIGHT(ch) = rand_number(120, 180);
  3870:     GET_HEIGHT(ch) = rand_number(160, 200); /* 5'4" - 6'8" */

  3874:   }
  3875:

  3877:     player_table[i].id = GET_IDNUM(ch) = ++top_idnum;
  3878:   else
  3879:     log("SYSERR: init_char: Character '%s' not found in player table.", GET_NAME(ch));
  3880: 
  3881:   for (i = 1; i <= MAX_SKILLS; i++) {

  3884:     else
  3885:       SET_SKILL(ch, i, 100);
  3886:   }

  3888:   classtrack_ensure_study_skill(ch);
  3889:

  3892:

  3897:   ch->real_abils.wis = 25;
  3898:   ch->real_abils.dex = 25;
  3899:   ch->real_abils.str = 25;
  3900:   ch->real_abils.str_add = 100;
  3901:   ch->real_abils.con = 25;
  3902:   ch->real_abils.cha = 25;
  3903: 
  3904:   for (i = 0; i < 3; i++)

  3920: /* returns the real number of the room with given virtual number */
  3921: room_rnum real_room(room_vnum vnum)
  3922: {
  3923:   room_rnum bot, top, mid;
  3924: 
  3925:   bot = 0;
  3926:   top = top_of_world;
  3927: 
  3928:   if (world[bot].number > vnum || world[top].number < vnum)
  3929:     return (NOWHERE);
  3930: 
  3931:   /* perform binary search on world-table */
  3932:   while (bot<= top) {
  3933:     mid = (bot + top) / 2;
  3934: 
  3935:     if ((world + mid)->number == vnum)
  3936:       return (mid);
  3937:     if ((world + mid)->number > vnum)
  3938:       top = mid - 1;
  3939:     else
  3940:       bot = mid + 1;
  3941:   }
  3942:   return (NOWHERE);
  3943: }
  3944: 
  3945: /* returns the real number of the monster with given virtual number */
  3946: mob_rnum real_mobile(mob_vnum vnum)
  3947: {
  3948:   mob_rnum bot, top, mid;
  3949: 
  3950:   bot = 0;
  3951:   top = top_of_mobt;
  3952: 
  3953:   /* quickly reject out-of-range vnums */
  3954:   if (mob_index[bot].vnum > vnum || mob_index[top].vnum < vnum)
  3955:     return (NOBODY);
  3956: 
  3957:   /* perform binary search on mob-table */
  3958:   while (bot <= top) {
  3959:     mid = (bot + top) / 2;
  3960: 
  3961:     if ((mob_index + mid)->vnum == vnum)
  3962:       return (mid);
  3963:     if ((mob_index + mid)->vnum > vnum)
  3964:       top = mid - 1;
  3965:     else
  3966:       bot = mid + 1;
  3967:   }
  3968:   return (NOBODY);
  3969: }
  3970: 
  3971: /* returns the real number of the object with given virtual number */

  3989:     if ((obj_index + mid)->vnum > vnum)
  3990:       top = mid - 1;
  3991:     else

  3995: }

  4022: /* Extend later to include more checks and add checks for unknown bitvectors. */
  4023: static int check_object(struct obj_data *obj)
  4024: {
  4025:   char objname[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 32];
  4026:   int error = FALSE, y;
  4027: 
  4028:   if (GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) < 0 && (error = TRUE))
  4029:     log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) has negative weight (%d).",
  4030: 	GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description, GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj));
  4031: 
  4032:   if (GET_OBJ_RENT(obj) < 0 && (error = TRUE))
  4033:     log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) has negative cost/day (%d).",
  4034: 	GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description, GET_OBJ_RENT(obj));
  4035: 
  4036:   snprintf(objname, sizeof(objname), "Object #%d (%s)", GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description);
  4037:   for(y = 0; y < TW_ARRAY_MAX; y++) {
  4038:     error |= check_bitvector_names(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj)[y], wear_bits_count, objname, "object wear");
  4039:     error |= check_bitvector_names(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj)[y], extra_bits_count, objname, "object extra");
  4040:     error |= check_bitvector_names(GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj)[y], affected_bits_count, objname, "object affect");
  4041:   }
  4042: 
  4043:   switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj)) {
  4044:   case ITEM_DRINKCON:
  4045:   case ITEM_FOUNTAIN:
  4046:     /*
  4047:      * Adventurer's Lair:
  4048:      * Liquid identity is stored in value 2. Object keywords are builder-facing
  4049:      * aliases only and no longer need to contain the liquid name in any
  4050:      * particular position.
  4051:      */
  4052:     if ((GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2) < 0 || GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2) >= NUM_LIQ_TYPES)
  4053:         && (error = TRUE))
  4054:       log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) has invalid liquid type %d.",
  4055:           GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description, GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2));
  4056: 
  4057:     if ((GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0) > 0) &&
  4058:         (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1) > GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0)) &&
  4059:         (error = TRUE))
  4060:       log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) contains (%d) more than maximum (%d).",
  4061:           GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description,
  4062:           GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0));
  4063:     break;
  4064:   case ITEM_SCROLL:
  4065:   case ITEM_POTION:
  4066:     error |= check_object_level(obj, 0);
  4067:     error |= check_object_spell_number(obj, 1);
  4068:     error |= check_object_spell_number(obj, 2);
  4069:     error |= check_object_spell_number(obj, 3);
  4070:     break;
  4071:   case ITEM_WAND:
  4072:   case ITEM_STAFF:
  4073:     error |= check_object_level(obj, 0);
  4074:     error |= check_object_spell_number(obj, 3);
  4075:     if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2) > GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1) && (error = TRUE))
  4076:       log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) has more charges (%d) than maximum (%d).",
  4077: 		GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description,
  4078: 		GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1));
  4079:     break;
  4080:   case ITEM_NOTE:
  4081:     if (obj->ex_description) {
  4082:       char onealias[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH],*next_name;
  4083:       next_name = any_one_arg(obj->name, onealias);
  4084:       do {
  4085:   	if (find_exdesc(onealias, obj->ex_description) && (error = TRUE)) {
  4086: 	log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) is type NOTE and has extra description with same name. (%s)",
  4087: 	  GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description, obj->name);
  4088:         }
  4089:   	next_name = any_one_arg(next_name, onealias);
  4090:       } while (*onealias);
  4091:     }
  4092:   break;
  4093:   case ITEM_FURNITURE:
  4094:     if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1) > GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0) && (error = TRUE))
  4095:       log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) contains (%d) more than maximum (%d).",
  4096:           GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description, GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1),
  4097: 	  GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0));
  4098:     break;
  4099:   }
  4100: 
  4101:   return (error);
  4102: }
  4103: 
  4104: static int check_object_spell_number(struct obj_data *obj, int val)
  4105: {
  4106:   int error = FALSE;
  4107:   const char *spellname;
  4108: 
  4109:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val) == -1 || GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val) == 0) /* no spell */
  4110:     return (error);
  4111: 
  4112:   /* Check for negative spells, spells beyond the top define, and any spell
  4113:    * which is actually a skill. */
  4114:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val) < 0)
  4115:     error = TRUE;
  4116:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val) > TOP_SPELL_DEFINE)
  4117:     error = TRUE;
  4118:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val) > MAX_SPELLS && GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val) <= MAX_SKILLS)
  4119:     error = TRUE;
  4120:   if (error)
  4121:     log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) has out of range spell #%d.",
  4122: 	GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description, GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val));
  4123: 
  4124:   if (scheck)		/* Spell names don't exist in syntax check mode. */
  4125:     return (error);
  4126: 
  4127:   /* Now check for unnamed spells. */
  4128:   spellname = skill_name(GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val));
  4129: 
  4130:   if ((spellname == unused_spellname || !str_cmp("UNDEFINED", spellname)) && (error = TRUE))
  4131:     log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) uses '%s' spell #%d.",
  4132: 		GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description, spellname,
  4133: 		GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val));
  4134: 
  4135:   return (error);
  4136: }
  4137: 
  4138: static int check_object_level(struct obj_data *obj, int val)
  4139: {
  4140:   int error = FALSE;
  4141: 
  4142:   if ((GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val) < 0 || GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val) > LVL_IMPL) && (error = TRUE))
  4143:     log("SYSERR: Object #%d (%s) has out of range level #%d.",
  4144: 	GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description, GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, val));
  4145: 
  4146:   return (error);
  4147: }
  4148: 
  4149: static int check_bitvector_names(bitvector_t bits, size_t namecount, const char *whatami, const char *whatbits)
  4150: {
  4151:   unsigned int flagnum;
  4152:   bool error = FALSE;
  4153: 
  4154:   /* See if any bits are set above the ones we know about. */
  4155:   if (bits <= (~(bitvector_t)0 >> (sizeof(bitvector_t) * 8 - namecount)))
  4156:     return (FALSE);
  4157: 
  4158:   for (flagnum = namecount; flagnum < sizeof(bitvector_t) * 8; flagnum++)
  4159:     if ((1 << flagnum) & bits) {
  4160:       log("SYSERR: %s has unknown %s flag, bit %d (0 through %d known).", whatami, whatbits, flagnum, (int)namecount - 1);
  4161:       error = TRUE;
  4162:     }
  4163: 
  4164:   return (error);
  4165: }

  4236:   CONFIG_MAX_BAD_PWS            = max_bad_pws;
  4237:   CONFIG_SITEOK_ALL             = siteok_everyone;
  4238:   CONFIG_NS_IS_SLOW             = nameserver_is_slow;
  4239:   CONFIG_NEW_SOCIALS            = use_new_socials;
  4240:   CONFIG_OLC_SAVE               = auto_save_olc;
  4241:   CONFIG_MENU                   = strdup(MENU);
  4242:   CONFIG_WELC_MESSG             = strdup(WELC_MESSG);
  4243:   CONFIG_START_MESSG            = strdup(START_MESSG);
  4244:   CONFIG_MEDIT_ADVANCED         = medit_advanced_stats;
  4245:   CONFIG_IBT_AUTOSAVE           = ibt_autosave;
  4246:   /* Autowiz options. */
  4247:   CONFIG_USE_AUTOWIZ            = use_autowiz;
  4248:   CONFIG_MIN_WIZLIST_LEV        = min_wizlist_lev;
  4249: }
  4250: 
  4251: void load_config( void )
  4252: {
  4253:   FILE *fl;
  4254:   char line[READ_SIZE - 2]; // to make sure there's room for readding \r\n
  4255:   char tag[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  4256:   int  num;
  4257:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  4258: 
  4259:   load_default_config();
  4260: 
  4261:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%s", CONFIG_DFLT_DIR, CONFIG_CONFFILE);
  4262:   if ( !(fl = fopen(CONFIG_CONFFILE, "r")) && !(fl = fopen(buf, "r")) ) {
  4263:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "No %s file, using defaults", CONFIG_CONFFILE);
  4264:     perror(buf);
  4265:     return;
  4266:   }
  4267: 
  4268:   /* Load the game configuration file. */
  4269:   while (get_line(fl, line)) {
  4270:     split_argument(line, tag);
  4271:     num = atoi(line);
  4272: 
  4273:     switch (LOWER(*tag)) {
  4274:       case 'a':
  4275:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "auto_save"))
  4276:           CONFIG_AUTO_SAVE = num;
  4277:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "autosave_time"))
  4278:           CONFIG_AUTOSAVE_TIME = num;
  4279:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "auto_save_olc"))
  4280:           CONFIG_OLC_SAVE = num;
  4281:         break;
  4282: 
  4283:       case 'c':
  4284:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "crash_file_timeout"))
  4285:           CONFIG_CRASH_TIMEOUT = num;
  4286:         break;
  4287: 
  4288:       case 'd':
  4289:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "debug_mode"))
  4290:           CONFIG_DEBUG_MODE = num;
  4291:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "display_closed_doors"))
  4292:           CONFIG_DISP_CLOSED_DOORS = num;
  4293:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "diagonal_dirs"))
  4294:           CONFIG_DIAGONAL_DIRS = num;
  4295:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "dts_are_dumps"))
  4296:           CONFIG_DTS_ARE_DUMPS = num;
  4297:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "donation_room_1"))
  4298:           if (num == -1)
  4299:             CONFIG_DON_ROOM_1 = NOWHERE;
  4300:           else
  4301:             CONFIG_DON_ROOM_1 = num;
  4302:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "donation_room_2"))
  4303:           if (num == -1)
  4304:             CONFIG_DON_ROOM_2 = NOWHERE;
  4305:           else
  4306:             CONFIG_DON_ROOM_2 = num;
  4307:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "donation_room_3"))
  4308:           if (num == -1)
  4309:             CONFIG_DON_ROOM_3 = NOWHERE;
  4310:           else
  4311:             CONFIG_DON_ROOM_3 = num;
  4312:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "dflt_dir")) {
  4313:           if (CONFIG_DFLT_DIR)
  4314:             free(CONFIG_DFLT_DIR);
  4315:           if (*line)
  4316:             CONFIG_DFLT_DIR = strdup(line);
  4317:           else
  4318:             CONFIG_DFLT_DIR = strdup(DFLT_DIR);
  4319:         } else if (!str_cmp(tag, "dflt_ip")) {
  4320:           if (CONFIG_DFLT_IP)
  4321:             free(CONFIG_DFLT_IP);
  4322:           if (*line)
  4323:             CONFIG_DFLT_IP = strdup(line);
  4324:           else
  4325:             CONFIG_DFLT_IP = NULL;
  4326:         } else if (!str_cmp(tag, "dflt_port"))
  4327:           CONFIG_DFLT_PORT = num;
  4328:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "default_map_size"))
  4329:           CONFIG_MAP_SIZE = num;
  4330:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "default_minimap_size"))
  4331:           CONFIG_MINIMAP_SIZE = num;
  4332:         break;
  4333: 
  4334:       case 'f':
  4335:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "free_rent"))
  4336:           CONFIG_FREE_RENT = num;
  4337:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "frozen_start_room"))
  4338:           CONFIG_FROZEN_START = num;
  4339:         break;
  4340: 
  4341:       case 'h':
  4342:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "holler_move_cost"))
  4343:           CONFIG_HOLLER_MOVE_COST = num;
  4344:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "huh")) {
  4345:           char tmp[READ_SIZE];
  4346:           if (CONFIG_HUH)
  4347:             free(CONFIG_HUH);
  4348:           snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s\r\n", line);
  4349:           CONFIG_HUH = strdup(tmp);
  4350:         }
  4351:         break;
  4352: 
  4353:       case 'i':
  4354:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "idle_void"))
  4355:           CONFIG_IDLE_VOID = num;
  4356:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "idle_rent_time"))
  4357:           CONFIG_IDLE_RENT_TIME = num;
  4358:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "idle_max_level"))
  4359:           CONFIG_IDLE_MAX_LEVEL = num;
  4360:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "immort_start_room"))
  4361:           CONFIG_IMMORTAL_START = num;
  4362:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "ibt_autosave"))
  4363: 		  CONFIG_IBT_AUTOSAVE = num;
  4364:         break;
  4365: 
  4366:       case 'l':
  4367:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "level_can_shout"))
  4368:           CONFIG_LEVEL_CAN_SHOUT = num;
  4369:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "load_into_inventory"))
  4370:           CONFIG_LOAD_INVENTORY = num;
  4371:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "logname")) {
  4372:           if (CONFIG_LOGNAME)
  4373:             free(CONFIG_LOGNAME);
  4374:           if (*line)
  4375:             CONFIG_LOGNAME = strdup(line);
  4376:           else
  4377:             CONFIG_LOGNAME = NULL;
  4378:         }
  4379:         break;
  4380: 
  4381:       case 'm':
  4382:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "max_bad_pws"))
  4383:           CONFIG_MAX_BAD_PWS = num;
  4384:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "max_exp_gain"))
  4385:           CONFIG_MAX_EXP_GAIN = num;
  4386:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "max_exp_loss"))
  4387:           CONFIG_MAX_EXP_LOSS = num;
  4388:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "max_filesize"))
  4389:           CONFIG_MAX_FILESIZE = num;
  4390:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "max_npc_corpse_time"))
  4391:           CONFIG_MAX_NPC_CORPSE_TIME = num;
  4392:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "max_obj_save"))
  4393:           CONFIG_MAX_OBJ_SAVE = num;
  4394:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "max_pc_corpse_time"))
  4395:           CONFIG_MAX_PC_CORPSE_TIME = num;
  4396:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "max_playing"))
  4397:           CONFIG_MAX_PLAYING = num;
  4398:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "menu")) {
  4399:           if (CONFIG_MENU)
  4400:             free(CONFIG_MENU);
  4401:           strncpy(buf, "Reading menu in load_config()", sizeof(buf));
  4402:           CONFIG_MENU = fread_string(fl, buf);
  4403:           parse_at(CONFIG_MENU);
  4404:         } else if (!str_cmp(tag, "min_rent_cost"))
  4405:           CONFIG_MIN_RENT_COST = num;
  4406:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "min_wizlist_lev"))
  4407:           CONFIG_MIN_WIZLIST_LEV = num;
  4408:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "mortal_start_room"))
  4409:           CONFIG_MORTAL_START = num;
  4410:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "map_option"))
  4411:           CONFIG_MAP = num;
  4412:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "medit_advanced_stats"))
  4413:           CONFIG_MEDIT_ADVANCED = num;
  4414:         break;
  4415: 
  4416:       case 'n':
  4417:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "nameserver_is_slow"))
  4418:           CONFIG_NS_IS_SLOW = num;
  4419:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "no_mort_to_immort"))
  4420:           CONFIG_NO_MORT_TO_IMMORT = num;
  4421:         else if (!str_cmp(tag, "noperson")) {

  4423:           if (CONFIG_NOPERSON)
  4424:             free(CONFIG_NOPERSON);
  4425:           snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s\r\n", line);
  4426:           CONFIG_NOPERSON = strdup(tmp);

  4428:           char tmp[READ_SIZE];

  4431:           snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s\r\n", line);
  4432:           CONFIG_NOEFFECT = strdup(tmp);
  4433:         }
  4434:         break;
  4435: 
  4436:       case 'o':
  4437:         if (!str_cmp(tag, "ok")) {
  4438:           char tmp[READ_SIZE];
  4439:           if (CONFIG_OK)
  4440:             free(CONFIG_OK);

  4458:         break;
  4459:

     1: /**
     2: * @file dg_event.c
     3: * This file contains a simplified event system to allow trigedit 
     4: * to use the "wait" command, causing a delay in the middle of a script.
     5: * This system could easily be expanded by coders who wish to implement
     6: * an event driven mud.
     7: * 
     8: * Part of the core tbaMUD source code distribution, which is a derivative
     9: * of, and continuation of, CircleMUD.
    10: * 
    11: * This source code, which was not part of the CircleMUD legacy code,
    12: * was created by the following people:                                      
    13: * $Author: Mark A. Heilpern/egreen/Welcor $                              
    14: * $Date: 2004/10/11 12:07:00$                                            
    15: * $Revision: 1.0.14 $

    17: 
    18: 
    19: #include "conf.h"
    20: #include "sysdep.h"
    21: #include "structs.h"
    22: #include "utils.h"
    23: #include "db.h"

    29: /***************************************************************************
    30:  * Begin mud specific event queue functions
    31:  **************************************************************************/
    32: /* file scope variables */
    33: /** The mud specific queue of events. */
    34: static struct dg_queue *event_q;
    35: 
    36: 
    37: /** Initializes the main event queue event_q.
    38:  * @post The main event queue, event_q, has been created and initialized.
    39:  */
    40: void event_init(void)
    41: {
    42:   event_q = queue_init();
    43: }
    44: 
    45: 
    46: /** Creates a new event 'object' that is then enqueued to the global event_q.
    47:  * @post If the newly created event is valid, it is always added to event_q.
    48:  * @param func The function to be called when this event fires. This function
    49:  * will be passed event_obj when it fires. The function must match the form
    50:  * described by EVENTFUNC. 
    51:  * @param event_obj An optional 'something' to be passed to func when this
    52:  * event fires. It is func's job to cast event_obj. If event_obj is not needed,
    53:  * pass in NULL.
    54:  * @param when Number of pulses between firing(s) of this event.
    55:  * @retval event * Returns a pointer to the newly created event.
    56:  **/
    57: struct event *event_create(EVENTFUNC(*func), void *event_obj, long when)
    58: {
    59:   struct event *new_event;
    60: 
    61:   if (when < 1) /* make sure its in the future */
    62:     when = 1;
    63: 
    64:   CREATE(new_event, struct event, 1);
    65:   new_event->func = func;
    66:   new_event->event_obj = event_obj;
    67:   new_event->q_el = queue_enq(event_q, new_event, when + pulse);
    68:   new_event->isMudEvent = FALSE;
    69: 
    70:   return new_event;
    71: }
    72: 
    73: /** Removes an event from event_q and frees the event. 
    74:  * @param event Pointer to the event to be dequeued and removed. 
    75:  */
    76: void event_cancel(struct event *event)
    77: {
    78:   if (!event) {
    79:     log("SYSERR:  Attempted to cancel a NULL event");
    80:     return;
    81:     }
    82: 
    83:   if (!event->q_el) {
    84:     log("SYSERR:  Attempted to cancel a non-NULL unqueued event, freeing anyway");
    85:   } else
    86:     queue_deq(event_q, event->q_el);
    87: 
    88:   if (event->event_obj)
    89:       cleanup_event_obj(event);
    90: 
    91:   free(event);
    92: }
    93: 
    94: /* The memory freeing routine tied into the mud event system */
    95: void cleanup_event_obj(struct event *event)
    96: {
    97:   struct mud_event_data * mud_event;
    98: 
    99:   if (event->isMudEvent) {  
   100:     mud_event = (struct mud_event_data *) event->event_obj;
   101:     free_mud_event(mud_event);
   102:   } else
   103:     free(event->event_obj);
   104: }
   105: 
   106: /** Process any events whose time has come. Should be called from, and at, every
   107:  * pulse of heartbeat. Re-enqueues multi-use events.
   108:  */
   109: void event_process(void)
   110: {
   111:   struct event *the_event;
   112:   long new_time;
   113: 
   114:   while ((long) pulse >= queue_key(event_q)) {
   115:     if (!(the_event = (struct event *) queue_head(event_q))) {
   116:       log("SYSERR: Attempt to get a NULL event");
   117:       return;
   118:     }
   119: 
   120:     /* Set the_event->q_el to NULL so that any functions called beneath 
   121:      * event_process can tell if they're being called beneath the actual
   122:      * event function. */
   123:     the_event->q_el = NULL;
   124: 
   125:     /* call event func, reenqueue event if retval > 0 */
   126:     if ((new_time = (the_event->func)(the_event->event_obj)) > 0)
   127:       the_event->q_el = queue_enq(event_q, the_event, new_time + pulse);
   128:     else
   129:     {
   130:       if (the_event->isMudEvent && the_event->event_obj != NULL)
   131:         free_mud_event((struct mud_event_data *) the_event->event_obj);
   132:       /* It is assumed that the_event will already have freed ->event_obj. */
   133:       free(the_event);
   134:     }
   135:       
   136:   }
   137: }
   138: 
   139: /** Returns the time remaining before the event as how many pulses from now. 
   140:  * @param event Check this event for its scheduled activation time.
   141:  * @retval long Number of pulses before this event will fire. */
   142: long event_time(struct event *event)
   143: {
   144:   long when;
   145: 
   146:   when = queue_elmt_key(event->q_el);
   147: 
   148:   return (when - pulse);
   149: }
   150: 
   151: /** Frees all events from event_q. */
   152: void event_free_all(void)
   153: {
   154:   if (event_q != NULL)
   155:     queue_free(event_q);
   156: }
   157: 
   158: /** Boolean function to tell whether an event is queued or not. Does this by
   159:  * checking if event->q_el points to anything but null.
   160:  * @retval int 1 if the event has been queued, 0 if the event has not.
   161:  **/
   162: int event_is_queued(struct event *event)
   163: {
   164:    if (event->q_el)
   165:      return 1;
   166:    else
   167:      return 0;
   168: }
   169: /***************************************************************************
   170:  * End mud specific event queue functions
   171:  **************************************************************************/
   172: 
   173: /***************************************************************************
   174:  * Begin generic (abstract) priority queue functions
   175:  **************************************************************************/
   176: /** Create a new, empty, priority queue and return it.
   177:  * @retval dg_queue * Pointer to the newly created queue structure. */
   178: struct dg_queue *queue_init(void)
   179: {
   180:   struct dg_queue *q;
   181: 
   182:   CREATE(q, struct dg_queue, 1);
   183: 
   184:   return q;
   185: }
   186: 
   187: /** Add some 'data' to a priority queue. 
   188:  * @pre The paremeter q must have been previously created by queue_init.
   189:  * @post A new q_element is created to hold the data parameter.
   190:  * @param q The existing dg_queue to add an element to. 
   191:  * @param data The data to be associated with, and theoretically used, when
   192:  * the element comes up in q. data is wrapped in a new q_element.
   193:  * @param key Indicates where this event should be located in the queue, and
   194:  * when the element should be activated.
   195:  * @retval q_element Pointer to the created q_element that contains
   196:  * the data. */
   197: struct q_element *queue_enq(struct dg_queue *q, void *data, long key)
   198: {
   199:   struct q_element *qe, *i;
   200:   int bucket;
   201: 
   202:   CREATE(qe, struct q_element, 1);
   203:   qe->data = data;
   204:   qe->key = key;
   205: 
   206:   bucket = key % NUM_EVENT_QUEUES;   /* which queue does this go in */
   207: 
   208:   if (!q->head[bucket]) { /* queue is empty */
   209:     q->head[bucket] = qe;
   210:     q->tail[bucket] = qe;
   211:   }
   212: 
   213:   else {
   214:     for (i = q->tail[bucket]; i; i = i->prev) {
   215: 
   216:       if (i->key < key) { /* found insertion point */
   217: 	if (i == q->tail[bucket])
   218: 	  q->tail[bucket] = qe;
   219: 	else {
   220: 	  qe->next = i->next;
   221: 	  i->next->prev = qe;
   222: 	}
   223: 
   224: 	qe->prev = i;
   225: 	i->next = qe;
   226: 	break;
   227:       }
   228:     }
   229: 
   230:     if (i == NULL) { /* insertion point is front of list */
   231:       qe->next = q->head[bucket];
   232:       q->head[bucket] = qe;
   233:       qe->next->prev = qe;
   234:     }
   235:   }
   236: 
   237:   return qe;
   238: }
   239: 
   240: /** Remove queue element qe from the priority queue q.
   241:  * @pre qe->data has been dealt with in some way.
   242:  * @post qe has been freed. 
   243:  * @param q Pointer to the queue containing qe.
   244:  * @param qe Pointer to the q_element to remove from q.
   245:  */
   246: void queue_deq(struct dg_queue *q, struct q_element *qe)
   247: {
   248:   int i;
   249: 
   250:   assert(qe);
   251: 
   252:   i = qe->key % NUM_EVENT_QUEUES;
   253: 
   254:   if (qe->prev == NULL)
   255:     q->head[i] = qe->next;
   256:   else
   257:     qe->prev->next = qe->next;
   258: 
   259:   if (qe->next == NULL)
   260:     q->tail[i] = qe->prev;
   261:   else
   262:     qe->next->prev = qe->prev;
   263: 
   264:   free(qe);
   265: }
   266: 
   267: /** Removes and returns the data of the first element of the priority queue q. 
   268:  * @pre pulse must be defined. This is a multi-headed queue, the current
   269:  * head is determined by the current pulse.
   270:  * @post the q->head is dequeued. 
   271:  * @param q The queue to return the head of.
   272:  * @retval void * NULL if there is not a currently available head, pointer
   273:  * to any data object associated with the queue element. */
   274: void *queue_head(struct dg_queue *q)
   275: {
   276:   void *dg_data;
   277:   int i;
   278: 
   279:   i = pulse % NUM_EVENT_QUEUES;
   280: 
   281:   if (!q->head[i])
   282:     return NULL;
   283: 
   284:   dg_data = q->head[i]->data;
   285:   queue_deq(q, q->head[i]);
   286:   return dg_data;
   287: }
   288: 
   289: /** Returns the key of the head element of the priority queue.
   290:  * @pre pulse must be defined. This is a multi-headed queue, the current
   291:  * head is determined by the current pulse. 
   292:  * @param q Queue to check for.
   293:  * @retval long Return the key element of the head q_element. If no head
   294:  * q_element is available, return LONG_MAX. */
   295: long queue_key(struct dg_queue *q)
   296: {
   297:   int i;
   298: 
   299:   i = pulse % NUM_EVENT_QUEUES;
   300: 
   301:   if (q->head[i])
   302:     return q->head[i]->key;
   303:   else
   304:     return LONG_MAX;
   305: }
   306: 
   307: /** Returns the key of queue element qe.
   308:  * @param qe Pointer to the keyed q_element.
   309:  * @retval long Key of qe. */
   310: long queue_elmt_key(struct q_element *qe)
   311: {
   312:   return qe->key;
   313: }
   314: 
   315: /** Free q and all contents.
   316:  * @pre Function requires definition of struct event.
   317:  * @post All items associeated qith q, including non-abstract data, are freed.
   318:  * @param q The priority queue to free.
   319:  */
   320: void queue_free(struct dg_queue *q)
   321: {
   322:   int i;
   323:   struct q_element *qe, *next_qe;
   324:   struct event *event;
   325: 
   326:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_EVENT_QUEUES; i++)
   327:   {
   328:     for (qe = q->head[i]; qe; qe = next_qe) 
   329:     {
   330:       next_qe = qe->next;
   331:       if ((event = (struct event *) qe->data) != NULL) 
   332:       {
   333:         if (event->event_obj)
   334:           cleanup_event_obj(event);
   335: 
   336:         free(event);
   337:       }
   338:       free(qe);
   339:     }
   340:   }
   341: 
   342:   free(q);
   343: }

    22: #define PULSE_DG_EVENT 1
    23: 
    24: /**************************************************************************
    25:  * Begin event structures and defines.
    26:  **************************************************************************/
    27: /** All Functions handled by the event system must be of this format. */
    28: #define EVENTFUNC(name) long (name)(void *event_obj)
    29: 
    30: /** The event structure. Events get attached to the queue and are executed
    31:  * when their turn comes up in the queue. */
    32: struct event {
    33:   EVENTFUNC(*func); /**< The function called when this event comes up. */
    34:   void *event_obj;  /**< event_obj is passed to func when func is called */
    35:   struct q_element *q_el;  /**< Where this event is located in the queue */
    36:   bool isMudEvent;  /**< used by the memory routines */
    37: };
    38: /**************************************************************************
    39:  * End event structures and defines.
    40:  **************************************************************************/
    41: 
    42: /**************************************************************************
    43:  * Begin priority queue structures and defines.
    44:  **************************************************************************/
    45: /** Number of buckets available in each queue. Reduces enqueue cost. */
    46: #define NUM_EVENT_QUEUES    10
    47: 
    48: /** The priority queue. */
    49: struct dg_queue {
    50:   struct q_element *head[NUM_EVENT_QUEUES]; /**< Front of each queue bucket. */
    51:   struct q_element *tail[NUM_EVENT_QUEUES]; /**< Rear of each queue bucket. */
    52: };
    53: 
    54: /** Queued elements. */
    55: struct q_element {
    56:   void *data;  /**< The event to be handled. */
    57:   long key;    /**< When the event should be handled. */
    58:   struct q_element *prev, *next; /**< Points to other q_elements in line. */
    59: };
    60: /**************************************************************************
    61:  * End priority queue structures and defines.
    62:  **************************************************************************/
    63: 
    64: /* - events - function protos needed by other modules */
    65: void event_init(void);
    66: struct event *event_create(EVENTFUNC(*func), void *event_obj, long when);
    67: void event_cancel(struct event *event);
    68: void event_process(void);
    69: long event_time(struct event *event);
    70: void event_free_all(void);
    71: void cleanup_event_obj(struct event *event);
    72: 
    73: /* - queues - function protos need by other modules */
    74: struct dg_queue *queue_init(void);
    75: struct q_element *queue_enq(struct dg_queue *q, void *data, long key);
    76: void queue_deq(struct dg_queue *q, struct q_element *qe);
    77: void *queue_head(struct dg_queue *q);
    78: long queue_key(struct dg_queue *q);
    79: long queue_elmt_key(struct q_element *qe);
    80: void queue_free(struct dg_queue *q);
    81: int  event_is_queued(struct event *event);
    82: 
    83: #endif /* _DG_EVENT_H_ */

    38: /* Trigedit */
    39: ACMD(do_oasis_trigedit)
    40: {
    41:   int number, real_num;
    42:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    43: 
    44:   /* No building as a mob or while being forced. */
    45:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
    46:     return;
    47: 
    48:   /* Parse any arguments. */
    49:   skip_spaces(&argument);
    50:   if (!*argument || !isdigit(*argument)) {
    51:     send_to_char(ch, "Specify a trigger VNUM to edit.\r\n");
    52:     return;
    53:   }
    54: 
    55:   number = atoi(argument);
    56: 
    57:   if (number < IDXTYPE_MIN || number > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
    58:     send_to_char(ch, "That trigger VNUM can't exist.\r\n");
    59:     return;
    60:   }
    61: 
    62:   /* Check that it isn't already being edited. */
    63:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
    64:     if (STATE(d) == CON_TRIGEDIT) {
    65:       if (d->olc && OLC_NUM(d) == number) {
    66:         send_to_char(ch, "That trigger is currently being edited by %s.\r\n",
    67:           GET_NAME(d->character));
    68:         return;
    69:       }
    70:     }
    71:   }
    72:   d = ch->desc;
    73:   /* Give descriptor an OLC structure. */
    74:   if (d->olc) {
    75:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE,
    76:       "SYSERR: do_oasis_trigedit: Player already had olc structure.");
    77:     free(d->olc);
    78:   }
    79:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
    80: 
    81:   /* Find the zone. */
    82:   if ((OLC_ZNUM(d) = real_zone_by_thing(number)) == NOWHERE) {
    83:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, there is no zone for that number!\r\n");
    84:     free(d->olc);
    85:     d->olc = NULL;
    86:     return;
    87:   }
    88: 
    89:   /* Everyone but IMPLs can only edit zones they have been assigned.*/
    90:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, OLC_ZNUM(d))) {
    91:     send_cannot_edit(ch, zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
    92:     /* Free the OLC structure. */
    93:     free(d->olc);
    94:     d->olc = NULL;
    95:     return;
    96:   }
    97:   OLC_NUM(d) = number;
    98: 
    99:   /* If this is a new trigger, setup a new one, otherwise, setup the a copy of 
   100:    * the existing trigger. */
   101:   if ((real_num = real_trigger(number)) == NOTHING)
   102:     trigedit_setup_new(d);
   103:   else
   104:     trigedit_setup_existing(d, real_num);
   105: 
   106:   trigedit_disp_menu(d);
   107:   STATE(d) = CON_TRIGEDIT;
   108: 
   109:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   110:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   111: 
   112:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,"OLC: %s starts editing zone %d [trigger](allowed zone %d)",
   113:          GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, GET_OLC_ZONE(ch));
   114: }

   116: /* Called when a mob or object is being saved to disk, so its script can be 
   117:  * saved. */
   118: void script_save_to_disk(FILE *fp, void *item, int type)
   119: {
   120:   struct trig_proto_list *t;
   121: 
   122:   if (type==MOB_TRIGGER)
   123:     t = ((struct char_data *)item)->proto_script;
   124:   else if (type==OBJ_TRIGGER)
   125:     t = ((struct obj_data *)item)->proto_script;
   126:   else if (type==WLD_TRIGGER)
   127:     t = ((struct room_data *)item)->proto_script;
   128:   else {
   129:     log("SYSERR: Invalid type passed to script_save_to_disk()");
   130:     return;
   131:   }
   132: 
   133:   while (t)
   134:   {
   135:     fprintf(fp,"T %d\n", t->vnum);
   136:     t = t->next;
   137:   }
   138: }

   140: static void trigedit_setup_new(struct descriptor_data *d)
   141: {
   142:   struct trig_data *trig;
   143: 
   144:   /* Allocate a scratch trigger structure. */
   145:   CREATE(trig, struct trig_data, 1);
   146: 
   147:   trig->nr = NOWHERE;
   148: 
   149:   /* Set up some defaults. */
   150:   trig->name = strdup("new trigger");
   151:   trig->trigger_type = MTRIG_GREET;
   152: 
   153:   /* cmdlist will be a large char string until the trigger is saved */
   154:   CREATE(OLC_STORAGE(d), char, MAX_CMD_LENGTH);
   155:   strncpy(OLC_STORAGE(d),
   156:     "%echo% This trigger commandlist is not complete!\r\n", MAX_CMD_LENGTH-1);
   157:   trig->narg = 100;
   158: 
   159:   OLC_TRIG(d) = trig;
   160:   OLC_VAL(d) = 0;  /* Has changed flag. (It hasn't so far, we just made it.) */
   161: }
   162: 
   163: void trigedit_setup_existing(struct descriptor_data *d, int rtrg_num)
   164: {
   165:   struct trig_data *trig;
   166:   struct cmdlist_element *c;
   167:   /* Allocate a scratch trigger structure. */
   168:   CREATE(trig, struct trig_data, 1);
   169: 
   170:   trig_data_copy(trig, trig_index[rtrg_num]->proto);
   171: 
   172:   /* convert cmdlist to a char string */
   173:   c = trig->cmdlist;
   174:   CREATE(OLC_STORAGE(d), char, MAX_CMD_LENGTH);
   175:   strcpy(OLC_STORAGE(d), "");
   176: 
   177:   while (c)
   178:   {
   179:     strcat(OLC_STORAGE(d), c->cmd);
   180:     strcat(OLC_STORAGE(d), "\r\n");
   181:     c = c->next;
   182:   }
   183:   /* Now trig->cmdlist is something to pass to the text editor it will be 
   184:    * converted back to a real cmdlist_element list later. */
   185: 
   186:   OLC_TRIG(d) = trig;
   187:   OLC_VAL(d) = 0;  /* Has changed flag. (It hasn't so far, we just made it.) */
   188: }

   190: static void trigedit_disp_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   191: {
   192:   struct trig_data *trig = OLC_TRIG(d);
   193:   char *attach_type;
   194:   char trgtypes[256];
   195: 
   196:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   197: 
   198:   if (trig->attach_type==OBJ_TRIGGER) {
   199:     attach_type = "Objects";
   200:     sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig), otrig_types, trgtypes, sizeof(trgtypes));
   201:   } else if (trig->attach_type==WLD_TRIGGER) {
   202:     attach_type = "Rooms";
   203:     sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig), wtrig_types, trgtypes, sizeof(trgtypes));
   204:   } else {
   205:     attach_type = "Mobiles";
   206:     sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig), trig_types, trgtypes, sizeof(trgtypes));
   207:   }
   208: 
   209:   clear_screen(d);
   210: 
   211:   write_to_output(d,
   212:   "Trigger Editor [%s%d%s]\r\n\r\n"
   213:   "%s1)%s Name         : %s%s\r\n"
   214:   "%s2)%s Intended for : %s%s\r\n"
   215:   "%s3)%s Trigger types: %s%s\r\n"
   216:   "%s4)%s Numeric Arg  : %s%d\r\n"
   217:   "%s5)%s Arguments    : %s%s\r\n"
   218:   "%s6)%s Commands:\r\n%s%s\r\n"
   219:   "%sW%s) Copy Trigger\r\n"
   220:   "%sY%s) References (read-only)\r\n"
   221:   "%sH%s) Trigger field help\r\n"
   222:   "%sQ)%s Quit\r\n"
   223:   "Enter Choice :",
   224: 
   225:   grn, OLC_NUM(d), nrm, 			/* vnum on the title line */
   226:   grn, nrm, yel, GET_TRIG_NAME(trig),		/* name                   */
   227:   grn, nrm, yel, attach_type,			/* attach type            */
   228:   grn, nrm, yel, trgtypes,			/* greet/drop/etc         */
   229:   grn, nrm, yel, trig->narg,			/* numeric arg            */
   230:   grn, nrm, yel, trig->arglist?trig->arglist:"",/* strict arg             */
   231:   grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_STORAGE(d),		/* the command list       */
   232:   grn, nrm, grn, nrm, grn, nrm, grn, nrm);                /* menu colors            */
   233: 
   234:   OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
   235: }

   256: static void trigedit_disp_types(struct descriptor_data *d)
   257: {
   258:   int i, columns = 0;
   259:   const char **types;
   260:   char bitbuf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   261: 
   262:   switch(OLC_TRIG(d)->attach_type)
   263:   {
   264:     case WLD_TRIGGER:
   265:       types = wtrig_types;
   266:       break;
   267:     case OBJ_TRIGGER:
   268:       types = otrig_types;
   269:       break;
   270:     case MOB_TRIGGER:
   271:     default:
   272:       types = trig_types;
   273:       break;
   274:   }
   275: 
   276:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   277:   clear_screen(d);
   278: 
   279:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_TRIG_TYPE_FLAGS; i++) {
   280:     if (!strncmp(types[i], "UNUSED", 6))
   281:       continue;
   282:     write_to_output(d, "%s%2d%s) %-20.20s  %s", grn, i + 1, nrm, types[i],
   283:               !(++columns % 2) ? "\r\n" : "");
   284:   }
   285:   sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(OLC_TRIG(d)), types, bitbuf, sizeof(bitbuf));
   286:   write_to_output(d, "\r\nCurrent types : %s%s%s\r\nEnter type (0 to quit) : ",
   287:                      cyn, bitbuf, nrm);
   288: 
   289: }

   311: // Change a string for another without memory bugs
   312: static char *str_replace(const char *string, const char *substr, const char *replacement) {
   313:     char *tok = NULL;
   314:     char *newstr = NULL;
   315:     char *oldstr = NULL;
   316:     char *head = NULL;
   317:     
   318:     // if either substr or replacement is NULL, duplicate string a let caller handle it
   319:     if (substr == NULL || replacement == NULL) {
   320:         return strdup (string);
   321:     }
   322:     
   323:     newstr = strdup (string);
   324:     head = newstr;
   325:     while ((tok = strstr(head, substr))) {
   326:         oldstr = newstr;
   327:         newstr = malloc(strlen(oldstr) - strlen(substr) + strlen (replacement) + 1);
   328:         // Failed to alloc mem, free old string and return NULL
   329:         if (newstr == NULL) {
   330:             free (oldstr);
   331:             return NULL;
   332:         }
   333:         memcpy (newstr, oldstr, tok - oldstr);
   334:         memcpy (newstr + (tok - oldstr), replacement, strlen (replacement));
   335:         memcpy (newstr + (tok - oldstr) + strlen(replacement), tok + strlen (substr), strlen (oldstr) - strlen (substr) - (tok - oldstr));
   336:         memset (newstr + strlen (oldstr) - strlen(substr) + strlen (replacement) , 0, 1 );
   337: 
   338:         // move back head right after the last replacement
   339:         head = newstr + (tok - oldstr) + strlen( replacement);
   340:         free (oldstr);
   341:     }
   342:     
   343:     return newstr;
   344: }
