   440:     // common commands (10)
   441:     { "drop ",           "\tcdrop \tn" },
   442:     { "emote ",          "\tcemote \tn" },
   443:     { "give ",           "\tcgive \tn" },
   444:     { "say ",            "\tcsay \tn" },
   445:     { "tell ",           "\tctell \tn" },
   446:     { "unlock ",         "\tcunlock \tn" }, // 30
   447:     { "lock ",           "\tclock \tn" },
   448:     { "open ",           "\tcopen \tn" },
   449:     { "close ",          "\tcclose \tn" },
   450:     { "junk ",          "\tcjunk \tn" } // 34
   451: };
   452: 
   453: 
   454: static void script_syntax_highlighting(struct descriptor_data *d, char *string)
   455: {
   456:     ACMD(do_action);
   457:     char buffer[MAX_STRING_LENGTH] = "";
   458:     char *newlist, *curtok;
   459:     
   460:     size_t i;
   461: 
   462:     // Parse script text line by line
   463:     newlist = strdup(string);
   464:     for (curtok = strtok(newlist, "\r\n"); curtok; curtok = strtok(NULL, "\r\n")) {
   465:         char *line = strdup(curtok);
   466:         bool comment = FALSE;
   467:         
   468:         // Find if is a comment
   469:         for (i=0;i <= strlen(line);i++) {
   470:             // skip initial spaces
   471:             if (strncmp(&line[i], " ", 1) == 0) {
   472:                 continue;
   473:             }
   474:             // is a comment, highlight
   475:             if (strncmp(&line[i], "*", 1) == 0) {
   476:                 line = str_replace(line, "*", "\tg*");
   477:                 comment = TRUE;
   478:                 break;
   479:             }
   480:             // not a comment
   481:             else {
   482:                 comment = FALSE;
   483:                 break;
   484:             }
   485:         }
   486:         
   487:         // Highlight lines
   488:         if (!comment) {
   489:             // Syntax replacement
   490:             for (i=0;i < SYNTAX_TERMS;i++) {
   491:                 line = str_replace(line, syntax_color_replacement[i][0], syntax_color_replacement[i][1]);
   492:             }
   493: 
   494:             // Commands replacement
   495:             for (i=0;i < COMMAND_TERMS;i++) {
   496:                 line = str_replace(line, command_color_replacement[i][0], command_color_replacement[i][1]);
   497:             }
   498:         
   499:             // Socials replacement (experimental)
   500:             int cmd;
   501:             for (cmd = 0; *complete_cmd_info[cmd].command != '\n'; cmd++) {
   502:                 if (complete_cmd_info[cmd].command_pointer == do_action) {
   503:                     char replace_social[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   504:                     snprintf(replace_social, MAX_INPUT_LENGTH, "\tc%s\tn", complete_cmd_info[cmd].command);
   505:                     line = str_replace(line, complete_cmd_info[cmd].command, replace_social);
   506:                 }
   507:             }
   508:         }
   509: 
   510:         strncat(buffer, line, sizeof(buffer) - strlen(buffer) - 1);
   511:         strncat(buffer, "\tn\r\n", sizeof(buffer) - strlen(buffer) - 1);
   512:     }
   513:     
   514:     page_string(d, buffer, TRUE);
   515: }
   516: /****************************************************************************************/
   517: 
   518: void trigedit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   519: {
   520:   int i = 0;
   521: 
   522:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   523:     case TRIGEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   524:      switch (tolower(*arg)) {
   525:        case 'q':
   526:          if (OLC_VAL(d)) { /* Anything been changed? */
   527:            if (!GET_TRIG_TYPE(OLC_TRIG(d))) {
   528:              write_to_output(d, "Invalid Trigger Type! Answer a to abort quit!\r\n");
   529:            }
   530:            write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   531:            OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   532:          } else
   533:            cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   534:          return;
   535:        case '1':
   536:          OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_NAME;
   537:          write_to_output(d, "Name: ");
   538:          break;
   539:        case '2':
   540:          OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_INTENDED;
   541:          write_to_output(d, "0: Mobiles, 1: Objects, 2: Rooms: ");
   542:          break;
   543:        case '3':
   544:          OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_TYPES;
   545:          trigedit_disp_types(d);
   546:          break;
   547:        case '4':
   548:          OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_NARG;
   549:          write_to_output(d, "Numeric argument: ");
   550:          break;
   551:        case '5':
   552:          OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_ARGUMENT;
   553:          write_to_output(d, "Argument: ");
   554:          break;
   555:        case '6':
   556:          OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_COMMANDS;
   557:          write_to_output(d, "Enter trigger commands: (/s saves /h for help)\r\n\r\n");
   558:          d->backstr = NULL;
   559:          if (OLC_STORAGE(d)) {
   560:            clear_screen(d);
   561:            script_syntax_highlighting(d, OLC_STORAGE(d));
   562:            d->backstr = strdup(OLC_STORAGE(d));
   563:          }
   564:          d->str = &OLC_STORAGE(d);
   565:          d->max_str = MAX_CMD_LENGTH;
   566:          d->mail_to = 0;
   567:          OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   568: 
   569:          break;
   570:        case 'h':
   571:          trigedit_disp_help(d);
   572:          return;
   573:        case 'y':
   574:          builder_refs_display(d, BREF_TRIGGER, OLC_NUM(d), "Trigger");
   575:          OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_REFERENCES;
   576:          return;
   577:        case 'w':
   578:        case 'W':
   579:          write_to_output(d, "Copy what trigger? ");
   580:          OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_COPY;
   581:          break;
   582:        default:
   583:          trigedit_disp_menu(d);
   584:          return;
   585:      }
   586:      return;
   587: 
   588:     case TRIGEDIT_REFERENCES:
   589:     case TRIGEDIT_HELP:
   590:       trigedit_disp_menu(d);
   591:       return;
   592: 
   593:     case TRIGEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   594:       switch(tolower(*arg)) {
   595:         case 'y':
   596:           trigedit_save(d);
   597:           mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE,
   598:                  "OLC: %s edits trigger %d", GET_NAME(d->character),
   599:                  OLC_NUM(d));
   600:           /* fall through */
   601:         case 'n':
   602:           cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   603:           return;
   604:         case 'a': /* abort quitting */
   605:           break;
   606:         default:
   607:           write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
   608:           write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   609:           return;
   610:       }
   611:       break;
   612: 
   613:     case TRIGEDIT_NAME:
   614:       smash_tilde(arg);
   615:       if (OLC_TRIG(d)->name)
   616:         free(OLC_TRIG(d)->name);
   617:       OLC_TRIG(d)->name = strdup((arg && *arg) ? arg : "undefined");
   618:       OLC_VAL(d)++;
   619:       break;
   620: 
   621:     case TRIGEDIT_INTENDED:
   622:       {
   623:         char *end = NULL;
   624:         long intended = strtol(arg, &end, 10);
   625:         while (end && *end && isspace((unsigned char)*end)) end++;
   626:         if (!arg || !*arg || !end || *end || intended < MOB_TRIGGER || intended > WLD_TRIGGER) {
   627:           write_to_output(d, "Invalid attach type. Enter 0, 1, or 2: ");
   628:           return;
   629:         }
   630:         if (OLC_TRIG(d)->attach_type != intended && GET_TRIG_TYPE(OLC_TRIG(d))) {
   631:           GET_TRIG_TYPE(OLC_TRIG(d)) = 0;
   632:           write_to_output(d, "Trigger flags cleared: bit meanings change between attach families.\r\n");
   633:         }
   634:         OLC_TRIG(d)->attach_type = intended;
   635:         OLC_VAL(d)++;
   636:       }
   637:       break;
   638: 
   639:     case TRIGEDIT_NARG:
   640:       {
   641:         char *end = NULL;
   642:         long value = strtol(arg, &end, 10);
   643:         while (end && *end && isspace((unsigned char)*end)) end++;
   644:         if (!arg || !*arg || !end || *end || value < 0 || value > INT_MAX) {
   645:           write_to_output(d, "Numeric argument must be a whole number from 0 to %d: ", INT_MAX);
   646:           return;
   647:         }
   648:         OLC_TRIG(d)->narg = (int)value;
   649:         OLC_VAL(d)++;
   650:       }
   651:       break;
   652: 
   653:     case TRIGEDIT_ARGUMENT:
   654:       smash_tilde(arg);
   655:       OLC_TRIG(d)->arglist = (*arg?strdup(arg):NULL);
   656:       OLC_VAL(d)++;
   657:       break;
   658: 
   659:     case TRIGEDIT_TYPES:
   660:       if ((i = atoi(arg)) == 0)
   661:         break;
   662:       else if (!((i < 0) || (i > NUM_TRIG_TYPE_FLAGS))) {
   663:         const char **types = OLC_TRIG(d)->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? otrig_types :
   664:                              OLC_TRIG(d)->attach_type == WLD_TRIGGER ? wtrig_types : trig_types;
   665:         if (!strncmp(types[i - 1], "UNUSED", 6)) {
   666:           write_to_output(d, "That bit is reserved and cannot be selected for this attach type.\r\n");
   667:           trigedit_disp_types(d);
   668:           return;
   669:         }
   670:         TOGGLE_BIT((GET_TRIG_TYPE(OLC_TRIG(d))), 1 << (i - 1));
   671:       }
   672:       OLC_VAL(d)++;
   673:       trigedit_disp_types(d);
   674:       return;
   675: 
   676:     case TRIGEDIT_COPY:
   677:       if ((i = real_trigger(atoi(arg))) != NOWHERE) {
   678:         trigedit_setup_existing(d, i);
   679:       } else
   680:         write_to_output(d, "That trigger does not exist.\r\n");
   681:       break;
   682: 
   683:     case TRIGEDIT_COMMANDS:
   684:       break;
   685: 
   686:   }
   687: 
   688:   OLC_MODE(d) = TRIGEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
   689:   trigedit_disp_menu(d);
   690: }
   691: 
   692: /* save the zone's triggers to internal memory and to disk */
   693: void trigedit_save(struct descriptor_data *d)
   694: {
   695:   builder_refs_invalidate();
   696:   int i;
   697:   trig_rnum rnum;
   698:   int found = 0;
   699:   char *s;
   700:   trig_data *proto;
   701:   trig_data *trig = OLC_TRIG(d);
   702:   trig_data *live_trig;
   703:   struct cmdlist_element *cmd, *next_cmd;
   704:   struct index_data **new_index;
   705:   struct descriptor_data *dsc;
   706:   FILE *trig_file;
   707:   int zone, top;
   708:   char buf[MAX_CMD_LENGTH];
   709:   char bitBuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   710:   char fname[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   711: 
   712:   if ((rnum = real_trigger(OLC_NUM(d))) != NOTHING) {
   713:     proto = trig_index[rnum]->proto;
   714:     for (cmd = proto->cmdlist; cmd; cmd = next_cmd) {
   715:       next_cmd = cmd->next;
   716:       if (cmd->cmd)
   717:         free(cmd->cmd);
   718:       free(cmd);
   719:     }
   720: 
   721: 
   722:     free(proto->arglist);
   723:     free(proto->name);
   724: 
   725:     /* Recompile the command list from the new script */
   726:     s = OLC_STORAGE(d);
   727: 
   728:     CREATE(trig->cmdlist, struct cmdlist_element, 1);
   729:     if (s) {
   730:       char *t = strtok(s, "\n\r"); /* strtok returns NULL if s is "\r\n" */
   731:       if (t)
   732:         trig->cmdlist->cmd = strdup(t);
   733:       else
   734:         trig->cmdlist->cmd = strdup("* No script");
   735: 
   736:       cmd = trig->cmdlist;
   737:       while ((s = strtok(NULL, "\n\r"))) {
   738:         CREATE(cmd->next, struct cmdlist_element, 1);
   739:         cmd = cmd->next;
   740:         cmd->cmd = strdup(s);
   741:       }
   742:     } else
   743:       trig->cmdlist->cmd = strdup("* No Script");
   744: 
   745:     /* make the prorotype look like what we have */
   746:     trig_data_copy(proto, trig);
   747: 
   748:     /* go through the mud and replace existing triggers         */
   749:     live_trig = trigger_list;
   750:     while (live_trig)
   751:     {
   752:       if (GET_TRIG_RNUM(live_trig) == rnum) {
   753:         if (live_trig->arglist) {
   754:           free(live_trig->arglist);
   755:           live_trig->arglist = NULL;
   756:         }
   757:         if (live_trig->name) {
   758:           free(live_trig->name);
   759:           live_trig->name = NULL;
   760:         }
   761: 
   762:         if (proto->arglist)
   763:           live_trig->arglist = strdup(proto->arglist);
   764:         if (proto->name)
   765:           live_trig->name = strdup(proto->name);
   766: 
   767:         /* anything could have happened so we don't want to keep these */
   768:         if (GET_TRIG_WAIT(live_trig)) {
   769:           event_cancel(GET_TRIG_WAIT(live_trig));
   770:           GET_TRIG_WAIT(live_trig)=NULL;
   771:         }
   772:         if (live_trig->var_list) {
   773:           free_varlist(live_trig->var_list);
   774:           live_trig->var_list=NULL;
   775:         }
   776: 
   777:         live_trig->cmdlist = proto->cmdlist;
   778:         live_trig->curr_state = live_trig->cmdlist;
   779:         live_trig->trigger_type = proto->trigger_type;
   780:         live_trig->attach_type = proto->attach_type;
   781:         live_trig->narg = proto->narg;
   782:         live_trig->data_type = proto->data_type;
   783:         live_trig->depth = 0;
   784:       }
   785: 
   786:       live_trig = live_trig->next_in_world;
   787:     }
   788:   } else {
   789:     /* this is a new trigger */
   790:     CREATE(new_index, struct index_data *, top_of_trigt + 2);
   791: 
   792:     /* Recompile the command list from the new script */
   793: 
   794:     s = OLC_STORAGE(d);
   795: 
   796:     CREATE(trig->cmdlist, struct cmdlist_element, 1);
   797:     if (s) {
   798:       /* strtok returns NULL if s is "\r\n" */
   799:       char *t = strtok(s, "\n\r");
   800:       trig->cmdlist->cmd = strdup(t ? t : "* No script");
   801:       cmd = trig->cmdlist;
   802: 
   803:       while ((s = strtok(NULL, "\n\r"))) {
   804:         CREATE(cmd->next, struct cmdlist_element, 1);
   805:         cmd = cmd->next;
   806:         cmd->cmd = strdup(s);
   807:       }
   808:     } else
   809:       trig->cmdlist->cmd = strdup("* No Script");
   810: 
   811:     for (i = 0; i < top_of_trigt; i++) {
   812:       if (!found) {
   813:         if (trig_index[i]->vnum > OLC_NUM(d)) {
   814:           found = TRUE;
   815:           rnum = i;
   816: 
   817:           CREATE(new_index[rnum], struct index_data, 1);
   818:           GET_TRIG_RNUM(OLC_TRIG(d)) = rnum;
   819:           new_index[rnum]->vnum = OLC_NUM(d);
   820:           new_index[rnum]->number = 0;
   821:           new_index[rnum]->func = NULL;
   822:           CREATE(proto, struct trig_data, 1);
   823:           new_index[rnum]->proto = proto;
   824:           trig_data_copy(proto, trig);
   825: 
   826:           new_index[rnum + 1] = trig_index[rnum];
   827: 
   828:           proto = trig_index[rnum]->proto;
   829:           proto->nr = rnum + 1;
   830:         } else {
   831:           new_index[i] = trig_index[i];
   832:         }
   833:       } else {
   834:          new_index[i + 1] = trig_index[i];
   835:          proto = trig_index[i]->proto;
   836:          proto->nr = i + 1;
   837:       }
   838:     }
   839: 
   840:     if (!found) {
   841:       rnum = i;
   842:       CREATE(new_index[rnum], struct index_data, 1);
   843:       GET_TRIG_RNUM(OLC_TRIG(d)) = rnum;
   844:       new_index[rnum]->vnum = OLC_NUM(d);
   845:       new_index[rnum]->number = 0;
   846:       new_index[rnum]->func = NULL;
   847: 
   848:       CREATE(proto, struct trig_data, 1);
   849:       new_index[rnum]->proto = proto;
   850:       trig_data_copy(proto, trig);
   851:     }
   852: 
   853:     free(trig_index);
   854: 
   855:     trig_index = new_index;
   856:     top_of_trigt++;
   857: 
   858:     /* HERE IT HAS TO GO THROUGH AND FIX ALL SCRIPTS/TRIGS OF HIGHER RNUM */
   859:     for (live_trig = trigger_list; live_trig; live_trig = live_trig->next_in_world)
   860:       GET_TRIG_RNUM(live_trig) += (GET_TRIG_RNUM(live_trig) != NOTHING && GET_TRIG_RNUM(live_trig) > rnum);
   861: 
   862:     /* Update other trigs being edited. */
   863:      for (dsc = descriptor_list; dsc; dsc = dsc->next)
   864:        if (STATE(dsc) == CON_TRIGEDIT)
   865:          if (GET_TRIG_RNUM(OLC_TRIG(dsc)) >= rnum)
   866:            GET_TRIG_RNUM(OLC_TRIG(dsc))++;
   867: 
   868:   }
   869: 
   870:   /* now write the trigger out to disk, along with the rest of the triggers for
   871:    * this zone. We write this to disk NOW instead of letting the builder have 
   872:    * control because if we lose this after having assigned a new trigger to an 
   873:    * item, we will get SYSERR's upton reboot that could make things hard to 
   874:    * debug. */
   875:   zone = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number;
   876:   top = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].top;
   877: 
   878: #ifdef CIRCLE_MAC
   879:   snprintf(fname, sizeof(fname), "%s:%i.new", TRG_PREFIX, zone);
   880: #else
   881:   snprintf(fname, sizeof(fname), "%s/%i.new", TRG_PREFIX, zone);
   882: #endif
   883: 
   884:   if (!(trig_file = fopen(fname, "w"))) {
   885:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE,
   886:            "SYSERR: OLC: Can't open trig file \"%s\"", fname);
   887:     return;
   888:   }
   889: 
   890:   for (i = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].bot; i <= top; i++) {
   891:     if ((rnum = real_trigger(i)) != NOTHING) {
   892:       trig = trig_index[rnum]->proto;
   893: 
   894:       if (fprintf(trig_file, "#%d\n", i) < 0) {
   895:         mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE,
   896:                "SYSERR: OLC: Can't write trig file!");
   897:         fclose(trig_file);
   898:         return;
   899:       }
   900:       sprintascii(bitBuf, GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig));
   901:       fprintf(trig_file,      "%s%c\n"
   902:                               "%d %s %d\n"
   903:                               "%s%c\n",
   904:            (GET_TRIG_NAME(trig)) ? (GET_TRIG_NAME(trig)) : "unknown trigger", STRING_TERMINATOR,
   905:            trig->attach_type,
   906:            *bitBuf ? bitBuf : "0", GET_TRIG_NARG(trig),
   907:            GET_TRIG_ARG(trig) ? GET_TRIG_ARG(trig) : "", STRING_TERMINATOR);
   908: 
   909:       /* Build the text for the script */
   910:       strcpy(buf,""); /* strcpy OK for MAX_CMD_LENGTH > 0*/
   911:       for (cmd = trig->cmdlist; cmd; cmd = cmd->next) {
   912:         strcat(buf, cmd->cmd);
   913:         strcat(buf, "\n");
   914:       }
   915: 
   916:       if (!buf[0])
   917:         strcpy(buf, "* Empty script");
   918: 
   919:       fprintf(trig_file, "%s%c\n", buf, STRING_TERMINATOR);
   920:       *buf = '\0';
   921:     }
   922:   }
   923: 
   924:   fprintf(trig_file, "$%c\n", STRING_TERMINATOR);
   925:   fclose(trig_file);
   926: 
   927: #ifdef CIRCLE_MAC
   928:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s:%d.trg", TRG_PREFIX, zone);
   929: #else
   930:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.trg", TRG_PREFIX, zone);
   931: #endif
   932: 
   933:   remove(buf);
   934:   rename(fname, buf);
   935: 
   936:   write_to_output(d, "Trigger saved to disk.\r\n");
   937:   trigedit_create_index(zone, "trg");
   938: }
   939: 
   940: static void trigedit_create_index(int znum, char *type)
   941: {
   942:   FILE *newfile, *oldfile;
   943:   char new_name[128], old_name[128], *prefix;
   944:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   945:   int num, found = FALSE;
   946: 
   947:   prefix = TRG_PREFIX;
   948: 
   949:   snprintf(old_name, sizeof(old_name), "%s/index", prefix);
   950:   snprintf(new_name, sizeof(new_name), "%s/newindex", prefix);
   951: 
   952:   if (!(oldfile = fopen(old_name, "r"))) {
   953:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: DG_OLC: Failed to open %s", old_name);
   954:     return;
   955:   } else if (!(newfile = fopen(new_name, "w"))) {
   956:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: DG_OLC: Failed to open %s", new_name);
   957:     return;
   958:   }
   959: 
   960:   /* Index contents must be in order: search through the old file for the right
   961:    * place, insert the new file, then copy the rest over. */
   962:   snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "%d.%s", znum, type);
   963:   while (get_line(oldfile, buf)) {
   964:     if (*buf == '$') {
   965:       fprintf(newfile, "%s\n$\n", (!found ? buf1 : ""));
   966:       break;
   967:     } else if (!found) {
   968:       sscanf(buf, "%d", &num);
   969:       if (num == znum)
   970:         found = TRUE;
   971:       else if (num > znum) {
   972:         found = TRUE;
   973:         fprintf(newfile, "%s\n", buf1);
   974:       }
   975:     }
   976:     fprintf(newfile, "%s\n", buf);
   977:   }
   978: 
   979:   fclose(newfile);
   980:   fclose(oldfile);
   981: 
   982:   /* Out with the old, in with the new. */
   983:   remove(old_name);
   984:   rename(new_name, old_name);
   985: }
   986: 
   987: void dg_olc_script_copy(struct descriptor_data *d)
   988: {
   989:   struct trig_proto_list *origscript, *editscript;
   990: 
   991:   if (OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d)==MOB_TRIGGER)
   992:     origscript = OLC_MOB(d)->proto_script;
   993:   else if (OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d)==OBJ_TRIGGER)
   994:     origscript = OLC_OBJ(d)->proto_script;
   995:   else origscript = OLC_ROOM(d)->proto_script;
   996: 
   997:   if (origscript) {
   998:     CREATE(editscript, struct trig_proto_list, 1);
   999:     OLC_SCRIPT(d) = editscript;
  1000: 
  1001:     while (origscript) {
  1002:       editscript->vnum = origscript->vnum;
  1003:       origscript = origscript->next;
  1004:       if (origscript)
  1005:         CREATE(editscript->next, struct trig_proto_list, 1);
  1006:       editscript = editscript->next;
  1007:     }
  1008:   } else
  1009:       OLC_SCRIPT(d) = NULL;
  1010: }
  1011: 
  1012: static struct trig_proto_list *dg_attachment_at(struct descriptor_data *d, int slot)
  1013: {
  1014:   struct trig_proto_list *trigger = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
  1015:   while (trigger && --slot > 0)
  1016:     trigger = trigger->next;
  1017:   return slot == 0 ? trigger : NULL;
  1018: }
  1019: 
  1020: static const char *dg_parent_noun(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1021: {
  1022:   return OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d) == MOB_TRIGGER ? "Mob" :
  1023:          OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d) == OBJ_TRIGGER ? "Object" : "Room";
  1024: }
  1025: 
  1026: static void dg_trigger_action_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1027: {
  1028:   struct trig_proto_list *attached = dg_attachment_at(d, OLC(d)->script_selected);
  1029:   trig_rnum rnum = attached ? real_trigger(attached->vnum) : NOTHING;
  1030:   struct trig_data *proto = rnum == NOTHING ? NULL : trig_index[rnum]->proto;
  1031:   char types[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH] = "Unknown";
  1032: 
  1033:   if (!attached) {
  1034:     dg_script_menu(d);
  1035:     return;
  1036:   }
  1037:   if (proto) {
  1038:     const char **names = proto->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? otrig_types :
  1039:                          proto->attach_type == WLD_TRIGGER ? wtrig_types : trig_types;
  1040:     sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(proto), names, types, sizeof(types));
  1041:   }
  1042:   clear_screen(d);
  1043:   write_to_output(d, "Attached Trigger\r\n----------------\r\n\r\n"
  1044:       "Attachment slot : %d\r\nTrigger VNUM    : %d\r\nName            : %s\r\n"
  1045:       "Type            : %s\r\nAttach Type     : %s\r\n"
  1046:       "Numeric Argument: %d\r\nArgument        : %s\r\n\r\n"
  1047:       "Behavior metadata:\r\n  %s\r\n\r\n"
  1048:       "1) Inspect Trigger\r\n2) Edit Trigger Prototype\r\n"
  1049:       "3) Detach From This %s\r\nQ) Return\r\n\r\nChoice: ",
  1050:       OLC(d)->script_selected, attached->vnum,
  1051:       proto && proto->name ? proto->name : "<missing trigger prototype>", types,
  1052:       proto ? (proto->attach_type == MOB_TRIGGER ? "Mobile" :
  1053:                proto->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? "Object" : "Room") : "Unknown",
  1054:       proto ? GET_TRIG_NARG(proto) : 0,
  1055:       proto && GET_TRIG_ARG(proto) ? GET_TRIG_ARG(proto) : "<none>",
  1056:       attached->vnum == 3011 ?
  1057:         "Picks up non-fountain room objects costing 15 gold or less." :
  1058:         "Unknown / arbitrary DG Script (no authored metadata).",
  1059:       dg_parent_noun(d));
  1060:   OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_TRIGGER_ACTION;
  1061: }
  1062: 
  1063: static void dg_trigger_inspect(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1064: {
  1065:   struct trig_proto_list *attached = dg_attachment_at(d, OLC(d)->script_selected);
  1066:   trig_rnum rnum = attached ? real_trigger(attached->vnum) : NOTHING;
  1067:   struct trig_data *proto = rnum == NOTHING ? NULL : trig_index[rnum]->proto;
  1068:   struct cmdlist_element *command;
  1069:   char types[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH] = "Unknown";
  1070: 
  1071:   if (!attached) {
  1072:     dg_script_menu(d);
  1073:     return;
  1074:   }
  1075:   if (proto) {
  1076:     const char **names = proto->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? otrig_types :
  1077:                          proto->attach_type == WLD_TRIGGER ? wtrig_types : trig_types;
  1078:     sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(proto), names, types, sizeof(types));
  1079:   }
  1080:   clear_screen(d);
  1081:   write_to_output(d, "Trigger Inspection (read-only)\r\n------------------------------\r\n\r\n"
  1082:       "VNUM: %d\r\nName: %s\r\nTrigger type: %s\r\nAttach type: %s\r\n"
  1083:       "Numeric argument: %d\r\nArgument phrase: %s\r\nMetadata availability: %s\r\n",
  1084:       attached->vnum, proto && proto->name ? proto->name : "<missing trigger prototype>",
  1085:       types, proto ? (proto->attach_type == MOB_TRIGGER ? "Mobile" :
  1086:                       proto->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? "Object" : "Room") : "Unknown",
  1087:       proto ? GET_TRIG_NARG(proto) : 0,
  1088:       proto && GET_TRIG_ARG(proto) ? GET_TRIG_ARG(proto) : "<none>",
  1089:       attached->vnum == 3011 ? "Available (verified from trigger commands)" : "Not authored");
  1090:   if (attached->vnum == 3011)
  1091:     write_to_output(d, "Known behavior: Picks up non-fountain room objects costing 15 gold or less.\r\n");
  1092:   else
  1093:     write_to_output(d, "Behavior classification: Unknown / arbitrary DG Script.\r\n");
  1094: 
  1095:   if (proto && (GET_LEVEL(d->character) >= LVL_IMPL ||
  1096:       can_edit_zone(d->character, real_zone_by_thing(attached->vnum)))) {
  1097:     write_to_output(d, "\r\nCommands:\r\n");
  1098:     for (command = proto->cmdlist; command; command = command->next)
  1099:       write_to_output(d, "  %s\r\n", command->cmd);
  1100:   } else
  1101:     write_to_output(d, "\r\nCommands: unavailable (zone permission required).\r\n");
  1102:   write_to_output(d, "\r\nQ) Return to selected trigger\r\nChoice: ");
  1103:   OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_INSPECT_TRIGGER;
  1104: }
  1105: 
  1106: void dg_script_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1107: {
  1108:   struct trig_proto_list *editscript;
  1109:   int i = 0;
  1110: 
  1111:   /* make sure our input parser gets used */
  1112:   OLC_MODE(d) = OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT;
  1113:   OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_MAIN_MENU;
  1114: 
  1115:   clear_screen(d);
  1116:   write_to_output(d, "     Script Editor\r\n\r\n     Trigger List:\r\n");
  1117: 
  1118:   editscript = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
  1119: 
  1120:   while (editscript) {
  1121:     trig_rnum rnum = real_trigger(editscript->vnum);
  1122:     struct trig_data *proto = rnum == NOTHING ? NULL : trig_index[rnum]->proto;
  1123:     write_to_output(d, "     %2d) [%s%d%s] %s%s%s", ++i, cyn,
  1124:       editscript->vnum, nrm, cyn,
  1125:       proto && proto->name ? proto->name : "<missing trigger prototype>", nrm);
  1126:     if (proto && proto->attach_type != OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d))
  1127:       write_to_output(d, "   %s** Mis-matched Trigger Type **%s\r\n",grn,nrm);
  1128:     else
  1129:       write_to_output(d, "\r\n");
  1130:     if (proto) {
  1131:       char types[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1132:       const char **names = proto->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? otrig_types :
  1133:                            proto->attach_type == WLD_TRIGGER ? wtrig_types : trig_types;
  1134:       sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(proto), names, types, sizeof(types));
  1135:       write_to_output(d, "         %s %s trigger; numeric argument: %d\r\n",
  1136:           types, proto->attach_type == MOB_TRIGGER ? "Mobile" :
  1137:                  proto->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? "Object" : "Room",
  1138:           GET_TRIG_NARG(proto));
  1139:       if (editscript->vnum == 3011)
  1140:         write_to_output(d, "         Picks up non-fountain room objects costing 15 gold or less\r\n");
  1141:       else
  1142:         write_to_output(d, "         Behavior: Unknown / arbitrary DG Script\r\n");
  1143:     }
  1144: 
  1145:     editscript = editscript->next;
  1146:   }
  1147:   if (i==0)
  1148:     write_to_output(d, "     <none>\r\n");
  1149: 
  1150:   write_to_output(d,  "\r\n"
  1151:     " %sN%s)  New trigger for this script\r\n"
  1152:     " %sD%s)  Delete a trigger in this script\r\n"
  1153:     " %sI%s)  Inspect attached trigger\r\n"
  1154:     " %sE%s)  Edit trigger prototype (safe handoff)\r\n"
  1155:     " %sR%s)  References / usage\r\n"
  1156:     " %sH%s)  Help\r\n"
  1157:     " %sX%s)  Exit Script Editor\r\n"
  1158:     " Select a number for attachment actions\r\n\r\n"
  1159:     "     Enter choice :",
  1160:     grn, nrm, grn, nrm, grn, nrm, grn, nrm, grn, nrm, grn, nrm,
  1161:     grn, nrm);
  1162: }
  1163: 
  1164: int dg_script_edit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
  1165: {
  1166:   struct trig_proto_list *trig, *currtrig;
  1167:   int count, pos, vnum;
  1168: 
  1169:   switch(OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d)) {
  1170:     case SCRIPT_MAIN_MENU:
  1171:       if (isdigit((unsigned char)*arg)) {
  1172:         char *end = NULL;
  1173:         long selection = strtol(arg, &end, 10);
  1174:         while (end && *end && isspace((unsigned char)*end))
  1175:           end++;
  1176:         pos = end && *end == '\0' && selection <= INT_MAX ? (int)selection : 0;
  1177:         currtrig = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
  1178:         while (currtrig && --pos > 0) currtrig = currtrig->next;
  1179:         if (currtrig && pos == 0) {
  1180:           OLC(d)->script_selected = (int)selection;
  1181:           dg_trigger_action_menu(d);
  1182:           return 1;
  1183:         }
  1184:       }
  1185:       switch(tolower(*arg)) {
  1186:         case 'q': /* Additive alias retained for builders used to newer menus. */
  1187:         case 'x':
  1188:           /* This was buggy. First we created a copy of a thing, but maintained
  1189: 	   * pointers to scripts, then if we altered the scripts, we freed the 
  1190: 	   * pointers and added new ones to the OLC_THING. If we then choose NOT
  1191: 	   * to save the changes, the pointers in the original pointed to 
  1192: 	   * garbage. If we saved changes the pointers were updated correctly.
  1193: 	   * Solution: Here we just point the working copies to the new 
  1194: 	   * proto_scripts. We only update the original when choosing to save 
  1195: 	   * internally, then free the unused memory there. -Welcor
  1196: 	   * Thanks to Jeremy Stanley and Torgny Bjers for the bug report.
  1197: 	   * After updating to OasisOLC 2.0.3 I discovered some malfunctions
  1198: 	   * in this code, so I restructured it a bit. Now things work like 
  1199: 	   * this: OLC_SCRIPT(d) is assigned a copy of the edited things' 
  1200: 	   * proto_script. OLC_OBJ(d), etc.. are initalized with proto_script =
  1201: 	   * NULL; On save, the saved copy is updated with OLC_SCRIPT(d) as new
  1202: 	   * proto_script (freeing the old one). On quit/nosave, OLC_SCRIPT is 
  1203: 	   * free()'d, and the prototype not touched. */
  1204:           return 0;
  1205:         case 'n':
  1206:           for (count = 0, trig = OLC_SCRIPT(d); trig; trig = trig->next) count++;
  1207:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nPlease enter position, vnum   (ex: 1, 200):\r\n"
  1208:               "Current attached triggers: %d\r\n"
  1209:               "Valid insertion slots: 1 through %d\r\nUse slot %d to append.\r\n"
  1210:               "Duplicate attachments are allowed by the legacy DG policy.\r\n\r\n"
  1211:               "Enter slot, VNUM or Q to cancel: ", count, count + 1, count + 1);
  1212:           OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_NEW_TRIGGER;
  1213:           break;
  1214:         case 'd':
  1215:           for (count = 0, trig = OLC_SCRIPT(d); trig; trig = trig->next) count++;
  1216:           if (!count) {
  1217:             write_to_output(d, "There are no trigger attachments to delete.\r\n");
  1218:             dg_script_menu(d);
  1219:             break;
  1220:           }
  1221:           write_to_output(d, "Detach which attachment slot?\r\n"
  1222:               "Enter 1 through %d, or 0/Q to cancel: ", count);
  1223:           OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_DEL_TRIGGER;
  1224:           break;
  1225:         case 'i':
  1226:           write_to_output(d, "Inspect which attachment position (or Q to cancel)? ");
  1227:           OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_INSPECT_SELECT;
  1228:           break;
  1229:         case 'e':
  1230:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nTrigger prototypes are edited separately.\r\n"
  1231:               "Select an attachment to learn its VNUM, save or discard this parent, then enter:\r\n"
  1232:               "  trigedit <vnum>\r\n\r\nQ) Return to Script Editor: ");
  1233:           OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_INFO_RETURN;
  1234:           break;
  1235:         case 'r':
  1236:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nReferences are available through the separate builder reference tools.\r\n"
  1237:               "No potentially expensive world scan is run from this menu.\r\n\r\n"
  1238:               "Q) Return to Script Editor: ");
  1239:           OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_INFO_RETURN;
  1240:           break;
  1241:         case 'h':
  1242:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nScript attachment help\r\n----------------------\r\n"
  1243:               "N attaches an existing Mobile/Object/Room trigger to the matching parent.\r\n"
  1244:               "Enter position, vnum (for example: 1, 200); attachment order is preserved.\r\n"
  1245:               "D removes one attachment by its numbered position; it does not delete the trigger.\r\n"
  1246:               "X returns to the parent editor. Attachments become permanent only when it is saved.\r\n"
  1247:               "Attaching a trigger does not edit its prototype. MEDIT accepts only Mobile triggers.\r\n\r\n");
  1248:           write_to_output(d, "Q) Return to Script Editor: ");
  1249:           OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_INFO_RETURN;
  1250:           break;
  1251:         default:
  1252:           dg_script_menu(d);
  1253:           break;
  1254:       }
  1255:       return 1;
  1256: 
  1257:     case SCRIPT_INFO_RETURN:
  1258:       if (tolower((unsigned char)*arg) == 'q')
  1259:         break;
  1260:       write_to_output(d, "Enter Q to return to the Script Editor: ");
  1261:       return 1;
  1262: 
  1263:     case SCRIPT_INSPECT_SELECT:
  1264:       if (tolower((unsigned char)*arg) == 'q')
  1265:         break;
  1266:       pos = atoi(arg);
  1267:       if (!dg_attachment_at(d, pos)) {
  1268:         write_to_output(d, "That attachment position does not exist. Enter a listed position, or Q: ");
  1269:         return 1;
  1270:       }
  1271:       OLC(d)->script_selected = pos;
  1272:       dg_trigger_inspect(d);
  1273:       return 1;
  1274: 
  1275:     case SCRIPT_INSPECT_TRIGGER:
  1276:       /* Inspection is read-only: never touch OLC_VAL here. */
  1277:       if (tolower((unsigned char)*arg) == 'q')
  1278:         dg_trigger_action_menu(d);
  1279:       else
  1280:         write_to_output(d, "Enter Q to return to the selected trigger: ");
  1281:       return 1;
  1282: 
  1283:     case SCRIPT_TRIGGER_ACTION:
  1284:       switch (tolower((unsigned char)*arg)) {
  1285:         case '1':
  1286:           dg_trigger_inspect(d);
  1287:           break;
  1288:         case '2':
  1289:           currtrig = dg_attachment_at(d, OLC(d)->script_selected);
  1290:           if (!currtrig || real_trigger(currtrig->vnum) == NOTHING) {
  1291:             write_to_output(d, "That trigger prototype no longer exists.\r\n");
  1292:           } else {
  1293:             write_to_output(d, "\r\nEdit Trigger Prototype\r\n----------------------\r\n\r\n"
  1294:                 "Trigger %d is edited by the authoritative trigger editor.\r\n\r\n"
  1295:                 "Nested Oasis OLC is not safe because all editors share one descriptor OLC structure.\r\n"
  1296:                 "Return to and save or discard this parent editor, then enter:\r\n  trigedit %d\r\n\r\n"
  1297:                 "The trigedit command will enforce builder level, zone ownership, descriptor state,\r\n"
  1298:                 "and concurrent-editor checks. No parent attachment has been changed.\r\n\r\n"
  1299:                 "Q) Return to selected trigger\r\nChoice: ", currtrig->vnum, currtrig->vnum);
  1300:             OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_INSPECT_TRIGGER;
  1301:             return 1;
  1302:           }
  1303:           dg_trigger_action_menu(d);
  1304:           break;
  1305:         case '3':
  1306:           currtrig = dg_attachment_at(d, OLC(d)->script_selected);
  1307:           if (!currtrig) {
  1308:             dg_script_menu(d);
  1309:             break;
  1310:           }
  1311:           {
  1312:             trig_rnum rnum = real_trigger(currtrig->vnum);
  1313:             struct trig_data *proto = rnum == NOTHING ? NULL : trig_index[rnum]->proto;
  1314:             write_to_output(d, "\r\nDetach attachment slot %d: trigger [%d] %s from this %s?\r\n"
  1315:                 "This removes only the attachment; it does not delete the trigger prototype.\r\nY/N: ",
  1316:                 OLC(d)->script_selected, currtrig->vnum,
  1317:                 proto && proto->name ? proto->name : "<missing trigger prototype>",
  1318:                 dg_parent_noun(d));
  1319:           }
  1320:           OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_DETACH_CONFIRM;
  1321:           break;
  1322:         case 'q':
  1323:           dg_script_menu(d);
  1324:           break;
  1325:         default:
  1326:           dg_trigger_action_menu(d);
  1327:       }
  1328:       return 1;
  1329: 
  1330:     case SCRIPT_NEW_TRIGGER:
  1331:       {
  1332:         char *cursor = arg, *end;
  1333:         long parsed_pos, parsed_vnum;
  1334:         while (isspace((unsigned char)*cursor)) cursor++;
  1335:         if (tolower((unsigned char)*cursor) == 'q' && cursor[1] == '\0') break;
  1336:         parsed_pos = strtol(cursor, &end, 10);
  1337:         if (end == cursor) goto incomplete_attach;
  1338:         cursor = end;
  1339:         while (isspace((unsigned char)*cursor)) cursor++;
  1340:         if (*cursor == ',') {
  1341:           cursor++;
  1342:           while (isspace((unsigned char)*cursor)) cursor++;
  1343:         } else if (cursor == end || !isspace((unsigned char)end[-1])) {
  1344:           goto incomplete_attach;
  1345:         }
  1346:         parsed_vnum = strtol(cursor, &end, 10);
  1347:         if (end == cursor) goto incomplete_attach;
  1348:         while (isspace((unsigned char)*end)) end++;
  1349:         if (*end || parsed_pos > INT_MAX || parsed_vnum > INT_MAX ||
  1350:             parsed_pos < INT_MIN || parsed_vnum < INT_MIN) goto incomplete_attach;
  1351:         pos = (int)parsed_pos;
  1352:         vnum = (int)parsed_vnum;
  1353:       }
  1354: 
  1355:       for (count = 0, trig = OLC_SCRIPT(d); trig; trig = trig->next) count++;
  1356:       if (pos < 1 || pos > count + 1) {
  1357:         write_to_output(d, "Insertion slot %d is invalid. Valid slots are 1 through %d.\r\n"
  1358:                            "Enter slot, VNUM or Q to cancel: ", pos, count + 1);
  1359:         return 1;
  1360:       }
  1361:       if (vnum < IDXTYPE_MIN || vnum > IDXTYPE_MAX || real_trigger(vnum) == NOTHING) {
  1362:         write_to_output(d, "Trigger %d does not exist.\r\nEnter slot, VNUM or Q to cancel: ", vnum);
  1363:         return 1;
  1364:       }
  1365:       if (trig_index[real_trigger(vnum)]->proto->attach_type != OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d)) {
  1366:         write_to_output(d, "Trigger %d is a %s trigger and cannot be attached to a %s.\r\n"
  1367:                            "Enter slot, VNUM or Q to cancel: ", vnum,
  1368:             trig_index[real_trigger(vnum)]->proto->attach_type == MOB_TRIGGER ? "mobile" :
  1369:             trig_index[real_trigger(vnum)]->proto->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? "object" : "room",
  1370:             dg_parent_noun(d));
  1371:         return 1;
  1372:       }
  1373:       if (!can_edit_zone(d->character, real_zone_by_thing(vnum))) {
  1374:         write_to_output(d, "You do not have permission to use trigger %d.\r\n"
  1375:                            "Enter slot, VNUM or Q to cancel: ", vnum);
  1376:         return 1;
  1377:       }
  1378: 
  1379:       /* add the new info in position */
  1380:       currtrig = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
  1381:       CREATE(trig, struct trig_proto_list, 1);
  1382:       trig->vnum = vnum;
  1383: 
  1384:       if (pos==1 || !currtrig) {
  1385:         trig->next = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
  1386:         OLC_SCRIPT(d) = trig;
  1387:       } else {
  1388:         while (currtrig->next && --pos > 1) {
  1389:           currtrig = currtrig->next;
  1390:         }
  1391:         trig->next = currtrig->next;
  1392:         currtrig->next = trig;
  1393:       }
  1394:       OLC_VAL(d)++;
  1395:       break;
  1396: 
  1397: incomplete_attach:
  1398:       write_to_output(d, "Enter both an insertion slot and trigger VNUM (for example: 1, 3011),"
  1399:                          " or Q to cancel: ");
  1400:       return 1;
  1401: 
  1402:     case SCRIPT_DEL_TRIGGER:
  1403:       if (tolower((unsigned char)*arg) == 'q') break;
  1404:       pos = atoi(arg);
  1405:       if (pos<=0) break;
  1406:       if (!dg_attachment_at(d, pos)) {
  1407:         write_to_output(d, "That attachment slot does not exist. Enter another slot, or 0/Q to cancel: ");
  1408:         return 1;
  1409:       }
  1410:       OLC(d)->script_selected = pos;
  1411:       dg_trigger_action_menu(d);
  1412:       /* Reuse the selected-trigger confirmation path. */
  1413:       return dg_script_edit_parse(d, "3");
  1414: 
  1415:     case SCRIPT_DETACH_CONFIRM:
  1416:       if (tolower((unsigned char)*arg) == 'y') {
  1417:         pos = OLC(d)->script_selected;
  1418:         if (pos == 1) {
  1419:           trig = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
  1420:           if (trig) OLC_SCRIPT(d) = trig->next;
  1421:         } else {
  1422:           currtrig = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
  1423:           while (currtrig && --pos > 1) currtrig = currtrig->next;
  1424:           trig = currtrig ? currtrig->next : NULL;
  1425:           if (trig) currtrig->next = trig->next;
  1426:         }
  1427:         if (trig) {
  1428:           free(trig);
  1429:           OLC_VAL(d)++;
  1430:         }
  1431:         break;
  1432:       }
  1433:       if (tolower((unsigned char)*arg) == 'n' || tolower((unsigned char)*arg) == 'q') {
  1434:         dg_trigger_action_menu(d);
  1435:         return 1;
  1436:       }
  1437:       write_to_output(d, "Enter Y to detach only this attachment, or N to cancel: ");
  1438:       return 1;
  1439:   }
  1440: 
  1441:   dg_script_menu(d);
  1442:   return 1;
  1443: }
  1444: 
  1445: void trigedit_string_cleanup(struct descriptor_data *d, int terminator)
  1446: {
  1447:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
  1448:     case TRIGEDIT_COMMANDS:
  1449:       trigedit_disp_menu(d);
  1450:       break;
  1451:   }
  1452: }
  1453: 
  1454: int format_script(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1455: {
  1456:   char nsc[MAX_CMD_LENGTH], *t, line[READ_SIZE];
  1457:   char *sc;
  1458:   size_t len = 0, nlen = 0, llen = 0;
  1459:   int indent = 0, indent_next = FALSE, line_num = 0, ret, i; // Declare i here
  1460:   int block_stack[READ_SIZE]; // Stack to track block types
  1461:   int stack_top = -1; // Initialize stack as empty
  1462:   int switch_indent[READ_SIZE]; // Array to track switch indent levels
  1463:   int switch_top = -1; // Index for switch_indent array
  1464:   int case_indent = 0; // Track indent for case blocks
  1465:   int in_switch = 0; // Flag to indicate if we're inside a switch block
  1466: 
  1467:   if (!d->str || !*d->str)
  1468:     return FALSE;
  1469: 
  1470:   sc = strdup(*d->str); // Work on a copy
  1471:   t = strtok(sc, "\n\r");
  1472:   *nsc = '\0';
  1473: 
  1474:   while (t) {
  1475:     line_num++;
  1476:     skip_spaces(&t);
  1477: 
  1478:     if (!strn_cmp(t, "switch ", 7)) {
  1479:       indent_next = TRUE;
  1480:       stack_top++;
  1481:       block_stack[stack_top] = 's'; // 's' for switch
  1482:       switch_top++;
  1483:       switch_indent[switch_top] = indent; // Save current indent level for switch
  1484:       in_switch++; // We're entering a switch block
  1485:     } else if (!strn_cmp(t, "case", 4) || !strn_cmp(t, "default", 7)) {
  1486:       if (in_switch > 0) { // If we're inside a switch
  1487:         indent = switch_indent[switch_top] + 1; // Indent cases one level under switch
  1488:         indent_next = TRUE; // Indent the next line after case
  1489:         case_indent = indent; // Save indent for case block
  1490:       }
  1491:     } else if (!strn_cmp(t, "if ", 3) || !strn_cmp(t, "while ", 6)) {
  1492:       indent_next = TRUE;
  1493:       stack_top++;
  1494:       block_stack[stack_top] = 'l'; // 'l' for loop or conditional
  1495:     } else if (!strn_cmp(t, "end", 3) || !strn_cmp(t, "done", 4)) {
  1496:       if (stack_top < 0) {
  1497:         write_to_output(d, "Unmatched 'end' or 'done' (line %d)!\r\n", line_num);
  1498:         free(sc);
  1499:         return FALSE;
  1500:       }
  1501:       if (block_stack[stack_top] == 's') {
  1502:         indent = switch_indent[switch_top]; // Reset to the exact indent level where switch was declared
  1503:         switch_top--; // Decrease switch stack if ending a switch
  1504:         case_indent = 0; // Reset case indent since we're leaving the switch
  1505:         in_switch--; // We're leaving a switch block
  1506:       } else {
  1507:         indent--; // For other blocks like while
  1508:       }
  1509:       stack_top--;
  1510:       indent_next = FALSE; // Reset for next line
  1511:     } else if (!strn_cmp(t, "else", 4)) {
  1512:       if (stack_top < 0 || block_stack[stack_top] != 'l') {
  1513:         write_to_output(d, "Unmatched 'else' (line %d)!\r\n", line_num);
  1514:         free(sc);
  1515:         return FALSE;
  1516:       }
  1517:       indent--; // Reduce indent for else, then increment for next statement
  1518:       indent_next = TRUE;
  1519:     } else if (!strn_cmp(t, "break", 5)) {
  1520:       if (stack_top < 0 || (block_stack[stack_top] != 's' && block_stack[stack_top] != 'l')) {
  1521:         write_to_output(d, "Break not in case or loop (line %d)!\r\n", line_num);
  1522:         free(sc);
  1523:         return FALSE;
  1524:       }
  1525:       indent = case_indent + 1; // Indent break one level deeper than case
  1526:       indent_next = FALSE; // Ensure no automatic increase for next line after break
  1527:     }
  1528: 
  1529:     *line = '\0';
  1530:     for (nlen = 0, i = 0; i < indent; i++) {
  1531:       strncat(line, "  ", sizeof(line) - strlen(line) - 1);
  1532:       nlen += 2;
  1533:     }
  1534: 
  1535:     ret = snprintf(line + nlen, sizeof(line) - nlen, "%s\r\n", t);
  1536:     llen = (size_t)ret;
  1537:     if (ret < 0 || llen + nlen + len > d->max_str - 1) {
  1538:       write_to_output(d, "String too long, formatting aborted\r\n");
  1539:       free(sc);
  1540:       return FALSE;
  1541:     }
  1542:     len = len + nlen + llen;
  1543:     strcat(nsc, line);  /* strcat OK, size checked above */
  1544: 
  1545:     if (indent_next) {
  1546:       indent++;
  1547:       indent_next = FALSE;
  1548:     }
  1549:     t = strtok(NULL, "\n\r");
  1550:   }
  1551: 
  1552:   if (stack_top >= 0)
  1553:     write_to_output(d, "Unmatched block statements ignored.\r\n");
  1554: 
  1555:   free(*d->str);
  1556:   *d->str = strdup(nsc);
  1557:   free(sc);
  1558: 
  1559:   return TRUE;
  1560: }

    79: /* Return pointer to first occurrence of string ct in cs, or NULL if not 
    80:  * present.  Case insensitive. All of ct must be found in cs for it to be 
    81:  * a match.
    82:  * @todo Move this function to string util library.
    83:  * @param cs The string to search.
    84:  * @param ct What to search for in cs.
    85:  * @retval char * NULL if ct is not a substring of cs, or pointer to the
    86:  * location in cs where substring ct begins. */
    87: char *str_str(char *cs, char *ct)
    88: {
    89:   char *s, *t;
    90: 
    91:   if (!cs || !ct || !*ct)
    92:     return NULL;
    93: 
    94:   while (*cs) {
    95:     t = ct;
    96: 
    97:     while (*cs && (LOWER(*cs) != LOWER(*t)))
    98:       cs++;
    99: 
   100:     s = cs;
   101: 
   102:     while (*t && *cs && (LOWER(*cs) == LOWER(*t))) {
   103:       t++;
   104:       cs++;
   105:     }
   106: 
   107:     /* If there we haven reached the end of ct via t,
   108:      * then the whole string was found. */
   109:     if (!*t)
   110:       return s;
   111:   }
   112: 
   113:   return NULL;
   114: }

   116: /** Returns the number of people in a room.
   117:  * @param vnum The virtual number of a room.
   118:  * @retval int Returns -1 if the room does not exist, or the total number of
   119:  * PCs and NPCs in the room. */
   120: int trgvar_in_room(room_vnum vnum) 
   121: {
   122:     room_rnum rnum = real_room(vnum);
   123:     int i = 0;
   124:     char_data *ch;
   125: 
   126:     if (rnum == NOWHERE) {
   127:         script_log("people.vnum: world[rnum] does not exist");
   128:         return (-1);
   129:     }
   130: 
   131:     for (ch = world[rnum].people; ch !=NULL; ch = ch->next_in_room)
   132:         i++;
   133: 
   134:     return i;
   135: }

   138: /** Find out if an object is within a list of objects.
   139:  * @param name Either the unique id of an object or a string identifying the
   140:  * object. Note the unique id must be prefixed with UID_CHAR.
   141:  * @param list The list of objects to look through.
   142:  * @retval obj_data * Pointer to the object if it is found in the list of
   143:  * objects, NULL if the object is not found in the list.
   144:  */
   145: obj_data *get_obj_in_list(char *name, obj_data *list)
   146: {
   147:     obj_data *i;
   148:     long id;
   149: 
   150:     if (*name == UID_CHAR){
   151:       id = atoi(name + 1);
   152: 
   153:       for (i = list; i; i = i->next_content)
   154:         if (id == i->script_id)
   155:           return i;
   156:       
   157:     } else {
   158:       for (i = list; i; i = i->next_content)
   159:         if (isname(name, i->name))
   160:           return i;
   161:     }
   162: 
   163:     return NULL;
   164: }

   166: /** Find out if an NPC or PC is carrying an object.
   167:  * @param ch Pointer to the NPC/PC to search through.
   168:  * @param name String describing either the name of the object or the unique
   169:  * id of the object. Note the unique id must be prefixed with UID_CHAR.
   170:  * @retval obj_data * Either a pointer to the first object found that matches
   171:  * the name argument, or the NULL if the object isn't found.
   172:  */
   173: obj_data *get_object_in_equip(char_data * ch, char *name)
   174: {
   175:   int j, n = 0, number;
   176:   obj_data *obj;
   177:   char tmpname[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   178:   char *tmp = tmpname;
   179:   long id;
   180: 
   181:   if (*name == UID_CHAR) {
   182:     id = atoi(name + 1);
   183: 
   184:     for (j = 0; j < NUM_WEARS; j++)
   185:       if ((obj = GET_EQ(ch, j)))
   186:         if (id == obj->script_id)
   187:           return (obj);
   188:   } else if (is_number(name)) {
   189:     obj_vnum ovnum = atoi(name);
   190:     for (j = 0; j < NUM_WEARS; j++)
   191:       if ((obj = GET_EQ(ch, j)))
   192:         if (GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj) == ovnum)
   193:           return (obj);
   194:   } else {
   195:     snprintf(tmpname, sizeof(tmpname), "%s", name);
   196:     if (!(number = get_number(&tmp)))
   197:       return NULL;
   198: 
   199:     for (j = 0; (j < NUM_WEARS) && (n <= number); j++)
   200:       if ((obj = GET_EQ(ch, j)))
   201:         if (isname(tmp, obj->name))
   202:           if (++n == number)
   203:             return (obj);
   204:   }
   205: 
   206:   return NULL;
   207: }

   209: /** Figures out if the argument is a valid location to 'wear' equipment.
   210:  * Handles 'held', 'light' and 'wield' positions - Welcor. After idea from 
   211:  * Byron Ellacott. 
   212:  * @param arg Either the name of the position, or the number of a wear
   213:  * location definition to check for.
   214:  * @retval int If arg is not a valid wear location name or number, return
   215:  * -1, else return the defined number of the wear location.
   216:  */
   217: int find_eq_pos_script(char *arg)
   218: {
   219:   int i;
   220:   struct eq_pos_list {
   221:     const char *pos;
   222:     int where;
   223:   } eq_pos[] = {
   224:     {"hold",     WEAR_HOLD},
   225:     {"held",     WEAR_HOLD},
   226:     {"light",    WEAR_LIGHT},
   227:     {"wield",    WEAR_WIELD},
   228:     {"rfinger",  WEAR_FINGER_R},
   229:     {"lfinger",  WEAR_FINGER_L},
   230:     {"neck1",    WEAR_NECK_1},
   231:     {"neck2",    WEAR_NECK_2},
   232:     {"body",     WEAR_BODY},
   233:     {"head",     WEAR_HEAD},
   234:     {"legs",     WEAR_LEGS},
   235:     {"feet",     WEAR_FEET},
   236:     {"hands",    WEAR_HANDS},
   237:     {"arms",     WEAR_ARMS},
   238:     {"shield",   WEAR_SHIELD},
   239:     {"about",    WEAR_ABOUT},
   240:     {"waist",    WEAR_WAIST},
   241:     {"rwrist",   WEAR_WRIST_R},
   242:     {"lwrist",   WEAR_WRIST_L},
   243:     {"none", -1}
   244:   };
   245: 
   246:   if (is_number(arg) && (i = atoi(arg)) >= 0 && i < NUM_WEARS)
   247:     return i;
   248: 
   249:   for (i = 0;eq_pos[i].where != -1;i++) {
   250:     if (!str_cmp(eq_pos[i].pos, arg))
   251:       return eq_pos[i].where;
   252:   }
   253:   return (-1);
   254: }
   255: 
   256: /** Figures out if an object can be worn on a defined wear location.
   257:  * @param obj The object to check.
   258:  * @param pos The defined wear location to check.
   259:  * @retval int TRUE if obj can be worn on pos, FALSE if not.
   260:  */
   261: int can_wear_on_pos(struct obj_data *obj, int pos)
   262: {
   263:   switch (pos) {
   264:     case WEAR_HOLD:
   265:     case WEAR_LIGHT:    return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_HOLD);
   266:     case WEAR_WIELD:    return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_WIELD);
   267:     case WEAR_FINGER_R:
   268:     case WEAR_FINGER_L: return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_FINGER);
   269:     case WEAR_NECK_1:
   270:     case WEAR_NECK_2:   return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_NECK);
   271:     case WEAR_BODY:     return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_BODY);
   272:     case WEAR_HEAD:     return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_HEAD);
   273:     case WEAR_LEGS:     return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_LEGS);
   274:     case WEAR_FEET:     return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_FEET);
   275:     case WEAR_HANDS:    return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_HANDS);
   276:     case WEAR_ARMS:     return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_ARMS);
   277:     case WEAR_SHIELD:   return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_SHIELD);
   278:     case WEAR_ABOUT:    return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_ABOUT);
   279:     case WEAR_WAIST:    return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_WAIST);
   280:     case WEAR_WRIST_R:
   281:     case WEAR_WRIST_L:  return CAN_WEAR(obj, ITEM_WEAR_WRIST);
   282:     default: return FALSE;
   283:   }
   284: }
   285: 
   286: /** Search for an NPC or PC by number routines.
   287:  * @param n The unique ID (PC or NPC) to look for.
   288:  * @retval char_data * Pointer to the character structure if it exists, or NULL
   289:  * if it cannot be found.
   290:  */
   291: struct char_data *find_char(long n)
   292: {
   293:   if (n>=ROOM_ID_BASE) /* See note in dg_scripts.h */
   294:     return NULL;
   295: 
   296:   return find_char_by_uid_in_lookup_table(n);
   297: }
   298: 
   299: /** Search for an object by number routines.
   300:  * @param n The unique ID to look for.
   301:  * @retval obj_data * Pointer to the object if it exists, or NULL if it cannot
   302:  * be found.
   303:  */
   304: static obj_data *find_obj(long n)
   305: {
   306:   if (n < OBJ_ID_BASE) /* see note in dg_scripts.h */
   307:     return NULL;
   308: 
   309:   return find_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table(n);
   310: }
   311: 
   312: /* Search for a room with UID n.
   313:  * @param n the Unique ID to look for.
   314:  * @retval room_data * Pointer to the room if it exists, or NULL if it cannot
   315:  * be found.
   316:  */
   317: static room_data *find_room(long n)
   318: {
   319:   room_rnum rnum;
   320: 
   321:   n -= ROOM_ID_BASE;
   322:   if (n<0)
   323:     return NULL;
   324:   rnum = real_room((room_vnum)n);
   325: 
   326:   if (rnum != NOWHERE)
   327:     return &world[rnum];
   328: 
   329:   return NULL;
   330: }
   331: 
   332: /* Generic searches based only on name. */
   333: /** Search the entire world for an NPC or PC by name. 
   334:  * @param name String describing the name or the unique id of the char. 
   335:  * Note the unique id must be prefixed with UID_CHAR.
   336:  * @retval char_data * Pointer to the char or NULL if char is not found. */
   337: char_data *get_char(char *name)
   338: {
   339:   char_data *i;
   340: 
   341:   if (*name == UID_CHAR) {
   342:     i = find_char(atoi(name + 1));
   343: 
   344:     if (i && valid_dg_target(i, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   345:       return i;
   346:   } else {
   347:     for (i = character_list; i; i = i->next)
   348:       if (isname(name, i->player.name) &&
   349:           valid_dg_target(i, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   350:         return i;
   351:   }
   352: 
   353:   return NULL;
   354: }

   356: /** Find a character by name in the same room as a known object.
   357:  * @todo Should this function not be constrained to the same room as an object
   358:  * if 'name' is a unique id? 
   359:  * @param obj An object that will constrain the search to the location that
   360:  * the object is in *if* the name argument is not a unique id.
   361:  * @param name Character name keyword to search for, or unique ID. Unique
   362:  * id must be prefixed with UID_CHAR.
   363:  * @retval char_data * Pointer to the the char if found, NULL if not. Will
   364:  * only find god characters if DG_ALLOW_GODS is on. */
   365: char_data *get_char_near_obj(obj_data *obj, char *name)
   366: {
   367:   char_data *ch;
   368: 
   369:   if (*name == UID_CHAR) {
   370:     ch = find_char(atoi(name + 1));
   371: 
   372:     if (ch && valid_dg_target(ch, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   373:       return ch;
   374:   } else {
   375:     room_rnum num;
   376:     if ((num = obj_room(obj)) != NOWHERE)
   377:       for (ch = world[num].people; ch; ch = ch->next_in_room)
   378:         if (isname(name, ch->player.name) &&
   379:             valid_dg_target(ch, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   380:           return ch;
   381:   }
   382: 
   383:   return NULL;
   384: }
   385: 
   386: /** Find a character by name in a specific room.
   387:  * @todo Should this function not be constrained to the room 
   388:  * if 'name' is a unique id? 
   389:  * @param room A room that will constrain the search to that location 
   390:  * *if* the name argument is not a unique id.
   391:  * @param name Character name keyword to search for, or unique ID. Unique
   392:  * id must be prefixed with UID_CHAR.
   393:  * @retval char_data * Pointer to the the char if found, NULL if not. Will
   394:  * only find god characters if DG_ALLOW_GODS is on. */
   395: char_data *get_char_in_room(room_data *room, char *name)
   396: {
   397:   char_data *ch;
   398: 
   399: 
   400:   if (*name == UID_CHAR) {
   401:     ch = find_char(atoi(name + 1));
   402: 
   403:     if (ch && valid_dg_target(ch, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   404:       return ch;
   405:   } else {
   406:     for (ch = room->people; ch; ch = ch->next_in_room)
   407:       if (isname(name, ch->player.name) &&
   408:           valid_dg_target(ch, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   409:         return ch;
   410:     }
   411: 
   412:   return NULL;
   413: }
   414: 
   415: /** Find a named object near another object (either in the same room, as
   416:  * a container or contained by).
   417:  * @param obj The obj with which to constrain the search.
   418:  * @param name The keyword of the object to search for. If 'self' or 'me'
   419:  * are passed in as arguments, obj is returned. Can also be a unique object
   420:  * id, and if so it must be prefixed with UID_CHAR.
   421: * @retval obj_data * Pointer to the object if found, NULL if not. */
   422: obj_data *get_obj_near_obj(obj_data *obj, char *name)
   423: {
   424:   obj_data *i = NULL;
   425:   char_data *ch;
   426:   int rm;
   427:   long id;
   428: 
   429:   if (!str_cmp(name, "self") || !str_cmp(name, "me"))
   430:     return obj;
   431: 
   432:   /* is it inside ? */
   433:   if (obj->contains && (i = get_obj_in_list(name, obj->contains)))
   434:     return i;
   435: 
   436:   /* or outside ? */
   437:   if (obj->in_obj) {
   438:     if (*name == UID_CHAR) {
   439:        id = atoi(name + 1);
   440: 
   441:       if (id == obj->in_obj->script_id)
   442:         return obj->in_obj;
   443:     } else if (isname(name, obj->in_obj->name))
   444:       return obj->in_obj;
   445:   }
   446:   /* or worn ?*/
   447:   else if (obj->worn_by && (i = get_object_in_equip(obj->worn_by, name)))
   448:     return i;
   449:   /* or carried ? */
   450:   else if (obj->carried_by &&
   451:           (i = get_obj_in_list(name, obj->carried_by->carrying)))
   452:     return i;
   453:   else if ((rm = obj_room(obj)) != NOWHERE) {
   454:     /* check the floor */
   455:     if ((i = get_obj_in_list(name, world[rm].contents)))
   456:       return i;
   457: 
   458:     /* check peoples' inventory */
   459:     for (ch = world[rm].people;ch ; ch = ch->next_in_room)
   460:       if ((i = get_object_in_equip(ch, name)))
   461:         return i;
   462:   }
   463:   return NULL;
   464: }
   465: 
   466: /* returns the object in the world with name name, or NULL if not found */
   467: obj_data *get_obj(char *name)
   468: {
   469:   obj_data *obj;
   470: 
   471:   if (*name == UID_CHAR)
   472:     return find_obj(atoi(name + 1));
   473:   else {
   474:     for (obj = object_list; obj; obj = obj->next)
   475:       if (isname(name, obj->name))
   476:         return obj;
   477:   }
   478: 
   479:   return NULL;
   480: }
   481: 
   482: /* finds room by id or vnum.  returns NULL if not found */
   483: room_data *get_room(char *name)
   484: {
   485:   room_rnum nr;
   486: 
   487:   if (*name == UID_CHAR)
   488:     return find_room(atoi(name + 1));
   489:   else if ((nr = real_room(atoi(name))) == NOWHERE)
   490:     return NULL;
   491:   else
   492:     return &world[nr];
   493: }

   495: /* Returns a pointer to the first character in world by name name, or NULL if 
   496:  * none found.  Starts searching with the person owing the object. */
   497: char_data *get_char_by_obj(obj_data *obj, char *name)
   498: {
   499:   char_data *ch;
   500: 
   501:   if (*name == UID_CHAR) {
   502:     ch = find_char(atoi(name + 1));
   503: 
   504:     if (ch && valid_dg_target(ch, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   505:       return ch;
   506:   } else {
   507:     if (obj->carried_by &&
   508:         isname(name, obj->carried_by->player.name) &&
   509:         valid_dg_target(obj->carried_by, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   510:       return obj->carried_by;
   511: 
   512:     if (obj->worn_by &&
   513:         isname(name, obj->worn_by->player.name) &&
   514:         valid_dg_target(obj->worn_by, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   515:       return obj->worn_by;
   516: 
   517:     for (ch = character_list; ch; ch = ch->next)
   518:       if (isname(name, ch->player.name) &&
   519:           valid_dg_target(ch, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   520:         return ch;
   521:   }
   522: 
   523:   return NULL;
   524: }
   525: 
   526: /* Returns a pointer to the first character in world by name name, or NULL if 
   527:  * none found.  Starts searching in room room first. */
   528: char_data *get_char_by_room(room_data *room, char *name)
   529: {
   530:   char_data *ch;
   531: 
   532:   if (*name == UID_CHAR) {
   533:     ch = find_char(atoi(name + 1));
   534: 
   535:     if (ch && valid_dg_target(ch, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   536:       return ch;
   537:   } else {
   538:     for (ch = room->people; ch; ch = ch->next_in_room)
   539:       if (isname(name, ch->player.name) &&
   540:           valid_dg_target(ch, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   541:         return ch;
   542: 
   543:     for (ch = character_list; ch; ch = ch->next)
   544:       if (isname(name, ch->player.name) &&
   545:           valid_dg_target(ch, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   546:         return ch;
   547:   }
   548: 
   549:   return NULL;
   550: }
   551: 
   552: /* Returns the object in the world with name name, or NULL if not found search 
   553:  * based on obj. */
   554: obj_data *get_obj_by_obj(obj_data *obj, char *name)
   555: {
   556:   obj_data *i = NULL;
   557:   int rm;
   558: 
   559:   if (*name == UID_CHAR)
   560:     return find_obj(atoi(name + 1));
   561: 
   562:   if (!str_cmp(name, "self") || !str_cmp(name, "me"))
   563:     return obj;
   564: 
   565:   if (obj->contains && (i = get_obj_in_list(name, obj->contains)))
   566:     return i;
   567: 
   568:   if (obj->in_obj && isname(name, obj->in_obj->name))
   569:       return obj->in_obj;
   570: 
   571:   if (obj->worn_by && (i = get_object_in_equip(obj->worn_by, name)))
   572:     return i;
   573: 
   574:   if (obj->carried_by &&
   575:      (i = get_obj_in_list(name, obj->carried_by->carrying)))
   576:     return i;
   577: 
   578:   if (((rm = obj_room(obj)) != NOWHERE) &&
   579:       (i = get_obj_in_list(name, world[rm].contents)))
   580:     return i;
   581: 
   582:   return get_obj(name);
   583: }
   584: 
   585: /* only searches the room */
   586: obj_data *get_obj_in_room(room_data *room, char *name)
   587: {
   588:   obj_data *obj;
   589:   long id;
   590: 
   591:   if (*name == UID_CHAR) {
   592:       id = atoi(name + 1);
   593:       for (obj = room->contents; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
   594:           if (id == obj->script_id)
   595:               return obj;
   596:   } else {
   597:       for (obj = room->contents; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
   598:           if (isname(name, obj->name))
   599:               return obj;
   600:   }
   601: 
   602:   return NULL;
   603: }
   604: 
   605: /* returns obj with name - searches room, then world */
   606: obj_data *get_obj_by_room(room_data *room, char *name)
   607: {
   608:   obj_data *obj;
   609: 
   610:   if (*name == UID_CHAR)
   611:     return find_obj(atoi(name+1));
   612: 
   613:   for (obj = room->contents; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
   614:     if (isname(name, obj->name))
   615:       return obj;
   616: 
   617:   for (obj = object_list; obj; obj = obj->next)
   618:     if (isname(name, obj->name))
   619:       return obj;
   620: 
   621:   return NULL;
   622: }

   624: /* checks every PULSE_SCRIPT for random triggers */
   625: void script_trigger_check(void)
   626: {
   627:   char_data *ch;
   628:   obj_data *obj;
   629:   struct room_data *room=NULL;
   630:   room_rnum nr;
   631:   struct script_data *sc;
   632: 
   633:   for (ch = character_list; ch; ch = ch->next) {
   634:     if (SCRIPT(ch)) {
   635:       sc = SCRIPT(ch);
   636: 
   637:       if (IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), WTRIG_RANDOM) &&
   638:           (!is_empty(world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone) ||
   639:            IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), WTRIG_GLOBAL)))
   640:         random_mtrigger(ch);
   641:     }
   642:   }
   643: 
   644:   for (obj = object_list; obj; obj = obj->next) {
   645:     if (SCRIPT(obj)) {
   646:       sc = SCRIPT(obj);
   647: 
   648:       if (IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), OTRIG_RANDOM))
   649:         random_otrigger(obj);
   650:     }
   651:   }
   652: 
   653:   for (nr = 0; nr <= top_of_world; nr++) {
   654:     if (SCRIPT(&world[nr])) {
   655:       room = &world[nr];
   656:       sc = SCRIPT(room);
   657: 
   658:       if (IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), WTRIG_RANDOM) &&
   659:           (!is_empty(room->zone) ||
   660:            IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), WTRIG_GLOBAL)))
   661:         random_wtrigger(room);
   662:     }
   663:   }
   664: }
   665: 
   666: void check_time_triggers(void)
   667: {
   668:   char_data *ch;
   669:   obj_data *obj;
   670:   struct room_data *room=NULL;
   671:   int nr;
   672:   struct script_data *sc;
   673: 
   674:   for (ch = character_list; ch; ch = ch->next) {
   675:     if (SCRIPT(ch)) {
   676:       sc = SCRIPT(ch);
   677: 
   678:       if (IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), WTRIG_TIME) &&
   679:           (!is_empty(world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone) ||
   680:            IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), WTRIG_GLOBAL)))
   681:         time_mtrigger(ch);
   682:     }
   683:   }
   684: 
   685:   for (obj = object_list; obj; obj = obj->next) {
   686:     if (SCRIPT(obj)) {
   687:       sc = SCRIPT(obj);
   688: 
   689:       if (IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), OTRIG_TIME))
   690:         time_otrigger(obj);
   691:     }
   692:   }
   693: 
   694:   for (nr = 0; nr <= top_of_world; nr++) {
   695:     if (SCRIPT(&world[nr])) {
   696:       room = &world[nr];
   697:       sc = SCRIPT(room);
   698: 
   699:       if (IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), WTRIG_TIME) &&
   700:           (!is_empty(room->zone) ||
   701:            IS_SET(SCRIPT_TYPES(sc), WTRIG_GLOBAL)))
   702:         time_wtrigger(room);
   703:     }
   704:   }
   705: }

   707: static EVENTFUNC(trig_wait_event)
   708: {
   709:   struct wait_event_data *wait_event_obj = (struct wait_event_data *)event_obj;
   710:   trig_data *trig;
   711:   void *go;
   712:   int type;
   713: 
   714:   trig = wait_event_obj->trigger;
   715:   go = wait_event_obj->go;
   716:   type = wait_event_obj->type;
   717: 
   718:   free(wait_event_obj);
   719:   GET_TRIG_WAIT(trig) = NULL;
   720: 
   721: #if 1  /* debugging */
   722:   {
   723:     int found = FALSE;
   724:     if (type == MOB_TRIGGER) {
   725:       struct char_data *tch;
   726:       for (tch = character_list;tch && !found;tch = tch->next)
   727:         if (tch == (struct char_data *)go)
   728:           found = TRUE;
   729:     } else if (type == OBJ_TRIGGER) {
   730:       struct obj_data *obj;
   731:       for (obj = object_list;obj && !found;obj = obj->next)
   732:         if (obj == (struct obj_data *)go)
   733:           found = TRUE;
   734:     } else {
   735:       room_rnum i;
   736:       for (i = 0;i<top_of_world && !found;i++)
   737:         if (&world[i] == (struct room_data *)go)
   738:           found = TRUE;
   739:     }
   740:     if (!found) {
   741:       log("Trigger restarted on unknown entity. Vnum: %d", GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
   742:       log("Type: %s trigger", type==MOB_TRIGGER ? "Mob" : type == OBJ_TRIGGER ? "Obj" : "Room");
   743:       log("attached %d places", trig_index[trig->nr]->number);
   744:       script_log("Trigger restart attempt on unknown entity.");
   745:       return 0;
   746:     }
   747:   }
   748: #endif
   749: 
   750:   script_driver(&go, trig, type, TRIG_RESTART);
   751: 
   752:   /* Do not reenqueue*/
   753:   return 0;
   754: }
   755: 
   756: static void do_stat_trigger(struct char_data *ch, trig_data *trig)
   757: {
   758:     struct cmdlist_element *cmd_list;
   759:     char sb[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   760:     int len = 0;
   761: 
   762:     if (!trig)
   763:     {
   764:         log("SYSERR: NULL trigger passed to do_stat_trigger.");
   765:         return;
   766:     }
   767: 
   768:     len += snprintf(sb, sizeof(sb), "Name: '%s%s%s',  VNum: [%s%5d%s], RNum: [%5d]\r\n",
   769:               CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
   770:               CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
   771:               GET_TRIG_RNUM(trig));
   772: 
   773:     if (trig->attach_type==OBJ_TRIGGER) {
   774:       len += snprintf(sb + len, sizeof(sb)-len, "Trigger Intended Assignment: Objects\r\n");
   775:       sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig), otrig_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
   776:     } else if (trig->attach_type==WLD_TRIGGER) {
   777:       len += snprintf(sb + len, sizeof(sb)-len, "Trigger Intended Assignment: Rooms\r\n");
   778:       sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig), wtrig_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
   779:     } else {
   780:       len += snprintf(sb + len, sizeof(sb)-len, "Trigger Intended Assignment: Mobiles\r\n");
   781:       sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig), trig_types, buf, sizeof(buf));
   782:     }
   783: 
   784:     len += snprintf(sb + len, sizeof(sb)-len, "Trigger Type: %s, Numeric Arg: %d, Arg list: %s\r\n",
   785:                      buf, GET_TRIG_NARG(trig),
   786:                     ((GET_TRIG_ARG(trig) && *GET_TRIG_ARG(trig))
   787:                      ? GET_TRIG_ARG(trig) : "None"));
   788: 
   789:     len += snprintf(sb + len, sizeof(sb)-len, "Commands:\r\n");
   790: 
   791:     cmd_list = trig->cmdlist;
   792:     while (cmd_list) {
   793:       if (cmd_list->cmd)
   794:         len += snprintf(sb + len, sizeof(sb)-len, "%s\r\n", cmd_list->cmd);
   795: 
   796:       if (len>MAX_STRING_LENGTH-80) {
   797:         snprintf(sb + len, sizeof(sb)-len, "*** Overflow - script too long! ***\r\n");
   798:         break;
   799:       }
   800:       
   801:       cmd_list = cmd_list->next;
   802:     }
   803: 
   804:     page_string(ch->desc, sb, 1);
   805: }
   806: 
   807: /* find the name of what the uid points to */
   808: void find_uid_name(char *uid, char *name, size_t nlen)
   809: {
   810:   char_data *ch;
   811:   obj_data *obj;
   812: 
   813:   if ((ch = get_char(uid)))
   814:     snprintf(name, nlen, "%s", ch->player.name);
   815:   else if ((obj = get_obj(uid)))
   816:     snprintf(name, nlen, "%s", obj->name);
   817:   else
   818:     snprintf(name, nlen, "uid = %s, (not found)", uid + 1);
   819: }
   820: 
   821: /* general function to display stats on script sc */
   822: static void script_stat (char_data *ch, struct script_data *sc)
   823: {
   824:   struct trig_var_data *tv;
   825:   trig_data *t;
   826:   char name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   827:   char namebuf[512];
   828:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   829:   int attachment_position = 0;
   830: 
   831:   send_to_char(ch, "Global Variables: %s\r\n", sc->global_vars ? "" : "None");
   832:   send_to_char(ch, "Global context: %ld\r\n", sc->context);
   833: 
   834:   for (tv = sc->global_vars; tv; tv = tv->next) {
   835:     snprintf(namebuf, sizeof(namebuf), "%s:%ld", tv->name, tv->context);
   836:     if (*(tv->value) == UID_CHAR) {
   837:       find_uid_name(tv->value, name, sizeof(name));
   838:       send_to_char(ch, "    %15s:  %s\r\n", tv->context?namebuf:tv->name, name);
   839:     } else
   840:       send_to_char(ch, "    %15s:  %s\r\n", tv->context?namebuf:tv->name, tv->value);
   841:   }
   842: 
   843:   for (t = TRIGGERS(sc); t; t = t->next) {
   844:     send_to_char(ch, "\r\n  Attachment %d: %s%s%s, VNum: [%s%5d%s], RNum: [%5d]\r\n",
   845:             ++attachment_position,
   846:             CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), GET_TRIG_NAME(t), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
   847:             CCGRN(ch, C_NRM), GET_TRIG_VNUM(t), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM),
   848:             GET_TRIG_RNUM(t));
   849: 
   850:     if (t->attach_type==OBJ_TRIGGER) {
   851:       send_to_char(ch, "  Trigger Intended Assignment: Objects\r\n");
   852:       sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(t), otrig_types, buf1, sizeof(buf1));
   853:     } else if (t->attach_type==WLD_TRIGGER) {
   854:       send_to_char(ch, "  Trigger Intended Assignment: Rooms\r\n");
   855:       sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(t), wtrig_types, buf1, sizeof(buf1));
   856:     } else {
   857:       send_to_char(ch, "  Trigger Intended Assignment: Mobiles\r\n");
   858:       sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(t), trig_types, buf1, sizeof(buf1));
   859:     }
   860: 
   861:     send_to_char(ch, "  Trigger Type: %s, Numeric Arg: %d, Arg list: %s\r\n",
   862:             buf1, GET_TRIG_NARG(t),
   863:             ((GET_TRIG_ARG(t) && *GET_TRIG_ARG(t)) ? GET_TRIG_ARG(t) :
   864:              "None"));
   865: 
   866:     if (GET_TRIG_WAIT(t)) {
   867:       send_to_char(ch, "    Wait: %ld, Current line: %s\r\n",
   868:               event_time(GET_TRIG_WAIT(t)),
   869:               t->curr_state ? t->curr_state->cmd : "End of Script");
   870:       send_to_char(ch, "  Variables: %s\r\n", GET_TRIG_VARS(t) ? "" : "None");
   871: 
   872:       for (tv = GET_TRIG_VARS(t); tv; tv = tv->next) {
   873:         if (*(tv->value) == UID_CHAR) {
   874:           find_uid_name(tv->value, name, sizeof(name));
   875:           send_to_char(ch, "    %15s:  %s\r\n", tv->name, name);
   876:         } else
   877:           send_to_char(ch, "    %15s:  %s\r\n", tv->name, tv->value);
   878:       }
   879:     }
   880:   }
   881: }
   882:

   916: /* Adds the trigger t to script sc in in location loc.  loc = -1 means add to 
   917:  * the end, loc = 0 means add before all other triggers. */
   918: void add_trigger(struct script_data *sc, trig_data *t, int loc)
   919: {
   920:   trig_data *i;
   921:   int n;
   922: 
   923:   for (n = loc, i = TRIGGERS(sc); i && i->next && (n != 0); n--, i = i->next);
   924: 
   925:   if (!loc) {
   926:           t->next = TRIGGERS(sc);
   927:     TRIGGERS(sc) = t;
   928:   } else if (!i)
   929:     TRIGGERS(sc) = t;
   930:   else {
   931:     t->next = i->next;
   932:     i->next = t;
   933:   }
   934: 
   935:   SCRIPT_TYPES(sc) |= GET_TRIG_TYPE(t);
   936: 
   937:   t->next_in_world = trigger_list;
   938:   trigger_list = t;
   939: }
