   941: ACMD(do_attach)
   942: {
   943:   char_data *victim;
   944:   obj_data *object;
   945:   room_data *room;
   946:   trig_data *trig;
   947:   char targ_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], trig_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   948:   char loc_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   949:   int loc, tn, rn, num_arg;
   950:   room_rnum rnum;
   951: 
   952:   argument = two_arguments(argument, arg, trig_name);
   953:   two_arguments(argument, targ_name, loc_name);
   954: 
   955:   if (!*arg || !*targ_name || !*trig_name) {
   956:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: attach { mob | obj | room } { trigger } { name } [ location ]\r\n");
   957:     return;
   958:   }
   959: 
   960:   num_arg = atoi(targ_name);
   961:   tn = atoi(trig_name);
   962:   loc = (*loc_name) ? atoi(loc_name) : -1;
   963: 
   964:   if (is_abbrev(arg, "mobile") || is_abbrev(arg, "mtr")) {
   965:     victim = get_char_vis(ch, targ_name, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD);
   966:     if (!victim) { /* search room for one with this vnum */
   967:       for (victim = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people;victim;victim=victim->next_in_room)
   968:         if (GET_MOB_VNUM(victim) == num_arg)
   969:           break;
   970: 
   971:       if (!victim) {
   972:         send_to_char(ch, "That mob does not exist.\r\n");
   973:         return;
   974:       }
   975:     }
   976:     if (!IS_NPC(victim) && !CONFIG_SCRIPT_PLAYERS)  {
   977:       send_to_char(ch, "Players can't have scripts.\r\n");
   978:       return;
   979:     }
   980:     if (!can_edit_zone(ch, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone)) {
   981:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only attach triggers in your own zone.\r\n");
   982:       return;
   983:     }
   984:     /* have a valid mob, now get trigger */
   985:     rn = real_trigger(tn);
   986:     if ((rn == NOTHING) || !(trig = read_trigger(rn))) {
   987:       send_to_char(ch, "That trigger does not exist.\r\n");
   988:       return;
   989:     }
   990: 
   991:     if (!SCRIPT(victim))
   992:       CREATE(SCRIPT(victim), struct script_data, 1);
   993:     add_trigger(SCRIPT(victim), trig, loc);
   994: 
   995:     if (IS_NPC(victim))
   996:     send_to_char(ch, "Trigger %d (%s) attached to %s [%d].\r\n",
   997:                  tn, GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_SHORT(victim), GET_MOB_VNUM(victim));
   998:     else 
   999:     send_to_char(ch, "Trigger %d (%s) attached to player named %s.\r\n", 
  1000:                  tn, GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_NAME(victim));
  1001:   }
  1002: 
  1003:   else if (is_abbrev(arg, "object") || is_abbrev(arg, "otr")) {
  1004:     object = get_obj_vis(ch, targ_name, NULL);
  1005:     if (!object) { /* search room for one with this vnum */
  1006:       for (object = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents;object;object=object->next_content)
  1007:         if (GET_OBJ_VNUM(object) == num_arg)
  1008:           break;
  1009: 
  1010:       if (!object) { /* search inventory for one with this vnum */
  1011:         for (object = ch->carrying;object;object=object->next_content)
  1012:           if (GET_OBJ_VNUM(object) == num_arg)
  1013:             break;
  1014: 
  1015:         if (!object) {
  1016:           send_to_char(ch, "That object does not exist.\r\n");
  1017:           return;
  1018:         }
  1019:       }
  1020:     }
  1021: 
  1022:     if (!can_edit_zone(ch, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone)) {
  1023:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only attach triggers in your own zone.\r\n");
  1024:       return;
  1025:     }
  1026:     /* have a valid obj, now get trigger */
  1027:     rn = real_trigger(tn);
  1028:     if ((rn == NOTHING) || !(trig = read_trigger(rn))) {
  1029:       send_to_char(ch, "That trigger does not exist.\r\n");
  1030:       return;
  1031:     }
  1032: 
  1033:     if (!SCRIPT(object))
  1034:       CREATE(SCRIPT(object), struct script_data, 1);
  1035:     add_trigger(SCRIPT(object), trig, loc);
  1036: 
  1037:     send_to_char(ch, "Trigger %d (%s) attached to %s [%d].\r\n",
  1038:                  tn, GET_TRIG_NAME(trig),
  1039:                  (object->short_description ?
  1040:                   object->short_description : object->name),
  1041:                   GET_OBJ_VNUM(object));
  1042:   }
  1043: 
  1044:   else if (is_abbrev(arg, "room") || is_abbrev(arg, "wtr")) {
  1045:     if (strchr(targ_name, '.'))
  1046:       rnum = IN_ROOM(ch);
  1047:     else if (isdigit(*targ_name))
  1048:       rnum = find_target_room(ch, targ_name);
  1049:     else
  1050:       rnum = NOWHERE;
  1051: 
  1052:     if (rnum == NOWHERE) {
  1053:       send_to_char(ch, "You need to supply a room number or . for current room.\r\n");
  1054:       return;
  1055:     }
  1056: 
  1057:     if (!can_edit_zone(ch, world[rnum].zone)) {
  1058:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only attach triggers in your own zone.\r\n");
  1059:       return;
  1060:     }
  1061:     /* have a valid room, now get trigger */
  1062:     rn = real_trigger(tn);
  1063:     if ((rn == NOTHING) || !(trig = read_trigger(rn))) {
  1064:       send_to_char(ch, "That trigger does not exist.\r\n");
  1065:       return;
  1066:     }
  1067: 
  1068:     room = &world[rnum];
  1069: 
  1070:     if (!SCRIPT(room))
  1071:       CREATE(SCRIPT(room), struct script_data, 1);
  1072:     add_trigger(SCRIPT(room), trig, loc);
  1073: 
  1074:     send_to_char(ch, "Trigger %d (%s) attached to room %d.\r\n",
  1075:                  tn, GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), world[rnum].number);
  1076:   }
  1077: 
  1078:   else
  1079:     send_to_char(ch, "Please specify 'mob', 'obj', or 'room'.\r\n");
  1080: }
  1081: 
  1082: /* Removes the trigger specified by name, and the script of o if it removes the
  1083:  * last trigger.  name can either be a number, or a 'silly' name for the 
  1084:  * trigger, including things like 2.beggar-death. Returns 0 if did not find the
  1085:  * trigger, otherwise 1.  If it matters, you might need to check to see if all 
  1086:  * the triggers were removed after this function returns, in order to remove 
  1087:  * the script. */
  1088: static int remove_trigger(struct script_data *sc, char *name)
  1089: {
  1090:   trig_data *i, *j;
  1091:   int num = 0, string = FALSE, n;
  1092:   char *cname;
  1093: 
  1094: 
  1095:   if (!sc)
  1096:     return 0;
  1097: 
  1098:   if ((cname = strstr(name,".")) || (!isdigit(*name)) ) {
  1099:     string = TRUE;
  1100:     if (cname) {
  1101:       *cname = '\0';
  1102:       num = atoi(name);
  1103:       name = ++cname;
  1104:     }
  1105:   } else
  1106:     num = atoi(name);
  1107: 
  1108:   for (n = 0, j = NULL, i = TRIGGERS(sc); i; j = i, i = i->next) {
  1109:     if (string) {
  1110:       if (isname(name, GET_TRIG_NAME(i)))
  1111:         if (++n >= num)
  1112:           break;
  1113:     }
  1114: 
  1115:     /* This isn't clean. A numeric value will match if it's position OR vnum 
  1116:      * is found. originally the number was position-only. */
  1117:     else if (++n >= num)
  1118:       break;
  1119:     else if (trig_index[i->nr]->vnum == num)
  1120:       break;
  1121:   }
  1122: 
  1123:   if (i) {
  1124:     if (j) {
  1125:       j->next = i->next;
  1126:       extract_trigger(i);
  1127:     }
  1128: 
  1129:     /* this was the first trigger */
  1130:     else {
  1131:       TRIGGERS(sc) = i->next;
  1132:       extract_trigger(i);
  1133:     }
  1134: 
  1135:     /* update the script type bitvector */
  1136:     SCRIPT_TYPES(sc) = 0;
  1137:     for (i = TRIGGERS(sc); i; i = i->next)
  1138:       SCRIPT_TYPES(sc) |= GET_TRIG_TYPE(i);
  1139: 
  1140:     return 1;
  1141:   } else
  1142:     return 0;
  1143: }
  1144: 
  1145: ACMD(do_detach)
  1146: {
  1147:   char_data *victim = NULL;
  1148:   obj_data *object = NULL;
  1149:   struct room_data *room;
  1150:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg3[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *snum;
  1151:   char *trigger = 0;
  1152:   int num_arg, tn, rn;
  1153:   room_rnum rnum;
  1154:   trig_data *trig;
  1155: 
  1156:   argument = two_arguments(argument, arg1, arg2);
  1157:   one_argument(argument, arg3);
  1158:   tn = atoi(arg3);
  1159:   rn = real_trigger(tn);
  1160:   trig = read_trigger(rn);
  1161: 
  1162:   if (!*arg1 || !*arg2) {
  1163:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: detach [ mob | object | room ] { target } { trigger |"
  1164:                  " 'all' }\r\n");
  1165:     return;
  1166:   }
  1167: 
  1168:   /* vnum of mob/obj, if given */
  1169:   num_arg = atoi(arg2);
  1170: 
  1171:   if (!str_cmp(arg1, "room") || !str_cmp(arg1, "wtr")) {
  1172:     if (!*arg3 || (strchr(arg2, '.')))
  1173:       rnum = IN_ROOM(ch);
  1174:     else if (isdigit(*arg2))
  1175:       rnum = find_target_room(ch, arg2);
  1176:     else
  1177:       rnum = NOWHERE;
  1178: 
  1179:     if (rnum == NOWHERE) {
  1180:       send_to_char(ch, "That's not a valid room.\r\n");
  1181:       return;
  1182:     }
  1183: 
  1184:     room = &world[rnum]; 
  1185:     if (!can_edit_zone(ch, room->zone)) {
  1186:       send_to_char(ch, "You can only detach triggers in your own zone\r\n");
  1187:       return;
  1188:     }
  1189:     if (!SCRIPT(room))
  1190:       send_to_char(ch, "This room does not have any triggers.\r\n");
  1191:     else if (!str_cmp(arg2, "all") || !str_cmp(arg3, "all")) {
  1192:       extract_script(room, WLD_TRIGGER);
  1193:       send_to_char(ch, "All triggers removed from room %d.\r\n", world[rnum].number);
  1194:     } else {
  1195:       if (*arg3)
  1196:         snum = arg3;
  1197:       else
  1198:         snum = arg2;
  1199: 
  1200:     if (remove_trigger(SCRIPT(room), snum)) {
  1201:       send_to_char(ch, "Trigger %d (%s) removed from %d.\r\n", tn, GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), world[rnum].number);
  1202:       
  1203:       if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(room)))
  1204:         extract_script(room, WLD_TRIGGER);
  1205: 
  1206:     } else
  1207:       send_to_char(ch, "That trigger was not found.\r\n");
  1208:    }
  1209:   }
  1210: 
  1211:   else {
  1212:     if (is_abbrev(arg1, "mobile") || !str_cmp(arg1, "mtr")) {
  1213:       victim = get_char_vis(ch, arg2, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD);
  1214:       if (!victim) { /* search room for one with this vnum */
  1215:         for (victim = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people;victim;victim=victim->next_in_room)
  1216:           if (GET_MOB_VNUM(victim) == num_arg)
  1217:             break;
  1218: 
  1219:         if (!victim) {
  1220:           send_to_char(ch, "No such mobile around.\r\n");
  1221:           return;
  1222:         }
  1223:       }
  1224: 
  1225:       if (!*arg3)
  1226:         send_to_char(ch, "You must specify a trigger to remove.\r\n");
  1227:       else
  1228:         trigger = arg3;
  1229:     }
  1230: 
  1231:     else if (is_abbrev(arg1, "object") || !str_cmp(arg1, "otr")) {
  1232:       object = get_obj_vis(ch, arg2, NULL);
  1233:       if (!object) { /* search room for one with this vnum */
  1234:         for (object = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents;object;object=object->next_content)
  1235:           if (GET_OBJ_VNUM(object) == num_arg)
  1236:             break;
  1237: 
  1238:         if (!object) { /* search inventory for one with this vnum */
  1239:           for (object = ch->carrying;object;object=object->next_content)
  1240:             if (GET_OBJ_VNUM(object) == num_arg)
  1241:               break;
  1242: 
  1243:           if (!object) { /* give up */
  1244:             send_to_char(ch, "No such object around.\r\n");
  1245:             return;
  1246:           }
  1247:         }
  1248:       }
  1249: 
  1250:       if (!*arg3)
  1251:         send_to_char(ch, "You must specify a trigger to remove.\r\n");
  1252:       else
  1253:         trigger = arg3;
  1254:     }
  1255:     else  {
  1256:       /* Thanks to Carlos Myers for fixing the line below */
  1257:       if ((object = get_obj_in_equip_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, ch->equipment)));
  1258:       else if ((object = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, ch->carrying)));
  1259:       else if ((victim = get_char_room_vis(ch, arg1, NULL)));
  1260:       else if ((object = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents)));
  1261:       else if ((victim = get_char_vis(ch, arg1, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)));
  1262:       else if ((object = get_obj_vis(ch, arg1, NULL)));
  1263:       else
  1264:         send_to_char(ch, "Nothing around by that name.\r\n");
  1265: 
  1266:       trigger = arg2;
  1267:     }
  1268: 
  1269:     if (victim) {
  1270: 
  1271:       if (!SCRIPT(victim)) 
  1272:         send_to_char(ch, "That %s doesn't have any triggers.\r\n", IS_NPC(victim) ? "mob" : "player");  
  1273:       else if (!can_edit_zone(ch, real_zone_by_thing(GET_MOB_VNUM(victim))) && IS_NPC(victim)) {
  1274:         send_to_char(ch, "You can only detach triggers in your own zone\r\n");
  1275:         return;
  1276:       }
  1277:       else if (trigger && !str_cmp(trigger, "all")) {
  1278:         extract_script(victim, MOB_TRIGGER);
  1279:         send_to_char(ch, "All triggers removed from %s.\r\n", IS_NPC(victim) ? GET_SHORT(victim) : GET_NAME(victim));
  1280:       }
  1281: 
  1282:       else if (trigger && remove_trigger(SCRIPT(victim), trigger)) {
  1283:         send_to_char(ch, "Trigger %d (%s) removed from %s.\r\n", 
  1284:           tn, GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), IS_NPC(victim) ? GET_SHORT(victim) : GET_NAME(victim));
  1285: 
  1286:         if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(victim))) {
  1287:           extract_script(victim, MOB_TRIGGER);
  1288:         }
  1289:       } else
  1290:         send_to_char(ch, "That trigger was not found.\r\n");
  1291:     }
  1292: 
  1293:     else if (object) {
  1294:       if (!SCRIPT(object))
  1295:         send_to_char(ch, "That object doesn't have any triggers.\r\n");
  1296: 
  1297:       else if (!can_edit_zone(ch, real_zone_by_thing(GET_OBJ_VNUM(object)))) {
  1298:         send_to_char(ch, "You can only detach triggers in your own zone\r\n");
  1299:         return;
  1300:       }
  1301:       else if (trigger && !str_cmp(trigger, "all")) {
  1302:         extract_script(object, OBJ_TRIGGER);
  1303:         send_to_char(ch, "All triggers removed from %s.\r\n",
  1304:                 object->short_description ? object->short_description :
  1305:                 object->name);
  1306:       }
  1307: 
  1308:       else if (remove_trigger(SCRIPT(object), trigger)) {
  1309:         send_to_char(ch, "Trigger %d (%s) removed from %s.\r\n", 
  1310:           tn, GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), object->short_description ? object->short_description : 
  1311:           object->name);
  1312:         if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(object))) {
  1313:           extract_script(object, OBJ_TRIGGER);
  1314:         }
  1315:       } else
  1316:         send_to_char(ch, "That trigger was not found.\r\n");
  1317:     }
  1318:   }
  1319: }
  1320: 
  1321: /* Logs any errors caused by scripts to the system log. Will eventually allow 
  1322:  * on-line view of script errors. */
  1323: void script_vlog(const char *format, va_list args)
  1324: {
  1325:   char output[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1326:   struct descriptor_data *i;
  1327: 
  1328:   /* parse the args, making the error message */ 
  1329:   vsnprintf(output, sizeof(output) - 2, format, args); 
  1330: 
  1331:   /* Save to the syslog file */ 
  1332:   basic_mud_log("SCRIPT ERROR: %s", output); 
  1333: 
  1334:   /* And send to imms */ 
  1335:   for (i = descriptor_list; i; i = i->next) { 
  1336:     if (STATE(i) != CON_PLAYING || IS_NPC(i->character)) /* switch */ 
  1337:       continue; 
  1338:     if (GET_LEVEL(i->character) < LVL_BUILDER) 
  1339:       continue; 
  1340:     if (PLR_FLAGGED(i->character, PLR_WRITING)) 
  1341:       continue; 
  1342:     if (NRM > (PRF_FLAGGED(i->character, PRF_LOG1) ? 1 : 0) + (PRF_FLAGGED(i->character, PRF_LOG2) ? 2 : 0)) 
  1343:       continue; 
  1344: 
  1345:     send_to_char(i->character, "%s[ %s ]%s\r\n", CCGRN(i->character, C_NRM), output, CCNRM(i->character, C_NRM)); 
  1346:   }
  1347: }
  1348: 
  1349: void script_log(const char *format, ...)
  1350: {
  1351:   va_list args;
  1352: 
  1353:   va_start(args, format);
  1354:   script_vlog(format, args);
  1355:   va_end(args);
  1356: }
  1357: 
  1358: /* Returns 1 if string is all digits, else 0. Bugfixed - would have returned 
  1359:  * true on num="------". */
  1360: static int is_num(char *arg)
  1361: {
  1362:    if (*arg == '\0')
  1363:       return FALSE;
  1364: 
  1365:    if (*arg == '+' || *arg == '-')
  1366:       arg++;
  1367: 
  1368:    for (; *arg != '\0'; arg++)
  1369:    {
  1370:       if (!isdigit(*arg))
  1371:          return FALSE;
  1372:    }
  1373: 
  1374:    return TRUE;
  1375: }
  1376: 
  1377: /* evaluates 'lhs op rhs', and copies to result */
  1378: static void eval_op(char *op, char *lhs, char *rhs, char *result, void *go,
  1379:              struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig)
  1380: {
  1381:   unsigned char *p;
  1382:   int n;
  1383: 
  1384:   /* strip off extra spaces at begin and end */
  1385:   while (*lhs && isspace(*lhs))
  1386:     lhs++;
  1387:   while (*rhs && isspace(*rhs))
  1388:     rhs++;
  1389: 
  1390:   for (p = (unsigned char *) lhs; *p; p++);
  1391:   for (--p; isspace(*p) && ((char *)p > lhs); *p-- = '\0');
  1392:   for (p = (unsigned char *) rhs; *p; p++);
  1393:   for (--p; isspace(*p) && ((char *)p > rhs); *p-- = '\0');
  1394: 
  1395: 
  1396:   /* find the op, and figure out the value */
  1397:   if (!strcmp("||", op)) {
  1398:     if ((!*lhs || (*lhs == '0')) && (!*rhs || (*rhs == '0')))
  1399:       strcpy(result, "0");
  1400:     else
  1401:       strcpy(result, "1");
  1402:   }
  1403: 
  1404:   else if (!strcmp("&&", op)) {
  1405:     if (!*lhs || (*lhs == '0') || !*rhs || (*rhs == '0'))
  1406:       strcpy (result, "0");
  1407:     else
  1408:       strcpy (result, "1");
  1409:   }
  1410: 
  1411:   else if (!strcmp("==", op)) {
  1412:     if (is_num(lhs) && is_num(rhs))
  1413:       sprintf(result, "%d", atoi(lhs) == atoi(rhs));
  1414:     else
  1415:       sprintf(result, "%d", !str_cmp(lhs, rhs));
  1416:   }
  1417: 
  1418:   else if (!strcmp("!=", op)) {
  1419:     if (is_num(lhs) && is_num(rhs))
  1420:       sprintf(result, "%d", atoi(lhs) != atoi(rhs));
  1421:     else
  1422:       sprintf(result, "%d", str_cmp(lhs, rhs));
  1423:   }
  1424: 
  1425:   else if (!strcmp("<=", op)) {
  1426:     if (is_num(lhs) && is_num(rhs))
  1427:       sprintf(result, "%d", atoi(lhs) <= atoi(rhs));
  1428:     else
  1429:       sprintf(result, "%d", str_cmp(lhs, rhs) <= 0);
  1430:   }
  1431: 
  1432:   else if (!strcmp(">=", op)) {
  1433:     if (is_num(lhs) && is_num(rhs))
  1434:       sprintf(result, "%d", atoi(lhs) >= atoi(rhs));
  1435:     else
  1436:       sprintf(result, "%d", str_cmp(lhs, rhs) <= 0);
  1437:   }
  1438: 
  1439:   else if (!strcmp("<", op)) {
  1440:     if (is_num(lhs) && is_num(rhs))
  1441:       sprintf(result, "%d", atoi(lhs) < atoi(rhs));
  1442:     else
  1443:       sprintf(result, "%d", str_cmp(lhs, rhs) < 0);
  1444:   }
  1445: 
  1446:   else if (!strcmp(">", op)) {
  1447:     if (is_num(lhs) && is_num(rhs))
  1448:       sprintf(result, "%d", atoi(lhs) > atoi(rhs));
  1449:     else
  1450:       sprintf(result, "%d", str_cmp(lhs, rhs) > 0);
  1451:   }
  1452: 
  1453:   else if (!strcmp("/=", op))
  1454:     sprintf(result, "%c", str_str(lhs, rhs) ? '1' : '0');
  1455: 
  1456:   else if (!strcmp("*", op))
  1457:     sprintf(result, "%d", atoi(lhs) * atoi(rhs));
  1458: 
  1459:   else if (!strcmp("/", op))
  1460:     sprintf(result, "%d", (n = atoi(rhs)) ? (atoi(lhs) / n) : 0);
  1461: 
  1462:   else if (!strcmp("+", op))
  1463:     sprintf(result, "%d", atoi(lhs) + atoi(rhs));
  1464: 
  1465:   else if (!strcmp("-", op))
  1466:     sprintf(result, "%d", atoi(lhs) - atoi(rhs));
  1467: 
  1468:   else if (!strcmp("!", op)) {
  1469:     if (is_num(rhs))
  1470:       sprintf(result, "%d", !atoi(rhs));
  1471:     else
  1472:       sprintf(result, "%d", !*rhs);
  1473:   }
  1474: }
  1475: 
  1476: /* p points to the first quote, returns the matching end quote, or the last 
  1477:  * non-null char in p.*/
  1478: char *matching_quote(char *p)
  1479: {
  1480:   for (p++; *p && (*p != '"'); p++) {
  1481:     if (*p == '\\')
  1482:       p++;
  1483:   }
  1484: 
  1485:   if (!*p)
  1486:     p--;
  1487: 
  1488:   return p;
  1489: }
  1490: 
  1491: /* p points to the first paren.  returns a pointer to the matching closing 
  1492:  * paren, or the last non-null char in p. */
  1493: static char *matching_paren(char *p)
  1494: {
  1495:   int i;
  1496: 
  1497:   for (p++, i = 1; *p && i; p++) {
  1498:     if (*p == '(')
  1499:       i++;
  1500:     else if (*p == ')')
  1501:       i--;
  1502:     else if (*p == '"')
  1503:       p = matching_quote(p);
  1504:   }
  1505: 
  1506:   return --p;
  1507: }
  1508: 
  1509: /* evaluates line, and returns answer in result */
  1510: static void eval_expr(char *line, char *result, void *go, struct script_data *sc,
  1511:                trig_data *trig, int type)
  1512: {
  1513:   char expr[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *p;
  1514: 
  1515:   while (*line && isspace(*line))
  1516:     line++;
  1517: 
  1518:   if (eval_lhs_op_rhs(line, result, go, sc, trig, type));
  1519: 
  1520:   else if (*line == '(') {
  1521:     strcpy(expr, line);
  1522:     p = matching_paren(expr);
  1523:     *p = '\0';
  1524:     eval_expr(expr + 1, result, go, sc, trig, type);
  1525:   }
  1526: 
  1527:   else
  1528:     var_subst(go, sc, trig, type, line, result);
  1529: }
  1530: 
  1531: /* Evaluates expr if it is in the form lhs op rhs, and copies answer in result.
  1532:  * Returns 1 if expr is evaluated, else 0. */
  1533: static int eval_lhs_op_rhs(char *expr, char *result, void *go, struct script_data *sc,
  1534:                     trig_data *trig, int type)
  1535: {
  1536:   char *p, *tokens[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1537:   char line[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], lhr[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], rhr[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1538:   int i, j;
  1539: 
  1540:   /*
  1541:    * valid operands, in order of priority
  1542:    * each must also be defined in eval_op()
  1543:    */
  1544:   static char *ops[] = {
  1545:     "||",
  1546:     "&&",
  1547:     "==",
  1548:     "!=",
  1549:     "<=",
  1550:     ">=",
  1551:     "<",
  1552:     ">",
  1553:     "/=",
  1554:     "-",
  1555:     "+",
  1556:     "/",
  1557:     "*",
  1558:     "!",
  1559:     "\n"
  1560:   };
  1561: 
  1562:   p = strcpy(line, expr);
  1563: 
  1564:   /* Initialize tokens, an array of pointers to locations in line where the 
  1565:    * ops could possibly occur. */
  1566:   for (j = 0; *p; j++) {
  1567:     tokens[j] = p;
  1568:     if (*p == '(')
  1569:       p = matching_paren(p) + 1;
  1570:     else if (*p == '"')
  1571:       p = matching_quote(p) + 1;
  1572:     else if (isalnum(*p))
  1573:       for (p++; *p && (isalnum(*p) || isspace(*p)); p++);
  1574:     else
  1575:       p++;
  1576:   }
  1577:   tokens[j] = NULL;
  1578: 
  1579:   for (i = 0; *ops[i] != '\n'; i++)
  1580:     for (j = 0; tokens[j]; j++)
  1581:       if (!strn_cmp(ops[i], tokens[j], strlen(ops[i]))) {
  1582:         *tokens[j] = '\0';
  1583:         p = tokens[j] + strlen(ops[i]);
  1584: 
  1585:         eval_expr(line, lhr, go, sc, trig, type);
  1586:         eval_expr(p, rhr, go, sc, trig, type);
  1587:         eval_op(ops[i], lhr, rhr, result, go, sc, trig);
  1588: 
  1589:         return 1;
  1590:       }
  1591: 
  1592:   return 0;
  1593: }
  1594: 
  1595: /* returns 1 if cond is true, else 0 */
  1596: static int process_if(char *cond, void *go, struct script_data *sc,
  1597:                trig_data *trig, int type)
  1598: {
  1599:   char result[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *p;
  1600: 
  1601:   eval_expr(cond, result, go, sc, trig, type);
  1602: 
  1603:   p = result;
  1604:   skip_spaces(&p);
  1605: 
  1606:   if (!*p || *p == '0')
  1607:     return 0;
  1608:   else
  1609:     return 1;
  1610: }
  1611: 
  1612: /* Scans for end of if-block.  returns the line containg 'end', or the last
  1613:  * line of the trigger if not found. */
  1614: static struct cmdlist_element *find_end(trig_data *trig, struct cmdlist_element *cl)
  1615: {
  1616:   struct cmdlist_element *c;
  1617:   char *p;
  1618: 
  1619:   if (!(cl->next)) { /* rryan: if this is the last line, theres no end */
  1620:     script_log("Trigger VNum %d has 'if' without 'end'. (error 1)", GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  1621:     return cl;
  1622:   }
  1623: 
  1624:   for (c = cl->next; c; c = c->next) {
  1625:     for (p = c->cmd; *p && isspace(*p); p++);
  1626: 
  1627:     if (!strn_cmp("if ", p, 3))
  1628:       c = find_end(trig, c);
  1629:     else if (!strn_cmp("end", p, 3))
  1630:       return c;
  1631: 
  1632:     /* thanks to Russell Ryan for this fix */
  1633:     if(!c->next) { /* rryan: this is the last line, we didn't find an end. */
  1634:       script_log("Trigger VNum %d has 'if' without 'end'. (error 2)", GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  1635:       return c;
  1636:     }
  1637:   }
  1638: 
  1639:   /* rryan: we didn't find an end */
  1640:   script_log("Trigger VNum %d has 'if' without 'end'. (error 3)", GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  1641:   return c;
  1642: }
  1643: 
  1644: /* Searches for valid elseif, else, or end to continue execution at. Returns 
  1645:  * line of elseif, else, or end if found, or last line of trigger. */
  1646: static struct cmdlist_element *find_else_end(trig_data *trig,
  1647:     struct cmdlist_element *cl, void *go, struct script_data *sc, int type)
  1648: {
  1649:   struct cmdlist_element *c;
  1650:   char *p;
  1651: 
  1652:   if (!(cl->next))
  1653:     return cl;
  1654: 
  1655:   for (c = cl->next;c->next; c = c->next) {
  1656:     for (p = c->cmd; *p && isspace(*p); p++); /* skip spaces */
  1657: 
  1658:     if (!strn_cmp("if ", p, 3))
  1659:       c = find_end(trig, c);
  1660: 
  1661:     else if (!strn_cmp("elseif ", p, 7)) {
  1662:       if (process_if(p + 7, go, sc, trig, type)) {
  1663:         GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig)++;
  1664:         return c;
  1665:       }
  1666:     }
  1667: 
  1668:     else if (!strn_cmp("else", p, 4)) {
  1669:       GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig)++;
  1670:       return c;
  1671:     }
  1672: 
  1673:     else if (!strn_cmp("end", p, 3))
  1674:       return c;
  1675: 
  1676:     /* thanks to Russell Ryan for this fix */
  1677:     if(!c->next) { /* rryan: this is the last line, return. */
  1678:       script_log("Trigger VNum %d has 'if' without 'end'. (error 4)", GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  1679:       return c;
  1680:     }
  1681:   }
  1682: 
  1683:   /* rryan: if we got here, it's the last line, if its not an end, log it. */
  1684:   for (p = c->cmd; *p && isspace(*p); p++); /* skip spaces */
  1685:   if(strn_cmp("end", p, 3))
  1686:     script_log("Trigger VNum %d has 'if' without 'end'. (error 5)", GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  1687:   return c;
  1688: }
  1689: 
  1690: /* processes any 'wait' commands in a trigger */
  1691: static void process_wait(void *go, trig_data *trig, int type, char *cmd,
  1692:                   struct cmdlist_element *cl)
  1693: {
  1694:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *arg;
  1695:   struct wait_event_data *wait_event_obj;
  1696:   long when, hr, min, ntime;
  1697:   char c;
  1698: 
  1699:   arg = any_one_arg(cmd, buf);
  1700:   skip_spaces(&arg);
  1701: 
  1702:   if (!*arg) {
  1703:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. wait w/o an arg: '%s'",
  1704:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cl->cmd);
  1705:     return;
  1706:   }
  1707: 
  1708:   if (!strn_cmp(arg, "until ", 6)) {
  1709: 
  1710:     /* valid forms of time are 14:30 and 1430 */
  1711:     if (sscanf(arg, "until %ld:%ld", &hr, &min) == 2)
  1712:       min += (hr * 60);
  1713:     else
  1714:       min = (hr % 100) + ((hr / 100) * 60);
  1715: 
  1716:     /* calculate the pulse of the day of "until" time */
  1717:     ntime = (min * SECS_PER_MUD_HOUR * PASSES_PER_SEC) / 60;
  1718: 
  1719:     /* calculate pulse of day of current time */
  1720:     when = (pulse % (SECS_PER_MUD_HOUR * PASSES_PER_SEC)) +
  1721:       (time_info.hours * SECS_PER_MUD_HOUR * PASSES_PER_SEC);
  1722: 
  1723:     if (when >= ntime) /* adjust for next day */
  1724:       when = (SECS_PER_MUD_DAY * PASSES_PER_SEC) - when + ntime;
  1725:     else
  1726:       when = ntime - when;
  1727:   }
  1728: 
  1729:   else {
  1730:     if (sscanf(arg, "%ld %c", &when, &c) == 2) {
  1731:       if (c == 't')
  1732:         when *= PULSES_PER_MUD_HOUR;
  1733:       else if (c == 's')
  1734:         when *= PASSES_PER_SEC;
  1735:     }
  1736:   }
  1737: 
  1738:   CREATE(wait_event_obj, struct wait_event_data, 1);
  1739:   wait_event_obj->trigger = trig;
  1740:   wait_event_obj->go = go;
  1741:   wait_event_obj->type = type;
  1742: 
  1743:   GET_TRIG_WAIT(trig) = event_create(trig_wait_event, wait_event_obj, when);
  1744:   trig->curr_state = cl->next;
  1745: }

  1747: /* processes a script set command */
  1748: static void process_set(struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig, char *cmd)
  1749: {
  1750:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *value;
  1751: 
  1752:   value = two_arguments(cmd, arg, name);
  1753: 
  1754:   skip_spaces(&value);
  1755: 
  1756:   if (!*name) {
  1757:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. set w/o an arg: '%s'",
  1758:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1759:     return;
  1760:   }
  1761: 
  1762:   add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(trig), name, value, sc ? sc->context : 0);
  1763: 
  1764: }

  1766: /* processes a script eval command */
  1767: void process_eval(void *go, struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig,
  1768:                  int type, char *cmd)
  1769: {
  1770:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1771:   char result[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *expr;
  1772: 
  1773:   expr = one_argument(cmd, arg); /* cut off 'eval' */
  1774:   expr = one_argument(expr, name); /* cut off name */
  1775: 
  1776:   skip_spaces(&expr);
  1777: 
  1778:   if (!*name) {
  1779:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. eval w/o an arg: '%s'",
  1780:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1781:     return;
  1782:   }
  1783: 
  1784:   eval_expr(expr, result, go, sc, trig, type);
  1785:   add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(trig), name, result, sc ? sc->context : 0);
  1786: }

  1788: /* script attaching a trigger to something */
  1789: static void process_attach(void *go, struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig,
  1790:                     int type, char *cmd)
  1791: {
  1792:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], trignum_s[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1793:   char result[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *id_p;
  1794:   trig_data *newtrig;
  1795:   char_data *c=NULL;
  1796:   obj_data *o=NULL;
  1797:   room_data *r=NULL;
  1798:   long trignum, id;
  1799: 
  1800:   id_p = two_arguments(cmd, arg, trignum_s);
  1801:   skip_spaces(&id_p);
  1802: 
  1803:   if (!*trignum_s) {
  1804:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. attach w/o an arg: '%s'",
  1805:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1806:     return;
  1807:   }
  1808: 
  1809:   if (!id_p || !*id_p || atoi(id_p)==0) {
  1810:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. attach invalid id arg: '%s'",
  1811:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1812:     return;
  1813:   }
  1814: 
  1815:   /* parse and locate the id specified */
  1816:   eval_expr(id_p, result, go, sc, trig, type);
  1817:   if (!(id = atoi(result))) {
  1818:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. attach invalid id arg: '%s'",
  1819:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1820:     return;
  1821:   }
  1822:   c = find_char(id);
  1823:   if (!c) {
  1824:     o = find_obj(id);
  1825:     if (!o) {
  1826:       r = find_room(id);
  1827:       if (!r) {
  1828:         script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. attach invalid id arg: '%s'",
  1829:                 GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1830:         return;
  1831:       }
  1832:     }
  1833:   }
  1834: 
  1835:   /* locate and load the trigger specified */
  1836:   trignum = real_trigger(atoi(trignum_s));
  1837:   if (trignum == NOTHING || !(newtrig=read_trigger(trignum))) {
  1838:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. attach invalid trigger: '%s'",
  1839:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), trignum_s);
  1840:     return;
  1841:   }
  1842: 
  1843:   if (c) {
  1844:     if (!IS_NPC(c) && !CONFIG_SCRIPT_PLAYERS) {
  1845:       script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. attach invalid target: '%s'",
  1846:               GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), GET_NAME(c));
  1847:       return;
  1848:     }
  1849:     if (!SCRIPT(c))
  1850:       CREATE(SCRIPT(c), struct script_data, 1);
  1851:     add_trigger(SCRIPT(c), newtrig, -1);
  1852:     return;
  1853:   }
  1854: 
  1855:   if (o) {
  1856:     if (!SCRIPT(o))
  1857:       CREATE(SCRIPT(o), struct script_data, 1);
  1858:     add_trigger(SCRIPT(o), newtrig, -1);
  1859:     return;
  1860:   }
  1861: 
  1862:   if (r) {
  1863:     if (!SCRIPT(r))
  1864:       CREATE(SCRIPT(r), struct script_data, 1);
  1865:     add_trigger(SCRIPT(r), newtrig, -1);
  1866:     return;
  1867:   }
  1868: }
  1869: 
  1870: /* script detaching a trigger from something */
  1871: static void process_detach(void *go, struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig,
  1872:     int type, char *cmd)
  1873: {
  1874:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], trignum_s[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1875:   char result[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *id_p;
  1876:   char_data *c=NULL;
  1877:   obj_data *o=NULL;
  1878:   room_data *r=NULL;
  1879:   long id;
  1880: 
  1881:   id_p = two_arguments(cmd, arg, trignum_s);
  1882:   skip_spaces(&id_p);
  1883: 
  1884:   if (!*trignum_s) {
  1885:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. detach w/o an arg: '%s'",
  1886:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1887:     return;
  1888:   }
  1889: 
  1890:   if (!id_p || !*id_p || atoi(id_p)==0) {
  1891:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. detach invalid id arg: '%s'",
  1892:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1893:     return;
  1894:   }
  1895: 
  1896:   /* parse and locate the id specified */
  1897:   eval_expr(id_p, result, go, sc, trig, type);
  1898:   if (!(id = atoi(result))) {
  1899:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. detach invalid id arg: '%s'",
  1900:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1901:     return;
  1902:   }
  1903:   c = find_char(id);
  1904:   if (!c) {
  1905:     o = find_obj(id);
  1906:     if (!o) {
  1907:       r = find_room(id);
  1908:       if (!r) {
  1909:         script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. detach invalid id arg: '%s'",
  1910:                 GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1911:         return;
  1912:       }
  1913:     }
  1914:   }
  1915: 
  1916: 
  1917:   if (c && SCRIPT(c)) {
  1918:     if (!strcmp(trignum_s, "all")) {
  1919:       extract_script(c, MOB_TRIGGER);
  1920:       return;
  1921:     }
  1922:     if (remove_trigger(SCRIPT(c), trignum_s)) {
  1923:       if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(c))) {
  1924:         extract_script(c, MOB_TRIGGER);
  1925:       }
  1926:     }
  1927:     return;
  1928:   }
  1929: 
  1930:   if (o && SCRIPT(o)) {
  1931:     if (!strcmp(trignum_s, "all")) {
  1932:       extract_script(o, OBJ_TRIGGER);
  1933:       return;
  1934:     }
  1935:     if (remove_trigger(SCRIPT(o), trignum_s)) {
  1936:       if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(o))) {
  1937:         extract_script(o, OBJ_TRIGGER);
  1938:       }
  1939:     }
  1940:     return;
  1941:   }
  1942: 
  1943:   if (r && SCRIPT(r)) {
  1944:     if (!strcmp(trignum_s, "all")) {
  1945:       extract_script(r, WLD_TRIGGER);
  1946:       return;
  1947:     }
  1948:     if (remove_trigger(SCRIPT(r), trignum_s)) {
  1949:       if (!TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(r))) {
  1950:         extract_script(r, WLD_TRIGGER);
  1951:       }
  1952:     }
  1953:     return;
  1954:   }
  1955: 
  1956: }
  1957: 
  1958: struct room_data *dg_room_of_obj(struct obj_data *obj)
  1959: {
  1960:   if (IN_ROOM(obj) != NOWHERE) return &world[IN_ROOM(obj)];
  1961:   if (obj->carried_by)        return &world[IN_ROOM(obj->carried_by)];
  1962:   if (obj->worn_by)           return &world[IN_ROOM(obj->worn_by)];
  1963:   if (obj->in_obj)            return (dg_room_of_obj(obj->in_obj));
  1964:   return NULL;
  1965: }
  1966: 
  1967: /* create a UID variable from the id number */
  1968: static void makeuid_var(void *go, struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig,
  1969:                  int type, char *cmd)
  1970: {
  1971:   char junk[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], varname[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1972:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1973:   char uid[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 1]; // to make room for UID_CHAR
  1974: 
  1975:   *uid = '\0';
  1976:   half_chop(cmd, junk, cmd);    /* makeuid */
  1977:   half_chop(cmd, varname, cmd); /* variable name */
  1978:   half_chop(cmd, arg, cmd);     /* numerical id or 'obj' 'mob' or 'room' */
  1979:   half_chop(cmd, name, cmd);    /* if the above was obj, mob or room, this is the name */
  1980: 
  1981:   if (!*varname) {
  1982:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. makeuid w/o an arg: '%s'",
  1983:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1984: 
  1985:     return;
  1986:   }
  1987: 
  1988:   if (!*arg) {
  1989:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. makeuid invalid id arg: '%s'",
  1990:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  1991:     return;
  1992:   }
  1993: 
  1994:   if (atoi(arg)!=0) { /* easy, if you pass an id number */
  1995:     char result[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1996: 
  1997:     eval_expr(arg, result, go, sc, trig, type);
  1998:     snprintf(uid, sizeof(uid), "%c%s", UID_CHAR, result);
  1999:   } else { /* a lot more work without it */
  2000:     if (!*name) {
  2001:       script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. makeuid needs name: '%s'",
  2002:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  2003:       return;
  2004:     }
  2005: 
  2006:     if (is_abbrev(arg, "mob")) {
  2007:       struct char_data *c = NULL;
  2008:       switch (type) {
  2009:         case WLD_TRIGGER:
  2010:           c = get_char_in_room((struct room_data *)go, name);
  2011:           break;
  2012:         case OBJ_TRIGGER:
  2013:           c = get_char_near_obj((struct obj_data *)go, name);
  2014:           break;
  2015:         case MOB_TRIGGER:
  2016:           c = get_char_room_vis((struct char_data *)go, name, NULL);
  2017:           break;
  2018:       }
  2019:       if (c)
  2020:         snprintf(uid, sizeof(uid), "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, char_script_id(c));
  2021:     } else if (is_abbrev(arg, "obj")) {
  2022:       struct obj_data *o = NULL;
  2023:       switch (type) {
  2024:         case WLD_TRIGGER:
  2025:           o = get_obj_in_room((struct room_data *)go, name);
  2026:           break;
  2027:         case OBJ_TRIGGER:
  2028:           o = get_obj_near_obj((struct obj_data *)go, name);
  2029:           break;
  2030:         case MOB_TRIGGER:
  2031:           if ((o = get_obj_in_list_vis((struct char_data *)go, name, NULL,
  2032:                     ((struct char_data *)go)->carrying)) == NULL)
  2033:             o = get_obj_in_list_vis((struct char_data *)go, name, NULL,
  2034:                     world[IN_ROOM((struct char_data *)go)].contents);
  2035:           break;
  2036:       }
  2037:       if (o)
  2038:         snprintf(uid, sizeof(uid), "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, obj_script_id(o));
  2039:     } else if (is_abbrev(arg, "room")) {
  2040:       room_rnum r = NOWHERE;
  2041:       switch (type) {
  2042:         case WLD_TRIGGER:
  2043:           r = real_room(((struct room_data *) go)->number);
  2044:           break;
  2045:         case OBJ_TRIGGER:
  2046:           r = obj_room((struct obj_data *)go);
  2047:           break;
  2048:         case MOB_TRIGGER:
  2049:           r = IN_ROOM((struct char_data *)go);
  2050:           break;
  2051:       }
  2052:       if (r != NOWHERE)
  2053:         snprintf(uid, sizeof(uid), "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, room_script_id(world + r));
  2054:     } else {
  2055:       script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. makeuid syntax error: '%s'",
  2056:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  2057: 
  2058:       return;
  2059:     }
  2060:   }
  2061:   if (*uid)
  2062:     add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(trig), varname, uid, sc ? sc->context : 0);
  2063: }
  2064: 
  2065: /* Processes a script return command. Returns the new value for the script to 
  2066:  * return. */
  2067: static int process_return(trig_data *trig, char *cmd)
  2068: {
  2069:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2070: 
  2071:   two_arguments(cmd, arg1, arg2);
  2072: 
  2073:   if (!*arg2) {
  2074:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. return w/o an arg: '%s'",
  2075:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  2076: 
  2077:     return 1;
  2078:   }
  2079: 
  2080:   return atoi(arg2);
  2081: }

  2083: /* Removes a variable from the global vars of sc, or the local vars of trig if

  2086: {
  2087:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *var;
  2088: 
  2089:   var = any_one_arg(cmd, arg);

  2103: /* Copy a locally owned variable to the globals of another script.
  2104:  * 'remote <variable_name> <uid>' */
  2105: static void process_remote(struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig, char *cmd)
  2106: {
  2107:   struct trig_var_data *vd;
  2108:   struct script_data *sc_remote=NULL;
  2109:   char *line, *var, *uid_p;
  2110:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2111:   long uid, context;
  2112:   room_data *room;
  2113:   char_data *mob;
  2114:   obj_data *obj;
  2115: 
  2116:   line = any_one_arg(cmd, arg);
  2117:   two_arguments(line, buf, buf2);
  2118:   var = buf;
  2119:   uid_p = buf2;
  2120:   skip_spaces(&var);
  2121:   skip_spaces(&uid_p);
  2122: 
  2123: 
  2124:   if (!*buf || !*buf2) {
  2125:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. remote: invalid arguments '%s'",
  2126:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  2127:     return;
  2128:   }
  2129: 
  2130:   /* find the locally owned variable */
  2131:   for (vd = GET_TRIG_VARS(trig); vd; vd = vd->next)
  2132:     if (!str_cmp(vd->name, buf))
  2133:       break;
  2134: 
  2135:   if (!vd)
  2136:     for (vd = sc->global_vars; vd; vd = vd->next)
  2137:       if (!str_cmp(vd->name, var) &&
  2138:           (vd->context==0 || vd->context==sc->context))
  2139:         break;
  2140: 
  2141:   if (!vd) {
  2142:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. local var '%s' not found in remote call",
  2143:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), buf);
  2144:     return;
  2145:   }
  2146:   /* find the target script from the uid number */
  2147:   uid = atoi(buf2);
  2148:   if (uid<=0) {
  2149:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. remote: illegal uid '%s'",
  2150:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), buf2);
  2151:     return;
  2152:   }
  2153: 
  2154:   /* For all but PC's, context comes from the existing context. For PC's, 
  2155:    * context is 0 (global) */
  2156:   context = vd->context;
  2157: 
  2158:   if ((room = find_room(uid))) {
  2159:     sc_remote = SCRIPT(room);
  2160:   } else if ((mob = find_char(uid))) {
  2161:     sc_remote = SCRIPT(mob);
  2162:     if (!IS_NPC(mob)) context = 0;
  2163:   } else if ((obj = find_obj(uid))) {
  2164:     sc_remote = SCRIPT(obj);
  2165:   } else {
  2166:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. remote: uid '%ld' invalid",
  2167:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), uid);
  2168:     return;
  2169:   }
  2170: 
  2171:   if (sc_remote==NULL) return; /* no script to assign */
  2172: 
  2173:   add_var(&(sc_remote->global_vars), vd->name, vd->value, context);
  2174: }

  2176: /* Command-line interface to rdelete. Named vdelete so people didn't think it 
  2177:  * was to delete rooms. */
  2178: ACMD(do_vdelete)
  2179: {
  2180:   struct trig_var_data *vd, *vd_prev=NULL;
  2181:   struct script_data *sc_remote=NULL;
  2182:   char *var, *uid_p;
  2183:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2184:   long uid;
  2185:   room_data *room;
  2186:   char_data *mob;
  2187:   obj_data *obj;
  2188: 
  2189:   two_arguments(argument, buf, buf2);
  2190:   var = buf;
  2191:   uid_p = buf2;
  2192:   skip_spaces(&var);
  2193:   skip_spaces(&uid_p);
  2194: 
  2195: 
  2196:   if (!*buf || !*buf2) {
  2197:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: vdelete { <variablename> | * | all } <id>\r\n");
  2198:     return;
  2199:   }
  2200: 
  2201:   /* find the target script from the uid number */
  2202:   uid = atoi(buf2);
  2203:   if (uid<=0) {
  2204:     send_to_char(ch, "vdelete: illegal id specified.\r\n");
  2205:     return;
  2206:   }
  2207: 
  2208:   if ((room = find_room(uid))) {
  2209:     sc_remote = SCRIPT(room);
  2210:   } else if ((mob = find_char(uid))) {
  2211:     sc_remote = SCRIPT(mob);
  2212:   } else if ((obj = find_obj(uid))) {
  2213:     sc_remote = SCRIPT(obj);
  2214:   } else {
  2215:     send_to_char(ch, "vdelete: cannot resolve specified id.\r\n");
  2216:     return;
  2217:   }
  2218: 
  2219:   if (sc_remote==NULL) {
  2220:     send_to_char(ch, "That id represents no global variables.(1)\r\n");
  2221:     return;
  2222:   }
  2223: 
  2224:   if (sc_remote->global_vars==NULL) {
  2225:     send_to_char(ch, "That id represents no global variables.(2)\r\n");
  2226:     return;
  2227:   }
  2228: 
  2229:   if (*var == '*' || is_abbrev(var, "all")) {
  2230:     struct trig_var_data *vd_next;
  2231:     for (vd = sc_remote->global_vars; vd; vd = vd_next) {
  2232:       vd_next = vd->next;
  2233:       free(vd->value);
  2234:       free(vd->name);
  2235:       free(vd);
  2236:     }
  2237:     sc_remote->global_vars = NULL;
  2238:     send_to_char(ch, "All variables deleted from that id.\r\n");
  2239:     return;
  2240:   }
  2241: 
  2242:   /* find the global */
  2243:   for (vd = sc_remote->global_vars; vd; vd_prev = vd, vd = vd->next)
  2244:     if (!str_cmp(vd->name, var))
  2245:       break;
  2246: 
  2247:   if (!vd) {
  2248:     send_to_char(ch, "That variable cannot be located.\r\n");
  2249:     return;
  2250:   }
  2251: 
  2252:   /* ok, delete the variable */
  2253:   if (vd_prev) vd_prev->next = vd->next;
  2254:   else sc_remote->global_vars = vd->next;
  2255: 
  2256:   /* and free up the space */
  2257:   free(vd->value);
  2258:   free(vd->name);
  2259:   free(vd);
  2260: 
  2261:   send_to_char(ch, "Deleted.\r\n");
  2262: }

  2264: /* Called from do_set - return 0 for failure, 1 for success.  ch and vict are 
  2265:  * verified. */
  2266: int perform_set_dg_var(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict, char *val_arg)
  2267: {
  2268:   char var_name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *var_value;
  2269: 
  2270:   var_value = any_one_arg(val_arg, var_name);
  2271: 
  2272:   if (!*var_name || var_value == NULL || !*var_value) {
  2273:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: set <char> <varname> <value>\r\n");
  2274:     return 0;
  2275:   }
  2276:   if (!SCRIPT(vict))
  2277:     CREATE(SCRIPT(vict), struct script_data, 1);
  2278: 
  2279:   add_var(&(SCRIPT(vict)->global_vars), var_name, var_value, 0);
  2280:   return 1;
  2281: }

  2283: /* Delete a variable from the globals of another script.
  2284:  * 'rdelete <variable_name> <uid>' */
  2285: static void process_rdelete(struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig, char *cmd)
  2286: {
  2287:   struct trig_var_data *vd, *vd_prev=NULL;
  2288:   struct script_data *sc_remote=NULL;
  2289:   char *line, *var, *uid_p;
  2290:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  2291:   long uid;
  2292:   room_data *room;
  2293:   char_data *mob;
  2294:   obj_data *obj;
  2295: 
  2296:   line = any_one_arg(cmd, arg);
  2297:   two_arguments(line, buf, buf2);
  2298:   var = buf;
  2299:   uid_p = buf2;
  2300:   skip_spaces(&var);
  2301:   skip_spaces(&uid_p);
  2302: 
  2303:   if (!*buf || !*buf2) {
  2304:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. rdelete: invalid arguments '%s'",
  2305:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  2306:     return;
  2307:   }
  2308: 
  2309:   /* find the target script from the uid number */
  2310:   uid = atoi(buf2);
  2311:   if (uid<=0) {
  2312:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. rdelete: illegal uid '%s'",
  2313:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), buf2);
  2314:     return;
  2315:   }
  2316: 
  2317:   if ((room = find_room(uid))) {
  2318:     sc_remote = SCRIPT(room);
  2319:   } else if ((mob = find_char(uid))) {
  2320:     sc_remote = SCRIPT(mob);
  2321:   } else if ((obj = find_obj(uid))) {
  2322:     sc_remote = SCRIPT(obj);
  2323:   } else {
  2324:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. remote: uid '%ld' invalid",
  2325:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), uid);
  2326:     return;
  2327:   }
  2328: 
  2329:   if (sc_remote==NULL) return; /* no script to delete a trigger from */
  2330:   if (sc_remote->global_vars==NULL) return; /* no script globals */
  2331: 
  2332:   /* find the global */
  2333:   for (vd = sc_remote->global_vars; vd; vd_prev = vd, vd = vd->next)
  2334:     if (!str_cmp(vd->name, var) &&
  2335:         (vd->context==0 || vd->context==sc->context))
  2336:       break;
  2337: 
  2338:   if (!vd) return; /* the variable doesn't exist, or is the wrong context */
  2339: 
  2340:   /* ok, delete the variable */
  2341:   if (vd_prev) vd_prev->next = vd->next;
  2342:   else sc_remote->global_vars = vd->next;
  2343: 
  2344:   /* and free up the space */
  2345:   free(vd->value);
  2346:   free(vd->name);
  2347:   free(vd);
  2348: }

  2350: /* Makes a local variable into a global variable. */
  2351: static void process_global(struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig, char *cmd, long id)
  2352: {
  2353:   struct trig_var_data *vd;
  2354:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *var;
  2355: 
  2356:   var = any_one_arg(cmd, arg);
  2357: 
  2358:   skip_spaces(&var);
  2359: 
  2360:   if (!*var) {
  2361:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. global w/o an arg: '%s'",
  2362:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), cmd);
  2363:     return;
  2364:   }
  2365: 
  2366:   for (vd = GET_TRIG_VARS(trig); vd; vd = vd->next)
  2367:     if (!str_cmp(vd->name, var))
  2368:       break;
  2369: 
  2370:   if (!vd) {
  2371:     script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d. local var '%s' not found in global call",
  2372:             GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), var);
  2373:     return;
  2374:   }
  2375: 
  2376:   add_var(&(sc->global_vars), vd->name, vd->value, id);
  2377:   remove_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(trig), vd->name);
  2378: }

  2398: static void extract_value(struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig, char *cmd)
  2399: {
  2400:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2401:   char *buf3;
  2402:   char to[128];
  2403:   int num;
  2404: 
  2405:   buf3 = any_one_arg(cmd, buf);
  2406:   half_chop(buf3, buf2, buf);
  2407:   strcpy(to, buf2);
  2408: 
  2409:   num = atoi(buf);
  2410:   if (num < 1) {
  2411:     script_log("extract number < 1!");
  2412:     return;
  2413:   }
  2414: 
  2415:   half_chop(buf, buf3, buf2);
  2416: 
  2417:   while (num>0) {
  2418:     half_chop(buf2, buf, buf2);
  2419:     num--;
  2420:   }
  2421: 
  2422:   add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(trig), to, buf, sc ? sc->context : 0);
  2423: }
  2424: 
  2425: /* Thanks to Jamie Nelson for 4 dimensions for this addition.
  2426:  * Syntax :
  2427:  * dg_letter <new varname> <letter position> <string to get from>. 
  2428:  *   set string L337-String
  2429:  *   dg_letter var1 4 %string%
  2430:  *   dg_letter var2 11 %string%
  2431:  *   now %var1% == 7 and %var2% == g
  2432:  *   Note that the index starts at 1. */
  2433: static void dg_letter_value(struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig, char *cmd)
  2434: {
  2435:   /* Set the letter/number at position 'num' as the variable. */
  2436:   char junk[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2437:   char varname[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2438:   char num_s[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2439:   char string[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2440:   int num;
  2441: 
  2442:   half_chop(cmd, junk, cmd);   /* "dg_letter" */
  2443:   half_chop(cmd, varname, cmd);
  2444:   half_chop(cmd, num_s, string);
  2445: 
  2446:   num = atoi(num_s);
  2447: 
  2448:   script_log("The use of dg_letter is deprecated");
  2449:   script_log("- Use 'set <new variable> %%<text/var>.charat(index)%%' instead.");
  2450: 
  2451: 
  2452:   if (num < 1) {
  2453:     script_log("Trigger #%d : dg_letter number < 1!", GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  2454:     return;
  2455:   }
  2456: 
  2457:   if ((size_t)num > strlen(string)) {
  2458:     script_log("Trigger #%d : dg_letter number > strlen!", GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  2459:     return;
  2460:   }
  2461: 
  2462:   *junk = string[num-1];
  2463:   *(junk+1) = '\0';
  2464:   add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(trig), varname, junk, sc->context);
  2465: }
  2466: 
  2467: /* This is the core driver for scripts.
  2468:  * Arguments:
  2469:  * void *go_adress
  2470:  *   A pointer to a pointer to the entity running the script. The reason for 
  2471:  *   this approcah is that we want to be able to see from the calling function,
  2472:  *   if the entity has been free'd.
  2473:  *
  2474:  * trig_data *trig
  2475:  *   A pointer to the current running trigger.
  2476:  *
  2477:  * int type
  2478:  *   MOB_TRIGGER, OBJ_TRIGGER or WLD_TRIGGER, respectively.
  2479:  *
  2480:  * int mode
  2481:      TRIG_NEW     just started from dg_triggers.c
  2482:      TRIG_RESTART restarted after a 'wait' */
  2483: int script_driver(void *go_adress, trig_data *trig, int type, int mode)
  2484: {
  2485:   static int depth = 0;
  2486:   int ret_val = 1;
  2487:   struct cmdlist_element *cl;
  2488:   char cmd[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *p;
  2489:   struct script_data *sc = 0;
  2490:   struct cmdlist_element *temp;
  2491:   void *go = NULL;
  2492: 
  2493:   void obj_command_interpreter(obj_data *obj, char *argument);
  2494:   void wld_command_interpreter(struct room_data *room, char *argument);
  2495: 
  2496:   switch (type) {
  2497:     case MOB_TRIGGER:
  2498:       go = *(char_data **)go_adress;
  2499:       sc = SCRIPT((char_data *) go);
  2500:       break;
  2501:     case OBJ_TRIGGER:
  2502:       go = *(obj_data **)go_adress;
  2503:       sc = SCRIPT((obj_data *) go);
  2504:       break;
  2505:     case WLD_TRIGGER:
  2506:       go = *(room_data **)go_adress;
  2507:       sc = SCRIPT((room_data *) go);
  2508:       break;
  2509:   }
  2510: 
  2511:   if (depth > MAX_SCRIPT_DEPTH) {
  2512:     script_log("Trigger %d recursed beyond maximum allowed depth.", GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  2513:     switch (type) {
  2514:       case MOB_TRIGGER:
  2515:         script_log("It was attached to %s [%d]",
  2516:            GET_NAME((char_data *) go), GET_MOB_VNUM((char_data *) go));
  2517:         break;
  2518:       case OBJ_TRIGGER:
  2519:         script_log("It was attached to %s [%d]",
  2520:            ((obj_data *) go)->short_description, GET_OBJ_VNUM((obj_data *) go));
  2521:         break;
  2522:       case WLD_TRIGGER:
  2523:         script_log("It was attached to %s [%d]",
  2524:            ((room_data *) go)->name, ((room_data *) go)->number);
  2525:         break;
  2526:     }
  2527: 
  2528:     extract_script(go, type);
  2529: 
  2530:     /* extract_script() works on rooms, but on mobiles and objects, it will be 
  2531:      * called again if the caller is load_mtrigger or load_otrigger if it is 
  2532:      * one of these, we must make sure the script is not just reloaded on the 
  2533:      * next mob. We make the calling code decide how to handle it, so it does
  2534:      * not get totally removed unless it's a load_xtrigger(). */
  2535:     return SCRIPT_ERROR_CODE;
  2536:   }
  2537: 
  2538:   depth++;
  2539: 
  2540:   if (mode == TRIG_NEW) {
  2541:     GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig) = 1;
  2542:     GET_TRIG_LOOPS(trig) = 0;
  2543:     sc->context = 0;
  2544:   }
  2545: 
  2546:   dg_owner_purged = 0;
  2547: 
  2548:   for (cl = (mode == TRIG_NEW) ? trig->cmdlist : trig->curr_state;
  2549:       cl && GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig); cl = cl->next) {
  2550:     for (p = cl->cmd; *p && isspace(*p); p++);
  2551: 
  2552:     if (*p == '*') /* comment */
  2553:       continue;
  2554: 
  2555:     else if (!strn_cmp(p, "if ", 3)) {
  2556:       if (process_if(p + 3, go, sc, trig, type))
  2557:         GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig)++;
  2558:       else
  2559:         cl = find_else_end(trig, cl, go, sc, type);
  2560:     }
  2561: 
  2562:     else if (!strn_cmp("elseif ", p, 7) ||
  2563:        !strn_cmp("else", p, 4)) {
  2564:       /* If not in an if-block, ignore the extra 'else[if]' and warn about it. */
  2565:       if (GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig) == 1) {
  2566:         script_log("Trigger VNum %d has 'else' without 'if'.",
  2567:                    GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  2568:         continue;
  2569:       }
  2570:       cl = find_end(trig, cl);
  2571:       GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig)--;
  2572:     } else if (!strn_cmp("while ", p, 6)) {
  2573:       temp = find_done(cl);
  2574:       if (!temp) {
  2575:         script_log("Trigger VNum %d has 'while' without 'done'.",
  2576:                    GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  2577:         return ret_val;
  2578:       }
  2579:       if (process_if(p + 6, go, sc, trig, type)) {
  2580:          temp->original = cl;
  2581:       } else {
  2582:          cl->loops = 0;
  2583:          cl = temp;
  2584:       }
  2585:     } else if (!strn_cmp("switch ", p, 7)) {
  2586:       cl = find_case(trig, cl, go, sc, type, p + 7);
  2587:     } else if (!strn_cmp("end", p, 3)) {
  2588:       /* If not in an if-block, ignore the extra 'end' and warn about it. */
  2589:       if (GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig) == 1) {
  2590:         script_log("Trigger VNum %d has 'end' without 'if'.",
  2591:                    GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  2592:         continue;
  2593:       }
  2594:       GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig)--;
  2595:     } else if (!strn_cmp("done", p, 4)) {
  2596:       /* if in a while loop, cl->original is non-NULL */
  2597:       if (cl->original) {
  2598:       char *orig_cmd = cl->original->cmd;
  2599:       while (*orig_cmd && isspace(*orig_cmd)) orig_cmd++;
  2600:       if (cl->original && process_if(orig_cmd + 6, go, sc, trig,
  2601:           type)) {
  2602:         cl = cl->original;
  2603:         cl->loops++;
  2604:         GET_TRIG_LOOPS(trig)++;
  2605:         if (cl->loops == 30) {
  2606:           cl->loops = 0;
  2607:           process_wait(go, trig, type, "wait 1", cl);
  2608:            depth--;
  2609:           return ret_val;
  2610:         }
  2611:           if (GET_TRIG_LOOPS(trig) >= 100) {
  2612:           script_log("Trigger VNum %d has looped 100 times!!!",
  2613:             GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig));
  2614:             break;
  2615:           }
  2616:         } else {
  2617:          /* if we're falling through a switch statement, this ends it. */
  2618:         }
  2619:       }
  2620:     } else if (!strn_cmp("break", p, 5)) {
  2621:       cl = find_done(cl);
  2622:     } else if (!strn_cmp("case", p, 4)) {
  2623:        /* Do nothing, this allows multiple cases to a single instance */
  2624:     }
  2625: 
  2626:     else {
  2627:       var_subst(go, sc, trig, type, p, cmd);
  2628: 
  2629:       if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "eval ", 5))
  2630:         process_eval(go, sc, trig, type, cmd);
  2631: 
  2632:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "nop ", 4)); /* nop: do nothing */
  2633: 
  2634:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "extract ", 8))
  2635:         extract_value(sc, trig, cmd);
  2636: 
  2637:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "dg_letter ", 10))
  2638:         dg_letter_value(sc, trig, cmd);
  2639: 
  2640:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "makeuid ", 8))
  2641:         makeuid_var(go, sc, trig, type, cmd);
  2642: 
  2643:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "halt", 4))
  2644:         break;
  2645: 
  2646:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "dg_cast ", 8))
  2647:         do_dg_cast(go, sc, trig, type, cmd);
  2648: 
  2649:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "dg_affect ", 10))
  2650:         do_dg_affect(go, sc, trig, type, cmd);
  2651: 
  2652:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "dg_skill ", 9))
  2653:         do_dg_skill(go, sc, trig, type, cmd);
  2654: 
  2655:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "dg_cooldown_check ", 18))
  2656:         do_dg_cooldown_check(go, sc, trig, type, cmd);
  2657: 
  2658:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "dg_cooldown_set ", 16))
  2659:         do_dg_cooldown_set(go, sc, trig, type, cmd);
  2660: 
  2661:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "global ", 7))
  2662:         process_global(sc, trig, cmd, sc->context);
  2663: 
  2664:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "context ", 8))
  2665:         process_context(sc, trig, cmd);
  2666: 
  2667:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "remote ", 7))
  2668:         process_remote(sc, trig, cmd);
  2669: 
  2670:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "rdelete ", 8))
  2671:         process_rdelete(sc, trig, cmd);
  2672: 
  2673:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "return ", 7))
  2674:         ret_val = process_return(trig, cmd);
  2675: 
  2676:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "set ", 4))
  2677:         process_set(sc, trig, cmd);
  2678: 
  2679:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "unset ", 6))
  2680:         process_unset(sc, trig, cmd);
  2681: 
  2682:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "wait ", 5)) {
  2683:         process_wait(go, trig, type, cmd, cl);
  2684:         depth--;
  2685:         return ret_val;
  2686:       }
  2687: 
  2688:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "attach ", 7))
  2689:         process_attach(go, sc, trig, type, cmd);
  2690: 
  2691:       else if (!strn_cmp(cmd, "detach ", 7))
  2692:         process_detach(go, sc, trig, type, cmd);
  2693: 
  2694:       else {
  2695:         switch (type) {
  2696:           case MOB_TRIGGER:
  2697:             if (!script_command_interpreter((char_data *) go, cmd))
  2698:             command_interpreter((char_data *) go, cmd);
  2699:             break;
  2700:           case OBJ_TRIGGER:
  2701:             obj_command_interpreter((obj_data *) go, cmd);
  2702:             break;
  2703:           case WLD_TRIGGER:
  2704:             wld_command_interpreter((struct room_data *) go, cmd);
  2705:             break;
  2706:         }
  2707:         if (dg_owner_purged) {
  2708:           depth--;
  2709:           if (type == OBJ_TRIGGER)
  2710:             *(obj_data **)go_adress = NULL;
  2711:           return ret_val;
  2712:         }
  2713:       }
  2714:     }
  2715:   }
  2716: 
  2717:   switch (type) { /* the script may have been detached */
  2718:     case MOB_TRIGGER:    sc = SCRIPT((char_data *) go);           break;
  2719:     case OBJ_TRIGGER:    sc = SCRIPT((obj_data *) go);            break;
  2720:     case WLD_TRIGGER:    sc = SCRIPT((room_data *) go);    break;
  2721:   }
  2722:   if (sc)
  2723:   free_varlist(GET_TRIG_VARS(trig));
  2724:   GET_TRIG_VARS(trig) = NULL;
  2725:   GET_TRIG_DEPTH(trig) = 0;
  2726: 
  2727:   depth--;
  2728:   return ret_val;
  2729: }
  2730: 
  2731: /* returns the real number of the trigger with given virtual number */
  2732: trig_rnum real_trigger(trig_vnum vnum)
  2733: {
  2734:   trig_rnum bot, top, mid;
  2735: 
  2736:   bot = 0;
  2737:   top = top_of_trigt - 1;
  2738: 
  2739:   if (!top_of_trigt || trig_index[bot]->vnum > vnum || trig_index[top]->vnum < vnum)
  2740:     return (NOTHING);
  2741: 
  2742:   /* perform binary search on trigger-table */
  2743:   while (bot <= top) {
  2744:     mid = (bot + top) / 2;
  2745: 
  2746:     if (trig_index[mid]->vnum == vnum)
  2747:       return (mid);
  2748:     if (trig_index[mid]->vnum > vnum)
  2749:       top = mid - 1;
  2750:     else
  2751:       bot = mid + 1;
  2752:   }
  2753:   return (NOTHING);
  2754: }
  2755: 
  2756: ACMD(do_tstat)
  2757: {
  2758:   int rnum;
  2759:   char str[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2760: 
  2761:   half_chop(argument, str, argument);
  2762:   if (*str) {
  2763:     rnum = real_trigger(atoi(str));
  2764:     if (rnum == NOTHING) {
  2765:       send_to_char(ch, "That vnum does not exist.\r\n");
  2766:       return;
  2767:     }
  2768: 
  2769:     do_stat_trigger(ch, trig_index[rnum]->proto);
  2770:   } else
  2771:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: tstat <vnum>\r\n");
  2772: }
  2773: 
  2774: /* Scans for a case/default instance. Returns the line containg the correct 
  2775:  * case instance, or the last line of the trigger if not found. */
  2776: static struct cmdlist_element *
  2777: find_case(struct trig_data *trig, struct cmdlist_element *cl,
  2778:           void *go, struct script_data *sc, int type, char *cond)
  2779: {
  2780:   char result[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  2781:   struct cmdlist_element *c;
  2782:   char *p, *buf;
  2783: 
  2784:   eval_expr(cond, result, go, sc, trig, type);
  2785: 
  2786:   if (!(cl->next))
  2787:     return cl;
  2788: 
  2789:   for (c = cl->next; c->next; c = c->next) {
  2790:     for (p = c->cmd; *p && isspace(*p); p++);
  2791: 
  2792:     if (!strn_cmp("while ", p, 6) || !strn_cmp("switch", p, 6))
  2793:       c = find_done(c);
  2794:     else if (!strn_cmp("case ", p, 5)) {
  2795:       buf = (char*)malloc(MAX_STRING_LENGTH);
  2796:       eval_op("==", result, p + 5, buf, go, sc, trig);
  2797:       if (*buf && *buf!='0') {
  2798:         free(buf);
  2799:         return c;
  2800:       }
  2801:       free(buf);
  2802:     } else if (!strn_cmp("default", p, 7))
  2803:       return c;
  2804:     else if (!strn_cmp("done", p, 3))
  2805:      return c;
  2806:   }
  2807:   return c;
  2808: }
  2809: 
  2810: /* Scans for end of while/switch-blocks. Returns the line containg 'end', or 
  2811:  * the last line of the trigger if not found. Malformed scripts may cause NULL 
  2812:  * to be returned. */
  2813: static struct cmdlist_element *find_done(struct cmdlist_element *cl)
  2814: {
  2815:   struct cmdlist_element *c;
  2816:   char *p;
  2817: 
  2818:   if (!cl || !(cl->next))
  2819:     return cl;
  2820: 
  2821:   for (c = cl->next; c && c->next; c = c->next) {
  2822:     for (p = c->cmd; *p && isspace(*p); p++);
  2823: 
  2824:     if (!strn_cmp("while ", p, 6) || !strn_cmp("switch ", p, 7))
  2825:       c = find_done(c);
  2826:     else if (!strn_cmp("done", p, 3))
  2827:       return c;
  2828:   }
  2829: 
  2830:   return c;
  2831: }
  2832: 
  2833: 
  2834: /* load in a character's saved variables */
  2835: void read_saved_vars(struct char_data *ch)
  2836: {
  2837:   FILE *file;
  2838:   long context;
  2839:   char fn[127];
  2840:   char input_line[1024], *temp, *p;
  2841:   char varname[32];
  2842:   char context_str[16];
  2843: 
  2844:   /* If getting to the menu from inside the game, the vars aren't removed. So 
  2845:    * let's not allocate them again. */
  2846:   if (SCRIPT(ch))
  2847:     return;
  2848: 
  2849:   /* Create the space for the script structure which holds the vars. We need to
  2850:    * do this first, because later calls to 'remote' will need. A script already 
  2851:    * assigned. */
  2852:   CREATE(SCRIPT(ch), struct script_data, 1);
  2853: 
  2854:   /* find the file that holds the saved variables and open it*/
  2855:   get_filename(fn, sizeof(fn), SCRIPT_VARS_FILE, GET_NAME(ch));
  2856:   file = fopen(fn,"r");
  2857: 
  2858:   /* if we failed to open the file, return */
  2859:   if( !file ) {
  2860:     log("%s had no variable file", GET_NAME(ch));
  2861:     return;
  2862:   }
  2863:   /* walk through each line in the file parsing variables */
  2864:   do {
  2865:     if (get_line(file, input_line)>0) {
  2866:       p = temp = strdup(input_line);
  2867:       temp = any_one_arg(temp, varname);
  2868:       temp = any_one_arg(temp, context_str);
  2869:       skip_spaces(&temp); /* temp now points to the rest of the line */
  2870: 
  2871:       context = atol(context_str);
  2872:       add_var(&(SCRIPT(ch)->global_vars), varname, temp, context);
  2873:       free(p); /* plug memory hole */
  2874:     }
  2875:   } while( !feof(file) );
  2876: 
  2877:   /* close the file and return */
  2878:   fclose(file);
  2879: }
  2880: 
  2881: /* save a characters variables out to disk */
  2882: void save_char_vars(struct char_data *ch)
  2883: {
  2884:   FILE *file;
  2885:   char fn[127];
  2886:   struct trig_var_data *vars;
  2887: 
  2888:   /* Immediate return if no script (and therefore no variables) structure has 
  2889:    * been created. this will happen when the player is logging in */
  2890:   if (SCRIPT(ch) == NULL) return;
  2891: 
  2892:   /* we should never be called for an NPC, but just in case... */
  2893:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) return;
  2894: 
  2895:   get_filename(fn, sizeof(fn), SCRIPT_VARS_FILE, GET_NAME(ch));
  2896:   unlink(fn);
  2897: 
  2898:   /* make sure this char has global variables to save */
  2899:   if (ch->script->global_vars == NULL) return;
  2900:   vars = ch->script->global_vars;
  2901: 
  2902:   file = fopen(fn,"wt");
  2903:   if (!file) {
  2904:     mudlog( NRM, LVL_GOD, TRUE,
  2905:             "SYSERR: Could not open player variable file %s for writing.:%s",
  2906:             fn, strerror(errno));
  2907:     return;
  2908:   }
  2909:   /* Note that currently, context will always be zero. This may change in the 
  2910:    * future. */
  2911:   while (vars) {
  2912:     if (*vars->name != '-') /* don't save if it begins with - */
  2913:       fprintf(file, "%s %ld %s\n", vars->name, vars->context, vars->value);
  2914:     vars = vars->next;
  2915:   }
  2916: 
  2917:   fclose(file);
  2918: }
  2919: 
  2920: /* load in a character's saved variables from an ASCII pfile*/
  2921: void read_saved_vars_ascii(FILE *file, struct char_data *ch, int count)
  2922: {
  2923:   long context;
  2924:   char input_line[1024], *temp, *p;
  2925:   char varname[READ_SIZE];
  2926:   char context_str[READ_SIZE];
  2927:   int i;
  2928: 
  2929:   /* If getting to the menu from inside the game, the vars aren't removed. So 
  2930:    * let's not allocate them again. */
  2931:   if (SCRIPT(ch))
  2932:     return;
  2933: 
  2934:   /* Create the space for the script structure which holds the vars. We need to
  2935:    * do this first, because later calls to 'remote' will need. A script already
  2936:    * assigned. */
  2937:   CREATE(SCRIPT(ch), struct script_data, 1);
  2938: 
  2939:   /* walk through each line in the file parsing variables */
  2940:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
  2941:   {
  2942:     if (get_line(file, input_line)>0) {
  2943:       p = temp = strdup(input_line);
  2944:       temp = any_one_arg(temp, varname);
  2945:       temp = any_one_arg(temp, context_str);
  2946:       skip_spaces(&temp); /* temp now points to the rest of the line */
  2947: 
  2948:       context = atol(context_str);
  2949:       add_var(&(SCRIPT(ch)->global_vars), varname, temp, context);
  2950:       free(p); /* plug memory hole */
  2951:     }
  2952:   }
  2953: }
  2954: 
  2955: /* save a characters variables out to an ASCII pfile */
  2956: void save_char_vars_ascii(FILE *file, struct char_data *ch)
  2957: {
  2958:   struct trig_var_data *vars;
  2959:   int count = 0;
  2960:   /* Immediate return if no script (and therefore no variables) structure has 
  2961:    * been created. this will happen when the player is logging in */
  2962:   if (SCRIPT(ch) == NULL) return;
  2963: 
  2964:   /* we should never be called for an NPC, but just in case... */
  2965:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) return;
  2966: 
  2967:   /* make sure this char has global variables to save */
  2968:   if (ch->script->global_vars == NULL) return;
  2969: 
  2970:   /* Note that currently, context will always be zero. This may change in the 
  2971:    * future */
  2972:   for (vars = ch->script->global_vars;vars;vars = vars->next)
  2973:     if (*vars->name != '-')
  2974:       count++;
  2975: 
  2976:   if (count != 0) {
  2977: 	  fprintf(file, "Vars: %d\n", count);
  2978: 
  2979:   for (vars = ch->script->global_vars;vars;vars = vars->next)
  2980:     if (*vars->name != '-') /* don't save if it begins with - */
  2981:       fprintf(file, "%s %ld %s\n", vars->name, vars->context, vars->value);
  2982:   }
  2983: }
  2984: 
  2985: /* find_char() helpers */
  2986: /* Must be power of 2. */
  2987: #define BUCKET_COUNT 64
  2988: /* To recognize an empty bucket. */
  2989: #define UID_OUT_OF_RANGE 1000000000
  2990: 
  2991: struct lookup_table_t {
  2992:   long uid;
  2993:   void * c;
  2994:   struct lookup_table_t *next;
  2995: };
  2996: static struct lookup_table_t lookup_table[BUCKET_COUNT];
  2997: 
  2998: void init_lookup_table(void)
  2999: {
  3000:   int i;
  3001:   for (i = 0; i < BUCKET_COUNT; i++) {
  3002:     lookup_table[i].uid  = UID_OUT_OF_RANGE;
  3003:     lookup_table[i].c    = NULL;
  3004:     lookup_table[i].next = NULL;
  3005:   }
  3006: }
  3007: 
  3008: static inline struct lookup_table_t *get_bucket_head(long uid)
  3009: {
  3010:   int bucket = (int) (uid & (BUCKET_COUNT - 1));
  3011:   return &lookup_table[bucket];
  3012: }
  3013: 
  3014: static inline struct lookup_table_t *find_element_by_uid_in_lookup_table(long uid)
  3015: {
  3016:   struct lookup_table_t *lt = get_bucket_head(uid);
  3017: 
  3018:   for (;lt && lt->uid != uid ; lt = lt->next) ;
  3019:   return lt;
  3020: }
  3021: 
  3022: static struct char_data *find_char_by_uid_in_lookup_table(long uid)
  3023: {
  3024:   struct lookup_table_t *lt = find_element_by_uid_in_lookup_table(uid);
  3025: 
  3026:   if (lt)
  3027:     return (struct char_data *)(lt->c);
  3028: 
  3029:   log("find_char_by_uid_in_lookup_table : No entity with number %ld in lookup table", uid);
  3030:   return NULL;
  3031: }
  3032: 
  3033: static struct obj_data *find_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table(long uid)
  3034: {
  3035:   struct lookup_table_t *lt = find_element_by_uid_in_lookup_table(uid);
  3036: 
  3037:   if (lt)
  3038:     return (struct obj_data *)(lt->c);
  3039: 
  3040:   log("find_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table : No entity with number %ld in lookup table", uid);
  3041:   return NULL;
  3042: }
  3043: 
  3044: int has_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table(long uid)
  3045: {
  3046:   struct lookup_table_t *lt = find_element_by_uid_in_lookup_table(uid);
  3047: 
  3048:   return lt != NULL;
  3049: }
  3050: 
  3051: void add_to_lookup_table(long uid, void *c)
  3052: {
  3053:   struct lookup_table_t *lt = get_bucket_head(uid);
  3054: 
  3055:   if (lt && lt->uid == uid) {
  3056:    log("add_to_lookup updating existing value for uid=%ld (%p -> %p)", uid, lt->c, c);
  3057:    lt->c = c;
  3058:    return;
  3059:   }
  3060: 
  3061:   for (;lt && lt->next; lt = lt->next)
  3062:     if (lt->next->uid == uid) {
  3063:       log("add_to_lookup updating existing value for uid=%ld (%p -> %p)", uid, lt->next->c, c);
  3064:       lt->next->c = c;
  3065:       return;
  3066:     }
  3067: 
  3068:   CREATE(lt->next, struct lookup_table_t, 1);
  3069:   lt->next->uid = uid;
  3070:   lt->next->c = c;
  3071: }
  3072: 
  3073: void remove_from_lookup_table(long uid)
  3074: {
  3075:   int bucket = (int) (uid & (BUCKET_COUNT - 1));
  3076:   struct lookup_table_t *lt = &lookup_table[bucket], *flt = NULL;
  3077: 
  3078:   /* This is not supposed to happen. UID 0 is not used. However, while I'm 
  3079:    * debugging the issue, let's just return right away. - Welcor */
  3080:   if (uid == 0)
  3081:     return;
  3082: 
  3083:   flt = find_element_by_uid_in_lookup_table(uid);
  3084: 
  3085:   if (flt) {
  3086:     for (lt = &lookup_table[bucket];lt->next != flt;lt = lt->next)
  3087:       ;
  3088:     lt->next = flt->next;
  3089:     free(flt);
  3090:     return;
  3091:   }
  3092: 
  3093:   log("remove_from_lookup. UID %ld not found.", uid);
  3094: }
  3095: 
  3096: bool check_flags_by_name_ar(int *array, int numflags, char *search, const char *namelist[]) 
  3097: { 
  3098:   int i, item=-1; 
  3099: 
  3100:   for (i=0; i<numflags && item < 0; i++) 
  3101:     if (!strcmp(search, namelist[i])) item = i; 
  3102: 
  3103:   if (item < 0) return FALSE; 
  3104: 
  3105:   if (IS_SET_AR(array, item)) return TRUE; 
  3106: 
  3107:   return FALSE; 
  3108: }
  3109: 
  3110: int trig_is_attached(struct script_data *sc, int trig_num) 
  3111: { 
  3112:   trig_data *t; 
  3113: 
  3114:   if (!sc || !TRIGGERS(sc)) return 0; 
  3115: 
  3116:   for (t = TRIGGERS(sc); t; t = t->next) 
  3117:     if (GET_TRIG_VNUM(t) == trig_num) 
  3118:       return 1; 
  3119: 
  3120:   return 0; 
  3121: }
  3122: 
  3123: /**
  3124: * Fetches the char's script id -- may also set it here if it's not set yet.
  3125: *
  3126: * This function was provided by EmpireMUD to help reduce how quickly DG Scripts
  3127: * runs out of id space.
  3128: *
  3129: * @param char_data *ch The character.
  3130: * @return long The unique ID.
  3131: */
  3132: long char_script_id(char_data *ch)
  3133: {
  3134:   if (ch->script_id == 0) {
  3135:     ch->script_id = max_mob_id++;
  3136:     add_to_lookup_table(ch->script_id, (void *)ch);
  3137:     
  3138:     if (max_mob_id >= ROOM_ID_BASE) {
  3139:       mudlog(CMP, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Script IDs for mobiles have exceeded the limit -- reboot to fix this");
  3140:     }
  3141:   }
  3142:   return ch->script_id;
  3143: }
  3144: 
  3145: /**
  3146: * Fetches the object's script id -- may also set it here if it's not set yet.
  3147: *
  3148: * This function was provided by EmpireMUD to help reduce how quickly DG Scripts
  3149: * runs out of id space.
  3150: *
  3151: * @param obj_data *obj The object.
  3152: * @return long The unique ID.
  3153: */
  3154: long obj_script_id(obj_data *obj)
  3155: {
  3156:   if (obj->script_id == 0) {
  3157:     obj->script_id = max_obj_id++;
  3158:     add_to_lookup_table(obj->script_id, (void *)obj);
  3159:     
  3160:     /* objs don't run out of idspace, currently
  3161:     if (max_obj_id > x && reboot_control.time > 16) {
  3162:       mudlog(CMP, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Script IDs for objects have exceeded the limit -- reboot to fix this");
  3163:     }
  3164:     */
  3165:   }
  3166:   return obj->script_id;
  3167: }
