    29: /* General functions used by several triggers. */
    30: 
    31: /* Copy first phrase into first_arg, returns rest of string. */
    32: char *one_phrase(char *arg, char *first_arg)
    33: {
    34:     skip_spaces(&arg);
    35: 
    36:     if (!*arg)
    37:         *first_arg = '\0';
    38: 
    39:     else if (*arg == '"')
    40:     {
    41:         char *p, c;
    42: 
    43:         p = matching_quote(arg);
    44:         c = *p;
    45:         *p = '\0';
    46:         strcpy(first_arg, arg + 1);
    47:         if (c == '\0')
    48:             return p;
    49:         else
    50:             return p + 1;
    51:     }
    52: 
    53:     else
    54:     {
    55:         char *s, *p;
    56: 
    57:         s = first_arg;
    58:         p = arg;
    59: 
    60:         while (*p && !isspace(*p) && *p != '"')
    61:             *s++ = *p++;
    62: 
    63:         *s = '\0';
    64:         return p;
    65:     }
    66: 
    67:     return arg;
    68: }
    69: 
    70: int is_substring(char *sub, char *string)
    71: {
    72:     char *s;
    73: 
    74:     if ((s = str_str(string, sub)))
    75:     {
    76:         int len = strlen(string);
    77:         int sublen = strlen(sub);
    78: 
    79:         /* check front */
    80:         if ((s == string || isspace(*(s - 1)) || ispunct(*(s - 1))) &&
    81: 
    82:             /* check end */
    83:             ((s + sublen == string + len) || isspace(s[sublen]) ||
    84:              ispunct(s[sublen])))
    85:             return 1;
    86:     }
    87: 
    88:     return 0;
    89: }
    90: 
    91: /* Return 1 if str contains a word or phrase from wordlist. Phrases are in
    92:  * double quotes ("). if wrdlist is NULL, then return 1, if str is NULL,
    93:  * return 0. */
    94: int word_check(char *str, char *wordlist)
    95: {
    96:     char words[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], phrase[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *s;
    97: 
    98:     if (*wordlist=='*') return 1;
    99: 
   100:     strcpy(words, wordlist);
   101: 
   102:     for (s = one_phrase(words, phrase); *phrase; s = one_phrase(s, phrase))
   103:         if (is_substring(phrase, str))
   104:             return 1;
   105: 
   106:     return 0;
   107: }

   109: /*Mob triggers. */
   110: void random_mtrigger(char_data *ch)
   111: {
   112:   trig_data *t;
   113: 
   114:   /* This trigger is only called if a char is in the zone without nohassle. */
   115:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_RANDOM) || AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM))
   116:     return;
   117: 
   118:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   119:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_RANDOM) &&
   120:         (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   121:       script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   122:       break;
   123:     }
   124:   }
   125: }

   127: void bribe_mtrigger(char_data *ch, char_data *actor, int amount)
   128: {
   129:   trig_data *t;
   130:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   131: 
   132:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_BRIBE) || AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM))
   133:     return;
   134: 
   135:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   136:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_BRIBE) && (amount >= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   137:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%d", amount);
   138:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "amount", buf, 0);
   139:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   140:       script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   141:       break;
   142:     }
   143:   }
   144: }

   146: void greet_memory_mtrigger(char_data *actor)
   147: {
   148:   trig_data *t;
   149:   char_data *ch;
   150:   struct script_memory *mem;
   151:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   152:   int command_performed = 0;
   153: 
   154:   if (!valid_dg_target(actor, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   155:     return;
   156: 
   157:   for (ch = world[IN_ROOM(actor)].people; ch; ch = ch->next_in_room) {
   158:     if (!SCRIPT_MEM(ch) || !AWAKE(ch) || FIGHTING(ch) || (ch == actor) ||
   159:         AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM))
   160:       continue;
   161:     /* find memory line with command only */
   162:     for (mem = SCRIPT_MEM(ch); mem && SCRIPT_MEM(ch); mem=mem->next) {
   163:       if (char_script_id(actor)!=mem->id) continue;
   164:       if (mem->cmd) {
   165:         command_interpreter(ch, mem->cmd); /* no script */
   166:         command_performed = 1;
   167:         break;
   168:       }
   169:       /* if a command was not performed execute the memory script */
   170:       if (mem && !command_performed) {
   171:         for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   172:           if (IS_SET(GET_TRIG_TYPE(t), MTRIG_MEMORY) &&
   173:               CAN_SEE(ch, actor) &&
   174:               !GET_TRIG_DEPTH(t) &&
   175:               rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t)) {
   176:               ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   177:               script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   178:               break;
   179:           }
   180:         }
   181:       }
   182:       /* delete the memory */
   183:       if (mem) {
   184:         if (SCRIPT_MEM(ch)==mem) {
   185:           SCRIPT_MEM(ch) = mem->next;
   186:         } else {
   187:           struct script_memory *prev;
   188:           prev = SCRIPT_MEM(ch);
   189:           while (prev->next != mem) prev = prev->next;
   190:           prev->next = mem->next;
   191:         }
   192:         if (mem->cmd) free(mem->cmd);
   193:         free(mem);
   194:       }
   195:     }
   196:   }
   197: }

   199: int greet_mtrigger(char_data *actor, int dir)
   200: {
   201:   trig_data *t;
   202:   char_data *ch;
   203:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   204:   int intermediate, final=TRUE;
   205:   struct trig_data *next_trig;
   206: 
   207:   if (!valid_dg_target(actor, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   208:     return TRUE;
   209: 
   210:   for (ch = world[IN_ROOM(actor)].people; ch; ch = ch->next_in_room) {
   211:     if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_GREET | MTRIG_GREET_ALL) ||
   212:         !AWAKE(ch) || FIGHTING(ch) || (ch == actor) ||
   213:         AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM))
   214:       continue;
   215: 
   216:     for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = next_trig) {
   217: 		next_trig = t->next;
   218: 		if (((IS_SET(GET_TRIG_TYPE(t), MTRIG_GREET) && CAN_SEE(ch, actor)) ||
   219:            IS_SET(GET_TRIG_TYPE(t), MTRIG_GREET_ALL)) &&
   220:           !GET_TRIG_DEPTH(t) && (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   221:         if (dir>=0 && dir < DIR_COUNT)
   222:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "direction", dirs[rev_dir[dir]], 0);
   223:         else
   224:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "direction", "none", 0);
   225:         ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   226:         intermediate = script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   227:         if (!intermediate) final = FALSE;
   228:         continue;
   229:       }
   230:     }
   231:   }
   232:   return final;
   233: }

   294: int command_mtrigger(char_data *actor, char *cmd, char *argument)
   295: {
   296:   char_data *ch, *ch_next;
   297:   trig_data *t;
   298:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   299: 
   300:   /* prevent people we like from becoming trapped :P */
   301:   if (!valid_dg_target(actor, 0))
   302:     return 0;
   303: 
   304:   for (ch = world[IN_ROOM(actor)].people; ch; ch = ch_next) {
   305:     ch_next = ch->next_in_room;
   306: 
   307:     if (SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_COMMAND) && !AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM) &&
   308:        ((actor!=ch) || CONFIG_SCRIPT_PLAYERS)) {
   309:       for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   310:         if (!TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_COMMAND))
   311:           continue;
   312: 
   313:         if (!GET_TRIG_ARG(t) || !*GET_TRIG_ARG(t)) {
   314:           mudlog(NRM, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Command Trigger #%d has no text argument!",
   315:             GET_TRIG_VNUM(t));
   316:           continue;
   317:         }
   318: 
   319:         if (*GET_TRIG_ARG(t)=='*' ||
   320:             !strn_cmp(GET_TRIG_ARG(t), cmd, strlen(GET_TRIG_ARG(t)))) {
   321:           ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   322:           skip_spaces(&argument);
   323:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "arg", argument, 0);
   324:           skip_spaces(&cmd);
   325:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "cmd", cmd, 0);
   326: 
   327:           if (script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW))
   328:             return 1;
   329:         }
   330:       }
   331:     }
   332:   }
   333: 
   334:   return 0;
   335: }
   336: 
   337: void speech_mtrigger(char_data *actor, char *str)
   338: {
   339:   char_data *ch, *ch_next;
   340:   trig_data *t;
   341:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   342: 
   343:   for (ch = world[IN_ROOM(actor)].people; ch; ch = ch_next)
   344:   {
   345:     ch_next = ch->next_in_room;
   346: 
   347:     if (SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_SPEECH) && AWAKE(ch) &&
   348:         !AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM) && ((actor!=ch) || CONFIG_SCRIPT_PLAYERS))
   349:       for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   350:         if (!TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_SPEECH))
   351:           continue;
   352: 
   353:         if (!GET_TRIG_ARG(t) || !*GET_TRIG_ARG(t)) {
   354:           mudlog(NRM, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Speech Trigger #%d has no text argument!",
   355:             GET_TRIG_VNUM(t));
   356:           continue;
   357:         }
   358: 
   359:         if (((GET_TRIG_NARG(t) && word_check(str, GET_TRIG_ARG(t))) ||
   360:              (!GET_TRIG_NARG(t) && is_substring(GET_TRIG_ARG(t), str)))) {
   361:           ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   362:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "speech", str, 0);
   363:           script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   364:           break;
   365:         }
   366:       }
   367:   }
   368: }
   369: 
   370: void act_mtrigger(const char_data *ch, char *str, char_data *actor,
   371:                   char_data *victim, obj_data *object,
   372:                   obj_data *target, char *arg)
   373: {
   374:   trig_data *t;
   375:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   376: 
   377:   if (SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_ACT) && !AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM) &&
   378:       (actor!=ch))
   379:     for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next)  {
   380:       if (!TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_ACT))
   381:         continue;
   382: 
   383:       if (!GET_TRIG_ARG(t) || !*GET_TRIG_ARG(t)) {
   384:         mudlog(NRM, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Act Trigger #%d has no text argument!",
   385:           GET_TRIG_VNUM(t));
   386:         continue;
   387:       }
   388: 
   389:       if (((GET_TRIG_NARG(t) && word_check(str, GET_TRIG_ARG(t))) ||
   390:            (!GET_TRIG_NARG(t) && is_substring(GET_TRIG_ARG(t), str)))) {
   391:         if (actor)
   392:           ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   393:         if (victim)
   394:           ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(victim), "victim", 0);
   395:         if (object)
   396:           ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, obj_script_id(object), "object", 0);
   397:         if (target)
   398:           ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, obj_script_id(target), "target", 0);
   399:         if (str) {
   400:           /* we're guaranteed to have a string ending with \r\n\0 */
   401:           char *nstr = strdup(str), *fstr = nstr, *p = strchr(nstr, '\r');
   402:           skip_spaces(&nstr);
   403:           *p = '\0';
   404:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "arg", nstr, 0);
   405:           free(fstr);
   406:         }
   407:         script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   408:         break;
   409:       }
   410:     }
   411: }

   413: void fight_mtrigger(char_data *ch)
   414: {
   415:   struct char_data *actor;
   416:   trig_data *t;
   417:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   418: 
   419:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_FIGHT) || !FIGHTING(ch) ||
   420:       AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM))
   421:     return;
   422: 
   423:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   424:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_FIGHT) &&
   425:         (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))){
   426:       actor = FIGHTING(ch);
   427:       if (actor)
   428:         ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   429:       else
   430:         add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "actor", "nobody", 0);
   431: 
   432:       script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   433:       break;
   434:     }
   435:   }
   436: }

   438: void hitprcnt_mtrigger(char_data *ch)

   457:   }

   460: int receive_mtrigger(char_data *ch, char_data *actor, obj_data *obj)
   461: {
   462:   trig_data *t;
   463:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   464:   int ret_val;
   465:   long object_id = obj_script_id(obj);
   466: 
   467:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_RECEIVE) || AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM))
   468:     return 1;
   469: 
   470:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   471:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_RECEIVE) &&
   472:         (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))){
   473: 
   474:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   475:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, object_id, "object", 0);
   476:       ret_val = script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   477:       // check for purged item before dereferencing.
   478:       if (DEAD(actor) || DEAD(ch) || !has_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table(object_id) || obj->carried_by != actor)
   479:         return 0;
   480:       else
   481:         return ret_val;
   482:     }
   483:   }
   484: 
   485:   return 1;
   486: }

   488: int death_mtrigger(char_data *ch, char_data *actor)
   489: {
   490:   trig_data *t;
   491:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   492: 
   493:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_DEATH) || AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM))
   494:     return 1;
   495: 
   496:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   497:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_DEATH) &&
   498:         (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))){
   499:       if (actor)
   500:         ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   501:       return script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   502:     }
   503:   }
   504: 
   505:   return 1;
   506: }

   508: void load_mtrigger(char_data *ch)
   509: {
   510:   trig_data *t;
   511:   int result = 0;
   512: 
   513:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_LOAD))
   514:     return;
   515: 
   516:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   517:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_LOAD) &&
   518:         (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   519:       result = script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   520:       break;
   521:     }
   522:   }
   523:   if (result == SCRIPT_ERROR_CODE) {
   524:     /* we have recursed beyond reasonable depth */
   525:     /* make sure this mob is the last one in the load chain */
   526:     if (GET_MOB_RNUM(ch) != NOBODY) {
   527:       free_proto_script(&mob_proto[GET_MOB_RNUM(ch)], MOB_TRIGGER);
   528:     }
   529:   }
   530: }

   532: int cast_mtrigger(char_data *actor, char_data *ch, int spellnum)
   533: {
   534:   trig_data *t;
   535:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   536: 
   537:   if (ch == NULL)
   538:     return 1;
   539: 
   540:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_CAST) || AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM))
   541:     return 1;
   542: 
   543:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   544:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, MTRIG_CAST) &&
   545:         (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   546:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   547:       sprintf(buf, "%d", spellnum);
   548:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "spell", buf, 0);
   549:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "spellname", skill_name(spellnum), 0);
   550:       return script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   551:     }
   552:   }
   553: 
   554:   return 1;
   555: }

   557: int damage_mtrigger(char_data *actor, char_data *victim, int dam, int attacktype)
   558: {
   559:   trig_data *t;
   560:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   561: 
   562:   if (victim == NULL)
   563:     return dam;

   566:     return dam;

   571:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   572:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(victim), "victim", 0);
   573:       sprintf(buf, "%d", dam);
   574:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "damage", buf, 0);
   575:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "attacktype", skill_name(attacktype), 0);
   576:       return script_driver(&victim, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   577:     }
   578:   }
   579: 
   580:   return dam;
   581: }

   584: int leave_mtrigger(char_data *actor, int dir)
   585: {
   586:   trig_data *t;
   587:   char_data *ch;
   588:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   589: 
   590:   if (!valid_dg_target(actor, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   591:     return 1;
   592: 
   593:   for (ch = world[IN_ROOM(actor)].people; ch; ch = ch->next_in_room) {
   594:     if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(ch, MTRIG_LEAVE) ||
   595:         !AWAKE(ch) || FIGHTING(ch) || (ch == actor) ||
   596:         AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_CHARM))
   597:       continue;
   598: 
   599:     for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next) {
   600:       if ((IS_SET(GET_TRIG_TYPE(t), MTRIG_LEAVE) && CAN_SEE(ch, actor)) &&
   601:           !GET_TRIG_DEPTH(t) && (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   602:         if (dir>=0 && dir < DIR_COUNT)
   603:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "direction", dirs[dir], 0);
   604:         else
   605:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "direction", "none", 0);
   606:         ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   607:         return script_driver(&ch, t, MOB_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   608:       }
   609:     }
   610:   }
   611:   return 1;
   612: }

   695: int get_otrigger(obj_data *obj, char_data *actor)
   696: {
   697:   trig_data *t;
   698:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   699:   int ret_val;
   700:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_GET))
   701:     return 1;
   702: 
   703:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj)); t; t = t->next) {
   704:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, OTRIG_GET) && (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   705:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   706:       ret_val = script_driver(&obj, t, OBJ_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   707:       /* Don't allow a get to take place, if the actor is killed (the mud
   708:        * would choke on obj_to_char) or the object is purged. */
   709:       if (DEAD(actor) || !obj)
   710:         return 0;
   711:       else
   712:         return ret_val;
   713:     }
   714:   }
   715: 
   716:   return 1;
   717: }
   718: 
   719: /* checks for command trigger on specific object. assumes obj has cmd trig */
   720: int cmd_otrig(obj_data *obj, char_data *actor, char *cmd,
   721:               char *argument, int type)
   722: {
   723:   trig_data *t;
   724:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   725: 
   726:   if (obj && SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_COMMAND))
   727:     for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj)); t; t = t->next) {
   728:       if (!TRIGGER_CHECK(t, OTRIG_COMMAND))
   729:         continue;
   730: 
   731:       if (IS_SET(GET_TRIG_NARG(t), type) &&
   732:           (!GET_TRIG_ARG(t) || !*GET_TRIG_ARG(t))) {
   733:         mudlog(NRM, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: O-Command Trigger #%d has no text argument!",
   734:           GET_TRIG_VNUM(t));
   735:         continue;
   736:       }
   737: 
   738:       if (IS_SET(GET_TRIG_NARG(t), type) &&
   739:           (*GET_TRIG_ARG(t)=='*' ||
   740:           !strn_cmp(GET_TRIG_ARG(t), cmd, strlen(GET_TRIG_ARG(t))))) {
   741: 
   742:         ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   743:         skip_spaces(&argument);
   744:         add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "arg", argument, 0);
   745:         skip_spaces(&cmd);
   746:         add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "cmd", cmd, 0);
   747: 
   748:         if (script_driver(&obj, t, OBJ_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW))
   749:           return 1;
   750:       }
   751:     }
   752: 
   753:   return 0;
   754: }
   755: 
   756: int command_otrigger(char_data *actor, char *cmd, char *argument)
   757: {
   758:   obj_data *obj;
   759:   int i;
   760: 
   761:   /* prevent people we like from becoming trapped :P */
   762:   if (!valid_dg_target(actor, 0))
   763:     return 0;
   764: 
   765:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
   766:     if (GET_EQ(actor, i))
   767:       if (cmd_otrig(GET_EQ(actor, i), actor, cmd, argument, OCMD_EQUIP))
   768:         return 1;
   769: 
   770:   for (obj = actor->carrying; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
   771:     if (cmd_otrig(obj, actor, cmd, argument, OCMD_INVEN))
   772:       return 1;
   773: 
   774:   for (obj = world[IN_ROOM(actor)].contents; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
   775:     if (cmd_otrig(obj, actor, cmd, argument, OCMD_ROOM))
   776:       return 1;
   777: 
   778:   return 0;
   779: }

   805: int remove_otrigger(obj_data *obj, char_data *actor)
   806: {
   807:   trig_data *t;
   808:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   809:   int ret_val;
   810: 
   811:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_REMOVE))
   812:     return 1;
   813: 
   814:   if (!valid_dg_target(actor, 0))
   815:     return 1;
   816: 
   817:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj)); t; t = t->next) {
   818:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, OTRIG_REMOVE)) {
   819:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   820:       ret_val = script_driver(&obj, t, OBJ_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   821:       /* Don't allow a remove to take place, if the object is purged. */
   822:       if (!obj)
   823:         return 0;
   824:       else
   825:         return ret_val;
   826:     }
   827:   }
   828: 
   829:   return 1;
   830: }
   831: 
   832: int drop_otrigger(obj_data *obj, char_data *actor)
   833: {
   834:   trig_data *t;
   835:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   836:   int ret_val;
   837: 
   838:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_DROP))
   839:     return 1;
   840: 
   841:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj)); t; t = t->next) {
   842:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, OTRIG_DROP) && (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   843:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   844:       ret_val = script_driver(&obj, t, OBJ_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   845:       /* Don't allow a drop to take place, if the object is purged. */
   846:       if (!obj)
   847:         return 0;
   848:       else
   849:         return ret_val;
   850:     }
   851:   }
   852: 
   853:   return 1;
   854: }

   856: int give_otrigger(obj_data *obj, char_data *actor, char_data *victim)
   857: {
   858:   trig_data *t;
   859:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   860:   int ret_val;
   861: 
   862:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_GIVE))
   863:     return 1;
   864: 
   865:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj)); t; t = t->next) {
   866:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, OTRIG_GIVE) && (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   867:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   868:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(victim), "victim", 0);
   869:       ret_val = script_driver(&obj, t, OBJ_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   870:       /* Don't allow a give to take place, if the object is purged or the
   871:        * object is not carried by the giver. */
   872:       if (!obj || obj->carried_by != actor)
   873:         return 0;
   874:       else
   875:         return ret_val;
   876:     }
   877:   }
   878: 
   879:   return 1;
   880: }
   881: 
   882: void load_otrigger(obj_data *obj)
   883: {
   884:   trig_data *t;
   885:   int result = 0;
   886: 
   887:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_LOAD))
   888:     return;
   889: 
   890:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj)); t; t = t->next) {
   891:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, OTRIG_LOAD) &&
   892:         (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   893:       result = script_driver(&obj, t, OBJ_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   894:       break;
   895:     }
   896:   }
   897:   if (result == SCRIPT_ERROR_CODE) {
   898:     /* we have recursed beyond reasonable depth */
   899:     /* make sure this mob is the last one in the load chain */
   900:     if (GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj) != NOTHING) {
   901:       free_proto_script(&obj_proto[GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj)], OBJ_TRIGGER);
   902:     }
   903:   }
   904: }
   905: 
   906: int cast_otrigger(char_data *actor, obj_data *obj, int spellnum)
   907: {
   908:   trig_data *t;
   909:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   910: 
   911:   if (obj == NULL)
   912:     return 1;
   913: 
   914:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_CAST))
   915:     return 1;
   916: 
   917:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj)); t; t = t->next) {
   918:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, OTRIG_CAST) &&
   919:         (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   920:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   921:       sprintf(buf, "%d", spellnum);
   922:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "spell", buf, 0);
   923:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "spellname", skill_name(spellnum), 0);
   924:       return script_driver(&obj, t, OBJ_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   925:     }
   926:   }
   927: 
   928:   return 1;
   929: }
   930: 
   931: int leave_otrigger(room_data *room, char_data *actor, int dir)
   932: {
   933:   trig_data *t;
   934:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   935:   int temp, final = 1;
   936:   obj_data *obj, *obj_next;
   937: 
   938:   if (!valid_dg_target(actor, DG_ALLOW_GODS))
   939:     return 1;
   940: 
   941:   for (obj = room->contents; obj; obj = obj_next) {
   942:     obj_next = obj->next_content;
   943:     if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_LEAVE))
   944:       continue;
   945: 
   946:     for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj)); t; t = t->next) {
   947:       if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, OTRIG_LEAVE) &&
   948:           (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
   949:         if (dir>=0 && dir < DIR_COUNT)
   950:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "direction", dirs[dir], 0);
   951:         else
   952:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "direction", "none", 0);
   953:         ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   954:         temp = script_driver(&obj, t, OBJ_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   955:         if (temp == 0)
   956:           final = 0;
   957:       }
   958:     }
   959:   }
   960: 
   961:   return final;
   962: }
   963: 
   964: int consume_otrigger(obj_data *obj, char_data *actor, int cmd)
   965: {
   966:   trig_data *t;
   967:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   968:   int ret_val;
   969: 
   970:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_CONSUME))
   971:     return 1;
   972: 
   973:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(obj)); t; t = t->next) {
   974:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, OTRIG_CONSUME)) {
   975:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
   976:       switch (cmd) {
   977:               case OCMD_EAT:
   978:                 add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "command", "eat", 0);
   979:                 break;
   980:               case OCMD_DRINK:
   981:                 add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "command", "drink", 0);
   982:                 break;
   983:         case OCMD_QUAFF:
   984:           add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "command", "quaff", 0);
   985:           break;
   986:       }
   987:       ret_val = script_driver(&obj, t, OBJ_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
   988:       /* Don't allow a wear to take place, if the object is purged. */
   989:       if (!obj)
   990:         return 0;
   991:       else
   992:         return ret_val;
   993:     }
   994:   }
   995: 
   996:   return 1;
   997: }

  1074: int command_wtrigger(char_data *actor, char *cmd, char *argument)
  1075: {
  1076:   struct room_data *room;
  1077:   trig_data *t;
  1078:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1079: 
  1080:   if (!actor || !SCRIPT_CHECK(&world[IN_ROOM(actor)], WTRIG_COMMAND))
  1081:     return 0;
  1082: 
  1083:   /* prevent people we like from becoming trapped :P */
  1084:   if (!valid_dg_target(actor, 0))
  1085:     return 0;
  1086: 
  1087:   room = &world[IN_ROOM(actor)];
  1088:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(room)); t; t = t->next) {
  1089:     if (!TRIGGER_CHECK(t, WTRIG_COMMAND))
  1090:       continue;
  1091: 
  1092:     if (!GET_TRIG_ARG(t) || !*GET_TRIG_ARG(t)) {
  1093:       mudlog(NRM, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: W-Command Trigger #%d has no text argument!",
  1094:         GET_TRIG_VNUM(t));
  1095:       continue;
  1096:     }
  1097: 
  1098:     if (*GET_TRIG_ARG(t)=='*' ||
  1099:         !strn_cmp(GET_TRIG_ARG(t), cmd, strlen(GET_TRIG_ARG(t)))) {
  1100:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
  1101:       skip_spaces(&argument);
  1102:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "arg", argument, 0);
  1103:       skip_spaces(&cmd);
  1104:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "cmd", cmd, 0);
  1105: 
  1106:       return script_driver(&room, t, WLD_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
  1107:     }
  1108:   }
  1109: 
  1110:   return 0;
  1111: }

  1113: void speech_wtrigger(char_data *actor, char *str)

  1115:   struct room_data *room;
  1116:   trig_data *t;
  1117:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];

  1119:   if (!actor || !SCRIPT_CHECK(&world[IN_ROOM(actor)], WTRIG_SPEECH))
  1120:     return;
  1121: 
  1122:   room = &world[IN_ROOM(actor)];
  1123:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(room)); t; t = t->next) {
  1124:     if (!TRIGGER_CHECK(t, WTRIG_SPEECH))
  1125:       continue;
  1126: 
  1127:     if (!GET_TRIG_ARG(t) || !*GET_TRIG_ARG(t)) {
  1128:       mudlog(NRM, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: W-Speech Trigger #%d has no text argument!",
  1129:         GET_TRIG_VNUM(t));
  1130:       continue;
  1131:     }
  1132: 
  1133:     if (*GET_TRIG_ARG(t)=='*' ||
  1134:        (GET_TRIG_NARG(t) && word_check(str, GET_TRIG_ARG(t))) ||
  1135:        (!GET_TRIG_NARG(t) && is_substring(GET_TRIG_ARG(t), str))) {
  1136:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
  1137:       add_var(&GET_TRIG_VARS(t), "speech", str, 0);
  1138:       script_driver(&room, t, WLD_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
  1139:       break;
  1140:     }
  1141:   }
  1142: }

  1144: int drop_wtrigger(obj_data *obj, char_data *actor)
  1145: {
  1146:   struct room_data *room;
  1147:   trig_data *t;
  1148:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1149:   int ret_val;
  1150:   long object_id = obj_script_id(obj);
  1151: 
  1152:   if (!actor || !SCRIPT_CHECK(&world[IN_ROOM(actor)], WTRIG_DROP))
  1153:     return 1;
  1154: 
  1155:   room = &world[IN_ROOM(actor)];
  1156:   for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(room)); t; t = t->next)
  1157:     if (TRIGGER_CHECK(t, WTRIG_DROP) &&
  1158:         (rand_number(1, 100) <= GET_TRIG_NARG(t))) {
  1159:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, char_script_id(actor), "actor", 0);
  1160:       ADD_UID_VAR(buf, t, object_id, "object", 0);
  1161:       ret_val = script_driver(&room, t, WLD_TRIGGER, TRIG_NEW);
  1162:       // check for purged object before dereferencing.
  1163:       if (!has_obj_by_uid_in_lookup_table(object_id) || obj->carried_by != actor)
  1164:         return 0;
  1165:       else
  1166:         return ret_val;
  1167:     }
  1168: 
  1169:   return 1;
  1170: }

    33: /* Thanks to James Long for his assistance in plugging the memory leak that
    34:  * used to be here. - Welcor */
    35: /* Adds a variable with given name and value to trigger. */
    36: void add_var(struct trig_var_data **var_list, const char *name, const char *value, long id)
    37: {
    38:   struct trig_var_data *vd;
    39: 
    40:   if (strchr(name, '.')) {
    41:     log("add_var() : Attempt to add illegal var: %s", name);
    42:     return;
    43:   }
    44: 
    45:   for (vd = *var_list; vd && str_cmp(vd->name, name); vd = vd->next);
    46: 
    47:   if (vd && (!vd->context || vd->context==id)) {
    48:     free(vd->value);
    49:     CREATE(vd->value, char, strlen(value) + 1);
    50:   }
    51: 
    52:   else {
    53:     CREATE(vd, struct trig_var_data, 1);
    54: 
    55:     CREATE(vd->name, char, strlen(name) + 1);
    56:     strcpy(vd->name, name);                            /* strcpy: ok*/
    57: 
    58:     CREATE(vd->value, char, strlen(value) + 1);
    59: 
    60:     vd->next = *var_list;
    61:     vd->context = id;
    62:     *var_list = vd;
    63:   }
    64: 
    65:   strcpy(vd->value, value);                            /* strcpy: ok*/
    66: }

    69: char *skill_percent(struct char_data *ch, char *skill)
    70: {
    71:   static char retval[16];
    72:   int skillnum;
    73: 
    74:   skillnum = find_skill_num(skill);
    75:   if (skillnum<=0) return("unknown skill");
    76: 
    77:   snprintf(retval, sizeof(retval), "%d", GET_SKILL(ch, skillnum));
    78:   return retval;

    81: /* Search through all the persons items, including containers. 0 if it doesnt
    82:  * exist, and greater then 0 if it does! Jamie Nelson.  Now also searches by
    83:  * vnum and returns the number of matching objects. - Welcor */
    84: int item_in_list(char *item, obj_data *list)
    85: {
    86:   obj_data *i;
    87:   int count = 0;
    88: 
    89:   if (!item || !*item)
    90:     return 0;
    91: 
    92:   if (*item == UID_CHAR) {
    93:     long id = atol(item + 1);
    94: 
    95:     for (i = list; i; i = i->next_content) {
    96:       if (id == i->script_id)
    97:         count ++;
    98:       if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(i) == ITEM_CONTAINER)
    99:         count += item_in_list(item, i->contains);
   100:     }
   101:   } else if (is_number(item)) { /* check for vnum */
   102:     obj_vnum ovnum = atoi(item);
   103: 
   104:     for (i = list; i; i = i->next_content) {
   105:       if (GET_OBJ_VNUM(i) == ovnum)
   106:         count++;
   107:       if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(i) == ITEM_CONTAINER)
   108:         count += item_in_list(item, i->contains);
   109:     }
   110:   } else {
   111:     for (i = list; i; i = i->next_content) {
   112:       if (isname(item, i->name))
   113:         count++;
   114:       if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(i) == ITEM_CONTAINER)
   115:         count += item_in_list(item, i->contains);
   116:     }
   117:   }
   118:   return count;
   119: }

   121: /* BOOLEAN return, just check if a player or mob has an item of any sort,
   122:  * searched for by name or id. Searching equipment as well as inventory, and
   123:  * containers. Jamie Nelson */
   124: int char_has_item(char *item, struct char_data *ch)
   125: {
   126: 
   127:   /* If this works, no more searching needed */
   128:   if (get_object_in_equip(ch, item) != NULL)
   129:     return 1;
   130: 
   131:   if (item_in_list(item, ch->carrying) == 0)
   132:     return 0;
   133:   else
   134:     return 1;
   135: }
   136: 
   137: static int handle_oset(struct obj_data * obj, char * argument)
   138: {
   139:   int i = 0;
   140:   bool found = FALSE;
   141:   char value[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   142:   
   143:   struct oset_handler {
   144:     const char * type;
   145:     bool (* name)(struct obj_data *, char *);
   146:   } handler[] = {
   147:     { "alias",     oset_alias },
   148:     { "apply",     oset_apply },
   149:     { "longdesc",  oset_long_description },
   150:     { "shortdesc", oset_short_description},
   151:     { "\n", NULL }
   152:   };
   153:   
   154:   if (!obj || !*argument)
   155:     return 0;
   156:   
   157:   argument = one_argument(argument, value);
   158:   
   159:   while (*handler[i].type != '\n') {
   160:     if (is_abbrev(value, handler[i].type)) {
   161:       found = TRUE;
   162:       break;
   163:     }
   164:     i++;
   165:   } 
   166:   
   167:   if (!found)
   168:     return 0;
   169:     
   170:   handler[i].name(obj, argument);  
   171:   return 1;
   172: }

   174: int text_processed(char *field, char *subfield, struct trig_var_data *vd,
   175:                    char *str, size_t slen)
   176: {
   177:   char *p, *p2;
   178:   char tmpvar[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   179: 
   180:   if (!str_cmp(field, "strlen")) {                     /* strlen    */
   181:     snprintf(str, slen, "%d", (int)strlen(vd->value));
   182:     return TRUE;
   183:   } else if (!str_cmp(field, "toupper")) {             /* toupper   */
   184:     char *upper = vd->value;
   185:     if (*upper)
   186:       snprintf(str, slen, "%c%s", UPPER(*upper), upper + 1);
   187:     return TRUE;
   188:   } else if (!str_cmp(field, "trim")) {                /* trim      */
   189:     /* trim whitespace from ends */
   190:     snprintf(tmpvar, sizeof(tmpvar)-1 , "%s", vd->value); /* -1 to use later*/
   191:     p = tmpvar;
   192:     p2 = tmpvar + strlen(tmpvar) - 1;
   193:     while (*p && isspace(*p)) p++;
   194:     while ((p<=p2) && isspace(*p2)) p2--;
   195:     if (p>p2) { /* nothing left */
   196:       *str = '\0';
   197:       return TRUE;
   198:     }
   199:     *(++p2) = '\0';                                         /* +1 ok (see above) */
   200:     snprintf(str, slen, "%s", p);
   201:     return TRUE;
   202:   } else if (!str_cmp(field, "contains")) {            /* contains  */
   203:     if (str_str(vd->value, subfield))
   204:       strcpy(str, "1");
   205:     else
   206:       strcpy(str, "0");
   207:     return TRUE;
   208:   } else if (!str_cmp(field, "car")) {                 /* car       */
   209:     char *car = vd->value;
   210:     while (*car && !isspace(*car))
   211:       *str++ = *car++;
   212:     *str = '\0';
   213:     return TRUE;
   214: 
   215:   } else if (!str_cmp(field, "cdr")) {                 /* cdr       */
   216:     char *cdr = vd->value;
   217:     while (*cdr && !isspace(*cdr)) cdr++; /* skip 1st field */
   218:     while (*cdr && isspace(*cdr)) cdr++;  /* skip to next */
   219: 
   220:     snprintf(str, slen, "%s", cdr);
   221:     return TRUE;
   222:   } else if (!str_cmp(field, "charat")) {              /* CharAt    */
   223:     size_t len = strlen(vd->value), cindex = atoi(subfield);
   224:     if (cindex > len || cindex < 1)
   225:       strcpy(str, "");
   226:     else
   227:       snprintf(str, slen, "%c", vd->value[cindex - 1]);
   228:     return TRUE;
   229:   } else if (!str_cmp(field, "mudcommand")) {
   230:     /* find the mud command returned from this text */
   231: /* NOTE: you may need to replace "cmd_info" with "complete_cmd_info", */
   232: /* depending on what patches you've got applied.                      */
   233: /* on older source bases:    extern struct command_info *cmd_info; */
   234:     int length, cmd;
   235:     for (length = strlen(vd->value), cmd = 0;
   236:          *cmd_info[cmd].command != '\n'; cmd++)
   237:       if (!strncmp(cmd_info[cmd].command, vd->value, length))
   238:         break;
   239: 
   240:     if (*cmd_info[cmd].command == '\n')
   241:       *str = '\0';
   242:     else
   243:       snprintf(str, slen, "%s", cmd_info[cmd].command);
   244:     return TRUE;
   245:   }
   246: 
   247:   return FALSE;
   248: }

   250: /* sets str to be the value of var.field */
   251: void find_replacement(void *go, struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig,
   252:                 int type, char *var, char *field, char *subfield, char *str, size_t slen)
   253: {
   254:   struct trig_var_data *vd=NULL;
   255:   char_data *ch, *c = NULL, *rndm;
   256:   obj_data *obj, *o = NULL;
   257:   struct room_data *room, *r = NULL;
   258:   char *name;
   259:   int num, count, i, j, doors;
   260: 
   261:   char *log_cmd[]        = {"mlog ",        "olog ",        "wlog "       };
   262:   char *send_cmd[]       = {"msend ",       "osend ",       "wsend "      };
   263:   char *echo_cmd[]       = {"mecho ",       "oecho ",       "wecho "      };
   264:   char *echoaround_cmd[] = {"mechoaround ", "oechoaround ", "wechoaround "};
   265:   char *door[]           = {"mdoor ",       "odoor ",       "wdoor "      };
   266:   char *force[]          = {"mforce ",      "oforce ",      "wforce "     };
   267:   char *load[]           = {"mload ",       "oload ",       "wload "      };
   268:   char *purge[]          = {"mpurge ",      "opurge ",      "wpurge "     };
   269:   char *teleport[]       = {"mteleport ",   "oteleport ",   "wteleport "  };
   270:   /* the x kills a 'shadow' warning in gcc. */
   271:   char *xdamage[]        = {"mdamage ",     "odamage ",     "wdamage "    };
   272:   char *zoneecho[]       = {"mzoneecho ",   "ozoneecho ",   "wzoneecho "  };
   273:   char *asound[]         = {"masound ",     "oasound ",     "wasound "    };
   274:   char *at[]             = {"mat ",         "oat ",         "wat "        };
   275:   /* there is no such thing as wtransform, thus the wecho below  */
   276:   char *transform[]      = {"mtransform ",  "otransform ",  "wecho "      };
   277:   char *recho[]          = {"mrecho ",      "orecho ",      "wrecho "     };
   278:   /* there is no such thing as mmove, thus the mecho below  */
   279:   char *omove[]          = {"mecho ",      "omove ",      "wmove "     };
   280: 
   281:   *str = '\0';
   282: 
   283:   /* X.global() will have a NULL trig */
   284:   if (trig)
   285:     for (vd = GET_TRIG_VARS(trig); vd; vd = vd->next)
   286:       if (!str_cmp(vd->name, var))
   287:         break;
   288: 
   289:   /* some evil waitstates could crash the mud if sent here with sc==NULL*/
   290:   if (!vd && sc)
   291:     for (vd = sc->global_vars; vd; vd = vd->next)
   292:       if (!str_cmp(vd->name, var) &&
   293:           (vd->context==0 || vd->context==sc->context))
   294:         break;
   295: 
   296:   if (!*field) {
   297:     if (vd)
   298:       snprintf(str, slen, "%s", vd->value);
   299:     else {
   300:       if (!str_cmp(var, "self")) {
   301:         switch (type) {
   302:         case MOB_TRIGGER:
   303:           snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, char_script_id((char_data *) go));
   304:           break;
   305:         case OBJ_TRIGGER:
   306:           snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, obj_script_id((obj_data *) go));
   307:           break;
   308:         case WLD_TRIGGER:
   309:           snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, room_script_id((room_data *)go));
   310:           break;
   311:         }
   312:       }
   313:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "global")) {
   314:         /* so "remote varname %global%" will work */
   315:         snprintf(str, slen, "%d", ROOM_ID_BASE);
   316:         return;
   317:       }
   318:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "door"))
   319:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", door[type]);
   320:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "force"))
   321:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", force[type]);
   322:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "load"))
   323:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", load[type]);
   324:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "purge"))
   325:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", purge[type]);
   326:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "teleport"))
   327:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", teleport[type]);
   328:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "damage"))
   329:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", xdamage[type]);
   330:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "send"))
   331:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", send_cmd[type]);
   332:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "echo"))
   333:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", echo_cmd[type]);
   334:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "echoaround"))
   335:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", echoaround_cmd[type]);
   336:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "zoneecho"))
   337:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", zoneecho[type]);
   338:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "asound"))
   339:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", asound[type]);
   340:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "at"))
   341:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", at[type]);
   342:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "transform"))
   343:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", transform[type]);
   344:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "recho"))
   345:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", recho[type]);
   346:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "move"))
   347:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", omove[type]);
   348:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "log"))
   349:         snprintf(str, slen, "%s", log_cmd[type]);
   350:       else
   351:         *str = '\0';
   352:     }
   353: 
   354:     return;
   355:   }
   356: 
   357:   else if (vd && text_processed(field, subfield, vd, str, slen)) return;
   358: 
   359:   else {
   360:     if (vd) {
   361:       name = vd->value;
   362: 
   363:       switch (type) {
   364:       case MOB_TRIGGER:
   365:         ch = (char_data *) go;
   366: 
   367:         if ((o = get_object_in_equip(ch, name)));
   368:         else if ((o = get_obj_in_list(name, ch->carrying)));
   369:         else if (IN_ROOM(ch) != NOWHERE && (c = get_char_in_room(&world[IN_ROOM(ch)], name)));
   370:         else if ((o = get_obj_in_list(name,world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents)));
   371:         else if ((c = get_char(name)));
   372:         else if ((o = get_obj(name)));
   373:         else if ((r = get_room(name))) {}
   374: 
   375:         break;
   376:       case OBJ_TRIGGER:
   377:         obj = (obj_data *) go;
   378: 
   379:         if ((c = get_char_by_obj(obj, name)));
   380:         else if ((o = get_obj_by_obj(obj, name)));
   381:         else if ((r = get_room(name))) {}
   382: 
   383:         break;
   384:       case WLD_TRIGGER:
   385:         room = (struct room_data *) go;
   386: 
   387:         if ((c = get_char_by_room(room, name)));
   388:         else if ((o = get_obj_by_room(room, name)));
   389:         else if ((r = get_room(name))) {}
   390: 
   391:         break;
   392:       }
   393:     }
   394: 
   395:     else {
   396:       if (!str_cmp(var, "self")) {
   397:         switch (type) {
   398:         case MOB_TRIGGER:
   399:           c = (char_data *) go;
   400:           r = NULL;
   401:           o = NULL;  /* NULL assignments added to avoid self to always be    */
   402:           break;     /* the room.  - Welcor        */
   403:         case OBJ_TRIGGER:
   404:           o = (obj_data *) go;
   405:           c = NULL;
   406:           r = NULL;
   407:           break;
   408:         case WLD_TRIGGER:
   409:           r = (struct room_data *) go;
   410:           c = NULL;
   411:           o = NULL;
   412:           break;
   413:         }
   414:       }
   415: 
   416:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "global")) {
   417:         struct script_data *thescript = SCRIPT(&world[0]);
   418:         *str = '\0';
   419:         if (!thescript) {
   420:           script_log("Attempt to find global var. Apparently the void has no script.");
   421:           return;
   422:         }
   423:         for (vd = thescript->global_vars; vd ; vd = vd->next)
   424:           if (!str_cmp(vd->name, field))
   425:             break;
   426: 
   427:         if (vd)
   428:           snprintf(str, slen, "%s", vd->value);
   429: 
   430:         return;
   431:       }
   432:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "people")) {
   433:         snprintf(str, slen, "%d",((num = atoi(field)) > 0) ? trgvar_in_room(num) : 0);
   434:         return;
   435:       }
   436:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "happyhour")) {
   437:         if (!str_cmp(field, "qp") && IS_HAPPYHOUR)
   438:           snprintf(str, slen, "%d", HAPPY_QP);
   439:         else if (!str_cmp(field, "exp") && IS_HAPPYHOUR)
   440:           snprintf(str, slen, "%d", HAPPY_EXP);
   441:         else if (!str_cmp(field, "gold") && IS_HAPPYHOUR)
   442:           snprintf(str, slen, "%d", HAPPY_GOLD);
   443:         else snprintf(str, slen, "%d", HAPPY_TIME);
   444:         return;
   445:       }
   446:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "time")) {
   447:         if (!str_cmp(field, "hour"))
   448:           snprintf(str, slen, "%d", time_info.hours);
   449:         else if (!str_cmp(field, "day"))
   450:           snprintf(str, slen, "%d", time_info.day + 1);
   451:         else if (!str_cmp(field, "month"))
   452:           snprintf(str, slen, "%d", time_info.month + 1);
   453:         else if (!str_cmp(field, "year"))
   454:           snprintf(str, slen, "%d", time_info.year);
   455:         else *str = '\0';
   456:         return;
   457:       }
   458: /* %findobj.<room vnum X>(<object vnum/id/name>)%
   459:  *  - count number of objects in room X with this name/id/vnum
   460:  * %findmob.<room vnum X>(<mob vnum Y>)%
   461:  *  - count number of mobs in room X with vnum Y
   462:  * For example you want to check how many PC's are in room with vnum 1204. PC's
   463:  * have the vnum -1 so: %echo% players in room 1204: %findmob.1204(-1)%
   464:  * Or say you had a bank, and you want a script to check the number of bags of
   465:  * gold (vnum: 1234). In the vault (vnum: 453). Use: %findobj.453(1234)% and it
   466:  * will return the number of bags of gold.
   467:  * Addition inspired by Jamie Nelson */
   468:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "findmob")) {
   469:         if (!field || !*field || !subfield || !*subfield) {
   470:           script_log("findmob.vnum(mvnum) - illegal syntax");
   471:           strcpy(str, "0");
   472:         } else {
   473:           room_rnum rrnum = real_room(atoi(field));
   474:           mob_vnum mvnum = atoi(subfield);
   475: 
   476:           if (rrnum == NOWHERE) {
   477:             script_log("findmob.vnum(ovnum): No room with vnum %d", atoi(field));
   478:             strcpy(str, "0");
   479:           } else {
   480:             for (i = 0, ch = world[rrnum].people; ch; ch = ch->next_in_room)
   481:               if (GET_MOB_VNUM(ch) == mvnum)
   482:                 i++;
   483: 
   484:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", i);
   485:           }
   486:         }
   487:       }
   488:       /* Addition inspired by Jamie Nelson. */
   489:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "findobj")) {
   490:         if (!field || !*field || !subfield || !*subfield) {
   491:           script_log("findobj.vnum(ovnum) - illegal syntax");
   492:           strcpy(str, "0");
   493:         } else {
   494:           room_rnum rrnum = real_room(atoi(field));
   495: 
   496:           if (rrnum == NOWHERE) {
   497:             script_log("findobj.vnum(ovnum): No room with vnum %d", atoi(field));
   498:             strcpy(str, "0");
   499:           } else {
   500:             /* item_in_list looks within containers as well. */
   501:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", item_in_list(subfield, world[rrnum].contents));
   502:           }
   503:         }
   504:       }
   505:       else if (!str_cmp(var, "random")) {
   506:         if (!str_cmp(field, "char")) {
   507:           rndm = NULL;
   508:           count = 0;
   509: 
   510:           if (type == MOB_TRIGGER) {
   511:             ch = (char_data *) go;
   512:             for (c = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; c; c = c->next_in_room)
   513:               if ((c != ch) && valid_dg_target(c, DG_ALLOW_GODS) &&
   514:                   CAN_SEE(ch, c)) {
   515:                 if (!rand_number(0, count))
   516:                   rndm = c;
   517:                 count++;
   518:               }
   519:           }
   520: 
   521:           else if (type == OBJ_TRIGGER) {
   522:             for (c = world[obj_room((obj_data *) go)].people; c;
   523:                  c = c->next_in_room)
   524:               if (valid_dg_target(c, DG_ALLOW_GODS)) {
   525:                 if (!rand_number(0, count))
   526:                   rndm = c;
   527:                 count++;
   528:               }
   529:           }
   530: 
   531:           else if (type == WLD_TRIGGER) {
   532:             for (c = ((struct room_data *) go)->people; c;
   533:                  c = c->next_in_room)
   534:               if (valid_dg_target(c, DG_ALLOW_GODS)) {
   535: 
   536:                 if (!rand_number(0, count))
   537:                   rndm = c;
   538:                 count++;
   539:               }
   540:           }
   541: 
   542:           if (rndm)
   543:             snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, char_script_id(rndm));
   544:           else
   545:             *str = '\0';
   546:         }
   547: 
   548:         else if (!str_cmp(field, "dir")) {
   549:           room_rnum in_room = NOWHERE;
   550: 
   551:           switch (type) {
   552:             case WLD_TRIGGER:
   553:               in_room = real_room(((struct room_data *) go)->number);
   554:               break;
   555:             case OBJ_TRIGGER:
   556:               in_room = obj_room((struct obj_data *) go);
   557:               break;
   558:             case MOB_TRIGGER:
   559:               in_room = IN_ROOM((struct char_data *)go);
   560:               break;
   561:           }
   562:           if (in_room == NOWHERE) {
   563:             *str = '\0';
   564:           } else {
   565:             doors = 0;
   566:             room = &world[in_room];
   567:             for (i = 0; i < DIR_COUNT; i++)
   568:               if (R_EXIT(room, i))
   569:                 doors++;
   570: 
   571:             if (!doors) {
   572:               *str = '\0';
   573:             } else {
   574:               for ( ; ; ) {
   575:                 doors = rand_number(0, DIR_COUNT-1);
   576:                 if (R_EXIT(room, doors))
   577:                   break;
   578:               }
   579:               snprintf(str, slen, "%s", dirs[doors]);
   580:             }
   581:           }
   582:         }
   583:         else
   584:           snprintf(str, slen, "%d", ((num = atoi(field)) > 0) ? rand_number(1, num) : 0);
   585: 
   586:         return;
   587:       }
   588:     }
   589: 
   590:     if (c) {
   591:       if (!str_cmp(field, "global")) { /* get global of something else */
   592:         if (IS_NPC(c) && c->script) {
   593:           find_replacement(go, c->script, NULL, MOB_TRIGGER,
   594:             subfield, NULL, NULL, str, slen);
   595:         }
   596:       }
   597:       /* set str to some 'non-text' first */
   598:       *str = '\x1';
   599: 
   600:       switch (LOWER(*field)) {
   601:         case 'a':
   602:           if (!str_cmp(field, "affect")) {
   603:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   604:               int spell = find_skill_num(subfield);
   605:               if (affected_by_spell(c, spell))
   606:                 strcpy(str, "1");
   607:               else
   608:                 strcpy(str, "0");
   609:             } else
   610:               strcpy(str, "0");
   611:           }
   612:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "alias"))
   613:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", GET_PC_NAME(c));
   614: 
   615:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "align")) {
   616:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   617:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   618:              GET_ALIGNMENT(c) = MAX(-1000, MIN(addition, 1000));
   619:             }
   620: 	    snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_ALIGNMENT(c));
   621:           }
   622:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "armor"))
   623:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", compute_armor_class(c));
   624:           break;
   625:         case 'c':
   626:           if (!str_cmp(field, "canbeseen")) {
   627:             if ((type == MOB_TRIGGER) && !CAN_SEE(((char_data *)go), c))
   628:               strcpy(str, "0");
   629:             else
   630:               strcpy(str, "1");
   631:           }
   632:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "cha")) {
   633:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   634:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   635:               c->real_abils.cha += addition;
   636:               clamp_base_stats(c);
   637:               affect_total(c);
   638:             }
   639:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_CHA(c));
   640:           }
   641:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "class")) {
   642:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   643:               int cl = get_class_by_name(subfield);
   644:               if (cl != -1) {
   645:                 GET_CLASS(c) = cl;
   646:                 snprintf(str, slen, "1");
   647:               } else {
   648:                 snprintf(str, slen, "0");
   649:               }
   650:             } else
   651:               sprinttype(GET_CLASS(c), pc_class_types, str, slen);
   652:           }
   653:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "con")) {
   654:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   655:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   656:               c->real_abils.con += addition;
   657:               clamp_base_stats(c);
   658:               affect_total(c);
   659:             }
   660:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_CON(c));
   661:           }
   662:           break;
   663:         case 'd':
   664:           if (!str_cmp(field, "damroll")) {
   665:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   666:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   667:               GET_DAMROLL(c) = MAX(1, GET_DAMROLL(c) + addition);
   668:             }
   669:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_DAMROLL(c));
   670:             } else if (!str_cmp(field, "dex")) {
   671:               if (subfield && *subfield) {
   672:                 int addition = atoi(subfield);
   673:                 c->real_abils.dex += addition;
   674:                 clamp_base_stats(c);
   675:                 affect_total(c);
   676:               }
   677:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_DEX(c));
   678:           }
   679:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "drunk")) {
   680:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   681:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   682:               GET_COND(c, DRUNK) = MAX(-1, MIN(addition, 24));
   683:             }
   684:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_COND(c, DRUNK));
   685:           }
   686:           break;
   687:         case 'e':
   688:           if (!str_cmp(field, "eq")) {
   689:             int pos;
   690:             if (!subfield || !*subfield)
   691:               *str = '\0';
   692:             else if (*subfield == '*') {
   693:               for (i = 0, j = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
   694:                 if (GET_EQ(c, i)) {
   695:                   j++;
   696:                   break;
   697:                 }
   698:               if (j > 0)
   699:                 strcpy(str,"1");
   700:               else
   701:                 *str = '\0';
   702:             } else if ((pos = find_eq_pos_script(subfield)) < 0 || !GET_EQ(c, pos))
   703:               *str = '\0';
   704:             else
   705:               snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld",UID_CHAR, obj_script_id(GET_EQ(c, pos)));
   706:           }
   707:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "exp")) {
   708:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   709:               int addition = MIN(atoi(subfield), 1000);
   710: 
   711:               gain_exp(c, addition);
   712:             }
   713:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_EXP(c));
   714:           }
   715:           break;
   716:         case 'f':
   717:           if (!str_cmp(field, "fighting")) {
   718:             if (FIGHTING(c))
   719:               snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, char_script_id(FIGHTING(c)));
   720:             else
   721:               *str = '\0';
   722:           }
   723:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "follower")) {
   724:             if (!c->followers || !c->followers->follower)
   725:               *str = '\0';
   726:             else
   727:               snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, char_script_id(c->followers->follower));
   728:           }
   729:           break;
   730:         case 'g':
   731:           if (!str_cmp(field, "gold")) {
   732:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   733:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   734:               increase_gold(c, addition);
   735:             }
   736:             snprintf(str, slen, "%lld", ((long long)GET_GOLD(c)));
   737:           }
   738:           break;
   739:         case 'h':
   740:           if (!str_cmp(field, "has_item")) {
   741:             if (!(subfield && *subfield))
   742:               *str = '\0';
   743:             else
   744:               snprintf(str, slen, "%d", char_has_item(subfield, c));
   745:           }
   746:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "hasattached")) {
   747:             if (!(subfield && *subfield) || !IS_NPC(c))
   748:               *str = '\0';
   749:             else {
   750:               i = atoi(subfield);
   751:               snprintf(str, slen, "%d", trig_is_attached(SCRIPT(c), i));
   752:             }
   753:           }
   754:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "heshe"))
   755:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", HSSH(c));
   756:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "himher"))
   757:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", HMHR(c));
   758:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "hisher"))
   759:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", HSHR(c));
   760:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "hitp")) {
   761:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   762:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   763:               GET_HIT(c) += addition;
   764:               update_pos(c);
   765:             }
   766:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_HIT(c));
   767:           }
   768:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "hitroll")) {
   769:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   770:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   771:               GET_HITROLL(c) = MAX(1, GET_HITROLL(c) + addition);
   772:             }
   773:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_HITROLL(c));
   774:           }
   775:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "hunger")) {
   776:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   777:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   778:               GET_COND(c, HUNGER) = MAX(-1, MIN(addition, 24));
   779:             }
   780:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_COND(c, HUNGER));
   781:           }
   782:           break;
   783:         case 'i':
   784:           if (!str_cmp(field, "id"))
   785:             snprintf(str, slen, "%ld", char_script_id(c));
   786:           /* new check for pc/npc status */
   787:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "is_pc")) {
   788:             if (IS_NPC(c))
   789:               strcpy(str, "0");
   790:             else
   791:               strcpy(str, "1");
   792:           }
   793:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "int")) {
   794:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   795:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   796:               c->real_abils.intel += addition;
   797:               clamp_base_stats(c);
   798:               affect_total(c);
   799:             }
   800:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_INT(c));
   801:           }
   802:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "inventory")) {
   803:             if(subfield && *subfield) {
   804:               for (obj = c->carrying;obj;obj=obj->next_content) {
   805:                 if(GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj)==atoi(subfield)) {
   806:                   snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, obj_script_id(obj)); /* arg given, found */
   807:                   return;
   808:                 }
   809:               }
   810:               if (!obj)
   811:                 *str = '\0'; /* arg given, not found */
   812:             } else { /* no arg given */
   813:               if (c->carrying) {
   814:                 snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, obj_script_id(c->carrying));
   815:               } else {
   816:                 *str = '\0';
   817:               }
   818:             }
   819:           }
   820:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "is_killer")) {
   821:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   822:               if (!str_cmp("on", subfield))
   823:                 SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(c), PLR_KILLER);
   824:               else if (!str_cmp("off", subfield))
   825:                 REMOVE_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(c), PLR_KILLER);
   826:             }
   827:             if (PLR_FLAGGED(c, PLR_KILLER))
   828:               strcpy(str, "1");
   829:             else
   830:               strcpy(str, "0");
   831:           }
   832:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "is_thief")) {
   833:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   834:               if (!str_cmp("on", subfield))
   835:                 SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(c), PLR_THIEF);
   836:               else if (!str_cmp("off", subfield))
   837:                 REMOVE_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(c), PLR_THIEF);
   838:             }
   839:             if (PLR_FLAGGED(c, PLR_THIEF))
   840:               strcpy(str, "1");
   841:             else
   842:               strcpy(str, "0");
   843:           }
   844:           break;
   845:         case 'l':
   846:           if (!str_cmp(field, "level")) {
   847:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   848:               int lev = atoi(subfield);
   849:               GET_LEVEL(c) = MIN(MAX(lev, 0), LVL_IMMORT-1);
   850:             } else
   851:               snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_LEVEL(c));
   852:           }
   853:           break;
   854:         case 'm':
   855:           if (!str_cmp(field, "mana")) {
   856:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   857:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   858:               GET_MANA(c) += addition;
   859:             }
   860:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_MANA(c));
   861:           }
   862:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "master")) {
   863:             if (!c->master)
   864:               *str = '\0';
   865:             else
   866:               snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, char_script_id(c->master));
   867:           }
   868:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "maxhitp")) {
   869:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   870:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   871:               GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(c) = MAX(GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(c) + addition, 1);
   872:               affect_total(c);
   873:             }
   874:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_MAX_HIT(c));
   875:           }
   876:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "maxmana")) {
   877:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   878:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   879:               GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(c) = MAX(GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(c) + addition, 1);
   880:               affect_total(c);
   881:             }
   882:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_MAX_MANA(c));
   883:           }
   884:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "maxmove")) {
   885:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   886:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   887:               GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(c) = MAX(GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(c) + addition, 1);
   888:               affect_total(c);
   889:             }
   890:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_MAX_MOVE(c));
   891:           }
   892:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "move")) {
   893:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   894:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   895:               GET_MOVE(c) += addition;
   896:             }
   897:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_MOVE(c));
   898:           }
   899:           break;
   900:         case 'n':
   901:           if (!str_cmp(field, "name"))
   902:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", GET_NAME(c));
   903: 
   904:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "next_in_room")) {
   905:             if (c->next_in_room)
   906:               snprintf(str, slen,"%c%ld",UID_CHAR, char_script_id(c->next_in_room));
   907:             else
   908:               *str = '\0';
   909:           }
   910:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "npcflag")) {
   911:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   912:                char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   913:                sprintbitarray(MOB_FLAGS(c), action_bits, PM_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   914:                 if (str_str(buf, subfield))
   915:                   snprintf(str, slen, "1");
   916:                 else
   917:                   snprintf(str, slen, "0");
   918:               }
   919:               else {
   920:                 snprintf(str, slen, "0");
   921:               }
   922:             }
   923:           break;
   924:         case 'p':
   925:           /* Thanks to Christian Ejlertsen for this idea
   926:              And to Ken Ray for speeding the implementation up :)*/
   927:           if (!str_cmp(field, "pos")) {
   928:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   929:               for (i = POS_SLEEPING; i <= POS_STANDING; i++) {
   930:                 /* allows : Sleeping, Resting, Sitting, Fighting, Standing */
   931:                 if (!strn_cmp(subfield, position_types[i], strlen(subfield))) {
   932:                   GET_POS(c) = i;
   933:                   break;
   934:                 }
   935:               }
   936:             }
   937:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", position_types[GET_POS(c)]);
   938:           }
   939:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "prac")) {
   940:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   941:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   942:               GET_PRACTICES(c) = MAX(0, GET_PRACTICES(c) + addition);
   943:             }
   944:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_PRACTICES(c));
   945:           }
   946:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "pref")) {
   947:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   948:               int pref = get_flag_by_name(preference_bits, subfield);
   949:               if (!IS_NPC(c) && pref != NOFLAG && PRF_FLAGGED(c, pref))
   950:                 strcpy(str, "1");
   951:               else
   952:                 strcpy(str, "0");
   953:             } else
   954:               strcpy(str, "0");
   955:           }
   956:           break;
   957:         case 'q':
   958:           if (!IS_NPC(c) && (!str_cmp(field, "questpoints") ||
   959:               !str_cmp(field, "qp") || !str_cmp(field, "qpnts")))
   960:           {
   961:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
   962:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
   963:               GET_QUESTPOINTS(c) += addition;
   964:             }
   965:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_QUESTPOINTS(c));
   966:           }
   967:            else if (!str_cmp(field, "quest"))
   968:            {
   969:                if (!IS_NPC(c) && (GET_QUEST(c) != NOTHING) && (real_quest(GET_QUEST(c)) != NOTHING))
   970:                  snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_QUEST(c));
   971:                else
   972:                  strcpy(str, "0");
   973:              }
   974:            else if (!str_cmp(field, "questdone"))
   975:            {
   976:                if (!IS_NPC(c) && subfield && *subfield) {

   978:                  if (is_complete(c, q_num))
   979:                    strcpy(str, "1");
   980:                  else
   981:                    strcpy(str, "0");
   982:                }
   983:                else
   984:                  strcpy(str, "0");
   985:              }

   987:         case 'r':
   988:           if (!str_cmp(field, "room")) {  /* in NOWHERE, return the void */
   989: /* see note in dg_scripts.h */
   990: #ifdef ACTOR_ROOM_IS_UID
   991:             snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld",UID_CHAR,
   992:                (IN_ROOM(c)!= NOWHERE) ? room_script_id(world + IN_ROOM(c)) : ROOM_ID_BASE);

   994:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", (IN_ROOM(c)!= NOWHERE) ? world[IN_ROOM(c)].number : 0);
   995: #endif
   996:           }
   997:           break;
   998:         case 's':
   999:           if (!str_cmp(field, "saving_breath")) {
  1000:             if (subfield && *subfield) {

  1002:               GET_SAVE(c, SAVING_BREATH) += addition;
  1003:             }
  1004:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_SAVE(c, SAVING_BREATH));

  1006:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "saving_para")) {

  1009:               GET_SAVE(c, SAVING_PARA) += addition;
  1010:             }
  1011:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_SAVE(c, SAVING_PARA));
  1012:           }
  1013:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "saving_petri")) {
  1014:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
  1015:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
  1016:               GET_SAVE(c, SAVING_PETRI) += addition;
  1017:             }

  1019:           }
  1020:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "saving_rod")) {
  1021:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
  1022:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
  1023:               GET_SAVE(c, SAVING_ROD) += addition;
  1024:             }
  1025:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_SAVE(c, SAVING_ROD));
  1026:           }
  1027:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "saving_spell")) {
  1028:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
  1029:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
  1030:               GET_SAVE(c, SAVING_SPELL) += addition;
  1031:             }
  1032:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_SAVE(c, SAVING_SPELL));
  1033:           }
  1034:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "sex"))
  1035:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", genders[(int)GET_SEX(c)]);
  1036:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "skill"))
  1037:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", skill_percent(c, subfield));
  1038:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "skillset")) {
  1039:             if (!IS_NPC(c) && subfield && *subfield) {
  1040:               char skillname[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], *amount;
  1041:               amount = one_word(subfield, skillname);
  1042:               skip_spaces(&amount);
  1043:               if (amount && *amount && is_number(amount)) {
  1044:                 int skillnum = find_skill_num(skillname);
  1045:                 if (skillnum > 0) {
  1046:                   int new_value = MAX(0, MIN(100, atoi(amount)));
  1047:                   SET_SKILL(c, skillnum, new_value);
  1048:                 }
  1049:               }
  1050:             }
  1051:             *str = '\0'; /* so the parser know we recognize 'skillset' as a field */
  1052:           }
  1053:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "str")) {

  1057:               clamp_base_stats(c);
  1058:               affect_total(c);

  1060:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_STR(c));
  1061:           }
  1062:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "stradd")) {
  1063:             if (GET_STR(c) >= 18) {
  1064:               if (subfield && *subfield) {
  1065:                 int addition = atoi(subfield);
  1066:                 c->real_abils.str_add += addition;
  1067:                 if (c->real_abils.str_add > 100) c->real_abils.str_add = 100;
  1068:                 if (c->real_abils.str_add < 0) c->real_abils.str_add = 0;
  1069:                 affect_total(c);
  1070:               }
  1071:               snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_ADD(c));

  1073:           }
  1074:           break;
  1075:         case 't':
  1076:           if (!str_cmp(field, "thirst")) {
  1077:             if (subfield && *subfield) {
  1078:               int addition = atoi(subfield);
  1079:               GET_COND(c, THIRST) = MAX(-1, MIN(addition, 24));
  1080:             }
  1081:             snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_COND(c, THIRST));
  1082:           }
  1083:           else if (!str_cmp(field, "title")) {
  1084:             if (!IS_NPC(c) && subfield && *subfield && valid_dg_target(c, DG_ALLOW_GODS)) {
  1085:               if (GET_TITLE(c)) free(GET_TITLE(c));
  1086:                 GET_TITLE(c) = strdup(subfield);
  1087:             }
  1088:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", IS_NPC(c) ? "" : GET_TITLE(c));
