  1561:                 snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, room_script_id(world + R_EXIT(r, UP)->to_room));
  1562:               else
  1563:                 *str = '\0';
  1564:             }
  1565:           } else /* no subfield - default to bits */
  1566:             sprintbit(R_EXIT(r, UP)->exit_info ,exit_bits, str, slen);
  1567:         } else
  1568:           *str = '\0';
  1569:       }
  1570:       else if (!str_cmp(field, "down")) {
  1571:         if (R_EXIT(r, DOWN)) {
  1572:           if (subfield && *subfield) {
  1573:             if (!str_cmp(subfield, "vnum"))
  1574:               snprintf(str, slen, "%d", GET_ROOM_VNUM(R_EXIT(r, DOWN)->to_room));
  1575:             else if (!str_cmp(subfield, "key"))
  1576:               snprintf(str, slen, "%d", R_EXIT(r, DOWN)->key);
  1577:             else if (!str_cmp(subfield, "bits"))
  1578:               sprintbit(R_EXIT(r, DOWN)->exit_info ,exit_bits, str, slen);
  1579:             else if (!str_cmp(subfield, "room")) {
  1580:               if (R_EXIT(r, DOWN)->to_room != NOWHERE)
  1581:                 snprintf(str, slen, "%c%ld", UID_CHAR, room_script_id(world + R_EXIT(r, DOWN)->to_room));
  1582:               else
  1583:                 *str = '\0';
  1584:             }
  1585:           } else /* no subfield - default to bits */
  1586:             sprintbit(R_EXIT(r, DOWN)->exit_info ,exit_bits, str, slen);
  1587:         } else
  1588:           *str = '\0';
  1589:       }
  1590:       else {
  1591:         if (SCRIPT(r)) { /* check for global var */
  1592:           for (vd = (SCRIPT(r))->global_vars; vd; vd = vd->next)
  1593:             if (!str_cmp(vd->name, field))
  1594:               break;
  1595:           if (vd)
  1596:             snprintf(str, slen, "%s", vd->value);
  1597:           else {
  1598:             *str = '\0';
  1599:             script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d, type: %d. unknown room field: '%s'",
  1600:                          GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), type, field);
  1601:           }
  1602:         } else {
  1603:           *str = '\0';
  1604:           script_log("Trigger: %s, VNum %d, type: %d. unknown room field: '%s'",
  1605:                      GET_TRIG_NAME(trig), GET_TRIG_VNUM(trig), type, field);
  1606:         }
  1607:       }
  1608:     } /* if (r).. */
  1609:   }
  1610: }
  1611: 
  1612: /* Now automatically checks if the variable has more then one field in it. And
  1613:  * if the field returns a name or a script UID or the like it can recurse. If
  1614:  * you supply a value like, %actor.int.str% it wont blow up on you either. Now
  1615:  * also lets subfields have variables parsed inside of them so that: %echo%
  1616:  * %actor.gold(%actor.gold%)% will double the actors gold every time its called.
  1617:  * - Jamie Nelson */
  1618: 
  1619: /* substitutes any variables into line and returns it as buf */
  1620: void var_subst(void *go, struct script_data *sc, trig_data *trig,
  1621:                int type, char *line, char *buf)
  1622: {
  1623:   char tmp[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], repl_str[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH - 20]; // - 20 to make room for "eval tmpvr "
  1624:   char *var = NULL, *field = NULL, *p = NULL;
  1625:   char tmp2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1626:   char *subfield_p, subfield[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1627:   int left, len;
  1628:   int paren_count = 0;
  1629:   int dots = 0;
  1630: 
  1631:   /* skip out if no %'s */
  1632:   if (!strchr(line, '%')) {
  1633:     strcpy(buf, line);
  1634:     return;
  1635:   }
  1636:   /*lets just empty these to start with*/
  1637:   *repl_str = *tmp = *tmp2 = '\0';
  1638: 
  1639:   p = strcpy(tmp, line);
  1640:   subfield_p = subfield;
  1641: 
  1642:   left = MAX_INPUT_LENGTH - 1;
  1643: 
  1644:   while (*p && (left > 0)) {
  1645: 
  1646: 
  1647:     /* copy until we find the first % */
  1648:     while (*p && (*p != '%') && (left > 0)) {
  1649:       *(buf++) = *(p++);
  1650:       left--;
  1651:     }
  1652: 
  1653:     *buf = '\0';
  1654: 
  1655:     /* double % */
  1656:     if (*p && (*(++p) == '%') && (left > 0)) {
  1657:       *(buf++) = *(p++);
  1658:       *buf = '\0';
  1659:       left--;
  1660:       continue;
  1661:     }
  1662: 
  1663:     /* so it wasn't double %'s */
  1664:     else if (*p && (left > 0)) {
  1665: 
  1666:       /* search until end of var or beginning of field */
  1667:       for (var = p; *p && (*p != '%') && (*p != '.'); p++);
  1668: 
  1669:       field = p;
  1670:       if (*p == '.') {
  1671:         *(p++) = '\0';
  1672:         dots = 0;
  1673:         for (field = p; *p && ((*p != '%')||(paren_count > 0) || (dots)); p++) {
  1674:           if (dots > 0) {
  1675:             *subfield_p = '\0';
  1676:             find_replacement(go, sc, trig, type, var, field, subfield, repl_str, sizeof(repl_str));
  1677:             if (*repl_str) {
  1678:               snprintf(tmp2, sizeof(tmp2), "eval tmpvr %s", repl_str); //temp var
  1679:               process_eval(go, sc, trig, type, tmp2);
  1680:               strcpy(var, "tmpvr");
  1681:               field = p;
  1682:               dots = 0;
  1683:               continue;
  1684:             }
  1685:             dots = 0;
  1686:           } else if (*p=='(') {
  1687:             *p = '\0';
  1688:             paren_count++;
  1689:           } else if (*p==')') {
  1690:             *p = '\0';
  1691:             paren_count--;
  1692:           } else if (paren_count > 0) {
  1693:             *subfield_p++ = *p;
  1694:           } else if (*p=='.') {
  1695:             *p = '\0';
  1696:             dots++;
  1697:           }
  1698:         } /* for (field.. */
  1699:       } /* if *p == '.' */
  1700: 
  1701:       *(p++) = '\0';
  1702:       *subfield_p = '\0';
  1703: 
  1704:       if (*subfield) {
  1705:         var_subst(go, sc, trig, type, subfield, tmp2);
  1706:         strcpy(subfield, tmp2);
  1707:       }
  1708: 
  1709:       find_replacement(go, sc, trig, type, var, field, subfield, repl_str, sizeof(repl_str));
  1710: 
  1711:       strncat(buf, repl_str, left);
  1712:       len = strlen(repl_str);
  1713:       buf += len;
  1714:       left -= len;
  1715:     } /* else if *p .. */
  1716:   } /* while *p .. */
  1717:   buf[sizeof(buf) - 1] = '\0';
  1718: }

   127: static int damage_severity_tier(int dam, struct char_data *victim)
   128: {
   129:   int pct;
   130: 
   131:   if (dam <= 0 || !victim)
   132:     return 0;
   133: 
   134:   pct = (dam * 100) / MAX(1, GET_MAX_HIT(victim));
   135: 
   136:   if (pct <= 4)        return 1;
   137:   else if (pct <= 9)   return 2;
   138:   else if (pct <= 19)  return 3;
   139:   else if (pct <= 29)  return 4;
   140:   else if (pct <= 44)  return 5;
   141:   else if (pct <= 59)  return 6;
   142:   else if (pct <= 74)  return 7;
   143:   else if (pct <= 89)  return 8;
   144:   else                 return 9;
   145: }

   177: static int is_shadow_servant_for(struct char_data *owner, struct char_data *mob)
   178: {
   179:   if (!owner || !mob || !IS_NPC(mob) || mob->master != owner)
   180:     return FALSE;
   181:   if (!AFF_FLAGGED(mob, AFF_CHARM) || GET_SUMMON_TIMER(mob) <= 0)
   182:     return FALSE;
   183:   return affected_by_spell(mob, SPELL_CALL_SHADOW_LEGION)
   184:       || affected_by_spell(mob, SPELL_SHADOW_EXTRACTION)
   185:       || affected_by_spell(mob, SPELL_ARISE_GREATER);
   186: }

   188: int is_owned_follower_target(struct char_data *attacker, struct char_data *victim)
   189: {
   190:   if (!attacker || !victim || attacker == victim || !IS_NPC(victim))
   191:     return FALSE;
   192: 
   193:   if (victim->master != attacker)
   194:     return FALSE;
   195: 
   196:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_CHARM))
   197:     return TRUE;
   198: 
   199:   if (GET_SUMMON_TIMER(victim) > 0)
   200:     return TRUE;
   201: 
   202:   if (is_shadow_servant_for(attacker, victim))
   203:     return TRUE;
   204: 
   205:   return FALSE;
   206: }

   208: static int count_shadow_servants_for(struct char_data *ch)
   209: {
   210:   struct follow_type *f;
   211:   int n = 0;
   212:   if (!ch)
   213:     return 0;
   214:   for (f = ch->followers; f; f = f->next)
   215:     if (is_shadow_servant_for(ch, f->follower))
   216:       n++;
   217:   return n;

   220: static int should_owned_follower_auto_assist(struct char_data *owner, struct char_data *follower)
   221: {
   222:   if (!owner || !follower || !IS_NPC(follower))
   223:     return FALSE;
   224:   if (follower->master != owner)
   225:     return FALSE;
   226:   if (IN_ROOM(follower) != IN_ROOM(owner))
   227:     return FALSE;
   228:   if (FIGHTING(follower))
   229:     return FALSE;
   230: 
   231:   /* Owned combat allies are charmed pets/summons and temporary summons. */
   232:   if (!AFF_FLAGGED(follower, AFF_CHARM) &&
   233:       GET_SUMMON_TIMER(follower) <= 0 &&
   234:       !is_shadow_servant_for(owner, follower))
   235:     return FALSE;
   236: 
   237:   /* Keep existing incapacity checks aligned with combat eligibility. */
   238:   if (GET_POS(follower) < POS_STANDING ||
   239:       AFF_FLAGGED(follower, AFF_STUNNED) ||
   240:       AFF_FLAGGED(follower, AFF_FEARFUL) ||
   241:       AFF_FLAGGED(follower, AFF_ROOTED))
   242:     return FALSE;
   243: 
   244:   if (!CAN_SEE(follower, owner))
   245:     return FALSE;
   246: 
   247:   return TRUE;
   248: }

   250: static void auto_assist_owned_followers(struct char_data *owner)
   251: {
   252:   struct follow_type *f;
   253:   int assist_fired = FALSE;
   254: 
   255:   if (!owner || !FIGHTING(owner))
   256:     return;
   257: 
   258:   /* Debug trace point: owner/follower eligibility for auto-assist is gated
   259:    * through should_owned_follower_auto_assist(). */
   260:   for (f = owner->followers; f; f = f->next) {
   261:     if (!should_owned_follower_auto_assist(owner, f->follower))
   262:       continue;
   263: 
   264:     /* Resolve target from the follower's current room via assist helper. */
   265:     do_assist(f->follower, GET_NAME(owner), 0, 0);
   266:     assist_fired = TRUE;
   267:   }
   268: 
   269:   if (assist_fired && CONFIG_DEBUG_MODE >= NRM && GET_LEVEL(owner) >= LVL_BUILDER) {
   270:     send_to_char(owner,
   271:       "\t1Combat Debug:\r\n"
   272:       "   \t2Summon Auto-aid:\t3fired\tn\r\n");
   273:   }
   274: }

   276: static int extracted_shadow_slot(struct char_data *mob)
   277: {
   278:   struct affected_type *af;
   279: 
   280:   if (!mob)
   281:     return -1;
   282: 
   283:   for (af = mob->affected; af; af = af->next) {
   284:     if (af->spell == SPELL_SHADOW_EXTRACTION && af->location == APPLY_NONE && af->modifier > 1)
   285:       return af->modifier - 2;
   286:   }
   287: 
   288:   return -1;
   289: }

   291: static void remove_follower_link_silently(struct char_data *master, struct char_data *follower)
   292: {
   293:   struct follow_type *node, *prev = NULL;
   294: 
   295:   if (!master || !follower)
   296:     return;
   297: 
   298:   for (node = master->followers; node; prev = node, node = node->next) {
   299:     if (node->follower != follower)
   300:       continue;
   301:     if (prev)
   302:       prev->next = node->next;
   303:     else
   304:       master->followers = node->next;
   305:     free(node);
   306:     break;
   307:   }
   308: }
   309: 
   310: static void prepare_shadow_servant_for_removal(struct char_data *mob)
   311: {
   312:   struct char_data *fighter, *next_fighter;
   313: 
   314:   if (!mob)
   315:     return;
   316: 
   317:   GET_SUMMON_TIMER(mob) = 0;
   318:   HUNTING(mob) = NULL;
   319: 
   320:   if (FIGHTING(mob))
   321:     stop_fighting(mob);
   322: 
   323:   for (fighter = combat_list; fighter; fighter = next_fighter) {
   324:     next_fighter = fighter->next_fighting;
   325:     if (FIGHTING(fighter) == mob)
   326:       stop_fighting(fighter);
   327:   }
   328: 
   329:   while (mob->followers) {
   330:     struct follow_type *next = mob->followers->next;
   331:     if (mob->followers->follower)
   332:       mob->followers->follower->master = NULL;
   333:     free(mob->followers);
   334:     mob->followers = next;
   335:   }
   336: 
   337:   if (mob->master) {
   338:     remove_follower_link_silently(mob->master, mob);
   339:     mob->master = NULL;
   340:   }
   341:   REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(mob), AFF_CHARM);
   342: }
   343: 
   344: static int return_extracted_shadow_to_storage(struct char_data *mob)
   345: {
   346:   struct char_data *owner;
   347:   int slot;
   348: 
   349:   if (!mob || !IS_NPC(mob))
   350:     return FALSE;
   351: 
   352:   owner = mob->master;
   353:   slot = extracted_shadow_slot(mob);
   354:   if (!owner || IS_NPC(owner) || slot < 0 || slot >= MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER)
   355:     return FALSE;
   356:   if (!SHADOW_SLOT_OCCUPIED(owner, slot))
   357:     return FALSE;
   358: 
   359:   SHADOW_SLOT_ACTIVE(owner, slot) = 0;
   360: 
   361:   if (IN_ROOM(mob) != NOWHERE)
   362:     act("$n dissolves into darkness.", FALSE, mob, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   363:   send_to_char(owner, "Your shadow %s is defeated and returns to your shadow storage.\r\n",
   364:                shadow_slot_display_name(owner, slot));
   365: 
   366:   prepare_shadow_servant_for_removal(mob);
   367:   extract_char(mob);
   368:   save_char(owner);
   369:   return TRUE;
   370: }

   388: static const char *severity_impact_wrap_open(int tier)
   389: {
   390:   switch (tier) {
   391:     case 7: return "- ";
   392:     case 8: return "** ";
   393:     case 9: return "***** ";
   394:     default: return "";
   395:   }
   396: }
   397: 
   398: static const char *severity_impact_wrap_close(int tier)
   399: {
   400:   switch (tier) {
   401:     case 7: return " -";
   402:     case 8: return " **";
   403:     case 9: return " *****";
   404:     default: return "";
   405:   }
   406: }
   407: 
   408: static int victim_condition_band(const struct char_data *victim)
   409: {
   410:   int pct;
   411: 
   412:   if (!victim || GET_MAX_HIT(victim) <= 0)
   413:     return 7;
   414: 
   415:   pct = (GET_HIT(victim) * 100) / GET_MAX_HIT(victim);
   416: 
   417:   if (pct >= 100) return 0;
   418:   if (pct >= 90)  return 1;
   419:   if (pct >= 75)  return 2;
   420:   if (pct >= 50)  return 3;
   421:   if (pct >= 30)  return 4;
   422:   if (pct >= 15)  return 5;
   423:   return 6;
   424: }
   425: 
   426: static const char *victim_condition_text(int band)
   427: {
   428:   switch (band) {
   429:     case 0: return "is in excellent condition.";
   430:     case 1: return "has a few scratches.";
   431:     case 2: return "has some small wounds and bruises.";
   432:     case 3: return "has quite a few wounds.";
   433:     case 4: return "has some big nasty wounds and scratches.";
   434:     case 5: return "is gravely injured.";
   435:     default: return "needs a hospital.";
   436:   }
   437: }

   439: static void apply_severity_verb(char *out, size_t outsz, const char *in, int tier)
   440: {
   441:   const char *col = severity_color(tier);
   442:   const char *vb  = severity_verb_base(tier);
   443:   const char *vt  = severity_verb_third(tier);
   444:   const char *pre = severity_impact_wrap_open(tier);
   445:   const char *post = severity_impact_wrap_close(tier);
   446:   char *pos;
   447: 
   448:   if (!in || !*in) {
   449:     if (outsz) out[0] = '\0';
   450:     return;
   451:   }
   452: 
   453:   snprintf(out, outsz, "%s", in);
   454: 
   455:   /* Prefer replacing " hit" (base) first (skills often use "You hit $N"). */
   456:   if ((pos = strstr(out, " hit "))) {
   457:     char tmp[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   458:     *pos = '\0';
   459:     snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s %s%s%s%s\tn %s", out, col, pre, vb, post, pos + 5);
   460:     snprintf(out, outsz, "%s", tmp);
   461:     return;
   462:   }
   463:   if ((pos = strstr(out, " hit!"))) {
   464:     char tmp[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   465:     *pos = '\0';
   466:     snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s %s%s%s%s\tn!%s", out, col, pre, vb, post, pos + 5);
   467:     snprintf(out, outsz, "%s", tmp);
   468:     return;
   469:   }
   470: 
   471:   /* Then replace third person " hits" (many spell messages use "X hits $N"). */
   472:   if ((pos = strstr(out, " hits "))) {
   473:     char tmp[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   474:     *pos = '\0';
   475:     snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s %s%s%s%s\tn %s", out, col, pre, vt, post, pos + 6);
   476:     snprintf(out, outsz, "%s", tmp);
   477:     return;
   478:   }
   479:   if ((pos = strstr(out, " hits!"))) {
   480:     char tmp[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   481:     *pos = '\0';
   482:     snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s %s%s%s%s\tn!%s", out, col, pre, vt, post, pos + 6);
   483:     snprintf(out, outsz, "%s", tmp);
   484:     return;
   485:   }
   486: 
   487:   /* If we cannot find a generic verb, leave as is. */
   488: }

   495: static int spirit_proc_damage(const struct char_data *ch)
   496: {
   497:   int bonus = 0;
   498:   int dam = 0;
   499: 
   500:   if (!ch)
   501:     return 0;
   502: 
   503:   bonus = MIN(GET_LEVEL(ch) / 30, 2);
   504:   dam = dice(1, 3) + bonus;
   505: 
   506:   return MIN(dam, 5);
   507: }
   508: 
   509: static void spirit_proc_attack(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict, int attacktype,
   510:                                int proc_chance, int hit_chance)
   511: {
   512:   int dam;
   513: 
   514:   if (!ch || IN_ROOM(ch) == NOWHERE)
   515:     return;
   516: 
   517:   if (!vict || IN_ROOM(vict) == NOWHERE)
   518:     return;
   519: 
   520:   if (DEAD(vict) || IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(vict))
   521:     return;
   522: 
   523:   if (rand_number(1, 100) > proc_chance)
   524:     return;
   525: 
   526:   if (!CAN_SEE(ch, vict))
   527:     return;
   528: 
   529:   if (rand_number(1, 100) > hit_chance) {
   530:     damage(ch, vict, 0, attacktype);
   531:     return;
   532:   }
   533: 
   534:   dam = spirit_proc_damage(ch);
   535:   damage(ch, vict, dam, attacktype);
   536: }
   537: 
   538: static void do_spirit_procs(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict)
   539: {
   540:   const int proc_chance = 10;
   541:   const int hit_chance = 70;
   542: 
   543:   if (!ch || IN_ROOM(ch) == NOWHERE)
   544:     return;
   545: 
   546:   if (!vict || IN_ROOM(vict) == NOWHERE)
   547:     return;
   548: 
   549:   if (!FIGHTING(ch))
   550:     return;
   551: 
   552:   if (DEAD(vict) || IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(vict))
   553:     return;
   554: 
   555:   if (!affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_BEAR_SPIRIT) &&
   556:       !affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_WOLF_SPIRIT) &&
   557:       !affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_TIGER_SPIRIT) &&
   558:       !affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_EAGLE_SPIRIT) &&
   559:       !affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_DRAGON_SPIRIT))
   560:     return;
   561: 
   562:   if (affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_BEAR_SPIRIT))
   563:     spirit_proc_attack(ch, vict, SPELL_BEAR_SPIRIT, proc_chance, hit_chance);
   564:   if (!vict || IN_ROOM(vict) == NOWHERE || DEAD(vict) || IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(vict))
   565:     return;
   566:   if (affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_WOLF_SPIRIT))
   567:     spirit_proc_attack(ch, vict, SPELL_WOLF_SPIRIT, proc_chance, hit_chance);
   568:   if (!vict || IN_ROOM(vict) == NOWHERE || DEAD(vict) || IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(vict))
   569:     return;
   570:   if (affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_TIGER_SPIRIT))
   571:     spirit_proc_attack(ch, vict, SPELL_TIGER_SPIRIT, proc_chance, hit_chance);
   572:   if (!vict || IN_ROOM(vict) == NOWHERE || DEAD(vict) || IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(vict))
   573:     return;
   574:   if (affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_EAGLE_SPIRIT))
   575:     spirit_proc_attack(ch, vict, SPELL_EAGLE_SPIRIT, proc_chance, hit_chance);
   576:   if (!vict || IN_ROOM(vict) == NOWHERE || DEAD(vict) || IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(vict))
   577:     return;
   578:   if (affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_DRAGON_SPIRIT))
   579:     spirit_proc_attack(ch, vict, SPELL_DRAGON_SPIRIT, proc_chance, hit_chance);
   580: }
   581: /* The Fight related routines */
   582: void appear(struct char_data *ch)
   583: {
   584:   if (affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_INVISIBLE))
   585:     affect_from_char(ch, SPELL_INVISIBLE);
   586: 
   587:   REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(ch), AFF_INVISIBLE);
   588:   REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(ch), AFF_HIDE);
   589: 
   590:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)
   591:     act("$n slowly fades into existence.", FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   592:   else
   593:     act("You feel a strange presence as $n appears, seemingly from nowhere.",
   594: 	FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   595: }

   597: int legacy_ac_to_armor(int legacy_ac)
   598: {
   599:   /* Legacy AC was lower-is-better with 100 as "no armor". Convert to
   600:    * the new higher-is-better Armor scale without inflating durability. */
   601:   int armor = (100 - legacy_ac + 2) / 4; /* rounded integer divide by 4 */
   602:   return MAX(0, MIN(200, armor));
   603: }
   604: 
   605: int compute_armor(struct char_data *ch)
   606: {
   607:   int armor_bonus = 10 + (GET_CON(ch) - 10) + ((GET_STR(ch) - 10) / 2);
   608:   int armor = GET_ARMOR(ch) + armor_bonus;
   609:   return MAX(0, armor);
   610: }
   611: 
   612: int compute_armor_class(struct char_data *ch)
   613: {
   614:   return compute_armor(ch);
   615: }
   616: 
   617: int compute_evasion(struct char_data *ch)
   618: {
   619:   int evasion_bonus = 10 + ((GET_DEX(ch) - 10) * 2);
   620:   int evasion = GET_EVASION(ch) + evasion_bonus;
   621:   return MAX(0, evasion);
   622: }
   623: 
   624: static int compute_defensive_evasion_value(struct char_data *victim, int *level_component)
   625: {
   626:   int level_bonus = 0;
   627: 
   628:   if (!victim) {
   629:     if (level_component)
   630:       *level_component = 0;
   631:     return 0;
   632:   }
   633: 
   634:   level_bonus = GET_LEVEL(victim);
   635:   if (level_component)
   636:     *level_component = level_bonus;
   637: 
   638:   return compute_evasion(victim) + level_bonus;
   639: }
   640: 
   641: static int concealment_hit_modifier(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
   642: {
   643:   if (!ch || !victim)
   644:     return 0;
   645: 
   646:   if (!(AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_INVISIBLE) || AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_HIDE)))
   647:     return 0;
   648: 
   649:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_TRUESIGHT))
   650:     return 6;
   651: 
   652:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_DETECT_INVIS) || AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_SENSE_LIFE))
   653:     return 3;
   654: 
   655:   return -12;
   656: }
   657: 
   658: int compute_offensive_hit_value(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
   659: {
   660:   int level_bonus = GET_LEVEL(ch);
   661:   int hitroll_bonus = GET_HITROLL(ch);
   662:   int stat_bonus = str_app[STRENGTH_APPLY_INDEX(ch)].tohit;
   663:   int mental_bonus = (GET_INT(ch) - 10) / 4 + (GET_WIS(ch) - 10) / 4;
   664:   int level_gap_bonus = 0;
   665:   int situational_bonus = 0;
   666: 
   667:   if (victim) {
   668:     int level_gap = GET_LEVEL(ch) - GET_LEVEL(victim);
   669:     if (level_gap > 0)
   670:       level_gap_bonus = (level_gap / 2) + (level_gap / 4);
   671:     else if (level_gap < 0)
   672:       level_gap_bonus = level_gap / 3;
   673:   }
   674: 
   675:   situational_bonus = concealment_hit_modifier(ch, victim);
   676: 
   677:   return 30 + level_bonus + hitroll_bonus + stat_bonus + mental_bonus +
   678:          level_gap_bonus + situational_bonus;
   679: }
   680: 
   681: int compute_hit_chance_from_values(int offensive_hit, int target_evasion)
   682: {
   683:   int hit_chance = 50 + (offensive_hit - target_evasion);
   684: 
   685:   return MAX(5, MIN(95, hit_chance));
   686: }
   687: 
   688: void get_player_unarmed_profile(int level, int *dice_num, int *dice_size, int *level_bonus)
   689: {
   690:   level = MAX(1, level);
   691:   if (dice_num)
   692:     *dice_num = MIN(4, 1 + (level / 30));
   693:   if (dice_size)
   694:     *dice_size = MIN(7, 2 + (level / 20));
   695:   if (level_bonus)
   696:     *level_bonus = MAX(0, level / 30);
   697: }
   698: 
   699: int unarmed_proficiency_bonus(int unarmed_component, int skill)
   700: {
   701:   int scaled, bonus, remainder;
   702: 
   703:   if (unarmed_component <= 0 || skill <= 0)
   704:     return 0;
   705: 
   706:   skill = MIN(100, skill);
   707:   /* Expected bonus is component * skill / 800: 12.5% at mastery.
   708:    * Stochastic rounding preserves that modest ratio for low-level dice instead
   709:    * of turning every small hit into a disproportionate flat +1. */
   710:   scaled = unarmed_component * skill;
   711:   bonus = scaled / 800;
   712:   remainder = scaled % 800;
   713:   if (remainder > 0 && rand_number(1, 800) <= remainder)
   714:     bonus++;
   715:   return bonus;
   716: }
   717: 
   718: int unarmed_expected_average_x100(int level, int skill)
   719: {
   720:   int dice_num, dice_size, level_bonus;
   721:   int base_average_x100;
   722: 
   723:   get_player_unarmed_profile(level, &dice_num, &dice_size, &level_bonus);
   724:   skill = MAX(0, MIN(100, skill));
   725:   base_average_x100 = dice_num * (dice_size + 1) * 50 + level_bonus * 100;
   726:   return base_average_x100 + (base_average_x100 * skill) / 800;
   727: }
   728: 
   729: void update_pos(struct char_data *victim)
   730: {
   731:   if ((GET_HIT(victim) > 0) && (GET_POS(victim) > POS_STUNNED))
   732:     return;
   733:   else if (GET_HIT(victim) > 0)
   734:     GET_POS(victim) = POS_STANDING;
   735:   else if (GET_HIT(victim) <= -11)
   736:     GET_POS(victim) = POS_DEAD;
   737:   else if (GET_HIT(victim) <= -6)
   738:     GET_POS(victim) = POS_MORTALLYW;
   739:   else if (GET_HIT(victim) <= -3)
   740:     GET_POS(victim) = POS_INCAP;
   741:   else
   742:     GET_POS(victim) = POS_STUNNED;
   743: }

   745: void check_killer(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict)
   746: {
   747:   if (PLR_FLAGGED(vict, PLR_KILLER) || PLR_FLAGGED(vict, PLR_THIEF))
   748:     return;
   749:   if (PLR_FLAGGED(ch, PLR_KILLER) || IS_NPC(ch) || IS_NPC(vict) || ch == vict)
   750:     return;
   751: 
   752:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_KILLER);
   753:   send_to_char(ch, "If you want to be a PLAYER KILLER, so be it...\r\n");
   754:   mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, MAX(GET_INVIS_LEV(ch), GET_INVIS_LEV(vict))), 
   755:     TRUE, "PC Killer bit set on %s for initiating attack on %s at %s.",
   756:     GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(vict), world[IN_ROOM(vict)].name);
   757: }

   759: /* start one char fighting another (yes, it is horrible, I know... )  */
   760: void set_fighting(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict)
   761: {
   762:   if (ch == vict)
   763:     return;
   764: 
   765:   if (FIGHTING(ch)) {
   766:     core_dump();
   767:     return;
   768:   }
   769: 
   770:   ch->next_fighting = combat_list;
   771:   combat_list = ch;
   772: 
   773:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_SLEEP))
   774:     affect_from_char(ch, SPELL_SLEEP);
   775: 
   776:   FIGHTING(ch) = vict;
   777:   GET_POS(ch) = POS_FIGHTING;
   778: 
   779: 
   780:   if (!CONFIG_PK_ALLOWED)
   781:     check_killer(ch, vict);
   782: }
   783: 
   784: /* remove a char from the list of fighting chars */
   785: void stop_fighting(struct char_data *ch)
   786: {
   787:   struct char_data *temp;
   788: 
   789:   /* Capture the opponent before the combat link is cleared.  The AI hook is
   790:    * transition-deduplicated and therefore safe for the many legacy callers. */
   791:   if (ch && FIGHTING(ch))
   792: 
   793:   if (ch == next_combat_list)
   794:     next_combat_list = ch->next_fighting;
   795: 
   796:   REMOVE_FROM_LIST(ch, combat_list, next_fighting);
   797:   ch->next_fighting = NULL;
   798:   FIGHTING(ch) = NULL;
   799:   GET_POS(ch) = POS_STANDING;
   800:   update_pos(ch);
   801: }
   802: 
   803: static void make_corpse(struct char_data *ch)
   804: {
   805:   int inv_dropped = 0;
   806:   long long dropped_gold = 0;
   807:   char buf2[MAX_NAME_LENGTH + 64];
   808:   struct obj_data *corpse, *o;
   809:   struct obj_data *money;
   810:   int i, x, y;
   811: 
   812:   corpse = create_obj();
   813: 
   814:   corpse->item_number = NOTHING;
   815:   IN_ROOM(corpse) = NOWHERE;
   816:   corpse->name = strdup("corpse");
   817: 
   818:   snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "The corpse of %s is lying here.", GET_NAME(ch));
   819:   corpse->description = strdup(buf2);
   820: 
   821:   snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "the corpse of %s", GET_NAME(ch));
   822:   corpse->short_description = strdup(buf2);
   823: 
   824:   GET_OBJ_TYPE(corpse) = ITEM_CONTAINER;
   825:   for(x = y = 0; x < EF_ARRAY_MAX || y < TW_ARRAY_MAX; x++, y++) {
   826:     if (x < EF_ARRAY_MAX)
   827:       GET_OBJ_EXTRA_AR(corpse, x) = 0;
   828:     if (y < TW_ARRAY_MAX)
   829:       corpse->obj_flags.wear_flags[y] = 0;
   830:   }
   831:   SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(corpse), ITEM_WEAR_TAKE);
   832:   SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(corpse), ITEM_NODONATE);
   833:   GET_OBJ_VAL(corpse, 0) = 0;	/* You can't store stuff in a corpse */
   834:   GET_OBJ_VAL(corpse, 1) = 0; /* container flags: corpse is open/non-closeable */
   835:   GET_OBJ_VAL(corpse, 2) = GET_LEVEL(ch); /* source level snapshot for shadow extraction */
   836:   GET_OBJ_VAL(corpse, 3) = 1;	/* corpse identifier */
   837:   CORPSE_SOURCE_VNUM(corpse) = IS_NPC(ch) ? GET_MOB_VNUM(ch) : NOBODY; /* source mob vnum for shadow extraction */
   838:   CORPSE_SHADOW_ATTEMPTS(corpse) = 3; /* shadow extraction attempts remaining */
   839:   CORPSE_SHADOW_ATTEMPTS_INIT(corpse) = 1; /* shadow extraction fields initialized */
   840:   GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(corpse) = GET_WEIGHT(ch) + IS_CARRYING_W(ch);
   841:   GET_OBJ_RENT(corpse) = 100000;
   842:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   843:     GET_OBJ_TIMER(corpse) = CONFIG_MAX_NPC_CORPSE_TIME;
   844:   else
   845:     GET_OBJ_TIMER(corpse) = CONFIG_MAX_PC_CORPSE_TIME;
   846: 
   847:   /* transfer character's inventory to the corpse */
   848:   corpse->contains = ch->carrying;
   849:   for (o = corpse->contains; o != NULL; o = o->next_content)
   850:     o->in_obj = corpse;
   851:   object_list_new_owner(corpse, NULL);
   852: 
   853:   /* transfer character's equipment to the corpse */
   854:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
   855:     if (GET_EQ(ch, i)) {
   856:       remove_otrigger(GET_EQ(ch, i), ch);
   857:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) {
   858:       obj_to_obj(unequip_char(ch, i), corpse);
   859:     }
   860: 
   861:     
   862:   }
   863: /* transfer gold */
   864:   if (!IS_NPC(ch)) {
   865:     long long have = (long long)GET_MONEY(ch);
   866:     dropped_gold = have / 10;
   867:     if (dropped_gold > 0) {
   868:       money = create_money((int)dropped_gold, 0);
   869:       obj_to_obj(money, corpse);
   870:       GET_MONEY(ch) = (long long)GET_MONEY(ch) - dropped_gold;
   871:     }
   872: 
   873:     /* Death drop summary for items and money. */
   874:     if (inv_dropped > 0 || dropped_gold > 0) {
   875:       send_to_char(ch, "Death penalty: You drop %lld gold and %d inventory item(s) on your corpse.\r\n",
   876:                    dropped_gold, inv_dropped);
   877:     } else {
   878:       send_to_char(ch, "Death penalty: You drop nothing.\r\n");
   879:     }
   880:     } else {
   881:     /* NPC gold drop: roll between gold_min and gold_max and place on corpse. */
   882:     long long gmin = ch->mob_specials.gold_min;
   883:     long long gmax = ch->mob_specials.gold_max;
   884:     if (gmin < 0) gmin = 0;
   885:     if (gmax < gmin) gmax = gmin;
   886:     dropped_gold = (gmax > 0) ? rand_number((int)gmin, (int)gmax) : 0;
   887:     if (dropped_gold > 0) {
   888:       money = create_money((int)dropped_gold, 0);
   889:       obj_to_obj(money, corpse);
   890:     }
   891:     apply_mob_loot_table(ch, corpse);
   892:   }
   893: ch->carrying = NULL;
   894:   IS_CARRYING_N(ch) = 0;
   895:   IS_CARRYING_W(ch) = 0;
   896: 
   897:   obj_to_room(corpse, IN_ROOM(ch));
   898: }
   899: 
   900: static void apply_mob_loot_table(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *corpse)
   901: {
   902:   int i;
   903: 
   904:   if (!ch || !corpse || !IS_NPC(ch))
   905:     return;
   906: 
   907:   for (i = 0; i < ch->mob_specials.loot_table_count; i++) {
   908:     int chance = MAX(0, MIN(100, ch->mob_specials.loot_table[i].chance));
   909:     obj_rnum ornum;
   910:     struct obj_data *obj;
   911: 
   912:     if (chance <= 0 || rand_number(1, 100) > chance)
   913:       continue;
   914: 
   915:     ornum = real_object(ch->mob_specials.loot_table[i].vnum);
   916:     if (ornum == NOTHING)
   917:       continue;
   918: 
   919:     obj = read_object(ornum, REAL);
   920:     if (!obj)
   921:       continue;
   922: 
   923:     obj_to_obj(obj, corpse);
   924:   }
   925: }
   926: 
   927: /* When ch kills victim */
   928: static void change_alignment(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
   929: {
   930:   /* new alignment change algorithm: if you kill a monster with alignment A,
   931:    * you move 1/16th of the way to having alignment -A.  Simple and fast. */
   932:   GET_ALIGNMENT(ch) += (-GET_ALIGNMENT(victim) - GET_ALIGNMENT(ch)) / 16;
   933: }
   934: 
   935: static int calc_pve_glory(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
   936: {
   937:   int diff = abs(GET_LEVEL(victim) - GET_LEVEL(ch));
   938:   int base = rand_number(15, 25);
   939: 
   940:   if (diff <= 3)
   941:     return base;
   942: 
   943:   return MAX(0, (base * MAX(0, (8 - diff))) / 5);
   944: }
   945: 
   946: static int calc_pvp_glory(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
   947: {
   948:   int diff = abs(GET_LEVEL(victim) - GET_LEVEL(ch));
   949:   int base = rand_number(800, 1200);
   950: 
   951:   if (diff <= 3)
   952:     return base;
   953: 
   954:   return MAX(0, (base * MAX(0, (10 - diff))) / 7);
   955: }
   956: 
   957: static bool recently_killed_for_glory(struct char_data *killer, struct char_data *victim)
   958: {
   959:   time_t now = time(NULL);
   960: 
   961:   if (!GET_LAST_PVP_GLORY_TIME(killer))
   962:     return FALSE;
   963: 
   964:   if (str_cmp(GET_LAST_PVP_GLORY_VICTIM(killer), GET_NAME(victim)))
   965:     return FALSE;
   966: 
   967:   return (now - GET_LAST_PVP_GLORY_TIME(killer)) < PVP_GLORY_COOLDOWN;
   968: }
   969: 
   970: static void grant_glory_for_kill(struct char_data *killer, struct char_data *victim)
   971: {
   972:   int glory = 0;
   973: 
   974:   if (!killer || IS_NPC(killer) || !victim)
   975:     return;
   976: 
   977:   if (IS_NPC(victim)) {
   978:     glory = calc_pve_glory(killer, victim);
   979:   } else {
   980:     if (recently_killed_for_glory(killer, victim))
   981:       return;
   982: 
   983:     glory = calc_pvp_glory(killer, victim);
   984:     if (glory > 0) {
   985:       strlcpy(GET_LAST_PVP_GLORY_VICTIM(killer), GET_NAME(victim), sizeof(GET_LAST_PVP_GLORY_VICTIM(killer)));
   986:       GET_LAST_PVP_GLORY_TIME(killer) = time(NULL);
   987:     }
   988:   }
   989: 
   990:   if (glory <= 0)
   991:     return;
   992: 
   993:   GET_GLORY(killer) += glory;
   994:   send_to_char(killer, "You gain %s%d%s %sGlory%s.\r\n",
   995:                CBYEL(killer, C_NRM), glory, CCNRM(killer, C_NRM),
   996:                CBCYN(killer, C_NRM), CCNRM(killer, C_NRM));
   997: }
   998: 
   999: void death_cry(struct char_data *ch)
  1000: {
  1001:   int door;
  1002: 
  1003:   act("\tRYour blood freezes as you hear $n's death cry.\tn", FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1004: 
  1005:   for (door = 0; door < DIR_COUNT; door++)
  1006:     if (CAN_GO(ch, door))
  1007:       send_to_room(world[IN_ROOM(ch)].dir_option[door]->to_room, "\tRYour blood freezes as you hear someone's death cry.\tn\r\n");
  1008: }
  1009: 
  1010: void raw_kill(struct char_data * ch, struct char_data * killer)
  1011: {
  1012: struct char_data *i;
  1013: 
  1014:   /* Must run before NPC extraction: no post-extraction AI writes. */
  1015:   if (killer)
  1016: 
  1017:   if (FIGHTING(ch))
  1018:     stop_fighting(ch);
  1019: 
  1020:   while (ch->affected)
  1021:     affect_remove(ch, ch->affected);
  1022: 
  1023:   /* To make ordinary commands work in scripts.  welcor*/
  1024:   GET_POS(ch) = POS_STANDING;
  1025: 
  1026:   if (killer) {
  1027:     if (death_mtrigger(ch, killer))
  1028:       death_cry(ch);
  1029:   } else
  1030:     death_cry(ch);
  1031: 
  1032:   if (killer) {
  1033:     if (killer->group) {
  1034:       while ((i = (struct char_data *) simple_list(killer->group->members)) != NULL)
  1035:         if(IN_ROOM(i) == IN_ROOM(ch)  || (world[IN_ROOM(i)].zone == world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone)) {
  1036:           autoquest_trigger_check(i, ch, NULL, AQ_MOB_KILL);
  1037:           quest_kill_trigger_check(i, ch);
  1038:           campaign_kill_trigger_check(i, ch);
  1039:         }
  1040:     } else
  1041:     {
  1042:       autoquest_trigger_check(killer, ch, NULL, AQ_MOB_KILL);
  1043:       quest_kill_trigger_check(killer, ch);
  1044:       campaign_kill_trigger_check(killer, ch);
  1045:     }
  1046:   }
  1047: 
  1048:   /* Alert Group if Applicable */
  1049:   if (GROUP(ch))
  1050:     send_to_group(ch, GROUP(ch), "%s has died.\r\n", GET_NAME(ch));
  1051: 
  1052:   update_pos(ch);
  1053: 
  1054:   make_corpse(ch);
  1055: 
  1056:   /* NPCs: original behavior. PCs: do NOT extract (extraction puts them into the menu).
  1057:      Instead, respawn them at the mortal start room and keep the descriptor playing. */
  1058:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) {
  1059:     extract_char(ch);
  1060:   } else {
  1061:     /* Clear combat state and ensure valid vitals. */
  1062:     GET_HIT(ch) = MAX(1, GET_HIT(ch));
  1063:     GET_POS(ch) = POS_RESTING;
  1064: 
  1065:     if (IN_ROOM(ch) != NOWHERE)
  1066:       char_from_room(ch);
  1067:     char_to_room(ch, r_mortal_start_room);
  1068: 
  1069:     /* Optional: clear target and stop any lingering fighting. */
  1070:     if (FIGHTING(ch))
  1071:       stop_fighting(ch);
  1072: 
  1073:     look_at_room(ch, 0);
  1074:     send_to_char(ch, "You have died. Your spirit reforms at the temple.\r\n");
  1075:   }
  1076:   if (killer) {
  1077:     autoquest_trigger_check(killer, NULL, NULL, AQ_MOB_SAVE);
  1078:     autoquest_trigger_check(killer, NULL, NULL, AQ_ROOM_CLEAR);
  1079:     if (affected_by_spell(killer, SPELL_SHADOW_REGENESIS))
  1080:       GET_MANA(killer) = MIN(effective_max_mana(killer), GET_MANA(killer) + (GET_LEVEL(killer) / 2));
  1081:     if (GET_SKILL(killer, SKILL_SHADOW_SURGE) > 0 && count_shadow_servants_for(killer) > 0) {
  1082:       struct affected_type af;
  1083:       int stacks = 0;
  1084:       struct affected_type *taf;
  1085:       for (taf = killer->affected; taf; taf = taf->next)
  1086:         if (taf->spell == SKILL_SHADOW_SURGE && taf->location == APPLY_DAMROLL)
  1087:           stacks++;
  1088:       if (stacks < 3) {
  1089:         new_affect(&af);
  1090:         af.spell = SKILL_SHADOW_SURGE;
  1091:         af.duration = 2 + (GET_LEVEL(killer) / 10);
  1092:         af.location = APPLY_DAMROLL;
  1093:         af.modifier = 2;
  1094:         affect_join(killer, &af, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE);
  1095:       }
  1096:     }
  1097:   }
  1098: }
  1099: 
  1100: void die(struct char_data * ch, struct char_data * killer)
  1101: {
  1102:   if (return_extracted_shadow_to_storage(ch))
  1103:     return;
  1104: 
  1105:   if (killer && killer != ch && !IS_NPC(ch) && !IS_NPC(killer) && GET_LEVEL(killer) < LVL_IMMORT && GET_BOUNTY(ch) > 0) {
  1106:     long long reward = GET_BOUNTY(ch);
  1107:     char reward_buf[64];
  1108: 
  1109:     format_gold_as_currency(reward_buf, sizeof(reward_buf), reward);
  1110:     SET_BOUNTY(ch, 0);
  1111:     increase_money_gold(killer, reward);
  1112:     save_char(ch);
  1113:     save_char(killer);
  1114:     send_to_char(killer, "You claim %s for the bounty on %s.\r\n", reward_buf, GET_NAME(ch));
  1115:   }
  1116:     /* Death penalty: lose 1-10% of TNL on a level-based curve. */
  1117:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) {
  1118:     long long tnl, loss;
  1119:     int pct, max_mortal_level;
  1120:     long long num, den, den2;
  1121: 
  1122:     /* TNL = exp needed for next level, clamped */
  1123:     tnl = (long long)level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), GET_LEVEL(ch) + 1) - (long long)GET_EXP(ch);
  1124:     if (tnl < 0)
  1125:       tnl = 0;
  1126: 
  1127:     max_mortal_level = LVL_IMMORT - 1;
  1128: 
  1129:     /* Quadratic curve: level 1 => 1%, top mortal => 10% */
  1130:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) <= 1 || max_mortal_level <= 1) {
  1131:       pct = 1;
  1132:     } else {
  1133:       num = (long long)(GET_LEVEL(ch) - 1);
  1134:       den = (long long)(max_mortal_level - 1);
  1135:       den2 = den * den;
  1136:       pct = 1 + (int)((9LL * num * num + den2 / 2) / den2);
  1137:       pct = MIN(10, MAX(1, pct));
  1138:     }
  1139: 
  1140:     /* ceil(tnl * pct / 100) */
  1141:     loss = (tnl * pct + 99) / 100;
  1142: 
  1143:     send_to_char(ch, "Death penalty: You lose %lld experience.\r\n", loss);
  1144: 
  1145:     /* gain_exp uses int; clamp to int range */
  1146:     if (loss > 2147483647LL) loss = 2147483647LL;
  1147:     gain_exp(ch, (int)(-loss));
  1148:   } else {
  1149:     gain_exp(ch, -(GET_EXP(ch) / 2));
  1150:   }
  1151: 
  1152:   if (!IS_NPC(ch)) {
  1153:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_KILLER);
  1154:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_THIEF);
  1155:   }
  1156: 
  1157:   /*
  1158:    * NPC gold payout to the killer (single, authoritative location).
  1159:    * Uses gold_min/gold_max if set, otherwise falls back to GET_GOLD(ch).
  1160:    * Clears NPC gold so it does not also appear on the corpse.
  1161:    */
  1162:   if (killer && ch && IS_NPC(ch) && !IS_NPC(killer)) {
  1163:     long long gold_gain = 0;
  1164:     long long gmin = (long long)ch->mob_specials.gold_min;
  1165:     long long gmax = (long long)ch->mob_specials.gold_max;
  1166: 
  1167:     if (gmin < 0) gmin = 0;
  1168:     if (gmax < 0) gmax = 0;
  1169:     if (gmax < gmin) gmax = gmin;
  1170: 
  1171:     if (gmin > 0 || gmax > 0) {
  1172:       int imin = (gmin > 2147483647LL) ? 2147483647 : (int)gmin;
  1173:       int imax = (gmax > 2147483647LL) ? 2147483647 : (int)gmax;
  1174:       gold_gain = (imin == imax) ? (long long)imin : (long long)rand_number(imin, imax);
  1175:     } else if (GET_GOLD(ch) > 0) {
  1176:       gold_gain = (long long)GET_GOLD(ch);
  1177:     }
  1178: 
  1179:     if (gold_gain > 0) {
  1180:       increase_money_gold(killer, gold_gain);
  1181:       send_to_char(killer, "You receive \ty%lld\tn \tYgold\tn from the kill.\r\n", gold_gain);
  1182:     }
  1183: 
  1184:     /* prevent corpse gold duplication */
  1185:     ch->mob_specials.gold_min = 0;
  1186:     ch->mob_specials.gold_max = 0;
  1187:     SET_GOLD(ch, 0);
  1188:   }
  1189: 
  1190:   raw_kill(ch, killer);
  1191: }
  1192: 
  1193: static void perform_group_gain(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim, int base_override)
  1194: {
  1195:   int share, rare_bonus = 0, final_gain;
  1196: 
  1197:   share = (base_override >= 0) ? base_override : mob_kill_base_xp(ch, victim);
  1198: 
  1199:   if (IS_NPC(victim)) {
  1200:     rare_bonus = rare_kill_bonus_for_victim(victim, share);
  1201:     share = npc_kill_raw_xp(victim, share);
  1202:   } else {
  1203:     share = MIN(CONFIG_MAX_EXP_GAIN, MAX(1, share));
  1204:   }
  1205: 
  1206:   final_gain = final_positive_xp_gain(share);
  1207:   if (final_gain > 1)
  1208:     send_to_char(ch, "You receive your share of \tCexperience\tn -- \ty%d\tn points.\r\n", final_gain);
  1209:   else if (final_gain == 1)
  1210:     send_to_char(ch, "You receive your share of experience -- one measly little point!\r\n");
  1211:   else
  1212:     send_to_char(ch, "You receive your share of experience, but gain no points.\r\n");
  1213: 
  1214:   if (rare_bonus > 0) {
  1215:     send_to_char(ch, "This was a \tcRare Kill\tn.\r\n");
  1216:   }
  1217: 
  1218:   gain_exp(ch, share);
  1219:   change_alignment(ch, victim);
  1220: }
  1221: 
  1222: static void group_gain(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
  1223: {
  1224:   int tot_members = 0, base, tot_gain;
  1225:   struct char_data *k;
  1226: 
  1227:   if (!IS_NPC(victim)) {
  1228:     while ((k = (struct char_data *) simple_list(GROUP(ch)->members)) != NULL)
  1229:       if (IN_ROOM(ch) == IN_ROOM(k))
  1230:         tot_members++;
  1231: 
  1232:     /* round up to the nearest tot_members */
  1233:     tot_gain = (GET_EXP(victim) / 3) + tot_members - 1;
  1234:     tot_gain = MIN(CONFIG_MAX_EXP_LOSS * 2 / 3, tot_gain);
  1235:     base = (tot_members >= 1) ? MAX(1, tot_gain / tot_members) : 0;
  1236: 
  1237:     while ((k = (struct char_data *) simple_list(GROUP(ch)->members)) != NULL)
  1238:       if (IN_ROOM(k) == IN_ROOM(ch))
  1239:         perform_group_gain(k, victim, base);
  1240:     return;
  1241:   }
  1242: 
  1243:   while ((k = (struct char_data *) simple_list(GROUP(ch)->members)) != NULL)
  1244:     if (IN_ROOM(k) == IN_ROOM(ch))
  1245:       perform_group_gain(k, victim, -1);
  1246: }
  1247: 
  1248: static void solo_gain(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
  1249: {
  1250:   int exp, rare_bonus = 0, final_gain;
  1251: 
  1252:   if (IS_NPC(victim)) {
  1253:     exp = mob_kill_base_xp(ch, victim);
  1254:     rare_bonus = rare_kill_bonus_for_victim(victim, exp);
  1255:     exp = npc_kill_raw_xp(victim, exp);
  1256:   } else {
  1257:     exp = MIN(CONFIG_MAX_EXP_GAIN, GET_EXP(victim) / 3);
  1258: 
  1259:     if (IS_NPC(ch))
  1260:       exp += MAX(0, (exp * MIN(4, (GET_LEVEL(victim) - GET_LEVEL(ch)))) / 8);
  1261:     else
  1262:       exp += MAX(0, (exp * MIN(8, (GET_LEVEL(victim) - GET_LEVEL(ch)))) / 8);
  1263: 
  1264:     exp = MAX(exp, 1);
  1265:   }
  1266: 
  1267:   final_gain = final_positive_xp_gain(exp);
  1268:   if (final_gain > 1)
  1269:     send_to_char(ch, "You receive \ty%d\tn \tCexperience\tn points.\r\n", final_gain);
  1270:   else if (final_gain == 1)
  1271:     send_to_char(ch, "You receive one lousy experience point.\r\n");
  1272:   else
  1273:     send_to_char(ch, "You receive no experience points.\r\n");
  1274: 
  1275:   if (rare_bonus > 0) {
  1276:     send_to_char(ch, "This was a \tcRare Kill\tn.\r\n");
  1277:   }
  1278: 
  1279:   gain_exp(ch, exp);
  1280: 
  1281:     change_alignment(ch, victim);
  1282: }
  1283: 
  1284: static int mob_kill_base_xp(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
  1285: {
  1286:   if (!ch || !victim || !IS_NPC(victim))
  1287:     return 0;
  1288: 
  1289:   return mob_kill_base_xp_for_levels(GET_LEVEL(ch), GET_LEVEL(victim));
  1290: }
  1291: 
  1292: int mob_kill_base_xp_for_levels(int attacker_level, int victim_level)
  1293: {
  1294:   int delta;
  1295: 
  1296:   delta = victim_level - attacker_level;
  1297: 
  1298:   if (delta <= -15) return 1;
  1299:   if (delta <= -10) return 3;
  1300:   if (delta <= -8)  return 5;
  1301:   if (delta <= -5)  return 15;
  1302:   if (delta <= -3)  return 40;
  1303:   if (delta == -2)  return 60;
  1304:   if (delta == -1)  return 90;
  1305:   if (delta == 0)   return 120;
  1306:   if (delta == 1)   return 150;
  1307:   if (delta == 2)   return 180;
  1308:   if (delta == 3)   return 220;
  1309:   if (delta == 4)   return 260;
  1310:   if (delta == 5)   return 300;
  1311:   return 350;
  1312: }
  1313: 
  1314: static int rare_kill_bonus_for_victim(struct char_data *victim, int base_xp)
  1315: {
  1316:   if (!victim || !IS_NPC(victim))
  1317:     return 0;
  1318: 
  1319:   return MOB_FLAGGED(victim, MOB_RARE) ? MAX(1, base_xp / 4) : 0;
  1320: }
  1321: 
  1322: /* Raw NPC reward: base + additive builder bonus + explicit rare bonus.
  1323:  * Happy Hour and the cap belong solely to gain_exp(). */
  1324: static int npc_kill_raw_xp(struct char_data *victim, int base_xp)
  1325: {
  1326:   long long raw = MAX(0, base_xp);
  1327:   raw += MAX(0, GET_EXP(victim));
  1328:   raw += rare_kill_bonus_for_victim(victim, base_xp);
  1329:   return (int)MIN((long long)INT_MAX, raw);
  1330: }
  1331: 
  1332: static struct char_data *resolve_reward_killer(struct char_data *killer)
  1333: {
  1334:   int hops = 0;
  1335:   struct char_data *iter = killer;
  1336: 
  1337:   if (!killer)
  1338:     return NULL;
  1339:   if (!IS_NPC(killer))
  1340:     return killer;
  1341: 
  1342:   while (iter && iter->master && hops < 20) {
  1343:     iter = iter->master;
  1344:     if (iter && !IS_NPC(iter))
  1345:       return iter;
  1346:     hops++;
  1347:   }
  1348: 
  1349:   return killer;
  1350: }
  1351: 
  1352: static char *replace_string(const char *str, const char *weapon_singular, const char *weapon_plural)
  1353: {
  1354:   static char buf[256];
  1355:   char *cp = buf;
  1356: 
  1357:   for (; *str; str++) {
  1358:     if (*str == '#') {
  1359:       switch (*(++str)) {
  1360:       case 'W':
  1361: 	for (; *weapon_plural; *(cp++) = *(weapon_plural++));
  1362: 	break;
  1363:       case 'w':
  1364: 	for (; *weapon_singular; *(cp++) = *(weapon_singular++));
  1365: 	break;
  1366:       default:
  1367: 	*(cp++) = '#';
  1368: 	break;
  1369:       }
  1370:     } else
  1371:       *(cp++) = *str;
  1372: 
  1373:     *cp = 0;
  1374:   }				/* For */
  1375: 
  1376:   return (buf);
  1377: }
  1378: 
  1379: /* message for doing damage with a weapon */
  1380: static void dam_message(int dam, struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim,
  1381: 		      int w_type)
  1382: {
  1383:   char *buf;
  1384:   int msgnum;
  1385: 
  1386:   int pct = 0;
  1387:   static struct dam_weapon_type {
  1388:     const char *to_room;
  1389:     const char *to_char;
  1390:     const char *to_victim;
  1391:   } dam_weapons[] = {
  1392: 
  1393:     /* #w is weapon singular text (used as a noun here: "with your slash"). */
  1394: 
  1395:     {
  1396:       "$n tries to use $s #w on $N, but misses.",
  1397:       "You try to use your #w on $N, but miss.",
  1398:       "$n tries to use $s #w on you, but misses."
  1399:     },
  1400: 
  1401:     {
  1402:       "$n 	Ggrazes	n $N with $s #w.",
  1403:       "You 	Ggraze	n $N with your #w.",
  1404:       "$n 	Ggrazes	n you with $s #w."
  1405:     },
  1406: 
  1407:     {
  1408:       "$n 	Gglances	n $N with $s #w.",
  1409:       "You 	Gglance	n $N with your #w.",
  1410:       "$n 	Gglances	n you with $s #w."
  1411:     },
  1412: 
  1413:     {

  1455: 
  1456:   w_type -= TYPE_HIT;		/* Change to base of table with text */
  1457:   if (dam <= 0) {
  1458:     msgnum = 0;
  1459:   } else {
  1460:     pct = (dam * 100) / MAX(1, GET_MAX_HIT(victim));
  1461: 
  1462:     if (pct <= 2)        msgnum = 1;
  1463:     else if (pct <= 6)   msgnum = 2;
  1464:     else if (pct <= 14)  msgnum = 3;
  1465:     else if (pct <= 24)  msgnum = 4;
  1466:     else if (pct <= 39)  msgnum = 5;
  1467:     else if (pct <= 54)  msgnum = 6;
  1468:     else if (pct <= 69)  msgnum = 7;
  1469:     else if (pct <= 84)  msgnum = 8;
  1470:     else                 msgnum = 9;
  1471:   }
  1472: /* damage message to onlookers */
  1473:   buf = replace_string(dam_weapons[msgnum].to_room,
  1474: 	  attack_hit_text[w_type].singular, attack_hit_text[w_type].plural);
  1475:   act(buf, FALSE, ch, NULL, victim, TO_NOTVICT);
  1476: 
  1477:   /* damage message to damager */
  1478:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT)
  1479: 	send_to_char(ch, "(%d) ", dam);
  1480:   buf = replace_string(dam_weapons[msgnum].to_char,
  1481: 	  attack_hit_text[w_type].singular, attack_hit_text[w_type].plural);
  1482:   act(buf, FALSE, ch, NULL, victim, TO_CHAR);
  1483:   send_to_char(ch, CCNRM(ch, C_CMP));
  1484: 
  1485:   /* damage message to damagee */
  1486:   if (GET_LEVEL(victim) >= LVL_IMMORT)
  1487:     send_to_char(victim, "\tR(%d)", dam);
  1488:   buf = replace_string(dam_weapons[msgnum].to_victim,
  1489: 	  attack_hit_text[w_type].singular, attack_hit_text[w_type].plural);
  1490:   act(buf, FALSE, ch, NULL, victim, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
  1491:   send_to_char(victim, CCNRM(victim, C_CMP));
  1492: }
