  1495: /*  message for doing damage with a spell or skill. Also used for weapon
  1496:  *  damage on miss and death blows. */
  1497: int skill_message(int dam, struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict,
  1498: 		      int attacktype)
  1499: {
  1500:   int i, j, nr;
  1501:   struct message_type *msg;
  1502: 
  1503:   char wmsg_att[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1504:   char wmsg_vic[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1505:   char wmsg_room[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1506:   struct obj_data *weap = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD);
  1507: 
  1508:   /* @todo restructure the messages library to a pointer based system as
  1509:    * opposed to the current cyclic location system. */
  1510:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_MESSAGES; i++) {
  1511:     if (fight_messages[i].a_type == attacktype) {      nr = dice(1, fight_messages[i].number_of_attacks);
  1512:       for (j = 1, msg = fight_messages[i].msg; (j < nr) && msg; j++)
  1513:         msg = msg->next;
  1514: 
  1515:       if (!IS_NPC(vict) && (GET_LEVEL(vict) >= LVL_IMPL)) {
  1516:         act(msg->god_msg.attacker_msg, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1517:         act(msg->god_msg.victim_msg, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_VICT);
  1518:         act(msg->god_msg.room_msg, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
  1519:       } else if (dam != 0) {
  1520:         /*
  1521:          * Don't send redundant color codes for TYPE_SUFFERING & other types
  1522:          * of damage without attacker_msg.
  1523:          */
  1524:         if (GET_POS(vict) == POS_DEAD) {
  1525:           if (msg->die_msg.attacker_msg) {
  1526:             send_to_char(ch, CCYEL(ch, C_CMP));
  1527:             apply_severity_verb(wmsg_att, sizeof(wmsg_att), msg->die_msg.attacker_msg, damage_severity_tier(dam, vict));
  1528:             act(wmsg_att, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1529:             send_to_char(ch, CCNRM(ch, C_CMP));
  1530:           }
  1531: 
  1532:           send_to_char(vict, CCRED(vict, C_CMP));
  1533:           apply_severity_verb(wmsg_vic, sizeof(wmsg_vic), msg->die_msg.victim_msg, damage_severity_tier(dam, vict));
  1534:           act(wmsg_vic, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
  1535:           send_to_char(vict, CCNRM(vict, C_CMP));
  1536: 
  1537:           apply_severity_verb(wmsg_room, sizeof(wmsg_room), msg->die_msg.room_msg, damage_severity_tier(dam, vict));
  1538:           act(wmsg_room, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
  1539:         } else {
  1540:           if (msg->hit_msg.attacker_msg) {
  1541:             send_to_char(ch, CCYEL(ch, C_CMP));
  1542:             apply_severity_verb(wmsg_att, sizeof(wmsg_att), msg->hit_msg.attacker_msg, damage_severity_tier(dam, vict));
  1543:             act(wmsg_att, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1544:             send_to_char(ch, CCNRM(ch, C_CMP));
  1545:           }
  1546: 
  1547:           send_to_char(vict, CCRED(vict, C_CMP));
  1548:           apply_severity_verb(wmsg_vic, sizeof(wmsg_vic), msg->hit_msg.victim_msg, damage_severity_tier(dam, vict));
  1549:           act(wmsg_vic, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
  1550:           send_to_char(vict, CCNRM(vict, C_CMP));
  1551: 
  1552:           apply_severity_verb(wmsg_room, sizeof(wmsg_room), msg->hit_msg.room_msg, damage_severity_tier(dam, vict));
  1553:           act(wmsg_room, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
  1554:         }
  1555:       } else if (ch != vict) {	/* Dam == 0 */
  1556:         if (msg->miss_msg.attacker_msg) {
  1557:           send_to_char(ch, CCYEL(ch, C_CMP));
  1558:           act(msg->miss_msg.attacker_msg, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_CHAR);
  1559:           send_to_char(ch, CCNRM(ch, C_CMP));
  1560:         }
  1561: 
  1562:         send_to_char(vict, CCRED(vict, C_CMP));
  1563:         act(msg->miss_msg.victim_msg, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
  1564:         send_to_char(vict, CCNRM(vict, C_CMP));
  1565: 
  1566:         act(msg->miss_msg.room_msg, FALSE, ch, weap, vict, TO_NOTVICT);
  1567:       }
  1568:       return (1);
  1569:     }
  1570:   }
  1571:   return (0);
  1572: }
  1573: 
  1574: /* This function returns the following codes:
  1575:  *	< 0	Victim died.
  1576:  *	= 0	No damage.
  1577:  *	> 0	How much damage done. */
  1578: 
  1579: /* dual wield offhand system */
  1580: static int g_offhand_attack = 0;
  1581: 
  1582: static int offhand_attack_chance(int skill)
  1583: {
  1584:   return MIN(95, 25 + (MAX(0, skill) * 3 / 4));
  1585: }
  1586: 
  1587: static int offhand_damage_percent(int skill)
  1588: {
  1589:   return 40 + (MAX(0, skill) / 2);
  1590: }
  1591: 
  1592: static int can_offhand_attack(struct char_data *ch)
  1593: {
  1594:   struct obj_data *prim = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD);
  1595:   struct obj_data *off  = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD);
  1596: 
  1597:   if (!ch) return 0;
  1598:   /* NPC offhand equipment is cosmetic until an explicit NPC proficiency
  1599:    * policy is designed.  Never access player skill storage for mobiles. */
  1600:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) return 0;
  1601:   if (!prim || !off) return 0;
  1602:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(prim) != ITEM_WEAPON) return 0;
  1603:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(off)  != ITEM_WEAPON) return 0;
  1604: 
  1605:   if (!GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_DUAL_WIELD)) return 0;
  1606:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(prim, ITEM_TWO_HANDER)) return 0;
  1607:   if (!OBJ_FLAGGED(off, ITEM_OFFHAND)) return 0;
  1608:   if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_SHIELD)) return 0;
  1609:   if (GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(off) > GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(prim)) return 0;
  1610: 
  1611:   return 1;
  1612: }
  1613: 
  1614: static int find_affect_modifier_for_flag(struct char_data *ch, int aff_flag, int fallback)
  1615: {
  1616:   struct affected_type *af;
  1617: 
  1618:   if (!ch)
  1619:     return fallback;
  1620: 
  1621:   for (af = ch->affected; af; af = af->next)
  1622:     if (IS_SET_AR(af->bitvector, aff_flag))
  1623:       return af->modifier;
  1624: 
  1625:   return fallback;
  1626: }
  1627: 
  1628: static int remove_affects_by_flag(struct char_data *ch, int aff_flag)
  1629: {
  1630:   struct affected_type *af, *next;
  1631:   int removed = 0;
  1632: 
  1633:   if (!ch)
  1634:     return 0;
  1635: 
  1636:   for (af = ch->affected; af; af = next) {
  1637:     next = af->next;
  1638:     if (IS_SET_AR(af->bitvector, aff_flag)) {
  1639:       affect_remove(ch, af);
  1640:       removed = 1;
  1641:     }
  1642:   }
  1643: 
  1644:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, aff_flag)) {
  1645:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(ch), aff_flag);
  1646:     removed = 1;
  1647:   }
  1648: 
  1649:   return removed;
  1650: }
  1651: 
  1652: static void do_offhand_attack(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
  1653: {
  1654:   struct obj_data *prim = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD);
  1655:   struct obj_data *off  = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD);
  1656: 
  1657:   if (!can_offhand_attack(ch)) return;
  1658:   if (!victim) return;
  1659:   if (rand_number(1, 100) > offhand_attack_chance(GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_DUAL_WIELD)))
  1660:     return;
  1661: 
  1662:   ch->equipment[WEAR_WIELD] = off;
  1663:   g_offhand_attack = 1;
  1664:   hit(ch, victim, TYPE_UNDEFINED);
  1665:   g_offhand_attack = 0;
  1666:   ch->equipment[WEAR_WIELD] = prim;
  1667: }
  1668: 
  1669: int damage(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim, int dam, int attacktype)
  1670: {
  1671:   /* OFFHAND DAMAGE SCALE */
  1672:   if (g_offhand_attack) {
  1673:     dam = (dam * offhand_damage_percent(GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_DUAL_WIELD))) / 100;
  1674:   }
  1675: 
  1676:   int damage_type = take_next_damage_type();
  1677:   int old_hit = 0;
  1678:   int old_band = 0;
  1679:   long local_gold = 0, happy_gold = 0;
  1680:   char local_buf[256];
  1681:   struct char_data *tmp_char;
  1682:   struct obj_data *corpse_obj;
  1683: 
  1684:   if (GET_POS(victim) <= POS_DEAD) {
  1685:     /* This is "normal"-ish now with delayed extraction. -gg 3/15/2001 */
  1686:     if (PLR_FLAGGED(victim, PLR_NOTDEADYET) || MOB_FLAGGED(victim, MOB_NOTDEADYET))
  1687:       return (-1);
  1688: 
  1689:     log("SYSERR: Attempt to damage corpse '%s' in room #%d by '%s'.",
  1690:         GET_NAME(victim), GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(victim)), GET_NAME(ch));
  1691:     die(victim, ch);
  1692:     return (-1);			/* -je, 7/7/92 */
  1693:   }
  1694: 
  1695:   if (ch && victim != ch && is_owned_follower_target(ch, victim)) {
  1696:     if (!IS_NPC(ch))
  1697:       send_to_char(ch, "You cannot attack one of your own followers.\r\n");
  1698:     return (0);
  1699:   }
  1700: 
  1701:   /* peaceful rooms */
  1702:   if (ch->nr != real_mobile(DG_CASTER_PROXY) &&
  1703:       ch != victim && ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(ch), ROOM_PEACEFUL)) {
  1704:     send_to_char(ch, "This room just has such a peaceful, easy feeling...\r\n");
  1705:     return (0);
  1706:   }
  1707: 
  1708:   /* shopkeeper and MOB_NOKILL protection */
  1709:   if (!ok_damage_shopkeeper(ch, victim) || MOB_FLAGGED(victim, MOB_NOKILL)) {
  1710:     send_to_char(ch, "This mob is protected.\r\n");
  1711:     return (0);
  1712:   }
  1713: 
  1714:   /* You can't damage an immortal! */
  1715:   if (!IS_NPC(victim) && ((GET_LEVEL(victim) >= LVL_IMMORT) && PRF_FLAGGED(victim, PRF_NOHASSLE)))
  1716:     dam = 0;
  1717: 
  1718:   dam = damage_mtrigger(ch, victim, dam, attacktype);
  1719:   if (dam == -1) {
  1720:   	return (0);
  1721:   }
  1722: 
  1723:   if (dam > 0 &&
  1724:       ch &&
  1725:       ch != victim &&
  1726:       IS_SPELL(attacktype) &&
  1727:       affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_TRIPLE_MAXIMIZE_MAGIC)) {
  1728:     dam *= 3;
  1729:     affect_from_char(ch, SPELL_TRIPLE_MAXIMIZE_MAGIC);
  1730:   }
  1731: 
  1732:   if (dam > 0 && IS_WEAPON(attacktype) && victim != ch && AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_PHASE) && rand_number(1, 100) <= 30) {
  1733:     act("$N phases out of alignment and your attack passes through harmlessly!", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_CHAR);
  1734:     act("$n's attack passes through you as you phase out of alignment!", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_VICT);
  1735:     act("$n's attack passes right through $N!", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_NOTVICT);
  1736:     dam = 0;
  1737:   }
  1738:   if (dam > 0 && IS_WEAPON(attacktype) && victim != ch && AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_MIRROR_IMAGE) && rand_number(1, 100) <= 20) {
  1739:     act("Your strike shatters one of $N's mirror images!", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_CHAR);
  1740:     act("$n strikes one of your mirror images, which shatters!", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_VICT);
  1741:     act("$n strikes one of $N's mirror images, which shatters!", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_NOTVICT);
  1742:     dam = 0;
  1743:   }
  1744:   if (dam > 0 && IS_WEAPON(attacktype) && victim != ch &&
  1745:       GET_SKILL(victim, SKILL_MONARCH_REFLEXES) > 0 &&
  1746:       !affected_by_spell(victim, SKILL_MONARCH_REFLEXES) &&
  1747:       rand_number(1, 100) <= 10) {
  1748:     struct affected_type af;
  1749:     new_affect(&af);
  1750:     af.spell = SKILL_MONARCH_REFLEXES;
  1751:     af.duration = 100;
  1752:     af.location = APPLY_NONE;
  1753:     af.modifier = 1;
  1754:     affect_join(victim, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  1755:     act("You evade the opening strike with monarch reflexes!", FALSE, victim, 0, ch, TO_CHAR);
  1756:     act("$N slips past your opening strike with terrifying reflexes!", FALSE, ch, 0, victim, TO_CHAR);
  1757:     dam = 0;
  1758:   }
  1759: 
  1760:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && ch != victim)
  1761: 
  1762:   if (victim != ch) {
  1763:     /* Start the attacker fighting the victim */
  1764:     if (GET_POS(ch) > POS_STUNNED && (FIGHTING(ch) == NULL))
  1765:       set_fighting(ch, victim);
  1766: 
  1767:     /* Start the victim fighting the attacker */
  1768:     if (GET_POS(victim) > POS_STUNNED && (FIGHTING(victim) == NULL)) {
  1769:       set_fighting(victim, ch);
  1770:       if (MOB_FLAGGED(victim, MOB_MEMORY) && !IS_NPC(ch))
  1771: 	remember(victim, ch);
  1772:     }
  1773:   }
  1774: 
  1775:   /* If you attack a pet, it hates your guts */
  1776:   if (victim->master == ch)
  1777:     stop_follower(victim);
  1778: 
  1779:   /* If the attacker is invisible, he becomes visible */
  1780:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_INVISIBLE) || AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_HIDE))
  1781:     appear(ch);
  1782: 
  1783:   /* Cut damage in half if victim has sanct, to a minimum 1 */
  1784:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_SANCTUARY) && dam >= 2)
  1785:     dam /= 2;
  1786: 
  1787:   if (dam > 0 && AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_MARKED)) {
  1788:     if (affected_by_spell(victim, SPELL_EXECUTION_MARK) &&
  1789:         GET_HIT(victim) * 100 <= GET_MAX_HIT(victim) * 25)
  1790:       dam = (dam * 14) / 10;
  1791:     else
  1792:       dam = (dam * 6) / 5;
  1793:   }
  1794: 
  1795:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_SHADOW_STEP)) {
  1796:     dam = (dam * 110) / 100;
  1797:     affect_from_char(ch, SPELL_SHADOW_STEP);
  1798:   }
  1799:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_SHADOW_EXCHANGE)) {
  1800:     affect_from_char(ch, SPELL_SHADOW_EXCHANGE);
  1801:   }
  1802:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_TOTAL_OCCULTATION)) {
  1803:     dam = (dam * 120) / 100;
  1804:     affect_from_char(ch, SPELL_TOTAL_OCCULTATION);
  1805:   }
  1806: 
  1807:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_PREDATORS_ADVANCE) > 0 &&
  1808:       GET_HIT(victim) * 100 <= GET_MAX_HIT(victim) * 30)
  1809:     dam = (dam * 110) / 100;
  1810: 
  1811:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_KILL_WINDOW) > 0 &&
  1812:       GET_HIT(victim) * 100 <= GET_MAX_HIT(victim) * 25)
  1813:     dam += 4;
  1814: 
  1815:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_ASSASSINS_INTENT) &&
  1816:       (AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_BLIND) || AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_BLINDED_MAGICAL) ||
  1817:        AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_ROOTED) || AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_STUNNED) ||
  1818:        AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_MARKED)))
  1819:     dam = (dam * 110) / 100;
  1820: 
  1821:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_HUNTERS_INSTINCT) &&
  1822:       GET_LEVEL(victim) > GET_LEVEL(ch))
  1823:     dam = (dam * 110) / 100;
  1824: 
  1825:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_DOMINION_OF_SHADOWS) &&
  1826:       damage_type == DAM_SHADOW)
  1827:     dam = (dam * 105) / 100;
  1828: 
  1829:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && attacktype > 0 && attacktype <= MAX_SPELLS &&
  1830:       GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_CHAIN_ASSASSAULT) > 0 &&
  1831:       affected_by_spell(ch, SKILL_CHAIN_ASSASSAULT) &&
  1832:       !IS_SET(spell_info[attacktype].targets, TAR_IGNORE) &&
  1833:       IS_SET(spell_info[attacktype].targets, TAR_CHAR_ROOM)) {
  1834:     dam = (dam * 110) / 100;
  1835:     affect_from_char(ch, SKILL_CHAIN_ASSASSAULT);
  1836:   }
  1837: 
  1838:   if (dam > 0 && ch && !IS_NPC(ch) && victim &&
  1839:       GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_OVERLORD_PRESENCE) > 0 &&
  1840:       IS_NPC(victim) && GET_LEVEL(ch) >= GET_LEVEL(victim) + 10)
  1841:     dam += 2;
  1842: 
  1843:   if (dam > 0 && ch && IS_NPC(ch) && ch->master && !IS_NPC(ch->master) && is_shadow_servant_for(ch->master, ch)) {
  1844:     if (GET_SKILL(ch->master, SKILL_SHADOW_COMMANDER) > 0)
  1845:       dam = (dam * 110) / 100;
  1846:     if (affected_by_spell(ch->master, SPELL_DOMINION_OF_SHADOWS))
  1847:       dam = (dam * 110) / 100;
  1848:     if (room_has_effect(&world[IN_ROOM(ch)], ROOM_EFFECT_SHADOW_DOMAIN))
  1849:       dam = (dam * 110) / 100;
  1850:     if (GET_SKILL(ch->master, SKILL_LEGION_MASTERY) > 0 &&
  1851:         count_shadow_servants_for(ch->master) >= 3)
  1852:       dam = (dam * 105) / 100;
  1853:   }
  1854:   if (dam > 0 && ch && IS_NPC(ch) && ch->master && !IS_NPC(ch->master) &&
  1855:       GET_SKILL(ch->master, SKILL_UNDEAD_COMMAND) > 0 &&
  1856:       GET_CLASS(ch) == CLASS_UNDEAD) {
  1857:     dam = (dam * 110) / 100;
  1858:   }
  1859: 
  1860:   if (dam > 0 && ch && ch != victim && affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_TIME_STOP)) {
  1861:     struct char_data *tch;
  1862:     affect_from_char(ch, SPELL_TIME_STOP);
  1863:     for (tch = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; tch; tch = tch->next_in_room) {
  1864:       if (tch == ch)
  1865:         continue;
  1866:       GET_WAIT_STATE(tch) = 0;
  1867:     }
  1868:     send_to_char(ch, "Your assault shatters the frozen moment.\r\n");
  1869:     act("Time lurches back into motion around $n.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1870:   }
  1871: 
  1872:   if (dam > 0 && AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_STONESKIN) && IS_WEAPON(attacktype)) {
  1873:     dam = MAX(1, dam - 5);
  1874:   }
  1875: 
  1876:   if (dam > 0 && IS_WEAPON(attacktype)) {
  1877:     int armor = compute_armor(victim);
  1878:     dam = (dam * 100) / (100 + armor);
  1879:   }
  1880: 
  1881:   if (dam > 0) {
  1882:     if (affected_by_spell(victim, SPELL_BODY_OF_EFFULGENT_BERYL) &&
  1883:         attacktype > 0 && IS_WEAPON(attacktype)) {
  1884:       dam = (dam * 75) / 100;
  1885:     }
  1886:     if (affected_by_spell(victim, SPELL_CRYSTAL_BODY) &&
  1887:         (damage_type == DAM_FIRE || damage_type == DAM_COLD ||
  1888:          damage_type == DAM_LIGHTNING || damage_type == DAM_ACID)) {
  1889:       dam = (dam * 75) / 100;
  1890:     }
  1891:     if (affected_by_spell(victim, SPELL_PANTHEON) &&
  1892:         (damage_type == DAM_HOLY || damage_type == DAM_SHADOW || damage_type == DAM_ARCANE))
  1893:       dam = (dam * 75) / 100;
  1894:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_ELEMENTAL_WARD_FIRE) && damage_type == DAM_FIRE)
  1895:       dam = (dam * 6) / 10;
  1896:     else if (AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_ELEMENTAL_WARD_COLD) && damage_type == DAM_COLD)
  1897:       dam = (dam * 6) / 10;
  1898:     else if (AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_ELEMENTAL_WARD_LIGHTNING) && damage_type == DAM_LIGHTNING)
  1899:       dam = (dam * 6) / 10;
  1900:     else if (AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_ELEMENTAL_WARD_ACID) && damage_type == DAM_ACID)
  1901:       dam = (dam * 6) / 10;
  1902:     if (affected_by_spell(victim, SPELL_SHADOW_ARMOR) &&
  1903:         (damage_type == DAM_SHADOW || damage_type == DAM_FORCE))
  1904:       dam = (dam * 8) / 10;
  1905:   }
  1906: 
  1907:   if (dam > 0 && AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_WARDED) &&
  1908:       attacktype > 0 && attacktype <= MAX_SPELLS)
  1909:     dam = (dam * 7) / 10;
  1910: 
  1911:   if (dam > 0 && damage_type == DAM_LIGHTNING && AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_STATIC)) {
  1912:     dam = (dam * 125) / 100;
  1913:     if (remove_affects_by_flag(victim, AFF_STATIC))
  1914:       send_to_char(victim, "The static charge around you dissipates.\r\n");
  1915:   }
  1916: 
  1917:   if (dam > 0 && ch && affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_DESPAIR_AURA) &&
  1918:       GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_DREAD_DOMINION) > 0 &&
  1919:       (damage_type == DAM_SHADOW || damage_type == DAM_NECROTIC))
  1920:     dam = (dam * 105) / 100;
  1921: 
  1922:   if (dam > 0 && victim && IS_SPELL(attacktype) && GET_MAX_HIT(victim) > 0) {
  1923:     int half_max = GET_MAX_HIT(victim) / 2;
  1924:     if (dam > half_max)
  1925:       dam = half_max + (dam / 4);
  1926:   }
  1927: 
  1928: 
  1929:   /* Melee crits (only weapon attacks) */
  1930:   if (dam > 0 && ch && victim && ch != victim && IS_WEAPON(attacktype)) {
  1931:     if (GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_CHAIN_ASSASSAULT) > 0) {
  1932:       struct affected_type af;
  1933:       new_affect(&af);
  1934:       af.spell = SKILL_CHAIN_ASSASSAULT;
  1935:       af.duration = 1;
  1936:       af.location = APPLY_NONE;
  1937:       af.modifier = 1;
  1938:       affect_join(ch, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  1939:     }
  1940:     int mult = 200;
  1941:     if (crit_check_melee(ch, &mult)) {
  1942:       dam = (dam * mult) / 100;
  1943:       crit_show_banner(ch, victim, mult);
  1944:     }
  1945:   }
  1946: 
  1947:   /* Check for PK if this is not a PK MUD */
  1948:   if (!CONFIG_PK_ALLOWED) {
  1949:     check_killer(ch, victim);
  1950:     if (PLR_FLAGGED(ch, PLR_KILLER) && (ch != victim))
  1951:       dam = 0;
  1952:   }
  1953: 
  1954:   /* Set the maximum damage per round and subtract the hit points */
  1955:   dam = MAX(MIN(dam, 1000), 0);
  1956:   if (dam > 0 && AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_SHIELDED)) {
  1957:     struct affected_type *af;
  1958:     for (af = victim->affected; af; af = af->next) {
  1959:       if (IS_SET_AR(af->bitvector, AFF_SHIELDED)) {
  1960:         int absorbed = MIN(dam, MAX(0, af->modifier));
  1961:         af->modifier = MAX(0, af->modifier - absorbed);
  1962:         dam -= absorbed;
  1963:         if (absorbed > 0) {
  1964:           send_to_char(victim, "Your protective shield absorbs %d damage.\r\n", absorbed);
  1965:           if (ch && ch != victim)
  1966:             send_to_char(ch, "%s's shield absorbs part of your attack.\r\n", GET_NAME(victim));
  1967:         }
  1968:         if (af->modifier <= 0) {
  1969:           act("Your protective shield shatters!", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_CHAR);
  1970:           act("$n's protective shield shatters!", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1971:           affect_remove(victim, af);
  1972:         }
  1973:         break;
  1974:       }
  1975:     }
  1976:   }
  1977: 
  1978:   if (dam > 0 && AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_DEATH_WARD) && GET_HIT(victim) - dam < 1) {
  1979:     struct affected_type *af;
  1980:     for (af = victim->affected; af; af = af->next) {
  1981:       if (IS_SET_AR(af->bitvector, AFF_DEATH_WARD)) {
  1982:         affect_remove(victim, af);
  1983:         break;
  1984:       }
  1985:     }
  1986:     send_to_char(victim, "A death ward flares and saves you from a killing blow!\r\n");
  1987:     act("A death ward flares around $n, snatching $m from death!", TRUE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  1988:     dam = MAX(0, GET_HIT(victim) - 1);
  1989:   }
  1990: 
  1991:   if (dam > 0 && affected_by_spell(victim, SPELL_UNDYING_WILL) && GET_HIT(victim) - dam < 1) {
  1992:     struct affected_type af;
  1993:     affect_from_char(victim, SPELL_UNDYING_WILL);
  1994:     GET_HIT(victim) = 1;
  1995:     GET_MANA(victim) = MIN(GET_MAX_MANA(victim), GET_MANA(victim) + (GET_LEVEL(victim) * 2));
  1996:     new_affect(&af);
  1997:     af.spell = SPELL_UNDYING_WILL;
  1998:     af.duration = 1;
  1999:     af.location = APPLY_NONE;
  2000:     SET_BIT_AR(af.bitvector, AFF_STUNNED);
  2001:     affect_join(victim, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2002:     send_to_char(victim, "Your undying will drags you back from the brink!\r\n");
  2003:     act("$n refuses death through sheer will!", TRUE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2004:     dam = 0;
  2005:   }
  2006: 
  2007:   old_hit = GET_HIT(victim);
  2008:   old_band = victim_condition_band(victim);
  2009:   GET_HIT(victim) -= dam;
  2010: 
  2011:   /* Gain exp for the hit */
  2012:   if (ch != victim)
  2013: 
  2014:   update_pos(victim);
  2015: 
  2016:   /* skill_message sends a message from the messages file in lib/misc.
  2017:    * dam_message just sends a generic "You hit $n extremely hard.".
  2018:    * skill_message is preferable to dam_message because it is more
  2019:    * descriptive.
  2020:    *
  2021:    * If we are _not_ attacking with a weapon (i.e. a spell), always use
  2022:    * skill_message. If we are attacking with a weapon: If this is a miss or a
  2023:    * death blow, send a skill_message if one exists; if not, default to a
  2024:    * dam_message. Otherwise, always send a dam_message. */
  2025:   if (!IS_WEAPON(attacktype)) {
  2026:     /* Always add a short severity verb line for spells, skills, DoTs. */
  2027:     int shown = skill_message(dam, ch, victim, attacktype);
  2028:     if (!shown && dam > 0 && IN_ROOM(victim) != NOWHERE) {
  2029:       static const char *const v3[] = {
  2030:         "misses", "grazes", "glances", "hits", "strikes", "slams", "crushes", "blasts", "shreds", "pulverizes"
  2031:       };
  2032:       static const char *const v3_past[] = {
  2033:         "missed", "grazed", "glanced", "hit", "struck", "slammed", "crushed", "blasted", "shredded", "pulverized"
  2034:       };
  2035:       int tier = damage_severity_tier(dam, victim);
  2036:       const char *col = severity_color(tier);
  2037:       const char *pre = severity_impact_wrap_open(tier);
  2038:       const char *post = severity_impact_wrap_close(tier);
  2039:       if (tier < 0) tier = 0;
  2040:       if (tier > 9) tier = 9;
  2041:       if (ch) {
  2042:         char to_char[160], to_vict[160], to_room[160];
  2043:         snprintf(to_char, sizeof(to_char), "Your magic %s%s%s%s\tn $N.", col, pre, v3[tier], post);
  2044:         snprintf(to_vict, sizeof(to_vict), "$n's magic %s%s%s%s\tn you.", col, pre, v3[tier], post);
  2045:         snprintf(to_room, sizeof(to_room), "$n's magic %s%s%s%s\tn $N.", col, pre, v3[tier], post);
  2046:         act(to_room, FALSE, ch, NULL, victim, TO_NOTVICT);
  2047:         act(to_char, FALSE, ch, NULL, victim, TO_CHAR);
  2048:         act(to_vict, FALSE, ch, NULL, victim, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
  2049:       } else {
  2050:         send_to_char(victim, "Lingering magic %s%s%s%s\tn you.\r\n", col, pre, v3[tier], post);
  2051:         {
  2052:           char roommsg[160];
  2053:           snprintf(roommsg, sizeof(roommsg), "$n is %s%s%s%s\tn by lingering magic.", col, pre, v3_past[tier], post);
  2054:           act(roommsg, TRUE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2055:         }
  2056:       }
  2057:     } else if (!shown) {
  2058:       /* If a spell has no messages and did 0 damage, still show something. */
  2059:       if (ch) {
  2060:         act("Your magic misses $N.", FALSE, ch, NULL, victim, TO_CHAR);
  2061:         act("$n's magic misses you.", FALSE, ch, NULL, victim, TO_VICT | TO_SLEEP);
  2062:         act("$n's magic misses $N.", FALSE, ch, NULL, victim, TO_NOTVICT);
  2063:       } else {
  2064:         send_to_char(victim, "You suffer.\r\n");
  2065:         act("$n suffers.", TRUE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2066:       }
  2067:     }
  2068:   } else {
  2069:     if (GET_POS(victim) == POS_DEAD || dam == 0) {
  2070:       if (!skill_message(dam, ch, victim, attacktype))
  2071: 	dam_message(dam, ch, victim, attacktype);
  2072:     } else {
  2073:       dam_message(dam, ch, victim, attacktype);
  2074:     }
  2075:   }
  2076:   if (ch && victim && ch != victim && GET_POS(victim) > POS_DEAD && dam > 0) {
  2077:     int new_band = victim_condition_band(victim);
  2078:     int tier = damage_severity_tier(dam, victim);
  2079: 
  2080:     if ((new_band > old_band && tier >= 4) || tier >= 7) {
  2081:       send_to_char(ch, "\tC%s %s\tn\r\n", PERS(victim, ch), victim_condition_text(new_band));
  2082:       if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT && CONFIG_DEBUG_MODE >= NRM)
  2083:         send_to_char(ch, "\tD(cond: %d%% -> %d%%)\tn\r\n",
  2084:                      (old_hit * 100) / MAX(1, GET_MAX_HIT(victim)),
  2085:                      (GET_HIT(victim) * 100) / MAX(1, GET_MAX_HIT(victim)));
  2086:     }
  2087:   }
  2088: 
  2089: 
  2090:   /* Use send_to_char -- act() doesn't send message if you are DEAD. */
  2091:   switch (GET_POS(victim)) {
  2092:   case POS_MORTALLYW:
  2093:     act("$n is mortally wounded, and will die soon, if not aided.", TRUE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2094:     send_to_char(victim, "You are mortally wounded, and will die soon, if not aided.\r\n");
  2095:     break;
  2096:   case POS_INCAP:
  2097:     act("$n is incapacitated and will slowly die, if not aided.", TRUE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2098:     send_to_char(victim, "You are incapacitated and will slowly die, if not aided.\r\n");
  2099:     break;
  2100:   case POS_STUNNED:
  2101:     act("$n is stunned, but will probably regain consciousness again.", TRUE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2102:     send_to_char(victim, "You're stunned, but will probably regain consciousness again.\r\n");
  2103:     break;
  2104:   case POS_DEAD:
  2105:     act("$n is dead!  \tYR.I.P.\tn", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2106:     send_to_char(victim, "You are dead!  Sorry...\r\n");
  2107:     break;
  2108: 
  2109:   default:			/* >= POSITION SLEEPING */
  2110:     if (dam > (GET_MAX_HIT(victim) / 4))
  2111:       send_to_char(victim, "That really did HURT!\r\n");
  2112: 
  2113:     if (GET_HIT(victim) < (GET_MAX_HIT(victim) / 4)) {
  2114:       send_to_char(victim, "%sYou wish that your wounds would stop BLEEDING so much!%s\r\n",
  2115: 		CCRED(victim, C_SPR), CCNRM(victim, C_SPR));
  2116:     }
  2117:     if (ch != victim && IS_NPC(victim) &&
  2118:         MOB_FLAGGED(victim, MOB_WIMPY) && !MOB_FLAGGED(victim, MOB_HELPER) &&
  2119:         GET_HIT(victim) > 0) {
  2120:       int flee_threshold = GET_MOB_WIMP_LEV(victim);
  2121: 
  2122:       /* Legacy fallback: old behavior when no mob-specific threshold is set. */
  2123:       if (flee_threshold <= 0)
  2124:         flee_threshold = GET_MAX_HIT(victim) / 4;
  2125: 
  2126:       if (GET_HIT(victim) < flee_threshold)
  2127:         do_flee(victim, NULL, 0, 0);
  2128:     }
  2129:     if (!IS_NPC(victim) && GET_WIMP_LEV(victim) && (victim != ch) &&
  2130: 	GET_HIT(victim) < GET_WIMP_LEV(victim) && GET_HIT(victim) > 0) {
  2131:       send_to_char(victim, "You wimp out, and attempt to flee!\r\n");
  2132:       do_flee(victim, NULL, 0, 0);
  2133:     }
  2134:     break;
  2135:   }
  2136: 
  2137:   /* Help out poor linkless people who are attacked */
  2138:   if (!IS_NPC(victim) && !(victim->desc) && GET_POS(victim) > POS_STUNNED) {
  2139:     do_flee(victim, NULL, 0, 0);
  2140:     if (!FIGHTING(victim)) {
  2141:       act("$n is rescued by divine forces.", FALSE, victim, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2142:       GET_WAS_IN(victim) = IN_ROOM(victim);
  2143:       char_from_room(victim);
  2144:       char_to_room(victim, 0);
  2145:     }
  2146:   }
  2147: 
  2148:   /* stop someone from fighting if they're stunned or worse */
  2149:   if (GET_POS(victim) <= POS_STUNNED && FIGHTING(victim) != NULL)
  2150:     stop_fighting(victim);
  2151: 
  2152:   /* Uh oh.  Victim died. */
  2153:   if (GET_POS(victim) == POS_DEAD) {
  2154:     struct char_data *reward_killer = resolve_reward_killer(ch);
  2155: 
  2156:     if (ch && reward_killer && reward_killer != ch &&
  2157:         CONFIG_DEBUG_MODE >= NRM && GET_LEVEL(reward_killer) >= LVL_BUILDER) {
  2158:       send_to_char(reward_killer,
  2159:         "\t1Combat Debug:\r\n"
  2160:         "   \t2Kill Attribution:\t3%s credited via %s\tn\r\n",
  2161:         GET_NAME(reward_killer), GET_NAME(ch));
  2162:     }
  2163: 
  2164:     if (ch != victim && ch && !IS_NPC(ch) &&
  2165:         GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_TACTICAL_SPELL_MEMORY) > 0 &&
  2166:         attacktype > 0 && attacktype <= MAX_SPELLS) {
  2167:       int mana_refund = MAX(1, GET_LEVEL(ch) / 4);
  2168:       GET_MANA(ch) = MIN(effective_max_mana(ch), GET_MANA(ch) + mana_refund);
  2169:       send_to_char(ch, "You retain tactical spell memory and recover %d mana.\r\n", mana_refund);
  2170:     }
  2171: 
  2172:     if (reward_killer && reward_killer != victim && !IS_NPC(reward_killer) &&
  2173:         (IS_NPC(victim) || victim->desc)) {
  2174:       if (GROUP(reward_killer))
  2175: 	group_gain(reward_killer, victim);
  2176:       else
  2177:         solo_gain(reward_killer, victim);
  2178:     }
  2179: 
  2180:     if (!IS_NPC(victim)) {
  2181:       mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, MAX(GET_INVIS_LEV(ch), GET_INVIS_LEV(victim))),
  2182:         TRUE, "%s killed by %s at %s", GET_NAME(victim), GET_NAME(ch), world[IN_ROOM(victim)].name);
  2183:       if (MOB_FLAGGED(ch, MOB_MEMORY))
  2184:         forget(ch, victim);
  2185:     }
  2186:     if (reward_killer && reward_killer != victim)
  2187:       grant_glory_for_kill(reward_killer, victim);
  2188:     /* Cant determine GET_GOLD on corpse, so do now and store */
  2189:     if (IS_NPC(victim)) {
  2190:       if ((IS_HAPPYHOUR) && (IS_HAPPYGOLD))
  2191:       {
  2192:         happy_gold = (long)(GET_GOLD(victim) * (((float)(HAPPY_GOLD))/(float)100));
  2193:         happy_gold = MAX(0, happy_gold);
  2194:         increase_gold(victim, happy_gold);
  2195:       }
  2196:       local_gold = GET_GOLD(victim);
  2197:       sprintf(local_buf,"%ld", (long)local_gold);
  2198:     }
  2199: 
  2200:     die(victim, reward_killer);
  2201:     if (reward_killer && GROUP(reward_killer) && (local_gold > 0) && PRF_FLAGGED(reward_killer, PRF_AUTOSPLIT) ) {
  2202:       generic_find("corpse", FIND_OBJ_ROOM, reward_killer, &tmp_char, &corpse_obj);
  2203:       if (corpse_obj) {
  2204:         do_get(reward_killer, "all.coin corpse", 0, 0);
  2205:         do_split(reward_killer, local_buf, 0, 0);
  2206:       }
  2207:       /* need to remove the gold from the corpse */
  2208:     } else if (reward_killer && !IS_NPC(reward_killer) && (reward_killer != victim) && PRF_FLAGGED(reward_killer, PRF_AUTOGOLD)) {
  2209:       do_get(reward_killer, "all.coin corpse", 0, 0);
  2210:     }
  2211:     if (reward_killer && !IS_NPC(reward_killer) && (reward_killer != victim) && PRF_FLAGGED(reward_killer, PRF_AUTOLOOT)) {
  2212:       do_get(reward_killer, "all corpse", 0, 0);
  2213:     }
  2214:     if (reward_killer && IS_NPC(victim) && !IS_NPC(reward_killer) && PRF_FLAGGED(reward_killer, PRF_AUTOSAC)) {
  2215:       do_sac(reward_killer,"corpse",0,0);
  2216:     }
  2217:     return (-1);
  2218:   }
  2219:   return (dam);
  2220: }
  2221: 
  2222: /* Calculate the THAC0 of the attacker. 'victim' currently isn't used but you
  2223:  * could use it for special cases like weapons that hit evil creatures easier
  2224:  * or a weapon that always misses attacking an animal. */
  2225: static int compute_thaco(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
  2226: {
  2227:   int calc_thaco;
  2228:   int situational_hit_bonus = 0;
  2229:   int level_gap_bonus = 0;
  2230: 
  2231:   if (!IS_NPC(ch))
  2232:     calc_thaco = thaco(GET_CLASS(ch), GET_LEVEL(ch));
  2233:   else		/* THAC0 for monsters is set in the HitRoll */
  2234:     calc_thaco = 20;
  2235:   calc_thaco -= str_app[STRENGTH_APPLY_INDEX(ch)].tohit;
  2236:   calc_thaco -= GET_HITROLL(ch);
  2237:   calc_thaco -= (int) ((GET_INT(ch) - 13) / 1.5);	/* Intelligence helps! */
  2238:   calc_thaco -= (int) ((GET_WIS(ch) - 13) / 1.5);	/* So does wisdom */
  2239:   if (victim)
  2240:     level_gap_bonus = (GET_LEVEL(ch) - GET_LEVEL(victim)) / 3;
  2241:   calc_thaco -= level_gap_bonus;
  2242:   situational_hit_bonus = concealment_hit_modifier(ch, victim);
  2243:   calc_thaco -= situational_hit_bonus;
  2244:   return MAX(1, calc_thaco);
  2245: }
  2246: 
  2247: void hit(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim, int type)
  2248: {
  2249:   struct obj_data *wielded = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD);
  2250:   int w_type, attacker_hit, defender_evasion, hit_chance, dam;
  2251:   int thaco_legacy, victim_ac_legacy, diceroll_legacy;
  2252:   int attacker_level, victim_level, hitroll_bonus, stat_bonus, mental_bonus;
  2253:   int level_gap_bonus, situational_bonus, defender_level_bonus;
  2254:   int shadow_assist_bonus = 0;
  2255:   int melee_level_bonus = 0;
  2256:   int final_hit_roll;
  2257: 
  2258:   /* Check that the attacker and victim exist */
  2259:   if (!ch || !victim) return;
  2260:   if (is_owned_follower_target(ch, victim)) {
  2261:     if (!IS_NPC(ch))
  2262:       send_to_char(ch, "You cannot attack one of your own followers.\r\n");
  2263:     return;
  2264:   }
  2265: 
  2266:   /* check if the character has a fight trigger */
  2267:   fight_mtrigger(ch);
  2268: 
  2269:   /* Do some sanity checking, in case someone flees, etc. */
  2270:   if (IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(victim)) {
  2271:     if (FIGHTING(ch) && FIGHTING(ch) == victim)
  2272:       stop_fighting(ch);
  2273:     return;
  2274:   }
  2275: 
  2276:   /* Find the weapon type (for display purposes only) */
  2277:   if (wielded && GET_OBJ_TYPE(wielded) == ITEM_WEAPON)
  2278:     w_type = GET_OBJ_VAL(wielded, 3) + TYPE_HIT;
  2279:   else {
  2280:     if (IS_NPC(ch) && ch->mob_specials.attack_type != 0)
  2281:       w_type = ch->mob_specials.attack_type + TYPE_HIT;
  2282:     else
  2283:       w_type = TYPE_HIT;
  2284:   }
  2285: 
  2286:   attacker_level = GET_LEVEL(ch);
  2287:   victim_level = GET_LEVEL(victim);
  2288:   hitroll_bonus = GET_HITROLL(ch);
  2289:   stat_bonus = str_app[STRENGTH_APPLY_INDEX(ch)].tohit;
  2290:   mental_bonus = (GET_INT(ch) - 10) / 4 + (GET_WIS(ch) - 10) / 4;
  2291:   if (attacker_level > victim_level)
  2292:     level_gap_bonus = ((attacker_level - victim_level) / 2) + ((attacker_level - victim_level) / 4);
  2293:   else if (attacker_level < victim_level)
  2294:     level_gap_bonus = (attacker_level - victim_level) / 3;
  2295:   else
  2296:     level_gap_bonus = 0;
  2297:   situational_bonus = concealment_hit_modifier(ch, victim);
  2298: 
  2299:   if (IS_NPC(ch) && ch->master && !IS_NPC(ch->master) &&
  2300:       is_shadow_servant_for(ch->master, ch) && victim && IS_NPC(victim)) {
  2301:     int owner_gap = GET_LEVEL(ch->master) - GET_LEVEL(victim);
  2302:     if (owner_gap >= 8)
  2303:       shadow_assist_bonus = MIN(14, 4 + (owner_gap / 4));
  2304:   }
  2305: 
  2306:   attacker_hit = 30 + attacker_level + hitroll_bonus + stat_bonus +
  2307:                  mental_bonus + level_gap_bonus + situational_bonus + shadow_assist_bonus;
  2308:   defender_evasion = compute_defensive_evasion_value(victim, &defender_level_bonus);
  2309:   hit_chance = compute_hit_chance_from_values(attacker_hit, defender_evasion);
  2310:   final_hit_roll = rand_number(1, 100);
  2311:   thaco_legacy = compute_thaco(ch, victim);
  2312:   victim_ac_legacy = compute_armor_class(victim) / 10;
  2313:   victim_ac_legacy = MAX(-10, MIN(10, victim_ac_legacy));
  2314:   diceroll_legacy = rand_number(1, 20);
  2315: 
  2316:   /* report for debugging if necessary */
  2317:   if (CONFIG_DEBUG_MODE >= NRM && GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_BUILDER)
  2318:     send_to_char(ch,
  2319:       "\t1Combat Debug:\r\n"
  2320:       "   \t2Attacker Lvl:\t3%d\r\n"
  2321:       "   \t2Victim Lvl:\t3%d\r\n"
  2322:       "   \t2Accuracy Value:\t3%d\r\n"
  2323:       "   \t2Evasion Value:\t3%d\r\n"
  2324:       "   \t2Hitroll Contribution:\t3%d\r\n"
  2325:       "   \t2Stat Contribution:\t3%d (STR) + %d (INT/WIS)\r\n"
  2326:       "   \t2Level-gap Contribution:\t3%d\r\n"
  2327:       "   \t2Shadow Assist Contribution:\t3%d\r\n"
  2328:       "   \t2Defender Level Contribution:\t3%d\r\n"
  2329:       "   \t2Final Hit Chance:\t3%d%%\r\n"
  2330:       "   \t2Final Hit Roll:\t3%d\r\n"
  2331:       "   \t2Legacy THAC0 Check:\t3THAC0 %d vs AC %d on d20(%d)\tn\r\n",
  2332:       attacker_level, victim_level, attacker_hit, defender_evasion, hitroll_bonus,
  2333:       stat_bonus, mental_bonus, level_gap_bonus, shadow_assist_bonus, defender_level_bonus,
  2334:       hit_chance, final_hit_roll, thaco_legacy, victim_ac_legacy, diceroll_legacy);
  2335: 
  2336:   dam = (!AWAKE(victim) || final_hit_roll <= hit_chance);
  2337: 
  2338:   if (!dam)
  2339:     /* the attacker missed the victim */
  2340:     damage(ch, victim, 0, type == SKILL_BACKSTAB ? SKILL_BACKSTAB : w_type);
  2341:   else {
  2342:     /* okay, we know the guy has been hit.  now calculate damage.
  2343:      * Start with the damage bonuses: the damroll and strength apply */
  2344:     dam = str_app[STRENGTH_APPLY_INDEX(ch)].todam;
  2345:     dam += GET_DAMROLL(ch) * 2;
  2346:     dam += MAX(0, (GET_STR(ch) - 10) / 2);
  2347:     melee_level_bonus = MAX(0, GET_LEVEL(ch) / 10);
  2348:     dam += melee_level_bonus;
  2349: 
  2350:     {
  2351:     int unarmed_base_roll = 0;
  2352:     int unarmed_level_scaling_bonus = 0;
  2353:     int unarmed_skill = 0;
  2354:     int unarmed_skill_bonus = 0;
  2355:     int level_gap_damage_bonus = 0;
  2356: 
  2357:     /* Maybe holding arrow? */
  2358:     if (wielded && GET_OBJ_TYPE(wielded) == ITEM_WEAPON) {
  2359:       /* Add weapon-based damage if a weapon is being wielded */
  2360:       dam += dice(GET_OBJ_VAL(wielded, 1), GET_OBJ_VAL(wielded, 2));
  2361:     } else {
  2362:       /* If no weapon, add bare hand damage instead */
  2363:       if (IS_NPC(ch)) {
  2364:         unarmed_base_roll = dice(ch->mob_specials.damnodice, ch->mob_specials.damsizedice);
  2365:         dam += unarmed_base_roll;
  2366:       } else {
  2367:         int unarmed_num, unarmed_size;
  2368:         int unarmed_component;
  2369: 
  2370:         get_player_unarmed_profile(GET_LEVEL(ch), &unarmed_num, &unarmed_size,
  2371:                                    &unarmed_level_scaling_bonus);
  2372:         unarmed_base_roll = dice(unarmed_num, unarmed_size);
  2373:         unarmed_component = unarmed_base_roll + unarmed_level_scaling_bonus;
  2374:         unarmed_skill = GET_SKILL(ch, SKILL_UNARMED);
  2375:         unarmed_skill_bonus = unarmed_proficiency_bonus(unarmed_component, unarmed_skill);
  2376:         dam += unarmed_component + unarmed_skill_bonus;
  2377:         improve_ability_from_use(ch, SKILL_UNARMED, TRUE);
  2378:       }
  2379:     }
  2380: 
  2381:     if (victim && GET_LEVEL(ch) > GET_LEVEL(victim)) {
  2382:       int level_gap = GET_LEVEL(ch) - GET_LEVEL(victim);
  2383:       level_gap_damage_bonus = MAX(1, level_gap / 6);
  2384:       if (level_gap >= 10)
  2385:         level_gap_damage_bonus += level_gap / 2;
  2386:       dam += level_gap_damage_bonus;
  2387:     }
  2388: 
  2389:     if (CONFIG_DEBUG_MODE >= NRM && GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_BUILDER)
  2390:       send_to_char(ch,
  2391:         "\t1Combat Debug:\r\n"
  2392:         "   \t2Melee Level Bonus:\t3%d\r\n"
  2393:         "   \t2Unarmed Base Damage Roll:\t3%d\r\n"
  2394:         "   \t2Unarmed Level Scaling Bonus:\t3%d\r\n"
  2395:         "   \t2Unarmed Proficiency:\t3%d%%\r\n"
  2396:         "   \t2Unarmed Skill Bonus:\t3%d\r\n"
  2397:         "   \t2Level-gap Damage Bonus:\t3%d\tn\r\n",
  2398:         melee_level_bonus, unarmed_base_roll, unarmed_level_scaling_bonus,
  2399:         unarmed_skill, unarmed_skill_bonus, level_gap_damage_bonus);
  2400:     }
  2401: 
  2402:     /* Include a damage multiplier if victim isn't ready to fight:
  2403:      * Position sitting  1.33 x normal
  2404:      * Position resting  1.66 x normal
  2405:      * Position sleeping 2.00 x normal
  2406:      * Position stunned  2.33 x normal
  2407:      * Position incap    2.66 x normal
  2408:      * Position mortally 3.00 x normal
  2409:      * Note, this is a hack because it depends on the particular
  2410:      * values of the POSITION_XXX constants. */
  2411:     if (GET_POS(victim) < POS_FIGHTING)
  2412:       dam *= 1 + (POS_FIGHTING - GET_POS(victim)) / 3;
  2413: 
  2414:     /* at least 1 hp damage min per hit */
  2415:     dam = MAX(1, dam);
  2416: 
  2417:     if (type == SKILL_BACKSTAB)
  2418:       damage(ch, victim, dam * backstab_mult(GET_LEVEL(ch)), SKILL_BACKSTAB);
  2419:     else
  2420:       damage(ch, victim, dam, w_type);
  2421:   }
  2422: 
  2423:   /* check if the victim has a hitprcnt trigger */
  2424:   hitprcnt_mtrigger(victim);
  2425: }
  2426: 
  2427: static void process_round_effects(void)
  2428: {
  2429:   struct char_data *i, *next_char;
  2430:   room_rnum room;
  2431: 
  2432:   for (i = character_list; i; i = next_char) {
  2433:     next_char = i->next;
  2434:     if (DEAD(i))
  2435:       continue;
  2436: 
  2437:     if (!IS_NPC(i))
  2438:       GET_HP_LAST_ROUND(i) = GET_HIT(i);
  2439: 
  2440:     if (!FIGHTING(i) && affected_by_spell(i, SKILL_MONARCH_REFLEXES))
  2441:       affect_from_char(i, SKILL_MONARCH_REFLEXES);
  2442: 
  2443:     tick_spell_cooldowns(i);
  2444: 
  2445:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_BURNING)) {
  2446:       set_next_damage_type(DAM_FIRE);
  2447:       if (damage(i, i, 5, TYPE_SUFFERING) == -1)
  2448:         continue;
  2449:     }
  2450: 
  2451:     if (affected_by_spell(i, SPELL_MIASMA)) {
  2452:       set_next_damage_type(DAM_POISON);
  2453:       if (damage(i, i, 5, TYPE_SUFFERING) == -1)
  2454:         continue;
  2455:     }
  2456: 
  2457:     if (affected_by_spell(i, SPELL_TOXIC_CLOUD)) {
  2458:       set_next_damage_type(DAM_POISON);
  2459:       if (damage(i, i, 6, TYPE_SUFFERING) == -1)
  2460:         continue;
  2461:       if (rand_number(1, 100) <= 30 && !AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_POISON))
  2462:         call_magic(i, i, NULL, SPELL_POISON, GET_LEVEL(i), CAST_SPELL);
  2463:     }
  2464: 
  2465:     if (affected_by_spell(i, SPELL_HELL_FLAME)) {
  2466:       set_next_damage_type(DAM_FIRE);
  2467:       if (damage(i, i, (GET_LEVEL(i) * 2) + dice(2, MAX(1, GET_LEVEL(i) / 4)), SPELL_HELL_FLAME) == -1)
  2468:         continue;
  2469:     }
  2470: 
  2471:     if (affected_by_spell(i, SPELL_NAPALM)) {
  2472:       set_next_damage_type(DAM_FIRE);
  2473:       if (damage(i, i, (GET_LEVEL(i) * 2) + dice(2, MAX(1, GET_LEVEL(i) / 4)), SPELL_NAPALM) == -1)
  2474:         continue;
  2475:       affect_from_char(i, SPELL_NAPALM);
  2476:     }
  2477: 
  2478:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_ARCANE_LEAK))
  2479:       GET_MANA(i) = MAX(0, GET_MANA(i) - 10);
  2480: 
  2481:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_BLOODLUST))
  2482:       GET_HIT(i) = MAX(1, GET_HIT(i) - 5);
  2483: 
  2484:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_REGENERATING)) {
  2485:       int regen = find_affect_modifier_for_flag(i, AFF_REGENERATING, 0);
  2486:       if (regen > 0)
  2487:         GET_HIT(i) = MIN(GET_MAX_HIT(i), GET_HIT(i) + regen);
  2488:     }
  2489: 
  2490:     if (affected_by_spell(i, SPELL_SOVEREIGNS_STEP))
  2491:       GET_MOVE(i) = MIN(GET_MAX_MOVE(i), GET_MOVE(i) + 10);
  2492: 
  2493:     if (FIGHTING(i) && AFF_FLAGGED(FIGHTING(i), AFF_MARKED)) {
  2494:       GET_MOVE(i) = MIN(GET_MAX_MOVE(i), GET_MOVE(i) + MAX(1, GET_MAX_MOVE(i) / 10));
  2495:       if (GET_SKILL(i, SKILL_RELENTLESS_HUNT) > 0)
  2496:         GET_MOVE(i) = MIN(GET_MAX_MOVE(i), GET_MOVE(i) + 5);
  2497:     }
  2498: 
  2499:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_TIME_SNARE))
  2500:       WAIT_STATE(i, PULSE_VIOLENCE);
  2501: 
  2502:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_FEARFUL) && FIGHTING(i)) {
  2503:       int fear_penalty = find_affect_modifier_for_flag(i, AFF_FEARFUL, 0);
  2504:       if (fear_penalty <= -10 && rand_number(1, 100) <= 60)
  2505:         do_flee(i, NULL, 0, 0);
  2506:       else if (affected_by_spell(i, SPELL_CRY_OF_THE_BANSHEE) && rand_number(1, 100) <= 40)
  2507:         do_flee(i, NULL, 0, 0);
  2508:     }
  2509: 
  2510:     if (affected_by_spell(i, SPELL_KINGS_COMMAND))
  2511:       remove_affects_by_flag(i, AFF_FEARFUL);
  2512: 
  2513:     if ((AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_FEARFUL) || AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_ROOTED) || AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_STUNNED))) {
  2514:       struct char_data *src;
  2515:       for (src = world[IN_ROOM(i)].people; src; src = src->next_in_room) {
  2516:         if (GET_SKILL(src, SKILL_SOVEREIGN_PRESSURE) <= 0)
  2517:           continue;
  2518:         if (FIGHTING(src) != i && FIGHTING(i) != src)
  2519:           continue;
  2520:         {
  2521:           struct affected_type af;
  2522:           new_affect(&af);
  2523:           af.spell = SKILL_SOVEREIGN_PRESSURE;
  2524:           af.duration = 1;
  2525:           af.location = APPLY_SAVING_SPELL;
  2526:           af.modifier = 1;
  2527:           affect_join(i, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2528:         }
  2529:         break;
  2530:       }
  2531:     }
  2532: 
  2533:     if (!IS_NPC(i) && GET_SKILL(i, SKILL_LEGION_MASTERY) > 0 &&
  2534:         count_shadow_servants_for(i) >= 3) {
  2535:       struct affected_type af;
  2536:       new_affect(&af);
  2537:       af.spell = SKILL_LEGION_MASTERY;
  2538:       af.duration = 1;
  2539:       af.location = APPLY_SAVING_SPELL;
  2540:       af.modifier = -2;
  2541:       affect_join(i, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2542:     }
  2543: 
  2544:     if (IS_NPC(i) && i->master && !IS_NPC(i->master) && is_shadow_servant_for(i->master, i) &&
  2545:         GET_SKILL(i->master, SKILL_SHADOW_COMMANDER) > 0) {
  2546:       struct affected_type af;
  2547:       new_affect(&af);
  2548:       af.spell = SKILL_SHADOW_COMMANDER;
  2549:       af.duration = 1;
  2550:       af.location = APPLY_HITROLL;
  2551:       af.modifier = 2;
  2552:       affect_join(i, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2553:       new_affect(&af);
  2554:       af.spell = SKILL_SHADOW_COMMANDER;
  2555:       af.duration = 1;
  2556:       af.location = APPLY_DAMROLL;
  2557:       af.modifier = 2;
  2558:       affect_join(i, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2559:       GET_HIT(i) = MIN(GET_MAX_HIT(i), GET_HIT(i) + MAX(1, GET_MAX_HIT(i) / 10));
  2560:     }
  2561: 
  2562:     if (IS_NPC(i) && i->master && !IS_NPC(i->master) && GET_SKILL(i->master, SKILL_LEGION_MASTERY) > 0 &&
  2563:         count_shadow_servants_for(i->master) >= 3 && AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_CHARM)) {
  2564:       struct affected_type af;
  2565:       new_affect(&af);
  2566:       af.spell = SKILL_LEGION_MASTERY;
  2567:       af.duration = 1;
  2568:       af.location = APPLY_HITROLL;
  2569:       af.modifier = 1;
  2570:       affect_join(i, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2571:       new_affect(&af);
  2572:       af.spell = SKILL_LEGION_MASTERY;
  2573:       af.duration = 1;
  2574:       af.location = APPLY_DAMROLL;
  2575:       af.modifier = 1;
  2576:       affect_join(i, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2577:     }
  2578: 
  2579:     if (affected_by_spell(i, SPELL_DESPAIR_AURA)) {
  2580:       struct char_data *tch;
  2581:       if (GET_SKILL(i, SKILL_DREAD_DOMINION) > 0) {
  2582:         struct affected_type af;
  2583:         new_affect(&af);
  2584:         af.spell = SKILL_DREAD_DOMINION;
  2585:         af.duration = 1;
  2586:         af.location = APPLY_SAVING_SPELL;
  2587:         af.modifier = 2;
  2588:         affect_join(i, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2589:         new_affect(&af);
  2590:         af.spell = SKILL_DREAD_DOMINION;
  2591:         af.duration = 1;
  2592:         af.location = APPLY_AC;
  2593:         af.modifier = 2;
  2594:         affect_join(i, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2595:       }
  2596:       for (tch = world[IN_ROOM(i)].people; tch; tch = tch->next_in_room) {
  2597:         struct affected_type af;
  2598:         if (tch == i)
  2599:           continue;
  2600:         if (!IS_NPC(tch) && !IS_NPC(i) && !CONFIG_PK_ALLOWED)
  2601:           continue;
  2602:         if (!IS_NPC(i) && IS_NPC(tch) && AFF_FLAGGED(tch, AFF_CHARM))
  2603:           continue;
  2604:         new_affect(&af);
  2605:         af.spell = SKILL_DREAD_DOMINION;
  2606:         af.duration = 1;
  2607:         af.location = APPLY_HITROLL;
  2608:         af.modifier = -4;
  2609:         affect_join(tch, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2610:         new_affect(&af);
  2611:         af.spell = SKILL_DREAD_DOMINION;
  2612:         af.duration = 1;
  2613:         af.location = APPLY_SAVING_SPELL;
  2614:         af.modifier = -2;
  2615:         affect_join(tch, &af, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE);
  2616:         if (FIGHTING(tch) && GET_LEVEL(tch) < GET_LEVEL(i) - 8 && rand_number(1, 100) <= 20)
  2617:           do_flee(tch, NULL, 0, 0);
  2618:       }
  2619:     }
  2620: 
  2621:     if (IS_NPC(i) && GET_SUMMON_TIMER(i) > 0) {
  2622:       GET_SUMMON_TIMER(i)--;
  2623:       if (GET_SUMMON_TIMER(i) <= 0) {
  2624:         struct char_data *owner = i->master;
  2625:         int slot = extracted_shadow_slot(i);
  2626:         if (owner && !IS_NPC(owner) && slot >= 0 && slot < MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER &&
  2627:             SHADOW_SLOT_OCCUPIED(owner, slot)) {
  2628:           SHADOW_SLOT_ACTIVE(owner, slot) = 0;
  2629:           save_char(owner);
  2630:         }
  2631:         act("$n flickers and vanishes as the summoning fades.", FALSE, i, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2632:         prepare_shadow_servant_for_removal(i);
  2633:         extract_char(i);
  2634:       }
  2635:     }
  2636:   }
  2637: 
  2638:   for (room = 0; room <= top_of_world; room++)
  2639:     room_tick_effects(&world[room]);
  2640: }
  2641: 
  2642: /* control the fights going on.  Called every 2 seconds from comm.c. */
  2643: void perform_violence(void)
  2644: {
  2645:   struct char_data *ch, *tch;
  2646:   unsigned long prompt_round;
  2647: 
  2648:   if (++combat_prompt_round == 0)
  2649:     ++combat_prompt_round;
  2650:   prompt_round = combat_prompt_round;
  2651: 
  2652:   if (!violence_tick_running) {
  2653:     violence_tick_running = TRUE;
  2654:     process_round_effects();
  2655:     violence_tick_running = FALSE;
  2656:   }
  2657: 
  2658:   for (ch = combat_list; ch; ch = next_combat_list) {
  2659:     next_combat_list = ch->next_fighting;
  2660: 
  2661:     if (FIGHTING(ch) == NULL || IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(FIGHTING(ch))) {
  2662:       stop_fighting(ch);
  2663:       continue;
  2664:     }
  2665: 
  2666:     /* Mark both direct combatants before any hit, trigger, death, flee, or
  2667:      * extraction path can clear FIGHTING().  The actual prompt is emitted
  2668:      * once, after every fighter's synchronous round output is complete. */
  2669:     mark_combat_prompt_participant(ch, prompt_round);
  2670:     mark_combat_prompt_participant(FIGHTING(ch), prompt_round);
  2671: 
  2672:     if (IS_NPC(ch)) {
  2673:       if (GET_MOB_WAIT(ch) > 0) {
  2674:         GET_MOB_WAIT(ch) -= PULSE_VIOLENCE;
  2675:         continue;
  2676:       }
  2677:       GET_MOB_WAIT(ch) = 0;
  2678:       if (GET_POS(ch) < POS_FIGHTING) {
  2679:         GET_POS(ch) = POS_FIGHTING;
  2680:         act("$n scrambles to $s feet!", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
  2681:       }
  2682:     }
  2683: 
  2684:     if (GET_POS(ch) < POS_FIGHTING) {
  2685:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't fight while sitting!!\r\n");
  2686:       continue;
  2687:     }
  2688: 
  2689:     if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_STUNNED)) {
  2690:       send_to_char(ch, "You are stunned and cannot act this round!\r\n");
  2691:       continue;
  2692:     }
  2693: 
  2694:     if (affected_by_spell(ch, SPELL_CONFUSION) && rand_number(1, 100) <= 33) {
  2695:       send_to_char(ch, "You falter in confusion and lose your action this round!\r\n");
  2696:       continue;
  2697:     }
  2698: 
  2699:     if (GROUP(ch) && GROUP(ch)->members && GROUP(ch)->members->iSize) {
  2700:       struct iterator_data Iterator;
  2701: 
  2702:       tch = (struct char_data *) merge_iterator(&Iterator, GROUP(ch)->members);
  2703:       for (; tch ; tch = next_in_list(&Iterator)) {
  2704:         if (tch == ch)
  2705:           continue;
  2706:         if (!IS_NPC(tch) && !PRF_FLAGGED(tch, PRF_AUTOASSIST))
  2707:           continue;
  2708:         if (IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(tch))
  2709:           continue;
  2710:         if (FIGHTING(tch))
  2711:           continue;
  2712:         if (GET_POS(tch) != POS_STANDING)
  2713:           continue;
  2714:         if (!CAN_SEE(tch, ch))
  2715:           continue;
  2716:       
  2717:         do_assist(tch, GET_NAME(ch), 0, 0);				  
  2718:       }
  2719:     }
  2720: 
  2721:     auto_assist_owned_followers(ch);
  2722: 
  2723:     hit(ch, FIGHTING(ch), TYPE_UNDEFINED);
  2724:     
  2725:     do_offhand_attack(ch, FIGHTING(ch));
  2726:     if (FIGHTING(ch))
  2727:       do_spirit_procs(ch, FIGHTING(ch));
  2728: 
  2729:     if (MOB_FLAGGED(ch, MOB_SPEC) && GET_MOB_SPEC(ch) && !MOB_FLAGGED(ch, MOB_NOTDEADYET)) {
  2730:       char actbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH] = "";
  2731:       (GET_MOB_SPEC(ch)) (ch, ch, 0, actbuf);
  2732:     }
  2733:   }
  2734: 
  2735:   queue_combat_round_prompts(prompt_round);
  2736: }

    24: int add_mobile(struct char_data *mob, mob_vnum vnum)
    25: {
    26:   int rnum, i, found = FALSE, shop, cmd_no;
    27:   zone_rnum zone;
    28:   struct char_data *live_mob;
    29: 
    30:   if ((rnum = real_mobile(vnum)) != NOBODY) {
    31:     /* Copy over the mobile and free() the old strings. */
    32:     copy_mobile(&mob_proto[rnum], mob);
    33: 
    34:     /* Now re-point all existing mobile strings to here. */
    35:     for (live_mob = character_list; live_mob; live_mob = live_mob->next)
    36:       if (rnum == live_mob->nr)
    37:         update_mobile_strings(live_mob, &mob_proto[rnum]);
    38: 
    39:     add_to_save_list(zone_table[real_zone_by_thing(vnum)].number, SL_MOB);
    40:     log("GenOLC: add_mobile: Updated existing mobile #%d.", vnum);
    41:     return rnum;
    42:   }
    43: 
    44:   RECREATE(mob_proto, struct char_data, top_of_mobt + 2);
    45:   RECREATE(mob_index, struct index_data, top_of_mobt + 2);
    46:   top_of_mobt++;
    47: 
    48:   for (i = top_of_mobt; i > 0; i--) {
    49:     if (vnum > mob_index[i - 1].vnum) {
    50:       mob_proto[i] = *mob;
    51:       mob_proto[i].nr = i;
    52:       copy_mobile_strings(mob_proto + i, mob);
    53:       mob_index[i].vnum = vnum;
    54:       mob_index[i].number = 0;
    55:       mob_index[i].func = 0;
    56:       found = i;
    57:       break;
    58:     }
    59:     mob_index[i] = mob_index[i - 1];
    60:     mob_proto[i] = mob_proto[i - 1];
    61:     mob_proto[i].nr++;
    62:   }
    63:   if (!found) {
    64:     mob_proto[0] = *mob;
    65:     mob_proto[0].nr = 0;
    66:     copy_mobile_strings(&mob_proto[0], mob);
    67:     mob_index[0].vnum = vnum;
    68:     mob_index[0].number = 0;
    69:     mob_index[0].func = 0;
    70:   }
    71: 
    72:   log("GenOLC: add_mobile: Added mobile %d at index #%d.", vnum, found);
    73: 
    74:   /* Update live mobile rnums. */
    75:   for (live_mob = character_list; live_mob; live_mob = live_mob->next)
    76:     GET_MOB_RNUM(live_mob) += (GET_MOB_RNUM(live_mob) != NOTHING && GET_MOB_RNUM(live_mob) >= found);
    77: 
    78:   /* Update zone table. */
    79:   for (zone = 0; zone <= top_of_zone_table; zone++)
    80:     for (cmd_no = 0; ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).command != 'S'; cmd_no++)
    81:       if (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).command == 'M')
    82: 	ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 += (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 >= found);
    83: 
    84:   /* Update shop keepers. */
    85:   if (shop_index)
    86:     for (shop = 0; shop <= top_shop; shop++)
    87:       SHOP_KEEPER(shop) += (SHOP_KEEPER(shop) != NOTHING && SHOP_KEEPER(shop) >= found);
    88: 
    89:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[real_zone_by_thing(vnum)].number, SL_MOB);
    90:   return found;
    91: }

    93: int copy_mobile(struct char_data *to, struct char_data *from)
    94: {
    95:   free_mobile_strings(to);
    96:   *to = *from;
    97:   check_mobile_strings(from);
    98:   copy_mobile_strings(to, from);
    99:   return TRUE;
   100: }

   102: static void extract_mobile_all(mob_vnum vnum)
   103: {
   104:   struct char_data *next, *ch;
   105:   int i;
   106: 
   107:   for (ch = character_list; ch; ch = next) {
   108:     next = ch->next;
   109:     if (GET_MOB_VNUM(ch) == vnum) {
   110: 			if ((i = GET_MOB_RNUM(ch)) != NOBODY) {
   111: 	    if (ch->player.name && ch->player.name != mob_proto[i].player.name)
   112:           free(ch->player.name);
   113: 				ch->player.name = NULL;
   114: 				
   115:         if (ch->player.title && ch->player.title != mob_proto[i].player.title)
   116:           free(ch->player.title);
   117: 				ch->player.title = NULL;
   118: 				
   119:         if (ch->player.short_descr && ch->player.short_descr != mob_proto[i].player.short_descr)
   120:           free(ch->player.short_descr);
   121: 				ch->player.short_descr = NULL;
   122: 				
   123:         if (ch->player.long_descr && ch->player.long_descr != mob_proto[i].player.long_descr)
   124:           free(ch->player.long_descr);
   125: 				ch->player.long_descr = NULL;
   126: 				
   127:         if (ch->player.description && ch->player.description != mob_proto[i].player.description)
   128:           free(ch->player.description);
   129: 				ch->player.description = NULL;
   130:     
   131:         /* free script proto list if it's not the prototype */
   132:         if (ch->proto_script && ch->proto_script != mob_proto[i].proto_script)
   133:           free_proto_script(ch, MOB_TRIGGER);			
   134: 				ch->proto_script = NULL;
   135: 			}
   136:       extract_char(ch);
   137: 		}
   138:   }
   139: }

   141: int delete_mobile(mob_rnum refpt)
   142: {
   143:   struct char_data *live_mob;
   144:   struct char_data *proto;
   145:   int counter, cmd_no;
   146:   mob_vnum vnum;
   147:   zone_rnum zone;
   148: 
   149: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
   150:   if (refpt == NOBODY || refpt > top_of_mobt) {
   151: #else
   152:   if (refpt < 0 || refpt > top_of_mobt) {
   153: #endif
   154:     log("SYSERR: GenOLC: delete_mobile: Invalid rnum %d.", refpt);
   155:     return NOBODY;
   156:   }
   157: 
   158:   vnum = mob_index[refpt].vnum;
   159:   proto = &mob_proto[refpt];
   160:   
   161:   extract_mobile_all(vnum);
   162:   extract_char(proto);
   163: 
   164:   for (counter = refpt; counter < top_of_mobt; counter++) {
   165:     mob_index[counter] = mob_index[counter + 1];
   166:     mob_proto[counter] = mob_proto[counter + 1];
   167:     mob_proto[counter].nr--;
   168:   }
   169: 
   170:   top_of_mobt--;
   171:   RECREATE(mob_index, struct index_data, top_of_mobt + 1);
   172:   RECREATE(mob_proto, struct char_data, top_of_mobt + 1);
   173: 
   174:   /* Update live mobile rnums. */
   175:   for (live_mob = character_list; live_mob; live_mob = live_mob->next)
   176:     GET_MOB_RNUM(live_mob) -= (GET_MOB_RNUM(live_mob) >= refpt);
   177: 
   178:   /* Update zone table. */
   179:   for (zone = 0; zone <= top_of_zone_table; zone++)
   180:     for (cmd_no = 0; ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).command != 'S'; cmd_no++)
   181:       if (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).command == 'M'){
   182:        if (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 == refpt) {
   183:         delete_zone_command(&zone_table[zone], cmd_no);
   184:         } else
   185:           ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 -= (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 > refpt);
   186:         }
   187: 
   188:   /* Update shop keepers. */
   189:   if (shop_index)
   190:     for (counter = 0; counter <= top_shop; counter++)
   191:       SHOP_KEEPER(counter) -= (SHOP_KEEPER(counter) >= refpt);
   192: 
   193:   save_mobiles(real_zone_by_thing(vnum));
   194: 
   195:   return refpt;
   196: }

   198: int copy_mobile_strings(struct char_data *t, struct char_data *f)
   199: {
   200:   if (f->player.name)
   201:     t->player.name = strdup(f->player.name);
   202:   if (f->player.title)
   203:     t->player.title = strdup(f->player.title);
   204:   if (f->player.short_descr)
   205:     t->player.short_descr = strdup(f->player.short_descr);
   206:   if (f->player.long_descr)
   207:     t->player.long_descr = strdup(f->player.long_descr);
   208:   if (f->player.description)
   209:     t->player.description = strdup(f->player.description);
   210:   return TRUE;
   211: }
   212: 
   213: int update_mobile_strings(struct char_data *t, struct char_data *f)
   214: {
   215:   if (f->player.name)
   216:     t->player.name = f->player.name;
   217:   if (f->player.title)
   218:     t->player.title = f->player.title;
   219:   if (f->player.short_descr)
   220:     t->player.short_descr = f->player.short_descr;
   221:   if (f->player.long_descr)
   222:     t->player.long_descr = f->player.long_descr;
   223:   if (f->player.description)
   224:     t->player.description = f->player.description;
   225:   return TRUE;
   226: }
   227: 
   228: int free_mobile_strings(struct char_data *mob)
   229: {
   230:   if (mob->player.name)
   231:     free(mob->player.name);
   232:   if (mob->player.title)
   233:     free(mob->player.title);
   234:   if (mob->player.short_descr)
   235:     free(mob->player.short_descr);
   236:   if (mob->player.long_descr)
   237:     free(mob->player.long_descr);
   238:   if (mob->player.description)
   239:     free(mob->player.description);
   240:   return TRUE;
   241: }
   242: 
   243: /* Free a mobile structure that has been edited. Take care of existing mobiles
   244:  * and their mob_proto! */
   245: int free_mobile(struct char_data *mob)
   246: {
   247:   mob_rnum i;
   248: 
   249:   if (mob == NULL)
   250:     return FALSE;
   251: 
   252:   /* Non-prototyped mobile.  Also known as new mobiles. */
   253:   if ((i = GET_MOB_RNUM(mob)) == NOBODY) {
   254:     free_mobile_strings(mob);
   255:     /* free script proto list */
   256:     free_proto_script(mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
   257:    } else {	/* Prototyped mobile. */
   258:     if (mob->player.name && mob->player.name != mob_proto[i].player.name)
   259:       free(mob->player.name);
   260:     if (mob->player.title && mob->player.title != mob_proto[i].player.title)
   261:       free(mob->player.title);
   262:     if (mob->player.short_descr && mob->player.short_descr != mob_proto[i].player.short_descr)
   263:       free(mob->player.short_descr);
   264:     if (mob->player.long_descr && mob->player.long_descr != mob_proto[i].player.long_descr)
   265:       free(mob->player.long_descr);
   266:     if (mob->player.description && mob->player.description != mob_proto[i].player.description)
   267:       free(mob->player.description);
   268:     /* free script proto list if it's not the prototype */
   269:     if (mob->proto_script && mob->proto_script != mob_proto[i].proto_script)
   270:       free_proto_script(mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
   271:   }
   272:   while (mob->affected)
   273:     affect_remove(mob, mob->affected);
   274: 
   275:   /* free any assigned scripts */
   276:   if (SCRIPT(mob))
   277:     extract_script(mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
   278: 
   279:   free(mob);
   280:   return TRUE;
   281: }
   282: 
   283: int save_mobiles(zone_rnum rznum)
   284: {
   285:   zone_vnum vznum;
   286:   FILE *mobfd;
   287:   room_vnum i;
   288:   mob_rnum rmob;
   289:   int written;
   290:   char mobfname[64], usedfname[64];
   291: 
   292: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
   293:   if (rznum == NOWHERE || rznum > top_of_zone_table) {
   294: #else
   295:   if (rznum < 0 || rznum > top_of_zone_table) {
   296: #endif
   297:     log("SYSERR: GenOLC: save_mobiles: Invalid real zone number %d. (0-%d)", rznum, top_of_zone_table);
   298:     return FALSE;
   299:   }
   300: 
   301:   vznum = zone_table[rznum].number;
   302:   snprintf(mobfname, sizeof(mobfname), "%s%d.new", MOB_PREFIX, vznum);
   303:   if ((mobfd = fopen(mobfname, "w")) == NULL) {
   304:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: GenOLC: Cannot open mob file for writing.");
   305:     return FALSE;
   306:   }
   307: 
   308:   for (rmob = 0; rmob <= top_of_mobt; rmob++) {
   309:     i = mob_index[rmob].vnum;
   310:     if (real_zone_by_thing(i) != rznum)
   311:       continue;
   312:     check_mobile_strings(&mob_proto[rmob]);
   313:     if (write_mobile_record(i, &mob_proto[rmob], mobfd) < 0)
   314:       log("SYSERR: GenOLC: Error writing mobile #%d.", i);
   315:   }
   316:   fputs("$\n", mobfd);
   317:   written = ftell(mobfd);
   318:   fclose(mobfd);
   319:   snprintf(usedfname, sizeof(usedfname), "%s%d.mob", MOB_PREFIX, vznum);
   320:   remove(usedfname);
   321:   rename(mobfname, usedfname);
   322: 
   323:   if (in_save_list(vznum, SL_MOB))
   324:     remove_from_save_list(vznum, SL_MOB);
   325:   log("GenOLC: '%s' saved, %d bytes written.", usedfname, written);
   326:   return written;
   327: }

   329: int write_mobile_espec(mob_vnum mvnum, struct char_data *mob, FILE *fd)
   330: {
   331:   int i;
   332: 
   333: 
   334: 
   335:   if (GET_ATTACK(mob) != 0)
   336:     fprintf(fd, "BareHandAttack: %d\n", GET_ATTACK(mob));
   337:   if (GET_STR(mob) != 11)
   338:     fprintf(fd, "Str: %d\n", GET_STR(mob));
   339:   if (GET_ADD(mob) != 0)
   340:     fprintf(fd, "StrAdd: %d\n", GET_ADD(mob));
   341:   if (GET_DEX(mob) != 11)
   342:     fprintf(fd, "Dex: %d\n", GET_DEX(mob));
   343:   if (GET_INT(mob) != 11)
   344:     fprintf(fd, "Int: %d\n", GET_INT(mob));
   345:   if (GET_WIS(mob) != 11)
   346:     fprintf(fd, "Wis: %d\n", GET_WIS(mob));
   347:   if (GET_CON(mob) != 11)
   348:     fprintf(fd, "Con: %d\n", GET_CON(mob));
   349:   if (GET_CHA(mob) != 11)
   350:     fprintf(fd, "Cha: %d\n", GET_CHA(mob));
   351:   if (GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_PARA) != 0)
   352:     fprintf(fd, "SavingPara: %d\n", GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_PARA));
   353:   if (GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_ROD) != 0)
   354:     fprintf(fd, "SavingRod: %d\n", GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_ROD));
   355:   if (GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_PETRI) != 0)
   356:     fprintf(fd, "SavingPetri: %d\n", GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_PETRI));
   357:   if (GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_BREATH) != 0)
   358:     fprintf(fd, "SavingBreath: %d\n", GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_BREATH));
   359:   if (GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_SPELL) != 0)
   360:     fprintf(fd, "SavingSpell: %d\n", GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_SPELL));
   361:   if (GET_PET_PRICE(mob) > 0)
   362:     fprintf(fd, "PetPrice: %d\n", GET_PET_PRICE(mob));
   363:   if (GET_MOB_WIMP_LEV(mob) > 0)
   364:     fprintf(fd, "Wimpy: %d\n", GET_MOB_WIMP_LEV(mob));
   365:   if (GET_EVASION(mob) != 0)
   366:     fprintf(fd, "Evasion: %d\n", GET_EVASION(mob));
   367:   
   368:   /* Persist gold min/max (used for corpse coin rolls). */
   369:   if ((long long)mob->mob_specials.gold_min != 0 || (long long)mob->mob_specials.gold_max != 0) {
   370:     fprintf(fd, "GoldMin: %lld\n", (long long)mob->mob_specials.gold_min);
   371:     fprintf(fd, "GoldMax: %lld\n", (long long)mob->mob_specials.gold_max);
   372:   }
   373:   for (i = 0; i < mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout_count; i++)
   374:     fprintf(fd, "EquipItem: %d %d\n",
   375:             mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout[i].vnum,
   376:             mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout[i].wear_pos);
   377:   for (i = 0; i < mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout_count; i++)
   378:     fprintf(fd, "InvItem: %d %d\n",
   379:             mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout[i].vnum,
   380:             mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout[i].count);
   381:   for (i = 0; i < mob->mob_specials.loot_table_count; i++)
   382:     fprintf(fd, "LootItem: %d %d\n",
   383:             mob->mob_specials.loot_table[i].vnum,
   384:             mob->mob_specials.loot_table[i].chance);
   385: fputs("E\n", fd);
   386:   return TRUE;
   387: }
   388: 
   389: int write_mobile_record(mob_vnum mvnum, struct char_data *mob, FILE *fd)
   390: {
   391:   char ldesc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   392:   char ddesc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   393:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   394: 
   395:   ldesc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1] = '\0';
   396:   ddesc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1] = '\0';
   397:   strip_cr(strncpy(ldesc, GET_LDESC(mob), MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1));
   398:   strip_cr(strncpy(ddesc, GET_DDESC(mob), MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1));
   399: 
   400:   int n = snprintf(buf, MAX_STRING_LENGTH, "#%d\n"
   401: 		"%s%c\n"
   402: 		"%s%c\n"
   403: 		"%s%c\n"
   404: 		"%s%c\n",
   405: 	mvnum,
   406: 	GET_ALIAS(mob), STRING_TERMINATOR,
   407: 	GET_SDESC(mob), STRING_TERMINATOR,
   408: 	ldesc, STRING_TERMINATOR,
   409: 	ddesc, STRING_TERMINATOR
   410:   );
   411: 
   412:   if(n < MAX_STRING_LENGTH) {
   413:     fprintf(fd, "%s", convert_from_tabs(buf));
   414:   
   415:     fprintf(fd, "%d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d E\n"
   416:         "%d %d %d %dd%d+%d %dd%d+%d\n",
   417:         MOB_FLAGS(mob)[0], MOB_FLAGS(mob)[1],
   418:         MOB_FLAGS(mob)[2], MOB_FLAGS(mob)[3],
   419:         AFF_FLAGS(mob)[0], AFF_FLAGS(mob)[1],
   420:         AFF_FLAGS(mob)[2], AFF_FLAGS(mob)[3],
   421:         GET_ALIGNMENT(mob),
   422:         GET_LEVEL(mob), 20 - GET_HITROLL(mob), GET_AC(mob), GET_HIT(mob),
   423:         GET_MANA(mob), GET_MOVE(mob), GET_NDD(mob), GET_SDD(mob),
   424:         GET_DAMROLL(mob));
   425:   
   426:     fprintf(fd, 	"%lld %d\n"
   427:       "%d %d %d\n",
   428:       GET_GOLD(mob), GET_EXP(mob),
   429:       GET_POS(mob), GET_DEFAULT_POS(mob), GET_SEX(mob)
   430:     );
   431:   
   432:     if (write_mobile_espec(mvnum, mob, fd) < 0)
   433:       log("SYSERR: GenOLC: Error writing E-specs for mobile #%d.", mvnum);
   434:   
   435:     script_save_to_disk(fd, mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
   436:   
   437:   
   438:   #if CONFIG_GENOLC_MOBPROG
   439:     if (write_mobile_mobprog(mvnum, mob, fd) < 0)
   440:       log("SYSERR: GenOLC: Error writing MobProgs for mobile #%d.", mvnum);
   441:   #endif
   442:   } else {
   443:     mudlog(BRF,LVL_BUILDER,TRUE,
   444:            "SYSERR: Could not save mobile #%d due to size (%d > maximum of %d)",
   445:            mvnum, n, MAX_STRING_LENGTH);
   446:   }
   447:   
   448:   return TRUE;
   449: }
   450: 
   451: void check_mobile_strings(struct char_data *mob)
   452: {
   453:   mob_vnum mvnum = mob_index[mob->nr].vnum;
   454:   check_mobile_string(mvnum, &GET_LDESC(mob), "long description");
   455:   check_mobile_string(mvnum, &GET_DDESC(mob), "detailed description");
   456:   check_mobile_string(mvnum, &GET_ALIAS(mob), "alias list");
   457:   check_mobile_string(mvnum, &GET_SDESC(mob), "short description");
   458: }
   459: 
   460: void check_mobile_string(mob_vnum i, char **string, const char *desc)
   461: {
   462:   if (*string == NULL || **string == '\0') {
   463:     char smbuf[128];
   464:     sprintf(smbuf, "GenOLC: Mob #%d has an invalid %s.", i, desc);
   465:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "%s", smbuf);
   466:     if (*string)
   467:       free(*string);
   468:     *string = strdup("An undefined string.\n");
   469:   }
   470: }
