    25: static int update_all_objects(struct obj_data *obj);
    26: static void copy_object_strings(struct obj_data *to, struct obj_data *from);
    27: 
    28: obj_rnum add_object(struct obj_data *newobj, obj_vnum ovnum)
    29: {
    30:   int found = NOTHING;
    31:   zone_rnum rznum = real_zone_by_thing(ovnum);
    32: 
    33:   /* Write object to internal tables. */
    34:   if ((newobj->item_number = real_object(ovnum)) != NOTHING) {
    35:     copy_object(&obj_proto[newobj->item_number], newobj);
    36:     update_all_objects(&obj_proto[newobj->item_number]);
    37:     add_to_save_list(zone_table[rznum].number, SL_OBJ);
    38:     return newobj->item_number;
    39:   }
    40: 
    41:   found = insert_object(newobj, ovnum);
    42:   adjust_objects(found);
    43:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[rznum].number, SL_OBJ);
    44:   return found;
    45: }
    46: 
    47: /* Fix all existing objects to have these values. We need to run through each
    48:  * and every object currently in the game to see which ones are pointing to
    49:  * this prototype. If object is pointing to this prototype, then we need to
    50:  * replace it with the new one. */
    51: static int update_all_objects(struct obj_data *refobj)
    52: {
    53:   struct obj_data *obj, swap;
    54:   int count = 0;
    55: 
    56:   for (obj = object_list; obj; obj = obj->next) {
    57:     if (obj->item_number != refobj->item_number)
    58:       continue;
    59: 
    60:     count++;
    61: 
    62:     /* Update the existing object but save a copy for private information. */
    63:     swap = *obj;
    64:     *obj = *refobj;
    65: 
    66:     /* Copy game-time dependent variables over. */
    67:     obj->script_id = swap.script_id;
    68:     IN_ROOM(obj) = swap.in_room;
    69:     obj->carried_by = swap.carried_by;
    70:     obj->worn_by = swap.worn_by;
    71:     obj->worn_on = swap.worn_on;
    72:     obj->in_obj = swap.in_obj;
    73:     obj->contains = swap.contains;
    74:     obj->next_content = swap.next_content;
    75:     obj->next = swap.next;
    76:     obj->sitting_here = swap.sitting_here;
    77:   }
    78: 
    79:   return count;
    80: }
    81: 
    82: /* Adjust the internal values of other objects as if something was inserted at
    83:  * the given array index. Might also be useful to make 'holes' in the array
    84:  * for some reason. */
    85: obj_rnum adjust_objects(obj_rnum refpt)
    86: {
    87:   int shop, i, zone, cmd_no;
    88:   struct obj_data *obj;
    89: 
    90: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
    91:   if (refpt == NOTHING || refpt > top_of_objt)
    92: #else
    93:   if (refpt < 0 || refpt > top_of_objt)
    94: #endif
    95:     return NOTHING;
    96: 
    97:   /* Renumber live objects. */
    98:   for (obj = object_list; obj; obj = obj->next)
    99:     GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj) += (GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj) != NOTHING && GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj) >= refpt);
   100: 
   101:   /* Renumber zone table. */
   102:   for (zone = 0; zone <= top_of_zone_table; zone++) {
   103:     for (cmd_no = 0; ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).command != 'S'; cmd_no++) {
   104:       switch (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).command) {
   105:       case 'P':
   106:         ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg3 += (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg3 >= refpt);
   107:          /* No break here - drop into next case. */
   108:       case 'O':
   109:       case 'G':
   110:       case 'E':
   111:         ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 += (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 >= refpt);
   112:         break;
   113:       case 'R':
   114:         ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg2 += (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg2 >= refpt);
   115:         break;
   116:       }
   117:     }
   118:   }
   119: 
   120:   /* Renumber notice boards. */
   121:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_OF_BOARDS; i++)
   122:     BOARD_RNUM(i) += (BOARD_RNUM(i) >= refpt);
   123: 
   124:   /* Renumber shop produce. */
   125:   for (shop = 0; shop <= top_shop; shop++)
   126:     for (i = 0; SHOP_PRODUCT(shop, i) != NOTHING; i++)
   127:       SHOP_PRODUCT(shop, i) += (SHOP_PRODUCT(shop, i) >= refpt);
   128: 
   129:   return refpt;
   130: }
   131: 
   132: /* Function handle the insertion of an object within the prototype framework.
   133:  * Note that this does not adjust internal values of other objects, use
   134:  * add_object() for that. */
   135: obj_rnum insert_object(struct obj_data *obj, obj_vnum ovnum)
   136: {
   137:   obj_rnum i;
   138: 
   139:   top_of_objt++;
   140:   RECREATE(obj_index, struct index_data, top_of_objt + 1);
   141:   RECREATE(obj_proto, struct obj_data, top_of_objt + 1);
   142: 
   143:   /* Start counting through both tables. */
   144:   for (i = top_of_objt; i > 0; i--) {
   145:     /* Check if current virtual is bigger than our virtual number. */
   146:     if (ovnum > obj_index[i - 1].vnum)
   147:       return index_object(obj, ovnum, i);
   148: 
   149:     /* Copy over the object that should be here. */
   150:     obj_index[i] = obj_index[i - 1];
   151:     obj_proto[i] = obj_proto[i - 1];
   152:     obj_proto[i].item_number = i;
   153:   }
   154: 
   155:   /* Not found, place at 0. */
   156:   return index_object(obj, ovnum, 0);
   157: }
   158: 
   159: obj_rnum index_object(struct obj_data *obj, obj_vnum ovnum, obj_rnum ornum)
   160: {
   161: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
   162:   if (obj == NULL || ornum == NOTHING || ornum > top_of_objt)
   163: #else
   164:   if (obj == NULL || ovnum < 0 || ornum < 0 || ornum > top_of_objt)
   165: #endif
   166:     return NOWHERE;
   167: 
   168:   obj->item_number = ornum;
   169:   obj_index[ornum].vnum = ovnum;
   170:   obj_index[ornum].number = 0;
   171:   obj_index[ornum].func = NULL;
   172: 
   173:   copy_object_preserve(&obj_proto[ornum], obj);
   174:   obj_proto[ornum].in_room = NOWHERE;
   175: 
   176:   return ornum;
   177: }
   178: 
   179: int save_objects(zone_rnum zone_num)
   180: {
   181:   char filename[128], buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   182:   char ebuf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], ebuf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], ebuf3[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], ebuf4[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   183:   char wbuf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], wbuf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], wbuf3[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], wbuf4[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   184:   char pbuf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], pbuf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], pbuf3[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], pbuf4[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   185:   int counter, counter2, realcounter;
   186:   FILE *fp;
   187:   struct obj_data *obj;
   188:   struct extra_descr_data *ex_desc;
   189: 
   190: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
   191:   if (zone_num == NOWHERE || zone_num > top_of_zone_table) {
   192: #else
   193:   if (zone_num < 0 || zone_num > top_of_zone_table) {
   194: #endif
   195:     log("SYSERR: GenOLC: save_objects: Invalid real zone number %d. (0-%d)", zone_num, top_of_zone_table);
   196:     return FALSE;
   197:   }
   198: 
   199:   snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "%s/%d.new", OBJ_PREFIX, zone_table[zone_num].number);
   200:   if (!(fp = fopen(filename, "w+"))) {
   201:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Cannot open objects file %s!", filename);
   202:     return FALSE;
   203:   }
   204:   /* Start running through all objects in this zone. */
   205:   for (realcounter = 0; realcounter <= top_of_objt; realcounter++) {
   206:     counter = obj_index[realcounter].vnum;
   207:     if (real_zone_by_thing(counter) == zone_num) {
   208:       if ((obj = &obj_proto[realcounter])->action_description) {
   209:         strncpy(buf, obj->action_description, sizeof(buf) - 1);
   210:         strip_cr(buf);
   211:       } else
   212:         *buf = '\0';
   213: 
   214:       int n = snprintf(buf2, MAX_STRING_LENGTH,
   215: 	      "#%d\n"
   216: 	      "%s~\n"
   217: 	      "%s~\n"
   218: 	      "%s~\n"
   219: 	      "%s~\n",
   220: 
   221: 	      GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj),
   222: 	      (obj->name && *obj->name) ? obj->name : "undefined",
   223: 	      (obj->short_description && *obj->short_description) ? obj->short_description : "undefined",
   224: 	      (obj->description && *obj->description) ?	obj->description : "undefined",
   225: 	      buf);
   226:         
   227:       if(n >= MAX_STRING_LENGTH) {
   228:         mudlog(BRF,LVL_BUILDER,TRUE,
   229:                "SYSERR: Could not save object #%d due to size (%d > maximum of %d).",
   230:                GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), n, MAX_STRING_LENGTH);
   231:         continue;
   232:       }
   233:       
   234:       fprintf(fp, "%s", convert_from_tabs(buf2));
   235: 
   236:       sprintascii(ebuf1, GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj)[0]);
   237:       sprintascii(ebuf2, GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj)[1]);
   238:       sprintascii(ebuf3, GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj)[2]);
   239:       sprintascii(ebuf4, GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj)[3]);
   240:       sprintascii(wbuf1, GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj)[0]);
   241:       sprintascii(wbuf2, GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj)[1]);
   242:       sprintascii(wbuf3, GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj)[2]);
   243:       sprintascii(wbuf4, GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj)[3]);
   244:       sprintascii(pbuf1, GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj)[0]);
   245:       sprintascii(pbuf2, GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj)[1]);
   246:       sprintascii(pbuf3, GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj)[2]);
   247:       sprintascii(pbuf4, GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj)[3]);
   248: 
   249:       fprintf(fp, "%d %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s\n"
   250:           "%d %d %d %d\n"
   251:           "%d %d %d %d %d\n",
   252: 
   253: 	  GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj),
   254:           ebuf1, ebuf2, ebuf3, ebuf4,
   255:           wbuf1, wbuf2, wbuf3, wbuf4,
   256:           pbuf1, pbuf2, pbuf3, pbuf4,
   257:           GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1),
   258:           GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3),
   259:           GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj), GET_OBJ_COST(obj),
   260:           GET_OBJ_RENT(obj), GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj), GET_OBJ_TIMER(obj)
   261:       );
   262: 
   263:       /* Do we have script(s) attached? */
   264:       script_save_to_disk(fp, obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
   265: 
   266:       /* Do we have extra descriptions? */
   267:       if (obj->ex_description) {	/* Yes, save them too. */
   268: 	for (ex_desc = obj->ex_description; ex_desc; ex_desc = ex_desc->next) {
   269: 	  /* Sanity check to prevent nasty protection faults. */
   270: 	  if (!ex_desc->keyword || !ex_desc->description || !*ex_desc->keyword || !*ex_desc->description) {
   271: 	    mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: oedit_save_to_disk: Corrupt ex_desc!");
   272: 	    continue;
   273: 	  }
   274: 	  strncpy(buf, ex_desc->description, sizeof(buf) - 1);
   275: 	  strip_cr(buf);
   276: 	  fprintf(fp, "E\n"
   277: 		  "%s~\n"
   278: 		  "%s~\n", ex_desc->keyword, buf);
   279: 	}
   280:       }
   281:       /* Do we have affects? */
   282:       for (counter2 = 0; counter2 < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; counter2++)
   283: 	if (obj->affected[counter2].modifier)
   284: 	  fprintf(fp, "A\n"
   285: 		  "%d %d\n", obj->affected[counter2].location,
   286: 		  obj->affected[counter2].modifier);
   287:     }
   288:   }
   289: 
   290:   /* Write the final line, close the file. */
   291:   fprintf(fp, "$~\n");
   292:   fclose(fp);
   293:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.obj", OBJ_PREFIX, zone_table[zone_num].number);
   294:   remove(buf);
   295:   rename(filename, buf);
   296: 
   297:   if (in_save_list(zone_table[zone_num].number, SL_OBJ))
   298:     remove_from_save_list(zone_table[zone_num].number, SL_OBJ);
   299:   return TRUE;
   300: }

   302: /* Free all, unconditionally. */
   303: void free_object_strings(struct obj_data *obj)
   304: {
   305:   if (obj->name)
   306:     free(obj->name);
   307:   if (obj->description)
   308:     free(obj->description);
   309:   if (obj->short_description)
   310:     free(obj->short_description);
   311:   if (obj->action_description)
   312:     free(obj->action_description);
   313:   if (obj->ex_description)
   314:     free_ex_descriptions(obj->ex_description);
   315: }
   316: 
   317: /* For object instances that are not the prototype. */
   318: void free_object_strings_proto(struct obj_data *obj)
   319: {
   320:   int robj_num = GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj);
   321: 
   322:   if (obj->name && obj->name != obj_proto[robj_num].name)
   323:     free(obj->name);
   324:   if (obj->description && obj->description != obj_proto[robj_num].description)
   325:     free(obj->description);
   326:   if (obj->short_description && obj->short_description != obj_proto[robj_num].short_description)
   327:     free(obj->short_description);
   328:   if (obj->action_description && obj->action_description != obj_proto[robj_num].action_description)
   329:     free(obj->action_description);
   330:   if (obj->ex_description) {
   331:     struct extra_descr_data *thised, *plist, *next_one; /* O(horrible) */
   332:     int ok_key, ok_desc, ok_item;
   333:     for (thised = obj->ex_description; thised; thised = next_one) {
   334:       next_one = thised->next;
   335:       for (ok_item = ok_key = ok_desc = 1, plist = obj_proto[robj_num].ex_description; plist; plist = plist->next) {
   336:         if (plist->keyword == thised->keyword)
   337:           ok_key = 0;
   338:         if (plist->description == thised->description)
   339:           ok_desc = 0;
   340:         if (plist == thised)
   341:           ok_item = 0;
   342:       }
   343:       if (thised->keyword && ok_key)
   344:         free(thised->keyword);
   345:       if (thised->description && ok_desc)
   346:         free(thised->description);
   347:       if (ok_item)
   348:         free(thised);
   349:     }
   350:   }
   351: }
   352: 
   353: static void copy_object_strings(struct obj_data *to, struct obj_data *from)
   354: {
   355:   to->name = from->name ? strdup(from->name) : NULL;
   356:   to->description = from->description ? strdup(from->description) : NULL;
   357:   to->short_description = from->short_description ? strdup(from->short_description) : NULL;
   358:   to->action_description = from->action_description ? strdup(from->action_description) : NULL;
   359: 
   360:   if (from->ex_description)
   361:     copy_ex_descriptions(&to->ex_description, from->ex_description);
   362:   else
   363:     to->ex_description = NULL;
   364: }
   365: 
   366: int copy_object(struct obj_data *to, struct obj_data *from)
   367: {
   368:   free_object_strings(to);
   369:   return copy_object_main(to, from, TRUE);
   370: }
   371: 
   372: int copy_object_preserve(struct obj_data *to, struct obj_data *from)
   373: {
   374:   return copy_object_main(to, from, FALSE);
   375: }
   376: 
   377: int copy_object_main(struct obj_data *to, struct obj_data *from, int free_object)
   378: {
   379:   *to = *from;
   380:   copy_object_strings(to, from);
   381:   return TRUE;
   382: }
   383: 
   384: int delete_object(obj_rnum rnum)
   385: {
   386:   obj_rnum i;
   387:   zone_rnum zrnum;
   388:   struct obj_data *obj, *tmp, *next_obj;
   389:   int shop, j, zone, cmd_no;
   390: 
   391:   if (rnum == NOTHING || rnum > top_of_objt)
   392:     return NOTHING;
   393: 
   394:   obj = &obj_proto[rnum];
   395: 
   396:   zrnum = real_zone_by_thing(GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj));
   397: 
   398:   /* This is something you might want to read about in the logs. */
   399:   log("GenOLC: delete_object: Deleting object #%d (%s).", GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj), obj->short_description);
   400: 
   401:   for (tmp = object_list; tmp; tmp = next_obj) {
   402: 	next_obj = tmp->next;
   403:     if (tmp->item_number != obj->item_number)
   404:       continue;
   405: 
   406:     /* extract_obj() will just axe contents. */
   407:     if (tmp->contains) {
   408:       struct obj_data *this_content, *next_content;
   409:       for (this_content = tmp->contains; this_content; this_content = next_content) {
   410:         next_content = this_content->next_content;
   411:         if (IN_ROOM(tmp)) {
   412:           /* Transfer stuff from object to room. */
   413:           obj_from_obj(this_content);
   414:           obj_to_room(this_content, IN_ROOM(tmp));
   415:         } else if (tmp->worn_by || tmp->carried_by) {
   416:           /* Transfer stuff from object to person inventory. */
   417:           obj_from_char(this_content);
   418:           obj_to_char(this_content, tmp->carried_by);
   419:         } else if (tmp->in_obj) {
   420:           /* Transfer stuff from object to containing object. */
   421:           obj_from_obj(this_content);
   422:           obj_to_obj(this_content, tmp->in_obj);
   423:         }
   424:       }
   425:     }
   426:     /* Remove from object_list, etc. - handles weightchanges, and similar. */
   427:     extract_obj(tmp);
   428:   }
   429: 
   430:   /* Make sure all are removed. */
   431:   assert(obj_index[rnum].number == 0);
   432: 
   433:   /* Adjust rnums of all other objects. */
   434:   for (tmp = object_list; tmp; tmp = tmp->next) {
   435:     GET_OBJ_RNUM(tmp) -= (GET_OBJ_RNUM(tmp) > rnum);
   436:   }
   437: 
   438:   for (i = rnum; i < top_of_objt; i++) {
   439:     obj_index[i] = obj_index[i + 1];
   440:     obj_proto[i] = obj_proto[i + 1];
   441:     obj_proto[i].item_number = i;
   442:   }
   443: 
   444:   top_of_objt--;
   445:   RECREATE(obj_index, struct index_data, top_of_objt + 1);
   446:   RECREATE(obj_proto, struct obj_data, top_of_objt + 1);
   447: 
   448:   /* Renumber notice boards. */
   449:   for (j = 0; j < NUM_OF_BOARDS; j++)
   450:     BOARD_RNUM(j) -= (BOARD_RNUM(j) > rnum);
   451: 
   452:   /* Renumber shop produce. */
   453:   for (shop = 0; shop <= top_shop; shop++)
   454:     for (j = 0; SHOP_PRODUCT(shop, j) != NOTHING; j++)
   455:       SHOP_PRODUCT(shop, j) -= (SHOP_PRODUCT(shop, j) > rnum);
   456: 
   457:   /* Renumber zone table. */
   458:   for (zone = 0; zone <= top_of_zone_table; zone++) {
   459:     for (cmd_no = 0; ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).command != 'S'; cmd_no++) {
   460:       switch (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).command) {
   461:       case 'P':
   462:         if (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg3 == rnum) {
   463:           delete_zone_command(&zone_table[zone], cmd_no);
   464:         } else
   465:           ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg3 -= (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg3 > rnum);
   466:         /* No break here - drop into next case. */
   467:       case 'O':
   468:       case 'G':
   469:       case 'E':
   470:         if (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 == rnum) {
   471:           delete_zone_command(&zone_table[zone], cmd_no);
   472:         } else
   473:           ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 -= (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg1 > rnum);
   474: 	break;
   475:       case 'R':
   476:         if (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg2 == rnum) {
   477:           delete_zone_command(&zone_table[zone], cmd_no);
   478:         } else
   479:           ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg2 -= (ZCMD(zone, cmd_no).arg2 > rnum);
   480: 	break;
   481:       }
   482:     }
   483:   }
   484: 
   485:   save_objects(zrnum);
   486: 
   487:   return rnum;
   488: }

   491: bool oset_alias(struct obj_data *obj, char * argument)
   492: { 
   493:   static size_t max_len = 64;
   494:   int i = GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj);
   495:   
   496:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   497:   
   498:   if (strlen(argument) > max_len)
   499:     return FALSE;
   500:   
   501:   if (i != NOWHERE && obj->name && obj->name != obj_proto[i].name)
   502:     free(obj->name);  
   503: 		   	   
   504:   obj->name = strdup(argument);  
   505:   
   506:   return TRUE;

   509: bool oset_apply(struct obj_data *obj, char * argument)
   510: { 
   511:   int i = 0, apply = -1, location = -1, mod = 0, empty = -1, value;
   512:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   513:   
   514:   argument = one_argument(argument, arg);
   515:   
   516:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   517:   
   518:   if ((value = atoi(argument)) == 0)
   519:     return FALSE;
   520:   
   521:   while (*apply_types[i] != '\n') {
   522:     if (is_abbrev(apply_types[i], arg)) {
   523:       apply = i;
   524:       break;
   525:     }
   526:     i++;
   527:   }
   528:   
   529:   if (apply == -1)
   530:     return FALSE;
   531:     
   532:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; i++) {
   533:     if (obj->affected[i].location == apply) {
   534:       location = i;
   535:       mod = obj->affected[i].modifier;
   536:       break;
   537:     } else if (obj->affected[i].location == APPLY_NONE && empty == -1) {
   538:       empty = i;
   539:     }
   540:   }
   541:   
   542:   /* No slot already using APPLY_XXX, so use an empty one... if available */
   543:   if (location == -1)
   544:     location = empty;  
   545:   
   546:   /* There is no slot already using our APPLY_XXX type, and no empty slots either */
   547:   if (location == -1)
   548:     return FALSE;
   549:   
   550:   obj->affected[location].modifier = mod + value;
   551:   
   552:   /* Our modifier is set at 0, so lets just clear the apply location so that it may
   553:    * be reused at a later point */
   554:   if (obj->affected[location].modifier != 0)
   555:     obj->affected[location].location = apply;
   556:   else
   557:     obj->affected[location].location = APPLY_NONE;
   558:   
   559:   return TRUE;
   560: }
   561: 
   562: bool oset_short_description(struct obj_data *obj, char * argument)
   563: {

    79: char *str_udupnl(const char *txt)
    80: {
    81:   char *str = NULL, undef[] = "undefined";
    82:   const char *ptr = NULL;
    83:   size_t n;
    84: 
    85:   ptr = (txt && *txt) ? txt : undef;
    86:   n = strlen(ptr) + 3;
    87: 
    88:   CREATE(str, char, n);
    89:   strlcpy(str, ptr, n);
    90:   strcat(str, "\r\n");
    91: 
    92:   return str;

    96: int save_all(void)
    97: {
    98:   while (save_list) {
    99:     if (save_list->type < 0 || save_list->type > SL_MAX) {
   100:       switch (save_list->type) {
   101:         case SL_ACT:
   102:           log("Actions not saved - can not autosave. Use 'aedit save'.");
   103:           save_list = save_list->next;    /* Fatal error, skip this one. */
   104:           break;
   105:         case SL_HLP:
   106:           log("Help not saved - can not autosave. Use 'hedit save'.");
   107:           save_list = save_list->next;    /* Fatal error, skip this one. */
   108:           break;
   109:         default:
   110:           log("SYSERR: GenOLC: Invalid save type %d in save list.\n", save_list->type);
   111:           save_list = save_list->next;    /* Fatal error, skip this one. */
   112:           break;
   113:         }
   114:     } else if ((*save_types[save_list->type].func) (real_zone(save_list->zone)) < 0)
   115:       save_list = save_list->next;      /* Fatal error, skip this one. */
   116:   }
   117:   return TRUE;
   118: }

   121: void strip_cr(char *buffer)
   122: {
   123:   int rpos, wpos;
   124: 
   125:   if (buffer == NULL)
   126:     return;
   127: 
   128:   for (rpos = 0, wpos = 0; buffer[rpos]; rpos++) {
   129:     buffer[wpos] = buffer[rpos];
   130:     wpos += (buffer[rpos] != '\r');
   131:   }
   132:   buffer[wpos] = '\0';
   133: }

   263: int sprintascii(char *out, bitvector_t bits)
   264: {
   265:   int i, j = 0;
   266:   /* 32 bits, don't just add letters to try to get more unless your bitvector_t is also as large. */
   267:   char *flags = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEF";
   268: 
   269:   for (i = 0; flags[i] != '\0'; i++)
   270:     if (bits & (1 << i))
   271:       out[j++] = flags[i];
   272: 
   273:   if (j == 0) /* Didn't write anything. */
   274:     out[j++] = '0';
   275: 
   276:   /* NUL terminate the output string. */
   277:   out[j++] = '\0';
   278:   return j;
   279: }

   281: /* converts illegal filename chars into appropriate equivalents */ 
   282: static void fix_filename(const char *str, char *outbuf, size_t maxlen)
   283: { 
   284:   const char *in = str;
   285:   char *out = outbuf;
   286:   int count = 0;
   287: 
   288:   while (*in) {
   289:     switch(*in) {
   290:       case ' ': *out = '_'; out++; break;
   291:       case '(': *out = '{'; out++; break;
   292:       case ')': *out = '}'; out++; break;
   293:  
   294:       /* skip the following */ 
   295:       case '\'':             break; 
   296:       case '"':              break; 
   297:  
   298:       /* Legal character */ 
   299:       default: *out = *in;  out++;break;
   300:     } 
   301:     in++;
   302:     count++;
   303:     if (count == maxlen - 1) break;
   304:   }
   305:   *out = '\0';
   306: }

   308: /* Export command by Kyle */ 
   309: ACMD(do_export_zone) 
   310: { 
   311: #ifdef CIRCLE_WINDOWS
   312:    /* tar and gzip are usually not available */
   313:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, that is not available in the windows port.\r\n");
   314: #else /* all other configurations */
   315:   zone_rnum zrnum; 
   316:   zone_vnum zvnum; 
   317:   char sysbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH]; 
   318:   char zone_name[READ_SIZE], fixed_file_name[READ_SIZE];
   319:   int success, errorcode = 0;
   320: 
   321:   /* system command locations are relative to where the binary IS, not where it
   322:    * was run from, thus we act like we are in the bin folder, because we are*/ 
   323:   char *path = "../lib/world/export/"; 
   324: 
   325:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMPL) 
   326:     return; 
   327: 
   328:   skip_spaces(&argument); 
   329:   if (!*argument){ 
   330:     send_to_char(ch, "Syntax: export <zone vnum>"); 
   331:     return; 
   332:   } 
   333: 
   334:   zvnum = atoi(argument); 
   335:   zrnum = real_zone(zvnum); 
   336: 
   337:   if (zrnum == NOWHERE) { 
   338:     send_to_char(ch, "Export which zone?\r\n"); 
   339:     return; 
   340:   } 
   341: 
   342:   /* If we fail, it might just be because the directory didn't exist.  Can't 
   343:    * hurt to try again. Do it silently though ( no logs ). */ 
   344:   if (!export_info_file(zrnum)) { 
   345:     sprintf(sysbuf, "mkdir %s", path);
   346:     errorcode = system(sysbuf);
   347:   } 
   348:   if (errorcode) {
   349:     send_to_char(ch, "Failed to create export directory.\r\n");
   350:     return;
   351:   }
   352: 
   353:   if (!(success = export_info_file(zrnum))) 
   354:     send_to_char(ch, "Info file not saved!\r\n"); 
   355:   if (!(success = export_save_shops(zrnum))) 
   356:     send_to_char(ch, "Shops not saved!\r\n"); 
   357:   if (!(success = export_save_mobiles(zrnum))) 
   358:     send_to_char(ch, "Mobiles not saved!\r\n"); 
   359:   if (!(success = export_save_objects(zrnum))) 
   360:     send_to_char(ch, "Objects not saved!\r\n"); 
   361:   if (!(success = export_save_zone(zrnum))) 
   362:     send_to_char(ch, "Zone info not saved!\r\n"); 
   363:   if (!(success = export_save_rooms(zrnum))) 
   364:     send_to_char(ch, "Rooms not saved!\r\n"); 
   365:   if (!(success = export_save_triggers(zrnum))) 
   366:     send_to_char(ch, "Triggers not saved!\r\n"); 
   367: 
   368:   /* If anything went wrong, don't try to tar the files. */ 
   369:   if (success) { 
   370:     send_to_char(ch, "Individual files saved to /lib/world/export.\r\n"); 
   371:     snprintf(zone_name, sizeof(zone_name), "%s", zone_table[zrnum].name); 
   372:   } else { 
   373:     send_to_char(ch, "Ran into problems writing to files.\r\n"); 
   374:     return; 
   375:   }
   376:   /* Make sure the name of the zone doesn't make the filename illegal. */ 
   377:   fix_filename(zone_name, fixed_file_name, sizeof(fixed_file_name));
   378: 
   379:   /* Remove the old copy. */ 
   380:   snprintf(sysbuf, sizeof(sysbuf), "rm %s%s.tar.gz", path, fixed_file_name);
   381:   errorcode = system(sysbuf);
   382:   if (errorcode) {
   383:     send_to_char(ch, "Failed to delete previous zip file. This is usually benign.\r\n");
   384:   }
   385: 
   386: 
   387:   /* Tar the new copy. */ 
   388:   snprintf(sysbuf, sizeof(sysbuf), "tar -cf %s%s.tar %sqq.info %sqq.wld %sqq.zon %sqq.mob %sqq.obj %sqq.trg %sqq.shp", path, fixed_file_name, path, path, path, path, path, path, path);
   389:   errorcode = system(sysbuf);
   390:   if (errorcode) {
   391:     send_to_char(ch, "Failed to tar files.\r\n");
   392:     return;
   393:   }
   394: 
   395:   /* Gzip it. */ 
   396:   snprintf(sysbuf, sizeof(sysbuf), "gzip %s%s.tar", path, fixed_file_name);
   397:   errorcode = system(sysbuf);
   398:   if (errorcode) {
   399:     send_to_char(ch, "Failed to gzip tar file.\r\n");
   400:     return;
   401:   }
   402: 
   403:   send_to_char(ch, "Files tar'ed to \"%s%s.tar.gz\"\r\n", path, fixed_file_name);
   404: #endif /* platform specific part */
   405: }

   407: static int export_info_file(zone_rnum zrnum)
   408: {
   409:   int i;
   410:   FILE *info_file;
   411: 
   412:   if (!(info_file = fopen("world/export/qq.info", "w"))) {
   413:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_info_file : Cannot open file!");
   414:     return FALSE;
   415:   } else if (fprintf(info_file, "tbaMUD Area file.\n") < 0) {
   416:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_info_file: Cannot write to file!");
   417:     fclose(info_file);
   418:     return FALSE;
   419:   }
   420: 
   421:   fprintf(info_file, "The files accompanying this info file contain the area: %s\n", zone_table[zrnum].name);

   429:   fprintf(info_file, "   zone 123, replace all occurences of QQ with 123 and rename the qq.zon file\n");

   438:       struct room_data *room;
   439:       int j;

   447:         if (!R_EXIT(room, j))
   448:           continue;
   449: 
   450:         if (R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room == NOWHERE || world[R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room].zone == zrnum)
   451:           continue;
   452: 
   453:         fprintf(info_file, "      Room QQ%02d : Exit to the %s\n",
   454:                            room->number%100, dirs[j]);
   455:       }
   456:     }
   457:     zone_exits = 0;
   458:   } else {
   459:     fprintf(info_file, "2. This area doesn't have any exits _out_ of the zone.\n");
   460:     fprintf(info_file, "   More info on connections can be found in the zone description room (QQ00).\n");
   461:   }
   462: 
   463:   fprintf(info_file, "\nAdditional zone information is available in the zone description room QQ00.\n");
   464:   fprintf(info_file, "The Builder's Academy is maintaining and improving these zones. Any typo or\n");
   465:   fprintf(info_file, "bug reports should be reported to rumble@tbamud.com or stop by The Builder Academy\n");

   468:   fprintf(info_file, "please stop by TBA and talk to Rumble.\n\n");
   469:   fprintf(info_file, "We at The Builder's Academy hope you will enjoy using the area.\n\n");
   470: 
   471:   fprintf(info_file, "Rumble - Admin of TBA\n");
   472:   fprintf(info_file, "Welcor - Coder of TBA\n");
   473:   fprintf(info_file, "\ntelnet://tbamud.com:9091/\n");
   474:

   476:   return TRUE;

   479: static int export_save_shops(zone_rnum zrnum)
   480: {
   481:   int i, j, rshop;
   482:   FILE *shop_file;
   483:   struct shop_data *shop;
   484: 
   485:   if (!(shop_file = fopen("world/export/qq.shp", "w"))) {
   486:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_save_shops : Cannot open shop file!");
   487:     return FALSE;
   488:   } else if (fprintf(shop_file, "CircleMUD v3.0 Shop File~\n") < 0) {
   489:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_save_shops: Cannot write to shop file!");
   490:     fclose(shop_file);
   491:     return FALSE;
   492:   }
   493:   /* Search database for shops in this zone. */
   494:   for (i = genolc_zone_bottom(zrnum); i <= zone_table[zrnum].top; i++) {
   495:     if ((rshop = real_shop(i)) != NOWHERE) {
   496:       fprintf(shop_file, "#QQ%02d~\n", i%100);
   497:       shop = &shop_index[rshop];
   498: 
   499:       /* Save the products. */
   500:       for (j = 0; S_PRODUCT(shop, j) != NOTHING; j++) {
   501:         if (obj_index[S_PRODUCT(shop, j)].vnum < genolc_zone_bottom(zrnum) ||
   502:             obj_index[S_PRODUCT(shop, j)].vnum > zone_table[zrnum].top)
   503:           continue;
   504: 
   505: 	fprintf(shop_file, "QQ%02d\n", obj_index[S_PRODUCT(shop, j)].vnum%100);
   506:       }
   507:       fprintf(shop_file, "-1\n");
   508: 
   509:       /* Save the rates. */
   510:       fprintf(shop_file, "%1.2f\n"
   511:                          "%1.2f\n",
   512:                          S_BUYPROFIT(shop),
   513:                          S_SELLPROFIT(shop));
   514: 
   515:       /* Save the buy types and namelists. */
   516:       for (j = 0;S_BUYTYPE(shop, j) != NOTHING; j++)
   517:         fprintf(shop_file, "%d%s\n",
   518:                 S_BUYTYPE(shop, j),
   519: 		S_BUYWORD(shop, j) ? S_BUYWORD(shop, j) : "");
   520:       fprintf(shop_file, "-1\n");
   521: 
   522:       /* Save messages. Added some defaults as sanity checks. */
   523:       fprintf(shop_file,
   524: 	      "%s~\n"
   525: 	      "%s~\n"
   526: 	      "%s~\n"
   527: 	      "%s~\n"
   528: 	      "%s~\n"
   529: 	      "%s~\n"
   530: 	      "%s~\n"
   531: 	      "%d\n"
   532: 	      "%ld\n"
   533: 	      "QQ%02d\n"
   534: 	      "%d\n",
   535: 	      S_NOITEM1(shop) ? S_NOITEM1(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   536: 	      S_NOITEM2(shop) ? S_NOITEM2(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   537: 	      S_NOBUY(shop) ? S_NOBUY(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   538: 	      S_NOCASH1(shop) ? S_NOCASH1(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   539: 	      S_NOCASH2(shop) ? S_NOCASH2(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   540: 	      S_BUY(shop) ? S_BUY(shop) : "%s Ke?! %d?",
   541: 	      S_SELL(shop) ? S_SELL(shop) : "%s Ke?! %d?",
   542: 	      S_BROKE_TEMPER(shop),
   543: 	      S_BITVECTOR(shop),
   544: 	      mob_index[S_KEEPER(shop)].vnum%100,
   545: 	      S_NOTRADE(shop)
   546: 	      );
   547: 
   548:       /* Save the rooms. */
   549:       for (j = 0;S_ROOM(shop, j) != NOWHERE; j++) {
   550:         if (S_ROOM(shop, j) < genolc_zone_bottom(zrnum) ||
   551:             S_ROOM(shop, j) > zone_table[zrnum].top)
   552:           continue;
   553: 
   554:         fprintf(shop_file, "QQ%02d\n", S_ROOM(shop, j)%100);
   555:       }
   556:       fprintf(shop_file, "-1\n");
   557: 
   558:       /* Save open/closing times. */
   559:       fprintf(shop_file, "%d\n%d\n%d\n%d\n", S_OPEN1(shop), S_CLOSE1(shop),
   560: 		S_OPEN2(shop), S_CLOSE2(shop));
   561:     }
   562:   }
   563:   fprintf(shop_file, "$~\n");
   564:   fclose(shop_file);
   565: 
   566:   return TRUE;
   567: }

   569: static int export_save_mobiles(zone_rnum rznum)
   570: {
   571:   FILE *mob_file;
   572:   mob_vnum i;
   573:   mob_rnum rmob;
   574: 
   575:   if (!(mob_file = fopen("world/export/qq.mob", "w"))) {
   576:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_save_mobiles : Cannot open file!");
   577:     return FALSE;
   578:   }
   579: 
   580:   for (i = genolc_zone_bottom(rznum); i <= zone_table[rznum].top; i++) {
   581:     if ((rmob = real_mobile(i)) == NOBODY)
   582:       continue;
   583:     check_mobile_strings(&mob_proto[rmob]);
   584:     if (export_mobile_record(i, &mob_proto[rmob], mob_file) < 0)
   585:       log("SYSERR: export_save_mobiles: Error writing mobile #%d.", i);
   586:   }
   587:   fputs("$\n", mob_file);
   588:   fclose(mob_file);
   589: 
   590:   return TRUE;
   591: }

   593: static int export_mobile_record(mob_vnum mvnum, struct char_data *mob, FILE *fd)
   594: {
   595: 
   596:   char ldesc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   597:   char ddesc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   598: 
   599:   ldesc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1] = '\0';
   600:   ddesc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1] = '\0';
   601:   strip_cr(strncpy(ldesc, GET_LDESC(mob), MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1));
   602:   strip_cr(strncpy(ddesc, GET_DDESC(mob), MAX_STRING_LENGTH - 1));
   603: 
   604:   fprintf(fd,	"#QQ%02d\n"
   605: 		"%s%c\n"
   606: 		"%s%c\n"
   607: 		"%s%c\n"
   608: 		"%s%c\n",
   609: 	mvnum%100,
   610: 	GET_ALIAS(mob), STRING_TERMINATOR,
   611: 	GET_SDESC(mob), STRING_TERMINATOR,
   612: 	ldesc, STRING_TERMINATOR,
   613: 	ddesc, STRING_TERMINATOR
   614:   );
   615: 
   616:   fprintf(fd, "%d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d E\n"
   617:       "%d %d %d %dd%d+%d %dd%d+%d\n",
   618:       MOB_FLAGS(mob)[0], MOB_FLAGS(mob)[1],
   619:       MOB_FLAGS(mob)[2], MOB_FLAGS(mob)[3],
   620:       AFF_FLAGS(mob)[0], AFF_FLAGS(mob)[1],
   621:       AFF_FLAGS(mob)[2], AFF_FLAGS(mob)[3],
   622:       GET_ALIGNMENT(mob),
   623:       GET_LEVEL(mob), 20 - GET_HITROLL(mob), GET_AC(mob), GET_HIT(mob),
   624:       GET_MANA(mob), GET_MOVE(mob), GET_NDD(mob), GET_SDD(mob),
   625:       GET_DAMROLL(mob));
   626: 
   627:   fprintf(fd, 	"%lld %d\n"
   628: 		"%d %d %d\n",
   629: 		GET_GOLD(mob), GET_EXP(mob),
   630: 		GET_POS(mob), GET_DEFAULT_POS(mob), GET_SEX(mob)
   631:   );
   632: 
   633:   if (write_mobile_espec(mvnum, mob, fd) < 0)
   634:     log("SYSERR: GenOLC: Error writing E-specs for mobile #%d.", mvnum);
   635: 
   636:   export_script_save_to_disk(fd, mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
   637: 
   638:   return TRUE;
   639: }

   641: static int export_save_zone(zone_rnum zrnum)
   642: {
   643:   int subcmd;
   644:   FILE *zone_file;
   645: 
   646:   if (!(zone_file = fopen("world/export/qq.zon", "w"))) {
   647:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_save_zone : Cannot open file!");
   648:     return FALSE;
   649:   }
   650: 
   651:   /* Print zone header to file. */
   652:   fprintf(zone_file, "#QQ\n"
   653:                  "%s~\n"
   654:                  "%s~\n"
   655:                  "QQ%02d QQ%02d %d %d\n",
   656: 	  (zone_table[zrnum].builders && *zone_table[zrnum].builders)
   657: 		? zone_table[zrnum].builders : "None.",
   658: 	  (zone_table[zrnum].name && *zone_table[zrnum].name)
   659: 		? zone_table[zrnum].name : "undefined",
   660:           genolc_zone_bottom(zrnum)%100,
   661: 	  zone_table[zrnum].top%100,
   662: 	  zone_table[zrnum].lifespan,
   663: 	  zone_table[zrnum].reset_mode
   664: 	  );
   665: 
   666: 	/* Handy Quick Reference Chart for Zone Values.
   667: 	 *
   668: 	 * Field #1    Field #3   Field #4  Field #5
   669: 	 * -------------------------------------------------
   670: 	 * M (Mobile)  Mob-Vnum   Wld-Max   Room-Vnum
   671: 	 * O (Object)  Obj-Vnum   Wld-Max   Room-Vnum
   672: 	 * G (Give)    Obj-Vnum   Wld-Max   Unused
   673: 	 * E (Equip)   Obj-Vnum   Wld-Max   EQ-Position
   674: 	 * P (Put)     Obj-Vnum   Wld-Max   Target-Obj-Vnum
   675: 	 * D (Door)    Room-Vnum  Door-Dir  Door-State
   676: 	 * R (Remove)  Room-Vnum  Obj-Vnum  Unused
   677:          * T (Trigger) Trig-type  Trig-Vnum Room-Vnum
   678:          * V (var)     Trig-type  Context   Room-Vnum Varname Value
   679: 	 * ------------------------------------------------- */
   680: 
   681:   for (subcmd = 0; ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).command != 'S'; subcmd++) {
   682:     switch (ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).command) {
   683:     case 'M':
   684:       fprintf(zone_file, "M %d QQ%02d %d QQ%02d \t(%s)\n",
   685: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).if_flag,
   686: 		mob_index[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].vnum%100,
   687: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2,
   688: 		world[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg3].number%100,
   689: 		mob_proto[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].player.short_descr);
   690:       break;
   691:     case 'O':
   692:       fprintf(zone_file, "O %d QQ%02d %d QQ%02d \t(%s)\n",
   693: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).if_flag,
   694: 		obj_index[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].vnum%100,
   695: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2,
   696: 		world[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg3].number%100,
   697: 		obj_proto[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].short_description);
   698:       break;
   699:     case 'G':
   700:       fprintf(zone_file, "G %d QQ%02d %d -1 \t(%s)\n",
   701: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).if_flag,
   702:                 obj_index[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].vnum%100,
   703:                 ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2,
   704:                 obj_proto[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].short_description);
   705:       break;
   706:     case 'E':
   707:       fprintf(zone_file, "E %d QQ%02d %d %d \t(%s)\n",
   708: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).if_flag,
   709: 		 obj_index[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].vnum%100,
   710: 		 ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2,
   711: 		 ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg3,
   712: 		 obj_proto[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].short_description);
   713:       break;
   714:     case 'P':
   715:       fprintf(zone_file, "P %d QQ%02d %d QQ%02d \t(%s)\n",
   716: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).if_flag,
   717: 		obj_index[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].vnum%100,
   718: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2,
   719: 		obj_index[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg3].vnum%100,
   720: 		obj_proto[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].short_description);
   721:       break;
   722:     case 'D':
   723:       fprintf(zone_file, "D %d QQ%02d %d %d \t(%s)\n",
   724: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).if_flag,
   725: 		world[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].number%100,
   726: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2,
   727: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg3,
   728: 		world[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].name);
   729:       break;
   730:     case 'R':
   731:       fprintf(zone_file, "R %d QQ%02d QQ%02d -1 \t(%s)\n",
   732: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).if_flag,
   733: 		world[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1].number%100,
   734: 		obj_index[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2].vnum%100,
   735: 		obj_proto[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2].short_description);
   736:       break;
   737:     case 'T':
   738:       fprintf(zone_file, "T %d %d QQ%02d QQ%02d \t(%s)\n",
   739: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).if_flag,
   740: 		ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1,
   741: 		trig_index[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2]->vnum%100,
   742: 		world[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg3].number%100,
   743: 		GET_TRIG_NAME(trig_index[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2]->proto));
   744:       break;
   745:     case 'V':
   746:       fprintf(zone_file, "V %d %d %d QQ%02d %s %s\n",
   747:               ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).if_flag,
   748:               ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg1,
   749:               ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg2,
   750:               world[ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).arg3].number%100,
   751:               ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).sarg1,
   752:               ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).sarg2);
   753:       break;
   754:     case '*':
   755:       /* Invalid commands are replaced with '*' - Ignore them. */
   756:       continue;
   757:     default:
   758:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_save_zone(): Unknown cmd '%c' - NOT saving", ZCMD(zrnum, subcmd).command);
   759:       continue;
   760:     }
   761:   }
   762:   fputs("S\n$\n", zone_file);
   763:   fclose(zone_file);
   764: 
   765:   return TRUE;
   766: }
   767: 
   768: static int export_save_objects(zone_rnum zrnum)
   769: {
   770:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   771:   char ebuf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], ebuf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], ebuf3[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], ebuf4[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   772:   char wbuf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], wbuf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], wbuf3[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], wbuf4[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   773:   char pbuf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], pbuf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], pbuf3[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], pbuf4[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   774:   obj_rnum ornum;
   775:   obj_vnum ovnum;
   776:   int i;
   777:   FILE *obj_file;
   778:   struct obj_data *obj;
   779:   struct extra_descr_data *ex_desc;
   780: 
   781:   if (!(obj_file = fopen("world/export/qq.obj", "w"))) {
   782:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_save_objects : Cannot open file!");
   783:     return FALSE;
   784:   }
   785:   /* Start running through all objects in this zone. */
   786:   for (ovnum = genolc_zone_bottom(zrnum); ovnum <= zone_table[zrnum].top; ovnum++) {
   787:     if ((ornum = real_object(ovnum)) != NOTHING) {
   788:       if ((obj = &obj_proto[ornum])->action_description) {
   789: 	strncpy(buf, obj->action_description, sizeof(buf) - 1);
   790: 	strip_cr(buf);
   791:       } else
   792: 	*buf = '\0';
   793: 
   794:       fprintf(obj_file,
   795: 	      "#QQ%02d\n"
   796: 	      "%s~\n"
   797: 	      "%s~\n"
   798: 	      "%s~\n"
   799: 	      "%s~\n",
   800: 
   801: 	      GET_OBJ_VNUM(obj)%100,
   802: 	      (obj->name && *obj->name) ? obj->name : "undefined",
   803: 	      (obj->short_description && *obj->short_description) ? obj->short_description : "undefined",
   804: 	      (obj->description && *obj->description) ?	obj->description : "undefined",
   805: 	      buf);
   806: 
   807:       sprintascii(ebuf1, GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj)[0]);
   808:       sprintascii(ebuf2, GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj)[1]);
   809:       sprintascii(ebuf3, GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj)[2]);
   810:       sprintascii(ebuf4, GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj)[3]);
   811:       sprintascii(wbuf1, GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj)[0]);
   812:       sprintascii(wbuf2, GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj)[1]);
   813:       sprintascii(wbuf3, GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj)[2]);
   814:       sprintascii(wbuf4, GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj)[3]);
   815:       sprintascii(pbuf1, GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj)[0]);
   816:       sprintascii(pbuf2, GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj)[1]);
   817:       sprintascii(pbuf3, GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj)[2]);
   818:       sprintascii(pbuf4, GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj)[3]);
   819: 
   820:       fprintf(obj_file,
   821:           "%d %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s %s\n",
   822:           GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj),
   823:           ebuf1, ebuf2, ebuf3, ebuf4,
   824:           wbuf1, wbuf2, wbuf3, wbuf4,
   825:           pbuf1, pbuf2, pbuf3, pbuf4);
   826: 
   827:       if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) != ITEM_CONTAINER)
   828:         fprintf(obj_file,
   829:                 "%d %d %d %d\n",
   830: 	        GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2), GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3));
   831:       else
   832:         fprintf(obj_file,
   833:                 "%d %d %s%02d %d\n",
   834: 	        GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0),
   835: 	        GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1),
   836: 	        GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2) == -1 ? "" : "QQ", /* key */
   837: 	        GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2) == -1 ? -1 : GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2)%100,
   838: 	        GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3));
   839: 
   840:       fprintf(obj_file,
   841: 	      "%d %d %d %d\n",
   842: 	      GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj), GET_OBJ_COST(obj), GET_OBJ_RENT(obj), GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj));
   843: 
   844:       /* Do we have script(s) attached? */
   845:       export_script_save_to_disk(obj_file, obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
   846: 
   847:       /* Do we have extra descriptions? */
   848:       if (obj->ex_description) {	/* Yes, save them too. */
   849: 	for (ex_desc = obj->ex_description; ex_desc; ex_desc = ex_desc->next) {
   850: 	  /* Sanity check to prevent nasty protection faults. */
   851: 	  if (!ex_desc->keyword || !ex_desc->description || !*ex_desc->keyword || !*ex_desc->description) {
   852: 	    mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: export_save_objects: Corrupt ex_desc!");
   853: 	    continue;
   854: 	  }
   855: 	  strncpy(buf, ex_desc->description, sizeof(buf) - 1);
   856: 	  strip_cr(buf);
   857: 	  fprintf(obj_file, "E\n"
   858: 		  "%s~\n"
   859: 		  "%s~\n", ex_desc->keyword, buf);
   860: 	}
   861:       }
   862:       /* Do we have affects? */
   863:       for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; i++)
   864: 	if (obj->affected[i].modifier)
   865: 	  fprintf(obj_file, "A\n"
   866: 		            "%d %d\n",
   867: 		  obj->affected[i].location,
   868: 		  obj->affected[i].modifier);
   869:     }
   870:   }
   871: 
   872:   /* Write the final line, close the file. */
   873:   fprintf(obj_file, "$~\n");
   874:   fclose(obj_file);
   875: 
   876:   return TRUE;
   877: }
   878: 
   879: static int export_save_rooms(zone_rnum zrnum)
   880: {
   881:   int i;
   882:   struct room_data *room;
   883:   FILE *room_file;
   884:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   885:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   886: 
   887:   if (!(room_file = fopen("world/export/qq.wld", "w"))) {
   888:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_save_rooms : Cannot open file!");
   889:     return FALSE;
   890:   }
   891: 
   892:   for (i = genolc_zone_bottom(zrnum); i <= zone_table[zrnum].top; i++) {
   893:     room_rnum rnum;
   894: 
   895:     if ((rnum = real_room(i)) != NOWHERE) {
   896:       int j;
   897: 
   898:       room = &world[rnum];
   899: 
   900:       /* Copy the description and strip off trailing newlines. */
   901:       strncpy(buf, room->description ? room->description : "Empty room.", sizeof(buf)-1 );
   902:       strip_cr(buf);
   903: 
   904:       /* Save the numeric and string section of the file. */
   905:       fprintf(room_file, 	"#QQ%02d\n"
   906: 			"%s%c\n"
   907: 			"%s%c\n"
   908: 			"QQ %d %d %d %d %d\n",
   909: 		room->number%100,
   910: 		room->name ? room->name : "Untitled", STRING_TERMINATOR,
   911: 		buf, STRING_TERMINATOR,
   912: 		room->room_flags[0], room->room_flags[1],
   913:                 room->room_flags[2], room->room_flags[3], room->sector_type
   914:       );
   915: 
   916:       /* Now you write out the exits for the room. */
   917:       for (j = 0; j < DIR_COUNT; j++) {
   918: 	if (R_EXIT(room, j)) {
   919: 	  int dflag;
   920: 	  if (R_EXIT(room, j)->general_description) {
   921: 	    strncpy(buf, R_EXIT(room, j)->general_description, sizeof(buf)-1);
   922: 	    strip_cr(buf);
   923: 	  } else
   924: 	    *buf = '\0';
   925: 
   926: 	  /* Figure out door flag. */
   927: 	  if (IS_SET(R_EXIT(room, j)->exit_info, EX_ISDOOR)) {
   928: 	    if (IS_SET(R_EXIT(room, j)->exit_info, EX_PICKPROOF))
   929: 	      dflag = 2;
   930: 	    else
   931: 	      dflag = 1;
   932: 	  } else
   933: 	    dflag = 0;
   934: 
   935: 	  if (R_EXIT(room, j)->keyword)
   936: 	    strncpy(buf1, R_EXIT(room, j)->keyword, sizeof(buf1)-1 );
   937: 	  else
   938: 	    *buf1 = '\0';
   939: 
   940: 	  /* Now write the exit to the file. */
   941:           if (R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room == NOWHERE || world[R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room].zone == zrnum)
   942: 	    fprintf(room_file,"D%d\n"
   943: 		              "%s~\n"
   944: 			      "%s~\n"
   945:         		      "%d %s%02d %s%02d\n",
   946: 			      j,
   947: 			      buf,
   948: 			      buf1,
   949: 			      dflag,
   950: 			      R_EXIT(room, j)->key == NOTHING ? "" : "QQ",
   951: 			      R_EXIT(room, j)->key == NOTHING ? -1 : R_EXIT(room, j)->key % 100 ,
   952: 			      R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room == NOTHING ? "" : "QQ",
   953: 			      R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room != NOTHING ? (world[R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room].number%100) : -1);
   954:           else {
   955: 	    fprintf(room_file,"D%d\n"
   956: 		              "%s~\n"
   957: 			      "%s~\n"
   958:         		      "%d %s%02d ZZ%02d\n",
   959: 			      j,
   960: 			      buf,
   961: 			      buf1,
   962: 			      dflag,
   963: 			      R_EXIT(room, j)->key == NOTHING ? "" : "QQ",
   964: 			      R_EXIT(room, j)->key == NOTHING ? -1 : R_EXIT(room, j)->key % 100 ,
   965: 			      world[R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room].number%100);
   966:             zone_exits++;
   967:           }
   968: 	}
   969:       }
   970: 
   971:       if (room->ex_description) {
   972:         struct extra_descr_data *xdesc;
   973: 
   974: 	for (xdesc = room->ex_description; xdesc; xdesc = xdesc->next) {
   975: 	  strncpy(buf, xdesc->description, sizeof(buf) - 1);
   976: 	  buf[sizeof(buf) - 1] = '\0';
   977: 	  strip_cr(buf);
   978: 	  fprintf(room_file,	"E\n"
   979: 			"%s~\n"
   980: 			"%s~\n", xdesc->keyword, buf);
   981: 	}
   982:       }
   983:       fprintf(room_file, "S\n");
   984:       export_script_save_to_disk(room_file, room, WLD_TRIGGER);
   985:     }
   986:   }
   987: 
   988:   /* Write the final line and close it. */
   989:   fprintf(room_file, "$~\n");
   990:   fclose(room_file);
   991: 
   992:   return TRUE;
   993: }
   994: 
   995: static void export_script_save_to_disk(FILE *fp, void *item, int type)
   996: {
   997:   struct trig_proto_list *t;
   998: 
   999:   if (type==MOB_TRIGGER)
  1000:     t = ((struct char_data *)item)->proto_script;
  1001:   else if (type==OBJ_TRIGGER)
  1002:     t = ((struct obj_data *)item)->proto_script;
  1003:   else if (type==WLD_TRIGGER)
  1004:     t = ((struct room_data *)item)->proto_script;
  1005:   else {
  1006:     log("SYSERR: Invalid type passed to export_script_save_to_disk()");
  1007:     return;
  1008:   }
  1009: 
  1010:   while (t)
  1011:   {
  1012:     fprintf(fp, "T QQ%02d\n", t->vnum%100);
  1013:     t = t->next;
  1014:   }
  1015: }
  1016: 
  1017: /* save the zone's triggers to internal memory and to disk */
  1018: static int export_save_triggers(zone_rnum zrnum)
  1019: {
  1020:   int i;
  1021:   trig_data *trig;
  1022:   struct cmdlist_element *cmd;
  1023:   FILE *trig_file;
  1024:   char bitBuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1025: 
  1026:   if (!(trig_file = fopen("world/export/qq.trg", "w"))) {
  1027:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: export_save_triggers : Cannot open file!");
  1028:     return FALSE;
  1029:   }
  1030: 
  1031:   for (i = genolc_zone_bottom(zrnum); i <= zone_table[zrnum].top; i++) {
  1032:     trig_rnum rnum;
  1033: 
  1034:     if ((rnum = real_trigger(i)) != NOTHING) {
  1035:       trig = trig_index[rnum]->proto;
  1036: 
  1037:       fprintf(trig_file, "#QQ%02d\n", i%100);
  1038: 
  1039:       sprintascii(bitBuf, GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig));
  1040:       fprintf(trig_file,      "%s%c\n"
  1041:                               "%d %s %d\n"
  1042:                               "%s%c\n",
  1043:            (GET_TRIG_NAME(trig)) ? (GET_TRIG_NAME(trig)) : "unknown trigger", STRING_TERMINATOR,
  1044:            trig->attach_type,
  1045:            *bitBuf ? bitBuf : "0", GET_TRIG_NARG(trig),
  1046:            GET_TRIG_ARG(trig) ? GET_TRIG_ARG(trig) : "", STRING_TERMINATOR);
  1047: 
  1048:       fprintf(trig_file, "* This trigger has been exported 'as is'. This means that vnums\n"
  1049:                          "* in this file are not changed, and will have to be edited by hand.\n"
  1050:                          "* This zone was number %d on The Builder Academy, so you\n"
  1051:                          "* should be looking for %dxx, where xx is 00-99.\n",
  1052:                          zone_table[zrnum].number, zone_table[zrnum].number);
  1053:         for (cmd = trig->cmdlist; cmd; cmd = cmd->next) {
  1054:           fprintf(trig_file, "%s\n", cmd->cmd);
  1055:         }
  1056:       fprintf(trig_file, "%c\n", STRING_TERMINATOR);
  1057:     }
  1058:   }
  1059: 
  1060:   fprintf(trig_file, "$%c\n", STRING_TERMINATOR);
  1061:   fclose(trig_file);
  1062:   return TRUE;
  1063: }

    23: int copy_quest(struct aq_data *to, struct aq_data *from, int free_old_strings)
    24: {
    25:   int i;
    26:   if (free_old_strings)
    27:     free_quest_strings(to);
    28:   to->vnum       = from->vnum;
    29:   to->flags      = from->flags;
    30:   to->type       = from->type;
    31:   to->qm         = from->qm;
    32:   to->target     = from->target;
    33:   to->prereq     = from->prereq;
    34:   to->prev_quest = from->prev_quest;
    35:   to->next_quest = from->next_quest;
    36:   for (i = 0; i < 7; i++){
    37:     to->value[i] = from->value[i];
    38:   }
    39:   to->gold_reward = from->gold_reward;
    40:   to->exp_reward  = from->exp_reward;
    41:   to->obj_reward  = from->obj_reward;
    42:   to->func        = from->func;
    43:   return copy_quest_strings(to, from);
    44: }
    45: 
    46: int copy_quest_strings(struct aq_data *to, struct aq_data *from)
    47: {
    48:   if (from == NULL || to == NULL) {
    49:     log("SYSERR: GenQST: copy_quest_strings: Null values passed.");
    50:     return FALSE;
    51:   }
    52:   to->name = str_udup(from->name);
    53:   to->desc = str_udup(from->desc);
    54:   to->info = str_udup(from->info);
    55:   to->done = str_udup(from->done);
    56:   to->quit = str_udup(from->quit);
    57:   return TRUE;
    58: }
    59: 
    60: void free_quest_strings(struct aq_data *quest)
    61: {
    62:   if (quest->name)
    63:     free(quest->name);
    64:   if (quest->desc)
    65:     free(quest->desc);
    66:   if (quest->info)
    67:     free(quest->info);
    68:   if (quest->done)
    69:     free(quest->done);
    70:   if (quest->quit)
    71:     free(quest->quit);
    72: }
    73: 
    74: void free_quest(struct aq_data *quest)
    75: {
    76:   free_quest_strings(quest);
    77:   free(quest);
    78: }

    81: 
    82: int add_quest(struct aq_data *nqst)
    83: {
    84:   qst_rnum rnum;
    85:   mob_rnum qmrnum;
    86:   zone_rnum rznum = real_zone_by_thing(nqst->vnum);
    87: 
    88:   /* The quest already exists, just update it.  */
    89:   if ((rnum = real_quest(nqst->vnum)) != NOWHERE) {
    90:     copy_quest(&aquest_table[rnum], nqst, TRUE);
    91:   } else {
    92:     /* increase the number of quest table entries */
    93:     total_quests++;
    94:     RECREATE(aquest_table, struct aq_data, total_quests );
    95:     /* Initialise top quest strings to null */
    96:     QST_NAME(total_quests - 1) = NULL;
    97:     QST_DESC(total_quests - 1) = NULL;
    98:     QST_INFO(total_quests - 1) = NULL;
    99:     QST_DONE(total_quests - 1) = NULL;
   100:     QST_QUIT(total_quests - 1) = NULL;
   101:     /* Now process enties from the top down to see where the new one goes */
   102:     for (rnum = total_quests - 1; rnum > 0; rnum--) {
   103:       if (nqst->vnum > QST_NUM(rnum - 1))
   104:         break; //found the place
   105:       aquest_table[rnum] = aquest_table[rnum - 1]; //shift quest up one
   106:     }
   107:     copy_quest(&aquest_table[rnum], nqst, FALSE);
   108:   }
   109:   qmrnum = real_mobile(QST_MASTER(rnum));
   110:   /* Make sure we assign spec procs to the questmaster */
   111:   if (qmrnum != NOBODY && mob_index[qmrnum].func &&
   112:      mob_index[qmrnum].func != questmaster)
   113:      QST_FUNC(rnum) = mob_index[qmrnum].func;
   114:   if(qmrnum != NOBODY) 
   115:     mob_index[qmrnum].func = questmaster;
   116: 
   117:   /* And make sure we save the updated quest information to disk */
   118:   if (rznum != NOWHERE)
   119:     add_to_save_list(zone_table[rznum].number, SL_QST);
   120:   else
   121:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE,
   122:            "SYSERR: GenOLC: Cannot determine quest zone.");
   123: 
   124:   return rnum;
   125: }
   126: 
   127: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   128: 
   129: int delete_quest(qst_rnum rnum)
   130: {
   131:   qst_rnum i;
   132:   zone_rnum rznum;
   133:   mob_vnum qm = QST_MASTER(rnum);
   134:   SPECIAL (*tempfunc);
   135:   int  quests_remaining = 0;
   136: 
   137:   if (rnum >= total_quests)
   138:     return FALSE;
   139:   rznum = real_zone_by_thing(QST_NUM(rnum)); 
   140:   log("GenOLC: delete_quest: Deleting quest #%d (%s).",
   141:        QST_NUM(rnum), QST_NAME(rnum));
   142:   /* make a note of the quest master's secondary spec proc */
   143:   tempfunc = QST_FUNC(rnum);
   144: 
   145: 
   146:   free_quest_strings(&aquest_table[rnum]);
   147:   for (i = rnum; i < total_quests - 1; i++) {
   148:     aquest_table[i] = aquest_table[i + 1];
   149:   }
   150:   total_quests--;
   151:   if (total_quests > 0)
   152:     RECREATE(aquest_table, struct aq_data, total_quests);
   153:   else {
   154:     free(aquest_table);
   155:     aquest_table = NULL; 
   156:    }
   157:   if (rznum != NOWHERE)
   158:      add_to_save_list(zone_table[rznum].number, SL_QST);
   159:   else
   160:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE,
   161:            "SYSERR: GenOLC: Cannot determine quest zone.");
   162:   /* does the questmaster mob have any quests left? */
   163:   if (qm != NOBODY) {
   164:     for (i = 0; i < total_quests; i++) {
   165:       if (QST_MASTER(i) == qm)
   166:         quests_remaining++;
   167:     }
   168:     if (quests_remaining == 0)
   169:       mob_index[qm].func = tempfunc; // point back to original spec proc
   170:   }
   171:   return TRUE;
   172: }

   175: 
   176: int save_quests(zone_rnum zone_num)
   177: {
   178:   FILE *sf;
   179:   char filename[128], oldname[128], quest_flags[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   180:   char quest_desc[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], quest_info[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   181:   char quest_done[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], quest_quit[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   182:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   183:   int i, num_quests = 0;
   184: 
   185: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
   186:   if (zone_num == NOWHERE || zone_num > top_of_zone_table) {
   187: #else
   188:   if (zone_num < 0 || zone_num > top_of_zone_table) {
   189: #endif
   190:     log("SYSERR: GenOLC: save_quests: Invalid zone number %d passed! (0-%d)",
   191:          zone_num, top_of_zone_table);
   192:     return FALSE;
   193:   }
   194: 
   195:   log("GenOLC: save_quests: Saving quests in zone #%d (%d-%d).",
   196:         zone_table[zone_num].number,
   197:  genolc_zone_bottom(zone_num), zone_table[zone_num].top);
   198: 
   199:   snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "%s/%d.new",
   200:  QST_PREFIX, zone_table[zone_num].number);
   201:   if (!(sf = fopen(filename, "w"))) {
   202:     perror("SYSERR: save_quests");
   203:     return FALSE;
   204:   }
   205:   for (i = genolc_zone_bottom(zone_num); i <= zone_table[zone_num].top; i++) {
   206:     qst_rnum rnum;
   207:     if ((rnum = real_quest(i)) != NOTHING) {
   208:       /* Copy the text strings and strip off trailing newlines. */
   209:       strncpy(quest_desc, QST_DESC(rnum) ? QST_DESC(rnum) : "undefined",
   210:               sizeof(quest_desc)-1 );
   211:       strncpy(quest_info, QST_INFO(rnum) ? QST_INFO(rnum) : "undefined",
   212:               sizeof(quest_info)-1 );
   213:       strncpy(quest_done, QST_DONE(rnum) ? QST_DONE(rnum) : "undefined",
   214:               sizeof(quest_done)-1 );
   215:       strncpy(quest_quit, QST_QUIT(rnum) ? QST_QUIT(rnum) : "undefined",
   216:               sizeof(quest_quit)-1 );
   217:       strip_cr(quest_desc);
   218:       strip_cr(quest_info);
   219:       strip_cr(quest_done);
   220:       strip_cr(quest_quit);
   221:       /* Save the quest details to the file.  */
   222:       sprintascii(quest_flags, QST_FLAGS(rnum));
   223:       int n = snprintf(buf, MAX_STRING_LENGTH,
   224:         "#%d\n"
   225:         "%s%c\n"
   226:         "%s%c\n"
   227:         "%s%c\n"
   228:         "%s%c\n"
   229:         "%s%c\n"
   230:         "%d %d %s %d %d %d %d\n"
   231:         "%d %d %d %d %d %d %d\n"
   232:         "%d %d %d\n"
   233:         "S\n",
   234:         QST_NUM(rnum),
   235:         QST_NAME(rnum) ? QST_NAME(rnum) : "Untitled", STRING_TERMINATOR,
   236:         quest_desc, STRING_TERMINATOR,
   237:         quest_info, STRING_TERMINATOR,
   238:         quest_done, STRING_TERMINATOR,
   239:         quest_quit, STRING_TERMINATOR,
   240:         QST_TYPE(rnum),
   241:         QST_MASTER(rnum) == NOBODY ? -1 : QST_MASTER(rnum),
   242:         quest_flags,
   243:         QST_TARGET(rnum) == NOTHING ? -1 : QST_TARGET(rnum),
   244:         QST_PREV(rnum)   == NOTHING ? -1 : QST_PREV(rnum),
   245:         QST_NEXT(rnum)   == NOTHING ? -1 : QST_NEXT(rnum),
   246:         QST_PREREQ(rnum) == NOTHING ? -1 : QST_PREREQ(rnum),
   247:         QST_POINTS(rnum), QST_PENALTY(rnum), QST_MINLEVEL(rnum),
   248:         QST_MAXLEVEL(rnum), QST_TIME(rnum),
   249:         QST_RETURNMOB(rnum) == NOBODY ? -1 : QST_RETURNMOB(rnum),
   250:         QST_QUANTITY(rnum), QST_GOLD(rnum), QST_EXP(rnum), QST_OBJ(rnum)
   251:       );
   252:       
   253:       if(n < MAX_STRING_LENGTH) {
   254:         fprintf(sf, "%s", convert_from_tabs(buf));
   255:         num_quests++;
   256:       } else {
   257:         mudlog(BRF,LVL_BUILDER,TRUE, 
   258:                "SYSERR: Could not save quest #%d due to size (%d > maximum of %d).", 
   259:                QST_NUM(rnum), n, MAX_STRING_LENGTH);
   260:       }
   261:     }
   262:   }
   263:   /* Write the final line and close it.  */
   264:   fprintf(sf, "$~\n");
   265:   fclose(sf);
   266: 
   267:   /* Old file we're replacing. */
   268:   snprintf(oldname, sizeof(oldname), "%s/%d.qst",
   269:            QST_PREFIX, zone_table[zone_num].number);
   270:   remove(oldname);
   271:   rename(filename, oldname);
   272: 
   273:   /* Do we need to update the index file? */
   274:   if (num_quests > 0)
   275:     create_world_index(zone_table[zone_num].number, "qst");
   276: 
   277:   if (in_save_list(zone_table[zone_num].number, SL_QST))
   278:     remove_from_save_list(zone_table[zone_num].number, SL_QST);
   279:   return TRUE;
   280: }

    27: void copy_shop(struct shop_data *tshop, struct shop_data *fshop, int free_old_strings)
    28: {
    29:   /* Copy basic information over. */
    30:   S_NUM(tshop) = S_NUM(fshop);
    31:   S_KEEPER(tshop) = S_KEEPER(fshop);
    32:   S_OPEN1(tshop) = S_OPEN1(fshop);
    33:   S_CLOSE1(tshop) = S_CLOSE1(fshop);
    34:   S_OPEN2(tshop) = S_OPEN2(fshop);
    35:   S_CLOSE2(tshop) = S_CLOSE2(fshop);
    36:   S_BANK(tshop) = S_BANK(fshop);
    37:   S_BROKE_TEMPER(tshop) = S_BROKE_TEMPER(fshop);
    38:   S_BITVECTOR(tshop) = S_BITVECTOR(fshop);
    39:   S_NOTRADE(tshop) = S_NOTRADE(fshop);
    40:   S_SORT(tshop) = S_SORT(fshop);
    41:   S_BUYPROFIT(tshop) = S_BUYPROFIT(fshop);
    42:   S_SELLPROFIT(tshop) = S_SELLPROFIT(fshop);
    43:   S_FUNC(tshop) = S_FUNC(fshop);
    44: 
    45:   /* Copy lists over. */
    46:   copy_shop_list(&(S_ROOMS(tshop)), S_ROOMS(fshop));
    47:   copy_shop_list(&(S_PRODUCTS(tshop)), S_PRODUCTS(fshop));
    48:   copy_shop_type_list(&(tshop->type), fshop->type);
    49: 
    50:   /* Copy notification strings over. */
    51:   if (free_old_strings)
    52:     free_shop_strings(tshop);
    53:   S_NOITEM1(tshop) = str_udup(S_NOITEM1(fshop));
    54:   S_NOITEM2(tshop) = str_udup(S_NOITEM2(fshop));
    55:   S_NOCASH1(tshop) = str_udup(S_NOCASH1(fshop));
    56:   S_NOCASH2(tshop) = str_udup(S_NOCASH2(fshop));
    57:   S_NOBUY(tshop) = str_udup(S_NOBUY(fshop));
    58:   S_BUY(tshop) = str_udup(S_BUY(fshop));
    59:   S_SELL(tshop) = str_udup(S_SELL(fshop));
    60: 
    61: }

    63: /* Copy a 'NOTHING' terminated integer array list. */
    64: static void copy_shop_list(IDXTYPE **tlist, IDXTYPE *flist)
    65: {
    66:   int num_items, i;
    67: 
    68:   if (*tlist)
    69:     free(*tlist);
    70: 
    71:   /* Count number of entries. */
    72:   for (i = 0; flist[i] != NOTHING; i++);
    73:   num_items = i + 1;
    74: 
    75:   /* Make space for entries. */
    76:   CREATE(*tlist, IDXTYPE, num_items);
    77: 
    78:   /* Copy entries over. */
    79:   for (i = 0; i < num_items; i++)
    80:     (*tlist)[i] = flist[i];
    81: }
    82: 
    83: /* Copy a -1 terminated (in the type field) shop_buy_data array list. */
    84: static void copy_shop_type_list(struct shop_buy_data **tlist, struct shop_buy_data *flist)
    85: {
    86:   int num_items, i;
    87: 
    88:   if (*tlist)
    89:     free_shop_type_list(tlist);
    90: 
    91:   /* Count number of entries. */
    92:   for (i = 0; BUY_TYPE(flist[i]) != NOTHING; i++);
    93:   num_items = i + 1;
    94: 
    95:   /* Make space for entries. */
    96:   CREATE(*tlist, struct shop_buy_data, num_items);
    97: 
    98:   /* Copy entries over. */
    99:   for (i = 0; i < num_items; i++) {
   100:     (*tlist)[i].type = flist[i].type;
   101:     if (BUY_WORD(flist[i]))
   102:       BUY_WORD((*tlist)[i]) = strdup(BUY_WORD(flist[i]));
   103:   }
   104: }
   105: 
   106: void remove_shop_from_type_list(struct shop_buy_data **list, int num)
   107: {
   108:   int i, num_items;
   109:   struct shop_buy_data *nlist;
   110: 
   111:   /* Count number of entries. */
   112:   for (i = 0; (*list)[i].type != NOTHING; i++);
   113: 
   114:   if (num < 0 || num >= i)
   115:     return;
   116:   num_items = i;
   117: 
   118:   CREATE(nlist, struct shop_buy_data, num_items);
   119: 
   120:   for (i = 0; i < num_items; i++)
   121:     nlist[i] = (i < num) ? (*list)[i] : (*list)[i + 1];
   122: 
   123:   free(BUY_WORD((*list)[num]));
   124:   free(*list);
   125:   *list = nlist;
   126: }
   127: 
   128: void add_shop_to_type_list(struct shop_buy_data **list, struct shop_buy_data *newl)
   129: {
   130:   int i, num_items;
   131:   struct shop_buy_data *nlist;
   132: 
   133:   /* Count number of entries. */
   134:   for (i = 0; (*list)[i].type != NOTHING; i++);
   135:   num_items = i;
   136: 
   137:   /* Make a new list and slot in the new entry. */
   138:   CREATE(nlist, struct shop_buy_data, num_items + 2);
   139: 
   140:   for (i = 0; i < num_items; i++)
   141:     nlist[i] = (*list)[i];
   142:   nlist[num_items] = *newl;
   143:   nlist[num_items + 1].type = NOTHING;
   144: 
   145:   /* Out with the old, in with the new. */
   146:   free(*list);
   147:   *list = nlist;
   148: }

   215:     free(S_NOBUY(shop));

   251: /* Returns the real number of the shop with given virtual number. We take so
   252:  * good care to keep it sorted - let's use it. - Welcor */
   253: shop_rnum real_shop(shop_vnum vnum)
   254: {
   255:   int bot, top, mid;
   256: 
   257:   bot = 0;
   258:   top = top_shop;
   259: 
   260:   /* perform binary search on shop_table */
   261:   while (bot <= top) {
   262:     mid = (bot + top) / 2;
   263:     if (SHOP_NUM(mid) == vnum)
   264:       return (mid);
   265:     if (SHOP_NUM(mid) > vnum)
   266:       top = mid - 1;
   267:     else
   268:       bot = mid + 1;
   269:   }
   270:   return NOWHERE;
   271: }

   273: /* Generic string modifier for shop keeper messages. */
   274: void modify_shop_string(char **str, char *new_s)
   275: {
   276: 
   277:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   278:   char *pointer;
   279: 
   280:   /* Check the '%s' is present, if not, add it. */
   281:   if (*new_s != '%') {
   282:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%%s %s", new_s);
   283:     pointer = buf;
   284:   } else
   285:     pointer = new_s;
   286: 
   287:   if (*str)
   288:     free(*str);
   289:   *str = strdup(pointer);
   290: }

   292: int add_shop(struct shop_data *nshp)
   293: {
   294:   shop_rnum rshop;
   295:   int found = 0;
   296:   zone_rnum rznum = real_zone_by_thing(S_NUM(nshp));
   297: 
   298:   /* The shop already exists, just update it. */
   299:   if ((rshop = real_shop(S_NUM(nshp))) != NOWHERE) {
   300:    /* free old strings. They're not used in any other place -- Welcor */
   301:    copy_shop(&shop_index[rshop], nshp, TRUE);
   302:     if (rznum != NOWHERE)
   303:       add_to_save_list(zone_table[rznum].number, SL_SHP);
   304:     else
   305:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: GenOLC: Cannot determine shop zone.");
   306:     return rshop;
   307:   }
   308: 
   309:   top_shop++;
   310:   RECREATE(shop_index, struct shop_data, top_shop + 1);
   311: 
   312:   for (rshop = top_shop; rshop > 0; rshop--) {
   313:     if (nshp->vnum > SHOP_NUM(rshop - 1)) {
   314:       found = rshop;
   315: 
   316:       /* Make a "nofree" variant and remove these later. */
   317:       shop_index[rshop].in_room = NULL;
   318:       shop_index[rshop].producing = NULL;
   319:       shop_index[rshop].type = NULL;
   320:       /* don't free old strings - they're still in use -- Welcor */
   321:       copy_shop(&shop_index[rshop], nshp, FALSE);
   322:       break;
   323:     }
   324:     shop_index[rshop] = shop_index[rshop - 1];
   325:   }
   326: 
   327:   if (!found) {
   328:     /* Make a "nofree" variant and remove these later. */
   329:     shop_index[rshop].in_room = NULL;
   330:     shop_index[rshop].producing = NULL;
   331:     shop_index[rshop].type = NULL;
   332:     /* don't free old strings - they're still in use -- Welcor */
   333:     copy_shop(&shop_index[0], nshp, FALSE);
   334:   }
   335: 
   336:   if (rznum != NOWHERE)
   337:     add_to_save_list(zone_table[rznum].number, SL_SHP);
   338:   else
   339:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: GenOLC: Cannot determine shop zone.");
   340: 
   341:   return rshop;
   342: }
   343: 
   344: int save_shops(zone_rnum zone_num)
   345: {
   346:   int i, j, rshop, num_shops = 0;
   347:   FILE *shop_file;
   348:   char fname[128], oldname[128], buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   349:   struct shop_data *shop;
   350: 
   351: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
   352:   if (zone_num == NOWHERE || zone_num > top_of_zone_table) {
   353: #else
   354:   if (zone_num < 0 || zone_num > top_of_zone_table) {
   355: #endif
   356:     log("SYSERR: GenOLC: save_shops: Invalid real zone number %d. (0-%d)", zone_num, top_of_zone_table);
   357:     return FALSE;
   358:   }
   359: 
   360:   snprintf(fname, sizeof(fname), "%s/%d.new", SHP_PREFIX, zone_table[zone_num].number);
   361:   if (!(shop_file = fopen(fname, "w"))) {
   362:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Cannot open shop file!");
   363:     return FALSE;
   364:   } else if (fprintf(shop_file, "CircleMUD v3.0 Shop File~\n") < 0) {
   365:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Cannot write to shop file!");
   366:     fclose(shop_file);
   367:     return FALSE;
   368:   }
   369:   /* Search database for shops in this zone. */
   370:   for (i = genolc_zone_bottom(zone_num); i <= zone_table[zone_num].top; i++) {
   371:     if ((rshop = real_shop(i)) != NOWHERE) {
   372:       fprintf(shop_file, "#%d~\n", i);
   373:       shop = shop_index + rshop;
   374: 
   375:       /* Save the products. */
   376:       for (j = 0; S_PRODUCT(shop, j) != NOTHING; j++)
   377: 	fprintf(shop_file, "%d\n", obj_index[S_PRODUCT(shop, j)].vnum);
   378:       fprintf(shop_file, "-1\n");
   379: 
   380:       /* Save the rates. */
   381:       fprintf(shop_file, "%1.2f\n"
   382:                          "%1.2f\n",
   383:                          S_BUYPROFIT(shop),
   384:                          S_SELLPROFIT(shop));
   385: 
   386:       /* Save the buy types and namelists. */
   387:       for (j = 0;S_BUYTYPE(shop, j) != NOTHING; j++)
   388:         fprintf(shop_file, "%d%s\n",
   389:                 S_BUYTYPE(shop, j),
   390: 		S_BUYWORD(shop, j) ? S_BUYWORD(shop, j) : "");
   391:       fprintf(shop_file, "-1\n");
   392: 
   393:       /* Save messages. Added some defaults as sanity checks. */
   394:       sprintf(buf,
   395: 	      "%s~\n"
   396: 	      "%s~\n"
   397: 	      "%s~\n"
   398: 	      "%s~\n"
   399: 	      "%s~\n"
   400: 	      "%s~\n"
   401: 	      "%s~\n"
   402: 	      "%d\n"
   403: 	      "%ld\n"
   404: 	      "%d\n"
   405: 	      "%d\n",
   406: 	      S_NOITEM1(shop) ? S_NOITEM1(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   407: 	      S_NOITEM2(shop) ? S_NOITEM2(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   408: 	      S_NOBUY(shop) ? S_NOBUY(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   409: 	      S_NOCASH1(shop) ? S_NOCASH1(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   410: 	      S_NOCASH2(shop) ? S_NOCASH2(shop) : "%s Ke?!",
   411: 	      S_BUY(shop) ? S_BUY(shop) : "%s Ke?! %d?",
   412: 	      S_SELL(shop) ? S_SELL(shop) : "%s Ke?! %d?",
   413: 	      S_BROKE_TEMPER(shop),
   414: 	      S_BITVECTOR(shop),
   415: 	      S_KEEPER(shop) == NOBODY ? -1 : mob_index[S_KEEPER(shop)].vnum,
   416: 	      S_NOTRADE(shop)
   417: 	      );
   418:         
   419:         fputs(convert_from_tabs(buf), shop_file);
   420: 
   421:       /* Save the rooms. */
   422:       for (j = 0;S_ROOM(shop, j) != NOWHERE; j++)
   423:         fprintf(shop_file, "%d\n", S_ROOM(shop, j));
   424:       fprintf(shop_file, "-1\n");
   425: 
   426:       /* Save open/closing times. */
   427:       fprintf(shop_file, "%d\n%d\n%d\n%d\n", S_OPEN1(shop), S_CLOSE1(shop),
   428:           S_OPEN2(shop), S_CLOSE2(shop));
   429:       num_shops++;
   430:     }
   431:   }
   432:   fprintf(shop_file, "$~\n");
   433:   fclose(shop_file);
   434:   snprintf(oldname, sizeof(oldname), "%s/%d.shp", SHP_PREFIX, zone_table[zone_num].number);
   435:   remove(oldname);
   436:   rename(fname, oldname);
   437: 
   438:   if (num_shops > 0)
   439:     create_world_index(zone_table[zone_num].number, "shp");
   440: 
   441:   if (in_save_list(zone_table[zone_num].number, SL_SHP))
   442:     remove_from_save_list(zone_table[zone_num].number, SL_SHP);
   443:   return TRUE;
   444: }

    23: /* This function will copy the strings so be sure you free your own copies of 
    24:  * the description, title, and such. */
    25: room_rnum add_room(struct room_data *room)
    26: {
    27:   struct char_data *tch;
    28:   struct obj_data *tobj;
    29:   int j, found = FALSE;
    30:   room_rnum i;
    31: 
    32:   if (room == NULL)
    33:     return NOWHERE;
    34: 
    35:   if ((i = real_room(room->number)) != NOWHERE) {
    36:     if (SCRIPT(&world[i]))
    37:       extract_script(&world[i], WLD_TRIGGER);
    38:     tch = world[i].people;
    39:     tobj = world[i].contents;
    40:     copy_room(&world[i], room);
    41:     world[i].people = tch;
    42:     world[i].contents = tobj;
    43:     add_to_save_list(zone_table[room->zone].number, SL_WLD);
    44:     log("GenOLC: add_room: Updated existing room #%d.", room->number);
    45:     return i;
    46:   }
    47: 
    48:   RECREATE(world, struct room_data, top_of_world + 2);
    49:   top_of_world++;
    50: 
    51:   for (i = top_of_world; i > 0; i--) {
    52:     if (room->number > world[i - 1].number) {
    53:       world[i] = *room;
    54:       copy_room_strings(&world[i], room);
    55:       found = i;
    56:       break;
    57:     } else {
    58:       /* Copy the room over now. */
    59:       world[i] = world[i - 1];
    60:       update_wait_events(&world[i], &world[i-1]);
    61: 
    62:       /* People in this room must have their in_rooms moved up one. */
    63:       for (tch = world[i].people; tch; tch = tch->next_in_room)
    64: 	IN_ROOM(tch) += (IN_ROOM(tch) != NOWHERE);
    65: 
    66:       /* Move objects too. */
    67:       for (tobj = world[i].contents; tobj; tobj = tobj->next_content)
    68: 	IN_ROOM(tobj) += (IN_ROOM(tobj) != NOWHERE);
    69:     }
    70:   }
    71:   if (!found) {
    72:     world[0] = *room;	/* Last place, in front. */
    73:     copy_room_strings(&world[0], room);
    74:   }
    75: 
    76:   log("GenOLC: add_room: Added room %d at index #%d.", room->number, found);
    77:   /* found is equal to the array index where we added the room. */
    78: 
    79:   /* Find what zone that room was in so we can update the loading table. */
    80:   for (i = room->zone; i <= top_of_zone_table; i++)
    81:     for (j = 0; ZCMD(i, j).command != 'S'; j++)
    82:       switch (ZCMD(i, j).command) {
    83:       case 'M':
    84:       case 'O':
    85:       case 'T':
    86:       case 'V':
    87: 	ZCMD(i, j).arg3 += (ZCMD(i, j).arg3 != NOWHERE && ZCMD(i, j).arg3 >= found);
    88: 	break;
    89:       case 'D':
    90:       case 'R':
    91: 	ZCMD(i, j).arg1 += (ZCMD(i, j).arg1 != NOWHERE && ZCMD(i, j).arg1 >= found);
    92:       case 'G':
    93:       case 'P':
    94:       case 'E':
    95:       case '*':
    96: 	/* Known zone entries we don't care about. */
    97:         break;
    98:       default:
    99:         mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: GenOLC: add_room: Unknown zone entry found!");
   100:       }
   101: 
   102:   /* Update the loadroom table. Adds 1 or 0. */
   103:   r_mortal_start_room += (r_mortal_start_room >= found);
   104:   r_immort_start_room += (r_immort_start_room >= found);
   105:   r_frozen_start_room += (r_frozen_start_room >= found);
   106: 
   107:   /* Update world exits. */
   108:   i = top_of_world + 1;
   109:   do {
   110:     i--;
   111:     for (j = 0; j < DIR_COUNT; j++)
   112:       if (W_EXIT(i, j) && W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room != NOWHERE)
   113: 	W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room += (W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room >= found);
   114:   } while (i > 0);
   115: 
   116:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[room->zone].number, SL_WLD);
   117: 
   118:   /* Return what array entry we placed the new room in. */
   119:   return found;
   120: }
