   122: int delete_room(room_rnum rnum)
   123: {
   124:   room_rnum i;
   125:   int j;
   126:   struct char_data *ppl, *next_ppl;
   127:   struct obj_data *obj, *next_obj;
   128:   struct room_data *room;
   129: 
   130:   if (rnum <= 0 || rnum > top_of_world)	/* Can't delete void yet. */
   131:     return FALSE;
   132: 
   133:   room = &world[rnum];
   134: 
   135:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[room->zone].number, SL_WLD);
   136: 
   137:   /* This is something you might want to read about in the logs. */
   138:   log("GenOLC: delete_room: Deleting room #%d (%s).", room->number, room->name);
   139: 
   140:   if (r_mortal_start_room == rnum) {
   141:     log("WARNING: GenOLC: delete_room: Deleting mortal start room!");
   142:     r_mortal_start_room = 0;	/* The Void */
   143:   }
   144:   if (r_immort_start_room == rnum) {
   145:     log("WARNING: GenOLC: delete_room: Deleting immortal start room!");
   146:     r_immort_start_room = 0;	/* The Void */
   147:   }
   148:   if (r_frozen_start_room == rnum) {
   149:     log("WARNING: GenOLC: delete_room: Deleting frozen start room!");
   150:     r_frozen_start_room = 0;	/* The Void */
   151:   }
   152: 
   153:   /* Dump the contents of this room into the Void.  We could also just extract 
   154:    * the people, mobs, and objects here. */
   155:   for (obj = world[rnum].contents; obj; obj = next_obj) {
   156:     next_obj = obj->next_content;
   157:     obj_from_room(obj);
   158:     obj_to_room(obj, 0);
   159:   }
   160:   for (ppl = world[rnum].people; ppl; ppl = next_ppl) {
   161:     next_ppl = ppl->next_in_room;
   162:     char_from_room(ppl);
   163:     char_to_room(ppl, 0);
   164:   }
   165: 
   166:   free_room_strings(room);
   167:   if (SCRIPT(room))
   168:     extract_script(room, WLD_TRIGGER);
   169:   free_proto_script(room, WLD_TRIGGER);
   170: 
   171:   if (room->events != NULL) {
   172: 	  if (room->events->iSize > 0) {
   173: 		struct event * pEvent;
   174: 
   175: 		while ((pEvent = simple_list(room->events)) != NULL)
   176: 		  event_cancel(pEvent);
   177: 	  }
   178: 	  free_list(room->events);
   179:     room->events = NULL;
   180:   }
   181: 
   182:   /* Change any exit going to this room to go the void. Also fix all the exits 
   183:    * pointing to rooms above this. */
   184:   i = top_of_world + 1;
   185:   do {
   186:     i--;
   187:     for (j = 0; j < DIR_COUNT; j++) {
   188:       if (W_EXIT(i, j) == NULL)
   189:         continue;
   190:       else if (W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room > rnum)
   191:         W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room -= (W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room != NOWHERE); /* with unsigned NOWHERE > any rnum */
   192:       else if (W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room == rnum) {
   193:       	if ((!W_EXIT(i, j)->keyword || !*W_EXIT(i, j)->keyword) &&
   194:       	    (!W_EXIT(i, j)->general_description || !*W_EXIT(i, j)->general_description)) {
   195:           /* no description, remove exit completely */
   196:           if (W_EXIT(i, j)->keyword)
   197:             free(W_EXIT(i, j)->keyword);
   198:           if (W_EXIT(i, j)->general_description)
   199:             free(W_EXIT(i, j)->general_description);
   200:           free(W_EXIT(i, j));
   201:           W_EXIT(i, j) = NULL;
   202:         } else {
   203:           /* description is set, just point to nowhere */
   204:           W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room = NOWHERE;
   205:         }
   206:       }
   207:     }
   208:   } while (i > 0);
   209: 
   210:   /* Find what zone that room was in so we can update the loading table. */
   211:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_zone_table; i++)
   212:     for (j = 0; ZCMD(i , j).command != 'S'; j++)
   213:       switch (ZCMD(i, j).command) {
   214:       case 'M':
   215:       case 'O':
   216:       case 'T':
   217:       case 'V':
   218: 	if (ZCMD(i, j).arg3 == rnum)
   219: 	  ZCMD(i, j).command = '*';	/* Cancel command. */
   220: 	else if (ZCMD(i, j).arg3 > rnum)
   221: 	  ZCMD(i, j).arg3 -= (ZCMD(i, j).arg3 != NOWHERE); /* with unsigned NOWHERE > any rnum */
   222: 	break;
   223:       case 'D':
   224:       case 'R':
   225: 	if (ZCMD(i, j).arg1 == rnum)
   226: 	  ZCMD(i, j).command = '*';	/* Cancel command. */
   227: 	else if (ZCMD(i, j).arg1 > rnum)
   228: 	  ZCMD(i, j).arg1 -= (ZCMD(i, j).arg1 != NOWHERE); /* with unsigned NOWHERE > any rnum */
   229:       case 'G':
   230:       case 'P':
   231:       case 'E':
   232:       case '*':
   233:         /* Known zone entries we don't care about. */
   234:         break;
   235:       default:
   236:         mudlog(BRF, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: GenOLC: delete_room: Unknown zone entry found!");
   237:       }
   238: 
   239:   /* Remove this room from all shop lists. */
   240:   for (i = 0; i <= top_shop; i++) {
   241:     for (j = 0;SHOP_ROOM(i, j) != NOWHERE;j++) {
   242:       if (SHOP_ROOM(i, j) == world[rnum].number)
   243:         SHOP_ROOM(i, j) = 0; /* set to the void */
   244:     }
   245:   }
   246:   /* Now we actually move the rooms down. */
   247:   for (i = rnum; i < top_of_world; i++) {
   248:     world[i] = world[i + 1];
   249:     update_wait_events(&world[i], &world[i+1]);
   250: 
   251:     for (ppl = world[i].people; ppl; ppl = ppl->next_in_room)
   252:       IN_ROOM(ppl) -= (IN_ROOM(ppl) != NOWHERE);	/* Redundant check? */
   253: 
   254:     for (obj = world[i].contents; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
   255:       IN_ROOM(obj) -= (IN_ROOM(obj) != NOWHERE);	/* Redundant check? */
   256:   }
   257: 
   258:   top_of_world--;
   259:   RECREATE(world, struct room_data, top_of_world + 1);
   260: 
   261:   return TRUE;
   262: }

   264: int save_rooms(zone_rnum rzone)
   265: {
   266:   int i;
   267:   struct room_data *room;
   268:   FILE *sf;
   269:   char filename[128];
   270:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   271:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   272:   char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   273: 
   274: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
   275:   if (rzone == NOWHERE || rzone > top_of_zone_table) {
   276: #else
   277:   if (rzone < 0 || rzone > top_of_zone_table) {
   278: #endif
   279:     log("SYSERR: GenOLC: save_rooms: Invalid zone number %d passed! (0-%d)", rzone, top_of_zone_table);
   280:     return FALSE;
   281:   }
   282: 
   283:   log("GenOLC: save_rooms: Saving rooms in zone #%d (%d-%d).",
   284: 	zone_table[rzone].number, genolc_zone_bottom(rzone), zone_table[rzone].top);
   285: 
   286:   snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "%s/%d.new", WLD_PREFIX, zone_table[rzone].number);
   287:   if (!(sf = fopen(filename, "w"))) {
   288:     perror("SYSERR: save_rooms");
   289:     return FALSE;
   290:   }
   291: 
   292:   for (i = genolc_zone_bottom(rzone); i <= zone_table[rzone].top; i++) {
   293:     room_rnum rnum;
   294: 
   295:     if ((rnum = real_room(i)) != NOWHERE) {
   296:       int j;
   297: 
   298:       room = (world + rnum);
   299: 
   300:       /* Copy the description and strip off trailing newlines. */
   301:       strncpy(buf, room->description ? room->description : "Empty room.", sizeof(buf)-1 );
   302:       strip_cr(buf);
   303: 
   304:       /* Save the numeric and string section of the file. */
   305:       int n = snprintf(buf2, MAX_STRING_LENGTH, "#%d\n"
   306: 			"%s%c\n"
   307: 			"%s%c\n"
   308: 			"%d %d %d %d %d %d\n",
   309: 	room->number,
   310: 	room->name ? room->name : "Untitled", STRING_TERMINATOR,
   311: 	buf, STRING_TERMINATOR,
   312: 	zone_table[room->zone].number, room->room_flags[0], room->room_flags[1], room->room_flags[2], 
   313: 	  room->room_flags[3], room->sector_type 
   314:       );
   315:       
   316:       if(n >= MAX_STRING_LENGTH) {
   317:         mudlog(BRF,LVL_BUILDER,TRUE,
   318:                "SYSERR: Could not save room #%d due to size (%d > maximum of %d).",
   319:                room->number, n, MAX_STRING_LENGTH);
   320:         continue;
   321:       }
   322: 
   323:   fprintf(sf, "%s", convert_from_tabs(buf2));
   324:  
   325:       /* Now you write out the exits for the room. */
   326:       for (j = 0; j < DIR_COUNT; j++) {
   327: 	if (R_EXIT(room, j)) {
   328: 	  int dflag;
   329: 	  if (R_EXIT(room, j)->general_description) {
   330: 	    strncpy(buf, R_EXIT(room, j)->general_description, sizeof(buf)-1);
   331: 	    strip_cr(buf);
   332: 	  } else
   333: 	    *buf = '\0';
   334: 
   335: 	  /* Figure out door flag. */
   336: 	  if (IS_SET(R_EXIT(room, j)->exit_info, EX_ISDOOR)) {
   337: 	    if (IS_SET(R_EXIT(room, j)->exit_info, EX_PICKPROOF))
   338: 	      dflag = 2;
   339: 	    else
   340: 	      dflag = 1;
   341: 	      
   342: 	   if (IS_SET(R_EXIT(room, j)->exit_info, EX_HIDDEN))
   343:           dflag += 2;   
   344:           
   345: 	  } else
   346: 	    dflag = 0;
   347: 
   348: 	  if (R_EXIT(room, j)->keyword)
   349: 	    strncpy(buf1, R_EXIT(room, j)->keyword, sizeof(buf1)-1 );
   350: 	  else
   351: 	    *buf1 = '\0';
   352: 
   353: 	  /* Now write the exit to the file. */
   354: 	  fprintf(sf,	"D%d\n"
   355: 			"%s~\n"
   356: 			"%s~\n"
   357: 			"%d %d %d\n", j, buf, buf1, dflag,
   358: 		R_EXIT(room, j)->key != NOTHING ? R_EXIT(room, j)->key : -1,
   359: 		R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room != NOWHERE ? world[R_EXIT(room, j)->to_room].number : -1);
   360: 
   361: 	}
   362:       }
   363: 
   364:       if (room->ex_description) {
   365:         struct extra_descr_data *xdesc;
   366: 
   367: 	for (xdesc = room->ex_description; xdesc; xdesc = xdesc->next) {
   368: 	  strncpy(buf, xdesc->description, sizeof(buf) - 1);
   369: 	  buf[sizeof(buf) - 1] = '\0';
   370: 	  strip_cr(buf);
   371: 	  fprintf(sf,	"E\n"
   372: 			"%s~\n"
   373: 			"%s~\n", xdesc->keyword, buf);
   374: 	}
   375:       }
   376:       fprintf(sf, "S\n");
   377:       script_save_to_disk(sf, room, WLD_TRIGGER);
   378:     }
   379:   }
   380: 
   381:   /* Write the final line and close it. */
   382:   fprintf(sf, "$~\n");
   383:   fclose(sf);
   384: 
   385:   /* Old file we're replacing. */
   386:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.wld", WLD_PREFIX, zone_table[rzone].number);
   387: 
   388:   remove(buf);
   389:   rename(filename, buf);
   390: 
   391:   if (in_save_list(zone_table[rzone].number, SL_WLD))
   392:     remove_from_save_list(zone_table[rzone].number, SL_WLD);
   393:   return TRUE;
   394: }
   395: 
   396: int copy_room(struct room_data *to, struct room_data *from)
   397: {
   398:   free_room_strings(to);
   399:   *to = *from;
   400:   copy_room_strings(to, from);
   401:   to->events = from->events;
   402: 
   403:   /* Don't put people and objects in two locations. Should this be done here? */
   404:   from->people = NULL;
   405:   from->contents = NULL;
   406:   from->events = NULL;
   407: 
   408:   return TRUE;
   409: }
   410: 
   411: /* Copy strings over so bad things don't happen.  We do not free the existing 
   412:  * strings here because copy_room() did a shallow copy previously and we'd be 
   413:  * freeing the very strings we're copying.  If this function is used elsewhere,
   414:  * be sure to free_room_strings() the 'dest' room first. */
   415: int copy_room_strings(struct room_data *dest, struct room_data *source)
   416: {
   417:   int i;
   418: 
   419:   if (dest == NULL || source == NULL) {
   420:     log("SYSERR: GenOLC: copy_room_strings: NULL values passed.");
   421:     return FALSE;
   422:   }
   423: 
   424:   dest->description = str_udup(source->description);
   425:   dest->name = str_udup(source->name);
   426: 
   427:   for (i = 0; i < DIR_COUNT; i++) {
   428:     if (!R_EXIT(source, i))
   429:       continue;
   430: 
   431:     CREATE(R_EXIT(dest, i), struct room_direction_data, 1);
   432:     *R_EXIT(dest, i) = *R_EXIT(source, i);
   433:     if (R_EXIT(source, i)->general_description)
   434:       R_EXIT(dest, i)->general_description = strdup(R_EXIT(source, i)->general_description);
   435:     if (R_EXIT(source, i)->keyword)
   436:       R_EXIT(dest, i)->keyword = strdup(R_EXIT(source, i)->keyword);
   437:   }
   438: 
   439:   if (source->ex_description)
   440:     copy_ex_descriptions(&dest->ex_description, source->ex_description);
   441: 
   442:   return TRUE;
   443: }
   444: 
   445: int free_room_strings(struct room_data *room)
   446: {
   447:   int i;
   448: 
   449:   /* Free descriptions. */
   450:   if (room->name)
   451:     free(room->name);
   452:   if (room->description)
   453:     free(room->description);
   454:   if (room->ex_description)
   455:     free_ex_descriptions(room->ex_description);
   456: 
   457:   /* Free exits. */
   458:   for (i = 0; i < DIR_COUNT; i++) {
   459:     if (room->dir_option[i]) {
   460:       if (room->dir_option[i]->general_description)
   461:         free(room->dir_option[i]->general_description);
   462: 
   463:       if (room->dir_option[i]->keyword)
   464:         free(room->dir_option[i]->keyword);
   465: 
   466:       free(room->dir_option[i]);
   467:       room->dir_option[i] = NULL;
   468:     }
   469:   }
   470: 
   471:   return TRUE;
   472: }

    20: /* real zone of room/mobile/object/shop given */
    21: zone_rnum real_zone_by_thing(room_vnum vznum)
    22: {
    23:   zone_rnum znum, best = NOWHERE;
    24:   int low, high;
    25:   int best_span = 0;
    26: 
    27:   if (top_of_zone_table < 0)
    28:     return NOWHERE;
    29: 
    30:   /*
    31:    * Do a full scan instead of binary search.
    32:    * Some worlds include zone index entries that are not sorted by bottom vnum
    33:    * (for example test/reserved zones appended at the end). A binary search on
    34:    * unsorted data can report NOWHERE for valid vnums.
    35:    */
    36:   for (znum = 0; znum <= top_of_zone_table; znum++) {
    37:     low = genolc_zone_bottom(znum);
    38:     high = zone_table[znum].top;
    39: 
    40:     if (low <= vznum && vznum <= high) {
    41:       int span = high - low;
    42:       if (best == NOWHERE || span < best_span) {
    43:         best = znum;
    44:         best_span = span;
    45:       }
    46:     }
    47:   }
    48:   return best;
    49: }
    50: 
    51: zone_rnum create_new_zone(zone_vnum vzone_num, room_vnum bottom, room_vnum top, const char **error)
    52: {
    53:   FILE *fp;
    54:   struct zone_data *zone;
    55:   int i, max_zone;
    56:   zone_rnum rznum;
    57:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    58: 
    59: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
    60:   max_zone = 655;
    61:   if (vzone_num == NOWHERE) {
    62: #else
    63:   max_zone = 327;
    64:   if (vzone_num < 0) {
    65: #endif
    66:     *error = "You can't make negative zones.\r\n";
    67:     return NOWHERE;
    68:    } else if (vzone_num > max_zone) {
    69: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
    70:     *error = "New zone cannot be higher than 655.\r\n";
    71: #else
    72:     *error = "New zone cannot be higher than 327.\r\n";
    73: #endif
    74:     return NOWHERE;
    75:   } else if (bottom > top) {
    76:     *error = "Bottom room cannot be greater than top room.\r\n";
    77:     return NOWHERE;
    78:   } else if (bottom <= 0) {
    79:     *error = "Bottom room cannot be less then 0.\r\n";
    80:     return NOWHERE;
    81:   } else if (top >= IDXTYPE_MAX) {
    82:     *error = "Top greater than IDXTYPE_MAX. (Commonly 65535)\r\n";
    83:     return NOWHERE;
    84:   }
    85: 
    86:   for (i = 0; i < top_of_zone_table; i++)
    87:     if (zone_table[i].number == vzone_num) {
    88:       *error = "That virtual zone already exists.\r\n";
    89:       return NOWHERE;
    90:      }
    91: 
    92:   /* Create the zone file. */
    93:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.zon", ZON_PREFIX, vzone_num);
    94:   if (!(fp = fopen(buf, "w"))) {
    95:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Can't write new zone file.");
    96:     *error = "Could not write zone file.\r\n";
    97:     return NOWHERE;
    98:   }
    99:   fprintf(fp, "#%d\nNone~\nNew Zone~\n%d %d 30 2\nS\n$\n", vzone_num, bottom, top);
   100:   fclose(fp);
   101: 
   102:   /* Create the room file. */
   103:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.wld", WLD_PREFIX, vzone_num);
   104:   if (!(fp = fopen(buf, "w"))) {
   105:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Can't write new world file.");
   106:     *error = "Could not write world file.\r\n";
   107:     return NOWHERE;
   108:   }
   109:   fprintf(fp, "#%d\nThe Beginning~\nNot much here.\n~\n%d 0 0\nS\n$\n", bottom, vzone_num);
   110:   fclose(fp);
   111: 
   112:   /* Create the mobile file. */
   113:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.mob", MOB_PREFIX, vzone_num);
   114:   if (!(fp = fopen(buf, "w"))) {
   115:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Can't write new mob file.");
   116:     *error = "Could not write mobile file.\r\n";
   117:     return NOWHERE;
   118:   }
   119:   fprintf(fp, "$\n");
   120:   fclose(fp);
   121: 
   122:   /* Create the object file. */
   123:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.obj", OBJ_PREFIX, vzone_num);
   124:   if (!(fp = fopen(buf, "w"))) {
   125:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Can't write new obj file.");
   126:     *error = "Could not write object file.\r\n";
   127:     return NOWHERE;
   128:   }
   129:   fprintf(fp, "$\n");
   130:   fclose(fp);
   131: 
   132:   /* Create the shop file. */
   133:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.shp", SHP_PREFIX, vzone_num);
   134:   if (!(fp = fopen(buf, "w"))) {
   135:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Can't write new shop file.");
   136:     *error = "Could not write shop file.\r\n";
   137:     return NOWHERE;
   138:   }
   139:   fprintf(fp, "$~\n");
   140:   fclose(fp);
   141: 
   142:   /* Create the quests file */
   143:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.qst", QST_PREFIX, vzone_num);
   144:   if (!(fp = fopen(buf, "w"))) {
   145:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Can't write new quest file");
   146:     *error = "Could not write quest file.\r\n";
   147:     return NOWHERE;
   148:   }
   149:   fprintf(fp, "$~\n");
   150:   fclose(fp);
   151: 
   152:   /* Create the trigger file. */
   153:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s/%d.trg", TRG_PREFIX, vzone_num);
   154:   if (!(fp = fopen(buf, "w"))) {
   155:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Can't write new trigger file");
   156:     *error = "Could not write trigger file.\r\n";
   157:     return NOWHERE;
   158:   }
   159:   fprintf(fp, "$~\n");
   160:   fclose(fp);
   161: 
   162:   /* Update index files. */
   163:   create_world_index(vzone_num, "qst");
   164:   create_world_index(vzone_num, "zon");
   165:   create_world_index(vzone_num, "wld");
   166:   create_world_index(vzone_num, "mob");
   167:   create_world_index(vzone_num, "obj");
   168:   create_world_index(vzone_num, "shp");
   169:   create_world_index(vzone_num, "trg");
   170: 
   171:   /* Make a new zone in memory. This was the source of all the zedit new
   172:    * crashes. It was happily overwriting the stack.  This new loop by Andrew
   173:    * Helm fixes that problem and is more understandable at the same time.
   174:    *
   175:    * The variable is 'top_of_zone_table_table + 2' because we need record 0
   176:    * through top_of_zone (top_of_zone_table + 1 items) and a new one which
   177:    * makes it top_of_zone_table + 2 elements large. */
   178:   RECREATE(zone_table, struct zone_data, top_of_zone_table + 2);
   179:   zone_table[top_of_zone_table + 1].number = 32000;
   180: 
   181:   if (vzone_num > zone_table[top_of_zone_table].number)
   182:     rznum = top_of_zone_table + 1;
   183:   else {
   184:     int j, room;
   185:     for (i = top_of_zone_table + 1; i > 0 && vzone_num < zone_table[i - 1].number; i--) {
   186:       zone_table[i] = zone_table[i - 1];
   187:       for (j = zone_table[i].bot; j <= zone_table[i].top; j++)
   188:         if ((room = real_room(j)) != NOWHERE)
   189:           world[room].zone++;
   190:     }
   191: rznum = i;
   192:   }
   193:   zone = &zone_table[rznum];
   194: 
   195:   /* Ok, insert the new zone here. */
   196:   zone->name = strdup("New Zone");
   197:   zone->number = vzone_num;
   198:   zone->builders = strdup("None");
   199:   zone->bot = bottom;
   200:   zone->top = top;
   201:   zone->lifespan = 30;
   202:   zone->age = 0;
   203:   zone->reset_mode = 2;
   204:   zone->min_level = -1;
   205:   zone->max_level = -1;
   206: 
   207:   for (i=0; i<ZN_ARRAY_MAX; i++)  zone->zone_flags[i] = 0;
   208: 
   209:   /* No zone commands, just terminate it with an 'S' */
   210:   CREATE(zone->cmd, struct reset_com, 1);
   211:   zone->cmd[0].command = 'S';
   212: 
   213:   top_of_zone_table++;
   214: 
   215:   add_to_save_list(zone->number, SL_ZON);
   216:   return rznum;
   217: }
   218: 
   219: void create_world_index(int znum, const char *type)
   220: {
   221:   FILE *newfile, *oldfile;
   222:   char new_name[32], old_name[32], *prefix;
   223:   int num, found = FALSE;
   224:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   225:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   226: 
   227:   switch (*type) {
   228:   case 'z':
   229:     prefix = ZON_PREFIX;
   230:     break;
   231:   case 'w':
   232:     prefix = WLD_PREFIX;
   233:     break;
   234:   case 'o':
   235:     prefix = OBJ_PREFIX;
   236:     break;
   237:   case 'm':
   238:     prefix = MOB_PREFIX;
   239:     break;
   240:   case 's':
   241:     prefix = SHP_PREFIX;
   242:     break;
   243:   case 't':
   244:     prefix = TRG_PREFIX;
   245:     break;
   246:   case 'q':
   247:     prefix = QST_PREFIX;
   248:     break;
   249:   default:
   250:     /* Caller messed up. */
   251:     return;
   252:   }
   253: 
   254:   snprintf(old_name, sizeof(old_name), "%s/index", prefix);
   255:   snprintf(new_name, sizeof(new_name), "%s/newindex", prefix);
   256: 
   257:   if (!(oldfile = fopen(old_name, "r"))) {
   258:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Failed to open %s.", old_name);
   259:     return;
   260:   } else if (!(newfile = fopen(new_name, "w"))) {
   261:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Failed to open %s.", new_name);
   262:     fclose(oldfile);
   263:     return;
   264:   }
   265: 
   266:   /* Index contents must be in order: search through the old file for the right
   267:    * place, insert the new file, then copy the rest over. */
   268:   snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "%d.%s", znum, type);
   269:   while (get_line(oldfile, buf)) {
   270:     if (*buf == '$') {
   271:       /* The following used to add a blank line, thanks to Brian Taylor for the fix. */
   272:       fprintf(newfile, "%s", (!found ? strncat(buf1, "\n$\n", sizeof(buf1) - strlen(buf1) - 1) : "$\n"));
   273:       break;
   274:     } else if (!found) {
   275:       sscanf(buf, "%d", &num);
   276:       if (num > znum) {
   277: 	found = TRUE;
   278: 	fprintf(newfile, "%s\n", buf1);
   279:       } else if (num == znum) {
   280:         /* index file already had an entry for this zone. */
   281:         fclose(oldfile);
   282:         fclose(newfile);
   283:         remove(new_name);
   284:         return;
   285:       }
   286:     }
   287:     fprintf(newfile, "%s\n", buf);
   288:   }
   289: 
   290:   fclose(newfile);
   291:   fclose(oldfile);
   292:   /* Out with the old, in with the new. */
   293:   remove(old_name);
   294:   rename(new_name, old_name);
   295: }
   296: 
   297: void remove_room_zone_commands(zone_rnum zone, room_rnum room_num)
   298: {
   299:   int subcmd = 0, cmd_room = -2;
   300: 
   301:   /* Delete all entries in zone_table that relate to this room so we can add
   302:    * all the ones we have in their place. */
   303:   while (zone_table[zone].cmd[subcmd].command != 'S') {
   304:     switch (zone_table[zone].cmd[subcmd].command) {
   305:     case 'M':
   306:     case 'O':
   307:     case 'T':
   308:     case 'V':
   309:       cmd_room = zone_table[zone].cmd[subcmd].arg3;
   310:       break;
   311:     case 'D':
   312:     case 'R':
   313:       cmd_room = zone_table[zone].cmd[subcmd].arg1;
   314:       break;
   315:     default:
   316:       break;
   317:     }
   318:     if (cmd_room == room_num)
   319:       remove_cmd_from_list(&zone_table[zone].cmd, subcmd);
   320:     else
   321:       subcmd++;
   322:   }
   323: }
   324: 
   325: /* Save all the zone_table for this zone to disk.  This function now writes
   326:  * simple comments in the form of (<name>) to each record.  A header for each
   327:  * field is also there. */
   328: int save_zone(zone_rnum zone_num)
   329: {
   330:   int subcmd, arg1 = -1, arg2 = -1, arg3 = -1, flag_tot=0, i;
   331:   char fname[128], oldname[128];
   332:   const char *comment = NULL;
   333:   FILE *zfile;
   334:   char zbuf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], zbuf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   335:   char zbuf3[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], zbuf4[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   336: 
   337: #if CIRCLE_UNSIGNED_INDEX
   338:   if (zone_num == NOWHERE || zone_num > top_of_zone_table) {
   339: #else
   340:   if (zone_num < 0 || zone_num > top_of_zone_table) {
   341: #endif
   342:     log("SYSERR: GenOLC: save_zone: Invalid real zone number %d. (0-%d)", zone_num, top_of_zone_table);
   343:     return FALSE;
   344:   }
   345: 
   346:   snprintf(fname, sizeof(fname), "%s/%d.new", ZON_PREFIX, zone_table[zone_num].number);
   347:   if (!(zfile = fopen(fname, "w"))) {
   348:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: save_zones:  Can't write zone %d.", zone_table[zone_num].number);
   349:     return FALSE;
   350:   }
   351: 
   352:   for (i=0; i<ZN_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   353:     flag_tot += zone_table[zone_num].zone_flags[(i)];
   354: 
   355:   /* If zone flags or levels aren't set, there is no reason to save them! */
   356:   if (flag_tot == 0 && zone_table[zone_num].min_level == -1 && zone_table[zone_num].max_level == -1)
   357:   {
   358:     /* Print zone header to file. */
   359:     fprintf(zfile, "#%d\n"
   360:                    "%s~\n"
   361:                    "%s~\n"
   362:                    "%d %d %d %d\n",
   363:            zone_table[zone_num].number,
   364:           (zone_table[zone_num].builders && *zone_table[zone_num].builders)
   365:                 ? zone_table[zone_num].builders : "None.",
   366:           (zone_table[zone_num].name && *zone_table[zone_num].name)
   367:                 ? convert_from_tabs(zone_table[zone_num].name) : "undefined",
   368:           genolc_zone_bottom(zone_num),
   369:           zone_table[zone_num].top,
   370:           zone_table[zone_num].lifespan,
   371:           zone_table[zone_num].reset_mode
   372:           );
   373:   } else {
   374:     sprintascii(zbuf1, zone_table[zone_num].zone_flags[0]);
   375:     sprintascii(zbuf2, zone_table[zone_num].zone_flags[1]);
   376:     sprintascii(zbuf3, zone_table[zone_num].zone_flags[2]);
   377:     sprintascii(zbuf4, zone_table[zone_num].zone_flags[3]);
   378: 
   379:     /* Print zone header to file. */
   380:     fprintf(zfile, "#%d\n"
   381:                    "%s~\n"
   382:                    "%s~\n"
   383:                    "%d %d %d %d %s %s %s %s %d %d\n",       /* New tbaMUD data line */
   384:            zone_table[zone_num].number,
   385:           (zone_table[zone_num].builders && *zone_table[zone_num].builders)
   386:                 ? zone_table[zone_num].builders : "None.",
   387:           (zone_table[zone_num].name && *zone_table[zone_num].name)
   388:                 ? convert_from_tabs(zone_table[zone_num].name) : "undefined",
   389:           genolc_zone_bottom(zone_num),
   390:           zone_table[zone_num].top,
   391:           zone_table[zone_num].lifespan,
   392:           zone_table[zone_num].reset_mode,
   393:           zbuf1, zbuf2, zbuf3, zbuf4,
   394:           zone_table[zone_num].min_level,
   395:           zone_table[zone_num].max_level
   396:           );
   397:   }
   398: 
   399: 	/* Handy Quick Reference Chart for Zone Values.
   400: 	 *
   401: 	 * Field #1    Field #3   Field #4  Field #5
   402: 	 * -------------------------------------------------
   403: 	 * M (Mobile)  Mob-Vnum   Wld-Max   Room-Vnum
   404: 	 * O (Object)  Obj-Vnum   Wld-Max   Room-Vnum
   405: 	 * G (Give)    Obj-Vnum   Wld-Max   Unused
   406: 	 * E (Equip)   Obj-Vnum   Wld-Max   EQ-Position
   407: 	 * P (Put)     Obj-Vnum   Wld-Max   Target-Obj-Vnum
   408: 	 * D (Door)    Room-Vnum  Door-Dir  Door-State
   409: 	 * R (Remove)  Room-Vnum  Obj-Vnum  Unused
   410:          * T (Trigger) Trig-type  Trig-Vnum Room-Vnum
   411:          * V (var)     Trig-type  Context   Room-Vnum Varname Value
   412: 	 * ------------------------------------------------- */
   413: 
   414:   for (subcmd = 0; ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).command != 'S'; subcmd++) {
   415:     switch (ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).command) {
   416:     case 'M':
   417:       arg1 = mob_index[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].vnum;
   418:       arg2 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2;
   419:       arg3 = world[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg3].number;
   420:       comment = mob_proto[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].player.short_descr;
   421:       break;
   422:     case 'O':
   423:       arg1 = obj_index[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].vnum;
   424:       arg2 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2;
   425:       arg3 = world[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg3].number;
   426:       comment = obj_proto[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].short_description;
   427:       break;
   428:     case 'G':
   429:       arg1 = obj_index[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].vnum;
   430:       arg2 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2;
   431:       arg3 = -1;
   432:       comment = obj_proto[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].short_description;
   433:       break;
   434:     case 'E':
   435:       arg1 = obj_index[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].vnum;
   436:       arg2 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2;
   437:       arg3 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg3;
   438:       comment = obj_proto[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].short_description;
   439:       break;
   440:     case 'P':
   441:       arg1 = obj_index[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].vnum;
   442:       arg2 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2;
   443:       arg3 = obj_index[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg3].vnum;
   444:       comment = obj_proto[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].short_description;
   445:       break;
   446:     case 'D':
   447:       arg1 = world[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].number;
   448:       arg2 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2;
   449:       arg3 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg3;
   450:       comment = world[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].name;
   451:       break;
   452:     case 'R':
   453:       arg1 = world[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1].number;
   454:       arg2 = obj_index[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2].vnum;
   455:       comment = obj_proto[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2].short_description;
   456:       arg3 = -1;
   457:       break;
   458:     case 'T':
   459:       arg1 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1; /* trigger type */
   460:       arg2 = trig_index[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2]->vnum; /* trigger vnum */
   461:       arg3 = world[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg3].number; /* room num */
   462:       comment = GET_TRIG_NAME(trig_index[real_trigger(arg2)]->proto);
   463:       break;
   464:     case 'V':
   465:       arg1 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg1; /* trigger type */
   466:       arg2 = ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg2; /* context */
   467:       arg3 = world[ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).arg3].number;
   468:       break;
   469:     case '*':
   470:       /* Invalid commands are replaced with '*' - Ignore them. */
   471:       continue;
   472:     default:
   473:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: z_save_to_disk(): Unknown cmd '%c' - NOT saving", ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).command);
   474:       continue;
   475:     }
   476:     if (ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).command != 'V')
   477:       fprintf(zfile, "%c %d %d %d %d \t(%s)\n",
   478: 		ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).command, ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).if_flag, arg1, arg2, arg3, comment);
   479:     else
   480:       fprintf(zfile, "%c %d %d %d %d %s %s\n",
   481:               ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).command, ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).if_flag, arg1, arg2, arg3,
   482:               ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).sarg1, ZCMD(zone_num, subcmd).sarg2);
   483:   }
   484:   fputs("S\n$\n", zfile);
   485:   fclose(zfile);
   486:   snprintf(oldname, sizeof(oldname), "%s/%d.zon", ZON_PREFIX, zone_table[zone_num].number);
   487:   remove(oldname);
   488:   rename(fname, oldname);
   489: 
   490:   if (in_save_list(zone_table[zone_num].number, SL_ZON))
   491:     remove_from_save_list(zone_table[zone_num].number, SL_ZON);
   492:   return TRUE;
   493: }
   494: 
   495: /* Some common code to count the number of comands in the list. */
   496: int count_commands(struct reset_com *list)
   497: {
   498:   int count = 0;
   499: 
   500:   while (list[count].command != 'S')
   501:     count++;
   502: 
   503:   return count;
   504: }
   505: 
   506: /* Adds a new reset command into a list.  Takes a pointer to the list so that
   507:  * it may play with the memory locations. */
   508: void add_cmd_to_list(struct reset_com **list, struct reset_com *newcmd, int pos)
   509: {
   510:   int count, i, l;
   511:   struct reset_com *newlist;
   512: 
   513:   /* Count number of commands (not including terminator). */
   514:   count = count_commands(*list);
   515: 
   516:   /* Value is +2 for the terminator and new field to add. */
   517:   CREATE(newlist, struct reset_com, count + 2);
   518: 
   519:   /* Even tighter loop to copy the old list and insert a new command. */
   520:   for (i = 0, l = 0; i <= count; i++) {
   521:     newlist[i] = ((i == pos) ? *newcmd : (*list)[l++]);
   522:   }
   523: 
   524:   /* Add terminator, then insert new list. */
   525:   newlist[count + 1].command = 'S';
   526:   free(*list);
   527:   *list = newlist;
   528: }
   529: 
   530: /* Remove a reset command from a list. Takes a pointer to the list so that it
   531:  * may play with the memory locations. */
   532: static void remove_cmd_from_list(struct reset_com **list, int pos)
   533: {
   534:   int count, i, l;
   535:   struct reset_com *newlist;
   536: 
   537:   /* Count number of commands (not including terminator). */
   538:   count = count_commands(*list);
   539: 
   540:   /* Value is 'count' because we didn't include the terminator above but since
   541:    * we're deleting one thing anyway we want one less. */
   542:   CREATE(newlist, struct reset_com, count);
   543: 
   544:   /* Even tighter loop to copy old list and skip unwanted command. */
   545:   for (i = 0, l = 0; i < count; i++) {
   546:     if (i != pos) {
   547:       newlist[l++] = (*list)[i];
   548:     }
   549:   }
   550:   /* Add the terminator, then insert the new list. */
   551:   newlist[count - 1].command = 'S';
   552:   free(*list);
   553:   *list = newlist;
   554: }
   555: 
   556: /* Error check user input and then add new (blank) command. */
   557: int new_command(struct zone_data *zone, int pos)
   558: {
   559:   int subcmd = 0;
   560:   struct reset_com new_com;
   561: 
   562:   /* Error check to ensure users hasn't given too large an index. */
   563:   while (zone->cmd[subcmd].command != 'S')
   564:     subcmd++;
   565: 
   566:   if (pos < 0 || pos > subcmd)
   567:     return 0;
   568: 
   569:   /* Ok, let's add a new (blank) command. */
   570:   new_com.command = 'N';
   571:   add_cmd_to_list(&zone->cmd, &new_com, pos);
   572:   return 1;
   573: }
   574: 
   575: /* Error check user input and then remove command. */
   576: void delete_zone_command(struct zone_data *zone, int pos)
   577: {
   578:   int subcmd = 0;
   579: 
   580:   /* Error check to ensure users hasn't given too large an index. */
   581:   while (zone->cmd[subcmd].command != 'S')
   582:     subcmd++;
   583: 
   584:   if (pos < 0 || pos >= subcmd)
   585:     return;
   586: 
   587:   /* Ok, let's zap it. */
   588:   remove_cmd_from_list(&zone->cmd, pos);
   589: }

    37: char *fname(const char *namelist)
    38: {
    39:   static char holder[READ_SIZE];
    40:   char *point;
    41: 
    42:   for (point = holder; isalpha(*namelist); namelist++, point++)
    43:     *point = *namelist;
    44: 
    45:   *point = '\0';
    46: 
    47:   return (holder);

    50: /* Leave this here even if you put in a newer isname().  Used for OasisOLC. */
    51: int is_name(const char *str, const char *namelist)
    52: {
    53:   const char *curname, *curstr;
    54: 
    55:   if (!str || !namelist || !*str || !*namelist)
    56:     return (0);
    57: 
    58:   curname = namelist;
    59:   for (;;) {
    60:     for (curstr = str;; curstr++, curname++) {
    61:       if (!*curstr && !isalpha(*curname))
    62:         return (1);
    63: 
    64:       if (!*curname)
    65:         return (0);
    66: 
    67:       if (!*curstr || *curname == ' ')
    68:         break;
    69: 
    70:       if (LOWER(*curstr) != LOWER(*curname))
    71:         break;
    72:     }
    73: 
    74:     /* skip to next name */
    75:    for (; isalpha(*curname); curname++)
    76:      ; /* semi-colon moved to suppress warning */
    77:      if (!*curname)
    78:        return (0);
    79:     curname++;                  /* first char of new name */
    80:   }
    81: }
    82: 
    83: /* allow abbreviations */
    84: #define WHITESPACE " \t"
    85: int isname(const char *str, const char *namelist)
    86: {
    87:   char *newlist;
    88:   char *curtok;
    89: 
    90:   if (!str || !*str || !namelist || !*namelist)
    91:     return 0;
    92: 
    93:   if (!strcmp(str, namelist)) /* the easy way */
    94:     return 1;
    95: 
    96:   newlist = strdup(namelist); /* make a copy since strtok 'modifies' strings */
    97:   for(curtok = strtok(newlist, WHITESPACE); curtok; curtok = strtok(NULL, WHITESPACE))
    98:     if(curtok && is_abbrev(str, curtok)) {
    99:       /* Don't allow abbreviated numbers. - Sryth */
   100:       if (isdigit(*str) && (atoi(str) != atoi(curtok)))
   101:         return 0;
   102:       free(newlist);
   103:       return 1;
   104:     }
   105:   free(newlist);
   106:   return 0;
   107: }

   232: static void affect_modify_ar(struct char_data * ch, byte loc, sbyte mod, int bitv[], bool add)
   233: {
   234:   int i , j;
   235: 
   236:   if (add) {
   237:     for(i = 0; i < AF_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   238:       for(j = 0; j < 32; j++)
   239:         if(IS_SET_AR(bitv, (i*32)+j))
   240:           SET_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(ch), (i*32)+j);
   241:   } else {
   242:     for(i = 0; i < AF_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   243:       for(j = 0; j < 32; j++)
   244:         if(IS_SET_AR(bitv, (i*32)+j))
   245:           REMOVE_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(ch), (i*32)+j);
   246:     /* Resource maxima are rebuilt from persistent bases by affect_total().
   247:      * Do not subtract a modifier from a freshly restored base. */
   248:     if (loc == APPLY_MANA || loc == APPLY_HIT || loc == APPLY_MOVE)
   249:       mod = 0;
   250:     else
   251:       mod = -mod;
   252:   }
   253: 
   254:   aff_apply_modify(ch, loc, mod, "affect_modify_ar");
   255: }

   257: /* This updates a character by subtracting everything he is affected by
   258:  * restoring original abilities, and then affecting all again. */
   259: void affect_total(struct char_data *ch)
   260: {
   261:   struct affected_type *af;
   262:   int i, j;
   263: 
   264:   /* Rebuild affected flags from the saved baseline every time. */
   265:   for (i = 0; i < AF_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   266:     AFF_FLAGS(ch)[i] = ch->char_specials.saved.affected_by[i];
   267: 
   268:   /* Effective maxima are derived from persistent base maxima. */
   269:   GET_MAX_HIT(ch) = GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(ch);
   270:   GET_MAX_MANA(ch) = GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(ch);
   271:   GET_MAX_MOVE(ch) = GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(ch);
   272: 
   273:   /* Remove equipment modifiers and bits. */
   274:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++) {
   275:     if (GET_EQ(ch, i))
   276:       for (j = 0; j < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; j++)
   277:         affect_modify_ar(ch,
   278:           GET_EQ(ch, i)->affected[j].location,
   279:           GET_EQ(ch, i)->affected[j].modifier,
   280:           GET_OBJ_AFFECT(GET_EQ(ch, i)),
   281:           FALSE);
   282:   }
   283: 
   284:   /* Remove spell/skill affects. */
   285:   for (af = ch->affected; af; af = af->next)
   286:     affect_modify_ar(ch, af->location, af->modifier, af->bitvector, FALSE);
   287: 
   288:   /* Reset abilities from real values, then apply racial bonuses. */
   289:   ch->aff_abils = ch->real_abils;
   290: 
   291:   if (!IS_NPC(ch)) {
   292:     ch->aff_abils.str   += race_abil_bonus(GET_RACE(ch), 0);
   293:     ch->aff_abils.dex   += race_abil_bonus(GET_RACE(ch), 1);
   294:     ch->aff_abils.con   += race_abil_bonus(GET_RACE(ch), 2);
   295:     ch->aff_abils.intel += race_abil_bonus(GET_RACE(ch), 3);
   296:     ch->aff_abils.wis   += race_abil_bonus(GET_RACE(ch), 4);
   297:     ch->aff_abils.cha   += race_abil_bonus(GET_RACE(ch), 5);
   298:   }
   299: 
   300:   /* Reapply equipment modifiers and bits. */
   301:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++) {
   302:     if (GET_EQ(ch, i))
   303:       for (j = 0; j < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; j++)
   304:         affect_modify_ar(ch,
   305:           GET_EQ(ch, i)->affected[j].location,
   306:           GET_EQ(ch, i)->affected[j].modifier,
   307:           GET_OBJ_AFFECT(GET_EQ(ch, i)),
   308:           TRUE);
   309:   }
   310: 
   311:   /* Reapply spell/skill affects. */
   312:   for (af = ch->affected; af; af = af->next)
   313:     affect_modify_ar(ch, af->location, af->modifier, af->bitvector, TRUE);
   314: 
   315:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(ch, AFF_TRUESIGHT)) {
   316:     SET_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(ch), AFF_DETECT_INVIS);
   317:     SET_BIT_AR(AFF_FLAGS(ch), AFF_SENSE_LIFE);
   318:   }
   319: 
   320:   /* Apply affects from furniture being used (sit/rest/sleep on ITEM_FURNITURE).
   321:      These must be derived only, based on SITTING(ch). */
   322:   if (SITTING(ch) && GET_OBJ_TYPE(SITTING(ch)) == ITEM_FURNITURE) {
   323:     struct obj_data *furn = SITTING(ch);
   324: 
   325:     /* Apply the furniture's affect bitvector (SANCT, INVIS, etc). */
   326:     affect_modify_ar(ch, APPLY_NONE, 0, GET_OBJ_AFFECT(furn), TRUE);
   327: 
   328:     /* Apply any numeric modifiers stored on the furniture safely. */
   329:     for (j = 0; j < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; j++) {
   330:       if (furn->affected[j].location != APPLY_NONE)
   331:         aff_apply_modify(ch, furn->affected[j].location, furn->affected[j].modifier, "furniture");
   332:     }
   333:   }
   334: 
   335:   /* Clamp fully modified stats. */
   336:   ch->aff_abils.str   = MAX(0, MIN(ch->aff_abils.str,   EFFECTIVE_STAT_CAP));
   337:   ch->aff_abils.dex   = MAX(0, MIN(ch->aff_abils.dex,   EFFECTIVE_STAT_CAP));
   338:   ch->aff_abils.con   = MAX(0, MIN(ch->aff_abils.con,   EFFECTIVE_STAT_CAP));
   339:   ch->aff_abils.intel = MAX(0, MIN(ch->aff_abils.intel, EFFECTIVE_STAT_CAP));
   340:   ch->aff_abils.wis   = MAX(0, MIN(ch->aff_abils.wis,   EFFECTIVE_STAT_CAP));
   341:   ch->aff_abils.cha   = MAX(0, MIN(ch->aff_abils.cha,   EFFECTIVE_STAT_CAP));
   342: 
   343:   /* Convert mortal strength beyond 18 into exceptional strength. */
   344:   if (!(IS_NPC(ch) || GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GRGOD)) {
   345:     if (GET_STR(ch) > 18) {
   346:       i = GET_ADD(ch) + ((GET_STR(ch) - 18) * 10);
   347:       GET_ADD(ch) = MIN(i, 100);
   348:       GET_STR(ch) = 18;
   349:     }
   350:   }
   351: 
   352:   clamp_mana_to_effective_max(ch);
   353:   clamp_move_to_effective_max(ch);
   354:   if (GET_HIT(ch) > GET_MAX_HIT(ch))
   355:     GET_HIT(ch) = GET_MAX_HIT(ch);
   356: }
   357: 
   358: /* Insert an affect_type in a char_data structure. Automatically sets
   359:  * apropriate bits and apply's */
   360: void affect_to_char(struct char_data *ch, struct affected_type *af)
   361: {
   362:   struct affected_type *cur;
   363:   struct affected_type *affected_alloc;
   364: 
   365:   /* Guard against exact duplicate entries. If all affect fields match except
   366:    * duration, refresh the existing entry instead of stacking another copy. */
   367:   for (cur = ch->affected; cur; cur = cur->next) {
   368:     if (cur->spell == af->spell &&
   369:         cur->location == af->location &&
   370:         cur->modifier == af->modifier &&
   371:         cur->bitvector[0] == af->bitvector[0] &&
   372:         cur->bitvector[1] == af->bitvector[1] &&
   373:         cur->bitvector[2] == af->bitvector[2] &&
   374:         cur->bitvector[3] == af->bitvector[3]) {
   375:       cur->duration = MAX(cur->duration, af->duration);
   376:       return;
   377:     }
   378:   }
   379: 
   380:   CREATE(affected_alloc, struct affected_type, 1);
   381: 
   382:   *affected_alloc = *af;
   383:   affected_alloc->next = ch->affected;
   384:   ch->affected = affected_alloc;
   385: 
   386:   affect_modify_ar(ch, af->location, af->modifier, af->bitvector, TRUE);
   387:   affect_total(ch);
   388: }
   389: 
   390: /* Remove an affected_type structure from a char (called when duration reaches
   391:  * zero). Pointer *af must never be NIL!  Frees mem and calls
   392:  * affect_location_apply */
   393: void affect_remove(struct char_data *ch, struct affected_type *af)
   394: {
   395:   struct affected_type *temp;
   396: 
   397:   if (ch->affected == NULL) {
   398:     core_dump();
   399:     return;
   400:   }
   401: 
   402:   affect_modify_ar(ch, af->location, af->modifier, af->bitvector, FALSE);
   403:   REMOVE_FROM_LIST(af, ch->affected, next);
   404:   free(af);
   405:   affect_total(ch);
   406: }
   407: 
   408: /* Call affect_remove with every affect from the spell "type" */
   409: void affect_from_char(struct char_data *ch, int type)
   410: {
   411:   struct affected_type *hjp, *next;
   412: 
   413:   for (hjp = ch->affected; hjp; hjp = next) {
   414:     next = hjp->next;
   415:     if (hjp->spell == type)
   416:       affect_remove(ch, hjp);
   417:   }
   418: }
   419: 
   420: /* Return TRUE if a char is affected by a spell (SPELL_XXX), FALSE indicates
   421:  * not affected. */
   422: bool has_any_affect_flags(const struct char_data *ch)
   423: {
   424:   int i;
   425: 
   426:   if (ch == NULL)
   427:     return FALSE;
   428: 
   429:   for (i = 0; i < AF_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   430:     if (AFF_FLAGS(ch)[i] != 0)
   431:       return TRUE;
   432: 
   433:   return FALSE;
   434: }

   436: bool affected_by_spell(struct char_data *ch, int type)
   437: {
   438:   struct affected_type *hjp;
   439: 
   440:   for (hjp = ch->affected; hjp; hjp = hjp->next)
   441:     if (hjp->spell == type)
   442:       return (TRUE);
   443: 
   444:   return (FALSE);
   445: }
   446: 
   447: void affect_join(struct char_data *ch, struct affected_type *af,
   448: 		      bool add_dur, bool avg_dur, bool add_mod, bool avg_mod)
   449: {
   450:   struct affected_type *hjp, *next;
   451: 
   452:   for (hjp = ch->affected; hjp; hjp = next) {
   453:     next = hjp->next;
   454: 
   455:     if ((hjp->spell == af->spell) && (hjp->location == af->location)) {
   456:       if (add_dur)
   457: 	af->duration += hjp->duration;
   458:       else if (avg_dur)
   459:         af->duration = (af->duration+hjp->duration)/2;
   460:       if (add_mod)
   461: 	af->modifier += hjp->modifier;
   462:       else if (avg_mod)
   463:         af->modifier = (af->modifier+hjp->modifier)/2;
   464: 
   465:       affect_remove(ch, hjp);
   466:     }
   467:   }
   468: 
   469:   affect_to_char(ch, af);
   470: }

   472: /* move a player out of a room */
   473: void char_from_room(struct char_data *ch)
   474: {
   475:   struct char_data *temp;
   476: 
   477:   if (ch == NULL || IN_ROOM(ch) == NOWHERE) {
   478:     log("SYSERR: NULL character or NOWHERE in %s, char_from_room", __FILE__);
   479:     exit(1);
   480:   }
   481: 
   482:   if (FIGHTING(ch) != NULL)
   483:     stop_fighting(ch);
   484: 
   485:   char_from_furniture(ch);
   486: 
   487:   if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT) != NULL)
   488:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT)) == ITEM_LIGHT)
   489:       if (GET_OBJ_VAL(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT), 2))	/* Light is ON */
   490: 	world[IN_ROOM(ch)].light--;
   491: 
   492:   REMOVE_FROM_LIST(ch, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people, next_in_room);
   493:   IN_ROOM(ch) = NOWHERE;
   494:   ch->next_in_room = NULL;
   495: }
   496: 
   497: /* place a character in a room */
   498: void char_to_room(struct char_data *ch, room_rnum room)
   499: {
   500:   if (ch == NULL || room == NOWHERE || room > top_of_world)
   501:     log("SYSERR: Illegal value(s) passed to char_to_room. (Room: %d/%d Ch: %p",
   502: 		room, top_of_world, (void *)ch);
   503:   else {
   504:     ch->next_in_room = world[room].people;
   505:     world[room].people = ch;
   506:     IN_ROOM(ch) = room;
   507: 
   508:     if (IS_NPC(ch))
   509:       apply_mob_loadout_after_placement(ch);
   510: 
   511:     autoquest_trigger_check(ch, 0, 0, AQ_ROOM_FIND);
   512:     autoquest_trigger_check(ch, 0, 0, AQ_MOB_FIND);
   513: 
   514:     if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT))
   515:       if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT)) == ITEM_LIGHT)
   516: 	if (GET_OBJ_VAL(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT), 2))	/* Light ON */
   517: 	  world[room].light++;
   518: 
   519:     /* Stop fighting now, if we left. */
   520:     if (FIGHTING(ch) && IN_ROOM(ch) != IN_ROOM(FIGHTING(ch))) {
   521:       stop_fighting(FIGHTING(ch));
   522:       stop_fighting(ch);
   523:     }
   524:   }
   525: }
   526: 
   527: /* Give an object to a char. */
   528: void obj_to_char(struct obj_data *object, struct char_data *ch)
   529: {
   530:   if (object && ch) {
   531:     object->next_content = ch->carrying;
   532:     ch->carrying = object;
   533:     object->carried_by = ch;
   534:     IN_ROOM(object) = NOWHERE;
   535:     IS_CARRYING_W(ch) += GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(object);
   536:     IS_CARRYING_N(ch)++;
   537: 
   538:     autoquest_trigger_check(ch, NULL, object, AQ_OBJ_FIND);
   539: 
   540:     /* set flag for crash-save system, but not on mobs! */
   541:     if (!IS_NPC(ch))
   542:       SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_CRASH);
   543:   } else
   544:     log("SYSERR: NULL obj (%p) or char (%p) passed to obj_to_char.", (void *)object, (void *)ch);
   545: }
   546: 
   547: /* take an object from a char */
   548: void obj_from_char(struct obj_data *object)
   549: {
   550:   struct obj_data *temp;
   551: 
   552:   if (object == NULL) {
   553:     log("SYSERR: NULL object passed to obj_from_char.");
   554:     return;
   555:   }
   556:   REMOVE_FROM_LIST(object, object->carried_by->carrying, next_content);
   557: 
   558:   /* set flag for crash-save system, but not on mobs! */
   559:   if (!IS_NPC(object->carried_by))
   560:     SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(object->carried_by), PLR_CRASH);
   561: 
   562:   IS_CARRYING_W(object->carried_by) -= GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(object);
   563:   IS_CARRYING_N(object->carried_by)--;
   564:   object->carried_by = NULL;
   565:   object->next_content = NULL;
   566: }
   567: 
   568: /* Return the effect of a piece of armor in position eq_pos */
   569: static int apply_armor(struct char_data *ch, int eq_pos)
   570: {
   571:   if (GET_EQ(ch, eq_pos) == NULL) {
   572:     core_dump();
   573:     return (0);
   574:   }
   575: 
   576:   if (!(GET_OBJ_TYPE(GET_EQ(ch, eq_pos)) == ITEM_ARMOR))
   577:     return (0);
   578:   return GET_OBJ_VAL(GET_EQ(ch, eq_pos), 0);
   579: }
   580: 
   581: int invalid_align(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj)
   582: {
   583:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_ANTI_EVIL) && IS_EVIL(ch))
   584:     return TRUE;
   585:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_ANTI_GOOD) && IS_GOOD(ch))
   586:     return TRUE;
   587:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_ANTI_NEUTRAL) && IS_NEUTRAL(ch))
   588:     return TRUE;
   589:   return FALSE;
   590: }
   591: 
   592: int character_is_using_two_hander(const struct char_data *ch)
   593: {
   594:   const struct obj_data *weapon;
   595: 
   596:   if (!ch || !(weapon = GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_WIELD)))
   597:     return FALSE;
   598: 
   599:   return (GET_OBJ_TYPE(weapon) == ITEM_WEAPON && OBJ_FLAGGED(weapon, ITEM_TWO_HANDER));
   600: }
   601: 
   602: void equip_char(struct char_data *ch, struct obj_data *obj, int pos)
   603: {
   604:   int j;
   605: 
   606:   if (pos < 0 || pos >= NUM_WEARS) {
   607:     core_dump();
   608:     return;
   609:   }
   610: 
   611:   if (GET_EQ(ch, pos)) {
   612:     log("SYSERR: Char is already equipped: %s, %s", GET_NAME(ch),
   613: 	    obj->short_description);
   614:     return;
   615:   }
   616:   if (obj->carried_by) {
   617:     log("SYSERR: EQUIP: Obj is carried_by when equip.");
   618:     return;
   619:   }
   620:   if (IN_ROOM(obj) != NOWHERE) {
   621:     log("SYSERR: EQUIP: Obj is in_room when equip.");
   622:     return;
   623:   }
   624:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON && OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_TWO_HANDER) &&
   625:       OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_OFFHAND)) {
   626:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
   627:            "SYSERR: equip_char preserved %s in %s's inventory; weapon has incompatible TWO_HANDER and OFFHAND flags.",
   628:            obj->short_description, GET_NAME(ch));
   629:     obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   630:     return;
   631:   }
   632:   if ((pos == WEAR_HOLD || pos == WEAR_SHIELD) && character_is_using_two_hander(ch)) {
   633:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
   634:            "SYSERR: equip_char preserved %s by moving it to %s's inventory; a two-handed weapon blocks position %d.",
   635:            obj->short_description, GET_NAME(ch), pos);
   636:     obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   637:     return;
   638:   }
   639:   if (pos == WEAR_WIELD && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON && OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_TWO_HANDER) &&
   640:       (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_HOLD) || GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_SHIELD))) {
   641:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
   642:            "SYSERR: equip_char preserved %s in %s's inventory; occupied secondary hand blocks two-handed equip.",
   643:            obj->short_description, GET_NAME(ch));
   644:     obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   645:     return;
   646:   }
   647:   if (invalid_align(ch, obj) || invalid_class(ch, obj)) {
   648:     act("You are zapped by $p and instantly let go of it.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_CHAR);
   649:     act("$n is zapped by $p and instantly lets go of it.", FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
   650:     /* Changed to drop in inventory instead of the ground. */
   651:     obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   652:     return;
   653:   }
   654: 
   655:   GET_EQ(ch, pos) = obj;
   656:   obj->worn_by = ch;
   657:   obj->worn_on = pos;
   658: 
   659:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_ARMOR)
   660:     GET_AC(ch) += apply_armor(ch, pos);
   661: 
   662:   if (IN_ROOM(ch) != NOWHERE) {
   663:     if (pos == WEAR_LIGHT && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_LIGHT)
   664:       if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2))	/* if light is ON */
   665: 	world[IN_ROOM(ch)].light++;
   666:   } else
   667:     log("SYSERR: IN_ROOM(ch) = NOWHERE when equipping char %s.", GET_NAME(ch));
   668: 
   669:   for (j = 0; j < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; j++)
   670:     affect_modify_ar(ch, obj->affected[j].location,
   671: 		  obj->affected[j].modifier,
   672: 		  GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj), TRUE);
   673: 
   674:   affect_total(ch);
   675: }
   676: 
   677: struct obj_data *unequip_char(struct char_data *ch, int pos)
   678: {
   679:   int j;
   680:   struct obj_data *obj;
   681: 
   682:   if ((pos < 0 || pos >= NUM_WEARS) || GET_EQ(ch, pos) == NULL) {
   683:     core_dump();
   684:     return (NULL);
   685:   }
   686: 
   687:   obj = GET_EQ(ch, pos);
   688:   obj->worn_by = NULL;
   689:   obj->worn_on = -1;
   690: 
   691:   if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_ARMOR)
   692:     GET_AC(ch) -= apply_armor(ch, pos);
   693: 
   694:   if (IN_ROOM(ch) != NOWHERE) {
   695:     if (pos == WEAR_LIGHT && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_LIGHT)
   696:       if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2))	/* if light is ON */
   697: 	world[IN_ROOM(ch)].light--;
   698:   } else
   699:     log("SYSERR: IN_ROOM(ch) = NOWHERE when unequipping char %s.", GET_NAME(ch));
   700: 
   701:   GET_EQ(ch, pos) = NULL;
   702: 
   703:   for (j = 0; j < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; j++)
   704:     affect_modify_ar(ch, obj->affected[j].location,
   705: 		  obj->affected[j].modifier,
   706: 		  GET_OBJ_AFFECT(obj), FALSE);
   707: 
   708:   affect_total(ch);
   709: 
   710:   return (obj);
   711: }
   712: 
   713: int get_number(char **name)
   714: {
   715:   int i;
   716:   char *ppos;
   717:   char number[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   718: 
   719:   *number = '\0';
   720: 
   721:   if ((ppos = strchr(*name, '.')) != NULL) {
   722:     *ppos++ = '\0';
   723:     strlcpy(number, *name, sizeof(number));
   724:     strcpy(*name, ppos);	/* strcpy: OK (always smaller) */
   725: 
   726:     for (i = 0; *(number + i); i++)
   727:       if (!isdigit(*(number + i)))
   728: 	return (0);
   729: 
   730:     return (atoi(number));
   731:   }
   732:   return (1);
   733: }
   734: 
   735: /* Search a given list for an object number, and return a ptr to that obj */
   736: struct obj_data *get_obj_in_list_num(int num, struct obj_data *list)
   737: {
   738:   struct obj_data *i;
   739: 
   740:   for (i = list; i; i = i->next_content)
   741:     if (GET_OBJ_RNUM(i) == num)
   742:       return (i);
   743: 
   744:   return (NULL);
   745: }
   746: 
   747: /* search the entire world for an object number, and return a pointer  */
   748: struct obj_data *get_obj_num(obj_rnum nr)
   749: {
   750:   struct obj_data *i;
   751: 
   752:   for (i = object_list; i; i = i->next)
   753:     if (GET_OBJ_RNUM(i) == nr)
   754:       return (i);
   755: 
   756:   return (NULL);
   757: }
   758: 
   759: /* search a room for a char, and return a pointer if found..  */
   760: struct char_data *get_char_room(char *name, int *number, room_rnum room)
   761: {
   762:   struct char_data *i;
   763:   int num;
   764: 
   765:   if (!number) {
   766:     number = &num;
   767:     num = get_number(&name);
   768:   }
   769: 
   770:   if (*number == 0)
   771:     return (NULL);
   772: 
   773:   for (i = world[room].people; i && *number; i = i->next_in_room)
   774:     if (isname(name, i->player.name))
   775:       if (--(*number) == 0)
   776: 	return (i);
   777: 
   778:   return (NULL);
   779: }
   780: 
   781: /* search all over the world for a char num, and return a pointer if found */
   782: struct char_data *get_char_num(mob_rnum nr)
   783: {
   784:   struct char_data *i;
   785: 
   786:   for (i = character_list; i; i = i->next)
   787:     if (GET_MOB_RNUM(i) == nr)
   788:       return (i);
   789: 
   790:   return (NULL);
   791: }
   792: 
   793: /* put an object in a room */
   794: void obj_to_room(struct obj_data *object, room_rnum room)
   795: {
   796:   if (!object || room == NOWHERE || room > top_of_world){
   797:     log("SYSERR: Illegal value(s) passed to obj_to_room. (Room #%d/%d, obj %p)",
   798: 	room, top_of_world, (void *)object);
   799:   }
   800:   else {
   801:     if (world[room].contents == NULL){  // if list is empty
   802:       world[room].contents = object; // add object to list
   803:     }
   804:     else {
   805:       struct obj_data *i = world[room].contents; // define a temporary pointer
   806:       while (i->next_content != NULL) i = i->next_content; // find the first without a next_content
   807:         i->next_content = object; // add object at the end
   808:     }
   809:     object->next_content = NULL; // mostly for sanity. should do nothing.
   810:     IN_ROOM(object) = room;
   811:     object->carried_by = NULL;
   812:     if (ROOM_FLAGGED(room, ROOM_HOUSE))
   813:       SET_BIT_AR(ROOM_FLAGS(room), ROOM_HOUSE_CRASH);
   814:   }
   815: }
   816: 
   817: /* Take an object from a room */
   818: void obj_from_room(struct obj_data *object)
   819: {
   820:   struct obj_data *temp;
   821:   struct char_data *t, *tempch;
   822: 
   823:   if (!object || IN_ROOM(object) == NOWHERE) {
   824:     log("SYSERR: NULL object (%p) or obj not in a room (%d) passed to obj_from_room",
   825: 	(void *)object, IN_ROOM(object));
   826:     return;
   827:   }
   828: 
   829:    /* if people are sitting in it, toss their butt to the ground */
   830:   if (OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(object) != NULL) {
   831:     for (tempch = OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(object); tempch; tempch = t) {
   832:        t = NEXT_SITTING(tempch);
   833:        SITTING(tempch) = NULL;
   834:        NEXT_SITTING(tempch) = NULL;
   835:     }
   836:   }
   837: 
   838:   REMOVE_FROM_LIST(object, world[IN_ROOM(object)].contents, next_content);
   839: 
   840:   if (ROOM_FLAGGED(IN_ROOM(object), ROOM_HOUSE))
   841:     SET_BIT_AR(ROOM_FLAGS(IN_ROOM(object)), ROOM_HOUSE_CRASH);
   842:   IN_ROOM(object) = NOWHERE;
   843:   object->next_content = NULL;
   844: }
   845: 
   846: /* put an object in an object (quaint)  */
   847: void obj_to_obj(struct obj_data *obj, struct obj_data *obj_to)
   848: {
   849:   struct obj_data *tmp_obj;
   850: 
   851:   if (!obj || !obj_to || obj == obj_to) {
   852:     log("SYSERR: NULL object (%p) or same source (%p) and target (%p) obj passed to obj_to_obj.",
   853: 	(void *)obj, (void *)obj, (void *)obj_to);
   854:     return;
   855:   }
   856: 
   857:   obj->next_content = obj_to->contains;
   858:   obj_to->contains = obj;
   859:   obj->in_obj = obj_to;
   860: 
   861:   /* Add weight to container, unless unlimited. */
   862:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj->in_obj, 0) > 0) {
   863:     for (tmp_obj = obj->in_obj; tmp_obj->in_obj; tmp_obj = tmp_obj->in_obj)
   864:       GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(tmp_obj) += GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj);
   865: 
   866:     /* top level object.  Subtract weight from inventory if necessary. */
   867:     GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(tmp_obj) += GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj);
   868:     if (tmp_obj->carried_by)
   869:       IS_CARRYING_W(tmp_obj->carried_by) += GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj);
   870:   }
   871: }
   872: 
   873: /* remove an object from an object */
   874: void obj_from_obj(struct obj_data *obj)
   875: {
   876:   struct obj_data *temp, *obj_from;
   877: 
   878:   if (obj->in_obj == NULL) {
   879:     log("SYSERR: (%s): trying to illegally extract obj from obj.", __FILE__);
   880:     return;
   881:   }
   882:   obj_from = obj->in_obj;
   883:   REMOVE_FROM_LIST(obj, obj_from->contains, next_content);
   884: 
   885:   /* Subtract weight from containers container unless unlimited. */
   886:   if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj->in_obj, 0) > 0) {
   887:     for (temp = obj->in_obj; temp->in_obj; temp = temp->in_obj)
   888:       GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(temp) -= GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj);
   889: 
   890:     /* Subtract weight from char that carries the object */
   891:     GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(temp) -= GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj);
   892:     if (temp->carried_by)
   893:       IS_CARRYING_W(temp->carried_by) -= GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj);
   894:   }
   895:   obj->in_obj = NULL;
   896:   obj->next_content = NULL;
   897: }
   898: 
   899: /* Set all carried_by to point to new owner */
   900: void object_list_new_owner(struct obj_data *list, struct char_data *ch)
   901: {
   902:   if (list) {
   903:     object_list_new_owner(list->contains, ch);
   904:     object_list_new_owner(list->next_content, ch);
   905:     list->carried_by = ch;
   906:   }
   907: }
   908: 
   909: /* Extract an object from the world */
   910: void extract_obj(struct obj_data *obj)
   911: {
   912:   struct char_data *ch, *next = NULL;
   913:   struct obj_data *temp;
   914: 
   915:   if (obj->worn_by != NULL)
   916:     if (unequip_char(obj->worn_by, obj->worn_on) != obj)
   917:       log("SYSERR: Inconsistent worn_by and worn_on pointers!!");
   918:   if (IN_ROOM(obj) != NOWHERE)
   919:     obj_from_room(obj);
   920:   else if (obj->carried_by)
   921:     obj_from_char(obj);
   922:   else if (obj->in_obj)
   923:     obj_from_obj(obj);
   924: 
   925:   if (OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(obj)){
   926:     for (ch = OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(obj); OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(obj); ch = next){
   927:       if (!NEXT_SITTING(ch))
   928:         OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(obj) = NULL;
   929:       else
   930:         OBJ_SAT_IN_BY(obj) = (next = NEXT_SITTING(ch));
   931:       SITTING(ch) = NULL;
   932:       NEXT_SITTING(ch) = NULL;
   933:     }
   934:   }
   935: 
   936:   /* Get rid of the contents of the object, as well. */
   937:   while (obj->contains)
   938:     extract_obj(obj->contains);
   939: 
   940:   REMOVE_FROM_LIST(obj, object_list, next);
   941: 
   942:   if (GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj) != NOTHING)
   943:     (obj_index[GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj)].number)--;
   944: 
   945:   if (SCRIPT(obj))
   946:     extract_script(obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
   947: 
   948:   if (obj->events != NULL) {
   949: 	  if (obj->events->iSize > 0) {
   950: 		struct event * pEvent;
   951: 
   952: 		while ((pEvent = simple_list(obj->events)) != NULL)
   953: 		  event_cancel(pEvent);
   954: 	  }
   955: 	  free_list(obj->events);
   956:     obj->events = NULL;
   957:   }
   958: 
   959:   if (GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj) == NOTHING || obj->proto_script != obj_proto[GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj)].proto_script)
   960:     free_proto_script(obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
   961: 
   962:   free_obj(obj);
   963: }
   964: 
   965: static void update_object(struct obj_data *obj, int use)
   966: {
   967:   /* dont update objects with a timer trigger */
   968:   if (!SCRIPT_CHECK(obj, OTRIG_TIMER) && (GET_OBJ_TIMER(obj) > 0))
   969:     GET_OBJ_TIMER(obj) -= use;
   970:   if (obj->contains)
   971:     update_object(obj->contains, use);
   972:   if (obj->next_content)
   973:     update_object(obj->next_content, use);
   974: }
   975: 
   976: void update_char_objects(struct char_data *ch)
   977: {
   978:   int i;
   979: 
   980:   if (GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT) != NULL)
   981:     if (GET_OBJ_TYPE(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT)) == ITEM_LIGHT)
   982:       if (GET_OBJ_VAL(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT), 2) > 0) {
   983: 	i = --GET_OBJ_VAL(GET_EQ(ch, WEAR_LIGHT), 2);
   984: 	if (i == 1) {
   985: 	  send_to_char(ch, "Your light begins to flicker and fade.\r\n");
   986: 	  act("$n's light begins to flicker and fade.", FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   987: 	} else if (i == 0) {
   988: 	  send_to_char(ch, "Your light sputters out and dies.\r\n");
   989: 	  act("$n's light sputters out and dies.", FALSE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   990: 	  world[IN_ROOM(ch)].light--;
   991: 	}
   992:       }
   993: 
   994:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
   995:     if (GET_EQ(ch, i))
   996:       update_object(GET_EQ(ch, i), 2);
   997: 
   998:   if (ch->carrying)
   999:     update_object(ch->carrying, 1);
  1000: }
  1001: 
  1002: /* Extract a ch completely from the world, and leave his stuff behind */
  1003: void extract_char_final(struct char_data *ch)
  1004: {
  1005:   struct char_data *k, *temp;
  1006:   struct descriptor_data *d;
  1007:   struct obj_data *obj;
  1008:   int i;
  1009: 
  1010:   if (IN_ROOM(ch) == NOWHERE) {
  1011:     log("SYSERR: NOWHERE extracting char %s. (%s, extract_char_final)",
  1012:         GET_NAME(ch), __FILE__);
  1013:     exit(1);
  1014:   }
  1015: 
  1016:   /* We're booting the character of someone who has switched so first we need
  1017:    * to stuff them back into their own body.  This will set ch->desc we're
  1018:    * checking below this loop to the proper value. */
  1019:   if (!IS_NPC(ch) && !ch->desc) {
  1020:     for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next)
  1021:       if (d->original == ch) {
  1022: 	do_return(d->character, NULL, 0, 0);
  1023:         break;
  1024:       }
  1025:   }
  1026: 
  1027:   if (ch->desc) {
  1028:     /* This time we're extracting the body someone has switched into (not the
  1029:      * body of someone switching as above) so we need to put the switcher back
  1030:      * to their own body. If this body is not possessed, the owner won't have a
  1031:      * body after the removal so dump them to the main menu. */
  1032:     if (ch->desc->original)
  1033:       do_return(ch, NULL, 0, 0);
  1034:     else {
  1035:       /* Now we boot anybody trying to log in with the same character, to help
  1036:        * guard against duping.  CON_DISCONNECT is used to close a descriptor
  1037:        * without extracting the d->character associated with it, for being
  1038:        * link-dead, so we want CON_CLOSE to clean everything up. If we're
  1039:        * here, we know it's a player so no IS_NPC check required. */
  1040:       for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
  1041:         if (d == ch->desc)
  1042:           continue;
  1043:         if (d->character && GET_IDNUM(ch) == GET_IDNUM(d->character))
  1044:           STATE(d) = CON_CLOSE;
  1045:       }
  1046:       STATE(ch->desc) = CON_MENU;
  1047:       write_to_output(ch->desc, "%s", CONFIG_MENU);
  1048:     }
  1049:   }
  1050: 
  1051:   /* On with the character's assets... */
  1052:   if (ch->followers || ch->master)
  1053:     die_follower(ch);
  1054: 
  1055:   /* Check to see if we are grouped! */
  1056:   if (GROUP(ch))
  1057:     leave_group(ch);
  1058: 
  1059:   /* transfer objects to room, if any */
  1060:   while (ch->carrying) {
  1061:     obj = ch->carrying;
  1062:     obj_from_char(obj);
  1063:     obj_to_room(obj, IN_ROOM(ch));
  1064:   }
  1065: 
  1066:   /* transfer equipment to room, if any */
  1067:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++)
  1068:     if (GET_EQ(ch, i))
  1069:       obj_to_room(unequip_char(ch, i), IN_ROOM(ch));
  1070: 
  1071:   if (FIGHTING(ch))
  1072:     stop_fighting(ch);
  1073: 
  1074:   for (k = combat_list; k; k = temp) {
  1075:     temp = k->next_fighting;
  1076:     if (FIGHTING(k) == ch)
  1077:       stop_fighting(k);
  1078:   }
  1079:   
  1080:   /* Whipe character from the memory of hunters and other intelligent NPCs... */
  1081:   for (temp = character_list; temp; temp = temp->next) {
  1082:     /* PCs can't use MEMORY, and don't use HUNTING() */
  1083:     if (!IS_NPC(temp))
  1084:       continue;
  1085:     /* If "temp" is hunting our extracted char, stop the hunt. */
  1086:     if (HUNTING(temp) == ch)
  1087:       HUNTING(temp) = NULL;
  1088:     /* If "temp" has allocated memory data and our ch is a PC, forget the 
  1089:      * extracted character (if he/she is remembered) */  
  1090:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && GET_POS(ch) == POS_DEAD && MEMORY(temp))
  1091:       forget(temp, ch); /* forget() is safe to use without a check. */
  1092:   }
  1093: 
  1094:   char_from_room(ch);
  1095: 
  1096:   if (IS_NPC(ch)) {
  1097:     if (GET_MOB_RNUM(ch) != NOTHING)	/* prototyped */
  1098:       mob_index[GET_MOB_RNUM(ch)].number--;
  1099:     clearMemory(ch);
  1100: 
  1101:     if (SCRIPT(ch))
  1102:       extract_script(ch, MOB_TRIGGER);
  1103: 
  1104:     if (SCRIPT_MEM(ch))
  1105:       extract_script_mem(SCRIPT_MEM(ch));
  1106:   } else {
  1107:     save_char(ch);
  1108:     Crash_delete_crashfile(ch);
  1109:   }
  1110: 
  1111:   /* If there's a descriptor, they're in the menu now. */
  1112:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc)
  1113:     free_char(ch);
  1114: }
  1115: 
  1116: /* Why do we do this? Because trying to iterate over the character list with
  1117:  * 'ch = ch->next' does bad things if the current character happens to die. The
  1118:  * trivial workaround of 'vict = next_vict' doesn't work if the _next_ person
  1119:  * in the list gets killed, for example, by an area spell. Why do we leave them
  1120:  * on the character_list? Because code doing 'vict = vict->next' would get
  1121:  * really confused otherwise.
  1122:  *
  1123:  * Fixed a bug where it would over-count extractions if you try to extract the
  1124:  * same character twice (e.g. double-purging in a script) -khufu / EmpireMUD
  1125:  */
  1126: void extract_char(struct char_data *ch)
  1127: {
  1128:   char_from_furniture(ch);
  1129:   clear_char_event_list(ch);
  1130: 
  1131:   if (IS_NPC(ch) && !MOB_FLAGGED(ch, MOB_NOTDEADYET)) {
  1132:     SET_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(ch), MOB_NOTDEADYET);
  1133:     ++extractions_pending;
  1134:   }
  1135:   else if (!IS_NPC(ch) && !PLR_FLAGGED(ch, PLR_NOTDEADYET)) {
  1136:     SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_NOTDEADYET);
  1137:     ++extractions_pending;
  1138:   }
  1139: }
  1140: 
  1141: /* I'm not particularly pleased with the MOB/PLR hoops that have to be jumped
  1142:  * through but it hardly calls for a completely new variable. Ideally it would
  1143:  * be its own list, but that would change the '->next' pointer, potentially
  1144:  * confusing some code. -gg This doesn't handle recursive extractions. */
  1145: void extract_pending_chars(void)
  1146: {
  1147:   struct char_data *vict, *next_vict, *prev_vict;
  1148: 
  1149:   if (extractions_pending < 0)
  1150:     log("SYSERR: Negative (%d) extractions pending.", extractions_pending);
  1151: 
  1152:   for (vict = character_list, prev_vict = NULL; vict && extractions_pending; vict = next_vict) {
  1153:     next_vict = vict->next;
  1154: 
  1155:     if (MOB_FLAGGED(vict, MOB_NOTDEADYET))
  1156:       REMOVE_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(vict), MOB_NOTDEADYET);
  1157:     else if (PLR_FLAGGED(vict, PLR_NOTDEADYET))
  1158:       REMOVE_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(vict), PLR_NOTDEADYET);
  1159:     else {
  1160:       /* Last non-free'd character to continue chain from. */
  1161:       prev_vict = vict;
  1162:       continue;
  1163:     }
  1164: 
  1165:     extract_char_final(vict);
  1166:     extractions_pending--;
  1167: 
  1168:     if (prev_vict)
  1169:       prev_vict->next = next_vict;
  1170:     else
  1171:       character_list = next_vict;
  1172:   }
  1173: 
  1174:   if (extractions_pending > 0)
  1175:     log("SYSERR: Couldn't find %d extractions as counted.", extractions_pending);
  1176: 
  1177:   extractions_pending = 0;
  1178: }
  1179: 
  1180: /* Here follows high-level versions of some earlier routines, ie functions
  1181:  * which incorporate the actual player-data */
  1182: struct char_data *get_player_vis(struct char_data *ch, char *name, int *number, int inroom)
  1183: {
  1184:   struct char_data *i;
  1185:   int num;
  1186: 
  1187:   if (!number) {
  1188:     number = &num;
  1189:     num = get_number(&name);
  1190:   }
  1191: 
  1192:   for (i = character_list; i; i = i->next) {
  1193:     if (IS_NPC(i))
  1194:       continue;
  1195:     if (inroom == FIND_CHAR_ROOM && IN_ROOM(i) != IN_ROOM(ch))
  1196:       continue;
  1197:     if (str_cmp(i->player.name, name)) /* If not same, continue */
  1198:       continue;
  1199:     if (!CAN_SEE(ch, i))
  1200:       continue;
  1201:     if (--(*number) != 0)
  1202:       continue;
  1203:     return (i);
  1204:   }
  1205: 
  1206:   return (NULL);
  1207: }

  1209: struct char_data *get_char_room_vis(struct char_data *ch, char *name, int *number)
  1210: {
  1211:   struct char_data *i;
  1212:   int num;
  1213: 
  1214:   if (!number) {
  1215:     number = &num;
  1216:     num = get_number(&name);
  1217:   }
  1218: 
  1219:   /* JE */
  1220:   if (!str_cmp(name, "self") || !str_cmp(name, "me"))
  1221:     return (ch);
  1222: 
  1223:   /* 0.<name> means PC with name */
  1224:   if (*number == 0)
  1225:     return (get_player_vis(ch, name, NULL, FIND_CHAR_ROOM));
  1226: 
  1227:   for (i = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; i && *number; i = i->next_in_room)
  1228:     if (isname(name, i->player.name))
  1229:       if (CAN_SEE(ch, i))
  1230: 	if (--(*number) == 0)
  1231: 	  return (i);
  1232: 
  1233:   return (NULL);
  1234: }

  1256:       continue;

  1258:       continue;
  1259:     if (--(*number) != 0)
  1260:       continue;

  1263:   }
  1264:   return (NULL);
  1265: }

  1299: /* search the entire world for an object, and return a pointer  */
  1300: struct obj_data *get_obj_vis(struct char_data *ch, char *name, int *number)
  1301: {
  1302:   struct obj_data *i;
  1303:   int num;
  1304: 
  1305:   if (!number) {
  1306:     number = &num;
  1307:     num = get_number(&name);
  1308:   }
  1309: 
  1310:   if (*number == 0)
  1311:     return (NULL);
  1312: 
  1313:   /* scan items carried */
  1314:   if ((i = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, name, number, ch->carrying)) != NULL)
  1315:     return (i);
  1316: 
  1317:   /* scan room */
  1318:   if ((i = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, name, number, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents)) != NULL)
  1319:     return (i);
  1320: 
  1321:   /* ok.. no luck yet. scan the entire obj list   */
  1322:   for (i = object_list; i && *number; i = i->next)
  1323:     if (isname(name, i->name))
  1324:       if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, i))
  1325: 	if (--(*number) == 0)
  1326: 	  return (i);
  1327: 
  1328:   return (NULL);
  1329: }

  1371: const char *money_desc(int amount_gold)
  1372: {
  1373:   static char buf[128];
  1374: 
  1375:   if (amount_gold <= 0) {
  1376:     log("SYSERR: Try to create negative or 0 money (%d).", amount_gold);
  1377:     return (NULL);
  1378:   }
  1379: 
  1380:   {
  1381:     long long count = (long long)amount_gold;
  1382: 
  1383:     if (count == 1)
  1384:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "a gold coin");
  1385:     else
  1386:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "a pile of gold coins");
  1387:   }
  1388: 
  1389:   return buf;
  1390: }
