  1392: 
  1393: struct obj_data *create_money(int amount_gold, int denom_hint)
  1394: {
  1395:   struct obj_data *obj;
  1396:   struct extra_descr_data *new_descr;
  1397:   char buf[256];
  1398:   int y;
  1399: 
  1400:   long long unit = 1;
  1401:   const char *metal = "gold";
  1402: 
  1403:   (void)denom_hint;
  1404: 
  1405:   if (amount_gold <= 0) {
  1406:     log("SYSERR: Try to create negative or 0 money. (%d)", amount_gold);
  1407:     return (NULL);
  1408:   }
  1409: 
  1410:   metal = "gold";
  1411: 
  1412:   {
  1413:     long long count = (long long)amount_gold / unit;
  1414:     long long rem   = (long long)amount_gold % unit;
  1415:     int singular = (count == 1 && rem == 0);
  1416: 
  1417:     obj = create_obj();
  1418:     CREATE(new_descr, struct extra_descr_data, 1);
  1419: 
  1420:     /* Keywords: only correct metal */
  1421:     {
  1422:       char k[128];
  1423:       snprintf(k, sizeof(k), "coin coins money pile %s", metal);
  1424:       obj->name = strdup(k);
  1425:       new_descr->keyword = strdup(k);
  1426:     }
  1427: 
  1428:     if (singular)
  1429:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "a %s coin", metal);
  1430:     else
  1431:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "a pile of %s coins", metal);
  1432:     obj->short_description = strdup(buf);
  1433: 
  1434:     if (singular)
  1435:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "A %s coin is lying here.", metal);
  1436:     else
  1437:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "A pile of %s coins is lying here.", metal);
  1438:     obj->description = strdup(buf);
  1439: 
  1440:     if (singular) {
  1441:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "It's a single %s coin.", metal);
  1442:     } else {
  1443:       if (count < 10)
  1444:         snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "There are %lld %s coins.", count, metal);
  1445:       else if (count < 100)
  1446:         snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "There are about %lld %s coins.", 10LL * (count / 10LL), metal);
  1447:       else if (count < 1000)
  1448:         snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "It looks to be about %lld %s coins.", 100LL * (count / 100LL), metal);
  1449:       else
  1450:         snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "There are a lot of %s coins.", metal);
  1451:     }
  1452:     new_descr->description = strdup(buf);
  1453: 
  1454:     new_descr->next = NULL;
  1455:     obj->ex_description = new_descr;
  1456: 
  1457:     GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) = ITEM_MONEY;
  1458:     for (y = 0; y < TW_ARRAY_MAX; y++)
  1459:       obj->obj_flags.wear_flags[y] = 0;
  1460:     SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), ITEM_WEAR_TAKE);
  1461: 
  1462:     GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0) = amount_gold;
  1463:     GET_OBJ_COST(obj) = MAX(1, amount_gold);
  1464:     obj->item_number = NOTHING;
  1465: 
  1466:     return obj;
  1467:   }
  1468: }

  1470: 
  1471: /* Generic Find, designed to find any object orcharacter.
  1472:  *  *arg     is the pointer containing the string to be searched for.
  1473:  *           This string doesn't have to be a single word, the routine
  1474:  *           extracts the next word itself.
  1475:  *  bitv..   All those bits that you want to "search through".
  1476:  *           Bit found will be result of the function
  1477:  *  *ch      This is the person that is trying to "find"
  1478:  *  **tar_ch Will be NULL if no character was found, otherwise points
  1479:  * **tar_obj Will be NULL if no object was found, otherwise points
  1480:  *
  1481:  * The routine used to return a pointer to the next word in *arg (just
  1482:  * like the one_argument routine), but now it returns an integer that
  1483:  * describes what it filled in. */
  1484: int generic_find(char *arg, bitvector_t bitvector, struct char_data *ch,
  1485: 		     struct char_data **tar_ch, struct obj_data **tar_obj)
  1486: {
  1487:   int i, found, number;
  1488:   char name_val[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1489:   char *name = name_val;
  1490: 
  1491:   *tar_ch = NULL;
  1492:   *tar_obj = NULL;
  1493: 
  1494:   one_argument(arg, name);
  1495: 
  1496:   if (!*name)
  1497:     return (0);
  1498:   if (!(number = get_number(&name)))
  1499:     return (0);
  1500: 
  1501:   if (IS_SET(bitvector, FIND_CHAR_ROOM)) {	/* Find person in room */
  1502:     if ((*tar_ch = get_char_room_vis(ch, name, &number)) != NULL)
  1503:       return (FIND_CHAR_ROOM);
  1504:   }
  1505: 
  1506:   if (IS_SET(bitvector, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)) {
  1507:     if ((*tar_ch = get_char_world_vis(ch, name, &number)) != NULL)
  1508:       return (FIND_CHAR_WORLD);
  1509:   }
  1510: 
  1511:   if (IS_SET(bitvector, FIND_OBJ_EQUIP)) {
  1512:     for (found = FALSE, i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS && !found; i++)
  1513:       if (GET_EQ(ch, i) && isname(name, GET_EQ(ch, i)->name) && --number == 0) {
  1514: 	*tar_obj = GET_EQ(ch, i);
  1515: 	found = TRUE;
  1516:       }
  1517:     if (found)
  1518:       return (FIND_OBJ_EQUIP);
  1519:   }
  1520: 
  1521:   if (IS_SET(bitvector, FIND_OBJ_INV)) {
  1522:     if ((*tar_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, name, &number, ch->carrying)) != NULL)
  1523:       return (FIND_OBJ_INV);
  1524:   }
  1525: 
  1526:   if (IS_SET(bitvector, FIND_OBJ_ROOM)) {
  1527:     if ((*tar_obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, name, &number, world[IN_ROOM(ch)].contents)) != NULL)
  1528:       return (FIND_OBJ_ROOM);
  1529:   }
  1530: 
  1531:   if (IS_SET(bitvector, FIND_OBJ_WORLD)) {
  1532:     if ((*tar_obj = get_obj_vis(ch, name, &number)))
  1533:       return (FIND_OBJ_WORLD);
  1534:   }
  1535: 
  1536:   return (0);
  1537: }
  1538: 
  1539: /* a function to scan for "all" or "all.x" */
  1540: int find_all_dots(char *arg)
  1541: {
  1542:   if (!strcmp(arg, "all"))
  1543:     return (FIND_ALL);
  1544:   else if (!strncmp(arg, "all.", 4)) {
  1545:     strcpy(arg, arg + 4);	/* strcpy: OK (always less) */
  1546:     return (FIND_ALLDOT);
  1547:   } else
  1548:     return (FIND_INDIV);
  1549: }

  1551: /* Group Handlers */
  1552: struct group_data * create_group(struct char_data * leader) 
  1553: {
  1554:   struct group_data * new_group;
  1555:   
  1556:   /* Allocate Group Memory & Attach to Group List*/
  1557:   CREATE(new_group, struct group_data, 1);
  1558:   add_to_list(new_group, group_list);
  1559:   
  1560:   /* Allocate Members List */
  1561:   new_group->members = create_list();
  1562:   
  1563:   /* Clear Data */
  1564:   new_group->group_flags = 0;
  1565:   
  1566:   /* Assign Data */
  1567:   SET_BIT(GROUP_FLAGS(new_group), GROUP_OPEN);
  1568:   
  1569:   if (IS_NPC(leader))
  1570:     SET_BIT(GROUP_FLAGS(new_group), GROUP_NPC);
  1571:   
  1572:   join_group(leader, new_group);
  1573:   
  1574:   return (new_group);
  1575: }
  1576: 
  1577: void free_group(struct group_data * group)
  1578: {
  1579:   struct char_data *tch;
  1580: 	struct iterator_data Iterator;
  1581: 	
  1582:   if (group->members->iSize) {
  1583: 		for (tch = (struct char_data *) merge_iterator(&Iterator, group->members);
  1584: 		  tch; 
  1585: 		    tch = next_in_list(&Iterator))
  1586:           leave_group(tch);
  1587:           
  1588:     remove_iterator(&Iterator);
  1589:   }
  1590:   
  1591:   free_list(group->members);
  1592:   remove_from_list(group, group_list);
  1593:   free(group);
  1594: }
  1595: 
  1596: void leave_group(struct char_data *ch)
  1597: {
  1598:   struct group_data *group;
  1599:   struct char_data *tch;
  1600:   struct iterator_data Iterator;
  1601:   bool found_pc = FALSE;
  1602: 	
  1603:   if ((group = ch->group) == NULL)
  1604:     return;
  1605: 
  1606:   send_to_group(NULL, group, "%s has left the group.\r\n", GET_NAME(ch));
  1607: 
  1608:   remove_from_list(ch, group->members);
  1609:   ch->group = NULL;
  1610:   
  1611:   if (group->members->iSize) {
  1612:     for (tch = (struct char_data *) merge_iterator(&Iterator, group->members);
  1613:       tch; tch = next_in_list(&Iterator))
  1614:         if (!IS_NPC(tch)) 
  1615:           found_pc = TRUE;
  1616:           
  1617:     remove_iterator(&Iterator);  
  1618:   }
  1619: 
  1620:   if (!found_pc)
  1621:     SET_BIT(GROUP_FLAGS(group), GROUP_NPC);
  1622:   
  1623:   if (GROUP_LEADER(group) == ch && group->members->iSize) {
  1624:     group->leader = (struct char_data *) random_from_list(group->members);
  1625:     send_to_group(NULL, group, "%s has assumed leadership of the group.\r\n", GET_NAME(GROUP_LEADER(group)));
  1626:   } else if (group->members->iSize == 0)
  1627:     free_group(group); 
  1628: }
  1629: 
  1630: void join_group(struct char_data *ch, struct group_data *group)
  1631: {
  1632:   add_to_list(ch, group->members);
  1633: 	
  1634:   if (group->leader == NULL)
  1635:     group->leader = ch;
  1636: 	  
  1637:   ch->group = group;  
  1638:   
  1639:   if (IS_SET(group->group_flags, GROUP_NPC) && !IS_NPC(ch))
  1640:     REMOVE_BIT(GROUP_FLAGS(group), GROUP_NPC);
  1641: 	
  1642:   if (group->leader == ch)
  1643:     send_to_group(NULL, group, "%s becomes leader of the group.\r\n", GET_NAME(ch));
  1644:   else
  1645:     send_to_group(NULL, group, "%s joins the group.\r\n", GET_NAME(ch));		
  1646: 
  1647: }

    38: ACMD(do_oasis_hedit)
    39: {
    40:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
    41:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    42:   int i;
    43: 
    44:   /* No building as a mob or while being forced. */
    45:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
    46:     return;
    47: 
    48:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, HEDIT_PERMISSION)) {
    49:     send_to_char(ch, "You don't have access to editing help files.\r\n");
    50:     return;
    51:   }
    52: 
    53:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
    54:     if (STATE(d) == CON_HEDIT) {
    55:       send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, only one can person can edit help files at a time.\r\n");
    56:       return;
    57:     }
    58:   }
    59: 
    60:   one_argument(argument, arg);
    61: 
    62:   if (!*arg) {
    63:     send_to_char(ch, "Please specify a help entry to edit.\r\n");
    64:     return;
    65:   }
    66: 
    67:   d = ch->desc;
    68: 
    69:   if (!str_cmp("save", arg)) {
    70:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "OLC: %s saves help files.",
    71:            GET_NAME(ch));
    72:     hedit_save_to_disk(d);
    73:     send_to_char(ch, "Saving help files.\r\n");
    74:     return;
    75:   }
    76: 
    77:   /* Give descriptor an OLC structure. */
    78:   if (d->olc) {
    79:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: do_oasis: Player already had olc structure.");
    80:     free(d->olc);
    81:   }
    82: 
    83:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
    84:   OLC_NUM(d) = 0;
    85:   OLC_STORAGE(d) = strdup(arg);
    86:   
    87:   OLC_ZNUM(d) = search_help(OLC_STORAGE(d), LVL_IMPL);
    88: 
    89:   if (OLC_ZNUM(d) != NOWHERE && help_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].duplicate) {
    90:     for (i = 0; i < top_of_helpt; i++)
    91:       if (help_table[i].duplicate == 0 && help_table[i].entry == help_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].entry) {
    92:         OLC_ZNUM(d) = i;
    93:         break;
    94:       }
    95:   }
    96: 
    97:   if (OLC_ZNUM(d) == NOWHERE) {
    98:     send_to_char(ch, "Do you wish to add the '%s' help file? ", OLC_STORAGE(d));
    99:     OLC_MODE(d) = HEDIT_CONFIRM_ADD;
   100:   } else {
   101:     send_to_char(ch, "Do you wish to edit the '%s' help file?", help_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].keywords);
   102:     OLC_MODE(d) = HEDIT_CONFIRM_EDIT;
   103:   }
   104: 
   105:   STATE(d) = CON_HEDIT;
   106:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   107:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   108:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), 
   109:     TRUE, "OLC: %s starts editing help files.", GET_NAME(d->character));
   110: }

   112: static void hedit_setup_new(struct descriptor_data *d)
   113: {
   114:   CREATE(OLC_HELP(d), struct help_index_element, 1);
   115: 
   116:   OLC_HELP(d)->keywords		= strdup(OLC_STORAGE(d));
   117:   OLC_HELP(d)->entry		= strdup("This help file is unfinished.\r\n");
   118:   OLC_HELP(d)->min_level	= 0;
   119:   OLC_HELP(d)->duplicate	= 0;
   120:   OLC_VAL(d) = 0;
   121: 
   122:   hedit_disp_menu(d);
   123: }
   124: 
   125: static void hedit_setup_existing(struct descriptor_data *d, int rnum)
   126: {
   127:   char keywords[MAX_HELP_KEYWORDS + 1];
   128: 
   129:   CREATE(OLC_HELP(d), struct help_index_element, 1);
   130: 
   131:   hedit_collect_keywords_for_entry(rnum, keywords, sizeof(keywords));
   132:   OLC_HELP(d)->keywords		= str_udup(*keywords ? keywords : help_table[rnum].keywords);
   133:   OLC_HELP(d)->entry		= str_udup(help_table[rnum].entry);
   134:   OLC_HELP(d)->duplicate	= help_table[rnum].duplicate;
   135:   OLC_HELP(d)->min_level	= help_table[rnum].min_level;
   136:   OLC_VAL(d) = 0;
   137: 
   138:   hedit_disp_menu(d);
   139: }
   140: 
   141: static void hedit_save_internally(struct descriptor_data *d)
   142: {
   143:   struct help_index_element *new_help_table = NULL;
   144: 
   145:   if (OLC_ZNUM(d) == NOWHERE) {
   146:     int i;
   147:     CREATE(new_help_table, struct help_index_element, top_of_helpt + 2);
   148: 
   149:     for (i = 0; i < top_of_helpt; i++)
   150:       new_help_table[i] = help_table[i];
   151:       
   152:     new_help_table[top_of_helpt++] = *OLC_HELP(d);
   153:     free(help_table);
   154:     help_table = new_help_table;
   155:   } else
   156:     help_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)] = *OLC_HELP(d);
   157: 
   158:   add_to_save_list(HEDIT_PERMISSION, SL_HLP);
   159:   hedit_save_to_disk(d);
   160: }
   161: 
   162: static void hedit_save_to_disk(struct descriptor_data *d)
   163: {
   164:   FILE *fp;
   165:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], keywords[MAX_HELP_KEYWORDS + 1], index_name[READ_SIZE];
   166:   int i, j;
   167: 
   168:   snprintf(index_name, sizeof(index_name), "%s%s", HLP_PREFIX, HELP_FILE);
   169:   if (!(fp = fopen(index_name, "w"))) {
   170:     log("SYSERR: Could not write help index file");
   171:     return;
   172:   }
   173: 
   174:   for (i = 0; i < top_of_helpt; i++) {
   175:     struct help_index_element *entry = &help_table[i];
   176: 
   177:     if (entry->duplicate)
   178:       continue;
   179: 
   180:     keywords[0] = '\0';
   181:     for (j = 0; j < top_of_helpt; j++) {
   182:       if (help_table[j].entry != entry->entry || !help_table[j].keywords)
   183:         continue;
   184: 
   185:       if (*keywords && strlen(keywords) + 1 < sizeof(keywords))
   186:         hedit_append_bounded(keywords, sizeof(keywords), " ");
   187:       hedit_append_bounded(keywords, sizeof(keywords), help_table[j].keywords);
   188:     }
   189:     if (!*keywords)
   190:       strlcpy(keywords, "UNNAMED", sizeof(keywords));
   191: 
   192:     strncpy(buf1, entry->entry ? entry->entry : "Empty\r\n", sizeof(buf1) - 1);
   193:     buf1[sizeof(buf1) - 1] = '\0';
   194:     strip_cr(buf1);
   195: 
   196:     fprintf(fp, "%s\n\n%s\n#%d\n\n", keywords, convert_from_tabs(buf1), entry->min_level);
   197:   }
   198:   /* Write final line and close. */
   199:   fprintf(fp, "$~\n");
   200:   fclose(fp);
   201: 
   202:   remove_from_save_list(HEDIT_PERMISSION, SL_HLP);
   203: 
   204:   /* Reboot the help files. */
   205:   free_help_table();     
   206:   index_boot(DB_BOOT_HLP);
   207: }
   208: 
   209: static void hedit_collect_keywords_for_entry(int rnum, char *out, size_t outsz)
   210: {
   211:   int i;
   212: 
   213:   if (!out || outsz == 0)
   214:     return;
   215: 
   216:   out[0] = '\0';
   217:   if (rnum < 0 || rnum >= top_of_helpt || !help_table[rnum].entry)
   218:     return;
   219: 
   220:   for (i = 0; i < top_of_helpt; i++) {
   221:     if (help_table[i].entry != help_table[rnum].entry || !help_table[i].keywords)
   222:       continue;
   223: 
   224:     if (*out && strlen(out) + 1 < outsz)
   225:       hedit_append_bounded(out, outsz, " ");
   226:     hedit_append_bounded(out, outsz, help_table[i].keywords);
   227:   }
   228: }
   229: 
   230: static void hedit_append_bounded(char *dst, size_t dstsz, const char *src)
   231: {
   232:   size_t used;
   233: 
   234:   if (!dst || !src || dstsz == 0)
   235:     return;
   236: 
   237:   used = strlen(dst);
   238:   if (used >= dstsz)
   239:     return;
   240: 
   241:   snprintf(dst + used, dstsz - used, "%s", src);
   242: }

   244: /* The main menu. */
   245: static void hedit_disp_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   246: {
   247:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   248: 
   249:   write_to_output(d,
   250:       "%s-- Help file editor\r\n"
   251:       "%s1%s) Keywords    : %s%s\r\n"
   252:       "%s2%s) Entry       :\r\n%s%s"
   253:       "%s3%s) Min Level   : %s%d\r\n"
   254:       "%sQ%s) Quit\r\n"
   255:       "Enter choice : ",
   256:        nrm,
   257:        grn, nrm, yel, OLC_HELP(d)->keywords ? OLC_HELP(d)->keywords : "(none)",
   258:        grn, nrm, yel, OLC_HELP(d)->entry,
   259:        grn, nrm, yel, OLC_HELP(d)->min_level,
   260:        grn, nrm
   261:   );
   262:   OLC_MODE(d) = HEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
   263: }
   264: 
   265: void hedit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   266: {
   267:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   268:   char *oldtext = "";
   269:   int number;
   270: 
   271:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   272:   case HEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   273:     switch (*arg) {
   274:     case 'y':
   275:     case 'Y':
   276:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "OLC: %s edits help for %s.", GET_NAME(d->character),
   277:                OLC_HELP(d)->keywords);
   278:       mudlog(TRUE, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), CMP, "%s", buf);
   279:       write_to_output(d, "Help saved to disk.\r\n");
   280:       hedit_save_internally(d);
   281: 
   282:       /* Do not free strings, just the help structure. */
   283:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_STRUCTS);
   284:       break;
   285:     case 'n':
   286:     case 'N':
   287:       /* Free everything up, including strings, etc. */
   288:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   289:       break;
   290:     default:
   291:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\nDo you wish to save your changes? : \r\n");
   292:       break;
   293:     }
   294:     return;
   295: 
   296:   case HEDIT_CONFIRM_EDIT:
   297:     switch (*arg)  {
   298:     case 'y': case 'Y':
   299:       hedit_setup_existing(d, OLC_ZNUM(d));
   300:       break;
   301:     case 'q': case 'Q': 
   302:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   303:       break;       
   304:     case 'n': case 'N':
   305:       OLC_ZNUM(d)++;
   306:       for (; OLC_ZNUM(d) < top_of_helpt; OLC_ZNUM(d)++)
   307:         if (is_abbrev(OLC_STORAGE(d), help_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].keywords))
   308:           break;
   309:         else
   310:           OLC_ZNUM(d) = top_of_helpt + 1;
   311: 
   312:       if (OLC_ZNUM(d) > top_of_helpt) {
   313:         write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to add the '%s' help file? ",
   314:             OLC_STORAGE(d));
   315:         OLC_MODE(d) = HEDIT_CONFIRM_ADD;
   316:       } else {
   317:         write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to edit the '%s' help file? ",
   318:             help_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].keywords);
   319:         OLC_MODE(d) = HEDIT_CONFIRM_EDIT;
   320:       }     
   321:       break;
   322:     default:
   323:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n"
   324:                          "Do you wish to edit the '%s' help file? ",
   325:                          help_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].keywords);
   326:       break;
   327:     }
   328:     return;
   329: 
   330:   case HEDIT_CONFIRM_ADD:
   331:     switch (*arg)  {
   332:       case 'y': case 'Y':
   333:       hedit_setup_new(d);
   334:       break;
   335:     case 'n': case 'N': case 'q': case 'Q':
   336:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   337:       break;
   338:     default:
   339:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n"
   340:                          "Do you wish to add the '%s' help file? ",
   341:                          OLC_STORAGE(d));
   342:       break;
   343:     }
   344:     return;
   345: 
   346:   case HEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   347:     switch (*arg) {
   348:     case 'q':
   349:     case 'Q':
   350:       if (OLC_VAL(d)) {
   351:         /* Something has been modified. */
   352:         write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   353:         OLC_MODE(d) = HEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   354:       } else {
   355:         write_to_output(d, "No changes made.\r\n");
   356:         cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   357:       }
   358:       break;
   359:     case '1':
   360:       write_to_output(d, "Enter keywords (space-separated): ");
   361:       OLC_MODE(d) = HEDIT_KEYWORDS;
   362:       break;
   363:     case '2':
   364:       OLC_MODE(d) = HEDIT_ENTRY;
   365:       clear_screen(d);
   366:       send_editor_help(d);
   367:       write_to_output(d, "Enter help entry: (/s saves /h for help)\r\n");
   368:       if (OLC_HELP(d)->entry) {
   369:         write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_HELP(d)->entry);
   370:         oldtext = strdup(OLC_HELP(d)->entry);
   371:       }
   372:       string_write(d, &OLC_HELP(d)->entry, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH, 0, oldtext);
   373:       OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   374:       break;
   375:     case '3':
   376:       write_to_output(d, "Enter min level : ");
   377:       OLC_MODE(d) = HEDIT_MIN_LEVEL;
   378:       break;
   379:     default:
   380:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
   381:       hedit_disp_menu(d);
   382:       break;
   383:     }
   384:     return;
   385: 
   386:   case HEDIT_KEYWORDS:
   387:     if (OLC_HELP(d)->keywords)
   388:       free(OLC_HELP(d)->keywords);
   389:     if (strlen(arg) > MAX_HELP_KEYWORDS)
   390:       arg[MAX_HELP_KEYWORDS - 1] = '\0';
   391:     strip_cr(arg);
   392:     skip_spaces(&arg);
   393:     if (*arg)
   394:       OLC_HELP(d)->keywords = str_udup(arg);
   395:     else
   396:       OLC_HELP(d)->keywords = str_udup(OLC_STORAGE(d));
   397:     break;
   398: 
   399:   case HEDIT_ENTRY:
   400:     /* We will NEVER get here, we hope. */
   401:     mudlog(TRUE, LVL_BUILDER, BRF, "SYSERR: Reached HEDIT_ENTRY case in parse_hedit");
   402:     break;
   403: 
   404:   case HEDIT_MIN_LEVEL:
   405:     number = atoi(arg);
   406:     if ((number < 0) || (number > LVL_IMPL))
   407:       write_to_output(d, "That is not a valid choice!\r\nEnter min level:-\r\n] ");
   408:     else {
   409:       OLC_HELP(d)->min_level = number;
   410:       break;
   411:     }
   412:     return;
   413: 
   414:   default:
   415:     /* We should never get here. */
   416:     mudlog(TRUE, LVL_BUILDER, BRF, "SYSERR: Reached default case in parse_hedit");
   417:     break;
   418:   }
   419: 
   420:   /* If we get this far, something has been changed. */
   421:   OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   422:   hedit_disp_menu(d);
   423: }
   424: 
   425: void hedit_string_cleanup(struct descriptor_data *d, int terminator)
   426: {
   427:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   428:   case HEDIT_ENTRY:
   429:     hedit_disp_menu(d);
   430:     break;
   431:   }
   432: }
   433: 
   434: ACMD(do_helpcheck)
   435: {
   436: 
   437:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   438:   int i, count = 0;
   439:   size_t len = 0, nlen;
   440: 
   441:   for (i = 1; *(complete_cmd_info[i].command) != '\n'; i++) {
   442:     if (complete_cmd_info[i].command_pointer != do_action && complete_cmd_info[i].minimum_level >= 0) {
   443:       if (search_help(complete_cmd_info[i].command, LVL_IMPL) == NOWHERE) {
   444:         nlen = snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%-20.20s%s", complete_cmd_info[i].command,
   445:                         (++count % 3 ? "" : "\r\n"));
   446:         if (len + nlen >= sizeof(buf))
   447:           break;
   448:         len += nlen;
   449:       }
   450:     }
   451:   }
   452:   if (count % 3 && len < sizeof(buf))
   453:     snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "\r\n");
   454: 
   455:   if (ch->desc) {
   456: 	if (len == 0)
   457: 	 send_to_char(ch, "All commands have help entries.\r\n");
   458: 	else {
   459: 	 send_to_char(ch, "Commands without help entries:\r\n");
   460: 	 page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   461: 	}
   462:   }
   463: }
   464: 
   465: ACMD(do_hindex)
   466: {
   467:   int len, len2, count = 0, count2=0, i;
   468:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   469: 
   470:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   471: 
   472:   if (!*argument) {
   473:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: hindex <string>\r\n");
   474:     return;
   475:   }
   476: 
   477:   len = sprintf(buf, "\t1Help index entries beginning with '%s':\t2\r\n", argument);
   478:   len2 = sprintf(buf2, "\t1Help index entries containing '%s':\t2\r\n", argument);
   479:   for (i = 0; i < top_of_helpt; i++) {
   480:     if (is_abbrev(argument, help_table[i].keywords)
   481:         && (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= help_table[i].min_level))
   482:       len +=
   483:           snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%-20.20s%s", help_table[i].keywords,
   484:                    (++count % 3 ? "" : "\r\n"));
   485:     else if (strstr(help_table[i].keywords, argument)
   486:         && (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= help_table[i].min_level))
   487:       len2 +=
   488:           snprintf(buf2 + len2, sizeof(buf2) - len2, "%-20.20s%s", help_table[i].keywords,
   489:                    (++count2 % 3 ? "" : "\r\n"));
   490:   }
   491:   if (count % 3)
   492:     len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "\r\n");
   493:   if (count2 % 3)
   494:     len2 += snprintf(buf2 + len2, sizeof(buf2) - len2, "\r\n");
   495: 
   496:   if (!count)
   497:     len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "  None.\r\n");
   498:   if (!count2)
   499:     snprintf(buf2 + len2, sizeof(buf2) - len2, "  None.\r\n");
   500: 
   501:   // Join the two strings
   502:   len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s", buf2);
   503: 
   504:   snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "\t1Applicable Index Entries: \t3%d\r\n"
   505:                                                  "\t1Total Index Entries: \t3%d\tn\r\n", count + count2, top_of_helpt);
   506: 
   507:   page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   508: }

    66: static IBT_DATA *new_ibt(void)
    67: {
    68:    int i;
    69:    IBT_DATA *ibtData;
    70: 
    71:    CREATE( ibtData, IBT_DATA, 1);
    72:

    74:    ibtData->prev       = NULL;
    75:    ibtData->name       = NULL;
    76:    ibtData->text       = NULL;
    77:    ibtData->body       = NULL;
    78:    ibtData->notes      = NULL;
    79:    ibtData->level      = 0;
    80:    ibtData->id_num     = NOBODY;
    81:    ibtData->room       = NOWHERE;
    82:    ibtData->dated      = 0;

    85:      ibtData->flags[i]   = 0;

    90: static void free_ibt_list(IBT_DATA *first_ibt, IBT_DATA *last_ibt)
    91: {
    92:   IBT_DATA **top_ptr, **bot_ptr, *this_ibt;
    93: 
    94:   if ((first_ibt == NULL) || (last_ibt == NULL)) return;
    95: 
    96:   top_ptr = &(first_ibt);
    97:   bot_ptr = &(last_ibt);
    98: 
    99:   while (first_ibt) {
   100:     this_ibt = first_ibt;
   101: 
   102:     /* Disconnect from the list */
   103:     UNLINK(this_ibt, first_ibt, last_ibt, next, prev);
   104: 
   105:     /* Free the strings first */
   106:     if (this_ibt->body)  STRFREE(this_ibt->body);
   107:     if (this_ibt->name)  STRFREE(this_ibt->name);
   108:     if (this_ibt->text)  STRFREE(this_ibt->text);
   109:     if (this_ibt->notes) STRFREE(this_ibt->notes);
   110: 
   111:     /* And free the struct */
   112:     DISPOSE(this_ibt);
   113:   }
   114: 
   115:   *(top_ptr) = NULL;
   116:   *(bot_ptr) = NULL;
   117: }
   118: static IBT_DATA *read_ibt( char *filename, FILE *fp )
   119: {
   120:    IBT_DATA *ibtData;
   121:    char *word, *id_num=NULL, *dated=NULL;
   122:    char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   123:    bool fMatch;
   124:    char letter;
   125: 
   126:    do
   127:    {
   128:       letter = getc( fp );
   129:       if( feof(fp) )
   130:       {
   131:          fclose( fp );
   132:          return NULL;
   133:       }
   134:    }
   135:    while( isspace(letter) );
   136:    ungetc( letter, fp );
   137: 
   138:    ibtData = new_ibt();
   139:    ibtData->name       = STRALLOC("");
   140:    ibtData->text       = STRALLOC("");
   141:    ibtData->body       = STRALLOC("");
   142: 
   143:    for ( ; ; )
   144:    {
   145:         word   = feof( fp ) ? "End" : fread_word( fp );
   146:         fMatch = FALSE;
   147: 
   148:         switch ( UPPER(word[0]) )
   149:         {
   150:           case 'B':
   151:             if (!str_cmp(word, "Body"))  STRFREE(ibtData->body);
   152:             KEY("Body",     ibtData->body,   fread_clean_string( fp, buf ));
   153:             break;
   154:           case 'D':
   155:             TXT_KEY("Dated", dated, fread_line(fp));          
   156:             break;
   157:           case 'E':
   158:             if (!str_cmp(word, "End"))
   159:             {
   160:               if ( id_num ) {
   161:                 ibtData->id_num = atol(id_num);
   162:                 STRFREE( id_num );
   163:               }  
   164:               if ( dated ) {
   165:                 ibtData->dated = atol(dated);
   166:                 STRFREE( dated );
   167:               }  
   168:               if ( !ibtData->name )
   169:                 ibtData->name = STRALLOC("");
   170:               if ( !ibtData->text )
   171:                 ibtData->text = STRALLOC("");
   172:               if ( !ibtData->body )
   173:                 ibtData->body = STRALLOC("");
   174:               if ( !ibtData->notes )
   175:                 ibtData->notes = STRALLOC("");
   176:               return ibtData;
   177:             }
   178:             break;
   179: 
   180:           case 'F':
   181:             if (!str_cmp(word, "Flags")) {
   182:               fMatch = TRUE;
   183:               fread_flags(fp, ibtData->flags, 4);
   184:             }
   185:             break;
   186: 
   187:           case 'I':
   188:             TXT_KEY("IdNum", id_num, fread_line(fp));
   189:             break;
   190: 
   191:           case 'L':
   192:             KEY("Level",    ibtData->level,   fread_number(fp));
   193:             break;
   194: 
   195:           case 'N':
   196:             if (!str_cmp(word, "Name") && ibtData->name)   STRFREE(ibtData->name);
   197:             if (!str_cmp(word, "Notes") && ibtData->notes)  STRFREE(ibtData->notes);
   198:             TXT_KEY("Name",     ibtData->name,    fread_line( fp ));
   199:             KEY("Notes",        ibtData->notes,   fread_clean_string( fp, buf ));
   200:             break;
   201: 
   202:           case 'R':
   203:             KEY("Room",     ibtData->room,    fread_number(fp));
   204:             break;
   205: 
   206:           case 'T':
   207:             if (!str_cmp(word, "Text"))  STRFREE(ibtData->text);
   208:             TXT_KEY("Text",     ibtData->text,    fread_line( fp ));
   209:             break;
   210: 
   211:           case '*':  /* Handle comments */
   212:             fread_to_eol(fp);
   213:             fMatch = TRUE;
   214:             break;
   215: 
   216:           default:
   217:             log("SYSERR: Invalid keyword (%s) in IBT file", word);
   218:             break;
   219:         }
   220:         if ( !fMatch )
   221:         {
   222:           fread_to_eol(fp);
   223:           log( "read_ibt (%s): no match: %s - aborting line!", filename, word );
   224:         }
   225:    }
   226:    log ("read_ibt: Aborted! Returning NULL");
   227:    if ( ibtData->name)
   228:          STRFREE( ibtData->name);
   229:    if ( ibtData->text)
   230:          STRFREE( ibtData->text);
   231:    if ( ibtData->body)
   232:          STRFREE( ibtData->body);
   233:    if ( id_num )
   234: 		 STRFREE( id_num );
   235:    if ( dated )
   236: 		 STRFREE( dated );
   237: 		 
   238:    DISPOSE( ibtData);
   239:    return NULL;
   240: }

   242: void load_ibt_file(int mode)
   243: {
   244:    char filename[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   245:    FILE *fp;
   246:    IBT_DATA *ibtData, *first_ibt, *last_ibt;
   247: 
   248:    switch(mode) {
   249:      case SCMD_BUG : sprintf( filename, "%s",BUGS_FILE );
   250:                      first_ibt = first_bug;
   251:                      last_ibt  = last_bug;
   252:                      break;
   253:      case SCMD_IDEA: sprintf( filename, "%s",IDEAS_FILE );
   254:                      first_ibt = first_idea;
   255:                      last_ibt  = last_idea;
   256:                      break;
   257:      case SCMD_TYPO: sprintf( filename, "%s",TYPOS_FILE );
   258:                      first_ibt = first_typo;
   259:                      last_ibt  = last_typo;
   260:                      break;
   261:      default       : log("SYSERR: Invalid mode (%d) in load_ibt_file", mode);
   262:                      return;
   263:    }
   264: 
   265:    /* Remove and free the old list */
   266:    if ((first_ibt) && (last_ibt)) {
   267:      free_ibt_list(first_ibt, last_ibt);
   268:      first_ibt = NULL;
   269:      last_ibt = NULL;
   270:    }
   271: 
   272:    if( ( fp = fopen( filename, "r" ) ) == NULL ) {
   273:       log("No File: %s", filename);
   274:       return;
   275:    }
   276: 
   277:    while( ( ibtData = read_ibt( filename, fp ) ) != NULL ) {
   278:      switch(mode) {
   279:        case SCMD_BUG : LINK( ibtData, first_bug, last_bug, next, prev );
   280:                        break;
   281:        case SCMD_IDEA: LINK( ibtData, first_idea, last_idea, next, prev );
   282:                        break;
   283:        case SCMD_TYPO: LINK( ibtData, first_typo, last_typo, next, prev );
   284:                        break;
   285:      }
   286:    }
   287: 
   288:    return;
   289: }
   290: 
   291: void save_ibt_file(int mode)
   292: {
   293:    IBT_DATA *ibtData, *first_ibt;
   294:    FILE *fp;
   295:    char filename[256];
   296: 
   297:    switch(mode) {
   298:      case SCMD_BUG : sprintf( filename, "%s",BUGS_FILE );
   299:                      first_ibt = first_bug;
   300:                      break;
   301:      case SCMD_IDEA: sprintf( filename, "%s",IDEAS_FILE );
   302:                      first_ibt = first_idea;
   303:                      break;
   304:      case SCMD_TYPO: sprintf( filename, "%s",TYPOS_FILE );
   305:                      first_ibt = first_typo;
   306:                      break;
   307:      default       : log("SYSERR: Invalid mode (%d) in save_ibt_file", mode);
   308:                      return;
   309:    }
   310: 
   311:    if (( fp = fopen(filename,"w")) == NULL)
   312:    {
   313:      log("SYSERR: Unable to open IBT file for writing in save_ibt_file");
   314:      log("        IBT File: %s", filename);
   315:      return;
   316:    }
   317:    else
   318:    {
   319:      for (ibtData = first_ibt;ibtData;ibtData=ibtData->next)
   320:      {
   321:        if (ibtData->text && *(ibtData->text))
   322:          fprintf(fp,"Text      %s~\n",ibtData->text);
   323:        if (ibtData->body && *(ibtData->body))
   324:          fprintf(fp,"Body      %s~\n",ibtData->body);
   325:        if (ibtData->name && *(ibtData->name))
   326:          fprintf(fp,"Name      %s~\n",ibtData->name);
   327:        if (ibtData->notes && *(ibtData->notes))
   328:          fprintf(fp,"Notes     %s~\n",ibtData->notes);
   329:        if (ibtData->id_num != NOBODY)
   330:          fprintf(fp,"IdNum     %ld\n",ibtData->id_num);
   331:        if (ibtData->dated != 0)
   332:          fprintf(fp,"Dated     %ld\n",ibtData->dated);
   333:        fprintf(fp,"Level     %d\n",ibtData->level);
   334:        fprintf(fp,"Room      %d\n",ibtData->room);
   335:        fprintf(fp,"Flags     %d %d %d %d\n",ibtData->flags[0],ibtData->flags[1],
   336:                                             ibtData->flags[2],ibtData->flags[3]);
   337:        fprintf(fp,"End\n");
   338:      }
   339:      fclose(fp);
   340:      return;
   341:    }
   342: }

   378: static IBT_DATA *get_ibt_by_num(int mode, int target_num)
   379: {
   380:   int no=0;
   381:   IBT_DATA *target_ibt, *first_ibt;
   382: 
   383:   if ((first_ibt = get_first_ibt(mode)) == NULL) return NULL;
   384: 
   385:   for (target_ibt=first_ibt;target_ibt;target_ibt=target_ibt->next) {
   386:     no++;
   387:     if (no==target_num) {
   388:       return target_ibt;
   389:     }
   390:   }
   391:   return NULL;
   392: }

   394: /* Search the IBT list, and return true if ibt is found there */
   395: static bool ibt_in_list(int mode, IBT_DATA *ibt)
   396: {
   397:   IBT_DATA *target_ibt, *first_ibt;
   398: 
   399:   if ((first_ibt = get_first_ibt(mode)) == NULL) return FALSE;
   400: 
   401:   for (target_ibt=first_ibt;target_ibt;target_ibt=target_ibt->next) {
   402:     if (target_ibt == ibt) {
   403:       return TRUE;
   404:     }
   405:   }
   406:   return FALSE;
   407: }
   408: 
   409: /* Free up an IBT struct, removing it from the list if necessary */
   410: /* returns TRUE on success                                       */
   411: static bool free_ibt(int mode, IBT_DATA *ibtData)
   412: {
   413:   if (ibtData == NULL) return FALSE;
   414: 
   415:   /* If this IBT is in the IBT list, take it out */
   416:   if (ibt_in_list(mode, ibtData)) {
   417: 	switch(mode) {
   418:       case SCMD_BUG : UNLINK(ibtData,first_bug,last_bug,next,prev);
   419:                       break;
   420:       case SCMD_IDEA: UNLINK(ibtData,first_idea,last_idea,next,prev);
   421:                       break;
   422:       case SCMD_TYPO: UNLINK(ibtData,first_typo,last_typo,next,prev);
   423:                       break;
   424:     }
   425:   }
   426: 
   427:   /* Free the strings first */
   428:   if (ibtData->body) STRFREE(ibtData->body);
   429:   if (ibtData->name) STRFREE(ibtData->name);
   430:   if (ibtData->text) STRFREE(ibtData->text);
   431: 
   432:   /* And free the struct */
   433:   DISPOSE(ibtData);
   434: 
   435:   return TRUE;
   436: }

   438: /* Return TRUE if 'ch' is the person who logged the IBT */
   439: static bool is_ibt_logger(IBT_DATA *ibtData, struct char_data *ch)
   440: {
   441:   if ( ch && !IS_NPC(ch) && ibtData ) {
   442: 
   443:     /* Check the ID number first (in case of name change)   */
   444:     if ((ibtData->id_num != NOBODY) && (ibtData->id_num == GET_IDNUM(ch)))
   445:       return TRUE;
   446: 
   447:     /* Check the name next (in case of deletion/recreation) */
   448:     if (strcmp(ibtData->name, GET_NAME(ch)) == 0)
   449:       return TRUE;
   450:   }
   451:   return FALSE;
   452: }

   454: ACMD(do_ibt)
   455: {
   456:   char arg[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   457:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], *arg_text, imp[30], timestr[128];
   458:   int i, num_res, num_unres;
   459:   size_t len = 0;
   460:   IBT_DATA *ibtData, *first_ibt;
   461:   int ano=0;
   462: 
   463:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   464:     return;
   465: 
   466:   arg_text  = one_argument(argument, arg);
   467:   two_arguments(argument, arg, arg2);
   468: 
   469:   first_ibt = get_first_ibt(subcmd);
   470: 
   471:   if ((!*arg)){
   472:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GRGOD){
   473:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %s%s submit <header>%s\r\n"
   474:                        "       %s%s list%s\r\n"
   475:                        "       %s%s show <num>%s\r\n"
   476:                        "       %s%s remove <num>%s\r\n"
   477:                        "       %s%s edit <num>%s\r\n"
   478:                        "       %s%s resolve <num>%s\r\n",
   479:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM,
   480:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM,
   481:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM,
   482:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM,
   483:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM,
   484:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM);
   485:       return;
   486:     } else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT) {
   487:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %s%s submit <header>%s\r\n"
   488:                        "       %s%s list%s\r\n"
   489:                        "       %s%s show <num>%s\r\n",
   490:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM,
   491:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM,
   492:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM);
   493:       return;
   494:     } else {
   495:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %s%s submit <header>%s\r\n"
   496:                        "       %s%s list%s\r\n"
   497:                        "       %s%s show <num>%s\r\n",
   498:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM,
   499:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM,
   500:                                QYEL, CMD_NAME, QNRM);
   501:       send_to_char(ch, "Note: Only %ss logged by you will be listed or shown.\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   502:       return;
   503:     }
   504:   }
   505:   else if(is_abbrev(arg,"show"))
   506:   {
   507:     if (!is_number(arg2)) {
   508:       send_to_char(ch, "Show which %s?\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   509:       return;
   510:     }
   511:     ano = atoi(arg2);
   512: 
   513:     if ((ibtData = get_ibt_by_num(subcmd, ano)) == NULL) {
   514:       send_to_char(ch, "That %s doesn't exist.\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   515:       return;
   516:     } else {
   517:       if ((GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) && (!is_ibt_logger(ibtData, ch))) {

   519:       } else {

   521:         if (ibtData->dated != 0) {
   522:           strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%c", localtime(&(ibtData->dated)));
   523:         } else {
   524:           strcpy(timestr, "Unknown");
   525:         }
   526:         send_to_char(ch, "%sSubmitted: %s%s\r\n", QCYN, QYEL, timestr);
   527:         if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT) {
   528:           send_to_char(ch, "%sLevel: %s%d\r\n",QCYN, QYEL, ibtData->level);
   529:           send_to_char(ch, "%sRoom : %s%d\r\n",QCYN, QYEL, ibtData->room);
   530:         }
   531:         send_to_char(ch, "%sTitle: %s%s\r\n",QCYN, QYEL, ibtData->text);
   532:         send_to_char(ch, "%s%s Details%s\r\n%s\r\n",QCYN, ibt_types[subcmd], QYEL, ibtData->body);
   533:         if (ibtData->notes && *(ibtData->notes))
   534:           send_to_char(ch, "%s%s Notes%s\r\n%s\r\n",QCYN, ibt_types[subcmd], QYEL, ibtData->notes);
   535:         send_to_char(ch, "%s%s Status: %s%s%s%s\r\n",QCYN, ibt_types[subcmd],
   536:                                        IBT_FLAGGED(ibtData, IBT_RESOLVED) ? QBGRN : QBRED,
   537:                                        IBT_FLAGGED(ibtData, IBT_RESOLVED) ? "Resolved" : "Unresolved",
   538:                                        IBT_FLAGGED(ibtData, IBT_INPROGRESS) ? " (In Progress)" : "",
   539:                                        QNRM);
   540:       }
   541:     }
   542: 
   543:     return;
   544:   }
   545:   else if(is_abbrev(arg,"list"))
   546:   {
   547:     if (first_ibt)
   548:     {
   549:       if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) {
   550:         len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
   551:                "%s No %s|%s Description\r\n"
   552:                "%s ---|-------------------------------------------------%s\r\n",
   553:                QCYN, QGRN, QCYN, QGRN, QNRM);
   554:       } else {
   555:         len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
   556:                "%s No %s|%sName        %s|%sRoom  %s|%sLevel%s|%s Description\r\n"
   557:                "%s ---|------------|------|-----|-------------------------------------------------%s\r\n",
   558:                QCYN, QGRN, QCYN, QGRN, QCYN, QGRN, QCYN, QGRN, QCYN, QGRN, QNRM);
   559:       }
   560:       i=num_res=num_unres=0;
   561:       for (ibtData=first_ibt;ibtData;ibtData = ibtData->next) {
   562:         i++;
   563: 
   564:         /* For mortals, skip IBT's that they didn't log */
   565:         if ((GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) && !is_ibt_logger(ibtData,ch))
   566:           continue;
   567: 
   568:         /* Set up the 'important' flag */
   569:         if (IBT_FLAGGED(ibtData, IBT_IMPORTANT))
   570:           sprintf(imp, "%s!%s", QBFRED, QNRM);
   571:         else
   572:           sprintf(imp, "%c", ' ');
   573: 
   574:         if (IBT_FLAGGED(ibtData, IBT_RESOLVED)) {
   575:           if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) {
   576:             len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s%s%3d|%s%s\r\n",
   577:                                   imp, QGRN, i, ibtData->text, QNRM);
   578:           } else {
   579:             len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s%s%3d%s|%s%-12s%s|%s%6d%s|%s%5d%s|%s%s%s\r\n",
   580:                                   imp, QGRN, i, QGRN,
   581:                                   QGRN, ibtData->name, QGRN,
   582:                                   QGRN, ibtData->room, QGRN,
   583:                                   QGRN, ibtData->level, QGRN,
   584:                                   QGRN, ibtData->text, QNRM);
   585:           }
   586:           num_res++;
   587:         } else if (IBT_FLAGGED(ibtData, IBT_INPROGRESS)) {
   588:           if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) {
   589:             len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s%s%3d%s|%s%s%s\r\n",
   590:                                   imp, QYEL, i, QGRN,
   591:                                   QYEL, ibtData->text, QNRM);
   592:           } else {
   593:             len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s%s%3d%s|%s%-12s%s|%s%6d%s|%s%5d%s|%s%s%s\r\n",
   594:                                   imp, QYEL, i, QGRN,
   595:                                   QYEL, ibtData->name, QGRN,
   596:                                   QYEL, ibtData->room, QGRN,
   597:                                   QYEL, ibtData->level, QGRN,
   598:                                   QYEL, ibtData->text, QNRM);
   599:           }
   600:           num_unres++;
   601:         } else {
   602:           if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) {
   603:             len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s%s%3d%s|%s%s%s\r\n",
   604:                                   imp, QRED, i, QGRN,
   605:                                   QRED, ibtData->text, QNRM);
   606:           } else {
   607:             len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s%s%3d%s|%s%-12s%s|%s%6d%s|%s%5d%s|%s%s%s\r\n",
   608:                                   imp, QRED, i, QGRN,
   609:                                   QRED, ibtData->name, QGRN,
   610:                                   QRED, ibtData->room, QGRN,
   611:                                   QRED, ibtData->level, QGRN,
   612:                                   QRED, ibtData->text, QNRM);
   613:           }
   614:           num_unres++;
   615:         }
   616:         if (len > sizeof(buf))
   617:           break;
   618:       }
   619:       if ((num_res + num_unres) > 0) {
   620:         len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
   621:                 "\n\r%s%d %ss in file. %s%d%s resolved, %s%d%s unresolved%s\r\n"
   622:                 "%s%ss in %sRED%s are unresolved %ss.\r\n"
   623:                 "%s%ss in %sYELLOW%s are in-progress %ss.\r\n"
   624:                 "%s%ss in %sGREEN%s are resolved %ss.\r\n",
   625:                 QCYN, i, CMD_NAME, QBGRN, num_res, QCYN, QBRED, num_unres, QCYN, QNRM,
   626:                 QCYN, ibt_types[subcmd], QRED, QCYN, CMD_NAME,
   627:                 QCYN, ibt_types[subcmd], QYEL, QCYN, CMD_NAME,
   628:                 QCYN, ibt_types[subcmd], QGRN, QCYN, CMD_NAME);
   629:       } else {
   630:         len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "No %ss have been found that were reported by you!\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   631:       }
   632:       if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_GRGOD) {
   633:         len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%sYou may use %s remove, resolve or edit to change the list..%s\r\n", QCYN, CMD_NAME, QNRM);
   634:       }
   635:       snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%sYou may use %s%s show <number>%s to see more indepth about the %s.%s\r\n", QCYN, QYEL, CMD_NAME, QCYN, CMD_NAME, QNRM);
   636:     } else {
   637:       snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "No %ss have been reported!\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   638:     }
   639: 
   640:     page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   641:     return;
   642:   }
   643:   else if (is_abbrev(arg,"submit"))
   644:   {
   645:     if (!*arg_text) {
   646:       send_to_char(ch, "You need to add a heading!\r\n");
   647:       return;
   648:     }
   649:     switch (subcmd) {
   650:       case SCMD_IDEA: SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_IDEA);
   651:                       break;
   652:       case SCMD_BUG : SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_BUG);
   653:                       break;
   654:       case SCMD_TYPO: SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_TYPO);
   655:                       break;
   656:       default       : log("Invalid subcmd (%d) in do_ibt", subcmd);
   657:                       return;
   658: 	}
   659:     SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   660: 
   661:     ibtData = new_ibt();
   662:     send_to_char(ch, "Write your %s.\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   663:     send_editor_help(ch->desc);
   664: 
   665:     sprintf(buf, "$n starts to give %s %s.", TANA(CMD_NAME), CMD_NAME);
   666:     act(buf, TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   667: 
   668:     string_write(ch->desc, &(ibtData->body),MAX_IBT_LENGTH, 0, NULL);
   669: 
   670:     ibtData->room   = GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch));
   671:     ibtData->level  = GET_LEVEL(ch);
   672:     ibtData->text   = STRALLOC(arg_text);
   673:     ibtData->name   = STRALLOC(GET_NAME(ch));
   674:     ibtData->id_num = GET_IDNUM(ch);
   675:     ibtData->dated  = time(0);
   676:     
   677:     switch(subcmd) {
   678:        case SCMD_BUG : LINK( ibtData, first_bug, last_bug, next, prev );
   679:                        break;
   680:        case SCMD_IDEA: LINK( ibtData, first_idea, last_idea, next, prev );
   681:                        break;
   682:        case SCMD_TYPO: LINK( ibtData, first_typo, last_typo, next, prev );
   683:                        break;
   684:     }
   685:     mudlog(NRM, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), 
   686:       FALSE, "%s has posted %s %s!", GET_NAME(ch), TANA(CMD_NAME), CMD_NAME);
   687:     return;
   688:   }
   689:   else if (is_abbrev(arg,"resolve"))
   690:   {
   691:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD){
   692:       send_to_char(ch, "%s what?\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   693:       return;
   694:     }
   695: 
   696:     if (!is_number(arg2)) {
   697:       send_to_char(ch, "Resolve which %s?\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   698:       return;
   699:     }
   700:     ano = atoi(arg2);
   701: 
   702:     if ((ibtData = get_ibt_by_num(subcmd, ano)) == NULL) {
   703:       send_to_char(ch, "%s not found\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   704:       return;
   705:     } else {
   706:       if (IBT_FLAGGED(ibtData, IBT_RESOLVED)){
   707:         send_to_char(ch, "That %s has already been resolved!\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   708:       } else {
   709:         send_to_char(ch,"%s %d resolved!\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd], ano);
   710:         SET_BIT_AR(IBT_FLAGS(ibtData), IBT_RESOLVED);
   711:         if (CONFIG_IBT_AUTOSAVE) {
   712: 		  save_ibt_file(subcmd);
   713: 		}
   714:       }
   715:     }
   716:     return;
   717:   } else if (is_abbrev(arg,"remove")) {
   718:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD){
   719:       send_to_char(ch, "%s what?\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   720:       return;
   721:     }
   722: 
   723:     if (!is_number(arg2)) {
   724:       send_to_char(ch, "Remove which %s?\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   725:       return;
   726:     }
   727:     ano = atoi(arg2);
   728: 
   729:     if ((ibtData = get_ibt_by_num(subcmd, ano)) == NULL) {
   730:       send_to_char(ch, "%s not found\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   731:       return;
   732:     } else {
   733:       if (free_ibt(subcmd, ibtData)) {
   734:         send_to_char(ch,"%s%s Number %d removed.%s\r\n", QCYN, ibt_types[subcmd], ano, QNRM);
   735:         if (CONFIG_IBT_AUTOSAVE) {
   736: 		  save_ibt_file(subcmd);
   737: 		}
   738:       } else {
   739:         send_to_char(ch,"%sUnable to remove %s %d!%s\r\n", QRED, CMD_NAME, ano, QNRM);
   740:       }
   741:     }
   742:     return;
   743:   } else if (is_abbrev(arg,"save")) {
   744:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD){
   745:       send_to_char(ch, "%s what?\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   746:       return;
   747:     }
   748:     save_ibt_file(subcmd);
   749:     send_to_char(ch,"%s list saved.\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   750:   } else if (is_abbrev(arg,"edit")) {
   751:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD){
   752:       send_to_char(ch, "%s what?\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   753:       return;
   754:     }
   755:     /* Pass control to the OLC without the 'edit' arg */
   756:     do_oasis_ibtedit(ch, arg_text, cmd, subcmd);
   757:   } else {
   758:     if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_GRGOD){
   759:       send_to_char(ch, "%s what?\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   760:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %s submit <text>\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   761:       return;
   762:     } else {
   763:       send_to_char(ch, "Usage:  %s (submit/list/show/remove/resolve)\r\n", CMD_NAME);
   764:       return;
   765:     }
   766:   }
   767: }
   768: 
   769: /* IBT Editor OLC */
   770: /* OLC_VAL(d)  - The IBT 'mode' - Idea, Bug or Typo */
   771: /* OLC_NUM(d)  - The IBT number (shown in 'list')   */
   772: /* OLC_ZNUM(d) - Used as 'has changed' flag         */
   773: ACMD(do_oasis_ibtedit)
   774: {
   775:   int number = NOTHING;
   776:   struct descriptor_data *d;
   777:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   778: 
   779:   /* No editing as a mob or while being forced. */
   780:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
   781:     return;
   782: 
   783:   /* Parse any arguments */
   784:   two_arguments(argument, buf1, buf2);
   785: 
   786:   if (!*buf1) {
   787:     send_to_char(ch, "Specify a %s number to edit.\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   788:     return;
   789:   } else if (!isdigit(*buf1)) {
   790:     send_to_char(ch, "Yikes!  Stop that, someone will get hurt!\r\n");
   791:     return;
   792:   }
   793: 
   794:   /* If a numeric argument was given (like a room number), get it. */
   795:   if (number == NOTHING)
   796:     number = atoi(buf1);
   797: 
   798:   /* Validate that the IBT number exists */
   799:   if (get_ibt_by_num(subcmd, number) == NULL) {
   800:     send_to_char(ch, "That %s number doesn't exist!\r\n", ibt_types[subcmd]);
   801:     return;
   802:   }
   803: 
   804:   /* Check that whatever it is isn't already being edited. */
   805:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   806:     if (STATE(d) == CON_IBTEDIT) {
   807:       if (d->olc && OLC_NUM(d) == number) {
   808:         send_to_char(ch, "That %s is currently being edited by %s.\r\n",
   809:           ibt_types[subcmd], GET_NAME(d->character));
   810:         return;
   811:       }
   812:     }
   813:   }
   814: 
   815:   d = ch->desc;
   816: 
   817:   /* Give descriptor an OLC structure. */
   818:   if (d->olc) {
   819:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: do_oasis_ibtedit: Player already had olc structure.");
   820:     free(d->olc);
   821:   }
   822: 
   823:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
   824: 
   825:   /* Set OLC variables. */
   826:   OLC_NUM(d)  = number;
   827:   OLC_VAL(d)  = subcmd;
   828:   OLC_ZNUM(d) = 0;
   829: 
   830:   /* setup the OLC structure. */
   831:   ibtedit_setup(d);
   832: 
   833:   /* Show the main IBT edit menu                              */
   834:   ibtedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   835:   STATE(d) = CON_IBTEDIT;
   836: 
   837:   /* Display the OLC messages to the players in the same room as the
   838:      editor and also log it. */
   839:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   840:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   841: 
   842:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,"OLC: %s starts editing %s %d",
   843:     GET_NAME(ch), IBT_TYPE, OLC_NUM(d));
   844: }
   845: 
   846: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   847: /* Copy IBT data into the OLC structure                              */
   848: static void ibtedit_setup(struct descriptor_data *d)
   849: {
   850:   IBT_DATA *ibtData;
   851:   int i;
   852: 
   853:   /* Set up a blank IBT struct */
   854:   OLC_IBT(d) = new_ibt();
   855: 
   856:   /* Should always be the case, but just to make sure */
   857:   if ((ibtData = get_ibt_by_num(OLC_VAL(d), OLC_NUM(d))) != NULL) {
   858:     if ((ibtData->text) && *(ibtData->text)) {
   859:       OLC_IBT(d)->text  = STRALLOC(ibtData->text);
   860:     }
   861:     if ((ibtData->body) && *(ibtData->body)) {
   862:       OLC_IBT(d)->body  = STRALLOC(ibtData->body);
   863:     }
   864:     if ((ibtData->name) && *(ibtData->name)) {
   865:       OLC_IBT(d)->name  = STRALLOC(ibtData->name);
   866:     }
   867:     if ((ibtData->notes) && *(ibtData->notes)) {
   868:       OLC_IBT(d)->notes = STRALLOC(ibtData->notes);
   869:     }
   870:     OLC_IBT(d)->level = ibtData->level;
   871:     OLC_IBT(d)->room  = ibtData->room;
   872:     for (i=0; i<IBT_ARRAY_MAX; i++) {
   873:       OLC_IBT(d)->flags[i] = ibtData->flags[i];
   874:     }
   875:   }
   876: }
   877: 
   878: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   879: /* Copy IBT data back to the correct list                            */
   880: static void ibtedit_save(struct descriptor_data *d)
   881: {
   882:   IBT_DATA *ibtData;
   883:   int i;
   884: 
   885:   /* Should always be the case, but just to make sure */
   886:   if ((ibtData = get_ibt_by_num(OLC_VAL(d), OLC_NUM(d))) != NULL) {
   887:     if ((OLC_IBT(d)->text) && *(OLC_IBT(d)->text)) {
   888:       if (ibtData->text) STRFREE(ibtData->text);
   889:       ibtData->text = STRALLOC(OLC_IBT(d)->text);
   890:       STRFREE(OLC_IBT(d)->text);
   891:     }
   892:     if ((OLC_IBT(d)->body) && *(OLC_IBT(d)->body)) {
   893:       if (ibtData->body) STRFREE(ibtData->body);
   894:       ibtData->body = STRALLOC(OLC_IBT(d)->body);
   895:       STRFREE(OLC_IBT(d)->body);
   896:     }
   897:     if ((OLC_IBT(d)->name) && *(OLC_IBT(d)->name)) {
   898:       if (ibtData->name) STRFREE(ibtData->name);
   899:       ibtData->name = STRALLOC(OLC_IBT(d)->name);
   900:       STRFREE(OLC_IBT(d)->name);
   901:     }
   902:     if ((OLC_IBT(d)->notes) && *(OLC_IBT(d)->notes)) {
   903:       if (ibtData->notes) STRFREE(ibtData->notes);
   904:       ibtData->notes = STRALLOC(OLC_IBT(d)->notes);
   905:       STRFREE(OLC_IBT(d)->notes);
   906:     }
   907:     ibtData->level = OLC_IBT(d)->level;
   908:     ibtData->room  = OLC_IBT(d)->room;
   909:     for (i=0; i<IBT_ARRAY_MAX; i++) {
   910:       ibtData->flags[i] = OLC_IBT(d)->flags[i];
   911:     }
   912:   } else {
   913:     log("SYSERR: ibtedit_save: Invalid IBT vnum (%d) in OLC struct", OLC_NUM(d));
   914:     log("        IBT possibly removed while being edited");
   915:     return;
   916:   }
   917: 
   918:   save_ibt_file(OLC_VAL(d));
   919: }
   920: 
   921: void free_olc_ibt(IBT_DATA *toFree) {
   922: 	
   923: 	if (!toFree)
   924: 	  return;
   925:  
   926: 	if (toFree->text) {
   927: 	  STRFREE(toFree->text);
   928: 	}
   929: 
   930: 	if (toFree->body) {
   931: 	  STRFREE(toFree->body);
   932: 	}
   933: 
   934: 	if (toFree->name) {
   935: 	  STRFREE(toFree->name);
   936: 	}
   937: 
   938: 	if (toFree->notes) {
   939: 	  STRFREE(toFree->notes);
   940: 	}
   941: 	
   942: 	free(toFree);
   943: }
   944: 
   945: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   946: /* main ibtedit menu function...                                     */
   947: static void ibtedit_disp_main_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   948: {
   949:   struct char_data *ch = d->character;
   950:   char flg_text[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   951:   room_rnum rr;
   952: 
   953:   get_char_colors(ch);
   954:   clear_screen(d);
   955: 
   956:   rr = real_room(OLC_IBT(d)->room);
   957:   sprintbitarray(OLC_IBT(d)->flags, ibt_bits, IBT_ARRAY_MAX, flg_text);
   958: 
   959:   send_to_char(ch, "%s-- Edit %s Number %s[%s%d%s]\r\n"
   960:                    "%s1%s) Reported By: %s%-12s\r\n"
   961:                    "%s2%s) Reported In: %s[%s%-5d%s]%s - %s%s\r\n"
   962:                    "%s3%s) Header Text: %s%s\r\n"
   963:                    "%s4%s) Flags      : %s%s\r\n"
   964:                    "%s5%s) Details:\r\n%s%s\r\n"
   965:                    "%s6%s) Admin Notes:\r\n%s%s\r\n"
   966:                    "%sQ%s) Quit %s Editor\r\n",
   967:                    QBGRN, IBT_TYPE, cyn, yel, OLC_NUM(d), cyn,
   968:                    yel, nrm, yel, OLC_IBT(d)->name,
   969:                    yel, nrm, cyn, yel, OLC_IBT(d)->room, cyn, nrm, (rr == NOWHERE) ? CCRED(d->character, C_NRM) : cyn, (rr == NOWHERE) ? "<Invalid Room!>" : world[rr].name,
   970:                    yel, nrm, yel, OLC_IBT(d)->text,
   971:                    yel, nrm, cyn, flg_text,
   972:                    yel, nrm, yel, OLC_IBT(d)->body ? OLC_IBT(d)->body : "<Not Set!>",
   973:                    yel, nrm, yel, OLC_IBT(d)->notes ? OLC_IBT(d)->notes : "<Not Set!>",
   974:                    yel, nrm, IBT_TYPE);
   975: 
   976:   OLC_MODE(d) = IBTEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
   977: 
   978: }
   979: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   980: /* Display IBT-flags menu. */
   981: static void ibtedit_disp_flags(struct descriptor_data *d)
   982: {
   983:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   984: 
   985:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   986:   clear_screen(d);
   987: 
   988:   column_list(d->character, 2, ibt_bits, NUM_IBT_FLAGS, TRUE);
   989: 
   990:   sprintbitarray(OLC_IBT(d)->flags, ibt_bits, IBT_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   991:   write_to_output(d, "\r\nCurrent flags : %s%s%s\r\nEnter flags (0 to quit) : ",
   992: 		  cyn, buf, nrm);
   993: 
   994:   OLC_MODE(d) = IBTEDIT_FLAGS;
   995: }
   996: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   997: /* main clanedit parser function... interpreter throws all input to here. */
   998: void ibtedit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   999: {
  1000:   int i;
  1001:   char *oldtext = NULL;
  1002: 
  1003:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
  1004:     case IBTEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
  1005:       switch (*arg) {
  1006:       case 'y':
  1007:       case 'Y':
  1008:         /* Save the IBT in memory and to disk. */
  1009:         ibtedit_save(d);
  1010:         mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE, "OLC: %s edits %s %d", GET_NAME(d->character), IBT_TYPE, OLC_NUM(d));
  1011:         cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1012:         return;
  1013:       case 'n':
  1014:       case 'N':
  1015:         /* If not saving, we must free the OLC memory. */
  1016:         cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1017:         return;
  1018:       default:
  1019:         write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
  1020:         write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
  1021:         return;
  1022:       }
  1023: 
  1024:     case IBTEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
  1025:       switch (*arg) {
  1026:         case 'q':
  1027:         case 'Q':
  1028:           if (OLC_ZNUM(d)) {	/* Anything been changed? */
  1029:             write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
  1030:             OLC_MODE(d) = IBTEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
  1031:           } else
  1032:             cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1033:           return;
  1034: 
  1035:         case '1':
  1036:           OLC_MODE(d) = IBTEDIT_NAME;
  1037:           write_to_output(d, "Who reported this %s? : ", IBT_TYPE);
  1038:           return;
  1039: 
  1040:         case '2':
  1041:           OLC_MODE(d) = IBTEDIT_ROOM;
  1042:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the room VNUM for this %s? : ", IBT_TYPE);
  1043:           return;
  1044: 
  1045:         case '3':
  1046:           OLC_MODE(d) = IBTEDIT_TEXT;
  1047:           write_to_output(d, "Enter the header text for this %s? : ", IBT_TYPE);
  1048:           return;
  1049: 
  1050:         case '4':
  1051:           ibtedit_disp_flags(d);
  1052:           return;
  1053: 
  1054:         case '5':
  1055:           OLC_MODE(d) = IBTEDIT_BODY;
  1056:           send_editor_help(d);
  1057:           write_to_output(d, "Enter %s description:\r\n\r\n", IBT_TYPE);
  1058:           if (OLC_IBT(d)->body) {
  1059:             write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_IBT(d)->body);
  1060:             if (oldtext) STRFREE(oldtext);
  1061:             oldtext = STRALLOC(OLC_IBT(d)->body);
  1062:           }
  1063:           string_write(d, &OLC_IBT(d)->body, MAX_IBT_LENGTH, 0, oldtext);
  1064:           OLC_ZNUM(d) = 1;
  1065:           return;
  1066: 
  1067:         case '6':
  1068:           OLC_MODE(d) = IBTEDIT_NOTES;
  1069:           send_editor_help(d);
  1070:           write_to_output(d, "Enter %s notes:\r\n\r\n", IBT_TYPE);
  1071:           if (OLC_IBT(d)->notes) {
  1072:             write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_IBT(d)->notes);
  1073:             if (oldtext) STRFREE(oldtext);
  1074:             oldtext = STRALLOC(OLC_IBT(d)->notes);
  1075:           }
  1076:           string_write(d, &OLC_IBT(d)->notes, MAX_IBT_LENGTH, 0, oldtext);
  1077:           OLC_ZNUM(d) = 1;
  1078:           return;
  1079: 
  1080:         default:
  1081:           ibtedit_disp_main_menu(d);
  1082:           return;
  1083:       }
  1084: 
  1085:     case IBTEDIT_NAME:
  1086:       smash_tilde(arg);
  1087:       if (OLC_IBT(d)->name) STRFREE(OLC_IBT(d)->name);
  1088:       OLC_IBT(d)->name = STRALLOC(arg);
  1089:       break;
  1090: 
  1091:     case IBTEDIT_ROOM:
  1092:       i = atoi(arg);
  1093:       if (i == 0) { /* Cancel option */
  1094:         ibtedit_disp_main_menu(d);
  1095:         return;
  1096:       }
  1097:       if (real_room(i) == NOWHERE) {
  1098:         write_to_output(d, "That room does not exist!\r\n"
  1099:                            "Enter room VNUM (0 to cancel) : ");
  1100:         return;
  1101:       }
  1102:       OLC_IBT(d)->room = i;
  1103:       /* Drop through to re-show main menu and set 'edited' flag */
  1104:       break;
  1105: 
  1106:     case IBTEDIT_TEXT:
  1107:       smash_tilde(arg);
  1108:       if (OLC_IBT(d)->text) STRFREE(OLC_IBT(d)->text);
  1109:       OLC_IBT(d)->text = STRALLOC(arg);
  1110:       break;
  1111: 
  1112:     case IBTEDIT_FLAGS:
  1113:       if ((i = atoi(arg)) <= 0)
  1114:         break;
  1115:       else if (i <= NUM_IBT_FLAGS)
  1116:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(IBT_FLAGS(OLC_IBT(d)), (i - 1));
  1117:       ibtedit_disp_flags(d);
  1118:       return;
  1119: 
  1120:     case IBTEDIT_BODY:
  1121:       /* We should never get here, modify.c throws user through ibtedit_string_cleanup. */
  1122:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1123:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: ibtedit_parse(): Reached BODY case!");
  1124:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1125:       break;
  1126: 
  1127:     case IBTEDIT_NOTES:
  1128:       /* We should never get here, modify.c throws user through ibtedit_string_cleanup. */
  1129:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1130:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: ibtedit_parse(): Reached NOTES case!");
  1131:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1132:       break;
  1133: 
  1134:     default:
  1135:       /* We should never get here. */
  1136:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1137:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: ibtedit_parse(): Reached default case!");
  1138:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1139:       break;
  1140:   }
  1141: 
  1142:   /* If we get here, something was changed */
  1143:   OLC_ZNUM(d) = 1;
  1144:   ibtedit_disp_main_menu(d);
  1145: }
  1146: 
  1147: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1148: void ibtedit_string_cleanup(struct descriptor_data *d, int terminator)
  1149: {
  1150:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
  1151: 
  1152:   case IBTEDIT_BODY:
  1153:   case IBTEDIT_NOTES:
  1154:   default:
  1155:      ibtedit_disp_main_menu(d);
  1156:      break;
  1157:   }
  1158: }
  1159: 
  1160: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1161: void free_ibt_lists()
  1162: {
  1163:   IBT_DATA *first_ibt, *last_ibt;
  1164:   int mode;
  1165: 
  1166:   for( mode=0; mode <=2; mode++){
  1167:     first_ibt = get_first_ibt(mode);
  1168:     last_ibt = get_last_ibt(mode);
  1169:     free_ibt_list(first_ibt, last_ibt);
  1170:   }
  1171: }
  1172: 
  1173: void clean_ibt_list(int mode)
  1174: {
  1175:   IBT_DATA *ibtData = get_first_ibt(mode), *ibtTemp;
  1176:   while (ibtData) {
  1177:     ibtTemp = ibtData;
  1178:     ibtData = ibtData->next;
  1179:     if (!ibtTemp->body || !*ibtTemp->body) {
  1180:       free_ibt(mode, ibtTemp);
  1181:     }
  1182:   }
  1183: }

     1: /**************************************************************************
     2: *  File: improved-edit.c                                   Part of tbaMUD *
     3: *  Usage: Routines specific to the improved editor.                       *
     4: **************************************************************************/
     5:
