  1449: /* deal with newcomers and other non-playing sockets */
  1450: 
  1451: /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  1452: /* Character creation: stat allocation                                       */
  1453: /* Base stats start at 25 (set in init_char). Players can spend a small pool */
  1454: /* to increase stats. CON costs 2 points per +1.                             */
  1455: 
  1456: #define STAT_ALLOC_POOL 15
  1457: #define STAT_ALLOC_CAP  BASE_STAT_CAP
  1458: static int stat_alloc_cost(int idx)
  1459: {
  1460:   /* 0 Str, 1 Dex, 2 Con, 3 Int, 4 Wis, 5 Cha */
  1461:   return (idx == 2) ? 2 : 1;
  1462: }
  1463: 
  1464: static int stat_alloc_get_real(struct char_data *ch, int idx)
  1465: {
  1466:   switch (idx) {
  1467:     case 0: return ch->real_abils.str;
  1468:     case 1: return ch->real_abils.dex;
  1469:     case 2: return ch->real_abils.con;
  1470:     case 3: return ch->real_abils.intel;
  1471:     case 4: return ch->real_abils.wis;
  1472:     case 5: return ch->real_abils.cha;
  1473:     default: return 0;
  1474:   }
  1475: }
  1476: 
  1477: static void stat_alloc_inc_real(struct char_data *ch, int idx)
  1478: {
  1479:   switch (idx) {
  1480:     case 0: ch->real_abils.str++; break;
  1481:     case 1: ch->real_abils.dex++; break;
  1482:     case 2: ch->real_abils.con++; break;
  1483:     case 3: ch->real_abils.intel++; break;
  1484:     case 4: ch->real_abils.wis++; break;
  1485:     case 5: ch->real_abils.cha++; break;
  1486:     default: break;
  1487:   }
  1488: }
  1489: 
  1490: static int stat_alloc_spent(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1491: {
  1492:   int i, spent = 0;
  1493:   struct char_data *ch = d->character;
  1494: 
  1495:   for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
  1496:     int delta = stat_alloc_get_real(ch, i) - d->stat_alloc_base[i];
  1497:     if (delta > 0)
  1498:       spent += delta * stat_alloc_cost(i);
  1499:   }
  1500:   return spent;
  1501: }
  1502: 
  1503: static int stat_alloc_remaining(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1504: {
  1505:   return d->stat_alloc_pool - stat_alloc_spent(d);
  1506: }
  1507: 
  1508: static void stat_alloc_snapshot_base(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1509: {
  1510:   struct char_data *ch = d->character;
  1511: 
  1512:   d->stat_alloc_pool = STAT_ALLOC_POOL;
  1513:   d->stat_alloc_base[0] = ch->real_abils.str;
  1514:   d->stat_alloc_base[1] = ch->real_abils.dex;
  1515:   d->stat_alloc_base[2] = ch->real_abils.con;
  1516:   d->stat_alloc_base[3] = ch->real_abils.intel;
  1517:   d->stat_alloc_base[4] = ch->real_abils.wis;
  1518:   d->stat_alloc_base[5] = ch->real_abils.cha;
  1519: }
  1520: 
  1521: static void stat_alloc_reset(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1522: {
  1523:   struct char_data *ch = d->character;
  1524: 
  1525:   ch->real_abils.str   = d->stat_alloc_base[0];
  1526:   ch->real_abils.dex   = d->stat_alloc_base[1];
  1527:   ch->real_abils.con   = d->stat_alloc_base[2];
  1528:   ch->real_abils.intel = d->stat_alloc_base[3];
  1529:   ch->real_abils.wis   = d->stat_alloc_base[4];
  1530:   ch->real_abils.cha   = d->stat_alloc_base[5];
  1531: 
  1532:   affect_total(ch);
  1533: }
  1534: 
  1535: static void stat_alloc_show(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1536: {
  1537:   int rem = stat_alloc_remaining(d);
  1538:   struct char_data *ch = d->character;
  1539: 
  1540:   write_to_output(d,
  1541:     "\r\nBase stat allocation\r\n"
  1542:     "Points remaining: %d  (CON costs 2)  Cap: %d\r\n\r\n"
  1543:     "Str %d   Dex %d   Con %d   Int %d   Wis %d   Cha %d\r\n\r\n"
  1544:     "1) Str +1  (1)\r\n"
  1545:     "2) Dex +1  (1)\r\n"
  1546:     "3) Con +1  (2)\r\n"
  1547:     "4) Int +1  (1)\r\n"
  1548:     "5) Wis +1  (1)\r\n"
  1549:     "6) Cha +1  (1)\r\n"
  1550:     "7) Done\r\n"
  1551:     "8) Reset\r\n"
  1552:     "\r\nChoice: ",
  1553:     rem, STAT_ALLOC_CAP,
  1554:     ch->real_abils.str, ch->real_abils.dex, ch->real_abils.con,
  1555:     ch->real_abils.intel, ch->real_abils.wis, ch->real_abils.cha);
  1556: }
  1557: 
  1558: static void stat_alloc_try_add(struct descriptor_data *d, int idx)
  1559: {
  1560:   struct char_data *ch = d->character;
  1561:   int cost = stat_alloc_cost(idx);
  1562:   int cur = stat_alloc_get_real(ch, idx);
  1563:   int rem = stat_alloc_remaining(d);
  1564: 
  1565:   if (cur >= STAT_ALLOC_CAP) {
  1566:     write_to_output(d, "\r\nThat stat is already at the cap (%d).\r\n", STAT_ALLOC_CAP);
  1567:     return;
  1568:   }
  1569:   if (rem < cost) {
  1570:     write_to_output(d, "\r\nNot enough points remaining.\r\n");
  1571:     return;
  1572:   }
  1573: 
  1574:   stat_alloc_inc_real(ch, idx);
  1575:   affect_total(ch);
  1576: }
  1577: 
  1578: static int complete_character_login(struct descriptor_data *d)
  1579: {
  1580:   int load_result;
  1581: 
  1582:   if (!d || !d->character)
  1583:     return 0;
  1584: 
  1585:   /* Password was correct, or account session is trusted. */
  1586:   load_result = GET_BAD_PWS(d->character);
  1587:   GET_BAD_PWS(d->character) = 0;
  1588:   d->bad_pws = 0;
  1589: 
  1590:   if (isbanned(d->host) == BAN_SELECT &&
  1591:       !PLR_FLAGGED(d->character, PLR_SITEOK)) {
  1592:     write_to_output(d, "Sorry, this char has not been cleared for login from your site!\r\n");
  1593:     STATE(d) = CON_CLOSE;
  1594:     mudlog(NRM, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "Connection attempt for %s denied from %s", GET_NAME(d->character), d->host);
  1595:     return 0;
  1596:   }
  1597: 
  1598:   if (GET_LEVEL(d->character) < circle_restrict) {
  1599:     write_to_output(d, "The game is temporarily restricted.. try again later.\r\n");
  1600:     STATE(d) = CON_CLOSE;
  1601:     mudlog(NRM, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "Request for login denied for %s [%s] (wizlock)", GET_NAME(d->character), d->host);
  1602:     return 0;
  1603:   }
  1604: 
  1605:   /* check and make sure no other copies of this player are logged in */
  1606:   if (perform_dupe_check(d))
  1607:     return 0;
  1608: 
  1609:   if (GET_LEVEL(d->character) >= LVL_IMMORT)
  1610:     write_to_output(d, "%s", imotd);
  1611:   else
  1612:     write_to_output(d, "%s", motd);
  1613: 
  1614:   if (GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character))
  1615:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE, "%s has connected. (invis %d)", GET_NAME(d->character), GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character));
  1616:   else
  1617:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "%s has connected.", GET_NAME(d->character));
  1618: 
  1619:   /* Add to the list of 'recent' players (since last reboot) */
  1620:   if (AddRecentPlayer(GET_NAME(d->character), d->host, FALSE, FALSE) == FALSE) {
  1621:     mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE, "Failure to AddRecentPlayer (returned FALSE).");
  1622:   }
  1623: 
  1624:   if (load_result) {
  1625:     write_to_output(d, "\r\n\r\n\007\007\007"
  1626:             "%s%d LOGIN FAILURE%s SINCE LAST SUCCESSFUL LOGIN.%s\r\n",
  1627:             CCRED(d->character, C_SPR), load_result,
  1628:             (load_result > 1) ? "S" : "", CCNRM(d->character, C_SPR));
  1629:     GET_BAD_PWS(d->character) = 0;
  1630:   }
  1631: 
  1632:   write_to_output(d, "\r\n*** PRESS RETURN: ");
  1633:   STATE(d) = CON_RMOTD;
  1634:   return 1;
  1635: }
  1636: 
  1637: void nanny(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
  1638: {
  1639:   int load_result;	/* Overloaded variable */
  1640:   int player_i;
  1641: 
  1642:   /* OasisOLC states */
  1643:   struct {
  1644:     int state;
  1645:     void (*func)(struct descriptor_data *, char *);
  1646:   } olc_functions[] = {
  1647:     { CON_OEDIT, oedit_parse },
  1648:     { CON_ZEDIT, zedit_parse },
  1649:     { CON_SEDIT, sedit_parse },
  1650:     { CON_MEDIT, medit_parse },
  1651:     { CON_REDIT, redit_parse },
  1652:     { CON_CEDIT, cedit_parse },
  1653:     { CON_TRIGEDIT, trigedit_parse },
  1654:     { CON_AEDIT, aedit_parse },
  1655:     { CON_HEDIT, hedit_parse },
  1656:     { CON_QEDIT, qedit_parse },
  1657:     { CON_PREFEDIT, prefedit_parse },
  1658:     { CON_IBTEDIT, ibtedit_parse },
  1659:     { CON_MSGEDIT, msgedit_parse },
  1660:     { -1, NULL }
  1661:   };
  1662: 
  1663:   skip_spaces(&arg);
  1664: 
  1665:   /* Quick check for the OLC states. */
  1666:   for (player_i = 0; olc_functions[player_i].state >= 0; player_i++)
  1667:     if (STATE(d) == olc_functions[player_i].state) {
  1668:       (*olc_functions[player_i].func)(d, arg);
  1669:       return;
  1670:     }
  1671: 
  1672:   /* Not in OLC. */
  1673:   switch (STATE(d)) {
  1674:   case CON_GET_PROTOCOL:
  1675:     write_to_output(d, "Collecting Protocol Information... Please Wait.\r\n");
  1676:     return;
  1677: 
  1678:     case CON_ACCT_NAME:
  1679:       account_storage_report();
  1680: 
  1681:       if (!*arg) {
  1682:         write_to_output(d, "Account name (or NEW): ");
  1683:         return;
  1684:       }
  1685: 
  1686:       d->acct_id = 0;
  1687:       d->acct_authed = 0;
  1688:       d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1689:       d->acct_pending_delete[0] = '\0';
  1690: 
  1691:       strlcpy(d->acct_name, arg, sizeof(d->acct_name));
  1692: 
  1693:       if (!strcasecmp(d->acct_name, "new")) {
  1694:         d->acct_name[0] = '\0';
  1695:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nNew account name: ");
  1696:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_CREATE_NAME;
  1697:         return;
  1698:       }
  1699: 
  1700:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nAccount password: ");
  1701:       echo_off(d);
  1702:       STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_PASS;
  1703:       return;
  1704: 
  1705:     case CON_ACCT_PASS: {
  1706:       long aid = 0;
  1707:       struct account_data acct;
  1708:       int used_temp = 0;
  1709: 
  1710:       if (!*arg) {
  1711:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nAccount password: ");
  1712:         echo_off(d);
  1713:         return;
  1714:       }
  1715: 
  1716:       echo_on(d);
  1717: 
  1718:       if (!d->acct_name[0]) {
  1719:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_NAME;
  1720:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nAccount name (or NEW): ");
  1721:         return;
  1722:       }
  1723: 
  1724:       if (!account_authenticate(d->acct_name, arg, &aid, &acct, &used_temp)) {
  1725:         d->acct_name[0] = '\0';
  1726:         d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1727:         d->acct_id = 0;
  1728:         d->acct_authed = 0;
  1729:         d->acct_prompted_menu = 0;
  1730:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nInvalid account or password.\r\n");
  1731:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_NAME;
  1732:         write_to_output(d, "Account name (or NEW): ");
  1733:         return;
  1734:       }
  1735: 
  1736:       (void)used_temp;
  1737: 
  1738:       d->acct_id = aid;
  1739:       d->acct_authed = 1;
  1740:       d->acct_prompted_menu = 0;
  1741:       d->acct_pending_delete[0] = '\0';
  1742: 
  1743:       if (acct.force_pw_change) {
  1744:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nThis account must set a new password now.\r\nNew password: ");
  1745:         d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1746:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_FORCEPASS1;
  1747:         echo_off(d);
  1748:         return;
  1749:       }
  1750: 
  1751:       STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_MENU;
  1752:       acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1753:       return;
  1754:     }
  1755: 
  1756: 
  1757: 
  1758:     case CON_ACCT_CREATE_NAME:
  1759:       if (!*arg) { STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_NAME; return; }
  1760:       strlcpy(d->acct_name, arg, sizeof(d->acct_name));
  1761:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nNew account password: ");
  1762:       echo_off(d);
  1763:       STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_CREATE_PASS1;
  1764:       return;
  1765: 
  1766:     case CON_ACCT_CREATE_PASS1:
  1767:       if (!*arg) { write_to_output(d, "\r\nNew account password: "); return; }
  1768:       strlcpy(d->acct_tmp_pass, arg, sizeof(d->acct_tmp_pass));
  1769:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nConfirm password: ");
  1770:       STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_CREATE_PASS2;
  1771:       return;
  1772: 
  1773:     case CON_ACCT_CREATE_PASS2: {
  1774:       long aid = 0;
  1775:       echo_on(d);
  1776:       if (strcmp(d->acct_tmp_pass, arg) != 0) {
  1777:         d->acct_name[0] = '\0';
  1778:         d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1779:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nPasswords do not match.\r\n");
  1780:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_NAME;
  1781:         return;
  1782:       }
  1783:       if (!account_create(d->acct_name, d->acct_tmp_pass, &aid)) {
  1784:         d->acct_name[0] = '\0';
  1785:         d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1786:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nCould not create account.\r\n");
  1787:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_NAME;
  1788:         return;
  1789:       }
  1790:       d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1791:       d->acct_id = aid;
  1792:       d->acct_authed = 1;
  1793:       STATE(d) = CON_GET_NAME;
  1794:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nAccount created.\r\nBy what name do you wish to be known?\r\n");
  1795:       return;
  1796:     }
  1797: 
  1798:     case CON_ACCT_FORCEPASS1:
  1799:       if (!*arg) {
  1800:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nNew password: ");
  1801:         return;
  1802:       }
  1803: 
  1804:       if (strlen(arg) > MAX_PWD_LENGTH || strlen(arg) < 3) {
  1805:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nIllegal password.\r\nNew password: ");
  1806:         return;
  1807:       }
  1808: 
  1809:       strlcpy(d->acct_tmp_pass, arg, sizeof(d->acct_tmp_pass));
  1810:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nConfirm password: ");
  1811:       STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_FORCEPASS2;
  1812:       return;
  1813: 
  1814:     case CON_ACCT_FORCEPASS2: {
  1815:       struct account_data acct;
  1816: 
  1817:       if (strcmp(d->acct_tmp_pass, arg) != 0) {
  1818:         d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1819:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nPasswords do not match.\r\nNew password: ");
  1820:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_FORCEPASS1;
  1821:         return;
  1822:       }
  1823: 
  1824:       memset(&acct, 0, sizeof(acct));
  1825:       if (d->acct_id > 0 && account_load_any(d->acct_id, &acct)) {
  1826:         if (!account_set_password(d->acct_id, arg, 0)) {
  1827:           echo_on(d);
  1828:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nCould not update password.\r\nAccount name (or NEW): ");
  1829:           STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_NAME;
  1830:           return;
  1831:         }
  1832:         acct.force_pw_change = 0;
  1833:         d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1834:         echo_on(d);
  1835:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nPassword updated.\r\n");
  1836:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_MENU;
  1837:         d->acct_prompted_menu = 0;
  1838:         acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1839:         return;
  1840:       }
  1841: 
  1842:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nCould not load account.\r\nAccount name (or NEW): ");
  1843:       echo_on(d);
  1844:       STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_NAME;
  1845:       return;
  1846:     }
  1847: 
  1848:     case CON_ACCT_CHANGEPASS1:
  1849:       if (!*arg) { write_to_output(d, "\r\nNew account password: "); return; }
  1850: 
  1851:       if (strlen(arg) > MAX_PWD_LENGTH || strlen(arg) < 3) {
  1852:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nIllegal password.\r\nNew account password: ");
  1853:         return;
  1854:       }
  1855: 
  1856:       strlcpy(d->acct_tmp_pass, arg, sizeof(d->acct_tmp_pass));
  1857:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nConfirm password: ");
  1858:       STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_CHANGEPASS2;
  1859:       return;
  1860: 
  1861:     case CON_ACCT_CHANGEPASS2: {
  1862:       struct account_data acct;
  1863: 
  1864:       if (strcmp(d->acct_tmp_pass, arg) != 0) {
  1865:         d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1866:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nPasswords do not match.\r\nNew account password: ");
  1867:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_CHANGEPASS1;
  1868:         return;
  1869:       }
  1870: 
  1871:       memset(&acct, 0, sizeof(acct));
  1872:       if (d->acct_id > 0 && account_load_any(d->acct_id, &acct)) {
  1873:         if (!account_set_password(d->acct_id, arg, 0)) {
  1874:           echo_on(d);
  1875:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nCould not update password.\r\nAccount name (or NEW): ");
  1876:           STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_NAME;
  1877:           return;
  1878:         }
  1879:         d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1880:         echo_on(d);
  1881:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nPassword updated.\r\n");
  1882:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_MENU;
  1883:         d->acct_prompted_menu = 0;
  1884:         acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1885:         return;
  1886:       }
  1887: 
  1888:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nCould not load account.\r\nAccount name (or NEW): ");
  1889:       echo_on(d);
  1890:       STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_NAME;
  1891:       return;
  1892:     }
  1893: 
  1894:     case CON_ACCT_MENU: {
  1895:       struct account_data acct;
  1896:       int i, choice;
  1897:       char cmd[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], target[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], resolved_name[64];
  1898: 
  1899:       if (!*arg) {
  1900:         if (!d->acct_prompted_menu) {
  1901:           d->acct_prompted_menu = 1;
  1902:           acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1903:         }
  1904:         return;
  1905:       }
  1906: 
  1907:       memset(&acct, 0, sizeof(acct));
  1908:       if (d->acct_id > 0)
  1909:         account_load_any(d->acct_id, &acct);
  1910: 
  1911:       while (*arg == ' ' || *arg == '\t') arg++;
  1912:       if (!*arg) {
  1913:         acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1914:         return;
  1915:       }
  1916: 
  1917:       if (!str_cmp(arg, "0") || !str_cmp(arg, "quit") || !str_cmp(arg, "exit")) {
  1918:         STATE(d) = CON_CLOSE;
  1919:         return;
  1920:       }
  1921: 
  1922:       if (!str_cmp(arg, "new")) {
  1923:         d->acct_prompted_menu = 0;
  1924:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nBy what name do you wish to be known?\r\n");
  1925:         STATE(d) = CON_GET_NAME;
  1926:         return;
  1927:       }
  1928: 
  1929:       if (!str_cmp(arg, "pass") || !str_cmp(arg, "password")) {
  1930:         d->acct_prompted_menu = 0;
  1931:         d->acct_tmp_pass[0] = '\0';
  1932:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nNew account password: ");
  1933:         echo_off(d);
  1934:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_CHANGEPASS1;
  1935:         return;
  1936:       }
  1937: 
  1938:       half_chop(arg, cmd, target);
  1939:       if (!str_cmp(cmd, "del") || !str_cmp(cmd, "delete")) {
  1940:         if (!*target) {
  1941:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nUsage: DEL <slot|name>\r\n");
  1942:           acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1943:           return;
  1944:         }
  1945: 
  1946:         if (!account_find_character_on_roster(&acct, target, NULL, resolved_name, sizeof(resolved_name))) {
  1947:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nThat character is not on this account.\r\n");
  1948:           acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1949:           return;
  1950:         }
  1951: 
  1952:         if (account_character_is_in_use(resolved_name)) {
  1953:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nCannot delete a character that is currently in use.\r\n");
  1954:           acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1955:           return;
  1956:         }
  1957: 
  1958:         strlcpy(d->acct_pending_delete, resolved_name, sizeof(d->acct_pending_delete));
  1959:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_DELETE_CONFIRM;
  1960:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nDelete character %s? Type YES to confirm or NO to cancel: ",
  1961:                         d->acct_pending_delete);
  1962:         return;
  1963:       }
  1964: 
  1965:       if (isdigit((unsigned char)*arg)) {
  1966:         choice = atoi(arg);
  1967:         if (choice < 1 || choice > acct.num_chars) {
  1968:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nInvalid selection.\r\n");
  1969:           acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1970:           return;
  1971:         }
  1972:         if (!acct.chars[choice - 1].name[0]) {
  1973:           write_to_output(d, "\r\nInvalid selection.\r\n");
  1974:           acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1975:           return;
  1976:         }
  1977: 
  1978:         d->acct_prompted_menu = 0;
  1979:         d->acct_roster_load_only = 1;
  1980:         STATE(d) = CON_GET_NAME;
  1981:         nanny(d, acct.chars[choice - 1].name);
  1982:         return;
  1983:       }
  1984: 
  1985:       for (i = 0; i < acct.num_chars && i < MAX_CHARS_PER_ACCOUNT; i++) {
  1986:         if (!acct.chars[i].name[0]) continue;
  1987:         if (!str_cmp(arg, acct.chars[i].name)) {
  1988:           d->acct_prompted_menu = 0;
  1989:           d->acct_roster_load_only = 1;
  1990:           STATE(d) = CON_GET_NAME;
  1991:           nanny(d, acct.chars[i].name);
  1992:           return;
  1993:         }
  1994:       }
  1995: 
  1996:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nThat character is not on this account.\r\n");
  1997:       acct_show_character_menu(d);
  1998:       return;
  1999:     }
  2000: 
  2001:     case CON_ACCT_DELETE_CONFIRM: {
  2002:       struct account_data acct;
  2003: 
  2004:       while (*arg == ' ' || *arg == '\t') arg++;
  2005:       if (!*d->acct_pending_delete || !*arg) {
  2006:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nDeletion cancelled.\r\n");
  2007:         d->acct_pending_delete[0] = '\0';
  2008:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_MENU;
  2009:         acct_show_character_menu(d);
  2010:         return;
  2011:       }
  2012: 
  2013:       if (!str_cmp(arg, "no")) {
  2014:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nDeletion cancelled.\r\n");
  2015:         d->acct_pending_delete[0] = '\0';
  2016:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_MENU;
  2017:         acct_show_character_menu(d);
  2018:         return;
  2019:       }
  2020: 
  2021:       if (str_cmp(arg, "yes")) {
  2022:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nType YES to confirm or NO to cancel: ");
  2023:         return;
  2024:       }
  2025: 
  2026:       memset(&acct, 0, sizeof(acct));
  2027:       if (!(d->acct_id > 0 && account_load_any(d->acct_id, &acct))) {
  2028:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nCould not load account data.\r\n");
  2029:         d->acct_pending_delete[0] = '\0';
  2030:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_MENU;
  2031:         acct_show_character_menu(d);
  2032:         return;
  2033:       }
  2034: 
  2035:       if (!account_find_character_on_roster(&acct, d->acct_pending_delete, NULL, NULL, 0)) {
  2036:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nThat character is not on this account.\r\n");
  2037:         d->acct_pending_delete[0] = '\0';
  2038:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_MENU;
  2039:         acct_show_character_menu(d);
  2040:         return;
  2041:       }
  2042: 
  2043:       if (account_character_is_in_use(d->acct_pending_delete)) {
  2044:         write_to_output(d, "\r\nCannot delete a character that is currently in use.\r\n");
  2045:         d->acct_pending_delete[0] = '\0';
  2046:         STATE(d) = CON_ACCT_MENU;
  2047:         acct_show_character_menu(d);
  2048:         return;
  2049:       }

  2491:     STATE(d) = CON_MENU;
  2492:     break;
  2493: 
  2494:   case CON_MENU: {		/* get selection from main menu  */

  2649: 
  2650:   /* It is possible, if enough pulses are missed, to kick someone off while they

    32: static int mail_recip_ok(const char *name)
    33: {
    34:   int player_i, ret = FALSE;
    35: 
    36:   if ((player_i = get_ptable_by_name(name)) >= 0) {
    37:     if (!IS_SET(player_table[player_i].flags, PINDEX_DELETED))
    38:       ret = TRUE;
    39:   }
    40:   return ret;
    41: }
    42: 
    43: static void free_mail_record(struct mail_t *record)
    44: {
    45: 	if (record->body)
    46: 		free(record->body);
    47:   free(record);
    48: }
    49: 
    50: static struct mail_t *read_mail_record(FILE *mail_file)
    51: {
    52:   char line[READ_SIZE];
    53:   long sender, recipient;
    54:   time_t sent_time;
    55:   struct mail_t *record;
    56: 
    57:   if (!get_line(mail_file, line))
    58:   	return NULL;
    59: 
    60:   if (sscanf(line, "### %ld %ld %ld", &recipient, &sender, (long *)&sent_time) != 3) {
    61:   	log("Mail system - fatal error - malformed mail header");
    62:   	log("Line was: %s", line);
    63:   	return NULL;
    64:   }
    65: 
    66:   CREATE(record, struct mail_t, 1);
    67: 
    68:   record->recipient = recipient;
    69:   record->sender = sender;
    70:   record->sent_time = sent_time;
    71:   record->body = fread_string(mail_file, "read mail record");
    72: 
    73:   return record;
    74: }
    75: 
    76: static void write_mail_record(FILE *mail_file, struct mail_t *record)
    77: {
    78: 	fprintf(mail_file, "### %ld %ld %ld\n"
    79: 	                   "%s~\n",
    80:                      record->recipient,
    81:                      record->sender,
    82:                      (long)record->sent_time,
    83:                      record->body );
    84: }
    85: 
    86: /* int scan_file(none)
    87:  * Returns false if mail file is corrupted or true if everything correct.
    88:  *
    89:  * This is called once during boot-up.  It scans through the mail file
    90:  * and indexes all entries currently in the mail file. */
    91: int scan_file(void)
    92: {
    93:   FILE *mail_file;
    94:   int count = 0;
    95:   struct mail_t *record;
    96: 
    97:   if (!(mail_file = fopen(MAIL_FILE, "r"))) {
    98:     log("   Mail file non-existant... creating new file.");
    99:     touch(MAIL_FILE);
   100:     return TRUE;
   101:   }
   102: 
   103:   record = read_mail_record(mail_file);
   104: 
   105:   while (record) {
   106:     free_mail_record(record);
   107:     record = read_mail_record(mail_file);
   108:     count++;
   109:   }
   110: 
   111:   fclose(mail_file);
   112:  	log("   Mail file read -- %d messages.", count);
   113:  	return TRUE;
   114: }
   115: 
   116: /* int has_mail(long #1)
   117:  * #1 - id number of the person to check for mail.
   118:  * Returns true or false.
   119:  *
   120:  * A simple little function which tells you if the player has mail or not. */
   121: int has_mail(long recipient)
   122: {
   123:   FILE *mail_file;
   124:   struct mail_t *record;
   125: 
   126:   if (!(mail_file = fopen(MAIL_FILE, "r"))) {
   127:     perror("read_delete: Mail file not accessible.");
   128:     return FALSE;
   129:   }
   130: 
   131:   record = read_mail_record(mail_file);
   132: 
   133:   while (record) {
   134:   	if (record->recipient == recipient) {
   135:   		free_mail_record(record);
   136:   		fclose(mail_file);
   137:   		return TRUE;
   138:     }
   139:     free_mail_record(record);
   140:     record = read_mail_record(mail_file);
   141:   }
   142:   fclose(mail_file);
   143:   return FALSE;
   144: }
   145: 
   146: /* void store_mail(long #1, long #2, char * #3)
   147:  * #1 - id number of the person to mail to.
   148:  * #2 - id number of the person the mail is from.
   149:  * #3 - The actual message to send.
   150:  *
   151:  * call store_mail to store mail.  (hard, huh? :-) )  Pass 3 arguments:
   152:  * who the mail is to (long), who it's from (long), and a pointer to the
   153:  * actual message text (char *). */
   154: void store_mail(long to, long from, char *message_pointer)
   155: {
   156:   FILE *mail_file;
   157:   struct mail_t *record;
   158: 
   159:   if (!(mail_file = fopen(MAIL_FILE, "a"))) {
   160:     perror("store_mail: Mail file not accessible.");
   161:     return;
   162:   }
   163:   CREATE(record, struct mail_t, 1);
   164: 
   165:   record->recipient = to;
   166:   record->sender = from;
   167:   record->sent_time = time(0);
   168:   record->body = message_pointer;
   169: 
   170:   write_mail_record(mail_file, record);
   171:   free(record); /* don't free the body */
   172:   fclose(mail_file);
   173: }
   174: 
   175: /* char *read_delete(long #1)
   176:  * #1 - The id number of the person we're checking mail for.
   177:  * Returns the message text of the mail received.
   178:  *
   179:  * Retrieves one messsage for a player. The mail is then discarded from
   180:  * the file. Expects mail to exist. */
   181: char *read_delete(long recipient)
   182: {
   183:   FILE *mail_file, *new_file;
   184:   struct mail_t *record, *record_to_keep = NULL;
   185:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   186: 
   187:   if (!(mail_file = fopen(MAIL_FILE, "r"))) {
   188:     perror("read_delete: Mail file not accessible.");
   189:     return strdup("Mail system malfunction - please report this");
   190:   }
   191: 
   192:   if (!(new_file = fopen(MAIL_FILE_TMP, "w"))) {
   193:     perror("read_delete: new Mail file not accessible.");
   194:     fclose(mail_file);
   195:     return strdup("Mail system malfunction - please report this");
   196:   }
   197: 
   198:   record = read_mail_record(mail_file);
   199: 
   200:   while (record) {
   201:   	if (!record_to_keep && record->recipient == recipient) {
   202:   		record_to_keep = record;
   203:   		record = read_mail_record(mail_file);
   204:   		continue; /* don't write and free this one just yet */
   205:     }
   206:     write_mail_record(new_file, record);
   207:     free_mail_record(record);
   208:     record = read_mail_record(mail_file);
   209:   }
   210: 
   211:   if (!record_to_keep)
   212:   	sprintf(buf, "Mail system error - please report");
   213:   else {
   214:     char timestr[25], *from, *to;
   215: 
   216:     strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%c", localtime(&(record_to_keep->sent_time)));
   217: 
   218:     from = get_name_by_id(record_to_keep->sender);
   219:     to = get_name_by_id(record_to_keep->recipient);
   220: 
   221:  		snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
   222:              " * * * * tbaMUD Mail System * * * *\r\n"
   223:              "Date: %s\r\n"
   224:              "To  : %s\r\n"
   225:              "From: %s\r\n"
   226:              "\r\n"
   227:              "%s",
   228: 
   229:              timestr,
   230:              to ? to : "Unknown",
   231:              from ? from : "Unknown",
   232:              record_to_keep->body ? record_to_keep->body : "No message" );
   233: 
   234:     free_mail_record(record_to_keep);
   235:   }
   236:   fclose(mail_file);
   237:   fclose(new_file);
   238: 
   239:   remove(MAIL_FILE);
   240:   rename(MAIL_FILE_TMP, MAIL_FILE);
   241: 
   242:   return strdup(buf);
   243: }
   244: 
   245: /* spec_proc for a postmaster using the above routines.  By Jeremy Elson */
   246: SPECIAL(postmaster)
   247: {
   248:   if (!ch->desc || IS_NPC(ch))
   249:     return (0);			/* so mobs don't get caught here */
   250: 
   251:   if (!(CMD_IS("mail") || CMD_IS("check") || CMD_IS("receive")))
   252:     return (0);
   253: 
   254:   if (no_mail) {
   255:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, the mail system is having technical difficulties.\r\n");
   256:     return (0);
   257:   }
   258: 
   259:   if (CMD_IS("mail")) {
   260:     postmaster_send_mail(ch, (struct char_data *)me, cmd, argument);
   261:     return (1);
   262:   } else if (CMD_IS("check")) {
   263:     postmaster_check_mail(ch, (struct char_data *)me, cmd, argument);
   264:     return (1);
   265:   } else if (CMD_IS("receive")) {
   266:     postmaster_receive_mail(ch, (struct char_data *)me, cmd, argument);
   267:     return (1);
   268:   } else
   269:     return (0);
   270: }
   271: 
   272: static void postmaster_send_mail(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *mailman,
   273: 			  int cmd, char *arg)
   274: {
   275:   long recipient;
   276:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], **mailwrite;
   277: 
   278:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < MIN_MAIL_LEVEL) {
   279:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n tells you, 'Sorry, you have to be level %d to send mail!'", MIN_MAIL_LEVEL);
   280:     act(buf, FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   281:     return;
   282:   }
   283:   one_argument(arg, buf);
   284: 
   285:   if (!*buf) {			/* you'll get no argument from me! */
   286:     act("$n tells you, 'You need to specify an addressee!'",
   287: 	FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   288:     return;
   289:   }
   290:   if (GET_GOLD(ch) < STAMP_PRICE && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) {
   291:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n tells you, 'A stamp costs %d coin%s.'\r\n"
   292: 	    "$n tells you, '...which I see you can't afford.'", STAMP_PRICE,
   293:             STAMP_PRICE == 1 ? "" : "s");
   294:     act(buf, FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   295:     return;
   296:   }
   297:   if ((recipient = get_id_by_name(buf)) < 0 || !mail_recip_ok(buf)) {
   298:     act("$n tells you, 'No one by that name is registered here!'",
   299: 	FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   300:     return;
   301:   }
   302:   act("$n starts to write some mail.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   303: 
   304:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) {
   305:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n tells you, 'I'll take %d coins for the stamp.'", STAMP_PRICE);
   306:     act(buf, FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   307:     decrease_gold(ch, STAMP_PRICE);
   308:   }
   309: 
   310:   act("$n tells you, 'Write your message. (/s saves /h for help).'", FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   311: 
   312:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_MAILING);	/* string_write() sets writing. */
   313: 
   314:   /* Start writing! */
   315:   CREATE(mailwrite, char *, 1);
   316:   string_write(ch->desc, mailwrite, MAX_MAIL_SIZE, recipient, NULL);
   317: }
   318: 
   319: static void postmaster_check_mail(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *mailman,
   320: 			  int cmd, char *arg)
   321: {
   322:   if (has_mail(GET_IDNUM(ch)))
   323:     act("$n tells you, 'You have mail waiting.'", FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   324:   else
   325:     act("$n tells you, 'Sorry, you don't have any mail waiting.'", FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   326: }
   327: 
   328: static void postmaster_receive_mail(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *mailman,
   329: 			  int cmd, char *arg)
   330: {
   331:   char buf[256];
   332:   struct obj_data *obj;
   333:   int y;
   334: 
   335:   if (!has_mail(GET_IDNUM(ch))) {
   336:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "$n tells you, 'Sorry, you don't have any mail waiting.'");
   337:     act(buf, FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   338:     return;
   339:   }
   340:   while (has_mail(GET_IDNUM(ch))) {
   341:     obj = create_obj(); 
   342:     obj->item_number = 1; 
   343:     obj->name = strdup("mail paper letter");
   344:     obj->short_description = strdup("a piece of mail");
   345:     obj->description = strdup("Someone has left a piece of mail here.");
   346: 
   347:     GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) = ITEM_NOTE;
   348:     for(y = 0; y < TW_ARRAY_MAX; y++)
   349:       obj->obj_flags.wear_flags[y] = 0;
   350:     SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), ITEM_WEAR_TAKE);
   351:     GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) = 1;
   352:     GET_OBJ_COST(obj) = 30;
   353:     GET_OBJ_RENT(obj) = 10;
   354:     obj->action_description = read_delete(GET_IDNUM(ch));
   355: 
   356:     if (obj->action_description == NULL)
   357:       obj->action_description =
   358: 	strdup("Mail system error - please report.  Error #11.\r\n");
   359: 
   360:     obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   361: 
   362:     act("$n gives you a piece of mail.", FALSE, mailman, 0, ch, TO_VICT);
   363:     act("$N gives $n a piece of mail.", FALSE, ch, 0, mailman, TO_ROOM);
   364:   }
   365: }
   366: 
   367: void notify_if_playing(struct char_data *from, int recipient_id) 
   368: { 
   369:   struct descriptor_data *d; 
   370: 
   371:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) 
   372:     if ((IS_PLAYING(d)) && (GET_IDNUM(d->character) == recipient_id) && (has_mail(GET_IDNUM(d->character)))) 
   373:       send_to_char(d->character, "You have new mudmail from %s.\r\n", GET_NAME(from)); 
   374: }

   101: /*  utility functions */
   102: ACMD(do_oasis_medit)
   103: {
   104:   int number = NOBODY, save = 0, real_num;
   105:   struct descriptor_data *d;
   106:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   107:   char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   108: 
   109:   /* No building as a mob or while being forced. */
   110:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
   111:     return;
   112: 
   113:   /* Parse any arguments */
   114:   two_arguments(argument, buf1, buf2);
   115: 
   116:   if (!*buf1) {
   117:     send_to_char(ch, "Specify a mobile VNUM to edit.\r\n");
   118:     return;
   119:   } else if (!isdigit(*buf1)) {
   120:     if (str_cmp("save", buf1) != 0) {
   121:       send_to_char(ch, "Yikes!  Stop that, someone will get hurt!\r\n");
   122:       return;
   123:     }
   124: 
   125:     save = TRUE;
   126: 
   127:     if (is_number(buf2))
   128:       number = atoi(buf2);
   129:     else if (GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) > 0) {
   130:       zone_rnum zlok;
   131: 
   132:       if ((zlok = real_zone(GET_OLC_ZONE(ch))) == NOWHERE)
   133:         number = NOWHERE;
   134:       else
   135:         number = genolc_zone_bottom(zlok);
   136:     }
   137: 
   138:     if (number == NOWHERE) {
   139:       send_to_char(ch, "Save which zone?\r\n");
   140:       return;
   141:     }
   142:   }
   143: 
   144:   /* If a numeric argument was given (like a room number), get it. */
   145:   if (number == NOBODY)
   146:     number = atoi(buf1);
   147: 
   148:   if (number < IDXTYPE_MIN || number > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
   149:     send_to_char(ch, "That mobile VNUM can't exist.\r\n");
   150:     return;
   151:   }
   152: 
   153:   /* Check that whatever it is isn't already being edited. */
   154:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   155:     if (STATE(d) == CON_MEDIT) {
   156:       if (d->olc && OLC_NUM(d) == number) {
   157:         send_to_char(ch, "That mobile is currently being edited by %s.\r\n",
   158:           GET_NAME(d->character));
   159:         return;
   160:       }
   161:     }
   162:   }
   163: 
   164:   d = ch->desc;
   165: 
   166:   /* Give descriptor an OLC structure. */
   167:   if (d->olc) {
   168:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE,
   169:       "SYSERR: do_oasis_medit: Player already had olc structure.");
   170:     free(d->olc);
   171:   }
   172: 
   173:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
   174: 
   175:   /* Find the zone. */
   176:   OLC_ZNUM(d) = save ? real_zone(number) : real_zone_by_thing(number);
   177:   if (OLC_ZNUM(d) == NOWHERE) {
   178:     if (save) {
   179:       send_to_char(ch, "Zone %d does not exist.\r\n", number);
   180:     } else if (real_mobile(number) == NOBODY) {
   181:       send_to_char(ch, "Mobile vnum %d does not exist and no zone owns that vnum.\r\n", number);
   182:     } else {
   183:       send_to_char(ch, "Mobile vnum %d exists but is not in any valid editable zone range.\r\n", number);
   184:     }
   185:     free(d->olc);
   186:     d->olc = NULL;
   187:     return;
   188:   }
   189: 
   190:   /* Everyone but IMPLs can only edit zones they have been assigned. */
   191:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, OLC_ZNUM(d))) {
   192:     send_cannot_edit(ch, zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   193:     /* Free the OLC structure. */
   194:     free(d->olc);
   195:     d->olc = NULL;
   196:     return;
   197:   }
   198: 
   199:   /* If save is TRUE, save the mobiles. */
   200:   if (save) {
   201:     send_to_char(ch, "Saving all mobiles in zone %d.\r\n",
   202:       zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   203:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
   204:       "OLC: %s saves mobile info for zone %d.",
   205:       GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   206: 
   207:     /* Save the mobiles. */
   208:     save_mobiles(OLC_ZNUM(d));
   209: 
   210:     /* Free the olc structure stored in the descriptor. */
   211:     free(d->olc);
   212:     d->olc = NULL;
   213:     return;
   214:   }
   215: 
   216:   OLC_NUM(d) = number;
   217: 
   218:   /* If this is a new mobile, setup a new one, otherwise, setup the
   219:      existing mobile. */
   220:   if ((real_num = real_mobile(number)) == NOBODY)
   221:     medit_setup_new(d);
   222:   else
   223:     medit_setup_existing(d, real_num);
   224: 
   225:   medit_disp_menu(d);
   226:   STATE(d) = CON_MEDIT;
   227: 
   228:   /* Display the OLC messages to the players in the same room as the
   229:      builder and also log it. */
   230:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   231:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   232: 
   233:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,"OLC: %s starts editing zone %d allowed zone %d",
   234:     GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, GET_OLC_ZONE(ch));
   235: }

   266: void medit_setup_existing(struct descriptor_data *d, int rmob_num)
   267: {
   268:   struct char_data *mob;

   286: /* Ideally, this function should be in db.c, but I'll put it here for portability. */
   287: static void init_mobile(struct char_data *mob)
   288: {
   289:   clear_char(mob);
   290: 
   291:   GET_HIT(mob) = GET_MANA(mob) = 1;
   292:   GET_MAX_MANA(mob) = GET_MAX_MOVE(mob) = 100;
   293:   GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(mob) = GET_MAX_MANA(mob);
   294:   GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(mob) = GET_MAX_MOVE(mob);
   295:   GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(mob) = GET_MAX_HIT(mob);
   296:   GET_NDD(mob) = GET_SDD(mob) = 1;
   297:   GET_WEIGHT(mob) = 200;
   298:   GET_HEIGHT(mob) = 198;
   299:   GET_PET_PRICE(mob) = 0;
   300: 
   301:   mob->real_abils.str = mob->real_abils.intel = mob->real_abils.wis = 11;
   302:   mob->real_abils.dex = mob->real_abils.con = mob->real_abils.cha = 11;
   303:   mob->aff_abils = mob->real_abils;
   304: 
   305:   GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_PARA)   = 0;
   306:   GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_ROD)    = 0;
   307:   GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_PETRI)  = 0;
   308:   GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_BREATH) = 0;
   309:   GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_SPELL)  = 0;
   310: 
   311:   SET_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(mob), MOB_ISNPC);
   312:   mob->player_specials = &dummy_mob;
   313: }
   314: 
   315: /* Save new/edited mob to memory. */
   316: void medit_save_internally(struct descriptor_data *d)
   317: {
   318:   int i;
   319:   mob_rnum new_rnum;
   320:   struct descriptor_data *dsc;
   321:   struct char_data *mob;
   322: 
   323:   i = (real_mobile(OLC_NUM(d)) == NOBODY);
   324: 
   325:   if ((new_rnum = add_mobile(OLC_MOB(d), OLC_NUM(d))) == NOBODY) {
   326:     log("medit_save_internally: add_mobile failed.");
   327:     return;
   328:   }
   329:   builder_refs_invalidate();
   330: 
   331: 
   332: 
   333:   /* Auto-sync GUILD_MASTER flag with the guild spec-proc. */
   334:   if (IS_SET_AR(MOB_FLAGS(OLC_MOB(d)), MOB_GUILD_MASTER)) {
   335:     mob_index[new_rnum].func = guild;
   336:   } else if (mob_index[new_rnum].func == guild) {
   337:     mob_index[new_rnum].func = NULL;
   338:   }
   339: 
   340:   /* Update triggers and free old proto list */
   341:   if (mob_proto[new_rnum].proto_script &&
   342:       mob_proto[new_rnum].proto_script != OLC_SCRIPT(d))
   343:     free_proto_script(&mob_proto[new_rnum], MOB_TRIGGER);
   344: 
   345:   mob_proto[new_rnum].proto_script = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
   346: 
   347:   /* this takes care of the mobs currently in-game */
   348:   for (mob = character_list; mob; mob = mob->next) {
   349:     if (GET_MOB_RNUM(mob) != new_rnum)
   350:       continue;
   351: 
   352:     /* remove any old scripts */
   353:     if (SCRIPT(mob))
   354:       extract_script(mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
   355: 
   356:     free_proto_script(mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
   357:     copy_proto_script(&mob_proto[new_rnum], mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
   358:     assign_triggers(mob, MOB_TRIGGER);
   359:   }
   360:   /* end trigger update */
   361: 
   362: 
   363:   if (!i)	/* Only renumber on new mobiles. */
   364:     return;
   365: 
   366:   /* Update keepers in shops being edited and other mobs being edited. */
   367:   for (dsc = descriptor_list; dsc; dsc = dsc->next) {
   368:     if (STATE(dsc) == CON_SEDIT)
   369:       S_KEEPER(OLC_SHOP(dsc)) += (S_KEEPER(OLC_SHOP(dsc)) != NOTHING && S_KEEPER(OLC_SHOP(dsc)) >= new_rnum);
   370:     else if (STATE(dsc) == CON_MEDIT)
   371:       GET_MOB_RNUM(OLC_MOB(dsc)) += (GET_MOB_RNUM(OLC_MOB(dsc)) != NOTHING && GET_MOB_RNUM(OLC_MOB(dsc)) >= new_rnum);
   372:   }
   373: 
   374:   /* Update other people in zedit too. From: C.Raehl 4/27/99 */
   375:   for (dsc = descriptor_list; dsc; dsc = dsc->next)
   376:     if (STATE(dsc) == CON_ZEDIT)
   377:       for (i = 0; OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].command != 'S'; i++)
   378:         if (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].command == 'M')
   379:           if (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].arg1 >= new_rnum)
   380:             OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].arg1++;
   381: }

   416: /* Find mob flags that shouldn't be set by builders */
   417: static bool medit_illegal_mob_flag(int fl)
   418: {
   419:   int i;
   420: 
   421:   /* add any other flags you dont want them setting */
   422:   const int illegal_flags[] = {
   423:     MOB_ISNPC,
   424:     MOB_NOTDEADYET,
   425:     20,
   426:   };
   427: 
   428:   const int num_illegal_flags = sizeof(illegal_flags)/sizeof(int);
   429: 
   430: 
   431:   for (i=0; i < num_illegal_flags;i++)
   432:     if (fl == illegal_flags[i])
   433:       return (TRUE);
   434: 
   435:   return (FALSE);
   436: 
   437: }
   438: 
   439: /* Due to illegal mob flags not showing in the mob flags list,
   440:    we need this to convert the list number back to flag value */
   441: static int medit_get_mob_flag_by_number(int num)
   442: {
   443:   int i, count = 0;
   444:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_MOB_FLAGS; i++) {
   445:     if (medit_illegal_mob_flag(i)) continue;
   446:     if ((++count) == num) return i;
   447:   }
   448:   /* Return 'illegal flag' value */
   449:   return -1;
   450: }

   492: static int medit_slot_required_wear_flag(int wear_pos)
   493: {
   494:   switch (wear_pos) {
   495:     case WEAR_LIGHT:    return ITEM_WEAR_TAKE;
   496:     case WEAR_FINGER_R:
   497:     case WEAR_FINGER_L: return ITEM_WEAR_FINGER;
   498:     case WEAR_NECK_1:   return ITEM_WEAR_NECK;
   499:     case WEAR_BODY:     return ITEM_WEAR_BODY;
   500:     case WEAR_HEAD:     return ITEM_WEAR_HEAD;
   501:     case WEAR_LEGS:     return ITEM_WEAR_LEGS;
   502:     case WEAR_FEET:     return ITEM_WEAR_FEET;
   503:     case WEAR_HANDS:    return ITEM_WEAR_HANDS;
   504:     case WEAR_ARMS:     return ITEM_WEAR_ARMS;
   505:     case WEAR_SHIELD:   return ITEM_WEAR_SHIELD;
   506:     case WEAR_ABOUT:    return ITEM_WEAR_ABOUT;
   507:     case WEAR_WAIST:    return ITEM_WEAR_WAIST;
   508:     case WEAR_WRIST_R:
   509:     case WEAR_WRIST_L:  return ITEM_WEAR_WRIST;
   510:     case WEAR_WIELD:    return ITEM_WEAR_WIELD;
   511:     case WEAR_HOLD:     return ITEM_WEAR_TAKE;
   512:     default:            return ITEM_WEAR_TAKE;
   513:   }
   514: }
   515: 
   516: static int medit_parse_int_argument(const char *arg, int *value)
   517: {
   518:   char *endptr = NULL;
   519:   long parsed;
   520: 
   521:   if (!arg || !*arg)
   522:     return FALSE;
   523: 
   524:   while (*arg && isspace((unsigned char)*arg))
   525:     arg++;
   526:   if (!*arg)
   527:     return FALSE;
   528: 
   529:   parsed = strtol(arg, &endptr, 10);
   530:   while (endptr && *endptr && isspace((unsigned char)*endptr))
   531:     endptr++;
   532:   if (endptr == arg || (endptr && *endptr != '\0'))
   533:     return FALSE;
   534: 
   535:   *value = (int)parsed;
   536:   return TRUE;
   537: }
   538: 
   539: static int medit_arg_is_cancel(const char *arg)
   540: {
   541:   const char *p;
   542: 
   543:   if (!arg)
   544:     return FALSE;
   545:   while (*arg && isspace((unsigned char)*arg))
   546:     arg++;
   547:   if (*arg != 'q' && *arg != 'Q')
   548:     return FALSE;
   549:   p = arg + 1;
   550:   while (*p && isspace((unsigned char)*p))
   551:     p++;
   552:   if (*p != '\0')
   553:     return FALSE;
   554:   return TRUE;
   555: }

   557: static const char *medit_slot_label_by_wear_pos(int wear_pos)
   558: {

   561:   for (i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof(medit_eq_picker_slots) / sizeof(medit_eq_picker_slots[0])); i++)
   562:     if (medit_eq_picker_slots[i] == wear_pos)
   563:       return medit_eq_picker_labels[i];
   564: 
   565:   return "Unknown";
   566: }

   612: static void medit_disp_remove_inventory_picker(struct descriptor_data *d)

   644: static int medit_object_can_equip_slot(struct obj_data *obj, int wear_pos)
   645: {
   646:   if (!obj || wear_pos < 0 || wear_pos >= NUM_WEARS)
   647:     return FALSE;
   648: 
   649:   if (wear_pos == WEAR_HOLD && GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_WEAPON && OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_OFFHAND) &&
   650:       !OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_TWO_HANDER))
   651:     return TRUE;
   652: 
   653:   return CAN_WEAR(obj, medit_slot_required_wear_flag(wear_pos));
   654: }

   656: static void medit_disp_loadout_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   657: {
   658:   struct char_data *mob = OLC_MOB(d);
   659:   int i, j;
   660: 
   661:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   662:   clear_screen(d);
   663:   write_to_output(d, "-- LOADOUT / LOOT: [%d] %s\r\n\r\n", OLC_NUM(d), GET_SDESC(mob));
   664: 
   665:   write_to_output(d, "EQUIPPED ITEMS\r\n%s is using:\r\n", GET_SDESC(mob));
   666:   for (i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof(medit_eq_picker_slots) / sizeof(medit_eq_picker_slots[0])); i++) {
   667:     int slot = medit_eq_picker_slots[i];
   668:     int found_idx = -1;
   669:     for (j = 0; j < mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout_count; j++) {
   670:       if (mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout[j].wear_pos == slot) {
   671:         found_idx = j;
   672:         break;
   673:       }
   674:     }
   675: 
   676:     if (found_idx < 0) {
   677:       write_to_output(d, "%-14s [NOTHING]\r\n", medit_eq_picker_labels[i]);
   678:     } else {
   679:       obj_rnum ornum = real_object(mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout[found_idx].vnum);
   680:       const char *sdesc = (ornum != NOTHING) ? obj_proto[ornum].short_description : "<missing object>";
   681:       write_to_output(d, "%-14s [%d] %s\r\n",
   682:         medit_eq_picker_labels[i], mob->mob_specials.equip_loadout[found_idx].vnum, sdesc);
   683:     }
   684:   }
   685: 
   686:   write_to_output(d, "\r\nINVENTORY ITEMS\r\n");
   687:   if (mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout_count <= 0)
   688:     write_to_output(d, "  [NONE]\r\n");
   689:   for (i = 0; i < mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout_count; i++) {
   690:     obj_rnum ornum = real_object(mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout[i].vnum);
   691:     const char *sdesc = (ornum != NOTHING) ? obj_proto[ornum].short_description : "<missing object>";
   692:     int count = MAX(1, mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout[i].count);
   693:     if (count > 1)
   694:       write_to_output(d, "  %2d) [%d] %s x%d\r\n", i + 1,
   695:         mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout[i].vnum, sdesc, count);
   696:     else
   697:       write_to_output(d, "  %2d) [%d] %s\r\n", i + 1,
   698:         mob->mob_specials.inventory_loadout[i].vnum, sdesc);
   699:   }
   700: 
   701:   write_to_output(d, "\r\nLOOT TABLE\r\n");
   702:   if (mob->mob_specials.loot_table_count <= 0)
   703:     write_to_output(d, "  [NONE]\r\n");
   704:   for (i = 0; i < mob->mob_specials.loot_table_count; i++) {
   705:     obj_rnum ornum = real_object(mob->mob_specials.loot_table[i].vnum);
   706:     const char *sdesc = (ornum != NOTHING) ? obj_proto[ornum].short_description : "<missing object>";
   707:     write_to_output(d, "  %2d) [%d] %-30s %3d%%\r\n", i + 1,
   708:       mob->mob_specials.loot_table[i].vnum, sdesc, mob->mob_specials.loot_table[i].chance);
   709:   }
   710: 
   711:   write_to_output(d,
   712:     "\r\nA) Equip object\r\n"
   713:     "B) Add inventory item\r\n"
   714:     "C) Add loot item\r\n"
   715:     "D) Remove equipped item\r\n"
   716:     "E) Remove inventory item\r\n"
   717:     "F) Remove loot item\r\n"
   718:     "Q) Quit\r\n"
   719:     "Enter choice : ");
   720:   OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_LOADOUT_MENU;
   721: }

   789: static void medit_disp_stats_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   790: {
   791:   struct char_data *mob;
   792:   char title[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   793:   int hp_min, hp_max;
   794:   int dmg_min, dmg_max;
   795:   int base_xp_preview, total_xp_preview;
   796: 
   797:   mob = OLC_MOB(d);
   798:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   799:   clear_screen(d);
   800: 
   801:   hp_min = GET_HIT(mob) + GET_MOVE(mob);
   802:   hp_max = (GET_HIT(mob) * GET_MANA(mob)) + GET_MOVE(mob);
   803:   dmg_min = GET_NDD(mob) + GET_DAMROLL(mob);
   804:   dmg_max = (GET_NDD(mob) * GET_SDD(mob)) + GET_DAMROLL(mob);
   805:   base_xp_preview = mob_kill_base_xp_for_levels(GET_LEVEL(mob), GET_LEVEL(mob));
   806:   total_xp_preview = LIMIT(base_xp_preview + GET_EXP(mob), 0, MAX_MOB_EXP);
   807:   snprintf(title, sizeof(title), "MOB BUILD: [%d] %s", OLC_NUM(d), GET_SDESC(mob));
   808: 
   809:   write_to_output(d,
   810:   "-------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n"
   811:   "%-79.79s\r\n"
   812:   "-------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n"
   813:   "QUICK BUILD\r\n"
   814:   "(%s1%s) Level:                     %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   815:   "(%s2%s) Reapply Recommended Stats\r\n"
   816:   "\r\n"
   817:   "Tip: Set the level first.\r\n"
   818:   "     After changing level, accept the Y/N prompt to fill recommended stats.\r\n"
   819:   "     Use option 2 later if you want to refresh recommended values again.\r\n"
   820:   "-------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n"
   821:   "HIT POINTS\r\n"
   822:   "(%s3%s) HP NumDice:                %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   823:   "(%s4%s) HP SizeDice:               %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   824:   "(%s5%s) HP Addition:               %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   825:   "    HP Preview:                %s[%s%5d%s to %s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   826:   "-------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n"
   827:   "DAMAGE\r\n"
   828:   "(%s6%s) BHD NumDice:               %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   829:   "(%s7%s) BHD SizeDice:              %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   830:   "(%s8%s) Damroll:                   %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   831:   "    Damage Preview:            %s[%s%5d%s to %s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   832:   "-------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n"
   833:   "COMBAT\r\n"
   834:   "(%sA%s) Armor:                     %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   835:   "(%sB%s) Hitroll:                   %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   836:   "(%sC%s) Evasion:                   %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   837:   "(%sD%s) Alignment:                 %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   838:   "(%sE%s) Wimpy Threshold:           %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   839:   "-------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n"
   840:   "REWARDS\r\n"
   841:   "(%sF%s) Bonus XP:                  %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   842:   "(%sG%s) Gold Min/Max:              %s[%s%5lld%s / %s%5lld%s]%s\r\n"
   843:   "    Base XP Preview:           %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   844:   "    Total XP Preview:          %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   845:   "    Note: Bonus XP is added on top of live kill XP.\r\n"
   846:   "    Note: RARE is an explicit mob flag; its bonus is based on calculated base XP.\r\n"
   847:   "-------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n"
   848:   "ATTRIBUTES\r\n"
   849:   "(%sH%s) Str: %s[%s%2d/%3d%s]%s   (%sI%s) Int: %s[%s%2d%s]%s   (%sJ%s) Wis: %s[%s%2d%s]%s\r\n"
   850:   "(%sK%s) Dex: %s[%s%2d%s]%s     (%sL%s) Con: %s[%s%2d%s]%s   (%sM%s) Cha: %s[%s%2d%s]%s\r\n"
   851:   "-------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n"
   852:   "SAVING THROWS\r\n"
   853:   "(%sN%s) Paralysis:               %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   854:   "(%sO%s) Rods/Staves:             %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   855:   "(%sP%s) Petrification:           %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   856:   "(%sR%s) Breath:                  %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   857:   "(%sS%s) Spells:                  %s[%s%5d%s]%s\r\n"
   858:   "-------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n"
   859:   "(%sQ%s) Quit to main menu\r\n"
   860:   "Enter choice : ",
   861:       title,
   862:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_LEVEL(mob), cyn, nrm,
   863:       cyn, nrm,
   864:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_HIT(mob), cyn, nrm,
   865:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_MANA(mob), cyn, nrm,
   866:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_MOVE(mob), cyn, nrm,
   867:       cyn, yel, hp_min, cyn, yel, hp_max, cyn, nrm,
   868:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_NDD(mob), cyn, nrm,
   869:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_SDD(mob), cyn, nrm,
   870:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_DAMROLL(mob), cyn, nrm,
   871:       cyn, yel, dmg_min, cyn, yel, dmg_max, cyn, nrm,
   872:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_AC(mob), cyn, nrm,
   873:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_HITROLL(mob), cyn, nrm,
   874:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_EVASION(mob), cyn, nrm,
   875:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_ALIGNMENT(mob), cyn, nrm,
   876:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_MOB_WIMP_LEV(mob), cyn, nrm,
   877:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_EXP(mob), cyn, nrm,
   878:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, (long long)mob->mob_specials.gold_min, cyn, yel, (long long)mob->mob_specials.gold_max, cyn, nrm,
   879:       cyn, yel, base_xp_preview, cyn, nrm,
   880:       cyn, yel, total_xp_preview, cyn, nrm,
   881:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_STR(mob), GET_ADD(mob), cyn, nrm,
   882:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_INT(mob), cyn, nrm,
   883:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_WIS(mob), cyn, nrm,
   884:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_DEX(mob), cyn, nrm,
   885:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_CON(mob), cyn, nrm,
   886:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_CHA(mob), cyn, nrm,
   887:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_PARA), cyn, nrm,
   888:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_ROD), cyn, nrm,
   889:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_PETRI), cyn, nrm,
   890:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_BREATH), cyn, nrm,
   891:       cyn, nrm, cyn, yel, GET_SAVE(mob, SAVING_SPELL), cyn, nrm,
   892:       cyn, nrm);
   893: 
   894:   OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_STATS_MENU;
   895: }
   896: 
   897: void medit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   898: {
   899:   int i = -1, j;
   900:   char *oldtext = NULL;
   901: 
   902:   if (OLC_MODE(d) == MEDIT_STATS_MENU ||
   903:       OLC_MODE(d) == MEDIT_GOLD ||
   904:       OLC_MODE(d) == MEDIT_LEVEL_AUTOFILL_CONFIRM ||
   905:       OLC_MODE(d) == MEDIT_DELETE) {
   906:     if (!genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   907:       return;
   908:   } else if (OLC_MODE(d) > MEDIT_NUMERICAL_RESPONSE &&
   909:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_MENU &&
   910:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_EQUIP_VNUM &&
   911:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_EQUIP_SLOT &&
   912:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_EQUIP_REPLACE &&
   913:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_INV_VNUM &&
   914:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_INV_COUNT &&
   915:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_LOOT_VNUM &&
   916:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_LOOT_CHANCE &&
   917:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_REMOVE_EQUIP &&
   918:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_REMOVE_INV &&
   919:              OLC_MODE(d) != MEDIT_LOADOUT_REMOVE_LOOT &&
   920:              OLC_MODE(d) != OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT) {
   921:     char *endptr = NULL;
   922:     long parsed;
   923: 
   924:     parsed = strtol(arg, &endptr, 10);
   925:     while (endptr && *endptr && isspace((unsigned char)*endptr))
   926:       endptr++;
   927: 
   928:     if (!*arg || endptr == arg || (endptr && *endptr != '\0')) {
   929:       write_to_output(d, "Try again : ");
   930:       return;
   931:     }
   932:     i = (int)parsed;
   933:   } else {	/* String response. */
   934:     if (!genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   935:       return;
   936:   }
   937:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   938:   case MEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   939:     /* Ensure mob has MOB_ISNPC set. */
   940:     SET_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(OLC_MOB(d)), MOB_ISNPC);
   941:     switch (*arg) {
   942:     case 'y':
   943:     case 'Y':
   944:       /* Save the mob in memory and to disk. */
   945:       medit_save_internally(d);
   946:       mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE, "OLC: %s edits mob %d", GET_NAME(d->character), OLC_NUM(d));
   947:       if (CONFIG_OLC_SAVE) {
   948:         medit_save_to_disk(zone_table[real_zone_by_thing(OLC_NUM(d))].number);
   949:         write_to_output(d, "Mobile saved to disk.\r\n");
   950:       } else
   951:         write_to_output(d, "Mobile saved to memory.\r\n");
   952:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   953:       return;
   954:     case 'n':
   955:     case 'N':
   956:       /* If not saving, we must free the script_proto list. We do so by
   957:        * assigning it to the edited mob and letting free_mobile in
   958:        * cleanup_olc handle it. */
   959:       OLC_MOB(d)->proto_script = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
   960:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   961:       return;
   962:     default:
   963:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
   964:       write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   965:       return;
   966:     }
   967: 
   968:   case MEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   969:     i = 0;
   970:     switch (*arg) {
   971:     case 'q':
   972:     case 'Q':
   973:       if (OLC_VAL(d)) {	/* Anything been changed? */
   974: 	      write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   975: 	      OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   976:       } else
   977: 	cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   978:       return;
   979:     case '1':
   980:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_SEX;
   981:       medit_disp_sex(d);
   982:       return;
   983:     case '2':
   984:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_KEYWORD;
   985:       i--;
   986:       break;
   987:     case '3':
   988:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_S_DESC;
   989:       i--;
   990:       break;
   991:     case '4':
   992:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_L_DESC;
   993:       i--;
   994:       break;
   995:     case '5':
   996:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_D_DESC;
   997:       send_editor_help(d);
   998:       write_to_output(d, "Enter mob description:\r\n\r\n");
   999:       if (OLC_MOB(d)->player.description) {
  1000: 	      write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_MOB(d)->player.description);
  1001: 	      oldtext = strdup(OLC_MOB(d)->player.description);
  1002:       }
  1003:       string_write(d, &OLC_MOB(d)->player.description, MAX_MOB_DESC, 0, oldtext);
  1004:       OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
  1005:       return;
  1006:     case '6':
  1007:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_POS;
  1008:       medit_disp_positions(d);
  1009:       return;
  1010:     case '7':
  1011:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_DEFAULT_POS;
  1012:       medit_disp_positions(d);
  1013:       return;
  1014:     case '8':
  1015:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_ATTACK;
  1016:       medit_disp_attack_types(d);
  1017:       return;
  1018:     case '9':
  1019:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_STATS_MENU;
  1020:       medit_disp_stats_menu(d);
  1021:       return;
  1022:     case 'a':
  1023:     case 'A':
  1024:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_NPC_FLAGS;
  1025:       medit_disp_mob_flags(d);
  1026:       return;
  1027:     case 'b':
  1028:     case 'B':
  1029:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_AFF_FLAGS;
  1030:       medit_disp_aff_flags(d);
  1031:       return;
  1032:     case 'p':
  1033:     case 'P':
  1034:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_PET_PRICE;
  1035:       write_to_output(d, "Enter pet price in gold (0 = automatic): ");
  1036:       return;
  1037:     case 'r':
  1038:     case 'R':
  1039:       medit_disp_loadout_menu(d);
  1040:       return;
  1041:     case 'y':
  1042:     case 'Y':
  1043:       builder_refs_display(d, BREF_MOB, OLC_NUM(d), "Mobile");
  1044:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_REFERENCES;
  1045:       return;
  1046:     case 'w':
  1047:     case 'W':
  1048:       write_to_output(d, "Copy what mob? ");
  1049:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_COPY;
  1050:       return;
  1051:     case 'x':
  1052:     case 'X':
  1053:       write_to_output(d, "Are you sure you want to delete this mobile? ");
  1054:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_DELETE;
  1055:       return;
  1056:     case 's':
  1057:     case 'S':
  1058:       OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_MAIN_MENU;
  1059:       dg_script_menu(d);
  1060:       return;
  1061:     default:
  1062:       medit_disp_menu(d);
  1063:       return;
  1064:     }
  1065:     if (i == 0)
  1066:       break;
  1067:     else if (i == 1)
  1068:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter new value : ");
  1069:     else if (i == -1)
  1070:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter new text :\r\n] ");
  1071:     else
  1072:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1073:     return;
  1074: 
  1075:   case MEDIT_REFERENCES:
  1076:     medit_disp_menu(d);
  1077:     return;
  1078: 
  1079:   case MEDIT_STATS_MENU:
  1080:     i=0;
  1081:     switch(*arg) {
  1082:     case 'q':
  1083:     case 'Q':
  1084:       medit_disp_menu(d);
  1085:       return;
  1086:     case '1':  /* Edit level */
  1087:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_LEVEL;
  1088:       i++;
  1089:       break;
  1090:     case '2':  /* Autoroll stats */
  1091:       medit_autoroll_stats(d);
  1092:       medit_disp_stats_menu(d);
  1093:       OLC_VAL(d) = TRUE;
  1094:       return;
  1095:     case '3':
  1096:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_NUM_HP_DICE;
  1097:       i++;
  1098:       break;
  1099:     case '4':
  1100:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_SIZE_HP_DICE;
  1101:       i++;
  1102:       break;
  1103:     case '5':
  1104:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_ADD_HP;
  1105:       i++;
  1106:       break;
  1107:     case '6':
  1108:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_NDD;
  1109:       i++;
  1110:       break;
  1111:     case '7':
  1112:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_SDD;
  1113:       i++;
  1114:       break;
  1115:     case '8':
  1116:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_DAMROLL;
  1117:       i++;
  1118:       break;
  1119:     case 'a':
  1120:     case 'A':
  1121:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_AC;
  1122:       i++;
  1123:       break;
  1124:     case 'b':
  1125:     case 'B':
  1126:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_HITROLL;
  1127:       i++;
  1128:       break;
  1129:     case 'd':
  1130:     case 'D':
  1131:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_ALIGNMENT;
  1132:       i++;
  1133:       break;
  1134:     case 'c':
  1135:     case 'C':
  1136:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_EVASION;
  1137:       i++;
  1138:       break;
  1139:     case 'e':
  1140:     case 'E':
  1141:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_WIMPY_THRESH;
  1142:       i++;
  1143:       break;
  1144:     case 'f':
  1145:     case 'F':
  1146:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_EXP;
  1147:       i++;
  1148:       break;
  1149:     case 'g':
  1150:     case 'G':
  1151:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_GOLD;
  1152:       write_to_output(d, "Enter gold min and max (example: 10 50) or a single value: ");
  1153:       return;
  1154:     case 'h':
  1155:     case 'H':
  1156:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_STR;
  1157:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter Strength base value [3-25]: ");
  1158:       return;
  1159:     case 'i':
  1160:     case 'I':
  1161:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_INT;
  1162:       i++;
  1163:       break;
  1164:     case 'j':
  1165:     case 'J':
  1166:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_WIS;
  1167:       i++;
  1168:       break;
  1169:     case 'k':
  1170:     case 'K':
  1171:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_DEX;
  1172:       i++;
  1173:       break;
  1174:     case 'l':
  1175:     case 'L':
  1176:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_CON;
  1177:       i++;
  1178:       break;
  1179:     case 'm':
  1180:     case 'M':
  1181:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_CHA;
  1182:       i++;
  1183:       break;
  1184:     case 'n':
  1185:     case 'N':
  1186:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_PARA;
  1187:       i++;
  1188:       break;
  1189:     case 'o':
  1190:     case 'O':
  1191:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_ROD;
  1192:       i++;
  1193:       break;
  1194:     case 'p':
  1195:     case 'P':
  1196:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_PETRI;
  1197:       i++;
  1198:       break;
  1199:     case 'r':
  1200:     case 'R':
  1201:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_BREATH;
  1202:       i++;
  1203:       break;
  1204:     case 's':
  1205:     case 'S':
  1206:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_SPELL;
  1207:       i++;
  1208:       break;
  1209:     default:
  1210:       medit_disp_stats_menu(d);
  1211:       return;
  1212:     }
  1213:     if (i == 0)
  1214:       break;
  1215:     else if (i == 1)
  1216:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter new value : ");
  1217:     else if (i == -1)
  1218:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter new text :\r\n] ");
  1219:     else
  1220:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1221:     return;
  1222: 
  1223:   case OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT:
  1224:     if (dg_script_edit_parse(d, arg)) return;
  1225:     medit_disp_menu(d);
  1226:     return;
  1227: 
  1228:   case MEDIT_KEYWORD:
  1229:     smash_tilde(arg);
  1230:     if (GET_ALIAS(OLC_MOB(d)))
  1231:       free(GET_ALIAS(OLC_MOB(d)));
  1232:     GET_ALIAS(OLC_MOB(d)) = str_udup(arg);
  1233:     break;
  1234: 
  1235:   case MEDIT_S_DESC:
  1236:     smash_tilde(arg);
  1237:     if (GET_SDESC(OLC_MOB(d)))
  1238:       free(GET_SDESC(OLC_MOB(d)));
  1239:     GET_SDESC(OLC_MOB(d)) = str_udup(arg);
  1240:     break;
  1241: 
  1242:   case MEDIT_L_DESC:
  1243:     smash_tilde(arg);
  1244:     if (GET_LDESC(OLC_MOB(d)))
  1245:       free(GET_LDESC(OLC_MOB(d)));
  1246:     if (arg && *arg) {
  1247:       char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1248:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s\r\n", arg);
  1249:       GET_LDESC(OLC_MOB(d)) = strdup(buf);
  1250:     } else
  1251:       GET_LDESC(OLC_MOB(d)) = strdup("undefined");
  1252: 
  1253:     break;
  1254: 
  1255:   case MEDIT_D_DESC:
  1256:     /*
  1257:      * We should never get here.
  1258:      */
  1259:     cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1260:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: medit_parse(): Reached D_DESC case!");
  1261:     write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1262:     break;
  1263: 
  1264:   case MEDIT_NPC_FLAGS:
  1265:     if ((i = atoi(arg)) <= 0)
  1266:       break;
  1267:     else if ( (j = medit_get_mob_flag_by_number(i)) == -1) {
  1268:        write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
  1269:        write_to_output(d, "Enter mob flags (0 to quit) :");
  1270:        return;
  1271:     } else if (j <= NUM_MOB_FLAGS) {
  1272:       TOGGLE_BIT_AR(MOB_FLAGS(OLC_MOB(d)), (j));
  1273:     }
  1274:     medit_disp_mob_flags(d);
  1275:     return;
  1276: 
  1277:   case MEDIT_AFF_FLAGS:
  1278:     if ((i = atoi(arg)) <= 0)
  1279:       break;

  1926: 
  1927:   case MEDIT_LEVEL:
  1928:   {

  1931:

  1937:       return;
  1938:     }
  1939:     medit_disp_stats_menu(d);
  1940:     return;
  1941:   }
  1942: 
  1943:   case MEDIT_LEVEL_AUTOFILL_CONFIRM:
  1944:     switch (*arg) {
  1945:     case 'y':
  1946:     case 'Y':
  1947:       medit_autoroll_stats(d);
  1948:       OLC_VAL(d) = TRUE;
  1949:       break;
  1950:     case 'n':
  1951:     case 'N':
  1952:       break;
  1953:     default:
  1954:       write_to_output(d, "Please answer Y or N: ");
  1955:       return;
  1956:     }
  1957:     medit_disp_stats_menu(d);
  1958:     return;
  1959: 
  1960:   case MEDIT_ALIGNMENT:
  1961:     GET_ALIGNMENT(OLC_MOB(d)) = LIMIT(i, -1000, 1000);
  1962:     OLC_VAL(d) = TRUE;
  1963:     medit_disp_stats_menu(d);
  1964:     return;
  1965: 
  1966:   case MEDIT_COPY:
  1967:     if ((i = real_mobile(atoi(arg))) != NOWHERE) {
  1968:       medit_setup_existing(d, i);
  1969:     } else
  1970:       write_to_output(d, "That mob does not exist.\r\n");
  1971:     break;
  1972: 
  1973:   case MEDIT_DELETE:
  1974:     if (*arg == 'y' || *arg == 'Y') {
  1975:       if (delete_mobile(GET_MOB_RNUM(OLC_MOB(d))) != NOBODY)
  1976:         write_to_output(d, "Mobile deleted.\r\n");
  1977:       else
  1978:         write_to_output(d, "Couldn't delete the mobile!\r\n");
  1979: 
  1980:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1981:       return;
  1982:     } else if (*arg == 'n' || *arg == 'N') {
  1983:       medit_disp_menu(d);
  1984:       OLC_MODE(d) = MEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
  1985:       return;
  1986:     } else
  1987:       write_to_output(d, "Please answer 'Y' or 'N': ");
  1988:     break;
  1989: 
  1990:   default:
  1991:     /* We should never get here. */
  1992:     cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1993:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: medit_parse(): Reached default case!");
  1994:     write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1995:     break;
  1996:   }
  1997: 
  1998: /* END OF CASE If we get here, we have probably changed something, and now want
  1999:    to return to main menu.  Use OLC_VAL as a 'has changed' flag */
  2000: 
  2001:   OLC_VAL(d) = TRUE;
  2002:   medit_disp_menu(d);
  2003: }

  2005: void medit_string_cleanup(struct descriptor_data *d, int terminator)
  2006: {
  2007:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
  2008: 
  2009:   case MEDIT_D_DESC:
  2010:   default:
  2011:      medit_disp_menu(d);
  2012:      break;
  2013:   }
  2014: }
  2015: 
  2016: void medit_autoroll_stats(struct descriptor_data *d)
  2017: {
  2018:   int mob_lev;
  2019: 
  2020:   mob_lev = GET_LEVEL(OLC_MOB(d));
  2021:   mob_lev = GET_LEVEL(OLC_MOB(d)) = LIMIT(mob_lev, 1, LVL_IMPL);
  2022: 
  2023:   GET_MOVE(OLC_MOB(d))    = mob_lev * 5;                 /* HP addition baseline */
  2024:   GET_HIT(OLC_MOB(d))     = MAX(1, mob_lev / 6);         /* number of HP dice */
  2025:   GET_MANA(OLC_MOB(d))    = MAX(4, (mob_lev / 6) + 2);   /* size of HP dice */
  2026: 
  2027:   GET_NDD(OLC_MOB(d))     = MAX(1, (mob_lev + 4) / 8);   /* number of damage dice */
  2028:   GET_SDD(OLC_MOB(d))     = MAX(2, (mob_lev + 9) / 10);  /* size of damage dice */
  2029:   GET_DAMROLL(OLC_MOB(d)) = mob_lev / 12;                /* damage bonus */
  2030: 
  2031:   GET_HITROLL(OLC_MOB(d)) = mob_lev / 8;                 /* conservative early hit chance */
  2032:   OLC_MOB(d)->mob_specials.gold_min = MAX(0, mob_lev);
  2033:   OLC_MOB(d)->mob_specials.gold_max = MAX(OLC_MOB(d)->mob_specials.gold_min, mob_lev * 2);
  2034:   GET_AC(OLC_MOB(d))      = 20 + mob_lev;                /* gentler armor scaling */
  2035:   GET_EVASION(OLC_MOB(d)) = mob_lev / 3;                 /* conservative evasion */
  2036:   GET_MOB_WIMP_LEV(OLC_MOB(d)) = MAX(1, mob_lev / 2);    /* default flee threshold */
  2037: 
  2038:   /* 'Advanced' stats are only rolled if advanced options are enabled */
  2039:   if (CONFIG_MEDIT_ADVANCED) {
  2040:     GET_STR(OLC_MOB(d))     = LIMIT((mob_lev*2)/3, 11, 18); /* 2/3 level in range 11 to 18 */
  2041:     GET_INT(OLC_MOB(d))     = LIMIT((mob_lev*2)/3, 11, 18);
  2042:     GET_WIS(OLC_MOB(d))     = LIMIT((mob_lev*2)/3, 11, 18);
  2043:     GET_DEX(OLC_MOB(d))     = LIMIT((mob_lev*2)/3, 11, 18);
  2044:     GET_CON(OLC_MOB(d))     = LIMIT((mob_lev*2)/3, 11, 18);
  2045:     GET_CHA(OLC_MOB(d))     = LIMIT((mob_lev*2)/3, 11, 18);
  2046:     OLC_MOB(d)->real_abils.str   = GET_STR(OLC_MOB(d));
  2047:     OLC_MOB(d)->real_abils.intel = GET_INT(OLC_MOB(d));
  2048:     OLC_MOB(d)->real_abils.wis   = GET_WIS(OLC_MOB(d));
  2049:     OLC_MOB(d)->real_abils.dex   = GET_DEX(OLC_MOB(d));
  2050:     OLC_MOB(d)->real_abils.con   = GET_CON(OLC_MOB(d));
  2051:     OLC_MOB(d)->real_abils.cha   = GET_CHA(OLC_MOB(d));
  2052: 
  2053:     GET_SAVE(OLC_MOB(d), SAVING_PARA)   = mob_lev / 4;  /* All Saving throws */
  2054:     GET_SAVE(OLC_MOB(d), SAVING_ROD)    = mob_lev / 4;  /* set to a quarter  */
  2055:     GET_SAVE(OLC_MOB(d), SAVING_PETRI)  = mob_lev / 4;  /* of the mobs level */
  2056:     GET_SAVE(OLC_MOB(d), SAVING_BREATH) = mob_lev / 4;
  2057:     GET_SAVE(OLC_MOB(d), SAVING_SPELL)  = mob_lev / 4;
  2058:   }
  2059: 
  2060: }
