   249: static void perform_obj_aff_list(struct char_data * ch, char *arg)
   250: {
   251:   int num, i, apply, v1 = 0, found = 0;
   252:   size_t len = 0, tmp_len = 0;
   253:   struct obj_list_item lst[MAX_OBJ_LIST];
   254:   obj_rnum r_num;
   255:   obj_vnum ov;
   256:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   257: 
   258:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_LIST; i++) {
   259:     lst[i].vobj = NOTHING;
   260:     lst[i].val  = 0;
   261:   }
   262:   apply = atoi(arg);
   263: 
   264:   if (apply <= 0 || apply >= NUM_APPLIES) {
   265:      send_to_char(ch, "Not a valid affect");
   266:      return;
   267:   }                                   /* Special cases below */
   268:   else if ((apply == APPLY_CLASS) ||  /* olist affect 7 is Weapon Damage      */
   269:            (apply == APPLY_LEVEL) ) { /* olist affect 8 is AC-Apply for Armor */
   270:     for (num = 0; num <= top_of_objt; num++) {
   271:       if ((apply == APPLY_CLASS && obj_proto[num].obj_flags.type_flag == ITEM_WEAPON) ||
   272:           (apply == APPLY_LEVEL && obj_proto[num].obj_flags.type_flag == ITEM_ARMOR) ) {
   273:         ov = obj_index[num].vnum;
   274:         if (apply == APPLY_CLASS)
   275:           v1 = ((obj_proto[num].obj_flags.value[2]+1)*(obj_proto[num].obj_flags.value[1])/2);
   276:         else
   277:           v1 = (obj_proto[num].obj_flags.value[0]);
   278: 
   279:         if ((r_num = real_object(ov)) != NOTHING)
   280:           add_to_obj_list(lst, MAX_OBJ_LIST, ov, v1);
   281:       }
   282:     }
   283: 
   284:     if (apply == APPLY_CLASS)
   285:       len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Highest average damage per hit for Weapons\r\n");
   286:     else if (apply == APPLY_LEVEL)
   287:       len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Highest Armor for Armor\r\n");
   288: 
   289:     for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_LIST; i++){
   290:       if ((r_num = real_object(lst[i].vobj)) != NOTHING) {
   291:         tmp_len = snprintf(buf+len, sizeof(buf)-len, "%s%3d%s) %s[%s%5d%s] %s%3d %s%-*s %s[%s]%s%s\r\n",
   292:                   QGRN, ++found, QNRM, QCYN, QYEL, lst[i].vobj, QCYN,
   293:                   QYEL, lst[i].val, QCYN, 42+count_color_chars(obj_proto[num].short_description),
   294:                   obj_proto[r_num].short_description,
   295:                   QYEL, item_types[obj_proto[num].obj_flags.type_flag], QNRM,
   296:                   obj_proto[num].proto_script ? " [TRIG]" : "");
   297:         len += tmp_len;
   298:         if (len > sizeof(buf))
   299:           break;
   300:       }
   301:     }
   302:     page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   303:     return;  /* End of special-case handling */
   304:   }
   305:   /* Non-special cases, list objects by affect */
   306:   for (num = 0; num <= top_of_objt; num++){
   307:     for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; i++){
   308:       if (obj_proto[num].affected[i].modifier) {
   309:         if (obj_proto[num].affected[i].location == apply){
   310:           ov = obj_index[num].vnum;
   311:           v1 = obj_proto[num].affected[i].modifier;
   312: 
   313:           if ((r_num = real_object(ov)) != NOTHING)
   314:             add_to_obj_list(lst, MAX_OBJ_LIST, ov, v1);
   315:         }
   316:       }
   317:     }
   318:   }
   319:   len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Objects with highest %s affect\r\n", apply_types[(apply)]);
   320:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_OBJ_LIST; i++) {
   321:     if ((r_num = real_object(lst[i].vobj)) != NOTHING) {
   322:       tmp_len = snprintf(buf+len, sizeof(buf)-len, "%s%3d%s) %s[%s%8d%s] %s%3d %s%-*s %s[%s]%s%s\r\n",
   323:                 QGRN, ++found, QNRM, QCYN, QYEL, lst[i].vobj, QCYN,
   324:                 QYEL, lst[i].val, QCYN, 42+count_color_chars(obj_proto[num].short_description),
   325:                 obj_proto[r_num].short_description,
   326:                 QYEL, item_types[obj_proto[r_num].obj_flags.type_flag], QNRM,
   327:                 obj_proto[r_num].proto_script ? " [TRIG]" : "");
   328:       len += tmp_len;
   329:     }
   330:   }
   331:   page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   332: }
   333: 
   334: static void perform_obj_name_list(struct char_data * ch, char *arg)
   335: {
   336:   int num, found = 0;
   337:   size_t len = 0, tmp_len = 0;
   338:   obj_vnum ov;
   339:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   340: 
   341:   len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Objects with the name '%s'\r\n"
   342:   "Index VNum    Num   Object Name                                Object Type\r\n"
   343:   "----- ------- ----- ------------------------------------------ ----------------\r\n", arg);
   344:   for (num = 0; num <= top_of_objt; num++) {
   345:     if (is_name(arg, obj_proto[num].name)) {
   346:       ov = obj_index[num].vnum;
   347:       tmp_len = snprintf(buf+len, sizeof(buf)-len, "%s%4d%s) %s[%s%5d%s] %s(%s%3d%s)%s %-*s%s [%s]%s%s\r\n",
   348:                 QGRN, ++found, QNRM, QCYN, QYEL, ov, QCYN, QNRM,
   349:                 QGRN, obj_index[num].number, QNRM, QCYN, 42+count_color_chars(obj_proto[num].short_description),
   350:                 obj_proto[num].short_description, QYEL, item_types[obj_proto[num].obj_flags.type_flag], QNRM,
   351:                 obj_proto[num].proto_script ? " [TRIG]" : "");
   352:       len += tmp_len;
   353:       if (len > sizeof(buf))
   354:         break;
   355:     }
   356:   }
   357: 
   358:   page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   359: }

   361: /* Ingame Commands */
   362: ACMD(do_oasis_list)
   363: {
   364:   zone_rnum rzone = NOWHERE;
   365:   room_rnum vmin = NOWHERE;
   366:   room_rnum vmax = NOWHERE;
   367:   char smin[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   368:   char smax[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   369:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   370:   bool use_name = FALSE;
   371:   int i;
   372: 
   373:   two_arguments(argument, smin, smax);
   374: 
   375:   if (!*smin || *smin == '.') {
   376:     rzone = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone;
   377:   } else if (!*smax) {
   378:     rzone = real_zone(atoi(smin));
   379: 
   380:     if ((rzone == NOWHERE || rzone == 0) && subcmd == SCMD_OASIS_ZLIST && !isdigit(*smin)) {
   381:       /* Must be zlist, with builder name as arg */
   382:       use_name = TRUE;
   383:     } else if (rzone == NOWHERE) {
   384:       send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, there's no zone with that number\r\n");
   385:       return;
   386:     }
   387:   } else {
   388:     /* Listing by min vnum / max vnum.  Retrieve the numeric values. */
   389:     vmin = atoi(smin);
   390:     vmax = atoi(smax);
   391: 
   392:     if (vmin > vmax) {
   393:       send_to_char(ch, "List from %d to %d - Aren't we funny today!\r\n", vmin, vmax);
   394:       return;
   395:     }
   396:   }
   397: 
   398:   switch (subcmd) {
   399:     case SCMD_OASIS_MLIST:
   400:       two_arguments(argument, arg, arg2);
   401: 
   402:       if (is_abbrev(arg, "help")) {
   403:         send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %smlist <zone>%s        - List mobiles in a zone\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   404:         send_to_char(ch, "       %smlist <vnum> <vnum>%s - List a range of mobiles by vnum\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   405:         send_to_char(ch, "       %smlist level <num>%s   - List all mobiles of a specified level\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   406: 	    send_to_char(ch, "       %smlist flags <num>%s - List all mobiles with flag set\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   407: 		send_to_char(ch, "Just type %smlist flags%s to view available options.\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   408:         return;
   409:       }
   410:       else if (is_abbrev(arg, "level") || is_abbrev(arg, "flags")) {
   411:         if (!*arg2) {
   412:           send_to_char(ch, "Which mobile flag or level do you want to list?\r\n");
   413:           for (i = 0; i < NUM_MOB_FLAGS; i++) {
   414:             send_to_char(ch, "%s%2d%s-%s%-14s%s", CCNRM(ch, C_NRM), i, CCNRM(ch, C_NRM), CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), action_bits[i], CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   415:             if (!((i+1)%4))  send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   416:           }
   417:           send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   418:           send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %smlist flags <num>%s\r\n", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   419:           send_to_char(ch, "       %smlist level <num>%s\r\n", CCYEL(ch, C_NRM), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
   420:           send_to_char(ch, "Displays mobs with the selected flag, or at the selected level\r\n\r\n");
   421: 
   422:           return;
   423:         }
   424:         if (is_abbrev(arg, "level"))
   425:           perform_mob_level_list(ch, arg2);
   426:         else
   427:           perform_mob_flag_list(ch, arg2);
   428:       } else
   429:         list_mobiles(ch, rzone, vmin, vmax);
   430:       break;
   431:     case SCMD_OASIS_OLIST:
   432:       two_arguments(argument, arg, arg2);
   433: 
   434:       if (is_abbrev(arg, "help")) {
   435:         send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %solist <zone>%s        - List objects in a zone\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   436:         send_to_char(ch, "       %solist <vnum> <vnum>%s - List a range of objects by vnum\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   437:         send_to_char(ch, "       %solist <name>%s        - List all named objects with count\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   438:         send_to_char(ch, "       %solist type <num>%s    - List all objects of a specified type\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   439:         send_to_char(ch, "       %solist affect <num>%s  - List top %d objects with affect\r\n", QYEL, QNRM, MAX_OBJ_LIST);
   440:         send_to_char(ch, "Just type %solist affect%s or %solist type%s to view available options\r\n", QYEL, QNRM, QYEL, QNRM);
   441:         return;
   442:       } else if (is_abbrev(arg, "type") || is_abbrev(arg, "affect")) {
   443:         if (is_abbrev(arg, "type")) {
   444:           if (!*arg2) {
   445:             send_to_char(ch, "Which object type do you want to list?\r\n");
   446:             for (i=1; i<NUM_ITEM_TYPES; i++)
   447:             {
   448:               send_to_char(ch, "%s%2d%s-%s%-14s%s", QNRM, i, QNRM, QYEL, item_types[i], QNRM);
   449:               if (!(i%4))  send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   450:             }
   451:             send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   452:             send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %solist type <num>%s\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   453:             send_to_char(ch, "Displays objects of the selected type.\r\n");
   454: 
   455:             return;
   456:           }
   457:           perform_obj_type_list(ch, arg2);
   458:         } else {  /* Assume arg = affect */
   459:           if (!*arg2) {
   460:             send_to_char(ch, "Which object affect do you want to list?\r\n");
   461:             for (i = 0; i < NUM_APPLIES; i++) {
   462:               if (i == APPLY_CLASS)       /* Special Case 1 - Weapon Dam */
   463:                 send_to_char(ch, "%s%2d-%s%-14s%s", QNRM, i, QYEL, "Weapon Dam", QNRM);
   464:               else if (i == APPLY_LEVEL)  /* Special Case 2 - Armor Armor */
   465:                 send_to_char(ch, "%s%2d-%s%-14s%s", QNRM, i, QYEL, "Armor", QNRM);
   466:               else
   467:                 send_to_char(ch, "%s%2d-%s%-14s%s", QNRM, i, QYEL, apply_types[i], QNRM);
   468:               if (!((i+1)%4))  send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   469:             }
   470:             send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   471:             send_to_char(ch, "Usage: %solist affect <num>%s\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   472:             send_to_char(ch, "Displays top %d objects, in order, with the selected affect.\r\n", MAX_OBJ_LIST);
   473: 
   474:             return;
   475:           }
   476:           perform_obj_aff_list(ch, arg2);
   477:         }
   478:       } else if (*arg && !isdigit(*arg)) {
   479:         perform_obj_name_list(ch, arg);
   480:       } else
   481:         list_objects(ch, rzone, vmin, vmax);
   482:       break;
   483:     case SCMD_OASIS_RLIST: list_rooms(ch, rzone, vmin, vmax); break;
   484:     case SCMD_OASIS_TLIST: list_triggers(ch, rzone, vmin, vmax); break;
   485:     case SCMD_OASIS_SLIST: list_shops(ch, rzone, vmin, vmax); break;
   486:     case SCMD_OASIS_QLIST: list_quests(ch, rzone, vmin, vmax); break;
   487:     case SCMD_OASIS_ZLIST:
   488:       if (!*smin)        /* No args - list all zones */
   489:         list_zones(ch, NOWHERE, 0, zone_table[top_of_zone_table].number, NULL);
   490:       else if (use_name) /* Builder name as arg */
   491:         list_zones(ch, NOWHERE, 0, zone_table[top_of_zone_table].number, smin);
   492:       else               /* Numerical args */
   493:         list_zones(ch, rzone, vmin, vmax, NULL);
   494:       break;
   495:     default:
   496:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't list that!\r\n");
   497:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE,
   498:         "SYSERR: do_oasis_list: Unknown list option: %d", subcmd);
   499:   }
   500: }

   502: ACMD(do_oasis_links)
   503: {
   504:   zone_rnum zrnum;
   505:   zone_vnum zvnum;
   506:   room_rnum nr, to_room;
   507:   room_vnum first, last;
   508:   int j;
   509:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   510: 
   511:   skip_spaces(&argument);
   512:   one_argument(argument, arg);
   513: 
   514:   if (!*arg) {
   515:     send_to_char(ch,
   516:       "Syntax: links <zone_vnum> ('.' for zone you are standing in)\r\n");
   517:       return;
   518:     }
   519: 
   520:   if (!strcmp(arg, ".")) {
   521:     zrnum = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].zone;
   522:     zvnum = zone_table[zrnum].number;
   523:   } else {
   524:     zvnum = atoi(arg);
   525:     zrnum = real_zone(zvnum);
   526:   }
   527: 
   528:   if (zrnum == NOWHERE || zvnum == NOWHERE) {
   529:     send_to_char(ch, "No zone was found with that number.\n\r");
   530:     return;
   531:   }
   532: 
   533:   last  = zone_table[zrnum].top;
   534:   first = zone_table[zrnum].bot;
   535: 
   536:   send_to_char(ch, "Zone %d is linked to the following zones:\r\n", zvnum);
   537:   for (nr = 0; nr <= top_of_world && (GET_ROOM_VNUM(nr) <= last); nr++) {
   538:     if (GET_ROOM_VNUM(nr) >= first) {
   539:       for (j = 0; j < DIR_COUNT; j++) {
   540: 	if (world[nr].dir_option[j]) {
   541: 	  to_room = world[nr].dir_option[j]->to_room;
   542: 	  if (to_room != NOWHERE && (zrnum != world[to_room].zone))
   543: 	    send_to_char(ch, "%3d %-30s%s at %5d (%-5s) ---> %5d\r\n",
   544: 	      zone_table[world[to_room].zone].number,
   545: 	      zone_table[world[to_room].zone].name, QNRM,
   546: 	      GET_ROOM_VNUM(nr), dirs[j], world[to_room].number);
   547: 	}
   548:       }
   549:     }
   550:   }
   551: }

   553: /* Helper Functions */
   554: /* List all rooms in a zone. */
   555: static void list_rooms(struct char_data *ch, zone_rnum rnum, room_vnum vmin, room_vnum vmax)
   556: {
   557:   room_rnum i;
   558:   room_vnum bottom, top;
   559:   int j, counter = 0;
   560:   size_t len;
   561:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   562: 
   563:   /* Expect a minimum / maximum number if the rnum for the zone is NOWHERE. */
   564:   if (rnum != NOWHERE) {
   565:     bottom = zone_table[rnum].bot;
   566:     top    = zone_table[rnum].top;
   567:   } else {
   568:     bottom = vmin;
   569:     top    = vmax;
   570:   }
   571: 
   572:   len = strlcpy(buf,
   573:   "Index VNum    Room Name                                    Exits\r\n"
   574:   "----- ------- -------------------------------------------- -----\r\n",
   575:   sizeof(buf));
   576: 
   577:   if (!top_of_world)
   578:     return;
   579: 
   580:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_world; i++) {
   581: 
   582:     /** Check to see if this room is one of the ones needed to be listed.    **/
   583:     if ((world[i].number >= bottom) && (world[i].number <= top)) {
   584:       counter++;
   585: 
   586:       len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%4d) [%s%-5d%s] %s%-*s%s %s",
   587:                           counter, QGRN, world[i].number, QNRM,
   588:                           QCYN, count_color_chars(world[i].name)+44, world[i].name, QNRM,
   589:                           world[i].proto_script ? "[TRIG] " : ""
   590:                           );
   591: 
   592:       for (j = 0; j < DIR_COUNT; j++) {
   593:         if (W_EXIT(i, j) == NULL)
   594:           continue;
   595:         if (W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room == NOWHERE)
   596:           continue;
   597: 
   598:         if (world[W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room].zone != world[i].zone)
   599:           len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "(%s%d%s)", QYEL, world[W_EXIT(i, j)->to_room].number, QNRM);
   600: 
   601:       }
   602: 
   603:       len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "\r\n");
   604:       
   605:       if (len > sizeof(buf))
   606: 		break;
   607:     }
   608:   }
   609: 
   610:   if (counter == 0)
   611:     send_to_char(ch, "No rooms found for zone/range specified.\r\n");
   612:   else
   613:     page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   614: }

   616: /* List all mobiles in a zone. */
   617: static void list_mobiles(struct char_data *ch, zone_rnum rnum, mob_vnum vmin, mob_vnum vmax)
   618: {
   619:   mob_rnum i;
   620:   mob_vnum bottom, top;
   621:   int counter = 0;
   622:   size_t len;
   623:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   624: 
   625:   if (rnum != NOWHERE) {
   626:     bottom = zone_table[rnum].bot;
   627:     top    = zone_table[rnum].top;
   628:   } else {
   629:     bottom = vmin;
   630:     top    = vmax;
   631:   }
   632: 
   633:   len = strlcpy(buf,
   634:   "Index VNum    Mobile Name                                  Level\r\n"
   635:   "----- ------- -------------------------------------------- -----\r\n",
   636:   sizeof(buf));
   637: 
   638:   if (!top_of_mobt)
   639:     return;
   640: 
   641:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_mobt; i++) {
   642:     if (mob_index[i].vnum >= bottom && mob_index[i].vnum <= top) {
   643:       counter++;
   644: 
   645:       len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s%4d%s) [%s%-5d%s] %s%-*s %s[%4d]%s%s\r\n",
   646:                    QGRN, counter, QNRM, QGRN, mob_index[i].vnum, QNRM,
   647:                    QCYN, count_color_chars(mob_proto[i].player.short_descr)+44, mob_proto[i].player.short_descr,
   648:                    QYEL, mob_proto[i].player.level, QNRM,
   649:                    mob_proto[i].proto_script ? " [TRIG]" : ""
   650:               );
   651:       if (len > sizeof(buf))
   652: 		break;
   653:     }
   654:   }
   655: 
   656:   if (counter == 0)
   657:     send_to_char(ch, "None found.\r\n");
   658:   else
   659:     page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   660: }

   662: /* List all objects in a zone. */
   663: static void list_objects(struct char_data *ch, zone_rnum rnum, obj_vnum vmin, obj_vnum vmax)
   664: {
   665:   obj_rnum i;
   666:   obj_vnum bottom, top;
   667:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   668:   int counter = 0;
   669:   size_t len;
   670: 
   671:   if (rnum != NOWHERE) {
   672:     bottom = zone_table[rnum].bot;
   673:     top    = zone_table[rnum].top;
   674:   } else {
   675:     bottom = vmin;
   676:     top    = vmax;
   677:   }
   678: 
   679:   len = strlcpy(buf,
   680: 	"Index VNum    Object Name                                  Object Type\r\n"
   681: 	"----- ------- -------------------------------------------- ----------------\r\n",
   682: 	sizeof(buf));
   683: 
   684:   if (!top_of_objt)
   685:     return;
   686: 
   687:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_objt; i++) {
   688:     if (obj_index[i].vnum >= bottom && obj_index[i].vnum <= top) {
   689:       counter++;
   690: 
   691:       len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, "%s%4d%s) [%s%-5d%s] %s%-*s %s[%s]%s%s\r\n",
   692:                    QGRN, counter, QNRM, QGRN, obj_index[i].vnum, QNRM,
   693:                    QCYN, count_color_chars(obj_proto[i].short_description)+44, obj_proto[i].short_description, QYEL,
   694:                    item_types[obj_proto[i].obj_flags.type_flag], QNRM,
   695:                    obj_proto[i].proto_script ? " [TRIG]" : ""
   696:               );
   697: 
   698:       if (len > sizeof(buf))
   699: 		break;
   700:     }
   701:   }
   702: 
   703:   if (counter == 0)
   704:     send_to_char(ch, "None found.\r\n");
   705:   else
   706:     page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   707: }

   709: /* List all shops in a zone. */
   710: static void list_shops(struct char_data *ch, zone_rnum rnum, shop_vnum vmin, shop_vnum vmax)
   711: {
   712:   shop_rnum i;
   713:   shop_vnum bottom, top;
   714:   int j, counter = 0;
   715: 
   716:   if (rnum != NOWHERE) {
   717:     bottom = zone_table[rnum].bot;
   718:     top    = zone_table[rnum].top;
   719:   } else {
   720:     bottom = vmin;
   721:     top    = vmax;
   722:   }
   723: 
   724:   send_to_char (ch,
   725:   "Index VNum    RNum    Shop Room(s)\r\n"
   726:   "----- ------- ------- -----------------------------------------\r\n");
   727: 
   728:   for (i = 0; i <= top_shop; i++) {
   729:     if (SHOP_NUM(i) >= bottom && SHOP_NUM(i) <= top) {
   730:       counter++;
   731: 
   732:       /* the +1 is strange but fits the rest of the shop code */
   733:       send_to_char(ch, "%s%4d%s) [%s%-5d%s] [%s%-5d%s]",
   734:         QGRN, counter, QNRM, QGRN, SHOP_NUM(i), QNRM, QGRN, i + 1, QNRM);
   735: 
   736:       /* Thanks to Ken Ray for this display fix. -Welcor */
   737:       for (j = 0; SHOP_ROOM(i, j) != NOWHERE; j++)
   738:         send_to_char(ch, "%s%s[%s%-5d%s]%s",
   739:                       ((j > 0) && (j % 6 == 0)) ? "\r\n                      " : " ",
   740:                       QCYN, QYEL, SHOP_ROOM(i, j), QCYN, QNRM);
   741: 
   742:       if (j == 0)
   743:         send_to_char(ch, " %sNone.%s", QCYN, QNRM);
   744: 
   745:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   746:     }
   747:   }
   748: 
   749:   if (counter == 0)
   750:     send_to_char(ch, "None found.\r\n");
   751: }

   753: /* List all zones in the world (sort of like 'show zones'). */
   754: static void list_zones(struct char_data *ch, zone_rnum rnum, zone_vnum vmin, zone_vnum vmax, char *name)
   755: {
   756:   int counter = 0;
   757:   size_t len = 0, tmp_len = 0;
   758:   zone_rnum i;
   759:   zone_vnum bottom, top;
   760:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], room_range[32];
   761:   bool use_name=FALSE;
   762: 
   763:   bottom = vmin;
   764:   top    = vmax;
   765: 
   766:   if (rnum != NOWHERE) {
   767:     /* Only one parameter was supplied - just list that zone */
   768:      print_zone(ch, zone_table[rnum].number);
   769:     return;
   770:   } else if (name && *name) {
   771:     use_name = TRUE;
   772:     if (!vmin)
   773:       bottom = zone_table[0].number;                 /* Lowest Zone  */
   774:     if (!vmax)
   775:       top    = zone_table[top_of_zone_table].number; /* Highest Zone */
   776:   }
   777: 
   778:   len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
   779:   "Zone  Room Range     Zone Name                      Builder(s)\r\n"
   780:   "----  -------------  ------------------------------ --------------------------------------\r\n");
   781: 
   782:   if (!top_of_zone_table)
   783:     return;
   784: 
   785:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_zone_table; i++) {
   786:     if (zone_table[i].number >= bottom && zone_table[i].number <= top) {
   787:       if ((!use_name) || (is_name(name, zone_table[i].builders))) {
   788:         counter++;
   789: 
   790:         snprintf(room_range, sizeof(room_range), "%d-%d", zone_table[i].bot, zone_table[i].top);
   791:         tmp_len = snprintf(buf+len, sizeof(buf)-len, "%s%-4d%s  %s%-13s%s  %s%-*s %s%s%s\r\n",
   792:             QGRN, zone_table[i].number, QNRM, QGRN, room_range, QNRM,
   793:             QCYN, count_color_chars(zone_table[i].name)+30, zone_table[i].name,
   794:             QYEL, zone_table[i].builders ? zone_table[i].builders : "None.", QNRM);
   795:         len += tmp_len;
   796:         if (len > sizeof(buf))
   797:           break;
   798:       }
   799:     }
   800:   }
   801: 
   802:   if (!counter)
   803:     send_to_char(ch, "  None found within those parameters.\r\n");
   804:   else
   805:     page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
   806: }
   807: 
   808: /* Prints all of the zone information for the selected zone. */
   809: void print_zone(struct char_data *ch, zone_vnum vnum)
   810: {
   811:   zone_rnum rnum;
   812:   int size_rooms, size_objects, size_mobiles, size_quests, size_shops, size_trigs, i, largest_table;
   813:   room_vnum top, bottom;
   814:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   815: 
   816:   if ((rnum = real_zone(vnum)) == NOWHERE) {
   817:     send_to_char(ch, "Zone #%d does not exist in the database.\r\n", vnum);
   818:     return;
   819:   }
   820: 
   821:   /* Locate the largest of the three, top_of_world, top_of_mobt, or top_of_objt. */
   822:   if (top_of_world >= top_of_objt && top_of_world >= top_of_mobt)
   823:     largest_table = top_of_world;
   824:   else if (top_of_objt >= top_of_mobt && top_of_objt >= top_of_world)
   825:     largest_table = top_of_objt;
   826:   else
   827:     largest_table = top_of_mobt;
   828: 
   829:   /* Initialize some of the variables. */
   830:   size_rooms   = 0;
   831:   size_objects = 0;
   832:   size_mobiles = 0;
   833:   size_shops   = 0;
   834:   size_trigs   = 0;
   835:   top          = zone_table[rnum].top;
   836:   bottom       = zone_table[rnum].bot;
   837: 
   838:   for (i = 0; i <= largest_table; i++) {
   839:     if (i <= top_of_world)
   840:       if (world[i].zone == rnum)
   841:         size_rooms++;
   842: 
   843:     if (i <= top_of_objt)
   844:       if (obj_index[i].vnum >= bottom && obj_index[i].vnum <= top)
   845:         size_objects++;
   846: 
   847:     if (i <= top_of_mobt)
   848:       if (mob_index[i].vnum >= bottom && mob_index[i].vnum <= top)
   849:         size_mobiles++;
   850:   }
   851:   for (i = 0; i<= top_shop; i++)
   852:     if (SHOP_NUM(i) >= bottom && SHOP_NUM(i) <= top)
   853:       size_shops++;
   854: 
   855:   for (i = 0; i < top_of_trigt; i++)
   856:     if (trig_index[i]->vnum >= bottom && trig_index[i]->vnum <= top)
   857:       size_trigs++;
   858: 
   859:   size_quests = count_quests(bottom, top);
   860:   sprintbitarray(zone_table[rnum].zone_flags, zone_bits, ZN_ARRAY_MAX, buf);
   861: 
   862:   /* Display all of the zone information at once. */
   863:   send_to_char(ch,
   864:     "%sVirtual Number = %s%d\r\n"
   865:     "%sName of zone   = %s%s\r\n"
   866:     "%sBuilders       = %s%s\r\n"
   867:     "%sLifespan       = %s%d\r\n"
   868:     "%sAge            = %s%d\r\n"
   869:     "%sBottom of Zone = %s%d\r\n"
   870:     "%sTop of Zone    = %s%d\r\n"
   871:     "%sReset Mode     = %s%s\r\n"
   872:     "%sZone Flags     = %s%s\r\n"
   873:     "%sMin Level      = %s%d\r\n"
   874:     "%sMax Level      = %s%d\r\n"
   875:     "%sSize\r\n"
   876:     "%s   Rooms       = %s%d\r\n"
   877:     "%s   Objects     = %s%d\r\n"
   878:     "%s   Mobiles     = %s%d\r\n"
   879:     "%s   Shops       = %s%d\r\n"
   880:     "%s   Triggers    = %s%d\r\n"
   881:     "%s   Quests      = %s%d%s\r\n",
   882:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].number,
   883:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].name,
   884:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].builders,
   885:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].lifespan,
   886:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].age,
   887:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].bot,
   888:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].top,
   889:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].reset_mode ? ((zone_table[rnum].reset_mode == 1) ?
   890:     "Reset when no players are in zone." : "Normal reset.") : "Never reset",
   891:     QGRN, QCYN, buf, 
   892:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].min_level, 
   893:     QGRN, QCYN, zone_table[rnum].max_level,
   894:     QGRN,
   895:     QGRN, QCYN, size_rooms,
   896:     QGRN, QCYN, size_objects,
   897:     QGRN, QCYN, size_mobiles,
   898:     QGRN, QCYN, size_shops,
   899:     QGRN, QCYN, size_trigs,
   900:     QGRN, QCYN, size_quests, QNRM);
   901: }
   902: 
   903: /* List code by Ronald Evers. */
   904: static void list_triggers(struct char_data *ch, zone_rnum rnum, trig_vnum vmin, trig_vnum vmax)
   905: {
   906:   int i, bottom, top, counter = 0;
   907:   char trgtypes[256];
   908: 
   909:   /* Expect a minimum / maximum number if the rnum for the zone is NOWHERE. */
   910:   if (rnum != NOWHERE) {
   911:     bottom = zone_table[rnum].bot;
   912:     top    = zone_table[rnum].top;
   913:   } else {
   914:     bottom = vmin;
   915:     top    = vmax;
   916:   }
   917: 
   918: 
   919:   /* Store the header for the room listing. */
   920:   send_to_char (ch,
   921:   "Index VNum    Trigger Name                                  Type\r\n"
   922:   "----- ------- --------------------------------------------- ---------\r\n");
   923: 
   924:   /* Loop through the world and find each room. */
   925:   for (i = 0; i < top_of_trigt; i++) {
   926:     /** Check to see if this room is one of the ones needed to be listed.    **/
   927:     if ((trig_index[i]->vnum >= bottom) && (trig_index[i]->vnum <= top)) {
   928:       counter++;
   929: 
   930:       send_to_char(ch, "%4d) [%s%5d%s] %s%-45.45s%s ",
   931:         counter, QGRN, trig_index[i]->vnum, QNRM, QCYN, trig_index[i]->proto->name, QNRM);
   932: 
   933:       if (trig_index[i]->proto->attach_type == OBJ_TRIGGER) {
   934:         sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig_index[i]->proto), otrig_types, trgtypes, sizeof(trgtypes));
   935:         send_to_char(ch, "obj %s%s%s\r\n", QYEL, trgtypes, QNRM);
   936:       } else if (trig_index[i]->proto->attach_type==WLD_TRIGGER) {
   937:         sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig_index[i]->proto), wtrig_types, trgtypes, sizeof(trgtypes));
   938:         send_to_char(ch, "wld %s%s%s\r\n", QYEL, trgtypes, QNRM);
   939:       } else {
   940:         sprintbit(GET_TRIG_TYPE(trig_index[i]->proto), trig_types, trgtypes, sizeof(trgtypes));
   941:         send_to_char(ch, "mob %s%s%s\r\n", QYEL, trgtypes, QNRM);
   942:       }
   943: 
   944:     }
   945:   }
   946: 
   947:  if (counter == 0) {
   948:    if (rnum == NOWHERE)
   949:      send_to_char(ch, "No triggers found from %d to %d\r\n", vmin, vmax);
   950:    else
   951:      send_to_char(ch, "No triggers found for zone #%d\r\n", zone_table[rnum].number);
   952:   }
   953: }

    61: /* Utility and exported functions */
    62: ACMD(do_oasis_oedit)
    63: {
    64:   int number = NOWHERE, save = 0, real_num;
    65:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    66:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    67:   char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    68: 
    69:   /* No building as a mob or while being forced. */
    70:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
    71:     return;
    72: 
    73:   /* Parse any arguments. */
    74:   two_arguments(argument, buf1, buf2);
    75: 
    76:   /* If there aren't any arguments they can't modify anything. */
    77:   if (!*buf1) {
    78:     send_to_char(ch, "Specify an object VNUM to edit.\r\n");
    79:     return;
    80:   } else if (!isdigit(*buf1)) {
    81:     if (str_cmp("save", buf1) != 0) {
    82:       send_to_char(ch, "Yikes!  Stop that, someone will get hurt!\r\n");
    83:       return;
    84:     }
    85: 
    86:     save = TRUE;
    87: 
    88:     if (is_number(buf2))
    89:       number = atoi(buf2);
    90:     else if (GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) > 0) {
    91:       zone_rnum zlok;
    92: 
    93:       if ((zlok = real_zone(GET_OLC_ZONE(ch))) == NOWHERE)
    94:         number = NOWHERE;
    95:       else
    96:         number = genolc_zone_bottom(zlok);
    97:     }
    98: 
    99:     if (number == NOWHERE) {
   100:       send_to_char(ch, "Save which zone?\r\n");
   101:       return;
   102:     }
   103:   }
   104: 
   105:   /* If a numeric argument was given, get it. */
   106:   if (number == NOWHERE)
   107:     number = atoi(buf1);
   108: 
   109:   if (number < IDXTYPE_MIN || number > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
   110:     send_to_char(ch, "That object VNUM can't exist.\r\n");
   111:     return;
   112:   }
   113: 
   114:   /* Check that whatever it is isn't already being edited. */
   115:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   116:     if (STATE(d) == CON_OEDIT) {
   117:       if (d->olc && OLC_NUM(d) == number) {
   118:         send_to_char(ch, "That object is currently being edited by %s.\r\n",
   119:           PERS(d->character, ch));
   120:         return;
   121:       }
   122:     }
   123:   }
   124: 
   125:   /* Point d to the builder's descriptor (for easier typing later). */
   126:   d = ch->desc;
   127: 
   128:   /* Give the descriptor an OLC structure. */
   129:   if (d->olc) {
   130:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE,
   131:       "SYSERR: do_oasis: Player already had olc structure.");
   132:     free(d->olc);
   133:   }
   134: 
   135:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
   136: 
   137:   /* Find the zone. */
   138:   OLC_ZNUM(d) = save ? real_zone(number) : real_zone_by_thing(number);
   139:   if (OLC_ZNUM(d) == NOWHERE) {
   140:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, there is no zone for that number!\r\n");
   141: 
   142:     /* Free the descriptor's OLC structure. */
   143:     free(d->olc);
   144:     d->olc = NULL;
   145:     return;
   146:   }
   147: 
   148:   /* Everyone but IMPLs can only edit zones they have been assigned. */
   149:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, OLC_ZNUM(d))) {
   150:     send_cannot_edit(ch, zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   151:     /* Free the OLC structure. */
   152:     free(d->olc);
   153:     d->olc = NULL;
   154:     return;
   155:   }
   156: 
   157:   /* If we need to save, save the objects. */
   158:   if (save) {
   159:     send_to_char(ch, "Saving all objects in zone %d.\r\n",
   160:       zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   161:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
   162:       "OLC: %s saves object info for zone %d.", GET_NAME(ch),
   163:       zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   164: 
   165:     /* Save the objects in this zone. */
   166:     save_objects(OLC_ZNUM(d));
   167: 
   168:     /* Free the descriptor's OLC structure. */
   169:     free(d->olc);
   170:     d->olc = NULL;
   171:     return;
   172:   }
   173: 
   174:   OLC_NUM(d) = number;
   175: 
   176:   /* If a new object, setup new, otherwise setup the existing object. */
   177:   if ((real_num = real_object(number)) != NOTHING)
   178:     oedit_setup_existing(d, real_num);
   179:   else
   180:     oedit_setup_new(d);
   181: 
   182:   oedit_disp_menu(d);
   183:   STATE(d) = CON_OEDIT;
   184: 
   185:   /* Send the OLC message to the players in the same room as the builder. */
   186:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   187:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   188: 
   189:   /* Log the OLC message. */
   190:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "OLC: %s starts editing zone %d allowed zone %d",
   191:     GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, GET_OLC_ZONE(ch));
   192: }
   193: 
   194: static void oedit_setup_new(struct descriptor_data *d)
   195: {
   196:   CREATE(OLC_OBJ(d), struct obj_data, 1);
   197: 
   198:   clear_object(OLC_OBJ(d));
   199:   OLC_OBJ(d)->name = strdup("unfinished object");
   200:   OLC_OBJ(d)->description = strdup("An unfinished object is lying here.");
   201:   OLC_OBJ(d)->short_description = strdup("an unfinished object");
   202:   SET_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(OLC_OBJ(d)), ITEM_WEAR_TAKE);
   203:   OLC_VAL(d) = 0;
   204:   OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d) = OBJ_TRIGGER;
   205: 
   206:   SCRIPT(OLC_OBJ(d)) = NULL;
   207:   OLC_OBJ(d)->proto_script = OLC_SCRIPT(d) = NULL;
   208: }
   209: 
   210: void oedit_setup_existing(struct descriptor_data *d, int real_num)
   211: {
   212:   struct obj_data *obj;
   213: 
   214:   /* Allocate object in memory. */
   215:   CREATE(obj, struct obj_data, 1);
   216:   copy_object(obj, &obj_proto[real_num]);
   217: 
   218:   /* Attach new object to player's descriptor. */
   219:   OLC_OBJ(d) = obj;
   220:   OLC_VAL(d) = 0;
   221:   OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d) = OBJ_TRIGGER;
   222:   dg_olc_script_copy(d);
   223:   /* The edited obj must not have a script. It will be assigned to the updated
   224:    * obj later, after editing. */
   225:   SCRIPT(obj) = NULL;
   226:   OLC_OBJ(d)->proto_script = NULL;
   227: }
   228: 
   229: void oedit_save_internally(struct descriptor_data *d)
   230: {
   231:   int i;
   232:   obj_rnum robj_num;
   233:   struct descriptor_data *dsc;
   234:   struct obj_data *obj;
   235: 
   236:   i = (real_object(OLC_NUM(d)) == NOTHING);
   237: 
   238:   if ((robj_num = add_object(OLC_OBJ(d), OLC_NUM(d))) == NOTHING) {
   239:     log("oedit_save_internally: add_object failed.");
   240:     return;
   241:   }
   242:   builder_refs_invalidate();
   243: 
   244: 
   245:   /* Update triggers and free old proto list  */
   246:   if (obj_proto[robj_num].proto_script &&
   247:       obj_proto[robj_num].proto_script != OLC_SCRIPT(d))
   248:     free_proto_script(&obj_proto[robj_num], OBJ_TRIGGER);
   249:   /* this will handle new instances of the object: */
   250:   obj_proto[robj_num].proto_script = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
   251: 
   252:   /* this takes care of the objects currently in-game */
   253:   for (obj = object_list; obj; obj = obj->next) {
   254:     if (obj->item_number != robj_num)
   255:       continue;
   256:     /* remove any old scripts */
   257:     if (SCRIPT(obj))
   258:       extract_script(obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
   259: 
   260:     free_proto_script(obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
   261:     copy_proto_script(&obj_proto[robj_num], obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
   262:     assign_triggers(obj, OBJ_TRIGGER);
   263:   }
   264:   /* end trigger update */
   265: 
   266:   if (!i)	/* If it's not a new object, don't renumber. */
   267:     return;
   268: 
   269:   /* Renumber produce in shops being edited. */
   270:   for (dsc = descriptor_list; dsc; dsc = dsc->next)
   271:     if (STATE(dsc) == CON_SEDIT)
   272:       for (i = 0; S_PRODUCT(OLC_SHOP(dsc), i) != NOTHING; i++)
   273: 	if (S_PRODUCT(OLC_SHOP(dsc), i) >= robj_num)
   274: 	  S_PRODUCT(OLC_SHOP(dsc), i)++;
   275: 
   276: 
   277:   /* Update other people in zedit too. From: C.Raehl 4/27/99 */
   278:   for (dsc = descriptor_list; dsc; dsc = dsc->next)
   279:     if (STATE(dsc) == CON_ZEDIT)
   280:       for (i = 0; OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].command != 'S'; i++)
   281:         switch (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].command) {
   282:           case 'P':
   283:             OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].arg3 += (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].arg3 >= robj_num);
   284:             /* Fall through. */
   285:           case 'E':
   286:           case 'G':
   287:           case 'O':
   288:             OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].arg1 += (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].arg1 >= robj_num);
   289:             break;
   290:           case 'R':
   291:             OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].arg2 += (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[i].arg2 >= robj_num);
   292:             break;
   293:           default:
   294:           break;
   295:         }
   296: }
   297: 
   298: static void oedit_save_to_disk(int zone_num)
   299: {
   300:   save_objects(zone_num);
   301: }

   330: 	  "Extra desc menu\r\n"
   331: 	  "%s1%s) Keywords: %s%s\r\n"
   332: 	  "%s2%s) Description:\r\n%s%s\r\n"
   333: 	  "%s3%s) Goto next description: %s\r\n"
   334: 	  "%s0%s) Quit\r\n"
   335: 	  "Enter choice : ",
   336: 
   337:      	  grn, nrm, yel, (extra_desc->keyword && *extra_desc->keyword) ? extra_desc->keyword : "<NONE>",
   338: 	  grn, nrm, yel, (extra_desc->description && *extra_desc->description) ? extra_desc->description : "<NONE>",
   339: 	  grn, nrm, !extra_desc->next ? "Not set." : "Set.", grn, nrm);
   340:   OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_EXTRADESC_MENU;
   341: }

   343: /* Ask for *which* apply to edit. */
   344: static void oedit_disp_prompt_apply_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   345: {
   346:   char apply_buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   347:   int counter;
   348: 
   349:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   350:   clear_screen(d);
   351: 
   352:   for (counter = 0; counter < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; counter++) {
   353:     if (OLC_OBJ(d)->affected[counter].modifier) {
   354:       sprinttype(OLC_OBJ(d)->affected[counter].location, apply_types, apply_buf, sizeof(apply_buf));
   355:       write_to_output(d, " %s%d%s) %+d to %s\r\n", grn, counter + 1, nrm,
   356: 	      OLC_OBJ(d)->affected[counter].modifier, apply_buf);
   357:     } else {
   358:       write_to_output(d, " %s%d%s) None.\r\n", grn, counter + 1, nrm);
   359:     }
   360:   }
   361:   write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter affection to modify (0 to quit) : ");
   362:   OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_PROMPT_APPLY;
   363: }

   416: /* Object value #1 */
   417: static void oedit_disp_val1_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   418: {
   419:   OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_VALUE_1;
   420:   switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(OLC_OBJ(d))) {
   421:   case ITEM_LIGHT:
   422:     /* values 0 and 1 are unused.. jump to 2 */
   423:     oedit_disp_val3_menu(d);
   424:     break;
   425:   case ITEM_SCROLL:
   426:   case ITEM_WAND:
   427:   case ITEM_STAFF:
   428:   case ITEM_POTION:
   429:     write_to_output(d, "Spell level : ");
   430:     break;
   431:   case ITEM_WEAPON:
   432:     /* This doesn't seem to be used if I remember right. */
   433:     write_to_output(d, "Modifier to Hitroll : ");
   434:     break;
   435:   case ITEM_ARMOR:
   436:     write_to_output(d, "Apply to Armor : ");
   437:     break;
   438:   case ITEM_CONTAINER:
   439:     write_to_output(d, "Max weight to contain (-1 for unlimited) : ");
   440:     break;
   441:   case ITEM_DRINKCON:
   442:   case ITEM_FOUNTAIN:
   443:     write_to_output(d, "Max drink units (-1 for unlimited) : ");
   444:     break;
   445:   case ITEM_FOOD:
   446:     write_to_output(d, "Hunger restore amount: ");
   447:     break;
   448:   case ITEM_MONEY:
   449:     write_to_output(d, "Number of gold coins : ");
   450:     break;
   451:   case ITEM_FURNITURE:
   452:     write_to_output(d, "Regen multiplier (0/1 normal, 3 for triple) : ");
   453:     break;
   454:   case ITEM_NOTE:  // These object types have no 'values' so go back to menu
   455:   case ITEM_OTHER:
   456:   case ITEM_WORN:
   457:   case ITEM_TREASURE:
   458:   case ITEM_TRASH:
   459:   case ITEM_KEY:
   460:   case ITEM_PEN:
   461:   case ITEM_BOAT:
   462:   case ITEM_FREE:   /* Not implemented, but should be handled here */
   463:   case ITEM_FREE2:  /* Not implemented, but should be handled here */
   464:     oedit_disp_menu(d);
   465:     break;
   466:   default:
   467:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Reached default case in oedit_disp_val1_menu()!");
   468:     break;
   469:   }
   470: }

   580: /* Object extra flags. */
   581: static void oedit_format_extra_flags(struct obj_data *obj, char *bits, size_t bits_size)
   582: {
   583:   int display_flags[EF_ARRAY_MAX];
   584: 
   585:   memcpy(display_flags, GET_OBJ_EXTRA(obj), sizeof(display_flags));
   586:   REMOVE_BIT_AR(display_flags, ITEM_OFFHAND);
   587:   REMOVE_BIT_AR(display_flags, ITEM_TWO_HANDER);
   588:   sprintbitarray(display_flags, extra_bits, EF_ARRAY_MAX, bits);
   589:   bits[bits_size - 1] = '\0';
   590: }
   591: 
   592: static void oedit_format_wear_flags(struct obj_data *obj, char *bits, size_t bits_size)
   593: {
   594:   sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_WEAR(obj), wear_bits, TW_ARRAY_MAX, bits);
   595:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_OFFHAND))
   596:     strlcat(bits, " OFFHAND", bits_size);
   597:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_TWO_HANDER))
   598:     strlcat(bits, " TWO-HANDED", bits_size);
   599: }
   600: 
   601: static int oedit_extra_flag_from_menu_choice(int choice)
   602: {
   603:   int flag, visible_choice = 0;
   604: 
   605:   for (flag = 0; flag < NUM_ITEM_FLAGS; flag++) {
   606:     if (flag == ITEM_OFFHAND || flag == ITEM_TWO_HANDER)
   607:       continue;
   608:     if (++visible_choice == choice)
   609:       return flag;
   610:   }
   611:   return -1;
   612: }
   613: 
   614: static void oedit_disp_extra_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   615: {
   616:   char bits[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   617:   int counter, columns = 0, choice = 0;
   618: 
   619:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   620:   clear_screen(d);
   621: 
   622:   for (counter = 0; counter < NUM_ITEM_FLAGS; counter++) {
   623:     if (counter == ITEM_OFFHAND || counter == ITEM_TWO_HANDER)
   624:       continue;
   625:     write_to_output(d, "%s%2d%s) %-20.20s %s", grn, ++choice, nrm,
   626: 		extra_bits[counter], !(++columns % 2) ? "\r\n" : "");
   627:   }
   628:   oedit_format_extra_flags(OLC_OBJ(d), bits, sizeof(bits));
   629:   write_to_output(d, "\r\nObject flags: %s%s%s\r\n"
   630: 	  "Enter object extra flag (0 to quit) : ",
   631: 	  cyn, bits, nrm);
   632: }

   652: static void oedit_disp_wear_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   653: {
   654:   char bits[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];

   665:   write_to_output(d, "%s17%s) %-20.20s %s", grn, nrm, "TWO-HANDED", !(++columns % 2) ? "\r\n" : "");
   666:   oedit_format_wear_flags(OLC_OBJ(d), bits, sizeof(bits));

   670: 
   671: /* Display main menu. */
   672: static void oedit_disp_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   673: {
   674:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   675:   char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   676:   char regen_buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   677:   char regen_line[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   678:   struct obj_data *obj;
   679: 
   680:   obj = OLC_OBJ(d);
   681:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   682:   clear_screen(d);
   683: 
   684:   if (oedit_type_supports_regen_mult(GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj)))
   685:     snprintf(regen_buf, sizeof(regen_buf), "%d", GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0));
   686:   else
   687:     snprintf(regen_buf, sizeof(regen_buf), "N/A");
   688: 
   689:   if (oedit_type_supports_regen_mult(GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj)))
   690:     snprintf(regen_line, sizeof(regen_line), "%sR%s) Regen Mult  : %s%s\r\n", grn, nrm, cyn, regen_buf);
   691:   else
   692:     *regen_line = '\0';
   693: 
   694:   /* Build buffers for first part of menu. */
   695:   sprinttype(GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj), item_types, buf1, sizeof(buf1));
   696:   oedit_format_extra_flags(obj, buf2, sizeof(buf2));
   697: 
   698:   /* Build first half of menu. */
   699:   write_to_output(d,
   700: 	  "-- Item number : [%s%d%s]\r\n"
   701: 	  "%s1%s) Keywords : %s%s\r\n"
   702: 	  "%s2%s) S-Desc   : %s%s\r\n"
   703: 	  "%s3%s) L-Desc   :-\r\n%s%s\r\n"
   704: 	  "%s4%s) A-Desc   :-\r\n%s%s"
   705: 	  "%s5%s) Type        : %s%s\r\n"
   706: 	  "%s6%s) Extra flags : %s%s\r\n",
   707: 
   708: 	  cyn, OLC_NUM(d), nrm,
   709: 	  grn, nrm, yel, (obj->name && *obj->name) ? obj->name : "undefined",
   710: 	  grn, nrm, yel, (obj->short_description && *obj->short_description) ? obj->short_description : "undefined",
   711: 	  grn, nrm, yel, (obj->description && *obj->description) ? obj->description : "undefined",
   712: 	  grn, nrm, yel, (obj->action_description && *obj->action_description) ? obj->action_description : "Not Set.\r\n",
   713: 	  grn, nrm, cyn, buf1,
   714: 	  grn, nrm, cyn, buf2
   715: 	  );
   716:   /* Send first half then build second half of menu. */
   717:   oedit_format_wear_flags(OLC_OBJ(d), buf1, sizeof(buf1));
   718:   sprintbitarray(GET_OBJ_AFFECT(OLC_OBJ(d)), affected_bits, EF_ARRAY_MAX, buf2);
   719: 
   720:   write_to_output(d,
   721: 	  "%s7%s) Wear flags  : %s%s\r\n"
   722:           "%s8%s) Weight      : %s%d\r\n"
   723:           "%s9%s) Cost        : %s%d\r\n"
   724:           "%sA%s) Cost/Day (legacy, unused): %s%d\r\n"
   725:           "%sB%s) Timer       : %s%d\r\n"
   726:           "%s"
   727:           "%sC%s) Values      : %s%d %d %d %d%s\r\n"
   728:           "%sD%s) Applies menu\r\n"
   729:           "%sE%s) Extra descriptions menu: %s%s%s\r\n"
   730:           "%sM%s) Min Level   : %s%d\r\n"
   731:           "%sP%s) Perm Affects: %s%s\r\n"
   732: 	  "%sS%s) Script      : %s%s\r\n"
   733:           "%sY%s) References (read-only)\r\n"
   734:           "%sW%s) Copy object\r\n"
   735:           "%sX%s) Delete object\r\n"
   736: 	  "%sQ%s) Quit\r\n"
   737: 	  "Enter choice : ",
   738: 
   739: 	  grn, nrm, cyn, buf1,
   740:           grn, nrm, cyn, GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj),
   741:           grn, nrm, cyn, GET_OBJ_COST(obj),
   742:           grn, nrm, cyn, GET_OBJ_RENT(obj),
   743:           grn, nrm, cyn, GET_OBJ_TIMER(obj),
   744:           regen_line,
   745:           grn, nrm, cyn, GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 0),
   746:           GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1),
   747:           GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2),
   748: 	  GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 3),
   749:           GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj) == ITEM_FOOD ? " (hunger thirst sated poison)" : "",
   750: 	  grn, nrm, grn, nrm, cyn, obj->ex_description ? "Set." : "Not Set.", grn,
   751:           grn, nrm, cyn, GET_OBJ_LEVEL(obj),
   752:           grn, nrm, cyn, buf2,
   753:           grn, nrm, cyn, OLC_SCRIPT(d) ? "Set." : "Not Set.",
   754:           grn, nrm,
   755: 	  grn, nrm,
   756: 	  grn, nrm,
   757:           grn, nrm
   758:   );
   759:   OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
   760: }
   761: 
   762: /* main loop (of sorts).. basically interpreter throws all input to here. */
   763: void oedit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   764: {
   765:   int number, max_val, min_val;
   766:   char *oldtext = NULL;
   767: 
   768:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   769: 
   770:   case OEDIT_REFERENCES:
   771:     oedit_disp_menu(d);
   772:     return;
   773: 
   774:   case OEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   775:     switch (*arg) {
   776:     case 'y':
   777:     case 'Y':
   778:       oedit_save_internally(d);
   779:       mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE,
   780:               "OLC: %s edits obj %d", GET_NAME(d->character), OLC_NUM(d));
   781:       if (CONFIG_OLC_SAVE) {
   782:         oedit_save_to_disk(real_zone_by_thing(OLC_NUM(d)));
   783:         write_to_output(d, "Object saved to disk.\r\n");
   784:       } else
   785:         write_to_output(d, "Object saved to memory.\r\n");
   786:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   787:       return;
   788:     case 'n':
   789:     case 'N':
   790:       /* If not saving, we must free the script_proto list. */
   791:       OLC_OBJ(d)->proto_script = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
   792:       free_proto_script(OLC_OBJ(d), OBJ_TRIGGER);
   793:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   794:       return;
   795:     case 'a': /* abort quit */
   796:     case 'A':
   797:       oedit_disp_menu(d);
   798:       return;
   799:     default:
   800:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
   801:       write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : \r\n");
   802:       return;
   803:     }
   804: 
   805:   case OEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   806:     /* Throw us out to whichever edit mode based on user input. */
   807:     switch (*arg) {
   808:     case 'q':
   809:     case 'Q':
   810:       if (OLC_VAL(d)) {	/* Something has been modified. */
   811: 	write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   812: 	OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   813:       } else
   814: 	cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   815:       return;
   816:     case '1':
   817:       write_to_output(d, "Enter keywords : ");
   818:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_KEYWORD;
   819:       break;
   820:     case '2':
   821:       write_to_output(d, "Enter short desc : ");
   822:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_SHORTDESC;
   823:       break;
   824:     case '3':
   825:       write_to_output(d, "Enter long desc :-\r\n| ");
   826:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_LONGDESC;
   827:       break;
   828:     case '4':
   829:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_ACTDESC;
   830:       send_editor_help(d);
   831:       write_to_output(d, "Enter action description:\r\n\r\n");
   832:       if (OLC_OBJ(d)->action_description) {
   833: 	write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_OBJ(d)->action_description);
   834: 	oldtext = strdup(OLC_OBJ(d)->action_description);
   835:       }
   836:       string_write(d, &OLC_OBJ(d)->action_description, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH, 0, oldtext);
   837:       OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   838:       break;
   839:     case '5':
   840:       oedit_disp_type_menu(d);
   841:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_TYPE;
   842:       break;
   843:     case '6':
   844:       oedit_disp_extra_menu(d);
   845:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_EXTRAS;
   846:       break;
   847:     case '7':
   848:       oedit_disp_wear_menu(d);
   849:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_WEAR;
   850:       break;
   851:     case '8':
   852:       write_to_output(d, "Enter weight : ");
   853:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_WEIGHT;
   854:       break;
   855:     case '9':
   856:       write_to_output(d, "Enter cost : ");
   857:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_COST;
   858:       break;
   859:     case 'a':
   860:     case 'A':
   861:       write_to_output(d, "Enter cost per day (legacy/unused) : ");
   862:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_COSTPERDAY;
   863:       break;
   864:     case 'b':
   865:     case 'B':
   866:       write_to_output(d, "Enter timer : ");
   867:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_TIMER;
   868:       break;
   869:     case 'r':
   870:     case 'R':
   871:       if (!oedit_type_supports_regen_mult(GET_OBJ_TYPE(OLC_OBJ(d)))) {
   872:         write_to_output(d, "This object type does not support a regen multiplier.\r\n");
   873:         oedit_disp_menu(d);
   874:       } else {
   875:         write_to_output(d, "Enter regen multiplier (0/1 for normal) : ");
   876:         OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_REGEN_MULT;
   877:       }
   878:       break;
   879:     case 'c':
   880:     case 'C':
   881:       /* Clear any old values */
   882:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 0) = 0;
   883:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 1) = 0;
   884:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 2) = 0;
   885:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 3) = 0;
   886:       OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   887:       oedit_disp_val1_menu(d);
   888:       break;
   889:     case 'd':
   890:     case 'D':
   891:       oedit_disp_prompt_apply_menu(d);
   892:       break;
   893:     case 'e':
   894:     case 'E':
   895:       /* If extra descriptions don't exist. */
   896:       if (OLC_OBJ(d)->ex_description == NULL) {
   897: 	CREATE(OLC_OBJ(d)->ex_description, struct extra_descr_data, 1);
   898: 	OLC_OBJ(d)->ex_description->next = NULL;
   899:       }
   900:       OLC_DESC(d) = OLC_OBJ(d)->ex_description;
   901:       oedit_disp_extradesc_menu(d);
   902:       break;
   903:     case 'm':
   904:     case 'M':
   905:       write_to_output(d, "Enter new minimum level: ");
   906:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_LEVEL;
   907:       break;
   908:     case 'p':
   909:     case 'P':
   910:       oedit_disp_perm_menu(d);
   911:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_PERM;
   912:       break;
   913:     case 's':
   914:     case 'S':
   915:       OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_MAIN_MENU;
   916:       dg_script_menu(d);
   917:       return;
   918:     case 'y':
   919:     case 'Y':
   920:       builder_refs_display(d, BREF_OBJECT, OLC_NUM(d), "Object");
   921:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_REFERENCES;
   922:       return;
   923:     case 'w':
   924:     case 'W':
   925:       write_to_output(d, "Copy what object? ");
   926:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_COPY;
   927:       break;
   928:     case 'x':
   929:     case 'X':
   930:       write_to_output(d, "Are you sure you want to delete this object? ");
   931:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_DELETE;
   932:       break;
   933:     default:
   934:       oedit_disp_menu(d);
   935:       break;
   936:     }
   937:     return; /* end of OEDIT_MAIN_MENU */
   938: 
   939:   case OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT:
   940:     if (dg_script_edit_parse(d, arg)) return;
   941:     oedit_disp_menu(d);
   942:     return;
   943: 
   944:   case OEDIT_KEYWORD:
   945:     if (!genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   946:       break;
   947:     if (OLC_OBJ(d)->name)
   948:       free(OLC_OBJ(d)->name);
   949:     OLC_OBJ(d)->name = str_udup(arg);
   950:     break;
   951: 
   952:   case OEDIT_SHORTDESC:
   953:     if (!genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   954:       break;
   955:     if (OLC_OBJ(d)->short_description)
   956:       free(OLC_OBJ(d)->short_description);
   957:     OLC_OBJ(d)->short_description = str_udup(arg);
   958:     break;
   959: 
   960:   case OEDIT_LONGDESC:
   961:     if (!genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   962:       break;
   963:     if (OLC_OBJ(d)->description)
   964:       free(OLC_OBJ(d)->description);
   965:     OLC_OBJ(d)->description = str_udup(arg);
   966:     break;
   967: 
   968:   case OEDIT_TYPE:
   969:     number = atoi(arg);
   970:     if ((number < 0) || (number >= NUM_ITEM_TYPES)) {
   971:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice, try again : ");
   972:       return;
   973:     } else
   974:       GET_OBJ_TYPE(OLC_OBJ(d)) = number;
   975:     /* what's the boundschecking worth if we don't do this ? -- Welcor */
   976:     GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 0) = GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 1) =
   977:     GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 2) = GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 3) = 0;
   978:     break;
   979: 
   980:   case OEDIT_EXTRAS:
   981:     number = atoi(arg);
   982:     if (number < 0 || (number > 0 && oedit_extra_flag_from_menu_choice(number) < 0)) {
   983:       oedit_disp_extra_menu(d);
   984:       return;
   985:     } else if (number == 0)
   986:       break;
   987:     else {
   988:       TOGGLE_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(OLC_OBJ(d)), oedit_extra_flag_from_menu_choice(number));
   989:       oedit_disp_extra_menu(d);
   990:       return;
   991:     }
   992: 
   993:   case OEDIT_WEAR:
   994:     number = atoi(arg);
   995:     if ((number < 0) || (number > NUM_ITEM_WEARS + 2)) {
   996:       write_to_output(d, "That's not a valid choice!\r\n");
   997:       oedit_disp_wear_menu(d);
   998:       return;
   999:     } else if (number == 0)	/* Quit. */
  1000:       break;
  1001:     else {
  1002:       if (number == NUM_ITEM_WEARS + 1) {
  1003:         if (!OBJ_FLAGGED(OLC_OBJ(d), ITEM_OFFHAND) && OBJ_FLAGGED(OLC_OBJ(d), ITEM_TWO_HANDER)) {
  1004:           REMOVE_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(OLC_OBJ(d)), ITEM_TWO_HANDER);
  1005:           write_to_output(d, "TWO-HANDED cleared: OFFHAND weapons must be one-handed.\r\n");
  1006:         }
  1007:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(OLC_OBJ(d)), ITEM_OFFHAND);
  1008:       } else if (number == NUM_ITEM_WEARS + 2) {
  1009:         if (!OBJ_FLAGGED(OLC_OBJ(d), ITEM_TWO_HANDER) && OBJ_FLAGGED(OLC_OBJ(d), ITEM_OFFHAND)) {
  1010:           REMOVE_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(OLC_OBJ(d)), ITEM_OFFHAND);
  1011:           write_to_output(d, "OFFHAND cleared: TWO-HANDED weapons require both hands.\r\n");
  1012:         }
  1013:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_EXTRA(OLC_OBJ(d)), ITEM_TWO_HANDER);
  1014:       }
  1015:       else
  1016:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_WEAR(OLC_OBJ(d)), (number - 1));
  1017:       oedit_disp_wear_menu(d);
  1018:       return;
  1019:     }
  1020: 
  1021:   case OEDIT_WEIGHT:
  1022:     GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(OLC_OBJ(d)) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, MAX_OBJ_WEIGHT);
  1023:     break;
  1024: 
  1025:   case OEDIT_COST:
  1026:     GET_OBJ_COST(OLC_OBJ(d)) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, MAX_OBJ_COST);
  1027:     break;
  1028: 
  1029:   case OEDIT_COSTPERDAY:
  1030:     GET_OBJ_RENT(OLC_OBJ(d)) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, MAX_OBJ_RENT);
  1031:     break;
  1032: 
  1033:   case OEDIT_TIMER:
  1034:     GET_OBJ_TIMER(OLC_OBJ(d)) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, MAX_OBJ_TIMER);
  1035:     break;
  1036: 
  1037:   case OEDIT_REGEN_MULT:
  1038:     GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 0) = MAX(0, atoi(arg));
  1039:     break;
  1040: 
  1041:   case OEDIT_LEVEL:
  1042:     GET_OBJ_LEVEL(OLC_OBJ(d)) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, LVL_IMPL);
  1043:     break;
  1044: 
  1045:   case OEDIT_PERM:
  1046:     if ((number = atoi(arg)) == 0)
  1047:       break;
  1048:     if (number > 0 && number < NUM_AFF_FLAGS) {
  1049:       /* Setting AFF_CHARM on objects like this is dangerous. */
  1050:       if (number != AFF_CHARM) {
  1051:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(GET_OBJ_AFFECT(OLC_OBJ(d)), number);
  1052:       }
  1053:     }
  1054:     oedit_disp_perm_menu(d);
  1055:     return;
  1056: 
  1057:   case OEDIT_VALUE_1:
  1058:     number = atoi(arg);
  1059:     switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(OLC_OBJ(d))) {
  1060:     case ITEM_FURNITURE:
  1061:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 0) = MAX(number, 0);
  1062:       oedit_disp_val2_menu(d);
  1063:       return;
  1064:     case ITEM_WEAPON:
  1065:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 0) = MAX(atoi(arg), 0);
  1066:       break;
  1067:     case ITEM_CONTAINER:
  1068:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 0) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), -1, MAX_CONTAINER_SIZE);
  1069:       break;
  1070:     default:
  1071:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 0) = atoi(arg);
  1072:     }
  1073:     /* proceed to menu 2 */
  1074:     oedit_disp_val2_menu(d);
  1075:     return;
  1076:   case OEDIT_VALUE_2:
  1077:     /* Here, I do need to check for out of range values. */
  1078:     number = atoi(arg);
  1079:     switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(OLC_OBJ(d))) {
  1080:     case ITEM_SCROLL:
  1081:     case ITEM_POTION:
  1082:       if (number == 0 || number == -1)
  1083: 	GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 1) = -1;
  1084:       else
  1085: 	GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 1) = LIMIT(number, 1, NUM_SPELLS);
  1086: 
  1087:       oedit_disp_val3_menu(d);
  1088:       break;
  1089:     case ITEM_CONTAINER:
  1090:       /* Needs some special handling since we are dealing with flag values here. */
  1091:       if (number < 0 || number > 4)
  1092: 	oedit_disp_container_flags_menu(d);
  1093:       else if (number != 0) {
  1094:         TOGGLE_BIT(GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 1), 1 << (number - 1));
  1095:         OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
  1096: 	oedit_disp_val2_menu(d);
  1097:       } else
  1098: 	oedit_disp_val3_menu(d);
  1099:       break;
  1100:     case ITEM_WEAPON:
  1101:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 1) = LIMIT(number, 1, MAX_WEAPON_NDICE);
  1102:       oedit_disp_val3_menu(d);
  1103:       break;
  1104: 
  1105:     case ITEM_FURNITURE:
  1106:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 1) = LIMIT(number, 0, MAX_PEOPLE);
  1107:       oedit_disp_val3_menu(d);
  1108:       break;
  1109: 
  1110:     default:
  1111:       GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 1) = number;
  1112:       oedit_disp_val3_menu(d);
  1113:     }
  1114:     return;
  1115: 
  1116:   case OEDIT_VALUE_3:
  1117:     number = atoi(arg);
  1118:     /* Quick'n'easy error checking. */
  1119:     switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(OLC_OBJ(d))) {
  1120:     case ITEM_SCROLL:
  1121:     case ITEM_POTION:
  1122:       if (number == 0 || number == -1) {
  1123: 	GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 2) = -1;
  1124: 	oedit_disp_val4_menu(d);
  1125: 	return;
  1126:       }
  1127:       min_val = 1;
  1128:       max_val = NUM_SPELLS;
  1129:       break;
  1130:     case ITEM_WEAPON:
  1131:       min_val = 1;
  1132:       max_val = MAX_WEAPON_SDICE;
  1133:       break;
  1134:     case ITEM_WAND:
  1135:     case ITEM_STAFF:
  1136:       min_val = 0;
  1137:       max_val = 20;
  1138:       break;
  1139:     case ITEM_DRINKCON:
  1140:     case ITEM_FOUNTAIN:
  1141:       min_val = 0;
  1142:       max_val = NUM_LIQ_TYPES - 1;
  1143:       number--;
  1144:       break;
  1145:     case ITEM_KEY:
  1146:       min_val = 0;
  1147:       max_val = 65099;
  1148:       break;
  1149:     default:
  1150:       min_val = -65000;
  1151:       max_val = 65000;
  1152:     }
  1153:     GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 2) = LIMIT(number, min_val, max_val);
  1154:     oedit_disp_val4_menu(d);
  1155:     return;
  1156: 
  1157:   case OEDIT_VALUE_4:
  1158:     number = atoi(arg);
  1159:     switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(OLC_OBJ(d))) {
  1160:     case ITEM_SCROLL:
  1161:     case ITEM_POTION:
  1162:       if (number == 0 || number == -1) {
  1163: 	GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 3) = -1;
  1164:         oedit_disp_menu(d);
  1165: 	return;
  1166:       }
  1167:       min_val = 1;
  1168:       max_val = NUM_SPELLS;
  1169:       break;
  1170:     case ITEM_WAND:
  1171:     case ITEM_STAFF:
  1172:       min_val = 1;
  1173:       max_val = NUM_SPELLS;
  1174:       break;
  1175:     case ITEM_WEAPON:
  1176:       min_val = 0;
  1177:       max_val = NUM_ATTACK_TYPES - 1;
  1178:       break;
  1179:     default:
  1180:       min_val = -65000;
  1181:       max_val = 65000;
  1182:       break;
  1183:     }
  1184:     GET_OBJ_VAL(OLC_OBJ(d), 3) = LIMIT(number, min_val, max_val);
  1185:     break;
  1186: 
  1187:   case OEDIT_PROMPT_APPLY:
  1188:     if ((number = atoi(arg)) == 0)
  1189:       break;
  1190:     else if (number < 0 || number > MAX_OBJ_AFFECT) {
  1191:       oedit_disp_prompt_apply_menu(d);
  1192:       return;
  1193:     }
  1194:     OLC_VAL(d) = number - 1;
  1195:     OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_APPLY;
  1196:     oedit_disp_apply_menu(d);
  1197:     return;
  1198: 
  1199:   case OEDIT_APPLY:
  1200:     if (((number = atoi(arg)) == 0) || ((number = atoi(arg)) == 1)) {
  1201:       OLC_OBJ(d)->affected[OLC_VAL(d)].location = 0;
  1202:       OLC_OBJ(d)->affected[OLC_VAL(d)].modifier = 0;
  1203:       oedit_disp_prompt_apply_menu(d);
  1204:     } else if (number < 0 || number > NUM_APPLIES)
  1205:       oedit_disp_apply_menu(d);
  1206:     else {
  1207:       int counter;
  1208: 
  1209:       /* add in check here if already applied.. deny builders another */
  1210:       if (GET_LEVEL(d->character) < LVL_IMPL) {
  1211:         for (counter = 0; counter < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; counter++) {
  1212:           if (OLC_OBJ(d)->affected[counter].location == number) {
  1213:             write_to_output(d, "Object already has that apply.");
  1214:             return;
  1215:           }
  1216:         }
  1217:       }
  1218: 
  1219:       OLC_OBJ(d)->affected[OLC_VAL(d)].location = number - 1;
  1220:       write_to_output(d, "Modifier : ");
  1221:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_APPLYMOD;
  1222:     }
  1223:     return;
  1224: 
  1225:   case OEDIT_APPLYMOD:
  1226:     OLC_OBJ(d)->affected[OLC_VAL(d)].modifier = atoi(arg);
  1227:     oedit_disp_prompt_apply_menu(d);
  1228:     return;
  1229: 
  1230:   case OEDIT_EXTRADESC_KEY:
  1231:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg)) {
  1232:       if (OLC_DESC(d)->keyword)
  1233:         free(OLC_DESC(d)->keyword);
  1234:       OLC_DESC(d)->keyword = str_udup(arg);
  1235:     }
  1236:     oedit_disp_extradesc_menu(d);
  1237:     return;
  1238: 
  1239:   case OEDIT_EXTRADESC_MENU:
  1240:     switch ((number = atoi(arg))) {
  1241:     case 0:
  1242:       if (!OLC_DESC(d)->keyword || !OLC_DESC(d)->description) {
  1243:         struct extra_descr_data *temp;
  1244: 
  1245: 	if (OLC_DESC(d)->keyword)
  1246: 	  free(OLC_DESC(d)->keyword);
  1247: 	if (OLC_DESC(d)->description)
  1248: 	  free(OLC_DESC(d)->description);
  1249: 
  1250: 	/* Clean up pointers */
  1251: 	REMOVE_FROM_LIST(OLC_DESC(d), OLC_OBJ(d)->ex_description, next);
  1252: 	free(OLC_DESC(d));
  1253: 	OLC_DESC(d) = NULL;
  1254:       }
  1255:     break;
  1256: 
  1257:     case 1:
  1258:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_EXTRADESC_KEY;
  1259:       write_to_output(d, "Enter keywords, separated by spaces :-\r\n| ");
  1260:       return;
  1261: 
  1262:     case 2:
  1263:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_EXTRADESC_DESCRIPTION;
  1264:       send_editor_help(d);
  1265:       write_to_output(d, "Enter the extra description:\r\n\r\n");
  1266:       if (OLC_DESC(d)->description) {
  1267: 	write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_DESC(d)->description);
  1268: 	oldtext = strdup(OLC_DESC(d)->description);
  1269:       }
  1270:       string_write(d, &OLC_DESC(d)->description, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH, 0, oldtext);
  1271:       OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
  1272:       return;
  1273: 
  1274:     case 3:
  1275:       /* Only go to the next description if this one is finished. */
  1276:       if (OLC_DESC(d)->keyword && OLC_DESC(d)->description) {
  1277: 	struct extra_descr_data *new_extra;
  1278: 
  1279: 	if (OLC_DESC(d)->next)
  1280: 	  OLC_DESC(d) = OLC_DESC(d)->next;
  1281: 	else {	/* Make new extra description and attach at end. */
  1282: 	  CREATE(new_extra, struct extra_descr_data, 1);
  1283: 	  OLC_DESC(d)->next = new_extra;
  1284: 	  OLC_DESC(d) = OLC_DESC(d)->next;
  1285: 	}
  1286:       }
  1287:       /* No break - drop into default case. */
  1288:     default:
  1289:       oedit_disp_extradesc_menu(d);
  1290:       return;
  1291:     }
  1292:     break;
  1293: 
  1294:   case OEDIT_COPY:
  1295:     if ((number = real_object(atoi(arg))) != NOTHING) {
  1296:       oedit_setup_existing(d, number);
  1297:     } else
  1298:       write_to_output(d, "That object does not exist.\r\n");
  1299:     break;
  1300: 
  1301:   case OEDIT_DELETE:
  1302:     if (*arg == 'y' || *arg == 'Y') {
  1303:       if (delete_object(GET_OBJ_RNUM(OLC_OBJ(d))) != NOTHING)
  1304:         write_to_output(d, "Object deleted.\r\n");
  1305:       else
  1306:         write_to_output(d, "Couldn't delete the object!\r\n");
  1307: 
  1308:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1309:     } else if (*arg == 'n' || *arg == 'N') {
  1310:       oedit_disp_menu(d);
  1311:       OLC_MODE(d) = OEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
  1312:     } else
  1313:       write_to_output(d, "Please answer 'Y' or 'N': ");
  1314:     return;
  1315:   default:
  1316:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: Reached default case in oedit_parse()!");
  1317:     write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1318:     break;
  1319:   }
  1320: 
  1321:   /* If we get here, we have changed something. */
  1322:   OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
  1323:   oedit_disp_menu(d);
  1324: }

    63: static int ensure_player_storage(void)
    64: {
    65:   static const char *dirs[] = { LIB_PLRFILES, LIB_PLRFILES "A-E", LIB_PLRFILES "F-J",
    66:     LIB_PLRFILES "K-O", LIB_PLRFILES "P-T", LIB_PLRFILES "U-Z", LIB_PLRFILES "ZZZ" };
    67:   size_t i;
    68: 
    69:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(dirs) / sizeof(dirs[0]); i++)
    70:     if (mkdir(dirs[i], 0755) == -1 && errno != EEXIST) {
    71:       log("SYSERR: player storage: mkdir %s failed: %s", dirs[i], strerror(errno));
    72:       return FALSE;
    73:     }
    74:   return TRUE;
    75: }
    76: 
    77: /* New version to build player index for ASCII Player Files. Generate index
    78:  * table for the player file. */
    79: void build_player_index(void)
    80: {
    81:   int rec_count = 0, i;
    82:   FILE *plr_index;
    83:   char index_name[40], line[256], bits[64];
    84:   char arg2[80];
    85: 
    86:   if (!ensure_player_storage()) {
    87:     top_of_p_table = -1;
    88:     return;
    89:   }
    90:   snprintf(index_name, sizeof(index_name), "%s%s", LIB_PLRFILES, INDEX_FILE);
    91:   log("Player persistence: loading index %s (player root %s)", index_name, LIB_PLRFILES);
    92:   if (!(plr_index = fopen(index_name, "r"))) {
    93:     top_of_p_table = -1;
    94:     log("No player index file!  First new char will be IMP!");
    95:     return;
    96:   }
    97: 
    98:   while (get_line(plr_index, line))
    99:     if (*line != '~')
   100:       rec_count++;
   101:   rewind(plr_index);
   102: 
   103:   if (rec_count == 0) {
   104:     player_table = NULL;
   105:     top_of_p_table = -1;
   106:     return;
   107:   }
   108: 
   109:   CREATE(player_table, struct player_index_element, rec_count);
   110:   for (i = 0; i < rec_count; i++) {
   111:     get_line(plr_index, line);
   112:     sscanf(line, "%ld %s %d %s %ld", &player_table[i].id, arg2,
   113:       &player_table[i].level, bits, (long *)&player_table[i].last);
   114:     CREATE(player_table[i].name, char, strlen(arg2) + 1);
   115:     strcpy(player_table[i].name, arg2);
   116:     player_table[i].flags = asciiflag_conv(bits);
   117:     top_idnum = MAX(top_idnum, player_table[i].id);
   118:   }
   119: 
   120:   fclose(plr_index);
   121:   top_of_p_file = top_of_p_table = i - 1;
   122:   log("Player persistence: loaded %d player index record%s", i, i == 1 ? "" : "s");
   123: }
   124: 
   125: /* Create a new entry in the in-memory index table for the player file. If the
   126:  * name already exists, by overwriting a deleted character, then we re-use the
   127:  * old position. */
   128: int create_entry(char *name)
   129: {
   130:   int i, pos;
   131: 
   132:   if (top_of_p_table == -1) {	/* no table */
   133:     pos = top_of_p_table = 0;
   134:     CREATE(player_table, struct player_index_element, 1);
   135:   } else if ((pos = get_ptable_by_name(name)) == -1) {	/* new name */
   136:     i = ++top_of_p_table + 1;
   137: 
   138:     RECREATE(player_table, struct player_index_element, i);
   139:     pos = top_of_p_table;
   140:   }
   141: 
   142:   CREATE(player_table[pos].name, char, strlen(name) + 1);
   143: 
   144:   /* copy lowercase equivalent of name to table field */
   145:   for (i = 0; (player_table[pos].name[i] = LOWER(name[i])); i++)
   146:     /* Nothing */;
   147: 
   148:   /* clear the bitflag in case we have garbage data */
   149:   player_table[pos].flags = 0;
   150: 
   151:   return (pos);
   152: }
   153: 
   154: /* Called after create_entry().  Slot zero alone is ambiguous: it means one
   155:  * record, not an empty table.  Also refuse elevation if an orphaned .plr file
   156:  * proves that a broken/missing index hid an existing real character. */
   157: int first_player_record_is_new(int pfilepos)
   158: {
   159:   static const char *buckets[] = { "A-E", "F-J", "K-O", "P-T", "U-Z", "ZZZ" };
   160:   DIR *dir;
   161:   struct dirent *entry;
   162:   char path[PATH_MAX];
   163:   size_t i, len;
   164: 
   165:   if (top_of_p_table != 0 || pfilepos != 0)
   166:     return FALSE;
   167:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(buckets) / sizeof(buckets[0]); i++) {
   168:     snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s%s", LIB_PLRFILES, buckets[i]);
   169:     if (!(dir = opendir(path)))
   170:       continue;
   171:     while ((entry = readdir(dir))) {
   172:       len = strlen(entry->d_name);
   173:       if (len > 4 && !strcmp(entry->d_name + len - 4, "." SUF_PLR)) {
   174:         closedir(dir);
   175:         return FALSE;
   176:       }
   177:     }
   178:     closedir(dir);
   179:   }
   180:   return TRUE;
   181: }
   182: 
   183: 
   184: /* Remove an entry from the in-memory player index table.               *
   185:  * Requires the 'pos' value returned by the get_ptable_by_name function */
   186: static void remove_player_from_index(int pos)
   187: {
   188:   int i;
   189: 
   190:   if (pos < 0 || pos > top_of_p_table)
   191:     return;
   192: 
   193:   /* We only need to free the name string */
   194:   free(PT_PNAME(pos));
   195: 
   196:   /* Move every other item in the list down the index */
   197:   for (i = pos+1; i <= top_of_p_table; i++) {
   198:     PT_PNAME(i-1) = PT_PNAME(i);
   199:     PT_IDNUM(i-1) = PT_IDNUM(i);
   200:     PT_LEVEL(i-1) = PT_LEVEL(i);
   201:     PT_FLAGS(i-1) = PT_FLAGS(i);
   202:     PT_LLAST(i-1) = PT_LLAST(i);
   203:   }
   204:   PT_PNAME(top_of_p_table) = NULL;
   205: 
   206:   /* Reduce the index table counter */
   207:   top_of_p_table--;
   208: 
   209:   /* And reduce the size of the table */
   210:   if (top_of_p_table >= 0)
   211:     RECREATE(player_table, struct player_index_element, (top_of_p_table+1));
   212:   else {
   213:     free(player_table);
   214:     player_table = NULL;
   215:   }
   216: }
   217: 
   218: /* This function necessary to save a seperate ASCII player index */
   219: int save_player_index(void)
   220: {
   221:   int i;
   222:   char index_name[50], bits[64];
   223:   FILE *index_file;
   224: 
   225:   if (!ensure_player_storage())
   226:     return FALSE;
   227:   snprintf(index_name, sizeof(index_name), "%s%s", LIB_PLRFILES, INDEX_FILE);
   228:   if (!(index_file = fopen(index_name, "w"))) {
   229:     log("SYSERR: Could not write player index file %s: %s", index_name, strerror(errno));
   230:     return FALSE;
   231:   }
   232: 
   233:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_p_table; i++)
   234:     if (*player_table[i].name) {
   235:       sprintascii(bits, player_table[i].flags);
   236:       fprintf(index_file, "%ld %s %d %s %ld\n", player_table[i].id,
   237: 	player_table[i].name, player_table[i].level, *bits ? bits : "0",
   238:         (long)player_table[i].last);
   239:     }
   240:   fprintf(index_file, "~\n");
   241: 
   242:   i = fflush(index_file);
   243:   if (i == 0 && fsync(fileno(index_file)) != 0)
   244:     i = -1;
   245:   if (fclose(index_file) != 0)
   246:     i = -1;
   247:   if (i != 0) {
   248:     log("SYSERR: Could not durably write player index %s: %s", index_name, strerror(errno));
   249:     return FALSE;
   250:   }
   251:   return TRUE;
   252: }
   253: 
   254: void free_player_index(void)
   255: {
   256:   int tp;
   257: 
   258:   if (!player_table)
   259:     return;
   260: 
   261:   for (tp = 0; tp <= top_of_p_table; tp++)
   262:     if (player_table[tp].name)
   263:       free(player_table[tp].name);
   264: 
   265:   free(player_table);
   266:   player_table = NULL;
   267:   top_of_p_table = -1;
   268: }

   303: /* Stuff related to the save/load player system. */
   304: /* New load_char reads ASCII Player Files. Load a char, TRUE if loaded, FALSE
   305:  * if not. */
   306: /*
   307:  * After changing the leveling curve, older pfiles may have XP that no longer matches
   308:  * the saved level. Clamp XP into the valid band for the current level so players
   309:  * do not instantly gain multiple levels from a tiny XP award, and so TNL is sane.
   310:  */
   311: static void clamp_player_exp_to_level(struct char_data *ch)
   312: {
   313:   int lvl, min_xp, max_xp;
   314: 
   315:   if (!ch)
   316:     return;
   317: 
   318:   lvl = GET_LEVEL(ch);
   319:   if (lvl < 1)
   320:     return;
   321: 
   322:   min_xp = level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), lvl);
   323: 
   324:   if (lvl + 1 < LVL_IMMORT)
   325:     max_xp = level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), lvl + 1) - 1;
   326:   else
   327:     max_xp = INT_MAX;
   328: 
   329:   if (GET_EXP(ch) < min_xp)
   330:     GET_EXP(ch) = min_xp;
   331: 
   332:   if (GET_EXP(ch) > max_xp)
   333:     GET_EXP(ch) = max_xp;
   334: }
   335: 
   336: /* Parse a numeric value from a tag line, handling optional label prefixes. */
   337: static long long parse_numeric_value(const char *line)
   338: {
   339:   const char *value = line;
   340: 
   341:   if (!line)
   342:     return 0;
   343: 
   344:   value = strchr(line, ':');
   345:   if (value != NULL) {
   346:     value++;
   347:     while (*value == ' ' || *value == '\t')
   348:       value++;
   349:   } else
   350:     value = line;
   351: 
   352:   return atoll(value);
   353: }

   356: static long long normalize_currency_units(long long stored)
   357: {
   358:   if (stored < 0)
   359:     return 0;
   360: 
   361:   return stored;
   362: }
