   491:     GET_SOFT_CLASS_TITLE(ch)[0] = '\0';
   492:     for (i = 0; i < MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER; i++) {
   493:       SHADOW_SLOT_OCCUPIED(ch, i) = 0;
   494:       SHADOW_SLOT_ACTIVE(ch, i) = 0;
   495:       SHADOW_SLOT_LEVEL(ch, i) = 0;
   496:       SHADOW_SLOT_VNUM(ch, i) = NOBODY;
   497:       SHADOW_SLOT_PROFILE_VALID(ch, i) = 0;
   498:       SHADOW_SLOT_MAX_HIT(ch, i) = 0;
   499:       SHADOW_SLOT_AC(ch, i) = 0;
   500:       SHADOW_SLOT_HITROLL(ch, i) = 0;
   501:       SHADOW_SLOT_DAMROLL(ch, i) = 0;
   502:       SHADOW_SLOT_MAX_MANA(ch, i) = 0;
   503:       SHADOW_SLOT_DAMNODICE(ch, i) = 0;
   504:       SHADOW_SLOT_DAMSIZEDICE(ch, i) = 0;
   505:       SHADOW_SLOT_STR(ch, i) = 0;
   506:       SHADOW_SLOT_INT(ch, i) = 0;
   507:       SHADOW_SLOT_WIS(ch, i) = 0;
   508:       SHADOW_SLOT_DEX(ch, i) = 0;
   509:       SHADOW_SLOT_CON(ch, i) = 0;
   510:       SHADOW_SLOT_CHA(ch, i) = 0;
   511:       SHADOW_SLOT_NAME(ch, i)[0] = '\0';
   512:     }
   513:     ch->player_specials->saved.identified_item_count = 0;
   514:     for (i = 0; i < MAX_IDENTIFIED_ITEMS; i++)
   515:       ch->player_specials->saved.identified_item_vnums[i] = NOTHING;
   516:     *GET_PROMPT(ch) = '\0';
   517: 
   518:     for (i = 0; i < AF_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   519:       AFF_FLAGS(ch)[i] = PFDEF_AFFFLAGS;
   520:     for (i = 0; i < PM_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   521:       PLR_FLAGS(ch)[i] = PFDEF_PLRFLAGS;
   522:     for (i = 0; i < PR_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   523:       PRF_FLAGS(ch)[i] = PFDEF_PREFFLAGS;
   524: 
   525:     while (get_line(fl, line)) {
   526:       tag_argument(line, tag, sizeof(tag));
   527: 
   528:       switch (*tag) {
   529:       case 'A':
   530:         if (!strcmp(tag, "Ac  ")) {
   531:           legacy_ac_raw = atoi(line);
   532:           legacy_ac_seen = TRUE;
   533:         }
   534:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Armr")) {
   535:           GET_AC(ch) = MAX(0, atoi(line));
   536:           armor_seen = TRUE;
   537:         }
   538: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Act ")) {
   539:          if (sscanf(line, "%s %s %s %s", f1, f2, f3, f4) == 4) {
   540:           PLR_FLAGS(ch)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f1);
   541:           PLR_FLAGS(ch)[1] = asciiflag_conv(f2);
   542:           PLR_FLAGS(ch)[2] = asciiflag_conv(f3);
   543:           PLR_FLAGS(ch)[3] = asciiflag_conv(f4);
   544:         } else
   545:           PLR_FLAGS(ch)[0] = asciiflag_conv(line);
   546:       } else if (!strcmp(tag, "Aff ")) {
   547:         if (sscanf(line, "%s %s %s %s", f1, f2, f3, f4) == 4) {
   548:           AFF_FLAGS(ch)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f1);
   549:           AFF_FLAGS(ch)[1] = asciiflag_conv(f2);
   550:           AFF_FLAGS(ch)[2] = asciiflag_conv(f3);
   551:           AFF_FLAGS(ch)[3] = asciiflag_conv(f4);
   552:         } else
   553:           AFF_FLAGS(ch)[0] = asciiflag_conv(line);
   554: 	}
   555: 	if (!strcmp(tag, "Affs")) 	load_affects(fl, ch);
   556:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Alin"))	GET_ALIGNMENT(ch)	= atoi(line);
   557: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Alis"))	read_aliases_ascii(fl, ch, atoi(line));
   558: 	          else if (!strcmp(tag, "AuLo")) GET_AUCTION_LOW(ch) = atoi(line);
   559: 	          else if (!strcmp(tag, "AuHi")) GET_AUCTION_HIGH(ch) = atoi(line);
   560: 	          else if (!strcmp(tag, "Acct"))  GET_ACCOUNT_ID(ch) = atol(line);
   561:         else if (sscanf(tag, "ArSc%d", &archetype_idx) == 1 &&
   562:                  archetype_idx >= 0 && archetype_idx < NUM_ARCHETYPES)
   563:           GET_ARCHETYPE_SCORE(ch, archetype_idx) = atoi(line);
   564:                 if (ch->desc && ch->desc->acct_authed && ch->desc->acct_id > 0 &&
   565:                     GET_ACCOUNT_ID(ch) > 0 && GET_ACCOUNT_ID(ch) != ch->desc->acct_id) {
   566:                   /* Wrong account trying to load this character */
   567:                   GET_ACCOUNT_ID(ch) = -1;
   568:                 }
   569:           break;
   570: 
   571:       case 'B':
   572: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Badp"))	GET_BAD_PWS(ch)		= atoi(line);
   573:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Bank") && !bank_money_seen) SET_BANK_GOLD(ch, atoi(line));
   574:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "BankMoney")) {
   575:           long long stored = atoll(line);
   576:           if (stored < 0)
   577:             stored = 0;
   578: 
   579:           __loaded_bank_money = stored;
   580:           bank_money_seen = TRUE;
   581:         }
   582:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Bounty")) {
   583:           long long stored = atoll(line);
   584:           if (stored < 0)
   585:             stored = 0;
   586: 
   587:           /* Legacy player files stored bounty in copper; convert if needed. */
   588:           SET_BOUNTY(ch, normalize_currency_units(stored));
   589:         }
   590: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Brth"))	ch->player.time.birth	= atol(line);
   591: 	break;
   592: 
   593:       case 'C':
   594: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Cha "))	ch->real_abils.cha	= atoi(line);
   595: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Clas"))	GET_CLASS(ch)		= atoi(line);
   596: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Con "))	ch->real_abils.con	= atoi(line);
   597: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Clan"))	GET_CLAN_ID(ch)		= atoi(line);
   598: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Clrk"))	GET_CLAN_RANK(ch)	= atoi(line);
   599:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "ClLo")) GET_CLASS_LOCKED(ch) = atoi(line);
   600:         else {
   601:           int idx;
   602:           if (!strcmp(tag, "CpAc")) GET_CAMPAIGN_ACTIVE(ch) = atoi(line);
   603:           else if (!strcmp(tag, "CpLv")) GET_CAMPAIGN_LEVEL(ch) = atoi(line);
   604:           else if (!strcmp(tag, "CpEx")) GET_CAMPAIGN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) = (time_t)atol(line);
   605:           else if (!strcmp(tag, "CpQp")) GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_QP(ch) = atoi(line);
   606:           else if (!strcmp(tag, "CpGo")) GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_GOLD(ch) = atoi(line);
   607:           else if (!strcmp(tag, "CpXp")) GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_XP(ch) = atoi(line);
   608:           else if (!strcmp(tag, "CpTr")) GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_TRAINS(ch) = atoi(line);
   609:           else if (!strcmp(tag, "CpPr")) GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_PRACTICES(ch) = atoi(line);
   610:           else if (!strcmp(tag, "CpCt")) GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_COUNT(ch) = atoi(line);
   611:           else if (sscanf(tag, "CpV%d", &idx) == 1 && idx >= 0 && idx < MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS)
   612:             GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, idx) = atoi(line);
   613:           else if (sscanf(tag, "CpR%d", &idx) == 1 && idx >= 0 && idx < MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS)
   614:             GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_ROOM(ch, idx) = atoi(line);
   615:           else if (sscanf(tag, "CpN%d", &idx) == 1 && idx >= 0 && idx < MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS)
   616:             GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REQUIRED(ch, idx) = atoi(line);
   617:           else if (sscanf(tag, "CpM%d", &idx) == 1 && idx >= 0 && idx < MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS)
   618:             GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, idx) = atoi(line);
   619:         }
   620: 	break;
   621: 
   622:       case 'D':
   623: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Desc"))	ch->player.description	= fread_string(fl, buf2);
   624: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Dex "))	ch->real_abils.dex	= atoi(line);
   625: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Drnk"))	GET_COND(ch, DRUNK)	= atoi(line);
   626: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Drol"))	GET_DAMROLL(ch)		= atoi(line);
   627: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Diamonds")) GET_DIAMONDS(ch) = atoi(line);
   628: 	break;
   629: 
   630:       case 'E':
   631: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Exp "))	GET_EXP(ch)		= atoi(line);
   632:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Evad")) GET_EVASION(ch) = atoi(line);
   633: 	break;
   634: 
   635:       case 'F':
   636: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Frez"))	GET_FREEZE_LEV(ch)	= atoi(line);
   637: 	break;
   638:

   640:         if (!strcmp(tag, "Gold"))
   641:           __loaded_gold_units = parse_numeric_value(line);
   642:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Glory")) GET_GLORY(ch) = atoi(line);
   643:         break;

   646: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Hit "))	load_HMVS(ch, line, LOAD_HIT);
   647: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Hite"))	GET_HEIGHT(ch)		= atoi(line);
   648:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Host")) {

   650:             free(GET_HOST(ch));

   654: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Hung"))	GET_COND(ch, HUNGER)	= atoi(line);
   655: 	break;

   658: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Id  "))	GET_IDNUM(ch)		= atol(line);
   659:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "IdKn")) load_identified_items(fl, ch);
   660: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Int "))	ch->real_abils.intel	= atoi(line);
   661: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Invs"))	GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)	= atoi(line);
   662: 	break;
   663: 
   664:       case 'L':
   665: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Last"))	ch->player.time.logon	= atol(line);
   666:   else if (!strcmp(tag, "LRoom")) GET_LAST_ROOM(ch) = atoi(line);
   667:   else if (!strcmp(tag, "Lern"))	GET_PRACTICES(ch)	= atoi(line);
   668: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Levl"))	GET_LEVEL(ch)		= atoi(line);
   669:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Lmot"))   GET_LAST_MOTD(ch)   = atoi(line);
   670:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Lnew"))   GET_LAST_NEWS(ch)   = atoi(line);
   671: 	break;
   672:       case 'M':
   673:              if (!strcmp(tag, "Mana"))    load_HMVS(ch, line, LOAD_MANA);
   674:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Move"))    load_HMVS(ch, line, LOAD_MOVE);
   675:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "MCrt"))    GET_MELEE_CRIT(ch)      = atoi(line);
   676:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "SCrt"))    GET_SPELL_CRIT(ch)      = atoi(line);
   677:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "HCrt"))    GET_HEAL_CRIT(ch)       = atoi(line);
   678:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "MCmt"))    GET_MELEE_CRIT_MULT(ch) = atoi(line);
   679:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "SCmt"))    GET_SPELL_CRIT_MULT(ch) = atoi(line);
   680:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "HCmt"))    GET_HEAL_CRIT_MULT(ch)  = atoi(line);
   681:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Mone") || !strcmp(tag, "Money")) {
   682:           long long stored = (long long)strtoll(line, NULL, 10);
   683:           if (stored < 0)
   684:             stored = 0;

   687:           money_seen = 1;

   689:         break;

   692: 	break;

   695:        if (!strcmp(tag, "Olc "))  GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) = atoi(line);
   696:   break;

   699:        if (!strcmp(tag, "Page"))  GET_PAGE_LENGTH(ch) = atoi(line);
   700: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Pass"))	strcpy(GET_PASSWD(ch), line);
   701: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Plyd"))	ch->player.time.played	= atoi(line);
   702: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "PfIn"))	POOFIN(ch)		= strdup(line);
   703: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "PfOt"))	POOFOUT(ch)		= strdup(line);
   704: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Prmt"))	strlcpy(GET_PROMPT(ch), line, MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH + 1);
   705:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Pref")) {
   706:           if (sscanf(line, "%s %s %s %s", f1, f2, f3, f4) == 4) {
   707:             PRF_FLAGS(ch)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f1);
   708:             PRF_FLAGS(ch)[1] = asciiflag_conv(f2);
   709:             PRF_FLAGS(ch)[2] = asciiflag_conv(f3);
   710:             PRF_FLAGS(ch)[3] = asciiflag_conv(f4);
   711:           } else
   712: 	    PRF_FLAGS(ch)[0] = asciiflag_conv(f1);
   713: 	  }
   714:         break;
   715: 
   716:       case 'Q':
   717: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Qstp"))  GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch)     = atoi(line);
   718:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "Qpnt")) GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch) = atoi(line); /* Backward compatibility */
   719:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "Qcur")) GET_QUEST(ch) = atoi(line);
   720:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "Qcnt")) GET_QUEST_COUNTER(ch) = atoi(line);
   721:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "Qest")) load_quests(fl, ch);

   723: 
   724:       case 'K':
   725:        if (!strcmp(tag, "KQac")) GET_KQUEST_ACTIVE(ch) = atoi(line);

   727:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "KQtv")) GET_KQUEST_TARGET(ch) = atoi(line);
   728:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "KQtr")) GET_KQUEST_ROOM(ch) = atoi(line);
   729:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "KQgv")) GET_KQUEST_GIVER(ch) = atoi(line);
   730:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "KQtm")) GET_KQUEST_TIME(ch) = atoi(line);
   731:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "KQex")) GET_KQUEST_EXPIRES_AT(ch) = (time_t)atol(line);
   732:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "KQcd")) GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) = (time_t)atol(line);
   733:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "KQcn")) GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_NOTIFIED(ch) = atoi(line);
   734:        else if (!strcmp(tag, "KQid")) GET_KQUEST_TARGET_ID(ch) = atol(line);

   736: 
   737:       case 'R':
   738:              if (!strcmp(tag, "Race"))  GET_RACE(ch) = atoi((line[0] ? (strchr(line,':') ? strchr(line,':')+1 : line) : line));
   739:         else	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Room"))	GET_LOADROOM(ch)	= atoi(line);
   740: 	break;
   741: 
   742:       case 'S':
   743: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Sex "))	GET_SEX(ch)		= atoi(line);

   745:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "SoTi"))
   746:           strlcpy(GET_SOFT_CLASS_TITLE(ch), line, sizeof(ch->player_specials->saved.soft_class_title));
   747:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "ShCt")) {

   749:         } else if (sscanf(tag, "ShSl%d", &shadow_slot_idx) == 1 &&

   756:             SHADOW_SLOT_OCCUPIED(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = occupied ? 1 : 0;
   757:             SHADOW_SLOT_ACTIVE(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = active ? 1 : 0;

   759:             SHADOW_SLOT_VNUM(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = source_vnum;

   770:           int str = 0, intel = 0, wis = 0, dex = 0, con = 0, cha = 0;
   771:           if (sscanf(line, "%d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d",
   772:                      &valid, &max_hit, &armor, &hitroll, &damroll, &max_mana,
   773:                      &damnodice, &damsizedice, &str, &intel, &wis, &dex, &con, &cha) == 14) {
   774:             SHADOW_SLOT_PROFILE_VALID(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = valid ? 1 : 0;
   775:             SHADOW_SLOT_MAX_HIT(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = MAX(1, max_hit);
   776:             SHADOW_SLOT_AC(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = armor;
   777:             SHADOW_SLOT_HITROLL(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = hitroll;
   778:             SHADOW_SLOT_DAMROLL(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = damroll;
   779:             SHADOW_SLOT_MAX_MANA(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = MAX(0, max_mana);
   780:             SHADOW_SLOT_DAMNODICE(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = MAX(1, damnodice);
   781:             SHADOW_SLOT_DAMSIZEDICE(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = MAX(1, damsizedice);
   782:             SHADOW_SLOT_STR(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = str;
   783:             SHADOW_SLOT_INT(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = intel;
   784:             SHADOW_SLOT_WIS(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = wis;
   785:             SHADOW_SLOT_DEX(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = dex;
   786:             SHADOW_SLOT_CON(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = con;
   787:             SHADOW_SLOT_CHA(ch, shadow_slot_idx) = cha;
   788:           }
   789:         }
   790: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Skil"))	load_skills(fl, ch);
   791:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "StLv")) load_study_levels(fl, ch);

   794: 
   795:       case 'T':
   796: 	     if (!strcmp(tag, "Thir"))	GET_COND(ch, THIRST)	= atoi(line);
   797: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Thr1"))	GET_SAVE(ch, 0)		= atoi(line);
   798: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Thr2"))	GET_SAVE(ch, 1)		= atoi(line);
   799: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Thr3"))	GET_SAVE(ch, 2)		= atoi(line);
   800: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Thr4"))	GET_SAVE(ch, 3)		= atoi(line);
   801: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Thr5"))	GET_SAVE(ch, 4)		= atoi(line);
   802: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Trns"))	GET_TRAINS(ch)		 = atoi(line);
   803: 	else if (!strcmp(tag, "Titl"))	GET_TITLE(ch)		= strdup(line);
   804:         else if (!strcmp(tag, "Trig") && CONFIG_SCRIPT_PLAYERS) {
   805:           if ((t_rnum = real_trigger(atoi(line))) != NOTHING) {
   806:             t = read_trigger(t_rnum);
   807:           if (!SCRIPT(ch))
   808:             CREATE(SCRIPT(ch), struct script_data, 1);
   809:           add_trigger(SCRIPT(ch), t, -1);

   827:     }
   828:   }
   829: 
   830:     if (!armor_seen && legacy_ac_seen)
   831:       GET_AC(ch) = legacy_ac_to_armor(legacy_ac_raw);
   832: 
   833:     if (money_seen && __loaded_money_gold >= 0) {
   834:       GET_MONEY(ch) = normalize_currency_units(__loaded_money_gold);
   835:     } else if (!money_seen && __loaded_gold_units >= 0) {
   836:       GET_MONEY(ch) = (long long)__loaded_gold_units;
   837:     }
   838: 
   839:     if (bank_money_seen && __loaded_bank_money >= 0)
   840:       GET_BANK_MONEY(ch) = normalize_currency_units(__loaded_bank_money);
   841: 
   842:   if (upgrade_legacy_immortal_levels(ch))
   843:       mudlog(CMP, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "%s converted to updated immortal tier (level %d).", GET_NAME(ch), GET_LEVEL(ch));
   844:   clamp_player_exp_to_level(ch);
   845: 
   846:   /* Ensure persisted base stats stay within the creation caps on load. */
   847:   clamp_base_stats(ch);
   848: 
   849:   /* Keep any existing characters in sync with their class spell/skill lists. */
   850:   ensure_class_abilities(ch);
   851:   classtrack_ensure_study_skill(ch);
   852: 
   853:   if (!*GET_SOFT_CLASS_TITLE(ch))
   854:     strlcpy(GET_SOFT_CLASS_TITLE(ch), "Adventurer", sizeof(ch->player_specials->saved.soft_class_title));
   855: 
   856:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER; i++)
   857:     SHADOW_SLOT_ACTIVE(ch, i) = 0;
   858: 
   859:   affect_total(ch);
   860: 
   861:   /* initialization for imms */
   862:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT) {
   863:     for (i = 1; i <= MAX_SKILLS; i++)
   864:       GET_SKILL(ch, i) = 100;
   865:     GET_COND(ch, HUNGER) = -1;
   866:     GET_COND(ch, THIRST) = -1;
   867:     GET_COND(ch, DRUNK) = -1;
   868:   }
   869:   fclose(fl);
   870:   DEFAULT_RACE_ON_LOAD(ch);
   871:   return(id);
   872: }
   873: 
   874: /* Write the vital data of a player to the player file. */
   875: /* This is the ASCII Player Files save routine. */
   876: int save_char(struct char_data * ch)
   877: {
   878:   FILE *fl;
   879:   char filename[40], buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], bits[127], bits2[127], bits3[127], bits4[127];
   880:   int i, j, id, save_index = FALSE, write_ok = TRUE;
   881:   struct affected_type *aff, tmp_aff[MAX_AFFECT];
   882:   struct obj_data *char_eq[NUM_WEARS];
   883:   trig_data *t;
   884: 
   885:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || GET_PFILEPOS(ch) < 0)
   886:     return FALSE;
   887: 
   888:   /* If ch->desc is not null, then update session data before saving. */
   889:   if (ch->desc) {
   890:     if (*ch->desc->host) {
   891:       if (!GET_HOST(ch))
   892:         GET_HOST(ch) = strdup(ch->desc->host);
   893:       else if (GET_HOST(ch) && strcmp(GET_HOST(ch), ch->desc->host)) {
   894:         free(GET_HOST(ch));
   895:         GET_HOST(ch) = strdup(ch->desc->host);
   896:       }
   897:     }
   898: 
   899:     /* Only update the time.played and time.logon if the character is playing. */
   900:     if (STATE(ch->desc) == CON_PLAYING) {
   901:       ch->player.time.played += time(0) - ch->player.time.logon;
   902:       ch->player.time.logon = time(0);
   903:     }
   904:   }
   905: 
   906:   if (!ensure_player_storage() || !get_filename(filename, sizeof(filename), PLR_FILE, GET_NAME(ch)))
   907:     return FALSE;
   908:   log("Player persistence: saving %s to %s", GET_NAME(ch), filename);
   909:   if (!(fl = fopen(filename, "w"))) {
   910:     mudlog(NRM, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: Couldn't open player file %s for write", filename);
   911:     mudlog(NRM, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: player save error: %s", strerror(errno));
   912:     return FALSE;
   913:   }
   914: 
   915:   /* Unaffect everything a character can be affected by. */
   916:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++) {
   917:     if (GET_EQ(ch, i)) {
   918:       char_eq[i] = unequip_char(ch, i);
   919: #ifndef NO_EXTRANEOUS_TRIGGERS
   920:       remove_otrigger(char_eq[i], ch);
   921: #endif
   922:     }
   923:     else
   924:       char_eq[i] = NULL;
   925:   }
   926: 
   927:   for (aff = ch->affected, i = 0; i < MAX_AFFECT; i++) {
   928:     if (aff) {
   929:       tmp_aff[i] = *aff;
   930:       for (j=0; j<AF_ARRAY_MAX; j++)
   931:         tmp_aff[i].bitvector[j] = aff->bitvector[j];
   932:       tmp_aff[i].next = 0;
   933:       aff = aff->next;
   934:     } else {
   935:       new_affect(&(tmp_aff[i]));
   936:       tmp_aff[i].next = 0;
   937:     }
   938:   }
   939: 
   940:   /* Remove the affections so that the raw values are stored; otherwise the
   941:    * effects are doubled when the char logs back in. */
   942: 
   943:   while (ch->affected)
   944:     affect_remove(ch, ch->affected);
   945: 
   946:   if ((i >= MAX_AFFECT) && aff && aff->next)
   947:     log("SYSERR: WARNING: OUT OF STORE ROOM FOR AFFECTED TYPES!!!");
   948: 
   949:   ch->aff_abils = ch->real_abils;
   950:   /* end char_to_store code */
   951: 
   952:   if (GET_NAME(ch))				fprintf(fl, "Name: %s\n", GET_NAME(ch));
   953:   if (GET_PASSWD(ch))				fprintf(fl, "Pass: %s\n", GET_PASSWD(ch));
   954:   if (GET_TITLE(ch))				fprintf(fl, "Titl: %s\n", GET_TITLE(ch));
   955:   if (ch->player.description && *ch->player.description) {
   956:     strcpy(buf, ch->player.description);
   957:     strip_cr(buf);
   958:     fprintf(fl, "Desc:\n%s~\n", buf);
   959:   }
   960:   if (POOFIN(ch))				fprintf(fl, "PfIn: %s\n", POOFIN(ch));
   961:   if (POOFOUT(ch))				fprintf(fl, "PfOt: %s\n", POOFOUT(ch));
   962:   if (*GET_PROMPT(ch))				fprintf(fl, "Prmt: %s\n", GET_PROMPT(ch));
   963:   if (GET_SEX(ch)	     != PFDEF_SEX)	fprintf(fl, "Sex : %d\n", GET_SEX(ch));
   964:   if (GET_CLASS(ch)	   != PFDEF_CLASS)	fprintf(fl, "Clas: %d\n", GET_CLASS(ch));
   965:   fprintf(fl, "Race: %d\n", GET_RACE(ch));
   966:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch)	   != PFDEF_LEVEL)	fprintf(fl, "Levl: %d\n", GET_LEVEL(ch));
   967: 
   968:   fprintf(fl, "Id  : %ld\n", GET_IDNUM(ch));
   969:     if (ch->desc && ch->desc->acct_authed && ch->desc->acct_id > 0)
   970:       GET_ACCOUNT_ID(ch) = ch->desc->acct_id;
   971:     fprintf(fl, "Acct: %ld\n", GET_ACCOUNT_ID(ch));
   972:   fprintf(fl, "Brth: %ld\n", (long)ch->player.time.birth);
   973:   fprintf(fl, "Plyd: %d\n",  ch->player.time.played);
   974:   fprintf(fl, "Last: %ld\n", (long)ch->player.time.logon);
   975: 
   976:   if (GET_LAST_MOTD(ch) != PFDEF_LASTMOTD)
   977:     fprintf(fl, "Lmot: %d\n", (int)GET_LAST_MOTD(ch));
   978:   if (GET_LAST_NEWS(ch) != PFDEF_LASTNEWS)
   979:     fprintf(fl, "Lnew: %d\n", (int)GET_LAST_NEWS(ch));
   980: 
   981:   if (GET_HOST(ch))				fprintf(fl, "Host: %s\n", GET_HOST(ch));
   982:   if (GET_HEIGHT(ch)	   != PFDEF_HEIGHT)	fprintf(fl, "Hite: %d\n", GET_HEIGHT(ch));
   983:   if (GET_WEIGHT(ch)	   != PFDEF_WEIGHT)	fprintf(fl, "Wate: %d\n", GET_WEIGHT(ch));
   984:   if (GET_ALIGNMENT(ch)  != PFDEF_ALIGNMENT)	fprintf(fl, "Alin: %d\n", GET_ALIGNMENT(ch));
   985: 
   986: 
   987:   sprintascii(bits,  PLR_FLAGS(ch)[0]);
   988:   sprintascii(bits2, PLR_FLAGS(ch)[1]);
   989:   sprintascii(bits3, PLR_FLAGS(ch)[2]);
   990:   sprintascii(bits4, PLR_FLAGS(ch)[3]);
   991:   fprintf(fl, "Act : %s %s %s %s\n", bits, bits2, bits3, bits4);
   992: 
   993:   sprintascii(bits,  AFF_FLAGS(ch)[0]);
   994:   sprintascii(bits2, AFF_FLAGS(ch)[1]);
   995:   sprintascii(bits3, AFF_FLAGS(ch)[2]);
   996:   sprintascii(bits4, AFF_FLAGS(ch)[3]);
   997:   fprintf(fl, "Aff : %s %s %s %s\n", bits, bits2, bits3, bits4);
   998: 
   999:   sprintascii(bits,  PRF_FLAGS(ch)[0]);
  1000:   sprintascii(bits2, PRF_FLAGS(ch)[1]);
  1001:   sprintascii(bits3, PRF_FLAGS(ch)[2]);
  1002:   sprintascii(bits4, PRF_FLAGS(ch)[3]);
  1003:   fprintf(fl, "Pref: %s %s %s %s\n", bits, bits2, bits3, bits4);
  1004: 
  1005:  if (GET_SAVE(ch, 0)	   != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)	fprintf(fl, "Thr1: %d\n", GET_SAVE(ch, 0));
  1006:   if (GET_SAVE(ch, 1)	   != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)	fprintf(fl, "Thr2: %d\n", GET_SAVE(ch, 1));
  1007:   if (GET_SAVE(ch, 2)	   != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)	fprintf(fl, "Thr3: %d\n", GET_SAVE(ch, 2));
  1008:   if (GET_SAVE(ch, 3)	   != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)	fprintf(fl, "Thr4: %d\n", GET_SAVE(ch, 3));
  1009:   if (GET_SAVE(ch, 4)	   != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)	fprintf(fl, "Thr5: %d\n", GET_SAVE(ch, 4));
  1010: 
  1011:   if (GET_WIMP_LEV(ch)	   != PFDEF_WIMPLEV)	fprintf(fl, "Wimp: %d\n", GET_WIMP_LEV(ch));
  1012:   if (GET_FREEZE_LEV(ch)   != PFDEF_FREEZELEV)	fprintf(fl, "Frez: %d\n", GET_FREEZE_LEV(ch));
  1013:   if (GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)	   != PFDEF_INVISLEV)	fprintf(fl, "Invs: %d\n", GET_INVIS_LEV(ch));
  1014:   if (GET_LOADROOM(ch)	   != PFDEF_LOADROOM)	fprintf(fl, "Room: %d\n", GET_LOADROOM(ch));
  1015:   if (GET_LAST_ROOM(ch) != NOWHERE) fprintf(fl, "LRoom: %d\n", GET_LAST_ROOM(ch));
  1016: 
  1017:   if (GET_BAD_PWS(ch)	   != PFDEF_BADPWS)	fprintf(fl, "Badp: %d\n", GET_BAD_PWS(ch));
  1018:   if (GET_PRACTICES(ch)	   != PFDEF_PRACTICES)	fprintf(fl, "Lern: %d\n", GET_PRACTICES(ch));
  1019:   if (GET_TRAINS(ch)       != PFDEF_TRAINS)     fprintf(fl, "Trns: %d\n", GET_TRAINS(ch));
  1020: 
  1021:   if (GET_COND(ch, HUNGER)   != PFDEF_HUNGER && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) fprintf(fl, "Hung: %d\n", GET_COND(ch, HUNGER));
  1022:   if (GET_COND(ch, THIRST) != PFDEF_THIRST && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) fprintf(fl, "Thir: %d\n", GET_COND(ch, THIRST));
  1023:   if (GET_COND(ch, DRUNK)  != PFDEF_DRUNK  && GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT) fprintf(fl, "Drnk: %d\n", GET_COND(ch, DRUNK));
  1024: 
  1025:   if (GET_HIT(ch)	   != PFDEF_HIT  || GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(ch)  != PFDEF_MAXHIT)  fprintf(fl, "Hit : %d/%d\n", GET_HIT(ch),  GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(ch));
  1026:   if (GET_MANA(ch)	   != PFDEF_MANA || GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(ch) != PFDEF_MAXMANA) fprintf(fl, "Mana: %d/%d\n", GET_MANA(ch), GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(ch));
  1027:   if (GET_MOVE(ch)	   != PFDEF_MOVE || GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(ch) != PFDEF_MAXMOVE) fprintf(fl, "Move: %d/%d\n", GET_MOVE(ch), GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(ch));
  1028: 
  1029:   if (GET_STR(ch)	   != PFDEF_STR  || GET_ADD(ch)      != PFDEF_STRADD)  fprintf(fl, "Str : %d/%d\n", GET_STR(ch),  GET_ADD(ch));
  1030: 
  1031: 
  1032:   if (GET_INT(ch)	   != PFDEF_INT)	fprintf(fl, "Int : %d\n", GET_INT(ch));
  1033:   if (GET_WIS(ch)	   != PFDEF_WIS)	fprintf(fl, "Wis : %d\n", GET_WIS(ch));
  1034:   if (GET_DEX(ch)	   != PFDEF_DEX)	fprintf(fl, "Dex : %d\n", GET_DEX(ch));
  1035:   if (GET_CON(ch)	   != PFDEF_CON)	fprintf(fl, "Con : %d\n", GET_CON(ch));
  1036:   if (GET_CHA(ch)	   != PFDEF_CHA)	fprintf(fl, "Cha : %d\n", GET_CHA(ch));
  1037: 
  1038:   if (GET_AC(ch)   != PFDEF_AC)         fprintf(fl, "Armr: %d\n", GET_AC(ch));
  1039:   if (GET_EVASION(ch) != 0)             fprintf(fl, "Evad: %d\n", GET_EVASION(ch));
  1040: 
  1041:   /* Gold is canonical; persist it directly. */
  1042:   fprintf(fl, "Gold: %lld\n", ((long long)GET_MONEY(ch)));
  1043:   fprintf(fl, "Bank: %lld\n", ((long long)GET_BANK_MONEY(ch)));
  1044:   if (GET_DIAMONDS(ch))
  1045:     fprintf(fl, "Diamonds: %d\n", GET_DIAMONDS(ch));
  1046:   if (GET_GLORY(ch))
  1047:     fprintf(fl, "Glory: %d\n", GET_GLORY(ch));
  1048:   fprintf(fl, "Bounty: %lld\n", GET_BOUNTY(ch));
  1049:   if (GET_CLAN_ID(ch)) fprintf(fl, "Clan: %d\n", GET_CLAN_ID(ch));
  1050:   if (GET_CLAN_RANK(ch)) fprintf(fl, "Clrk: %d\n", GET_CLAN_RANK(ch));
  1051:   if (GET_CLASS_LOCKED(ch)) fprintf(fl, "ClLo: %d\n", GET_CLASS_LOCKED(ch));
  1052:   if (*GET_SOFT_CLASS_TITLE(ch)) fprintf(fl, "SoTi: %s\n", GET_SOFT_CLASS_TITLE(ch));
  1053:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_ARCHETYPES; i++) {
  1054:     if (GET_ARCHETYPE_SCORE(ch, i) > 0)
  1055:       fprintf(fl, "ArSc%d: %d\n", i, GET_ARCHETYPE_SCORE(ch, i));
  1056:   }
  1057:   {
  1058:     int shadow_count = 0;
  1059:     for (i = 0; i < MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER; i++) {
  1060:       if (SHADOW_SLOT_OCCUPIED(ch, i))
  1061:         shadow_count++;
  1062:     }
  1063:     if (shadow_count > 0) {
  1064:       fprintf(fl, "ShCt: %d\n", shadow_count);
  1065:       for (i = 0; i < MAX_SHADOW_ROSTER; i++) {
  1066:         if (!SHADOW_SLOT_OCCUPIED(ch, i))
  1067:           continue;
  1068:         fprintf(fl, "ShSl%d: %d %d %d %d %s\n",
  1069:                 i,
  1070:                 SHADOW_SLOT_OCCUPIED(ch, i),
  1071:                 SHADOW_SLOT_ACTIVE(ch, i),
  1072:                 SHADOW_SLOT_LEVEL(ch, i),
  1073:                 SHADOW_SLOT_VNUM(ch, i),
  1074:                 SHADOW_SLOT_NAME(ch, i)[0] ? SHADOW_SLOT_NAME(ch, i) : "nameless shadow");
  1075:         fprintf(fl, "ShCp%d: %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d\n",
  1076:                 i,
  1077:                 SHADOW_SLOT_PROFILE_VALID(ch, i),
  1078:                 SHADOW_SLOT_MAX_HIT(ch, i),
  1079:                 SHADOW_SLOT_AC(ch, i),
  1080:                 SHADOW_SLOT_HITROLL(ch, i),
  1081:                 SHADOW_SLOT_DAMROLL(ch, i),
  1082:                 SHADOW_SLOT_MAX_MANA(ch, i),
  1083:                 SHADOW_SLOT_DAMNODICE(ch, i),
  1084:                 SHADOW_SLOT_DAMSIZEDICE(ch, i),
  1085:                 SHADOW_SLOT_STR(ch, i),
  1086:                 SHADOW_SLOT_INT(ch, i),
  1087:                 SHADOW_SLOT_WIS(ch, i),
  1088:                 SHADOW_SLOT_DEX(ch, i),
  1089:                 SHADOW_SLOT_CON(ch, i),
  1090:                 SHADOW_SLOT_CHA(ch, i));
  1091:       }
  1092:     }
  1093:   }
  1094:   if (GET_EXP(ch)	   != PFDEF_EXP)	fprintf(fl, "Exp : %d\n", GET_EXP(ch));
  1095:   if (GET_HITROLL(ch)	   != PFDEF_HITROLL)	fprintf(fl, "Hrol: %d\n", GET_HITROLL(ch));
  1096:   if (GET_DAMROLL(ch)	   != PFDEF_DAMROLL)	fprintf(fl, "Drol: %d\n", GET_DAMROLL(ch));
  1097:   if (GET_MELEE_CRIT(ch))                  fprintf(fl, "MCrt: %d\n", GET_MELEE_CRIT(ch));
  1098:   if (GET_SPELL_CRIT(ch))                  fprintf(fl, "SCrt: %d\n", GET_SPELL_CRIT(ch));
  1099:   if (GET_HEAL_CRIT(ch))                   fprintf(fl, "HCrt: %d\n", GET_HEAL_CRIT(ch));
  1100:   if (GET_MELEE_CRIT_MULT(ch))             fprintf(fl, "MCmt: %d\n", GET_MELEE_CRIT_MULT(ch));
  1101:   if (GET_SPELL_CRIT_MULT(ch))             fprintf(fl, "SCmt: %d\n", GET_SPELL_CRIT_MULT(ch));
  1102:   if (GET_HEAL_CRIT_MULT(ch))              fprintf(fl, "HCmt: %d\n", GET_HEAL_CRIT_MULT(ch));
  1103:   if (GET_OLC_ZONE(ch)     != PFDEF_OLC)        fprintf(fl, "Olc : %d\n", GET_OLC_ZONE(ch));
  1104:   if (GET_PAGE_LENGTH(ch)  != PFDEF_PAGELENGTH) fprintf(fl, "Page: %d\n", GET_PAGE_LENGTH(ch));
  1105:   if (GET_SCREEN_WIDTH(ch) != PFDEF_SCREENWIDTH) fprintf(fl, "ScrW: %d\n", GET_SCREEN_WIDTH(ch));
  1106:   if (GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch)  != PFDEF_QUESTPOINTS) fprintf(fl, "Qstp: %d\n", GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch));
  1107:   if (GET_QUEST_COUNTER(ch)!= PFDEF_QUESTCOUNT)  fprintf(fl, "Qcnt: %d\n", GET_QUEST_COUNTER(ch));
  1108:   if (GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch)   != PFDEF_COMPQUESTS) {
  1109:     fprintf(fl, "Qest:\n");
  1110:     for (i = 0; i < GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch); i++)
  1111:       fprintf(fl, "%d\n", ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests[i]);
  1112:     fprintf(fl, "%d\n", NOTHING);
  1113:   }
  1114:   if (GET_QUEST(ch)        != PFDEF_CURRQUEST)  fprintf(fl, "Qcur: %d\n", GET_QUEST(ch));
  1115:   if (GET_KQUEST_ACTIVE(ch) != PFDEF_KQUEST_ACTIVE) fprintf(fl, "KQac: %d\n", GET_KQUEST_ACTIVE(ch));
  1116:   if (GET_KQUEST_COMPLETE(ch) != PFDEF_KQUEST_COMPLETE) fprintf(fl, "KQcp: %d\n", GET_KQUEST_COMPLETE(ch));
  1117:   if (GET_KQUEST_TARGET(ch) != PFDEF_KQUEST_TARGET) fprintf(fl, "KQtv: %d\n", GET_KQUEST_TARGET(ch));
  1118:   if (GET_KQUEST_ROOM(ch) != PFDEF_KQUEST_ROOM) fprintf(fl, "KQtr: %d\n", GET_KQUEST_ROOM(ch));

  1122:   if (GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) != PFDEF_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_EXPIRES_AT) fprintf(fl, "KQcd: %ld\n", (long)GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_EXPIRES_AT(ch));

  1134:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS; i++) {
  1135:     if (GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, i) != NOBODY) fprintf(fl, "CpV%d: %d\n", i, GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, i));
  1136:     if (GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_ROOM(ch, i) != NOWHERE) fprintf(fl, "CpR%d: %d\n", i, GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_ROOM(ch, i));
  1137:     if (GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REQUIRED(ch, i) > 0) fprintf(fl, "CpN%d: %d\n", i, GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REQUIRED(ch, i));
  1138:     if (GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i) > 0) fprintf(fl, "CpM%d: %d\n", i, GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i));
  1139:   }
  1140:   if (GET_AUCTION_LOW(ch) != PFDEF_AUCTION_LOW) fprintf(fl, "AuLo: %d\n", GET_AUCTION_LOW(ch));
  1141:   if (GET_AUCTION_HIGH(ch) != PFDEF_AUCTION_HIGH) fprintf(fl, "AuHi: %d\n", GET_AUCTION_HIGH(ch));
  1142: 
  1143:  if (SCRIPT(ch)) {
  1144:    for (t = TRIGGERS(SCRIPT(ch)); t; t = t->next)
  1145:    fprintf(fl, "Trig: %d\n",GET_TRIG_VNUM(t));
  1146: }
  1147: 
  1148:   /* Save skills */
  1149:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT) {
  1150:     for (i = 1; i <= MAX_SKILLS; i++)
  1151:       GET_SKILL(ch, i) = 100;
  1152:   }
  1153:   fprintf(fl, "Skil:\n");
  1154:   for (i = 1; i <= MAX_SKILLS; i++) {
  1155:     if (GET_SKILL(ch, i))
  1156:       fprintf(fl, "%d %d\n", i, GET_SKILL(ch, i));
  1157:   }
  1158:   fprintf(fl, "0 0\n");
  1159: 
  1160:   fprintf(fl, "StLv:\n");
  1161:   for (i = 1; i <= MAX_SKILLS; i++) {
  1162:     if (GET_STUDY_LEARN_LEVEL(ch, i) > 0)
  1163:       fprintf(fl, "%d %d\n", i, GET_STUDY_LEARN_LEVEL(ch, i));
  1164:   }
  1165:   fprintf(fl, "0 0\n");
  1166: 
  1167:   fprintf(fl, "IdKn:\n");
  1168:   for (i = 0; i < ch->player_specials->saved.identified_item_count &&
  1169:               i < MAX_IDENTIFIED_ITEMS; i++) {
  1170:     if (ch->player_specials->saved.identified_item_vnums[i] > NOTHING)
  1171:       fprintf(fl, "%d\n", ch->player_specials->saved.identified_item_vnums[i]);
  1172:   }
  1173:   fprintf(fl, "0\n");
  1174: 
  1175:   /* Save affects */
  1176:   if (tmp_aff[0].spell > 0) {
  1177:     fprintf(fl, "Affs:\n");
  1178:     for (i = 0; i < MAX_AFFECT; i++) {
  1179:       aff = &tmp_aff[i];
  1180:       if (aff->spell)
  1181: 		fprintf(fl, "%d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d\n", aff->spell, aff->duration,
  1182:           aff->modifier, aff->location, aff->bitvector[0], aff->bitvector[1], aff->bitvector[2], aff->bitvector[3]);
  1183:     }
  1184:     fprintf(fl, "0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0\n");
  1185:   }
  1186: 
  1187:   write_aliases_ascii(fl, ch);
  1188:   save_char_vars_ascii(fl, ch);
  1189: 
  1190:   write_ok = (fflush(fl) == 0);
  1191:   if (write_ok && fsync(fileno(fl)) != 0)
  1192:     write_ok = FALSE;
  1193:   if (fclose(fl) != 0)
  1194:     write_ok = FALSE;
  1195:   if (!write_ok) {
  1196:     mudlog(NRM, LVL_GOD, TRUE, "SYSERR: Could not durably save player file %s: %s", filename, strerror(errno));
  1197:     write_ok = FALSE;
  1198:   }
  1199: 
  1200:   /* More char_to_store code to add spell and eq affections back in. */
  1201:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_AFFECT; i++) {
  1202:     if (tmp_aff[i].spell)
  1203:       affect_to_char(ch, &tmp_aff[i]);
  1204:   }
  1205: 
  1206:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_WEARS; i++) {
  1207:     if (char_eq[i])
  1208: #ifndef NO_EXTRANEOUS_TRIGGERS
  1209:         if (wear_otrigger(char_eq[i], ch, i))
  1210: #endif
  1211:     equip_char(ch, char_eq[i], i);
  1212: #ifndef NO_EXTRANEOUS_TRIGGERS
  1213:           else
  1214:           obj_to_char(char_eq[i], ch);
  1215: #endif
  1216:   }
  1217:   /* end char_to_store code */
  1218: 
  1219:   /* Rebuild derived stats even if no affects/eq were present so aff_abils
  1220:    * retains racial bonuses and other modifiers after saving. */
  1221:   affect_total(ch);
  1222: 
  1223:   if (!write_ok)
  1224:     return FALSE;
  1225: 
  1226:   if ((id = get_ptable_by_name(GET_NAME(ch))) < 0)
  1227:     return FALSE;
  1228: 
  1229:   /* update the player in the player index */
  1230:   if (player_table[id].level != GET_LEVEL(ch)) {
  1231:     save_index = TRUE;
  1232:     player_table[id].level = GET_LEVEL(ch);
  1233:   }
  1234:   if (player_table[id].last != ch->player.time.logon) {
  1235:     save_index = TRUE;
  1236:     player_table[id].last = ch->player.time.logon;
  1237:   }
  1238:   i = player_table[id].flags;
  1239:   if (PLR_FLAGGED(ch, PLR_DELETED))
  1240:     SET_BIT(player_table[id].flags, PINDEX_DELETED);
  1241:   else
  1242:     REMOVE_BIT(player_table[id].flags, PINDEX_DELETED);
  1243:   if (PLR_FLAGGED(ch, PLR_NODELETE))
  1244:     SET_BIT(player_table[id].flags, PINDEX_NODELETE);
  1245:   else
  1246:     REMOVE_BIT(player_table[id].flags, PINDEX_NODELETE);
  1247: 
  1248:   if (PLR_FLAGGED(ch, PLR_FROZEN) || PLR_FLAGGED(ch, PLR_NOWIZLIST))
  1249:     SET_BIT(player_table[id].flags, PINDEX_NOWIZLIST);
  1250:   else
  1251:     REMOVE_BIT(player_table[id].flags, PINDEX_NOWIZLIST);
  1252: 
  1253:   if (player_table[id].flags != i || save_index)
  1254:     if (!save_player_index())
  1255:       return FALSE;
  1256:   return TRUE;
  1257: }
  1258: 
  1259: /* Separate an id tag from the data it precedes */
  1260: void tag_argument(char *argument, char *tag, size_t taglen)
  1261: {
  1262:   char *tmp = argument, *wrt = argument;
  1263:   size_t n = 0;
  1264: 
  1265:   if (taglen == 0) return;
  1266: 
  1267:   while (*tmp && *tmp != ':' && n + 1 < taglen) {
  1268:     tag[n++] = *tmp++;
  1269:   }
  1270:   tag[n] = '\0';
  1271: 
  1272:   while (*tmp && *tmp != ':')
  1273:     tmp++;
  1274: 
  1275:   while (*tmp == ':' || isspace((unsigned char)*tmp))
  1276:     tmp++;
  1277: 
  1278:   while (*tmp)
  1279:     *(wrt++) = *(tmp++);
  1280:   *wrt = '\0';
  1281: }

  1283: /* Stuff related to the player file cleanup system. */
  1284: 
  1285: /* remove_player() removes all files associated with a player who is self-deleted,
  1286:  * deleted by an immortal, or deleted by the auto-wipe system (if enabled). */
  1287: void remove_player(int pfilepos)
  1288: {
  1289:   char filename[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], timestr[25];
  1290:   int i;
  1291: 
  1292:   if (!*player_table[pfilepos].name)
  1293:     return;
  1294: 
  1295:   /* Unlink all player-owned files */
  1296:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_FILES; i++) {
  1297:     if (get_filename(filename, sizeof(filename), i, player_table[pfilepos].name))
  1298:       unlink(filename);
  1299:   }
  1300: 
  1301:   strftime(timestr, sizeof(timestr), "%c", localtime(&(player_table[pfilepos].last)));
  1302:   log("PCLEAN: %s Lev: %d Last: %s",
  1303: 	player_table[pfilepos].name, player_table[pfilepos].level,
  1304: 	timestr);
  1305:   player_table[pfilepos].name[0] = '\0';
  1306: 
  1307:   /* Update index table. */
  1308:   remove_player_from_index(pfilepos);
  1309: 
  1310:   save_player_index();
  1311: }
  1312: 
  1313: void clean_pfiles(void)
  1314: {
  1315:   int i, ci;
  1316: 
  1317:   for (i = 0; i <= top_of_p_table; i++) {
  1318:     /* We only want to go further if the player isn't protected from deletion
  1319:      * and hasn't already been deleted. */
  1320:     if (!IS_SET(player_table[i].flags, PINDEX_NODELETE) &&
  1321:         *player_table[i].name) {
  1322:       /* If the player is already flagged for deletion, then go ahead and get
  1323:        * rid of him. */
  1324:       if (IS_SET(player_table[i].flags, PINDEX_DELETED)) {
  1325: 	remove_player(i);
  1326:       } else {
  1327:         /* Check to see if the player has overstayed his welcome based on level. */
  1328: 	for (ci = 0; pclean_criteria[ci].level > -1; ci++) {
  1329: 	  if (player_table[i].level <= pclean_criteria[ci].level &&
  1330: 	      ((time(0) - player_table[i].last) >
  1331: 	       (pclean_criteria[ci].days * SECS_PER_REAL_DAY))) {
  1332: 	    remove_player(i);
  1333: 	    break;
  1334: 	  }
  1335: 	}
  1336:         /* If we got this far and the players hasn't been kicked out, then he
  1337: 	 * can stay a little while longer. */
  1338:       }
  1339:     }
  1340:   }
  1341:   /* After everything is done, we should rebuild player_index and remove the
  1342:    * entries of the players that were just deleted. */
  1343: }

  1345: /* load_affects function now handles both 32-bit and
  1346:    128-bit affect bitvectors for backward compatibility */
  1347: static void load_affects(FILE *fl, struct char_data *ch)
  1348: {
  1349:   int num = 0, num2 = 0, num3 = 0, num4 = 0, num5 = 0, num6 = 0, num7 = 0, num8 = 0, i, n_vars;
  1350:   char line[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 1];
  1351:   struct affected_type af;
  1352: 
  1353:   i = 0;
  1354:   do {
  1355:     new_affect(&af);
  1356:     get_line(fl, line);
  1357:     n_vars = sscanf(line, "%d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d", &num, &num2, &num3, &num4, &num5, &num6, &num7, &num8);
  1358:     if (num > 0) {
  1359:       af.spell = num;
  1360:       af.duration = num2;
  1361:       af.modifier = num3;
  1362:       af.location = num4;
  1363:       if (n_vars == 8) {              /* New 128-bit version */
  1364:           af.bitvector[0] =  num5;
  1365:           af.bitvector[1] =  num6;
  1366:           af.bitvector[2] =  num7;
  1367:           af.bitvector[3] =  num8;
  1368:       } else if (n_vars == 5) {       /* Old 32-bit conversion version */
  1369:         if (num5 > 0 && num5 < NUM_AFF_FLAGS)  /* Ignore invalid values */
  1370:           SET_BIT_AR(af.bitvector, num5);
  1371:       } else {
  1372:         log("SYSERR: Invalid affects in pfile (%s), expecting 5 or 8 values", GET_NAME(ch));
  1373:       }
  1374:       affect_to_char(ch, &af);
  1375:       i++;
  1376:     }
  1377:   } while (num != 0);
  1378: }
  1379: 
  1380: static void load_skills(FILE *fl, struct char_data *ch)
  1381: {
  1382:   int num = 0, num2 = 0;
  1383:   char line[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 1];
  1384: 
  1385:   do {
  1386:     get_line(fl, line);
  1387:     sscanf(line, "%d %d", &num, &num2);
  1388:     if (num != 0) {
  1389:       if (num < 1 || num > MAX_SKILLS) {
  1390:         log("SYSERR: Invalid skill id %d in pfile (%s)", num, GET_NAME(ch));
  1391:         continue;
  1392:       }
  1393:       if (num2 < 0)
  1394:         num2 = 0;
  1395:       else if (num2 > 100)
  1396:         num2 = 100;
  1397:       GET_SKILL(ch, num) = num2;
  1398:     }
  1399:   } while (num != 0);
  1400: 
  1401:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMMORT) {
  1402:     for (num = 1; num <= MAX_SKILLS; num++)
  1403:       GET_SKILL(ch, num) = 100;
  1404:   }
  1405: }
  1406: 
  1407: static void load_study_levels(FILE *fl, struct char_data *ch)
  1408: {
  1409:   int num = 0, num2 = 0;
  1410:   char line[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 1];
  1411: 
  1412:   do {
  1413:     get_line(fl, line);
  1414:     sscanf(line, "%d %d", &num, &num2);
  1415:     if (num != 0) {
  1416:       if (num < 1 || num > MAX_SKILLS) {
  1417:         log("SYSERR: Invalid study level id %d in pfile (%s)", num, GET_NAME(ch));
  1418:         continue;
  1419:       }
  1420:       if (num2 < 0)
  1421:         num2 = 0;
  1422:       else if (num2 > 255)
  1423:         num2 = 255;
  1424:       SET_STUDY_LEARN_LEVEL(ch, num, num2);
  1425:     }
  1426:   } while (num != 0);
  1427: }

  1429: static void load_identified_items(FILE *fl, struct char_data *ch)

  1461: static int upgrade_legacy_immortal_levels(struct char_data *ch)
  1462: {
  1463:   int new_level = 0, old_level = GET_LEVEL(ch);
  1464: 
  1465:   if (old_level < 31 || old_level > 34)
  1466:     return FALSE;
  1467: 
  1468:   switch (old_level) {
  1469:   case 31: new_level = LVL_IMMORT; break;
  1470:   case 32: new_level = LVL_GOD; break;
  1471:   case 33: new_level = LVL_GRGOD; break;
  1472:   case 34: new_level = LVL_IMPL; break;
  1473:   default: return FALSE;
  1474:   }
  1475: 
  1476:   GET_LEVEL(ch) = new_level;
  1477: 
  1478:   if (GET_EXP(ch) < level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), new_level))
  1479:     GET_EXP(ch) = level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), new_level);
  1480: 
  1481:   log("Updating %s from legacy immortal level %d to %d.",
  1482:       GET_NAME(ch) ? GET_NAME(ch) : "<unknown>", old_level, new_level);
  1483: 
  1484:   return TRUE;
  1485: }
  1486: 
  1487: static void load_HMVS(struct char_data *ch, const char *line, int mode)
  1488: {
  1489:   int num = 0, num2 = 0;
  1490: 
  1491:   sscanf(line, "%d/%d", &num, &num2);
  1492: 
  1493:   switch (mode) {
  1494:   case LOAD_HIT:
  1495:     GET_HIT(ch) = num;
  1496:     GET_MAX_HIT(ch) = num2;
  1497:     GET_BASE_MAX_HIT(ch) = num2;
  1498:     break;
  1499: 
  1500:   case LOAD_MANA:
  1501:     GET_MANA(ch) = num;
  1502:     GET_MAX_MANA(ch) = num2;
  1503:     GET_BASE_MAX_MANA(ch) = num2;
  1504:     break;
  1505: 
  1506:   case LOAD_MOVE:
  1507:     GET_MOVE(ch) = num;
  1508:     GET_MAX_MOVE(ch) = num2;
  1509:     GET_BASE_MAX_MOVE(ch) = num2;
  1510:     break;
  1511: 
  1512:   case LOAD_STRENGTH:
  1513:     ch->real_abils.str = num;
  1514:     ch->real_abils.str_add = num2;
  1515:     break;
  1516:   }
  1517: }
  1518: 
  1519: static void write_aliases_ascii(FILE *file, struct char_data *ch)
  1520: {
  1521:   struct alias_data *temp;
  1522:   int count = 0;
  1523: 
  1524:   if (GET_ALIASES(ch) == NULL)
  1525:     return;
  1526: 
  1527:   for (temp = GET_ALIASES(ch); temp; temp = temp->next)
  1528:     count++;
  1529: 
  1530:   fprintf(file, "Alis: %d\n", count);
  1531: 
  1532:   for (temp = GET_ALIASES(ch); temp; temp = temp->next)
  1533:     fprintf(file, " %s\n"   /* Alias: prepend a space in order to avoid issues with aliases beginning
  1534:                              * with * (get_line treats lines beginning with * as comments and ignores them */
  1535:                   "%s\n"    /* Replacement: always prepended with a space in memory anyway */
  1536:                   "%d\n",   /* Type */
  1537:                   temp->alias,
  1538:                   temp->replacement,
  1539:                   temp->type);
  1540: }
  1541: 
  1542: static void read_aliases_ascii(FILE *file, struct char_data *ch, int count)
  1543: {
  1544:   int i;
  1545: 
  1546:   if (count == 0) {
  1547:     GET_ALIASES(ch) = NULL;
  1548:     return; /* No aliases in the list. */
  1549:   }
  1550: 
  1551:   /* This code goes both ways for the old format (where alias and replacement start at the
  1552:    * first character on the line) and the new (where they are prepended by a space in order
  1553:    * to avoid the possibility of a * at the start of the line */
  1554:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  1555:     char abuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH+1], rbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH+1], tbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1556: 
  1557:     /* Read the aliased command. */
  1558:     get_line(file, abuf);
  1559: 
  1560:     /* Read the replacement. This needs to have a space prepended before placing in
  1561:      * the in-memory struct. The space may be there already, but we can't be certain! */
  1562:     rbuf[0] = ' ';
  1563:     get_line(file, rbuf+1);
  1564: 
  1565:     /* read the type */
  1566:     get_line(file, tbuf);
  1567: 
  1568:     if (abuf[0] && rbuf[1] && *tbuf) {
  1569:       struct alias_data *temp;
  1570:       CREATE(temp, struct alias_data, 1);
  1571:       temp->alias       = strdup(abuf[0] == ' ' ? abuf+1 : abuf);
  1572:       temp->replacement = strdup(rbuf[1] == ' ' ? rbuf+1 : rbuf);
  1573:       temp->type        = atoi(tbuf);
  1574:       temp->next        = GET_ALIASES(ch);
  1575:       GET_ALIASES(ch)   = temp;
  1576:     }
  1577:   }
  1578: }

    32: /* Note: there is no setup_new, as you can ONLY edit an existing player */
    33: /*       vict is normally = d->character, except when imps edit players */
    34: static void prefedit_setup(struct descriptor_data *d, struct char_data *vict)
    35: {
    36:   int i;
    37:   struct prefs_data *toggles;
    38: 
    39:   if (!vict) vict = d->character;
    40: 
    41:   /*. Build a copy of the player's toggles .*/
    42:   CREATE (toggles, struct prefs_data, 1);
    43: 
    44:   /* no strings to allocate space for */
    45:   for (i=0; i<PR_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
    46:     toggles->pref_flags[i] = PRF_FLAGS(vict)[i];
    47: 
    48:   toggles->wimp_level   = GET_WIMP_LEV(vict);
    49:   toggles->page_length  = GET_PAGE_LENGTH(vict);
    50:   toggles->screen_width = GET_SCREEN_WIDTH(vict);
    51: 
    52:   toggles->ch = vict;
    53: 
    54:   /*. Attach toggles copy to editors descriptor .*/
    55:   OLC_PREFS(d) = toggles;
    56:   OLC_VAL(d) = 0;
    57:   prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
    58: }
    59: 
    60: static void prefedit_save_to_char(struct descriptor_data *d)
    61: {
    62:   int i;
    63:   struct char_data *vict;
    64: 
    65:   vict = PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR;
    66: 
    67:   if (vict && vict->desc && IS_PLAYING(vict->desc))
    68:   {
    69:     for (i=0; i<PR_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
    70:       PRF_FLAGS(vict)[i]  = OLC_PREFS(d)->pref_flags[i];
    71: 
    72:     GET_WIMP_LEV(vict)     = OLC_PREFS(d)->wimp_level;
    73:     GET_PAGE_LENGTH(vict)  = OLC_PREFS(d)->page_length;
    74:     GET_SCREEN_WIDTH(vict) = OLC_PREFS(d)->screen_width;
    75: 
    76:     save_char(vict);
    77:   }
    78:   else
    79:   {
    80:   if (!vict) {
    81:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Unable to save toggles (no vict)");
    82:     send_to_char(d->character, "Unable to save toggles (no vict)");
    83:   } else if (!vict->desc) {
    84:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Unable to save toggles (no vict descriptor)");
    85:     send_to_char(d->character, "Unable to save toggles (no vict descriptor)");
    86:   } else if (!IS_PLAYING(vict->desc)) {
    87:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Unable to save toggles (vict not playing)");
    88:     send_to_char(d->character, "Unable to save toggles (vict not playing)");
    89:   } else {
    90:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Unable to save toggles (unknown reason)");
    91:     send_to_char(d->character, "Unable to save toggles (unknown reason)");
    92:     }
    93:   }
    94: }

    96: static void prefedit_disp_main_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
    97: {
    98:   struct char_data *vict;
    99:   char color_string[10], syslog_string[10];
   100:   const char *multi_types[] = { "Off", "Brief", "Normal", "Complete", "\n" };
   101: 
   102:   /* Set up the required variables and strings */
   103:   vict = PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR;
   104: 
   105:   sprintf(color_string, "%s", multi_types[(PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_COLOR_1) ? 1 : 0) + (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_COLOR_2) ? 2 : 0)]);
   106: 
   107:   send_to_char(d->character, "\r\n%sPreferences for %s%s\r\n",
   108:                               CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM),
   109:                               GET_NAME(vict),
   110:                               CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM) );
   111: 
   112: 
   113:   /* The mortal preferences section of the actual menu */
   114:   send_to_char(d->character, "\r\n"
   115:                              "%sPreferences\r\n"
   116:                              "%sL%s) Pagelength : %s[%s%-3d%s]  %sC%s) Color  : %s[%s%-8s%s]\r\n"
   117:                              "%sS%s) Screenwidth: %s[%s%-3d%s]  %sW%s) Wimpy  : %s[%s%-4d%s]%s\r\n",
   118:              CCWHT(d->character, C_NRM),
   119: /* Line 1 - pagelength and color */
   120:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM),
   121:              PREFEDIT_GET_PAGELENGTH, CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM),
   122:              CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM), color_string, CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM),
   123: /* Line 2 - screenwidth and wimpy */
   124:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM),
   125:              PREFEDIT_GET_SCREENWIDTH, CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM),
   126:              CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM), PREFEDIT_GET_WIMP_LEV, CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM)
   127:              );
   128: 
   129:   send_to_char(d->character, "%sT%s) Toggle Preferences...\r\n",
   130:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM) );
   131: 
   132:   /* Imm Prefs */
   133:   if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) >= LVL_IMMORT)
   134:   {
   135:     sprintf(syslog_string, "%s", multi_types[((PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_LOG1) ? 1 : 0)+ (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_LOG2) ? 2 : 0))] );
   136: 
   137:     send_to_char(d->character, "\r\n"
   138:                                "%sImmortal Preferences\r\n"
   139:                                "%s1%s) Syslog Level %s[%s%8s%s]   %s4%s) ClsOLC    %s[%s%3s%s]\r\n"
   140:                                "%s2%s) Show Flags   %s[%s%3s%s]        %s5%s) No WizNet %s[%s%3s%s]\r\n"
   141:                                "%s3%s) No Hassle    %s[%s%3s%s]        %s6%s) Holylight %s[%s%3s%s]\r\n"
   142:                                "%s7%s) Verbose      %s[%s%3s%s]        ",
   143:              CBWHT(d->character, C_NRM),
   144: /* Line 1 - syslog and clsolc */
   145:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM),
   146:              syslog_string, CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM),
   147:              CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM), ONOFF(PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_CLS)), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM),
   148: /* Line 2 - show vnums and nowiz */
   149:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM),
   150:              ONOFF(PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_SHOWVNUMS)), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM),
   151:              CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM), ONOFF(PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOWIZ)), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM),
   152: /* Line 3 - nohassle and holylight */
   153:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM),
   154:              ONOFF(PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOHASSLE)), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM),
   155:              CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM), ONOFF(PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_HOLYLIGHT)), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM),
   156: /* Line 4 - Verbose */
   157:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM),
   158:              ONOFF(PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_VERBOSE)), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM)
   159:              );
   160:     if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) == LVL_IMPL)
   161:       send_to_char(d->character, "%s8%s) Zone Resets  %s[%s%3s%s]\r\n",
   162:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM),
   163:              ONOFF(PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_ZONERESETS)), CCCYN(d->character, C_NRM));
   164:     else
   165:       send_to_char(d->character, "\r\n");
   166:   }
   167: 
   168: /* Finishing Off */
   169:   send_to_char(d->character, "\r\n"
   170:                              "%sD%s) Restore all default values\r\n"
   171:                              "%sQ%s) Quit\r\n"
   172:                              "\r\n",
   173:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM),
   174:              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM)
   175:              );
   176: 
   177: 
   178:   /* Bottom of the menu */
   179: 
   180:   OLC_MODE(d) = PREFEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
   181: }

   310: static void prefedit_disp_syslog_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   311: {
   312:   send_to_char(d->character, "%sSyslog level\r\n"
   313:                              "%s1%s) Off      %s(do not display any logs or error messages)%s\r\n"
   314:                              "%s2%s) Brief    %s(show only important warnings or errors)%s\r\n"
   315:                              "%s3%s) Normal   %s(show all warnings and errors)%s\r\n"
   316:                              "%s4%s) Complete %s(show all logged information for your level)%s\r\n",
   317:                              CBWHT(d->character, C_NRM),
   318:                              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM),
   319:                              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM),
   320:                              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM),
   321:                              CBYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM), CCYEL(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM) );
   322: 
   323:   send_to_char(d->character, "Enter Choice :");
   324:   OLC_MODE(d) = PREFEDIT_SYSLOG;
   325: }
   326: 
   327: void prefedit_parse(struct descriptor_data * d, char *arg)
   328: {
   329:   int number;
   330: 
   331:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   332:   case PREFEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVE:
   333:     switch (*arg) {
   334:     case 'y':
   335:     case 'Y':
   336:       prefedit_save_to_char(d);
   337:       mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE, "OLC: %s edits toggles for %s", 
   338:         GET_NAME(d->character), GET_NAME(OLC_PREFS(d)->ch));
   339:       /*. No strings to save - cleanup all .*/
   340:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   341:       break;
   342:     case 'n':
   343:     case 'N':
   344:       /* don't save to char, just free everything up */
   345:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   346:       break;
   347:     default:
   348:       send_to_char(d->character, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
   349:       send_to_char(d->character, "Do you wish to save these toggle settings? : ");
   350:       break;
   351:     }
   352:     return;
   353: 
   354:   case PREFEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   355:     switch (*arg) {
   356:     case 'q':
   357:     case 'Q':
   358:       if (OLC_VAL(d))
   359:       { /*. Something has been modified .*/
   360:         send_to_char(d->character, "Do you wish to save these toggle settings? : ");
   361:         OLC_MODE(d) = PREFEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVE;
   362:       } else
   363:         cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   364:       return;
   365: 
   366:     case 'c':
   367:     case 'C':
   368:       prefedit_disp_color_menu(d);
   369:       return;
   370: 
   371:     case 'l':
   372:     case 'L':
   373:       send_to_char(d->character, "Enter number of lines per page (10-60): ");
   374:       OLC_MODE(d) = PREFEDIT_PAGELENGTH;
   375:       return;
   376: 
   377:     case 's':
   378:     case 'S':
   379:       send_to_char(d->character, "Enter number of columns per page (40-120): ");
   380:       OLC_MODE(d) = PREFEDIT_SCREENWIDTH;
   381:       return;
   382: 
   383:     case 'w':
   384:     case 'W':
   385:       send_to_char(d->character, "Enter HP at which to flee (0-%d): ", MIN(GET_MAX_HIT(d->character)/2, 500));
   386:       OLC_MODE(d) = PREFEDIT_WIMPY;
   387:       return;
   388: 
   389:     case 't':
   390:     case 'T':
   391:       prefedit_disp_toggles_menu(d);
   392:       return;
   393: 
   394:     case 'd':
   395:     case 'D':
   396:       prefedit_Restore_Defaults(d);
   397:       break;
   398: 
   399:     /* Below this point are Imm-only toggles */
   400:     case '1':
   401:       if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) < LVL_IMMORT)
   402:       {
   403:         send_to_char(d->character, "%sInvalid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   404:         prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   405:       }
   406:       else
   407:       {
   408:         prefedit_disp_syslog_menu(d);
   409:         return;
   410:       }
   411:       break;
   412: 
   413:     case '2':
   414:       if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) < LVL_IMMORT)
   415:       {
   416:         send_to_char(d->character, "%sInvalid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   417:         prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   418:       }
   419:       else
   420:       {
   421:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_SHOWVNUMS);
   422:       }
   423:       break;
   424: 
   425:     case '3':
   426:       if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) < LVL_IMMORT)
   427:       {
   428:         send_to_char(d->character, "%sInvalid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   429:         prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   430:       }
   431:       else
   432:       {
   433:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOHASSLE);
   434:       }
   435:       break;
   436: 
   437:     case '4':
   438:       if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) < LVL_IMMORT)
   439:       {
   440:         send_to_char(d->character, "%sInvalid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   441:         prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   442:       }
   443:       else
   444:       {
   445:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_CLS);
   446:       }
   447:       break;
   448: 
   449:     case '5':
   450:       if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) < LVL_IMMORT)
   451:       {
   452:         send_to_char(d->character, "%sInvalid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   453:         prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   454:       }
   455:       else
   456:       {
   457:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOWIZ);
   458:       }
   459:       break;
   460: 
   461:     case '6':
   462:       if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) < LVL_IMMORT)
   463:       {
   464:         send_to_char(d->character, "%sInvalid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   465:         prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   466:       }
   467:       else
   468:       {
   469:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_HOLYLIGHT);
   470:       }
   471:       break;
   472: 
   473:   case '7':
   474:     if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) < LVL_IMMORT)
   475:     {
   476:       send_to_char(d->character, "%sInvalid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   477:       prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   478:     }
   479:     else
   480:     {
   481:       TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_VERBOSE);
   482:     }
   483:     break;
   484: 
   485:   case '8':
   486:       if (GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) < LVL_IMPL)
   487:       {
   488:         send_to_char(d->character, "%sInvalid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   489:         prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   490:       }
   491:       else
   492:       {
   493:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_ZONERESETS);
   494:       }
   495:       break;
   496: 
   497:     default:
   498:         send_to_char(d->character, "%sInvalid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   499:       prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   500:       break;
   501:     }
   502:     break;
   503: 
   504:   case PREFEDIT_PAGELENGTH:
   505:     number = atoi(arg);
   506:     OLC_PREFS(d)->page_length = MAX(10, MIN(number, 60));
   507:     break;
   508: 
   509:   case PREFEDIT_SCREENWIDTH:
   510:     number = atoi(arg);
   511:     OLC_PREFS(d)->screen_width = MAX(40, MIN(number, 120));
   512:     break;
   513: 
   514:   case PREFEDIT_WIMPY:
   515:     number = atoi(arg);
   516:     OLC_PREFS(d)->wimp_level = MAX(0, MIN(number, 500));
   517:     break;
   518: 
   519:   case PREFEDIT_COLOR:
   520:     number = atoi(arg) - 1;
   521:     if ((number < 0) || (number > 3)) {
   522:       send_to_char(d->character, "%sThat's not a valid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   523:       prefedit_disp_color_menu(d);
   524:       return;
   525:     }
   526:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_COLOR_1);
   527:     REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_COLOR_2);
   528:     if (number % 2)   SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_COLOR_1);
   529:     if (number >= 2)  SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_COLOR_2);
   530: 
   531:     break;
   532: 
   533:   case PREFEDIT_TOGGLE_MENU:
   534:     switch (*arg) {
   535:       case 'q':
   536:       case 'Q':
   537:       case 'x' :
   538:       case 'X' : prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   539:                  return;
   540: 
   541:       case '1':
   542:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOEXIT);
   543:         break;
   544: 
   545:       case '2':
   546:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOLOOT);
   547:         break;
   548: 
   549:       case '3':
   550:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOGOLD);
   551:         break;
   552: 
   553:       case '4':
   554:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOSAC);
   555:         break;
   556: 
   557:       case '5':
   558:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOASSIST);
   559:         break;
   560: 
   561:       case '6':
   562:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOSPLIT);
   563:         break;
   564: 
   565:       case '7':
   566:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOMAP);
   567:         break;
   568: 
   569:       case '8':
   570:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOKEY);
   571:         break;
   572: 
   573:       case '9':
   574:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTODOOR);
   575:         break;
   576: 
   577:       case 'a':
   578:       case 'A':
   579:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOGOSS);
   580:         break;
   581: 
   582:       case 'b':
   583:       case 'B':
   584:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOSHOUT);
   585:         break;
   586: 
   587:       case 'c':
   588:       case 'C':
   589:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOTELL);
   590:         break;
   591: 
   592:       case 'd':
   593:       case 'D':
   594:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOAUCT);
   595:         break;
   596: 
   597:       case 'e':
   598:       case 'E':
   599:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOGRATZ);
   600:         break;
   601: 
   602:       case 'f':
   603:       case 'F':
   604:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_SUMMONABLE);
   605:         break;
   606: 
   607:       case 'g':
   608:       case 'G':
   609:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOREPEAT);
   610:         break;
   611: 
   612:       case 'h':
   613:       case 'H':
   614:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_BRIEF);
   615:         break;
   616: 
   617:       case 'i':
   618:       case 'I':
   619:         TOGGLE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_COMPACT);
   620:         break;
   621:         
   622:       case 'j':
   623:       case 'J':
   624:         TOGGLE_VAR(d->pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt);
   625:         break;
   626:         
   627:       case 'k':
   628:       case 'K':
   629:         TOGGLE_VAR(d->pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_ANSI_COLORS]->ValueInt);
   630:         break;        
   631: 
   632:       case 'l':
   633:       case 'L':
   634:         TOGGLE_VAR(d->pProtocol->bCHARSET);
   635:         break;        
   636:         
   637:       case 'm':
   638:       case 'M':
   639:         TOGGLE_VAR(d->pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_MXP]->ValueInt);
   640:         break;
   641: 
   642:       case 'n':
   643:       case 'N':
   644:         TOGGLE_VAR(d->pProtocol->bMSDP);
   645:         break;
   646:         
   647:       case 'o':
   648:       case 'O':
   649:         TOGGLE_VAR(d->pProtocol->bATCP);
   650:         break;      
   651: 
   652:       case 'p':
   653:       case 'P':
   654:         TOGGLE_VAR(d->pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_UTF_8]->ValueInt);
   655:         break;
   656: 
   657:       case 'r':
   658:       case 'R':
   659:         TOGGLE_VAR(d->pProtocol->bMSP);
   660:         break;   
   661: 
   662:       default  : send_to_char(d->character, "Invalid Choice, try again (Q to Quit to main menu): ");
   663:                  return;
   664:     }
   665:     /* Set the 'value has changed' flag thing */
   666:     OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   667:     prefedit_disp_toggles_menu(d);
   668: 
   669:     return;
   670: 
   671:   case PREFEDIT_SYSLOG:
   672:     number = atoi(arg) - 1;
   673:     if ((number < 0) || (number > 3)) {
   674:       send_to_char(d->character, "%sThat's not a valid choice!%s\r\n", CBRED(d->character, C_NRM), CCNRM(d->character, C_NRM));
   675:       prefedit_disp_color_menu(d);
   676:       return;
   677:     }
   678: 
   679:     if ((number % 2) == 1) SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_LOG1);
   680:     else                   REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_LOG1);
   681: 
   682:     if (number >= 2) SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_LOG2);
   683:     else             REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_LOG2);
   684: 
   685:     break;
   686: 
   687:   default:
   688:     /* we should never get here */
   689:     mudlog(BRF,LVL_BUILDER,TRUE,"SYSERR: Reached default case in parse_prefedit");
   690:     break;
   691:   }
   692:   /*. If we get this far, something has be changed .*/
   693:   OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   694:   prefedit_disp_main_menu(d);
   695: }
   696: 
   697: void prefedit_Restore_Defaults(struct descriptor_data *d)
   698: {
   699:   /* Let's do toggles one at a time */
   700:   /* PRF_BRIEF      - Off */
   701:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_BRIEF))
   702:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_BRIEF);
   703: 
   704:   /* PRF_COMPACT    - Off */
   705:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_COMPACT))
   706:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_COMPACT);
   707: 
   708:   /* PRF_NOSHOUT       - Off */
   709:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOSHOUT))
   710:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOSHOUT);
   711: 
   712:   /* PRF_NOTELL     - Off */
   713:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOTELL))
   714:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOTELL);
   715: 
   716:   /* PRF_AUTOEXIT   - On */
   717:   if (!PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AUTOEXIT))
   718:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOEXIT);
   719: 
   720:   /* PRF_NOHASSLE   - On for Imms */
   721:   if (!PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOHASSLE) && GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) > LVL_IMMORT)
   722:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOHASSLE);
   723:   else
   724:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOHASSLE);
   725: 
   726:   /* PRF_QUEST      - Off */
   727:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_QUEST))
   728:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_QUEST);
   729: 
   730:   /* PRF_SUMMONABLE - Off */
   731:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_SUMMONABLE))
   732:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_SUMMONABLE);
   733: 
   734:   /* PRF_NOREPEAT   - Off */
   735:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOREPEAT))
   736:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOREPEAT);
   737: 
   738:   /* PRF_HOLYLIGHT  - On for Imms */
   739:   if (!PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_HOLYLIGHT) && GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) > LVL_IMMORT)
   740:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_HOLYLIGHT);
   741:   else
   742:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_HOLYLIGHT);
   743: 
   744:   /* PRF_COLOR      - On (Complete) */
   745:   if (!PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_COLOR_1))
   746:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_COLOR_1);
   747:   if (!PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_COLOR_2))
   748:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_COLOR_2);
   749: 
   750:   /* PRF_NOWIZ      - Off */
   751:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOWIZ))
   752:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOWIZ);
   753: 
   754:   /* PRF_LOG1       - Off */
   755:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_LOG1))
   756:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_LOG1);
   757: 
   758:   /* PRF_LOG2       - Off */
   759:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_LOG2))
   760:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_LOG2);
   761: 
   762:   /* PRF_NOAUCT     - Off */
   763:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOAUCT))
   764:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOAUCT);
   765: 
   766:   /* PRF_NOGOSS     - Off */
   767:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOGOSS))
   768:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOGOSS);
   769: 
   770:   /* PRF_NOGRATZ    - Off */
   771:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_NOGRATZ))
   772:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_NOGRATZ);
   773: 
   774:   /* PRF_SHOWVNUMS  - On for Imms */
   775:   if (!PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_SHOWVNUMS) && GET_LEVEL(PREFEDIT_GET_CHAR) > LVL_IMMORT)
   776:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_SHOWVNUMS);
   777:   else
   778:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_SHOWVNUMS);
   779: 
   780:   /* PRF_CLS - Off */
   781:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_CLS))
   782:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_CLS);
   783: 
   784:   /* PRF_AFK - Off */
   785:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AFK))
   786:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AFK);
   787: 
   788:   /* PRF_AUTOLOOT   - On */
   789:   if (!PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AUTOLOOT))
   790:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOLOOT);
   791: 
   792:   /* PRF_AUTOGOLD   - On */
   793:   if (!PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AUTOGOLD))
   794:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOGOLD);
   795: 
   796:   /* PRF_AUTOSPLIT  - Off */
   797:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AUTOSPLIT))
   798:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOSPLIT);
   799: 
   800:   /* PRF_AUTOSAC    - Off */
   801:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AUTOSAC))
   802:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOSAC);
   803: 
   804:   /* PRF_AUTOASSIST - Off */
   805:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AUTOASSIST))
   806:      REMOVE_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOASSIST);
   807: 
   808:   /* PRF_AUTOMAP    - On */
   809:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AUTOMAP))
   810:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOMAP);
   811: 
   812:   /* PRF_AUTOKEY    - On */
   813:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AUTOKEY))
   814:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTOKEY);
   815: 
   816:   /* PRF_AUTODOOR   - On */
   817:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_AUTODOOR))
   818:      SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_AUTODOOR);
   819: 
   820:   /* PRF_VERBOSE    - On */
   821:   if (PREFEDIT_FLAGGED(PRF_VERBOSE))
   822:     SET_BIT_AR(PREFEDIT_GET_FLAGS, PRF_VERBOSE);
   823: 
   824:   /* Other (non-toggle) options */
   825:   PREFEDIT_GET_WIMP_LEV   = 0;   /* Wimpy off by default */
   826:   PREFEDIT_GET_PAGELENGTH = 22;  /* Default telnet screen is 22 lines   */
   827:   PREFEDIT_GET_SCREENWIDTH = 80; /* Default telnet screen is 80 columns */
   828: }
   829: 
   830: ACMD(do_oasis_prefedit)
   831: {
   832:   struct descriptor_data *d;
   833:   struct char_data *vict;
   834:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   835:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   836:   char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   837: 
   838:   /****************************************************************************/
   839:   /** Parse any arguments.                                                   **/
   840:   /****************************************************************************/
   841:   two_arguments(argument, buf1, buf2);
   842: 
   843:   /****************************************************************************/
   844:   /** If there aren't any arguments...well...they can only modify their      **/
   845:   /** own toggles, can't they?                                               **/
   846:   /****************************************************************************/
   847:   if (!*buf1) {
   848:     vict = ch;
   849:   }
   850:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMPL)
   851:   {
   852:     if ((vict = get_player_vis(ch, buf1, NULL, FIND_CHAR_WORLD)) == NULL)
   853:     {
   854:       send_to_char(ch, "There is no-one here by that name.\r\n");
   855:       return;
   856:     }
   857:   }
   858:   else
   859:   {
   860:       send_to_char(ch, "You can't do that!\r\n");
   861:       return;
   862:   }
   863: 
   864:   if (IS_NPC(vict))
   865:   {
   866:       send_to_char(ch, "Don't be ridiculous! Mobs don't have toggles.\r\n");
   867:       return;
   868:   }
   869: 
   870:   /****************************************************************************/
   871:   /** Check that whatever it is isn't already being edited.                  **/
   872:   /****************************************************************************/
   873:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   874:     if (STATE(d) == CON_PREFEDIT) {
   875:       if (d->olc && OLC_PREFS(d)->ch == vict) {
   876:         if (ch == vict)
   877:           send_to_char(ch, "Your preferences are currently being edited by %s.\r\n", PERS(d->character, ch));
   878:         else
   879:           sprintf(buf, "$S$u preferences are currently being edited by %s.", PERS(d->character, ch));
   880:         act(buf, FALSE, ch, 0, vict, TO_CHAR);
   881:         return;
   882:       }
   883:     }
   884:   }
   885: 
   886:   /****************************************************************************/
   887:   /** Point d to the builder's descriptor (for easier typing later).         **/
   888:   /****************************************************************************/
   889:   d = ch->desc;
   890: 
   891:   /****************************************************************************/
   892:   /** Give the descriptor an OLC structure.                                  **/
   893:   /****************************************************************************/
   894:   if (d->olc) {
   895:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: do_oasis_prefedit: Player already had olc structure.");
   896:     free(d->olc);
   897:   }
   898: 
   899:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
   900: 
   901:   OLC_NUM(d) = 0;
   902: 
   903:   /****************************************************************************/
   904:   /** If this is a new quest, setup a new quest, otherwise setup the       **/
   905:   /** existing quest.                                                       **/
   906:   /****************************************************************************/
   907:   prefedit_setup(d, vict);
   908: 
   909:   STATE(d) = CON_PREFEDIT;
   910: 
   911:   /****************************************************************************/
   912:   /** Send the OLC message to the players in the same room as the builder.   **/
   913:   /****************************************************************************/
   914:   act("$n starts editing toggles.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   915:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   916: 
   917:   /****************************************************************************/
   918:   /** Log the OLC message.                                                   **/
   919:   /****************************************************************************/
   920: /* No need - done elsewhere */
   921: //  mudlog(CMP, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "OLC: (prefedit) %s starts editing toggles for %s", GET_NAME(ch), GET_NAME(vict));
   922: }
   923:

    44: static void Write( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apData )
    45: {
    46:    if ( apDescriptor != NULL)
    47:    {
    48:       if ( apDescriptor->pProtocol->WriteOOB > 0 || *(apDescriptor->output) == '\0' )
    49:       {
    50:          apDescriptor->pProtocol->WriteOOB = 2;
    51:       }
    52:    }
    53:    write_to_output( apDescriptor, apData, 0 );
    54: }
