   273: /******************************************************************************
   274:  Protocol global functions.
   275:  ******************************************************************************/
   276: 
   277: protocol_t *ProtocolCreate( void )
   278: {
   279:    int i; /* Loop counter */
   280:    protocol_t *pProtocol;
   281: 
   282:    /* Called the first time we enter - make sure the table is correct */
   283:    static bool_t bInit = false;
   284:    if ( !bInit )
   285:    {
   286:       bInit = true;
   287:       for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
   288:       {
   289:          if ( VariableNameTable[i].Variable != i )
   290:          {
   291:             ReportBug( "MSDP: Variable table does not match the enums in the header.\n" );
   292:             break;
   293:          }
   294:       }
   295:    }
   296: 
   297:    pProtocol = (protocol_t *) malloc(sizeof(protocol_t));
   298:    pProtocol->WriteOOB = 0;
   299:    pProtocol->bIACMode = false;
   300:    pProtocol->bNegotiated = false;
   301:    pProtocol->bBlockMXP = false;
   302:    pProtocol->bTTYPE = false;
   303:    pProtocol->bNAWS = false;
   304:    pProtocol->bCHARSET = false;
   305:    pProtocol->bMSDP = false;
   306:    pProtocol->bATCP = false;
   307:    pProtocol->bMSP = false;
   308:    pProtocol->bMXP = false;
   309:    pProtocol->bMCCP = false;
   310:    pProtocol->b256Support = eUNKNOWN;
   311:    pProtocol->ScreenWidth = 0;
   312:    pProtocol->ScreenHeight = 0;
   313:    pProtocol->pMXPVersion = AllocString("Unknown");
   314:    pProtocol->pLastTTYPE = NULL;
   315:    pProtocol->pVariables = (MSDP_t **) malloc(sizeof(MSDP_t*)*eMSDP_MAX);
   316: 
   317:    for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
   318:    {
   319:       pProtocol->pVariables[i] = (MSDP_t *) malloc(sizeof(MSDP_t));
   320:       pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bReport = false;
   321:       pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bDirty = false;
   322:       pProtocol->pVariables[i]->ValueInt = 0;
   323:       pProtocol->pVariables[i]->pValueString = NULL;
   324: 
   325:       if ( VariableNameTable[i].bString )
   326:       {
   327:          if ( VariableNameTable[i].pDefault != NULL )
   328:             pProtocol->pVariables[i]->pValueString = AllocString(VariableNameTable[i].pDefault);
   329:          else if ( VariableNameTable[i].bConfigurable )
   330:             pProtocol->pVariables[i]->pValueString = AllocString("Unknown");
   331:          else /* Use an empty string */
   332:             pProtocol->pVariables[i]->pValueString = AllocString("");
   333:       }
   334:       else if ( VariableNameTable[i].Default != 0 )
   335:       {
   336:          pProtocol->pVariables[i]->ValueInt = VariableNameTable[i].Default;
   337:       }
   338:    }
   339: 
   340:    return pProtocol;
   341: }
   342: 
   343: void ProtocolDestroy( protocol_t *apProtocol )
   344: {
   345:    int i; /* Loop counter */
   346: 
   347:    for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
   348:    {
   349:       if (apProtocol->pVariables[i]->pValueString)
   350:         free(apProtocol->pVariables[i]->pValueString);
   351:       free(apProtocol->pVariables[i]);
   352:    }
   353: 
   354:    free(apProtocol->pVariables);
   355:    if (apProtocol->pLastTTYPE) /* Isn't saved over copyover so may still be NULL */
   356:      free(apProtocol->pLastTTYPE);
   357:    free(apProtocol->pMXPVersion);
   358:    free(apProtocol);
   359: }
   360: 
   361: ssize_t ProtocolInput( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, char *apData, int aSize, char *apOut )
   362: {
   363:    static char CmdBuf[MAX_PROTOCOL_BUFFER+1];
   364:    static char IacBuf[MAX_PROTOCOL_BUFFER+1];
   365:    ssize_t CmdIndex = 0;
   366:    ssize_t IacIndex = 0;
   367:    ssize_t Index;
   368: 
   369:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
   370: 
   371:    for ( Index = 0; Index < aSize; ++Index )
   372:    {
   373:       /* If we'd overflow the buffer, we just ignore the input */
   374:       if ( CmdIndex >= MAX_PROTOCOL_BUFFER || IacIndex >= MAX_PROTOCOL_BUFFER )
   375:       {
   376:          ReportBug("ProtocolInput: Too much incoming data to store in the buffer.\n");
   377:          return (-1);
   378:       }
   379: 
   380:       /* IAC IAC is treated as a single value of 255 */
   381:       if ( apData[Index] == (char)IAC && apData[Index+1] == (char)IAC )
   382:       {
   383:          if ( pProtocol->bIACMode )
   384:             IacBuf[IacIndex++] = (char)IAC;
   385:          else /* In-band command */
   386:             CmdBuf[CmdIndex++] = (char)IAC;
   387:          Index++;
   388:       }
   389:       else if ( pProtocol->bIACMode )
   390:       {
   391:          /* End subnegotiation. */
   392:          if ( apData[Index] == (char)IAC && apData[Index+1] == (char)SE )
   393:          {
   394:             Index++;
   395:             pProtocol->bIACMode = false;
   396:             IacBuf[IacIndex] = '\0';
   397:             if ( IacIndex >= 2 )
   398:                PerformSubnegotiation( apDescriptor, IacBuf[0], &IacBuf[1], IacIndex-1 );
   399:             IacIndex = 0;
   400:          }
   401:          else
   402:            IacBuf[IacIndex++] = apData[Index];
   403:       }
   404:       else if ( apData[Index] == (char)27 && apData[Index+1] == '[' && 
   405:          isdigit(apData[Index+2]) && apData[Index+3] == 'z' )
   406:       {
   407:          char MXPBuffer [1024];
   408:          char *pMXPTag = NULL;
   409:          int i = 0; /* Loop counter */
   410: 
   411:          Index += 4; /* Skip to the start of the MXP sequence. */
   412: 
   413:          while ( Index < aSize && apData[Index] != '>' && i < 1000 )
   414:          {
   415:             MXPBuffer[i++] = apData[Index++];
   416:          }
   417:          MXPBuffer[i++] = '>';
   418:          MXPBuffer[i] = '\0';
   419: 
   420:          if ( ( pMXPTag = GetMxpTag( "CLIENT=", MXPBuffer ) ) != NULL )
   421:          {
   422:             /* Overwrite the previous client name - this is harder to fake */
   423:             free(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString);
   424:             pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString = AllocString(pMXPTag);
   425:          }
   426: 
   427:          if ( ( pMXPTag = GetMxpTag( "VERSION=", MXPBuffer ) ) != NULL )
   428:          {
   429:             const char *pClientName = pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString;
   430: 
   431:             InfoMessage(apDescriptor, "Receiving MXP Version From Client.\r\n");
   432: 
   433:             free(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->pValueString);
   434:             pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->pValueString = AllocString(pMXPTag);
   435: 
   436:             if ( MatchString( "MUSHCLIENT", pClientName ) )
   437:             {
   438:                /* MUSHclient 4.02 and later supports 256 colours. */
   439:                if ( strcmp(pMXPTag, "4.02") >= 0 )
   440:                {
   441:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
   442:                   pProtocol->b256Support = eYES;
   443:                }
   444:                else /* We know for sure that 256 colours are not supported */
   445:                   pProtocol->b256Support = eNO;
   446:             }
   447:             else if ( MatchString( "CMUD", pClientName ) )
   448:             {
   449:                /* CMUD 3.04 and later supports 256 colours. */
   450:                if ( strcmp(pMXPTag, "3.04") >= 0 )
   451:                {
   452:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
   453:                   pProtocol->b256Support = eYES;
   454:                }
   455:                else /* We know for sure that 256 colours are not supported */
   456:                   pProtocol->b256Support = eNO;
   457:             }
   458:             else if ( MatchString( "ATLANTIS", pClientName ) )
   459:             {
   460:                /* Atlantis 0.9.9.0 supports XTerm 256 colours, but it doesn't 
   461:                 * yet have MXP.  However MXP is planned, so once it responds 
   462:                 * to a <VERSION> tag we'll know we can use 256 colours.
   463:                 */
   464:                pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
   465:                pProtocol->b256Support = eYES;
   466:             }
   467:          }
   468: 
   469:          if ( ( pMXPTag = GetMxpTag( "MXP=", MXPBuffer ) ) != NULL )
   470:          {
   471:             free(pProtocol->pMXPVersion);
   472:             pProtocol->pMXPVersion = AllocString(pMXPTag);
   473:          }
   474:  
   475:          /* No longer necessary
   476:           * 
   477:          if ( strcmp(pProtocol->pMXPVersion, "Unknown") )
   478:          {
   479:             Write( apDescriptor, "\n" );
   480:             sprintf( MXPBuffer, "MXP version %s detected and enabled.\r\n", 
   481:                pProtocol->pMXPVersion );
   482:             InfoMessage( apDescriptor, MXPBuffer );
   483:          } */
   484:       }
   485:       else /* In-band command */
   486:       {
   487:          if ( apData[Index] == (char)IAC )
   488:          {
   489:             switch ( apData[Index+1] )
   490:             {
   491:                case (char)SB: /* Begin subnegotiation. */
   492:                   Index++;
   493:                   pProtocol->bIACMode = true;
   494:                   break;
   495: 
   496:                case (char)DO: /* Handshake. */
   497:                case (char)DONT:
   498:                case (char)WILL:
   499:                case (char)WONT: 
   500:                   PerformHandshake( apDescriptor, apData[Index+1], apData[Index+2] );
   501:                   Index += 2;
   502:                   break;
   503: 
   504:                case (char)IAC: /* Two IACs count as one. */
   505:                   CmdBuf[CmdIndex++] = (char)IAC;
   506:                   Index++;
   507:                   break;
   508: 
   509:                default: /* Skip it. */
   510:                   Index++;
   511:                   break;
   512:             }
   513:          }
   514:          else
   515:             CmdBuf[CmdIndex++] = apData[Index];
   516:       }
   517:    }
   518: 
   519:    /* Terminate the two buffers */
   520:    IacBuf[IacIndex] = '\0';
   521:    CmdBuf[CmdIndex] = '\0';
   522: 
   523:    /* Copy the input buffer back to the player. */
   524:    strcat( apOut, CmdBuf );
   525:    return (CmdIndex);
   526: }
   527: 
   528: const char *ProtocolOutput( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apData, int *apLength )
   529: {
   530:    static char Result[MAX_OUTPUT_BUFFER+1];
   531:    const char Tab[] = "\t";
   532:    const char MSP[] = "!!";
   533:    const char MXPStart[] = "\033[1z<";
   534:    const char MXPStop[] = ">\033[7z";
   535:    const char LinkStart[] = "\033[1z<send>\033[7z";
   536:    const char LinkStop[] = "\033[1z</send>\033[7z";
   537:    bool_t bTerminate = false, bUseMXP = false, bUseMSP = false;
   538:    int i = 0, j = 0; /* Index values */
   539: 
   540:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
   541:    if ( pProtocol == NULL || apData == NULL )
   542:       return apData;
   543: 
   544:    /* Strip !!SOUND() triggers if they support MSP or are using sound */
   545:    if ( pProtocol->bMSP || pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_SOUND]->ValueInt )
   546:       bUseMSP = true;
   547: 
   548:    for ( ; i < MAX_OUTPUT_BUFFER && apData[j] != '\0' && !bTerminate && 
   549:       (*apLength <= 0 || j < *apLength); ++j )
   550:    {
   551:       if ( apData[j] == '\t' )
   552:       {
   553:          const char *pCopyFrom = NULL;
   554:          char UnicodeSubstitute[8] = { 0 };
   555: 
   556:          switch ( apData[++j] )
   557:          {
   558:             case '\t': /* Two tabs in a row will display an actual tab */
   559:                pCopyFrom = Tab;
   560:                break;
   561:             case '_':
   562:                pCopyFrom = "\x1B[4m"; /* Underline... if supported */
   563:                break;
   564:             case '+':
   565:                pCopyFrom = "\x1B[1m"; /* Bold... if supported */
   566:                break;
   567:             case '-':
   568:                pCopyFrom = "\x1B[5m"; /* Blinking... if supported */
   569:                break;
   570:             case '=':
   571:                pCopyFrom = "\x1B[7m"; /* Reverse... if supported */
   572:                break;
   573:             case '*':
   574:                pCopyFrom = "@"; /* The At Symbol... I don't really like this, but it seems like
   575:                                    a simple way to allow for the @ symbol while maintain portability
   576:                                    between pre-ProtocolOutput() muds and post ProtocolOutput() muds.*/
   577:                break;
   578:             /* 1,2,3 to be used a MUD's base colour palette. Just to maintain
   579:              * some sort of common colouring scheme amongst coders/builders */
   580:             case '1':
   581:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, RGBone);
   582:                break;
   583:             case '2':
   584:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, RGBtwo);
   585:                break;
   586:             case '3':
   587:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, RGBthree);
   588:                break;
   589:             case 'n':
   590:                pCopyFrom = s_Clean;
   591:                break;
   592:             case 'd': /* dark grey / black */
   593:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F000");
   594:                break;
   595:             case 'D': /* light grey */
   596:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F111");
   597:                break;
   598:             case 'a': /* dark azure */
   599:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F021");
   600:                break;
   601:             case 'A': /* light Azure */
   602:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F053");
   603:                break;
   604:             case 'r': /* dark red */
   605:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F200");
   606:                break;
   607:             case 'R': /* light red */
   608:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F500");
   609:                break;
   610:             case 'g': /* dark green */
   611:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F020");
   612:                break;
   613:             case 'G': /* light green */
   614:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F050");
   615:                break;
   616:             case 'y': /* dark yellow */
   617:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F330");
   618:                break;
   619:             case 'Y': /* light yellow */
   620:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F550");
   621:                break;
   622:             case 'b': /* dark blue */
   623:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F012");
   624:                break;
   625:             case 'B': /* light blue */
   626:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F025");
   627:                break;
   628:             case 'm': /* dark magenta */
   629:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F202");
   630:                break;
   631:             case 'M': /* light magenta */
   632:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F505");
   633:                break;
   634:             case 'c': /* dark cyan */
   635:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F022");
   636:                break;
   637:             case 'C': /* light cyan */
   638:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F055");
   639:                break;
   640:             case 'w': /* dark white */
   641:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F333");
   642:                break;
   643:             case 'W': /* light white */
   644:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F555");
   645:                break;
   646:             case 'o': /* dark orange */
   647:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F520");
   648:                break;
   649:             case 'O': /* light orange */
   650:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F530");
   651:                break;
   652:             case 'p': /* dark pink */
   653:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F301");
   654:                break;
   655:             case 'P': /* light pink */
   656:                pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, "F501");
   657:                break;
   658:             case '(': /* MXP link */
   659:                if ( !pProtocol->bBlockMXP && pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_MXP]->ValueInt )
   660:                   pCopyFrom = LinkStart;
   661:                break;
   662:             case ')': /* MXP link */
   663:                if ( !pProtocol->bBlockMXP && pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_MXP]->ValueInt )
   664:                   pCopyFrom = LinkStop;
   665:                pProtocol->bBlockMXP = false;
   666:                break;
   667:             case '<':
   668:                if ( !pProtocol->bBlockMXP && pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_MXP]->ValueInt )
   669:                {
   670:                   pCopyFrom = MXPStart;
   671:                   bUseMXP = true;
   672:                }
   673:                else /* No MXP support, so just strip it out */
   674:                {
   675:                   while ( apData[j] != '\0' && apData[j] != '>' )
   676:                      ++j;
   677:                }
   678:                pProtocol->bBlockMXP = false;
   679:                break;
   680:             case '[':
   681:                if ( tolower(apData[++j]) == 'u' )
   682:                {
   683:                   char BugString[256];
   684:                   int Index = 0;
   685:                   int Number = 0;
   686:                   bool_t bDone = false, bValid = true;
   687: 
   688:                   while ( isdigit(apData[++j]) )
   689:                   {
   690:                      Number *= 10;
   691:                      Number += (apData[j])-'0';
   692:                   }
   693: 
   694:                   if ( apData[j] == '/' )
   695:                      ++j;
   696: 
   697:                   while ( apData[j] != '\0' && !bDone )
   698:                   {
   699:                      if ( apData[j] == ']' )
   700:                         bDone = true;
   701:                      else if ( Index < 7 )
   702:                         UnicodeSubstitute[Index++] = apData[j++];
   703:                      else /* It's too long, so ignore the rest and note the problem */
   704:                      {
   705:                         j++;
   706:                         bValid = false;
   707:                      }
   708:                   }
   709: 
   710:                   if ( !bDone )
   711:                   {
   712:                      sprintf( BugString, "BUG: Unicode substitute '%s' wasn't terminated with ']'.\n", UnicodeSubstitute );
   713:                      ReportBug( BugString );
   714:                   }
   715:                   else if ( !bValid )
   716:                   {
   717:                      sprintf( BugString, "BUG: Unicode substitute '%s' truncated.  Missing ']'?\n", UnicodeSubstitute );
   718:                      ReportBug( BugString );
   719:                   }
   720:                   else if ( pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_UTF_8]->ValueInt )
   721:                   {
   722:                      pCopyFrom = UnicodeGet(Number);
   723:                   }
   724:                   else /* Display the substitute string */
   725:                   {
   726:                      pCopyFrom = UnicodeSubstitute;
   727:                   }
   728: 
   729:                   /* Terminate if we've reached the end of the string */
   730:                   bTerminate = !bDone;
   731:                }
   732:                else if ( tolower(apData[j]) == 'f' || tolower(apData[j]) == 'b' )
   733:                {
   734:                   char Buffer[8] = { 0 }, BugString[256];
   735:                   int Index = 0;
   736:                   bool_t bDone = false, bValid = true;
   737: 
   738:                   /* Copy the 'f' (foreground) or 'b' (background) */
   739:                   Buffer[Index++] = apData[j++];
   740: 
   741:                   while ( apData[j] != '\0' && !bDone && bValid )
   742:                   {
   743:                      if ( apData[j] == ']' )
   744:                         bDone = true;
   745:                      else if ( Index < 4 )
   746:                         Buffer[Index++] = apData[j++];
   747:                      else /* It's too long, so drop out - the colour code may still be valid */
   748:                         bValid = false;
   749:                   }
   750: 
   751:                   if ( !bDone || !bValid)
   752:                   {
   753:                      sprintf( BugString, "BUG: RGB %sground colour '%s' wasn't terminated with ']'.\n", 
   754:                         (tolower(Buffer[0]) == 'f') ? "fore" : "back", &Buffer[1] );
   755:                      ReportBug( BugString );
   756:                   }
   757:                   else if ( !IsValidColour(Buffer) )
   758:                   {
   759:                      sprintf( BugString, "BUG: RGB %sground colour '%s' invalid (each digit must be in the range 0-5).\n", 
   760:                         (tolower(Buffer[0]) == 'f') ? "fore" : "back", &Buffer[1] );
   761:                      ReportBug( BugString );
   762:                   }
   763:                   else /* Success */
   764:                   {
   765:                      pCopyFrom = ColourRGB(apDescriptor, Buffer);
   766:                   }
   767:                }
   768:                else if ( tolower(apData[j]) == 'x' )
   769:                {
   770:                   char Buffer[8] = { 0 }, BugString[256];
   771:                   int Index = 0;
   772:                   bool_t bDone = false, bValid = true;
   773: 
   774:                   ++j; /* Skip the 'x' */
   775: 
   776:                   while ( apData[j] != '\0' && !bDone )
   777:                   {
   778:                      if ( apData[j] == ']' )
   779:                         bDone = true;
   780:                      else if ( Index < 7 )
   781:                         Buffer[Index++] = apData[j++];
   782:                      else /* It's too long, so ignore the rest and note the problem */
   783:                      {
   784:                         j++;
   785:                         bValid = false;
   786:                      }
   787:                   }
   788: 
   789:                   if ( !bDone )
   790:                   {
   791:                      sprintf( BugString, "BUG: Required MXP version '%s' wasn't terminated with ']'.\n", Buffer );
   792:                      ReportBug( BugString );
   793:                   }
   794:                   else if ( !bValid )
   795:                   {
   796:                      sprintf( BugString, "BUG: Required MXP version '%s' too long.  Missing ']'?\n", Buffer );
   797:                      ReportBug( BugString );
   798:                   }
   799:                   else if ( !strcmp(pProtocol->pMXPVersion, "Unknown") || 
   800:                      strcmp(pProtocol->pMXPVersion, Buffer) < 0 )
   801:                   {
   802:                      /* Their version of MXP isn't high enough */
   803:                      pProtocol->bBlockMXP = true;
   804:                   }
   805:                   else /* MXP is sufficient for this tag */
   806:                   {
   807:                      pProtocol->bBlockMXP = false;
   808:                   }
   809: 
   810:                   /* Terminate if we've reached the end of the string */
   811:                   bTerminate = !bDone;
   812:                }
   813:                break;
   814:             case '!': /* Used for in-band MSP sound triggers */
   815:                pCopyFrom = MSP;
   816:                break;
   817:             case '\0':
   818:                bTerminate = true;
   819:                break;
   820:             default:
   821:                break;
   822:          }
   823: 
   824:          /* Copy the colour code, if any. */
   825:          if ( pCopyFrom != NULL )
   826:          {
   827:             while ( *pCopyFrom != '\0' && i < MAX_OUTPUT_BUFFER )
   828:                Result[i++] = *pCopyFrom++;
   829:          }
   830:       }
   831:       else if ( bUseMXP && apData[j] == '>' )
   832:       {
   833:          const char *pCopyFrom = MXPStop;
   834:          while ( *pCopyFrom != '\0' && i < MAX_OUTPUT_BUFFER)
   835:             Result[i++] = *pCopyFrom++;
   836:          bUseMXP = false;
   837:       }
   838:       else if ( bUseMSP && j > 0 && apData[j-1] == '!' && apData[j] == '!' && 
   839:          PrefixString("SOUND(", &apData[j+1]) )
   840:       {
   841:          /* Avoid accidental triggering of old-style MSP triggers */
   842:          Result[i++] = '?';
   843:       }
   844:       else /* Just copy the character normally */
   845:       {
   846:          Result[i++] = apData[j];
   847:       }
   848:    }
   849: 
   850:    /* If we'd overflow the buffer, we don't send any output */
   851:    if ( i >= MAX_OUTPUT_BUFFER )
   852:    {
   853:       i = 0;
   854:       ReportBug("ProtocolOutput: Too much outgoing data to store in the buffer.\n");
   855:    }
   856: 
   857:    /* Terminate the string */
   858:    Result[i] = '\0';
   859: 
   860:    /* Store the length */
   861:    if ( apLength )
   862:       *apLength = i;
   863: 
   864:    /* Return the string */
   865:    return Result;
   866: }
   867: 
   868: /* Some clients (such as GMud) don't properly handle negotiation, and simply 
   869:  * display every printable character to the screen.  However TTYPE isn't a 
   870:  * printable character, so we negotiate for it first, and only negotiate for 
   871:  * other protocols if the client responds with IAC WILL TTYPE or IAC WONT 
   872:  * TTYPE.  Thanks go to Donky on MudBytes for the suggestion.
   873:  */
   874: void ProtocolNegotiate( descriptor_t *apDescriptor )
   875: {
   876:    static const char DoTTYPE [] = { (char)IAC, (char)DO, TELOPT_TTYPE, '\0' };
   877:    Write(apDescriptor, DoTTYPE);
   878: }
   879: 
   880: /******************************************************************************
   881:  Copyover save/load functions.
   882:  ******************************************************************************/
   883: 
   884: const char *CopyoverGet( descriptor_t *apDescriptor )
   885: {
   886:    static char Buffer[64];
   887:    char *pBuffer = Buffer;
   888:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
   889: 
   890:    if ( pProtocol != NULL )
   891:    {
   892:       sprintf(Buffer, "%d/%d", pProtocol->ScreenWidth, pProtocol->ScreenHeight);
   893: 
   894:       /* Skip to the end */
   895:       while ( *pBuffer != '\0' )
   896:          ++pBuffer;
   897: 
   898:       if ( pProtocol->bTTYPE )
   899:          *pBuffer++ = 'T';
   900:       if ( pProtocol->bNAWS )
   901:          *pBuffer++ = 'N';
   902:       if ( pProtocol->bMSDP )
   903:          *pBuffer++ = 'M';
   904:       if ( pProtocol->bATCP )
   905:          *pBuffer++ = 'A';
   906:       if ( pProtocol->bMSP )
   907:          *pBuffer++ = 'S';
   908:       if ( pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_MXP]->ValueInt )
   909:          *pBuffer++ = 'X';
   910:       if ( pProtocol->bMCCP )
   911:       {
   912:          *pBuffer++ = 'c';
   913:          CompressEnd(apDescriptor);
   914:       }
   915:       if ( pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt )
   916:          *pBuffer++ = 'C';
   917:       if ( pProtocol->bCHARSET )
   918:          *pBuffer++ = 'H';
   919:       if ( pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_UTF_8]->ValueInt )
   920:          *pBuffer++ = 'U';
   921:    }
   922: 
   923:    /* Terminate the string */
   924:    *pBuffer = '\0';
   925: 
   926:    return Buffer;
   927: }
   928: 
   929: void CopyoverSet( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apData )
   930: {
   931:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
   932: 
   933:    if ( pProtocol != NULL && apData != NULL )
   934:    {
   935:       int Width = 0, Height = 0;
   936:       bool_t bDoneWidth = false;
   937:       int i; /* Loop counter */
   938: 
   939:       for ( i = 0; apData[i] != '\0'; ++i )
   940:       {
   941:          switch ( apData[i] )
   942:          {
   943:             case 'T':
   944:                pProtocol->bTTYPE = true;
   945:                break;
   946:             case 'N':
   947:                pProtocol->bNAWS = true;
   948:                break;
   949:             case 'M':
   950:                pProtocol->bMSDP = true;
   951:                break;
   952:             case 'A':
   953:                pProtocol->bATCP = true;
   954:                break;
   955:             case 'S':
   956:                pProtocol->bMSP = true;
   957:                break;
   958:             case 'X':
   959:                pProtocol->bMXP = true;
   960:                pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_MXP]->ValueInt = 1;
   961:                break;
   962:             case 'c':
   963:                pProtocol->bMCCP = true;
   964:                CompressStart(apDescriptor);
   965:                break;
   966:             case 'C':
   967:                pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
   968:                break;
   969:             case 'H':
   970:                pProtocol->bCHARSET = true;
   971:                break;
   972:             case 'U':
   973:                pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_UTF_8]->ValueInt = 1;
   974:                break;
   975:             default:
   976:                if ( apData[i] == '/' )
   977:                   bDoneWidth = true;
   978:                else if ( isdigit(apData[i]) )
   979:                {
   980:                   if ( bDoneWidth )
   981:                   {
   982:                      Height *= 10;
   983:                      Height += (apData[i] - '0');
   984:                   }
   985:                   else /* We're still calculating height */
   986:                   {
   987:                      Width *= 10;
   988:                      Width += (apData[i] - '0');
   989:                   }
   990:                }
   991:                break;
   992:          }
   993:       }
   994: 
   995:       /* Restore the width and height */
   996:       pProtocol->ScreenWidth = Width;
   997:       pProtocol->ScreenHeight = Height;
   998: 
   999:       /* If we're using MSDP or ATCP, we need to renegotiate it so that the 
  1000:        * client can resend the list of variables it wants us to REPORT.
  1001:        *
  1002:        * Note that we only use ATCP if MSDP is not supported.
  1003:        */
  1004:       if ( pProtocol->bMSDP )
  1005:       {
  1006:          char WillMSDP [] = { (char)IAC, (char)WILL, TELOPT_MSDP, '\0' };
  1007:          Write(apDescriptor, WillMSDP);
  1008:       }
  1009:       else if ( pProtocol->bATCP )
  1010:       {
  1011:          char DoATCP [] = { (char)IAC, (char)DO, (char)TELOPT_ATCP, '\0' };
  1012:          Write(apDescriptor, DoATCP);
  1013:       }
  1014: 
  1015:       /* Ask the client to send its MXP version again */
  1016:       if ( pProtocol->bMXP )
  1017:          MXPSendTag( apDescriptor, "<VERSION>" );
  1018:    }
  1019: }
  1020: 
  1021: /******************************************************************************
  1022:  MSDP global functions.
  1023:  ******************************************************************************/
  1024: 
  1025: void MSDPUpdate( descriptor_t *apDescriptor )
  1026: {
  1027:    int i; /* Loop counter */
  1028: 
  1029:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1030: 
  1031:    for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
  1032:    {
  1033:       if ( pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bReport )
  1034:       {
  1035:          if ( pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bDirty )
  1036:          {
  1037:             MSDPSend( apDescriptor, (variable_t)i );
  1038:             pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bDirty = false;
  1039:          }
  1040:       }
  1041:    }
  1042: }
  1043: 
  1044: void MSDPFlush( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, variable_t aMSDP )
  1045: {
  1046:    if ( aMSDP > eMSDP_NONE && aMSDP < eMSDP_MAX )
  1047:    {
  1048:       protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1049: 
  1050:       if ( pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->bReport )
  1051:       {
  1052:          if ( pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->bDirty )
  1053:          {
  1054:             MSDPSend( apDescriptor, aMSDP );
  1055:             pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->bDirty = false;
  1056:          }
  1057:       }
  1058:    }
  1059: }
  1060: 
  1061: void MSDPSend( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, variable_t aMSDP )
  1062: {
  1063:    char MSDPBuffer[MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH+1] = { '\0' };
  1064: 
  1065:    if ( aMSDP > eMSDP_NONE && aMSDP < eMSDP_MAX )
  1066:    {
  1067:       protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1068: 
  1069:       if ( VariableNameTable[aMSDP].bString )
  1070:       {
  1071:          /* Should really be replaced with a dynamic buffer */
  1072:          int RequiredBuffer = strlen(VariableNameTable[aMSDP].pName) + 
  1073:             strlen(pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString) + 12;
  1074: 
  1075:          if ( RequiredBuffer >= MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH )
  1076:          {
  1077:             sprintf( MSDPBuffer, 
  1078:                "MSDPSend: %s %d bytes (exceeds MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH of %d).\n", 
  1079:                VariableNameTable[aMSDP].pName, RequiredBuffer, 
  1080:                MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH );
  1081:             ReportBug( MSDPBuffer );
  1082:             MSDPBuffer[0] = '\0';
  1083:          }
  1084:          else if ( pProtocol->bMSDP )
  1085:          {
  1086:             sprintf( MSDPBuffer, "%c%c%c%c%s%c%s%c%c", 
  1087:                IAC, SB, TELOPT_MSDP, MSDP_VAR, 
  1088:                VariableNameTable[aMSDP].pName, MSDP_VAL, 
  1089:                pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString, IAC, SE );
  1090:          }
  1091:          else if ( pProtocol->bATCP )
  1092:          {
  1093:             sprintf( MSDPBuffer, "%c%c%cMSDP.%s %s%c%c", 
  1094:                IAC, SB, TELOPT_ATCP, 
  1095:                VariableNameTable[aMSDP].pName, 
  1096:                pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString, IAC, SE );
  1097:          }
  1098:       }
  1099:       else /* It's an integer, not a string */
  1100:       {
  1101:          if ( pProtocol->bMSDP )
  1102:          {
  1103:             sprintf( MSDPBuffer, "%c%c%c%c%s%c%d%c%c", 
  1104:                IAC, SB, TELOPT_MSDP, MSDP_VAR, 
  1105:                VariableNameTable[aMSDP].pName, MSDP_VAL, 
  1106:                pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->ValueInt, IAC, SE );
  1107:          }
  1108:          else if ( pProtocol->bATCP )
  1109:          {
  1110:             sprintf( MSDPBuffer, "%c%c%cMSDP.%s %d%c%c", 
  1111:                IAC, SB, TELOPT_ATCP, 
  1112:                VariableNameTable[aMSDP].pName, 
  1113:                pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->ValueInt, IAC, SE );
  1114:          }
  1115:       }
  1116: 
  1117:       /* Just in case someone calls this function without checking MSDP/ATCP */
  1118:       if ( MSDPBuffer[0] != '\0' )
  1119:          Write( apDescriptor, MSDPBuffer );
  1120:    }
  1121: }
  1122: 
  1123: void MSDPSendPair( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apVariable, const char *apValue )
  1124: {
  1125:    char MSDPBuffer[MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH+1] = { '\0' };
  1126: 
  1127:    if ( apVariable != NULL && apValue != NULL )
  1128:    {
  1129:       protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1130: 
  1131:       /* Should really be replaced with a dynamic buffer */
  1132:       int RequiredBuffer = strlen(apVariable) + strlen(apValue) + 12;
  1133: 
  1134:       if ( RequiredBuffer >= MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH )
  1135:       {
  1136:          if ( RequiredBuffer - strlen(apValue) < MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH )
  1137:          {
  1138:             sprintf( MSDPBuffer, 
  1139:                "MSDPSendPair: %s %d bytes (exceeds MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH of %d).\n", 
  1140:                apVariable, RequiredBuffer, MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH );
  1141:          }
  1142:          else /* The variable name itself is too long */
  1143:          {
  1144:             sprintf( MSDPBuffer, 
  1145:                "MSDPSendPair: Variable name has a length of %d bytes (exceeds MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH of %d).\n", 
  1146:                RequiredBuffer, MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH );
  1147:          }
  1148: 
  1149:          ReportBug( MSDPBuffer );
  1150:          MSDPBuffer[0] = '\0';
  1151:       }
  1152:       else if ( pProtocol->bMSDP )
  1153:       {
  1154:          sprintf( MSDPBuffer, "%c%c%c%c%s%c%s%c%c", 
  1155:             IAC, SB, TELOPT_MSDP, MSDP_VAR, apVariable, MSDP_VAL, 
  1156:             apValue, IAC, SE );
  1157:       }
  1158:       else if ( pProtocol->bATCP )
  1159:       {
  1160:          sprintf( MSDPBuffer, "%c%c%cMSDP.%s %s%c%c", 
  1161:             IAC, SB, TELOPT_ATCP, apVariable, apValue, IAC, SE );
  1162:       }
  1163: 
  1164:       /* Just in case someone calls this function without checking MSDP/ATCP */
  1165:       if ( MSDPBuffer[0] != '\0' )
  1166:          Write( apDescriptor, MSDPBuffer );
  1167:    }
  1168: }
  1169: 
  1170: void MSDPSendList( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apVariable, const char *apValue )
  1171: {
  1172:    char MSDPBuffer[MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH+1] = { '\0' };
  1173: 
  1174:    if ( apVariable != NULL && apValue != NULL )
  1175:    {
  1176:       protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1177: 
  1178:       /* Should really be replaced with a dynamic buffer */
  1179:       int RequiredBuffer = strlen(apVariable) + strlen(apValue) + 12;
  1180: 
  1181:       if ( RequiredBuffer >= MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH )
  1182:       {
  1183:          if ( RequiredBuffer - strlen(apValue) < MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH )
  1184:          {
  1185:             sprintf( MSDPBuffer, 
  1186:                "MSDPSendList: %s %d bytes (exceeds MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH of %d).\n", 
  1187:                apVariable, RequiredBuffer, MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH );
  1188:          }
  1189:          else /* The variable name itself is too long */
  1190:          {
  1191:             sprintf( MSDPBuffer, 
  1192:                "MSDPSendList: Variable name has a length of %d bytes (exceeds MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH of %d).\n", 
  1193:                RequiredBuffer, MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH );
  1194:          }
  1195: 
  1196:          ReportBug( MSDPBuffer );
  1197:          MSDPBuffer[0] = '\0';
  1198:       }
  1199:       else if ( pProtocol->bMSDP )
  1200:       {
  1201:          int i; /* Loop counter */
  1202:          sprintf( MSDPBuffer, "%c%c%c%c%s%c%c%c%s%c%c%c", 
  1203:             IAC, SB, TELOPT_MSDP, MSDP_VAR, apVariable, MSDP_VAL, 
  1204:             MSDP_ARRAY_OPEN, MSDP_VAL, apValue, MSDP_ARRAY_CLOSE, IAC, SE );
  1205: 
  1206:          /* Convert the spaces to MSDP_VAL */
  1207:          for ( i = 0; MSDPBuffer[i] != '\0'; ++i )
  1208:          {
  1209:             if ( MSDPBuffer[i] == ' ' )
  1210:                MSDPBuffer[i] = MSDP_VAL;
  1211:          }
  1212:       }
  1213:       else if ( pProtocol->bATCP )
  1214:       {
  1215:          sprintf( MSDPBuffer, "%c%c%cMSDP.%s %s%c%c", 
  1216:             IAC, SB, TELOPT_ATCP, apVariable, apValue, IAC, SE );
  1217:       }
  1218: 
  1219:       /* Just in case someone calls this function without checking MSDP/ATCP */
  1220:       if ( MSDPBuffer[0] != '\0' )
  1221:          Write( apDescriptor, MSDPBuffer );
  1222:    }
  1223: }
  1224: 
  1225: void MSDPSetNumber( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, variable_t aMSDP, int aValue )
  1226: {
  1227:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1228: 
  1229:    if ( pProtocol != NULL && aMSDP > eMSDP_NONE && aMSDP < eMSDP_MAX )
  1230:    {
  1231:       if ( !VariableNameTable[aMSDP].bString )
  1232:       {
  1233:          if ( pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->ValueInt != aValue )
  1234:          {
  1235:             pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->ValueInt = aValue;
  1236:             pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->bDirty = true;
  1237:          }
  1238:       }
  1239:    }
  1240: }

  1242: void MSDPSetString( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, variable_t aMSDP, const char *apValue )
  1243: {
  1244:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1245: 
  1246:    if ( pProtocol != NULL && apValue != NULL )
  1247:    {
  1248:       if ( VariableNameTable[aMSDP].bString )
  1249:       {
  1250:          if ( strcmp(pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString, apValue) )
  1251:          {
  1252:             free(pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString);
  1253:             pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString = AllocString(apValue);
  1254:             pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->bDirty = true;
  1255:          }
  1256:       }
  1257:    }
  1258: }
  1259: 
  1260: void MSDPSetTable( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, variable_t aMSDP, const char *apValue )
  1261: {
  1262:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1263: 
  1264:    if ( pProtocol != NULL && apValue != NULL )
  1265:    {
  1266:       if ( *apValue == '\0' )
  1267:       {
  1268:          /* It's easier to call MSDPSetString if the value is empty */
  1269:          MSDPSetString(apDescriptor, aMSDP, apValue);
  1270:       }
  1271:       else if ( VariableNameTable[aMSDP].bString )
  1272:       {
  1273:          const char MsdpTableStart[] = { (char)MSDP_TABLE_OPEN, '\0' };
  1274:          const char MsdpTableStop[]  = { (char)MSDP_TABLE_CLOSE, '\0' };
  1275: 
  1276:          char *pTable = (char *) malloc(strlen(apValue) + 3); /* 3: START, STOP, NUL */
  1277: 
  1278:          strcpy(pTable, MsdpTableStart);
  1279:          strcat(pTable, apValue);
  1280:          strcat(pTable, MsdpTableStop);
  1281: 
  1282:          if ( strcmp(pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString, pTable) )
  1283:          {
  1284:             free(pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString);
  1285:             pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString = pTable;
  1286:             pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->bDirty = true;
  1287:          }
  1288:          else /* Just discard the table, we've already got one */
  1289:          {
  1290:             free(pTable);
  1291:          }
  1292:       }
  1293:    }
  1294: }
  1295: 
  1296: void MSDPSetArray( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, variable_t aMSDP, const char *apValue )
  1297: {
  1298:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1299: 
  1300:    if ( pProtocol != NULL && apValue != NULL )
  1301:    {
  1302:       if ( *apValue == '\0' )
  1303:       {
  1304:          /* It's easier to call MSDPSetString if the value is empty */
  1305:          MSDPSetString(apDescriptor, aMSDP, apValue);
  1306:       }
  1307:       else if ( VariableNameTable[aMSDP].bString )
  1308:       {
  1309:          const char MsdpArrayStart[] = { (char)MSDP_ARRAY_OPEN, '\0' };
  1310:          const char MsdpArrayStop[]  = { (char)MSDP_ARRAY_CLOSE, '\0' };
  1311: 
  1312:          char *pArray = (char *) malloc(strlen(apValue) + 3); /* 3: START, STOP, NUL */
  1313: 
  1314:          strcpy(pArray, MsdpArrayStart);
  1315:          strcat(pArray, apValue);
  1316:          strcat(pArray, MsdpArrayStop);
  1317: 
  1318:          if ( strcmp(pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString, pArray) )
  1319:          {
  1320:             free(pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString);
  1321:             pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->pValueString = pArray;
  1322:             pProtocol->pVariables[aMSDP]->bDirty = true;
  1323:          }
  1324:          else /* Just discard the array, we've already got one */
  1325:          {
  1326:             free(pArray);
  1327:          }
  1328:       }
  1329:    }
  1330: }

  1344: /******************************************************************************
  1345:  MXP global functions.
  1346:  ******************************************************************************/
  1347: 
  1348: const char *MXPCreateTag( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apTag )
  1349: {
  1350:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1351: 
  1352:    if ( pProtocol != NULL && pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_MXP]->ValueInt && 
  1353:       strlen(apTag) < 1000 )
  1354:    {
  1355:       static char MXPBuffer [1024];
  1356:       sprintf( MXPBuffer, "\033[1z%s\033[7z", apTag );
  1357:       return MXPBuffer;
  1358:    }
  1359:    else /* Leave the tag as-is, don't try to MXPify it */
  1360:    {
  1361:       return apTag;
  1362:    }
  1363: }
  1364: 
  1365: void MXPSendTag( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apTag )
  1366: {
  1367:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1368: 
  1369:    if ( pProtocol != NULL && pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_MXP]->ValueInt && 
  1370:       strlen(apTag) < 1000 )
  1371:    {
  1372:       char MXPBuffer [1024];
  1373:       sprintf(MXPBuffer, "\033[1z%s\033[7z\r\n", apTag );
  1374:       Write(apDescriptor, MXPBuffer);
  1375:    }
  1376: }

  1378: /******************************************************************************
  1379:  Sound global functions.
  1380:  ******************************************************************************/
  1381: 
  1382: void SoundSend( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apTrigger )
  1383: {
  1384:    const int MaxTriggerLength = 128; /* Used for the buffer size */
  1385: 
  1386:    if ( apDescriptor != NULL && apTrigger != NULL )
  1387:    {
  1388:       protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1389: 
  1390:       if ( pProtocol != NULL && pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_SOUND]->ValueInt )
  1391:       {
  1392:          if ( pProtocol->bMSDP || pProtocol->bATCP )
  1393:          {
  1394:             /* Send the sound trigger through MSDP or ATCP */
  1395:             MSDPSendPair( apDescriptor, "PLAY_SOUND", apTrigger );
  1396:          }
  1397:          else if ( strlen(apTrigger) <= MaxTriggerLength )
  1398:          {
  1399:             /* Use an old MSP-style trigger */
  1400:             char *pBuffer = alloca(MaxTriggerLength+10);
  1401:             sprintf( pBuffer, "\t!SOUND(%s)", apTrigger );
  1402:             Write(apDescriptor, pBuffer);
  1403:          }
  1404:       }
  1405:    }
  1406: }
