  1408: /******************************************************************************
  1409:  Colour global functions.
  1410:  ******************************************************************************/
  1411: 
  1412: const char *ColourRGB( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apRGB )
  1413: {
  1414:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  1415:    bool charHasColor = TRUE;
  1416:    
  1417:    if (apDescriptor->character && !clr(apDescriptor->character, C_CMP))
  1418:      charHasColor = FALSE;
  1419: 
  1420:    if ( pProtocol && pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_ANSI_COLORS]->ValueInt && charHasColor )
  1421:    {
  1422:       if ( IsValidColour(apRGB) )
  1423:       {
  1424:          bool_t bBackground = (tolower(apRGB[0]) == 'b');
  1425:          int Red = apRGB[1] - '0';
  1426:          int Green = apRGB[2] - '0';
  1427:          int Blue = apRGB[3] - '0';
  1428: 
  1429:          if ( pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt )
  1430:             return GetRGBColour( bBackground, Red, Green, Blue );
  1431:          else /* Use regular ANSI colour */
  1432:             return GetAnsiColour( bBackground, Red, Green, Blue );
  1433:       }
  1434:       else /* Invalid colour - use this to clear any existing colour. */
  1435:       {
  1436:          return s_Clean;
  1437:       }
  1438:    }
  1439:    else /* Don't send any colour, not even clear */
  1440:    {
  1441:       return "";
  1442:    }
  1443: }
  1444: 
  1445: /******************************************************************************
  1446:  UTF-8 global functions.
  1447:  ******************************************************************************/
  1448: 
  1449: char *UnicodeGet( int aValue )
  1450: {
  1451:    static char Buffer[8];
  1452:    char *pString = Buffer;
  1453: 
  1454:    UnicodeAdd( &pString, aValue );
  1455:    *pString = '\0';
  1456: 
  1457:    return Buffer;
  1458: }
  1459: 
  1460: void UnicodeAdd( char **apString, int aValue )
  1461: {
  1462:    if ( aValue < 0x80 )
  1463:    {
  1464:       *(*apString)++ = (char)aValue;
  1465:    }
  1466:    else if ( aValue < 0x800 )
  1467:    {
  1468:       *(*apString)++ = (char)(0xC0 | (aValue>>6));
  1469:       *(*apString)++ = (char)(0x80 | (aValue & 0x3F));
  1470:    }
  1471:    else if ( aValue < 0x10000 )
  1472:    {
  1473:       *(*apString)++ = (char)(0xE0 | (aValue>>12));
  1474:       *(*apString)++ = (char)(0x80 | (aValue>>6 & 0x3F));
  1475:       *(*apString)++ = (char)(0x80 | (aValue & 0x3F));
  1476:    }
  1477:    else if ( aValue < 0x200000 )
  1478:    {
  1479:       *(*apString)++ = (char)(0xF0 | (aValue>>18));
  1480:       *(*apString)++ = (char)(0x80 | (aValue>>12 & 0x3F));
  1481:       *(*apString)++ = (char)(0x80 | (aValue>>6 & 0x3F));
  1482:       *(*apString)++ = (char)(0x80 | (aValue & 0x3F));
  1483:    }
  1484: }
  1485: 
  1486: /******************************************************************************
  1487:  Local negotiation functions.
  1488:  ******************************************************************************/
  1489: 
  1490: static void Negotiate( descriptor_t *apDescriptor )
  1491: {
  1492:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor->pProtocol;
  1493: 
  1494:    if ( pProtocol->bNegotiated )
  1495:    {
  1496:       const char RequestTTYPE   [] = { (char)IAC, (char)SB,   TELOPT_TTYPE, SEND, (char)IAC, (char)SE, '\0' };
  1497:       const char DoNAWS         [] = { (char)IAC, (char)DO,   TELOPT_NAWS,      '\0' };
  1498:       const char DoCHARSET      [] = { (char)IAC, (char)DO,   TELOPT_CHARSET,   '\0' };
  1499:       const char WillMSDP       [] = { (char)IAC, (char)WILL, TELOPT_MSDP,      '\0' };
  1500:       const char WillMSSP       [] = { (char)IAC, (char)WILL, TELOPT_MSSP,      '\0' };
  1501:       const char DoATCP         [] = { (char)IAC, (char)DO,   (char)TELOPT_ATCP,'\0' };
  1502:       const char WillMSP        [] = { (char)IAC, (char)WILL, TELOPT_MSP,       '\0' };
  1503:       const char DoMXP          [] = { (char)IAC, (char)DO,   TELOPT_MXP,       '\0' };
  1504: 
  1505: #ifdef USING_MCCP
  1506:       const char WillMCCP       [] = { (char)IAC, (char)WILL, TELOPT_MCCP,      '\0' };
  1507: #endif // USING_MCCP
  1508: 
  1509:       /* Request the client type if TTYPE is supported. */
  1510:       if ( pProtocol->bTTYPE )
  1511:          Write(apDescriptor, RequestTTYPE);
  1512: 
  1513:       /* Check for other protocols. */
  1514:       Write(apDescriptor, DoNAWS);
  1515:       /* Gnome-mud seems to have an issue with negotiating DoCHARSET under
  1516:        * certain conditions cause it to crash. This is a GNOME-MUD issue
  1517:        * and not an issue on our end. Never-the-less, if you discover you
  1518:        * are having this issue you can either a) disable protocol negotiation
  1519:        * in cedit, or b) disable detection of CHARSET by deleting/commenting
  1520:        * the following line.
  1521:        * 
  1522:        * For more information on gnome-mud's bug see:
  1523:        * https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/gnome-mud/+bug/398340 */
  1524:       Write(apDescriptor, DoCHARSET);
  1525:       Write(apDescriptor, WillMSDP);
  1526:       Write(apDescriptor, WillMSSP);
  1527:       Write(apDescriptor, DoATCP);
  1528:       Write(apDescriptor, WillMSP);
  1529:       Write(apDescriptor, DoMXP);
  1530: 
  1531: #ifdef USING_MCCP
  1532:       Write(apDescriptor, WillMCCP);
  1533: #endif // USING_MCCP
  1534:    }
  1535: }
  1536: 
  1537: static void PerformHandshake( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, char aCmd, char aProtocol )
  1538: {
  1539:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor->pProtocol;
  1540: 
  1541:    switch ( aProtocol )
  1542:    {
  1543:       case (char)TELOPT_TTYPE:
  1544:          if ( aCmd == (char)WILL )
  1545:          {
  1546:             if ( !pProtocol->bNegotiated )
  1547:             {
  1548:                /* Negotiate for the remaining protocols. */
  1549:                pProtocol->bNegotiated = true;
  1550:                pProtocol->bTTYPE = true;
  1551:                Negotiate(apDescriptor);
  1552:             }
  1553:          }
  1554:          else if ( aCmd == (char)WONT )
  1555:          {
  1556:             if ( !pProtocol->bNegotiated )
  1557:             {
  1558:                /* Still negotiate, as this client obviously knows how to 
  1559:                 * correctly respond to negotiation attempts - but we don't 
  1560:                 * ask for TTYPE, as it doesn't support it.
  1561:                 */
  1562:                pProtocol->bNegotiated = true;
  1563:                pProtocol->bTTYPE = false;
  1564:                Negotiate(apDescriptor);
  1565:             }
  1566:          }
  1567:          break;
  1568: 
  1569:       case (char)TELOPT_NAWS:
  1570:          if ( aCmd == (char)WILL )
  1571:             pProtocol->bNAWS = true;
  1572:          else if ( aCmd == (char)WONT )
  1573:             pProtocol->bNAWS = false;
  1574:          break;
  1575: 
  1576:       case (char)TELOPT_CHARSET:
  1577:          if ( aCmd == (char)WILL )
  1578:          {
  1579:             char charset_utf8 [] = { (char)IAC, (char)SB, TELOPT_CHARSET, 1, ' ', 'U', 'T', 'F', '-', '8', (char)IAC, (char)SE, '\0' };
  1580:             Write(apDescriptor, charset_utf8);
  1581:             pProtocol->bCHARSET = true;
  1582:          }
  1583:          else if ( aCmd == (char)WONT )
  1584:             pProtocol->bCHARSET = false;
  1585:          break;
  1586: 
  1587:       case (char)TELOPT_MSDP:
  1588:          if ( aCmd == (char)DO )
  1589:          {
  1590:             pProtocol->bMSDP = true;
  1591: 
  1592:             /* Identify the mud to the client. */
  1593:             MSDPSendPair( apDescriptor, "SERVER_ID", MUD_NAME );
  1594:          }
  1595:          else if ( aCmd == (char)DONT )
  1596:             pProtocol->bMSDP = false;
  1597:          break;
  1598: 
  1599:       case (char)TELOPT_MSSP:
  1600:          if ( aCmd == (char)DO )
  1601:             SendMSSP( apDescriptor );
  1602:          else if ( aCmd == (char)DONT )
  1603:             ; /* Do nothing. */
  1604:          break;
  1605: 
  1606:       case (char)TELOPT_MCCP:
  1607:          if ( aCmd == (char)DO )
  1608:          {
  1609:             pProtocol->bMCCP = true;
  1610:             CompressStart( apDescriptor );
  1611:          }
  1612:          else if ( aCmd == (char)DONT )
  1613:          {
  1614:             pProtocol->bMCCP = false;
  1615:             CompressEnd( apDescriptor );
  1616:          }
  1617:          break;
  1618: 
  1619:       case (char)TELOPT_MSP:
  1620:          if ( aCmd == (char)DO )
  1621:             pProtocol->bMSP = true;
  1622:          else if ( aCmd == (char)DONT )
  1623:             pProtocol->bMSP = false;
  1624:          break;
  1625: 
  1626:       case (char)TELOPT_MXP:
  1627:          if ( aCmd == (char)WILL || aCmd == (char)DO )
  1628:          {
  1629:             /* Enable MXP. */
  1630:             const char EnableMXP[] = { (char)IAC, (char)SB, TELOPT_MXP, (char)IAC, (char)SE, '\0' };
  1631:             Write(apDescriptor, EnableMXP);
  1632: 
  1633:             /* Create a secure channel, and note that MXP is active. */
  1634:             Write(apDescriptor, "\033[7z");
  1635:             pProtocol->bMXP = true;
  1636:             pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_MXP]->ValueInt = 1;
  1637:          }
  1638:          else if ( aCmd == (char)WONT )
  1639:          {
  1640:             if ( !pProtocol->bMXP )
  1641:             {
  1642:                /* The MXP standard doesn't actually specify whether you should 
  1643:                 * negotiate with IAC DO MXP or IAC WILL MXP.  As a result, some 
  1644:                 * clients support one, some the other, and some support both.
  1645:                 * 
  1646:                 * Therefore we first try IAC DO MXP, and if the client replies 
  1647:                 * with WONT, we try again (here) with IAC WILL MXP.
  1648:                 */
  1649:                const char WillMXP[] = { (char)IAC, (char)WILL, TELOPT_MXP, '\0' };
  1650:                Write(apDescriptor, WillMXP);
  1651:             }
  1652:             else // The client is actually asking us to switch MXP off.
  1653:             {
  1654:                pProtocol->bMXP = false;
  1655:             }
  1656:          }
  1657:          else if ( aCmd == (char)DONT )
  1658:             pProtocol->bMXP = false;
  1659:          break;
  1660: 
  1661:       case (char)TELOPT_ATCP:
  1662:          if ( aCmd == (char)WILL )
  1663:          {
  1664:             /* If we don't support MSDP, fake it with ATCP */
  1665:             if ( !pProtocol->bMSDP )
  1666:             {
  1667:                pProtocol->bATCP = true;
  1668: 
  1669: #ifdef MUDLET_PACKAGE
  1670:                /* Send the Mudlet GUI package to the user. */
  1671:                if ( MatchString( "Mudlet",
  1672:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString ) )
  1673:                {
  1674:                   SendATCP( apDescriptor, "Client.GUI", MUDLET_PACKAGE );
  1675:                }
  1676: #endif /* MUDLET_PACKAGE */
  1677: 
  1678:                /* Identify the mud to the client. */
  1679:                MSDPSendPair( apDescriptor, "SERVER_ID", MUD_NAME );
  1680:             }
  1681:          }
  1682:          else if ( aCmd == (char)WONT )
  1683:             pProtocol->bATCP = false;
  1684:          break;
  1685: 
  1686:       default:
  1687:          break;
  1688:    }
  1689: }
  1690: 
  1691: static void PerformSubnegotiation( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, char aCmd, char *apData, int aSize )
  1692: {
  1693:    protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor->pProtocol;
  1694: 
  1695:    switch ( aCmd )
  1696:    {
  1697:       case (char)TELOPT_TTYPE:
  1698:          if ( pProtocol->bTTYPE )
  1699:          {
  1700:             /* Store the client name. */
  1701:             const int MaxClientLength = 64;
  1702:             char *pClientName = alloca(MaxClientLength+1);
  1703:             int i = 0, j = 1;
  1704:             bool_t bStopCyclicTTYPE = false;
  1705: 
  1706:             for ( ; apData[j] != '\0' && i < MaxClientLength; ++j )
  1707:             {
  1708:                if ( isprint(apData[j]) )
  1709:                   pClientName[i++] = apData[j];
  1710:             }
  1711:             pClientName[i] = '\0';
  1712: 
  1713:             /* Store the first TTYPE as the client name */
  1714:             if ( !strcmp(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString, "Unknown") )
  1715:             {
  1716:                free(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString);
  1717:                pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString = AllocString(pClientName);
  1718: 
  1719:                /* This is a bit nasty, but using cyclic TTYPE on windows telnet 
  1720:                 * causes it to lock up.  None of the clients we need to cycle 
  1721:                 * with send ANSI to start with anyway, so we shouldn't have any 
  1722:                 * conflicts.
  1723:                 * 
  1724:                 * An alternative solution is to use escape sequences to check 
  1725:                 * for windows telnet prior to negotiation, and this also avoids 
  1726:                 * the player losing echo, but it has other issues.  Because the 
  1727:                 * escape codes are technically in-band, even though they'll be 
  1728:                 * stripped from the display, the newlines will still cause some 
  1729:                 * scrolling.  Therefore you need to either pause the session 
  1730:                 * for a few seconds before displaying the login screen, or wait 
  1731:                 * until the player has entered their name before negotiating.
  1732:                 */
  1733:                if ( !strcmp(pClientName,"ANSI") )
  1734:                   bStopCyclicTTYPE = true;
  1735:             }
  1736: 
  1737:             /* Cycle through the TTYPEs until we get the same result twice, or 
  1738:              * find ourselves back at the start.
  1739:              * 
  1740:              * If the client follows RFC1091 properly then it will indicate the 
  1741:              * end of the list by repeating the last response, and then return 
  1742:              * to the top of the list.  If you're the trusting type, then feel 
  1743:              * free to remove the second strcmp ;)
  1744:              */
  1745:             if ( pProtocol->pLastTTYPE == NULL || 
  1746:                (strcmp(pProtocol->pLastTTYPE, pClientName) && 
  1747:                strcmp(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString, pClientName)) )
  1748:             {
  1749:                char RequestTTYPE [] = { (char)IAC, (char)SB, TELOPT_TTYPE, SEND, (char)IAC, (char)SE, '\0' };
  1750:                const char *pStartPos = strstr( pClientName, "-" );
  1751: 
  1752:                /* Store the TTYPE */
  1753:                if (pProtocol->pLastTTYPE)
  1754:                  free(pProtocol->pLastTTYPE);
  1755:                pProtocol->pLastTTYPE = AllocString(pClientName);
  1756: 
  1757:                /* Look for 256 colour support */
  1758:                if ( (pStartPos != NULL && MatchString(pStartPos, "-256color")) || MatchString(pClientName, "xterm") )
  1759:                {
  1760:                   /* This is currently the only way to detect support for 256 
  1761:                    * colours in TinTin++, WinTin++ and BlowTorch.
  1762:                    */
  1763:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
  1764:                   pProtocol->b256Support = eYES;
  1765:                }
  1766: 
  1767:                /* Request another TTYPE */
  1768:                if ( !bStopCyclicTTYPE )
  1769:                   Write(apDescriptor, RequestTTYPE);
  1770:             }
  1771: 
  1772:             if ( PrefixString("MTTS ", pClientName) )
  1773:             {
  1774:                pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->ValueInt = atoi(pClientName+5);
  1775: 
  1776:                if (pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->ValueInt & 1)
  1777:                {
  1778:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_ANSI_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
  1779:                }
  1780:                if (pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->ValueInt & 4)
  1781:                {
  1782:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_UTF_8]->ValueInt = 1;
  1783:                }
  1784:                if (pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->ValueInt & 8)
  1785:                {
  1786:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
  1787:                   pProtocol->b256Support = eYES;
  1788:                }
  1789: 
  1790:             }
  1791:             else if ( PrefixString("Mudlet", pClientName) )
  1792:             {
  1793:                /* Mudlet beta 15 and later supports 256 colours, but we can't 
  1794:                 * identify it from the mud - everything prior to 1.1 claims 
  1795:                 * to be version 1.0, so we just don't know.
  1796:                 */ 
  1797:                pProtocol->b256Support = eSOMETIMES;
  1798: 
  1799:                if ( strlen(pClientName) > 7 )
  1800:                {
  1801:                   pClientName[6] = '\0';
  1802:                   free(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString);
  1803:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString = AllocString(pClientName);
  1804:                   free(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->pValueString);
  1805:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->pValueString = AllocString(pClientName+7);
  1806: 
  1807:                   /* Mudlet 1.1 and later supports 256 colours. */
  1808:                   if ( strcmp(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->pValueString, "1.1") >= 0 )
  1809:                   {
  1810:                      pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
  1811:                      pProtocol->b256Support = eYES;
  1812:                   }
  1813:                }
  1814:             }
  1815:             else if ( MatchString(pClientName, "EMACS-RINZAI") )
  1816:             {
  1817:                /* We know for certain that this client has support */
  1818:                pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
  1819:                pProtocol->b256Support = eYES;
  1820:             }
  1821:             else if ( PrefixString("DecafMUD", pClientName) )
  1822:             {
  1823:                /* We know for certain that this client has support */
  1824:                pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_XTERM_256_COLORS]->ValueInt = 1;
  1825:                pProtocol->b256Support = eYES;
  1826: 
  1827:                if ( strlen(pClientName) > 9 )
  1828:                {
  1829:                   pClientName[8] = '\0';
  1830:                   free(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString);
  1831:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_ID]->pValueString = AllocString(pClientName);
  1832:                   free(pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->pValueString);
  1833:                   pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_CLIENT_VERSION]->pValueString = AllocString(pClientName+9);
  1834:                }
  1835:             }
  1836:             else if ( MatchString(pClientName, "MUSHCLIENT") || 
  1837:                MatchString(pClientName, "CMUD") || 
  1838:                MatchString(pClientName, "ATLANTIS") || 
  1839:                MatchString(pClientName, "KILDCLIENT") || 
  1840:                MatchString(pClientName, "TINTIN++") || 
  1841:                MatchString(pClientName, "TINYFUGUE") )
  1842:             {
  1843:                /* We know that some versions of this client have support */
  1844:                pProtocol->b256Support = eSOMETIMES;
  1845:             }
  1846:             else if ( MatchString(pClientName, "ZMUD") )
  1847:             {
  1848:                /* We know for certain that this client does not have support */
  1849:                pProtocol->b256Support = eNO;
  1850:             }
  1851:          }
  1852:          break;
  1853: 
  1854:       case (char)TELOPT_NAWS:
  1855:          if ( pProtocol->bNAWS )
  1856:          {
  1857:             /* Store the new width. */
  1858:             pProtocol->ScreenWidth = (unsigned char)apData[0];
  1859:             pProtocol->ScreenWidth <<= 8;
  1860:             pProtocol->ScreenWidth += (unsigned char)apData[1];
  1861: 
  1862:             /* Store the new height. */
  1863:             pProtocol->ScreenHeight = (unsigned char)apData[2];
  1864:             pProtocol->ScreenHeight <<= 8;
  1865:             pProtocol->ScreenHeight += (unsigned char)apData[3];
  1866:          }
  1867:          break;
  1868: 
  1869:       case (char)TELOPT_CHARSET:
  1870:          if ( pProtocol->bCHARSET )
  1871:          {
  1872:             /* Because we're only asking about UTF-8, we can just check the 
  1873:              * first character.  If you ask for more than one CHARSET you'll 
  1874:              * need to read through the results to see which are accepted.
  1875:              *
  1876:              * Note that the user must also use a unicode font!
  1877:              */
  1878:             if ( apData[0] == ACCEPTED )
  1879:                pProtocol->pVariables[eMSDP_UTF_8]->ValueInt = 1;
  1880:          }
  1881:          break;
  1882: 
  1883:       case (char)TELOPT_MSDP:
  1884:          ParseMSDP( apDescriptor, apData );
  1885:          break;
  1886: 
  1887:       case (char)TELOPT_ATCP:
  1888:          ParseATCP( apDescriptor, apData );
  1889:          break;
  1890: 
  1891:       default: /* Unknown subnegotiation, so we simply ignore it. */
  1892:          break;
  1893:    }
  1894: }
  1895: 
  1896: /******************************************************************************
  1897:  Local MSDP functions.
  1898:  ******************************************************************************/
  1899: 
  1900: static void ParseMSDP( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apData )
  1901: {
  1902:    char Variable[MSDP_VAL][MAX_MSDP_SIZE+1] = { {'\0'}, {'\0'} };
  1903:    char *pPos = NULL, *pStart = NULL;
  1904: 
  1905:    while ( *apData )
  1906:    {
  1907:       switch ( *apData )
  1908:       {
  1909:          case MSDP_VAR: case MSDP_VAL:
  1910:             pPos = pStart = Variable[*apData++-1];
  1911:             break;
  1912:          default: /* Anything else */
  1913:             if ( pPos && pPos-pStart < MAX_MSDP_SIZE )
  1914:             {
  1915:                *pPos++ = *apData;
  1916:                *pPos = '\0';
  1917:             }
  1918: 
  1919:             if ( *++apData )
  1920:                continue;
  1921:       }
  1922: 
  1923:       ExecuteMSDPPair( apDescriptor, Variable[MSDP_VAR-1], Variable[MSDP_VAL-1] );
  1924:       Variable[MSDP_VAL-1][0] = '\0';
  1925:    }
  1926: }
  1927: 
  1928: static void ExecuteMSDPPair( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apVariable, const char *apValue )
  1929: {
  1930:    if ( apVariable[0] != '\0' && apValue[0] != '\0' )
  1931:    {
  1932:       if ( MatchString(apVariable, "SEND") )
  1933:       {
  1934:          bool_t bDone = false;
  1935:          int i; /* Loop counter */
  1936:          for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX && !bDone; ++i )
  1937:          {
  1938:             if ( MatchString(apValue, VariableNameTable[i].pName) )
  1939:             {
  1940:                MSDPSend( apDescriptor, (variable_t)i );
  1941:                bDone = true;
  1942:             }
  1943:          }
  1944:       }
  1945:       else if ( MatchString(apVariable, "REPORT") )
  1946:       {
  1947:          bool_t bDone = false;
  1948:          int i; /* Loop counter */
  1949:          for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX && !bDone; ++i )
  1950:          {
  1951:             if ( MatchString(apValue, VariableNameTable[i].pName) )
  1952:             {
  1953:                apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bReport = true;
  1954:                apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bDirty = true;
  1955:                bDone = true;
  1956:             }
  1957:          }
  1958:       }
  1959:       else if ( MatchString(apVariable, "RESET") )
  1960:       {
  1961:          if ( MatchString(apValue, "REPORTABLE_VARIABLES") || 
  1962:             MatchString(apValue, "REPORTED_VARIABLES") )
  1963:          {
  1964:             int i; /* Loop counter */
  1965:             for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
  1966:             {
  1967:                if ( apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bReport )
  1968:                {
  1969:                   apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bReport = false;
  1970:                   apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bDirty = false;
  1971:                }
  1972:             }
  1973:          }
  1974:       }
  1975:       else if ( MatchString(apVariable, "UNREPORT") )
  1976:       {
  1977:          bool_t bDone = false;
  1978:          int i; /* Loop counter */
  1979:          for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX && !bDone; ++i )
  1980:          {
  1981:             if ( MatchString(apValue, VariableNameTable[i].pName) )
  1982:             {
  1983:                apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bReport = false;
  1984:                apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bDirty = false;
  1985:                bDone = true;
  1986:             }
  1987:          }
  1988:       }
  1989:       else if ( MatchString(apVariable, "LIST") )
  1990:       {
  1991:          if ( MatchString(apValue, "COMMANDS") )
  1992:          {
  1993:             const char MSDPCommands[] = "LIST REPORT RESET SEND UNREPORT";
  1994:             MSDPSendList( apDescriptor, "COMMANDS", MSDPCommands );
  1995:          }
  1996:          else if ( MatchString(apValue, "LISTS") )
  1997:          {
  1998:             const char MSDPCommands[] = "COMMANDS LISTS CONFIGURABLE_VARIABLES REPORTABLE_VARIABLES REPORTED_VARIABLES SENDABLE_VARIABLES GUI_VARIABLES";
  1999:             MSDPSendList( apDescriptor, "LISTS", MSDPCommands );
  2000:          }
  2001:          /* Split this into two if some variables aren't REPORTABLE */
  2002:          else if ( MatchString(apValue, "SENDABLE_VARIABLES") || 
  2003:             MatchString(apValue, "REPORTABLE_VARIABLES") )
  2004:          {
  2005:             char MSDPCommands[MAX_OUTPUT_BUFFER] = { '\0' };
  2006:             int i; /* Loop counter */
  2007: 
  2008:             for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
  2009:             {
  2010:                if ( !VariableNameTable[i].bGUI )
  2011:                {
  2012:                   /* Add the separator between variables */
  2013:                   strcat( MSDPCommands, " " );
  2014: 
  2015:                   /* Add the variable to the list */
  2016:                   strcat( MSDPCommands, VariableNameTable[i].pName );
  2017:                }
  2018:             }
  2019: 
  2020:             MSDPSendList( apDescriptor, apValue, MSDPCommands );
  2021:          }
  2022:          else if ( MatchString(apValue, "REPORTED_VARIABLES") )
  2023:          {
  2024:             char MSDPCommands[MAX_OUTPUT_BUFFER] = { '\0' };
  2025:             int i; /* Loop counter */
  2026: 
  2027:             for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
  2028:             {
  2029:                if ( apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->bReport )
  2030:                {
  2031:                   /* Add the separator between variables */
  2032:                   if ( MSDPCommands[0] != '\0' )
  2033:                      strcat( MSDPCommands, " " );
  2034: 
  2035:                   /* Add the variable to the list */
  2036:                   strcat( MSDPCommands, VariableNameTable[i].pName );
  2037:                }
  2038:             }
  2039: 
  2040:             MSDPSendList( apDescriptor, apValue, MSDPCommands );
  2041:          }
  2042:          else if ( MatchString(apValue, "CONFIGURABLE_VARIABLES") )
  2043:          {
  2044:             char MSDPCommands[MAX_OUTPUT_BUFFER] = { '\0' };
  2045:             int i; /* Loop counter */
  2046: 
  2047:             for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
  2048:             {
  2049:                if ( VariableNameTable[i].bConfigurable )
  2050:                {
  2051:                   /* Add the separator between variables */
  2052:                   if ( MSDPCommands[0] != '\0' )
  2053:                      strcat( MSDPCommands, " " );
  2054: 
  2055:                   /* Add the variable to the list */
  2056:                   strcat( MSDPCommands, VariableNameTable[i].pName );
  2057:                }
  2058:             }
  2059: 
  2060:             MSDPSendList( apDescriptor, "CONFIGURABLE_VARIABLES", MSDPCommands );
  2061:          }
  2062:          else if ( MatchString(apValue, "GUI_VARIABLES") )
  2063:          {
  2064:             char MSDPCommands[MAX_OUTPUT_BUFFER] = { '\0' };
  2065:             int i; /* Loop counter */
  2066: 
  2067:             for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
  2068:             {
  2069:                if ( VariableNameTable[i].bGUI )
  2070:                {
  2071:                   /* Add the separator between variables */
  2072:                   if ( MSDPCommands[0] != '\0' )
  2073:                      strcat( MSDPCommands, " " );
  2074: 
  2075:                   /* Add the variable to the list */
  2076:                   strcat( MSDPCommands, VariableNameTable[i].pName );
  2077:                }
  2078:             }
  2079: 
  2080:             MSDPSendList( apDescriptor, apValue, MSDPCommands );
  2081:          }
  2082:       }
  2083:       else /* Set any configurable variables */
  2084:       {
  2085:          int i; /* Loop counter */
  2086: 
  2087:          for ( i = eMSDP_NONE+1; i < eMSDP_MAX; ++i )
  2088:          {
  2089:             if ( VariableNameTable[i].bConfigurable )
  2090:             {
  2091:                if ( MatchString(apVariable, VariableNameTable[i].pName) )
  2092:                {
  2093:                   if ( VariableNameTable[i].bString )
  2094:                   {
  2095:                      /* A write-once variable can only be set if the value 
  2096:                       * is "Unknown".  This is for things like client name, 
  2097:                       * where we don't really want the player overwriting a 
  2098:                       * proper client name with junk - but on the other hand, 
  2099:                       * its possible a client may choose to use MSDP to 
  2100:                       * identify itself.
  2101:                       */
  2102:                      if ( !VariableNameTable[i].bWriteOnce || 
  2103:                         !strcmp(apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->pValueString, "Unknown") )
  2104:                      {
  2105:                         /* Store the new value if it's valid */
  2106:                         char *pBuffer = alloca(VariableNameTable[i].Max+1);
  2107:                         int j; /* Loop counter */
  2108: 
  2109:                         for ( j = 0; j < VariableNameTable[i].Max && *apValue != '\0'; ++apValue )
  2110:                         {
  2111:                            if ( isprint(*apValue) )
  2112:                               pBuffer[j++] = *apValue;
  2113:                         }
  2114:                         pBuffer[j++] = '\0';
  2115: 
  2116:                         if ( j >= VariableNameTable[i].Min )
  2117:                         {
  2118:                            free(apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->pValueString);
  2119:                            apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->pValueString = AllocString(pBuffer);
  2120:                         }
  2121:                      }
  2122:                   }
  2123:                   else /* This variable only accepts numeric values */
  2124:                   {
  2125:                      /* Strip any leading spaces */
  2126:                      while ( *apValue == ' ' )
  2127:                         ++apValue;
  2128: 
  2129:                      if ( *apValue != '\0' && IsNumber(apValue) )
  2130:                      {
  2131:                         int Value = atoi(apValue);
  2132:                         if ( Value >= VariableNameTable[i].Min && 
  2133:                            Value <= VariableNameTable[i].Max )
  2134:                         {
  2135:                            apDescriptor->pProtocol->pVariables[i]->ValueInt = Value;
  2136:                         }
  2137:                      }
  2138:                   }
  2139:                }
  2140:             }
  2141:          }
  2142:       }
  2143:    }
  2144: }

  2146: /******************************************************************************
  2147:  Local ATCP functions.
  2148:  ******************************************************************************/
  2149: 
  2150: static void ParseATCP( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apData )
  2151: {
  2152:    char Variable[MSDP_VAL][MAX_MSDP_SIZE+1] = { {'\0'}, {'\0'} };
  2153:    char *pPos = NULL, *pStart = NULL;
  2154: 
  2155:    while ( *apData )
  2156:    {
  2157:       switch ( *apData )
  2158:       {
  2159:          case '@': 
  2160:             pPos = pStart = Variable[0];
  2161:             apData++;
  2162:             break;
  2163:          case ' ': 
  2164:             pPos = pStart = Variable[1];
  2165:             apData++;
  2166:             break;
  2167:          default: /* Anything else */
  2168:             if ( pPos && pPos-pStart < MAX_MSDP_SIZE )
  2169:             {
  2170:                *pPos++ = *apData;
  2171:                *pPos = '\0';
  2172:             }
  2173: 
  2174:             if ( *++apData )
  2175:                continue;
  2176:       }
  2177: 
  2178:       ExecuteMSDPPair( apDescriptor, Variable[MSDP_VAR-1], Variable[MSDP_VAL-1] );
  2179:       Variable[MSDP_VAL-1][0] = '\0';
  2180:    }
  2181: }
  2182: 
  2183: #ifdef MUDLET_PACKAGE
  2184: static void SendATCP( descriptor_t *apDescriptor, const char *apVariable, const char *apValue )
  2185: {
  2186:    char ATCPBuffer[MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH+1] = { '\0' };
  2187: 
  2188:    if ( apVariable != NULL && apValue != NULL )
  2189:    {
  2190:       protocol_t *pProtocol = apDescriptor ? apDescriptor->pProtocol : NULL;
  2191: 
  2192:       /* Should really be replaced with a dynamic buffer */
  2193:       int RequiredBuffer = strlen(apVariable) + strlen(apValue) + 12;
  2194: 
  2195:       if ( RequiredBuffer >= MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH )
  2196:       {
  2197:          if ( RequiredBuffer - strlen(apValue) < MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH )
  2198:          {
  2199:             sprintf( ATCPBuffer, 
  2200:                "SendATCP: %s %d bytes (exceeds MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH of %d).\n", 
  2201:                apVariable, RequiredBuffer, MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH );
  2202:          }
  2203:          else /* The variable name itself is too long */
  2204:          {
  2205:             sprintf( ATCPBuffer, 
  2206:                "SendATCP: Variable name has a length of %d bytes (exceeds MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH of %d).\n", 
  2207:                RequiredBuffer, MAX_VARIABLE_LENGTH );
  2208:          }
  2209: 
  2210:          ReportBug( ATCPBuffer );
  2211:          ATCPBuffer[0] = '\0';
  2212:       }
  2213:       else if ( pProtocol->bATCP )
  2214:       {
  2215:          sprintf( ATCPBuffer, "%c%c%c%s %s%c%c", 
  2216:             IAC, SB, TELOPT_ATCP, apVariable, apValue, IAC, SE );
  2217:       }
  2218: 
  2219:       /* Just in case someone calls this function without checking ATCP */
  2220:       if ( ATCPBuffer[0] != '\0' )
  2221:          Write( apDescriptor, ATCPBuffer );
  2222:    }
  2223: }
  2224: #endif /* MUDLET_PACKAGE */

  2247: static void SendMSSP( descriptor_t *apDescriptor )

  2293:       /* World */
  2294: /*

  2296:       { "HELPFILES",          "0" },
  2297:       { "MOBILES",            "0" },
  2298:       { "OBJECTS",            "0" },
  2299:       { "ROOMS",              "0" },
  2300:       { "CLASSES",            "0" },
  2301:       { "LEVELS",             "0" },
  2302:       { "RACES",              "0" },
  2303:       { "SKILLS",             "0" },

  2334:

  2336: /*

  2362: /*
  2363:       { "ATCP",               "1" },
  2364:       { "SSL",                "0" },
  2365:       { "ZMP",                "0" },

  2367:       { NULL, NULL, NULL } /* This must always be last. */
  2368:    };

  2370:    /* Begin the subnegotiation sequence */
  2371:    sprintf( MSSPBuffer, "%c%c%c", IAC, SB, TELOPT_MSSP );
  2372: 
  2373:    for ( i = 0; MSSPTable[i].pName != NULL; ++i )
  2374:    {
  2375:       int SizePair;
  2376: 
  2377:       /* Retrieve the next MSSP variable/value pair */
  2378:       sprintf( MSSPPair, "%c%s%c%s", MSSP_VAR, MSSPTable[i].pName, MSSP_VAL, 
  2379:          MSSPTable[i].pFunction ? (*MSSPTable[i].pFunction)() : 
  2380:          MSSPTable[i].pValue );
  2381: 
  2382:       /* Make sure we don't overflow the buffer */
  2383:       SizePair = strlen(MSSPPair);
  2384:       if ( SizePair+SizeBuffer < MAX_MSSP_BUFFER-4 )
  2385:       {
  2386:          strcat( MSSPBuffer, MSSPPair );
  2387:          SizeBuffer += SizePair;
  2388:       }
  2389:    }
  2390: 
  2391:    /* End the subnegotiation sequence */
  2392:    sprintf( MSSPPair, "%c%c", IAC, SE );
  2393:    strcat( MSSPBuffer, MSSPPair );
  2394: 
  2395:    /* Send the sequence */
  2396:    Write( apDescriptor, MSSPBuffer );
  2397: }

  2399: /******************************************************************************
  2400:  Local MXP functions.
  2401:  ******************************************************************************/
  2402: 
  2403: static char *GetMxpTag( const char *apTag, const char *apText )
  2404: {
  2405:    static char MXPBuffer [64];
  2406:    const char *pStartPos = strstr(apText, apTag);
  2407: 
  2408:    if ( pStartPos != NULL )
  2409:    {
  2410:       const char *pEndPos = apText+strlen(apText);
  2411: 
  2412:       pStartPos += strlen(apTag); /* Add length of the tag */
  2413: 
  2414:       if ( pStartPos < pEndPos )
  2415:       {
  2416:          int Index = 0;
  2417: 
  2418:          /* Some clients use quotes...and some don't. */
  2419:          if ( *pStartPos == '\"' )
  2420:             pStartPos++;
  2421: 
  2422:          for ( ; pStartPos < pEndPos && Index < 60; ++pStartPos )
  2423:          {
  2424:             char Letter = *pStartPos;
  2425:             if ( Letter == '.' || isdigit(Letter) || isalpha(Letter) )
  2426:             {
  2427:                MXPBuffer[Index++] = Letter;
  2428:             }
  2429:             else /* Return the result */
  2430:             {
  2431:                MXPBuffer[Index] = '\0';
  2432:                return MXPBuffer;
  2433:             }
  2434:          }
  2435:       }
  2436:    }
  2437: 
  2438:    /* Return NULL to indicate no tag was found. */
  2439:    return NULL;
  2440: }
  2441: 
  2442: /******************************************************************************
  2443:  Local colour functions.
  2444:  ******************************************************************************/
  2445: 
  2446: static const char *GetAnsiColour( bool_t abBackground, int aRed, int aGreen, int aBlue )
  2447: {
  2448:    if ( aRed == aGreen && aRed == aBlue && aRed < 2)
  2449:       return abBackground ? s_BackBlack : aRed >= 1 ? s_BoldBlack : s_DarkBlack;
  2450:    else if ( aRed == aGreen && aRed == aBlue )
  2451:       return abBackground ? s_BackWhite : aRed >= 4 ? s_BoldWhite : s_DarkWhite;
  2452:    else if ( aRed > aGreen && aRed > aBlue )
  2453:       return abBackground ? s_BackRed : aRed > 3 ? s_BoldRed : s_DarkRed;
  2454:    else if ( aRed == aGreen && aRed > aBlue )
  2455:       return abBackground ? s_BackYellow : aRed > 3 ? s_BoldYellow : s_DarkYellow;
  2456:    else if ( aRed == aBlue && aRed > aGreen )
  2457:       return abBackground ? s_BackMagenta : aRed >= 3 ? s_BoldMagenta : s_DarkMagenta;
  2458:    else if ( aGreen > aBlue )
  2459:       return abBackground ? s_BackGreen : aGreen >= 3 ? s_BoldGreen : s_DarkGreen;
  2460:    else if ( aGreen == aBlue )
  2461:       return abBackground ? s_BackCyan : aGreen >= 3 ? s_BoldCyan : s_DarkCyan;
  2462:    else /* aBlue is the highest */
  2463:       return abBackground ? s_BackBlue : aBlue >= 3 ? s_BoldBlue : s_DarkBlue;
  2464: }
  2465: 
  2466: static const char *GetRGBColour( bool_t abBackground, int aRed, int aGreen, int aBlue )
  2467: {
  2468:    static char Result[16];
  2469:    int ColVal = 16 + (aRed * 36) + (aGreen * 6) + aBlue;
  2470:    sprintf( Result, "\033[%c8;5;%c%c%cm", 
  2471:       '3'+abBackground,      /* Background */
  2472:       '0'+(ColVal/100),      /* Red        */
  2473:       '0'+((ColVal%100)/10), /* Green      */
  2474:       '0'+(ColVal%10) );     /* Blue       */
  2475:    return Result;
  2476: }
  2477: 
  2478: static bool_t IsValidColour( const char *apArgument )
  2479: {
  2480:    int i; /* Loop counter */
  2481: 
  2482:    /* The sequence is 4 bytes, but we can ignore anything after it. */
  2483:    if ( apArgument == NULL || strlen(apArgument) < 4 )
  2484:       return false;
  2485: 
  2486:    /* The first byte indicates foreground/background. */
  2487:    if ( tolower(apArgument[0]) != 'f' && tolower(apArgument[0]) != 'b' )
  2488:       return false;
  2489: 
  2490:    /* The remaining three bytes must each be in the range '0' to '5'. */
  2491:    for ( i = 1; i <= 3; ++i )
  2492:    {
  2493:       if ( apArgument[i] < '0' || apArgument[i] > '5' )
  2494:          return false;
  2495:    }
  2496: 
  2497:    /* It's a valid foreground or background colour */
  2498:    return true;
  2499: }
  2500: 
  2501: /******************************************************************************
  2502:  Other local functions.
  2503:  ******************************************************************************/
  2504: 
  2505: static bool_t MatchString( const char *apFirst, const char *apSecond )
  2506: {
  2507:    while ( *apFirst && tolower(*apFirst) == tolower(*apSecond) ) {
  2508:       ++apFirst;
  2509:       ++apSecond;
  2510:    }
  2511:    return ( !*apFirst && !*apSecond );
  2512: }
  2513: 
  2514: static bool_t PrefixString( const char *apPart, const char *apWhole )
  2515: {
  2516:    while ( *apPart && tolower(*apPart) == tolower(*apWhole) ) {
  2517:       ++apPart;
  2518:       ++apWhole;
  2519:    }
  2520:    return ( !*apPart );
  2521: }
  2522: 
  2523: static bool_t IsNumber( const char *apString )
  2524: {
  2525:    while ( *apString && isdigit(*apString) )
  2526:       ++apString;
  2527:    return ( !*apString );
  2528: }
  2529: 
  2530: static char *AllocString( const char *apString )
  2531: {
  2532:    char *pResult = NULL;
  2533: 
  2534:    if ( apString != NULL )
  2535:    {
  2536:       int Size = strlen(apString);
  2537:       pResult = (char *) malloc(Size+1);
  2538:       if ( pResult != NULL )
  2539:          strcpy( pResult, apString );
  2540:    }
  2541: 
  2542:    return pResult;
  2543: }

    53: ACMD(do_oasis_qedit)
    54: {
    55:   int number = NOWHERE, save = 0;
    56:   qst_rnum real_num;
    57:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    58:   char buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
    59:   char buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
    60: 
    61:   /****************************************************************************/
    62:   /** Parse any arguments.                                                   **/
    63:   /****************************************************************************/
    64:   two_arguments(argument, buf1, buf2);
    65: 
    66:   if (!*buf1) {
    67:     send_to_char(ch, "Specify a quest VNUM to edit.\r\n");
    68:     return;
    69:   } else if (!isdigit(*buf1)) {
    70:     if (str_cmp("save", buf1) != 0) {
    71:       send_to_char(ch, "Yikes!  Stop that, someone will get hurt!\r\n");
    72:       return;
    73:     }
    74: 
    75:     save = TRUE;
    76: 
    77:     if (is_number(buf2))
    78:       number = atoi(buf2);
    79:     else if (GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) > 0) {
    80:       zone_rnum zlok;
    81: 
    82:       if ((zlok = real_zone(GET_OLC_ZONE(ch))) == NOWHERE)
    83:         number = NOWHERE;
    84:       else
    85:         number = genolc_zone_bottom(zlok);
    86:     }
    87: 
    88:     if (number == NOWHERE) {
    89:       send_to_char(ch, "Save which zone?\r\n");
    90:       return;
    91:     }
    92:   }
    93: 
    94:   /****************************************************************************/
    95:   /** If a numeric argument was given, get it.                               **/
    96:   /****************************************************************************/
    97:   if (number == NOWHERE)
    98:     number = atoi(buf1);
    99: 
   100:   if (number < IDXTYPE_MIN || number > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
   101:     send_to_char(ch, "That quest VNUM can't exist.\r\n");
   102:     return;
   103:   }
   104: 
   105:   /****************************************************************************/
   106:   /** Check that the quest isn't already being edited.                       **/
   107:   /****************************************************************************/
   108:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   109:     if (STATE(d) == CON_QEDIT) {
   110:       if (d->olc && OLC_NUM(d) == number) {
   111:         send_to_char(ch, "That quest is currently being edited by %s.\r\n",
   112:           PERS(d->character, ch));
   113:         return;
   114:       }
   115:     }
   116:   }
   117: 
   118:   /****************************************************************************/
   119:   /** Point d to the builder's descriptor.                                   **/
   120:   /****************************************************************************/
   121:   d = ch->desc;
   122: 
   123:   /****************************************************************************/
   124:   /** Give the descriptor an OLC structure.                                  **/
   125:   /****************************************************************************/
   126:   if (d->olc) {
   127:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE,
   128:       "SYSERR: do_oasis_quest: Player already had olc structure.");
   129:     free(d->olc);
   130:   }
   131: 
   132:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
   133: 
   134:   /****************************************************************************/
   135:   /** Find the zone.                                                         **/
   136:   /****************************************************************************/
   137:   if ((OLC_ZNUM(d) = real_zone_by_thing(number)) == NOWHERE) {
   138:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, there is no zone for that number!\r\n");
   139:     free(d->olc);
   140:     d->olc = NULL;
   141:     return;
   142:   }
   143: 
   144:   /****************************************************************************/
   145:   /** Everyone but IMPLs can only edit zones they have been assigned.        **/
   146:   /****************************************************************************/
   147:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, OLC_ZNUM(d))) {
   148:     send_to_char(ch, "You do not have permission to edit this zone.\r\n");
   149: 
   150:     /**************************************************************************/
   151:     /** Free the OLC structure.                                              **/
   152:     /**************************************************************************/
   153:     free(d->olc);
   154:     d->olc = NULL;
   155:     return;
   156:   }
   157: 
   158:   if (save) {
   159:     send_to_char(ch, "Saving all quests in zone %d.\r\n",
   160:       zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   161:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
   162:       "OLC: %s saves quest info for zone %d.",
   163:       GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   164: 
   165:     /**************************************************************************/
   166:     /** Save the quest to the quest file.                                    **/
   167:     /**************************************************************************/
   168:     qedit_save_to_disk(OLC_ZNUM(d));
   169: 
   170:     /**************************************************************************/
   171:     /** Free the OLC structure.                                              **/
   172:     /**************************************************************************/
   173:     free(d->olc);
   174:     d->olc = NULL;
   175:     return;
   176:   }
   177: 
   178:   OLC_NUM(d) = number;
   179: 
   180:   if ((real_num = real_quest(number)) != NOTHING)
   181:     qedit_setup_existing(d, real_num);
   182:   else
   183:     qedit_setup_new(d);
   184: 
   185:   STATE(d) = CON_QEDIT;
   186: 
   187:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   188:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   189: 
   190:   mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
   191:          "OLC: %s starts editing zone %d allowed zone %d",
   192:          GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, GET_OLC_ZONE(ch));
   193: }
   194: 
   195: static void qedit_setup_new(struct descriptor_data *d)
   196: {
   197:   struct aq_data *quest;
   198: 
   199:   /* Allociate some quest shaped space                          */
   200:   CREATE(quest, struct aq_data, 1);
   201:   /* Set default values                                         */
   202:   quest->vnum       = OLC_NUM(d);     /* Quest vnum             */
   203:   quest->qm         = NOBODY;         /* Questmaster rnum       */
   204:   quest->flags      = 0;              /* Quest bitflags         */
   205:   quest->type       = AQ_UNDEFINED;   /* Quest type             */
   206:   quest->target     = NOTHING;        /* Quest target           */
   207:   quest->prereq     = NOTHING;        /* Prerequisite object    */
   208:   quest->value[0]   = 0;              /* Points for completing  */
   209:   quest->value[1]   = 0;              /* Points for abandoning  */
   210:   quest->value[2]   = 0;              /* Minimum level          */
   211:   quest->value[3]   = LVL_IMPL;       /* Maximim level          */
   212:   quest->value[4]   = -1;             /* Time limit             */
   213:   quest->value[5]   = NOBODY;         /* Mob to return object   */
   214:   quest->value[6]   = 1;              /* Quantity of targets    */
   215:   quest->prev_quest = NOTHING;        /* Previous quest         */
   216:   quest->next_quest = NOTHING;        /* Next quest             */
   217:   quest->gold_reward= 0;              /* Prize in gold coins    */
   218:   quest->exp_reward = 0;              /* Prize in exp points    */
   219:   quest->obj_reward = NOTHING;        /* vnum of reward object  */
   220:   quest->name       = strdup("Undefined Quest");
   221:   quest->desc       = strdup("Quest definition is incomplete.");
   222:   quest->info       = strdup("There is no information on this quest.\r\n");
   223:   quest->done       = strdup("You have completed the quest.\r\n");
   224:   quest->quit       = strdup("You have abandoned the quest.\r\n");
   225:   quest->func       = NULL;           /* Secondary qm spec proc */
   226:   /* Set the descriptor OLC structure to point to this quest    */
   227:   OLC_QUEST(d) = quest;
   228:   /* Show the main quest edit menu                              */
   229:   qedit_disp_menu(d);
   230: }

   251: static void qedit_disp_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   252: {
   253:   struct aq_data *quest;
   254:   char quest_flags[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   255:   char targetname[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   256:   mob_vnum return_mob;
   257: 
   258:   quest = OLC_QUEST(d);
   259: 
   260:   clear_screen(d);
   261:   sprintbit(quest->flags, aq_flags, quest_flags, sizeof(quest_flags));
   262:   if (quest->type == AQ_OBJ_RETURN) {
   263:     if ((return_mob = real_mobile(quest->value[5])) != NOBODY)
   264:       snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "to %s [%d]",
   265:         mob_proto[return_mob].player.short_descr,
   266:         quest->value[5]);
   267:     else
   268:       snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "to an unknown mob [%d].",
   269:                quest->value[5]);
   270:   }
   271:   switch (quest->type) {
   272:     case AQ_OBJ_FIND:
   273:     case AQ_OBJ_RETURN:
   274:       snprintf(targetname, sizeof(targetname), "%s",
   275:                real_object(quest->target) == NOTHING ?
   276:                "An unknown object" :
   277:                obj_proto[real_object(quest->target)].short_description);
   278:       break;
   279:     case AQ_ROOM_FIND:
   280:     case AQ_ROOM_CLEAR:
   281:       snprintf(targetname, sizeof(targetname), "%s",
   282:                real_room(quest->target) == NOWHERE ?
   283:                "An unknown room" :
   284:                world[real_room(quest->target)].name);
   285:       break;
   286:     case AQ_MOB_FIND:
   287:     case AQ_MOB_KILL:
   288:     case AQ_MOB_SAVE:
   289:       snprintf(targetname, sizeof(targetname), "%s",
   290:                real_mobile(quest->target) == NOBODY ?
   291:                "An unknown mobile" :
   292:                GET_NAME(&mob_proto[real_mobile(quest->target)]));
   293:       break;
   294:     default:
   295:       snprintf(targetname, sizeof(targetname), "Unknown");
   296:       break;
   297:   }
   298:   write_to_output(d,
   299:     "-- Quest Number    : \tn[\tc%6d\tn]\r\n"
   300:     "\tg 1\tn) Quest Name     : \ty%s\r\n"
   301:     "\tg 2\tn) Description    : \ty%s\r\n"
   302:     "\tg 3\tn) Accept Message\r\n\ty%s"
   303:     "\tg 4\tn) Completion Message\r\n\ty%s"
   304:     "\tg 5\tn) Quit Message\r\n\ty%s"
   305:     "\tg 6\tn) Quest Flags    : \tc%s\r\n"
   306:     "\tg 7\tn) Quest Type     : \tc%s %s\r\n"
   307:     "\tg 8\tn) Quest Master   : [\tc%6d\tn] \ty%s\r\n"
   308:     "\tg 9\tn) Quest Target   : [\tc%6d\tn] \ty%s\r\n"
   309:     "\tg A\tn) Quantity       : [\tc%6d\tn]\r\n"
   310:     "\tn    Quest Point Rewards\r\n"
   311:     "\tg B\tn) Completed      : [\tc%6d\tn] \tg C\tn) Abandoned   : [\tc%6d\tn]\r\n"
   312:     "\tn    Other Rewards Rewards\r\n"
   313:     "\tg G\tn) Gold Coins     : [\tc%6d\tn] \tg T\tn) Exp Points  : [\tc%6d\tn] \tg O\tn) Object : [\tc%6d\tn]\r\n"
   314:     "\tn    Level Limits to Accept Quest\r\n"
   315:     "\tg D\tn) Lower Level    : [\tc%6d\tn] \tg E\tn) Upper Level : [\tc%6d\tn]\r\n"
   316:     "\tg F\tn) Prerequisite   : [\tc%6d\tn] \ty%s\r\n"
   317:     "\tg L\tn) Time Limit     : [\tc%6d\tn]\r\n"
   318:     "\tg N\tn) Next Quest     : [\tc%6d\tn] \ty%s\r\n"
   319:     "\tg P\tn) Previous Quest : [\tc%6d\tn] \ty%s\r\n"
   320:     "\tg X\tn) Delete Quest\r\n"
   321:     "\tg Q\tn) Quit\r\n"
   322:     "Enter Choice : ",
   323:     quest->vnum,
   324:     quest->name,
   325:     quest->desc,
   326:     quest->info && (str_cmp(quest->info, "undefined"))
   327:      ? quest->info : "Nothing\r\n",
   328:     quest->done && (str_cmp(quest->done, "undefined"))
   329:      ? quest->done : "Nothing\r\n",
   330:     quest->quit && (str_cmp(quest->quit, "undefined"))
   331:      ? quest->quit : "Nothing\r\n",
   332:     quest_flags,
   333:     quest_types[quest->type],
   334:     quest->type == AQ_OBJ_RETURN ? buf2 : "",
   335:     quest->qm == NOBODY ? -1 :     quest->qm,
   336:     real_mobile(quest->qm) == NOBODY ? "Invalid Mob" : mob_proto[(real_mobile(quest->qm))].player.short_descr,
   337:     quest->target == NOBODY ? -1 : quest->target, targetname,
   338:     quest->value[6],
   339:     quest->value[0], quest->value[1],
   340:     quest->gold_reward, quest->exp_reward, quest->obj_reward == NOTHING ? -1 : quest->obj_reward,
   341:     quest->value[2], quest->value[3],
   342:     quest->prereq     == NOTHING ? -1 : quest->prereq,
   343:     quest->prereq     == NOTHING ? "" :
   344:       real_object(quest->prereq) == NOTHING ? "an unknown object" :
   345:                   obj_proto[real_object(quest->prereq)].short_description,
   346:     quest->value[4],
   347:     quest->next_quest == NOTHING ? -1 : quest->next_quest,
   348:     real_quest(quest->next_quest) == NOTHING ? "" : QST_DESC(real_quest(quest->next_quest)),
   349:     quest->prev_quest == NOTHING ? -1 : quest->prev_quest,
   350:     real_quest(quest->prev_quest) == NOTHING ? "" : QST_DESC(real_quest(quest->prev_quest)));
   351:   OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
   352: }

   374: /**************************************************************************
   375:   The GARGANTUAN event handler
   376: **************************************************************************/
   377: 
   378: void qedit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   379: {
   380:   int number = atoi(arg);
   381:   char *oldtext = NULL;
   382: 
   383:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   384:     /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   385:     case QEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   386:       switch (*arg) {
   387:         case 'y':
   388:         case 'Y':
   389:           send_to_char(d->character, "Saving Quest to memory.\r\n");
   390:           qedit_save_internally(d);
   391:           mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE,
   392:      "OLC: %s edits quest %d", GET_NAME(d->character), OLC_NUM(d));
   393:           if (CONFIG_OLC_SAVE) {
   394:             qedit_save_to_disk(real_zone_by_thing(OLC_NUM(d)));
   395:             write_to_output(d, "Quest %d saved to disk.\r\n", OLC_NUM(d));
   396:           } else
   397:             write_to_output(d, "Quest %d saved to memory.\r\n", OLC_NUM(d));
   398:           cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_STRUCTS);
   399:    return;
   400:         case 'n':
   401:         case 'N':
   402:           cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   403:           return;
   404:         default:
   405:           write_to_output(d,
   406:             "Invalid choice!\r\nDo you wish to save the quest? : ");
   407:           return;
   408:       }
   409:     /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   410:     case QEDIT_CONFIRM_DELETE:
   411:       switch (*arg) {
   412:         case 'y':
   413:         case 'Y':
   414:           if (delete_quest(real_quest(OLC_NUM(d))))
   415:             write_to_output(d, "Quest deleted.\r\n");
   416:    else
   417:             write_to_output(d, "Couldn't delete the quest!\r\n");
   418:           if (CONFIG_OLC_SAVE) {
   419:             qedit_save_to_disk(real_zone_by_thing(OLC_NUM(d)));
   420:             write_to_output(d, "Quest file saved to disk.\r\n");
   421:           } else
   422:             write_to_output(d, "Quest file saved to memory.\r\n");
   423:           cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   424:    return;
   425:         case 'n':
   426:         case 'N':
   427:           qedit_disp_menu(d);
   428:           return;
   429:         default:
   430:           write_to_output(d,
   431:             "Invalid choice!\r\nDo you wish to delete the quest? : ");
   432:           return;
   433:       }
   434: 
   435:     /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   436:     case QEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   437:       switch (*arg) {
   438:         case 'q':
   439:  case 'Q':
   440:    if (OLC_VAL(d)) {   /*. Anything been changed? . */
   441:             write_to_output(d,
   442:               "Do you wish to save the changes to the Quest? (y/n) : ");
   443:             OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   444:           } else
   445:             cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   446:           return;
   447:  case 'x':
   448:  case 'X':
   449:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_CONFIRM_DELETE;
   450:    write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to delete the Quest? (y/n) : ");
   451:    break;
   452:  case '1':
   453:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_NAME;
   454:    write_to_output(d, "Enter the quest name : ");
   455:    break;
   456:         case '2':
   457:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_DESC;
   458:    write_to_output(d, "Enter the quest description :-\r\n] ");
   459:    break;
   460:         case '3':
   461:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_INFO;
   462:           clear_screen(d);
   463:           send_editor_help(d);
   464:           write_to_output(d, "Enter quest acceptance message:\r\n\r\n");
   465: 
   466:           if (OLC_QUEST(d)->info) {
   467:             write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_QUEST(d)->info);
   468:             oldtext = strdup(OLC_QUEST(d)->info);
   469:           }
   470:           string_write(d, &OLC_QUEST(d)->info, MAX_QUEST_MSG, 0, oldtext);
   471:           OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   472:           break;
   473:         case '4':
   474:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_COMPLETE;
   475:           clear_screen(d);
   476:           send_editor_help(d);
   477:           write_to_output(d, "Enter quest completion message:\r\n\r\n");
   478: 
   479:           if (OLC_QUEST(d)->done) {
   480:             write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_QUEST(d)->done);
   481:             oldtext = strdup(OLC_QUEST(d)->done);
   482:           }
   483:           string_write(d, &OLC_QUEST(d)->done, MAX_QUEST_MSG, 0, oldtext);
   484:           OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   485:           break;
   486:         case '5':
   487:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_ABANDON;
   488:           clear_screen(d);
   489:           send_editor_help(d);
   490:           write_to_output(d, "Enter quest quit message:\r\n\r\n");
   491: 
   492:           if (OLC_QUEST(d)->quit) {
   493:             write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_QUEST(d)->quit);
   494:             oldtext = strdup(OLC_QUEST(d)->quit);
   495:           }
   496:           string_write(d, &OLC_QUEST(d)->quit, MAX_QUEST_MSG, 0, oldtext);
   497:           OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   498:           break;
   499:         case '6':
   500:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_FLAGS;
   501:           qedit_disp_flag_menu(d);
   502:           break;
   503:         case '7':
   504:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_TYPES;
   505:           qedit_disp_type_menu(d);
   506:           break;
   507:         case '8':
   508:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_QUESTMASTER;
   509:           write_to_output(d, "Enter vnum of quest master : ");
   510:           break;
   511:         case '9':
   512:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_TARGET;
   513:           write_to_output(d, "Enter target vnum : ");
   514:           break;
   515:  case 'a':
   516:  case 'A':
   517:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_QUANTITY;
   518:    write_to_output(d, "Enter quantity of target : ");
   519:    break;
   520:         case 'b':
   521:         case 'B':
   522:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_POINTSCOMP;
   523:           write_to_output(d, "Enter points for completing the quest : " );
   524:           break;
   525:  case 'c':
   526:         case 'C':
   527:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_POINTSQUIT;
   528:           write_to_output(d, "Enter points for quitting the quest : " );
   529:           break;
   530:  case 'd':
   531:         case 'D':
   532:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_LEVELMIN;
   533:           write_to_output(d, "Enter minimum level to accept the quest : " );
   534:           break;
   535:  case 'e':
   536:         case 'E':
   537:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_LEVELMAX;
   538:           write_to_output(d, "Enter maximum level to accept the quest : " );
   539:           break;
   540:  case 'f':
   541:  case 'F':
   542:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_PREREQ;
   543:    write_to_output(d, "Enter a prerequisite object vnum (-1 for none) : ");
   544:    break;
   545:  case 'g':
   546:  case 'G':
   547:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_GOLD;
   548:    write_to_output(d, "Enter the number of gold coins (0 for none) : ");
   549:    break;
   550:  case 't':
   551:  case 'T':
   552:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_EXP;
   553:    write_to_output(d, "Enter a number of experience points (0 for none) : ");
   554:    break;
   555:  case 'o':
   556:  case 'O':
   557:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_OBJ;
   558:    write_to_output(d, "Enter the prize object vnum (-1 for none) : ");
   559:    break;
   560:  case 'l':
   561:         case 'L':
   562:    OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_TIMELIMIT;
   563:           write_to_output(d, "Enter time limit to complete (-1 for none) : " );
   564:           break;
   565:  case 'n':
   566:  case 'N':
   567:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_NEXTQUEST;
   568:           write_to_output(d, "Enter vnum of next quest (-1 for none) : ");
   569:           break;
   570:    case 'p':
   571:  case 'P':
   572:           OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_PREVQUEST;
   573:           write_to_output(d, "Enter vnum of previous quest (-1 for none) : ");
   574:           break;
   575:         default:
   576:    write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
   577:    qedit_disp_menu(d);
   578:    break;
   579:       }
   580:       return;
   581:     /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   582:     case QEDIT_NAME:
   583:       if (!genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   584:         break;
   585:       if (OLC_QUEST(d)->name)
   586:         free(OLC_QUEST(d)->name);
   587:       arg[MAX_QUEST_NAME - 1] = '\0';
   588:       OLC_QUEST(d)->name = str_udup(arg);
   589:       break;
   590:     case QEDIT_DESC:
   591:       if (!genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   592:         break;
   593:       if (OLC_QUEST(d)->desc)
   594:         free(OLC_QUEST(d)->desc);
   595:       arg[MAX_QUEST_DESC - 1] = '\0';
   596:       OLC_QUEST(d)->desc = str_udup(arg);
   597:       break;
   598:     case QEDIT_QUESTMASTER:
   599:       if (number != -1)
   600:         if (real_mobile(number) == NOBODY) {
   601:           write_to_output(d, "That mobile does not exist, try again : ");
   602:           return;
   603:         }
   604:       OLC_QUEST(d)->qm = number;
   605:       break;
   606:     case QEDIT_TYPES:
   607:       number--;
   608:       if (number < 0 || number >= NUM_AQ_TYPES) {
   609:         write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
   610:         qedit_disp_type_menu(d);
   611:         return;
   612:       }
   613:       OLC_QUEST(d)->type = number;
   614:       if (number == AQ_OBJ_RETURN) {
   615:         OLC_MODE(d) = QEDIT_RETURNMOB;
   616:         write_to_output(d, "Enter mob vnum to return object to : ");
   617:         return;
   618:       }
   619:       break;
   620:     case QEDIT_FLAGS:
   621:       if (number < 0 || number > NUM_AQ_FLAGS) {
   622:         write_to_output(d, "That is not a valid choice!\r\n");
   623:         qedit_disp_flag_menu(d);
   624:       } else if (number == 0)
   625:         break;
   626:       else {
   627:         TOGGLE_BIT(OLC_QUEST(d)->flags, number );
   628:         qedit_disp_flag_menu(d);
   629:       }
   630:       return;
   631:     case QEDIT_QUANTITY:
   632:       OLC_QUEST(d)->value[6] = LIMIT(number, 1, 50);
   633:       break;
   634:     case QEDIT_POINTSCOMP:
   635:       OLC_QUEST(d)->value[0] = LIMIT(number, 0, 999999);
   636:       break;
   637:     case QEDIT_POINTSQUIT:
   638:       OLC_QUEST(d)->value[1] = LIMIT(number, 0, 999999);
   639:       break;
   640:     case QEDIT_PREREQ:
   641:       if ((number = atoi(arg)) != -1)
   642:         if (real_object(number) == NOTHING) {
   643:           write_to_output(d, "That object does not exist, try again : ");
   644:           return;
   645:         }
   646:       OLC_QUEST(d)->prereq = number;
   647:       break;
   648:     case QEDIT_LEVELMIN:
   649:       if (number < 0 || number > LVL_IMPL) {
   650:         write_to_output(d, "Level must be between 0 and %d!\r\n", LVL_IMPL);
   651:  write_to_output(d, "Enter minimum level to accept the quest : " );
   652:         return;
   653:       }  else if (number > OLC_QUEST(d)->value[3]) {
   654:  write_to_output(d, "Minimum level can't be above maximum level!\r\n");
   655:  write_to_output(d, "Enter minimum level to accept the quest : " );
   656:         return;
   657:       } else {
   658:         OLC_QUEST(d)->value[2] = number;
   659:         break;
   660:       }
   661:     case QEDIT_LEVELMAX:
   662:       if (number < 0 || number > LVL_IMPL) {
   663:         write_to_output(d, "Level must be between 0 and %d!\r\n", LVL_IMPL);
   664:  write_to_output(d, "Enter maximum level to accept the quest : " );
   665:         return;
   666:       } else if (number < OLC_QUEST(d)->value[2]) {
   667:  write_to_output(d, "Maximum level can't be below minimum level!\r\n");
   668:  write_to_output(d, "Enter maximum level to accept the quest : " );
   669:         return;
   670:       } else {
   671:         OLC_QUEST(d)->value[3] = number;
   672:         break;
   673:       }
   674:     case QEDIT_TIMELIMIT:
   675:       OLC_QUEST(d)->value[4] = LIMIT(number, -1, 100);
   676:       break;
   677:     case QEDIT_RETURNMOB:
   678:       if ((number = atoi(arg)) != -1)
   679:         if (real_mobile(number) == NOBODY) {
   680:           write_to_output(d, "That mobile does not exist, try again : ");
   681:           return;
   682:         }
   683:       OLC_QUEST(d)->value[5] = number;
   684:       break;
   685:     case QEDIT_TARGET:
   686:       OLC_QUEST(d)->target = number;
   687:       break;
   688:     case QEDIT_NEXTQUEST:
   689:       if ((number = atoi(arg)) != -1) {
   690:         if (real_quest(number) == NOTHING) {
   691:           write_to_output(d, "That is not a valid quest, try again (-1 for none) : ");
   692:           return;
   693:         }
   694:       }
   695:       OLC_QUEST(d)->next_quest = (number == -1 ? NOTHING : atoi(arg));
   696:       break;
   697:     case QEDIT_PREVQUEST:
   698:       if ((number = atoi(arg)) != -1) {
   699:         if (real_quest(number) == NOTHING) {
   700:           write_to_output(d, "That is not a valid quest, try again (-1 for none) : ");
   701:           return;
   702:         }
   703:       }
   704:       OLC_QUEST(d)->prev_quest = (number == -1 ? NOTHING : atoi(arg));
   705:       break;
   706:     case QEDIT_GOLD:
   707:       OLC_QUEST(d)->gold_reward = LIMIT(number, 0, 99999);
   708:       break;
   709:     case QEDIT_EXP:
   710:       OLC_QUEST(d)->exp_reward = LIMIT(number, 0, 99999);
   711:       break;
   712:     case QEDIT_OBJ:
   713:       if ((number = atoi(arg)) != -1)
   714:         if (real_object(number) == NOTHING) {
   715:           write_to_output(d, "That object does not exist, try again : ");
   716:           return;
   717:         }
   718:       OLC_QUEST(d)->obj_reward = number;
   719:       break;
   720:     default:
   721:       /*. We should never get here . */
   722:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   723:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: qedit_parse(): "
   724:         "Reached default case!");
   725:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
   726:       break;
   727:   }
   728:   /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   729:   /*. END OF CASE
   730:   If we get here, we have probably changed something, and now want to
   731:   return to main menu.  Use OLC_VAL as a 'has changed' flag . */
   732: 
   733:   OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   734:   qedit_disp_menu(d);
   735: }
   736: 
   737: void qedit_string_cleanup(struct descriptor_data *d, int terminator)
   738: {
   739:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   740:   case QEDIT_INFO:
   741:   case QEDIT_COMPLETE:
   742:   case QEDIT_ABANDON:
   743:     qedit_disp_menu(d);
   744:     break;
   745:   }
   746: }

    90: static void clear_kill_quest(struct char_data *ch)
    91: {
    92:   GET_KQUEST_ACTIVE(ch) = 0;
    93:   GET_KQUEST_COMPLETE(ch) = 0;
    94:   GET_KQUEST_TARGET(ch) = NOBODY;
    95:   GET_KQUEST_ROOM(ch) = NOWHERE;
    96:   GET_KQUEST_GIVER(ch) = NOBODY;
    97:   GET_KQUEST_TIME(ch) = 0;
    98:   GET_KQUEST_EXPIRES_AT(ch) = 0;
    99:   GET_KQUEST_TARGET_ID(ch) = 0;
   100: }

   102: static int seconds_to_minutes_ceiling(time_t seconds_remaining)
   103: {
   104:   if (seconds_remaining <= 0)
   105:     return 0;
   106: 
   107:   return (int)((seconds_remaining + 59) / 60);
   108: }
   109: 
   110: bool is_on_quest(struct char_data *ch)
   111: {
   112:   return ch && !IS_NPC(ch) && GET_KQUEST_ACTIVE(ch) != 0;
   113: }
   114: 
   115: bool is_quest_ready(struct char_data *ch)
   116: {
   117:   return is_on_quest(ch) && GET_KQUEST_COMPLETE(ch) != 0;
   118: }
   119: 
   120: bool is_quest_expired(struct char_data *ch)
   121: {
   122:   time_t now;
   123: 
   124:   if (!is_on_quest(ch))
   125:     return FALSE;
   126: 
   127:   now = time(0);
   128:   return GET_KQUEST_EXPIRES_AT(ch) > 0 && now >= GET_KQUEST_EXPIRES_AT(ch);
   129: }
   130: 
   131: bool is_on_quest_cooldown(struct char_data *ch)
   132: {
   133:   time_t now;
   134: 
   135:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch))
   136:     return FALSE;
   137: 
   138:   now = time(0);
   139:   return GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) > now;
   140: }
   141: 
   142: int get_quest_minutes_remaining(struct char_data *ch)
   143: {
   144:   time_t now;
   145: 
   146:   if (!is_on_quest(ch))
   147:     return 0;
   148: 
   149:   now = time(0);
   150:   return seconds_to_minutes_ceiling(GET_KQUEST_EXPIRES_AT(ch) - now);
   151: }
   152: 
   153: int get_quest_cooldown_minutes_remaining(struct char_data *ch)

   155:   time_t now;
   156: 
   157:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch))
   158:     return 0;
   159: 
   160:   now = time(0);
   161:   return seconds_to_minutes_ceiling(GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) - now);

   164: static void start_kill_quest_cooldown(struct char_data *ch)
   165: {
   166:   GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) = time(0) + KQUEST_COOLDOWN_SECS;
   167:   GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_NOTIFIED(ch) = 0;
   168: }
   169: 
   170: static void notify_quest_cooldown_ready_if_needed(struct char_data *ch)
   171: {
   172:   time_t now;
   173: 
   174:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch))
   175:     return;
   176: 
   177:   if (GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) <= 0 || GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_NOTIFIED(ch))
   178:     return;
   179: 
   180:   now = time(0);
   181:   if (now < GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_EXPIRES_AT(ch))
   182:     return;
   183: 
   184:   send_to_char(ch, "%sQUEST: You may now quest again.%s\r\n", QRED, QNRM);
   185:   GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_NOTIFIED(ch) = 1;
   186:   save_char(ch);
   187: }
   188: 
   189: static void expire_kill_quest_if_needed(struct char_data *ch, bool notify)
   190: {
   191:   if (!is_on_quest(ch) || !is_quest_expired(ch))
   192:     return;
   193: 
   194:   clear_kill_quest(ch);
   195:   start_kill_quest_cooldown(ch);
   196:   if (notify)
   197:     send_to_char(ch, "Your quest has expired. You have failed to complete it in time.\r\n");
   198:   save_char(ch);
   199: }

   201: static struct char_data *find_present_questmaster(struct char_data *ch)
   202: {
   203:   struct char_data *mob;
   204: 
   205:   for (mob = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; mob; mob = mob->next_in_room) {
   206:     if (IS_NPC(mob) && GET_MOB_SPEC(mob) == questmaster && CAN_SEE(ch, mob))
   207:       return mob;
   208:   }
   209: 
   210:   return NULL;
   211: }

   213: static int is_service_or_protected_mob(struct char_data *mob)
   214: {
   215:   SPECIAL(*spec);
   216: 
   217:   if (!mob || !IS_NPC(mob))
   218:     return TRUE;
   219: 
   220:   if (MOB_FLAGGED(mob, MOB_NOKILL) || MOB_FLAGGED(mob, MOB_GUILD_MASTER))
   221:     return TRUE;
   222: 
   223:   spec = GET_MOB_SPEC(mob);
   224:   if (spec == questmaster || spec == shop_keeper || spec == guild || spec == postmaster || spec == receptionist ) {
   225:     return TRUE;
   226:   }
   227: 
   228:   return FALSE;
   229: }

   231: static int room_is_quest_safe(room_rnum room)
   232: {
   233:   if (!VALID_ROOM_RNUM(room))
   234:     return TRUE;
   235: 
   236:   return ROOM_FLAGGED(room, ROOM_PEACEFUL) ||
   237:          ROOM_FLAGGED(room, ROOM_GODROOM) ||
   238:          ROOM_FLAGGED(room, ROOM_DEATH) ||
   239:          ROOM_FLAGGED(room, ROOM_NOMOB);
   240: }
