   242: static int campaign_size_step(int target_count)
   243: {
   244:   int divisor = MAX(1, MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS - CAMPAIGN_MIN_TARGETS);
   245:   int numerator = URANGE(CAMPAIGN_MIN_TARGETS, target_count, MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS) - CAMPAIGN_MIN_TARGETS;
   246:   return (numerator * 100) / divisor;
   247: }
   248: 
   249: static int campaign_scaled_percent(int target_count, int min_pct, int max_pct)
   250: {
   251:   int step = campaign_size_step(target_count);
   252:   return min_pct + ((max_pct - min_pct) * step) / 100;
   253: }
   254: 
   255: static int campaign_level_xp_span(struct char_data *ch)
   256: {
   257:   int level;
   258:   int at_level;
   259:   int next_level;
   260: 
   261:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch))
   262:     return 0;
   263: 
   264:   level = URANGE(1, GET_CAMPAIGN_LEVEL(ch), LVL_IMMORT - 1);
   265:   if (level >= LVL_IMMORT - 1)
   266:     return 0;
   267: 
   268:   at_level = level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), level);
   269:   next_level = level_exp(GET_CLASS(ch), level + 1);
   270:   return MAX(1, next_level - at_level);
   271: }
   272: 
   273: static void calculate_campaign_rewards(struct char_data *ch, int target_count, struct campaign_rewards *out)
   274: {
   275:   int quest_qp_base;
   276:   int quest_gold_base;
   277:   int xp_span;
   278:   int xp_pct;
   279:   int qp_pct;
   280:   int gold_pct;
   281:   int level_bonus;
   282: 
   283:   if (!out)
   284:     return;
   285: 
   286:   out->xp = 0;
   287:   out->qp = 0;
   288:   out->gold = 0;
   289:   out->trains = 0;
   290:   out->practices = 0;
   291: 
   292:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch))
   293:     return;
   294: 
   295:   quest_qp_base = MAX(5, GET_LEVEL(ch) / 2);
   296:   quest_gold_base = MAX(100, GET_LEVEL(ch) * 75);
   297:   xp_span = campaign_level_xp_span(ch);
   298: 
   299:   xp_pct = campaign_scaled_percent(target_count, CAMPAIGN_XP_MULTIPLIER_MIN_PCT, CAMPAIGN_XP_MULTIPLIER_MAX_PCT);
   300:   qp_pct = campaign_scaled_percent(target_count, CAMPAIGN_QP_MULTIPLIER_MIN_PCT, CAMPAIGN_QP_MULTIPLIER_MAX_PCT);
   301:   gold_pct = campaign_scaled_percent(target_count, CAMPAIGN_GOLD_MULTIPLIER_MIN_PCT, CAMPAIGN_GOLD_MULTIPLIER_MAX_PCT);
   302: 
   303:   out->xp = (int)MIN((long long)INT_MAX, ((long long)xp_span * (long long)xp_pct) / 100LL);
   304:   out->qp = (int)MIN((long long)INT_MAX, ((long long)quest_qp_base * (long long)qp_pct) / 100LL);
   305:   out->gold = (int)MIN((long long)INT_MAX, ((long long)quest_gold_base * (long long)gold_pct) / 100LL);
   306: 
   307:   level_bonus = MIN(8, MAX(0, GET_LEVEL(ch) / 15));
   308: 
   309:   if (target_count <= CAMPAIGN_SMALL_TARGETS) {
   310:     out->trains = 1;
   311:     out->practices = 7;
   312:   } else if (target_count <= CAMPAIGN_STANDARD_TARGETS) {
   313:     out->trains = 2;
   314:     out->practices = 12;
   315:   } else {
   316:     out->trains = 3;
   317:     out->practices = 18;
   318:   }
   319: 
   320:   out->trains = MIN(5, out->trains + (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= 45 ? 1 : 0));
   321:   out->practices = MIN(30, out->practices + level_bonus);
   322: }
   323: 
   324: static void clear_campaign(struct char_data *ch)
   325: {
   326:   int i;
   327:   GET_CAMPAIGN_ACTIVE(ch) = 0;
   328:   GET_CAMPAIGN_LEVEL(ch) = 0;
   329:   GET_CAMPAIGN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) = 0;
   330:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_QP(ch) = 0;
   331:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_GOLD(ch) = 0;
   332:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_XP(ch) = 0;
   333:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_TRAINS(ch) = 0;
   334:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_PRACTICES(ch) = 0;
   335:   GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_COUNT(ch) = 0;
   336:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS; i++) {
   337:     GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, i) = NOBODY;
   338:     GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_ROOM(ch, i) = NOWHERE;
   339:     GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REQUIRED(ch, i) = 0;
   340:     GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i) = 0;
   341:   }
   342: }
   343: 
   344: static bool is_on_campaign(struct char_data *ch)
   345: {
   346:   return ch && !IS_NPC(ch) && GET_CAMPAIGN_ACTIVE(ch) != 0;
   347: }
   348: 
   349: static bool is_campaign_expired(struct char_data *ch)
   350: {
   351:   time_t now;
   352: 
   353:   if (!is_on_campaign(ch))
   354:     return FALSE;
   355: 
   356:   now = time(0);
   357:   return GET_CAMPAIGN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) > 0 && now >= GET_CAMPAIGN_EXPIRES_AT(ch);
   358: }
   359: 
   360: static int campaign_remaining_targets(struct char_data *ch)
   361: {
   362:   int i, remaining = 0;
   363:   for (i = 0; i < GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_COUNT(ch); i++)
   364:     if (GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i) > 0)
   365:       remaining += GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i);
   366:   return remaining;
   367: }
   368: 
   369: static int campaign_seconds_remaining(struct char_data *ch)
   370: {
   371:   time_t now;
   372:   if (!is_on_campaign(ch))
   373:     return 0;
   374:   now = time(0);
   375:   if (GET_CAMPAIGN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) <= now)
   376:     return 0;
   377:   return (int)(GET_CAMPAIGN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) - now);
   378: }
   379: 
   380: static void format_campaign_time_left(int total_seconds, char *buf, size_t bufsz)
   381: {
   382:   int days, hours, minutes;
   383:   if (total_seconds < 0)
   384:     total_seconds = 0;
   385:   days = total_seconds / (24 * 60 * 60);
   386:   total_seconds %= (24 * 60 * 60);
   387:   hours = total_seconds / (60 * 60);
   388:   total_seconds %= (60 * 60);
   389:   minutes = total_seconds / 60;
   390:   snprintf(buf, bufsz, "%d day%s, %d hour%s and %d minute%s",
   391:            days, days == 1 ? "" : "s",
   392:            hours, hours == 1 ? "" : "s",
   393:            minutes, minutes == 1 ? "" : "s");
   394: }
   395: 
   396: static void format_campaign_deadline(time_t when, char *buf, size_t bufsz)
   397: {
   398:   struct tm *tm_ptr = localtime(&when);
   399:   if (!tm_ptr) {
   400:     strlcpy(buf, "Unknown", bufsz);
   401:     return;
   402:   }
   403:   strftime(buf, bufsz, "%I:%M%p on %d %b %Y", tm_ptr);
   404: }
   405: 
   406: static const char *campaign_target_name(mob_vnum vnum)
   407: {
   408:   mob_rnum rnum = real_mobile(vnum);
   409:   if (rnum == NOBODY)
   410:     return "an unknown target";
   411:   return GET_NAME(&mob_proto[rnum]);
   412: }
   413: 
   414: static const char *campaign_target_area(room_vnum rvnum)
   415: {
   416:   room_rnum rr = real_room(rvnum);
   417:   if (rr == NOWHERE)
   418:     return "Unknown Area";
   419:   return zone_table[world[rr].zone].name;
   420: }
   421: 
   422: static void expire_campaign_if_needed(struct char_data *ch, bool notify)
   423: {
   424:   if (!is_on_campaign(ch) || !is_campaign_expired(ch))
   425:     return;
   426: 
   427:   clear_campaign(ch);
   428:   if (notify)
   429:     send_to_char(ch, "%sYour campaign has expired. The contract has been revoked.%s\r\n", QRED, QNRM);
   430:   save_char(ch);
   431: }
   432: 
   433: struct campaign_candidate_data {
   434:   mob_vnum vnum;
   435:   room_vnum room_vnum;
   436:   int zone;
   437: };
   438: 
   439: static int select_campaign_targets(struct char_data *ch, struct campaign_candidate_data selected[MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS], int *selected_count)
   440: {
   441:   struct char_data *mob;
   442:   struct campaign_candidate_data pool[2000];
   443:   int pool_count = 0, i, j, need, max_targets;
   444:   int level_window_low = GET_LEVEL(ch) - 5;
   445:   int level_window_high = GET_LEVEL(ch) + 2;
   446: 
   447:   for (mob = character_list; mob; mob = mob->next) {
   448:     room_rnum in_room;
   449:     int mob_level;
   450: 
   451:     if (!IS_NPC(mob) || IN_ROOM(mob) == NOWHERE)
   452:       continue;
   453:     if (is_service_or_protected_mob(mob))
   454:       continue;
   455:     if (MOB_FLAGGED(mob, MOB_NOTDEADYET))
   456:       continue;
   457: 
   458:     in_room = IN_ROOM(mob);
   459:     if (room_is_quest_safe(in_room))
   460:       continue;
   461: 
   462:     mob_level = GET_LEVEL(mob);
   463:     if (mob_level < level_window_low || mob_level > level_window_high)
   464:       continue;
   465: 
   466:     if (pool_count >= (int)(sizeof(pool) / sizeof(pool[0])))
   467:       break;
   468: 
   469:     pool[pool_count].vnum = GET_MOB_VNUM(mob);
   470:     pool[pool_count].room_vnum = GET_ROOM_VNUM(in_room);
   471:     pool[pool_count].zone = world[in_room].zone;
   472:     pool_count++;
   473:   }
   474: 
   475:   if (pool_count < CAMPAIGN_MIN_TARGETS)
   476:     return 0;
   477: 
   478:   max_targets = MIN(MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS, pool_count);
   479:   need = rand_number(CAMPAIGN_MIN_TARGETS, max_targets);
   480:   *selected_count = 0;
   481: 
   482:   for (i = 0; i < pool_count; i++) {
   483:     j = rand_number(i, pool_count - 1);
   484:     if (i != j) {
   485:       struct campaign_candidate_data tmp = pool[i];
   486:       pool[i] = pool[j];
   487:       pool[j] = tmp;
   488:     }
   489:   }
   490: 
   491:   for (i = 0; i < pool_count && *selected_count < need; i++) {
   492:     mob_vnum vnum = pool[i].vnum;
   493:     int zone = pool[i].zone;
   494:     int seen_vnum = FALSE, seen_zone = FALSE;
   495: 
   496:     for (j = 0; j < *selected_count; j++) {
   497:       if (selected[j].vnum == vnum)
   498:         seen_vnum = TRUE;
   499:       if (selected[j].zone == zone)
   500:         seen_zone = TRUE;
   501:     }
   502:     if (seen_vnum || seen_zone)
   503:       continue;
   504: 
   505:     selected[*selected_count] = pool[i];
   506:     (*selected_count)++;
   507:   }
   508: 
   509:   for (i = 0; i < pool_count && *selected_count < need; i++) {
   510:     mob_vnum vnum = pool[i].vnum;
   511:     int seen_vnum = FALSE;
   512:     for (j = 0; j < *selected_count; j++)
   513:       if (selected[j].vnum == vnum)
   514:         seen_vnum = TRUE;
   515:     if (seen_vnum)
   516:       continue;
   517:     selected[*selected_count] = pool[i];
   518:     (*selected_count)++;
   519:   }
   520: 
   521:   return *selected_count >= CAMPAIGN_MIN_TARGETS;
   522: }
   523: 
   524: static struct char_data *select_kill_quest_target(struct char_data *ch)
   525: {
   526:   struct char_data *mob, *choice = NULL;
   527:   int weight, total = 0;
   528:   int level_diff;
   529: 
   530:   for (mob = character_list; mob; mob = mob->next) {
   531:     if (!IS_NPC(mob) || IN_ROOM(mob) == NOWHERE)
   532:       continue;
   533:     if (room_is_quest_safe(IN_ROOM(mob)))
   534:       continue;
   535:     if (is_service_or_protected_mob(mob))
   536:       continue;
   537:     if (MOB_FLAGGED(mob, MOB_NOTDEADYET))
   538:       continue;
   539: 
   540:     level_diff = GET_LEVEL(ch) - GET_LEVEL(mob);
   541:     if (level_diff < -3 || level_diff > 8)
   542:       continue;
   543: 
   544:     if (level_diff >= 0 && level_diff <= 4)
   545:       weight = 6;
   546:     else if (level_diff <= 6)
   547:       weight = 3;
   548:     else
   549:       weight = 1;
   550: 
   551:     total += weight;
   552:     if (rand_number(1, total) <= weight)
   553:       choice = mob;
   554:   }
   555: 
   556:   return choice;
   557: }
   558: 
   559: static void quest_request_kill(struct char_data *ch)
   560: {
   561:   struct char_data *qm, *target;
   562:   room_rnum tr;
   563: 
   564:   qm = find_present_questmaster(ch);
   565:   if (!qm) {
   566:     send_to_char(ch, "You must be in the same room as a quest master to request a quest.\r\n");
   567:     return;
   568:   }
   569:   expire_kill_quest_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
   570:   if (GET_QUEST(ch) != NOTHING || GET_KQUEST_ACTIVE(ch)) {
   571:     send_to_char(ch, "%s tells you, 'You already have a quest to finish first.'\r\n", GET_NAME(qm));
   572:     return;
   573:   }
   574:   if (is_on_quest_cooldown(ch)) {
   575:     send_to_char(ch, "You must wait %d minute%s before requesting another quest.\r\n",
   576:                  get_quest_cooldown_minutes_remaining(ch),
   577:                  get_quest_cooldown_minutes_remaining(ch) == 1 ? "" : "s");
   578:     return;
   579:   }
   580: 
   581:   target = select_kill_quest_target(ch);
   582:   if (!target) {
   583:     send_to_char(ch, "%s tells you, 'I have no suitable hunt for you right now. Return shortly.'\r\n", GET_NAME(qm));
   584:     return;
   585:   }
   586: 
   587:   tr = IN_ROOM(target);
   588:   GET_KQUEST_ACTIVE(ch) = 1;
   589:   GET_KQUEST_COMPLETE(ch) = 0;
   590:   GET_KQUEST_TARGET(ch) = GET_MOB_VNUM(target);
   591:   GET_KQUEST_ROOM(ch) = GET_ROOM_VNUM(tr);
   592:   GET_KQUEST_GIVER(ch) = GET_MOB_VNUM(qm);
   593:   GET_KQUEST_TIME(ch) = 60;
   594:   GET_KQUEST_EXPIRES_AT(ch) = time(0) + KQUEST_DURATION_SECS;
   595:   GET_KQUEST_TARGET_ID(ch) = char_script_id(target);
   596:   GET_KQUEST_COOLDOWN_NOTIFIED(ch) = 1;
   597: 
   598:   send_to_char(ch, "You ask %s for a quest.\r\n", GET_NAME(qm));
   599:   send_to_char(ch, "%s tells you, 'Thank you, brave %s!'\r\n", GET_NAME(qm), GET_NAME(ch));
   600:   send_to_char(ch, "%s tells you, 'An enemy of mine, %s, is making vile threats against Ayla!'\r\n",
   601:       GET_NAME(qm), GET_NAME(target));
   602:   send_to_char(ch, "%s tells you, 'Seek %s out somewhere near %s in the area of %s.'\r\n",
   603:       GET_NAME(qm), GET_NAME(target), world[tr].name, zone_table[world[tr].zone].name);
   604:   send_to_char(ch, "%s tells you, 'Good luck, %s. Return safely!'\r\n", GET_NAME(qm), GET_NAME(ch));
   605:   send_to_char(ch, "You have 60 minutes to complete your quest.\r\n");
   606:   save_char(ch);
   607: }
   608: 
   609: static void quest_info_kill(struct char_data *ch)
   610: {
   611:   room_rnum room;
   612:   const char *target_name;
   613: 
   614:   expire_kill_quest_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
   615:   if (!is_on_quest(ch)) {
   616:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not currently on a kill quest.\r\n");
   617:     return;
   618:   }
   619:   if (is_quest_ready(ch)) {
   620:     send_to_char(ch, "You have slain your target. Return to a quest master and type 'quest complete'.\r\n");
   621:     send_to_char(ch, "Time remaining: %d minute%s.\r\n",
   622:                  get_quest_minutes_remaining(ch),
   623:                  get_quest_minutes_remaining(ch) == 1 ? "" : "s");
   624:     return;
   625:   }
   626: 
   627:   room = real_room(GET_KQUEST_ROOM(ch));
   628:   if (room == NOWHERE) {
   629:     send_to_char(ch, "Your assigned target can no longer be located. Please request a new quest.\r\n");
   630:     return;
   631:   }
   632: 
   633:   target_name = (real_mobile(GET_KQUEST_TARGET(ch)) != NOBODY) ?
   634:     GET_NAME(&mob_proto[real_mobile(GET_KQUEST_TARGET(ch))]) : "your target";
   635:   send_to_char(ch, "You are on a quest to slay %s!\r\n", target_name);
   636:   send_to_char(ch, "%s can be found in the vicinity of %s which\r\nis in the general area of %s.\r\n",
   637:       target_name,
   638:       world[room].name, zone_table[world[room].zone].name);
   639:   send_to_char(ch, "Time remaining: %d minute%s.\r\n",
   640:                get_quest_minutes_remaining(ch),
   641:                get_quest_minutes_remaining(ch) == 1 ? "" : "s");
   642: }
   643: 
   644: static void quest_complete_kill(struct char_data *ch)
   645: {
   646:   struct char_data *qm;
   647:   int qp_reward, gold_reward, exp_reward;
   648: 
   649:   expire_kill_quest_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
   650:   if (!is_on_quest(ch)) {
   651:     send_to_char(ch, "You have no active kill quest to complete.\r\n");
   652:     return;
   653:   }
   654:   if (!is_quest_ready(ch)) {
   655:     send_to_char(ch, "You have not yet slain your assigned target.\r\n");
   656:     return;
   657:   }
   658: 
   659:   qm = find_present_questmaster(ch);
   660:   if (!qm) {
   661:     send_to_char(ch, "You must return to a quest master to complete this quest.\r\n");
   662:     return;
   663:   }
   664: 
   665:   qp_reward = MAX(5, GET_LEVEL(ch) / 2);
   666:   gold_reward = MAX(100, GET_LEVEL(ch) * 75);
   667:   exp_reward = MAX(250, GET_LEVEL(ch) * 250);
   668: 
   669:   GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch) += qp_reward;
   670:   increase_gold(ch, gold_reward);
   671:   gain_exp(ch, exp_reward);
   672:   send_to_char(ch, "You inform %s that you have completed your quest.\r\n", GET_NAME(qm));
   673:   send_to_char(ch, "%s tells you, 'Congratulations, %s, on completing your quest!'\r\n",
   674:                GET_NAME(qm), GET_NAME(ch));
   675:   send_to_char(ch, "%s tells you, 'As a reward, I am giving you %d quest points and %d gold.'\r\n",
   676:                GET_NAME(qm), qp_reward, gold_reward);
   677:   send_to_char(ch, "%s tells you, 'Give campaigns a try %s, see %sHELP CAMPAIGNS%s.'\r\n",
   678:                GET_NAME(qm), GET_NAME(ch), QYEL, QNRM);
   679:   send_to_char(ch, "You receive %d experience.\r\n", exp_reward);
   680: 
   681:   clear_kill_quest(ch);
   682:   start_kill_quest_cooldown(ch);
   683:   save_char(ch);
   684: }
   685: 
   686: static void campaign_show_header(struct char_data *ch)
   687: {
   688:   send_to_char(ch, "%s--------------------------[ YOUR CURRENT CAMPAIGN ]----------------------%s\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   689: }
   690: 
   691: static void campaign_request(struct char_data *ch)
   692: {
   693:   struct campaign_candidate_data selected[MAX_CAMPAIGN_TARGETS];
   694:   struct campaign_rewards rewards;
   695:   int count, i;
   696: 
   697:   expire_campaign_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
   698:   if (is_on_campaign(ch)) {
   699:     send_to_char(ch, "%sYou already have an active campaign. Use 'campaign info'.%s\r\n", QRED, QNRM);
   700:     return;
   701:   }
   702: 
   703:   if (!select_campaign_targets(ch, selected, &count)) {
   704:     send_to_char(ch, "%sNo suitable campaign targets are available for your level right now. Please try again later.%s\r\n", QRED, QNRM);
   705:     return;
   706:   }
   707: 
   708:   clear_campaign(ch);
   709:   GET_CAMPAIGN_ACTIVE(ch) = 1;
   710:   GET_CAMPAIGN_LEVEL(ch) = GET_LEVEL(ch);
   711:   GET_CAMPAIGN_EXPIRES_AT(ch) = time(0) + CAMPAIGN_DURATION_SECS;
   712:   GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_COUNT(ch) = count;
   713:   calculate_campaign_rewards(ch, count, &rewards);
   714:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_QP(ch) = rewards.qp;
   715:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_GOLD(ch) = rewards.gold;
   716:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_XP(ch) = rewards.xp;
   717:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_TRAINS(ch) = rewards.trains;
   718:   GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_PRACTICES(ch) = rewards.practices;
   719: 
   720:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   721:     GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, i) = selected[i].vnum;
   722:     GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_ROOM(ch, i) = selected[i].room_vnum;
   723:     GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REQUIRED(ch, i) = 1;
   724:     GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i) = 1;
   725:   }
   726: 
   727:   send_to_char(ch, "%sCampaign accepted.%s %sYou have %d targets and 6 real-world days to finish.%s\r\n",
   728:                QGRN, QNRM, QCYN, count, QNRM);
   729:   send_to_char(ch, "Use %s'campaign info'%s for full details, %s'cp check'%s for remaining targets.\r\n",
   730:                QYEL, QNRM, QYEL, QNRM);
   731:   save_char(ch);
   732: }
   733: 
   734: static void campaign_info(struct char_data *ch)
   735: {
   736:   int i;
   737:   char left_buf[128], deadline_buf[64];
   738: 
   739:   expire_campaign_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
   740:   if (!is_on_campaign(ch)) {
   741:     send_to_char(ch, "%sYou do not currently have an active campaign.%s\r\n", QRED, QNRM);
   742:     return;
   743:   }
   744: 
   745:   format_campaign_time_left(campaign_seconds_remaining(ch), left_buf, sizeof(left_buf));
   746:   format_campaign_deadline(GET_CAMPAIGN_EXPIRES_AT(ch), deadline_buf, sizeof(deadline_buf));
   747: 
   748:   campaign_show_header(ch);
   749:   send_to_char(ch, "%sComplete By........:%s [ %s%s%s ]\r\n", QCYN, QNRM, QWHT, deadline_buf, QNRM);
   750:   send_to_char(ch, "%sTime Left..........:%s [ %s%s%s ]\r\n", QCYN, QNRM, QGRN, left_buf, QNRM);
   751:   send_to_char(ch, "%sLevel Taken........:%s [ %5d ]\r\n", QCYN, QNRM, GET_CAMPAIGN_LEVEL(ch));
   752:   send_to_char(ch, "%sExperience.........:%s [ %5d ]\r\n", QCYN, QNRM, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_XP(ch));
   753:   send_to_char(ch, "%sQuest Points.......:%s [ %5d ]\r\n", QCYN, QNRM, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_QP(ch));
   754:   send_to_char(ch, "%sGold Coins.........:%s [ %5d ]\r\n", QCYN, QNRM, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_GOLD(ch));
   755:   send_to_char(ch, "%sTrains.............:%s [ %5d ]\r\n", QCYN, QNRM, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_TRAINS(ch));
   756:   send_to_char(ch, "%sPractices..........:%s [ %5d ]\r\n", QCYN, QNRM, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_PRACTICES(ch));
   757:   send_to_char(ch, "%s----------------------------[ Campaign Victims ]-------------------------%s\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   758:   send_to_char(ch, "The targets for this campaign are:\r\n");
   759:   for (i = 0; i < GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_COUNT(ch); i++) {
   760:     send_to_char(ch, "Find and kill %d * %s%s%s (%s%s%s)\r\n",
   761:                  GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REQUIRED(ch, i),
   762:                  QGRN, campaign_target_name(GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, i)), QNRM,
   763:                  QCYN, campaign_target_area(GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_ROOM(ch, i)), QNRM);
   764:   }
   765:   send_to_char(ch, "%s--------------------------------------------------------------------------%s\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   766:   send_to_char(ch, "Use '%scp check%s' to see only targets that you still need to kill.\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   767: }
   768: 
   769: static void campaign_check(struct char_data *ch)
   770: {
   771:   int i, shown = 0;
   772:   char left_buf[128];
   773: 
   774:   expire_campaign_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
   775:   if (!is_on_campaign(ch)) {
   776:     send_to_char(ch, "%sYou do not currently have an active campaign.%s\r\n", QRED, QNRM);
   777:     return;
   778:   }
   779: 
   780:   for (i = 0; i < GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_COUNT(ch); i++) {
   781:     if (GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i) <= 0)
   782:       continue;
   783:     shown++;
   784:     send_to_char(ch, "You still have to kill * %s%s%s (%s%s%s)\r\n",
   785:                  QGRN, campaign_target_name(GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, i)), QNRM,
   786:                  QCYN, campaign_target_area(GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_ROOM(ch, i)), QNRM);
   787:   }
   788:   if (!shown)
   789:     send_to_char(ch, "%sAll campaign targets are complete. Rewards will be granted automatically.%s\r\n", QGRN, QNRM);
   790: 
   791:   format_campaign_time_left(campaign_seconds_remaining(ch), left_buf, sizeof(left_buf));
   792:   send_to_char(ch, "\r\nYou have %s%s%s left to finish this campaign.\r\n", QGRN, left_buf, QNRM);
   793:   send_to_char(ch, "You may take a campaign at this level.\r\n");
   794: }
   795: 
   796: static void campaign_brief(struct char_data *ch)
   797: {
   798:   int i, shown = 0;
   799:   expire_campaign_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
   800:   if (!is_on_campaign(ch)) {
   801:     send_to_char(ch, "%sNo active campaign.%s\r\n", QRED, QNRM);
   802:     return;
   803:   }
   804: 
   805:   send_to_char(ch, "%sCampaign brief:%s %d remaining target%s.\r\n",
   806:                QYEL, QNRM, campaign_remaining_targets(ch), campaign_remaining_targets(ch) == 1 ? "" : "s");
   807:   for (i = 0; i < GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_COUNT(ch); i++) {
   808:     if (GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i) <= 0)
   809:       continue;
   810:     shown++;
   811:     send_to_char(ch, " - %s%s%s (%s%s%s)\r\n",
   812:                  QGRN, campaign_target_name(GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, i)), QNRM,
   813:                  QCYN, campaign_target_area(GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_ROOM(ch, i)), QNRM);
   814:     if (shown >= 5)
   815:       break;
   816:   }
   817: }
   818: 
   819: static void campaign_today(struct char_data *ch)
   820: {
   821:   char left_buf[128];
   822:   expire_campaign_if_needed(ch, FALSE);
   823:   if (!is_on_campaign(ch)) {
   824:     send_to_char(ch, "%sCampaign Status:%s You may request a campaign now.\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
   825:     return;
   826:   }
   827:   format_campaign_time_left(campaign_seconds_remaining(ch), left_buf, sizeof(left_buf));
   828:   send_to_char(ch, "%sCampaign Status:%s Active with %s%d%s target%s remaining. Time left: %s%s%s.\r\n",
   829:                QYEL, QNRM, QGRN, campaign_remaining_targets(ch), QNRM,
   830:                campaign_remaining_targets(ch) == 1 ? "" : "s", QGRN, left_buf, QNRM);
   831: }
   832: 
   833: static void campaign_quit(struct char_data *ch)
   834: {
   835:   expire_campaign_if_needed(ch, FALSE);
   836:   if (!is_on_campaign(ch)) {
   837:     send_to_char(ch, "%sYou have no active campaign to quit.%s\r\n", QRED, QNRM);
   838:     return;
   839:   }
   840:   clear_campaign(ch);
   841:   send_to_char(ch, "%sYou abandon your campaign and forfeit all rewards.%s\r\n", QRED, QNRM);
   842:   save_char(ch);
   843: }

   849: qst_rnum real_quest(qst_vnum vnum)
   850: {
   851:   int rnum;
   852: 
   853:   for (rnum = 0; rnum < total_quests; rnum++)
   854:     if (QST_NUM(rnum) == vnum)
   855:       return(rnum);
   856:   return(NOTHING);
   857: }
   858: 
   859: int is_complete(struct char_data *ch, qst_vnum vnum)
   860: {
   861:   int i;
   862: 
   863:   for (i = 0; i < GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch); i++)
   864:     if (ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests[i] == vnum)
   865:       return TRUE;
   866:   return FALSE;
   867: }
   868: 
   869: qst_vnum find_quest_by_qmnum(struct char_data *ch, mob_vnum qm, int num)
   870: {
   871:   qst_rnum rnum;
   872:   int found=0;
   873:   for (rnum = 0; rnum < total_quests; rnum++) {
   874:     if (qm == QST_MASTER(rnum))
   875:       if (++found == num)
   876:         return (QST_NUM(rnum));
   877:   }
   878:   return NOTHING;
   879: }

   885: void destroy_quests(void)
   886: {
   887:   qst_rnum rnum = 0;
   888: 
   889:   if (!aquest_table)
   890:     return;
   891: 
   892:   for (rnum = 0; rnum < total_quests; rnum++){
   893:     free_quest_strings(&aquest_table[rnum]);
   894:   }
   895:   free(aquest_table);
   896:   aquest_table = NULL;
   897:   total_quests = 0;
   898: 
   899:   return;
   900: }
   901: 
   902: int count_quests(qst_vnum low, qst_vnum high)
   903: {
   904:   int i, j;
   905: 
   906:   if (!aquest_table)
   907:     return 0;
   908: 
   909:   for (i = j = 0; i < total_quests; i++)
   910:     if (QST_NUM(i) >= low && QST_NUM(i) <= high)
   911:       j++;
   912: 
   913:   return j;
   914: }
   915: 
   916: void parse_quest(FILE *quest_f, int nr)
   917: {
   918:   static char line[256];
   919:   static int i = 0, j;
   920:   int retval = 0, t[7];
   921:   char f1[128], buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   922:   aquest_table[i].vnum = nr;
   923:   aquest_table[i].qm = NOBODY;
   924:   aquest_table[i].name = NULL;
   925:   aquest_table[i].desc = NULL;
   926:   aquest_table[i].info = NULL;
   927:   aquest_table[i].done = NULL;
   928:   aquest_table[i].quit = NULL;
   929:   aquest_table[i].flags = 0;
   930:   aquest_table[i].type = -1;
   931:   aquest_table[i].target = -1;
   932:   aquest_table[i].prereq = NOTHING;
   933:   for (j = 0; j < 7; j++)
   934:     aquest_table[i].value[j] = 0;
   935:   aquest_table[i].prev_quest = NOTHING;
   936:   aquest_table[i].next_quest = NOTHING;
   937:   aquest_table[i].func = NULL;
   938: 
   939:   aquest_table[i].gold_reward = 0;
   940:   aquest_table[i].exp_reward  = 0;
   941:   aquest_table[i].obj_reward  = NOTHING;
   942: 
   943:   /* begin to parse the data */
   944:   aquest_table[i].name = fread_string(quest_f, buf2);
   945:   aquest_table[i].desc = fread_string(quest_f, buf2);
   946:   aquest_table[i].info = fread_string(quest_f, buf2);
   947:   aquest_table[i].done = fread_string(quest_f, buf2);
   948:   aquest_table[i].quit = fread_string(quest_f, buf2);
   949:   if (!get_line(quest_f, line) ||
   950:       (retval = sscanf(line, " %d %d %s %d %d %d %d",
   951:              t, t+1, f1, t+2, t+3, t + 4, t + 5)) != 7) {
   952:     log("Format error in numeric line (expected 7, got %d), %s\n",
   953:         retval, line);
   954:     exit(1);
   955:   }
   956:   aquest_table[i].type       = t[0];
   957:   aquest_table[i].qm         = (real_mobile(t[1]) == NOBODY) ? NOBODY : t[1];
   958:   aquest_table[i].flags      = asciiflag_conv(f1);
   959:   aquest_table[i].target     = (t[2] == -1) ? NOTHING : t[2];
   960:   aquest_table[i].prev_quest = (t[3] == -1) ? NOTHING : t[3];
   961:   aquest_table[i].next_quest = (t[4] == -1) ? NOTHING : t[4];
   962:   aquest_table[i].prereq     = (t[5] == -1) ? NOTHING : t[5];
   963:   if (!get_line(quest_f, line) ||
   964:       (retval = sscanf(line, " %d %d %d %d %d %d %d",
   965:           t, t+1, t+2, t+3, t+4, t + 5, t + 6)) != 7) {
   966:     log("Format error in numeric line (expected 7, got %d), %s\n",
   967:         retval, line);
   968:     exit(1);
   969:   }
   970:   for (j = 0; j < 7; j++)
   971:     aquest_table[i].value[j] = t[j];
   972: 
   973:   if (!get_line(quest_f, line) ||
   974:       (retval = sscanf(line, " %d %d %d",
   975:              t, t+1, t+2)) != 3) {
   976:     log("Format error in numeric (rewards) line (expected 3, got %d), %s\n",
   977:         retval, line);
   978:     exit(1);
   979:   }
   980: 
   981:   aquest_table[i].gold_reward = t[0];
   982:   aquest_table[i].exp_reward  = t[1];
   983:   aquest_table[i].obj_reward  = (t[2] == -1) ? NOTHING : t[2];
   984: 
   985:   for (;;) {
   986:     if (!get_line(quest_f, line)) {
   987:       log("Format error in %s\n", line);
   988:       exit(1);
   989:     }
   990:     switch(*line) {
   991:     case 'S':
   992:       total_quests = ++i;
   993:       return;
   994:     }
   995:   }
   996: } /* parse_quest */
   997: 
   998: void assign_the_quests(void)
   999: {
  1000:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1001:   mob_rnum mrnum;
  1002: 
  1003:   cmd_tell = find_command("tell");
  1004: 
  1005:   for (rnum = 0; rnum < total_quests; rnum ++) {
  1006:     if (QST_MASTER(rnum) == NOBODY) {
  1007:       log("SYSERR: Quest #%d has no questmaster specified.", QST_NUM(rnum));
  1008:       continue;
  1009:     }
  1010:     if ((mrnum = real_mobile(QST_MASTER(rnum))) == NOBODY) {
  1011:       log("SYSERR: Quest #%d has an invalid questmaster.", QST_NUM(rnum));
  1012:       continue;
  1013:     }
  1014:     if (mob_index[(mrnum)].func &&
  1015:  mob_index[(mrnum)].func != questmaster)
  1016:       QST_FUNC(rnum) = mob_index[(mrnum)].func;
  1017:     mob_index[(mrnum)].func = questmaster;
  1018:   }
  1019: }

  1021: /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1022: /* Quest Completion Functions                                               */

  1024: void set_quest(struct char_data *ch, qst_rnum rnum)
  1025: {
  1026:   GET_QUEST(ch) = QST_NUM(rnum);
  1027:   GET_QUEST_TIME(ch) = QST_TIME(rnum);
  1028:   GET_QUEST_COUNTER(ch) = QST_QUANTITY(rnum);
  1029:   SET_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(ch), PRF_QUEST);
  1030:   return;
  1031: }
  1032: 
  1033: void clear_quest(struct char_data *ch)
  1034: {
  1035:   GET_QUEST(ch) = NOTHING;
  1036:   GET_QUEST_TIME(ch) = -1;
  1037:   GET_QUEST_COUNTER(ch) = 0;
  1038:   REMOVE_BIT_AR(PRF_FLAGS(ch), PRF_QUEST);
  1039:   return;
  1040: }
  1041: 
  1042: void add_completed_quest(struct char_data *ch, qst_vnum vnum)
  1043: {
  1044:   qst_vnum *temp;
  1045:   int i;
  1046: 
  1047:   CREATE(temp, qst_vnum, GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch) +1);
  1048:   for (i=0; i < GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch); i++)
  1049:     temp[i] = ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests[i];
  1050: 
  1051:   temp[GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch)] = vnum;
  1052:   GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch)++;
  1053: 
  1054:   if (ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests)
  1055:     free(ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests);
  1056:   ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests = temp;
  1057: }
  1058: 
  1059: void remove_completed_quest(struct char_data *ch, qst_vnum vnum)
  1060: {
  1061:   qst_vnum *temp;
  1062:   int i, j = 0;
  1063: 
  1064:   CREATE(temp, qst_vnum, GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch));
  1065:   for (i = 0; i < GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch); i++)
  1066:     if (ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests[i] != vnum)
  1067:       temp[j++] = ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests[i];
  1068: 
  1069:   GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch)--;
  1070: 
  1071:   if (ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests)
  1072:     free(ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests);
  1073:   ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests = temp;
  1074: }
  1075: 
  1076: void generic_complete_quest(struct char_data *ch)
  1077: {
  1078:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1079:   qst_vnum vnum = GET_QUEST(ch);
  1080:   struct obj_data *new_obj;
  1081:   int happy_qp, happy_gold, happy_exp;
  1082: 
  1083:   if (--GET_QUEST_COUNTER(ch) <= 0) {
  1084:     rnum = real_quest(vnum);
  1085:     if (IS_HAPPYHOUR && IS_HAPPYQP) {
  1086:       happy_qp = (int)(QST_POINTS(rnum) * (((float)(100+HAPPY_QP))/(float)100));
  1087:       happy_qp = MAX(happy_qp, 0);
  1088:       GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch) += happy_qp;
  1089:       send_to_char(ch,
  1090:           "%s\r\nYou have been awarded %d quest points for your service.\r\n",
  1091:           QST_DONE(rnum), happy_qp);
  1092: 	} else {
  1093:       GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch) += QST_POINTS(rnum);
  1094:       send_to_char(ch,
  1095:           "%s\r\nYou have been awarded %d quest points for your service.\r\n",
  1096:           QST_DONE(rnum), QST_POINTS(rnum));
  1097:     }
  1098:     if (QST_GOLD(rnum)) {
  1099:       if ((IS_HAPPYHOUR) && (IS_HAPPYGOLD)) {
  1100:         happy_gold = (int)(QST_GOLD(rnum) * (((float)(100+HAPPY_GOLD))/(float)100));
  1101:         happy_gold = MAX(happy_gold, 0);
  1102:         increase_gold(ch, happy_gold);
  1103:         send_to_char(ch,
  1104:               "You have been awarded %d gold coins for your service.\r\n",
  1105:               happy_gold);
  1106: 	  } else {
  1107:         increase_gold(ch, QST_GOLD(rnum));
  1108:         send_to_char(ch,
  1109:               "You have been awarded %d gold coins for your service.\r\n",
  1110:               QST_GOLD(rnum));
  1111:       }
  1112:     }
  1113:     if (QST_EXP(rnum)) {
  1114:       gain_exp(ch, QST_EXP(rnum));
  1115:       if ((IS_HAPPYHOUR) && (IS_HAPPYEXP)) {
  1116:         happy_exp = (int)(QST_EXP(rnum) * (((float)(100+HAPPY_EXP))/(float)100));
  1117:         happy_exp = MAX(happy_exp, 0);
  1118:         send_to_char(ch,
  1119:               "You have been awarded %d experience for your service.\r\n",
  1120:               happy_exp);
  1121:       } else {
  1122:         send_to_char(ch,
  1123:               "You have been awarded %d experience points for your service.\r\n",
  1124:               QST_EXP(rnum));
  1125:       }
  1126:     }
  1127:     if (QST_OBJ(rnum) && QST_OBJ(rnum) != NOTHING) {
  1128:       if (real_object(QST_OBJ(rnum)) != NOTHING) {
  1129:         if ((new_obj = read_object((QST_OBJ(rnum)),VIRTUAL)) != NULL) {
  1130:             obj_to_char(new_obj, ch);
  1131:             send_to_char(ch, "You have been presented with %s%s for your service.\r\n",
  1132:                 GET_OBJ_SHORT(new_obj), CCNRM(ch, C_NRM));
  1133:         }
  1134:       }
  1135:     }
  1136:     if (!IS_SET(QST_FLAGS(rnum), AQ_REPEATABLE))
  1137:       add_completed_quest(ch, vnum);
  1138:     clear_quest(ch);
  1139:     if ((real_quest(QST_NEXT(rnum)) != NOTHING) &&
  1140:         (QST_NEXT(rnum) != vnum) &&
  1141:         !is_complete(ch, QST_NEXT(rnum))) {
  1142:       rnum = real_quest(QST_NEXT(rnum));
  1143:       set_quest(ch, rnum);
  1144:       send_to_char(ch,
  1145:           "The next stage of your quest awaits:\r\n%s",
  1146:           QST_INFO(rnum));
  1147:     }
  1148:   }
  1149:   save_char(ch);
  1150: }
  1151: 
  1152: void autoquest_trigger_check(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict,
  1153:                 struct obj_data *object, int type)
  1154: {
  1155:   struct char_data *i;
  1156:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1157:   int found = TRUE;
  1158: 
  1159:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  1160:     return;
  1161:   if (GET_QUEST(ch) == NOTHING)  /* No current quest, skip this */
  1162:     return;
  1163:   if (GET_QUEST_TYPE(ch) != type)
  1164:     return;
  1165:   if ((rnum = real_quest(GET_QUEST(ch))) == NOTHING)
  1166:     return;
  1167:   switch (type) {
  1168:     case AQ_OBJ_FIND:
  1169:       if (QST_TARGET(rnum) == GET_OBJ_VNUM(object))
  1170:         generic_complete_quest(ch);
  1171:       break;
  1172:     case AQ_ROOM_FIND:
  1173:       if (QST_TARGET(rnum) == world[IN_ROOM(ch)].number)
  1174:         generic_complete_quest(ch);
  1175:       break;
  1176:     case AQ_MOB_FIND:
  1177:       for (i=world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; i; i = i->next_in_room)
  1178:         if (IS_NPC(i))
  1179:           if (QST_TARGET(rnum) == GET_MOB_VNUM(i))
  1180:             generic_complete_quest(ch);
  1181:       break;
  1182:     case AQ_MOB_KILL:
  1183:       if (!IS_NPC(ch) && IS_NPC(vict) && (ch != vict))
  1184:           if (QST_TARGET(rnum) == GET_MOB_VNUM(vict))
  1185:             generic_complete_quest(ch);
  1186:       break;
  1187:     case AQ_MOB_SAVE:
  1188:        if (ch == vict)
  1189:         found = FALSE;
  1190:       for (i = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; i && found; i = i->next_in_room)
  1191:           if (i && IS_NPC(i) && !MOB_FLAGGED(i, MOB_NOTDEADYET))
  1192:             if ((GET_MOB_VNUM(i) != QST_TARGET(rnum)) &&
  1193:                 !AFF_FLAGGED(i, AFF_CHARM))
  1194:               found = FALSE;
  1195:       if (found)
  1196:         generic_complete_quest(ch);
  1197:       break;
  1198:     case AQ_OBJ_RETURN:
  1199:       if (IS_NPC(vict) && (GET_MOB_VNUM(vict) == QST_RETURNMOB(rnum)))
  1200:         if (object && (GET_OBJ_VNUM(object) == QST_TARGET(rnum)))
  1201:           generic_complete_quest(ch);
  1202:       break;
  1203:     case AQ_ROOM_CLEAR:
  1204:       if (QST_TARGET(rnum) == world[IN_ROOM(ch)].number) {
  1205:         for (i = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; i && found; i = i->next_in_room)
  1206:           if (i && IS_NPC(i) && !MOB_FLAGGED(i, MOB_NOTDEADYET))
  1207:             found = FALSE;
  1208:         if (found)
  1209:    generic_complete_quest(ch);
  1210:       }
  1211:       break;
  1212:     default:
  1213:       log("SYSERR: Invalid quest type passed to autoquest_trigger_check");
  1214:       break;
  1215:   }
  1216: }
  1217: 
  1218: void quest_timeout(struct char_data *ch)
  1219: {
  1220:   if ((GET_QUEST(ch) != NOTHING) && (GET_QUEST_TIME(ch) != -1)) {
  1221:     clear_quest(ch);
  1222:     send_to_char(ch, "You have run out of time to complete the quest.\r\n");
  1223:   }
  1224: }
  1225: 
  1226: void check_timed_quests(void)
  1227: {
  1228:   struct char_data *ch;
  1229: 
  1230:   for (ch = character_list; ch; ch = ch->next) {
  1231:     if (!IS_NPC(ch) && (GET_QUEST(ch) != NOTHING) && (GET_QUEST_TIME(ch) != -1))
  1232:       if (--GET_QUEST_TIME(ch) == 0)
  1233:         quest_timeout(ch);
  1234:     if (!IS_NPC(ch))
  1235:       expire_kill_quest_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
  1236:     if (!IS_NPC(ch))
  1237:       expire_campaign_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
  1238:     if (!IS_NPC(ch))
  1239:       notify_quest_cooldown_ready_if_needed(ch);
  1240:   }
  1241: }
  1242: 
  1243: void quest_kill_trigger_check(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict)
  1244: {
  1245:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch) || !vict || !IS_NPC(vict))
  1246:     return;
  1247:   expire_kill_quest_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
  1248:   if (!is_on_quest(ch) || is_quest_ready(ch) || is_quest_expired(ch))
  1249:     return;
  1250:   if (GET_KQUEST_TARGET(ch) != GET_MOB_VNUM(vict))
  1251:     return;
  1252:   if (GET_KQUEST_TARGET_ID(ch) > 0 && GET_KQUEST_TARGET_ID(ch) != char_script_id(vict))
  1253:     return;
  1254: 
  1255:   GET_KQUEST_COMPLETE(ch) = 1;
  1256:   send_to_char(ch, "\tRQuest Target Slain!\tn\r\n");
  1257:   send_to_char(ch, "\tYQUEST: You have almost completed your QUEST!\tn\r\n");
  1258:   send_to_char(ch, "\tYReturn to the questmaster before your time runs out.\tn\r\n");
  1259:   save_char(ch);
  1260: }
  1261: 
  1262: void campaign_kill_trigger_check(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *vict)
  1263: {
  1264:   int i, remaining;
  1265: 
  1266:   if (!ch || IS_NPC(ch) || !vict || !IS_NPC(vict))
  1267:     return;
  1268: 
  1269:   expire_campaign_if_needed(ch, TRUE);
  1270:   if (!is_on_campaign(ch))
  1271:     return;
  1272: 
  1273:   for (i = 0; i < GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_COUNT(ch); i++) {
  1274:     if (GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i) <= 0)
  1275:       continue;
  1276:     if (GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, i) != GET_MOB_VNUM(vict))
  1277:       continue;
  1278: 
  1279:     GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_REMAINING(ch, i)--;
  1280:     remaining = campaign_remaining_targets(ch);
  1281:     send_to_char(ch, "%sCAMPAIGN:%s You have slain one of your campaign targets: %s%s%s.\r\n",
  1282:                  QYEL, QNRM, QGRN, campaign_target_name(GET_CAMPAIGN_TARGET_VNUM(ch, i)), QNRM);
  1283:     send_to_char(ch, "%sCAMPAIGN:%s %d target%s remain.\r\n",
  1284:                  QYEL, QNRM, remaining, remaining == 1 ? "" : "s");
  1285: 
  1286:     if (remaining <= 0) {
  1287:       int campaign_trains = GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_TRAINS(ch);
  1288:       int campaign_practices = GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_PRACTICES(ch);
  1289: 
  1290:       gain_exp(ch, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_XP(ch));
  1291:       GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch) += GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_QP(ch);
  1292:       increase_gold(ch, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_GOLD(ch));
  1293:       GET_TRAINS(ch) = MIN(INT_MAX - campaign_trains, GET_TRAINS(ch)) + campaign_trains;
  1294:       GET_PRACTICES(ch) = MIN(INT_MAX - campaign_practices, GET_PRACTICES(ch)) + campaign_practices;
  1295:       send_to_char(ch, "%sCAMPAIGN:%s You have completed your campaign!\r\n", QYEL, QNRM);
  1296:       send_to_char(ch, "%sCAMPAIGN:%s You receive %s%d%s experience, %s%d%s gold, %s%d%s quest points, %s%d%s train%s, and %s%d%s practice%s.\r\n",
  1297:                    QYEL, QNRM,
  1298:                    QGRN, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_XP(ch), QNRM,
  1299:                    QGRN, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_GOLD(ch), QNRM,
  1300:                    QGRN, GET_CAMPAIGN_REWARD_QP(ch), QNRM,
  1301:                    QGRN, campaign_trains, QNRM, campaign_trains == 1 ? "" : "s",
  1302:                    QGRN, campaign_practices, QNRM, campaign_practices == 1 ? "" : "s");
  1303:       clear_campaign(ch);
  1304:     }
  1305:     save_char(ch);
  1306:     return;
  1307:   }
  1308: }
  1309: 
  1310: int is_player_quest_target(struct char_data *viewer, struct char_data *mob)
  1311: {
  1312:   if (!viewer || IS_NPC(viewer) || !mob || !IS_NPC(mob))
  1313:     return FALSE;
  1314:   expire_kill_quest_if_needed(viewer, FALSE);
  1315:   if (!is_on_quest(viewer) || is_quest_ready(viewer) || is_quest_expired(viewer))
  1316:     return FALSE;
  1317:   if (GET_KQUEST_TARGET(viewer) != GET_MOB_VNUM(mob))
  1318:     return FALSE;
  1319:   if (GET_KQUEST_TARGET_ID(viewer) > 0 && GET_KQUEST_TARGET_ID(viewer) != char_script_id(mob))
  1320:     return FALSE;
  1321: 
  1322:   return TRUE;
  1323: }

  1329: void list_quests(struct char_data *ch, zone_rnum zone, qst_vnum vmin, qst_vnum vmax)
  1330: {
  1331:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1332:   qst_vnum bottom, top;
  1333:   int counter = 0;
  1334: 
  1335:   if (zone != NOWHERE) {
  1336:     bottom = zone_table[zone].bot;
  1337:     top    = zone_table[zone].top;
  1338:   } else {
  1339:     bottom = vmin;
  1340:     top    = vmax;
  1341:   }
  1342:   /* Print the header for the quest listing. */
  1343:   send_to_char (ch,
  1344:   "Index VNum    Description                                  Questmaster\r\n"
  1345:   "----- ------- -------------------------------------------- -----------\r\n");
  1346:   for (rnum = 0; rnum < total_quests ; rnum++)
  1347:     if (QST_NUM(rnum) >= bottom && QST_NUM(rnum) <= top)
  1348:       send_to_char(ch, "\tg%4d\tn) [\tg%-5d\tn] \tc%-44.44s\tn \ty[%5d]\tn\r\n",
  1349:           ++counter, QST_NUM(rnum), QST_NAME(rnum),
  1350:           QST_MASTER(rnum) == NOBODY ? 0 : QST_MASTER(rnum));
  1351:   if (!counter)
  1352:     send_to_char(ch, "None found.\r\n");
  1353: }

  1355: static void quest_hist(struct char_data *ch)
  1356: {
  1357:   int i = 0, counter = 0;
  1358:   qst_rnum rnum = NOTHING;
  1359: 
  1360:   send_to_char(ch, "Quests that you have completed:\r\n"
  1361:     "Index Description                                          Questmaster\r\n"
  1362:     "----- ---------------------------------------------------- -----------\r\n");
  1363:   for (i = 0; i < GET_NUM_QUESTS(ch); i++) {
  1364:     if ((rnum = real_quest(ch->player_specials->saved.completed_quests[i])) != NOTHING)
  1365:       send_to_char(ch, "\tg%4d\tn) \tc%-52.52s\tn \ty%s\tn\r\n",
  1366:  ++counter, QST_DESC(rnum), (real_mobile(QST_MASTER(rnum)) == NOBODY) ? "Unknown" : GET_NAME(&mob_proto[(real_mobile(QST_MASTER(rnum)))]));
  1367:     else
  1368:       send_to_char(ch,
  1369:         "\tg%4d\tn) \tcUnknown Quest (it no longer exists)\tn\r\n", ++counter);
  1370:   }
  1371:   if (!counter)
  1372:     send_to_char(ch, "You haven't completed any quests yet.\r\n");
  1373: }

  1375: static void quest_join(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *qm, char argument[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH])
  1376: {
  1377:   qst_vnum vnum;
  1378:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1379:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1380: 
  1381:   if (!*argument)
  1382:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1383:              "%s What quest did you wish to join?", GET_NAME(ch));
  1384:   else if (GET_QUEST(ch) != NOTHING)
  1385:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1386:              "%s But you are already part of a quest!", GET_NAME(ch));
  1387:   else if((vnum = find_quest_by_qmnum(ch, GET_MOB_VNUM(qm), atoi(argument))) == NOTHING)
  1388:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1389:              "%s I don't know of such a quest!", GET_NAME(ch));
  1390:   else if ((rnum = real_quest(vnum)) == NOTHING)
  1391:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1392:              "%s I don't know of such a quest!", GET_NAME(ch));
  1393:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < QST_MINLEVEL(rnum))
  1394:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1395:              "%s You are not experienced enough for that quest!", GET_NAME(ch));
  1396:   else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) > QST_MAXLEVEL(rnum))
  1397:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1398:              "%s You are too experienced for that quest!", GET_NAME(ch));
  1399:   else if (is_complete(ch, vnum))
  1400:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1401:              "%s You have already completed that quest!", GET_NAME(ch));
  1402:   else if ((QST_PREV(rnum) != NOTHING) && !is_complete(ch, QST_PREV(rnum)))
  1403:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1404:              "%s That quest is not available to you yet!", GET_NAME(ch));
  1405:   else if ((QST_PREREQ(rnum) != NOTHING) &&
  1406:            (real_object(QST_PREREQ(rnum)) != NOTHING) &&
  1407:            (get_obj_in_list_num(real_object(QST_PREREQ(rnum)),
  1408:        ch->carrying) == NULL))
  1409:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1410:              "%s You need to have %s first!", GET_NAME(ch),
  1411:       obj_proto[real_object(QST_PREREQ(rnum))].short_description);
  1412:   else {
  1413:     act("You join the quest.",    TRUE, ch, NULL, NULL, TO_CHAR);
  1414:     act("$n has joined a quest.", TRUE, ch, NULL, NULL, TO_ROOM);
  1415:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1416:              "%s Listen carefully to the instructions.", GET_NAME(ch));
  1417:     do_tell(qm, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
  1418:     set_quest(ch, rnum);
  1419:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", QST_INFO(rnum));
  1420:     if (QST_TIME(rnum) != -1)
  1421:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1422:         "%s You have a time limit of %d turn%s to complete the quest.",
  1423:         GET_NAME(ch), QST_TIME(rnum), QST_TIME(rnum) == 1 ? "" : "s");
  1424:     else
  1425:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
  1426:         "%s You can take however long you want to complete the quest.",
  1427:  GET_NAME(ch));
  1428:   }
  1429:   do_tell(qm, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
  1430:   save_char(ch);
  1431: }

  1433: void quest_list(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *qm, char argument[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH])
  1434: {
  1435:   qst_vnum vnum;
  1436:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1437: 
  1438:   if ((vnum = find_quest_by_qmnum(ch, GET_MOB_VNUM(qm), atoi(argument))) == NOTHING)
  1439:     send_to_char(ch, "That is not a valid quest!\r\n");
  1440:   else if ((rnum = real_quest(vnum)) == NOTHING)
  1441:     send_to_char(ch, "That is not a valid quest!\r\n");
  1442:   else if (QST_INFO(rnum)) {
  1443:     send_to_char(ch,"Complete Details on Quest %d \tc%s\tn:\r\n%s",
  1444:                       vnum,
  1445:          QST_DESC(rnum),
  1446:          QST_INFO(rnum));
  1447:     if (QST_PREV(rnum) != NOTHING)
  1448:       send_to_char(ch, "You have to have completed quest %s first.\r\n",
  1449:           QST_NAME(real_quest(QST_PREV(rnum))));
  1450:     if (QST_TIME(rnum) != -1)
  1451:       send_to_char(ch,
  1452:          "There is a time limit of %d turn%s to complete the quest.\r\n",
  1453:           QST_TIME(rnum),
  1454:           QST_TIME(rnum) == 1 ? "" : "s");
  1455:   } else
  1456:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no further information on that quest.\r\n");
  1457: }

  1459: static void quest_quit(struct char_data *ch)
  1460: {
  1461:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1462: 
  1463:   if (GET_QUEST(ch) == NOTHING)
  1464:     send_to_char(ch, "But you currently aren't on a quest!\r\n");
  1465:   else if ((rnum = real_quest(GET_QUEST(ch))) == NOTHING) {
  1466:     clear_quest(ch);
  1467:     send_to_char(ch, "You are now no longer part of the quest.\r\n");
  1468:     save_char(ch);
  1469:   } else {
  1470:     clear_quest(ch);
  1471:     if (QST_QUIT(rnum) && (str_cmp(QST_QUIT(rnum), "undefined") != 0))
  1472:       send_to_char(ch, "%s", QST_QUIT(rnum));
  1473:     else
  1474:       send_to_char(ch, "You are now no longer part of the quest.\r\n");
  1475:     if (QST_PENALTY(rnum)) {
  1476:       GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch) -= QST_PENALTY(rnum);
  1477:       send_to_char(ch,
  1478:         "You have lost %d quest points for your cowardice.\r\n",
  1479:         QST_PENALTY(rnum));
  1480:     }
  1481:     save_char(ch);
  1482:   }
  1483: }

  1485: static void quest_progress(struct char_data *ch)
  1486: {
  1487:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1488: 
  1489:   if (GET_QUEST(ch) == NOTHING)
  1490:     send_to_char(ch, "But you currently aren't on a quest!\r\n");
  1491:   else if ((rnum = real_quest(GET_QUEST(ch))) == NOTHING) {
  1492:     clear_quest(ch);
  1493:     send_to_char(ch, "Your quest seems to no longer exist.\r\n");
  1494:   } else {
  1495:     send_to_char(ch, "You are on the following quest:\r\n%s\r\n%s",
  1496:         QST_DESC(rnum), QST_INFO(rnum));
  1497:     if (QST_QUANTITY(rnum) > 1)
  1498:       send_to_char(ch,
  1499:           "You still have to achieve %d out of %d goals for the quest.\r\n",
  1500:    GET_QUEST_COUNTER(ch), QST_QUANTITY(rnum));
  1501:     if (GET_QUEST_TIME(ch) > 0)
  1502:       send_to_char(ch,
  1503:           "You have %d turn%s remaining to complete the quest.\r\n",
  1504:    GET_QUEST_TIME(ch),
  1505:    GET_QUEST_TIME(ch) == 1 ? "" : "s");
  1506:   }
  1507: }

  1527: static void quest_stat(struct char_data *ch, const char *argument)
  1528: {
  1529:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1530:   mob_rnum qmrnum;
  1531:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1532:   char targetname[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1533: 
  1534:   if (!*argument)
  1535:     send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", quest_imm_usage);
  1536:   else if ((rnum = real_quest(atoi(argument))) == NOTHING )
  1537:     send_to_char(ch, "That quest does not exist.\r\n");
  1538:   else {
  1539:     sprintbit(QST_FLAGS(rnum), aq_flags, buf, sizeof(buf));
  1540:     switch (QST_TYPE(rnum)) {
  1541:       case AQ_OBJ_FIND:
  1542:       case AQ_OBJ_RETURN:
  1543:         snprintf(targetname, sizeof(targetname), "%s",
  1544:                  real_object(QST_TARGET(rnum)) == NOTHING ?
  1545:                  "An unknown object" :
  1546:     obj_proto[real_object(QST_TARGET(rnum))].short_description);
  1547:  break;
  1548:       case AQ_ROOM_FIND:
  1549:       case AQ_ROOM_CLEAR:
  1550:         snprintf(targetname, sizeof(targetname), "%s",
  1551:           real_room(QST_TARGET(rnum)) == NOWHERE ?
  1552:                  "An unknown room" :
  1553:     world[real_room(QST_TARGET(rnum))].name);
  1554:         break;
  1555:       case AQ_MOB_FIND:
  1556:       case AQ_MOB_KILL:
  1557:       case AQ_MOB_SAVE:
  1558:  snprintf(targetname, sizeof(targetname), "%s",
  1559:                  real_mobile(QST_TARGET(rnum)) == NOBODY ?
  1560:     "An unknown mobile" :
  1561:     GET_NAME(&mob_proto[real_mobile(QST_TARGET(rnum))]));
  1562:  break;
  1563:       default:
  1564:  snprintf(targetname, sizeof(targetname), "Unknown");
  1565:  break;
  1566:     }
  1567:     qmrnum = real_mobile(QST_MASTER(rnum));
  1568:     send_to_char(ch,
  1569:         "VNum  : [\ty%5d\tn], RNum: [\ty%5d\tn] -- Questmaster: [\ty%5d\tn] \ty%s\tn\r\n"
  1570:         "Name  : \ty%s\tn\r\n"
  1571:  "Desc  : \ty%s\tn\r\n"
  1572:  "Accept Message:\r\n\tc%s\tn"
  1573:  "Completion Message:\r\n\tc%s\tn"
  1574:  "Quit Message:\r\n\tc%s\tn"
  1575:  "Type  : \ty%s\tn\r\n"
  1576:         "Target: \ty%d\tn \ty%s\tn, Quantity: \ty%d\tn\r\n"
  1577:  "Value : \ty%d\tn, Penalty: \ty%d\tn, Min Level: \ty%2d\tn, Max Level: \ty%2d\tn\r\n"
  1578:  "Flags : \tc%s\tn\r\n",
  1579:      QST_NUM(rnum), rnum,
  1580:  QST_MASTER(rnum) == NOBODY ? -1 : QST_MASTER(rnum),
  1581:  (qmrnum == NOBODY) ? "(Invalid vnum)" : GET_NAME(&mob_proto[(qmrnum)]),
  1582:         QST_NAME(rnum), QST_DESC(rnum),
  1583:         QST_INFO(rnum), QST_DONE(rnum),
  1584:  (QST_QUIT(rnum) &&
  1585:   (str_cmp(QST_QUIT(rnum), "undefined") != 0)
  1586:           ? QST_QUIT(rnum) : "Nothing\r\n"),
  1587:      quest_types[QST_TYPE(rnum)],
  1588:  QST_TARGET(rnum) == NOBODY ? -1 : QST_TARGET(rnum),
  1589:  targetname,
  1590:  QST_QUANTITY(rnum),
  1591:      QST_POINTS(rnum), QST_PENALTY(rnum), QST_MINLEVEL(rnum),
  1592:  QST_MAXLEVEL(rnum), buf);
  1593:     if (QST_PREREQ(rnum) != NOTHING)
  1594:       send_to_char(ch, "Preq  : [\ty%5d\tn] \ty%s\tn\r\n",
  1595:         QST_PREREQ(rnum) == NOTHING ? -1 : QST_PREREQ(rnum),
  1596:         QST_PREREQ(rnum) == NOTHING ? "" :
  1597:    real_object(QST_PREREQ(rnum)) == NOTHING ? "an unknown object" :
  1598:        obj_proto[real_object(QST_PREREQ(rnum))].short_description);
  1599:     if (QST_TYPE(rnum) == AQ_OBJ_RETURN)
  1600:       send_to_char(ch, "Mob   : [\ty%5d\tn] \ty%s\tn\r\n",
  1601:         QST_RETURNMOB(rnum),
  1602:  real_mobile(QST_RETURNMOB(rnum)) == NOBODY ? "an unknown mob" :
  1603:            mob_proto[real_mobile(QST_RETURNMOB(rnum))].player.short_descr);
  1604:     if (QST_TIME(rnum) != -1)
  1605:       send_to_char(ch, "Limit : There is a time limit of %d turn%s to complete.\r\n",
  1606:    QST_TIME(rnum),
  1607:    QST_TIME(rnum) == 1 ? "" : "s");
  1608:     else
  1609:       send_to_char(ch, "Limit : There is no time limit on this quest.\r\n");
  1610:     send_to_char(ch, "Prior :");
  1611:     if (QST_PREV(rnum) == NOTHING)
  1612:       send_to_char(ch, " \tyNone.\tn\r\n");
  1613:     else
  1614:       send_to_char(ch, " [\ty%5d\tn] \tc%s\tn\r\n",
  1615:         QST_PREV(rnum), QST_DESC(real_quest(QST_PREV(rnum))));
  1616:     send_to_char(ch, "Next  :");
  1617:     if (QST_NEXT(rnum) == NOTHING)
  1618:       send_to_char(ch, " \tyNone.\tn\r\n");
  1619:     else
  1620:       send_to_char(ch, " [\ty%5d\tn] \tc%s\tn\r\n",
  1621:         QST_NEXT(rnum), QST_DESC(real_quest(QST_NEXT(rnum))));
  1622:   }
  1623: }

  1625: /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1626: /* Quest Command Processing Function and Questmaster Special                */
  1627: /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1628: 
  1629: ACMD(do_quest)
  1630: {
  1631:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1632:   int  tp;
  1633: 
  1634:   two_arguments(argument, arg1, arg2);
  1635:   if (!*arg1)
  1636:     send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT ?
  1637:                      quest_mort_usage : quest_imm_usage);
  1638:   else if (((tp = search_block(arg1, quest_cmd, FALSE)) == -1))
  1639:     send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT ?
  1640:                      quest_mort_usage : quest_imm_usage);
  1641:   else {
  1642:     switch (tp) {
  1643:       case SCMD_QUEST_LIST:
  1644:       case SCMD_QUEST_JOIN:
  1645:         /* list, join should hve been handled by questmaster spec proc */
  1646:         send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, but you cannot do that here!\r\n");
  1647:         break;
  1648:       case SCMD_QUEST_HISTORY:
  1649:         quest_hist(ch);
  1650:         break;
  1651:       case SCMD_QUEST_LEAVE:
  1652:         quest_quit(ch);
  1653:         break;
  1654:       case SCMD_QUEST_PROGRESS:
  1655:  quest_progress(ch);
  1656:  break;
  1657:       case SCMD_QUEST_REQUEST:
  1658:         quest_request_kill(ch);
  1659:         break;
  1660:       case SCMD_QUEST_INFO:
  1661:         quest_info_kill(ch);
  1662:         break;
  1663:       case SCMD_QUEST_COMPLETE:
  1664:         quest_complete_kill(ch);
  1665:         break;
  1666:       case SCMD_QUEST_STATUS:
  1667:         if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT)
  1668:           send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", quest_mort_usage);
  1669:         else
  1670:           quest_stat(ch, arg2);
  1671:         break;
  1672:       default: /* Whe should never get here, but... */
  1673:         send_to_char(ch, "%s\r\n", GET_LEVEL(ch) < LVL_IMMORT ?
  1674:                      quest_mort_usage : quest_imm_usage);
  1675:  break;
  1676:     } /* switch on subcmd number */
  1677:   }
  1678: }
  1679: 
  1680: ACMD(do_campaign)
  1681: {
  1682:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1683:   int tp;
  1684: 
  1685:   one_argument(argument, arg1);
  1686:   if (!*arg1) {
  1687:     send_to_char(ch, "Campaign what? Options are - Request, Info, Quit, Check, Brief and Today.\r\n");
  1688:     return;
  1689:   }
  1690: 
  1691:   tp = search_block(arg1, campaign_cmd, FALSE);
  1692:   if (tp < 0) {
  1693:     send_to_char(ch, "Campaign what? Options are - Request, Info, Quit, Check, Brief and Today.\r\n");
  1694:     return;
  1695:   }
  1696: 
  1697:   switch (tp) {
  1698:     case 0: campaign_request(ch); break;
  1699:     case 1: campaign_info(ch); break;
  1700:     case 2: campaign_quit(ch); break;
  1701:     case 3: campaign_check(ch); break;
  1702:     case 4: campaign_brief(ch); break;
  1703:     case 5: campaign_today(ch); break;
  1704:     default:
  1705:       send_to_char(ch, "Campaign what? Options are - Request, Info, Quit, Check, Brief and Today.\r\n");
  1706:       break;
  1707:   }
  1708: }
  1709: 
  1710: SPECIAL(questmaster)
  1711: {
  1712:   qst_rnum rnum;
  1713:   char arg1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], arg2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1714:   int  tp;
  1715:   struct char_data *qm = (struct char_data *)me;
  1716: 
  1717:   /* check that qm mob has quests assigned */
  1718:   for (rnum = 0; (rnum < total_quests &&
  1719:       QST_MASTER(rnum) != GET_MOB_VNUM(qm)) ; rnum ++);
  1720:   if (rnum >= total_quests)
  1721:     return FALSE; /* No quests for this mob */
  1722:   else if (QST_FUNC(rnum) && (QST_FUNC(rnum) (ch, me, cmd, argument)))
  1723:     return TRUE;  /* The secondary spec proc handled this command */
  1724:   else if (CMD_IS("quest")) {
  1725:     two_arguments(argument, arg1, arg2);
  1726:     if (!*arg1)
  1727:       return FALSE;
  1728:     else if (((tp = search_block(arg1, quest_cmd, FALSE)) == -1))
  1729:       return FALSE;
  1730:     else {
  1731:       switch (tp) {
  1732:       case SCMD_QUEST_LIST:
  1733:         if (!*arg2)
  1734:           quest_show(ch, GET_MOB_VNUM(qm));
  1735:         else
  1736:    quest_list(ch, qm, arg2);
  1737:         break;
  1738:       case SCMD_QUEST_JOIN:
  1739:         quest_join(ch, qm, arg2);
  1740:         break;
  1741:       default:
  1742:  return FALSE; /* fall through to the do_quest command processor */
  1743:       } /* switch on subcmd number */
  1744:       return TRUE;
  1745:     }
  1746:   } else {
  1747:     return FALSE; /* not a questmaster command */
  1748:   }
  1749: }

    43: /* Utils and exported functions. */
    44: ACMD(do_oasis_redit)
    45: {
    46:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    47:   char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    48:   int number = NOWHERE, save = 0, real_num;
    49:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    50: 
    51:   /* No building as a mob or while being forced. */
    52:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
    53:     return;
    54: 
    55:   /* Parse any arguments. */
    56:   two_arguments(argument, buf1, buf2);
    57: 
    58:   if (!*buf1)
    59:     number = GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch));
    60:   else if (!isdigit(*buf1)) {
    61:     if (str_cmp("save", buf1) != 0) {
    62:       send_to_char(ch, "Yikes!  Stop that, someone will get hurt!\r\n");
    63:       return;
    64:     }
    65: 
    66:     save = TRUE;
    67: 
    68:     if (is_number(buf2))
    69:       number = atoi(buf2);
    70:     else if (GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) != NOWHERE) {
    71:       zone_rnum zlok;
    72: 
    73:       if ((zlok = real_zone(GET_OLC_ZONE(ch))) == NOWHERE)
    74:         number = NOWHERE;
    75:       else
    76:         number = genolc_zone_bottom(zlok);
    77:     }
    78: 
    79:     if (number == NOWHERE) {
    80:       send_to_char(ch, "Save which zone?\r\n");
    81:       return;
    82:     }
    83:   }
    84: 
    85:   /* If a numeric argument was given (like a room number), get it. */
    86:   if (number == NOWHERE)
    87:     number = atoi(buf1);
    88: 
    89:   if (number < IDXTYPE_MIN || number > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
    90:     send_to_char(ch, "That room VNUM can't exist.\r\n");
    91:     return;
    92:   }
    93: 
    94:   /* Check to make sure the room isn't already being edited. */
    95:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
    96:     if (STATE(d) == CON_REDIT) {
    97:       if (d->olc && OLC_NUM(d) == number) {
    98:         send_to_char(ch, "That room is currently being edited by %s.\r\n",
    99:           PERS(d->character, ch));
   100:         return;
   101:       }
   102:     }
   103:   }
   104: 
   105:   /* Retrieve the player's descriptor. */
   106:   d = ch->desc;
   107: 
   108:   /* Give the descriptor an OLC structure. */
   109:   if (d->olc) {
   110:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: do_oasis_redit: Player already had olc structure.");
   111:     free(d->olc);
   112:   }
   113: 
   114:   /* Create the OLC structure. */
   115:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
   116: 
   117:   /* Find the zone. */
   118:   OLC_ZNUM(d) = save ? real_zone(number) : real_zone_by_thing(number);
   119:   if (OLC_ZNUM(d) == NOWHERE) {
   120:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, there is no zone for that number!\r\n");
   121:     free(d->olc);
   122:     d->olc = NULL;
   123:     return;
   124:   }
   125: 
   126:   /* Make sure the builder is allowed to modify this zone. */
   127:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, OLC_ZNUM(d))) {
   128:     send_cannot_edit(ch, zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   129:     /* Free the OLC structure. */
   130:     free(d->olc);
   131:     d->olc = NULL;
   132:     return;
   133:   }
   134: 
   135:   if (save) {
   136:     send_to_char(ch, "Saving all rooms in zone %d.\r\n", zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   137:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "OLC: %s saves room info for zone %d.", GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   138: 
   139:     /* Save the rooms. */
   140:     save_rooms(OLC_ZNUM(d));
   141: 
   142:     /* Free the olc data from the descriptor. */
   143:     free(d->olc);
   144:     d->olc = NULL;
   145:     return;
   146:   }
   147: 
   148:   OLC_NUM(d) = number;
   149: 
   150:   if ((real_num = real_room(number)) != NOWHERE)
   151:     redit_setup_existing(d, real_num);
   152:   else
   153:     redit_setup_new(d);
   154: 
   155:   redit_disp_menu(d);
   156:   STATE(d) = CON_REDIT;
   157:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   158:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   159: 
   160:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "OLC: %s starts editing zone %d allowed zone %d",
   161:     GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, GET_OLC_ZONE(ch));
   162: }
   163: 
   164: static void redit_setup_new(struct descriptor_data *d)
   165: {
   166:   CREATE(OLC_ROOM(d), struct room_data, 1);
   167: 
   168:   OLC_ROOM(d)->name = strdup("An unfinished room");
   169:   OLC_ROOM(d)->description = strdup("You are in an unfinished room.\r\n");
   170:   OLC_ROOM(d)->number = NOWHERE;
   171:   OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d) = WLD_TRIGGER;
   172:   OLC_ROOM(d)->proto_script = OLC_SCRIPT(d) = NULL;
   173: 
   174:   OLC_VAL(d) = 0;
   175: }
   176: 
   177: void redit_setup_existing(struct descriptor_data *d, int real_num)
   178: {
   179:   struct room_data *room;
   180:   int counter;
   181: 
   182:   /* Build a copy of the room for editing. */
   183:   CREATE(room, struct room_data, 1);
   184: 
   185:   *room = world[real_num];
   186:   
   187:   /* Make new room people list be empty.                          */ 
   188:   /* Fixes bug where copying a room from within that room creates */ 
   189:   /* an infinite loop when you next act() in the new room (goto?) */ 
   190:   /* and you are your next_in_room          -- anderyu (10-05-22) */ 
   191:   room->people = NULL; 
   192: 
   193:   /* Nullify the events structure. */
   194:   room->events = NULL;
   195: 
   196:   /* Allocate space for all strings. */
   197:   room->name = str_udup(world[real_num].name);
   198:   room->description = str_udup(world[real_num].description);
   199: 
   200:   /* Exits - We allocate only if necessary. */
   201:   for (counter = 0; counter < DIR_COUNT; counter++) {
   202:     if (world[real_num].dir_option[counter]) {
   203:       CREATE(room->dir_option[counter], struct room_direction_data, 1);
   204: 
   205:       /* Copy the numbers over. */
   206:       *room->dir_option[counter] = *world[real_num].dir_option[counter];
   207:       /* Allocate the strings. */
   208:       if (world[real_num].dir_option[counter]->general_description)
   209:         room->dir_option[counter]->general_description = strdup(world[real_num].dir_option[counter]->general_description);
   210:       if (world[real_num].dir_option[counter]->keyword)
   211:         room->dir_option[counter]->keyword = strdup(world[real_num].dir_option[counter]->keyword);
   212:     }
   213:   }
   214: 
   215:   /* Extra descriptions, if necessary. */
   216:   if (world[real_num].ex_description) {
   217:     struct extra_descr_data *tdesc, *temp, *temp2;
   218:     CREATE(temp, struct extra_descr_data, 1);
   219: 
   220:     room->ex_description = temp;
   221:     for (tdesc = world[real_num].ex_description; tdesc; tdesc = tdesc->next) {
   222:       temp->keyword = strdup(tdesc->keyword);
   223:       temp->description = strdup(tdesc->description);
   224:       if (tdesc->next) {
   225: 	CREATE(temp2, struct extra_descr_data, 1);
   226: 	temp->next = temp2;
   227: 	temp = temp2;
   228:       } else
   229: 	temp->next = NULL;
   230:     }
   231:   }
   232: 
   233:   /* Attach copy of room to player's descriptor. */
   234:   OLC_ROOM(d) = room;
   235:   OLC_VAL(d) = 0;
   236:   OLC_ITEM_TYPE(d) = WLD_TRIGGER;
   237: 
   238:   dg_olc_script_copy(d);
   239:   room->proto_script = NULL;
   240:   SCRIPT(room) = NULL;
   241: }
   242: 
   243: void redit_save_internally(struct descriptor_data *d)
   244: {
   245:   builder_refs_invalidate();
   246:   int j, room_num, new_room = FALSE;
   247:   struct descriptor_data *dsc;
   248: 
   249:   if (OLC_ROOM(d)->number == NOWHERE)
   250:     new_room = TRUE;
   251: 
   252:   OLC_ROOM(d)->number = OLC_NUM(d); 
   253:   /* FIXME: Why is this not set elsewhere? */
   254:   OLC_ROOM(d)->zone = OLC_ZNUM(d);
   255: 
   256:   if ((room_num = add_room(OLC_ROOM(d))) == NOWHERE) {
   257:     write_to_output(d, "Something went wrong...\r\n");
   258:     log("SYSERR: redit_save_internally: Something failed! (%d)", room_num);
   259:     return;
   260:   }
   261: 
   262:   /* Update triggers and free old proto list */
   263:   if (world[room_num].proto_script &&
   264:       world[room_num].proto_script != OLC_SCRIPT(d))
   265:     free_proto_script(&world[room_num], WLD_TRIGGER);
   266: 
   267:   world[room_num].proto_script = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
   268:   assign_triggers(&world[room_num], WLD_TRIGGER);
   269:   /* end trigger update */
   270: 
   271:   /* Don't adjust numbers on a room update. */
   272:   if (!new_room)
   273:     return;
   274: 
   275:   /* Idea contributed by C.Raehl 4/27/99 */
   276:   for (dsc = descriptor_list; dsc; dsc = dsc->next) {
   277:     if (dsc == d)
   278:       continue;
   279: 
   280:     if (STATE(dsc) == CON_ZEDIT) {
   281:       for (j = 0; OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[j].command != 'S'; j++)
   282:         switch (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[j].command) {
   283:           case 'O':
   284:           case 'M':
   285:           case 'T':
   286:           case 'V':
   287:             OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[j].arg3 += (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[j].arg3 >= room_num);
   288:             break;
   289:           case 'D':
   290:             OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[j].arg2 += (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[j].arg2 >= room_num);
   291:             /* Fall through */
   292:           case 'R':
   293:             OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[j].arg1 += (OLC_ZONE(dsc)->cmd[j].arg1 >= room_num);
   294:             break;
   295:           }
   296:     } else if (STATE(dsc) == CON_REDIT) {
   297:       for (j = 0; j < DIR_COUNT; j++)
   298:         if (OLC_ROOM(dsc)->dir_option[j])
   299:           if (OLC_ROOM(dsc)->dir_option[j]->to_room >= room_num)
   300:             OLC_ROOM(dsc)->dir_option[j]->to_room++;
   301:     }
   302:   }
   303: }

   305: static void redit_save_resets(struct descriptor_data *d)
   306: {
   307:   if (!OLC_ZONE(d) || !OLC_ZONE(d)->age || !OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd)
   308:     return;
   309: 
   310:   free(zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].cmd);
   311:   zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].cmd = OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd;
   312:   OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd = NULL;
   313:   OLC_ZONE(d)->age = 0;
   314: 
   315:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, SL_ZON);
   316: }
