   544: static int redit_cmd_room(const struct reset_com *cmd)
   545: {
   546:   switch (cmd->command) {
   547:     case 'M':
   548:     case 'O':
   549:     case 'T':
   550:     case 'V':
   551:       return cmd->arg3;
   552:     case 'D':
   553:     case 'R':
   554:       return cmd->arg1;
   555:     default:
   556:       return NOWHERE;
   557:   }
   558: }
   559: 
   560: static void redit_setup_reset_editor(struct descriptor_data *d)
   561: {
   562:   int count, i;
   563:   struct zone_data *zone;
   564: 
   565:   if (OLC_ZONE(d))
   566:     return;
   567: 
   568:   CREATE(zone, struct zone_data, 1);
   569:   count = count_commands(zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].cmd);
   570:   CREATE(zone->cmd, struct reset_com, count + 1);
   571:   for (i = 0; i <= count; i++)
   572:     zone->cmd[i] = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].cmd[i];
   573: 
   574:   zone->age = 0;
   575:   OLC_ZONE(d) = zone;
   576: }
   577: 
   578: static int redit_collect_room_resets(struct descriptor_data *d, int **entries, int **chain_ends, int **roots)
   579: {
   580:   int i = 0, j, k, count = 0;
   581:   int room_num = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
   582:   int total = count_commands(OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd);
   583:   struct reset_com *cmd = OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd;
   584: 
   585:   if (room_num == NOWHERE || total <= 0) {
   586:     *entries = *chain_ends = *roots = NULL;
   587:     return 0;
   588:   }
   589: 
   590:   CREATE(*entries, int, total);
   591:   CREATE(*chain_ends, int, total);
   592:   CREATE(*roots, int, total);
   593: 
   594:   while (cmd[i].command != 'S') {
   595:     if ((cmd[i].command == 'M' || cmd[i].command == 'O') && cmd[i].arg3 == room_num) {
   596:       j = i + 1;
   597:       while (cmd[j].command != 'S' &&
   598:              cmd[j].command != 'M' &&
   599:              cmd[j].command != 'O' &&
   600:              cmd[j].command != 'D' &&
   601:              cmd[j].command != 'R')
   602:         j++;
   603: 
   604:       for (k = i; k < j; k++) {
   605:         (*entries)[count] = k;
   606:         (*chain_ends)[count] = (k == i) ? (j - 1) : k;
   607:         (*roots)[count] = (k == i);
   608:         count++;
   609:       }
   610:       i = j;
   611:       continue;
   612:     } else if (redit_cmd_room(&cmd[i]) == room_num) {
   613:       (*entries)[count] = i;
   614:       (*chain_ends)[count] = i;
   615:       (*roots)[count] = 1;
   616:       count++;
   617:     }
   618:     i++;
   619:   }
   620: 
   621:   return count;
   622: }
   623: 
   624: static int redit_find_room_insert_pos(struct descriptor_data *d)
   625: {
   626:   int i, count, room_num, cmd_room;
   627:   int *entries = NULL, *chain_ends = NULL, *roots = NULL;
   628: 
   629:   count = redit_collect_room_resets(d, &entries, &chain_ends, &roots);
   630:   if (count > 0) {
   631:     i = chain_ends[count - 1] + 1;
   632:     free(entries);
   633:     free(chain_ends);
   634:     free(roots);
   635:     return i;
   636:   }
   637: 
   638:   room_num = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
   639:   for (i = 0; OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd[i].command != 'S'; i++) {
   640:     cmd_room = redit_cmd_room(&OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd[i]);
   641:     if (cmd_room != NOWHERE && cmd_room > room_num)
   642:       return i;
   643:   }
   644:   return i;
   645: }
   646: 
   647: static void redit_disp_resets_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   648: {
   649:   int i, count, zone_index, *entries = NULL, *chain_ends = NULL, *roots = NULL;
   650:   int current_mob = NOWHERE;
   651:   struct reset_com *cmd;
   652:   room_rnum room_num = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
   653: 
   654:   redit_setup_reset_editor(d);
   655:   cmd = OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd;
   656:   count = (room_num == NOWHERE) ? 0 : redit_collect_room_resets(d, &entries, &chain_ends, &roots);
   657: 
   658:   clear_screen(d);
   659:   write_to_output(d, "-- Room Resets: [%d] %s\r\n\r\n", OLC_NUM(d),
   660:     OLC_ROOM(d)->name ? OLC_ROOM(d)->name : "<unnamed room>");
   661: 
   662:   if (room_num == NOWHERE) {
   663:     write_to_output(d, "This room does not exist yet. Save the room first, then edit resets.\r\n");
   664:   } else if (count <= 0) {
   665:     write_to_output(d, "No resets found for this room.\r\n");
   666:   } else {
   667:     for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   668:       zone_index = entries[i];
   669:       write_to_output(d, "%2d) ", i + 1);
   670:       switch (cmd[zone_index].command) {
   671:         case 'M':
   672:           current_mob = (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_mobt) ?
   673:             mob_index[cmd[zone_index].arg1].vnum : NOWHERE;
   674:           write_to_output(d, "Mob [%d] %-30.30s max:%d\r\n",
   675:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_mobt) ?
   676:               mob_index[cmd[zone_index].arg1].vnum : -1,
   677:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_mobt) ?
   678:               mob_proto[cmd[zone_index].arg1].player.short_descr : "<invalid mob>",
   679:             cmd[zone_index].arg2);
   680:           break;
   681:         case 'O':
   682:           current_mob = NOWHERE;
   683:           write_to_output(d, "Obj [%d] %-30.30s room object max:%d\r\n",
   684:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ?
   685:               obj_index[cmd[zone_index].arg1].vnum : -1,
   686:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ?
   687:               obj_proto[cmd[zone_index].arg1].short_description : "<invalid object>",
   688:             cmd[zone_index].arg2);
   689:           break;
   690:         case 'E':
   691:           write_to_output(d, "Obj [%d] %-30.30s equip on mob [%d] (%s) max:%d\r\n",
   692:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ?
   693:               obj_index[cmd[zone_index].arg1].vnum : -1,
   694:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ?
   695:               obj_proto[cmd[zone_index].arg1].short_description : "<invalid object>",
   696:             current_mob,
   697:             (cmd[zone_index].arg3 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg3 < NUM_WEARS) ?
   698:               equipment_types[cmd[zone_index].arg3] : "invalid slot",
   699:             cmd[zone_index].arg2);
   700:           break;
   701:         case 'G':
   702:           write_to_output(d, "Obj [%d] %-30.30s give to mob [%d] max:%d\r\n",
   703:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ?
   704:               obj_index[cmd[zone_index].arg1].vnum : -1,
   705:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ?
   706:               obj_proto[cmd[zone_index].arg1].short_description : "<invalid object>",
   707:             current_mob,
   708:             cmd[zone_index].arg2);
   709:           break;
   710:         case 'P':
   711:           write_to_output(d, "Obj [%d] %-30.30s put in obj [%d] max:%d\r\n",
   712:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ?
   713:               obj_index[cmd[zone_index].arg1].vnum : -1,
   714:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg1 <= top_of_objt) ?
   715:               obj_proto[cmd[zone_index].arg1].short_description : "<invalid object>",
   716:             (cmd[zone_index].arg3 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg3 <= top_of_objt) ?
   717:               obj_index[cmd[zone_index].arg3].vnum : -1,
   718:             cmd[zone_index].arg2);
   719:           break;
   720:         case 'R':
   721:           write_to_output(d, "Obj [%d] %-30.30s remove from room\r\n",
   722:             (cmd[zone_index].arg2 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg2 <= top_of_objt) ?
   723:               obj_index[cmd[zone_index].arg2].vnum : -1,
   724:             (cmd[zone_index].arg2 >= 0 && cmd[zone_index].arg2 <= top_of_objt) ?
   725:               obj_proto[cmd[zone_index].arg2].short_description : "<invalid object>");
   726:           break;
   727:         case 'D':
   728:           write_to_output(d, "Door %-9s set to %s\r\n",
   729:             dirs[cmd[zone_index].arg2],
   730:             (cmd[zone_index].arg3 == 2) ? "locked" :
   731:             ((cmd[zone_index].arg3 == 1) ? "closed" : "open"));
   732:           break;
   733:         case 'T':
   734:           write_to_output(d, "Trigger [%d] attach to %s\r\n",
   735:             trig_index[cmd[zone_index].arg2]->vnum,
   736:             cmd[zone_index].arg1 == MOB_TRIGGER ? "mob" :
   737:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 == OBJ_TRIGGER ? "object" : "room"));
   738:           break;
   739:         case 'V':
   740:           write_to_output(d, "Var %s:%d = %s (%s)\r\n",
   741:             cmd[zone_index].sarg1 ? cmd[zone_index].sarg1 : "<none>",
   742:             cmd[zone_index].arg2,
   743:             cmd[zone_index].sarg2 ? cmd[zone_index].sarg2 : "<none>",
   744:             cmd[zone_index].arg1 == MOB_TRIGGER ? "mob" :
   745:             (cmd[zone_index].arg1 == OBJ_TRIGGER ? "object" : "room"));
   746:           break;
   747:         default:
   748:           write_to_output(d, "Command %c\r\n", cmd[zone_index].command);
   749:           break;
   750:       }
   751:     }
   752:   }
   753: 
   754:   write_to_output(d,
   755:     "\r\nA) Add mob reset\r\n"
   756:     "B) Add object reset\r\n"
   757:     "D) Delete reset\r\n"
   758:     "Q) Quit\r\n"
   759:     "Enter choice: ");
   760:   OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_RESETS_MENU;
   761: 
   762:   if (entries) free(entries);
   763:   if (chain_ends) free(chain_ends);
   764:   if (roots) free(roots);
   765: }
   766: 
   767: /* The main loop*/
   768: void redit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   769: {
   770:   int number;
   771:   char *oldtext = NULL;
   772: 
   773:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   774:   case REDIT_REFERENCES:
   775:     redit_disp_menu(d);
   776:     return;
   777:   case REDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   778:     switch (*arg) {
   779:     case 'y':
   780:     case 'Y':
   781:       redit_save_resets(d);
   782:       redit_save_internally(d);
   783:       mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE, "OLC: %s edits room %d.", GET_NAME(d->character), OLC_NUM(d));
   784:       if (CONFIG_OLC_SAVE) {
   785:         redit_save_to_disk(real_zone_by_thing(OLC_NUM(d)));
   786:         save_zone(OLC_ZNUM(d));
   787:         write_to_output(d, "Room saved to disk.\r\n");
   788:       } else
   789:         write_to_output(d, "Room saved to memory.\r\n");
   790:       /* Free everything. */
   791:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   792:       break;
   793:     case 'n':
   794:     case 'N':
   795:       /* If not saving, we must free the script_proto list. We do so by 
   796:        * assigning it to the edited room and letting free_room in 
   797:        * cleanup_olc handle it. */
   798:       OLC_ROOM(d)->proto_script = OLC_SCRIPT(d);
   799:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   800:       break;
   801:     default:
   802:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\nDo you wish to save your changes ? : ");
   803:       break;
   804:     }
   805:     return;
   806: 
   807:   case REDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   808:     switch (*arg) {
   809:     case 'q':
   810:     case 'Q':
   811:       if (OLC_VAL(d)) { /* Something has been modified. */
   812:         write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   813:         OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   814:       } else
   815:         cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   816:       return;
   817:     case '1':
   818:       write_to_output(d, "Enter room name:-\r\n] ");
   819:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_NAME;
   820:       break;
   821:     case '2':
   822:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_DESC;
   823:       clear_screen(d);
   824:       send_editor_help(d);
   825:       write_to_output(d, "Enter room description:\r\n\r\n");
   826: 
   827:       if (OLC_ROOM(d)->description) {
   828: 	write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_ROOM(d)->description);
   829: 	oldtext = strdup(OLC_ROOM(d)->description);
   830:       }
   831:       string_write(d, &OLC_ROOM(d)->description, MAX_ROOM_DESC, 0, oldtext);
   832:       OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   833:       break;
   834:     case '3':
   835:       redit_disp_flag_menu(d);
   836:       break;
   837:     case '4':
   838:       redit_disp_sector_menu(d);
   839:       break;
   840:     case '5':
   841:       OLC_VAL(d) = NORTH;
   842:       redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   843:       break;
   844:     case '6':
   845:       OLC_VAL(d) = EAST;
   846:       redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   847:       break;
   848:     case '7':
   849:       OLC_VAL(d) = SOUTH;
   850:       redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   851:       break;
   852:     case '8':
   853:       OLC_VAL(d) = WEST;
   854:       redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   855:       break;
   856:     case '9':
   857:       OLC_VAL(d) = UP;
   858:       redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   859:       break;
   860:     case 'a':
   861:     case 'A':
   862:       OLC_VAL(d) = DOWN;
   863:       redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   864:       break;
   865:     case 'b':
   866:     case 'B':
   867:       if (!CONFIG_DIAGONAL_DIRS) {
   868:         write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!");
   869:         redit_disp_menu(d);
   870:       } else {
   871:         OLC_VAL(d) = NORTHWEST;
   872:         redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   873:       }
   874:       break;
   875:     case 'c':
   876:     case 'C':
   877:       if (!CONFIG_DIAGONAL_DIRS) {
   878:         write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!");
   879:         redit_disp_menu(d);
   880:       } else {
   881:         OLC_VAL(d) = NORTHEAST;
   882:         redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   883:       }
   884:       break;
   885:     case 'd':
   886:     case 'D':
   887:       if (!CONFIG_DIAGONAL_DIRS) {
   888:         write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!");
   889:         redit_disp_menu(d);
   890:       } else {
   891:         OLC_VAL(d) = SOUTHEAST;
   892:         redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   893:       }
   894:       break;
   895:     case 'e':
   896:     case 'E':
   897:       if (!CONFIG_DIAGONAL_DIRS) {
   898:         write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!");
   899:         redit_disp_menu(d);
   900:       } else {
   901:         OLC_VAL(d) = SOUTHWEST;
   902:         redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
   903:       }
   904:       break;
   905:     case 'f':
   906:     case 'F':
   907:       /* If the extra description doesn't exist. */
   908:       if (!OLC_ROOM(d)->ex_description)
   909: 	CREATE(OLC_ROOM(d)->ex_description, struct extra_descr_data, 1);
   910:       OLC_DESC(d) = OLC_ROOM(d)->ex_description;
   911:       redit_disp_extradesc_menu(d);
   912:       break;
   913:     case 'y':
   914:     case 'Y':
   915:       builder_refs_display(d, BREF_ROOM, OLC_NUM(d), "Room");
   916:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_REFERENCES;
   917:       return;
   918:     case 'w':
   919:     case 'W':
   920:       write_to_output(d, "Copy what room? ");
   921:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_COPY;
   922:       break;
   923:     case 'r':
   924:     case 'R':
   925:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
   926:       return;
   927:     case 'x':
   928:     case 'X':
   929:       /* Delete the room, prompt first. */
   930:       write_to_output(d, "Are you sure you want to delete this room? ");
   931:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_DELETE;
   932:       break;
   933: 
   934:     case 's':
   935:     case 'S':
   936:       OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT_MODE(d) = SCRIPT_MAIN_MENU;
   937:       dg_script_menu(d);
   938:       return;
   939:     default:
   940:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!");
   941:       redit_disp_menu(d);
   942:       break;
   943:     }
   944:     return;
   945: 
   946: 
   947:   case OLC_SCRIPT_EDIT:
   948:     if (dg_script_edit_parse(d, arg)) return;
   949:     redit_disp_menu(d);
   950:     return;
   951: 
   952:   case REDIT_NAME:
   953:     if (!genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   954:       break;
   955:     if (count_non_protocol_chars(arg) > MAX_ROOM_NAME / 2) {
   956:       write_to_output(d, "Size limited to %d non-protocol characters.\r\n", MAX_ROOM_NAME / 2);
   957:       break;
   958:     }
   959:     if (OLC_ROOM(d)->name)
   960:       free(OLC_ROOM(d)->name);
   961:     arg[MAX_ROOM_NAME - 1] = '\0';
   962:     OLC_ROOM(d)->name = str_udup(arg);
   963:     break;
   964: 
   965:   case REDIT_DESC:
   966:     /* We will NEVER get here, we hope. */
   967:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Reached REDIT_DESC case in parse_redit().");
   968:     write_to_output(d, "Oops, in REDIT_DESC.\r\n");
   969:     break;
   970: 
   971:   case REDIT_FLAGS:
   972:     number = atoi(arg);
   973:     if (number < 0 || number > NUM_ROOM_FLAGS) {
   974:       write_to_output(d, "That is not a valid choice!\r\n");
   975:       redit_disp_flag_menu(d);
   976:     } else if (number == 0)
   977:       break;
   978:     else {
   979:       /* Toggle the bit. */
   980:       TOGGLE_BIT_AR(OLC_ROOM(d)->room_flags, number - 1);
   981:       redit_disp_flag_menu(d);
   982:     }
   983:     return;
   984: 
   985:   case REDIT_SECTOR:
   986:     number = atoi(arg) - 1;
   987:     if (number < 0 || number >= NUM_ROOM_SECTORS) {
   988:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!");
   989:       redit_disp_sector_menu(d);
   990:       return;
   991:     }
   992:     OLC_ROOM(d)->sector_type = number;
   993:     break;
   994: 
   995:   case REDIT_EXIT_MENU:
   996:     switch (*arg) {
   997:     case '0':
   998:       break;
   999:     case '1':
  1000:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_EXIT_NUMBER;
  1001:       write_to_output(d, "Exit to room number : ");
  1002:       return;
  1003:     case '2':
  1004:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_EXIT_DESCRIPTION;
  1005:       send_editor_help(d);
  1006:       write_to_output(d, "Enter exit description:\r\n\r\n");
  1007:       if (OLC_EXIT(d)->general_description) {
  1008: 	write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_EXIT(d)->general_description);
  1009: 	oldtext = strdup(OLC_EXIT(d)->general_description);
  1010:       }
  1011:       string_write(d, &OLC_EXIT(d)->general_description, MAX_EXIT_DESC, 0, oldtext);
  1012:       return;
  1013:     case '3':
  1014:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_EXIT_KEYWORD;
  1015:       write_to_output(d, "Enter keywords : ");
  1016:       return;
  1017:     case '4':
  1018:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_EXIT_KEY;
  1019:       write_to_output(d, "Enter key number : ");
  1020:       return;
  1021:     case '5':
  1022:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_EXIT_DOORFLAGS;
  1023:       redit_disp_exit_flag_menu(d);
  1024:       return;
  1025:     case '6':
  1026:       /*
  1027:        * Delete an exit.
  1028:        */
  1029:       if (OLC_EXIT(d)->keyword)
  1030: 	free(OLC_EXIT(d)->keyword);
  1031:       if (OLC_EXIT(d)->general_description)
  1032: 	free(OLC_EXIT(d)->general_description);
  1033:       if (OLC_EXIT(d))
  1034: 	free(OLC_EXIT(d));
  1035:       OLC_EXIT(d) = NULL;
  1036:       break;
  1037:     default:
  1038:       write_to_output(d, "Try again : ");
  1039:       return;
  1040:     }
  1041:     break;
  1042: 
  1043:   case REDIT_EXIT_NUMBER:
  1044:     if ((number = atoi(arg)) != -1)
  1045:       if ((number = real_room(number)) == NOWHERE) {
  1046: 	write_to_output(d, "That room does not exist, try again : ");
  1047: 	return;
  1048:       }
  1049:     OLC_EXIT(d)->to_room = number;
  1050:     redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
  1051:     return;
  1052: 
  1053:   case REDIT_EXIT_DESCRIPTION:
  1054:     /* We should NEVER get here, hopefully. */
  1055:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Reached REDIT_EXIT_DESC case in parse_redit");
  1056:     write_to_output(d, "Oops, in REDIT_EXIT_DESCRIPTION.\r\n");
  1057:     break;
  1058: 
  1059:   case REDIT_EXIT_KEYWORD:
  1060:     if (OLC_EXIT(d)->keyword)
  1061:       free(OLC_EXIT(d)->keyword);
  1062:     OLC_EXIT(d)->keyword = str_udup(arg);
  1063:     redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
  1064:     return;
  1065: 
  1066:   case REDIT_EXIT_KEY:
  1067:     number = atoi(arg);
  1068:     if (number < 0)
  1069:       OLC_EXIT(d)->key = NOTHING;
  1070:     else
  1071:       OLC_EXIT(d)->key = number;
  1072:     redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
  1073:     return;
  1074: 
  1075:   case REDIT_EXIT_DOORFLAGS:
  1076:     number = atoi(arg);
  1077:     if (number < 0 || number > 4) {
  1078:       write_to_output(d, "That's not a valid choice!\r\n");
  1079:       redit_disp_exit_flag_menu(d);
  1080:     } else {
  1081:       /* Doors are a bit idiotic, don't you think? :) -- I agree. -gg */
  1082:       OLC_EXIT(d)->exit_info = (number == 0 ? 0 :
  1083: 				(number == 1 ? EX_ISDOOR :
  1084:                 (number == 2 ? EX_ISDOOR | EX_PICKPROOF :
  1085:                 (number == 3 ? EX_ISDOOR | EX_HIDDEN :
  1086:                 (number == 4 ? EX_ISDOOR | EX_PICKPROOF | EX_HIDDEN : 0)))));
  1087:       /* Jump back to the menu system. */
  1088:       redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
  1089:     }
  1090:     return;
  1091: 
  1092:   case REDIT_EXTRADESC_KEY:
  1093:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg)) {
  1094:       if (OLC_DESC(d)->keyword)
  1095:         free(OLC_DESC(d)->keyword);
  1096:       OLC_DESC(d)->keyword = str_udup(arg);
  1097:     }
  1098:     redit_disp_extradesc_menu(d);
  1099:     return;
  1100: 
  1101:   case REDIT_EXTRADESC_MENU:
  1102:     switch ((number = atoi(arg))) {
  1103:     case 0:
  1104:       /* If something got left out, delete the extra description when backing 
  1105:          out to the menu. */
  1106:       if (OLC_DESC(d)->keyword == NULL || OLC_DESC(d)->description == NULL) {
  1107: 	struct extra_descr_data *temp;
  1108: 	if (OLC_DESC(d)->keyword)
  1109: 	  free(OLC_DESC(d)->keyword);
  1110: 	if (OLC_DESC(d)->description)
  1111: 	  free(OLC_DESC(d)->description);
  1112: 
  1113: 	/* Clean up pointers. */
  1114: 	REMOVE_FROM_LIST(OLC_DESC(d), OLC_ROOM(d)->ex_description, next);
  1115: 	free(OLC_DESC(d));
  1116:       }
  1117:       break;
  1118:     case 1:
  1119:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_EXTRADESC_KEY;
  1120:       write_to_output(d, "Enter keywords, separated by spaces : ");
  1121:       return;
  1122:     case 2:
  1123:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_EXTRADESC_DESCRIPTION;
  1124:       send_editor_help(d);
  1125:       write_to_output(d, "Enter extra description:\r\n\r\n");
  1126:       if (OLC_DESC(d)->description) {
  1127: 	write_to_output(d, "%s", OLC_DESC(d)->description);
  1128: 	oldtext = strdup(OLC_DESC(d)->description);
  1129:       }
  1130:       string_write(d, &OLC_DESC(d)->description, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH, 0, oldtext);
  1131:       return;
  1132:     case 3:
  1133:       if (OLC_DESC(d)->keyword == NULL || OLC_DESC(d)->description == NULL) {
  1134: 	write_to_output(d, "You can't edit the next extra description without completing this one.\r\n");
  1135: 	redit_disp_extradesc_menu(d);
  1136:       } else {
  1137: 	struct extra_descr_data *new_extra;
  1138: 
  1139: 	if (OLC_DESC(d)->next)
  1140: 	  OLC_DESC(d) = OLC_DESC(d)->next;
  1141: 	else {
  1142: 	  /* Make new extra description and attach at end. */
  1143: 	  CREATE(new_extra, struct extra_descr_data, 1);
  1144: 	  OLC_DESC(d)->next = new_extra;
  1145: 	  OLC_DESC(d) = new_extra;
  1146: 	}
  1147: 	redit_disp_extradesc_menu(d);
  1148:       }
  1149:       return;
  1150:     }
  1151:     break;
  1152: 
  1153:   case REDIT_COPY:
  1154:     if ((number = real_room(atoi(arg))) != NOWHERE) {
  1155:       redit_setup_existing(d, number);
  1156:     } else
  1157:       write_to_output(d, "That room does not exist.\r\n");
  1158:     break;
  1159:   
  1160:   case REDIT_DELETE:
  1161:     if (*arg == 'y' || *arg == 'Y') {
  1162:       if (delete_room(real_room(OLC_ROOM(d)->number)))
  1163:         write_to_output(d, "Room deleted.\r\n");
  1164:      else
  1165:         write_to_output(d, "Couldn't delete the room!.\r\n");
  1166: 
  1167:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1168:       return;
  1169:     } else if (*arg == 'n' || *arg == 'N') {
  1170:       redit_disp_menu(d);
  1171:       OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_MAIN_MENU;
  1172:       return;
  1173:     } else
  1174:       write_to_output(d, "Please answer 'Y' or 'N': ");
  1175: 
  1176:     break;
  1177: 
  1178:   case REDIT_RESETS_MENU:
  1179:     switch (*arg) {
  1180:       case 'a':
  1181:       case 'A':
  1182:         write_to_output(d, "Enter mob vnum and max existing (1-%d, 0 to cancel): ", MAX_DUPLICATES);
  1183:         OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_RESETS_ADD_MOB;
  1184:         return;
  1185:       case 'b':
  1186:       case 'B':
  1187:         write_to_output(d, "Enter object vnum and max existing (1-%d, 0 to cancel): ", MAX_DUPLICATES);
  1188:         OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_RESETS_ADD_OBJ;
  1189:         return;
  1190:       case 'd':
  1191:       case 'D':
  1192:         write_to_output(d, "Delete which room reset number (0 to cancel)? ");
  1193:         OLC_MODE(d) = REDIT_RESETS_DELETE;
  1194:         return;
  1195:       case 'q':
  1196:       case 'Q':
  1197:         redit_disp_menu(d);
  1198:         return;
  1199:       default:
  1200:         write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
  1201:         redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1202:         return;
  1203:     }
  1204:     break;
  1205: 
  1206:   case REDIT_RESETS_ADD_MOB:
  1207:   {
  1208:     char mob_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], max_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1209:     mob_rnum mob_num;
  1210:     room_rnum room_num;
  1211:     int max_existing;
  1212:     struct reset_com newcmd;
  1213: 
  1214:     two_arguments(arg, mob_arg, max_arg);
  1215:     if (!*mob_arg || *mob_arg == '0') {
  1216:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1217:       return;
  1218:     }
  1219:     room_num = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
  1220:     if (room_num == NOWHERE) {
  1221:       write_to_output(d, "You must save this room before adding resets.\r\n");
  1222:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1223:       return;
  1224:     }
  1225: 
  1226:     if (!isdigit(*mob_arg) || (mob_num = real_mobile(atoi(mob_arg))) == NOBODY) {
  1227:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid mob vnum.\r\n");
  1228:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1229:       return;
  1230:     }
  1231: 
  1232:     if (!*max_arg || !isdigit(*max_arg)) {
  1233:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid max existing value.\r\n");
  1234:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1235:       return;
  1236:     }
  1237: 
  1238:     max_existing = atoi(max_arg);
  1239:     if (max_existing <= 0 || max_existing > MAX_DUPLICATES) {
  1240:       write_to_output(d, "Max existing must be between 1 and %d.\r\n", MAX_DUPLICATES);
  1241:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1242:       return;
  1243:     }
  1244: 
  1245:     memset(&newcmd, 0, sizeof(newcmd));
  1246:     newcmd.command = 'M';
  1247:     newcmd.if_flag = 0;
  1248:     newcmd.arg1 = mob_num;
  1249:     newcmd.arg2 = max_existing;
  1250:     newcmd.arg3 = room_num;
  1251:     add_cmd_to_list(&OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd, &newcmd, redit_find_room_insert_pos(d));
  1252:     OLC_ZONE(d)->age = 1;
  1253:     OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
  1254:     redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1255:     return;
  1256:   }
  1257: 
  1258:   case REDIT_RESETS_ADD_OBJ:
  1259:   {
  1260:     char obj_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], max_arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1261:     obj_rnum obj_num;
  1262:     room_rnum room_num;
  1263:     int max_existing;
  1264:     struct reset_com newcmd;
  1265: 
  1266:     two_arguments(arg, obj_arg, max_arg);
  1267:     if (!*obj_arg || *obj_arg == '0') {
  1268:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1269:       return;
  1270:     }
  1271:     room_num = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
  1272:     if (room_num == NOWHERE) {
  1273:       write_to_output(d, "You must save this room before adding resets.\r\n");
  1274:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1275:       return;
  1276:     }
  1277: 
  1278:     if (!isdigit(*obj_arg) || (obj_num = real_object(atoi(obj_arg))) == NOTHING) {
  1279:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid object vnum.\r\n");
  1280:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1281:       return;
  1282:     }
  1283: 
  1284:     if (!*max_arg || !isdigit(*max_arg)) {
  1285:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid max existing value.\r\n");
  1286:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1287:       return;
  1288:     }
  1289: 
  1290:     max_existing = atoi(max_arg);
  1291:     if (max_existing <= 0 || max_existing > MAX_DUPLICATES) {
  1292:       write_to_output(d, "Max existing must be between 1 and %d.\r\n", MAX_DUPLICATES);
  1293:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1294:       return;
  1295:     }
  1296: 
  1297:     memset(&newcmd, 0, sizeof(newcmd));
  1298:     newcmd.command = 'O';
  1299:     newcmd.if_flag = 0;
  1300:     newcmd.arg1 = obj_num;
  1301:     newcmd.arg2 = max_existing;
  1302:     newcmd.arg3 = room_num;
  1303:     add_cmd_to_list(&OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd, &newcmd, redit_find_room_insert_pos(d));
  1304:     OLC_ZONE(d)->age = 1;
  1305:     OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
  1306:     redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1307:     return;
  1308:   }
  1309: 
  1310:   case REDIT_RESETS_DELETE:
  1311:   {
  1312:     int entry, count;
  1313:     int *entries = NULL, *chain_ends = NULL, *roots = NULL;
  1314:     int zone_index, i;
  1315:     struct reset_com *cmd;
  1316: 
  1317:     entry = atoi(arg);
  1318:     if (entry <= 0) {
  1319:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1320:       return;
  1321:     }
  1322: 
  1323:     count = redit_collect_room_resets(d, &entries, &chain_ends, &roots);
  1324:     if (entry > count) {
  1325:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid reset number.\r\n");
  1326:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1327:       if (entries) free(entries);
  1328:       if (chain_ends) free(chain_ends);
  1329:       if (roots) free(roots);
  1330:       return;
  1331:     }
  1332: 
  1333:     zone_index = entries[entry - 1];
  1334:     cmd = OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd;
  1335:     if (!roots[entry - 1] &&
  1336:         (cmd[zone_index].command == 'G' || cmd[zone_index].command == 'E' ||
  1337:          cmd[zone_index].command == 'P' || cmd[zone_index].command == 'T' ||
  1338:          cmd[zone_index].command == 'V')) {
  1339:       write_to_output(d, "Delete the parent room load reset to remove this child reset safely.\r\n");
  1340:       redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1341:       free(entries);
  1342:       free(chain_ends);
  1343:       free(roots);
  1344:       return;
  1345:     }
  1346: 
  1347:     for (i = zone_index; i <= chain_ends[entry - 1]; i++)
  1348:       delete_zone_command(OLC_ZONE(d), zone_index);
  1349: 
  1350:     OLC_ZONE(d)->age = 1;
  1351:     OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
  1352:     redit_disp_resets_menu(d);
  1353:     free(entries);
  1354:     free(chain_ends);
  1355:     free(roots);
  1356:     return;
  1357:   }
  1358: 
  1359:   default:
  1360:     /* We should never get here. */
  1361:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: Reached default case in parse_redit");
  1362:     break;
  1363:   }
  1364:   /* If we get this far, something has been changed. */
  1365:   OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
  1366:   redit_disp_menu(d);
  1367: }
  1368: 
  1369: void redit_string_cleanup(struct descriptor_data *d, int terminator)
  1370: {
  1371:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
  1372:   case REDIT_DESC:
  1373:     redit_disp_menu(d);
  1374:     break;
  1375:   case REDIT_EXIT_DESCRIPTION:
  1376:     redit_disp_exit_menu(d);
  1377:     break;
  1378:   case REDIT_EXTRADESC_DESCRIPTION:
  1379:     redit_disp_extradesc_menu(d);
  1380:     break;
  1381:   }
  1382: }

    38:   OLC_SHOP(d)->vnum = OLC_NUM(d);
    39:   add_shop(OLC_SHOP(d));
    40: }
    41: 
    42: static void sedit_save_to_disk(int num)
    43: {
    44:   save_shops(num);
    45: }
    46: 
    47: /* utility functions */
    48: ACMD(do_oasis_sedit)
    49: {
    50:   int number = NOWHERE, save = 0;
    51:   shop_rnum real_num;
    52:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    53:   char buf1[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
    54:   char buf2[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
    55: 
    56:   /* No building as a mob or while being forced. */
    57:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
    58:     return;
    59:     
    60:   /* Parse any arguments. */
    61:   two_arguments(argument, buf1, buf2);
    62: 
    63:   if (!*buf1) {
    64:     send_to_char(ch, "Specify a shop VNUM to edit.\r\n");
    65:     return;
    66:   } else if (!isdigit(*buf1)) {
    67:     if (str_cmp("save", buf1) != 0) {
    68:       send_to_char(ch, "Yikes!  Stop that, someone will get hurt!\r\n");
    69:       return;
    70:     }
    71: 
    72:     save = TRUE;
    73: 
    74:     if (is_number(buf2))
    75:       number = atoi(buf2);
    76:     else if (GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) > 0) {
    77:       zone_rnum zlok;
    78: 
    79:       if ((zlok = real_zone(GET_OLC_ZONE(ch))) == NOWHERE)
    80:         number = NOWHERE;
    81:       else
    82:         number = genolc_zone_bottom(zlok);
    83:     }
    84: 
    85:     if (number == NOWHERE) {
    86:       send_to_char(ch, "Save which zone?\r\n");
    87:       return;
    88:     }
    89:   }
    90: 
    91:   /* If a numeric argument was given, get it. */
    92:   if (number == NOWHERE)
    93:     number = atoi(buf1);
    94: 
    95:   if (number < IDXTYPE_MIN || number > IDXTYPE_MAX) {
    96:     send_to_char(ch, "That shop VNUM can't exist.\r\n");
    97:     return;
    98:   }
    99: 
   100:   /* Check that the shop isn't already being edited. */
   101:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   102:     if (STATE(d) == CON_SEDIT) {
   103:       if (d->olc && OLC_NUM(d) == number) {
   104:         send_to_char(ch, "That shop is currently being edited by %s.\r\n",
   105:           PERS(d->character, ch));
   106:         return;
   107:       }
   108:     }
   109:   }
   110: 
   111:   /* Point d to the builder's descriptor. */
   112:   d = ch->desc;
   113: 
   114:   /* Give the descriptor an OLC structure. */
   115:   if (d->olc) {
   116:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE,
   117:       "SYSERR: do_oasis_sedit: Player already had olc structure.");
   118:     free(d->olc);
   119:   }
   120: 
   121:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
   122: 
   123:   /* Find the zone. */
   124:   OLC_ZNUM(d) = save ? real_zone(number) : real_zone_by_thing(number);
   125:   if (OLC_ZNUM(d) == NOWHERE) {
   126:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, there is no zone for that number!\r\n");
   127:     free(d->olc);
   128:     d->olc = NULL;
   129:     return;
   130:   }
   131: 
   132:   /* Everyone but IMPLs can only edit zones they have been assigned. */
   133:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, OLC_ZNUM(d))) {
   134:     send_cannot_edit(ch, zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   135:     /* Free the OLC structure. */
   136:     free(d->olc);
   137:     d->olc = NULL;
   138:     return;
   139:   }
   140: 
   141:   if (save) {
   142:     send_to_char(ch, "Saving all shops in zone %d.\r\n",
   143:       zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   144:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
   145:       "OLC: %s saves shop info for zone %d.",
   146:       GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   147: 
   148:     /* Save the shops to the shop file. */
   149:     save_shops(OLC_ZNUM(d));
   150: 
   151:     /* Free the OLC structure. */
   152:     free(d->olc);
   153:     d->olc = NULL;
   154:     return;
   155:   }
   156: 
   157:   OLC_NUM(d) = number;
   158: 
   159:   if ((real_num = real_shop(number)) != NOTHING)
   160:     sedit_setup_existing(d, real_num);
   161:   else
   162:     sedit_setup_new(d);
   163: 
   164:   sedit_disp_menu(d);
   165:   STATE(d) = CON_SEDIT;
   166: 
   167:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   168:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   169: 
   170:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "OLC: %s starts editing zone %d allowed zone %d",
   171:     GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, GET_OLC_ZONE(ch));
   172: }
   173: 
   174: static void sedit_setup_new(struct descriptor_data *d)
   175: {
   176:   struct shop_data *shop;
   177: 
   178:   /* Allocate a scratch shop structure. */
   179:   CREATE(shop, struct shop_data, 1);
   180: 
   181:   /* Fill in some default values. */
   182:   S_KEEPER(shop) = NOBODY;
   183:   S_CLOSE1(shop) = 28;
   184:   S_BUYPROFIT(shop) = 1.0;
   185:   S_SELLPROFIT(shop) = 1.0;
   186:   S_NOTRADE(shop) = 0;
   187:   /* Add a spice of default strings. */
   188:   S_NOITEM1(shop) = strdup("%s Sorry, I don't stock that item.");
   189:   S_NOITEM2(shop) = strdup("%s You don't seem to have that.");
   190:   S_NOCASH1(shop) = strdup("%s I can't afford that!");
   191:   S_NOCASH2(shop) = strdup("%s You are too poor!");
   192:   S_NOBUY(shop) = strdup("%s I don't trade in such items.");
   193:   S_BUY(shop) = strdup("%s That'll be %d coins, thanks.");
   194:   S_SELL(shop) = strdup("%s I'll give you %d coins for that.");
   195:   /* Stir the lists lightly. */
   196:   CREATE(S_PRODUCTS(shop), obj_vnum, 1);
   197: 
   198:   S_PRODUCT(shop, 0) = NOTHING;
   199:   CREATE(S_ROOMS(shop), room_rnum, 1);
   200: 
   201:   S_ROOM(shop, 0) = NOWHERE;
   202:   CREATE(S_NAMELISTS(shop), struct shop_buy_data, 1);
   203: 
   204:   S_BUYTYPE(shop, 0) = NOTHING;
   205: 
   206:    /* Presto! A shop. */
   207:   OLC_SHOP(d) = shop;
   208: }
   209: 
   210: void sedit_setup_existing(struct descriptor_data *d, int rshop_num)
   211: {
   212:   /* Create a scratch shop structure. */
   213:   CREATE(OLC_SHOP(d), struct shop_data, 1);
   214: 
   215:   /* don't waste time trying to free NULL strings -- Welcor */
   216:   copy_shop(OLC_SHOP(d), shop_index + rshop_num, FALSE);
   217: }

   423: 	  grn, nrm, yel, S_BUY(shop),
   424: 	  grn, nrm, yel, S_SELL(shop),

   432: 
   433: /* The GARGANTUAN event handler */
   434: void sedit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   435: {
   436:   int i;
   437: 
   438:   if (OLC_MODE(d) > SEDIT_NUMERICAL_RESPONSE) {
   439:     if (!isdigit(arg[0]) && ((*arg == '-') && (!isdigit(arg[1])))) {
   440:       write_to_output(d, "Field must be numerical, try again : ");
   441:       return;
   442:     }
   443:   }
   444:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   445:   case SEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   446:     switch (*arg) {
   447:     case 'y':
   448:     case 'Y':
   449:       sedit_save_internally(d);
   450:       mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE,
   451:              "OLC: %s edits shop %d", GET_NAME(d->character),
   452:              OLC_NUM(d));
   453:       if (CONFIG_OLC_SAVE) {
   454:         sedit_save_to_disk(real_zone_by_thing(OLC_NUM(d)));
   455:         write_to_output(d, "Shop saved to disk.\r\n");
   456:       } else
   457:         write_to_output(d, "Shop saved to memory.\r\n");
   458: 
   459:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_STRUCTS);
   460:       return;
   461:     case 'n':
   462:     case 'N':
   463:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   464:       return;
   465:     default:
   466:      write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\nDo you wish to save your changes? : ");
   467:       return;
   468:     }
   469: 
   470:   case SEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   471:     i = 0;
   472:     switch (*arg) {
   473:     case 'w':
   474:     case 'W':
   475:       write_to_output(d, "Copy what shop? ");
   476:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_COPY;
   477:       return;
   478:     case 'q':
   479:     case 'Q':
   480:       if (OLC_VAL(d)) {		/* Anything been changed? */
   481: 	write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   482: 	OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   483:       } else
   484: 	cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   485:       return;
   486:     case '0':
   487:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_KEEPER;
   488:       write_to_output(d, "Enter vnum number of shop keeper : ");
   489:       return;
   490:     case '1':
   491:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_OPEN1;
   492:       i++;
   493:       break;
   494:     case '2':
   495:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_CLOSE1;
   496:       i++;
   497:       break;
   498:     case '3':
   499:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_OPEN2;
   500:       i++;
   501:       break;
   502:     case '4':
   503:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_CLOSE2;
   504:       i++;
   505:       break;
   506:     case '5':
   507:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_BUY_PROFIT;
   508:       i++;
   509:       break;
   510:     case '6':
   511:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_SELL_PROFIT;
   512:       i++;
   513:       break;
   514:     case '7':
   515:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_NOITEM1;
   516:       i--;
   517:       break;
   518:     case '8':
   519:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_NOITEM2;
   520:       i--;
   521:       break;
   522:     case '9':
   523:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_NOCASH1;
   524:       i--;
   525:       break;
   526:     case 'a':
   527:     case 'A':
   528:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_NOCASH2;
   529:       i--;
   530:       break;
   531:     case 'b':
   532:     case 'B':
   533:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_NOBUY;
   534:       i--;
   535:       break;
   536:     case 'c':
   537:     case 'C':
   538:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_BUY;
   539:       i--;
   540:       break;
   541:     case 'd':
   542:     case 'D':
   543:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_SELL;
   544:       i--;
   545:       break;
   546:     case 'e':
   547:     case 'E':
   548:       sedit_no_trade_menu(d);
   549:       return;
   550:     case 'f':
   551:     case 'F':
   552:       sedit_shop_flags_menu(d);
   553:       return;
   554:     case 'r':
   555:     case 'R':
   556:       sedit_rooms_menu(d);
   557:       return;
   558:     case 'p':
   559:     case 'P':
   560:       sedit_products_menu(d);
   561:       return;
   562:     case 't':
   563:     case 'T':
   564:       sedit_namelist_menu(d);
   565:       return;
   566:     default:
   567:       sedit_disp_menu(d);
   568:       return;
   569:     }
   570: 
   571:     if (i == 0)
   572:       break;
   573:     else if (i == 1)
   574:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter new value : ");
   575:     else if (i == -1)
   576:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter new text :\r\n] ");
   577:     else
   578:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
   579:     return;
   580: 
   581:   case SEDIT_NAMELIST_MENU:
   582:     switch (*arg) {
   583:     case 'a':
   584:     case 'A':
   585:       sedit_types_menu(d);
   586:       return;
   587:     case 'd':
   588:     case 'D':
   589:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nDelete which entry? : ");
   590:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_DELETE_TYPE;
   591:       return;
   592:     case 'q':
   593:     case 'Q':
   594:       break;
   595:     }
   596:     break;
   597: 
   598:   case SEDIT_PRODUCTS_MENU:
   599:     switch (*arg) {
   600:     case 'a':
   601:     case 'A':
   602:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter new product vnum number : ");
   603:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_NEW_PRODUCT;
   604:       return;
   605:     case 'd':
   606:     case 'D':
   607:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nDelete which product? : ");
   608:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_DELETE_PRODUCT;
   609:       return;
   610:     case 'q':
   611:     case 'Q':
   612:       break;
   613:     }
   614:     break;
   615: 
   616:   case SEDIT_ROOMS_MENU:
   617:     switch (*arg) {
   618:     case 'a':
   619:     case 'A':
   620:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nEnter new room vnum number : ");
   621:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_NEW_ROOM;
   622:       return;
   623:     case 'c':
   624:     case 'C':
   625:       sedit_compact_rooms_menu(d);
   626:       return;
   627:     case 'l':
   628:     case 'L':
   629:       sedit_rooms_menu(d);
   630:       return;
   631:     case 'd':
   632:     case 'D':
   633:       write_to_output(d, "\r\nDelete which room? : ");
   634:       OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_DELETE_ROOM;
   635:       return;
   636:     case 'q':
   637:     case 'Q':
   638:       break;
   639:     }
   640:     break;
   641: 
   642:     /* String edits. */
   643:   case SEDIT_NOITEM1:
   644:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   645:       modify_shop_string(&S_NOITEM1(OLC_SHOP(d)), arg);
   646:     break;
   647:   case SEDIT_NOITEM2:
   648:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   649:       modify_shop_string(&S_NOITEM2(OLC_SHOP(d)), arg);
   650:     break;
   651:   case SEDIT_NOCASH1:
   652:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   653:       modify_shop_string(&S_NOCASH1(OLC_SHOP(d)), arg);
   654:     break;
   655:   case SEDIT_NOCASH2:
   656:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   657:       modify_shop_string(&S_NOCASH2(OLC_SHOP(d)), arg);
   658:     break;
   659:   case SEDIT_NOBUY:
   660:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   661:       modify_shop_string(&S_NOBUY(OLC_SHOP(d)), arg);
   662:     break;
   663:   case SEDIT_BUY:
   664:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   665:       modify_shop_string(&S_BUY(OLC_SHOP(d)), arg);
   666:     break;
   667:   case SEDIT_SELL:
   668:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg))
   669:       modify_shop_string(&S_SELL(OLC_SHOP(d)), arg);
   670:     break;
   671:   case SEDIT_NAMELIST:
   672:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg)) {
   673:       struct shop_buy_data new_entry;
   674: 
   675:       BUY_TYPE(new_entry) = OLC_VAL(d);
   676:       BUY_WORD(new_entry) = strdup(arg);
   677:       add_shop_to_type_list(&(S_NAMELISTS(OLC_SHOP(d))), &new_entry);
   678:     }
   679:     sedit_namelist_menu(d);
   680:     return;
   681: 
   682:     /* Numerical responses. */
   683:   case SEDIT_KEEPER:
   684:     if ((i = atoi(arg)) != -1)
   685:       if ((i = real_mobile(i)) == NOBODY) {
   686: 	write_to_output(d, "That mobile does not exist, try again : ");
   687: 	return;
   688:       }
   689:     S_KEEPER(OLC_SHOP(d)) = i;
   690:     if (i == -1)
   691:       break;
   692:     /* Fiddle with special procs. */
   693:     S_FUNC(OLC_SHOP(d)) = mob_index[i].func != shop_keeper ? mob_index[i].func : NULL;
   694:     mob_index[i].func = shop_keeper;
   695:     break;
   696:   case SEDIT_OPEN1:
   697:     S_OPEN1(OLC_SHOP(d)) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, 28);
   698:     break;
   699:   case SEDIT_OPEN2:
   700:     S_OPEN2(OLC_SHOP(d)) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, 28);
   701:     break;
   702:   case SEDIT_CLOSE1:
   703:     S_CLOSE1(OLC_SHOP(d)) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, 28);
   704:     break;
   705:   case SEDIT_CLOSE2:
   706:     S_CLOSE2(OLC_SHOP(d)) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, 28);
   707:     break;
   708:   case SEDIT_BUY_PROFIT:
   709:     sscanf(arg, "%f", &S_BUYPROFIT(OLC_SHOP(d)));
   710:     break;
   711:   case SEDIT_SELL_PROFIT:
   712:     sscanf(arg, "%f", &S_SELLPROFIT(OLC_SHOP(d)));
   713:     break;
   714:   case SEDIT_TYPE_MENU:
   715:     OLC_VAL(d) = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, NUM_ITEM_TYPES - 1);
   716:     write_to_output(d, "Enter namelist (return for none) :-\r\n] ");
   717:     OLC_MODE(d) = SEDIT_NAMELIST;
   718:     return;
   719:   case SEDIT_DELETE_TYPE:
   720:     remove_shop_from_type_list(&(S_NAMELISTS(OLC_SHOP(d))), atoi(arg));
   721:     sedit_namelist_menu(d);
   722:     return;
   723:   case SEDIT_NEW_PRODUCT:
   724:     if ((i = atoi(arg)) != -1)
   725:       if ((i = real_object(i)) == NOTHING) {
   726: 	write_to_output(d, "That object does not exist, try again : ");
   727: 	return;
   728:       }
   729:     if (i > 0)
   730:       add_shop_to_int_list(&(S_PRODUCTS(OLC_SHOP(d))), i);
   731:     sedit_products_menu(d);
   732:     return;
   733:   case SEDIT_DELETE_PRODUCT:
   734:     remove_shop_from_int_list(&(S_PRODUCTS(OLC_SHOP(d))), atoi(arg));
   735:     sedit_products_menu(d);
   736:     return;
   737:   case SEDIT_NEW_ROOM:
   738:     if ((i = atoi(arg)) != -1)
   739:       if ((i = real_room(i)) == NOWHERE) {
   740: 	write_to_output(d, "That room does not exist, try again : ");
   741: 	return;
   742:       }
   743:     if (i >= 0)
   744:       add_shop_to_int_list(&(S_ROOMS(OLC_SHOP(d))), atoi(arg));
   745:     sedit_rooms_menu(d);
   746:     return;
   747:   case SEDIT_DELETE_ROOM:
   748:     remove_shop_from_int_list(&(S_ROOMS(OLC_SHOP(d))), atoi(arg));
   749:     sedit_rooms_menu(d);
   750:     return;
   751:   case SEDIT_SHOP_FLAGS:
   752:     if ((i = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, NUM_SHOP_FLAGS)) > 0) {
   753:       TOGGLE_BIT(S_BITVECTOR(OLC_SHOP(d)), 1 << (i - 1));
   754:       sedit_shop_flags_menu(d);
   755:       return;
   756:     }
   757:     break;
   758:   case SEDIT_NOTRADE:
   759:     if ((i = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, NUM_TRADERS)) > 0) {
   760:       TOGGLE_BIT(S_NOTRADE(OLC_SHOP(d)), 1 << (i - 1));
   761:       sedit_no_trade_menu(d);
   762:       return;
   763:     }
   764:     break;
   765:   case SEDIT_COPY:
   766:     if ((i = real_shop(atoi(arg))) != NOWHERE) {
   767:       sedit_setup_existing(d, i);
   768:     } else
   769:       write_to_output(d, "That shop does not exist.\r\n");
   770:     break;
   771: 
   772:   default:
   773:     /* We should never get here. */
   774:     cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   775:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: sedit_parse(): Reached default case!");
   776:     write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
   777:     break;
   778:   }
   779: 
   780: /* If we get here, we have probably changed something, and now want to return 
   781:    to main menu.  Use OLC_VAL as a 'has changed' flag. */
   782:   OLC_VAL(d) = 1;
   783:   sedit_disp_menu(d);
   784: }

   134: static int is_ok_char(struct char_data *keeper, struct char_data *ch, int shop_nr)
   135: {
   136:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   137: 
   138:   if (!CAN_SEE(keeper, ch)) {
   139:     char actbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH] = MSG_NO_SEE_CHAR;
   140:     do_say(keeper, actbuf, cmd_say, 0);
   141:     return (FALSE);
   142:   }
   143:   if (IS_GOD(ch))
   144:     return (TRUE);
   145: 
   146:   if ((IS_GOOD(ch) && NOTRADE_GOOD(shop_nr)) ||
   147:       (IS_EVIL(ch) && NOTRADE_EVIL(shop_nr)) ||
   148:       (IS_NEUTRAL(ch) && NOTRADE_NEUTRAL(shop_nr))) {
   149:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s %s", GET_NAME(ch), MSG_NO_SELL_ALIGN);
   150:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   151:     return (FALSE);
   152:   }
   153:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
   154:     return (TRUE);
   155: 
   156:   if ((IS_MAGIC_USER(ch) && NOTRADE_MAGIC_USER(shop_nr)) ||
   157:       (IS_CLERIC(ch) && NOTRADE_CLERIC(shop_nr)) ||
   158:       (IS_THIEF(ch) && NOTRADE_THIEF(shop_nr)) ||
   159:       (IS_WARRIOR(ch) && NOTRADE_WARRIOR(shop_nr))) {
   160:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s %s", GET_NAME(ch), MSG_NO_SELL_CLASS);
   161:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   162:     return (FALSE);
   163:   }
   164:   return (TRUE);
   165: }
   166: 
   167: static int is_open(struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr, int msg)
   168: {
   169:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   170: 
   171:   *buf = '\0';
   172:   if (SHOP_OPEN1(shop_nr) > time_info.hours)
   173:     strlcpy(buf, MSG_NOT_OPEN_YET, sizeof(buf));
   174:   else if (SHOP_CLOSE1(shop_nr) < time_info.hours) {
   175:     if (SHOP_OPEN2(shop_nr) > time_info.hours)
   176:       strlcpy(buf, MSG_NOT_REOPEN_YET, sizeof(buf));
   177:     else if (SHOP_CLOSE2(shop_nr) < time_info.hours)
   178:       strlcpy(buf, MSG_CLOSED_FOR_DAY, sizeof(buf));
   179:   }
   180:   if (!*buf)
   181:     return (TRUE);
   182:   if (msg)
   183:     do_say(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   184:   return (FALSE);
   185: }
   186: 
   187: static int is_ok(struct char_data *keeper, struct char_data *ch, int shop_nr)
   188: {
   189:   if (is_open(keeper, shop_nr, TRUE))
   190:     return (is_ok_char(keeper, ch, shop_nr));
   191:   else
   192:     return (FALSE);
   193: }
