   195: static void push(struct stack_data *stack, int pushval)
   196: {
   197:   S_DATA(stack, S_LEN(stack)++) = pushval;
   198: }
   199: 
   200: static int top(struct stack_data *stack)
   201: {
   202:   if (S_LEN(stack) > 0)
   203:     return (S_DATA(stack, S_LEN(stack) - 1));
   204:   else
   205:     return (-1);
   206: }
   207: 
   208: static int pop(struct stack_data *stack)
   209: {
   210:   if (S_LEN(stack) > 0)
   211:     return (S_DATA(stack, --S_LEN(stack)));
   212:   else {
   213:     log("SYSERR: Illegal expression %d in shop keyword list.", S_LEN(stack));
   214:     return (0);
   215:   }
   216: }
   217: 
   218: static void evaluate_operation(struct stack_data *ops, struct stack_data *vals)
   219: {
   220:   int oper;
   221: 
   222:   if ((oper = pop(ops)) == OPER_NOT)
   223:     push(vals, !pop(vals));
   224:   else {
   225:     int val1 = pop(vals),
   226: 	val2 = pop(vals);
   227: 
   228:     /* Compiler would previously short-circuit these. */
   229:     if (oper == OPER_AND)
   230:       push(vals, val1 && val2);
   231:     else if (oper == OPER_OR)
   232:       push(vals, val1 || val2);
   233:   }
   234: }
   235: 
   236: static int find_oper_num(char token)
   237: {
   238:   int oindex;
   239: 
   240:   for (oindex = 0; oindex <= MAX_OPER; oindex++)
   241:     if (strchr(operator_str[oindex], token))
   242:       return (oindex);
   243:   return (NOTHING);
   244: }
   245: 
   246: static int evaluate_expression(struct obj_data *obj, char *expr)
   247: {
   248:   struct stack_data ops, vals;
   249:   char *ptr, *end, name[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   250:   int temp, eindex;
   251: 
   252:   if (!expr || !*expr)	/* Allows opening ( first. */
   253:     return (TRUE);
   254: 
   255:   ops.len = vals.len = 0;
   256:   ptr = expr;
   257:   while (*ptr) {
   258:     if (isspace(*ptr))
   259:       ptr++;
   260:     else {
   261:       if ((temp = find_oper_num(*ptr)) == NOTHING) {
   262: 	end = ptr;
   263: 	while (*ptr && !isspace(*ptr) && find_oper_num(*ptr) == NOTHING)
   264: 	  ptr++;
   265: 	strncpy(name, end, ptr - end);	/* strncpy: OK (name/end:MAX_STRING_LENGTH) */
   266: 	name[ptr - end] = '\0';
   267: 	for (eindex = 0; *extra_bits[eindex] != '\n'; eindex++)
   268: 	  if (!str_cmp(name, extra_bits[eindex])) {
   269: 	    push(&vals, OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, eindex));
   270: 	    break;
   271: 	  }
   272: 	if (*extra_bits[eindex] == '\n')
   273: 	  push(&vals, isname(name, obj->name));
   274:       } else {
   275: 	if (temp != OPER_OPEN_PAREN)
   276: 	  while (top(&ops) > temp)
   277: 	    evaluate_operation(&ops, &vals);
   278: 
   279: 	if (temp == OPER_CLOSE_PAREN) {
   280: 	  if ((temp = pop(&ops)) != OPER_OPEN_PAREN) {
   281: 	    log("SYSERR: Illegal parenthesis in shop keyword expression.");
   282: 	    return (FALSE);
   283: 	  }
   284: 	} else
   285: 	  push(&ops, temp);
   286: 	ptr++;
   287:       }
   288:     }
   289:   }
   290:   while (top(&ops) != -1)
   291:     evaluate_operation(&ops, &vals);
   292:   temp = pop(&vals);
   293:   if (top(&vals) != -1) {
   294:     log("SYSERR: Extra operands left on shop keyword expression stack.");
   295:     return (FALSE);
   296:   }
   297:   return (temp);
   298: }
   299: 
   300: static int trade_with(struct obj_data *item, int shop_nr)
   301: {
   302:   int counter;
   303: 
   304:   if (GET_OBJ_COST(item) < 1)
   305:     return (OBJECT_NOVAL);
   306: 
   307:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(item, ITEM_NOSELL))
   308:     return (OBJECT_NOTOK);
   309: 
   310:   for (counter = 0; SHOP_BUYTYPE(shop_nr, counter) != NOTHING; counter++)
   311:     if (SHOP_BUYTYPE(shop_nr, counter) == GET_OBJ_TYPE(item)) {
   312:       if (GET_OBJ_VAL(item, 2) == 0 &&
   313: 		(GET_OBJ_TYPE(item) == ITEM_WAND ||
   314: 		 GET_OBJ_TYPE(item) == ITEM_STAFF))
   315: 	return (OBJECT_DEAD);
   316:       else if (evaluate_expression(item, SHOP_BUYWORD(shop_nr, counter)))
   317: 	return (OBJECT_OK);
   318:     }
   319:   return (OBJECT_NOTOK);
   320: }
   321: 
   322: static int same_obj(struct obj_data *obj1, struct obj_data *obj2)
   323: {
   324:   int aindex;
   325: 
   326:   if (!obj1 || !obj2)
   327:     return (obj1 == obj2);
   328: 
   329:   if (GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj1) != GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj2))
   330:     return (FALSE);
   331: 
   332:   if (GET_OBJ_COST(obj1) != GET_OBJ_COST(obj2))
   333:     return (FALSE);
   334: 
   335:   for (aindex = 0; aindex < MAX_OBJ_AFFECT; aindex++)
   336:     if ((obj1->affected[aindex].location != obj2->affected[aindex].location) ||
   337: 	(obj1->affected[aindex].modifier != obj2->affected[aindex].modifier))
   338:       return (FALSE);
   339: 
   340:   return (TRUE);
   341: }
   342: 
   343: static int shop_producing(struct obj_data *item, int shop_nr)
   344: {
   345:   int counter;
   346: 
   347:   if (GET_OBJ_RNUM(item) == NOTHING)
   348:     return (FALSE);
   349: 
   350:   for (counter = 0; SHOP_PRODUCT(shop_nr, counter) != NOTHING; counter++)
   351:     if (same_obj(item, &obj_proto[SHOP_PRODUCT(shop_nr, counter)]))
   352:       return (TRUE);
   353:   return (FALSE);
   354: }
   355: 
   356: static int transaction_amt(char *arg)
   357: {
   358:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   359: 
   360:   char *buywhat;
   361: 
   362:   /* If we have two arguments, it means 'buy 5 3', or buy 5 of #3. We don't do
   363:    * that if we only have one argument, like 'buy 5', buy #5. By Andrey Fidrya */
   364:   buywhat = one_argument(arg, buf);
   365:   if (*buywhat && *buf && is_number(buf)) {
   366:     strcpy(arg, arg + strlen(buf) + 1);	/* strcpy: OK (always smaller) */
   367:     return (atoi(buf));
   368:   }
   369:   return (1);
   370: }
   371: 
   372: static char *times_message(struct obj_data *obj, char *name, int num)
   373: {
   374:   static char buf[256];
   375:   size_t len;
   376:   char *ptr;
   377: 
   378:   if (obj)
   379:     len = strlcpy(buf, obj->short_description, sizeof(buf));
   380:   else {
   381:     if ((ptr = strchr(name, '.')) == NULL)
   382:       ptr = name;
   383:     else
   384:       ptr++;
   385:     len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s %s", AN(ptr), ptr);
   386:   }
   387: 
   388:   if (num > 1 && len < sizeof(buf))
   389:     snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, " (x %d)", num);
   390: 
   391:   return (buf);
   392: }
   393: 
   394: static struct obj_data *get_slide_obj_vis(struct char_data *ch, char *name, struct obj_data *list)
   395: {
   396:   struct obj_data *i, *last_match = NULL;
   397:   int j, number;
   398:   char tmpname[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   399:   char *tmp;
   400: 
   401:   strlcpy(tmpname, name, sizeof(tmpname));
   402:   tmp = tmpname;
   403:   if (!(number = get_number(&tmp)))
   404:     return (NULL);
   405: 
   406:   for (i = list, j = 1; i && (j <= number); i = i->next_content)
   407:     if (isname(tmp, i->name))
   408:       if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, i) && !same_obj(last_match, i)) {
   409: 	if (j == number)
   410: 	  return (i);
   411: 	last_match = i;
   412: 	j++;
   413:       }
   414:   return (NULL);
   415: }
   416: 
   417: static struct obj_data *get_hash_obj_vis(struct char_data *ch, char *name, struct obj_data *list)
   418: {
   419:   struct obj_data *loop, *last_obj = NULL;
   420:   int qindex;
   421: 
   422:   if (is_number(name))
   423:     qindex = atoi(name);
   424:   else if (is_number(name + 1))
   425:     qindex = atoi(name + 1);
   426:   else
   427:     return (NULL);
   428: 
   429:   for (loop = list; loop; loop = loop->next_content)
   430:     if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, loop) && GET_OBJ_COST(loop) > 0)
   431:       if (!same_obj(last_obj, loop)) {
   432: 	if (--qindex == 0)
   433: 	  return (loop);
   434: 	last_obj = loop;
   435:       }
   436:   return (NULL);
   437: }
   438: 
   439: static struct obj_data *get_purchase_obj(struct char_data *ch, char *arg, struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr, int msg)
   440: {
   441:   char name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   442:   struct obj_data *obj;
   443: 
   444:   one_argument(arg, name);
   445:   do {
   446:     if (*name == '#' || is_number(name))
   447:       obj = get_hash_obj_vis(ch, name, keeper->carrying);
   448:     else
   449:       obj = get_slide_obj_vis(ch, name, keeper->carrying);
   450:     if (!obj) {
   451:       if (msg) {
   452:         char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   453: 
   454: 	snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), shop_index[shop_nr].no_such_item1, GET_NAME(ch));
   455: 	do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   456:       }
   457:       return (NULL);
   458:     }
   459:     if (GET_OBJ_COST(obj) <= 0) {
   460:       extract_obj(obj);
   461:       obj = NULL;
   462:     }
   463:   } while (!obj);
   464:   return (obj);
   465: }
   466: 
   467: /* Shop purchase adjustment, based on charisma-difference from buyer to keeper.
   468:    for i in `seq 15 -15`; do printf " * %3d: %6.4f\n" $i \
   469:    `echo "scale=4; 1+$i/70" | bc`; done
   470:    Shopkeeper higher charisma (markup)
   471:    ^  15: 1.2142  14: 1.2000  13: 1.1857  12: 1.1714  11: 1.1571
   472:    |  10: 1.1428   9: 1.1285   8: 1.1142   7: 1.1000   6: 1.0857
   473:    |   5: 1.0714   4: 1.0571   3: 1.0428   2: 1.0285   1: 1.0142
   474:    +   0: 1.0000
   475:    |  -1: 0.9858  -2: 0.9715  -3: 0.9572  -4: 0.9429  -5: 0.9286
   476:    |  -6: 0.9143  -7: 0.9000  -8: 0.8858  -9: 0.8715 -10: 0.8572
   477:    v -11: 0.8429 -12: 0.8286 -13: 0.8143 -14: 0.8000 -15: 0.7858
   478:    Player higher charisma (discount)
   479:    Most mobiles have 11 charisma so an 18 charisma player would get a 10%
   480:    discount beyond the basic price.  That assumes they put a lot of points
   481:    into charisma, because on the flip side they'd get 11% inflation by
   482:    having a 3. */
   483: static int buy_price_internal(struct obj_data *obj, int shop_nr, struct char_data *keeper, struct char_data *buyer, struct buy_price_info *out)
   484: {
   485:   float base = (float)GET_OBJ_COST(obj) * (float)SHOP_BUYPROFIT(shop_nr);
   486:   int keeper_cha = keeper ? GET_CHA(keeper) : 13;
   487:   float discount = shop_charisma_discount(buyer, keeper_cha);
   488:   long final_price = shop_calculate_buy_price(GET_OBJ_COST(obj), SHOP_BUYPROFIT(shop_nr), keeper_cha, buyer);
   489: 
   490:   if (out) {
   491:     out->base_price = base;
   492:     out->discount_factor = discount;
   493:     out->final_price = (int)final_price;
   494:   }
   495: 
   496:   return (int)final_price;
   497: }
   498: 
   499: static int buy_price(struct obj_data *obj, int shop_nr, struct char_data *keeper, struct char_data *buyer)
   500: {
   501:   return buy_price_internal(obj, shop_nr, keeper, buyer, NULL);
   502: }
   503: 
   504: #ifdef SHOP_PRICE_DEBUG
   505: static void shop_debug_price(struct char_data *viewer, struct obj_data *obj, int shop_nr, const struct buy_price_info *info)
   506: {
   507:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   508: 
   509:   if (!viewer || !info || IS_NPC(viewer))
   510:     return;
   511: 
   512:   if (GET_LEVEL(viewer) < LVL_IMMORT)
   513:     return;
   514: 
   515:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
   516:            "[SHOP_PRICE_DEBUG] item '%s' cost %d | buyprofit %.2f | base %.2f | discount %.3f | final %d\r\n",
   517:            obj ? obj->short_description : "<unknown>",
   518:            obj ? GET_OBJ_COST(obj) : 0,
   519:            SHOP_BUYPROFIT(shop_nr),
   520:            info->base_price,
   521:            info->discount_factor,
   522:            info->final_price);
   523: 
   524:   send_to_char(viewer, "%s", buf);
   525: }
   526: #endif
   527: 
   528: /* When the shopkeeper is buying, we reverse the discount. Also make sure
   529:    we don't buy for more than we sell for, to prevent infinite money-making. */
   530: static int sell_price(struct obj_data *obj, int shop_nr, struct char_data *keeper, struct char_data *seller)
   531: {
   532:   float sell_cost_modifier = SHOP_SELLPROFIT(shop_nr) * (1 - (GET_CHA(keeper) - GET_CHA(seller)) / 70.0);
   533:   float buy_cost_modifier = SHOP_BUYPROFIT(shop_nr) * (1 + (GET_CHA(keeper) - GET_CHA(seller)) / 70.0);
   534: 
   535:     if (sell_cost_modifier > buy_cost_modifier)
   536:     sell_cost_modifier = buy_cost_modifier;
   537: 
   538:   {
   539:     long base_cost = shop_scale_base_cost(GET_OBJ_COST(obj));
   540:     return (int) (base_cost * sell_cost_modifier);
   541:   }
   542: }
   543: 
   544: static void shopping_buy(char *arg, struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr)
   545: {
   546:   char tempstr[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH - 10], tempbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   547:   struct obj_data *obj, *last_obj = NULL;
   548:   int goldamt = 0, buynum, bought = 0;
   549: 
   550:   if (!is_ok(keeper, ch, shop_nr))
   551:     return;
   552: 
   553:   if (SHOP_SORT(shop_nr) < IS_CARRYING_N(keeper))
   554:     sort_keeper_objs(keeper, shop_nr);
   555: 
   556:   if ((buynum = transaction_amt(arg)) < 0) {
   557:     char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   558: 
   559:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s A negative amount?  Try selling me something.",
   560: 	    GET_NAME(ch));
   561:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   562:     return;
   563:   }
   564:   if (!*arg || !buynum) {
   565:     char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   566: 
   567:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s What do you want to buy??", GET_NAME(ch));
   568:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   569:     return;
   570:   }
   571:   if (!(obj = get_purchase_obj(ch, arg, keeper, shop_nr, TRUE)))
   572:     return;
   573: 
   574:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_QUEST)) {
   575:     if (GET_OBJ_COST(obj) > GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch)) {
   576:       char actbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   577:       snprintf(actbuf, sizeof(actbuf),
   578:         "%s You haven't earned enough quest points for such an item.",
   579:         GET_NAME(ch));
   580:       do_tell(keeper, actbuf, cmd_tell, 0);
   581:       return;
   582:     }
   583:   } else { /*has the player got enough money? */
   584:     long long price = buy_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch);
   585: 
   586:     if (price < 0) {
   587:       log("SYSERR: Shop %d has invalid price %lld for %s.", shop_nr, price,
   588:           obj->short_description ? obj->short_description : "(null)");
   589:       return;
   590:     }
   591: 
   592:     if (GET_GOLD(ch) < price) {
   593:       char actbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   594: 
   595:       snprintf(actbuf, sizeof(actbuf), shop_index[shop_nr].missing_cash2, GET_NAME(ch));
   596:       do_tell(keeper, actbuf, cmd_tell, 0);
   597: 
   598:       switch (SHOP_BROKE_TEMPER(shop_nr)) {
   599:       case 0:
   600:         do_action(keeper, strcpy(actbuf, GET_NAME(ch)), cmd_puke, 0);	/* strcpy: OK (MAX_NAME_LENGTH < MAX_INPUT_LENGTH) */
   601:         return;
   602:       case 1:
   603:         do_echo(keeper, strcpy(actbuf, "smokes on his joint."), cmd_emote, SCMD_EMOTE);	/* strcpy: OK */
   604:         return;
   605:       default:
   606:         return;
   607:       }
   608:     }
   609:   }
   610: 
   611:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || (!IS_NPC(ch) && !PRF_FLAGGED(ch, PRF_NOHASSLE))) {
   612: 	if (IS_CARRYING_N(ch) + 1 > CAN_CARRY_N(ch)) {
   613:       send_to_char(ch, "%s: You can't carry any more items.\r\n", fname(obj->name));
   614: 	  return;
   615:     }
   616:     if (IS_CARRYING_W(ch) + GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) > CAN_CARRY_W(ch)) {
   617: 	  send_to_char(ch, "%s: You can't carry that much weight.\r\n", fname(obj->name));
   618:       return;
   619: 	}
   620:   }
   621:   
   622:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_QUEST)) {
   623:     while (obj &&
   624:            (GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch) >= GET_OBJ_COST(obj))
   625:     && IS_CARRYING_N(ch) < CAN_CARRY_N(ch)
   626:     && bought < buynum
   627:     && IS_CARRYING_W(ch) + GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) <= CAN_CARRY_W(ch)) {
   628:       bought++;
   629:       /* Test if producing shop ! */
   630:       if (shop_producing(obj, shop_nr)) {
   631:         obj = read_object(GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj), REAL);
   632:       } else {
   633:         obj_from_char(obj);
   634:         SHOP_SORT(shop_nr)--;
   635:       }
   636:       obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   637: 
   638:       goldamt += GET_OBJ_COST(obj);
   639:       GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch) -= GET_OBJ_COST(obj);
   640: 
   641:       last_obj = obj;
   642:       obj = get_purchase_obj(ch, arg, keeper, shop_nr, FALSE);
   643:       if (!same_obj(obj, last_obj))
   644:         break;
   645:     }
   646:   } else {
   647:   while (obj && bought < buynum) {
   648:     long long price = buy_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch);
   649:     int charged;
   650: 
   651:     if (price < 0) {
   652:       log("SYSERR: Shop %d has invalid price %lld for %s.", shop_nr, price,
   653:           obj->short_description ? obj->short_description : "(null)");
   654:       break;
   655:     }
   656: 
   657:     if (GET_GOLD(ch) < price || IS_CARRYING_N(ch) >= CAN_CARRY_N(ch) ||
   658:         IS_CARRYING_W(ch) + GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) > CAN_CARRY_W(ch))
   659:       break;
   660: 
   661:     bought++;
   662:     /* Test if producing shop ! */
   663:     if (shop_producing(obj, shop_nr))
   664:       obj = read_object(GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj), REAL);
   665:     else {
   666:       obj_from_char(obj);
   667:       SHOP_SORT(shop_nr)--;
   668:     }
   669:     obj_to_char(obj, ch);
   670: 
   671: #ifdef SHOP_PRICE_DEBUG
   672:     {
   673:       struct buy_price_info price_info;
   674:       charged = buy_price_internal(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch, &price_info);
   675:       shop_debug_price(ch, obj, shop_nr, &price_info);
   676:     }
   677: #else
   678:     charged = buy_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch);
   679: #endif
   680:     goldamt += charged;
   681:     GET_GOLD(ch) -= charged;
   682:     if (GET_GOLD(ch) < 0) {
   683:       log("SYSERR: Negative gold balance for %s after shop charge.",
   684:           GET_NAME(ch) ? GET_NAME(ch) : "(unknown)");
   685:       SET_GOLD(ch, 0);
   686:     }
   687: 
   688:     last_obj = obj;
   689:     obj = get_purchase_obj(ch, arg, keeper, shop_nr, FALSE);
   690:     if (!same_obj(obj, last_obj))
   691:       break;
   692:   }
   693:   }
   694:   if (bought < buynum) {
   695:     char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   696: 
   697:     if (!obj || !same_obj(last_obj, obj))
   698:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s I only have %d to sell you.", GET_NAME(ch), bought);
   699:     else if (!OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_QUEST) && obj &&
   700:       GET_GOLD(ch) < buy_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch))
   701:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s You can only afford %d.", GET_NAME(ch), bought);
   702:     else if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_QUEST) &&
   703:       GET_QUESTPOINTS(ch) < GET_OBJ_COST(obj))
   704:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s You only had sufficient quest points for %d.",
   705:         GET_NAME(ch), bought);
   706:     else if (IS_CARRYING_N(ch) >= CAN_CARRY_N(ch))
   707:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s You can only hold %d.", GET_NAME(ch), bought);
   708:     else if (IS_CARRYING_W(ch) + GET_OBJ_WEIGHT(obj) > CAN_CARRY_W(ch))
   709:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s You can only carry %d.", GET_NAME(ch), bought);
   710:     else
   711:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s Something screwy only gave you %d.", GET_NAME(ch), bought);
   712:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   713:   }
   714:   if (obj && !OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_QUEST)) {
   715:     GET_GOLD(keeper) += goldamt;
   716:     if (SHOP_USES_BANK(shop_nr))
   717:       if (GET_GOLD(keeper) > MAX_OUTSIDE_BANK) {
   718:         SHOP_BANK(shop_nr) += (GET_GOLD(keeper) - MAX_OUTSIDE_BANK);
   719:         SET_GOLD(keeper, MAX_OUTSIDE_BANK);
   720:       }
   721:   }
   722:   strlcpy(tempstr, times_message(ch->carrying, 0, bought), sizeof(tempstr));
   723: 
   724:   snprintf(tempbuf, sizeof(tempbuf), "$n buys %s.", tempstr);
   725:   act(tempbuf, FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
   726: 
   727:   if (obj && OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_QUEST))
   728:     snprintf(tempbuf, sizeof(tempbuf), "%s That has cost you %d quest points.", GET_NAME(ch), goldamt);
   729:   else
   730:     snprintf(tempbuf, sizeof(tempbuf), shop_index[shop_nr].message_buy, GET_NAME(ch), goldamt);
   731: 
   732:   do_tell(keeper, tempbuf, cmd_tell, 0);
   733: 
   734:   send_to_char(ch, "You now have %s.\r\n", tempstr);
   735: 
   736: }
   737: 
   738: static struct obj_data *get_selling_obj(struct char_data *ch, char *name, struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr, int msg)
   739: {
   740:   char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   741:   struct obj_data *obj;
   742:   int result;
   743: 
   744:   if (!(obj = get_obj_in_list_vis(ch, name, NULL, ch->carrying))) {
   745:     if (msg) {
   746:       char tbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   747: 
   748:       snprintf(tbuf, sizeof(tbuf), shop_index[shop_nr].no_such_item2, GET_NAME(ch));
   749:       do_tell(keeper, tbuf, cmd_tell, 0);
   750:     }
   751:     return (NULL);
   752:   }
   753:   if (OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_KEPT)) {
   754:     if (msg)
   755:       do_tell(keeper, "You are keeping that item safe. Unlock it first.", cmd_tell, 0);
   756:     return (NULL);
   757:   }
   758:   if ((result = trade_with(obj, shop_nr)) == OBJECT_OK)
   759:     return (obj);
   760: 
   761:   if (!msg)
   762:     return (0);
   763: 
   764:   switch (result) {
   765:   case OBJECT_NOVAL:
   766:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s You've got to be kidding, that thing is worthless!", GET_NAME(ch));
   767:     break;
   768:   case OBJECT_NOTOK:
   769:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), shop_index[shop_nr].do_not_buy, GET_NAME(ch));
   770:     break;
   771:   case OBJECT_DEAD:
   772:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s %s", GET_NAME(ch), MSG_NO_USED_WANDSTAFF);
   773:     break;
   774:   default:
   775:     log("SYSERR: Illegal return value of %d from trade_with() (%s)", result, __FILE__);	/* Someone might rename it... */
   776:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s An error has occurred.", GET_NAME(ch));
   777:     break;
   778:   }
   779:   do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   780:   return (NULL);
   781: }
   782: 
   783: /* This function is a slight hack!  To make sure that duplicate items are only
   784:  * listed once on the "list", this function groups "identical" objects together
   785:  * on the shopkeeper's inventory list.  The hack involves knowing how the list
   786:  * is put together, and manipulating the order of the objects on the list. (But
   787:  * since most of DIKU is not encapsulated, and information hiding is almost
   788:  * never used, it isn't that big a deal). -JF */
   789: static struct obj_data *slide_obj(struct obj_data *obj, struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr)
   790: {
   791:   struct obj_data *loop;
   792:   int temp;
   793: 
   794:   if (SHOP_SORT(shop_nr) < IS_CARRYING_N(keeper))
   795:     sort_keeper_objs(keeper, shop_nr);
   796: 
   797:   /* Extract the object if it is identical to one produced */
   798:   if (shop_producing(obj, shop_nr)) {
   799:     temp = GET_OBJ_RNUM(obj);
   800:     extract_obj(obj);
   801:     return (&obj_proto[temp]);
   802:   }
   803:   SHOP_SORT(shop_nr)++;
   804:   loop = keeper->carrying;
   805:   obj_to_char(obj, keeper);
   806:   keeper->carrying = loop;
   807:   while (loop) {
   808:     if (same_obj(obj, loop)) {
   809:       obj->next_content = loop->next_content;
   810:       loop->next_content = obj;
   811:       return (obj);
   812:     }
   813:     loop = loop->next_content;
   814:   }
   815:   keeper->carrying = obj;
   816:   return (obj);
   817: }
   818: 
   819: static void sort_keeper_objs(struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr)
   820: {
   821:   struct obj_data *list = NULL, *temp;
   822: 
   823:   while (SHOP_SORT(shop_nr) < IS_CARRYING_N(keeper)) {
   824:     temp = keeper->carrying;
   825:     obj_from_char(temp);
   826:     temp->next_content = list;
   827:     list = temp;
   828:   }
   829: 
   830:   while (list) {
   831:     temp = list;
   832:     list = list->next_content;
   833:     if (shop_producing(temp, shop_nr) &&
   834: 	!get_obj_in_list_num(GET_OBJ_RNUM(temp), keeper->carrying)) {
   835:       obj_to_char(temp, keeper);
   836:       SHOP_SORT(shop_nr)++;
   837:     } else
   838:       slide_obj(temp, keeper, shop_nr);
   839:   }
   840: }
   841: 
   842: static void shopping_sell(char *arg, struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr)
   843: {
   844:   char tempstr[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH - 10], name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], tempbuf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH]; // - 10 to make room for constants in format
   845:   struct obj_data *obj;
   846:   int sellnum, sold = 0, goldamt = 0;
   847: 
   848:   if (!(is_ok(keeper, ch, shop_nr)))
   849:     return;
   850: 
   851:   if ((sellnum = transaction_amt(arg)) < 0) {
   852:     char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   853: 
   854:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s A negative amount?  Try buying something.", GET_NAME(ch));
   855:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   856:     return;
   857:   }
   858:   if (!*arg || !sellnum) {
   859:     char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   860: 
   861:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s What do you want to sell??", GET_NAME(ch));
   862:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   863:     return;
   864:   }
   865:   one_argument(arg, name);
   866:   if (!(obj = get_selling_obj(ch, name, keeper, shop_nr, TRUE)))
   867:     return;
   868: 
   869:   if (!IS_SET(SHOP_BITVECTOR(shop_nr), HAS_UNLIMITED_CASH) && GET_GOLD(keeper) + SHOP_BANK(shop_nr) < sell_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch)) {
   870:     char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   871: 
   872:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), shop_index[shop_nr].missing_cash1, GET_NAME(ch));
   873:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   874:     return;
   875:   }
   876:   while (obj && (IS_SET(SHOP_BITVECTOR(shop_nr), HAS_UNLIMITED_CASH) || GET_GOLD(keeper) + SHOP_BANK(shop_nr) >= sell_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch)) && sold < sellnum) {
   877:     int charged = sell_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch);
   878: 
   879:     goldamt += charged;
   880:     if (!IS_SET(SHOP_BITVECTOR(shop_nr), HAS_UNLIMITED_CASH)) {
   881:       long long remaining = charged;
   882: 
   883:       if (GET_GOLD(keeper) >= remaining) {
   884:         GET_GOLD(keeper) -= remaining;
   885:       } else {
   886:         remaining -= GET_GOLD(keeper);
   887:         SET_GOLD(keeper, 0);
   888: 
   889:         if (SHOP_BANK(shop_nr) >= remaining)
   890:           SHOP_BANK(shop_nr) -= remaining;
   891:         else {
   892:           log("SYSERR: Shop %d bank underflow paying %s.", shop_nr,
   893:               GET_NAME(ch) ? GET_NAME(ch) : "(unknown)");
   894:           SHOP_BANK(shop_nr) = 0;
   895:         }
   896:       }
   897: 
   898:       if (GET_GOLD(keeper) < 0) {
   899:         log("SYSERR: Negative gold balance for keeper %s after shop payout.",
   900:             GET_NAME(keeper) ? GET_NAME(keeper) : "(unknown)");
   901:         SET_GOLD(keeper, 0);
   902:       }
   903:     }
   904:     sold++;
   905:     obj_from_char(obj);
   906:     slide_obj(obj, keeper, shop_nr);    /* Seems we don't use return value. */
   907:     obj = get_selling_obj(ch, name, keeper, shop_nr, FALSE);
   908:   }
   909: 
   910:   if (sold < sellnum) {
   911:     char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   912: 
   913:     if (!obj)
   914:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s You only have %d of those.", GET_NAME(ch), sold);
   915:     else if (GET_GOLD(keeper) + SHOP_BANK(shop_nr) < sell_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch))
   916:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s I can only afford to buy %d of those.", GET_NAME(ch), sold);
   917:     else
   918:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s Something really screwy made me buy %d.", GET_NAME(ch), sold);
   919: 
   920:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   921:   }
   922:   GET_GOLD(ch) += goldamt;
   923: 
   924:   strlcpy(tempstr, times_message(0, name, sold), sizeof(tempstr));
   925:   snprintf(tempbuf, sizeof(tempbuf), "$n sells %s.", tempstr);
   926:   act(tempbuf, FALSE, ch, obj, 0, TO_ROOM);
   927: 
   928:   snprintf(tempbuf, sizeof(tempbuf), shop_index[shop_nr].message_sell, GET_NAME(ch), goldamt);
   929:   do_tell(keeper, tempbuf, cmd_tell, 0);
   930: 
   931:   send_to_char(ch, "The shopkeeper now has %s.\r\n", tempstr);
   932: 
   933:   if (GET_GOLD(keeper) < MIN_OUTSIDE_BANK) {
   934:     goldamt = MIN(MAX_OUTSIDE_BANK - GET_GOLD(keeper), SHOP_BANK(shop_nr));
   935:     SHOP_BANK(shop_nr) -= goldamt;
   936:     GET_GOLD(keeper) += goldamt;
   937:   }
   938: }
   939: 
   940: static void shopping_value(char *arg, struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr)
   941: {
   942:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
   943:   struct obj_data *obj;
   944: 
   945:   if (!is_ok(keeper, ch, shop_nr))
   946:     return;
   947: 
   948:   if (!*arg) {
   949:     snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s What do you want me to evaluate??", GET_NAME(ch));
   950:     do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   951:     return;
   952:   }
   953:   one_argument(arg, name);
   954:   if (!(obj = get_selling_obj(ch, name, keeper, shop_nr, TRUE)))
   955:     return;
   956: 
   957:   { long long _sp = shop_units_to_gold((long long)sell_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch)); char _pb[64]; shop_format_price(_pb, sizeof(_pb), _sp); snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s I\'ll give you %s for that!", GET_NAME(ch), _pb); }
   958:   do_tell(keeper, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
   959: }
   960: 
   961: static char *list_object(struct obj_data *obj, int cnt, int aindex, int shop_nr, struct char_data *keeper, struct char_data *ch)
   962: {
   963:   char pricebuf[64];
   964:   long long price_gold = 0;
   965: #ifdef SHOP_PRICE_DEBUG
   966:   struct buy_price_info info;
   967:   int price = buy_price_internal(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch, &info);
   968:   shop_debug_price(ch, obj, shop_nr, &info);
   969: #else
   970:   int price = buy_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch);
   971: #endif
   972:   price_gold = shop_units_to_gold((long long)price);
   973:   shop_format_price(pricebuf, sizeof(pricebuf), price_gold);
   974:   static char result[256];
   975:   char  itemname[128],
   976:         quantity[16];   /* "Unlimited" or "%d" */
   977: 
   978:   if (shop_producing(obj, shop_nr))
   979:     strcpy(quantity, "Unlimited");      /* strcpy: OK (for 'quantity >= 10') */
   980:   else
   981:     sprintf(quantity, "%d", cnt);       /* sprintf: OK (for 'quantity >= 11', 32-bit int) */
   982: 
   983:   switch (GET_OBJ_TYPE(obj)) {
   984:   case ITEM_DRINKCON:
   985:     if (GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1))
   986:       snprintf(itemname, sizeof(itemname), "%s of %s", obj->short_description, drinks[GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2)]);
   987:     else
   988:       strlcpy(itemname, obj->short_description, sizeof(itemname));
   989:     break;
   990: 
   991:   case ITEM_WAND:
   992:   case ITEM_STAFF:
   993:     snprintf(itemname, sizeof(itemname), "%s%s", obj->short_description,
   994:         GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 2) < GET_OBJ_VAL(obj, 1) ? " (partially used)" : "");
   995:     break;
   996: 
   997:   default:
   998:     strlcpy(itemname, obj->short_description, sizeof(itemname));
   999:     break;
  1000:   }
  1001:   CAP(itemname);
  1002: 
  1003:   snprintf(result, sizeof(result), " %2d)  %9s   %-*s %12s%s\r\n",
  1004:         aindex, quantity, count_color_chars(itemname)+48, itemname,
  1005:         pricebuf, OBJ_FLAGGED(obj, ITEM_QUEST) ? " qp" : "");
  1006:   return (result);
  1007: }
  1008: 
  1009: static void shopping_list(char *arg, struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr)
  1010: {
  1011:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], name[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1012:   struct obj_data *obj, *last_obj = NULL;
  1013:   int cnt = 0, lindex = 0, found = FALSE, has_quest = FALSE;
  1014:   size_t len;
  1015:   /* cnt is the number of that particular object available */
  1016:   /* has_quest indicates if the shopkeeper sells quest items */
  1017: 
  1018:   if (!is_ok(keeper, ch, shop_nr))
  1019:     return;
  1020: 
  1021:   if (SHOP_SORT(shop_nr) < IS_CARRYING_N(keeper))
  1022:     sort_keeper_objs(keeper, shop_nr);
  1023: 
  1024:   one_argument(arg, name);
  1025: 
  1026:   len = strlcpy(buf,   " ##   Available   Item                                               Cost\r\n"
  1027:       "----------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n", sizeof(buf));
  1028:   if (keeper->carrying)
  1029:     for (obj = keeper->carrying; obj; obj = obj->next_content)
  1030:       if (CAN_SEE_OBJ(ch, obj) && GET_OBJ_COST(obj) > 0) {
  1031: 	if (!last_obj) {
  1032: 	  last_obj = obj;
  1033: 	  cnt = 1;
  1034: 	} else if (same_obj(last_obj, obj))
  1035: 	  cnt++;
  1036: 	else {
  1037: 	  lindex++;
  1038: 	  if (!*name || isname(name, last_obj->name)) {
  1039: 	    strncat(buf, list_object(last_obj, cnt, lindex, shop_nr, keeper, ch), sizeof(buf) - len - 1);	/* strncat: OK */
  1040:             len = strlen(buf);
  1041:             if (len + 1 >= sizeof(buf))
  1042:               break;
  1043:             found = TRUE;
  1044:             if (OBJ_FLAGGED(last_obj, ITEM_QUEST))
  1045:               has_quest = TRUE;
  1046: 	  }
  1047: 	  cnt = 1;
  1048: 	  last_obj = obj;
  1049: 	}
  1050:       }
  1051:   lindex++;
  1052:   if (!last_obj)	/* we actually have nothing in our list for sale, period */
  1053:     send_to_char(ch, "Currently, there is nothing for sale.\r\n");
  1054:   else if (*name && !found)	/* nothing the char was looking for was found */
  1055:     send_to_char(ch, "Presently, none of those are for sale.\r\n");
  1056:   else {
  1057:     if (!*name || isname(name, last_obj->name))	/* show last obj */
  1058:       if (len < sizeof(buf))
  1059:         strncat(buf, list_object(last_obj, cnt, lindex, shop_nr, keeper, ch), sizeof(buf) - len - 1);	/* strncat: OK */
  1060:     page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
  1061:     if (has_quest)
  1062:       send_to_char(ch, "Items flagged \"qp\" require quest points to purchase.\r\n");
  1063:   }
  1064: }

  1066: static int ok_shop_room(int shop_nr, room_vnum room)
  1067: {
  1068:   int mindex;
  1069: 
  1070:   for (mindex = 0; SHOP_ROOM(shop_nr, mindex) != NOWHERE; mindex++)
  1071:     if (SHOP_ROOM(shop_nr, mindex) == room)
  1072:       return (TRUE);
  1073:   return (FALSE);
  1074: }
  1075: 
  1076: SPECIAL(shop_keeper)
  1077: {
  1078:   struct char_data *keeper = (struct char_data *)me;
  1079:   int shop_nr;
  1080: 
  1081:   for (shop_nr = 0; shop_nr <= top_shop; shop_nr++)
  1082:     if (SHOP_KEEPER(shop_nr) == keeper->nr)
  1083:       break;
  1084: 
  1085:   if (shop_nr > top_shop)
  1086:     return (FALSE);
  1087: 
  1088:   if (SHOP_FUNC(shop_nr))	/* Check secondary function */
  1089:     if ((SHOP_FUNC(shop_nr)) (ch, me, cmd, argument))
  1090:       return (TRUE);
  1091: 
  1092:   if (keeper == ch) {
  1093:     if (cmd)
  1094:       SHOP_SORT(shop_nr) = 0;	/* Safety in case "drop all" */
  1095:     return (FALSE);
  1096:   }
  1097:   if (!ok_shop_room(shop_nr, GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch))))
  1098:     return (0);
  1099: 
  1100:   if (!AWAKE(keeper))
  1101:     return (FALSE);
  1102: 
  1103:   if (CMD_IS("steal")) {
  1104:     char argm[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1105: 
  1106:     snprintf(argm, sizeof(argm), "$N shouts '%s'", MSG_NO_STEAL_HERE);
  1107:     act(argm, FALSE, ch, 0, keeper, TO_CHAR);
  1108: 
  1109:     do_action(keeper, GET_NAME(ch), cmd_slap, 0);
  1110:     return (TRUE);
  1111:   }
  1112: 
  1113:   if (CMD_IS("buy")) {
  1114:     shopping_buy(argument, ch, keeper, shop_nr);
  1115:     return (TRUE);
  1116:   } else if (CMD_IS("sell")) {
  1117:     shopping_sell(argument, ch, keeper, shop_nr);
  1118:     return (TRUE);
  1119:   } else if (CMD_IS("value")) {
  1120:     shopping_value(argument, ch, keeper, shop_nr);
  1121:     return (TRUE);
  1122:   } else if (CMD_IS("list")) {
  1123:     shopping_list(argument, ch, keeper, shop_nr);
  1124:     return (TRUE);
  1125:   } else if (CMD_IS("appraise")) {
  1126:     return (shopping_appraise(argument, ch, keeper, shop_nr));
  1127:   } else if (CMD_IS("identify")) {
  1128:     return (shopping_identify(argument, ch, keeper, shop_nr));
  1129:   }
  1130:   return (FALSE);
  1131: }

  1133: int ok_damage_shopkeeper(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *victim)
  1134: {
  1135:   int sindex;
  1136: 
  1137:   if (!IS_MOB(victim) || mob_index[GET_MOB_RNUM(victim)].func != shop_keeper)
  1138:     return (TRUE);
  1139: 
  1140:   /* Prevent "invincible" shopkeepers if they're charmed. */
  1141:   if (AFF_FLAGGED(victim, AFF_CHARM))
  1142:     return (TRUE);
  1143: 
  1144:   for (sindex = 0; sindex <= top_shop; sindex++)
  1145:     if (GET_MOB_RNUM(victim) == SHOP_KEEPER(sindex) && !SHOP_KILL_CHARS(sindex)) {
  1146:       char buf[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
  1147: 
  1148:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s %s", GET_NAME(ch), MSG_CANT_KILL_KEEPER);
  1149:       do_tell(victim, buf, cmd_tell, 0);
  1150: 
  1151:       do_action(victim, GET_NAME(ch), cmd_slap, 0);
  1152:       return (FALSE);
  1153:     }
  1154: 
  1155:   return (TRUE);
  1156: }

  1158: /* val == obj_vnum and obj_rnum (?) */
  1159: static int add_to_shop_list(struct shop_buy_data *list, int type, int *len, int *val)
  1160: {
  1161:   if (*val != NOTHING && *val >= 0) { /* necessary after changing to unsigned v/rnums -- Welcor */
  1162:     if (*len < MAX_SHOP_OBJ) {
  1163:       if (type == LIST_PRODUCE)
  1164: 	*val = real_object(*val);
  1165:       if (*val != NOTHING) {
  1166: 	BUY_TYPE(list[*len]) = *val;
  1167: 	BUY_WORD(list[(*len)++]) = NULL;
  1168:       } else
  1169: 	*val = NOTHING;
  1170:       return (FALSE);
  1171:     } else
  1172:       return (TRUE);
  1173:   }
  1174:   return (FALSE);
  1175: }

  1177: static int end_read_list(struct shop_buy_data *list, int len, int error)
  1178: {
  1179:   if (error)
  1180:     log("SYSERR: Raise MAX_SHOP_OBJ constant in shop.h to %d", len + error);
  1181:   BUY_WORD(list[len]) = NULL;
  1182:   BUY_TYPE(list[len++]) = NOTHING;
  1183:   return (len);
  1184: }

  1186: static void read_line(FILE *shop_f, const char *string, void *data)
  1187: {
  1188:   char buf[READ_SIZE];
  1189: 
  1190:   if (!get_line(shop_f, buf) || !sscanf(buf, string, data)) {
  1191:     log("SYSERR: Error in shop #%d, near '%s' with '%s'", SHOP_NUM(top_shop), buf, string);
  1192:     exit(1);
  1193:   }
  1194: }
  1195: 
  1196: static int read_list(FILE *shop_f, struct shop_buy_data *list, int new_format,
  1197: 	          int max, int type)
  1198: {
  1199:   int count, temp, len = 0, error = 0;
  1200: 
  1201:   if (new_format) {
  1202:     for (;;) {
  1203:       read_line(shop_f, "%d", &temp);
  1204:       if (temp < 0)	/* Always "-1" the string. */
  1205:         break;
  1206:       error += add_to_shop_list(list, type, &len, &temp);
  1207:     }
  1208:   } else
  1209:     for (count = 0; count < max; count++) {
  1210:       read_line(shop_f, "%d", &temp);
  1211:       error += add_to_shop_list(list, type, &len, &temp);
  1212:     }
  1213:   return (end_read_list(list, len, error));
  1214: }
  1215: 
  1216: /* END_OF inefficient. */
  1217: static int read_type_list(FILE *shop_f, struct shop_buy_data *list,
  1218: 		       int new_format, int max)
  1219: {
  1220:   int tindex, num, len = 0, error = 0;
  1221:   char *ptr, buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
  1222: 
  1223:   if (!new_format)
  1224:     return (read_list(shop_f, list, 0, max, LIST_TRADE));
  1225: 
  1226:   do {
  1227:     if (fgets(buf, sizeof(buf), shop_f) == NULL) {
  1228:       if (feof(shop_f))
  1229:         log("SYSERR: unexpected end of file reading shop file type list.");
  1230:       else if (ferror(shop_f))
  1231:         log("SYSERR: error reading reading shop file type list: %s", strerror(errno));
  1232:       else
  1233:         log("SYSERR: error reading reading shop file type list.");
  1234:     }
  1235:     if ((ptr = strchr(buf, ';')) != NULL)
  1236:       *ptr = '\0';
  1237:     else
  1238:       *(END_OF(buf) - 1) = '\0';
  1239: 
  1240:     num = -1;
  1241: 
  1242:     if (strncmp(buf, "-1", 2) != 0)
  1243:       for (tindex = 0; *item_types[tindex] != '\n'; tindex++)
  1244:         if (!strn_cmp(item_types[tindex], buf, strlen(item_types[tindex]))) {
  1245:           num = tindex;
  1246:           memmove(buf, buf + strlen(item_types[tindex]), strlen(buf) - strlen(item_types[tindex]) + 1);
  1247:           break;
  1248:         }
  1249: 
  1250:     ptr = buf;
  1251:     if (num == -1) {
  1252:       sscanf(buf, "%d", &num);
  1253:       while (!isdigit(*ptr))
  1254: 	ptr++;
  1255:       while (isdigit(*ptr))
  1256: 	ptr++;
  1257:     }
  1258:     while (isspace(*ptr))
  1259:       ptr++;
  1260:     while (isspace(*(END_OF(ptr) - 1)))
  1261:       *(END_OF(ptr) - 1) = '\0';
  1262:     error += add_to_shop_list(list, LIST_TRADE, &len, &num);
  1263:     if (*ptr)
  1264:       BUY_WORD(list[len - 1]) = strdup(ptr);
  1265:   } while (num >= 0);
  1266:   return (end_read_list(list, len, error));
  1267: }
  1268: 
  1269: static char *read_shop_message(int mnum, room_vnum shr, FILE *shop_f, const char *why)
  1270: {
  1271:   int cht, ss = 0, ds = 0, err = 0;
  1272:   char *tbuf;
  1273: 
  1274:   if (!(tbuf = fread_string(shop_f, why)))
  1275:     return (NULL);
  1276: 
  1277:   for (cht = 0; tbuf[cht]; cht++) {
  1278:     if (tbuf[cht] != '%')
  1279:       continue;
  1280: 
  1281:     if (tbuf[cht + 1] == 's')
  1282:       ss++;
  1283:     else if (tbuf[cht + 1] == 'd' && (mnum == 5 || mnum == 6)) {
  1284:       if (ss == 0) {
  1285:         log("SYSERR: Shop #%d has %%d before %%s, message #%d.", shr, mnum);
  1286:         err++;
  1287:       }
  1288:       ds++;
  1289:     } else if (tbuf[cht + 1] != '%') {
  1290:       log("SYSERR: Shop #%d has invalid format '%%%c' in message #%d.", shr, tbuf[cht + 1], mnum);
  1291:       err++;
  1292:     }
  1293:   }
  1294: 
  1295:   if (ss > 1 || ds > 1) {
  1296:     log("SYSERR: Shop #%d has too many specifiers for message #%d. %%s=%d %%d=%d", shr, mnum, ss, ds);
  1297:     err++;
  1298:   }
  1299: 
  1300:   if (err) {
  1301:     free(tbuf);
  1302:     return (NULL);
  1303:   }
  1304:   return (tbuf);
  1305: }
  1306: 
  1307: void boot_the_shops(FILE *shop_f, char *filename, int rec_count)
  1308: {
  1309:   char *buf, buf2[256];
  1310:   int temp, count, new_format = FALSE;
  1311:   struct shop_buy_data list[MAX_SHOP_OBJ + 1];
  1312:   int done = FALSE;
  1313: 
  1314:   snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "beginning of shop file %s", filename);
  1315: 
  1316:   while (!done) {
  1317:     buf = fread_string(shop_f, buf2);
  1318:     if (*buf == '#') {		/* New shop */
  1319:       sscanf(buf, "#%d\n", &temp);
  1320:       snprintf(buf2, sizeof(buf2), "shop #%d in shop file %s", temp, filename);
  1321:       free(buf);		/* Plug memory leak! */
  1322:       top_shop++;
  1323:       if (!top_shop)
  1324: 	CREATE(shop_index, struct shop_data, rec_count);
  1325:       SHOP_NUM(top_shop) = temp;
  1326:       temp = read_list(shop_f, list, new_format, MAX_PROD, LIST_PRODUCE);
  1327:       CREATE(shop_index[top_shop].producing, obj_vnum, temp);
  1328:       for (count = 0; count < temp; count++)
  1329: 	SHOP_PRODUCT(top_shop, count) = BUY_TYPE(list[count]);
  1330: 
  1331:       read_line(shop_f, "%f", &SHOP_BUYPROFIT(top_shop));
  1332:       read_line(shop_f, "%f", &SHOP_SELLPROFIT(top_shop));
  1333: 
  1334:       temp = read_type_list(shop_f, list, new_format, MAX_TRADE);
  1335:       CREATE(shop_index[top_shop].type, struct shop_buy_data, temp);
  1336:       for (count = 0; count < temp; count++) {
  1337: 	SHOP_BUYTYPE(top_shop, count) = BUY_TYPE(list[count]);
  1338: 	SHOP_BUYWORD(top_shop, count) = BUY_WORD(list[count]);
  1339:       }
  1340: 
  1341:       shop_index[top_shop].no_such_item1 = read_shop_message(0, SHOP_NUM(top_shop), shop_f, buf2);
  1342:       shop_index[top_shop].no_such_item2 = read_shop_message(1, SHOP_NUM(top_shop), shop_f, buf2);
  1343:       shop_index[top_shop].do_not_buy = read_shop_message(2, SHOP_NUM(top_shop), shop_f, buf2);
  1344:       shop_index[top_shop].missing_cash1 = read_shop_message(3, SHOP_NUM(top_shop), shop_f, buf2);
  1345:       shop_index[top_shop].missing_cash2 = read_shop_message(4, SHOP_NUM(top_shop), shop_f, buf2);
  1346:       shop_index[top_shop].message_buy = read_shop_message(5, SHOP_NUM(top_shop), shop_f, buf2);
  1347:       shop_index[top_shop].message_sell = read_shop_message(6, SHOP_NUM(top_shop), shop_f, buf2);
  1348:       read_line(shop_f, "%d", &SHOP_BROKE_TEMPER(top_shop));
  1349:       read_line(shop_f, "%ld", &SHOP_BITVECTOR(top_shop));
  1350:       read_line(shop_f, "%hd", &SHOP_KEEPER(top_shop));
  1351: 
  1352:       SHOP_KEEPER(top_shop) = real_mobile(SHOP_KEEPER(top_shop));
  1353:       read_line(shop_f, "%d", &SHOP_TRADE_WITH(top_shop));
  1354: 
  1355:       temp = read_list(shop_f, list, new_format, 1, LIST_ROOM);
  1356:       CREATE(shop_index[top_shop].in_room, room_vnum, temp);
  1357:       for (count = 0; count < temp; count++)
  1358: 	SHOP_ROOM(top_shop, count) = BUY_TYPE(list[count]);
  1359: 
  1360:       read_line(shop_f, "%d", &SHOP_OPEN1(top_shop));
  1361:       read_line(shop_f, "%d", &SHOP_CLOSE1(top_shop));
  1362:       read_line(shop_f, "%d", &SHOP_OPEN2(top_shop));
  1363:       read_line(shop_f, "%d", &SHOP_CLOSE2(top_shop));
  1364: 
  1365:       SHOP_BANK(top_shop) = 0;
  1366:       SHOP_SORT(top_shop) = 0;
  1367:       SHOP_FUNC(top_shop) = NULL;
  1368:     } else {
  1369:       if (*buf == '$')		/* EOF */
  1370: 	done = TRUE;
  1371:       else if (strstr(buf, VERSION3_TAG))	/* New format marker */
  1372: 	new_format = TRUE;
  1373:       free(buf);		/* Plug memory leak! */
  1374:     }
  1375:   }
  1376: }

  1378: void assign_the_shopkeepers(void)
  1379: {
  1380:   int cindex;
  1381: 
  1382:   cmd_say = find_command("say");
  1383:   cmd_tell = find_command("tell");
  1384:   cmd_emote = find_command("emote");
  1385:   cmd_slap = find_command("slap");
  1386:   cmd_puke = find_command("puke");
  1387: 
  1388:   for (cindex = 0; cindex <= top_shop; cindex++) {
  1389:     if (SHOP_KEEPER(cindex) == NOBODY)
  1390:       continue;
  1391: 
  1392:     if (SHOP_KEEPER(cindex) > top_of_mobt) {
  1393:     	log ("shop %d had mob out of bounds", cindex);
  1394:     	abort();
  1395:     }
  1396: 
  1397: 
  1398:     /* Having SHOP_FUNC() as 'shop_keeper' will cause infinite recursion. */
  1399:     if (mob_index[SHOP_KEEPER(cindex)].func && mob_index[SHOP_KEEPER(cindex)].func != shop_keeper)
  1400:       SHOP_FUNC(cindex) = mob_index[SHOP_KEEPER(cindex)].func;
  1401: 
  1402:     mob_index[SHOP_KEEPER(cindex)].func = shop_keeper;
  1403: 
  1404:   }
  1405: }

  1407: static char *customer_string(int shop_nr, int detailed)
  1408: {
  1409:   int sindex = 0, flag = 1, nlen;
  1410:   size_t len = 0;
  1411:   static char buf[256];
  1412: 
  1413:   while (*trade_letters[sindex] != '\n' && len + 1 < sizeof(buf)) {
  1414:     if (detailed) {
  1415:       if (!IS_SET(flag, SHOP_TRADE_WITH(shop_nr))) {
  1416: 	nlen = snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len, ", %s", trade_letters[sindex]);
  1417: 
  1418:         if (len + nlen >= sizeof(buf) || nlen < 0)
  1419:           break;
  1420: 
  1421:         len += nlen;
  1422:       }
  1423:     } else {
  1424:       buf[len++] = (IS_SET(flag, SHOP_TRADE_WITH(shop_nr)) ? '_' : *trade_letters[sindex]);
  1425:       buf[len] = '\0';
  1426: 
  1427:       if (len >= sizeof(buf))
  1428:         break;
  1429:     }
  1430: 
  1431:     sindex++;
  1432:     flag <<= 1;
  1433:   }
  1434: 
  1435:   buf[sizeof(buf) - 1] = '\0';
  1436:   return (buf);
  1437: }

  1439: /* END_OF inefficient */
  1440: static void list_all_shops(struct char_data *ch)
  1441: {
  1442:   const char *list_all_shops_header =
  1443: 	" ##   Virtual   Where    Keeper    Buy   Sell   Customers\r\n"
  1444: 	"---------------------------------------------------------\r\n";
  1445:   int shop_nr, headerlen = strlen(list_all_shops_header);
  1446:   size_t len = 0;
  1447:   char buf[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], buf1[16];
  1448: 
  1449:   *buf = '\0';
  1450:   for (shop_nr = 0; shop_nr <= top_shop && len < sizeof(buf); shop_nr++) {
  1451:     /* New page in page_string() mechanism, print the header again. */
  1452:     if (!(shop_nr % (PAGE_LENGTH - 2))) {
  1453:       /*
  1454:        * If we don't have enough room for the header, or all we have room left
  1455:        * for is the header, then don't add it and just quit now.
  1456:        */
  1457:       if (len + headerlen + 1 >= sizeof(buf))
  1458:         break;
  1459:       strcpy(buf + len, list_all_shops_header);	/* strcpy: OK (length checked above) */
  1460:       len += headerlen;
  1461:     }
  1462: 
  1463:     if (SHOP_KEEPER(shop_nr) == NOBODY)
  1464:       strcpy(buf1, "<NONE>");	/* strcpy: OK (for 'buf1 >= 7') */
  1465:     else
  1466:       sprintf(buf1, "%6d", mob_index[SHOP_KEEPER(shop_nr)].vnum);	/* sprintf: OK (for 'buf1 >= 11', 32-bit int) */
  1467: 
  1468:     len += snprintf(buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len,
  1469:         "%3d   %6d   %6d    %s   %3.2f   %3.2f    %s\r\n",
  1470:         shop_nr + 1, SHOP_NUM(shop_nr), SHOP_ROOM(shop_nr, 0), buf1,
  1471:         SHOP_SELLPROFIT(shop_nr), SHOP_BUYPROFIT(shop_nr),
  1472:         customer_string(shop_nr, FALSE));
  1473:   }
  1474: 
  1475:   page_string(ch->desc, buf, TRUE);
  1476: }

  1478: static void list_detailed_shop(struct char_data *ch, int shop_nr)
  1479: {
  1480:   struct char_data *k;
  1481:   int sindex, column, flag = 1, found = 0;

  1499:     else
  1500:       linelen = snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "<UNKNOWN> (#%d)", SHOP_ROOM(shop_nr, sindex));
  1501: 
  1502:     /* Implementing word-wrapping: assumes screen-size == 80 */
  1503:     if (linelen + column >= 78 && column >= 20) {
  1504:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n            ");
  1505:       /* 12 is to line up with "Rooms:" printed first, and spaces above. */

  1531:   column = 12;  /* ^^^ strlen ^^^ */
  1532:   for (sindex = 0; *trade_letters[sindex] != '\n'; sindex++) {
  1533:     char buf1[128];
  1534:     int linelen;
  1535:

  1539:         column += 2;
  1540:       }
  1541:       linelen = snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "%s", trade_letters[sindex]);

  1544:         send_to_char(ch, "\r\n            ");

  1549:         return;

  1627: void show_shops(struct char_data *ch, char *arg)
  1628: {
  1629:   int shop_nr;
  1630: 
  1631:   if (!*arg)
  1632:     list_all_shops(ch);
  1633:   else {
  1634:     if (!str_cmp(arg, ".")) {
  1635:       for (shop_nr = 0; shop_nr <= top_shop; shop_nr++)
  1636: 	if (ok_shop_room(shop_nr, GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch))))
  1637: 	  break;
  1638: 
  1639:       if (shop_nr > top_shop) {
  1640: 	send_to_char(ch, "This isn't a shop!\r\n");
  1641: 	return;
  1642:       }
  1643:     } else if (is_number(arg))
  1644:       shop_nr = real_shop(atoi(arg));
  1645:     else
  1646:       shop_nr = -1;
  1647: 
  1648:     if (shop_nr < 0 || shop_nr > top_shop) {
  1649:       send_to_char(ch, "Illegal shop number.\r\n");
  1650:       return;
  1651:     }
  1652:     list_detailed_shop(ch, shop_nr);
  1653:   }
  1654: }
  1655: 
  1656: void destroy_shops(void)
  1657: {
  1658:   ssize_t cnt, itr;
  1659: 
  1660:   if (!shop_index)
  1661:     return;
  1662: 
  1663:   for (cnt = 0; cnt <= top_shop; cnt++) {
  1664:     if (shop_index[cnt].no_such_item1)
  1665:       free(shop_index[cnt].no_such_item1);
  1666:     if (shop_index[cnt].no_such_item2)
  1667:       free(shop_index[cnt].no_such_item2);
  1668:     if (shop_index[cnt].missing_cash1)
  1669:       free(shop_index[cnt].missing_cash1);
  1670:     if (shop_index[cnt].missing_cash2)
  1671:       free(shop_index[cnt].missing_cash2);
  1672:     if (shop_index[cnt].do_not_buy)
  1673:       free(shop_index[cnt].do_not_buy);
  1674:     if (shop_index[cnt].message_buy)
  1675:       free(shop_index[cnt].message_buy);
  1676:     if (shop_index[cnt].message_sell)
  1677:       free(shop_index[cnt].message_sell);
  1678:     if (shop_index[cnt].in_room)
  1679:       free(shop_index[cnt].in_room);
  1680:     if (shop_index[cnt].producing)
  1681:       free(shop_index[cnt].producing);
  1682: 
  1683:     if (shop_index[cnt].type) {
  1684:       for (itr = 0; BUY_TYPE(shop_index[cnt].type[itr]) != NOTHING; itr++)
  1685:         if (BUY_WORD(shop_index[cnt].type[itr]))
  1686:           free(BUY_WORD(shop_index[cnt].type[itr]));
  1687:       free(shop_index[cnt].type);
  1688:     }
  1689:   }
  1690: 
  1691:   free(shop_index);
  1692:   shop_index = NULL;
  1693:   top_shop = -1;
  1694: }

  1706: static bool shopping_inspect_item(char *arg, struct char_data *ch, struct char_data *keeper, int shop_nr, const char *no_arg_msg)
  1707: {
  1708:   char buy_buf[64], sell_buf[64];
  1709:   struct obj_data *obj;
  1710: 
  1711:   if (!is_ok(keeper, ch, shop_nr))
  1712:     return FALSE;
  1713: 
  1714:   if (SHOP_SORT(shop_nr) < IS_CARRYING_N(keeper))
  1715:     sort_keeper_objs(keeper, shop_nr);
  1716: 
  1717:   if (!*arg) {
  1718:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", no_arg_msg);
  1719:     return TRUE;
  1720:   }
  1721: 
  1722:   if (!(obj = get_purchase_obj(ch, arg, keeper, shop_nr, FALSE))) {
  1723:     send_to_char(ch, "That item is not sold here.\r\n");
  1724:     return TRUE;
  1725:   }
  1726: 
  1727:   shop_format_price(buy_buf, sizeof(buy_buf), buy_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch));
  1728:   shop_format_price(sell_buf, sizeof(sell_buf), sell_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch));
  1729: 
  1730:   act("You take a closer look at $p.", FALSE, ch, obj, keeper, TO_CHAR);
  1731:   send_to_char(ch, "Shop Price: %s%s%s (sell value: %s%s%s)\r\n",
  1732:                QYEL, buy_buf, QNRM,
  1733:                QYEL, sell_buf, QNRM);
  1734:   show_identify_item(ch, obj, IDENTIFY_FULL);
  1735:   return TRUE;
  1736: }
  1737: 
  1738: static bool find_shopkeeper_for_room(struct char_data *ch, struct char_data **keeper_out, int *shop_nr_out)
  1739: {
  1740:   struct char_data *keeper;
  1741:   int shop_nr;
  1742: 
  1743:   if (!ch || !keeper_out || !shop_nr_out || IN_ROOM(ch) == NOWHERE)
  1744:     return FALSE;
  1745: 
  1746:   for (keeper = world[IN_ROOM(ch)].people; keeper; keeper = keeper->next_in_room) {
  1747:     if (!IS_MOB(keeper) || GET_MOB_RNUM(keeper) == NOBODY)
  1748:       continue;
  1749:     if (mob_index[GET_MOB_RNUM(keeper)].func != shop_keeper)
  1750:       continue;
  1751: 
  1752:     for (shop_nr = 0; shop_nr <= top_shop; shop_nr++) {
  1753:       if (SHOP_KEEPER(shop_nr) != keeper->nr)
  1754:         continue;
  1755:       if (ok_shop_room(shop_nr, GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch)))) {
  1756:         *keeper_out = keeper;
  1757:         *shop_nr_out = shop_nr;
  1758:         return TRUE;
  1759:       }
  1760:     }
  1761:   }
  1762: 
  1763:   return FALSE;
  1764: }
  1765: 
  1766: ACMD(do_shopdisc)
  1767: {
  1768:   char arg[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH], price_buf[64];
  1769:   struct char_data *keeper = NULL;
  1770:   struct obj_data *obj = NULL;
  1771:   int shop_nr = -1, i;
  1772:   const int samples[] = { 10, 13, 18, 25 };
  1773: 
  1774:   if (IS_NPC(ch))
  1775:     return;
  1776: 
  1777:   if (!find_shopkeeper_for_room(ch, &keeper, &shop_nr)) {
  1778:     send_to_char(ch, "You must be in a shop to use that command.\r\n");
  1779:     return;
  1780:   }
  1781: 
  1782:   one_argument(argument, arg);
  1783: 
  1784:   if (!*arg) {
  1785:     send_to_char(ch, "Usage: shopdisc <item keyword>\r\n");
  1786:     return;
  1787:   }
  1788: 
  1789:   if (!is_ok(keeper, ch, shop_nr))
  1790:     return;
  1791: 
  1792:   if (!(obj = get_purchase_obj(ch, arg, keeper, shop_nr, TRUE)))
  1793:     return;
  1794: 
  1795:   send_to_char(ch, "Item: %s\r\n", obj->short_description ? obj->short_description : obj->name);
  1796: 
  1797:   {
  1798:     int saved_cha = ch->aff_abils.cha;
  1799: 
  1800:     for (i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof(samples) / sizeof(samples[0])); i++) {
  1801:       long price_gold;
  1802:       int price;
  1803: 
  1804:       ch->aff_abils.cha = samples[i];
  1805:       price = buy_price(obj, shop_nr, keeper, ch);
  1806:       price_gold = shop_units_to_gold((long long)price);
  1807: 
  1808:       shop_format_price(price_buf, sizeof(price_buf), price_gold);
  1809:       send_to_char(ch, "CHA %2d price %s\r\n", samples[i], price_buf);
  1810:     }
  1811: 
  1812:     ch->aff_abils.cha = saved_cha;
  1813:   }
  1814: }
  1815: 
  1816: ACMD(do_appraise)
  1817: {
  1818:   struct char_data *keeper = NULL;
  1819:   int shop_nr = -1;
  1820: 
  1821:   if (!*argument) {
  1822:     send_to_char(ch, "Appraise what?\r\n");
  1823:     return;
  1824:   }
  1825: 
  1826:   if (!find_shopkeeper_for_room(ch, &keeper, &shop_nr)) {
  1827:     send_to_char(ch, "There is no shopkeeper here to appraise that for you.\r\n");
  1828:     return;
  1829:   }
  1830: 
  1831:   (void)shopping_appraise(argument, ch, keeper, shop_nr);
  1832: }

   369: /***
   370:  **Possible Targets:
   371:  **  TAR_IGNORE    : IGNORE TARGET.
   372:  **  TAR_CHAR_ROOM : PC/NPC in room.
   373:  **  TAR_CHAR_WORLD: PC/NPC in world.
   374:  **  TAR_FIGHT_SELF: If fighting, and no argument, select tar_char as self.
   375:  **  TAR_FIGHT_VICT: If fighting, and no argument, select tar_char as victim (fighting).
   376:  **  TAR_SELF_ONLY : If no argument, select self, if argument check that it IS self.
   377:  **  TAR_NOT_SELF  : Target is anyone else besides self.
   378:  **  TAR_OBJ_INV   : Object in inventory.
   379:  **  TAR_OBJ_ROOM  : Object in room.
   380:  **  TAR_OBJ_WORLD : Object in world.
   381:  **  TAR_OBJ_EQUIP : Object held.
   382:  ***/
   383: #define TAR_IGNORE      (1 << 0)
   384: #define TAR_CHAR_ROOM   (1 << 1)
   385: #define TAR_CHAR_WORLD  (1 << 2)
   386: #define TAR_FIGHT_SELF  (1 << 3)
   387: #define TAR_FIGHT_VICT  (1 << 4)
   388: #define TAR_SELF_ONLY   (1 << 5) /* Only a check, use with i.e. TAR_CHAR_ROOM */
   389: #define TAR_NOT_SELF   	(1 << 6) /* Only a check, use with i.e. TAR_CHAR_ROOM */
   390: #define TAR_OBJ_INV     (1 << 7)
   391: #define TAR_OBJ_ROOM    (1 << 8)
   392: #define TAR_OBJ_WORLD   (1 << 9)
   393: #define TAR_OBJ_EQUIP	  (1 << 10)
   394: 
   395: struct spell_info_type {
   396:    byte min_position;	/* Position for caster	 */
   397:    int mana_min;	/* Min amount of mana used by a spell (highest lev) */
   398:    int mana_max;	/* Max amount of mana used by a spell (lowest lev) */
   399:    int mana_change;	/* Change in mana used by spell from lev to lev */
   400: 
   401:    int min_level[MAX_CLASSES];
   402:    int routines;
   403:    byte violent;
   404:    int targets;         /* See below for use with TAR_XXX  */
   405:    const char *name;	/* Input size not limited. Originates from string constants. */
   406:    const char *wear_off_msg;	/* Input size not limited. Originates from string constants. */
   407: };
   408: 
   409: /* Possible Targets:
   410:    bit 0 : IGNORE TARGET
   411:    bit 1 : PC/NPC in room
   412:    bit 2 : PC/NPC in world
   413:    bit 3 : Object held
   414:    bit 4 : Object in inventory
   415:    bit 5 : Object in room
   416:    bit 6 : Object in world
   417:    bit 7 : If fighting, and no argument, select tar_char as self
   418:    bit 8 : If fighting, and no argument, select tar_char as victim (fighting)
   419:    bit 9 : If no argument, select self, if argument check that it IS self. */
   420: #define SPELL_TYPE_SPELL   0
   421: #define SPELL_TYPE_POTION  1
   422: #define SPELL_TYPE_WAND    2
   423: #define SPELL_TYPE_STAFF   3
   424: #define SPELL_TYPE_SCROLL  4

   631: 
   632: /** OPT_USEC determines how many commands will be processed by the MUD per
   633:  * second and how frequently it does socket I/O.  A low setting will cause
   634:  * actions to be executed more frequently but will increase overhead due to
   635:  * more cycling to check.  A high setting (e.g. 1 Hz) may upset your players
   636:  * as actions (such as large speedwalking chains) take longer to be executed.
   637:  * You shouldn't need to adjust this.
   638:  * This will equate to 10 passes per second.
   639:  * @see PASSES_PER_SEC
   640:  * @see RL_SEC
   641:  */
   642: #define OPT_USEC	100000
   643: /** How many heartbeats equate to one real second.
   644:  * @see OPT_USEC
   645:  * @see RL_SEC
   646:  */
   647: #define PASSES_PER_SEC	(1000000 / OPT_USEC)
   648: /** Used with other macros to define at how many heartbeats a control loop
   649:  * gets executed. Helps to translate pulse counts to real seconds for
   650:  * human comprehension.
   651:  * @see PASSES_PER_SEC
   652:  */
   653: #define RL_SEC		* PASSES_PER_SEC
   654: 
   655: /** Controls when a zone update will occur. */
   656: #define PULSE_ZONE      (10 RL_SEC)
   657: /** Controls when mobile (NPC) actions and updates will occur. */
   658: #define PULSE_MOBILE    (10 RL_SEC)
   659: /** Controls the time between turns of combat. */
   660: #define PULSE_VIOLENCE  ( 2 RL_SEC)
   661: /** Controls when characters and houses (if implemented) will be autosaved.
   662:  * @see CONFIG_AUTO_SAVE
   663:  */
   664: #define PULSE_AUTOSAVE  (60 RL_SEC)
   665: /** Controls when checks are made for idle name and password CON_ states */
   666: #define PULSE_IDLEPWD   (15 RL_SEC)
   667: /** Currently unused. */
   668: #define PULSE_SANITY    (30 RL_SEC)
   669: /** How often to log # connected sockets and # active players.
   670:  * Currently set for 5 minutes.
   671:  */
   672: #define PULSE_USAGE     (5 * 60 RL_SEC)
   673: /** Controls when to save the current ingame MUD time to disk.

   675: #define PULSE_TIMESAVE	(30 * 60 RL_SEC)

   748: /** Bitvector type for 32 bit unsigned long bitvectors. 'unsigned long long'
   749:  * will give you at least 64 bits if you have GCC. You'll have to search
   750:  * throughout the code for "bitvector_t" and change them yourself if you'd
   751:  * like this extra flexibility. */
   752: typedef unsigned long int bitvector_t;

   754: /** Extra description: used in objects, mobiles, and rooms. For example,
   755:  * a 'look hair' might pull up an extra description (if available) for
   756:  * the mob, object or room.
   757:  * Multiple extra descriptions on the same object are implemented as a
   758:  * linked list. */

  1630: /**
  1631:  Main Game Configuration Structure.
  1632:  Global variables that can be changed within the game are held within this
  1633:  structure. During gameplay, elements within this structure can be altered,
  1634:  thus affecting the gameplay immediately, and avoiding the need to recompile
  1635:  the code.
  1636:  If changes are made to values of the elements of this structure during game
  1637:  play, the information will be saved to disk.
  1638:  */
  1639: struct config_data
  1640: {
  1641:   /** Path to on-disk file where the config_data structure gets written. */
  1642:   char *CONFFILE;
  1643:   /** In-game specific global settings, such as allowing player killing. */
  1644:   struct game_data play;
  1645:   /** How is renting, crash files, and object saving handled? */
  1646:   struct crash_save_data csd;
  1647:   /** Special designated rooms, like start rooms, and donation rooms. */
  1648:   struct room_numbers room_nums;
  1649:   /** Basic operational settings, like max file sizes and max players. */
  1650:   struct game_operation operation;
  1651:   /** Autowiz specific settings, like turning it on and minimum level */
  1652:   struct autowiz_data autowiz;
  1653: };

    15: #include "genolc.h"
    16: #include "oasis.h"
    17: #include "improved-edit.h"
    18: #include "modify.h"
    19: 
    20: extern time_t motdmod;
    21: extern time_t newsmod;
    22: 
    23: void tedit_string_cleanup(struct descriptor_data *d, int terminator)
    24: {
    25:   FILE *fl;
    26:   char *storage = OLC_STORAGE(d);
    27: 
    28:   if (!storage)
    29:     terminator = STRINGADD_ABORT;
    30: 
    31:   switch (terminator) {
    32:   case STRINGADD_SAVE:
    33:     if (!(fl = fopen(storage, "w")))
    34:       mudlog(CMP, LVL_IMPL, TRUE, "SYSERR: Can't write file '%s'.", storage);
    35:     else {
    36:       if (*d->str) {
    37:         strip_cr(*d->str);
    38:         fputs(*d->str, fl);
    39:       }
    40:       fclose(fl);
    41:       mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_GOD, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE, "OLC: %s saves '%s'.", GET_NAME(d->character), storage);
    42:       write_to_output(d, "Saved.\r\n");
    43:       if (!strcmp(storage, NEWS_FILE))
    44:         newsmod = time(0);
    45:       if (!strcmp(storage, MOTD_FILE))
    46:         motdmod = time(0);
    47:     }
    48:     break;
    49:   case STRINGADD_ABORT:
    50:     write_to_output(d, "Edit aborted.\r\n");
    51:     act("$n stops editing some scrolls.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
    52:     break;
    53:   default:
    54:     log("SYSERR: tedit_string_cleanup: Unknown terminator status.");
    55:     break;
    56:   }
    57: 
    58:   /* Common cleanup code. */
    59:   cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
    60:   STATE(d) = CON_PLAYING;
    61: }
    62: 
    63: ACMD(do_tedit)
    64: {
    65:   int l, i = 0;
    66:   char field[MAX_INPUT_LENGTH];
    67:   char *backstr = NULL;
    68: 
    69:   struct {
    70:     char *cmd;
    71:     char level;
    72:     char **buffer;
    73:     int  size;
    74:     char *filename;
    75:   } fields[] = {
    76: 	/* edit the lvls to your own needs */
    77: 	{ "credits",	LVL_IMPL,	&credits,	2400,	CREDITS_FILE},
    78: 	{ "news",	LVL_GRGOD,	&news,		8192,	NEWS_FILE},
    79: 	{ "motd",	LVL_GRGOD,	&motd,		2400,	MOTD_FILE},
    80: 	{ "imotd",	LVL_IMPL,	&imotd,		2400,	IMOTD_FILE},
    81:         { "greetings",  LVL_IMPL,       &GREETINGS,     2400,   GREETINGS_FILE},
    82:         { "help",       LVL_GRGOD,      &help,          2400,   HELP_PAGE_FILE},
    83: 	{ "ihelp",      LVL_GRGOD,	&ihelp, 	2400,	IHELP_PAGE_FILE},
    84: 	{ "info",	LVL_GRGOD,	&info,		8192,	INFO_FILE},
    85: 	{ "background",	LVL_IMPL,	&background,	8192,	BACKGROUND_FILE},
    86: 	{ "handbook",   LVL_IMPL,	&handbook,	8192,   HANDBOOK_FILE},
    87: 	{ "policies",	LVL_IMPL,	&policies,	8192,	POLICIES_FILE},
    88:         { "wizlist",    LVL_IMPL,       &wizlist,       2400,   WIZLIST_FILE},
    89:         { "immlist",    LVL_GRGOD,      &immlist,       2400,   IMMLIST_FILE},
    90: 	{ "\n",		0,		NULL,		0,	NULL }
    91:   };
    92: 
    93:   if (ch->desc == NULL)
    94:     return;
    95: 
    96:   one_argument(argument, field);
    97: 
    98:   if (!*field) {
    99:     send_to_char(ch, "Files available to be edited:\r\n");
   100:     for (l = 0; *fields[l].cmd != '\n'; l++) {
   101:       if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= fields[l].level) {
   102: 	send_to_char(ch, "%-11.11s ", fields[l].cmd);
   103: 	if (!(++i % 7))
   104: 	  send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   105:       }
   106:     }
   107:     if (i % 7)
   108:       send_to_char(ch, "\r\n");
   109:     if (i == 0)
   110:       send_to_char(ch, "None.\r\n");
   111:     return;
   112:   }
   113:   for (l = 0; *(fields[l].cmd) != '\n'; l++)
   114:     if (!strncmp(field, fields[l].cmd, strlen(field)))
   115:       break;
   116: 
   117:   if (*fields[l].cmd == '\n') {
   118:     send_to_char(ch, "Invalid text editor option.\r\n");
   119:     return;
   120:   }
   121: 
   122:   if (GET_LEVEL(ch) < fields[l].level) {
   123:     send_to_char(ch, "You are not godly enough for that!\r\n");
   124:     return;
   125:   }
   126: 
   127:   /* set up editor stats */
   128:   clear_screen(ch->desc);
   129:   send_editor_help(ch->desc);
   130:   send_to_char(ch, "Edit file below:\r\n\r\n");
   131: 
   132:   if (ch->desc->olc) {
   133:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: do_tedit: Player already had olc structure.");
   134:     free(ch->desc->olc);
   135:   }
   136:   CREATE(ch->desc->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
   137: 
   138:   if (*fields[l].buffer) {
   139:     send_to_char(ch, "%s", *fields[l].buffer);
   140:     backstr = strdup(*fields[l].buffer);
   141:   }
   142: 
   143:   OLC_STORAGE(ch->desc) = strdup(fields[l].filename);
   144:   string_write(ch->desc, (char **)fields[l].buffer, fields[l].size, 0, backstr);
   145: 
   146:   act("$n begins editing a scroll.", TRUE, ch, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   147:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   148:   STATE(ch->desc) = CON_TEDIT;
   149: }

   157: void convert(char *filename)
   158: {
   159:   FILE *fl, *outfile, *index_file;
   160:   struct char_file_u_plrtoascii player;
   161:   char index_name[40], outname[40], bits[127];
   162:   int i, j;
   163:   struct char_special_data_saved_plrtoascii *csds;
   164:   struct player_special_data_saved_plrtoascii *psds;
   165:   struct char_ability_data_plrtoascii *cad;
   166:   struct char_point_data_plrtoascii *cpd;
   167:   struct affected_type_plrtoascii *aff;
   168: 
   169:   if (!(fl = fopen(filename, "r+"))) {
   170:     perror("error opening playerfile");
   171:     exit(1);
   172:   }
   173:   sprintf(index_name, "%s%s", LIB_PLRFILES, INDEX_FILE);
   174:   if (!(index_file = fopen(index_name, "w"))) {
   175:     perror("error opening index file");
   176:     exit(1);
   177:   }
   178:   for (;;) {
   179:     j = fread(&player, sizeof(struct char_file_u_plrtoascii), 1, fl);
   180:     if (feof(fl)) {
   181:       fclose(fl);
   182:       fclose(index_file);
   183:       exit(1);
   184:     }
   185: 
   186:     if (!plr_filename(player.name, outname))
   187:       exit(1);
   188:     printf("writing: %s\n", outname);
   189: 
   190:     fprintf(index_file, "%ld %s %d 0 %ld\n", 
   191: 	player.char_specials_saved.idnum, bits, player.level,
   192: 	(long)player.last_logon);
   193: 
   194:     if (!(outfile = fopen(outname, "w"))) {
   195:       printf("error opening output file");
   196:       exit(1);
   197:     }
   198: 
   199: /* char_file_u */
   200:     fprintf(outfile, "Name: %s\n", player.name);
   201:     fprintf(outfile, "Pass: %s\n", player.pwd);
   202:     fprintf(outfile, "Titl: %s\n", player.title);
   203:     if (*player.description)
   204:       fprintf(outfile, "Desc:\n%s~\n", player.description);
   205:     if (player.sex != PFDEF_SEX)
   206:       fprintf(outfile, "Sex : %d\n", (int)player.sex); 
   207:     if (player.chclass != PFDEF_CLASS)
   208:       fprintf(outfile, "Clas: %d\n", (int)player.chclass); 
   209:     if (player.level != PFDEF_LEVEL)
   210:       fprintf(outfile, "Levl: %d\n", (int)player.level); 
   211:     fprintf(outfile, "Brth: %d\n", (int)player.birth);
   212:     fprintf(outfile, "Plyd: %d\n", (int)player.played);
   213:     fprintf(outfile, "Last: %d\n", (int)player.last_logon);
   214:     fprintf(outfile, "Host: %s\n", player.host);
   215:     if (player.height != PFDEF_HEIGHT)
   216:       fprintf(outfile, "Hite: %d\n", (int)player.height);
   217:     if (player.weight != PFDEF_WEIGHT)
   218:       fprintf(outfile, "Wate: %d\n", (int)player.weight);
   219: 
   220: /* char_special_data_saved */
   221:     csds = &(player.char_specials_saved);
   222:     if (csds->alignment != PFDEF_ALIGNMENT)
   223:       fprintf(outfile, "Alin: %d\n", csds->alignment);
   224:     fprintf(outfile, "Id  : %d\n", (int)csds->idnum);
   225:     if (csds->act != PFDEF_PLRFLAGS)
   226:       fprintf(outfile, "Act : %d\n", (int)csds->act);
   227:     if (csds->affected_by != PFDEF_AFFFLAGS) {
   228:       sprintascii(bits, csds->affected_by);
   229:       fprintf(outfile, "Aff : %s\n", bits);
   230:     }
   231:     if (csds->apply_saving_throw[0] != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)
   232:       fprintf(outfile, "Thr1: %d\n", csds->apply_saving_throw[0]);
   233:     if (csds->apply_saving_throw[1] != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)
   234:       fprintf(outfile, "Thr2: %d\n", csds->apply_saving_throw[1]);
   235:     if (csds->apply_saving_throw[2] != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)
   236:       fprintf(outfile, "Thr3: %d\n", csds->apply_saving_throw[2]);
   237:     if (csds->apply_saving_throw[3] != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)
   238:       fprintf(outfile, "Thr4: %d\n", csds->apply_saving_throw[3]);
   239:     if (csds->apply_saving_throw[4] != PFDEF_SAVETHROW)
   240:       fprintf(outfile, "Thr5: %d\n", csds->apply_saving_throw[4]);
   241: 
   242: /* player_special_data_saved */
   243:     psds = &(player.player_specials_saved);
   244:     if (player.level < LVL_IMMORT) {
   245:       fprintf(outfile, "Skil:\n");
   246:       for (i = 1; i <= PLRTOASCII_LEGACY_MAX_SKILLS; i++) {
   247: 	if (psds->skills[i])
   248: 	  fprintf(outfile, "%d %d\n", i, (int)psds->skills[i]);
   249:       }
   250:       fprintf(outfile, "0 0\n");
   251:     }
   252:     if (psds->wimp_level != PFDEF_WIMPLEV)
   253:       fprintf(outfile, "Wimp: %d\n", psds->wimp_level);
   254:     if (psds->freeze_level != PFDEF_FREEZELEV)
   255:       fprintf(outfile, "Frez: %d\n", (int)psds->freeze_level);
   256:     if (psds->invis_level != PFDEF_INVISLEV)
   257:       fprintf(outfile, "Invs: %d\n", (int)psds->invis_level);
   258:     if (psds->load_room != PFDEF_LOADROOM)
   259:       fprintf(outfile, "Room: %d\n", (int)psds->load_room);
   260:     if (psds->pref != PFDEF_PREFFLAGS) {
   261:       sprintascii(bits, psds->pref);
   262:       fprintf(outfile, "Pref: %s\n", bits);
   263:     }
   264:     if (psds->conditions[HUNGER] && player.level < LVL_IMMORT &&
   265: 	psds->conditions[HUNGER] != PFDEF_HUNGER)
   266:       fprintf(outfile, "Hung: %d\n", (int)psds->conditions[0]);
   267:     if (psds->conditions[THIRST] && player.level < LVL_IMMORT &&
   268: 	psds->conditions[THIRST] != PFDEF_THIRST)
   269:       fprintf(outfile, "Thir: %d\n", (int)psds->conditions[1]);
   270:     if (psds->conditions[2] && player.level < LVL_IMMORT &&
   271: 	psds->conditions[DRUNK] != PFDEF_DRUNK)
   272:       fprintf(outfile, "Drnk: %d\n", (int)psds->conditions[2]);
   273:     if (psds->spells_to_learn != PFDEF_PRACTICES)
   274:       fprintf(outfile, "Lern: %d\n", (int)psds->spells_to_learn);
   275:     if (psds->trains != PFDEF_TRAINS)
   276:       fprintf(outfile, "Trns: %d\n", psds->trains);
   277: 
   278: /* char_ability_data */
   279:     cad = &(player.abilities);
   280:     if (cad->str != PFDEF_STR || cad->str_add != PFDEF_STRADD)
   281:       fprintf(outfile, "Str : %d/%d\n", cad->str, cad->str_add);
   282:     if (cad->intel != PFDEF_INT)
   283:       fprintf(outfile, "Int : %d\n", cad->intel);
   284:     if (cad->wis != PFDEF_WIS)
   285:       fprintf(outfile, "Wis : %d\n", cad->wis);
   286:     if (cad->dex != PFDEF_DEX)
   287:       fprintf(outfile, "Dex : %d\n", cad->dex);
   288:     if (cad->con != PFDEF_CON)
   289:       fprintf(outfile, "Con : %d\n", cad->con);
   290:     if (cad->cha != PFDEF_CHA)
   291:       fprintf(outfile, "Cha : %d\n", cad->cha);
   292: 
   293: /* char_point_data */
   294:     cpd = &(player.points);
   295:     if (cpd->hit != PFDEF_HIT || cpd->max_hit != PFDEF_MAXHIT)
   296:       fprintf(outfile, "Hit : %d/%d\n", cpd->hit, cpd->max_hit);
   297:     if (cpd->mana != PFDEF_MANA || cpd->max_mana != PFDEF_MAXMANA)
   298:       fprintf(outfile, "Mana: %d/%d\n", cpd->mana, cpd->max_mana);
   299:     if (cpd->move != PFDEF_MOVE || cpd->max_move != PFDEF_MAXMOVE)
   300:       fprintf(outfile, "Move: %d/%d\n", cpd->move, cpd->max_move);
   301:     if (cpd->armor != PFDEF_AC)
   302:       fprintf(outfile, "Ac  : %d\n", cpd->armor);
   303:     if (cpd->gold != PFDEF_GOLD)
   304:       fprintf(outfile, "Gold: %d\n", cpd->gold);
   305:     if (cpd->bank_gold != PFDEF_BANK)
   306:       fprintf(outfile, "Bank: %d\n", cpd->bank_gold);
   307:     if (cpd->exp != PFDEF_EXP)
   308:       fprintf(outfile, "Exp : %d\n", cpd->exp);
   309:     if (cpd->hitroll != PFDEF_HITROLL)
   310:       fprintf(outfile, "Hrol: %d\n", cpd->hitroll);
   311:     if (cpd->damroll != PFDEF_DAMROLL)
   312:       fprintf(outfile, "Drol: %d\n", cpd->damroll);
   313: 
   314: /* affected_type */
   315:     fprintf(outfile, "Affs:\n");
   316:     for (i = 0; i < MAX_AFFECT; i++) {
   317:       aff = &(player.affected[i]);
   318:       if (aff->type)
   319: 	fprintf(outfile, "%d %d %d %d %d\n", aff->type, aff->duration,
   320: 	  aff->modifier, aff->location, (int)aff->bitvector);
   321:     }
   322:     fprintf(outfile, "0 0 0 0 0\n");
   323: 
   324:     fclose(outfile);
   325:   }
   326: }
   327: 
   328: 
   329: int main(int argc, char **argv)
   330: {
   331:   if (argc != 2)
   332:     printf("Usage: %s playerfile-name\n", argv[0]);
   333:   else
   334:     convert(argv[1]);
   335: 
   336:   return 0;
   337: }
   338: 
   339: 
   340: int sprintascii(char *out, bitvector_t bits)
   341: {
   342:   int i, j = 0;
   343:   /* 32 bits, don't just add letters to try to get more unless your bitvector_t is also as large. */
   344:   char *flags = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEF";
   345: 
   346:   for (i = 0; flags[i] != '\0'; i++)
   347:     if (bits & (1 << i))
   348:       out[j++] = flags[i];
   349: 
   350:   if (j == 0) /* Didn't write anything. */
   351:     out[j++] = '0';
   352: 
   353:   /* NUL terminate the output string. */
   354:   out[j++] = '\0';
   355:   return j;
   356: }
   357: 
   358: 
   359: int plr_filename(char *orig_name, char *filename)
   360: {
   361:   const char *middle;
   362:   char name[64], *ptr;
   363: 
   364:   if (orig_name == NULL || *orig_name == '\0' || filename == NULL) {
   365:     perror("error getting player file name");
   366:     return (0);
   367:   }
   368: 
   369:   strcpy(name, orig_name);
   370:   for (ptr = name; *ptr; ptr++)
   371:     *ptr = LOWER(*ptr);
   372: 
   373:   switch (LOWER(*name)) {
   374:   case 'a':  case 'b':  case 'c':  case 'd':  case 'e':
   375:     middle = "A-E";
   376:     break;
   377:   case 'f':  case 'g':  case 'h':  case 'i':  case 'j':
   378:     middle = "F-J";
   379:     break;
   380:   case 'k':  case 'l':  case 'm':  case 'n':  case 'o':
   381:     middle = "K-O";
   382:     break;
   383:   case 'p':  case 'q':  case 'r':  case 's':  case 't':
   384:     middle = "P-T";
   385:     break;
   386:   case 'u':  case 'v':  case 'w':  case 'x':  case 'y':  case 'z':
   387:     middle = "U-Z";
   388:     break;
   389:   default:
   390:     middle = "ZZZ";
   391:     break;
   392:   }
   393: 
   394:   sprintf(filename, "%s%s"SLASH"%s.%s", LIB_PLRFILES, middle, name, SUF_PLR);
   395:   return (1);
   396: }
