   244: /** A calloc based memory allocation macro.
   245:  * @param result Pointer to created memory.
   246:  * @param type The type of memory (int, struct char_data, etc.).
   247:  * @param number How many of type to make. */
   248: #define CREATE(result, type, number)  do {\
   249: 	if ((number) * sizeof(type) <= 0)	\
   250: 		log("SYSERR: Zero bytes or less requested at %s:%d.", __FILE__, __LINE__);	\
   251: 	if (!((result) = (type *) calloc ((number), sizeof(type))))	\
   252: 		{ perror("SYSERR: malloc failure"); abort(); } } while(0)
   253: 
   254: /** A realloc based memory reallocation macro. Reminder: realloc can reduce
   255:  * the size of an array as well as increase it.
   256:  * @param result Pointer to created memory.
   257:  * @param type The type of memory (int, struct char_data, etc.).
   258:  * @param number How many of type to make. */
   259: #define RECREATE(result, type, number) do {\
   260:   if (!((result) = (type *) realloc ((result), sizeof(type) * (number))))\
   261: 		{ perror("SYSERR: realloc failure"); abort(); } } while(0)
   262: 
   263: /** Remove an item from a linked list and reset the links.
   264:  * If item is at the list head, change the head, else traverse the
   265:  * list looking for the item before the one to be removed.
   266:  * @pre Requires that a variable 'temp' be declared as the same type as the
   267:  * list to be manipulated.
   268:  * @post List pointers are correctly reset and item is no longer in the list.
   269:  * item can now be changed, removed, etc independently from the list it was in.
   270:  * @param item Pointer to item to remove from the list.
   271:  * @param head Pointer to the head of the linked list.
   272:  * @param next The variable name pointing to the next in the list.
   273:  * */
   274: #define REMOVE_FROM_LIST(item, head, next)	\
   275:    if ((item) == (head))		\
   276:       head = (item)->next;		\
   277:    else {				\
   278:       temp = head;			\
   279:       while (temp && (temp->next != (item))) \
   280: 	 temp = temp->next;		\
   281:       if (temp)				\
   282:          temp->next = (item)->next;	\
   283:    }					\
   284: 
   285: /* Connect 'link' to the end of a double-linked list
   286:  * The new item becomes the last in the linked list, and the last
   287:  * pointer is updated.
   288:  * @param link  Pointer to item to remove from the list.
   289:  * @param first Pointer to the first item of the linked list.
   290:  * @param last  Pointer to the last item of the linked list.
   291:  * @param next  The variable name pointing to the next in the list.
   292:  * @param prev  The variable name pointing to the previous in the list.
   293:  * */
   294: #define LINK(link, first, last, next, prev)                     \
   295: do                                                              \
   296: {                                                               \
   297:     if ( !(first) )                                             \
   298:       (first)                   = (link);                       \
   299:     else                                                        \
   300:       (last)->next              = (link);                       \
   301:     (link)->next                = NULL;                         \
   302:     (link)->prev                = (last);                       \
   303:     (last)                      = (link);                       \
   304: } while(0)
   305: 
   306: /* Remove 'link' from a double-linked list
   307:  * @post  item is removed from the list, but remains in memory, and must
   308:    be free'd after unlinking.
   309:  * @param link  Pointer to item to remove from the list.
   310:  * @param first Pointer to the first item of the linked list.
   311:  * @param last  Pointer to the last item of the linked list.
   312:  * @param next  The variable name pointing to the next in the list.
   313:  * @param prev  The variable name pointing to the previous in the list.
   314:  * */
   315: #define UNLINK(link, first, last, next, prev)                   \
   316: do                                                              \
   317: {                                                               \
   318:     if ( !(link)->prev )                                        \
   319:       (first)                   = (link)->next;                 \
   320:     else                                                        \
   321:       (link)->prev->next        = (link)->next;                 \
   322:     if ( !(link)->next )                                        \
   323:       (last)                    = (link)->prev;                 \
   324:     else                                                        \
   325:       (link)->next->prev        = (link)->prev;                 \
   326: } while(0)
   327: 
   328: /* Free a pointer, and log if it was NULL
   329:  * @param point The pointer to be free'd.
   330:  * */
   331: #define DISPOSE(point)                                          \
   332: do                                                              \
   333: {                                                               \
   334:   if (!(point))                                                 \
   335:   {                                                             \
   336:         log( "SYSERR: Freeing null pointer %s:%d", __FILE__, __LINE__ ); \
   337:   }                                                             \
   338:   else free(point);                                             \
   339:   point = NULL;                                                 \
   340: } while(0)
   341:

   343: /* Allocate memory for a string, and return a pointer
   344:  * @param point The string to be copied.
   345:  * */
   346: #define STRALLOC(point)         (strdup(point))
   347: /* Free allocated memory for a string
   348:  * @param point The string to be free'd.
   349:  * */
   350: #define STRFREE(point)          DISPOSE(point)

   352: /* basic bitvector utils */
   353: /** Return the bitarray field number x is in. */
   354: #define Q_FIELD(x)  ((int) (x) / 32)
   355: /** Return the bit to set in a bitarray field. */
   356: #define Q_BIT(x)    (1 << ((x) % 32))
   357: /** 1 if bit is set in the bitarray represented by var, 0 if not. */
   358: #define IS_SET_AR(var, bit)       ((var)[Q_FIELD(bit)] & Q_BIT(bit))
   359: /** Set a specific bit in the bitarray represented by var to 1. */
   360: #define SET_BIT_AR(var, bit)      ((var)[Q_FIELD(bit)] |= Q_BIT(bit))
   361: /** Unset a specific bit in the bitarray represented by var to 0. */
   362: #define REMOVE_BIT_AR(var, bit)   ((var)[Q_FIELD(bit)] &= ~Q_BIT(bit))
   363: /** If bit is on in bitarray var, turn it off; if it is off, turn it on. */
   364: #define TOGGLE_BIT_AR(var, bit)   ((var)[Q_FIELD(bit)] = (var)[Q_FIELD(bit)] ^ Q_BIT(bit))
   365: 
   366: /* Older, stock tbaMUD bit settings. */
   367: /** 1 if bit is set in flag, 0 if it is not set. */
   368: #define IS_SET(flag,bit)  ((flag) & (bit))
   369: /** Set a specific bit in var to 1. */
   370: #define SET_BIT(var,bit)  ((var) |= (bit))
   371: /** Set a specific bit bit in var to 0. */
   372: #define REMOVE_BIT(var,bit)  ((var) &= ~(bit))
   373: /** If bit in var is off, turn it on; if it is on, turn it off. */
   374: #define TOGGLE_BIT(var,bit) ((var) ^= (bit))

    39: ACMD(do_oasis_zedit)
    40: {
    41:   int number = NOWHERE, save = 0, real_num;
    42:   zone_rnum zone_num = NOWHERE;
    43:   zone_vnum zone_vnum = NOWHERE;
    44:   struct descriptor_data *d;
    45:   char *stop;
    46:   char sbot[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    47:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    48:   char buf2[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    49:   char buf3[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
    50:   room_vnum bottom, top;
    51: 
    52:   /* No building as a mob or while being forced. */
    53:   if (IS_NPC(ch) || !ch->desc || STATE(ch->desc) != CON_PLAYING)
    54:     return;
    55: 
    56:   /* Parse any arguments. */
    57:   stop = one_argument(two_arguments(argument, buf1, buf2), sbot);
    58:   one_argument(stop, buf3);
    59: 
    60:   /* If no argument was given, use the zone the builder is standing in. */
    61:   if (!*buf1)
    62:     number = GET_ROOM_VNUM(IN_ROOM(ch));
    63:   else if (!isdigit(*buf1)) {
    64:     if (str_cmp("save", buf1) == 0) {
    65:       save = TRUE;
    66: 
    67:       if (is_number(buf2))
    68:         number = atoidx(buf2);
    69:       else if (GET_OLC_ZONE(ch) > 0) {
    70:         zone_rnum zlok;
    71: 
    72:         if ((zlok = real_zone(GET_OLC_ZONE(ch))) == NOWHERE)
    73:           number = NOWHERE;
    74:         else
    75:           number = genolc_zone_bottom(zlok);
    76:       }
    77: 
    78:       if (number == NOWHERE) {
    79:         send_to_char(ch, "Save which zone?\r\n");
    80:         return;
    81:       }
    82:     } else if (!str_cmp("room", buf1)) {
    83:       if (!*buf2 || !is_number(buf2)) {
    84:         send_to_char(ch, "Usage:\r\n"
    85:                          "  zedit\r\n"
    86:                          "  zedit <zone vnum>\r\n"
    87:                          "  zedit room <room vnum>\r\n"
    88:                          "  zedit new <zone vnum> <bottom room> <top room>\r\n");
    89:         return;
    90:       }
    91: 
    92:       number = atoidx(buf2);
    93: 
    94:       if (number < 0 || real_room(number) == NOWHERE) {
    95:         send_to_char(ch, "Usage:\r\n"
    96:                          "  zedit\r\n"
    97:                          "  zedit <zone vnum>\r\n"
    98:                          "  zedit room <room vnum>\r\n"
    99:                          "  zedit new <zone vnum> <bottom room> <top room>\r\n");
   100:         return;
   101:       }
   102:     } else if (GET_LEVEL(ch) >= LVL_IMPL) {
   103:       if (str_cmp("new", buf1) || !stop || !*stop)
   104:         send_to_char(ch, "Usage:\r\n"
   105:                          "  zedit\r\n"
   106:                          "  zedit <zone vnum>\r\n"
   107:                          "  zedit room <room vnum>\r\n"
   108:                          "  zedit new <zone vnum> <bottom room> <top room>\r\n");
   109:       else {
   110:         if (atoi(stop) < 0 || atoi(sbot) < 0) {
   111:           send_to_char(ch, "Zones cannot contain negative vnums.\r\n");
   112:           return;
   113:         }
   114:         number = atoidx(buf2);
   115:         if (number < 0)
   116:           number = NOWHERE;
   117:         bottom = atoidx(sbot);
   118:         top = atoidx(stop);
   119: 
   120:         /* Setup the new zone (displays the menu to the builder). */
   121:         zedit_new_zone(ch, number, bottom, top);
   122:       }
   123: 
   124:       /* Done now, exit the function. */
   125:       return;
   126: 
   127:     } else {
   128:       send_to_char(ch, "Yikes!  Stop that, someone will get hurt!\r\n");
   129:       return;
   130:     }
   131:   }
   132: 
   133:   /* If a numeric argument was given, treat it as a zone vnum. */
   134:   if (number == NOWHERE) {
   135:     zone_vnum = atoidx(buf1);
   136:     zone_num = real_zone(zone_vnum);
   137:     if (zone_num == NOWHERE) {
   138:       send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, there is no zone for that number!\r\n");
   139:       return;
   140:     }
   141: 
   142:     number = zone_table[zone_num].bot;
   143:   }
   144: 
   145:   /* Check that nobody is currently editing this zone. */
   146:   for (d = descriptor_list; d; d = d->next) {
   147:     if (STATE(d) == CON_ZEDIT) {
   148:       if (d->olc && OLC_NUM(d) == number) {
   149:         send_to_char(ch, "That zone is currently being edited by %s.\r\n",
   150:           PERS(d->character, ch));
   151:         return;
   152:       }
   153:     }
   154:   }
   155: 
   156:   /* Store the builder's descriptor in d. */
   157:   d = ch->desc;
   158: 
   159:   /* Give the builder's descriptor an OLC structure. */
   160:   if (d->olc) {
   161:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_IMMORT, TRUE, "SYSERR: do_oasis_zedit: Player already "
   162:       "had olc structure.");
   163:     free(d->olc);
   164:   }
   165: 
   166:   CREATE(d->olc, struct oasis_olc_data, 1);
   167: 
   168:   /* Find the zone. */
   169:   if (save)
   170:     OLC_ZNUM(d) = real_zone(number);
   171:   else if (!str_cmp("room", buf1))
   172:     OLC_ZNUM(d) = real_zone_by_thing(number);
   173:   else if (*buf1)
   174:     OLC_ZNUM(d) = real_zone(zone_vnum);
   175:   else
   176:     OLC_ZNUM(d) = real_zone_by_thing(number);
   177:   if (OLC_ZNUM(d) == NOWHERE) {
   178:     send_to_char(ch, "Sorry, there is no zone for that number!\r\n");
   179: 
   180:     /* Free the descriptor's OLC structure. */
   181:     free(d->olc);
   182:     d->olc = NULL;
   183:     return;
   184:   }
   185: 
   186:   /* Everyone but IMPLs can only edit zones they have been assigned. */
   187:   if (!can_edit_zone(ch, OLC_ZNUM(d))) {
   188:     send_cannot_edit(ch, zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   189:     /* Free the OLC structure. */
   190:     free(d->olc);
   191:     d->olc = NULL;
   192:     return;
   193:   }
   194: 
   195:   /* If we need to save, then save the zone. */
   196:   if (save) {
   197:     send_to_char(ch, "Saving all zone information for zone %d.\r\n",
   198:       zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   199:     mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE,
   200:       "OLC: %s saves zone information for zone %d.", GET_NAME(ch),
   201:       zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number);
   202: 
   203:     /* Save the zone information to the zone file. */
   204:     save_zone(OLC_ZNUM(d));
   205: 
   206:     /* Free the descriptor's OLC structure. */
   207:     free(d->olc);
   208:     d->olc = NULL;
   209:     return;
   210:   }
   211: 
   212:   OLC_NUM(d) = number;
   213: 
   214:   if ((real_num = real_room(number)) == NOWHERE) {
   215:     write_to_output(d, "That room does not exist.\r\n");
   216: 
   217:     /* Free the descriptor's OLC structure. */
   218:     free(d->olc);
   219:     d->olc = NULL;
   220:     return;
   221:   }
   222: 
   223:   zedit_setup(d, real_num);
   224:   STATE(d) = CON_ZEDIT;
   225: 
   226:   act("$n starts using OLC.", TRUE, d->character, 0, 0, TO_ROOM);
   227:   SET_BIT_AR(PLR_FLAGS(ch), PLR_WRITING);
   228: 
   229:   mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_IMMORT, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "OLC: %s starts editing zone %d allowed zone %d",
   230:     GET_NAME(ch), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, GET_OLC_ZONE(ch));
   231: }
   232: 
   233: static void zedit_setup(struct descriptor_data *d, int room_num)
   234: {
   235:   struct zone_data *zone;
   236:   int subcmd = 0, count = 0, cmd_room = NOWHERE, i;
   237: 
   238:   /* Allocate one scratch zone structure. */
   239:   CREATE(zone, struct zone_data, 1);
   240: 
   241:   /* Copy all the zone header information over. */
   242:   zone->name = strdup(zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].name);
   243:   if (zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].builders)
   244:     zone->builders = strdup(zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].builders);
   245:   zone->lifespan = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].lifespan;
   246:   zone->bot = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].bot;
   247:   zone->top = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].top;
   248:   zone->reset_mode = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].reset_mode;
   249:   /* The remaining fields are used as a 'has been modified' flag */
   250:   zone->number = 0;	/* Header information has changed.	*/
   251:   zone->age = 0;	/* The commands have changed.		*/
   252: 
   253:   for (i=0; i<ZN_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   254:     zone->zone_flags[(i)] = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].zone_flags[(i)];
   255: 
   256:   zone->min_level = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].min_level;
   257:   zone->max_level = zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].max_level;
   258: 
   259:   /* Start the reset command list with a terminator. */
   260:   CREATE(zone->cmd, struct reset_com, 1);
   261:   zone->cmd[0].command = 'S';
   262: 
   263:   /* Add all entries in zone_table that relate to this room. */
   264:   while (ZCMD(OLC_ZNUM(d), subcmd).command != 'S') {
   265:     switch (ZCMD(OLC_ZNUM(d), subcmd).command) {
   266:     case 'M':
   267:     case 'O':
   268:     case 'T':
   269:     case 'V':
   270:       cmd_room = ZCMD(OLC_ZNUM(d), subcmd).arg3;
   271:       break;
   272:     case 'D':
   273:     case 'R':
   274:       cmd_room = ZCMD(OLC_ZNUM(d), subcmd).arg1;
   275:       break;
   276:     default:
   277:       break;
   278:     }
   279:     if (cmd_room == room_num) {
   280:       add_cmd_to_list(&(zone->cmd), &ZCMD(OLC_ZNUM(d), subcmd), count);
   281:       count++;
   282:     }
   283:     subcmd++;
   284:   }
   285: 
   286:   OLC_ZONE(d) = zone;
   287:   /*
   288:    * Display main menu.
   289:    */
   290:   zedit_disp_menu(d);
   291: }
   292: 
   293: /* Create a new zone. */
   294: static void zedit_new_zone(struct char_data *ch, zone_vnum vzone_num, room_vnum bottom, room_vnum top)
   295: {
   296:   int result;
   297:   const char *error;
   298:   struct descriptor_data *dsc;
   299: 
   300:   if ((result = create_new_zone(vzone_num, bottom, top, &error)) == NOWHERE) {
   301:     write_to_output(ch->desc, "%s", error);
   302:     return;
   303:   }
   304: 
   305:   for (dsc = descriptor_list; dsc; dsc = dsc->next) {
   306:     switch (STATE(dsc)) {
   307:       case CON_REDIT:
   308:         OLC_ROOM(dsc)->zone += (OLC_ZNUM(dsc) >= result);
   309:         /* Fall through. */
   310:       case CON_ZEDIT:
   311:       case CON_MEDIT:
   312:       case CON_SEDIT:
   313:       case CON_OEDIT:
   314:       case CON_TRIGEDIT:
   315:       case CON_QEDIT:
   316:         OLC_ZNUM(dsc) += (OLC_ZNUM(dsc) >= result);
   317:         break;
   318:       default:
   319:         break;
   320:     }
   321:   }
   322: 
   323:   zedit_save_to_disk(result); /* save to disk .. */
   324: 
   325:   mudlog(BRF, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(ch)), TRUE, "OLC: %s creates new zone #%d", GET_NAME(ch), vzone_num);
   326:   write_to_output(ch->desc, "Zone created successfully.\r\n");
   327: }
   328: 
   329: /* Save all the information in the player's temporary buffer back into
   330:  * the current zone table. */
   331: static void zedit_save_internally(struct descriptor_data *d)
   332: {
   333:   int	mobloaded = FALSE,
   334: 	objloaded = FALSE,
   335: 	subcmd, i;
   336:   room_rnum room_num = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
   337: 
   338:   builder_refs_invalidate();
   339: 
   340:   if (room_num == NOWHERE) {
   341:     log("SYSERR: zedit_save_internally: OLC_NUM(d) room %d not found.", OLC_NUM(d));
   342:     return;
   343:   }
   344: 
   345:   remove_room_zone_commands(OLC_ZNUM(d), room_num);
   346: 
   347:   /* Now add all the entries in the players descriptor list */
   348:   for (subcmd = 0; MYCMD.command != 'S'; subcmd++) {
   349:     /* Since Circle does not keep track of what rooms the 'G', 'E', and
   350:      * 'P' commands are exitted in, but OasisOLC groups zone commands
   351:      * by rooms, this creates interesting problems when builders use these
   352:      * commands without loading a mob or object first.  This fix prevents such
   353:      * commands from being saved and 'wandering' through the zone command
   354:      * list looking for mobs/objects to latch onto.
   355:      * C.Raehl 4/27/99 */
   356:     switch (MYCMD.command) {
   357:       /* Possible fail cases. */
   358:       case 'G':
   359:       case 'E':
   360:         if (mobloaded)
   361:           break;
   362:         write_to_output(d, "Equip/Give command not saved since no mob was loaded first.\r\n");
   363:         continue;
   364:       case 'P':
   365:         if (objloaded)
   366:           break;
   367:         write_to_output(d, "Put command not saved since another object was not loaded first.\r\n");
   368:         continue;
   369:       /* Pass cases. */
   370:       case 'M':
   371:         mobloaded = TRUE;
   372:         break;
   373:       case 'O':
   374:         objloaded = TRUE;
   375:         break;
   376:       default:
   377:         mobloaded = objloaded = FALSE;
   378:         break;
   379:     }
   380:     add_cmd_to_list(&(zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].cmd), &MYCMD, subcmd);
   381:   }
   382: 
   383:   /* Finally, if zone headers have been changed, copy over */
   384:   if (OLC_ZONE(d)->number) {
   385:     free(zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].name);
   386:     free(zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].builders);
   387: 
   388:     zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].name = strdup(OLC_ZONE(d)->name);
   389:     zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].builders = strdup(OLC_ZONE(d)->builders);
   390:     zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].bot = OLC_ZONE(d)->bot;
   391:     zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].top = OLC_ZONE(d)->top;
   392:     zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].reset_mode = OLC_ZONE(d)->reset_mode;
   393:     zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].lifespan = OLC_ZONE(d)->lifespan;
   394:     zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].min_level = OLC_ZONE(d)->min_level;
   395:     zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].max_level = OLC_ZONE(d)->max_level;
   396:     for (i=0; i<ZN_ARRAY_MAX; i++)
   397:       zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].zone_flags[(i)] = OLC_ZONE(d)->zone_flags[(i)];
   398:   }
   399:   add_to_save_list(zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, SL_ZON);
   400: }
   401: 
   402: static void zedit_save_to_disk(int zone)
   403: {
   404:   save_zone(zone);
   405: }
   406: 
   407: /* Error check user input and then setup change */
   408: static int start_change_command(struct descriptor_data *d, int pos)
   409: {
   410:   if (pos < 0 || pos >= count_commands(OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd))
   411:     return 0;
   412: 
   413:   /* Ok, let's get editing. */
   414:   OLC_VAL(d) = pos;
   415:   return 1;
   416: }

   418: /*------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   419: static void zedit_disp_flag_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   420: {
   421:   char bits[MAX_STRING_LENGTH];
   422: 
   423:   clear_screen(d);
   424:   column_list(d->character, 0, zone_bits, NUM_ZONE_FLAGS, TRUE);
   425: 
   426:   sprintbitarray(OLC_ZONE(d)->zone_flags, zone_bits, ZN_ARRAY_MAX, bits);
   427:   write_to_output(d, "\r\nZone flags: \tc%s\tn\r\n"
   428:          "Enter Zone flags, 0 to quit : ", bits);
   429:   OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ZONE_FLAGS;
   430: }

   432: /*------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   433: static bool zedit_get_levels(struct descriptor_data *d, char *buf)
   434: {
   435:   /* Create a string for the recommended levels for this zone. */
   436:   if ((OLC_ZONE(d)->min_level == -1) && (OLC_ZONE(d)->max_level == -1)) {
   437:     sprintf(buf, "<Not Set!>");
   438:     return FALSE;
   439:   }
   440: 
   441:   if (OLC_ZONE(d)->min_level == -1) {
   442:     sprintf(buf, "Up to level %d", OLC_ZONE(d)->max_level);
   443:     return TRUE;
   444:   }
   445: 
   446:   if (OLC_ZONE(d)->max_level == -1) {
   447:     sprintf(buf, "Above level %d", OLC_ZONE(d)->min_level);
   448:     return TRUE;
   449:   }
   450: 
   451:   sprintf(buf, "Levels %d to %d", OLC_ZONE(d)->min_level, OLC_ZONE(d)->max_level);
   452:   return TRUE;
   453: }

   455: /*------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   456: /* Menu functions */
   457: /* the main menu */
   458: static void zedit_disp_menu(struct descriptor_data *d)
   459: {
   460:   int subcmd = 0, counter = 0;
   461:   char buf1[MAX_STRING_LENGTH], lev_string[50];
   462:   bool levels_set = FALSE;
   463: 
   464:   get_char_colors(d->character);
   465:   clear_screen(d);
   466: 
   467:   sprintbitarray(OLC_ZONE(d)->zone_flags, zone_bits, ZN_ARRAY_MAX, buf1);
   468:   levels_set = zedit_get_levels(d, lev_string);
   469: 
   470:   /* Menu header */
   471:   send_to_char(d->character,
   472: 	  "Room number: %s%d%s Room zone: %s%d\r\n"
   473: 	  "%s1%s) Builders       : %s%s\r\n"
   474: 	  "%sZ%s) Zone name      : %s%s\r\n"
   475: 	  "%sL%s) Lifespan       : %s%d minutes\r\n"
   476: 	  "%sB%s) Bottom of zone : %s%d\r\n"
   477: 	  "%sT%s) Top of zone    : %s%d\r\n"
   478: 	  "%sR%s) Reset Mode     : %s%s\r\n"
   479: 	  "%sF%s) Zone Flags     : %s%s\r\n"
   480: 	  "%sM%s) Level Range    : %s%s%s\r\n"
   481: 	  "[Command list]\r\n",
   482: 
   483: 	  cyn, OLC_NUM(d), nrm,
   484: 	  cyn, zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number,
   485: 	  grn, nrm, yel, OLC_ZONE(d)->builders ? OLC_ZONE(d)->builders : "None.",
   486: 	  grn, nrm, yel, OLC_ZONE(d)->name ? OLC_ZONE(d)->name : "<NONE!>",
   487: 	  grn, nrm, yel, OLC_ZONE(d)->lifespan,
   488: 	  grn, nrm, yel, OLC_ZONE(d)->bot,
   489: 	  grn, nrm, yel, OLC_ZONE(d)->top,
   490: 	  grn, nrm, yel,
   491: 	  OLC_ZONE(d)->reset_mode ? ((OLC_ZONE(d)->reset_mode == 1) ? "Reset when no players are in zone." : "Normal reset.") : "Never reset",
   492: 	  grn, nrm, cyn, buf1,
   493: 	  grn, nrm, levels_set ? cyn : yel, lev_string,
   494: 	  nrm
   495: 	  );
   496: 
   497:   /* Print the commands for this room into display buffer. */
   498:   while (MYCMD.command != 'S') {
   499:     /* Translate what the command means. */
   500:     write_to_output(d, "%s%d - %s", nrm, counter++, yel);
   501:     switch (MYCMD.command) {
   502:     case 'M':
   503:       write_to_output(d, "%sLoad %s [%s%d%s], Max : %d",
   504:               MYCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   505:               mob_proto[MYCMD.arg1].player.short_descr, cyn,
   506:               mob_index[MYCMD.arg1].vnum, yel, MYCMD.arg2
   507:               );
   508:       break;
   509:     case 'G':
   510:       write_to_output(d, "%sGive it %s [%s%d%s], Max : %d",
   511: 	      MYCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   512: 	      obj_proto[MYCMD.arg1].short_description,
   513: 	      cyn, obj_index[MYCMD.arg1].vnum, yel,
   514: 	      MYCMD.arg2
   515: 	      );
   516:       break;
   517:     case 'O':
   518:       write_to_output(d, "%sLoad %s [%s%d%s], Max : %d",
   519: 	      MYCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   520: 	      obj_proto[MYCMD.arg1].short_description,
   521: 	      cyn, obj_index[MYCMD.arg1].vnum, yel,
   522: 	      MYCMD.arg2
   523: 	      );
   524:       break;
   525:     case 'E':
   526:       write_to_output(d, "%sEquip with %s [%s%d%s], %s, Max : %d",
   527: 	      MYCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   528: 	      obj_proto[MYCMD.arg1].short_description,
   529: 	      cyn, obj_index[MYCMD.arg1].vnum, yel,
   530: 	      equipment_types[MYCMD.arg3],
   531: 	      MYCMD.arg2
   532: 	      );
   533:       break;
   534:     case 'P':
   535:       write_to_output(d, "%sPut %s [%s%d%s] in %s [%s%d%s], Max : %d",
   536: 	      MYCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   537: 	      obj_proto[MYCMD.arg1].short_description,
   538: 	      cyn, obj_index[MYCMD.arg1].vnum, yel,
   539: 	      obj_proto[MYCMD.arg3].short_description,
   540: 	      cyn, obj_index[MYCMD.arg3].vnum, yel,
   541: 	      MYCMD.arg2
   542: 	      );
   543:       break;
   544:     case 'R':
   545:       write_to_output(d, "%sRemove %s [%s%d%s] from room.",
   546: 	      MYCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   547: 	      obj_proto[MYCMD.arg2].short_description,
   548: 	      cyn, obj_index[MYCMD.arg2].vnum, yel
   549: 	      );
   550:       break;
   551:     case 'D':
   552:       write_to_output(d, "%sSet door %s as %s.",
   553: 	      MYCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   554: 	      dirs[MYCMD.arg2],
   555: 	      MYCMD.arg3 ? ((MYCMD.arg3 == 1) ? "closed" : "locked") : "open"
   556: 	      );
   557:       break;
   558:     case 'T':
   559:       write_to_output(d, "%sAttach trigger %s%s%s [%s%d%s] to %s",
   560:         MYCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   561:         cyn, trig_index[MYCMD.arg2]->proto->name, yel,
   562:         cyn, trig_index[MYCMD.arg2]->vnum, yel,
   563:         ((MYCMD.arg1 == MOB_TRIGGER) ? "mobile" :
   564:           ((MYCMD.arg1 == OBJ_TRIGGER) ? "object" :
   565:             ((MYCMD.arg1 == WLD_TRIGGER)? "room" : "????"))));
   566:       break;
   567:     case 'V':
   568:       write_to_output(d, "%sAssign global %s:%d to %s = %s",
   569:         MYCMD.if_flag ? " then " : "",
   570:         MYCMD.sarg1, MYCMD.arg2,
   571:         ((MYCMD.arg1 == MOB_TRIGGER) ? "mobile" :
   572:           ((MYCMD.arg1 == OBJ_TRIGGER) ? "object" :
   573:             ((MYCMD.arg1 == WLD_TRIGGER)? "room" : "????"))),
   574:         MYCMD.sarg2);
   575:       break;
   576:     default:
   577:       write_to_output(d, "<Unknown Command>");
   578:       break;
   579:     }
   580:     write_to_output(d, "\r\n");
   581:     subcmd++;
   582:   }
   583:   /* Finish off menu */
   584:    write_to_output(d,
   585: 	  "%s%d - <END OF LIST>\r\n"
   586: 	  "%sN%s) Insert new command.\r\n"
   587: 	  "%sE%s) Edit a command.\r\n"
   588: 	  "%sD%s) Delete a command.\r\n"
   589: 	  "%sY%s) References (read-only)\r\n"
   590: 	  "%sQ%s) Quit\r\nEnter your choice : ",
   591: 	  nrm, counter, grn, nrm, grn, nrm, grn, nrm, grn, nrm, grn, nrm
   592: 	  );
   593: 
   594:   OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_MAIN_MENU;
   595: }

   615: }

   617: /* Print the appropriate message for the command type for arg1 and set
   618:    up the input catch clause */
   619: static void zedit_disp_arg1(struct descriptor_data *d)
   620: {
   621:   write_to_output(d, "\r\n");
   622: 
   623:   switch (OLC_CMD(d).command) {
   624:   case 'M':
   625:     write_to_output(d, "Input mob's vnum : ");
   626:     OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ARG1;
   627:     break;
   628:   case 'O':
   629:   case 'E':
   630:   case 'P':
   631:   case 'G':
   632:     write_to_output(d, "Input object vnum : ");
   633:     OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ARG1;
   634:     break;
   635:   case 'D':
   636:   case 'R':
   637:     /* Arg1 for these is the room number, skip to arg2 */
   638:     OLC_CMD(d).arg1 = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
   639:     zedit_disp_arg2(d);
   640:     break;
   641:   case 'T':
   642:   case 'V':
   643:     write_to_output(d, "Input trigger type (0:mob, 1:obj, 2:room) :");
   644:     OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ARG1;
   645:     break;
   646:   default:
   647:     /* We should never get here. */
   648:     cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   649:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: zedit_disp_arg1(): Help!");
   650:     write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
   651:     return;
   652:   }
   653: }

   655: /* Print the appropriate message for the command type for arg2 and set
   656:    up the input catch clause. */

   682:     break;
   683:   case 'V':
   684:     write_to_output(d, "Global's context (0 for none) : ");

   686:   default:
   687:     /* We should never get here, but just in case.  */
   688:     cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   689:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: zedit_disp_arg2(): Help!");
   690:     write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
   691:     return;
   692:   }
   693:   OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ARG2;
   694: }

   734: /*
   735:  * Print the recommended levels menu and setup response catch.
   736:  */
   737: static void zedit_disp_levels(struct descriptor_data *d)
   738: {
   739:   char lev_string[50];
   740:   bool levels_set = FALSE;
   741: 
   742:   levels_set = zedit_get_levels(d, lev_string);
   743: 
   744:   clear_screen(d);

   746: 	"\r\n"

   749: 	"\ty3\tn) Clear level recommendations\r\n\r\n"
   750: 	"\ty0\tn) Quit to main menu\r\n"
   751:         "\tgCurrent Setting: %s%s%s\r\n"
   752: 	"\r\n"
   753: 	"Enter choice (0 to quit): ", levels_set ? "\tc" : "\ty", lev_string, "\tn"
   754: 	);
   755:   OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_LEVELS;
   756: }
   757: 
   758: /* The event handler */
   759: void zedit_parse(struct descriptor_data *d, char *arg)
   760: {
   761:   int pos, number;
   762: 
   763:   switch (OLC_MODE(d)) {
   764:   case ZEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING:
   765:     switch (*arg) {
   766:     case 'y':
   767:     case 'Y':
   768:       /* Save the zone in memory, hiding invisible people. */
   769:       zedit_save_internally(d);
   770:       if (CONFIG_OLC_SAVE) {
   771:         write_to_output(d, "Saving zone info to disk.\r\n");
   772:         zedit_save_to_disk(OLC_ZNUM(d));
   773:       } else
   774:         write_to_output(d, "Saving zone info in memory.\r\n");
   775: 
   776:       mudlog(CMP, MAX(LVL_BUILDER, GET_INVIS_LEV(d->character)), TRUE, "OLC: %s edits zone info for room %d.", GET_NAME(d->character), OLC_NUM(d));
   777:       /* FALL THROUGH */
   778:     case 'n':
   779:     case 'N':
   780:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   781:       break;
   782:     default:
   783:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
   784:       write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   785:       break;
   786:     }
   787:     break;
   788:    /* End of ZEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING */
   789: 
   790:   case ZEDIT_MAIN_MENU:
   791:     switch (*arg) {
   792:     case 'q':
   793:     case 'Q':
   794:       if (OLC_ZONE(d)->age || OLC_ZONE(d)->number) {
   795: 	write_to_output(d, "Do you wish to save your changes? : ");
   796: 	OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_CONFIRM_SAVESTRING;
   797:       } else {
   798: 	write_to_output(d, "No changes made.\r\n");
   799: 	cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
   800:       }
   801:       break;
   802:     case 'n':
   803:     case 'N':
   804:       /* New entry. */
   805:       if (OLC_ZONE(d)->cmd[0].command == 'S') {
   806:         /* first command */
   807:         if (new_command(OLC_ZONE(d), 0) && start_change_command(d, 0)) {
   808: 	  zedit_disp_comtype(d);
   809: 	  OLC_ZONE(d)->age = 1;
   810:           break;
   811: 	}
   812:       }
   813:       write_to_output(d, "What number in the list should the new command be? : ");
   814:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_NEW_ENTRY;
   815:       break;
   816:     case 'y':
   817:     case 'Y':
   818:       builder_refs_display(d, BREF_ZONE, zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d)].number, "Zone");
   819:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_REFERENCES;
   820:       break;
   821:     case 'e':
   822:     case 'E':
   823:       /* Change an entry. */
   824:       write_to_output(d, "Which command do you wish to change? : ");
   825:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_CHANGE_ENTRY;
   826:       break;
   827:     case 'd':
   828:     case 'D':
   829:       /* Delete an entry. */
   830:       write_to_output(d, "Which command do you wish to delete? : ");
   831:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_DELETE_ENTRY;
   832:       break;
   833:     case 'z':
   834:     case 'Z':
   835:       /* Edit zone name. */
   836:       write_to_output(d, "Enter new zone name : ");
   837:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ZONE_NAME;
   838:       break;
   839:     case '1':
   840:       /* Edit zone builders. */
   841:       write_to_output(d, "Enter new builders list : ");
   842:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ZONE_BUILDERS;
   843:       break;
   844:     case 'b':
   845:     case 'B':
   846:       /* Edit bottom of zone. */
   847:       if (GET_LEVEL(d->character) < LVL_IMPL)
   848: 	zedit_disp_menu(d);
   849:       else {
   850: 	write_to_output(d, "Enter new bottom of zone : ");
   851: 	OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ZONE_BOT;
   852:       }
   853:       break;
   854:     case 't':
   855:     case 'T':
   856:       /* Edit top of zone. */
   857:       if (GET_LEVEL(d->character) < LVL_IMPL)
   858: 	zedit_disp_menu(d);
   859:       else {
   860: 	write_to_output(d, "Enter new top of zone : ");
   861: 	OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ZONE_TOP;
   862:       }
   863:       break;
   864:     case 'l':
   865:     case 'L':
   866:       /* Edit zone lifespan. */
   867:       write_to_output(d, "Enter new zone lifespan : ");
   868:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ZONE_LIFE;
   869:       break;
   870:     case 'r':
   871:     case 'R':
   872:       /* Edit zone reset mode. */
   873:       write_to_output(d, "\r\n"
   874: 		"0) Never reset\r\n"
   875: 		"1) Reset only when no players in zone\r\n"
   876: 		"2) Normal reset\r\n"
   877: 		"Enter new zone reset type : ");
   878:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_ZONE_RESET;
   879:       break;
   880:     case 'f':
   881:     case 'F':
   882:       zedit_disp_flag_menu(d);
   883:       break;
   884:     case 'm':
   885:     case 'M':
   886:       /*** Edit zone level restrictions (sub-menu) ***/
   887:       zedit_disp_levels(d);
   888:       break;
   889:     default:
   890:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
   891:       break;
   892:     }
   893:     break;
   894:   case ZEDIT_REFERENCES:
   895:     zedit_disp_menu(d);
   896:     break;
   897:     /* End of ZEDIT_MAIN_MENU */
   898: 
   899: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   900:   case ZEDIT_LEVELS:
   901:     switch (*arg) {
   902:     case '1': write_to_output(d, "Enter the min level for this zone (0-%d, -1 = none): ", (LVL_IMMORT-1));
   903:               OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_LEV_MIN;
   904:               break;
   905: 
   906:     case '2': write_to_output(d, "Enter the max level for this zone (0-%d, -1 = none): ", (LVL_IMMORT-1));
   907:               OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_LEV_MAX;
   908:               break;
   909: 
   910:     case '3': OLC_ZONE(d)->min_level = -1;
   911:               OLC_ZONE(d)->max_level = -1;
   912:               OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
   913:               zedit_disp_menu(d);
   914:               break;
   915: 
   916:     case '0':
   917:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
   918:       break;
   919: 
   920:     default: write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice!\r\n");
   921:              break;
   922:     }
   923:     break;
   924: 
   925: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   926:   case ZEDIT_LEV_MIN:
   927:     pos = atoi(arg);
   928:     OLC_ZONE(d)->min_level = MIN(MAX(pos,-1), 100);
   929:     OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
   930:     zedit_disp_levels(d);
   931:     break;
   932: 
   933: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   934:   case ZEDIT_LEV_MAX:
   935:     pos = atoi(arg);
   936:     OLC_ZONE(d)->max_level = MIN(MAX(pos,-1), 100);
   937:     OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
   938:     zedit_disp_levels(d);
   939:     break;
   940: 
   941: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   942:   case ZEDIT_NEW_ENTRY:
   943:     /* Get the line number and insert the new line. */
   944:     pos = atoi(arg);
   945:     if (isdigit(*arg) && new_command(OLC_ZONE(d), pos)) {
   946:       if (start_change_command(d, pos)) {
   947: 	zedit_disp_comtype(d);
   948: 	OLC_ZONE(d)->age = 1;
   949:       }
   950:     } else
   951:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
   952:     break;
   953: 
   954: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   955:   case ZEDIT_DELETE_ENTRY:
   956:     /* Get the line number and delete the line. */
   957:     pos = atoi(arg);
   958:     if (isdigit(*arg)) {
   959:       delete_zone_command(OLC_ZONE(d), pos);
   960:       OLC_ZONE(d)->age = 1;
   961:     }
   962:     zedit_disp_menu(d);
   963:     break;
   964: 
   965: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   966:   case ZEDIT_CHANGE_ENTRY:
   967:     /* Parse the input for which line to edit, and goto next quiz. Abort edit,
   968:        and return to main menu idea from Mark Garringer zizazat@hotmail.com */
   969:     if (toupper(*arg) == 'A') {
   970:       if (OLC_CMD(d).command == 'N') {
   971:         OLC_CMD(d).command = '*';
   972:       }
   973:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
   974:       break;
   975:     }
   976: 
   977:     pos = atoi(arg);
   978:     if (isdigit(*arg) && start_change_command(d, pos)) {
   979:       zedit_disp_comtype(d);
   980:       OLC_ZONE(d)->age = 1;
   981:     } else
   982:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
   983:     break;
   984: 
   985: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   986:   case ZEDIT_COMMAND_TYPE:
   987:     /* Parse the input for which type of command this is, and goto next quiz. */
   988:     OLC_CMD(d).command = toupper(*arg);
   989:     if (!OLC_CMD(d).command || (strchr("MOPEDGRTV", OLC_CMD(d).command) == NULL)) {
   990:       write_to_output(d, "Invalid choice, try again : ");
   991:     } else {
   992:       if (OLC_VAL(d)) {	/* If there was a previous command. */
   993:         if (OLC_CMD(d).command == 'T' || OLC_CMD(d).command == 'V') {
   994:           OLC_CMD(d).if_flag = 1;
   995:           zedit_disp_arg1(d);
   996:         } else {
   997: 	  write_to_output(d, "Is this command dependent on the success of the previous one? (y/n)\r\n");
   998: 	  OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_IF_FLAG;
   999:         }
  1000:       } else {	/* 'if-flag' not appropriate. */
  1001: 	OLC_CMD(d).if_flag = 0;
  1002: 	zedit_disp_arg1(d);
  1003:       }
  1004:     }
  1005:     break;
  1006: 
  1007: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1008:   case ZEDIT_IF_FLAG:
  1009:     /* Parse the input for the if flag, and goto next quiz. */
  1010:     switch (*arg) {
  1011:     case 'y':
  1012:     case 'Y':
  1013:       OLC_CMD(d).if_flag = 1;
  1014:       break;
  1015:     case 'n':
  1016:     case 'N':
  1017:       OLC_CMD(d).if_flag = 0;
  1018:       break;
  1019:     default:
  1020:       write_to_output(d, "Try again : ");
  1021:       return;
  1022:     }
  1023:     zedit_disp_arg1(d);
  1024:     break;
  1025: 
  1026: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1027:   case ZEDIT_ARG1:
  1028:     /* Parse the input for arg1, and goto next quiz. */
  1029:     if (!isdigit(*arg)) {
  1030:       write_to_output(d, "Must be a numeric value, try again : ");
  1031:       return;
  1032:     }
  1033:     switch (OLC_CMD(d).command) {
  1034:     case 'M':
  1035:       if ((pos = real_mobile(atoi(arg))) != NOBODY) {
  1036: 	OLC_CMD(d).arg1 = pos;
  1037: 	zedit_disp_arg2(d);
  1038:       } else
  1039: 	write_to_output(d, "That mobile does not exist, try again : ");
  1040:       break;
  1041:     case 'O':
  1042:     case 'P':
  1043:     case 'E':
  1044:     case 'G':
  1045:       if ((pos = real_object(atoi(arg))) != NOTHING) {
  1046: 	OLC_CMD(d).arg1 = pos;
  1047: 	zedit_disp_arg2(d);
  1048:       } else
  1049: 	write_to_output(d, "That object does not exist, try again : ");
  1050:       break;
  1051:     case 'T':
  1052:     case 'V':
  1053:       if (atoi(arg)<MOB_TRIGGER || atoi(arg)>WLD_TRIGGER)
  1054:         write_to_output(d, "Invalid input.");
  1055:       else {
  1056:        OLC_CMD(d).arg1 = atoi(arg);
  1057:         zedit_disp_arg2(d);
  1058:       }
  1059:       break;
  1060:     case 'D':
  1061:     case 'R':
  1062:     default:
  1063:       /* We should never get here. */
  1064:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1065:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: zedit_parse(): case ARG1: Ack!");
  1066:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1067:       break;
  1068:     }
  1069:     break;
  1070: 
  1071: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1072:   case ZEDIT_ARG2:
  1073:     /* Parse the input for arg2, and goto next quiz. */
  1074:     if (!isdigit(*arg)) {
  1075:       write_to_output(d, "Must be a numeric value, try again : ");
  1076:       return;
  1077:     }
  1078:     switch (OLC_CMD(d).command) {
  1079:     case 'M':
  1080:     case 'O':
  1081:       OLC_CMD(d).arg2 = MIN(MAX_DUPLICATES, atoi(arg));
  1082:       OLC_CMD(d).arg3 = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
  1083:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1084:       break;
  1085:     case 'G':
  1086:       OLC_CMD(d).arg2 = MIN(MAX_DUPLICATES, atoi(arg));
  1087:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1088:       break;
  1089:     case 'P':
  1090:     case 'E':
  1091:       OLC_CMD(d).arg2 = MIN(MAX_DUPLICATES, atoi(arg));
  1092:       zedit_disp_arg3(d);
  1093:       break;
  1094:     case 'V':
  1095:       OLC_CMD(d).arg2 = atoi(arg); /* context */
  1096:       OLC_CMD(d).arg3 = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
  1097:       write_to_output(d, "Enter the global name : ");
  1098:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_SARG1;
  1099:       break;
  1100:     case 'T':
  1101:       if (real_trigger(atoi(arg)) != NOTHING) {
  1102:         OLC_CMD(d).arg2 = real_trigger(atoi(arg)); /* trigger */
  1103:         OLC_CMD(d).arg3 = real_room(OLC_NUM(d));
  1104:         zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1105:       } else
  1106:         write_to_output(d, "That trigger does not exist, try again : ");
  1107:       break;
  1108:     case 'D':
  1109:       pos = atoi(arg);
  1110:       /* Count directions. */
  1111:       if (pos < 0 || pos > DIR_COUNT)
  1112: 	write_to_output(d, "Try again : ");
  1113:       else {
  1114: 	OLC_CMD(d).arg2 = pos;
  1115: 	zedit_disp_arg3(d);
  1116:       }
  1117:       break;
  1118:     case 'R':
  1119:       if ((pos = real_object(atoi(arg))) != NOTHING) {
  1120: 	OLC_CMD(d).arg2 = pos;
  1121: 	zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1122:       } else
  1123: 	write_to_output(d, "That object does not exist, try again : ");
  1124:       break;
  1125:     default:
  1126:       /* We should never get here, but just in case. */
  1127:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1128:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: zedit_parse(): case ARG2: Ack!");
  1129:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1130:       break;
  1131:     }
  1132:     break;
  1133: 
  1134: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1135:   case ZEDIT_ARG3:
  1136:     /* Parse the input for arg3, and go back to main menu. */
  1137:     if (!isdigit(*arg)) {
  1138:       write_to_output(d, "Must be a numeric value, try again : ");
  1139:       return;
  1140:     }
  1141:     switch (OLC_CMD(d).command) {
  1142:     case 'E':
  1143:       pos = atoi(arg) - 1;
  1144:       /* Count number of wear positions. */
  1145:       if (pos < 0 || pos >= NUM_WEARS)
  1146: 	write_to_output(d, "Try again : ");
  1147:       else {
  1148: 	OLC_CMD(d).arg3 = pos;
  1149: 	zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1150:       }
  1151:       break;
  1152:     case 'P':
  1153:       if ((pos = real_object(atoi(arg))) != NOTHING) {
  1154: 	OLC_CMD(d).arg3 = pos;
  1155: 	zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1156:       } else
  1157: 	write_to_output(d, "That object does not exist, try again : ");
  1158:       break;
  1159:     case 'D':
  1160:       pos = atoi(arg);
  1161:       if (pos < 0 || pos > 2)
  1162: 	write_to_output(d, "Try again : ");
  1163:       else {
  1164: 	OLC_CMD(d).arg3 = pos;
  1165: 	zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1166:       }
  1167:       break;
  1168:     case 'M':
  1169:     case 'O':
  1170:     case 'G':
  1171:     case 'R':
  1172:     case 'T':
  1173:     case 'V':
  1174:     default:
  1175:       /* We should never get here, but just in case. */
  1176:       cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1177:       mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: zedit_parse(): case ARG3: Ack!");
  1178:       write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1179:       break;
  1180:     }
  1181:     break;
  1182: 
  1183: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1184:   case ZEDIT_SARG1:
  1185:     if (strlen(arg)) {
  1186:       OLC_CMD(d).sarg1 = strdup(arg);
  1187:       OLC_MODE(d) = ZEDIT_SARG2;
  1188:       write_to_output(d, "Enter the global value : ");
  1189:     } else
  1190:       write_to_output(d, "Must have some name to assign : ");
  1191:     break;
  1192: 
  1193: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1194:   case ZEDIT_SARG2:
  1195:     if (strlen(arg)) {
  1196:       OLC_CMD(d).sarg2 = strdup(arg);
  1197:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1198:     } else
  1199:       write_to_output(d, "Must have some value to set it to :");
  1200:     break;
  1201: 
  1202: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1203:   case ZEDIT_ZONE_NAME:
  1204:     /* Add new name and return to main menu. */
  1205:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg)) {
  1206:       if (OLC_ZONE(d)->name)
  1207:         free(OLC_ZONE(d)->name);
  1208:       else
  1209:         log("SYSERR: OLC: ZEDIT_ZONE_NAME: no name to free!");
  1210:       OLC_ZONE(d)->name = strdup(arg);
  1211:       OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
  1212:     }
  1213:     zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1214:     break;
  1215: 
  1216: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1217:   case ZEDIT_ZONE_BUILDERS:
  1218:     /* Add new builders list and return to main menu. */
  1219:     if (genolc_checkstring(d, arg)) {
  1220:       if (OLC_ZONE(d)->builders)
  1221:         free(OLC_ZONE(d)->builders);
  1222:       else
  1223:         log("SYSERR: OLC: ZEDIT_ZONE_BUILDERS: no builders list to free!");
  1224:       OLC_ZONE(d)->builders = strdup(arg);
  1225:       OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
  1226:     }
  1227:     zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1228:     break;
  1229: 
  1230: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1231:   case ZEDIT_ZONE_RESET:
  1232:     /* Parse and add new reset_mode and return to main menu. */
  1233:     pos = atoi(arg);
  1234:     if (!isdigit(*arg) || pos < 0 || pos > 2)
  1235:       write_to_output(d, "Try again (0-2) : ");
  1236:     else {
  1237:       OLC_ZONE(d)->reset_mode = pos;
  1238:       OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
  1239:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1240:     }
  1241:     break;
  1242: 
  1243: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1244:   case ZEDIT_ZONE_LIFE:
  1245:     /* Parse and add new lifespan and return to main menu. */
  1246:     pos = atoi(arg);
  1247:     if (!isdigit(*arg) || pos < 0 || pos > 240)
  1248:       write_to_output(d, "Try again (0-240) : ");
  1249:     else {
  1250:       OLC_ZONE(d)->lifespan = pos;
  1251:       OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
  1252:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1253:     }
  1254:     break;
  1255: 
  1256: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1257:   case ZEDIT_ZONE_FLAGS:
  1258:     number = atoi(arg);
  1259:     if (number < 0 || number > NUM_ZONE_FLAGS) {
  1260:       write_to_output(d, "That is not a valid choice!\r\n");
  1261:       zedit_disp_flag_menu(d);
  1262:     } else if (number == 0) {
  1263:       zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1264:       break;
  1265:       }
  1266:     else {
  1267:       if ((number - 1) == ZONE_QUEST &&
  1268:           !IS_SET_AR(OLC_ZONE(d)->zone_flags, ZONE_QUEST)) {
  1269:         write_to_output(d, "ZONE_QUEST is deprecated and has no gameplay effect; it cannot be newly enabled.\r\n");
  1270:         zedit_disp_flag_menu(d);
  1271:         break;
  1272:       }
  1273:       /*
  1274:        * Toggle the bit.
  1275:        */
  1276:       TOGGLE_BIT_AR(OLC_ZONE(d)->zone_flags, number - 1);
  1277:       OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
  1278:       zedit_disp_flag_menu(d);
  1279:     }
  1280:     return;
  1281: 
  1282: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1283:   case ZEDIT_ZONE_BOT:
  1284:     /* Parse and add new bottom room in zone and return to main menu. */
  1285:     if (OLC_ZNUM(d) == 0)
  1286:       OLC_ZONE(d)->bot = LIMIT(atoi(arg), 0, OLC_ZONE(d)->top);
  1287:     else
  1288:       OLC_ZONE(d)->bot = LIMIT(atoi(arg), zone_table[OLC_ZNUM(d) - 1].top + 1, OLC_ZONE(d)->top);
  1289:     OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
  1290:     zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1291:     break;
  1292: 
  1293: /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  1294:   case ZEDIT_ZONE_TOP:
  1295:     /* Parse and add new top room in zone and return to main menu. */
  1296:     if (OLC_ZNUM(d) == top_of_zone_table)
  1297:       OLC_ZONE(d)->top = LIMIT(atoi(arg), genolc_zonep_bottom(OLC_ZONE(d)), 32000);
  1298:     else
  1299:       OLC_ZONE(d)->top = LIMIT(atoi(arg), genolc_zonep_bottom(OLC_ZONE(d)), genolc_zone_bottom(OLC_ZNUM(d) + 1) - 1);
  1300:     OLC_ZONE(d)->number = 1;
  1301:     zedit_disp_menu(d);
  1302:     break;
  1303: 
  1304:   default:
  1305:     /* We should never get here, but just in case... */
  1306:     cleanup_olc(d, CLEANUP_ALL);
  1307:     mudlog(BRF, LVL_BUILDER, TRUE, "SYSERR: OLC: zedit_parse(): Reached default case!");
  1308:     write_to_output(d, "Oops...\r\n");
  1309:     break;
  1310:   }
  1311: }
